text: I'm not a religious woman but I do think this is what Heaven should be, if it's not already. My god where do I start?? RIght from the get-to this place has you mesmerized. The interior/decor is stunning, with gorgeous wallpaper behind the bar and cheeky black-and-white stripes on the ceiling. The wine list is decently sized, and organized so well. Try the orange wine! Then the food, oh my! We shared the cheese plate, Caesar salad, and the Valentino pizza. Hands down the best pizza I've ever eaten. But the best part, all the pizzas come with 3 dipping sauces. No more wasting those pizza butts!! I cannot wait to visit SB again and eat more of that insanely delicious pizza. Also, shout out to Jamie, our waitress (at least I think that was her name, sorry if I got that wrong). She was an absolute sweetheart and made our night even better!
Miguel was a fabulous bartender!!!  Super nice and easy going.  The Mac and cheese was amazing!!  Thanks again for the great service.
I had the chicken mole.   It was excellent.    Service is a little slow but the food was worth it

Waited next door at the Maple Leaf for a table, took a little over an hour on a weekend night.

I had the blackened red snapper. It was very good. My wife's green salad came with a (gratuitous) fried oyster on top.

A little too busy for me to thoroughly enjoy it. Our table was in a high traffic area -- watch your elbows. Worth a visit? Sure. Would I wait for more than an hour again to eat here? I don't think so. Food was very good but the opportunity cost of waiting in line in New Orleans is so, so high -- plenty of other great places to eat.

In short, my recommendation would be to absolutely visit this place on a weeknight. On a weekend I'd think twice.

Given the space and limited number of small tables, and the popularity of the lunch buffet, I was very skeptical about our lunch reservation for 18 people.  Not only did the owners personally look after our accommodations, but they even thoughtfully hung decorations around our table to honor the graduation party.  This review is based on the all you can eat lunch buffet for $8.95.

The Nepalese-Korean-Indian concept was intriguing.  In actuality, it was DELICIOUS!  If you're looking for hardcore tumultuously spicy Indian food, this is not it.  Instead, the food is well-rounded, healthful, and even the spicy dishes leave your gut intact.  The fried options such as the samosas were not as greasy as the typical Indian samosa.  The milder curry dishes demanded a 2nd full heaping on a fresh plate. The few Korean dishes represent the influence of the wife owner. Given my very sensitive digestive system, I was a little wary of the spices and potential grease factor, but there was no need to fear - my colon appreciated the wholesome food.

There was also a generous array of vegetarian options, just about one for every meat option.  I also appreciated the overall philosophy of the restaurant to offer fresh food to promote a healthy lifestyle.  The chef and husband owner has a string of degrees indicating his background in social work and public health.  He even offers free public health screenings every weekend!

SmashBurger makes some good burgers.  Different burgers on the menu have different buns and the buns are pretty boss.  The smash fries are essentially french fries with oil and spices on them, and they're pretty great too.  

I'll have to agree that it is a bit pricey but with that being said, I've never been less than entirely satisfied with a burger from SmashBurger.

And yes of course it's not the same as Five Guys or Bobby's BP but SmashBurger is definitely a "better than fastfood" burger chain contender.

Killer burgers and sandwiches made with meat mostly sourced from local butchers. Serious care put into everything from the fries to the sauces. Cooks take pride in what they concoct and, if you're on the fence about what to order, will gladly share their passionate two (or more) cents. Even the cheese steak--an eyebrow raising menu item west of Pennsylvania--exceeds expectations. 

And finally, the BEER. The owner Roy is at least as much of a connoisseur of fine ales as he is of straight up awesome "burger joint" cuisine. While the thought of only two taps may not tantalize the average brew-seeker, but rest assured that whatever he has flowing through either of them is worth twenty taps at your favorite restaurant. Imperial stouts, triple IPAs, Belgian-style strong ales, and often kegs that are hard--if not impossible--to find not just in Reno but anywhere. 

If you've never been to Reno and you need to go have an Awful-Awful, that's understandable; but you do it properly and wait till 2am to soak up your night. If you want to treat yourself to a truly superior burger (or sandwich, etc.) and a spectacular beer, come to Beefy's any time.

A good place to have a beer and above average BBQ while listening to almost famous musicians. Try the ribs; great flavor. Both upstairs and down has a light open concept. The staff is typical bar waitresses.

Very yummy chicken. Crunchy on the outside, juicy on the inside. The hot chicken was HOT but not so hot that it ruins your day hot. The mac n cheese was tasty. The potato salad was the perfect compliment to cool your mouth. The banana pudding was very very rich and sweet. The coleslaw was standard. The fries were standard. 

Pros: super delicious chicken, portions were perfect size 
Upbeat atmosphere. They leave water and cups out for people waiting in line

Con. Waiting in line, only like 2 fans outside when they should have like fans above the door and fans around the entire patio like a few feet apart and place the water jug where people at the end of the line can see it too.
This is my favorite place for authentic tacos! They have a good selection of meats and their drinks are good. I love the atmosphere..and the staff is great!

My boyfriend and I have been to the new crush cakes 4 times since it opened. and I have to say I am sooo excited for this gem to be in Isla Vista. Each time I went I got the breakfast skillet, it was just too good to get anything different. My boyfriend got the lox bagel and also a breakfast sandwich which he was impressed with. I don't really care for much of the iv food places but obviously we like it if we have been back 4 times now. 

   The service is great here as well. the owner is super nice and for our first visit she gave us a free cup cake. My boyfriend came in another time and got a coffee and since they were out of whipped cream (btw the whipped cream is home made and delicious) he got another free cupcake. 

Great food, great service and I definitely happy crush cakes has come to iv!

Hands down the best pizza I have ever eaten!! It was fresh. The crust  is really light. The toppings were really good.  If u don't eat pork,, no worries bc they Turkey based products.. omg delicious.  The staff is really friendly

The Philly cheesesteak here was so good! Friendly and welcoming! The waitress who served us was very nice and always on top of our drink refills. Had a great food experience here when we visited Philly.

Love. Many delicious and unique options for great pizza. Salads are the best. Portion sizes are huge. A little bit pricier, but worth it for the food and portions. Kid friendly. Energetic and well trained staff. Always on top of their game. Roasted Veg Salad, Pear Gorgonzola pizza and anything with 'BBQ Chicken' in its name are highly recommended. Hate the takeout though. Wish they offered curbside. Having to walk inside and hang out in that 'closet' with full view to the service kitchen does not help to build up an appetite. Otherwise, dining in and on their patio is well enjoyed. We are a frequent visitor and will be back again soon!
This establishment has closed as of two weeks ago from January 28th, 2k18.  I spoke with someone inside the bar area that was doing inventory, who told me the news.  It was an alright place to visit.

This place is awesome! The guy at the counter was super nice. I got the gyro combo with cheese fries and my friend got the donut burger (with one patty) with cheese and bacon and cheese fries and it was so good! The donuts and pastries are awesome as well! We will definitely be back very soon!

Been here twice and both times the drive thru person is super loud and obnoxious and not friendly. Also the slowest drive thru I have ever been to. Only three cars ahead of me and it still took over 20 minutes.

A group of nine friends travelled from all corners of the country to celebrate a friend's bachelor party weekend.  The groom is one of my best, and in fact, my oldest friend.  We wanted a special Saturday night dinner to be the centerpiece of the weekend.  The election settled upon MiLa...and they delivered magnificently.

I'm going to rate this a 4.5 because the service (seemingly not fully engaged and sporadically absent) and setting (placed awkwardly in the front near the bar) were a notch below ideal, and because my cocktail (Louisiana 75) was pedestrian.  But the food was across-the-board phenomenal.  Absolutely outstanding.  Between the delectable dishes and the fantastic company, it was a wonderfully memorable evening.

A pleasant amuse bouche of crab salad on a cucumber slice.

An exquisite parsnip-puree soup with copious crab meat and a drizzle of lemon oil.  

Earthy scallion cornbread with sea-salted butter and lovely sweet potato rolls with a compelling lima bean puree.

Unbelievably rich, savory pan-roasted sweetbreads with black truffle grits and sherry bacon jus.

Simple but expertly prepared sweet potato pappardelle with mushrooms and cheese.

Venison tenderloin with mushrooms, red wine reduction, and edenic brussels sprouts.

Rice pudding, an elusive favorite, with super-sweet date chutney.

French-press coffee and an extra hour of reminiscence and revelry to top everything off.

Excellent choice:  too bad that I can't take all the credit.  In any case, I highly, highly, highly recommend MiLa for an evening of gastreauxnomic delights.
So glad that Jonathon and the crew are back!  Amazing service, selection and art!!

Just walked out. Sat for ten minutes, no service. We were seated at a table by the bar. No one came by to take drink order or check on us. This was our first visit had heard good things about the place. Don't know if we'll go back.

Pirate-themed bar. My sister and I went here twice. Great place to drink absinthe! More affordable than Pravda on Decatur, for example, but farther out of the way. 

Three different price levels of absinthe. We went for a mid-range French one and were very satisfied.

They do the fancy absinthe thing: sugar cube set on fire then extinguished by a slow drip coming from an especially-for-absinthe vat of water. Great experience. I think about this absinthe all the time.

Came here for a large party for brunch. Food was okay. The tots were good. My gripe is with the poor service. There was a fly in my friends mimosa, she asked for another one and the waitress tells us that they are out of champagne which is shocking since it was 1:00pm on a Sunday.

Impromptu Sunday dinner on the way home from the shore. My boyfriend and I sat out front on one of the lopsided tables placed on slanted sidewalk so I kind of felt like I was about to go down a slide the whole dinner. A bird also took aim on us, but thank goodness it was before the food came out. Service was decent, food was decent, but nothing special. The pulled pork was better than the chicken sandwich, but I wouldn't recommend the tots. Not a lot of flavor. I would return to try more and update my review. I would say more of a 3.5 out of 5, than 3, but I couldn't round up to 4. Jacks a block away looks a little more inviting and will probably be my next stop. I have been to Urban on a weekend night for drinks and I do love the inside atmosphere. There are also tvs for games, and we saw a sign for brunch that says 11-4!

During my stay in New Orleans, I tried numerous chargrilled oysters and this place was definitely the best. I wanted to lick my plate. The "shuckers" were very entertaining and watching their speed was memorizing. Great place!

A great little spot for excellent seafood away from the busy downtown Clearwater Beach area.

We made a reservation (make sure to note if you want inside or outside if you book online) and had a great dinner. 

We had the braised short rib appetizer based on photos and other reviews and almost licked the plate clean. 

The wife had crab cakes which were excellent, you can tell they were handmade. Lots of crab meat and very little breadcrumbs.

I had the fresh grouper blackened with spicy avocado. The fish was cooked perfectly, and the avocado had a serious kick, but very tasty. 

Finished off the meal with the salted caramel cheesecake, which I would go back for just that. 

Service was excellent and friendly. We were there for our anniversary and the manager came over to congratulate us. 

Would absolutely go back again, highly recommended.
Green Lemon has amazing tacos and protein bowls! The guacamole is prepared right at your table. Everything is so fresh and absolutely delicious!

Delicious coffee! I've only been here one time and I have the maple breve and it was so good! I am going back today! I don't get into Murray in very often but if I do I'm always going to go here for my morning coffee!!

Okay so finally decided to give this place a try based on all of the review and I have to say that we were disappointed from the get go.  We came in for two specific sandwiches listed in their website and were told that they no longer made those sandwiches.  Obviously the shop owners don't read their yelp reviews or they may have left the Sammies on the menu.  The sandwiches in question? The goober burger and the turkey dinner sandwich.  They were even out of the donuts that other helpers recommended.  Out as in no longer made regularly.  Not a great start.  We were hungry so we decided to try them anyway and made two other sandwich selections on the fly-the donut burger and the chicken and waffle sandwich.  They were actually FABULOUS!  Now I'm really really upset that they took the others off the menu.  We also decided to take home a dozen assorted donuts to try including the cronut and the apple fritter.  We snuck a small piece of cronut outta the box on the way home and Yowza! Was it good!  Again, now I'm upset that the other donuts are off the menu.  I hope they consider adding the things back to the menu.  We really like this place and thought the food was dynamite.
Very cute, little café off of State street. The lemon crepe was our favorite!

Definitely not what it used to be pre-Katrina, but still a great spot none the less.

Having worked in the French Quarter, I have fond memories of their wonderful pastas and pizzas and turkey sandwich at 2am after getting off work.

It seems like the menu has changed a bit, but all in all I consider this spot a good stand by in the Quarter that I will continue to frequent.

Love their pizza and their baked goods even more. Their seeing spots cake is delicious. I love their white mushroom pizza. It's a pick up pizza joint and the service is always friendly. I also enjoy their soups!
Small diner with booths and a wrap around counter .  Food was fine; service good.  If you want breakfast at any hour or basic comfort food this is the place for you.  I'll be back again.  CASH only.

Buuuuh, this place is LEGIT! These fools got it down my doods. Litterly everytime i eat here it's freaking gold! The staff and owners are some of the most chill people EVER! Honestly it can be abit pricey if you eat there too much like my big ass, but its soooooo worth. This place gets a 11/10. First timers go for the pene vodka it'sfreakin tits man!
the owner really cares about his business. I reported a problem and he resolved it very kindly.

Amzing place to eat. I love this place. The food is so good and the restaurant is very clean, employees are very friendly. I go to tampa everymonth for work and this restaurant is the TO Go spot for lunch. Awsome thing i just found out is they give me 10% off for military. You guy should try out.

This is was my third visit to this place.  My other review is on google+.
I took a co-worker here and we ended up ordering the same thing in different formats.  She got the Special in a wrap while I did the Rye (toasted).  I also got a bowl of Soup.

The staff is friendly and the place is spotless.  Don't expect fancy decor since they are on the bottom corner of a large office building.  

Our food took no time after being freshly prepared.  The sandwiches were great.  The soup was a tad thin for me but still had great flavors.

I had dinner here last night with my parents and sister who were in town visiting for the weekend, and we had a wonderful meal with great service!   We were a little early for our reservation, and so were more than happy to wait in the bar for a bit, but our table was actually ready early.  We all enjoyed some of the fun cocktails.  I had the veronese derby; I usually don't go for sweeter cocktails, but this really sounded good and I was not disappointed - bourbon, strawberry shrub, zinfandel and a frothy egg white topping.  it was delicious and pretty too!   

We started with the grand board, and some of the bacon wrapped dates.  I really don't think you can go wrong with the grand board; it is chef's choice, but unless someone is really picky, this is an amazing deal; $30 for generous portions of 3 cheeses and 3 meats with lots of bread, pickled veggies and mustard.   It is beautifully presented on an arched wooden board and was plenty for a first course for the four of us.  The dates were wonderful as well; sweet and salty and delicious.   

I had the scallops for my entree.  Again the presentation was beautiful, and the scallops were sweet and delicious.  I loved the little chicken pieces in between the scallops too; I never thought scallops and chicken would work on the same plate, but it really did!  The flavors of the kale and corn went very well with the dish and seasonings and sauces complimented very nicely.   My family members had the duck and halibut and really enjoyed their dishes as well.  

For dessert, I had the decadent chocolate cake which was so good!   It's served warm in a dish with ice cream and roasted cherries.   My family had the homemade truffles and the dessert that is a new twist on bananas foster.  We loved it all!

Service was great!  Everyone was friendly and the meal was nicely paced!  Absolutely no problems with entrees arriving before we had thoroughly enjoyed our cheese and meat board!   There was a huge party in the back room that slowed things down a bit after we ordered our desserts.  We didn't complain at all, but our server first apologized saying that the salads for the large group were put in just before our desserts.  Then, again, without us saying anything, the manager came over, and again apologized and said they'd be taking care of the desserts for us.   Wow, not necessary, but a really nice touch!   

Valet parking is the way to go on a busy night.  They do have a small lot off of Walnut Street, but it was full when we arrived.  The valet is only $6 and saves the hunt on Mass Ave particularly when there are big events going in the area!   

We were there from about 6:45PM-8:30PM on a Saturday night and it was definitely busy and full, but we didn't find it too noisy!  It was very easy to have a conversation.   I'm guessing that those who have noted a high noise level have been there after the live music starts.   

Great food, wonderful service, we will definitely be back!

I've tried this place the first time it was great! The food was fresh, hot and savory. The second time I went it was on a Saturday around 2pm it was terrible!  The seafood I ordered was cold the potatoes were not done! (I had to say something when thy came around to each table to ask "how I like my food?")I had to say my experience wasn't great for the price that charged me50.00!for the #1. Although she did bring me out another order of potatoes with the butter I suggested? Thy still were not done! Also the price was a lot higher than the first time?  They also charge for the seasoning you want for the seafood on top of the purchase of the food! It just wasn't a good experience at all! I'm the type of person tht doesn't mind paying for good quality food n experience! Oh well

Best gelato in Nashville. There, I said it. 

I used to be a big fan of the Whole Foods gelato bar or places like Bravo Gelato, but now I can't go to either without sighing. *sigh* This isn't Legato.  
Legato, you have ruined me. I'm not even mad. 

Parking can be interesting in Edgehill, especially if you're cheap like me and avoid the pay lot at all costs.  Pick a side street and take a little stroll to walk off what you're about to indulge in. 

I can't really give an accurate flavor recommendation because they change often and are basically all amazing.  Lately the peach has been my favorite and dark chocolate is always good mixed with banana or pretty much anything else. 

Bonus: Find them at the 12th South farmer's market on a hot day to cool you off while you browse!

We came here about 530.  Kinda a hole in the wall.  I'd guess they only have maybe 16-20 items and none of the pans were full but everything tasted fresh....they do a high turnover in the kitchen so the food doesn't sit out on the line for hours like some places.  Food tasted like someone's Mom was in the kitchen....loving it.  Lots of Asians eating in there and they were eating off the buffet....good sign.  Bathroom was super clean....another good sign.  Heard no spanish in the kitchen, just asian(couldn't pick out the language)....another good sign.  I saved this place to my GPS.

Where to start... the service is friendly and very accommodating, even tailoring in the kitchen for particular needs, even suggesting some changes you might not have thought were possible.

The food is SOOOO good and not the same old breakfast stuff. You can't come here without getting the cornbread sand sausage gravy. The cornbread is sweet, the gravy light and the sausage with a slight fennel taste (Italian, but not too strong.) it sounds odd, but it is amazing for the sausage gravy fan.

Chakchouka must be tried, and the breakfast tacos are great! They even look lovely.

Delaware County has very few, good, sit down Mexican restaurants with a liquor license. We've been coming here for years and always leave satisfied, with food to take home. Generally we go throughout the week. Saturdays are definitely the most busy with a wait up to 45 minutes. On a week day you will be seated right away. 

It is definitely the best Mexican restaurant in the area. Even compared to La Tolteca, I'd say the quality of food and quantity is far superior along with the interior and decor. It is everything you would expect and want from a Mexican restaurant. Chips and salsa when you arrive, great guacamole (ask for small side if you don't want table side), tasty large main dishes, and delicious frozen margaritas. They come from a machine, not a blender, which guarantees they are smooth and consistent.  

The small touches, including the new granite tables, stone back splashes, and comfortable, clean seating, make this a step up from your average Mexican spot. They recently renovated the bar which looks great. In the summer we love sitting outdoors in the "garden" - it is a great way to end the work day.

Very friendly staff and great management. We've enjoyed seeing the same staff for years who are genuine and care about your experience. On the front end everything is fast...drinks come out quick, food less than 15 minutes. We always leave happy and have probably been there hundreds of times. It is frightening to think of the money we've spent here over the years! we'll keep coming back!

We came here on our last day of vacation for a late breakfast. We had about a 30 minute wait. The restaurant it self is very crowded and kind of hot because the line is out the door and the door is constantly open. 

We ordered chicken and waffles and country fried steak. This was my first time ever having southern fried chicken and it was THE BEST! The chicken was so tender on the inside and so crispy. There was just a tiny after kick of spicy. It was so good. And to top it off, the service was fantastic. Our server was running around like crazy but she took care of our every need. 

The restaurant does automatically add an 18% tip for parties of 5+. We tipped her more, though. 

The atmosphere is nothing to be excited about but the food and service were amazing!
They have improved their operation and taste! Had them at the last night market, and it was DELICIOUS. Super dooper amazing. I suggest you go to Nomad and try it out - I can't wait to do so!

Heard from the locals that this has the best cheesesteak in DE, and it did not disappoint. I got a cheesesteak hoagie with onions, cheese, lettuce, tomatoes and onions. For $10 for a 12inch sub, this was a pretty good deal! I ate it for 2 meals, so definitely worth it.  I thought the cheesesteak was well cooked, very flavorful, and the workers were very nice. This place is close to home, so I definitely need to come here more often.

Note: Not much seating inside. Their kitchen is more like a deli where you order everything and they will make it for you to take to go, or eat in their limited seating area. Either way, will come back here again!

Man, we really tried with this place. After the third time of getting an order to go and getting home with the wrong order, we've officially given up. While waiting in line this morning, three other people came back into the store with wrong orders. Not to mention that I was third in line and it took 20 minutes to get my order. Get it together, einsteins.
Coffee was mediocre. And they don't take credit cards. Really? I'm sorry, the ambience was so so and the coffee was, again, subpar. I'd rather go to Starbucks.
Plates are very very very small in size and portions  for $18. Wasn't the most flavorful oxtails and were kind of tough.
The "Dev burger" is my favorite. The fries are some of the best I've ever had. If you work at Angie's List, it's certainly worth checking out. They are now open for breakfast every morning as well.

I have been to many different coffee Cafes through my travels but I have never seen a coffee shop that looks so pretty, actually it looks more like a really cool restaurant which it is, the owner was very sweet and friendly, the coffee was excellent as was my Bacon & Egg on a delicious roll, can't wait to return the owner is adorable

My friends have been telling me about Cafe Poca Cosa for quite awhile. So for my birthday, one of my friends treated me to lunch here.
The interior is very warm which was great because the hostess was not. She seemed very put out to help us, even though we had reservations. (as a side note, they would not seat us until our entire party was present) 
Our waiter was friendly but talked very fast. There are no conventional menus, rather it was written on a chalkboard and our waiter ran through each dish and what was in it. We both opted for the Chef's Choice and it did not disappoint! Everything was full of flavor and the meat was tender and juicy. The sauces were seasoned perfectly. There was a salad on the plate that I wish was either a little smaller or came on a separate dish. But the dressing is awesome! I don't know what it was, but I wish they would sell it!! 
I think this is the perfect place for a business lunch or date night. Picky eaters would probably be hard pressed to enjoy a meal here as would smaller kids. I did not get a family vibe and would not recommend bringing young children or kids that do not behave well in restaurants. 
I would go back for sure. It would be a perfect place to bring out of town guests to!

The drinks! The drinks! The drinks!
The drinks at this place are absolutely delish! If I could drink and not eat, this is the place where I would do it! We got the world famous Pat O'briens Hurricane which was the best hurricane I've ever seen or tasted! I also ordered a Planters Punch which was very very good! Their drinks are so reasonably priced! 
We also got an order of alligator bites. I wanted to get something that complimented the town that we were in. They were okay, but I would never get them again. I'm not sure of what the consistency is supposed to be with this food item, but it was very tough to chew and not too tasty. The menu offered a lot of food items, I guess I just wanted to order something that I normally wouldn't order or that I don't have at home. I would definitely recommend others to try as it was under $12 order and they just might like it.

Customer service was absolutely delightful! And delightful was quite hard to be in an establishment that's as busy as this one! This place has five bars, tables and seats galore! It is so crowded here but it's manageable! I was completely impressed on how kind of staff was considering all they had to do to keep things in order. We were greeted by several people along our journey to our seats but the one that we received that stuck with us was a gentleman by the name of James. James was absolutely awesome! He had a personality that was so contagious that it had me smiling my entire visit there! He made great beverage menu suggestions, and keep us up-to-date with the status of our drink and food as we waited.

I am returning back to this town, and when I do I will be coming back here to get the same drinks and order some different food items so that I can expand my foodie knowledge here at this place!

Probably some of the best Italian food I've ever had. The portions are definitely big enough to save some for the next meal. Love the quaint and cozy feel as well as the outstanding service from the staff. My new favorite place as a newcomer to the area!!!

This is the best Taco Bell in Tucson. Their service is always above the standard and the staff is always so friendly and polite. The food is always hot and doesn't look like they just threw stuff into the taco. Always go out of my way to go to this one

We visited Soho Backyard to celebrate my husband's birthday. While I was expecting a place with more of a trendy lounge feel, the ambiance was still fun and casual. The bar wasn't overly packed - which was nice - despite the fact that there were a few college football games going on. It seems like a great place to blend drinks and watching football without the chaotic sports bar atmosphere.  

The wine list had numerous selections, all of which were not your typical "house wines" that you so frequently see at chain restaurants and average bars. I enjoyed the Sauvignon blanc that I ordered. The service was quick and friendly; they do have a cocktail waitress.

I called in reservations for 8 on Friday the 31st for a bunch of  hungry golfers.  Talked to the owner, and our server Jade did an outstanding job.  Food was 5 star fresh, homemade, and plenty to eat.  Fantastic thin crust wood fired pizza, great wine selection, apps., and entrees simply fantastic, and the desserts were great..  Love a well run Family restaurant, and this one is a big thumbs up.   It is a must go to place, and being Italian, and a caterer, they exceeded my expectations.

Had lunch on a weekday, place was not crowded.  Ordered the Calabacitas tacos.  The tacos tasted good but there were two tiny street tacos and some non-flavorful beans and rice that where both cold.  This was all for $15!  I would rather have gone to Taco Bell!

I order delivery from here about once every other week (so does half my office). 
Online ordering is very simple, and the delivery is usually on time, though our building can be hard to navigate, so a few extra minutes doesn't bug any of us. 

The food is yummy, that's not up for debate. I've never really had anything that I wasn't pleased with. 
The price though... That's what hinders me from going more often. 
I do like that they have a rewards program, as some of those rewards come in handy. 

Once or twice a month though? Can't complain!

Once I walked in, the atmosphere just surrounded me. It's busy but not incredibly busy & the employees here are absolutely wonderful and generous. They give you generous samples of their foods and help you pick out items you're not too familiar with. And don't even get me started on the food. Huge fucking plate of food for less than $10. You got me fucked up, Bruh.

Every time we go to NOLA we have to try a new restaurant. After hearing a reservation is almost necessary for this place, we tried to see if we could get a table by walk in. We went after the lunch rush and got right in. Words cannot express how amazing our experience was. Everything was perfect. My husband ordered the brisket and grits topped with a pepper salad, while I ordered the duck and dumplings. We began our order with oysters and boudin balls. We couldn't walk after, but this place is too perfect to pass up. Service was friendly and the managers came by to check on our experience. If this place is out of your way, make time. It's worth the trip and any money spent here.

My family and I are staying at a hotel nearby and was craving pizza. I open up my handy dandy yelp app and here pops up this location. 

First, the young man who answered the phone was very polite. He took our order and asked if we prefer to meet the delivery person at the lobby or our room; we said our room since we  have small children. 

We ordered a large pie with pepperoni and chicken. The pizza came fast 25-35 minutes and was piping hot. The guy even brought some plates and napkins. That was nice of them. 

The pie was very good, fresh and the dough had a nice garlic flavor. We enjoyed it very much. Oh, and the price was very affordable, under $20! 

We're not from this area but I recommend this pizza hands down.
This is a great place for brunch and Sunday Funday.  It gets busy around 1-2 PM.  Good service, food and vibe.  I would go back again.

The service was VERY good.  The meats were just okay for the most part.  Considering how we felt about the quality of the meat (though there was a LOT of it), we felt the food wasn't worthy of the price.

...Some of the best Indian Food I have ever had!  I've been to many places in the world-eaten  my share of good Indian food -this is a gem to have in St Pete! The curry blew my face off! The goat dish was true to tradition Try this  place out -it's great !

This place is fabulous!  Staff was extremely friendly and willing to help with any questions.  Lots of great variety and options for all.  It can be a little pricey for some side items but overall not too bad.  I highly recommend the Turkey Avocado!  Definitely will be frequenting this spot!

BYOB. Fan, but more like 3.75 stars and can satisfy a lunch craving vs. dinner. If you are in the neighborhood, def. worth a try- but there isn't anything outstanding besides the 3 standard roll price for $10.95! On a friday night, it wasn't too hard to get a seat at the bar.

Do's
1) Get any of the three rolls specials
2) Also tried the Vic's special with lobster salad on top of shrimp tempura. It was good, but I really wanted a crunch to the sushi. The shrimp tempura here doesn't have the fancy shrimp tails sticking out of the rolls. 

Don'ts
1) Eat in Edamame. They just heat it in a microwave.
2) Miso Soup. It's not great- so I would pass.

This place doesn't serve anything else besides sushi- so if you need some other Japanese affair. Move on. But I'll def. make a trip back to visit Vic.

Just about everything you could ask for! Banh Mi, pizza rolls, Mac-n-cheese, sandwiches, take-away deli salads, soups, smoothies, coffee/tea, fountain drinks, juices, etc. There staff is super friendly and helpful if you get overwhelmed with so many great options. Love this place! I'll be back the next time I'm in Nashville!
Best Spanish restaurant in town!  Very fresh and delicious tasting. Inexpensive and large portions.

I sat at the bar on New Year's Eve and Amanda and Ty were amazing- super attentive and fun to be around on an otherwise mediocre evening! The drinks were all great (especially the Parisian) and they stuffed the olives right in front of me. Cheeseburger was incredible! Great spot
OMG Spicey Pork Soup Dumplings were awesome, great little place! Service quick and friendly and they do their best to explain the dishes if you need help

a few weeks back i was trying to find a place that sells fresh fish and i came across this Cox's it very small you know like a mom and pop store but the fish are fresh and to me all that matter and the store is also clean the service is ok for the size store if you know what i mean i have been here ever since and i love it so far.

First time visiting The Pharmacy and prior to arrival I questioned how good could a burger place truly  be beyond ordinary to warrant the number of reviews, however, My food was superb. I enjoyed the falafel burger with sweet potato fries and it was delicious. The atmosphere was bustling which was  to be expected on a Saturday afternoon,however, my party of 2 was seated fairly quick and service was friendly. I'd definitely go back and look forward to bringing friends and family to this place.
Small but worth the wait!  Super fresh grouper - blackened was spicy but not too much. Drunken shrimp and fish spread were awesome starters and homemade key lime tarts were a great finish!

We looked for asian restaurants and saw this with all the glowing reviews.  Decided to try it although not familiar with Korean food.   The restaurant is very clean.  The food was tasty, fresh and presented well.  We opted for the "lettuce wraps" thinking that it was akin to PF Changs' but when we were served, we realized that it was an alternative method to eating the delicious dishes.  My friend had the Bibimbap bowl and I had the Bulgogi.  Looking forward to going back again.  If this restaurant was in Midtown, the lines would be out the door!

On the recommendation of my barber, we checked out Ordinary Pizza! What a cute little spot in a small town just outside of indy. The staff was super friendly, let us know about some specials we will for sure be coming back to try! The pizza was amazing, thick and full of toppings, the crust was crunchy and able to hold the toppings without them falling off. So good. The garlic cheese bread was okay, I just don't think we were fans, we will get breadsticks next time. Can't wait to try this place again!

First things first: I don't know how anybody could say this place has bad service. While I know experiences definitely differ from person to person, our server was friendly, attentive, super helpful, and personable. My water glass was never more than half empty before being refilled...and I drink a lot of water (I know; I'm wild like that.). 

We came here for restaurant week and will be coming back as soon as possible. Highlights for me were the ensalada de higos (smoked figs?! DIE.) and the churros. The Pechuga Rellena con Requesón (i.e. the chicken) was also pretty amazing. The corn served on the plate was SO GOOD, though I thought the dish itself could be a little spicier. Still, it was perfectly prepared. PERFECTLY. 

The ambiance up in hurr is so nice. We felt relaxed and at home the whole time and it's simply but wonderfully decorated and lit. 

OH. And the margaritas. BEST.IN.PHILLY. Honestly. Places tend to look at me strange when I ask bluntly if they use sours mix in their margaritas. I hate sours mix. It should not be involved in my drink of choice. Half price margaritas for happy hour! I will be back here any time I need a good marg. Yum.

Independently owned/operated coffee shops are the best. Here you will find friendly efficient waitstaff/baristas, a small town funky vibe with stellar latte foam art, ( A plus plus in my personal opinion) yummy brunch  menu-- Belgian waffles and egg/ biscuit sandwiches. LIVE music; the Philly- Main Line Ukulele Group was in attendance/ holding a open mike session on my most recent visit. This place is fantastic. So much YES.
Delicious food and excellent service. The cafe de olla was also delicious and the Maria's galletas just made our breakfast experience tastier. The music also added to the ambience.

First of all, this place is a very small hole in the wall with few tables. There was no posted menu and girl said nothing. I figured out there was a paper by small counter with menu.  The Big Cheezy sandwich was UNEVENTFUL! It was not on Hawaiian bread as stated and I had no cheddar.  I resent having a roll of brown industrial paper to use as napkins.  Just a cheap sandwich and I won't return.

YOU MUST TRY THE CORNED BEEF, 
I know this is the french toast king and it rocks but, I love the corned beef!
Good strong coffee to the way it should be. 
Food is cooked to order and awesome, the smoothie is awesome to

I'm surprised no one has reviewed this Bonefish Grill yet.  It's a pretty nice replacement for the truly awful Friendly's that used to stand in its spot.  I'm happy for the new addition to the neighborhood.

I've been to this Bonefish two times since it opened.  The first night was a Wednesday, which is $5 Bang Bang Shrimp night, so it was packed.  Still, my  husband and I were able to find a seat at the shared tables in the bar.  We were elbow to elbow with a couple on each side of us, but we got to chatting with them eventually and it spiced up the evening.  The even bigger benefit is that we didn't have to wait for a table.  This area still has access to the full menu and waiter service, so it's kind of a no-brainer pick during busy times.  That evening we split a Bang Bang Shrimp and had a couple of beers.  For a chain restaurant they have a reasonably good craft beer selection along with the regular American drafts.  The Bang Bang Shrimp is rich and filling, and as we had each had a late lunch, this worked out to be a perfect, low-cost meal.

Another night I met a former co-worker there and had a made a reservation in advance (good thinking!).  I had a shrimp and scallops entree with mango salsa and was very pleased with it.  I also had a salad to start and one of their seasonal sides, which was perfectly ripe tomatoes with balsamic and I believe some feta.  Key lime pie rounded off the meal and was a completely unnecessary and gluttonous move (but very delicious nonetheless).

I haven't got a bad thing to say about the place -- they're prompt and friendly service-wise, it's a great convenient location, and they do a consistently good job with their food.  Also, they have an outdoor patio!  The view is Route 309 and the surrounding parking lot, but spots for dining al fresco in the suburbs are few and far between, so I'll take it!

I was really excited to check this place out because I love southern food but I was pretty disappointed. The mac n cheese was not good at all. It was bland. And it was served cold. The fried chicken was okay, but it wasn't very flavorful. The fries were salty. One of my friends that I was with had the fried chicken with honey hot sauce and she said it wasn't even hot. I was looking forward to this place because of all positive reviews it had but I definitely won't be coming back for the food. The vibe is nice and the staff are friendly but that's about it.

Kris Harvey Wouldn't let me bring my bike into the space on a Tuesday. There are no bike locks out front. The space was 78% empty Sept 25th. 

Not a welcoming space. FYi.

The stars remain the same, but there is a dish worth mentioning:

PORK BELLY BENEDICT. Now this is pork belly done right: thick cubes of pork belly, smoked with maple, appropriately seasoned with salt and pepper...kind of like Korean BBQ pork belly. If you are a true pork belly fan, you must get this!

I would've bumped up one star just on the pork belly alone, but the Chicken and Waffles Benedict was horrible. Small pieces of fried chicken that wasn't even crispy. No thanks.

The Red Velvet Pancakes are huge like everyone mentioned, but it wasn't too sweet and the chocolate morsels were just enough and not overwhelming.

We have been in Florida since 2004 desperately searching for a great pizza...seemed like no one had a clue on how to make a great one...until now! We went to Paul's Chicago Pizza for Valentine's day just to give it a shot, and to our surprise the Pizza was extremely tasty...the crust was thin and crisp just the way we like it although they also have a stuffed crust if that's what you like. So happy to finally have great pizza in Florida!

We went here last month and loved the place!  Gorgeous rooftop bar with a great view.   So nice not to be packed in like sardines, we danced all night, to a DJ.  Highly recommend it as a fun place to go and hang out.   First floor had a band, and its a very nice place.   We did not eat here, but would like to check out dinner here sometime.   Next time we visit Nashville for sure!

I understand that it's McDonald's and the bar for customer service is very low, but somehow this specific location goes above and beyond to be TERRIBLE at customer service. I'd reccomend driving to the next closest McDonald's because it will save you time overall. Wish I could make my review 0/5 stars.

Went there especially for the prime rib.  Was told it was great.  I love my roast beef really rare.  Was told it's done medium but they would look for the rarest piece.  I got the 24 oz. Which was 24.00.  It comes with a salad and a side.  The salad was small but sufficient.  The baked potato was great and hot.  The prime rib came out medium and was a good portion. I really wanted the rib so u ate it the way it was. I would probably not get the prime rib there again.  Not cooked the way I wanted and cost a little pricey.  The rob is better than some steak houses in the area; however, there you can get it your way but it doesn't taste as good as Jim's.  So recap....prime rib really good, not cooked the way I would like and costs to much for not getting what you want.  Yes I will continue to go back because I do like several other items on the menu.
I don't even want to give one star. It was very expensive and the food was mediocre at best. Took over an hour to be delivered and the fries and chicken fingers were terrible.

Ate here this morning with a party of 5. Two adults, three teenagers. When we drove up they all said: Mom! What is this? From reading other peoples' posts and based on their hunger status, we made a go of it.  We are all so glad we did! We tried a lot of things. The firebird special was amazing, shrimp and grits a terrific change from our usual Birmingham butter, olive oil and pancetta treatment, Bourbon Street omelette was fabulous, and while the French toast was a bit sweet for my taste, it was incredibly decadent and good. We added in some fried green tomatoes and bronuts for the table. We ate outside in the tent on picnic tables and while a bit rustic, (I did notice an earthworm under my seat-but hey, I am from Alabama-used to it at picnics) our server was very kind and helpful. Lest I forget, the side of plain grits was "life changing". A must have for grit lovers and newbies alike.  Everything was fantastic!!! The jams are also great-we bought 3 to give as gifts, OK, maybe not as gifts. Don't pass this unlikely looking gem up!
We always come here for a brunch date. It's one of my favorite brunch restaurants. And the service is always great.

Excellent service , food even though it was crazy busy I was very surprised . Saw the manager walking around keeping tabs . I been to a lot of Boston pizzas this food is one of the best I have had to date . Place was clean and service was fast . I will be going here again !

Can't recommend this place. Despite the fact that the counter looked like it hadn't been cleaned all day, I went ahead and ordered a cone. (There weren't many toppings left, and the containers were messy.) But the frozen yogurt didn't have much flavor. The staff seemed more interested in talking with each other than serving customers.

I am truly disappointed tonight. My husband has never been, finally agreed to go and an epic fail played out in front of my eyes. I have always said they have the best Pud Thai in town....sadly I can no longer say that.  It had half the ingredients it normally does and it was very dry. We ordered the spicy crispy duck it too was extremely dry and there was nothing crispy about it, way too much juice made it a soggy mess. Our waiter we saw once, never to return...even to drop the check off. We had to go up to the front and ask for our bill. There was a group of 8 individuals who were obnoxiously loud and disrespectful. The restaurant did nothing about them. They seated 2 groups of 2 elsewhere due to this group; however nothing was asked of the group to keep it down or to tone it down or to watch their language. So unfortunately the rest of us had to deal with this groups inappropriate behavior. The manager or owners need to figure out how to handle an unruly group so the rest of the restaurant doesn't suffer, obviously they don't know how to handle this yet. I brought everyone of these points up while we were checking out, what we were offered was "Oh, sorry about that but at least the food was good right?!" So they obviously weren't listening when I talked about the food... we will not re-visit again.

This is one of my favorite places to gather with friends and eat. Beautiful decorum and a yummy, unique menu selection. Try the Blackhawk (not on menu), STL salad, and a sundae (homemadd Almond Joy ice cream)! You won't be disappointed!

This used to be our go to brunch place. We brought all of our out of town friends here. We loved the salad and eggs Benedict. The service has always been slow, but the food was worth it. However, this past time we went will be the last. The lady at the register was rude. The serving staff was talking to one another to the point where we eventually settled on taking one of their rags and wiping down our own table. Even with the rough start, we had hope that the food would make up for the rest. Unfortunately, we were wrong. The eggs in the Benedict were over cooked and hard. The breakfast potatoes were cooked to a mush. The chicken in the salad was also overcooked and dry. They also forgot all the toppings and essentially brought out a salad consisting of lettuce dressing and chicken... after correcting their mistake and adding the toppings, the presentation was messy and the salad was half empty and no were near worth $16. In addition, their "freshly squeezed" orange juice tasted watered down. We could see it sitting in the pitcher out on the counter. Who knows how long it had been there and they were making no effort keep it fresh. Sadly, we will not be returning again.

Service was outstanding, our waitress was attentive but not intrusive. Three of our party had ribs and one had a sandwich. The ribs were good, just the right amount of seasonings and sauce. The sides, coleslaw, french fries and cornbread all were great. Potato salad was just OK, I don't like tasting vinegar in my potato salad. The sandwich was a variant of the BLT, had plenty of bacon which was pretty crispy and tomato slices nice and thick, but not enough spread on the bread and the bread was just regular wheat, nothing special. We would definitely recommend this place and will be back.

Yum!!! I guess it's good this place is a little out of the way for me, or else I would be stopping in on a daily basis for a bubble tea. The service is always fast and friendly, which of course is a perk. The parking at Frosty's is a little odd, but nothing too stressful.

Very nice food nice service and I will go eat there again  
The food come hot and the way we want all the servers are friendly and trying to hep

I should have taken a picture of this feast...but, I failed. Anyway, I met a friend here for lunch recently. While waiting, I ordered the sangria which was good, but nothing to write home about. We ordered the Mazorca to start and holy goodness, that was hands down the best thing on the table. I could have just eaten the entire bowl of that and been satisfied. We each got 2 tacos for our entrees. I ordered the Langostino and the Mixo, and my friend got the Langostino and the Pescado. All were very good. The shrimp taco was definitely my favorite, for I found the mixo to be a little on the dry side. The prices weren't bad for the amount of food you get, and the service was pleasant. I would definitely return to try other items on the menu.
Really good food, huge portions and most importantly excellent service. We have been here twice and plan to return often. Very clean huge place. Do yourself a favor and give it a try.

This quick stop is located right inside a gas station right on Magazine St. The staff is so friendly, and they were right: they produce food "right from home." We got the chicken shawarma and the beef/lamb lula kebab plate. The seasonings were absolutely delicious. It really hit the spot! I'll definitely be back to try their spinach pies!

Absolute worst service I have ever received! It took forever to give my order, then it was wrong and cold. They acted as if they didn't care and said I could take the order or not but wasn't getting the "correct" order without paying yet again! I'll never come here again and I will let everyone on social media know how crappy this place is

Great meal for 2 under $25. Portion sizes are large so you might be able to share. Lighting was a bit much, but after a brief conversation with the manager they were able to reduce it to a more tolerable level. Overall, a welcome addition to the Cherry Hill breakfast scene.

A friend of mine recently brought me a Delco's cheesesteak for lunch last week and it was fantastic. The bread, meat, cheese, and toppings were fresh with great flavor. It was a great size and I have no complaints. I wish they were a little closer to me as I would be a regular here on a weekly basis. 

They're are not too many cheesesteak places in the area that I like, but Delco's is now on the good list and I will definitely stop in next time I am in the area.
Excellent food and service!  From the appetizer of "Sausages with mustard sauce", Split Pea soup( to die for),Schwaben Teller, to the finally of Hot Berries, I can't wait to return!

One of my favorite breakfast spots. Although I drive about 30 minutes to get here it's worth it. For some reason I always get the French toast breakfast. I'll switch up one day. The crispy sour dough bread buttered so nicely with the hot maple syrup. Those little bottles are so cute. Once you're done eating you can catch a movie at Neshaminy Mall. Our server was efficient, never had any bad service here. Oh and don't forget the country store. If you have kids they won't mind the wait because they can browse the store.

Well, we have been coming here for years. It has been a year and a half since we came last. It has gone down hill.  The prime Rib was so tough you could not even chew it.  Plus they are now charging $15.00 per person for crab legs that you could not even get out of the shell.  Wife said salad bar was not that good either.   They better get their stuff together.

This Restaurant is Fantastic!  The prices are great and comparable to other food eateries in the area.  The service is always fantastic.  It is a mix of Cajun and Tex/Mex.  I am never disappointed when I go.  Freshly made chips and salsa for the table.  Portions are generous.  If you leave hungry you are doing it wrong.  The place is a little loud and will get very very busy.  The only down side is they do not take reservations.  Great for couples, singles, family, business lunches etc!

Dickmans is a carnivores delight. Go there for quality choice meat. Into exotic meats? They've got you covered too. Prefer to grab a sandwich! They've got that too! Really- they have so much to choose from and will make sure you leave happy.
Ive eaten there many times ( partys etc, that i never setup, just went to be polite) every meal has been really bad, i would rather eat chief boyardee.

My favorite place to get fries.

It's very centrally located, which is a plus and a minus but honestly, I'm willing to wait for Ishkabibble's fries.

I love the inside even more than the carnival-esque outside. It's a little off, with autographed photos of tons of 'celebrities' that kind of ring a bell? Maybe? One hit wonder in the 90's? But I like it. It's pretty reminiscent of what people are already calling the old-new south street (it's changed a lot in the past three years, even more than it already had) which is comforting to those of us who grew up here.

The service is wonderful, the people on the grill and at the register are friendly, but efficient. There's very little chit chat unless it's dull, but you never feel unwanted (cough::LORENZO'S::cough) and you feel like your money is going to the people, not a company.

I gave this restaurant 5 stars because it fulfills what it is - a beach dive in a great location that serves classic dive food.  If you are looking for this then you will enjoy your stay.  If you are thinking gourmet food and dining experience then this is not your place and you will not agree with the 5 star rating.

I have been going to The Spot several times a year when I am in Carpinteria.  Their grilled food just hits "the spot."  I enjoy their grilled cheesebugers with crispy lettuce, tomatoes, onion, pickes, and sauce.  It is a simple stick to your ribs burger that doesn't cost much more than a fast food joint that serves up microwaved hamburgers.  Their fries, onion rings, and chili-cheese fries are also good.

On my recent trip I tried their sausage breakfast burrito and this was probably the best breakfast burrito I have ever had.  Fresh grilled potatoes, fluffy eggs, sausage - wow.

I tried their clam chowder because this is what we do when we travel to coastal communities.  I was disappointed because if I order clam chowder in a bread bowl, there is a certain expectation for taste.  The chowder obviously came from a can.  It had the canned taste, potaties were too uniform, and the clams were dark like they were processed.  - fishy after taste.  

Despite the clam chowder I will likely be back after I have worked up an appetite swimming and crave Americana Dive food that is well done.  The atmosphere like I said fits this place so as a total beach dive experience, it is as good as it gets.  I recommend sticking  to the grilled food to get the best out of your visit.

The food is good , the fries are nice. Fresh Sammie's .
I use to come here when I was in highschool since it was in walking distance but the customer service is poor
The women they have working behind the counter hardly speaks English 
poor service , she mistook my order more than once and charged me for fries before I gave her my card I told her, before I paid since she didn't run my order by me and she did not give me what I ordered def. Could be better with better staff, not interested in this place any longer.

Pizza is pretty great, can't go wrong with the pairing of the ovum (carbonara) and a Margherita however some of their dinner courses are suboptimal. It's worth noting we've never tried any seafood courses which may be good.

Thoroughly enjoyed our meal and service at this quaint restaurant. Had the goat cheese with apples and walnut on focaccia. The only reason I'm not giving 5 stars is because I was disappointed with my iced latte. All at the table found the espresso bitter and weak. The latte was pretty watery, but loved my (and my friends') meal(s).

first time I had sabrina's cafe was in University city while back which was a let down. I am glad I came back and tried the one in South Philly.
Small place near Italian Market...was lost finding this place.
I got the Huevos Rancheros which was amazing...love the balance of each texture and dish...oh man I took a bite out of the fried jalapeno pepper which was really hot. This dish is worth getting.
My friend got the ulimate mexi scramble which he liked a lot. The grits were flavorful and he devoured his meal.
We split the stuffed challah french toast which was heavy with a heavy meal we had for our entree. If you get this stuffed challah get something citrus or acid with it. 
overall experience worth coming back and trying out other dishes.
I saw other customers food that came out worth looking to get

I've now been back a few times, and it's running neck-in-neck with Takamatsu for the lunch buffets. They both have some different strong points, but I'd gladly go to either one any time. 
Full disclosure- I can't speak to their dinner service, having not been, it seems to be a place for the young and hip, and I'm not young (although I'm totally hip, lol) and don't go out much at night, plus there are at least five sushi bars within a couple of miles of my house, so we tend to go to one of them. If the evening comes that friends want to go there, I'll gladly go too- it's a great place.

The food here was great. We had pork and brisket sandwiches. I'd get carry out from here in a heartbeat, but I won't be back to dine in. The employees weren't very friendly or helpful (especially the man who brought out our food) and they were very solicitous to a customer who was there with a very scary Doberman. I don't need that when I'm just trying to have dinner!

Holy cow! This place is amazing!!! Pie Five offers a variety of fresh pizza toppings that are so delicious. They have a Subway-style system that makes it easy to guarantee a correct order. All pizzas are only $6.99 including all the toppings! My family and I have enjoyed a wonderful meal tonight (3 pizzas, 3 drinks, and a dessert) for only $30. I will definitely be returning to this restaurant. A+

I love this place! This small family owned Japanese restaurant has amazing food and such nice people. This is the best Japanese food I've had in Tucson and very cheap for the quality. 
I strongly recommend the spicy tuna don volcano style. The Ikkyu special is also very good, $8 for a lot of food. Their sushi is good but some of the rolls come in four giant pieces which make it harder to eat. The baked scallop California roll is comparable to any high end sushi restaurant. The ramen I thought was ok. I've had the shoyu and tonkotsu ramen. The tonkotsu was definitely better but it wasn't crazy good. 
They can get very busy, especially when I go around lunch time. I always call in advance and order takeout so I never have to wait. The only downside about this restaurant is that they are closed on Sundays.

I miss the old Yards... the ambiance, the food, the location, the people.  Totally different vibe at the new Yards.  I will not give the new location a bad review because of my love of the old location and the hope that it will possibly re-open as a satellite Yards :) ??????? (5 stars for the beer)  I am also hopeful that the foie gras fries (?) have been removed from the menu... foie gras should not be on any menu.

5 = food
5 = service

The best meal we had while vacationing in Santa Barbara. For our small plates we got the bone marrow bruschetta. To die for. We got the candied carrots in duck oil.

I ordered their beef cheek. It was in place of the beef ribs. So tender, melts in your mouth.

Our server was wonderful and she explained the specials clearly. Great service all around.

Al's is located in ybor one block south of the busy 7th ave. I've passed by it so many times in the past but never realized it was a BBQ restaurant because every time I passed it previously, they've been closed. Also, the building just looks like a regular residential home when its not opened and packed with customers.  Last Friday, I made it to Al's around 8pm and they close at 9pm. Unfortunately, since it was late in the day some of the food items I wanted to order were sold out. In the end, I ordered the sausage and ribs platter with collared greens and okra, The food was so amazing and the staff was very helpful and friendly.  I will definitely be coming back very soon to try the other barbecue and side options.

Same owner as South Philly Barbacoa! 

Everyday the chalkboard menu changes. 

Ingredients are local in Italian Market.

Cash Only.

I like that the menu is small and simple.

Parking can be a bit tough in that neighborhood.

Definitely worth bringing a date here.

The vibe inside is old classic Mexican restaurant. 

Fairly cheap and delicious!

One of our favorite sushi spots. It's a little bit cramped inside, seating is first come first serve. It's BYOB as well, they have soft drinks that you can purchase and free hot tea. I always order the Mango Tango here (it's the best!) and my girl orders the 3 Roll Special. We usually choose California Roll, Shrimp Tempura, and Alaskan Roll. They do take out too, and preps it pretty fast.

Great pizza!  We are new to the area and the staff was very helpful on the phone for us while placing an order.  The only reason I didn't give a 5 star is you're a pizza place, delivery goes hand in hand.  Otherwise excellent!
The food here is excellent but the service is enough to make you run out the door. It feels like the owners are just maintaining and the snotty, careless attitude of the staff is disappointing.

Nice place deep in the heart of Spanish Springs. There were a lot of tables and the wait staff was really nice. The food, although not the ultimate Chinese food, was quite good. What set this place apart from many others to me was the fact that the service was so quick and there was really a lot of space in the restaurant which is something I like. We had the General Tso's chicken and pork fried rice. I also had hot and sour soup which was a little different than normal but still very good. We will be back someday.

The Chicken and Waffles gets all the attention but I found the trout also to be great paired with polenta cakes and poached eggs. I wish more restaurants had polenta on the menu. 

Staff at the bar was attentive and gave me the inside/local scoop as an out-of-towner.

Had the BEST WAITRESS EVERRR!!! she only works Sat and her name is Callen! We were seated in the bar /booth area in the front and let me tell u just HOW AWESOME she was!!! She was there without being 'there' ! Awesome customer service! Can't rave enough about how awesome she is!!!! Food is always on point , even after having to take back twice to get reheated!!! She reorderd it and came out piping hot and fresh!! Truly wonderful experience and will most definitely coming back on Sats just to have her service
Definitely worth the wait. Came to NO with my boyfriend and dined here around 1 ish waited in an hour line but it was so worth it.. Bloody Mary was yummy and the food was on point!

Really cozy place. Staff was amazing and incredibly helpful and attentive. Food was a mix of outstanding and good. 

The Jerk Black Drum: outstanding! Best dish ordered. Fish was cooked perfectly; "stand clap clap sit" to the chef at the meat station.

Hamachi: was good but sauce had a strong fish sauce flavor; just wasn't my flavor. Beautiful presentation and was good; I enjoyed it. 

Biscuits: this is the bread service. The biscuits had a clam like flavor to it, which just wasn't my thing but the butters that came with it were delicious. 

Andromeda cocktail: good but not wow. 

I'd recommend coming here; Great vibe and ambience.
Took the family here for dinner.  Food was good, however the service was lacking and took MUCH longer than it should (especially since there were only 4 tables filled on a mid-week night....

Delishousness ! Yes, I like made up words. It was a bit hot last evening in INDY and the humidity was on swap-o-meter HIGH! But the Iozzo's Garden of Italy did impress my Hip Mamas group. We enjoyed the outdoor garden area. There was a slight breeze and the servers were patient with my group (23) while we stood around and mingled with our half price wine by the glass (on Wed) for about an hour. I split the stuffed mushrooms caps, OH how I love mushrooms and these were made to please!! The Fettuccine Alfredo was slightly sweet and loved the sun dried tomatoes and we added mushrooms... SO Delightful!  I also tasted a friend's sea bass and it was excellent!  Katie the owner made us feel at home and we all enjoyed a fabulous evening! Parking is easy and the location is convenient for anyone since it's minutes from the highway.

THIS PLACE IS AMAZING!!!!! We got the Kabob festival for 6 people and it was absolutely delicious!! Coming back to this place again and again. The staff was so kind and attentive. This is one of my new favorite places!!!

My group went here and ordered the pulled pork plate and sand which and the brisket plate. We all strategically ordered the sides so we got a little of everything.  The baked beans were like nothing I've ever ate. They weren't glopped in thick sauce but still had a lot of flavor and spice.  The cole slaw and potatoe salad were homemade and good. The Mac and cheese was a little over cooked and the noodles were mushy but still tasted cheesy.  The only real complaint is that the place is kind of gross. There's 4 picnic tables on and inclined concrete floor inside a screened in gazebo basically. We didn't eat there but the food was just what we were looking for.
My good friend told me about this spot years ago and it's an amazing location for great made to order sandwiches as well as amazing breakfast burritos. Will come back next visit to SB!

Best halal place in Indy! Kabobs are a must! Everything we had was good,alh. (pizza, wings, subs)Very friendly owner. Pretty much can't go wrong with anything you order. As far as I know everything is halal so eat with your heart's content. The pizza was amazingggg. [chicken tikka]

Truly a time portal to another era. I only dropped in for drinks with friends, but our barman was fantastic (a handlebar mustache will do that), the beer list was phenomenal, and the punch out of this world. 

Can I just move in and live here?

This BYOB used to be a neighborhood gem when it opened. I'd go at least twice a month and everything was fantastic, including the staff. Once their sister restaurant Arde opened, it has slowly gone downhill to the point that I will not be returning. Used to be on a Thursday night it would be a full house, and last night we found ourselves to be one of two filled tables at a prime time of 8:00pm. Not a single familiar face still around from when it opened just a few years ago. Meals aren't prepared as well as they used to be. Our waiter recommended we get the Gamberotti with shrimp, lump crab and panna. Realized after dinner that the lump crab and panna were not even in the dish and the pasta had been overcooked vs the nice al dente they used to serve. The menu hasn't changed much, but nothing tastes as good as it sounds any more. It used to be well above average. I sung it's praises and convinced many to try it out. Now I would be embarrassed to recommend this place to anyone, as the food has become underwhelming and ordinary. In addition to the pasta dish, we got the bruschetta which was literally saturated in oil, and one of the pizzas, which was okay (hard to go wrong with pizza). It's sad to see what was once a great restaurant go bad in such a short amount of time. it seems that all of the attention the owners previously gave to this location has been transferred over to Arde in Wayne. All I can say is they better keep their game up at Arde, as the Main Line brings a far less forgiving crowd.

A solid meh. It's alright if you're hungry. If you're craving a Thai experience, it just ain't it. The food is "americanized" and watered-down. The service could be improved to be more welcoming and friendly. I had to grab my own menu for dining information instance. Where this place shines is  not the food but their COVID-19 safety measures. All the utensils and plating are single use throwaways. The staff wore masks and there were plenty of hand sanitizers around. If safety is more important than taste, then come here. If taste is more important, you're gonna be disappointed lol

Atrocious ...  truly don't know what is worse ..... the totally horrendous service or the god awful, greasy disgusting food  and filthy floors and tables?  Both are truly reprehensible !  Staff stand around chatting while glasses go unfilled,  food from kitchen takes forever and when it does finally arrive it's overcooked, cold and greasy!   This is clearly a case where there is no quality control and clearly all the owner cares about is how many restaurants he can own regardless of how atrocious they are! Just go to Frida's and avoid this place like the plague!

Highly recommend this place!!
I've been coming here for a while now. The hostess remembers us and welcomes us back. We mainly go for Sunday Brunch. Literally almost always get the same thing every time. The chilaquiles with steak is really good but not pictured. I highly recommend the queso dip. It is a little spicy but very good. Also the enchiladas norteñas is something I've started ordering. Staff is very friendly but I wish they would write down my order when I place it. I've gone here with my girlfriend and almost always mess up the way we order the eggs whether over easy or over hard. It almost never comes out as requested. It makes it difficult to order my food exactly as I want and makes it not as good of an experience. I'm still giving 5 stars besides that just because the food is so good and staff so friendly.

The food here is so good! It's been a while since I've been here but we've gone twice over the last month. The first time I was really pleased with our food and the price. We sat in the outdoor section while it was under construction but was still nice, but they had someone playing guitar and singing where the bar now is and he was so loud we could not enjoy our company which was a shame since I live out of state and was taking my father out for dinner. My boyfriend and I went again for dinner last night, no musician and the outside is just about finished. The food again was lovely and the manager/owner was extremely kind. The server though was unfriendly abd we certainly got the feeling we were being treated different than the couple next to us. They had their bread delivered with their appetizer, we had to ask for our bread abd it came with our dinner, they got an extension on their very small table for the pizza they ordered, we did not and we had other dishes for dinner besides the pizza. They were shown a dessert tray we were not. After our food was delivered we waited about a half hour for the server to come back and wrap our food and give us the check. We will definitely be back but some of their servers need to work on their skills.
I had to wait 45 minutes when I dine in because of the DoorDash priority , they make their sandwiches first as we sit and wait and we only have an hour for lunch not happy
This food is fantastic! Loved the chicken breast, and the white beans, but have to say the catfish is the best I've ever had - EVER!! I cannot recommend this place enough :)
Great food with HUGE portions! The queso was a little loose for my liking but the wet burrito with the rojo sauce is worth going back for!

I like to stop in here for an afternoon happy hour/dinner snack if I'm at Costco.  The food is always on point; love the tacos.  I'm not a huge beer person so I can't speak to that; but I enjoy the service and it also seems like a super fun place to watch football/sports.  Plenty of tvs which aren't turned up too loud.  The place has a great feel and some super yummy menu items that veer away from typical bar food - there are a few surprise twists on the menu, some with an Asian flair.  Yum.
Great burger. Unique texture. Ground short rib and brisket. Salmon and fish tacos were spectacular. Excellent sangria.
My favorite place for an açaí berry bowl.  I've tried other places but this one is by far the best!

Such a disappointment. I'm not sure if the food sucked because it's kinda late at night or if it's because it's a holiday or if it's because I'm from NY and expect good pasta dishes...the only reason I'm giving it 2 stars and not 1 is because one of the I assume managers was really helpful and got me plastic ware.... believe it or not it was very hard to get silverware with my Togo order... so, when I first got in the hostess sent me to the bar next door to pick up my food ( not a problem), but when I got to the bar it took a very long time to be acknowledged (like nothing was going on) and then when I told the bartender I was there to pick up a Togo order he ignored me for 5 mins and then grabbed the order of food that was sitting there the entire time. Overall it sucked, I'm sure a frozen dinner would have had more flavor and the service sucked... the manager who got me plastic ware was nice though.

I have been eating and craving!!! Chow express for 10 years. The hot and sour soup is so fresh, perfectly spicy with so many textures , I cant say enough good things. 
General Taos chicken, the bomb!!. Crunchy, juicy, hot and sweet.  Everything you want. And served in a container you would pay $1.50 for at grocery.  
I have yet to get a poor dish here and I have tried at least a dozen Chinese take out restaurants that have disappointed me. 
A RARE find!!! 
Trust me! Give them a shout and you'll be hooked like me.

P.S. I live downtown now and every time I go up north I call chow express. Its that good.
Some of the best TexMex we have had. Loved the Guacamole, Fish Tacos and Margaritas. Service was great and very friendly

yum...yum..yum...pandemic mania...we ordered straight from your menu... weekly girls meet up...outside...with friends..in the back yard...lunch from cafe fontana...2 large delicious pizzas....pick up was friendly and easy...masks on.... hats off to you and your staff for making our girls' day extra delicious

For a long time, this was probably the best hand drawn noodle place in Philadelphia. I think it's because it was the only one. It's pretty awesome that the noodle chef is working on the noodles in the back and you hear him whipping them about and drawing them out. I actually prefer the shaved noodles here because they're a little thicker and more chewy, but the hand drawn noodles are great too. Freshly made noodles just taste great.

The problem I have with Nan Zhou is the broth. The noodles are a critical part of the equation, and they're made very well here, but the broth is also just as important! In beef noodle soup, the beef is supposed to be lovingly braised, and the broth rich and flavorful, a sign that the beef has been stewing for a long time. I have a feeling that the beef has just not been braising long enough because the broth is still running clear. The flavors in the broth just haven't had the time to develop. I also love to add marinated egg to my noodles, and those too, have not been marinating long enough. They should be a nice creamy brown color, not beige or white with brown spots.

This place only accepts cash, but chances are you won't be running a terribly high bill.

Best Chinese place around Boise. It's a fantastic location downtown, I live 30 minutes away and it's worth the drive for sure. Service is fantastic, food is amazing, and it's overall great. Our favorite is the spicy beef (#69), and the lemon chicken.

Well, my experience with this place is limited thus far to 2 visits.
