One went okay when I ordered the Nachos and Cheese, but today didn't go quite as well due to the place being in transition as both the workers and, I think that was also the owner as well who told me much the same.

First off, if you;d like somewhere nice and quiet to sit and eat or have a drink, Thornton's doesn't really fit the bill, as part of the "transition" process involves construction work inside the bar during business hours.

In fact, I don't see why they don't consider closing down temporarily until such time as all construction work is completed. Having free reign of the place to get work done more quickly while closed for repairs would make things easier for construction workers, I'm sure.


Second, a while back, Thornton's sent out menu flyers to houses around the area (mine included). But, seems that another part of the "transition" involved removing stuff from the menu that was listed in the menu flyers they sent out a while back.


This begs the question as to why it was somehow impossible for them to simply honor their current menu until such time as new menu flyers were made up and sent out to neighborhood residents around here.


At any rate... I had ordered the "basket of chips" for $1.50 on the menu I have for them, whereas what came back was the pub chips for twice the price ($3).

*Shrugs shoulders* I have to wonder if this is perhaps some sort of odd form of "bait and switch" or something.

I mean, if it is only merely a mistake, then like I said, this mistake and all others involving the 'old menu" compared to the current one could be easily avoided if they simply honor those old menu prices for all customer orders until such time as they print up new menus.

Granted, to his credit, the owner (I think it was) did offer to refund me... only AFTER a started complaining. But, I did let it go. However, fact remains that prospective customers need to be warned of these discrepancies with the menus flyers that was sent to people, and their current one.

Simply put... while the place will perhaps be better when it is no longer a work in progress, I can only judge based on my visits of how it is now, since it was just earlier today that I swung by to try more stuff from their menu after having some quite good nachos and cheese there yesterday.

In closing, the place is noisy... usually impossible to get in and out the side entrance during construction, and just simply a train wreck when it comes to how well they seem have their act together currently.


Trust me, people... as it currently stands, I really think you can do better as a customer by visiting other bars in and around Port Richmond.

We walked from the French Quarter here(about 15-20 minute walk) because the Yelp reviews and our friends that live in NO said it was a "must do".  The line was fairly long and the smell outside made us even hungrier.  The service was fast, fresh, friendly and the menu had a lot to offer.  We will go back if we're in NO again.

First off I've got to say that I've been teetering between 4 and 5 stars for the past few hours.  This was a tough call. 

Overall, in a sea of Italian restaurants in the Collingswood / Westmont area, this clearly stands out as one of the best (along with Il Fiore, Sappori, and Zeppoli (so I hear) ).  There were a few small details that bothered us on this trip that led me to a 4 over a 5.  

THE FOOD:  Fantastic!  Huge portions.  Moderately priced given the amount of food you get.  For appetizers we went with a caprese salad and the side meatballs.  The waitress gloated that the latter were featured on "The 10 Show" and it was worth noting because they were excellent.  As for the entree, I had one of the best chicken piccata dishes I've ever had.  The gnocchi dish my wife had was equally delicious and massive.   As for the dessert the waitress stated that the manager makes all of the desserts and you could tell.  We went with the brownie/cookie combo and it was great.   

Note: If the brownie/cookie was a little warm it would have been over the top.


Con:  For a place with great food and service, I would have expected some freshly shaved cheese and ground pepper for the dishes.  Not a deal breaker, but an easy touch that just adds to the service and flavor.

THE SERVICE:  Our waitress (Lauren I believe) was excellent.  There were a lot of specials and she knew them all off the top of her head.  She was very attentive and the support staff was very quick to replace silverware and dishes.  She also dealt with my fussy father in law pretty well, so we appreciated that.  

Con:  Our one gripe (which my wife convinced me to downgrade from a 5 to a 4) was with the host when we walked in.  We showed up at 5 on Sunday without a reservation.  

This is when it got weird.   

We were told we had two options...

1)  A table with a reservation at 6:15
2) A table with a reservation at 7:15

Ok... so what are you telling me?  I have to be finished and gone by this time or what?  

It was just very off putting.  

It's fine, just don't give us the table and we'll come back another time.  I've never been put in that position that I felt rushed to finish by a time.  

Just very odd.

When we did sit we were put at a table where the managers were doing their paperwork for the restaurant.  Sort of annoying to my wife but it didn't bother me as much.

Overall that's my experience.  

The decor is a bit kitschy in my opinion and I think the name is kind of odd, but let's face it, we are there for the food and the service... both of which were as good as any other place in Collingswood.

Hopefully I can bump this up to a 5 on my next visit.

The ambiance and decor very pleasant on a Sunday 6 pm.  Reservation perfectly retrieved. The samosa [2] appetizer comes with attractive very delicious generous delicately and complex spiced warmed chutney.  One of Veggies option of Brussels sprouts overly salty. OMG butter chicken was better than excellent for its very flavorful sauce, and a very generous portion.  Turmeric basmati rice very nice accompanying omg chicken sauce. Service was fair served by a waitress with kitchen items served hot by kitchen staff.  Tables set up with water in bottles,  metal serving plates and wrapped eating implements in place at table.  Non-padded seating none the less very comfortable curved wood.  Chef with highly esteemed reputation for her food very justified by our experience.  Shared dinner with Gujarati Patel couple for their first meal at the site.  Parking is very close, free and accessible behind venues  at Charlotte at 40th Avenue north .  We shall return for another round of OMG butter chicken and their so delicious chutney/lentil-potato samosas and further menu exploration. Enjoy!!!

This place is great, came for lunch one day, returned for dinner and lunch again following day, couldn't get enough! Very reasonably priced, friendly service and delicious. 
Menu is customer friendly and a cozy little outdoor area along with nice indoor seating.
Highly reccomended.

I'm a regular here at Miller's. I remember when this location was Smokey Bones which was horrible. Anyway, I got here around 4pm on a Saturday afternoon with a friend. Hostess was friendly. Instead of waiting for twenty minutes for a booth, we opted for a high top table in their terrace/additional seating area. The restaurant seating area was packed while our area was slowly filling in with all the college football fans wandering in. 

We had a seat. There only seemed to be one server in the area so it took him about six minutes to realize we were there. I ordered my favorite, draft of Angry Orchard beer and my friend had a regular margarita. We chatted for a while,looked over the menu and half of my beer was gone before we could place an order. Smh. Sheesh. We finally ordered our food. I ordered the fish tacos which were awesome. No complaints at all. Friend ordered chicken quesadillas. 

Honestly I love sports bars and this one is my favorite simply because of their huge beer selection! Food is good as far as appetizers. Their regular menu items get a slight nod of approval. Weren't the best entrees. But then again I don't go to a sports bar for a Great entree. The service needs a slight boost though.

I really enjoy places that try and stay local. First the line was outside the door at lunch time and parking isn't the easiest either.  The menu is creative but familiar at the same time. I tried the Italian which was delicious.  The bread and the meats we're top quality. I also saw they make certain sodas in house and had to try the strawberry ginger mint yummy is all I can say. Definitely  try when you're  in town.
Amazing good , super accomodative of food restrictions. If you around the area should definitely try it :) friendly staff too

This place is amazing!!!!!!! I'm so happy they have a new place on Davis island that came up to every expectation, staff is amazing food was incredible can't wait to be back tomorrow? Thanks Dean for being so awesome!

This review is specific to the Mother's Day Brunch.  

We always enjoyed this restaurant previously.  The food is always great & was very good on this occasion. 

However, we were really disappointed with the Mother's Day Brunch.  I understand brunch isn't usually part of your offerings, but to not have a kids' menu at 10:15am on Mother's Day (aside from the lunch/dinner) was a huge miss for us. 

I am sure this is a very busy day but instead of enjoying a leisurely brunch we were in & out in less than 40 minutes.  Our bread had barely cooled off before we were served our entrees.  Well, almost all the entrees. My food showed up about five minutes after everyone else's. 

When you are heading out for a special day & open to spending a bit more than usual for a Sunday brunch, I guess I just expected a bit more effort.

Now this is the definition of a gastropub. The food is adapted from owners food truck days to be some delicious invitation to dining. And don't forget a great take on mixed cocktails. 
What do I suggest? Everything. Take your pick. Decide what meat you're  in the mood for may help lead you in the right direction, but there is absolutely no wrong direction. 
The stinky buns are NOT stinky. They are a little sticky and a lot amazing. Even, surprisingly, actually shockingly... The zucchini one was superb as well.  
Just stop reading and go and enjoy.

I wish I could rate this Little Caesars on their pizzas, but I can't. I have stopped by several times over the last couple of months and have yet to get a pizza. I have ordered a "Hot and Ready Lunch Special" only to be told "We don't serve those after 2:00pm, 3:00pm", "We're out of them now". And today I was told ( at 1:15pm) it would be 10 to 15 min wait. When I asked" I thought you had them Hot n Ready" I was told "Oh, that's weekdays only". 
So, as much as I do enjoy Little Caesars pizzas, it seems I CANNOT ever get one at this location. 
Good luck trying to get the special.

We shared "a flight" last night. We chose Chocolate covered Mango, Home Means Nevada, Cookie Roulette, Honey Sesame, Strawberry Lemonade Sorbet and Salted Butterscotch. What a great way to share and try some of the many offerings here. I loved the "Home Means Nevada". I'm a tea drinker and I'd pair this with Afternoon Tea.  The Strawberry Lemonade Sorbet was smooth, light and tasted just like a delicious cup I'd enjoy on a hot summer evening watching a beautiful sunset.

We had a bad experience here last Saturday night. On Sunday the owner Cory actually called me. He heard about the problem from his staff and was very apologetic. He invited us back for dinner on him to make things right. We went last night. The staff was very accommodating and the food was delicious. We enjoyed everything from the appetizer to the dessert. Cory came out to meet us after dinner and was charming. I am glad we had the opportunity to eat here and will go back. I would recommend Colonial to others for their food, atmosphere and service.

I love every dishes we ordered. The foods are absolutely delicious. Friendly owner and staff, reasonable price, big portions, clean place, and easy to find a parking. It's BYOB. Highly recommend, I think it's the best Thai restaurant I try so far in PA. Will definitely come back again :)

1.5 stars

2 stars for food
1 star for service

Drove over 30 mins to get here while on vacation and as first timers, I was confused when walking in. I was ushered to the back to look at a menu and was told it'd be 10 mins for a table. Two tables opened up and we walked over to grab one (two adults and a 1 year old) and we were basically scolded into squishing into a bench-style table with another mom and her baby. Her son was throwing a fit and their coats were taking up the entire bench. I definitely think they are not kid friendly and frown upon kiddos in their restaurant. 

Anyways, we ordered at the counter and the food took over 30 mins to come out. It was COLD. Like, ice cold. No one refilled our waters, no one CE around to ask how it was, nada. You refill coffees on your own. It's basically a jazzed up food runner instead of a server. This makes me mad when they have you leave the tip before you see what the food and service are like. 

The 15+ groups of people that came after us were greeted with a smile, an explanation of how to order, and -suprise- were allowed to sit anywhere there was an open table. 

The food was gross (breakfast sandwich, porkroll, 2 egg meal, kids sausage and eggs) the service was absolutely horrendous, and the table was sticky from syrup. We left 75% of our food and called it a day. Definitely wouldn't give them another shot, even if it was free.
Ribs are good. Their signature t bones lack flavor and quality. Service was good.

Cool location right by all of the action on the part of State Street that is closest to the pier. Not near the pier, but up across the freeway and right there! Old school type establishment right in the heart of the action. Bartenders excellent and friendly, servers the same. Hors d'oeuvres were the artichoke but hardly any meat. The brown squaw bread was great, mashed potatoes great old school no skins in them, just a bunch of butter., scallops excellent, but the New York pepper steak a bit tough. Should have ordered the filet mignon pepper steak. Definitely will come back again.

Yummy! What goes better with a cold beer than some flavorful tacos? The Pinches truck is now built in to Borderlands and it's great to have some food options here. We opted to share some Carne Asada tacos and they were delicious! Flavorful meat with that crispy griddled cheese - yum. I would definitely call these rich but ours were not overly greasy. Top it off with some salsa (really good, with a kick!) or guac and chase with some beer for a really yummy bite. The tacos come with a small bag of chips, which was also a nice touch. Would gladly enjoy these again next time we're popping in for beer!

Great food. We all enjoyed the ambiance of the building and the waitress was fantastic 

Would highly recommend for the price point.

Amazing! My co-workers and I came here for dinner and shared many plates of tapas. Everything was a hit! Especially delicious were the mussels, the croquets, truffle sauce on hangar steak, whipped sheep cheese, and flourless chocolate cake. I'm probably forgetting some! 

This is a fantastic spot for a group that enjoys family style.

I accidentally ordered from this location and it turned out to be fine. The only con was the cinnamon bread sticks were stale and they reheated them up... Was not happy about that. Everything else was good. Ed the delivery guy was friendly.
Fish was so good! Grits were a bit bland but atmosphere was so good! Live music is a bonus as well! Family owned establishment!

Love this place. Its like my own little personal hide out spot. Its quiet during the week during happy hour most days. The staff is always very nice and will spark up convo with you. Food is great. Especially the wings...my goodness the WINGS!
Just came back from here (25 min drive) with takeout and had a little bit- again, so so good! Definitely worth it, can't wait to bring some home again!

We went to Yaquis late on a Friday to get some pizza. Very cool, eclectic little place with an interesting band playing. Piano, tuba, horn and bass...not what we expected to stumble upon but we were glad we did! The sangria was very good, my husband loved the chili and the pizza was awesome! They had some unique offerings, we got the Cinco de Queso. So good! Not sure why I'd never thought to put blue cheese on a pizza myself. We will return, I'd like to try the brunch.

My favorite breakfast destination. The Oatmeal is fantastic.  Allot of thought  has gone into the operations of this restaurant. One of the best restaurant operators in Tampa. Beautiful environment and a great service culture prevails at one of Tampa's landmark restaurants.

Had a great time at dinner Friday night!  I'll definitely return.

Things we loved:

Drinks: The cocktail list has a nice variety of specialty items named for Grateful Dead songs.  In the end, we went for the house margaritas.  They were really fresh tasting, none of that sticky overly syrupy from a bottle pre-made mix.  Not too strong, but definitely a hit!

Food: We started with the guac.  Decent portion, perfect for three to share.  It was creamy, yet still had decent "chunks" of avocado.  Chips were good and crunchy.
For dinner, my boyfriend opted for the vegetable tacos with eggplant, squash and potatoes.  They are served three to an order on small flour tortillas.  My friend and I then shared the chicken enchilada and the fish tacos.  The enchilada was good, but would have been better had we not requested sauce on the side.  The verde sauce was my favorite.  It was a little thicker than I've had in the past, but was fresh tasting with a nice subtle kick.  The mole was ok, but had a hint of anise that I didn't really care for as it overwhelmed the chocolatey flavor I love about mole.  The fish tacos were phenomenal!  I feel like I'm often disappointed by fish tacos because they're either all beer-batter in flavor or no crunch and all fish.  La Calaca Feliz gets it right on the money.  The batter is made with tortilla and plantain chips so it's crunchy and full of flavor, but the fish stays moist and flavorful inside.  I could not recommend them more!  I also had a side of sweet plantains -- nice balance between the sweetness of the plantains and the salty queso fresco.

Atmosphere: They're really done a great job with the interior.  The murals are awesome, the teal/pool blue wall color is bright and cheery.  Illuminaire's dining room often felt uncomfortable, like you were dining on display.  Somehow, with a few tweaks to the seating layout, it's now really cozy.

Things we didn't love:
The transformation of the nook in the front into a waiting area was a great idea.  I'd love to see some slim stools in the area so you could sit and wait.  Also some hooks for coats/bags would keep the slip bar that borders the area free for drinks and appetizers.
The bar service was not as strong at the dining area.  They were just a little less approachable and inviting.

Overall, great food and drinks, awesome spot, and the service was spot-on (Margaret was fantastic and answered a ridiculous amount of questions!).  They definitely planned carefully in order to have a successful launch, and it shows!

I have hard a time finding authentic Vietnames restaurant this one is good, they have all the soups, beef ribs and alot of other selections. The servers are very friendly enjoyed my meal. They also have lunch specials.
Delicious food! Quick service! Definitely fresh food with different choices then the regular breakfast diner!

This is a restaurant that I would nominate for an episode of Restaurant Impossible, if that show was still around. The decor is old, dark, and dated--fake Tiffany lampshades, a fountain in the middle surrounded by dying plants and 50's Musak on an endless loop.

The Sicilian pizza was super skimpy on the toppings--on par with Little Cesar's. The sausage was weird, tasteless oblong discs. The sad draft beer selection offerings were two styles of Dos XX, two domestic brews, one Italian beer and a fake microbrew--Blue Moon (Miller).

The one positive was a very friendly staff member. She was smiling and helpful at the counter where you ordered, but we never saw her again. You get called over a loudspeaker to pick up your pie sitting on the kitchen pass-through.

Just keep driving.....

Great Food , usually a wait, but worth it. I like the
Potato Leaves and The Lamb w/ Rice. Great comfort food and  healthy! I just wish they would add more Meat to their platters, but flavors are out of this world.... Delicious.

We are so happy to have this new jewel
In town. The Pastrami Torta was delicious and big enough to split among two people. We also had the Pozzole soup which was a perfect compliment to the Torta on a cold winter afternoon. The service was prompt and The owner and the staff were very friendly. Look forward to going back with friends again. 
Also, it's worth noting that this place is pet friendly and carries wine and beer. I love the transformation of this part of town with all these new shops and restaurants.
Great New York style food in the Reading Terminal Market

We went to Luna Bella on a Friday night, and it was relatively busy. This was my second visit, and although I am usually more adventurous, I was in the mood for an old-fashioned pasta dish. I was in the right place for such a craving, since Luna Bella's menu has a wide selection of pasta, from fettuccine alfredo to linguine with clams. Luna Bella does pasta right, too; my dish was generous in size, cooked al dente, and the ingredients were obviously fresh. The meatballs in my dish were especially delicious. The only downside of the meal was the appetizer we started with. We ordered the bacon-wrapped prawn appetizer, and for 10.50, we got 2 prawns. That, to me, is ridiculous. I will return to Luna Bella for the entrees (the first time, I had steak, which was as large and delicious as the pasta), but I will definitely skip the appetizer.

I have eaten here twice over the last couple of weeks and I was pleasantly surprised. We were referred to this restaurant through our friend, whose parents recommended it to him. The first time we went as a group, and I was impressed with the atmosphere and the food, as well as the wine selection. I used to go to Sabor Divino for a good steak and nice atmosphere, until they started getting mediocre as they gained popularity. Bistecca was much better. The servers are very attentive, there is a diverse menu, and the food is fabulous. 

After such a positive experience the first time, I decided to go back for my birthday last night. It was different as we were going on a date just the two of us and it was very romantic. I couldn't have chosen a better place to celebrate an occasion. We received the same excellent service and food and they surprised me with some moscato for my celebration. 

Whether I am going with friends, or just with my husband on a special date, I will be back, and I recommend it to anyone else looking for a reasonable fine dining experience.

This place is super cute (although in a super shady part of town) and I was happy to try it. All of the small plates my group got were excellent (I could have eaten ten servings of the fried artichokes!) and my flatiron steak with broccoli was fabulous. However I have two complaints: one, this place has an unbearably loud noise level. I guess it's the mechanics of the structure but I found it intolerable and it turned my headache into a full on migraine. When I go back, it will have to be on the patio. Not sure if there are any ways to mitigate noise? Second, and this is is not huge, but they only had 3 entrees to choose from. I did love the steak but it would be nice to have more entree options if you don't want to be sharing a bunch of small plates with your friends.

I love this place! amazing atmosphere, great service, and just an overall feeling like you are a part of their family. as far as pizza goes, their regular pie is out of this world. I love how thin it is, so you can eat more without feeling guilty!;) and get the chocolate sundae for dessert... just trust me!

I highly recommend the hot habanero burrito, lots of carne asada, fries, it's spicy but tolerable and tastes so good! I wish they'd put a location closer into town! I'd come in more often. I've never been let down when I've driven 45 minutes to pick up a fresh made burrito!
I love their charbroiled chicken sandwiches. It's the only thing I eat there. hehe

This is our family go-to Mexican "fast food" take out place. The ingredients are always fresh. Food is quick, good and cheap. We like their carne asada burritos and fish taco. Their carne asada is very filling without cheese nor beans which I like. The sauce of fish taco bind the fried fish and lettuce and salsa well. The fresh tortilla is always a plus.

Ate here twice. First time, I was pleasantly surprised with my chicken burrito on jalepeno cheddar tortilla. Second time I was grossed out by my steak burrito on honey wheat tortilla. A burrito should be consistent. So 2 stars is my review.

I haven't even placed an order with this establishment and the woman on the phone has me livid. She hung up on me twice b/c I was asking her about Birria tacos - I asked her what days do they offer them, since she said they only make them on certain days - she advised just the weekends, before I could find something else to order, she hung up again. Now why on earth are they on the menu as an option if it's something that is only offered twice a week? Shouldn't the menu advise this? Yes it should.

I work in Westchase and am always on the hunt for good Sushi. Zen and Samurai Blue are closer than Origami but I'd make the drive for Origami before going back to either of the other joints. 

They've got a good lunch special. You can get 2 rolls, salad and soup for under $10. I went with my mom and we got one lunch special with spicy tuna and tampa rolls and (due to recommendations from Yelp) the scorched earth roll. The miso is flavorful but a little light on the wakame and tofu. The basic rolls were solid but the scorched earth roll- WOWZA. The menu describes it as tuna, salmon, yellowtail, escolar, tilapia, krab stick, avocado, cucumber, crunch, scallion, spicy mayo and sesame seeds. I called it a volcano rolls on crack. It's 2 California rolls with tuna, salmon, yellowtail, escolar and tilapia in spicy mayo resting on top. I don't recommend you get it with someone you're not comfortable having to unhinge your jaw in front of. I haven't had anything quite like it. It's expensive at $14 a roll but it would be more than enough for me to eat as a meal. I could even share it if I started with soup. It's beautifully presented as well.

I guess I would recommend getting a reservation for lunch. We got the last table that wasn't reserved. Plan on sitting at the Sushi bar if you go on a whim. The service was good but a little slow. However I expected this when I saw how crowded there were. They've got a lot of great looking speciality rolls, all beautifully presented. I look forward to going back and trying more!

This restaurant was extremely disappointing. Size of the portions is very small.  that included the tacos, the rice bowl and the nachos were awful. There was hardly any meat and the tortilla chips were stale. This is going to be a one and done. Sorry I hope they find someone that likes their food and the size of their portions but it's not me

My family & I were visiting from California & we came across this beautiful restaurant. The ambiance from outside caught our eye of course. ~ We were immediately greeted by the friendly staff and even though it was busy, we were seated in less than 10 mins. We ordered an array of dishes as we were all going to share. The hot plates were delicious & the sushi was creative & artistic. This is something we'd see back home in California. Definitely going back to MiAn next time we visit. Five Stars!!!

I've been coming here for nearly 2 decades, and the food is AMAZING. Like CONSISTENTLY amazing. The service is crazy fast and super friendly, I would honestly give them 5,000 stars if I could. I love Pueblo, keep it up!
This place is awesome!! Second time here and I feel like a regular. Tasty food, great drink specials and awesome staff!!

My partner and I were here for DevourIndy. We made a reservation for pretty early and glad we did since the place started getting super busy as we were leaving. 
Tommy and Matteo (I hope I remembered their names correctly, took to long to write this review) took care of us, and what a great job they did! They were both super tentative but also knew how to give us space to enjoy our meal and drinks. Tommy was so knowledgeable and friendly. He gave us some great wine and food suggestions. 
Every single bite we had here was pure deliciousness! Salads we had were very tasty. Salmon dish was delish but the star of the night was the mushroom risotto with scallops (added for extra $$). 
We are new to the city and this quickly became our favorite place so far! We are excited to go back for the post covid time.

Went for a sunday brunch. Got to sit outside by the band. The Brunch Buffet is massive, and covers everything from eggs to jambalaya to desserts. Granted it's a wee bit swampy in New Orleans, but they keep the water coming, and the brunch drinks help keep you cool. I wish I had gone there less hungover, but I had plenty to eat, and the eating was good.
Great customer service, I was seated right away and asked what I wanted to drink shortly after.  The portions are very generous with this delicious food. I would definitely recommend the place.

First, let me say this place is super-super fast! From the time I was seated (around 7pm) to the time I received my food, it was only about 10 minutes tops! The food was very hot and didn't give off the microwave vibe so no idea how that was even possible. The waitress was quick with the food and the bill. Also a plus! However, the taste of the food was meh. I ordered something that was quick (chicken tenders and mashed potatoes) since I had to grab a fight, but there was nothing that really stood out in flavor. The double mashed potatoes actually had some strangely unidentifiable ingredients to them and, for the most part, were not eaten. Kind of a sawdust like consistency. The lady next to me has ordered my first choice ( a salad with chicken), but I could tell by looking at her plate that the lettuce was the bagged produce kind. She didn't eat much of it either! So if you need fast, 5 stars! If you need awesome, or at least "really tasty" and you have the time, keep on walking. I am sure there are a few better options.

Can't speak for other locations but customer service/milk tea at this location is not good...entered the store with one customer in front of me.  The customer ordered her drink and a few minutes later the assistant called out her order number and left.  Then they started making several orders, wasn't sure if they just had uber orders that were in front of me so I waited ...and waited...and waited ...I ordered a taro milk tea and a red bean drink with boba...was waiting for my order number to be called or something light purple to appear...nope nothing.  Had to approach the counter to ask if my order is ready and one of the girl behind the counter asked if I'm with uber... mind you I literally been in the store the whole time...from ordering to waiting ...stood in the same spot. Kicker was my drinks were ready prob 5 mins prior to me approaching the counter...they just never called out my number.  The drinks look nothing like what I expected the taro was a cappuccino color and the red bean was literally just white milk with some red beans at the bottom.  Taste wise absolutely no taro taste...zero ...why did I pay 5$ for sweeten milk ??? Never again.
Great place and solid food.  Interior could use a little updating but otherwise no complaints.  Very reliable place to eat or to have a party.
Best BBQ I have had in a long time. Could eat the ribs without adding sauce, but the sauces were all great. Potato salad and put beans we're amazing

Great burgers and great prices. Always always crowded. Not enough sitting room inside. The brown tissue paper they use to wrap the burger (goes on before the white wrapper) I think is unnecessary because it blends in with the bun and gets eaten! 
Very clean and friendly atmosphere.

The food here is identical to that available at every other McDonald's on this planet, which I enjoy.

The service, however, is terrible. My latest experience involved ordering several meals at the drive-through and being shorted 2 cheeseburgers. Given my long experience with this McDonald's location, I did not pull away until we had completely checked our order. The young man at the window seemed unsurprised that our order was wrong. While he did promptly produce the unfilled portion of our order, he did not apologize.
Delicious food and dessert. The selection of desserts is very large. I always have a hard time choosing what to order. I love the sugar cookies and cupcakes.
I loved the place. Good food, good people. It didn't break the bank and we left FULL.

This sushi is amazing! We have been ordering "whatever Teru suggests" for years now, starting back at his Sakana days. Not only does he deliver the most delicious sushi experience, he takes the time to remember what his locals love the most and incorporates that into the next dining experience. On top of it all, he's a fun person to talk to and get to know!

If this is your first time at Teru's, do yourself a favor and order whatever sushi/nigiri he recommends that day. You won't regret it.

Not what to expect when going to the mall but Lure is a beautiful spot for chilling in the patio for appetizers and drinks or dining with the wide variety fish selection menu. Exceptional five star service and ambiance. What a pleasant surprise !

Absolutely AMAZING service and the BEST gluten free breadsticks I've ever had. In fact, I've never had a gluten free productive so soft and fluffy. The gluten free pasta left a little to be desired, might have been undercooked. Overall definitely a place I would visit again.

Honestly, meh. Location is cool, I really enjoyed watching the planes come and go. The food was not good. We ordered the cheese fondue. It came out cold and was clearly just alfredo sauce that they were passing off as fondue, or trying to at least. Food was in serious need of S & P, or really just any flavor for that matter. Incredibly expensive for the quality we received. Maybe we just came on an off day, idk ... but we won't be back.
Super good food, super great prices. Small dining area or you can take it to go. Everyone was friendly and there was so many options, authentic and so good!

Don't let the location intimidate you, Oxford Exchange provides a phenomenal atmosphere and delivers a delicious meal through their high quality ingredients and attention to detail. The restaurant is located between Downtown and the Hyde Park area. I follow them on IG, I've seen their venue published in wedding blogs and their food has won local awards... but I had never been because parking downtown can be hard to find. As the location is on the outskirts of downtown, the parking was  surprisingly convenient. There are many side streets and lots to find a free space. It wasn't the big ordeal I had built up in my mind. 

The quality of the food is top notch and the professionalism of the staff is superior to their peers in the area. The servers and front hosts were accommodating and genuine. My visit was for a weekday breakfast but I can only imagine how impressive they must be with special events.

A short review / explanation aimed at the tasteless, grossed-out non-St. Louisans:

Instead of mozzarella - universally and un-originally used in every pizza from coast-to-coast, including your grocer's freezer - Imo's uses Provel, which is a delicious, 100% processed cheese blend presented by God as a gift to His Favored City, St. Louis. Read up:

http://en.wikipedia.or...

If Provel ain't your thing....go home.

Great organic market during our trip to Santa Barbara. Great assortment of fresh and staple items. They have a nice select of organic health and beauty including several of my favorite brands which was helpful since I left a few things at home. 

Nice selection of fresh flowers and local items. We partook in a number of local wines while we stayed within walking distance. 

The location was great for us as we could walk to pick up what we needed. The staff was friendly the three times we visited. They directed me to several items I asked about and were friendly talking to my 7 year old daughter when we checked out.
Great fresh sushi. My favorite spot in town. Staff is always welcoming and nice. Also very quick to fulfill our order, even when we have a huge group of people.

Very good for a nice casual dinner or we went for a date night. The service was great and very friendly. The place is small and quaint, but not at all to its detriment. Appetizers, main course (get the prime rib!), sides...everything was really great. And you absolutely can't beat the quality for the price. Would definitely recommend a dinner here and will probably be going back at some point.

Beware- YELP gives incorrect directions!! We called  and got correct directions and it was worth it!!  Owner was very accommodating and friendly! Terrific sandwiches. Tried to go back before we headed out of town in Tuesday but looks like it was closed. Delicious food, we ll be back!!
Coming from a FOODIE, I will say save your money and go somewhere else.  The food is good, the service is PISS POOR.  Long wait times and low quality staff for price point of food.

This is my first visit back to this Hooters since the big remodel.  They were very busy on a Saturday afternoon (good sign) but the experience suffered.  When we walked in the two hostesses had their backs to the door so we just stood there until the manager quickly found a seat for us.  Ordered drinks, but the tap was out so we ordered a back up beer.  The beer took almost ten minutes and came canned, the waitress kind of dumped it on the table and a manager came by behind her with glasses.  

You could tell they were backlogged and the bar was having issues because we heard tables around us experiencing the same thing.  Another 15 minutes went by and I had to flag down our girl to place our order and then she ran off quickly.

Overall, the food came out as OK (although my salad was a bit wilty and sad) and pretty quick, but we were there almost 30 minutes before I was able to get our order in.  I know our girl was making up for problems at the bar, but she was not attentive at all.  Will try the beach location next time.
Great selection of meats, and the service was perfect. Asked us if we wanted more of any specific cut. The price is great too. Much better than Fogo.
Food and drinks are fresh and delicious. Not a big fan of their cakes. I had a slice of the funfetti cake and it was dry and dense.

Great place for big groups!! You have the ability to make a reservation or walk in... we walked in around 6-7 pm on a Saturday & it wasn't that busy. So a perfect place to go to when all other restaurants are fully booked! It's pretty easy to get a table since they're not that crowded! It was nice that they had live music- added a lovely touch to the restaurant! Food was alright... it was good, but nothing spectacular. They don't have anything vegetarian on the menu, but they are able to make items on the menu vegetarian. For example, the waitress said she really liked the BLT but instead of bacon, add avocado. I got the oyster club without meat (weird I know) but it was actually really good! It'd be nice if they added vegetarian items to the menu. The staff are all very friendly and accommodating! The service was really slow though... our waitress would show up a bunch of times at once, and then disappear for a long time. She had another big table though so maybe that's why? Unusually slow service though. The place is two stories & very spacious. Not overly loud too.

Wildly unsafe as far as covid goes. Non of the bartenders wearing masks. Packed room with no social distance. One out of three servers wearing masks. Mangers with maske around their chins. Just ridiculous lack of safety.
Not what I expected at all.. The food is under seasoned, and the staff act like they we're tired, even a little rude.

My husband and I had a great dining experience! We were celebrating my birthday and I had a delicious medium steak and my husband had some super tasty rainbow trout! 

Shout out to Tony for being an AMAZING waiter and taking care of us on such a busy Saturday night. The owner is super nice as well and ensures that everyone is happy with their service!  

There was an extremely aggravated couple beside us who tried to cause a scene because the woman's steak was a little undercooked. She demanded a brand new steak and cussed at the owner and the waiter.  

At any other establishment, large chain or family owned, they're going to offer to cook your steak longer. Not get you a brand new one. Steak isn't cheap and cooking one a little longer isn't going to hurt you or the food. She was going to put A1 on the steak anyways and ruin it.  The owner was awesome in handling the situation! We will definitely be back!

Possibly the best bagel I have ever had in my life. I'm flying home to Texas this afternoon and I bought some extra ones to stash in my luggage! Place could use a little freshening up, new ceiling tiles and some touch up paint on the chairs would make a difference. But no denying that these bagels are amazing!

My family ate at Magpies last night for the first time since the makeover. What a lovely change! We stopped eating in when they changed their beer selection because it was very limited. I read that after the remodel they expanded the bar so we gave them another chance. I'm so happy we did! In the past the service had always been not bad, but not very good. Friendly, but slow and lackluster. Our server Theresa was the best we've ever had at Magpies. We immediately received menus, then drinks. We were thrilled to be able to get Dos Equis again! The kids were given balls of dough to shape while we waited for the pizzas. After dinner the dough creations were presented to my girls baked and dusted with cinnamon sugar. Delicious, like a hot cinnamon roll. Onto the pizzas. Husband and I split a Magnificent Giant, as always my idea of the best deluxe pizza in town. Pepperoni, Italian sausage, bell peppers, onions, olives and mushrooms. Classic combination done perfectly every time. The kids shared a half bacon half cheese pizza. Lots of cheese and nice crispy bacon. Theresa boxed up our leftovers for us and we were able to pay very quickly. The owner had stopped by our table to tell us about their new yogurt place next door. Of course we had to try it, but that's another review entirely!
Food was great and staff was awesome. Came with a family with 2 girls 10 and 7 during Sunday football. They loved the atmosphere and liked all of the Packer fans.
The service was bad, no one came to take our drink order til about 10 mins in. Then we waited a little over and hour for our pizza, that was under cooked. I wanted to like this place but I just can't

Simply amazing bites. Just strolling and located this gem of taco goodness. I will revisit again soon to try more options. The El pastor tacos we're delicious for starters. You can sit indoor or outdoor based on your desires.

I really wanted to like Ulele. The flavors were not there. 
While waiting for our table I was drooling over the menu. Everything sounded so good. The inside of ulele is beautiful. A bit industrial but classy. I love it. 
The service was good. Waiter was very efficient, nice, and knowledgeable. 
When our food came out it looked beautiful. The first bit was a totally disappointment. No flavor in any of the tables dishes. 
I got the flank steak with avocado Chimichurri and grilled veggies. My steak came out raw, still cold. I wanted it medium rare. After sending it back, it came back medium well. Anyway, it wasn't great. Pretty boring. Chimichurri did nothing to help it. Asparagus was really thick, too hard, too boring. Everything needed a healthy dose of salt. 
My boyfriend got a bunch of sides. Baked squash was so boring-could have made something way better at home. Jalapeño cornbread was dry and also flavorless. Mac and cheese was fine, but nothing special. 
They have the space, and their wait staff down, but the food is lacking big time. I might try Ulele again once they have more time to improve.

Me and my dad have been going to OTA for a long time it it a nice place to refresh after a long bike ride it is also so close to the harbor you can look out and feel the cool breeze and sometimes even see a seal the food is really good. My favorite is the breakfast burrito the only thing that I don't like is that they only have seats out side with one long community table in the hot beating sun

Tried delivery as it is a rare Chinese place that delivers here....I got dumplings and those were of course good. The actual General Tso's and fried rice was terrible....the chicken was so crispy it was inedible. The rice was just greasy. I ended up throwing almost all of it away and I felt bad for having wasted the money.
Awesome atmosphere, awesome food, awesome people, awesome music, awesome beer! What more could you ask for? Prost! :)

EH??
Well, here it goes. I tried. I really really tried. I just don't get this place. 

For starters, this is Reno. Trying to get too fancy in Reno just doesn't work. I had 3 things on the menu. The title/descriptions for the words were so oddball I don't even remember them now. One had pork in it, the other chicken and the desert had chocolate.

I do remember our server acting as if us being in the restaurant and in his omnipotent presence should have been enough. Umm...scuz moi if that's just not good enough for little old me. I came here to eat, not to be put down my a dude in tshirts and jeans who charges $78 for a plate of dinky ass, tough chewy pork. The chicken dish was a bit better but so damn bland I bet if my dog were there should wouldn't even want it.

Like I said, I was jazzed to eat here but having to bring a dictionary with me so I can dechipher a menu is just plain f'n annoying. 

I later found out our "waiter" was the owner. I should have known.

I still only left him a $1.00 tip. See, I"m not totally heartless!!

In my opinion, save your dough and go eat somewhere else...hell...for the same damn price...charter a f'n jet and go eat at mcdonalds in san fran. Better food, same price.

Small, friendly BYOB. I like the loud, busy atmosphere of this place. Our waitress was friendly and quickly explained that the menu changes frequently so it is written on the chalkboard wall. We had a pear,onion and brie flat bread special as a shared appetizer, it was good, and that might just sum up this place "good, but not great". I enjoyed my Salmon and the pork chop my companion had was very good, moist and tender and quite a large portion. One person in our party had the fillet and it was a bit overcooked, and the crab cakes looked more like crab croquettes. The chocolate chip cheesecake was very good, light and tasty. Unfortunately nothing here really stood out as special. The menu is very small and not very inventive and I do think it was a bit expensive.

OK we just had coffee there for some coffee after the Portuguese festival. (a whole other story) anyway, the place is kinda funky and  had a movie theme to it. I didn't really see what they had as far as food or frozen desserts so i will have to go back and do more research. The things I do for you all! hah!

We went here for a late lunch on the recommendation of our Uber driver. It was ok, not great -- I've had better in Atlanta and even my home state of Michigan. I'd try a different bar-b-que next time I'm in town.

Stopped serving breakfast after I stood in the TSA line for an hour. I know it's not their fault, but I saw a delicious looking breakfast sandwich on their menu and this really got my hopes up at 10:18, when they stop serving at 10:00am. Why can't everywhere be like McDonald's and have breakfast all day? Is it simply a lot to ask? I love that stuff...anywho, this place had mini pizzas for 9 bucks. It's essentially a slightly tastier, way more expensive Celeste pizza...you know the ones they have in your local grocery store for 10 for 10 bucks. Decent quick eat, in an airport...I kinda expected it. So they got me. The woman working was super nice though and honestly made the experience worth my 9 bucks because she actually served me with a smile. It was crazy!!! Thank you lady, and I appreciate you as you seem to appreciate my business.
Thanks for the awesome service, Dana Marie! Nashville hot chicken was delicious! We will be back to see you!  Great spot with fun bands!
Awesome! The Genoa is an amazing sub, and their homemade potato salad sells out QUICK! Great prices, fast service, and run by some of the nicest folks :)

This is some of the best Korean in town! I have never been disappointed at Mama's. Excellent quality, reasonably priced and the side dishes! The kimchi is just beautiful, the sauteed bok choy, the bulgogi....delicious! Give it a try!

I remember enjoying the Melting Pot chain years ago.  Not any more.  It is insanely overpriced, for one.  For two of us we spent $100 before tip and that was with a special going on.  Plus it takes forever!  Especially this most recent visit.  That was due in large part to very slow (and poor) service. Due to a forecast ice storm the place was practically empty but it still took a half hour to get our beverages after we ordered.  

Some reviews talk about this being a romantic spot.  That's only true if you find the sight of your significant other trying to stab raw chicken with a dull fondue fork sexy.  Or the sound of children having sword fights with their fondue forks at the table next to yours.  

If you really want to try it, just go for the fondue with stale bread or dessert.  Just be sure to wear something that wont get stained by drippy chocolate.

I ate at Alma de Cuba once, The best part of the restaurant was the Ceviche and the fried plantains. I did not feel that my entree was cook as well as it could have been and the atmosphere feels far to simple and plain. When your spending about 35 dollars on an entree the meal should be perfect and I feel the did not succeed.

Great restaurant off the beaten path with an emphasis on local, seasonal food and innovative cocktails. There are many menu items with New Orleans flare as well as a few outside of that cuisine. I had the vegi farmers plate with tofu and it was not only delicious but very refreshing after a vacation filled with deep fried oysters, soft shell crab and creamy everything. Our party of 4 sat outside and loved the ambiance. Cocktails were delicious.

I was really excited about Festiva. I love Mexican food and divey looking places. The porch is plastic wrapped and quaint, which is where we sat. I'll start by saying we really, really enjoyed our margaritas. That being said, our server was a little pushy as we decided on less food rather than more, and was a little bit of a know it all when we ordered one more item, saying, "I told you you'd need more." Okay, fine. 

I thought the pork would be amazing, but I've definitely had better. We also ordered the poblano, which was good but not legendary. That being said, we had a plate of tacos, an appetizer, and a few rounds of drinks that landed me a $96 bill for two people. Just didn't seem worth it to me. Probably won't be back unless someone else is buying.

Terrible service for the 20 minutes that we were there we only had 5 people we waited to be seated when we were called the hostess tried to sit us in a small booth... with 5 adults and a baby I told her that was to small we stood in the aisle for 5 mins while she just looked around then we were finally seated at a table and we waited for 20 mins and no one ever came to take our drink order. We finally walked out!
Beautiful and elegant accommodations. Spotless. Attentive and friendly service. Across the street from Bern's steakhouse, where we had a delicious meal. Wonderful experience!

Awesome first stop on my trip to Nashville. Really good bbq ribs, pork and brisket, and friendly employees. They have a variety of different sauces. So if you like sweet or if you like spicy they have it.

I stopped in for brunch this morning.  Service was friendly and prompt.  It's a pretty standard diner with decent food.  Management checked on us, which was a nice touch at the end.  I struggled between 3 and 4 stars, more like 3.5, but I rounded up because the service was nice.  Food wasn't very memorable or interesting.
Never had a bad experience here. Best chicken lo mien ever.  Our go to for Chinese in the area.
Who ever the chef was who made the quarter pounders on the night may 17 is the fucking best chef in the world. I got my burger done medium with pickles evenly distributed and cheese perfectly placed.
Super friendly service, adorable and whimsical decor, fantastic treats and drinks. Open for dine in with great air conditioning!

I like the vibe very much! It has a sultry jazz bar atmosphere- one room actually has live music and it's a nice little buppy spot! The food, however, wasn't anything to write home about to be honest. I had the catfish, collard greens, and something else that didn't leave much of a lasting impression. Don't get me wrong it was good, just not great. The staff was nice and friendly (the waitress did forget to bring our oysters but I'm not super upset about it). Overall it was a nice experience. I'll probably go back and try to sit in on the music!

Hmm... what can I say? It's another burger place.
Be prepared to wait and wait for it.
For a little over $7 you get a burger with fresh lettuce pickle and onion no cheese and a few fresh hot crinkle cut fries. Got an appetite? You'll need to shell out over $5 for a second burger - they're not very filling.
No drink included for that either.
It's a good burger, but let's face it there are lots of places that deliver a tasty burger much faster at a better price.  
Negatives? It's crowded, noisy, and very very cold - keep your coat on. Ceiling fans running on the coldest day this winter.
This was also annoying - remember to get napkins and straws before you sit down, they don't put them in the bag or ask if you want any...
Oh yes, clean up your table when you leave.
This is the 3rd time I've been there. With any luck maybe it'll be the last!

Pad Thai is supposed to be the corner stone of any Thai restaurant (especially in the States). I've had it at so many restaurants and have a Thai family member. This was the worst pad Thai I've ever had. The noodles were mushy and almost none existent,  the sauce was way too heavy and the chicken was too thick. They also put way way way too much bean sprouts on top. Bean sprouts are of the most common suspects when it comes to food poisoning. Please do better. People in Seminole Heights deserve a home grown Thai restaurant of quality.

Really amazing service. Knocked off two stars because my food is always cold! The staff is so friendly but I cannot stand cold food. I will always give it another try but until they start serving hot food I don't think I will enjoy it as much as I could

Came here and ordered a dozen raw oysters and onion rings.  The onion rings were lightly battered and crispy just the way I like them.  The oysters were amazing.  Definitely recommend this place as a must try in NOLA.

Great pizza! You can get it by the slice, and it is consistently good, normal pizza. I live close by so I have tried most things on their menu and while nothing is insanely unique or anything, it is a really good reliable corner pizza joint. Oh, except their homemade fried mozzarella.

One of the first places my wife and I went to when we moved to Indianapolis. Great atmosphere; it can be quiet and chilled during the week, or it can be jumping on a Friday night playing pool downstairs. Along with great steaks that melt like butter in your mouth, they have a great selection of local beers like Hoosier Stout to try with your meal in the form of their sampler (my suggestion for those who enjoy good beer and don't want to get hammered). Prices are moderate, and you definitely get what you pay for. We have never had a bad meal there, and remains at the top of our list for a steak night out. If you haven't been, check them out either off of 86th Street or in downtown Indy. Both locations are good. Enjoy, and have a beer for me!
In typical fashion...this place screwed up my order once again.  Pretty sure a BLT has Bacon in it and Tomatoes!

Love this place, lots of selections. I actually prefer this place then downtown. Both place downtown gave my husband a stomach ache. This place is a small place but the meat and fish is fresh and delicious. The staffs here are very nice too. I will be back.
Environment is pretty nice. Seems clean. A little nicer than the take out Chinese. It is convenient.

Very good food and a clean and modern decor.  I had the mole poblano chicken, which is usually my go-to to test how good a Mexican restaurant is and it was very delicious. The menu is very affordable. Around probably $10 per person. I highly recommend this for Mexican food in the Fenton area.

I am not the biggest fan of pizza. That being said, The Carnivore pizza here was delish! What a crust! Almost focaccia like. And the housemade FIG balsamic vinaigrette?!  Don't like figs or vinaigrettes but somehow, together, they were amazing.

This establishment went above my expectations to make a meal for me.  I'm blown away 
No Meat, Dairy, Eggs, wheat, corn, vinegar or prefab dressings.

a steakhouse is a steakhouse.  so it's hard to say whether this should be 4 or 5 stars.

the food was obvs good, but really...how can a steakhouse mess up steak?

did the girl thing and had a petite filet mignon (6 oz).  it was mignon.  comparatively teeny next to the hulking 16 oz. strip & porterhouse but just right for me as a moderate red meat eater.  preferred to have more variety of sides anyway.  snap peas were an unusual touch.

wine list was MORE than reasonable.  the waitress's wine recos were a little questionable so go with what you know if you know.

enjoy your visit to the burbs...

Excellent and authentic Eastern European food. Omg I was taken back to my childhood with my Bobchie's cooking. One thing we had that isn't pictured were the Mushroom Blinchiki. I'm not sure which was my favorite. Make sure you check open table to make reservations and ENJOY. You will not be disappointed. Homemade food from scratch is the best!

Had the panko crusted squid appetizer, fatty tuna and abalone sashimi, and chirashi. The sauce for the squid was a bit over tangy but everything else was spot on. Good mix of fish in the chirashi and the rice was superbly cooked and seasoned. Presentation was simple, dishes came out in a timely manner, and service was responsive and unobstrusive. Decor was plain and unnoteworthy. The menu was extensive and warrants a revisit. Not a place for a special occasion but definitely for a good, relaxed casual Japanese meal.

I am not a fan of Starr restaurants but I have to say the food exceeded my expectations.  I went here the other evening with my husband and one yr old daughter.  The place is family friendly and the hostesses and waitress were really nice and friendly to us.  We ordered two pies (tartufo (yum!) and magherita (sp?)).  The pies were individually sized but priced for a large.  I am used to sizes from places like Lombardi's & Ray's in New York.  Nevertheless the pizzas had a lot of flavor and the wood fire stove really added a special smoky flavor to the crust. We also had the broccoli rabe.  I was surprised since I haven't had rabe prepared this way.  They were really soft and lacked the bitter taste I am used to.  The house wine is really good and goes will with the food.  My husband ordered other wines from the menu and I really think the house wine was better. 

I would definitely come back here.

This was our second visit since they opened. The pho was very good the first time, but they have clearly made major changes because the food was amazing. Very filling, hot, fresh and reasonably priced. The gentleman behind the counter gave prompt, polite and personable service. The restaurant was not busy, and the confusing array of multicultural decor led to a conversation that was as pleasant as the soup. 

Please consider an all-you-can-eat "phomotion". Thanks for an excellent lunch.
Great food. Awesome handcrafted margaritas.  They need to NOT allow electric cigs at BAR when employees friends are taking up all bar seats...

So happy to have found this place near me! It's so clean and beautifully decorated. The food is amazing of course. I love that they have Thai chili's because I like my food spicy. The teas are DELICIOUS too. And staff is friendly.

I was apprehensive at first to order food delivery. But Wow! I ordered via Grub Hub and my food arrived ahead of time, and piping hot! Everything was packed nicely in aluminum foil and take out cartons...added napkins, forks and lots of salsa. Thank you very much for everything, all was packed very neatly! Food was delicious as always! This isn't my first time enjoying Mexican food here lol  and this is the only Mexican restaurant nearby that has chicharron tacos! Everything was so delicious!

Fast and friendly service! I have always enjoyed their Dim Sum. I went there for lunch with a friend and we greatly enjoyed every bite. Our server, Alisha, was knowledgeable and attentive! She recommended the sweet custard bun fried for desert and it was delicious! Don't listen to the other reviews, try it yourself in house!

Tried to order one night with pizza.com and was told there was no way they were coming to Cherry Hill, yet they were here before.  Almost acted offended.  Not only will I not order from there or use pizza.com again, I work in Voorhees and wont order fron there either.

I ordered a Sangria - $11 dollars - and the glass was 3/4 full of ice. When I approached the bartender, a big tall guy about 6'3", about it, he laughed at me and proceeded to tell me that "thats just how it's made." So I paid 11 dollars for a glass of ice with a splash of sangria. I will never come to Triumph again because of the attitude of the bartender and the rip-off drink I paid for.

This place is cute. The hazelnut gelato affogato is fantastic! The shakes are good, but I think it really depends on what you choose, also we weren't allowed to choose more than 1 flavor and that's a bummer. But there isn't 1 thing that I didn't like there. There's lower calorie options, like sorbet. This place could be slow when there's a group in front of you, because everyone wants to taste their options... I don't blame them. The employees are nice enough, but not overly helpful or super knowledgeable. Also, the espresso in the affogato was perfecto. I believe they use Counter Culture coffee. Give yourself a few minutes to find parking.

We ordered the Run Across America Sampler. This appetizer wasn't too bad. The chicken was over cooked. However, we ordered the Forrest Seafood Feast. This was very greasy. I think I'm just too picky on this restaurant because I remember when they first opened & they were at a lot higher standard on the service & the food. I'm hoping they get the high quality back.

Happy hour till 7 which is nice! I ordered pub fries which are just pre frozen fries with seasoning salt. I was told they had bacon and cheese on top by the waiter so I was a bit disappointed. Other than that really nice service and can't wait to try the rest of their food.
Hier geluncht, altijd prima eten hier. De tunamelt was wat saai. De saladebar was gewoon goed.
One of my favorite places to get a poboy or a Caesar salad! The daiquiris are obviously great

Awesome and flavorful burritos!

I didn't go in but while I was in SB, my friend went to the store and stopped by there to get some grub before heading back to his dad's place in SB. He ordered 3 burritos with a side of beans and rice. The food was quite tasty and good and would rank up there amongst my favorite Mexican restaurants. The chips were pretty good too. The salsas were alright and runny. They were both mild and would like them more spicy.

I didn't give it the 5th star because it is the first time I've eaten there and needed to try it out a couple more times before doing so. Plus I would need to go in there myself!

Stopped in for their Chicken Thai Pizza. I had this over a year ago and it was delish. It's not on the menu anymore but I was still able to order it. Very bright and funky restaurant with good size bar area. Parking is limited
Best wings in Philadelphia, great beer list, and the staff is great.  Cash only - so come prepared!

Hands down one of the best quick service restaurants in town. Fabulous, high quality food made just the way you like it. If you are not in the mood for a burger then try the wings or cheeseburger egg rolls! Fantastic food, hard working and kind owners will make you glad you stopped in for lunch or dinner!!

This place is small in size and doesn't seat many but their food is outstanding. Pizza was really good. Salad was fresh and large. My son said the wings were the best he has ever had. Very friendly wait staff.
Small, out of the way eatery.  Service is friendly  and quick.   Good was authentic and tasty.  Very glad we found this place.  When in the area, will come again.

I'm new to the Tucson area and this was the first bar I went to and with good reason. Browsing through yelp reviews on Tucson gay bars I realized there are no decent ones, not really at least. On one review of I don't remember what bar, one girl wrote a review and mentioned The Surly Wench at the end, and I was convinced. 

Great atmosphere, amazing staff/bartenders, friendly, etc.
Favourite place to drink so far.

Good take on Asian Fusion.  Buddakan keeps the food somewhat traditional, and adds flair to the dish as opposed to a full on twist. Crab fried rice (served inside a crab shell!), steamed dumplings, spring rolls with a wasabi mustard... Simple, yet elegant.  Service is well (as expected from a place like this), portions are generous as they encourage sharing, and decor is swanky. So whether it's date night with a spouse or spouse prospect, or friends just catching up - Buddakan works.  Well played, Stephen Starr.

Can't decide if I want to give this place 3 or 4 stars. We had the beef pho here and the broth was delicious. I ended up slurping up all the soup after I finished the noodles and meat. The food was a bit slow to arrive at our table. Tried to use the 20% off with Yelp check-in but was told December 27th, Friday was a holiday. Prices were a bit higher than other pho places. The restraunt was more spacious inside than it looks outside. The other thing I noticed was that the tables were higher than usual.

3% surcharge if you want to use your credit card.
Great staff so friendly makes you feel at home! Awesome pasta specials and best wings ever. A must go to place!

I spend $40 getting a Medium Meat Lovers with extra Cheese and Onions,  Chicken Wings which were the Smallest I have ever seen or Gotten, and very expensive Chef Salad that was Their Full size Salad. Don't order from this Place. The Pizza was Salty and not much Meat. I am sorry that Times are Hard, but if I was able to eat in the Restaurant,  I would have send it all Back. I wish I had gone to CiCi Pizza instead of Here

I had talked about trying this place for about a month before we actually went on vacation, and then they were voted one of the top 50 new restaurants in the country by Bon Appetit magazine! Super excited to go now, right?  WRONG!  Their sweet tea was great and so were the bonuts (biscuit and donut mixture with lemon mascarpone and blueberry compote). Unfortunately, that's where all good things come to an end. I ordered the Lily, French toast biscuits, which were dry and had barely any flavor, no extra syrup served, so biscuits soaked up all the syrup before I even had it sitting in front of me.  My sister ordered the sausage Benny, eggs benedict with sausage gravy and ham, which had eggs that were poached way too long. There was no creamy egg yolk, it was almost done to hard boil consistency. I saw two people send back their chicken and biscuit dish (not sure which one) in the 30 minutes my family was sitting there. My mom got good ol' biscuits and gravy which is something she said she'd eat, but not order again. I'm so terribly disappointed that we didn't care for this place. I would say just order bonuts at this place on your stop.

The food has always been delicious. The drinks are yum. It's the service that can be hit or miss. I've been in large groups as well as just the 2 of us. Sometimes it's amazing and I rave about the visit. Other times I leave saying "At leatd the food was good!" 

Definitely give it shot! The daytime is the best as it is right on the beach and the view is awesome.

Saturday evening at 9:30pm we went in and a guy greeted us and said the kitchen is closed.  Hours on the door said 10pm, and they have a bright neon "open" light.  So if you want to try out this place go before the staff decides they are done for the evening.

I love this place, food is fresh, served directly from the kitchen hot and the staff is very friendly. Only problem is that it closes at 8:00 pm.
As a suggestion, a change in the menu would be nice once in a while. Perhaps introduce new dishes as specials for the week/month to test them out.  I would give 5 stars but the 8:00 pm closing time prohibits 5 stars.
Good food. Rather odd and uncomfortable area for waiting for carry out orders.

I remain loyal to this place because this is where Mom used to take me when I was a kid some 30 years ago.  Although since then I have come to prefer other Philly cheesesteak places over Pat's, they're still quite good most of the time.  I will admit there have been times I was disappointed by a Pat's steak, but they are rare, and it hasn't happened in years. Unlike the place across the street I've tried many times, which has never held a candle to Pat's.

I work in the mall so trust me when I say I've tried all the options. This place is great, and the people who own it are great also! So friendly and happy all the time, I enjoy going here on my breaks to try new things off the menu.
LOVE THIS PLACE! So great to pick out the sweets you want and then pay at the counter. The cookies are delicious as well as the cake we picked up for a birthday party.

New to the area - we are looking for our go-to Sushi restaurant. I must say - this DEFINITELY will not be it. We tried this first because it's so close to our house. I would rather drive a distance than order anything else from here. Anywhere I've ever been-  $25 gets you two decent sized rolls. Just look at the picture I attached.  It was absolutely pitiful. There was nothing wrong with the taste of what we were served, but the fact that my husband and I had to make dinner after our $25 sushi was absolutely ridiculous. I am utterly disappointed and will never give this place another dollar.

I thought this place was a chain restaurant, but was looking for something new, so I decided to try it even though I had never heard of this place. I ordered the filet. Holy cow! It was flawless. For the price I was expecting to deal with a little gristle or fat...there wasn't any!!! In a "fancy" restaurant you would probably pay $10-15 more. 

On the way out I spoke to Jo-Jo (spelling?) to inquire where to find other Sioux City restaurants and found out that they are NOT a chain. I told him what I thought about the filet and he said you should try the ribs. I did, and they are easily the best I have ever had - and I lived in Tx for a spell!! I have been back 4 times now and got the ribs each time! I always get two meals out of it making the cost WAY worthwhile!!

Would love to be able to review the food but after walking in at 8:30 on a Friday night the waitress greeted us with a throat slashing gesture and explained "Kitchen's closed! You can come back tomorrow at 5:30". No thanks.  This was after driving around for 20 minutes looking for a parking place and then feeding quarters into a meter.  Stay away from this tourist trap.  If you're looking for good seafood at John's Pass, Gators on the south side of the pass has very good food, reasonable prices with ample and free parking.

In this case what you see is what you get. With limited lunch options in the area, this place gets the job done when it comes to individual slices. A couple slices and a drink will run you $9 which is not ideal but once again local options are limited but at least they take corporate AMEX cards. The size of the slices never are uniform so you better believe I point to the exact slice I want.

My favorite slices you ask? BBQ chicken, anything sicilian, and don't overlook the carmelized onions as a topping. My personal preference would be for some more sauce and cheese but I definitely enjoy their wood fired crust. 

A decent amount of seating but be warned this place fills up at lunch. Maybe one of these days I will get around to trying some of the Italian entrees but with all the varieties of pizza slices staring you down upon entering, it is tough to get past this station.

It's my first time in Nashville and I was looking for BBQ. Peg Leg Porker looked interesting. Both my wife had I the pulled pork sandwich. The pork itself was rather tough and really lacking in flavor. I added extra sauce but out of the dozen bottles available, all were labeled "mild", no choices. The side of smoked grew beans was very good. The Mac and cheese and the potato salad were average. I'd pass by. I'll try others in Nashville, there has to be better.

The venue is stunning and very impressive.  The service attempts to be engaging and white glove but comes across a little desperate and aloof at the same time.  The food was good but not great.  We ordered at least half the appetizers and quite a few of the entrees.  The foies gras and corn dumpling apps were the best.  None of the entrees were amazing but the desserts were very pretty and tasted great.  The wine list is nice but very overpriced (assume 4X what you would normally pay for retail).  I would go back if someone wanted to check out the venue but not go back solely for the food.

Lived in Tucson for years and this is a great addition. Just a hole in the wall spot that is hard to locate when just driving by. Directly behind the gaslight theater, this breakfast book really pushes the combination envelope in the eggs Benedict department! Some really inventive options. 

I chose the duck confit as the duck is braised for 48 hours prior and how could I say no to that? We were seated on the back patio and it just feels like someone's backyard, pretty cozy but to the point. 

My dish was full of flavor and the eggs were cooked perfectly. Paired with the hash browns, I was very happy. Ended up splitting the dish with my dad and half was the perfect amount. 

Everyone else ordered the Bloody Mary and that thing is a dish within itself! Sausage and bacon and pickles and olives galore. 

Check this spot out!

I love this place.  They are so nice and they treat you like family.  I would eat here every day if I could he food is so delicious and I love the hummus and falafel the best.  You have to try this.  Don't let the homey decor chase you away.  The food and the staff make it so nice.  Thank you for being so great.

My 5 friends and I (4 graduate students + a mom) tried New Tavern on a Tuesday night. We arrived around 5:30pm, and the restaurant was empty. We were greeted warmly and seated promptly, but the ambience of the restaurant seemed a bit stiff - white tablecloths... and utter silence.

For the price, the food is mediocre. The fare is an eclectic mixture of Italian, seafood, and American, yet I had trouble finding something that sounded good. There are a couple of sandwich/burger options that are reasonably priced, but other entrees get pretty pricey, at least for the quality ($20+). I got the ahi tuna, which was a bit overcooked and bland. Luckily, the roasted sweet potatoes that accompanied it were quite good. 

Our server was attentive without being overbearing. Overall, the service was solid, but nothing to write home about. 

By 6:30pm, the front room was full, and we were the only patrons under the age of about 70. 

All in all, we all agreed we won't be going back - there are just too many local restaurants with better food at lower prices.
Ribs were yummy and I don't like ribs. We shared several appetizers that were all good. Mai Tai was delicious. So glad a local took us in here - we will be back!

Spinach and Artichoke Dip = Delicious!  The chips are fresh and crispy and the dip can't be beat.  Chicken Salad = pretty presentation, good white meat chicken with tasty dressing.  Five nut brownie = Wonderful!  Perfect ending to a great meal.  I'd recommend it and go back.

You have to try this Burger place, just amazing selection of protein and the best X-rated Adult shakes in town. First time here the service was fast and the staff friendly. Gotta come thru when in Tampa visiting or as a local.

The best french toast ive ever had. I think it was also the best breakfast ive ever had. I had the daily special: cinnamon apple French toast! Dad had the bananas foster French toast was also amazing. Fresh squeezed apple juice? Yes please! They also have juice specials of the day, so ask about them as well!!
So delicious, definitely a must in NOLA!

The Good first. Cily pushes chicken on you in name and decor, and they're not messing around. I had their fried chicken with rice and it was SCRUMPTIOUS. The outside of the chicken was so crispy. It was like I was crunching glass in my mouth (in a good way), but the meat was still moist and delicate. I was really surprised by the rice. My dining companions and I kept looking at each other and saying, "my god, the rice!" after every bite. Never before have I gone to a restaurant and been wowed by rice, but Cily changed that. My dining companions also ordered chicken and rice dishes and were similarly impressed. Our appetizers we ordered were a smorgasbord of fried delights. Really clogged our arteries on crab rangoons, spring rolls and dumplings. All were pretty solid and everything was extremely friendly to our wallets. Seriously though...That rice...Heavenly.

There aren't many bad things about this place. I suppose the place is  small and I was a little disappointed they didn't have Thai fishcakes in stock. A legitimate criticism I have, and this is nitpicking, is that there were a lack of vegetables with our chicken sets. But Cily does have some vegetable mains that we could've gotten if we really wanted our fix of greens.

TL;DR Nothing silly about Cily Chicken Rice. Chicken is genuinely good. Maybe get some veggie dishes on the side though.
