I work in casual fine dining, and my restaurant serves baked macaroni with the entree, so I know how long something like this takes. Two small pasta plates should never take as long as a relatively large sized baked pasta dish. It was clear that the bartender forgot to put our other food items in-- which is fine, i have forgotten a tables food before as well. I am also well aware of the protocol when that should happen-- apologize profusely and ask if there is anything I can get them while they wait. However, instead of apologizing and offering us some more bread or another drink, he simply said the kitchen was plating our food then walked off. There was no apology--NOTHING! 
We never go to a restaurant and have to leave because the service was SO bad, but this time we left. After being told that our food was being plated (if that were the case, the bartender could have waited for it in the kitchen) it took another 5ish minutes before the food came. During that time, the man next to us finished his meal! We were so disgusted that we asked for our check, and that we no longer wanted the pasta plates. When the food did come out, we were told that it was going to be comped off our check and we could take it home with us--a very nice gesture, but I do not like eating food that I did not pay for, so it was even more uncomfortable. My boyfriend has dined there several times and had a wonderful experience; however, he was sitting at a table. Perhaps avoiding the bar would solve the problem, I will never know because I refuse to go back. I also know that servers have a bad day, but there are so many different ways to solve a problem, and our bartender really cared so little that he never even attempted to try and make our experience better!!

Honestly one of the best Mexican restaurants I've been too! 

I visit Santa Barbara maybe twice or three times a year and I always have to stop by for lunch here! The food is amazing, it can be pricey but it's worth it for the quality you're getting. If you never been here been here before I definitely recommend it! Try the enchiladas! They are so freaking good!!!!!!
We just enjoyed a fantastic brunch: two adults and seven children. The service was pleasant, food was delicious the menu has lots of options! This is a great find!!

The place was nice and I will return.  I believe this restaurant will appeal to almost everyone but nothing extraordinary for anyone.

I ordered fried chicken, mac & cheese, and mashed potatoes.  The fried chicken was too bland.  Not terrible or anything but missed making any impression.  Mac & cheese was great - maybe a little sweet for some people.  Mashed potatoes were good not great.

Overall solid experience in a mall.  Exceeded my expectations actually, but nothing to draw me back.

Enjoy if you are at the mall.

Had the diablo shrimp pasta. Pasta tasted like it  was cooked in a smoker. Shrimp was very chewy and over cooked but hey the beer was good. Dos xx cant ever go wrong, to bad I had to pay $45.00 for beer and a meal I didnt like. Cheers.....
By far my favorite sandwich is the aporkalypse. Seriously, stop what you are doing and get one. Why are you still reading? Go get one

Restaurant has two kitchens
Mexican and sushi. Ordered 3 sushi rolls and 2 items from the Mexican kitchen.
Salmon with mango salsa and chipotle cream sauce. Camarones a la diabla.
Everything looked and tasted excellent. Also great and pleasant food server Jim added to the experience.
Chef Ramon came and greeted us at the table.
We will come back with friends from L.A.

I read a review and was determined to try this weekend.  Fried Chicken close to home is a must try.  When I read about @lovebird.pa in Bryn Mawr I had to go and try their fried chicken. Who can pass on fried chicken? The location is clean with simple decor. The staff was very welcoming and very helpful with the most popular items.  It is large enough to eat.  One thing I noticed was no heavy smell of fried food. 

I added mac&cheese as a side and ordered a 2 piece with a thigh and a wing.  There are a number of sauces to add on the side, I picked the Lovebird Special Sauce.  The mac & cheese is pasta with a rich and creamy cheese ssuce.

In addition to fried chicken there are sandwiches with( fried chicken breast,miso-garlic grilled chicken, miso-garlirc tofu)  salads, bowls, and sides (fries, crispy brussel sprouts, mac&cheese, and coleslaw). 

The chicken was very juicy with a crispy skin that is not greasy.  It is not overly seasoned but the sauce made it delicious.

I noticed a few customers were picking up orders. My take-out order was ready in less than 15 minutes.

Why 5 stars? Because I've finally found the best BBQ in Tampa Bay.  

   ---   ---   ---

Well it took 350 reviews, but the search is finally over. I have hunted down the best BBQ in the area, and at long last... it has been discovered.

Ironically, I drove past this unknown little gem hundreds of times in the past year or two. I was always tempted to check it out, but never did... and I am definitely kicking myself for waiting so long.

Before declaring this the "Best BBQ in Tampa Bay" I made sure and ate it twice. I wanted to scream it from a mountain top after my first visit but I had two problems:

1) I needed confirmation that I didn't just get REALLY lucky the first time.

2) There are no mountains in the area.

3) (Bonus problem) No one would be able to hear me even if I did yell it from a mountain top. 

Non-problems, but we'll call this section "Slight Issues"

1) There isn't a big menu...

MEAT - ribs, thin ends and BBQ chicken

SIDES - baked beans, potato salad, mac-n-cheese, and collard greens (and the latter two are only on certain days.)

2) The hours are Wednesday-Sunday 1130a-6p, but the owner (Ice Cream) admits that sometimes he doesn't come out on Wednesdays.

But I am telling you right now... these ribs are EASILY the best in our area. I've tried just about every place from Lutz to St Pete, from Valrico to Palm Harbor... and this is the champion. The ribs are the meatiest, the most tender, and BBQ sauce is top notch. I've tried the potato salad, and the mac - and both are very good!

Ironic that I've driven all over the metro, and the best in town ends up being about 1 mile from my house. It's amazing... ANOTHER Seminole Heights eatery comes through. I love my neighborhood.

We came here literally for 48hrs and decided to stop by at Deanie's, since we have heard so many great reviews about this place!! Multiple people have been telling us that this place was the place to be for crawfish! 

Crawfish: 3/5
I felt like the flavors were great, but I feel like the crawfish was a tad over cooked and mushy.... 

Fried seafood platter: 4/5
Omg this platter is HUGE. HUGE. Initially I thought it was overpriced for fried food, but when the platter came out, I finally realized why it was 60$... the whole seafood platter can literally feed 5 people... 

All in all I thought this place was just ok, it was AMAZING.

Super service, good Quality and reasonable pricing. We pre reserved via the web where something went wrong. The assistant understood and helped us. 
Pretty cool! Steaks were as expected.

there's only a few things you need to know about alyan's:

1. it's delicious.
2. the falafel is the best i've ever encountered. so fresh, so crisp and non-greasy, so yummy.
3. the prices are insanely reasonable.
4. go there.

Organized a dinner here for group of 21 (including a 12th-grade boys basketball team) on a super busy Saturday night and the owner/manager/servers took care of us! They held a long, long table for our group, which was a challenge as others who were eyeing those seats. Thanks to Yelp photos and recommendations, we decided on four orders of the following:

Appetizers
*Salt and pepper calamari
*Salt and pepper chicken wings

Main Dishes
*General's chicken
*Mongolian beef
*Chicken chow fun
Green beans with XO sauce

Also ordered:
*Garlic noodles
Crayfish - liked the AZN sauce more than the Thai basil one

All the food came out piping hot and very tasty -- not greasy or too salty or spicy, but just right (and this SF/SJ gal knows her Asian food). I starred* our absolute favorites above. With beers and cocktails for the parents, it was less than $25 per person including tax and tip. Prefer this type of dinner over the Casino buffets.

Thanks, Crawfish Asian Fusion, for a delicious and memorable meal!

This was the second time I visited The Cider Press Cafe on Central Avenue in downtown St. Pete.  We decided to try the Avoblt, which was made with eggplant.  My daughter loved the sandwich but I was not impressed with the eggplant as I found it too chewed and stringy, although the flavor the sandwich was good as well as the tomato salad that I got with it.  The restaurant has plenty of outdoor seating, much of which is shady with the addition of umbrellas.  Everything on the menu is vegan and there are also alcoholic beverages.  I would recommend this place to all who travel the area as well as St. Pete folks.

Found this place when I googled "nearby restaurants". I've always been a fan of pizza shops and this place did not fail to meet my expectations. The staff greeted me and were flexible with my requests. Their calzone looks great and is worth the wait.

Took my parents for the chicken sandwich and we got home and opened them up to find they were about 1/2 the size they used to be.  Boy, make a sandwich popular and then start cutting back on the product while still charging the same price.  Very disappointed.
Great food. Service is hit or miss at times. Red velvet pancakes are yummy. Wait times are ridiculous.
Awesome!  They have definitely upped their game. Love the $5 monthly margaritas special. The $10 meal is so good. I leave full every time, the service is great and its easy on the wallet

I ordered for the family through Uber eats. My youngest wanted a grilled cheese however when you select the type of cheese you want there's an up charge. My son wanted corn dogs however the ends were well done and completely soaked in grease with a very light batter. Play ordered a second grill cheese for another family member, again charged extra when selecting the cheese and pay two dollars more for the large that wants the same size as the regular. The burger was tasteless and the onions dipped in batter we're extremely greasy in the batter wasn't cooked all the way. The fries were the only thing that we actually ate and the remainder of the $40 order is now garbage. Extremely frustrating. I understand it was end of night but this was our first try and now our last.

Our experience here was just ok. Given all the options in the area, I don't know that I would go back. Service was horribly slow - we even made some jokes at the table that there didn't seem to be anyone in charge of the place. Our poor server was sweet, but seemed totally out of his element. 
I ordered the chicken and waffles, but it just wasn't good. The chicken was dry and the waffle was flavorless. Everyone else had a moderate reaction to their dishes as well, which was too bad because the location is cute. Also, I'm not sure if the regular bartender was out, but the bloody mary was terrible as well. I love them and couldn't drink it.

Believe the hype. All of it. Just. Go. Now. The line is extremely long but moves pretty quickly. The seasoning on the food is awesome. My friend and I shared 1lb of crawfish, 1lb of shrimp, 4 corns, crab legs and a shrimp fried rice. Everything, and I do mean everything was bomb.com. I would go back again and again and again! And I like this location because we were able to get our gloves, sit and eat! Highly recommended!

I have been to the Pop Shop many times  and the food is pretty good. I am giving it 3 stars bEcause the last 3 times the service was terrible.   I had to constantly ask the server for things several times including utensils.  I eventually had to get it myself . He rarely came by the table to see if we needed anything.  He only brought 2 of our 3 desserts ordered and then forgot a spoon .    Worse service ever!

This is the second time I have returned to Termini Brothers Bakery inside the Reading Terminal Market. Their best seller which is the cannoli is worth the 1 & 1/2 hr. drive from where I live. This time, aside from the customary order of cannoli, we tried some of their other offerings i.e. - their mini cakes 1) Limoncello cake & 2) Red Velvet cake. They were heavenly! The cakes were moist, decadent & not overly sweet. Needless to say, you cannot just stop at one bite (they were history before we even got out of the Reading Terminal Market). This review however is for the "pecan bar". Had to make sure I had to get some this visit. It did not disappoint. This pecan bar was heavenly, just the right amount of sweetness, texture & moistness. I am so glad I got more than one. I will most surely try other pastries they offer next visit. Definitely in my must visit list when traveling back to Philly. This place is highly recommended.

YES!!!! Found this place on Yelp! and finally was in the right 'hood to try it. Part of an urban grocery / market. 

Totally will come back at lunch, but today I ordered a simple avocado brownie w peanut butter on top. YUM!!  I have been trying to eat plant based and this is such a cool place.

They have a great menu, also pastries and a few to go salads for a quick grab and go lunch.

Excited to try more.

Barnabas is an incredible server, the service assistant was prompt, & the whole experience was wonderful. Truly great dining experience and so much to choose from. The scallops were absolutely perfect and the cannoli & chocolate pyramid were exquisite. I want to go back again and again to try new things. Thank you Barnabas, for a great belated Mother's Day dinner!

Had the Chicken Ramen. Best ever. A bit pricey, but it's worth it.  I would get it again.  The collard greens in the soup had a unique taste.  I was told it was pickled.  The soft boiled egg was a great touch.
Very nice inside and a wonderful outdoor seating area under the trees.

With not a lot of places open on Christmas . Daisy dukes was the Resturant is kid friendly and easy to get too . The server was super helpful first time here and made the experience a slam dunk. The food was served hot and fresh . The menu wasn't too pricy i would come back again a must stop in New Orleans

Where the heck has this place been my entire life?  One thing I have found about Remo recently, the sandwiches are super awesome out here...especially at Capriotti's.

Today was my first time here and I was super impressed.  The service is fantastic.  Super personable and friendly...I picked up a small hot italian with all the fixings plus mushrooms no mayo.  Little did I know that the small is bigger than my forearm...9" to be exact.  Whoa.  It's definitely enough to feed 2 peeps.  

The sandwich came out hot...piled with meat and delish peppers.  The bread was super soft and the juices were plentiful.  My goodness...it was amazing.  This place puts subway to shame.  I wish there was a location in California!!!!!!!!!!!  

This will definitely be a staple everytime I'm out here.  Plus, it was only $8!  5 stars!!!

Came here during the Philly Free Street. Didn't expect much when we walked in...but wow. The sandwich were awesome. I had the short rib it was delis. The flavor and The quality of the ingredients is really worth the price. I will come back again to try other items on the menu.

My wife and I ate here, found the food and drinks to be below average, and subsequently spent the night with acute belly ache, which was not a very pleasant experience at all. We did have good service from our waiter, however. I noticed  also other Yelpers reporting sickness after eating at this restaurant. The manager swears that the cause of our sickness was not his restaurant even though it does seem like a big coincidence to me that we got sick right after eating there. 

Afterwards, the manager offered to comp us on drinks, which I thought was nice of him, although we still remain apprehensive about eating there again so are quite unlikely to return. To be fair to this restaurant, others might very well have a different experience, but our experience was quite poor. For health's sake and for their future patrons, I do hope that I can encourage them to double check hygiene standards in their kitchen.

Wow where to begin!!!! Destiny was a FANTASTIC server. Started off with a Bloody Mary and I was NOT disappointed, maybe one of the best bloody Mary's I have ever had. Then got the scotch eggs...... I was weary at first but so happy I got them! They were by far my favorite thing I ate that day. You gotta try this place it was AWESOME!

Stopped in around 10:30 yesterday morning (a non-holiday Monday) and was very impressed by 1) the friendliness of the wait staff, and 2) the quality of the coffee. The atmosphere is relaxed and I could easily imagine how it works well as a nighttime live music venue. Along with my dark roast coffee, I also ordered the potato + avocado + asparagus + poached egg food option, which I found tasty but was admittedly about 85% potatoes (for $8). I'm not sure this would ever be my top pick food option, but I certainly hope/plan to be back for more coffee and perhaps some evening music at some point.
Great food! I highly suggest the tacos with medium sauce. The chat grilled chicken and tortillas is fantastic. Best chicken in town!

Stopped here while visiting Boise and was not disappointed. Traditional American breakfast menu; Benedicts, omelettes, pancakes etc. Great prices, lots of seating, good, quick service. Would come here again if in town.

We have been to FW a few times. Always been happy. Good service, decent food, good prices, fine live music.
Last night failed on most counts
Good IPA. One catfish sandwich, more bun than fish. Diner described the fish as "eviscerated"
Hamburger was rated as just fine. Two (2) Ruben sandwiches were grilled to death. The bread almost burnt and cardboard like.
Got the bill, but I had a question. I looked around for our server, Jameson, or for that matter ANY server. None were in sight or attendance for 10 minutes. I waited, and waited, and waited, and finally left.

We're big fans of all the Sacramento-area Blaze locations, but this was awful.  I ordered a thick crust build your own and dough-knots, so maybe these items really take tons of extra time to make.  At 8:35 pm there was one family ahead of me and it took over 25 minutes to receive my pizza.  Three employees were huddled around the dough squisher chatting, and my pizza came out of the oven and sat ready for an extra eight minutes.  I finally asked about it and received a rude reply:  "we don't have any boxes. "The rude employee finally got a box and I got my pizza....The pizza tasted good, but I've never seen a staff that is less customer-focused than this.

So, we had heard pretty good things but honestly they didn't do justice. I am amazed this place isn't packed!

Mike and I got there in the afternoon. Quickly and pleasantly seated. This was our first time and the server was patient as we reviewed the menu and let us know she could answer any questions we had.

We got a Maui pineapple wheat beer which was good, a hibiscus tea that tasted delightful and my husband particularly liked, and a pomegranate soda that they make which was my fave.

We ultimately chose two sandwiches. Sadly at home now I can't remember the names but one was the ham and pineapple which was the perfect blend of flavors! The other had teriyaki beef and was my fave of the two with the very delicious bits of slaw in it and fresh jalapeño.
They were out of the beet slaw so we were given two other sides of a different slaw and their potato salad. The owner was sitting in a booth behind us and helped us learn more on the delicious sides. The one slaws unique flavor came from the addition of rice wine making it quite delicious. Meanwhile, I have never like veganase but the soy-free version used on their potato salad was delicious.

The owner, Theresa, was a delight to speak with. Most everything is homemade in the restaurant with even the kimchi being done in-house staring in the next few weeks! 

We look forward to going again!

Man this place got the best location in the mall but every time I walk by, I feel like I have to zoom by so they don't try to shove free samples down my throat. There's really nothing Thai about Ruby Thai Kitchen. May be the owner's name is Ruby Thai but they are Chinese? Food borderlines Chinese flavors more than Thai food and even then it's pretty flavorless.  You probably should just skip any restaurant in the mall.

This is another one of Man v Food's spots so while visiting a friend up in Philly, we made it a point to come here to try DiNic's famous roast pork sandwich.  Unfortunately, the line was so dang long that we skipped it and figured that we'd save DiNic's for another visit.

Other than our failed attempt at getting a roast pork sandwich, Reading Terminal is great, although very overwhelming with the amount of people, businesses and food choices.  

Here are some of the spots that I stopped and purchased food at:

L. Halteman Family - great jams especially the blackberry and strawberry flavors; the wildflower honey went especially quick upon bringing it home

AJ Pickle and Patch Salad - they have the biggest pickles I have ever seen; 1 for $1

Sweet as Fudge Candy Shoppe - I could have gone crazy in this store, what with my sweet tooth but just bought dark chocolate covered espresso beans.

Fat Fish Sandwiches - With such inventive names such as "Fat Cajun, Fat Buffalo, Fat Pig, Fat Boy, and Fat Dan" I just ordered the soft shell crab sandwich.  I love soft shell crab, however, it was just tasted too fishy for me.

Lancaster County Dairy and Juices - Great fresh Strawberry Lemonade

Miller's Twist Pretzels and More - Get a fresh pretzel once it comes out of the oven...so soft and buttery

Old City Coffee - They roast their beans on-site.  Pretty good ice coffee.

Kauffman's Lancaster County Produce: sold interesting dehydrated vegetables such as okra and beets (recommended by MacRae O.)  I did buy it because I love both of those vegetable but in dehydration form, is a another story.  I ended up sending it to my dad who enjoyed it more than I ever would.  

Before I left, I ended my food gorging with a cookie to go along with my ice coffee.  I don't remember the name of the shop but you can't miss it as it's near one of the entrances.
Excellent food - fast, fresh, and very tasty.  Outstanding service.  Family friendly.  They handled our party of 10, including a grumpy infant, with a smile.  Highly recommended!!!  Try the waffles!

I can't put zero stars but this was the worst meal I've ever had in my entire life. Disgusting food, found a bug on plate, rude and incompetent service, obnoxious manager, loud, (white) wine was warm, dirty, and generally a terrible experience. Do NOT go here.  Have actually had better fast food meals in terms of quality and service. Run away. Do not go.

I was blown away by the great service we had here.  Our server was amazing, he made sure we were well taken care of while respecting the fact we didn't want to be interrupted every five minutes.  Food was good, drinks were awesome.  We will be back again!

If I want to get pizza delivered from Royal I have to get it from the west end location. It's never as good as when I pick up and get it from the Hamptons location. Always inconsistent with their quality. Last night I ordered and barely any sauce on the pizza and undercooked. From now on I will just pick up from the Hamptons!

We tried this place out for dinner one night because I was craving a turkey club and this was the only place that had it on the menu that was open for dinner. We walked in and the decor is just your average pizza place. We brought a bottle of wine and were presented with two frosted wine glasses and a bottle opener. I ordered the turkey club and my husband ordered the Reuben Stromboli. We both weren't expecting much of the food except just average tasting. My club was a generous size and the Reuben was huge we both ended up taking home leftovers. The turkey looked fresh carved and not just turkey lunch meat. The Reuben... oh the Reuben was so good. We love the dough that they use and the spices that they put on it.

We just went back on Wednesday to order a Hawaiian Pizza. The dough did not disappoint! It was the same delicious, thin crust dough that we had on the Reuben. I'm so glad we found this spot so we can go for a casual, impromptu, byob dinner.
This used to be my all time favorite pizza place. But the last 3 times I've been in the pizza is so old and dry or its extremely over cooked and hard as a rock. Completely inedible. Such a shame.

Some of the best Ethiopian I've ever had. 

Heads up: If you're vegetarian, make sure to mention it. I don't know if this is how they always do it, but we didn't get a menu - they just seated us and a little while later brought out a giant platter with basically everything on it. All of the food was delicious, so I was into it. But there was a healthy serving of spiced meat included. I'm sure they'll swap something else out if you just tell them you're veggie.

Went back for more since I'm head over heels in love with their dim sum service  was definatly more attentive then usual and from my last experiences.

However I had to ask for sugar 5 times they must have thought I was crazy. But hey I'm American and enjoy my tea sweet. 

Aside from that food was delicious as always and of course I'll be back. Service can always be more friendly. But hey willing to deal with the lack of politeness for their orgasmic dumplings

Thanks to my fellow Yelpers (Michelle, Amanda, Mark, etc.) for alerting me to this needle in the haystack just across the street from home.

While I do visit the bars and restaurants at International Mall (Except of course Blue Martini, which is about as appealing to me as walking on broken glass while moving a sectional couch to a third floor residence), I never even think about a food court because it just makes me feel like I'm in an 80's movie.

That changed with today's visit to Rise Pies. 

On one hand, it fits the damn food court because it is set up like the other spots. Heck, even the counter of ingredients looks like the place to the Asian kiosk to the left and the outdated sandwich spot to the right. 

However, Rise Pies produces a made-to-order hot and fresh thin crust pizza in minutes that far surpasses anything you would consider to be standard food court fare.

I was happy with the preparation, the short time to cook it, the look of the finished product and definitely the taste.

There were plenty of options for crust, sauces, toppings and seasoning to create my own two topping pie for just $7.95. I think this is good value and outright better than these flatbreads being pushed by restaurants at similar prices.

One of my toppings was the meatballs, which are actually a specialty of Rise Pies and they are crushed instead of whole or sliced in half. The texture was perfect and they gave me enough to cover practically the whole thing.

So, if you can get around the Can't Buy Me Love/Fast Times at Ridgemont High/Bill and Ted's Excellent Adventure food court memories and you don't mind those neighboring Asian places wielding chicken on toothpicks at you to sample, Rise Pies makes it worth the visit.

How can you run a business without a manager present. I enjoy the food here however you better not have a issue that may require you get a refund. What happened to me was they were charging more then what was quoted on the menu. When I questioned this practice I was told their prices had increased. NOT MY PROBLEM! you must honor what was posted I said. When I asked to speak with a manager they said there wasn't one there. The staff seemed confused that someone challenged their misquoted prices. I wasn't happy about the runaround I got. I even gave them the option to barter by giving me something of equal value like a fruit cup juice or soda. I wasn't settling for this nonsense. I requested to speak to a supervisor over the phone I'm cool with that too but NOPE! now I'm pissed off you're not keeping my money no way no how. I waited for the staff to come to a conclusion while they waisted my time. Finally one of the workers handed me cash with an apology. Get it together Vale you put your staff in a bad position someone unlike me might get very angry and combative over a few dollars. Give your staff management codes to accommodate their mistakes

I like the ambience. Sushi was great,  and they are not that expensive.  Nice little date spot also. To top it off they have Beer for 2$, IMPORTS ALSO ,thats a deal by itself. They have a specialty menu,and a cheap menu for sushi. Small peices but they are worth every bite. They also hva ehot food soup, and a little area for specialty dining.  Its own room . The fact thats its in broad ripple is plus. Right in the strip.

Went here for dinner and was soo disappointed. 
Ordered the 199.00 Family Special and they literally had nothing on the menu. Owner came out and kept saying "We can sub you a bigger lobster, crabs for the lobster, or fish or clams..." and when we picked crabs, she came back 5 minutes later and said they couldn't sub it...she suggested we get the "bigger" lobster but would have to charge us an extra 25.00..Waittttt...if you have a preset menu, why would you NOT have what you offer?! And then come out and offer us a sub and come back and say, oh sorry, we can't do it.

 I was aggravated to the 10th power. Food was lackluster and if it wasn't for me dining with my whole family, I would have walked out. 

Auto gratuity was added ($43.00) and wasn't deserved.

I won't ever be going back.

Called in a carry out order on Sunday at 800 am when the opened. The said 10-15 min. I showed up at 815 but the were having computer issues. So I wait. The restaurant fills up by this time. They try to take my payment but can't. While the call the owner up for help I ask if the food is done seems how it is 840 by this point. The owner starts yelling at me. She told me my order didn't go to the top and it would be 30 minutes. I told her I already been there for 20. She started screaming how she didn't need my business anyways. I used to frequent this place but after meeting this owner with an attitude we will be going elsewhere. 

You should appreciate your customers. No matter how bad of day you have.

I really enjoyed our visit to Highway 61 Roadhouse.  I took my family along with my dad and step mom here for dinner on my daughter's birthday.  The food was good (although not quite as good as Gulf Shores) but the entertainment was an added treat.  My dad, who never wants to go anywhere but Cracker Barrel, wants to go back to Highway 61 Roadhouse, even wants to go listen to the music again.  Definitely will be going back.
Great food! Delicious bbq in a good neighborhood

If you are looking for customer service look else where. The bar tender and bar backs are extremely rude. I refuse to go back. Last night was my third time there and I wanted to give it another chance. I will say it is consistent.... Consistent in that the bar tenders are not friendly, helpful or even happy to be working there.

This is an amazing terminal. So many good eats and cool merchants to choose from. Fresh fruit and veggies and cheese and pastries and treats!!!! I loved it! I live in north Jersey and sometimes consider driving to Philly for the day just to visit this terminal!
This place was the bomb diggity!  Must stop for the food n beer!  I had the Lieberkase sandwich with Belgian twice fried pomme frittes with curry mayo.  And the Winged Nut beer was perfecto!!!!

The place is really great! I like the fact that the staff seem to have a good relationship with their younger customers. I like the whole pick what you want on their food. The prices are really good and I can see they get a lot of younger people coming.

My boss raved about this place and their white pie. Well let's just say it was amazxng. We all ordered individual size white pie and we were all in heaven. One of my co-workers added mushrooms, the other added spinach and my boss and myself went naked white.

I am dreaming about my next pizza.
Trashhhh.  They won't give u refunds because you tried the sample that tastes nothing like what they serve you. Horrible customer service. Horrible food.
The menu is diverse and the  food and service was excellent.Our waitress  Jennifer was amazing
Nice location and atmosphere inside. Great service and delicious food! My favorite is their Tom Yum soup and Shrimp pad Thai!

Best chargrilled oysters in New Orleans! It comes to your table sizzling. I drove in through town and heard recommendations about this place and I wasn't disappointed. I shared the oysters and got the shrimp po boy (1/2 grilled and fried). We also got the hush puppies. I would recommend all of the 3. It was the only seafood place I've been where I've left truly stuffed!

This place is the best spot. The food is incredible. The drinks were outstanding. 

We ordered the ahi tuna and the cheesesteak egg rolls to start. 10/10. 

Great atmosphere and vibe. Highly recommend this place

All around excellent experience! Very interactive and delicious meal. I came here not knowing what I was getting myself into....and I am definitely glad I decided to try hot pot. 

I came here with a group of friends. We reserved a table but it seemed unnecessary. We went around 6 pm on a Friday and the restaurant wasn't busy until at least 730 pm. The staff were very helpful with explaining how hot pot worked, since we all seemed perplexed. You choose a base broth and what you would like to cook in the broth. The options are staggering. Everything from fish balls, to sweet potatoes to eggs are available.  You then need to head up to a seasoning station and grab whatever you think will enhance your broth. After a short while your sever brings the uncooked food and then you cook the food as you please. Be aware that they provide you with an ample amount of whatever you order and you can ask for more.....so don't order every second thing on the menu (a mistake my whole party made which lead to us drown in plates of food).

Stopped in while visiting Indianapolis from Toledo, Ohio. Food was excellent as well as the staff. The smothered gravy slaps. And peach cobbler was outta control!! Definitely will be back. Oh yeah, the dressing was hitting too!

Breakfast at Surrey's was very good. We had New Orleans style French toast (with real maple syrup- which was actually real!) and the magas plate.
The French toast was a brioche style and very good plus I got an order of home fries.
We got seated right away. The area is a tight fit, but they kindly allowed us to put our luggage behind the door (we had a gap between check out and check in at our next Airbnb). The coffee was good, the service was excellent, and the atmosphere was good.

Very mediocre pho. I've been here maybe a dozen times in my lifetime and while this place was an initial favourite, it quickly fell down the ranks due to inconsistency. 

During my most recent visit, I ordered the spicy beef broth soup. I asked to replace the noodles with pho noodles, and they were glad to accommodate. I didn't think it was particularly good or bad, just okay. The portions are VERY big though, and for 9 bucks I thought it was very cheap. I tried my sister's brisket pho, and again, was not impressed. The flavours aren't rich and the broth is especially salty. The noodles are very soggy. 

I do however, REALLY REALLY like their pork spring rolls. Highly recommend. Otherwise, there are definitely better options in the area. I will say that this place has a nice atmosphere and decor though.
Great experience.  Ordered tacos and margaritas.  Server was extremely friendly.  Although the restaurant was extremely busy, they accommodated ya in a reasonable amount of time!

I felt like a bonafide grownup when I hung out at Vintage the other night...maybe it was the fact that I was drinking some smooth wine while listening to some sensual music under fantastic mood lighting, but why analyze? I had a great time and the bartenders were attentive and helpful. My husband had one of the specials and I had my beloved Riesling, a perfect apres-Lolita treat. 

When it's time for your to graduate from beer (or just mix it up a bit), be sure to check out the adult grape juice here.

I had been looking forward to eating here for a very long time and was finally able to this trip to Nashville.  I love trying unique dishes - viewing previous menus and pictures had me really excited.

I'll start with some good - the ambiance is really cool.  Loved the entrance, sitting around a high top bar watching the food being prepared, the serving dishes and utensils are really unique, and the restroom is cool in a trippy sort of way.  My fiance actually poked the mirror thinking she was having a flashback.

Unfortunately when the food arrived the good stopped.  I am going to preface this with I am very adventurous when it comes to food but this was just bad with a few exceptions  The first course was very good, smoked cows tongue fritter.  Loved it, this is going to be great!  Then things went down hill.  Cod sperm?  Chicken gel?  Calves brain?  Not what I was looking forward to.  We left with 3 courses to go, very disappointed especially since I was looking so forward to eating here.

If they get a new chef I may try again because I want this place to be good!  This currently seems like an experiment to see if people will actually eat the food.  So disappointed.

So happy The Mill has opened in Tampa. Great translation of their St Pete restaurant, and the perfect place for it. My wife and I had our 9th anniversary here. We ordered the pork tomahawk, and bison steak (Philadelphia style). Absolutely perfectly done in both cases. Also the octopus appetizer was delicious, the beet jam added a unique and yummy interpretation. (Octopus was a tiny bit overdone; just 1 minute less would have made it perfect - but delicious nonetheless). The Chocolate Mudslide desert was decadent, and delicious - and the drinks lived up to our expectations. Try the Millhattan! We'll be back for sure. Fun decor too - check out the mechanoid possum on the way to the restroom... Oh, and the service was outstanding - our waiter, Josh, was very attentive and had great recommendations. A couple of other staff also stopped by to check on things.

Food was good but the service was terrible

I ate here on March 6, 2016 and was very displeased with my experience.  The food came out and everything looked delicious and fresh.  Then the waiter came over to fill up my glass of water and ended up spilling most of the water into my bowl of shrimp and grits.  His response was "Oh did I miss? My bad."  My dinner was now swimming in a half inch of water.  He hardly apologized and did not offer to bring me a new plate or give me a free dinner.  So I left hungry and paid for a meal that I didn't get to eat all of because it was drowning in the water he spilled into my bowl.  I definitely will never be eating here again.

Amazing! We always go for happy hour. Fan of the fried rice, potstickers, broccoli, bao buns (if you can handle the richness), and the brownie. The happy hour cocktails are also great as well. Try to sit inside! We sat outside for the first time today but the ambience inside is the best for eating this time of the year.

Super cute! If you're into pictures this a good place for you.  Prices are fair. But beware drinks are tasty but weak. Good amount of options on the menu but not overwhelming. I had the pineapple upside down cake cocktail which was delicious and by far my favorite part of the meal. My friend had the mermaid lyte which was cute and made for a good photo op but really tasted like sprite. Queso appetizer was good but not special. I had the shrimp and Gouda grits as my entree. Once again nothing to write home about. Overall I was pleased and will go again.

This is one of my favorite casual restaurants in New Orleans and certainly my favorite on Bourbon Street.  It's located in the beautiful historic Royal Sonesta Hotel right near the start of Bourbon Street in the French Quarter. 

I always start with the Creole BBQ Shrimp which has an awesome sauce for sopping bread. And I always end with their bread pudding which is served as a slice like cheesecake with bourbon butter sauce.

On today's visit, I tried the crawfish carbonara. I kid you not but this may be the best carbonara I've ever had in my life. Perfect al dente pasta, rich sauce with prominent bacon flavor, and the crawfish were like little flavor angels singing in my mouth.

Nov 20, 2021
 I ordered Buffalo boneless wings that were so mushy i had to put them in my airfryer before they were edable. 
Never order them again.
Love the pizza and subs however.
Stay away from their so called boneless wings. ..  .....$10.00

This is the worst Steak 'n Shake that I've ever been to. No matter what time of day. Most times that I try it, I end up leaving the drive-thru without my order because no one acknowledges me. This time, they said the drive-thru isn't working and there's no one inside. WORST STEAK N SHAKE EVER. I've never been to a worse restaurant in my life. Will NEVER be back.
Beautiful atmosphere and impeccable service. Food was tasty. Frose' was delicious, add a float for a little kick. Really interesting menu and lots of craft beer. Highly recommend.

We just visited their new location on East State Street. Not going back there again.  Their old place had a great community friendly atmosphere.  
One could sit back and relax.  It felt homey.  This new spot is cold and has no atmosphere.  Might as well be a factory.

This was my first time ordering To Go at Olive Garden, and first time ever at this location. Despite the mixed reviews for this location, I had a wonderful experience. The food was all fresh, the portions generous, and hadn't been sitting around under a heat lamp. Though the place was slammed, the service was nonetheless excellent. There was a bit of a wait while they finished up my order, and the server apologize profusely and gave me two coupons for my next visit. Great first impression, guys!

I love hearing Welcome to Moe's upon entering the restaurant.   I always order one of their salads with pork  or steak and appreciate that they add grilled veggies if desired.   The salsa selection is decent as there  are several mild and medium selections with 1 hot salsa  available.   The bathroom  was clean and the trash emptied.   Three  iced tea selections are available with lemon wedges: green, black,  and sweetened.   Beer,  soda,  and sparking mineral water are available too.   I appreciate the coupons they send me for my birthday and anniversary.

Worst Wendy's I have ever been too. They forgot to put half the toppings on the kind of salad I got. They were rude and one of the employees had headphones in while I was talking to them. Won't be back

This location is cool. You present your order, and they are usually quick with getting your food to you. The great thing is that your food is always hot... The customer service is descent,  sometimes it depends on who's at the window.. Cool service..

This place is cozy, fast, friendly, affordable and simply offers the great variety of tea and coffee products. I rarely get to taste an espresso of this extraordinary quality and truly enjoyed my quick pit stop in Tucson en route from California to Texas for a caffeine recharge at this sweet-little cafe. Recommended.

This has been one of our go-to places since we moved to Reno about five years ago. The service is good, the place is decently clean, and the pho is wonderful. The broth is very good..... it has a real depth of flavor that I have never tasted at any other pho place.  

It is located in a somewhat seedy area of downtown, but please don't let that deter you. Once you taste this place's pho, it will ruin all other pho for you. It's that good.

My favorites are the number 11 and number 14. My husband's is number 3. They do serve other items, but people come for the pho....

Their new system for customer service sucks and they're @$$holes about it.

They ask you to place an order, then call your name when it's ready, and then you're allowed to stand in line for 20 minutes to actually get it.

Ok, fine. I get it, protecting your staff should take priority, even if this is a bit convoluted.

So I call in an order, get told "30 minutes or so", get there in 20 to make it easy on them, and stand under the speaker to be sure.

15 minutes go by, no name. So I ask, "Nope, not on the list, give it a few minutes.

10 more... again, nope.

Finally, 10 more... "Let me look. Oh, it's been out for a while, go get in line"

I look over: 15 people in line... "ok, fine, but no one called my name" "you must have missed it."

I wait another 20 minutes in line. Get handed a cold cheesesteak, and I'm just like "yea, forget it."

Again, I understand and support wanting to keep your staff safe, but if you can't find a way to offer the most basic customer service, then do that by SHUTTING DOWN FOR THE DURATION.

Or at least take responsibility and apologize when you screw up.

Anyway, once I cool off I'll be back.

Just annoying as heck.

This place certainly does not serve authentic Indian food. Their Biryani was pathetic - looked and tasted more like South Indian Sambar rice than like Biryani. Being from Hyderabad where I am used to tasting outstanding Biryani, I could hardly get two spoofuls in my mouth before discarding the whole thing.The roti,naan and curries tasted just as bad. Find some other restaurant if you want to eat authentic Indian food. I will not recommend this place to anyone I know. If you want a great ambience with really bad food, this is the place to be.

I write this review as I stuff wild mushroom pizza into my face, so it may be bias. 

This may be one of the best pizzas in nola. It's perfectly charred, thin, and crisp. Brick oven style. Which is hard to find in nola. 

Happy hour till 7 is $9 pizzas.  Get yo self a pie and sit at #bar1908.  You wont regret it.

Went Mardi Gras night (8:15).  We had reservations and were seated promptly.  Service a little slow.  The boil was OK (sausage, shrimp, crayfish, snow crab (blue crab was sold out).  Added an extra corn and potato and mushrooms.

Flavor was good, but the crayfish mostly small.  Worst was the barely cooked potatoes.

Not as good as other boil places we've been (Low Country in Chicago is amazing) but better then some.  For the prices, should be much better. 

Meal was OK but not worth returning.

I've been searching for a good sushi place in Clearwater since moving here from Los Angeles a few years ago, I finally found one! This place was excellent! The rolls, nigiri and miso soup was top notch! Also very well priced, bill with tip was only $25! The sushi Chefs were also very conversational and friendly. Will definitely be coming back and sending people to this place!

I came in on a Sunday afternoon to see 1 employee total running the place. She didn't look happy to be there. 10 minute line with just 2 people ahead of me. Sub tasted about the same as anywhere else. I asked for 15 seconds in the toaster but was more like 30. Maybe 15 is not possible?

I did not get a receipt. I saw the sign offering a free sub when this happens but I really just wanted to leave. Worker was in a rush so I can understand but plenty of other restaurants on the same street I'd rather go to next time.

Worker was bilingual in Spanish. I suppose that's a plus.

Hubs & I came here tonight for dinner, and it was just ok. Nothing to write home about. I ordered the Pho Ga, and the noodles were way too soft, practically falling apart halfway through my meal. Broth was a bit salty, and chicken a little too firm for my taste. I always love a good bowl of pho, but was a little disappointed this time. Hubs order their special Chicken With Mixed Vegetables (and sauce on the side) he always orders it that way, less calories he said! And he just used the sauce sparingly. That tasted good, when I took a bite. Overall, giving it 3 star
We tried this place out a few weeks ago and I really appreciate the simplicity of the menu. And the ribs were very tasty. The meat was so tender and juicy, and it just melted off the bone!

This was my first of many trips to Jamaican Style Jerk! We dined on Jerk chicken, Curry chicken, beef patty, rice and peas, Coco bread, plantains and cabbage. Everything was fresh and very flavorful! I could've had just the cabbage and would have been happy. The portions are generous and the price is very reasonable. I look forward to my next trip and I will have to try the oxtails!

This is such a neat throw back place!! It reminds me of a 50s burger place combined with that hole in the wall feeling of a small family business!  The burgers are fantastic and there are lots of choices for sides.  Don't expect this to be a diet option though.  This place is pure guilty pleasure!! I had their mushroom burger sooo yummy!!!

So yummy! And the service was great! Keirsten was amazing! So friendly and gave us great suggestions. We had the Tvravs and saganaki for apps. Then I had the Chicken parm with Alfredo pasta as the side for dinner. It all came out super quick and was really flavorful. Try the baklava for desert as well! Will definitely be coming back!!

FULL MOON YOGA!  Hubby and I just enjoyed our third Full Moon yoga date night at the Belmont and it was amazing. The price of admission includes a day pass to the pool and fitness areas, a small group outdoor evening yoga class and wine after class.  What's not to love?  Yesterday we kicked our day up a notch by adding a couples massage in the beautiful spa. The experience was seamless, the spa staff really knows their business and Ty and Pat (our therapists) were very skilled and professional. All in all this was a very romantic, intimate, relaxed day for this long married couple.

We enjoy their food frequently, more for take out but sometimes to eat in. We love their California rolls and they have the best hot and sour soup anywhere. We have had a number of entrees and have always been very happy with the taste, amount served,  and quality. I highly recommend them!

super yummy salad.
okay doner.

Very very good.  Nice and fresh.  Service excellent.  Will post my pics.  Nice and clean.  The menu was not the usual 50 entrée choices which was nice to see.  We will be back for sure and tell all our friends.  Horchata was yummy.  Guacamole so good.  Hubby had the pork chop dish which was also delicious.  I had the Aztec dish with corn cakes and shrimp.  We were both stuffed and had leftovers.
Indian food at its best!  Finally we got a authentic. Indian food in town. Friendly staff. Excellent service. We will highly recommend this place.

I would like to give Vizcayas more stars because the evening started out great. The tapas were very good, the main coarse also very good. We ordered desert which never came, in fact the waitress just never came back to our table. I had to go find her to get our check and she had charged us for the deserts. After I told her we didn't get them she subtracted them from the bill but didn't seem to care at all that a mistake was made. I would give Vizcayas a second chance since everything else was great.

Beautiful restaurant inside and out.  Summer time meals on the deck overlooking the lake are wonderful.  My favorite appetizers are the calamari as well as the chicken cordon blue fingers.  For the entree I love the catfish fillets.

Have visited multiple times (5+) and have never been disappointed by the staff or by the food! In my opinion the food outshines Yolk by a long shot and is just as good (if not better) than Patachou.

MENU STARS: 

-Any omelette - MUST get with trio of roasted potatoes! Literally the best breakfast potatoes I've had in my life. Plus the omelette was fluffy and huge and perfect!
-Breakfast Salad. I know, I know, who wants salad for breakfast? But I know my way around a salad since I eat vegan about 90% of the time and this is an amazing choice if you aren't feeling regular breakfast fare. The dressing was superb!
-East Meets West Hummus Sandwich - You've never had a pickled vegetable until you've had the pickled eggplant in this sandwich. Satisfies a mean salt & vinegar craving like no other.

Wait staff have always been very attentive and are easily agreeable to customizing orders and helping customers! This is my number one favorite place for no-nonsense, unpretentious breakfast food that's made right!

Last night, we ordered two Blue Moons only to walk out and discover pretty quickly that what we received was not Blue Moon. Of course, the employee is not the one who falsely connected the tubes to something that tastes more like a very light lager, which we feel is along the lines of piss water, but rather someone who simply walked in there looking for a job and is doing it...so we didn't want to give her a hard time. But we were, nevertheless, pretty irritated and disgusted with our unknown nasty beers, which we thought would be Blue Moons. Not sure what causes such a deceitful act in business...perhaps they feel the majority of people are too drunk on Bourbon Street to notice, so they connect what should be one beer to a significantly cheaper beer (and obviously a far different one). Gross. It's not always the case. In our case, we are new to the area, are exploring and wanted to have a beer on our little stroll, completely sober. And we've drank Blue Moon far long enough to know what Blue Moon is and, certainly, what it is not. We were given a beer far different in color, thickness and taste. Don't try to pass on one beer as another and think people won't catch on.

It's OK. It's not terrible. I have had better, but I think the thing that saves this place is the portions and family style seating. Both go hand in hand. It's basically like a less done-up Buca di Beppo in Brandon. Huge portions because they expect you to share. Try the dishes with the sun-dried tomatoes. Delicious.

But, basically, if your family is in town and they don't mind Italian or sharing, then give this place a try.
Probably one of the better buffets in the area. Clean most importantly and everything I tried was tasty.

I am at a Bridal Shower at the Concordville Inn.  This is my first time attending an event at this establishment.  I have had dinner her about seven times in the past year or so.  The food is always excellent, even at a catered event.  My favorite is the Cajun Chicken Pasta.  It is to die for.  When ordering a cocktail ask the bartender, Kevin, to make you a "Blue  Long Island Iced Tea". He is an excellent bartender and can truly mix a superb drink.  If you live in the area the Concordville Inn is a great place to dine.  I am glad that I found them.
Great atmosphere, great baked items, great coffee, great service and really nice restrooms.

This restaurant was close to the Hyatt Regency, so I had dinner one night and breakfast another morning. The fried chicken sandwich was fantastic - tender chicken, with a spicy slaw. And the bun was perfect with it. I also had avocado toast for breakfast. Very well done, and beautifully presented with edible flowers. Great counter. Great coffee. Airy space.

I did not expect to like this place to be honest.  I don't normally go for chain restaurants  (nor am a I big barbecue fan) and this one just seemed randomly plopped down on 11th street - but I was mistaken.  It was great!  I will attest to the fact that I did not get the Barbecue, but I got the smoked sausage, mac and cheese, and baked beans and I was pleased.  The baked beans were a little too sweet for me but the rest was very tasty.  

They also have some legit sweet tea (which I halved with the unsweetened for the perfect combo) and I must also admit that upon leaving I had to buy a huge slice of their chocolate cake - it most definitely tastes as good as it looks!  So even if you're not a huge lover of Barbecue, give it a try!

Fat Mo's is by far the best burger you'll ever eat. I absolutely adore this place, and have never had a bad meal there. They never get my order wrong, are always quick, and the prices are amazing. The sides aren't always on point, but if you're going to Fat Mo's and don't want a burger, go somewhere else because this place does burgers and does them better than anyone.

Extensive wine list, great food and friendly staff... That pretty much says it all. I enjoyed the very relaxed, comfortable vibe and moderate prices. I highly recommend the burger and paired with a nice glass of wine, what could be better? Give Rumours Wine Bar a shot, you won't regret it.

One of the better pizza places in the area that's not a fast takeout spot. Prices are a bit higher than what I'd like to pay for pizza, but this isn't a typical pizza place.

The crust is what sells it for me, great flavor and texture that you would expect from a wood fired spot. They don't go too heavy on the sauce and toppings either making sure the pizza is balanced.

It was delicious. Staff was very friendly. Service was a little slow but that's to be expected on the first week being open. Alex did a great job especially since it was his first job ever. I'm sure ill be back soon.
OMG the most amazing restaurant I go all the time it's so phenomenal I can't explain yumm!! :)

Calypso was one of the first places I ate when I first moved here,  and for a light lunch or dinner, really hits the spot. 
                I usually get their curry chicken plate here,  along with seasonal fruit or spiced sweet potatoes (sprinkled with coconut), and the fantastic coconut cornbread muffins. Recently I tried the BBQ chicken,  and found that rather as well. Their fruit tea is absolutely delicious and I always get it when I'm here! 
                  I've tried at least one salad here,  but it wasn't to my liking. I'm a picky salad eater anyhow. The burger option they have here is also good,  with spices and possibly peppers added to the burger patty. They do make excellent brownies and cookie bars,  and the key lime pie I had last visit was heavenly. Even with that I wasn't overly full;  the meals here really aren't too heavy.  This place is also pretty affordable, which makes it a nice healthy option in a sea of fat food choices.
Just so so. Sadly the only real selection for Korean in center city. The usual selection of dishes and decent quality.

I have been waiting to get to Lucky Dill for a while, I have not seen anything close to a authentic deli in the area and was hoping that this place would come close.  Mostly it did not disappoint.  

I had the King of New York sandwich which was delicious.  I was surprised the rye wasn't toasted, I didn't ask for it but expected it. The coleslaw was also very good, and the meal came with a dessert, I had the Apple Strudel, it was awesome!  They have a bakery also which looked very tasty.

A little issue, it was $14 for my sandwich, which is a bit pricey unless you put a lot of money into ambience like Lucky Dill did, then I guess your have to make it up.  But the thing is, I can still get a $10 New York Yankee at Jason's Deli without the more upsale feel.

One other thing, the lights in the bar area are really in your face, like it's 3am and they jack them up to get you out the door kinda bright.  

But still 5 stars all in all for the taste, great service even in the bar, and having Pepsi!
For someone who is from Hawaii, I think they did a pretty good job at replicating similar menu item. The ambiance was really nice, and the food was pretty good.

Anytime I get to get it I get it. I'll drink the caniac sauce like a fine wine. 


We need this in Wisconsin ASAP!!!


Chick fil a is not enough.

Ordered a 10 inch pizza takeout. It was very good.  It tastes fresh. The crust is not too thick and not too thin, just right. I wish I  wasn't on a diet; I would eat the entire 10in pizza.  The place was very clean.
The blackened shrimp was recommended. I got them on a garden salad with balsamic dressing. I'm sure I will be craving it next week! Yummi!

Females workers are very rude. I know that's a strong accusation but I have visited this location countless times and experienced this treatment. They seem as if they don't want to work and a simple bowl is difficult to make. I've even sat and watched them interact with male patrons and seen a obvious difference. Their portions are always bigger! Literally paled high and a pleasant experience is always given. I spend too much money at this location and I'm tired of this shit! Grand is closet to my house however I will now take my business elsewhere!

Fabulous, trendy, and clean establishment. Excellent friendly and efficient staff. Awesome happy hour! You can purchase the entire menu for 35.00! We had the chicken sandwich, dill fries, mac & cheese, and corn bread. The chicken sandwich and dill fries were our favorite! Half off drafts, wine and well liquor.  We would highly recommend this to anyone!!

This was my first time eating here and if I were judging based upon food alone, I'd give it 2.5 stars, but the server was kind so that tipped the scale to a little in their favor. The chicken was dry and I wasn't personally a fan of the sauce.

I'd recommend this place to anyone wanting to avoid crowds of people and eat something quick that is a lot better than fast-food.

If I do happen to be in the area again and decide to eat here over the other options, then I'll definitely order a different protein. The creamed spinach and potatoes were pretty good.

Every time I've been here I've had a great experience.  To be able to sit outside on a nice sunny day and enjoy a great drink and some good food, what more can you ask for?

The last time I was here I had brunch on a Saturday.  I went for the breakfast, while my friends decided to do lunch items.  My pancakes and bacon were good.  The calamari salad, which I shared, was excellent.  The fact that you can get drinks with breakfast food, means The Continental is a winner in my book.  But in all seriousness, the food is great and the service each time I have been has been excellent.

I've been going here for 7 years. I've always had a good experience. The food is delicious and I've never been disappointed! I love the Thai iced tea, chicken curry and their salads. My family loves going here as well. It's a small restaurant that is well decorated, well kept and clean. most of the time I order and pick up and take it home. When we do eat here it's a quiet & nice experience. The employees are very friendly and they know us by name. They are so nice to my daughter, she enjoys going there too. This is one of my favorite places.

We stopped in after enjoying ourselves a little too much all day.  We needed food- I'm not sure if that's why we loved this place.  Our server was Joy, and she was nice and sweet and cheerful.  Very happy to have her as our waitress!  I had 1/2 muffuletta, which was huge and delicious.   Like I said, not sure if a buzz made this food really good, or if it was legit great.  Either way, service and atmosphere were awesome and we'll be back!

I actually don't really care for custard but Bobby's is AMAZING. The chocolate custard is by far my favorite. It's so creamy and smooth. It's rich in flavor too. I loved it so much that I purchased two quarts to take home. I've also had the pumpkin pie one and that was really great too. To me, the vanilla wasn't as great as the chocolate but it still was really good. It sucks that it isn't open all year round or else I'd be going back all the time!

Go for the apps and eat them all...  forget about entrees because the apps, dips and small bites are incredible.   Tasty, exciting and nicely sized portions for the price point.    It's a fun, bright but not too loud atmosphere, bartenders perhaps a bit too cool for school, overall a solid bar and nosh experience.   An unexpected find in a slightly surprisingly location (off a hotel lobby) that delivered.

So many good reviews of this place left me thinking it would be an ok place to eat. Boy was I wrong. When people say friendly staff, I guess you'd have to consider a "hello", "are you ready to order" and "enjoy"... Friendly. I was never asked how my sandwich was. Which was sadly absolutely horrible. This is my first time visiting this place and I can not say I would come back. If the waitress had asked me how it was I would have told her I was exceptionally dissatisfied. I took one bite and asked for a box to feed it to my dogs. I would have thought she would have thought it was weird that I ordered a sandwich and took one bite and boxed it up. I ended up eating the remainder of my daughters kids meal. Maybe their breakfast menu is better but I can't say I recommend the lunch menu.

Wayne Location is so much better. 

I love White Dog Cafe, ESP one in Wayne, PA. But this location....I do not think I am ever going to come back. I came here for brunch last Saturday and I was excited to eat their amazing food. When we got there, there was a huge line, but I made a reservation so we didn't have to wait that long. The hostess was very rude and did not say hi and was flustered the whole time. After getting sat, the server greeted us fairly quickly and gave us the menu. From that point on, it went downhill. What I hate the most in the world is being rushed. The server was rushing us to place an order and after we got our food, she was nowhere to be found. When we were almost done with our food, she came back multiple times to clean off our plate....this might sound like a good thing but the problem was, we were still eating and we just felt rushed. I was scared to put my fork down because I thought she was gonna take my plate away. After cleaning our table off, once again, she was nowhere to be found to give us our check.

To top it all off, the food was not as good compared to the other location. If anyone wants a full on White Dog cafe expeiernce, do not come to this location!

Good Food!!! While visiting NOLA for my birthday this year, a friend suggested this place. I was so happy she did since I was on the search for good seafood and a few New Orleans signature entrees. This was definitely the right place. 

First, I have to admit that this was a new experience for me, I've never eaten at a place that served potatoes instead of rolls- by the time the entrees rolled out.... I was full from the potatoes -LOL

I ordered Etoufee, which was the best I've had. The service was quick &  sweet. The prices were reasonable for an authentic New Orlean experience. Next time I'm in town, Deanies will be first on my list!

I enjoyed this restaurant. They have a vast selection of Japanese items on their menu. It would be a great place to go if you're craving sushi but have no friends who want or like sushi, because they have lots of other options. I ordered the red dragon roll, and it was spicy and delicious! I also ordered the chicken okonomiyaki, and that was so yummy! The service was friendly and efficient. Overall, a place I would come back to if I was a local.

Love the pizza. What I love even more is the pizza specials. A pint of beer and a slice. 

I've only been there twice but I enjoyed it both times. Next time I'm in town I'll definitely make sure to stop by.

This is one of our favorite restaurants and we always take visitors there. We had early menu, and again, seafood is delicious (catch of the day - grouper and tuna teriyaki w/o teriyaki sauce). Desert is always fabulous. So for food I'll give them 5 star. 

Due the rain we had to eat inside. Our first indoor dining since February. Staff didn't wear masks, including our waiter. Waiter made us very uncomfortable by leaning to close to speak to us.  On top of it, younger guy (I assume manager) decided to adjust wall thermostat that was just above our table. He leaned very close to us (no mask) to us.

Will not be going back until they start using masks or when pandemic is no longer an issue. 

Sorry to do this, but I felt too uncomfortable to be there.

The food was excellent however the service lacked. The server brought out French fries instead of salad that was ordered and didn't apologize or say there was a mix up she replied "yea I know you ordered a salad" then went to get it and just placed it on the table and walked away. There were a few other unpleasant interactions that was not appreciated and I don't recall every being told the servers name however it's a Friday afternoon (June 15) at 12-1pm and we were at table 13. 
And we were just ready to leave (paying in cash) and we used the ziosk in order to see the bill to make it easier since she rarely came back to the table and the waitress walks past us places the bill and walks away quickly without saying a word. And all of sudden her mood changed when we had the cash on the table. I usually don't tip bad but how do you tip when nothing is done correctly or enjoyable?

I really wanted to like this place.  I really did. 

Some give negative food reviews when service is terrible. I don't think service should affect the review for the food. I thought the service here was great, but the food was sub par.  I travel for work and have many places to compare this to, and this just doesn't live up to others that have great yelp reviews. 

I came for the ramen. Tasted water down. The pork was so tiny it couldn't have been any smaller.  I'm not sure if other reviewers where comparing this ramen to the stuff in plastic bags people ate in college or maybe they were comparing it to cup of noodles and that's why they gave this place great reviews. Comparing it to other ramen I've had in So Cal, Bay Area, and other places with higher concentration of authentic Asian cuisine, this place is just nowhere close. 

I had the sushi roll which is half off with ramen. They must've taken half the amount of fish off too. It was just rice and seaweed.

Absolutely fantastic! Could be one of the better restaurants in Nashville. Try the Cornish game hens and the lamb shank. The service was impeccable and our waiter, Zee, was very accommodating and explained the menu and origins of all the recipes. You do not want to miss the jewel!

It's rare to have an aesthetic experience in a restaurant but this is as good as it gets. Visually pleasing with complex, subtle, and perfectly balanced flavor in everything we ordered. Friendly and professional staff who didn't rush us even as the restaurant was closing. Reasonably priced for the high quality and not pretentious. I can't afford to eat here all the time but will continue to come for special occasions. If I could I wouldn't hesitate to give a 6 star recommendation.

First this is not Mexican food it is really Mexican inspired white-yuppy food. The menu is so limited and frankly boring. If you are looking to see and be seen in a trendy restaurant this is your place. If you want genuinely, delicious Mexican food definitely look elsewhere.
Great food! The brisket is amazing, the sides are delicious and the desserts are so yummy!

Before I left my home, I checked the website for the store hours of the Eegee's at 8320 E Broadway Blvd. Tucson, AZ, 85710 and it said 11:00 p.m. That was perfect as I was going to be heading to work at the VA Hospital in South Tucson. I pulled into the drive-thru at 10:50 p.m. and waited, and waited....finally a voice comes on the speaker and says, "I need to let you know, our system is down, we can only take cash" No HELLO, just that blanket statement. In response I said, "perfect, I have cash" I waited, and waited....another voice came on the speaker and said "we are CLOSED" in which I replied, "not according to your website, you are open until 11 p.m." I waited, and waited and he repeated "we are closed" and again I repeated, "not according to your website, it says 11 p.m. and listen, I'm on my way to work at the VA Hospital and just want a sandwich for my "lunch" break. To which he replied, "we closed at 10:30 p.m. tonight". Can you say LIVID??!! I was LIVID!! So here I am at the VA Hospital with nothing to eat!! I have already told my co-workers about this experience. I will also be posting it on my Facebook page for family and friends to see it. You & I & everybody else that reads this knows these employees were LYING!! They had put everything away, counted down the till, & were cleaning up to get out of there as early as possible, not expecting a customer to pull in at 10:50 p.m. and THAT is NOT my fault!! I hope you enjoy all the negative reviews from these two employees not wanting to do their JOBS!! Besides, it may not seem like much, but I calculated it and I would have spent about $12, but how often are they doing THIS? How much money are YOU losing because these boys are turning customers away? Think about THAT for a minute. Finally, I have loved Eegee's for years, but THIS was only the culmination of how shitty your customer service has gotten and I will NOT be back!! Baggins Gourmet Sandwiches, Beyond Bread, Chef Chic, Hoagie House, Jason's Deli, Jimmy John's, Jersey Mike's, Planet Sub,  Potbelly Sandwich Shop, Serial Grillers, etc., etc. You see where I'm going with this? I have PLENTY of places to choose from that would be HAPPY to take MY money....especially right NOW, when MANY people have lost their jobs. I'm grateful I haven't and can still afford to eat out occasionally.

Been going here since it first opened and really don't have any major complaints or bad experiences in what must be 50+ visits.  That alone is worth 5 stars in my book.  

I think the food is exactly what you would expect for a craft beer and happy cows place.  Allthough the portions have shrunk thru the years. (you should have seen the original chicken quesadilla back in the day,)  it is consistent.  I guess they were losing money on me during my chick quesa and Maker's Mint Julep phase.  

While I've read some raves about the Tues nite trivia, I wouldn't bother if you are 35+ and like to hear yourself think.  I've never understood needing more entertainment than alcohol and bull#%^&.  

Also, for what it's worth, I finally found a hot cool wife, but I definitely wasn't looking for her in there.  Call me crazy, but it's not an easy place to meet the ladies. 

As always, I will run in there for lunch and a beer or a few drinks with my friends at nite, as long as it is not Tues nite!

The ramen was pretty good. I got the tonkotsu shoyu. It's a little pricey for ramen compared to what I pay for when I go to sac. Their level of spicy is a little light in my opinion. I got a 2 just to see what it was like. It was a little less than mild. But I could've gone up to a level 4/5. Overall their service is good, broth was good, egg and pork is delicious, and the noodles were cooked nicely.

being middle eastern, i am a. critical, b. always curious about places that claim to be authentic.

this place feels pretty authentic. the store front is your average ME import store, with a restaurant area off to the side. i ordered the ishtar platter, which is a combo plate with chicken kabobs, ground meat kabob (lula), and falafel with a grilled tomato, charred onion, raw onion with sumac, some chopped veggies and rice. the meat was a tiny bit dry but the chicken was simply incredible. everything else was great also. i am a sucker for falafel, and theirs was amazing. they brought me complimentary hummus and hot bread, which was also quite tasty.

for dessert i had tea and baklava. the baklava was so-so (i've had better, i've also had less good...in three different countries) and the tea was not what i was expecting. at least it was sadaf tea bags and not random earl grey stuff, but i was expecting authentic tea from a kettle or samovar or something. tea bags just aren't the same.

over all, the food was pretty good and the prices were fair, and the service was great. if i were to go back, i would probably just go straight for the taok kabob plate or the falafel plate, and skip the combo.

Okay this is where I have to question the value of Yelp reviews.  I live in NOLA.  I ate at GW Fins when it first opened.  I found the atmosphere to be generic, commercial and depressing.  I thought the food was mediocre at best.  I had redfish that had obviously been frozen and I found to be overpriced at $21.  The service was okay.  It felt like it might be the server"s first job so we were very patient and she was very sweet.  By the end of the meal I felt I would never return even though the restaurant is in walking distance of my house.

Several friends who came to visit asked to eat at GWFINS.  I was sort of shocked .  They had read about it on YELP.  I usually steered them toward places I thought would be more local and better seafood.   

Finally I had a house guest on the week end who really wanted to go there.  I realized that I had created a prejudice  based on several years ago.  I said sure, and was eager to go again and see what all the fuss was about. 

Yikes, groundhogs day all over again.  The place has become even mor depressing in terms of a faux atmosphere.  I ordered the redfish again it was soft like only frozen redfish can be.  Even my friend was mystified by the high ratings and the mediocre food.  The worst thing about GWFINS is that it does not make you dream and the food is average.  You could be anywhere USA. There are so many better seafood places in NOLA.  I am starting to lose my faith in YELP.  Instead of getting a sense of direction from the reviews I just get more confused now.
After this, we went to superior seafood and the oysters there were better and it was overall cheaper. Makes Dragos seem less worth the hype!

I could hang out at Rawk Star Cafe all day. As soon as you come in, they introduce themselves and offer a sample of all of their custom made, raw vegan sauces and chili! I loved that they did this because it helps you really decide what you like and don't like so you are 100% satisfied with your order. I ordered a collard wrap with the chili paste and a custom banana berry smoothie. They also offer vegan and gluten snacks throughout the store!

Very poorly run. Placed my online order 20 minutes before showing up and it still took them an additional 10 minutes after I showed up to have it ready. Not because the food was not finished, but because they were running around aimlessly. I listened to one cashier complain to a customer about a co-worker for five minutes before she saw fit to assist me. When I finally got the sandwich, it was soggy. Plus the fries were below average.

Had the pastrami cheese on rye... and it was the most amazing pastrami sandwich I've ever had! I ordered a whole, and it was enough to last 2 meals or 2.5 meals! :-) 

Service is good! Very sweet owner and silly workers. 

I would love to come again to try something else. Highly highly recommend.

The bar food at Cajun Mike's is better than the gourmet version in other cities.  It is close to the Quarter without all the terrible things that means.  It looks and smells just like a bar should.  I recommend the burgers, the oyster po boys, the onion rings, and whatever I get next week because that will be good too.
