Nice family restaurant. You can eating and enjoy your time with family. Absolutely, the food is outstanding. I am Asian, but I still very enjoy this kinds of food. Next time I will try the honey wine.

Really good food. Small place but super cute. Service was good but not super friendly. Had a groupon so it was a great deal. It does close by 3 everyday so make sure you get there early. Last time we tried at about 25 min till and they  wouldn't seat us. Would definitely try it again. Amazing selection on crepes, will try a desert crepe next time.

Geno's Steaks is really not that great.  Pat's is wayyy better.  However, sometimes, when Pat's is closed for a minute or has too many people in line, you have to go to Geno's.  There's nothing nice about Geno's- I keep going there at 3 am wasted, and eating cheese fries, and unfortunately for my body, cheesesteaks.  The salt that is dumped in the cheese fries is too much! Especially when you're already dehydrated from drinking all night.  Sometimes my neighbor is there working and it freaks me out.  My friend Mark likes Geno's better than Pat's, so when he's with me, we do Geno's.  He only likes Geno's because of the hot guy that power washes the sidewalks from 3-5am.  I really should stay away from here at these hours.
The people and food here is the best in my point of view and I recomend it to many people of different races. They have many oriental meals that anyone would enjoy.

First time I tried to eat here there was a 45 min wait so I made some reservations this time. From what you have probably already read the place is awesome very cozy and totally for fills the New Orleans vibe...but most importantly you must order the Pan Fried Pork Shoulder. It's perfection on a plate since it's served on top of a bed the the most heavenly & creamy grits you will ever eat. My husband got the burger and fries which was good but is just a burger. I was nice enough to share and he agreed!

Ritz Diner at the intersection of Roosevelt Blvd and Rhawn, is a fairly typical roadside diner in Northeast Philadelphia. Its menu is likewise standard fare, with a full page of breakfast possibilities on the back. That's what I was there for, and it only took a minute to decide I wanted their Ritz Omelet (onion, green pepper, tomato and hot Italian sausage), with Rye Toast and bottomless mug of Java. 

Service was very good and it was beautifully presented within minutes of ordering. First observation was that it looked to be a three egger with filling enough for a smaller shell. Its pants were too big for its body, as both ends were a couple inches of egg without anything within. It tasted fine although the heat from the sausage failed to materialize very often. It was still enough for me, especially with the well buttered toast and refills of coffee brought to me by my friendly server. So, I am not complaining, but only making an observation, and suggestion that if I was aware of this imbalance, others would be too, and perhaps adjustments should be made. 

Didn't see much in the way of in-house bakery goods, nor a bar, nor even a traditional counter with spinners for the solitary traveler.  

Adequate parking in front.
ate here had a hamburger for my 16th birthday im a fan love to come here when visiting

o taqueria del sol how i wanted to love you.  perhaps you have been opened too short a time?  the food was meh, the service oscillated between helpful and completely rude.  your location is perfect, the concept works for you in atlanta....but, today you felt like "a chain restaurant".  maybe you are?  not my thing. i did not know that was what you are....

had i known you were a chain, i would have been satisfied with the food. 'hot plate' mexican with zero spice - ready in 30 seconds (wow, amazing how fast that could be created & then appear in front of me).

i was told afterwards (from food loving friends), that i need to venture out to murfreesboro road for fresh and authentic mexican food...with flavor.  think i will take that advice.....

There are some tasty breakfast places in the ridge area, but no where else has the same waitresses, grill top, and decor from the day they opened. :)  
The food is exactly what you expect, maybe even tastier than you'd expect. The service is exactly what you'd expect. The decor is always better than I remember even though it never really changes. 
I do not like Dots - I prefer Breakfast Club. We don't end up here quite as much as we used to, but that's due to the hours. Once they shortened the hours, we aren't there as much, but we still call in more often than I realize for a Saturday or Sunday morning breakfast.

Came here recently for a weekday lunch and the service was very good and fast! They have so many good options to pick from. We had an order of the Beignets (which are much better than cafe du monde, in my opinion), Chicken salad croissant, and an omelette.  The portions were pretty good, although my chicken salad was a little bland.  The beignets were amazing and we really enjoyed the live music.  The outside dining area is gorgeous.

Union 50 is one of those places where there were so many choices on the menu that looked amazing, I struggled to choose.  Eventually I settled on a mixed drink.  Sadly, I don't remember the name if the drink, but it was Rye Whisky with a peach infusion.  Very tasty.  For my food, I chose a mixed salad to start, and a very good and spicy Kimchi Meatloaf.  The salad was good.

The meatloaf was a typical smoky meatloaf with a very spicy Kimchi tomato sauce on top.  Delicious.

Great drink menu with lots of whiskeys, ryes, wines, beer, and mixed drinks.  While the drink menu had a great list of wines, they were very short on wines by the glass, only offering 4 Reds and 4 Whites by the glass.

The atmosphere was trendy, loud, good music, and they have live bands later in the evening.  The crowd is younger and the restaurant has more of a bar feel than restaurant with many tables being high tables with bar chairs.  

Tip for the ladies, it was chilly inside.  Normally as a guy, I love it cool, but it was downright chilly inside.  My wife and daughters were all wearing long sleeves and still a little chilly.  I saw ladies at other tables obviously freezing.  Tip, bring a jacket.

Service was good however the wait staff were very busy and we did not see the waiter as much as we would have liked.  Normally you are offered a drink refill in between the appetizers and the main dish, but we didn't see our waiter again until after the mains had arrived.

Overall really good restaurant and great food.  We would recommend!

Tasty thin cracker style crust pizza. 12" was plenty for me and my 3 year old. The cheese has almost a creamy texture /taste- different than other pizza cheese. Will definitely eat there when in town again!

Erica is right I would give this restaurant zero stars if possible they awarded me free beer on Facebook but had a tough time honoring.  Now they are holding my money for four days.  Bad service bad food half the beers were out of stock.  Manager Avoided us.  Full of smokers and dogs.

Staying at an Airbnb close by and celebrating a birthday during covid had us doing takeout The food was so good; the crispy chicken app w chili sauce was NOT disappointing. The skirt steak was tender and the sides were so tasty. The cilantro rice was also very good. We will be going back before we head home. Super nice owner too.

Service was horrible.
 4 tables in the bar where we were seated and our order was put in after a table who was seated after us.
We waited 1 hour for lunch and then our order was sent out incorrect.
My new item Chopped Steak was raw instead of medium rare. Not worth complaining about at this point.
What a disaster.

Being a Florida Cracker, I've had tons of bbq and this place is authentic Florida Cracker bbq and the best I've ever had in my life! My husband brought home chicken, brisket, pork, sausage, ribs, baked beans, and cole slaw. 

There is no rival for the taste of each and every one of these items!!! This owner knows what he's doing!!! The meat is perfect and moist and the taste is just absolutely...well, PERFECT! The bbq sauce is just spicy and sweet enough, but not overwhelming, and it tastes great! The baked beans are not your typical baked beans and you will be pleasantly surprised by them as they are delicious!

My husband didn't realize they had smoked cabbage or he would've definitely brought some of that home to me too. I can't wait to try that and the smoked mullet the next time around! 

For all the food he brought home, we have enough for two meals for three people and it was only $40. You just can't beat that for the quality of bbq you are getting here!

We are currently rolling around our house so full it's ridiculous and already can't wait to eat the rest of it later!!

My boyfriend and I dined here for our six month anniversary on April 18th and it was an amazing experience. Our server Amaro was extremely kind, sweet, and helpful. Both my partner and I are a bit indecisive when choosing what to eat, but Amaro was patient and gave us good recommendations. Outside seating was comfortably spaced. The food was incredible. It is definitely one of my favorite restaurants now, and whenever I can make it back out to Boise (I'm from Central Washington) I'm definitely going to go again.

If you're craving some New York, street slice pizza - here ya go!  They are friendly over the phone, delivery is always pretty fast (30-45 minutes) and the prices are cheap!  The pizza is exactly like they say...the foldable, New York style thinner crust that is still very soft.

This is not the fancy thin crust that's wood fired nor is it deep dish. Go elsewhere for that! They've never messed up an order and my husband and I usually do half and half.

This place use to be fabulous, but, has since gone down.  Every week there are different wait staff who is just learning. Their experienced staff keeps leaving which is part of the problem because they knew how to cater to customers.  Soup is always cold, steak use to be great, twice i ordered it recently and both times it was wrong.  One of their salads I love I don't even order anymore because they don't make it right and it always missing something, I ran into three waitresses outside at other diners the horror stories of their treatment from management was horrible.  One night we actually sat there and watched in horror as two waitresses bullied another and management did nothing until we said something.  Oh, and if you go sit in the front section, because the bad in the back is terrible and extremely loud.

Delicious! I had the Monte cristo sandwhich. Such a good portion and the carrot cake after was the best ending to an amazing lunch. I was able to have left overs for dinner. I recommend you try this place if you have not yet. It's like a higher grade Panera bread.

We were on the hunt for a new place to eat and knew we wanted pizza and we found this on Yelp and decided to give it a go and we are so pleased we did! The service is  first class, the food is great! We had the pizza with  white sauce....which I highly recommend. .. It's  not a fancy place, it's a comfortable  space. Support your local businesses  starting with this one. We will be back.

I read most of the reviews here and some have some validity to them. First of all i would like to address the reviewers who say the Nostalgic or fun factor isnt there any more. I'm willing to bet that they are seen the mall from the point when they where in their late teens or early 20's. Therefore of course it isnt going to be the same now that you are in your 30's. So its kind of an unfair assessment. On to the review its true that the mall wasnt the best designed mall. Its long and narrow and a bit confusing. The perceived large crowds are merely about 10 or so people but the design of the mall makes it feel like 30. Usually these are high traffic areas that tend to get "crowded". Ummm its a mall so of course it's going to attract unruly teenagers. I myself back in the 90's use to go there to try and hit on girls. True as most reviewers say the mall has seen better days. Some of this is due to the economy. Some of its due to simple fact the mall itself is now approaching 25 years. Most of the anchor stores have left. It is true what 1 reviewer said there are many stores basically selling the same thing. However, there is still plenty of  different stores and plenty of variety in here. Another thing i think may of hurt the mall is about 6 years ago rumors where circulated about the mall been demolished. Well fast forward and she is still there. On the security issues yes there are some break ins but overall i consider the mall basically safe. I think some of the reviewers are jittery Suburbanites. That been said they probably could use extra security patrolling the parking lots. There are lot of areas to cover and again the design of the mall itself can make it difficult for 2 or so Security Patrol cars to cover. So although the Mills is probably past her prime i still feel there is something to offer. It's not yet in too bad of despair as some of the reviews suggest.

Went here for dinner and I've never heard of this place. I was surprised because it was really really good. I had a little sticker shock when seeing the prices for the entrees but after I had a few sips of my margarita, I was ready to order.

I ordered the flank steak and chorizo entree. It came with guacamole, rice, and refried beans. I was surprised how soon the food came out on a Saturday evening. 

The flank steak was very very good. Perfectly cooked and and tender I put it in a homecooked tortilla that was warmed with rice and the beans and gauc and it was heaven almost. I could have eaten that all night long.

The meal was very worth price and would go back here again. 
I would like to note that the Hispanic music sounded a lot like the Police except in Spanish.

Went here on the recommendation of the Chamber of Commerce and they were spot on.  Got the bacon appetizer which made bacon even better if that is possible.  The bacon lettuce fried green tomato sandwich lived up to it's name.  Friendly staff rounded out the visit.
After a long wait, we enjoyed a delicious meal with great service! Glad to see this restaurant thriving! (Crab stuffed portobello was amazing)
Liked the food, great flavor to the shrimp and grits. Nice friendly, causal atmosphere. Definitely worth the wait and would come back again.
Ceviche St Petersburg, so excellent! Had the potato chips, chorizo, cod, paella and Catalan Cream. All amazing

0/5 for service
5/5 for Covid social distancing 

We called ahead of time to see if they had outdoor seating and if we could make a reservation. They said sure so we made a reservation and when we arrived, it didn't seem like the hostess or anyone had any idea about our reservation. This wasn't a big deal as there was ample outdoor seating. We told them we'd like to sit outside if that was ok and the hostess said sure and gave us the QR menu code and said she would have someone bring us water and take our order. After about 15 minutes of waiting and no water or someone even coming outside to check on us, we got up and left.

Thank you so much Capitol Cellars for hosting my special evening. We held a private event their to celebrate our marriage with 10 people. Their back room was beautiful to hang out in and the food was terrific. Thank you for making our night special!
The baked oysters were amazing. Really great combo of super garlicy and a tiny bit of cheese and some butter. The service was so friendly but the oysters were to die for!

Disappointing. The food was average at best - the popular appetizer croquettes was presented well but the marinara side sauce tasted like it was out of a jar. The beef barley soup looked flavorful, but nearly tasteless and the Steak of the Union was poorly cooked and ropy. Nice atmosphere but the service was just okay. Not worth the trip and  we won't return...

I have been treating myself to Frankie's  for a few years now, and I have yet to be disappointed. This is a true Tucson Gem, cut and polished to absolute culinary brilliance. 
This is the kind of place that offers a masterpiece... and then some other stuff. Don't bother going here unless you are in the mood for a real Tucson Cheesesteak. I grew up in the Mid-Atlantic region, within 100 miles of Philadelphia, and to say I've had a few cheesesteaks in my day is an understatement. They may have been invented in Philly but they were perfected in Tucson. 
The "South Philly" is the way to go, with the broccoli rabe. You can add mushrooms and sweet or spicy peppers for an additional fee. The meat is juicy and tender and the rolls are always fresh, like they were flown in on an F16 and were still warm when they got here.
Some people swear by the Cheez Whiz, but to me, putting goop from a jar on this work of art is like restoring the Mona Lisa with cans of Krylon. Go for the   provolone, "authenticity" be damned.

Best Thai food place in St. Louis. I've been coming here for years and nothing tops Pearl Cafe's dishes and beer selection. Cute little place that you absolutely have to try. Everything from the appetizers to the noodle dishes to the rice dishes are amazing! The owners are so sweet and make you feel right at home.

We had nice time at Bardenay.  The atmosphere was wonderful.  I will say that I felt that it was over priced but it was such a lovely atmosphere I guess that is why the food and drinks cost so much.  We had a few cocktails and shared a meat and cheese tray appetizer.  I wold not return again because despite it being a beautiful restaurant and the waitress being a lovely lady, I can get drinks and appetizers elsewhere for a more reasonable price.

I'm not sure what's going on at this place but it really has gone down hill yet the prices are still on the higher side of pizza shops.

I rarely feel ripped off when ordering from a pizza shop but ordering 2 large pizzas and 36 wings for $70 then getting wings the size of my pinky. no I don't have huge giant hands I have average hands.

the pizza is decent but even that has gone a bit downhill. their other locations definitely taste better. 

probably won't be ordering from here anymore.
It's the best Mediterranean option here in Exton. Falafel balls and Grape leaves are good option in Appetizers. Chicken/Kafta Kebab platters are also good in Entrée. Must try
It was late and they delivered to our hotel room. It was thin, crispy, hot and full of flavor. Delicious!

We love the Chicago style pizza here! Time quotes are generally accurate, and the bartenders are friendly in helping you choose a good beer to pass the time if you order in. Pizza sauce is a bit on the spicy side - definitely some good kick to it.

The biggest challenge for me personally in writing this review was the price.  I fully admit I knew what I was getting into beforehand.  It was Valentines Day, so they were "Prix Fixe" which is french for "We know it's a lovers holiday and you are a sucker".

In approaching it all the question is, what kind of dinner is worth $246.43 for two (Including tax and tip)?  What kind of service and food quality approaches that price?  I guess like art you know it when you see it. It was a 

We arrived early so it wasn't very busy, but by the time we left it was packed.  There were plenty of other people doing the same math I was I guess.

The Prix Fixe was a four course meal.

I started with the Cesar Salad which was good, and included BONUS bacon. I've never heard of a Cesar with Bacon but its possible I'm just not "epicurean" enough to know such things.

After that it was the Ravioli filled with goat cheese and artichokes served in a roasted pepper sauce.  This was probably my favorite entree of the meal.  Chef Boyardee would be proud to see Ravioli done this well.

For the main course it was Beef rib-eye in a peppercorn sauce served with mashed potatoes.  I was surprised at how unevenly cooked this was.  Not that it was bad, but the edges seemed like they were well charred and the middle was just okay.  The potatoes were decent, but overall this was a disappointment.

For dessert the better half got the Tiramisu and I got the Torrone and chocolate semifreddo.  They were both good, but the semifreddo was delicious.  I've never had anything like this before, but I would recommend it to everyone. fantastic.

In the end, I guess I just can't recommend this meal at this price, even ON Valentines Day. For a regular price and meal this would probably have garnered 3 or 4 stars, but at this price it's just 2.

I had to update my review to 3 stars after trying their pho. I had previously been disappointed with their Rice Vermicelli, but since my boyfriend said he had liked their pho, I decided it was only fair that I give it a shot. I got the P2 Pho with White Meat Chicken and although I wasn't a fan of the meat, the broth was decent. The vegetables were fresh and the broth was piping hot which I appreciate. 

Prices are reasonable and their $1.50 delivery charge via GrubHub is less than most restaurants so I can see myself ordering from here again.

This place is awesome , I wish I can give it 10 stars , are waitress was cool as hell , I don't know her name but her family is from Connecticut and I am from the same town ,  the food was excellent , It's too bad that it takes me an hour to get here from Sarasota or I would come here more often

Best breakfast place hands down. Everything was amazing. Service, food especially. Do not be discouraged by the wait, the food is more than worth it. They are normally very busy, and they had forgotten our appetizer, but the manager came over to apologize, brought us a gift card, and later on brought us an appetizer on the house. Very accommodating we always speak very highly of this place and will continue to do so!

Dropped by here for lunch once and tried out the chicken dosa. Never had dosa before so I didn't know what to expect. It was like a giant crepe. The chicken had just enough spice to make it interesting. Really liked it, along with the condiments/sauces it came with. The desserts looked yummy but didn't try them. Will come back here again if I'm ever back in Exton and perhaps try their thali. That seems to be their bargain lunch special but didn't realize that until after I made my order. As others have said, the decor here is "modest" but that's an understatement. You definitely come here for the food, not the ambiance.

My wife and I dined here for the first time on Friday night. We wanted to have a nice meal for her birthday, and she knew that I was craving lobster. We arrived on a cold, rainy night, and were very pleased to be seated immediately. We then met our waiter, Johnny. Johnny, without a doubt, is one of the best waiters that has ever served us. He was friendly, polite, and witty. He knew the menu, and made an excellent suggestion for an appetizer. Our food was brought to us in a very timely manner, and was hot, fresh, and delicious. Everything, including the vegetables, was done to perfection. We have dined at a few other high end restaurants in town, and have been very disappointed on more than one occasion. Red Lobster delivered the full package. Good service, good food at a fair price. Even though it is at the opposite end of town from us, we will definitely be back. Thank you, Johnny, for making a special night just that much better! You deserve a raise!

This place makes seriously good food. The dishes taste like they were prepared with love by your Moroccan fairy-grandmother. The entrees deftly combine savory and sweet and are a comfort food you wish you had discovered sooner. 

Tip for ordering: skip the Mediterranean and go for the Moroccan specialties.

Went here from a recommendation from a friend. Only been here once so far and will come back to try a different dish as the tacos were not that great. Had the chicken and steak taco. The meat wasn't very savory and had no kick to it at all. Authentic tacos would naturally be spicy and these weren't that. Had to add the hot sauce just to make the taco half way decent.

In NYC there were so many great authentic places that I was spoiled. Was told thus place was authentic but I disagree.

Also had the Mexican cheese curds (awesome) and street corn (also great.) Next time will try a burrito or torta.

Wow, I finally had a sea salt body scrub that completely does NOT wet my hair and that I must admit was better than the salt n' glow at Burke Williams.  I had the best spa experience from the professional services that were rendered by Ebony and Eric.  The aroma at the spa was very pleasing  and I particularly like that I was given a choice as to what scent I was used for my massage and blended with my sea salt.

Awesomely food and awesome service. Our waitress was wonderful. She guided us through the menu. The grits are AH-MAZING!! I don't like Gouda- but I would eat a bowl of the Gouda grits any day. And the biscuits are too die for.

Overall my 2-night stay here was good. 

However upon arrival they didn't have the room I reserved available and we were put in a smaller room than I wanted.  Still nice and clean regardless.

Staff is super friendly.  I was a little disappointed our "concierge" at check in was so attentive, personable, and funny...but then saw us the next day and didn't even remember our names or that he was our contact during our stay...saw me a 3rd time and even confused me for someone else.

The staff in the Elevage Restaurant were beyond amazing...Tiffany went ABOVE AND BEYOND.  Food was a solid 4 there.  They do a bloody/mimosa brunch with all you can drink...$15 I think it was.  Worth the money...we had some cocktails and brunch before hitting up the spa for a couple's massage.

The spa was great!  Very relaxing.

Rooftop bar is a nice touch.  The couches are relaxing.  Service was a little slow up there.  This place gets busy at night...best bet is to get there a little early and TIP - don't be afraid to share a couch section with other people...that's what we did and saw many others doing the same.

Right across from Bern's...so make your reservation there in advance and you don't even have to wait forever for your car from valet!  You can just literally walk across the street.

I normally go through and read the bad reviews on Yelp. Sometimes they are funny. Sometimes they are whiny. And sometimes they are informative. The few I found for the Rattlesnake Club I think were trying to be helpful. All I can say is if you are one of the people that have had a bad experience here, I would give them another try. 

When my wife and I walked in we were greeted immediately and seated shortly after. I will not go into the decorations as they have been fully covered. 

We started with salads and I had the Kale Caesar. It was VERY GOOD. Their house made dressing was good, but they also put a balsamic vinagrette on it which was tangy and really complemented the salad. 

For the main course I lived dangerously and had the Pepperoni Pizza on a cauliflower crust. It was fantastic. The cheese was perfect and the marinara was seasoned just right. I had to have the manager assure me that the crust was cauliflower. 

I really enjoyed my experience here and highly recommend it.

Worth the hype.  The ribs are some of the best I've ever had.  No sauce needed, perfect texture but go early because they run out of things.  They have boards up to show the tally of what's left.  We waited in line for about 30 mins the whole time watching the number of slabs get lower and lower.  I was one of the lucky ones that got a rack and wish I was gluttonous and got another.  This place is the real deal and they deserve the publicity that they get.

Easy to order, quick to pick up. The food is always fresh and delicious. I always get the Chicken Fried Rice and try different things on their menu. Loved their Beef Taryaki (sp?). They have a nice selection. They surprised me with a complimentary pint of iced tea. It was home made and so I thought it might need sugar and lemon. Straight out of the container, delicious and thirst quenching. It needed nothing. I just hope it's order able because I will ask for it next time I am there if it is. Highly recommend this restaurant. Happy it is close to where I live.

Alright, I'll admit right off the bat, I probably have some neighborhood bias here.  I can literally throw a stone from my window and hit this place (not that I've tried).

They serve quality renditions of diner standards.  Don't go expecting some noveau Greek-American cuisine.  Nope.  Just burgers, hoagies, club sandwiches, great greasy-spoon breakfast, and as Jamie S. points out, a small selection of Greek food.

Not only is the food always on target, the staff is very friendly--I've never walked in and not caught a smile.  The ambiance is cozy.  By that, I mean you feel right at home dining by yourself with a book at lunch time, but also that you probably won't fit more than 4 people in one of their 5 or 6 larger booths.  The rest of the booths are 2 seaters, and they have the classic "diner" bar setup for singles.

Couple of my friends highly recommended this noodle place to me and ever since that it becomes my favorite noodle place in the city of Philadelphia. The place is clean,the price is reasonable, and the service is great. I will definitely recommend this place to my other friends who haven't try this place. BTW my favorite dishes are the spicy beef with shaved noodle soup  with extra side of fried egg and the dumplings

One of the best meat and three's in the area. It has all the southern staples you'd expect, but the star here is the hot chicken. The portions are huge, so watch out and the desserts (especially the chess pie) are fantastic.

A bit overrated for the food and drinks but it's a much needed place for the area.  Jordan couldn't get over the fact that his beer was $10 for a normal pint.  Yeesh!

Lobster Bisque was just ok.  Nothing compared to other restaurants of similar caliber.

Shrimp cocktail was bar none... 

Godfather cocktail - 3 stars super strong
 
Prime Rib - 4 stars but was decently overcooked.  I ordered it medium rare and it was medium garage... excuse me "well."  My S.O. even said it was tough to chew at times.
This is great Thai food!! I ordered the drunken spicy noodle, yum!! Spicy and good! Best drunken noodle I've had in years!

This is hands down the best pizza I've had in florida.
Coming from Connecticut/ NY area, this pizza is just like home!

I went back for a gyro to-go after my hair date with Vince Walker, just a few stores down. It was too convenient NOT to go.

They chop the lamb to put into the sandwich, even though they slice it off the spit.

I added feta, red onions, lettuce, tomato, olives and tzatziki.

All incredibly fresh ingredients. Gol, I love this combination.

I ate the whole thing in one sitting, BUT I didn't eat the pita. There was nothing wrong with it. It looked beautiful. I just didn't want the carbs.

I think next time, I'll ask for a gyro without the pita. It was so good!!

I made a reservation through YELP for the bistro but found out when I arrived that the Bistro area was closed for a private party. I was not able to review this place. Walked down to Manayunk Brewery instead.

i consider Byrnes one of the most overrated places in philly. there food is mediocre....AT BEST!  the wings are intensely inconsistent. the rost beef sandwich is about the size of a quarter. the logs taste exactly like they sound. the crabs are small, bland and expensive. it is crowded and cramped. i just dont get it.  probably never will. if you want crabs and fries, go to chickie and petes. if you want wings, i am sure you will find better. they must hypnotize people as they come in because there is simply NOTHING special here.
The one restaurant we always go back to. Amazing food and great service every single time.

Simply put, WOW!  The food was amazing! We went to Panorama for a family function so we had a fixed menu for the first and second courses, and we got to pick from a list of 4 options for our third. For the first course there were their roasted mushrooms, Caesar salad, and mozzarella with roasted peppers and tomato. The mushrooms were not your typical mushroom, but Hen of the Wood mushrooms with black garlic sauce... they were amazing! Then for the 2nd course rigatoni with braised beef shank and short ribs, and gnocchi in a dream sauce. Both were excellent! I wanted to keep eating the rigatoni. For the 3rd course I had a veal tenderloin with parsnip purée. Parsnip is not my favorite thing, but the veal was tender and tasted amazing. To top the meal off we had cannoli and coffee. Overall the meal was amazing! I'll definitely come here again.

This is where I ate my first muffeletta.  This place is so classic.  This place inspired me to start making them on my own at home in California.    You know its going to be something great when there is a line full of locals.  

I litterally think of returning often and want to because of the sandwich.   LOVE IT!
Can I just say YUM! I live on campus and my roommate and I make weekly visits!
Another visit to Flip Burger. Brought the family today. Had a great time with awesome servers tasty food and great service.... we love this place!!!!

Visiting SB for business. I was walking towards the pier for dinner when I saw this place and there was a good crowd. Curious that I didn't see it on Yelp (yesterday), I learned they had just opened. I was seated at a community table. Turned out that the owner and his brother were at the table and we had a nice conversation while I enjoyed my dinner and drinks. Very nice vibe, great food, and good staff. Good luck you Finney's!
I love this place so much it has a great atmosphere and amazing food. Their cali club sandwhich is to die for. Their food is speedy quick, but that doesent change anything. Its really good

This place didn't look like much on the outside in this strip mall

But once inside an awesome up town place

Food was top notch 

I would recommend this place
Great place, friendly staff. Food was fresh and delicious! Brandon is a real hustler, gives good service.  Hope you get him when you go there!

Thanks Pita Pit for a healthy dinner i didn't feel guilty for stuffing my face with.  So many choices and combinations i would love to try them all someday.  The sandwiches are great because they are so flavorful and light but full of tasty goodness.  The service is fast from the time i walked in to the time i sat down it was maybe 5 min it takes longer to narrow down what then it takes them to make the food.  My only thing was the girl that waited on us i don't know if she was new or just shot out prob a bit of both cuz she had no idea what was going on and she didn't greet us when we walked in she just stood at the register and stared till we were like can we have...  Deffinatly check this place out its flavorful and fulfilling with out all the guilt of stuffing your face.

It's *amazing*!! They are whole food-based with simple ingredients (all ingredients are listed). They have kid bowls too. The ginger green broth is not at all salty. The ginger chamomile was salty and sweet. Bone broth super savory.
Best Chinese food !!!!  Huge portions!!   I go here often. I love the Black Pepper Chicken

No. Just no. Came here for breakfast and waited over 25 minutes for an egg sandwich. Place was pretty gross and the counters were sticky. Food was alright but not worth the wait. Toast is not toasted and the check comes long before your food even gets to you.

One of my favorite art museums. It's small enough to tackle in one day but large enough were you can come back many times and always learn something new. It's like a smaller version of NYCs Metropolitan Art Museum and NYC's Cloisters combined. I say that because they've got a number of recreated or authentic rooms reassembled from different cultures and periods in addition to the normal rooms and halls full of beautiful paintings and sculptures from most periods and countries. The museum is also very beautiful and is where the most famous scene of Rocky was shot. Feel free to run up the steps while humming "Eye of the Tiger" then stand where Sylvester Stalone stood, or just stand back and watch people from all over do just that. The top of the steps offers the best view of Philly for those who'd like to just get that perspective while the statue in front of the Museum is a wonderful piece of art as well (definitely worth walking around and climbing up on for a better view). 

If you appreciate art to any extent your trip to Philly would seriously be lacking without a trip to this museum.

We decided to try Kim Son, as we were  staying out by the airport, and this place is close by.  First of all, don't be confused by their sign in front of the restaurant, which says "Kim Son Seafood"...it's the same place. My husband ordered the bun...vermicelli noodles with chicken, and I ordered the lemongrass chicken. We decided to share the Vietnamese chicken wings as an appetizer, as we've seen these on many menus and often wondered about them.  We didn't wait too long for the first food to arrive, but it was my husband's entree which came out first, then, about 7 minutes later, the chicken wing appetizer came out. We shrugged, and ate the food as it was brought to us, as it was delicious and we were hungry, but my lemongrass chicken was nowhere to be seen. When I asked about it, I was told that it takes a long time, and then about 5 minutes later it finally arrived, but my husband ws already done with his entree, so I complained. The waitress sent the owner over, and she explained that the printer in the kitchen ran out of paper and that's why our order backed up a bit. I believe their expanation, and they were very nice about it, but they should have let me know before there was a problem, so service and communication can be issues here. The food itself was wonderful...my lemongrass chicken was spicy and full of lemongrass flavor, and the wings were in a sweet and sour sauce that tasted of fish sauce...really interesting and fun. My husband loved the bun, and, because our order got screwed up, the owner brought us a fabulous dessert of exotic fruit in chilled milk on the house. We will definitley return to Kim Son, and we wish them all the best, as they're doing a great job with the food.

Café Mochi has an excellent happy hour. Although there is not a huge selection of beverages to choose from, $2 or $3 per drink and the particularly yummy pink geisha is quite sufficient to make me happy. Sushi was  1/2 price with a few exceptions. I have been here twice so far and I enjoyed the inexpensive eats and drinks. The food is enjoyable and service can be hit or miss depending on how crowded they get during the HH.

The Post Dispatch food critic was right on with his poor review.  A very disappointing meal and a ridiculously limited menu.  Have to go back because I foolishly purchased 2 Groupons.  Oh well maybe the salad will be tolerable.

This a generic pizza chain around Delaware.  Nothing to be excited about, all their food is pretty below average.  Their pizza is really weird.  I used to eat at this one every once in a while becuase they are one of the few places that have service a little later into the evening if you don't want the national fast food chains.  The dining room seemed clean and the staff was friendly enough.
Food is good, Original Margarita is good and the service is great.  Manager makes sure everyone is taken care of.

So glad to have found this gem in Germantown. First of all: the deep dish is some of the best I've had including in Chicago. Be forewarned: proper deep dish takes time (45mins to an hour). On a busy night you can expect to wait a bit for your pizza. But it's well worth it.

The staff is friendly. There is a good selection of craft and domestic beers as well.
Food is overpriced and subpar. Ate here twice, horrible service both times, the second time it took them 40 mins to make a 2 egg pickup order that was told to only take 10-15 mins no more.

I can never be satisfied with this location. I love Popeyes, however the service and freshness is not working for me here. Like, when do we draw the line? The service is whack! I went through the drive-thru and asked for lemonade. Guess what? They do not serve lemonade! So I went inside because I noticed something was missing from my order and guess what I seen where the drinks are dispensed? Good old fashioned, refreshing lemonade! So not only did they forget something from my order but they refuse to serve me lemonade which is advertised on their menu. So if you want lemonade you have to order inside their establishment and not in the drive-thru because apparently their staff is too lazy to walk around the counter to pour you what you have requested. 
And can you believe that when I went inside to get my order corrected the cashier was handling food after handling cash without washing their hands. Also the fries  are always cold. I have to put the fries in my air fryer to make them satisfactory. I feel like this review isn't for Popeyes as a whole but this location
 can definitely step it up!

Cold food. The food is never temperature hot, the meats might be 100 degrees. Chipotle you need to find a better way to make a burrito that is above room temperature. Staff is great, clean place and quick with the order.

Disappointing. Sunday jazz brunch on the patio was so crowded there were super long lines. The food was edible but not spectacular. We had to ask 6-7 times for a knife to eat the prime rib. My husband did not get the drink he ordered until the meal was almost over. They had to give him a canned soda since their machine was broken, which is fine, it just took forever. Overpriced.

Had the chocolate chip cookie. It was warm and had big chocolate chunks that were melty. The cookie wasn't exactly the fluffiest but it wasn't crispy either - more of in between the two. Very friendly staff!

Let me start off by saying that the staff was extremely friendly when I came here last night. Its unfortunate that the food here isn't very good. I got the creamy chicken alfredo and my friend ordered a calzone with bbq chicken and onions.  The alfredo came with two small slices of Italian bread which was some of the worst tasting Italian bread I've ever had.  The alfredo was decent but the chicken was very flavorless. I got over the flavor of the alfredo as well and after eating about half I realized I was just eating to get my moneys worth and not because I was enjoying it.  The bbq calzone was a little better than the alfredo but not enough to make me want to return.

Ate here while vacationing on St. Pete Beach.  The food was REALLY good.  Everything we ordered tasted like it was made fresh in house.  Even the kids chicken tenders were fantastic, no frozen stuff here.  The staff was attentive and friendly.  All that on top of the rum runner special and you have a great place to go.

This was the best baklava I have ever had all over the US. Damnit it was so good. These are the owners of Babylon Market. That's why it's so fucking good. I had the falafel. Amazing and everything looked so fresh. Next time I'm buying a tray of baklava.

Scratch off your go to list! After years of loyal patronage, we tried lunch for the first time.  We were alone on a sunny Saturday afternoon and service was just fine.  But, after reading a sign on the front window advertising a lunch special and ordering according to it's listing, we were rudely charged ala carte prices and then verbally reprimanded for not knowing how to order properly?  By the owners no less?   READ...NEVER COMING BACK!  P.S. The sushi was just average.

Was here for dinner recently. Small restaurant but nice atmosphere. I thought the menu was a bit limited--particularly since it was so eclectic. Also portions were a bit small. For example, the angry crab spaghetti was a rather modest portion of pasta and very light on the crab. Loved the squash hummus however: had nice kick to it and homemade breadsticks were one of the highlights of the meal. On the other hand I was a little let down by the broccoli starter after all the positive reviews I read about it. The tempura style batter gave broccoli a nice crunch but I just didn't think it was anything that special....
Finally the wine pours were maddeningly small. Sorry--when you're paying $16 for a glass of wine you should never feel like the waitress is rationing it. But I got the message: if I go back I will definitely order a bottle. Or better yet I will try the breakfast.

Bagels & Co has quickly become my favorite place to go to in Northern Liberties! Amazing coffee, New York style bagels and a plethora of cream cheeses for every mood. My go-to was the jalapeño cheddar, which exceeded my expectations. It's been an adventure to find a breakfast place that is always fresh with good service, but Bagels & Co, has both!

I knew I'd stumbled upon a gem when I was seated at Ocean Harbor and realized everyone around me was Chinese. "They are doing something right here," I thought to myself. As a general rule of thumb, I tend to avoid ethnic restaurants that fail to attract their own. However, in the three times I visited Ocean Harbor, I'd never found dishes that truly wow-ed me. 

All of that's changed now, and it's because I went with a Chinese friend.

It's absolutely the truth. Every other visit has had me salivating over the food at everyone else's table, but only semi-satisfied with the food before me. I tried the Peking duck (don't waste your time, go to Sang Kee Peking Duck), the Singapore noodles (generic), and a bunch of other mediocre dishes that barely suppressed hunger, and failed to impress. When I visited last night, I told my friend with a straight face, "Hey, let's order some General Tso--it looks yummy." She looked at me like I had antlers growing out of every facet of my face, and then sniffed in disdain with, "This is an authentic Chinese restaurant. We never order those kinds of dishes." (Did I mention that she's the out-of-towner and I was supposed to be showing her around?)

Case-in-point: Last night I was wowed by the asparagus and crab soup--I don't even LIKE asparagus but this broth was thick, eggy, and wholly satisfying. The beef and chinese broccoli was delicious (minus the fact that the pieces were ginormous, but I like having that kind of problem), and my friend and I split the lobster with ginger and scallion dish. I've never tried lobster prepared this way, and it was tasty. And generously-portioned family style for two people left yours truly a very happy patron indeed. 

So I have three dishes I will be sure to try again during my next Ocean Harbor visit, and highly recommend that you should try, too. My only problem now is that I'll have to wait awhile before I can try anything new on the menu. You know, until I can go with another Chinese friend.
I have no complaints. Everyone was kind to me. Food was the bomb and I didn't even have to wait a long time for it.

Love this authentic Thai restaurant in a shopping plaza in riverview near gibsonton.

Food is fresh and place is very clean. Traditional thai hospitality!!
An all time favorite! I could not live without this establishment ! Thank You for feeding me well !

This place is a disaster!!! If you have eaten at Memphis location you will be sorely disappointed. We waited over an hour for our dinner.
Then both dinners came out at different times.
Good but not great. I found the pizza to be a bit greasy. Perhaps my hopes were too high given all the great reviews.

Located across the street from Aldi, this place can be a little intimidating. It's also not very welcoming on the inside either. The couple who runs this place is very nice. Menu is limited to a few stable items. Interior is very bare so don't expect to impress a new date here. The kitchen is actually in the food truck located out front. 

I tried a chicken tinga taco, steak taco and lingua (beef tongue) taco. I found them all to be dry and lacking in the flavor department. The salsa verde here is very good and actually packs punch. 

However, my search for authentic Mexican tacos in Nashville continues...

My drink was good and that's it. I got the bruschetta and the bread was thick and soggy, the tomatoes had no flavor, tasted like diced ones from a can. I took a couple bites then told the waitress I'm not enjoying it and sent it back, and ordered the Margherita Pizza. The pizza was floppy and watery. Everything slid off the crust, was not satisfied and definitely not worth buying. My friend got the filet steak sliders and she was chewing on it forever just to get it down. The table next to us also sent their wings back. Not worth the money. We also went on a night where I previously rained during the day and all the seats and table were wet, we had to go to the bathroom to get paper towels to wipe our seats before sitting. They could have atleast wipes the seats down or provided a rag. I paid for all the food, even the food I sent back wasn't removed from the check.

Came here with a large party (I'm talking about 20-30 people) so we were seated in a semi private room. 

Drink: Frozen French 75. Good and will get you drunk, but nothing fancy.

Apps: chargrilled oysters, raw oysters, crab stuffed mushrooms, sensation salad. The chargrilled oysters were SO. GOOD. I died. Mushrooms were pretty good as well. 

Entree: got the 12 oz steak with fries. I ordered medium rare and it came out medium well. I didn't wanna say anything but luckily my coworker talked to the waitress for me, and she was very nice about getting me a new steak that was actually pink in the middle. My 2nd steak was delicious!

Dessert: got the carrot cake. I heard rave reviews but it was pretty dry. 

I will say that our service was fantastic considering we had such a large party. Yay!

This is one of my go to spots around SoBro, and had been for years. While dinner is great, the filet a la dina is my absolute favorite thing here, preceding a plate of amazing stuffed mushrooms or the cheesy, flavorful pestiolis, the time I use find myself drawn here is for lunch.

The lunch portions are generous, coming with bread, soup or salad, and your meal, you can't beat it, especially with prices like $8.95 for chicken parmesan (my fave lunch item). The staff are always nice and quick. The ambience is reminiscent of a classic italian restaurant, not too stuffy or anything like that, and if you like sports they always have a couple of games playing on the tv's. 

My honest opinion of this place is, you can't beat the food for the price. Make sure and check it out on Tuesdays when they have the 6 oz. filet for $11.95

I frequent the pub on a regular basis. I have tried almost everything on the menu and find that my meal is always good. I like the help everyone is always pleasant and accommodating. Thanks for making my lunch and taking suck good care of me when I come in.

This place is just ok. If you like flavorless meat and runny salsa this is the place for you. I got three tacos and some chips with one cup of salsa. When I say cup I mean the smallest cup you can imagine. Salsa taste canned and the staff were not friendly. Since it was two people I said can the other person get some salsa also and there response was 2 bucks. Never again stay away far better options out there.

The service is excellent, the affable gentlemen who own and operate this family business are polite and helpful. 

The prices are on the higher side, for an appetizer, main and mango smoothly + tip it came to around $45.

The quality of the food is some of the best in the city. 

I was especially impressed with the freshness of the salad rolls. 

The menu is concise and to the point, it's a Vietnamese and Thai place and that is the food they are good at.
We go to Ben and Irv's often. My kids love it. The food is excellent and the wait staff are friendly and efficient. If you are looking for a great deli to eat at Ben and Irv's is the place to go.

I've gone to this location quite a few times and I've never had a bad experience! Today our server was absolutely fantastic. Our food came out a little messed up, but she quickly corrected it without an issue. I wish I had of taken my receipt to get her name to mention it here! Dang! Lol.

Wonderful atmosphere, ordered chicken nuzio... Chicken was tender and succulent while the sauce was good, but one of the cheeses seemed to mute the flavors... Like adding a Kraft American Single.  Excellent Rieseling.  The biggest negative, the Gelato - too creamy, flavor lacked kick, I'd skip it next time.
They have the best crabs...a little pricey but good. The place is always packed so be prepared to wait a little if you go during peak times especially the weekends.
This is our local go to spot for a nice meal. It can be little tight in there but that's what you get with a old building ! Good itialian and pizza - give it a try

Did a weeknight dinner. This is "American classic dining" executed very very well. The service is impeccable and professional in and old guard way yet, felt very unstuffy and southern. Just- warm, attentive, and polite. Real service like you never see anymore. Cocktails were great. I had a milk punch that I'm still craving. 
The whole place smells like butter and cinnamon due to the bananas foster that explodes all over the dining room like delicious spontaneous flair ups. 
My date and I must have had 8 things and each one just got better and better. It tasted like the kitchen was half full of southern church ladies and Died in the Wool Escoffier line cooks. So so pleased with this dinner. My biggest criticism was that this was our first meal of the trip and the bar was set so high most everywhere else was a let down! 
In short, this meal (indeed the whole experience) tasted like it had a reputation to up hold.

My husband proposed to me on this boat! We had tickets to join the jazz dinner and he took me to the bow and freaking proposed! We were completely alone when it happened, but apparently word spread throughout the boat, and next thing we knew, there was a call over the intercom asking us to come to the captain's quarters. We did so, and they had a bottle of champagne and champagne flutes (that we got to keep!) waiting for us! This was NOT part of my husband's plan- they did this spur of the moment when they heard there was a proposal! It really made us feel special and just added so much sparkle to an already surreal moment! We're about to celebrate our 5th wedding anniversary and we toast to our love every anniversary with those Creole Queen champagne flutes!

Our server was the sweetest!! She was very attentive and polite. So sad we didn't get her name but she had dark brown hair. Wednesday afternoon. Great recommendations and was very clear with us. We ordered a bit too much and left pretty stuffed but I'm not complaining! Loved the burger!

Solid music venue. Basically the size of The Note in West Chester when that was around. Good beer and drink selection - but I'm not a drinker and this place didn't have NAs except for coke. Which is weak sauce man.

My kids loved the chocolate chip pancakes. My Cinnamon roll French toast was great.

I love breakfast potatoes and this place has awesome breakfast potatoes!

The staff was friendly and quick

While visiting friends in Philly, they insisted we go here for Saturday brunch and raved about it the whole previous day. I'm happy to say that they did not exaggerate! 

We went around noon on Sat, so it was pretty busy and there wasn't much room for our group of six. However, a lovely couple saw our dilemma and offered to move so we could sit at the more accommodating center tables. That basically sums up the demographic here; everyone is so neighborly! We had a great conversation with the family sitting next to us while we waited for our food.

Speaking of the food, it was awesome! I got the #10, which came with beef bacon, two eggs, and three french toast. I couldn't even finish it all! I was curious about the beef bacon, which ended up tasting pretty similar to pork bacon (aka delicious). It was cooked nice and crispy. While I don't normally put butter on my french toast, it came with butter already on it and was so nice and melty that I may have to change my ways. Perfectly golden and fluffy. It was a great deal for about $8. 

Our server Faye was sweet and attentive, and I speak for everyone when I say this visit MADE our Saturday morning. Everyone enjoyed their meal to the max. Looking forward to stopping by by next time I'm in town!

AWESOME FOOD! 
Happy Staff eager to please!
Sooooo many options to satisfy the appetite !!

Jalapeno peppers are HOT! 
Hot sauce bar is definitely very cautious.... the 'super spicy' was not.

Goodness, this little spot makes me happy. Maybe it's the striking crisp white subway tile behind the meat counter. Maybe it's the perfectly stocked shelves of Mexican spices. I don't know, this space is just beautifully designed, bright and welcoming. You're lured through the shelves of specialty Mexican grocery items until you finally come to the hot counter with rows of stewed meats, steaming chicharron, pozole, menudo and more taunting you from behind the glass. 

As you're salivating over everything you're offered free samples of anything in the cases by the most friendly and kind staff! The staff is so happy you're there. Want some meats to take home on the grill, they have it all. Marinated, not marinated, whatever you like. Don't have a grill at home or lets be real, you're just feeling lazy? Mr. Toro's staff will throw it on the grill for you free of charge! 

The Birria is top notch. The red chile pork is fall apart good, not spicy but that's okay because the flavor is wonderful. Green chile pork punching with flavor and just the right amount of heat for me. The breakfast burros, made to order are stuffed with anything you'd like on a soft flour tortilla. I've had one with chorizo and I would order again. Pork chicharron so crispy and tender, grabbing a bag to share is a must. 

You can take your meal to go after loading up on salsas and toppings at the salsa bar OR you can dine in, they have a few small bar style seating areas. 

Such a welcome locally owned spot in the current dining desert state of the Rita Ranch/Vail Area. Don't live in the area? Try a Tucson adventure, just drive East  on Valencia as far as you can, if you hit the dirt road you'll know you've just passed it. :)

To be honest I did not enjoy the tacos. Santa Barbara needs something more authentic for me. I have had better tacos so this was not my preference. 
Two tacos with rice and beans for $8-12.....overpriced if you ask me. Would not recommend.
Clean establishment. Super friendly staff. And fresh, flavorful meals. Prices are reasonable as well!!
Food is usually great. It's a pain that they don't take credit cards (cash or check only).  No website or online menus...seems absurd in 2015!

Good food and great service. I hear people often go for the pizza but we tried it and weren't completely on board. What I love are the pastas and appetizers. So very good. I make it a point to stop by every couple months or so. The dining areas are somewhat small and parking is sometimes a challenge but there's never too long of a wait.

Been wanting to try this place for a while!! Did not disappoint!! Paige was a great server and another young gentlemen who I didn't catch his name even offered to wash our daughters binky when it fell on the floor! Food was great and the s'mores hot chocolate was sooooo good! 10/10 recommend!!

Very poor service by bartender. Lacks customer service and hospitality.  Recommend Cleveland Heath down the street!!  We left Chophouse to get drinks/dinner at Cleveland Heath and received great service and food!!
Waiter was phenomenal. Food was outstanding. Above and beyond all the way to my doggie bags

Only few time you get what you are actually looking for and this place has it. Food was to die for... We were visiting Nashville and found this nice cozy restaurant with full of flavor. Definitely recommending this place to others and coming back. Keep it up guys good work and excellent cooking.

Nice atmosphere.. Ok food... weird wait staff...liked this place better when it was old location.... Marginal foid... Marginal service... Goid location... Nice seating outside... Fire most wait staff keep buspeople and hostesses...
As good if not better than Vietnamese places on Washington Ave in Philly. Pho is great, cant be beat for $6. The lemongrass stir fried beef is great. Fast service, free tea...

The food was completely bland, lacked seasoning, felt like Thai food for people who don't like actual Thai food.
The service was...well, one of the servers was clearly angry as a party of 6 came in and she literally was slamming tables together, scraping them across the floor, tossing dishes loudly into the bus tub, not rude to us but not friendly. The second waiter brought us our check after our appetizer and before the rest of our food came....she was apologetic, clearly trying to cover for her fellow server. I was a server for many years, if the food was actually good, I would let it slide and come back.
But, no.

I'm not sure why this place doesn't have a higher rating?!  The food is AWESOME.  My bf and I had the barbacoa tacos and they were down right perfect.  The lamb was very well seasoned and just fell apart into strands of meaty goodness.  We also tried the veggie tacos (i think it was cauliflower and something else?) they were equally awesome.  The tortillas are nice and light, are a good hand-held size, and were served warm.  They also have a great texture (none of that chewy shit).  

I'm withholding a star if only because it was a tad bit pricey (I've specifically been warned not to pay a whooping $9 for the guac) and because my sangria could have been better.  

Definitely worth a try if you want some authentic mexican food (not the stuff they serve at Cactus down the street).

Wonderful atmosphere, thoroughly enjoyed a late lunch of ravioli.  Salad was perfectly served with olives on a chilled plate, awesome presentation.  The red sauce is outstanding & so fresh tasting!  The service was exemplary.  This is the best Italian restaurant in the area!

I purchased 2 groupons to use at this truck.  I was successfull in finding it the first time.  The cupcakes were not bad, but the frosting was way too light for the heaviness of the cupcakes.  Putting that aside, I tried 3 more times to go back to use the second groupon, but this truck is never where it promises to be.  I find that unforgivable, after trekking across the city to its promised location, well within the time periods listed - thus the bad rating.  To quote someone else's review, this truck is just not worth all the drama.  I will say that he runs a cleaner truck than the other truck mentioned below.

Awful service, and really disappointing. We live in the neighborhood and braved the storm to have a few drinks. The bartenders were incompetent, hostess was over the top rude, and we were totally surprised with the attitude. Have lived in the city for 20 years, we thought we had seen it all. Apparently not.  everyone in our party had the same impression. Very rude, and I was embarrassed that I had suggested it.

Great, fresh food. Good portion size. Fast service for take-out! First time here and I was not disappointed! I ordered the Greek Side salad add Chicken and the Steak Kabob Entree. Both were delicious!

Trendy vegan-friendly cafes in West Philly are a dime a dozen, but if you need one on the not-especially-clean or double-pretentious-with-a-shot-of-entitlement end of the spectrum, this is the one for you. Parking favors cyclists. You can call in your order ahead of time, but somehow it will still never be ready when they tell you to come in (UPDATE: this is no longer available, for increased inconvenience.) The in-store playlist is curated with a taste for the eclectic. Personal hygiene is optional here, but cash is a must.

I love a good beach bar. And PCI Bar & Grill is just that. Walk up from the beach, or visit from the pool area for a delicious drink or some food.

Their drink menu is extensive and I appreciate all the fruity frozen options. I got the mahi sandwich from the grill and quite enjoyed it! Their homemade chips are so good. I love the picnic tables- plenty of seating to enjoy your food (and not have to bring it back to the beach)

There was a guitar playing singing and playing some great music. Also a beach volleyball court. 

The atmosphere was exactly what you'd want out of a beach bar and grill. Love this place!

This is my second try at this place and there won't be a 3rd visit. First visit food was ok but extremely long wait on food which was a simple order club sandwich and burger.--Sad part is that only one customer was at the bar, so it wasn't that they had a lot of food to prepare.  Second and last visit 3 drinks ordered all were flat we were told that the machine was checked and she could offer water, tea or a diet coke which was in a 2 liter. One diet coke ordered and yes it was flat but did charge us $2.50 for one diet coke poured out of a 2 liter bottle and we know that 2 liter  didn't cost $2.50.   Very disappointed in the food. Sorry but that was last visit.

I have visited The Sandwich Spot in many locations and when I found out they were coming here I was so excited! The sandwiches are the best around and there are many to choose from. These guys are going to do great here. I love the bread, sauces and meats they use. The staff is great and I enjoy supporting good hearted local people! Btw, can I get that secret sauce recipe!? I promise not to tell anyone ‍

I happened to find this place just by walking by on my way home from work. I only stopped because I saw the macarons through the window. I actually walked past. Did a double take. And then went inside. The macarons were $1.25 each but since I used LevelUp for the first time I got 4 macarons for $3. I ate the lemon and rose petal (got a pistachio and raspberry for my husband) and they were absolutely delicious. I get macarons from Laduree every time I am in Paris and miss them terribly all other times. The rose petal was incredible. The lemon was also quite tasty but sweeter than I am used to. I will definitely be going back the next time I have a macaron craving or find myself missing Paris.

Where to begin..

I met up with a friend and his family today, 4/16/16 at Joe's after they completed the Susan G Komen Race for the Cure. The restaurant was busy, but not incredibly so. They only had what appeared to be 2-3 people on wait staff to serve the restaurant full of customers. When the server eventually got around to getting our drink and food orders, only one of our group got a straw, and it was very difficult to get her attention to have her bring us more, almost like she was trying not to look at our table. 

Then the wait begins....over an hour. I sit drinking my water, chiseling the old dried-on food off the "clean" silverware that was brought. Our group sits and waits, and waits, and waits. No stops for apology that our food is taking so long. You can pretty much fill up on the unimpressive, cold bagged tortilla chips and salsa. We nearly had to physically grab the server to get her attention to bring refills. I was about to get up and walk out when people who arrived AFTER us started getting their food BEFORE us, but then they started bringing out our food (after almost 1 1/2 hours) with no real explanation on why we had to wait.

Now to the "food". I ordered the Mis Tres Amigos, which includes a taco and two enchiladas. The quality of the food wouldn't stand up to the worst quality high school cafeteria Mexican selection. It was absolutely awful, the 3 or 4 bites of it that I could eat. Mexican should be flavorful, but my food was BLAND. And the "beef" definitely wasn't fresh. The taste and consistency was something akin to pressed, mashed canned beans with beef flavor added, and it wasn't particularly warm. 

I used to come to to Acapulco Joe's all the time when I was a kid, when Joe himself was still around. What the restaurant has become today is an embarassment to his legacy, and it needs to be sold to someone who can manage the place properly, or close altogether. Alas, all good things must come to an end as it certainly has at AJ's. At least after speaking with the manager, I didn't have to pay for the couple bites I had. Do yourself a favor and go elsewhere....anywhere...seriously.

If you're looking to get a milkshake or a soda, and especially if you want to mix it up with some booze, Soda Jerks is a great option. They serve at least 50 varieties of high quality sodas (Boylan's, Fentiman's, Grizzly Paw, and more yum) - all in bottles. And they have a variety of Shakes and Floats.. And at $4.99 for a large shake, they're quite a good value if you have a sweet tooth. My wife loves the Peanut Butter shake.

The decor of this location is actually quite nice - it feels in many ways like your typical semi-upscale chain restaurant (Moxie's, Earl's, Joey's), complete with tunes that wouldn't be out of place in the lobby of a W hotel, but without the pretense or prices to match.

While the ability to build your own burger and the variety (and taste) of toppings are fantastic, I was a disappointed in my patty, which was hard, somewhat burnt, and contained a piece of gristle. I think I'll go for the pulled pork next time, as I'll be able to get a bunch of great toppings (Brie! Roasted Red Peppers!) with a less dry filling.

There's a changing table in the washroom, which makes it an easy option if you're dining with young tots.

I love this place - Boba tea is excellent and has best tasting boba around.  The only problem is that the service is TOO slow -- even before the pandemic I would normally be sitting here waiting over 20 mins for my crispy samurai chicken order to come out.  I stopped by today and not only did their system not take my mobile payment but I sat in the parking drive through service spot for over 30 mins.  Very disappointed- they need to figure out a better system - it defeats the purpose of fast food.

I was so excited to try this place, that I only took pictures of our food. I was able to place my order online and it was ready and warm for us when we got there. The indoor seating was open and we took advantage of the nice view provided. They made our shakes when we got there and took them to our table. I had the grass fed burger (traditional burger) which taste delicious and my husband had the carne asada burger. The Carne Asada burger came on a jalapeño burger bun, with the patty, a piece of carne asada and the best tasting Guac I have ever had. 

We had sweet potatoe fries and onion rings. Both super yummy. Those shakes are super tasty. I had a strawberry shake and my husband had the chocolate shake. Both were delicious, thick creamy shakes. I can't wait to try other flavors.  Bonus points for being close to work!

I will not be eating again  at Burger Me in Reno. 

*The Kids Hamburger was SO SMALL, like 2 adult bites. The Kids hot dog was a HALF of a hot dog. 

*The prices on the website do NOT match the prices in the actual restaurant, and in fact because of this when placing a phone order it was quite confusing due to the kids meal pricing, what it included, what it didn't include, none of it matched the website. 

*I ordered a hamburger with cheese, bacon and avocado. They charged me for the avocado but forgot to put it on the burger. The burger was dry and flavorless. 

*Hubby had the trainwreck burger and he loved it. 

*The food was made quickly and ready for pickup when he got there. 

Lesson learned. We will stick with Archies.
Good chicken shawarma, not great. Good hummus. All the bread (for the hummus and the shawarma wrap) was cold and hard. It was all decent, but nothing to draw me back.

Beignets... Enough Said... But since I need to write more I will do just that. Cafe Du Monde is a staple if you are visiting New Orleans. You are going to see long lines, you are going to see lots of people waiting. Get in line and wait with them. They are so worth it and you need to go here! We waited for almost an hour for the to go line this last time. If you can get a table that's even better. But this is worth it. 

Cafe Du Monde is Cash Only! Do not wait in the line to get to the front and realize this. It would not be fun after wasting that time. 

Get the coffee. Even if you are not a coffee drinker, get the coffee. The Coffee has Chickerie in it and makes it better. 

Cafe Du Monde is open 24 hours a day 7 days a week. If you want shorter lines go really early in the morning or really late at night. Do Not Wear Black and go to Cafe Du Monde on a windy day. Your shirt won't be black anymore. 

If you are flying in and out of Louis Armstrong Airport at least in the Southwest area, their is now a Cafe Du Monde in the airport with really short lines. But do yourself a favor, go to the one in the French Quarter. It is the original and the better one! But you can grab some Beignets and bring them home to loved ones! 


I highly recommend!

Too much hype. Very authentic but lacks in flavor. I guess you get what you pay for... cheap. I got the quesadilla and it was awful to say the least. Sweet, little location but that's about it. Not the worst but DEFINITELY not the best

Downtown Kitchen & Cocktails, another restaurant by our famous chef, Janos. It seems he can do no wrong. Everything he touches is EXCELLENT - unique menus using local, first rate ingredients. Can't make up your mind which to choose? Close your eyes, circle your finger in the air above the menu and lower your finger to the menu to find your selection for that mean. You cannot go wrong! Delicious!!

Can you post this at zero stars?!?!?!
Hotel has serious issues!! Staff wax extremely rude, even called us liars when we told them we found cockroaches in our room. Specifically in our bed. Why would I make up something like that?
Just warning others so they don't end up taking home an extra guest they didn't plan on.

Oh Hibachi, so much fun. Took a little group of folks here on a Friday night and the place was incredibly busy and very crowded. We had to wait a bit despite having reservations, but it was worth it. 
Watching your food being cooked in front of your eyes is always cool. Some of the chefs are all business, others put on a great show. It's the luck of the draw unfortunately. But regardless of that, the drinks are great, the food is yummy and the prices are pretty reasonable. 
A definite must if you have a small group.

1818 Chophouse is the place to eat! They have amazing food and drinks, Jay behind the bar is very professional and just an all around good guy to talk to, you want a drink, he knows how to make it! All of the staff there is top notch from the hostess's to the servers to the kitchen crew. The managers are very friendly and you can tell they take pride in what they do. I have not had one bad experience there! We love 1818 chophouse and look forward to visiting for many more years!

You're almost certain to see them making the bagels right before your eyes. The bagels are always fresh, sometimes warm, and always very tasty! I would give them five stars if not for the seemingly constant turnover of employees.

If I could give no stars I would. I just left and although the girls at the front are sweet, someone in the kitchen clearly was careless and rushing and thank goodness I checked the bag. Golden strips normally come with 5 tenders, I got 4 wimpy small ones, I ordered sweet potato fries, they forgot them then gave me a container that was half full and no lid (I ordered take out). I got no coleslaw with my tenders, and no sauce, and my $2 side of edamame was brown and wimpy. Wow. What a shame
Always delicious! We shared the bang bang shrimp and I had the spicy tuna bowl and it was so yummy.

Great byob in the northern liberties area. Really a 4.5 star experience rather than a 4.Same owner as monsu which is another great byob! Went on a Tuesday which I found out is the night the owner is the chef. It gets very popular so reservations are required on Tuesdays. 

I had the turista menu.-4 courses. I did the grilled calamari. It was good but very lemony. Next time I would try a different appetizer. I then had the fettuccini. It was a spicy fettuccini with sausage. Very good!! Then I had the cioppino. Again delicious! Tried some of the lamb which was seriously amazing also. And agree with other reviewers, get the tiramisu. Some of the best I've had!! 

Overall amazing dining experience. Can't wait to go back!

This is probably one of my favorite places to eat in St. Louis.  

Many of their items in the menu are delicious and allow me to be transported back home. This last visit was on Monday, January 29. I had taken one of my friends that had never been but had always seen it there. 

We started off with someone greeting us as soon as we came in and we were seated right away. I have been here at times when there was a wait but this time we came in at just the right time of 3:00 on Monday. 

After being handed the menus, pleural because there is also a very extensive drink menu. After a few seconds, we were greeted by our waitress that had the super bubbly personality. We stuck to waters this time around but some of the drinks sounded so good. 

We started with deviled eggs. Let me tell you, I have a degree in culinary arts and I couldn't make eggs this great. Then we order brisket, I never knew you could get more than one type of the cut. My friend got lean and fatty, where I got fatty and burnt ends. 

After dinner we just sat and enjoyed the atmosphere. 

So I give Salt + Smoke a 10/10

Deeeeeeelicious!!!  You could tell that everything was made from scratch and so fresh.  To top it off they have a great list of beers they brew.   Everyone that works there is extremely friendly and helpful.  We will definitely add this to one of favorite places to eat

Eating from the bar menu tastes great, but the food is so bad for you.  The waitress tried to warn me when I ordered the wild mushroom plate..."You realize that's a salad, right?"  She needn't have worried. It was generously coated with dressing and topped with delicious cheese.

The chef/marketing team who collaborated on the "potatoes gorgonzola" should be commended for their awesomeness...I wouldn't have ordered this if I'd known it was "just" crinkle cut french fries sprinkled with cheese, but they're SO GOOD.  

I think the crispy-crust pizzas might actually be the healthiest thing they serve; I love the rotisserie chicken! There's actually less cheese on this pizza than on the salad, so the chicken and roasted pepper flavors come through.

I've lived a mile from Hacienda for 15 years now yet I tend to choose other Mexican restaurants first.  While Hacienda is a well know Mexican restaurant I think it's mostly due to their amazing atmosphere because the food is just okay. Not bad by any means, but I've never been amazed by it. The margaritas I've had are usually light on the tequila and heavy on the sweetness, making for a pricey drink that provides a sugar buzz instead of an alcohol buzz.  Probably better enjoyed on premise rather than take out.
