How have I not heard about Al's sooner? Old school, white table cloth, upscale. Top-notch staff who make what could come off as a pretentious establishment feel warm and inviting. No printed menu. The servers know the dishes by heart and present them to you along with days cuts of meat. On a dinner date to celebrate my husband's birthday, I enjoyed Chilean sea bass and escargot. Everything cooked to perfection. A hidden gem. I will be back.

hmm..the interior is really nice and modern. bathroom is clean ( a plus)

got here alittle before 5pm which was our reservation time and they told us to sit at the bar area because they don't start serving till 5pm. weird. 

i went with two others and we got the bento box for 2 but they made it for 3 and its basically four different verisons of dumplings. hmm. really? not a fan. go to h-mart and get your own dumplings for less money and more qty.
dishes- duck/ribs w/filet/ and a seafood dish that had shrimp/scallops/beef.
i felt like i was paying for high priced chinese food. 

dessert: home made icrecream - three flavors - a scoop each. 

i don't think i'll be swinging this way for a while. must forget about the food before i'm fooled into coming back.

My first time ordering takeout. They were easy to order via online. I was able to pick up my order at the time i selected. The pizza I ordered was their monthly special and one of their menu items. Both were delicious and fresh. I love their crust, soft and crispy. Just enough toppings so it's not soggy. I'll definitely order again.

I love their happy hour although we found out that they no longer have food specials which is very disappointing. However, after hearing such horrible news, we did have an amazing experience. This is all due to one person, the bartender Amaya. She made our night. Most bartenders don't take the time to speak to the clients but she entertained us the entire time. She suggested several different food options and also gave us additional information on drink selections. She provided more than amazing service and despite the food happy hour specials we will be returning because of Amaya alone. Awesome ladies night.

The food is hot and delicious just like home. It's a small place so it can be pretty busy around lunch. Not sure how they accommodate large groups but have seen groups of 6 or so. Staff is super friendly and accommodating. It's mostly soul food which is hard to find this Far East.

The place serves a mix of delicious Thai, Vietnamese, and Chinese food.  Prices are low for the quantity and quality of food you get.  Owners and servers are very friendly, courteous, and professional.  I ate there two days in a row, once for lunch and once for dinner.  On the second day, for dinner, the woman owner asked me why I eat alone and said she needs to find me a girl....that was very endearing.  I asked if what I ordered was enough, and she replied laughingly that it was "enough for my belly" ....haha...cute. :)  I will be going back.

Throughout our trip in Nashville, everyone mentioned this place. So it is no surprise that it was delicious. However, it wasn't just one or two items (ahem friend cheese curds I'm looking at you), but it was everything that was ordered at our table. I got the Buffalo Chicken Wrap and others at the table got the Hot Chicken and BBQ Chicken Wrap. I regret not getting the Hot Chicken, not because my lunch wasn't delicious, but because holy hot chicken batman! It was crunchy, spicy, and free of annoying bones (added plus). The homemade Mac N Cheese was equally scrumptious as well. The fact that we stumbled in on a Tuesday dreadfully exhausted, starving were greatly aided by the 2 for 1 drinks. Will be back here, count on that!

Met some friends here for Taco Tuesday !! They have a taco bar set up, and it's $8.95 for all you can eat. The bar consists of hard corn tortilla shells, and steams soft (small) tortillas. There is carne asada, pork, I think chicken (didn't try), and Al Pastor. All the condiments (mild to hot sauces), rice, beans, etc. The bar food was good, not great, but for the $, I'm not complaining.
We had a few margaritas, that were tasty, and had a little punch to them . I will come back for a real dinner, but as for a quick, fun meal on a Tuesday, give it a shot !!
Went in and it was empty for a Saturday night...service was excellent and friendly...food came out quickly but the food was awful.  Won't be going back.

We stopped in for a late breakfast on our way out of town. Best ending to a birthday trip! Lisa's cafe literally had the best corned beef hash we've ever eaten. Everything is made homemade. All their food is fresh, never frozen. The crab cake Benedict was to die for. Service was excellent and topped it off with a fantastic Bloody Mary. Will be returning to Lisa's next time we visit for sure!
Not happy. Wrong food was delivered. Staff didn't seem to care. I was shocked at the low care factor. See ya-never again.

Amazing shakes at a 100-year old malt shop: if it weren't for the hour-long wait, this place would get 5 stars!

CCK is located in an otherwise desolate part of STL: there's a noticeable difference between the upper/middle class white folks (for lack of a classier generalization) and the surrounding neighborhoods we walked through to get there.

We got some menus while we waited outside for what felt like forever... The line split in two once we got inside the door: for people who wanted to sit, and for people who wanted take-out. The take-out line moved pretty quickly once our order was taken; the sandwich took about 15 minutes but it didn't feel that long. There was a cute little park across the street where we could enjoy our ice cream sundae, cherry malt, and grilled cheese sandwich.

All in all, it was worth it for the delicious, rewarding experience ... not sure if I would bother coming again unless I knew the lines were shorter, since CCK is a bit out of the way.

The ambiance of the restaurant was nice. The restaurant was clean and maintained. It took awhile to be seated even though we had reservations. The biggest complaint was the slow service from our waiter. We didn't get the drink orders we placed until after our 2nd course came out, this was after having the chargrilled oysters and our first course. That was disappointing however the waiter did recognize this and tried to make up for it by bringing us a second round on the house. The chargrilled oysters were amazing, very flavorful. The boudin balls, although fried to perfection with a decent flavor, is not traditional boudin if you are familiar with what boudin is. The Cajun egg rolls were great. We also had the gumbo which was a thick, dark roux, it was slightly burnt to the taste but not bad enough to ruin the experience. The shrimp pasta had a good flavor but the shrimp were not deveined. And finally the bread pudding was excellent, the rum sauce flavor was very rich and complemented the dessert perfectly. I would go back to the restaurant again and gave the experience a 7.5/10 overall.

Great place and location.  Food was great.  Our table had Mahi sandwich, grouper sandwich, and Cuban panini. All really good.  We're Cuban sandwich lovers and this one was good. Salami could have been better, but overall good. Not traditional Cuban bread, remember it'sa panini,  but we like different takes.  Key lime pie was good also. Bread on the fish sandwiches was excellent. Would recommend to anyone.

What can you say about Woody's.  It's there, and they have food, and they are next door the the best sports bar this side of the Mason Dixon Line.  The food is OK but never anything special.  I had the chicken sandwich last time and it was a bit rubbery so I will go with the tri tip next time.  Its good for a quick lunch stop but I wouldn't take a date there unless you just pulled her out of Monty's.  
The people that work there are always very nice and helpful. Props to them.
Accidentally ran into this place.  I ended up leaving with an iced caramel latte and it was amazing.

This place is awesome, the food is super authentic and delicious and fresh and you can sit outside on State Street it is completely delicious and delightful. The dumplings the bow the spareribs the Ramen so many of the Dim Sum it's all perfect and delicious what a treat to get the stuff for dinner! Normally Dim Sum is only through tea time

Absolutely will never ask them to deliver again ! They said I would be 45-1 hour delivery time. 2.5 hours later no pizza. Call 3 times to speak to management , been on hold  for 30 minutes . No one will pick up . So I go to the store and lol their not even busy . Their just in the making a few orders clowning around.

After discovering that Adamas is now closed or changing ownership, I decided to try the Sojourner Cafe near historic El Presidio. It was busy for a Sunday night, but since I was by myself, I got a seat all to myself at their juice bar. Two of their specials attracted my attention: hearty beef-less stew and a lentil/kale burger. I chose the stew since the server who prepared it, Sarah, is also vegan. 

The stew was mildly spicy - a pleasant surprise - and completely satisfying as it came in a very large bowl. It could have used more mushrooms and veggies, but the rice did not dominate the stew. Perhaps it was half a cup of cooked rice for this large bowl.

Several of the servers are vegan themselves. The vegan options are prolific on the menu. Not certain where the reviewer who said that there were only four items available to vegans may have been dining.

I went ahead and ordered a vegan plum tart because this place was voted best place for desserts in Santa Barbara and, sadly, they were all out of their berry cobbler. It wasn't as impressive as the stew.
Whoever took my order was an asshole. Absolutely the worst customer service skills I have ever experienced in my entire life. I would rather starve for a whole day then eat at this place.

Since Mimi's changed there menu the food quality has gone down hill.  Very inconsistent.  I've eaten here twice since the change and I won't be coming back.  Not very busy and I had to flag down the waiter to refill drinks.

I've been to this place a few times now and each time is great. The typical NOLA food, which a lot of times is not as good as your favorite place. Here they make everything good, that I've had anyway. I've had fried seafood poboys and boiled crawfish, and all have been very good. It's a hole in the wall type place with great food, who doesn't like that?

The boiled crawfish are a definite highlight. I have never had boiled crawfish from a restaurant that were that good, usually have to wait for a family and friend boil where you can put whatever you want in. Restaurants usually don't want to make them too spicy for tourists or people that don't eat crawfish. Portside does it right. I didn't want to go back to work after eating them, just relax out on their porch. I've had their poboys as well, most recently the catfish poboy, it was great. 

The staff is very friendly, and it's easy to blend in and feel at home. It's a popular lunch spot for sure, and I'll be back again, especially for crawfish season.
Items labeled S7, S5, and the summer trolls are outstanding as is the friendly and attentive service.

The location, atmosphere and food are all great! Wishing I could find more coupons but the prices are good. I love the soup and everyone was very nice and helpful. I had the catering at a wedding and it is awesome!!!

McDonald's are generally all pretty similar in quality of food and this one food-wise is just fine. The reason it's two stars is because of the drive-through. Usually I get a nice lady, but this last time I got a girl who was extremely rude. So bad in fact I don't think I'll be coming back to this location. Not worth it

Diggin' this place... been in the neighborhood 6 months and my landlord recommended it long time ago!  Finally visited this am and was impressed with the friendliness and the atmosphere.  May turn it into my new study spot...
Went there for the grand opening. Great atmosphere, great staff and great food . This is something st pete beach has been missing for years ! Can't wait for the top lounge to open up !

Its a long wait for GREAT bbq with mediocre sides.

The build your own burger with adding a fried egg is delicious.

My favorite dish is alacarte.  It's may be shrimp tacos, or tenderloin sandwich.  Either way, the place will twist your thoughts on your backyard approach.

The Ribs are a B-, the brisquit is A. The pulled pork is a B.

The best gourmet bbq establishment I've been to recently.

Chuck

I went here a few days before Anthony Bourdain's Layover in Philadelphia aired and went kind of giddy when I saw him eating Pho here. I sat the table behind his!

To me, this is the best Pho compared to other Pho I've had in Philadelphia with Pho Ha a close second (probably top 5 ever, with the other 4 in California). I've only been here once, so I can't claim it to be the best, but maybe when I come back, I'll go again and write a more credible review.

I always order Pho Tai, and ask for the meat to be on the side. They aren't cheap with the meat - I had enough for two bowls. And I have to say, the meat was noticeably soft, melt in your mouth amazing. I know that sounds strange, but it stood out. The Broth tasted great alone (hoison sauce and sirarcha aren't really needed at all).  only slight complaint was that the noodles were a little too cooked for my preference. 

And I love the decor! They aren't trying to please anyone and they aren't trying to be modern. It's a standard Vietnamese pho restaurant layout, with a whole lot of pink.
Love this place. Great European vibe. Fantastic coffee, great for lunch or breakfast. Croissants and pastries to die for. Yummy quiches. How lucky am I that I work a block away???

Their counter is always busy for good reason! Hemingway's makes one of the best Cuban sandwiches in the city. 

When Armature Works opened, I think a lot of us were lured to Hemingway's by asking other people "what drink is that?" You couldn't help but notice every other person was carrying a cup of their delicious sangria

The prices are on track with the other stores and the wait isn't long, even though you get a pager so you can still roam around. 

Don't skip dessert!!  The Dulce de leche tres leches and the guava & cheese empanadas are AMAZING.

The map on YELP is right. It is a parking lot; and YES, this place does get 5 stars. And probably the best kind and caring service you'll ever get. 

Bill Connell is such an amazing person, there is no wonder he has been selling hot dogs for all these years. It feels like he is more interested in making you smile instead of the money you need to pay him. I enjoyed my time there, plus, you can also walk to the bluff for an amazing ocean view. Hot dogs were great. Limited in variety, but that is also a huge plus; less time to sit and think about what you want. 

I definitely recommend you stop for a hello and a bite. Keep an eye out, he's out there.

Good location. Decent staff. Food didn't wow us but it was ok. The men mostly got the wings and said they seemed more like BBQ. My salad was good, I liked the fries, the chicken sandwich was a good idea that lacked in its execution.
Best pizza. Sweet Lil Razorback is my favoriteservice was also excellent. No complaints!

You can get mediocre pizza elsewhere. I went here for lunch and had a slice of pizza, it was fine, and a side Caesar salad which came with wilted lettuce, a few croutons and balsamic dressing. 

When leaving, the owner stopped me and said I didn't pay for the salad and they need to charge me. Just to be clear, they put all of the food on the tray, gave me a total and then I paid. Not sure how 20 mins later they decided I didn't pay for the salad. 

They then went looking through the trash for my receipt to make sure that they didn't charge me for the $3 salad. After 5 mins of them insisting on finding the receipt, I gave them $3 cash and walked out while they were still digging through the garbage. They couldn't have handled this any worse. At the point that there is no receipt and the food has been eaten, cut your losses and the $3 salad should be on the house ( if in fact I didn't pay for it). I will never go back there.

I absolutely love the sangria and tapas at Ceviche!

I prefer dining outside when the weather is nice.  I made the mistake of dining downstairs once and it kind of smells like a wet, musty basement.

If you come with a group of friends I recommend getting the full sized plate tapas to share with the table.  Some of my favorite tapas are the albondigas (meatballs), veal stuffed peppers, any of the steak or pork dishes, and the tuna tartare.  Be sure to indulge in the bread and pesto: so good and perfect for mopping up all the flavorful sauces from the tapas!  If you save room for dessert the tres leches dessert is out of this world good and large enough to share with several people!

Reservations recommended on the weekend, this place gets packed!

Adding an edit - Reading the manager's response to my first review of this restaurant let's me know that my first impression was spot on. Rather than owning up to what was clearly very poor service and rushed plates, she is exhibiting petty and defensive behavior. If this is the management's attitude toward customers' reviews, there's no room for improvement. 
I hope others don't have the same experience. What a shame.

*****

This place was so promising before I went with a large party on a Saturday night... Although it has an overall high rating on Yelp, reading some of the other reviews, it seems that nothing about our poor experience is uncommon for Eastland Cafe.

I understand that it might be difficult to take care of a larger party (14 for us, but our reservation was pretty late, after most of the tables were cleared out or finishing up their means), but they managed to "lose" part of our ticket and forgot to make 3 of orders. While waiting over an hour for our food, I ordered a glass of wine, and it was one of the stingiest pours I've ever experienced. I had the shrimp and grits (one of the lost orders), and it was a flavorless mass sitting in a puddle of vinegar. Shrimp and grits is one of my favorite meals, and I've never tasted anything like this. A lot of people in my group ordered the steak, which was clearly a cheaper cut of meat poorly masked by over seasoning. It's never a good sign when people are reaching for bread at the end of the meal over finishing their entrees. The bread wasn't very good either. 

To apologize for the poor service, the manager did take care of the lost entrees and sent out desserts. However, it was a poorly carried out gesture too. They just keep sending out large portions of brownies (pretty good), strawberry shortcake (not great), and apple doughnuts (actually quite delicious!) - too many for our party, so just a bit wasteful and ineffective in making us forget about the terrible experience and dinner plates left half uneaten. 

In all this time, the servers never asked anyone if we wanted another drink. What a fail. 

Also, the restaurant space is cute, but they have some issues with noise level. I've been to many restaurants with open kitchens and high ceilings, but for some reason noises really amplify in this space. It was really hard to hear one another even when the place had pretty much emptied out. 

They have some work to do is all I can say.

Went out for dinner with friends. Service was friendly and the Tuna carpaccio was tasty. The ceviche is wrongly labelled, more of a poached shrimp and scallop. My entree was simply terrible. The pistachio crusted halibut sound intriguing but the halibut was way overlooked and super dry, and the topped with a horrid lemon sauce. This sauce tasted like lemon meringue pudding and was god awful sweet. The manager was very attentive and took it off our bill- do not think we will go back despite the friendly service. My husbands ribeye was not seasoned at all and not cooked evenly.
LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS PLACE! Friendly service, wonderful food and also makes the most delicious and beautiful gift baskets.

I had only been in here for drinks before but I loved the cozy, trendy atmosphere which felt perfect for a date night. I came back and tried their food. They don't take reservations unless you're a bigger party but they sat table for 2 8pm on a Friday after 10 mins. Our server explained to us for the Hygge boards on the menu 3 is probably good for 1 person. Choosing 5 is probably good for two peoples entrees. We chose three and loved the empanadas, cheese, and salumi. Since we came for dinner we also ordered the buttermilk chicken app and fries to split after. All the food was amazing. It is now one of my favorite philly restaurants.

Came here a few times we had no problems but the last two times our chicken was not cooked good which was really disappointing as that's what we came for. We ordered a chicken share platter and the chicken skin was black and tasted burnt.. the next time we came we ordered my son a kids chicken tender meal  and the chicken was way over dry, we told them that and they offered to replace it with a chicken skewer which was also super dry. My son could not eat either of them and did not end up getting to eat his meal which we paid for beforehand. I will definitely not be coming back here.
oddly have to enter through a hotel lobby. the food menu is good and the whiskey selection is huge. very cute

On par with other chain stores. I had a burger on Monday night, which is 7$ burger night. I was pleasantly surprised that it was cooked and flavored well with average garnishment and fries.

The service from the bar slow and inattentive, but I did not expect much. Not terrible though. I go out of my way to get burgers all over and Applebee's had one not that much under the 12$ variety you would find at a more upscale bar or bbq spot.
Serves a wide variety of food, all just okay. Great if you're looking for variety. But don't come looking for  unbeatable quality

Used to be our favorite neighborhood bar for a drink and occasionally food.  The price of a glass of Kendall Jackson went from $7 to $9!  Outpriced a regular customer.  We also liked the old menu much better.
Bar tenders were awesome. Food was amazing. Had the salmon with shrimp. Best ever! Would definitely come back!

My boyfriend had the raw oysters which he did say tasted a a little "off."  He sent them back because he didn't want to get sick.  He's an oyster connoisseur so if said they weren't good, then they weren't good.  I had the crab stuffed shrimp which was divine.  My boyfriend also had the hogfish which he enjoyed.  Overall a great experience.  The restaurant is huge!  The employees wore masks.  Overall great dining experience.

brunch on sunday.  good service, pretty quick food delivery.  all the food was good in my party of 6.  not the biggest menu for brunch, but ok
very convenient and a good piano player in the bar area.
Some of the best Italian food I have ever had.  Great food, great wine list, great service at a reasonable price.  This will become a regular date night spot.   Keep up the great work!!!
The nicest people and the best food! The sandwiches are stuffed full! The parmesan fries are fresh and so flavorful! Each bite is like a piece of heaven. You definitely won't leave hungry.

I waited 30 minutes for my take out order to be cooked while they served every single dine in customers first, even those who came in well after me. 

I get it, the dine in customers tip more, but it's lunch hour and everyone has got something to do. Get it together

Five stars for the venue. ... to Jess D.'s point whose review I can see as i type this: "Who doesn't love North Bowl??"

Super fun, super cool.

We didnt eat so I cant judge but we will be back.... soon!!

My tastebuds are so happy. Finally made it here and am so glad we did. Everything we had was fresh and full of flavor. Also given some of the dietary restrictions of our group, honeygrow was a crowd pleaser. The strawberry lemonade is a great way to top off your meal. The staff welcomed us when we entered the place and we extremely helpful. I will also share that They did a great job following protocols for Covid too. Friendly and full of flavor is how I summarize my visit.
Caroline is the best! Very sweet and accommodating with my allergies. I'm on vacation right now but I would come back here just too see her.
Kinda just wish I could give this 0 stars. Coming from some who does customer service, the service is poor. Staff is rude af. Trust that I will never go there again.

They also have a grocery store next door. It's small and people are on top of each other while shopping. 3 of their employees got tested positive for Coronavirus and they did not tell anyone and they kept conducting business. I luckily did not get infected.

That is to irresponsible for me so I will never shop their again. 

The local city ordinance ordered them to close.
Food was good. Lots of flavor. Only thing I didn't like was the small cups they give you. I needed like refills of Sprite.
House Pho excellent choice. Small bowl plenty of food.   Good amount of meat in dish. Ice tea is refreshing.

Needed a quick bite on my lunch break today and decided to try this place. They took my order promptly, though I had to repeat myself because it was very loud inside. I got a half-pound of brisket topped with bacon, cheddar cheese and green peppers. They didn't just throw these on top, they tossed it all together on the grill, which melted the cheese nice and even throughout the entree. And I got all of this for less than $10. I'll definitely be coming back.

Place is quiet.  Service is sloughie.  Staff servers apologize.  Where is the owner.  This is shameful in the middle of Cherry Hill!!
Can the owners get a REAL manager to shape up this place.

This is our go to place (and has been for years and years while visiting Saint Pete Beach!)
The bartenders are phenomenal (as well as the margaritas!) and the food never disappoints! The blackened grouper sandwich as well as the grouper Reuben are phenomenal... But the burger is equally delicious! Love this place!

The food quality is second to none. Too bad their bartender, Amy, doesn't possess the same qualities. I sat down for a nice grilled Mahi salad and conch fritters, awesome btw. This woman starts demanding my credit card for my dinner and a sweet tea...NOTHING ALCOHOLIC. I told her that it is very inappropriate and that she wasn't getting cards from anyone else. I was dressed in slacks and a $100 shirt.THE MEAL WAS FANTASTIC though their food runners were the ones asking me how my food was, not THE ZERO behind the bar. She never said one word to me until I asked for the check. I also asked for a receipt for what she did with my card and she refused. She got a "manager" who was equally a ZERO, and an outright b_t_h...you fill in the blanks. She refused to provide a receipt as well. If anyone does anything with my card other than $1, Amy will be arrested.

Frenchy's Rockaway Grill can go to hell. I have been a customer there for 20 yrs but they have lost my referrals and my business...I drive 54 passenger motorcoaches that will never make that stop.

As far as the tip goes, I wish I could tip the cook with Amy not getting her unsanitary hands on it. Handling money and dirty plates, touching her hair and face, then other people's food? CROSS CONTAMINATION! The Health Department will hear from me on Monday.

NO TIP OR FURTHER BUSINESS FOR YOU, AMY, AND FRENCHY'S ROCKAWAY GRILL.

I also observed several of the staff members stumbling for no reason at all. I wonder when the ownership last conducted a random drug test of its employees. Start with Amy...then the obese, brown-long-haired female "manager..."

I spoke with a couple in the parking lot and they agreed with me that the staff is VERY RUDE. They also mentioned that they had seen a couple cockroaches scurry when the band started playing, but without proof, that's heresy and I can't use that. RUDENESS AND POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE IS OBVIOUS AND ANYONE CAN SEE THAT.

If you love GREAT FOOD AND EXTREMELY POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE, DISRESPECT, AND ROACHES THAT ALLEGEDLY CAN DANCE TO LIVE MUSIC, YOU KNOW WHERE TO FIND IT.

BTW, the band was excellent as well.

Everyone was happy with their meals. I had the fried green tomato BLT and it was great. They actually wove the slices of bacon so it was like a mat of bacon which did not fall out when you bit in to it. I wanted some red beans and rice but even though it was breakfast time out wait person rustled some up for me. It was delicious too. I'm going back.

Obon is my favorite sushi place in the city.  I travel a lot for my job and this is one of the best sushi places I've been to ANYWHERE in the country.  I've visited twice in the last week and the experience has been phenomenal both times. 

Food:  Highly recommend the calamari for a starter.  The ramen is really tasty and huge portion for the price.  I'm highly addicted to yuku yellowtail sashimi, fukushu and tataki maki rolls were fresh as can be.  No Soy necessary here.   

Adult beverages: As far as drinks go, don't forget to try the black tea old fashion.  Matt the bartender makes crazy good craft cocktails and is super friendly.  Sit at the bar and you won't be disappointed.  Guy is like a chemist.  Really is the best barkeep in the business.  

Atmosphere: Unique and fun vibe in the place.  Modern Japanese decor really pops and the energy around the place makes for a fun evening out.  Can't get enough of this place.

We went with family members to celebrate an anniversary. We chose it because husband remembered going to this restaurant as a young man with his family and having very fond memories. But this time, everyone was so disappointed, they swore they would never go again and lamented the pile of money spent.

To start with, the service was quite dismal. I ordered my six-year-old child a glass of apple juice and asked for a child-friendly glass. It came in a large fancy goblet made for adults which she had trouble using and eventually spilled all over the table. Service was also slow and fairly unremarkable.

The food was atrocious. The Greek salad came with fairly plain lettuce and vegetables with NO dressing on it. There was a bowl of dressing on the side, and the server explained we had to pour the dressing on ourselves. I had never seen that before and it didn't taste good.

My husband's roasted lamb came with mashed potatoes that tasted like instant mashed potatoes to everyone at the table. Usually in Greek restaurants, you get roasted Greek potatoes, and I have never been served mashed potatoes, let alone instant mashed, in a Greek restaurant before. We all thought it was quite odd. 

The Greek rice was very overlooked and mushy. It was quite disgusting and we could hardly eat any.

I ordered Greek prawns that were a little stinky and tough, maybe overlooked and old.

My husband received an au jus dip for his lamb which, after visiting many Greek places in Canada and Europe, we have never before received. He thought it was quite plain and used it on his yucky instant potatoes in order to swallow a bite.

Never again!
Great wait staff - fun drinks - good food - right next door to the Rock n Bowl.

UPDATE:  I got sick on the food as well!  STAY AWAY THIS PLACE IS A SALMONELLA FACTORY!!!

I have been in here twice in the last week, late night on 3/25/20 and 3/26/20..  Each time I was served by the ill kept ogre-looking fat dude working the closing shift.  No smile.  No welcome.  No please.  No thank you.  No nothing.  I was treated rudely and talked to in barely audible grunts.  It was as if I was inconveniencing this boorish jerk by patronizing your establishment.  Sorry to bother you for asking you to do do your *JOB*  you *JERK*.  

If this guy were working for me I'd fire him immediately.  The food was "meh." If I go in again and that rude fat slob is still  there I'm walking out.  Fire that inconsiderate loser! This is the person you want representing your restaurant?

The friends I once caroused with are now nesting. I'm not sure if it's the dropping temperatures or their new relationships that have their party panties all in a bunch, but either way, I'm not going down without a fight. Last weekend, I urged them to unlock the shackles while I squared away some solid dance floor plans. 

Low and behold, they were all in. We huddled up, headed out, and hustled from one bar to the next. Once 2am hit, the pack started diminishing. I, for one, wasn't about to end my night without the obligatory cheeseburger. Dancing is like exercise and they say you should always eat within 30 minutes after your work out, so I felt totally justified with my craving. 

My last two friends and I waited in a 15 minute line outside of Pete's until we were ushered in and escorted to our counterside stools. Our waitress was cheery and my burger was the best thing ever put between two buns that's ever been put into my mouth. I really liked their steak fries too. 

Bottom line: Go after 2am, observe the sloppy party kids, get the burger. Just a warning, this isn't actually a goooood burger, it's just a great burger after 2am. Ya dig?

Zero ambience but the best tacos al pastor in the city.  

In order to avoid service problems:  Smile at your waitress as soon as you sit down.  And order what you need right from the start- refills of anything can be difficult to secure.  Even the check.  

Bring Your Own Beer!

All I can say is, if you want to talk trash about a customer in your language while your customer is standing right in front of you, PLEASE make sure that the customer you are talking about doesn't speak the language and/or understand what you are saying. And if splitting a bill 2 ways is too much trouble then maybe, just maybe, you should consider another profession instead of rolling your eyes at the people who help determine your income. As far as the food is concerned, let's just say that it lacks in authenticity and flavor.

Came to CBQ for drinks and an appetizer before enjoying a movie at our favorite theater. First of all, we thought that the place was closed. No one at the door and only one table with guests. The bartender noticed us standing there for 15 minutes and we sat at the bar.  We then noticed the new menu is void of our favorite items: bunt ends and okra! Only one type of ribs??? No St. Louis style ribs. Being half-Texan I know BBQ.  This place is not a BBQ restaurant.  That being said, the menu does not state that the place is a BBQ place, rather a "Bar & Que" because of the pool tables next door. Sorry CBQ, you just lost a customer and we will not be back!

I don't know how a Mexican Taco joint can run out of Mexican beer on tap, but Rosy's did.  The alternative that the waitress suggested was a good replacement, but running our of Dos XXs on a Monday afternoon?

The food was delivered remarkably quickly.  Granted, the restaurant was not that crowded, but we received the food much faster than we expected.

I have eaten many a taco salad in my lifetime.  Usually it is served in an edible shell.  Rosy's was served in a bowl meant to look like wood but it isn't/wasn't.  From a presentation viewpoint it was a bit of a turn-off.  I would have also liked salsa to be part of the salad.  I probably could have asked for some but I didn't.

Now, if you like hot sauces, there is a shelf full of many different kinds of hot sauces.  The menu said we had to ask the waitress for the hot sauce(s) we wanted, but our waitress told us to self serve; she said they wipe down the bottles after each use.  You might want to check the "best by" date on the bottle(s) you select; one of my bottles was best used by October 2020.  It tasted fine, but it probably would have been a bit more potent had it not been past its prime.

My husband enjoyed his enchiladas and would order them again (and he is from TX).

We were trying to figure out the decor.  It looked unfinished to me.

Our waitress was good, but the young man who brought out our food was not very professional.  He was wearing headphones the whole time he served us and the other patrons in the place.  I get that the place was not very busy, bur he could have removed his headphones while he was actually working.

Will we give it another try? Yes.

I wish I could rate this higher. Very nice staff and a nice set up. The food just isn't very good at the end of the day. The pizza was expensive and cheaply made. The salad was expensive and terrible. We came here on a Friday night and there was no wait, which is a bad sign for a restaurant in Franklin/Brentwood. 

I'll be back because it has a great bar upstairs, but I won't be back for the food.

Had a nice meal here followed by a relaxing meeting with coworkers. The space is modern, open, and inviting. Kind of reminded me of waking up fresh as a daisy on a sunny spring morning. (Of course in reality it was cold and windy outside and I was sleep deprived/slightly hungover.)

I had the BEC (bacon jam, egg, cheddar, toasted brioche) with fresh fruit subbed for the potatoes. I love me a good breakfast sandwich and this one held up with the best of them. Toasted brioche? Bacon jam? Come on! Really great coffee as well.

Sadly I live like 420 miles away so I won't make it back very often. However, I know it's a go-to spot for my coworkers who live in St. Louis, the very reason I ended up here at all. And I'm glad I did.
The food here is excellent. I live in CA and visit IN often, everytime I visit I have to eat here. Tenderloin, Pizza, and Fired Chicken Sandwich are all 10/10!!!

I passed by this stall with a few friends and we shared the funnel cake, chili cheese fries, and the cheese curds. 

I was feeling pretty nostalgic for funnel cake, as I had just been to a flea market but unfortunately didn't pass by a funnel cake stand... Luckily Fox & Son was there to fill the void! I was super pleased with the warm, fluffy inside and the thick strings of dough. It was exactly what I was craving. (-:

The chili fries were great, not soggy with a good chili to cheese to fries ratio!

Finally, the cheese curds... Just do yourself a favor and try them. May have been my favorite from everything we ordered. Crunchy outside and weirdly perfect cheesy yet firm inside? Git that ranch sawce. The funnel cake drew me in, but when I go back, I'm going for the curds.

Great pizza and great service. I've ordered pizza twice in as many weeks and it's fantastic. Best pizza in town and the service has been way above expectations. I ordered curbside each time and they have staff wearing masks outside running back and forth bringing the food to your car. Very organized. Will definitely be my go to pizza joint!

First,  the parking,  not sure who paid someone off but20spaces for Budsand Morning Call? New Orleans never forgotten pay to play at work.   Thursday afternoon 2:07pm,  Outside about 5 tables may 12 inside and 10 guests waiting for food.  White Hairedand bearded man that I will guess is the owner took the mans order in front of me and when I stepped to the counter turned grabbed his Laptop and walked away.  Two of his employees working behind the line said" Be right with you".  The young lady took my order.  Sign on the cash register 3.9% surcharge for using a card? Really?   Fix your prices .40 on $10 would not be noticed.

I have been coming here for years and they are still delicious! They have a nice selection of yummy sandwiches, soups and salads. They are usually busy and quick service. Yesterday stopped by for lunch and got the Vegetarian sandwich with eggplant and fresh mozzarella cheese. Delicious panini. Slso, for those who like la colombe coffee, if you get coffee they have la colombe!! I will come back soon.thanks for still having quick and courtesy service and delicious products.

I went here with a party of 6. Honestly we hadn't intended to go here, but we were looking for an Italian restaurant after a viewing at a local funereal parlor, and we just chose this place at random. And we loved it.

We were met by the owner at the door, a very personable, friendly individual. The food was excellent - I had the salmon special, over risotto with green beans. This was delicious, in fact, other members of my party commented on how great it looked. One of us had the Sunday Gravy Special, in his case penne pasta. A huge bowl. The menu had a very nice variety of Italian dishes.

Overall we had an excellent time. If I'm ever in Collingswood again, I would definitely go again, and I would recommend this place highly.

Just moved here a few weeks ago and wanted to try this bagel place that I saw.  I should've kept driving.  Horrible service!  And rude!!  Walked in at 2:10pm and ordered a bagel with white fish.  I asked to dine in. About 10 minutes later my order was walked out to me in a bag and I said it was for here and she said "We put it in the bag for you to go".  I said I wanted to eat here and she said well we're really tired it's been a long day and we're trying to get cleaned up. Wow!  Unbelievably rude!  It's not like I walked in right before they closed. There are a lot of bagel places around here and I know who I won't be giving my money to in the future.
Pure crap I ordered through Doordash flavor was crap. We wasted our money big time. I will never order from here again

Went in to get Indian sweets tonight with my husband, We have picked up sweets from this location in the past and they have been pretty decent 

This time unfortunately the sweets seemed very stable and not cooked well. Not sure if this was just an off day but not sure if we will be returning again. 

The hot dishes are decent or at least they were pre pandemic, not sure how it is now as we have not tried anything in a while.

My go to is the chicken sandwich and never disappoints me.  This is a big sandwich and comes with lettuce, tomato, onion, and ranch sauce.  

The only complaint is that it's a pricey sandwich and you might still be hungry.  Probably want to add a side if you're here.

I went at 9:15 p.m. The OPEN sign  was on.
I was told they are closed. But could get me deep fried.... 
This isn't the first time this has happened here. Ok ast time  it was at 10:15 open sign was on. They told me they closed at 10:00

Yup, this ramen is good. Soup is killer. Noodle has great texture and chew. Soup options are varied, but not ridiculous.  

Pork or chicken based soup, variations from there.  Pork based is creamy, nap inducing luxury. 
Chicken based is clear, pure, not heavy. Biking afterward? maybe.  

Accouterments like the black mushrooms, bok choy, bean sprouts, crispy renkon make sense. They looks good, taste good. 

Complaints?  Its lined-up early! Come with a friend, not a group. And the gyoza... I don't know.  Its focused on the wrapper, not the filling.  Can't endorse it. The math doesn't work.

Fun place, delicious ramen, lineups. Reminds me of a country I know...

Easily one of my favorite Nashville restaurants! The owners are two of the kindest people when you walk in and make the experience well worth your time. Also you cannot beat this food! My favorite is the philly cheese steak, but i've loved everything i've tried so far! Run don't walk to try the place!!!

I love this place! Sashimi is always fresh and yummy!  I love getting a boat load of fish delivered to my table :) The sushi chefs are awesome and service is usually good.

We go here a lot!

Won't ever go back here again. Twice have had bad experiences. Who knows what the food is like, can't get that far, the service is so bad. They've lost my business and anyone else I can convince not to go as well. Just ridiculous. Go To Brown's Social House a block away, great food, great service.
The King Cobra is AMAZING! I will drive out if my way just to pick one up and take home for lunch.  Yum!!!
I suspect the reviews are so high because it's better food than you expect from the furnishings. The barbecue sauce has a nice flavor profile.

For some reason in 2017 someone decided to change the menu and the dressed hummus has taken a major nose dive. Previously accompanied by roasted red peppers and sundried tomatoes, someone made the horrible decision to substitute these items with cold tasteless cherry tomatoes and similarly tasteless roasted cauliflower, which in no way goes with this hummus. I love my neighborhood Reginelli's and eat there at least once a week, but this is a fail. Not sure why anyone would mess a classic winning item, but I would like to place my plea for the good ol original. Sometimes, change is bad.

I was a little wary of coming here after reading all the reviews about bad service, but I'm glad I just decided to come here anyway because I didn't have that kind of experience at all. I guess they've taken the reviews seriously and improved their service.  I've been to the original cafe Soho in North Philly about three times now, and the chicken has always been really delicious.  The only thing it was missing was some good light bites for me to eat that aren't fried food because it does take a while for those delicious wings to cook.

Here's where Cafe Soho 2 comes in.  They have a sushi bar, and surprisingly it's pretty good sushi.  My fiancé and I split a simple tuna roll (standard 6 pieces), and since it was good, I ordered a salmon roll after that.  It was full of nice sized pieces of fresh salmon.  The prices weren't bad either.  Our order of half spicy and half soy  wings came out hot and fresh with a very large bowl of radish pickles.  The quality was just as good!  That chicken so freaking crispy and delicious with that spicy and sweet flavorful sauce!  I haven't found fried chicken anywhere else in Philly that's this addictingly good!

The service was excellent.  Even the sushi chef greeted us when we arrived and when we left.  Our server came to check on us just the right amount of times and made sure we were happy with our meal and brought us plenty of napkins.

I will most definitely be back.  I find myself craving these wings now every few weeks.  Nothing else will suffice!  It's still really far away from me, but not that bad of a trip if I'm already up in the King of Prussia area shopping.  The only thing this location is missing is a bar, but I really don't miss it because of the sushi bar. Oh and it's quieter because the music isn't as loud as it is at the other location, but I find that to be a positive thing.   I think I will try some sashimi next time.  The sashimi the people next to us were eating looked incredibly delicious!
Having been to Hk many times and have had roasted delights in USA countless times. I think this is the best restaurant I've been so far.

Omg I wanted to post photos of the food but we forgot to and there was nothing left to photo. 

Best BBQ place- food was great....but coming from NY durning a pandemic we ordered food to go. While there a couple before us asked to speak to the manager because they were offended that their food was taking to long and that they weren't offered a glass of water. The manager spoke to them we listened to the manager explaining to the couple apologizing for the wait they were understaffed due to covid and he explained if anyone says they are not feeling well he asks them to say home for 10 days even if their test is negative.

The couple became upset with the manager, he apologized and said if you come back to the restaurant ask for me and I will take care of you.  

I went to the manager and said I had to thank him we are from NY and he is doing the right thing and keep doing what your doing, we felt the safest we have felt in a long time, they have the bar seats separated and dividers between tables it's perfect.

Highly recommend this restaurant- also great food and amazing staff!

This place was exactly what I wanted from my NOLA visit.  I had a recommendation from a friend of a friend, and followed up on it when we were in the neighborhood.  Yes, they're efficient, yes, maybe a little bit rude of you don't have your shit together.  Pro tip, look at the menu first, and be ready!

HOWEVER.  That means I got through the huge line quickly, got my food in the time it took for me to wash my hands, and it was SO good.  We got the Ferdi special as recommended, and a cup of the jambalaya.  SO GOOD.  We shared one full sandwich and one cup for 2 of us, and we went in hangry, and came out delighted!
Very good food with a variety that you can try something different each time. Have had the New Orleans and a couple of others and they are all great!

Food was fresh and delicious I had the kebabs, salad, roasted vegetables seasoned perfectly with a couple of small pieces of fresh Naan. Then Uber eats got it to my office and it was still hot!  I haven't been more pleased especially since the craziness going on right now. You can tell they put time and effort into the food. Well done!

Amazing food but they can't cook a burger correctly to save their life. Been there 5 times and every time the burger comes way over cooked. Last night I ordered take out and requested medium rare. Burger came well done. Besides that the ladies running the front desk don't really know what they are doing. Also expect a hour wait although many table are empty. Beside that.....they have amazing food. Best pork nachos ever. And even though my burger was over cooked, it was amazing. Highly recommend. Just don't be to picky and how your burger is cooked.

Excellent little hole in the wall! Yes parking isn't the greatest, Yes there aren't very many tables, but this shouldn't take away from the food quality people! I'm a SB local of 40yrs, have had my share of all other so called "authentic" mexican food spots in town and i'm beyond satisfied with Cuernavaca's food, service and cleanliness! I am a fan of Lilly's tacos, if i'm ONLY in the mood for tacos. SuperRica is another one, except for its super highly priced and nothing to really brag about except for their "raja taco", I literally have not yet had it better anywhere else in town or out of town. El Bajio (on Milpas) eh... pretty good, but I'd rather park a block away and feast at Cuernavaca.

Highly recommend it, Enjoy!

We were from out of town and the restaurant we originally wanted to go to had an hour wait.  We thought how lucky we were that this restaurant had 0 wait time compared to all of the other restaurants along the river.  We should have been smarter to realize that 0 wait time may have equaled a terrible restaurant.   

Let's start with the appetizer that took 20 minutes to come out.  We ordered guacamole and chips and the vast majority of the guacamole was the avocado pit.   When we asked to get new dip the waitress then proceeded to ask for the chip back that husband had in his hand.  Please tell me why he couldn't have the chip!!  

When we got our pizza (which came before our appetizer), the crust on the bottom was soaking wet.  I was so hungry by the time it came out that I sucked it up and just ate half of it.
Small little diner with great food.  I had the egg scramble with Sriracha ketchup and my wife had the corned beef hash, both were excellent.

This place may just be my new favorite happy hour place!!!
I had the happy hour burger and the spinach dip.  My friend had the shrimp cocktail and spicy eggplant and shrimp.  We also shared the chocolate lava cake.

Positive:  the burger was amazing!!!!!!!!!!, the happy hour has $3 tasters and they are amazing (the burger was one of them), the cake was great with amazing gelato

Negative: the lava cake price was a little steep

I will be going back for sure!!

Went with family and friends one evening. Had a BBQ Chicken taco and a Fish taco. I liked them both, and preferred the fish somewhat. The rest of my family all got the chicken and one other, and, unanimously, they all preferred the other one (non-chicken). One plus is that each taco is $3 or $3.25, making a taco dinner fairly inexpensive. I was happy with two plus a drink. My younger daughter seems adamant that the she doesn't want it again, because she prefers hard tacos, and these are soft shells. I liked them greatly, though. To each his/her own. :) I'm going back, as is my wife.

I've eaten here a few times and I've always been satisfied with the food. I usually get the shrimp or roast beef po boy so I can't remark on anything else on the menu. Be prepared to wait as they always have a line out the door, however, it does move quickly. Mother's is definitely a place you must try here in NO.

So after me and my husband loosing our last regular sushi place we decided to give this place a try. The food is great the people are and it is a relaxing atmosphere. Although there are a few bumps along the way the place is as good as it gets. 



This is a retraction to my previous review this place has gone downhill me and my husband have been to this place three separate times at three different times of the day and have had to wait ridiculous amounts of time for food. The first time  and second time we let it go but tonight we ventured in and received three rolls and after waiting 40 minutes for the rest of order we politely asked asked were our food was the waiter had gone to check ten minutes passed and we had to flag him down we requested to forget the rest of our order and we would pay ala carte for what we had the manger appeared to inform us that it made to order and when they are operating at 100% capacity and to expect delays there were empty tables and an empty bar. We felt like to be shamed we will not return

Highly recommend coming here! Excellent food and great service. I had the scrambled eggs and you can pick any kind of cheese you want. The homemade sausage is delicious. I also tried the biscuits and gravy which was super flavorful. And the best pancakes ever... they tasted like cake. Definitely going back!

If I could give this place zero stars I would. The food was ok but service was probably the worst I've experienced. First a patron in our party was served a dipping sauce that included peanuts after he made it clear before ordering that he was allergic to peanuts. The sauce made him so ill he had to leave so he could try to get some fresh air and breath. Next we waited over 40 mins just to get our cards ran. When we asked to speak to the manager, he went to the wrong table, bypassing our table then refused to come back and address the issues. 

We even called while waiting and were told by the manager himself that he was too busy expediting food to speak with us. Some of our tickets were also incorrectly charged for others orders and still the manager refused to come out and address the concerns. Our waiter also refused to help and just threw his hands up and walked away. I have never had service this bad and for a manager to refuse to do his job was absolutely deplorable. This entire experience was mortifying considering I was the person who actually recommended this restaurant as I had been here before and enjoyed the experience.  

What should have been a fun night out with friends turned into one of the worst service experiences I've ever had. Will never recommend this place to anyone again. Absolutely horrible experience. I will be disputing the charges just as we were refused a proper solution
to rectify the situation. This manager, Tom Promkul, should be ashamed to call himself a manager of a place of business.

We were at the Ice Festival yesterday and wanted to eat, we have missed our lebanese foods, so we stopped in to visit Ranoush.   We were greeted by a very nice woman who seated us.  The menu is amazing but missing a mid price section of offering sandwiches instead of meals.   

We had a bunch of appetizers, arabic french fries cooked to perfection and some potatoes that were very spicy.  Za'atar bread YUM and of course Falafels.  The best was the grape leaves.  They were stuffed to perfection and had a great flavor and taste.   We were very happy with everything, including the service.  Everyone is friendly and nice.  

The one thing I think that may help them is to put up menus by the doors.  We were not sure about ordering and having to come in was something most people will just pass on.  

There is a hookah section but it's closed off and I really did not see any of it.  

The atmosphere is very nice.  The tables were cleaned off as soon as people left.  

OHHH and they did not have any dessert when we were there.  That was sad because were were going to order two, but what can you do.   Wish they had some while we were there.

First of all, Pui, the general manager is one of the nicest people you will meet. She is a member of the local community website and works hard to make personal connections with virtually everyone who loves her restaurant. That is a BIG DEAL for Webster Groves peeps, especially me - this shows me that they really care about their food, and the people who eat it. 

I definitely look forward to trying everyone new super-local restaurant and make certain that my husband and I have time to really review the menu, try appetizers, and get drinks.

I have to admit, I do not eat ANY sushi with uncooked fish of any kind in it. I eat only the tempura battered sushi rolls - no nigiri, no sashimi, etc. Now, my husband is a different story, he ordered a huge board and tried a significant variety of things to try. Rolls, nigiri, sashimi, etc. He is incredibly picky when it comes to comparing one restaurant's quality, taste, to another. He was very pleased with Sushi Station's variety and the rolls. The fried California roll, and the Spicy Shrimp Tempura, and the Spicy Girl are my favorites. The Spicy mayo is one of my favorites. I've had some at other sushi places that were so watery and not spicy at all.

We ordered the spicy edamame, very good - we have been experimenting with our own similar version of this at home we enjoyed it so much.

The wings were a touch bland by themselves, but tasted really good with the spicy sweet dipping sauce they send along with it.

Calamari rings fared well with our table. 

The prices on the sake are some of the better prices I've seen, a bottle for $15 of the good stuff - not an off-brand. 

I have found that all of the rolls were extremely well-made, very filling, and seemingly incredibly fresh (coming from someone who has gotten food poisoning from bad "to-go" sushi at another place - I am acutely aware of anything less than fresh). 

We have been there twice in the last month, and we even went on Christmas Eve with our parents - perhaps, this will start being our family tradition each Christmas Eve!

Best of luck to this new little business - try them, its worth it!

They thought I was under 21 so that's a compliment haha! The drinks were really good and the bartenders were super personable which is hard to find nowadays. Loved the long bar and that they have the Stacie bar attached; which is a bit quieter so it feels like a separate venue. I went for my apartment complex's happy hour as I was off on a Friday and had a lot of fun. I like that they utilize Lucky Dill for some of their appetizers because they were tasty! I had the rum and pineapple happy hour drink as well as the skinny grapefruit margarita and both were good. Will be back as it's really cool and in close proximity!

Service: 10/10 
Food: 10/10 

Super friendly staff! We were immediately greeted with waters. When the sun started to hit our table someone came running over to adjust our umbrella. I was so pleasantly surprised by how accommodating and friendly everyone was. 

We ordered the corn & clam chowder, lobster Benedict and Marco's crazy mango salad. All came out amazing and we're super delish. We will definitely be back!

I was highly disappointed and underwhelmed. We went here for lunch on a Friday and they were almost literally out of everything. The lady taking our order was pretty embarrassed as well. Its a friday people not a monday or tuesday after a busy weekend. Aside from that every table was dirty and I'll add there was probably 6 empty/ dirty ones out of the 10 they have. Must have been from the big breakfast rush they got who also ate all the food as well. On a positive note the coffee was solid, so that  I would recommened.

This review was going to start off as a three star but then I changed it to four. Here's why.

My complementary salad that came with my meal had to little lettuce and too much sauce. It was not appetizing to say the least.

But then my papaya Boba drink came out topped with whipped cream. I've never seen bubble tea have whip cream on it but I have to say it tasted great. The bubbles were just the right texture and the flavor tasted great.

Next came out my beef bun bowl. The bowl was large as you would expect from any good Vietnamese restaurant. It had some lettuce in it which I wasn't too much of a fond of because it got soggy after while. Other than the soggy lettuce it was very tasty!

Our servers were quick and very responsive. Good customer service here.

I would definitely come back again.
From the history to the Architecture to the food I enjoyed it all. When you go you have to try the 1905 salad it is truly delicious!!

Bei Denny's gibts lecker Frühstuck 24/7.


 Mit knusprigem Speck, Pancakes mit lecker Ahornsirup, Eier und Toast.


 Kaffee wird einmal gezahlt und danach immer wieder nachgeschenkt.


 Was auch sehr zu empfehlen ist der Oreo Eisbecher kostet so ungefähr zwischen 3 und 5 Dollar aber ist der Hammer. Es gibt 2 verschiedene aber der mit der Schokosoße ist noch eine Ecke süßer. Mittag und zu Abend essen kann man hier, auch gut.

One of my favorite gastropubs! Delicious kale salad, Mac n cheese, fries, and burger. I literally get those items whenever I go for dinner. The cocktails are refreshing and very tasty. I recommend trying a few of their speciality cocktails, they are definitely work the price. The ambiance and overall experience is always very pleasant.
Excellent ramen - rich broth.  I had shoulder, generous portion and really flavorful meats

I came here for the first time with my family on their opening night and wasn't too impressed with the food & service but I thought I'd give it another try to give them a chance. I went back yesterday with my sister during happy hour and I ordered the wings with the BBQ sauce and it was absolutely delicious wings they were so tender and tasty. I totally loved the flavor.  My sister ordered the bacon burger and she said it was also delicious. The server that waited on us was great, she was very friendly and she kept checking on us to see if everything was good. I know I'll be coming back and I'm going to tell my friends about my experience. :)

My sister and I had brunch here on Sunday.  We both made our selections off the brunch menu this visit but the regular menu has served us well in the past. We both loved loved loved our choices.  There is inside seating or outside seating at tables or the bar.  Our waiter/bartender was fast and fun.  We had margaritas but others around us were enjoying endless mimosas or bloody marys from the bloody mary bar. This is definitely a two thumbs up kind of place.

I would say it is more likely 3.5 Stars, but I decided not to round up.  I found it weird that they claim home made ice cream, but half the freezer case is filled with flavors they do not make on their own.  So, definitely ask which flavors are "HOME MADE".  

Between the GF and I, we tried only the Home Made flavors of Butter Pecan, Nutter Butter and Chocolate Overload.  All were pretty good and of superior quality to large batch industrial ice cream.  

A good spot to grab a coffee or a scoop while roaming around Nashville's little downtown area (Sorry, I am from NYC, no offense intended).
Great food, but a bit pricy. The cost is worth it though. This is a piece of Tampa's rich history.

Super cute place. Come early because when it gets busy it will take 20-30 min to get a coffee. Ordered lox bagel and the salmon was super sparse. For 12 bucks I usually get a bunch of salmon. Super cute date coffee place. If you are coming to eat and get coffee for value it's not great. They could add another cash register and staff on Sunday. That would help a bunch.

Finally, a Mexican restaurant that understands my love for queso.  I ordered Maria's enchiladas: three chicken enchiladas completely covered in queso.  While my arteries didn't love it, my tastebuds and stomach sure did.  It came with a side of rice and a cheap price tag of $7.99.

Mom got nachos topped with queso (because duh), chicken, beef, onion and bell pepper.  I enjoyed scraping the cheesy goodness off her plate and into my mouth with some of our leftover chips.

We ate outside and got to enjoy the weather as we munched on our chips and salsa.  I should have gone for a margarita to help beat the heat.  There were a few flavors and they could be made frozen or on the rocks.

A great place to grab a quick, cheap, queso-covered Mexican bite.

Note: Not everything is smothered in queso, but if I had my way, it would be.

Beware of HOWARD! This guy will take you for a financial ride. We had items on our bill that we didn't order. These were items that he implied were comped. He pressured us into ordering food that we had no intention of ordering. Our bill was was nearly $1,000 when at most it should have been $250. This guy needs to me fired. On top of everything else, he was rude and argumentative.

Food was good BUT service was definitely different for us compared to how a lady next to us was served. She was greeted and offered the happy hour special . We, who are brown were not offered the deal. In fact I ordered a mimosa and wasn't informed of happy hour. Hmmmmm. Did the waiter forget ??? Did the manager forget??All I can say is that we were treated differently. Please consider treating all customers the  same .. The manager did compensate by taking  3.00 off  the bill  when I asked about the happy hour. She is actually the person who took our order bc the waiter was as busy?? Her explanation was that Happy hour just started so the way it is rings  up is tricky when U order one...:..smh

in town visiting my dad and decided to check out Somo- we were both VERY pleased! our food was delicious, the service was flawless.

we shared the lemon garlic parm wings and ordered the lobster and shrimp mac, brussels sprouts, and seared octopus - EVERYTHING was perfectly prepared. I know I'll dream about those wings 

not only was the food impeccable, the service was wonderful - thank you for being so attentive to my dad and I; you made us feel welcome. we will absolutely be back

Yuck! This location mad me wish I still had a dog. They would have appreciated it more than I could. The wings were unusually large. I am not particularly a fan of that so that was problem one. The seasoning was packed on so it turned my stomach. The fries tasted like they sat. Waste of money.

This is a great local steakhouse in Meridian. Been here a few times and have had great service and consistently good food. I am a little surprised that they don't have a ribeye selection on their menu. Although, they do offer a ribeye special on Monday and Tuesday evening. But get there early. They run out within an hour or so. Overall, great little spot with good service and good food.

We had a wonderful dinner catered by shawarma this evening. The beef/lamb platter was a favorite but the chicken Shawarma was also very good. The chicken kabob was also delicious. It was an excellent meal. Everyone was impressed.

The food here was like a new crush, when it's so good and all-encompassing that you're still thinking about it hours and probably days and weeks later.  I loved this place so much. 

It's all vegan, but there is a little something for every vegan-friendly eater, from the super health conscious to the junk food fanatic. 

I had the Buffalo Blue Cheese burger.  I don't know how they sublimated a blue cheese sauce, but ahhh... I loved that the burger did not pretend to be meat as many veggie burgers make the mistake of doing.  Instead,  it was it's own hearty combo of flavors from black bean to sweet potato.  I think I even caught a hint of fennel in there,  which I normally hate,  but actually really loved in this. 

The tater tots with just a hint of spicy were also excellent. 

I want to bring everyone I know and try every dish.  If only we lived closer....

Cafe L'aube is the best creperie you will ever try.  My fiance and I are vegetarian and our favorite crepes are the Legumes Vegetarien: avocados, mushrooms, leeks, spinach, and a slight hint of fondue.  For you meat-lovers, before I made a commitment to become a leaf-muncher, I could not get enough of the Le Fromager: eggs, bacon, goat cheese, and tomatoes.  And when I say bacon, I don't mean that flimsy crap your mama used to buy.  This is almost pork belly - amazing.

If you doubt my love for L'aube, let me leave you with this:

I included two Legumes Vegetariens as part of my proposal to my wife-to-be.  She said yes.  (I hope it was because of me, but maybe it was the crepes).

WORST service I have EVER experienced.  Rude waitress. Cold food. Over cooked seafood. 
Late movie??? DO NOT go here.  The waitress literally asked us if we wanted dessert before our drinks were even in.  They wanted us OUT. NO WONDER THE PLACE IS LIKE A WESTERN MOVIE SCENE WITH A TUMBLEWEED BLOWING THROUGH IT! I will never go back.

Went there yesterday as my wife and I were craving Halal Guys. We tried them in NY couple years ago and wanted to try the one in Chinatown being the closest one near South Jersey. We both had a regular platter of beef over rice. The food was great and service was excellent. The manager Pete did help us with our large stroller to go down the stairs and out after he finished. He was very kind and friendly and checked to see if we where satisfied. The only thing I felt was different than the Halal Guys in NY. Is that they served less than what they serve in NY. In NY they load your platter where you barely close it. But this wouldn't stop me from driving over the Ben Franklin bridge the next time we crave Halal guys. Please go and try it for yourself. You can just YouTube how popular the Halal Guys are. Celebrities go to there food carts in NY for a bite.the prices are very reasonable..

The French, disinterested and uncaring?  Say it isn't so!!!!

It took me some time to decide between giving this 1 star or 2.  In the end, their yummy pastries won them 2 stars and that is the ONLY reason 2 stars can be given.

Our waitress was the WORST waitress I have ever experienced in St. Louis.  She was really French (authentic!), quiet, crabby, and in a MASSIVE hurry.  Why was she in a hurry?  Because there were 3 tables waiting for breakfast!!!!  Can you imagine the plight of 1 waitress handling 3 tables?  I have been a waitress my friends and it is no walk in the park, but 3 tables is a freakin piece of cake!!!!

She did not take our drink orders ever.  She didn't even give us the time to shout, "Orange juice please!" in her direction.  I'm going to guess she was around 70 years old?  I hope to God she's the owner b/c she was VERY bossy to the other waitress (who curiously had no tables) and I can't think of any reason someone would actually hire someone with such little personality to wait tables.  It's decided, she owns the place---at least in my mind.

I specifically said, "No whip cream on my waffle please."  She's a gal that doesn't write orders down.  This is okay.  It ALWAYS makes me nervous though that the order will turn out wrong.....and in this case, it did!  She hands me the plate (with mounds of whip cream) and says, "I forgot, no whip cream" in very broken english.  Fabulous!  She doesn't offer to take it back, no, they're FAR too busy for that!  I tried scraping the pound of whip cream off, but it was just too much.  If it were a calorie thing, I would have just dug in and dealt with it, but it's a matter of taste!  I don't like the taste!  Therefore, my breakfast sucked!

I went to the front and got a strawberry almond muffin.  This ended up being my breakfast b/c it tasted 1,000 times better than my actual order. 

Also, it's expensive for so-so breakfast that you could get ANYWHERE.  It's not particularly french.  If you're in the area, just head up the road to Sunrise Cafe for breakfast.  It tastes better.

Come in and buy the pastries, muffins, cookies, and such, but DON'T eat here unless you are aching for some bad service!
What ever you order will be hot and taste great.   Portion is enough for a big guy, hey you have to save room for dessert!

Fantastic place!!
They have a great market feel, best place to grab and go for dinner at home.  Have been here many times and love it, highly recommend
Loved this place. Great atmosphere, delicious food. The carrot cake cupcake was perfect. Wow, It's definitely a must visit when in Carpinteria.

This was the only bad meal we had on our recent 5 day visit to New Orleans.  We picked it because it was close to our hotel and it had decent ratings. On top of it we were only having breakfast, how badly could they screw up.  Completely, is the answer!

My wife had the special which was biscuit, fried sausage, and scrambled eggs. It was awful.  The biscuit was lumpy with not a bit of loft to it.  The sausage was mediocre and the scrambeled eggs were dry and nearly inedible.

I opted for the diot yourself omelette, with baked ham, tomatoes, onions, peppers and spinach.  It came without spinach and microscopic amounts of everything except the ham (which is what Mother's is famous for and it was good).  The omelette was dry and tasteless, but I did my duty and ate it.  There was no comparison between this and the custom omelette I had had the morning before at the Old Coffepot, even though both cost the same $12.

In the end I felt like this was a tourist trap.  The food was memorable, for being the worst I had in NO. I won't ever be returning to this venue, but the long lines at lunch suggest that poor quality has not hurt their business.
I enjoy their happy hour, you can get a Jai Alai for $1.99 and their molasses BBQ wings for $2.49. Will be back.
Worst pizza i've ever had. The pizza was cold and the staff was horrible. I'm from new york so I understand a late night meal and this was not it

Best food we had in Nashville. Some plates are tapas style. Whipped feta with pita was unreal, a must have. Another stunner was kale and Brussels  sprouts- don't knock it till u try it. Also fried chicken was moist and crunchy, and I was convinced to try a lamb frite which was very good, I don't like lamb either... plates are on the small side so u can order a few to share. Then go around thee corner to the adaboy speakeasy for a fancy drink.
Crappy customer service! You pull to the intercom and you hear (Hey how are you). You ask her something and she gives you attitude! SMDH!

Bison, Iced tea and home made half sour pickles. Get them now. Every time I go here I must eat these items. 

This place is kick ass. I have NEVER had a bad experience or meal here. Staff is also great especially Mike, the bartender.  

Pay the extra few bucks and get the bison instead of beef.  It is worth every penny. If you do not like meat they have other choices. However, if that is an issue for you, you should just stay home and eat lettuce.  

Home made chips are good too. Sliders rock. Home made cookies are also on the top of my list.

Chilis is the other restaurant in the parking lot. If you go there instead of Teds you are an idiot.

Short review:

Although this is a chain, I had a great lunch experience here! I ate at the bar and was served by the nice bartender - he name is Alex. I told him I was at lunch and he made sure that my food came out quickly. I noticed that there were other patrons in the bar area and they were on their laptops. Assuming they were students, I can see how this can be a great study spot since there is free wi-fi and never-ending soup, salad, and bread sticks!

On to the food: Create your own Tour of Italy. I chose their lasagna classico, chicken marsala  ravioli, and fettuccine alfredo. I'm not going to go over the usual fare but I did want to rave about their chicken marsala ravioli! The sauce was so savory and yummy! I even took my fettuccine and swirled it in the marsala sauce! This was my favorite! The bartender told me that I can get the sauce on any pasta which is what I plan to do for my next visit. Give it a try!

Everybody goes for the fresh cookies from The Famous 4th Street Cookie Company (which are very good), but don't miss out on the amazing cookies at this little shop located in the back of the market.

They sell the cookies by weight ($10 per pound). I only got two since there are so many other things to eat in the market. We went with the Turtle Cookie, which was incredible, and the Wilbur Peanut Butter Cookie which was one of the best peanut butter cookies I've ever had. Filled with dark chocolate buds (?), once you bite into it you get a ton of melty, gooey chocolate. As anyone knows, that taste mixed with peanut butter is one of the greatest flavors on earth, so you must try this cookie.

In addition to the great cookies, they have a ton of other stuff, like pretzel rolls, chocolate covered bacon, nuts, popcorn, pretzels, etc. I will keep on coming back though to try more of those ridiculously good cookies, as there are still so many more to taste.

Have loved this restaurant for years but this is the first time we tried their sushi. 

It was amazing. The Baked Salmon roll was by far the best. Great service, awesome food, and an all around perfect experience. 

Chris was our sushi chef and he was attentive and had great humor. And obviously- an amazing chef. 

We were surprised though that he was the only chef at the bar. It seemed like a lot of work for only one chef. 

We have read reviews about the bar being slow and having rude staff. That was not our experience. Obviously cooked rolls take longer but other than that everything came out in a timely manner. Madison was our server and she was very attentive and sweet. 

Also, local discount with an ID!

Have eaten here at least a dozen times
Strong kitchen talent 
Wish they would get the trout off the menu and get back to ocean fish
Great salads
First time, food was excellent.  The service was attentive and there was little wait for our food. The seaweed salad was one of the best I've had.

Family owned place with cute decor. The food is..meh alright. Noting that there is some amazing mexican food in the area this places food ranks about average. Nothing too amazing. But not bad either.

The staff was a bit slow at seating our group. There wasn't anyone dining here just yet and with plenty of staff standing around it took about 15min for someone to get to us after talking among one another.

The food came out fast and like I said before was alright. Some of our food was cold while others was warm or hot. So timing on cooking could be improved.

I would say his would be a fine joint for families. As the food is pretty basic and not spicy so kids can eat just about everything on the menu. However if you have more refined taste buds you might find it a bit bland.
1 word: Yuck!  Stopped by to grab a bite to eat while on my way to my Sissies. The smell of the Lo-Mein was so bad, so repulsive, so disgusting that we had to throw it away. Never again.
