This place is awesome. It has the best prices and tastes awesome. The owner is cool too and this spot is a special place in the neighborhood.
Dined during an off "lunch" hour and the service was great; the food was great as well, the fried items were fried well and very tasty. The grilled items were nice and moist (not at all dry!).

Giving 2 stars mainly for the view!  We stopped by Whiskey Joe's for the first time a few weeks ago on a Friday night with a party of 6.  We tried a variety of alcoholic drinks that were all mediocre definitely for the price and a few shots of fireball which were warm.  Our group ordered fish taco, the grouper nuggets, and burgers.  I did not think any of them were good.  The items that were fried tasted like a pound of grease, and the burgers and fish tacos were gross.  The view was nice, our waitress was friendly, but unfortunately since the drinks and food were not good we won't be back.

Very good store. Food is always fresh, service good and employees friendly. They have a good special on Monday with 6.99 specials. Only gripe is they don't have green peppers. Make sure to try the marinated tomatoes.

If I could do half stars, this would be more of a 3.5 rating.  But, I'll round it up to four this time. 

I really like the setting of this steakhouse.  It's mostly red and taupe colors, accessorized by dark browns.  And the walls are decorated with various pics of Lake Tahoe at sunset, and I find them beautiful and pleasant for a dinner experience.  

I was craving red meat, and the hubby saw that they have an "Early Bird" special on Mondays, so we ventured here. The maitre'd welcomed us as soon as we entered.   The host seated us at a table, where our waiter greeted us by introducing himself and taking our drink order.  We chose to keep it simple with iced water.  

We started with the beef carpaccio, which was sliced a bit thicker than how I know it to traditionally be.  The capers and the greens gave it some additional flavor, though it seemed to be lacking in what should've been a lemon juice kick.  For our second course, the hubby partook of their wedge salad with blue cheese dressing, though our waiter informed us that theirs usually comes with a balsamic dressing. I had their soup du jour, steak and potato soup, which was something new to me.  While it seemed pretty good, it was a bit more salty than I like my food, but figure it's to be expected when eating out.  

For the main course, I ordered the "baseball" top sirloin 10oz steak.  I requested medium, as Aaron informed me that they tend to cook on the rarer side.  Imagine my surprise when the plate arrived, and my steak was nearly well done, hardly any pink inside.  I took a bite, and it was chewy and definitely not the way I like to enjoy my meat.  I waited for Aaron to come check on us, and he noticed the mistake immediately, and apologized profusely.  I requested that it be taken back to the chef and remade, which he did without hesitation.  In the meantime, I took a bite of my hubby's prime rib, dipped in au jus and creamed horseradish.  The prime rib is not my favorite pick of meat, but his was cooked perfectly, and the bite was really delicious.  His side of mashed potatoes wasn't perfect, but still quite edible, along with baby carrots and asparagus.  

I didn't mind waiting for my meal to be recooked since I was already starting to feel full on the carpaccio and soup.  Aaron continued to stop by without seeming like he was trying too hard.  Eventually, my plate reappeared, brought out by the maitre'd and it definitely had more pink, though it still wasn't as much as I preferred.  I took a bite and I was able to enjoy it. My meal was accompanied by potatoes au gratin, along with the baby carrots and asparagus. Overall, it was a good dinner.  I appreciated the effort to make it right and to make the evening a positive experience. 

We finished with Godiva Chocolate Lava Cake for dessert, along with a cup of decaf coffee.  I liked that the coffee came with a tray loaded with little blocks of cream, sugar, chocolate stirs, and chocolate shavings.  I took a few bites to satisfy my sweet tooth, finished the ice cream, knowing that wouldn't make it home, and boxed the rest for later. 

I would be willing to venture this restaurant again, if nothing else but than to feel like I'm dining at sunset on Lake Tahoe.  Oh, and the three cheese bread was excellent.  And I would be more than happy to request Aaron as my server.

Least favorite Chick Fil A in the area. I always get spicy chicken burrito for breakfast at CFA. This one is the worst! Third time giving it a chance and I regret it, again. First time, no spicy chicken. Second time, barely any egg or chicken but at least the chicken was spicy. Third time- worst yet. Full of sautéed onions/peppers so it was very soggy, not much cheese, not much egg, and 3 pieces of spicy chicken! So disappointing... lesson learned. Get the minis or chicken biscuit. Can't mess that up. PS- they also won't put a spicy chicken filet on the Cobb salad, but the one on Vets in Metry and Kennah bra do!

The reviews for this restaurant were great so I tried it; this was by far the worst ramen I've ever had. It tastes like $1 cup of noodles but cost me $12. Go anywhere else, the broth was gross and tasted thrown together and low quality. I tossed 2/3 of it because l could not finish it. Waste of money, go anywhere else.
Best Mexican restaurant around! Friendly staff, extremely fast service, and crazy good food. I recommend this place to anyone in the Edwardsville area.

Yum yum yum. I ordered the garlic sauce dish with chicken. It is so flavorful unlike most garlic chicken dishes at other asians spots. It was my first time stopping by but I will definitely be going back. I ordered for takeout and the food was still hot and fresh when I got home. Yum.
Great service by Tim...fab buffalo shrimp & calamari...outside is the best!   We will be back!

The finest raw meats in the area! Served us raw steaks when we asked for medium.  Extremely busy and understaffed. I get this place is new, but it needs a lot of work. Manager was nice and comped us our meal, but I'm very hesitant to return despite the fact we were given gift cards to be used for a future visit. Even when your bar tender tells you to come back in a few months, that alone is highly concerning about the competence of this establishment to function as a reliable and trustworthy restaurant.

Good lunch spot - we enjoyed sitting out back and the service was more then adequate.  Very responsive and timely.  My husband had the sausage poboy and started with the intention of only eating half - FAIL - He finished it!  I had the Asian pear and jicama salad - it was very tasty, and I'll have it again.  We shared the spring rolls between three of us and they were very good - especially the peanut dipping sauce - they were the largest spring rolls I've ever seen.  Also enjoyed the jasmine tea - and refills were plentiful - we'll be back!
Great service - amOng food and cool atmosphere - local beers and amazing sides. And close to the best theatre in stl

My husband and I have stayed here on several occasions and it is absolutely beautiful. The views of the sea are great. The staff where able to help with all of our room requests. The rooms were clean and smelled great.  ( I think they use some kind of aromatherapy). The rooftop bar was also great with a large selection of drinks. We would recommend this place if you want a hotel close to the beach.

Shyan's Kitchen in Metairie is my FAVORITE  hidden gem when it comes to Pakistani food. Every dish I've tried here is magical and packed with tons of flavor and spice.

My favorite dish is the Paneer Tikka Masala [Spicy] with naan. I decided to branch out last night and try the Goat Curry [Spicy] & it was so amazing. The Goat Biryani is banging too! They have plenty of vegetarian options too!


The atmosphere is casual and family friendly.  I've been with my father and son too. The staff is quite friendly and helpful.  They will help you and answer any questions you have. 

If you love flavorful, well spiced food, in a comfortable place you definitely need to go to Shyan's!

Food is OK.  I have a problem with the service.  Servers are nice so it must be the kitchen.  It takes a while for the food to be served, my husband had to send his soup back because it was not warm enough.
(But the vegetable bean soup was very good.)  I had ordered a second glass of wine to enjoy with my sandwich.  This glass was never served, I did cancel it because I was almost finished my sandwich when the wait person passed my table.
There was  "funny" moment when the person delivering the check told us we weren't charged for the second glass of wine. Duh?

Well there is a reason this place is dead on a Thursday night. Worst watered down Mojito ever with not a hint of alcohol. I would consider changing there name to something that they can actually make.
Great sandwich. Way too expensive and the wait was forever. Remember - This is fast food, not even a commercial restaurant.

What a pleasant surprise right in my back yard! I've lived in west philly for a total of 8 years and had no idea that this place existed and boy am I pissed.  A group of 6 of us when to "brunch" at 2:00pm here.  They had options for everyone in our group--a couple of pescatarians, a vegan, two carnivores and kids who'll eat anything. They had so many tasty looking options. I loved the fresh ingredients and the seasonings that I had in my dish, the Shrimp and Grits.  Actually, I haven't been to a non-southern restaurant and had good Shrimp and Grits before, so I was doubly surprised.  I was told by my table guest that the waffle, calamari, foul, and potatoes were also great.

The service was fast and efficient and the waitresses were very attentive to our water refill needs.  I would most definitely come back to this place to try the regular menu because it looked really good.

P.S. It's BYOB, so there's also that bonus fact.

Location, location, location! Had lunch on the sand! Felix was an excellent server. He agreed to substitute the Ahi for fresh fish of the day on the "Ahi" salad. A terrific perfectly grilled piece of fish on a bed if lightly dressed mixed greens was perfect!

I'm going with a 4, but if I could I would say 3.5. The cheese and charcuterie were delicious and thoughtfully curated with accompanying marmalade and lavender honey. Our first delivery of house bread was really crusty and dry, whereas the second was moist and delicious. So that was a bit inconsistent. We both had delicious entrees, but the dessert was lackluster. Chic and cozy interior, but terrible service. As you may have noticed, it seems to be the restaurant of "but"s. Good food but no plans to return any time soon
I love their Reuben sandwiches. They are massive and delicious. Their sweet potato waffle fries with powdered sugar sprinkled on top are amazing too

As the duchess of this fine establishment (don't argue with me. see the little crown? above this review? yeah. beat it.)... i think its my duty that i provide my favorites to the public. 

I'm here every weekend.  Not only because the food is amazing, but because the people that work here are amazing.  Where else can you go where you'll be WELCOMED into a restaurant with open arms? probably a lot of places. forget that I started off updating my review with that question. 

but really though, the friendliness and the warm atmosphere is enough to get people coming back. you feel like you become a part of that small family. 

My brother isn't 21 yet and he never understood why people went to bars. I never go to bars to have a conversation with a bartender (unless its in hawaii and i'm already hammered. then the bartender is my best friend.) but I guess the way that its portrayed in movies where someone goes to the bar and chats up a storm with the bartender is how he thought it was supposed to be.  He still didn't understand until he came in one night with me after work to grub and he instantly felt the hospitality and the warmth of these employees.  please note: this place doesn't have a fully stocked bar. He's just not 21 and thinks that any place that serves beer over a bar-like structure is a bar. Haha, so young and so very innocent. 

enough of that. my favorites:

pb and j burger. the first time I tried it, I was blacked out and I don't remember what it tasted like at all. I had it this past Saturday night and holy shiiiiiiii-, it was so good. And again, i hate savory and sweet. Maybe my taste buds are slowly changing? Because there have been a lot of these combinations that I'm starting to like... 

macaroni and cheese with mushrooms and caramelized bacon. 

grilled cheese with tomato and arugula. the green makes me feel a little bit better about neglecting my vegetables.

raspberry shock top beer.

Nothing fancy, but it's the kind of pizza place you go to when you just want a slice or when you need to put something in your stomach after a night out.  You can dine in or order by the slice from the widow and eat outside at one of the tables.

Prices are reasonable.  The menu has a variety ranging from wings and lasagna,  to sandwiches and whole pizzas.  You will find beer & wine on the menu as well.

Poutine is probably one of my favourite things in Canada. The hype about La Poutine was quite big but to be honest, i enjoyed the poutine from It'dog much more. It'dog is right across the street and is much more reasonable. But again, this is a personal choice.

Absolutely phenomenal food and atmosphere. We came in for a late dinner at 9pm and were accommodated at the bar. It's a great spot to be because you can watch the well-oiled machine if the kitchen crew. The food was stunning. Best gumbo and shrimp and grits we had in all of NOLA.

Great hidden gem in Castleton! Wanted to eat at another noodle place for lunch but they hadn't opened yet so my friend and fellow Yelper decided to try out this place. I've driven past Ichiban a hundred of times, always curious how the food was. 

I ended up getting the Shoyu Udon (recommended by the server) - crispy pork, spinach in soup stock. It was perfect for a cool fall day.  Your meal comes with soup or a salad - I got the salad since I was already eating soup. The udon was enormous - but I definitely ate the whole thing. i love the thick  noodles, which were cooked perfectly, and the stock itself was so flavorful and rich. The pork was so so, about 5 pieces, but I enjoyed the meal as a whole. 

We were the only ones in the restaurant but it picked up as a lunch crowd trickled in. They only had one server, so we didn't see much of him throughout our meal. One of my biggest peeves is when servers put everything on one bill without asking how it should be split, which happened today. We had to wait around an extra 10 minutes before we could get our bill settled.

All in all, the food was good (or at least mine was), but service could be a bit better.

Hard to find spot that is actually in the back of a bar (Erin Rose bar) with a different name than Killer. Luckily I pressed on an found it. The shrimp Po Boy was awesome and so was the hot sauce. Not fried like the traditional kind but grilled with cole slaw. Great nonetheless. Also friendly server/cook at the grill!

After receiving credible (inside not available to the public) information that the apple fritters at Dunkin' Donuts are brought in frozen and the Krispy Kreme version is made fresh daily I had to make a trip.  My day started as it normally does with a mild anxiety attack.  I jumped out of bed with a defined mission almost possessed to couple Dunkin' Donuts coffee with a Krispy Kreme apple fritter.   Phase 1 of my plan went off perfectly - Dunkin' Donuts coffee is amazing.

I then made my way across town sipping coffee, taking in some news, in anticipation of a made fresh daily apple fritter.  Well.   The Krispy Kreme facility and ordering process was antiquated,  not nearly as friendly as Dunkin' Donuts.  I ordered the apple fritter, opened the box and then everything went downhill.  It was essentially a cold and lifeless cafeteria style sad generic Cinnabon - ruined my day.   I hate you Krispy Kreme so much.

I ordered online for the fishers location, when I went to pick up they seemed confused and then started getting my order together. I was given the wrong kind of chicken and wrong sauces. When I got home I realized the fries were soggy and the chicken was inedible. The breading was wet and the chicken was tough. The biscuits were raw on the inside. This was the worst fast food I have ever had.

Oh Whiskey Joe's, how I adore thee.  I met a friend here for dinner and we were able to enjoy some cocktails at the beach bar, and successfully made reservations for the inside restaurant.

The beach bar was a bit overrated, there was some areas roped off, and a lot of stuff looked like it needed updating.  I can definitely see the appeal though if you ventured there by boat. I was there a weekday and I've personally seen from the causeway how packed it can be. Looks like it could be fun with a crowd.

The inside restaurant was very nice. The server seemed to come around every time we needed drinks or more napkins. She was extremely sweet and nice. The food was pretty good.

The cool part was, sitting in the restaurant as a storm rolled in. We sat next to the window so it was if our dining experience had its own show! We could watch the storm come in, and we watch the eaves crash underneath us.

I have to say, this is the perfect restaurant to bring out of town guests to for the Florida experience.  I can't say how the party crowd is on the weekend, but it was low key on a Wednesday night.

Make reservations to ensure a table when you get there. They sat us immediately!

My favorite Mediterranean restaurant in Reno- always really delicious food, and the owners/staff are really sweet. My orders have had a couple of errors, either things were left out or swapped, which is the only reason I didn't give 5 stars. Never too big of an issue though, as we've always enjoyed the food regardless. Definitely recommend giving this place a try!

Like their food but when I order delivery through their web site is ALWAYS wrong. Toppings I didn't ask for or missing toppings, etc. I usually just harrumph, scrape the extra stuff of my cheesesteak and move on with my day because it takes so long I don't feel like waiting for a replacement. The one time I did call, the person on the other end was rude and insisted I give the uneaten wrong order to the delivery person to get my replacement. Yeah, this is really an elaborate plot to get extra fries.... Even the delivery person was shocked when I handed him the food. Thought maybe it would be better if I went to the store to order...but nope. Again, like the food but just once I'd like to get what I ordered.

If you are looking for a fancy and stuffy Italian restaurant with waiters in tuxedos and overpriced bubbly, well, I feel truly bad for you, I'm sorry that someone hurt you so badly and also, this is not the place for you. 

If you are looking for an Italian experience... the one where you enter a space as strangers and leave as family, the one that leaves you warm and whole inside (whether from the experience itself or the liquor is frankly, no ones business), where cheese and marinara and paired with love, laughs, eccentricity, and familia...then this is absolutely the place for you. 

As Nevada's oldest restaurant, this little local secret has withstood the test of time, and in dining there, it is easy to see why. This locally, family owned and operated, restaurant is a homage to family, friends, and the Italian spirit. If you can some how manage to dine here and not laugh and smile the entire time, again, I feel sorry for you. 

Casale's is the epitome of old world Reno meets old world Italy! The lasagna is perfect, you will feel like you are at the kitchen table of a sweet little Italian grandmother, the ravioli is hand rolled and cut daily, the Kellames appetizer (garlic bread and marinara) is, well, garlic bread and marinara, and if that doesn't speak to you on a spiritual level, it should. The pizzas are a unique twist on traditional pies and very worth the experience! The bar, and the drinks it provides, have the wisdom (and strength) to show why this place has stood the test of time! 

Finally, the family. From Mama Inez to her amazing children and grandchildren, that still run and operate this restaurant, you won't find better people, and you won't find yourself leaving, anything less than familia! 
Mangia'!

Beautiful spot with fantastic food!

Had a choice of sitting indoors or outdoors and since we wanted to savor what's remaining of the warm summer sun. Beautiful views of the Delaware River from wherever you sit on their large patio.

Service started off weird...took a while for our waitress to get to us but once she came over our waitress was sweet and took our order and disappeared again. The woman who was bussing tables was also getting coffee for tables and completely skips ours, serves the table that came after us and then tries to move on to another table next to us until we call her over for coffee before she does. I asked for some splenda because I see only see two in there and I'm gonna have more than one cup... she argues there's always 3 in there, so I show her the 2 packets, she goes back to get some and then tosses a handful at our table acting like I've insulted her...ok then....

The specials were a Carnita Benedict and a pumpkin pancakes. The carnita was unbelievably seasoned and seriously was the best I've tasted outside of Mexico. Like holy wow! Also ordered the breakfast nachos, wished they had used crumbled chorizo in place of a regular breakfast sausage patty but it was so pretty dang tasty.  Thankfully coffee was delicious but wished it was hotter. 

Been visiting New Hope since '99, and really haven't a bad meal he ever so will continue to come here too (even with snarky staff members around). Eat local! Support local!

Years ago I used to order from JC's it was one of the best for chinese food. Last evening my children and I wanted the taste of good chinese food so we for ego our ordinary takeout place and ordered take out from JC. 

The food was horrible. I paid $35 for 3 containers of food we could barely recognize. The beef and mushrooms looked like a carton for brown slop with mushrooms, the chicken in garlic sauce was so dark we thought it was the beef and the sweet and sour shrimp was already in the sauce so it was just a soggy mess. Oh and i guess to save money we only got one qt of rice to go with our food. But they managed to splurge on the 3 packs of soy sauce, 3 packs of duck sauce and 3 packs of mustard to go with each qt of food I ordered. 
I told my daughters we will never be ordering from them again. And I wouldn't recommend anyone else eating there either

GREAT FOOD!   Delivery took a long time, but in the end worth the wait. Waiting for their new location to open. Not a bad thing in the menu!   Loved the food.  Nice people run the place and provide good service and fabulous food.  Highly recommend.

Holiday gift to my mother: overnight in New Hope with the daughters. Booked two queen rooms for four (plus Bucks County playhouse matinee show tickets and Sat Eve dinner reservations nearby.). All booked more than a month ahead.

Logan permits one night weekend stays, unlike most of the nearby inns requiring two. We really hoped for an inn with great breakfast as part of stay, which Logan does not have. Can't have it all, alas.

Good location. Good updated rooms. Saw no ghosts. A bit pricy, but the one night weekend policy worked for this group. Three stars means Logan was quite good for our purposes and a nice adventure for a senior in New Hope: worked out as our Christmas gift to her. To get four or more stars, Logan would need to either lower price or really reconsider adding truly delicious breakfast as part as so many of the higher rated inns do. We paid $270 per queen room at time we went. Current online price looks a bit lower now.

Pizza here is the best in Wayne pa. The Greek gyro is the best I have had. I also enjoy their
Greek salad. The people are so sweet who take you order. Plus delivery here is fast and polite. I been a consumer now for 3 years of west avenue pizza..

Great food, great prices, great service, and free margaritas!! What more could you ask for? This is my new go-to Mexican spot. I've been going to their Conshohocken location for awhile now, but this one is closer to me. This location is more spacious then the Conshohocken location. I really like the open kitchen concept. The food is delicious and the servings are large. I can't say enough good things about this place! Go see for yourself, you won't regret it.

This is fine dining at its best. Light bohemian music played in the background as customers enjoyed large glasses of wine with their small portions. Each bite has a unique taste that compliments each flavor very well. There is a lot of detail given to service, food presentation, quality and taste. Great place for a date!

This is a great place to go for fast Mexican food. I love stopping in and having an $8.00 pitcher of margaritas while waiting for my food. Service is normally fast, and the staff is nice and accommodating. Don't go here in the summer as they don't use the ac and it gets uncomfortably hot inside. The food is not spicy, but the portion sizes are very favorable. Not a must go to place but if you're in the area it's not bad.
Delicious breakfast and amazing croissants! I had scrambled eggs and sausage and my daughter had a gigantic order of pancakes. I can't wait to go back and try more.

Dined here for Thanksgiving with my son. Unfortunately the reservations were backed up but a short wait in the lovely bar took care of it.  We were seated in the main dining room and the service while a bit harried ensured a quality experience, and the menu so enticing convinced me to order the filet entree with my son ordering the lobster pasta; neither of us having anything resembling a traditional turkey holiday dinner. The food was delicious and we would certainly return.
If you are paying $7 for falafel over rice and you get half bowl full,  then I would rather go to the halal guys.

The food is superb!!
We order the crawfish etouffee, jazzy crab cakes plater and gator tail bites. I loved my crab cake. My man love his etouffee so much. The gator tail, it's so so. Nothing special. 
Service is ok. The only minus is the appetizer come out very late, as if it was dessert.
Delicious food and nice environment inside. Need to spend some time cleaning the entrance area and sidewalks.

First time at Chuck Lager's. This place is great, possibly my new favorite. A little empty due to Covid (grrr!)  or the fact that it was New Years Day. Great food and friendly service. The big pretzel appetizer has no salt, but don't be alarmed, the Parmesan cheese crust makes up taste wise. I had the Aztec burger, really nice flavor. My wife's tomato basil bisque could have been thicker, but I always go for thicker (I've never said I wish this soup was thinner). It was really good on any count and she couldn't stop offering me a bite of her brisket grilled cheese. Our server ( Justin) deserves a special mention as he was both friendly and attentive without being overly so. Super nice guy. No negatives to mention. I would definitely recommend visiting here and can't wait to go back.

The market is simply awesome but the three times I have had lunch there it has been just average. I have had better sandwiches in many other places. I have had meatball and Italian subs. You would think they'd be memorable, but they are not. I will be shopping there again, but not eating there.

My wife and I live just down the street and thought we would try the place again after an average meal last time. This time we started with spring rolls. Tasty and generous. Very fresh ingredients. We then had the Red Dragon roll, maguro and shake sashimi , and scallop sushi . The Red Dragon roll was flavorless and tiny. The sashimi was fresh and generous. The scallop sushi was weird as it was chopped and blended with regular not spicy mayo. Overall a C grade. We finished with Pad Thai. Checkout the pic of the chicken. We wouldn't eat it as It was hard and didn't look like chicken. A German tourist next to us had the same dish wand wouldn't eat it since he said it was pelican. Ha!
Service is OK. Atmosphere is Ok. We won't go back.

We have been patient and tried ordering three times from this location even though each time the pizzas were wrong. 
Tonight not only we're the pizzas wrong yet again but so greasy they are inedible.
Asked for cheese on had of one with pepperoni on the other half- we received a pepperoni/ mushroom pizza.
Asked for sausage and jalapeño on the other- we got pepperoni and jalapeño.
Both pies were so greasy they literally fell apart.
We attempted to call and speak to them and were placed on hold TWICE for more than 15 minutes each time.
I understand it's just pizza but be prepared for a bad experience if you choose to use this location.

We were greeted by the owner and received like family. I had the butterfish special and ink fish appetizer. Everything was amazing. The rest of the party ordered the shrimp and Halibut. I could not suggest any improvements to our dining experience.
The worst ghetto people and unclean gave me food poisoning absolutely horrible. Go to the Popeyes on island ave instead
First time here  since I'm from Houston Tx. Great place and food. The staff was helpful and very sweet!

I used CIBO recently to cater an event for 50 people, not only was the food delicious (don't sleep on their cannolis) and thoughtfully prepared (eg oils on the side to prevent sogginess) but the communication with the owner was excellent. Not only did he take the time to give me multiple estimates to work with my budget but when my department asked for more detailed receipts he provided them quickly and took the initiative to follow up with me to ensure I'd been reimbursed. I highly recommended them!

Super yummy place. Prices were a bit steep but it's seafood, so can't explain. Took my team of college tennis players that are from all over the world (USA, Mexico and Africa) and they all loved it. Big portions and such good flavors!  

Service was great. I forgot her name, but our server was so nice and explained everything to the players that never really ate Mexican food. The fried red snapper was amazing. Nicely fried and not oily. The Cameron Rellenos are super crunchy and the shrimp inside was still so flavorful and soft.  Oysters were ok... not as chilled as I would like. Nonetheless, yummy.

Bartender Jacqueline was amazing! So sweet, attentive, and funny. My girlfriend and I sat at the bar and we were also taken care of by the manager on duty, whose name we missed, unfortunately! Jacqueline and the manager took great care of us and also helped us narrow down which movie we would watch tonight :) having worked in the industry so long, it means a lot to meet others who are genuine about their service! It was my first time at this location, but certainly not my last, thanks to them :)

We did not have a very good experience here. Food was okay.  Literally just okay.  Nothing special at all. We went in after seeing a movie and just chose it out of convenience.  We definitely won't be back. Service was not good!  The husband ordered wings and was served the most pathetic little "nub" of a wing. We certainly would not recommend this place.

**update- after I posted this (coincidentally or not - you decide) the manager came over and brought us two free meal cards.  And- in fairness- when we pointed out the ridiculous wing they served us, they did bring out a few better ones.

I've been here a small handful of times, and have yet to be impressed.

Last time I went was a few weeks ago with my family. I met them there and arrived 15 minutes after they did. Not only did they not have their drinks yet, but the server hadn't even come by to say that he'd be right with them. Another 5 minutes or so went by before our server came to the table. We put in our drink and app orders and my dad and I got a glass of Cabernet and a manhattan. While the kids drinks came right away, we had our appetizers before my dad and I had our drinks from the bar. Our server was also nowhere to be seen during our meal unless it was to run our food or drop off the check.

The service is mediocre at best, and the food is nothing to rave about. I definitely would not recommend this restaurant, and will not be coming here again.

Awful food, terrible wait staff. I will never come back to this place. The waitress was nasty from the moment we sat down because she was the only one with 7 tables. She made this known and wanted sympathy. I even called ahead and asked if it was busy/if we needed a reservation and the hostess said no. The food was terrible too. We ordered a few things that were on the menu and were told they didn't have them. I ordered Mac and cheese for my son because they didn't have something else and she said she never put that order in. I will never come back to this awful place.

I've driven by the Drake multiple times per week and never considered stopping in. I'm glad I did, and I'll be back - when I want a heavy, fried meal. (You know that happens every once in a while!)

I was working with a sales girl around Thanksgiving, who casually mentioned that she's vegetarian when I was making small talk about the recent holiday. We compared notes on our favorite restaurants, and she turned me on to the Drake. This tavern seems most popular for its burgers, and they do a mean veggie burger. 

The patty was deep fried and scalding hot, but very good - almost like a hush puppy loaded with shredded carrots and other veggies. You can sub in a veggie patty on any of their specialty burgers (although there is an upcharge - a little ridiculous, as you should get a credit for saying hold the bacon). I really liked the Captain Morgan's, which was smothered in a sticky sweet sauce. We also ordered one plain, which was a little bland. 

You can park on the street, and there's also a lot off of Greenwood and another off West (although you'll have to back straight out - you'll understand if you go there).

I love Jonathan's Cork! Claudia Jeff and James are excellent bartenders. And Jonathan is pretty cool too! LOL I love them all! thank you for always having great service great food and the best martini in town
After a chardonnay glass lined with dust, mediocre sushi, and the average price of a roll being about $2.00 more than what we've experienced, we won't be going back.

In the past, I have enjoyed the seafood poboys and the hotplates; red/white beans and rice and the meatloaf are some of my favorites.

Based on recommendations in the reviews, I decided to try the roast beef poboy.  I was very disappointed.  The roast beef flavor was lacking, and the texture seemed off.  (not sure how to describe it, but it seemed firmer than what it should be)

In any case, I will go to Koz's on Hickory Ave. if I want a roast beef po-boy in the Harahan area.

Went here today she was doing grab and go so the platters came out very quick I had the fried fish with the Mac and cheese candied yams and seafood salad the Mac cheese was okay I had better the candy yams and seafood salad was good too but i didn't see what the hype is about this place I had asked for tarter sauce for my fish they didn't have that nor did they have any drinks ready I don't think I would be back

Great place for lunch with my daughter. Service was great and our lunch was very good. The Mayfair dressing should have been chilled before serving though. Love the ambiance - very charming. Will be back!

This place is aMazing. Hibachi and sushi do not disappoint. It's Byo, and prices are reasonable. Be sure Call for reservations for hibachi on weekends. They have awesome hibachi specials like, pick 3, dinner for two or four and also land and sea for two! However I don't recommend hibachi lobster anywhere, just gets too tough on the grill in my opinion. Osaka is a must try! I am new to the neighborhood and already been here 3 times!

Don't bother. We were there nearly 2 hours waiting for everyone to get their food. The waitress, named Jamie, was horrible. One guy in our group got his appetizer and main dish before another guy got any food at all. I asked the waitress to check and see if grilled shrimp could be put on the pasta (they do put it on the salad) and she never got back to me, just brought me the salad. The alligator balls are super expensive considering what you get. 

All in all, a horrible experience. If I lived in the area, I would stay as far away as I possibly could. Maybe in IL we do things faster and more efficient. Maybe we demand everyone be fed at the same time and that is not such a big deal in the south. I don't know. I just know that the table next to ours called over the manager and complained (apparently about the same thing we were experiencing) and we didn't even bother. We just wanted out of there. 

The food was average. I have had better shrimp salad in the Phoenix or Tucson (far away from the ocean) and the staff beyond horrible. Certainly if I lived in New Orleans I would NEVER go back again and if you are a tourist on a schedule....walk on by. 

If I could give this no stars. I would. I didn't deserve one. Not for anything

3.5 stars. I have had delivery from here a couple times now--it's consistently good but not amazing. I've tried both the saag paneer and the saag with shrimp, and my boyfriend gets the chicken vindaloo which was too mild when he asked for medium spicy and too spicy when he just went with the normal level of spice. The portions are good sized, and it usually lasts me 2 meals. 

A big plus for this place is their speedy delivery. Both times I have ordered they have quoted me 45 or so minutes for delivery, and they are usually at my door before 30 minutes has passed. I definitely want to dine in sometime soon because it's BYO!

Waiter was great but... Don't go here for dinner!  Run... don't walk... RUN AWAY!!!   Food was cold, owner is an jack***!  Basically told us we were lying when we told him our food was cold.  His words, " I can't believe 9 people ordered dinner and they are ALL cold.  I stuck my finger in the spaghetti and burned my finger."  WHO DOES THAT?!?  Needless to say, that ruined my wife's appetite.  He told my father there was no way his prime rib was cold.  Owner was very condescending and argumentative.  I have been in food service before and THE CUSTOMER IS ALWAYS RIGHT!!!!  He just sent the food back and reheated the spaghetti, with a finger hole in it and poured a nasty brown gravy over everything else.  After the waiter set my wife's spaghetti in front of her, she did not make a move toward it.  The owner came back and got down on a knee in front of my wife and said, 'Clearly you are not happy."  My wife told him that you don't treat customers this way.  The customer is ALWAYS right.  The owner looked my wife in the eye and said, "Well, it doesn't look like you will be eating this."  Then he took her dinner away without another word.  She did not have anything but salad that night.  It our children we not present we would have gotten up and left.  Took the cold dishes of the bill but the damage had been done.  We will NEVER, EVER return.  We WILL tell everyone we can to never go there for ANYTHING!!!

Great little East Nashville spot. Has all the bases covered. Coffee to a full bar, they are here for you any time of the day. Your mini donuts are made to order and you can either pick one of their creative toppings or mix and match your own. I liked the options and ordered from their menu. All were very tasty! I wish that you could order different donut flavors instead of just toppings but I think that would unnecessarily complicate their operation. Your donuts are sold to you fresh and hot. How can you beat a hot donut?!

Hello IKEA decor meets burgers.  So many choices! I loved the ability to create what you want and I was very happy to find a veggie option. I ordered the Blue burger with a vegan patty and added lettuce and tomato with an order of sweet potato tots (I was bummed I forgot to also get the homemade pickles and on a wheat bun).  FYI an order of tots can easily be shared between two or three.  Too bad my group didn't realize this as we had beyond plenty to go around.  

Seemed like everyone in my group liked their burgers and fries and/or tots and left full.  The lady who took our orders was really friendly and the food was made quickly.  

I wouldn't say my burger was super gourmet and the tots were a bit greasy but it was a good burger and reasonably priced. The vegan patty was really great and not skimpy in size.  

Very casual and relaxed place to get a decent meal.  I don't have kids but this seems like a good place for families.  I also like that they use local farmers and ingredients.

Came here on a Sunday afternoon and was seated right away in one of their big booths. Our server janessa was great and very attentive the whole time, always filling waters and asking if we needed anything. The menu has so many options it's hard to choose, but we stuck with appetizers. The fried mac n cheese is delicious and tomato bisque that comes to dip it in is so good. Calamari was so good and the tarter sauce with it made it even better. Caesar salad and French onion soup combo is a great deal. The Brussel sprouts were my favorite thing ever and the sauce underneath them was amazing, I could dip anything in that. Lobster and crab dip with the pita was also great. Nachos were okay, could have been more flavorful. Drink menu is also large and good. Will definitely be back!

Servet was an excellent server, go visit him at Anatolia in west Nashville! As for this experience we Tried to use the Yelp app to use a coupon and the lady who I assume was the manager would not honor it. She Called the owner supposedly who did not honor it either. I get that if you're not offering coupons at this time that's fine, but why have the coupon up if you're going to make the guest look stupid when presenting it? Whoever was managing at the time asked me to "print" the Yelp coupon in hopes that I wouldn't be able to use it, even though it's physically impossible to print a Yelp coupon. Again however it was not our servers fault. He was EXCELLENT, very polite.

Bazbeaux's -  I appreciate the amount of toppings to cheese ratio you add to your pizzas. I like how you have green olives too. It's the little things. The Colossus and the BBQ chicken pizza are 10's. I personally like how they have a lot of great pizza combinations besides pepperoni, sausage, or cheese. The "Bayou Chicken" pizza with the cajun chicken sounds like another winner along with "The Luke," blue cheese and buffalo chicken together that's another winning combo. They use quality ingredients that make it a great place to enjoy pizza. 

They also have a great sandwich that's famous in New Orleans that you can hardly find here the Muffuletta! If you're wanting a light and refreshing dessert try the sorbetti. It's like eating a frozen creamsicle slushy in an orange. I highly recommend those! They have orange and lemon to choose from. 

You may be thinking I haven't been to Bazbeaux's in awhile. If that's the case you can plan out you're next outing because those are the highlights now a days ;-) Picking up pizza and garlic bread that's an even better highlight!

We strolled in here near 9:40 p.m. On a Sunday after leaving a friend's house to give into a pregnancy craving.  The restaurant was closing at 10p.m. But they still waited on us to dine in.  
I'm visiting from California where there's no shortage of Vietnamese restaurants but i have to say this restaurant's meals were packing a lot of flavor. So refreshing!! I had the bun Bo hue Soup and the broth was Very tasty. My hubby had the chicken fried rice. The servings are large and our entire meal was under $20 before tip. I'm definitely returning before I fly out to California.

When I finally sat down and could fully absorb the decor of Distrito, I could help but think freaky 70's Mexican disco porn. I like pink but not that much pink. And the lucha libre masks ? Along with the waiter/waitress outfits, I get the whimsical nature behind the decor...but i just didn't get it, if that makes sense ?Maybe that side of my brain wasn't tuned in that.
   Nonetheless, the food was delicious. The tapas small plate style was spot on, especially considering that we were dining rather late. The vegetarian spinach tamale   was light, smooth and flavorful. The guacamole was creamy, balanced with a little acidity. And while nachos are on page one of "Cooking Mexican For Dummies" the nachos carnitas (sp?) were well prepared. Yet the star of the evening was the grapefruit margarita. Perfect.  And this is coming from a guy who's not a huge cocktail person. Swift and attentive service with a smile. I just think eating dinner in a swing is  kind of kinky.

First time there. Everything was really good. We are inside and arrived at 4:30. Glad we did bc by 5 the place was packed ! I thought the service was good, friendly. Food arrived pretty quick and very hot and fresh. The only two things I didn't like is that they do not have kid size drinks. They charge kids for an adult size soda and give them a huge cup. This needs corrected as there are a ton of families with kids in this area. Secondly, we ordered one pepperoni and sausage and one pizza with just pepperoni. The pizza with only pepperoni had twice the amount of pepperoni as the pizza with 2 toppings. Not sure why this was but it was  disappointing. We ordered the cheese bread and it was great but it was a joke to serve a tiny plastic container of marinara with it. We will come back though.

My girlfriend Rachel and I decided to try this place out after reading many reviews and talking with our friends. Tall chairs upstairs lower seating down. If you haven't been here before parking is in the back, and they are nice parking spots with great lighting. 

Started of with the Fresh Ceviche and came with halibut. Really good. 

Paired that with a porter they had rotating and Rachel had a Stella. Little upset they didn't have Heineken, I mean it is available in 192 countries. We had three rounds of drinks. 

The food. The food was 4 stars however was definitely fresh and unique. We split the Dungeness Crab California style and the surf and turf sliders (fire). Exceptional just oddly portioned. They brought it out covered and presented it nicely. 

They vibe from the employees felt like Reno. Being here the last 6 years, I've grown to understand the culture here and it is awesome. The people are just friendly, and go out of there way. For example, the bar manager when not on the clock decided to just ask how we were doing. And that is comfort. On top of that, (I'm sorry I forgot your name I think Jen) got us a round at the bar! Exceptional service for just being a nice person. 

Lastly, Phoebe was our server. She was great and attentive. Made sure our beers were full, and had light conversation which was nice to see another human not a robot. She was smiling and seemed truly happy to be there which is what you want in an employee. 

It's not hard to go the extra mile, and it always pays off. Thanks!
Good food and great service at a very good price. Nothing fancy, but a fun place to go if you are on a beach vacation.
Great food. Great service.  Floyd was a great server and my girls and I had a great time!
Good drinks, friendly staff and a great view! The only reason I'm giving 4/5 stars is because the food is overpriced for what it is.

I've been to Corner Cantina six times since it's opened, and I'm happy to say the experience has gotten better each time.

First, the food is really good. I'm a big fan of the enchiladas and the chile relleno. The nachos are also a solid choice for an appetizer. They're HUGE. Boyfriend and I split them for lunch one time and we were both totally satisfied. The entree prices are a little higher than some Mexican restaurants but I wouldn't call Corner Cantina expensive. I think the menu has also been pared down since the restaurant opened. It seems like the options have been reduced but the dishes on the menu have gotten better as a result. 

The drinks are also good. Margaritas are definitely fresh, although sometimes they seem a little weak tequila-wise. The pomegranate Paloma is really delicious. The drink prices are comparable to what you'd find anywhere else downtown. I think a margarita will run you about $8. 

Now the real issue I have with this place is the service. The servers are nice, but many of them seem inattentive/untrained. None of the issues I've had have been deal breakers--think more like no silverware/waters, drink orders taking forever to come out, forgetting to bring a side of sour cream or something. These are very minor complaints but service really can make or break a restaurant. I think this place could be really great with the right staff. 

TL;DR The food is great, the service isn't so great but it's not so terrible as to prevent me from coming back. Definitely check the place out while the upstairs patio is still open.

I ate here last night and have been here for business and personal lunches, happy hours and dinners maybe 5-7 times in the past few years. As always, the food was well cooked and the service was friendly. I will certainly continue to eat here whenever the situation calls for a nice steak dinner. If I had to find fault anywhere (and this is reaching deep) I would say that the service bordered on being too attentive at times and the food came out only a few minutes after ordering.

My daughter was craving a pizza and we ended up here. They had some nice gluten free options and the owner was super nice.  While we waited Cora got to practice making her own pizza with some dough she got. The food was quick, service was great and we will see this joint again when in town.

Great place to study, has wifi available for customers who purchase items. Plenty of space, and is a 24 hour location. However, the coffee is mediocre at best. I can make a cup at home much better than this place has to offer, hate to say it. There are not many other options in Tucson that give you a nice place to study, that is well lit, with drink and food options to keep you busy. If you are a coffee guru that is coming here for the coffee, I would recommend you go elsewhere, however, if you are looking for a nice study place, this is the only place in Town that has good space.
I love this place. Been here several times. The staff is nice and the food is great. I especially like their fresh sushi rolls and their sake. Happy to live near this place and will visit often.

As with places with too many reviews to read, I will keep this succinct and informative:

-Food: If you come here, I suggest getting the Good Dog burger. The burger is quite good, but by no means exceptional. 
-Pictures of dogs are a great touch for the relaxed ambiance at this dive bar.
-Pricing is fair.
-Staff is generally attentive.

Overall assessment: Not impressed but not unhappy. If you're looking for a new place to try and a decent dining experience, this should be on your list.

Love the pizza. Fresh ingredients, interesting combinations.  But stick with the pizza. Salads are no-hum at best. Had the chop salad, and for $10 you get a whole bunch of lettuce, six little toasted tomatoes, a few red onions and some cheese. The lettuce overwhelms, despite the yummy house dressing. This salad needs some help, and I expected more from a place that has great gourmet pizza, but honestly, the chain pizza joints have much superior salads. Will not go back unless I plan to chow down on only the pizza. Frankly, I can get both at  Napolese.

The lunch special is unbeatable, you can get the rainbow roll or Vegas w/5 pieces of nigiri for $10. My favorite roll is the half & half! However...

I'll be honest, it is not the best or freshest sushi in town. The rolls are too big with way too much rice, poorly rolled & the service is slow. There is never more than one waitress working at a time. I only continue to go back because the family that owns the joint is fantastic. 

At the end of the day it's nice to go in there because its not too loud or crowded like many sushi bars. You can grab a seat, sip a beer, eat some sushi in peace or chat with the wonderful owner. Don't knock it til you try it!
Very good diner. Small selection but everything was delicious and affordable. Highly recommended his place for basic diner fair

Simply the best Mexican food in Santa Barbara. Elegant decor, amiable service, and delicious dishes make this a must visit.

Although the dishes feel light, they're filling and packed with flavor. Any molcajete is mouthwatering, but any menu item honestly is an appetizing choice. Enchiladas and Chile rellenos are wrapped in flavor!

Their drinks are also flavorful. If you're going nonalcoholic, their horchata is perfectly sweetened. If alcohol is your aim, their margaritas and micheladas are pleasing alkie mixtures.

Los Agaves is a mixture of amazing food and a worthwhile experience.
I've never been disappointed with Fortel's pizza. Always generous with the toppings, and always a consistent good quality pizza. Definitely recommended!

Very disappointing meal tonight.  The Pad Tai was rubbery and overly sweet.  The chicken was tough and too big to eat with chop sticks.  This dish was basically unsatisfactory.  Spring rolls were only ok.  My husbands curry ribs had grizzle which also made the dish unappealing.  I like to frequent local restaurants in Temple Terrace but I doubt we will get takeout from here again.

Terrible service. The bartender was so rude and unfriendly.  He just wanted to get out of there and it was only 9pm . Tall , skinny guy with a ponytail was the worst bartender I've ever had. Food and view was amazing

I've been there about 4 or 5 times now and I love it! Their original margarita is VERY good. I also recommend the original margarita in the blackberry flavor! What keeps me coming back though is their carne asada!

Had to wait for a while to get seated, very very small cute place. We ordered Maki Rolls, Miso soup, corn cakes and dessert and it was all very yummy. The waitress was a bit rough with her hands, setting down plates and picking them up. But whatever, it's who she is. Her man might like it. Will definitely come back, if there's enough space. ;)

Great service. Good choice of wine. 
Bread was great. Turtle soup, a bit hung up on sherry. Lobster Thermidor sauce a little salty, as was the side of butter mushrooms. Interestingly, the creamed spinach, with the bechamel sauce needed a little more salt...

We eat here often and it is not your typical quick-service restaurant. The wraps are great and we LOVE the housemade condiments/sauces including some very good hummus and jalapeno salsa. These wraps are very filling so we often split one and order an extra side of chips.
One perplexing thing to me are the 2 times I've been in after 7:30 (no more!). If they are open until 9:00, why do they start cleaning up so early? It's not like the place is dead at that time. When the kitchen staff are wading in mop water and the place smells like pine-sol it is very off-putting.

Again, good food but I know now not to arrive after 7:30. BTW - I contacted their customer service link on the website but a week later and no response so....I'm posting this apparent flaw in an otherwise nice restaurant.

The boyf and I went here for University City's Dining Days tonight ($15/person for an appetizer, entree, and a dessert?! STFU!). I'd been before, but my first experience was kinda... ok?

But I like second chances. And I freaking love cilantro. So, Vietnam Cafe was our choice for dinner!

A few days ago, I left a question on Vietnam Cafe's facebook wall asking if any desserts were vegan (I'm one of THOSE people), and I was informed that they all contain dairy. Oh well. No dessert for me, but I could at least still have a cheap dinner!

Upon arriving, our waiter informed me that the 3 pudding desserts were, in fact, vegan. I took the risk!

But first, let's start with appetizers. I got the fried tofu (ask for vegan dipping sauce!), and it was pretty good. I mean, the tofu was fried perfectly and the sauce was great, but the tofu tasted like... just that. Tofu.

For my entree, I got the vermicilli rice noodle dish topped with fried spring rolls and crushed peanuts. It was a LOT of food. The spring rolls were pretty good... but still, some flavour was missing. Some umph! Some salt! Some peppers! Some soy sauce! Something... I'd eat it again, sure. I have the left overs downstairs. It wasn't bad, it just wasn't AWESOME.

Of course, since our waiter told us there are vegan dessert options, I go the taro pudding (taro + rice + coconut milk, served hot). So simple, SO GOOD. SOOOO GOOD.

I didn't think the service was slow at all, but we went at a 4 o'clock on a Sunday. Our waiter was super nice! 

And 100+ bonus points for the prettyfullness of the restaurant.
This place is such a hidden treasure. I'm so happy we found this  place. The All You Can Eat Lunch is so worth it. I'll definitely bee returninG.
For late night you can't beat it, Friday and Saturday night's till 2:30am!  Closed Sunday's.  The Thai Basil Burger is outta this world.  Go get em' night owl's!

Fantastic food!! Diet soda needs improvement, but the enchiladas (chicken) were perfect, beans and rice amazing also. Great place!


For those who think it has a "drug cartel" theme - uh no.... Lucha is the Mexican Wrestler (remember Jack black's Movie Lucha Libre) and there are a bunch of Mexican Wrestler Masks on display.
Great pizza with great flavors. The breadsticks are a must to order and you won't be disappointed with whatever you order.

This is most differently a man sport bar. With a surprise that You didn't see corning. But of course the have a really great sexy bartenders. And a large choice on the menu. And the same choice in beers.

Sunday night rockabilly is great.

the live band really get you in the mood, the bartenders are nice, service is great, drinks are perfectly mixed. only downfall is the size of this place, its TINY :( which is the only reason it didn't get a 100% amazing star rating. 

parking - you can easily park in the train station lot (its across the street) or even just take the train.

Amazing atmosphere on the top floor of the Bok. Cool space with nice decor and views of the city. I always enjoy sitting at the bar, but the floor seating did look nice also. Food was good and cocktails were really good. Mostly smaller plates with some larger ones. Good date spot for sure.

We came to this little hidden gem during U of A homecoming weekend last week. From the Google reviews, we decided to check it out. Located in a little strip mall, it didn't look fancy. Small place but once we walked in, I loved the homey and inviting energy. It was definitely a mom pop establishment, but the aroma of the food was heavenly. Our waitress was very friendly and accommodating. I could tell the majority of the customers are locals and I loved the ambience. As for the food.....DELICIOUS! I had French toast, eggs over easy, hash browns and bacon. Everything tasted amazing. Just when I thought I was done, I overheard our waitress ask one of the customers if they wanted a slice of coconut cream pie of pecan pie. I knew I couldn't leave without having a slice; especially since coconut cream pie is my all-time favorite. The slice was big and I could have easily shared it with my husband, but I was being selfish. He ended up getting a slice because he knew I was not going to let him have a bite. Talk about delicious! It was probably the best coconut cream pie I've ever had. All in all, this place is amazing! Much better than the chain restaurants and very reasonable for the amount of food you get. We will definitely be coming back next time we're in the area!

So happy to have them in Affton. Not only are the pretzels great, the owners are wonderful members of the community. I have been genuinely impressed on my many occasions going there now watching how well the owner treats people. Large variety of pretzel choices too. Like any restaurant I think they are probably best during peak hours. The price is great, better than average for fast food. I love to support a small business!

The food here is good, but I have always had an awful experience with service. The hosts are rude and the servers are not attentive. Would not come here if it weren't one of the only places with sushi and drinks.
All I can really say is I'm not impressed. I mean, the burgers aren't cooked to order, just literally smashed into a dry meat patty. The milkshake was good. That's about it.

Obviously, you are not getting the point of why I wrote this review.  Other than your worthless restaurant, where else would they charge full price for a baby?? NEVER have I ever been charged for a baby wherever I went.  If your waitress assigned to our table were there for more than half, or even a quarter, of the time that we were there, she would have seen that our babies had the tiniest amount of food...equivalent to a pancake! The rest of the time she was eating Gerber snacks and meals WE brought from home, including juice WE brought from home.  SORRY we had to use your plate! Also, the manager on at the time DID NOT do anything to help the situation except say that her son at 10 months old ate more than an adult?? Please tell me how that helps other than telling me that her son has an eating problem at 10 months old if he ate more than an adult?

Honestly..just stop reading comments and go get some for yourself. It's the best chicken and waffles in town! I had the Cookie Monster waffle and it was DELICIOUS! Order it to go because the seating is limited! Chicken is whole chicken..NOT Tenders to my delight!
Great pizza.  The bathroom was dirty though.  That big mechanic across the street was tearing up the toilet.  People had to leave and the place was empty for the night

Great little family run authentic Thai restaurant.

The flavors here are closer to what I had in Thailand.

Highly recommend the larb, refreshingly delicious but not as well known Thai dish. I ordered this with sticky rice, which was perfect.

The spice levels are authentic too so don't go overboard unless you truly enjoy hot food and can handle it.

Mango with sticky rice was the perfect blend of sweet, salty, cold and hot.

I wanted to like this place so badly.  I love sushi and it's local, two wins.  But ultimately neither of them are reasons for me to go back.  My husband and I wanted a low key easy dinner..sushi checked those boxes.  We thought we'd give this place a try.  I eat a lot of sushi, both grocery store and top sushi place sushi.  This was neither.  It lacked so many things.  Out of the 4 rolls we ordered, 1 tasted decent because it had cilantro and lime on it.  The other 3 all tasted the same.  The prices were higher than any other sushi place I'd been.  I don't mind paying, but it better be worth it. The place was absolutely empty as well.  Saturday night at 7:00 and maybe 3 tables including us.  It just left something to be desired.

We wanted to come to this place just to try it out. We've heard all about it and the line is always crazy, so when we had a little extra time in the AM on a work trip, we made our way over. The line wasn't terrible, but it's not something I would necessarily wait in again (in the heat with kids). 

The favorites: The bonuts were great. The chronic bacon was a fave. The OJ was legit. 

I got the Lindstrom and i didn't find it remarkable but I at least felt healthy while eating it so I guess that counts (?). My husband got the East Nasty and loved it. 

Line was long-ish but staff was kind and the process was smooth. Overall, we are glad we went and tried it out.

Nice! Haven't had E. Coast Italian before and I liked it. The pizza was really good, very addictive. The sausage on it was to die for. The meatballs on it weren't that great but they were edible... The meatballs tasted like only sugar and cumin. 

My friend had the pasta which I posted. We though it was amusing that it looks like maggots. I really liked it though. It was different than any other pasta I've tasted (probably better and more "legit", ha ha... LA has terrible food). The taste of the wheat was more pronounced and the pasta was a bit chewier and bready, though pleasantly so. I wish it had a bit more sauce but I liked it.
Ive had some bad nights at this place with bad service and everything else. Last night totally changed the way I feel awesome food awesome service and no drama. We will be back

Being from the NYC area I was beyond skeptical to try anything regarding pizza down here, however the thin crust Vedura pie has become a favorite of ours. It's all veggies and full of flavor. Delivery is fast and efficient.

I've been eating at New Wayne for close to a year now and can't believe I never actually wrote a review of this place. To start, they have very good pizza. It's not too bready. It has the right amount of cheese and dough. Some of their other menu items are also pretty good. Their chicken cheesesteaks and regular cheesesteaks are delicious. They don't use cheeze whiz, which is a plus. 

I'm not a huge fan of their gyros. I've had both the chicken and lamb gyros. Both come with thinly sliced processed meat. Don't get me wrong, they do taste good; however, I expected real chicken breast with my chicken gyro order. I guess I should blame Pandora's in Center City for this. They actually made their gyros with juicy chicken breast. Friends and family have told me this is typical for gyros. Eh, not for me.

The chicken provolone and spinach hoagie is very filling. Now with this, you will get juicy chicken breast as opposed to thinly sliced processed meat. Their salads are also good. The lettuce tastes fresh and they don't seem to skimp on what you ask for. For example, if you order a chicken caesar salad, you will be pleased with the quantity of chicken placed on top of your greens. As for sides, their fries are really good. I don't think they do anything special to them, but they have the right amount of crisp on the outside with a fluffy inner.

We took shelter here during a passing downpour on the 4th of July. We were outside next door at old city beer garden. We actually met the owner outside who told us about it like "if it rains, you can just go next door to my place," which originally sounded very nice, but I soon realized it was just a really good way to get more customers. 

They have $2 tequila shots on Tuesdays, so that's neat. 

The restroom was extremely filthy. It's downstairs, and the stairs take up a lot of space in relation to the size of the building itself. 

The bar also takes up a good amount of space and only leaves an awkwardly small amount of space (across from the stairs) during busy times. I didn't go too far back, only stayed near the front. 

I would not return unless it were pouring again.

You guys suck! Like literally suck! Your waiters are cool & they deserve a raise, but your cooks got simple orders & fxcked that up.. HOW?! We waited 3 hours until our food got out. 3 FUCKING HOURS!!!

Do they have any NEGATIVE STARS?!? We ordered a large steak and mushroom pizza. Went home and realized it was raw and could not be eaten. It was too late to do anything. Then we went to work. The following night, I called and explained our dilemma. The response from the owner was we throw slips away the same night and we would need the pizza back. If you order from us again, remember that. Oh yeah after wasting 23.00 I'm going to return there for future business...hell  no!!!!

I always feel badly when ethnic restaurants try really hard but still fail to attract customers.  Good food and good service is obviously key, but the most important thing besides getting new customers is keeping old ones.

This is one of the few restaurants in Reno that I try to patronize, not because of the decent food and prices, but because the waiters try to hard to keep us happy.  

I am not a fan of lamb, but will try just about anything with chicken or lentils when it comes to Indian food.  Having been to India, I know that each region has its own speciality, so it's hard to pick a favorite dish if the restaurant doesn't offer that region's best cuisine.  This places does just about everything right and the naan is goooooood!
I love this place! Amazing Food. Friendly Staff. Really great options for burgers, like Bison, Elk, even Ahi & Cod sandwiches. Try em all!!! Don't forget about shakes & Malts too.

The place is definitely good. From a top chef. Service was on point. Our server made us feel very welcomed and the environment was very hip. The food was good, but very much so on the pricey side. I had spent close to $150 on two people (without doing the chef special) just because we wanted to try things off the menu. Being from California, definitely ordered the Foie Gras, (banned out in CA). It was seared and on point. 


I'd definitely recommend this place, but I probably won't go back if I ever do visit Philyl again. One of those one-time things.

Also, that candle in the middle of the table is very awkward.

We went in last Wednesday and sat at the bar, and we were attended to right away. The bartender's name was Kier and he was great. We told him that we like IPA's and he let us sample a few different varieties. The selection of local and other craft brews from around the country was phenomenal. I had a pint of the Jai Alai from Cigar city and an IPA from 7th Sun (who  was a great recommendation from Kier) which apparently is brewed just down the street in Dunedin. We started with a margaretta flatbread pizza which was so good we ordered the Hawaiian. We also had the porkbelly sliders and the mojito scallops which were delicious and fresh (all the seafood comes from Frenchy's, who is also part owner we found out). Overall outstanding service and delicious food. Make sure to stop in next time you are in Dunedin, can't wait to go back.

This is the best Brazilian steakhouse I've ever been to.  I've been to many.  The food is above and beyond excellent.  The service is something that will spoil you for any other restaurant.  Last night was our first time and we definitely decided it won't be our last!  Paco was wonderful to us and even helped my son around the salad bar.  He was a very special waiter but all the wait staff were completely attentive in every way.  This is a must go restaurant !
R&R

Service was pretty poor.  A definite language issue, and that is only part of it. 
Ordered a Dark Star beer.  Was on tap and not one I had heard of.  Asked the waitress where it was brewed.  She said she came from Romania.  When I finally got  my question thru to her, she said she didn't know but would check.  When she came back she said the bar tender didn't know either.  Unbelievable,  I had looked it up on my phone in the mean time.  A decent beer.
Ordered a burger with shoe string potatoes.  Had been flying all day and we just wanted something quick and easy.
The waitress basically disappeared.  No refills, more beer, etc.  Brought the check and disappeared again.  We got tired of waiting and just signed them to our rooms and left.  Stiffed her on the tip.

Lunch here is such a great experience and deal. For $28, you get three solid courses and wonderful ambiance. My reserved, British husband had the drink Under My Umbrella and said it was the best cocktail of his life. He also could not stop talking about his Corn and Crab soup. I would return just to see him react this way to food again! 

One thing to note, I would say the service was a little less than expected for a restaurant of this caliber (and since some might go at dinner and pay more, I'll just mention it). Nothing bad happened and nothing was ever a miss, but we waited for a while before anyone came to our table, my husband also waited a good while to get a spoon for his soup, I was handed my salad from across the table, there was reaching like none other and the woman who served us always made me feel like we were taxing her. Maybe it's only lunch or it was an off day! Would still return.

I highly recommend, I can't say enough great things about this place. I'm Mexican and very picky with Mexican food since I believe my grandmothers home cooking is the best but this place is equally just as good. That saids a lot. I had menudo which they make fresh on sundays as well as huevos rancheros. Menudo was really good, tasty not salty and perfectly cooked. Huevos rancheros was amazing. It's like a party in your mouth that you don't want to end. Over easy eggs with salsa under a corn tortilla with beans. In house made tortillas were so good, I don't like my tortillas with flour on them (powder) these were not. The salsa was really good as well. It was all tasty and flavorful, my mouth is watering just thinking about it. My server was Bernie make sure you ask for him he is great and helped us make our first visit extraordinary. I crave it now and I'm not even pregnant.

Do NOT order anything for delivery. We made an order online through the Popeyes website, which they told their contractor delivery driver that they cancelled, but still charged us for the order. We couldn't ask for a refund because this locations phone number was seemingly disconnected. So we had to go through corporate customer service which may take days to resolve. Without this incident this location would still only be two stars at most. Bottom line is, their service is TERRIBLE.
Love the menu and the vibe. I especially love the patio seating during the warm weather seasons. The food is very consistent! It's our favorite Mexican "go-to" place!

So good!  Lots of amazing vegetarian and pescatarian options!  Definitely check out the grilled fish tacos, the ra has con cream (vegetarian) and the nopales (vegetarian).  Flavors are fresh and bright.  Highly recommend!
Good food, but very very slow during lunch time. I waited 35 minutes just to be seated

Good, but not great.  After driving around the block several times trying to find parking, we did finally find a spot.  Once we got into the restaurant, my fiance and I were left waiting in the doorway for several minutes while several confused-looking waiters were shuffling around - in spite of the fact that there were several clean and vacant tables.  When we were finally seated, we were approched by a couple of different waiters, asking if someone had taken our order yet.  For a small restaurant, I was really surprised at their lack of organization.  Our sampler appetizer and entrees were good, but I was expecting a little more spice to the soup when the waiter told me that it had a little "kick" to it.  My overall impression of the restaurant was that it was too pricy to be casual dining and not nice enough to go out of my way to get there for a nice night out.  The food was good, but I think it'll be a while before I go back.
To summarize, I ate here years ago and forgot its there despite driving by it every day. It's forgettable and too expensive. Next!

Went for dinner tonight and it was wonderful! Steaks were cooked to perfectly and came with soup, salad, veg and a side (potato, spaghetti, etc). We had the filet (med rare) and the ribeye (medium). Bar drinks reasonably priced and there is happy hour from 5-7 on weekdays. The service was good and the place is casual, but I would make reservations for dinner. The table by the fireplace is nice! Finally, there is plenty of parking which is always a plus.
Nice dinner at Outback tonight!  Great service from TJ...so much fun and friendly. I had the Outback Burger and fries...everything delicious and made to order. Social distancing is observed.

Clumsy... as in lacking grace.  The food here is good and the facility is great.  However, you can never count on the outside spaces being open.  Also, the staff is part pretentious, part goofy and part annoying.   I feel like this place has awesome potential, but the atmosphere is always strange.  It could be because the layout is difficult, but they need some way of making people feel like they are having a great experience....  because if you pay that much, you expect more than a plate of food.

We have had breakfast here a few times and it just doesn't get any better here in Carp!!  The food and service are always very good!  All of the staff hustles and helps each other out.  As for food, the omelette are yummy, home potatoes crisp,  love the French toast and of course great fresh bagels!  Seating both inside and out on a nice patio area.  I would highly recommend.  Very good coffee and expresso!!

Love Portillos in Chicago so when we saw this place....I had to get a quick snack.  

Food was tasty but food preparation not so much.  What I mean is this....we asked for one beef sandwich with no spicy peppers and the other with spicey peppers.  Well, they both come out with peppers unmarked...The old lady bites into the spicey one and I have to hear about the whole way home.

Love me beef sandwiches!!!
One of my favorite places. Obviously the waitresses stand out with the body paint. Even putting that aside it's just a friendly place. A great atmosphere that allows you to be yourself.

Yummy food, great service and cool atmosphere!  We have gone twice, both visits we enjoyed our experience.  Our second visit was a Saturday morning, it was much busier than our prior weekday evening visit.  However we didn't mind the wait for our table as there was some self service coffee available while we waited and the staff was super friendly!!!  Definitely will be going back.  Peace

Not the most comfortable seats at the bar or at tables, but nachos are some of the best I've ever had.  Lots of cilantro and other fresh ingredients.  For drinks, the chili margarita and a tequila sampler are the way to go!
Great lunch or dinner spot in center city. Love their seafood salads.  A favorite spot in the neighborhood.

I still call this place Pi haha.  It's essentially the same place as the original.  Solid slice for either lunch or great for the late night slice without the grease of bourbon street.  Outlaw also offers a selection of other italian type of items besides pizza and their salads aren't bad as well.  During late night hours, you can buy pizza by the slice here.
The burgers are super good (try the Philly philly) and the fries are great. The service was on point.

Excellent restaurant! We loved the friendly service and the food was great! The owners, Mrs. Linda & Chef Raz both stopped by our table to chat. The Jambalaya Pasta and the Hawaiian Steak were both wonderful, as well as the Sticks & Strings (fried zucchini strips and onions) appetizer. Mrs. Linda's even brought us a sample of her gumbo, which is what I will be getting next time. We will definitely go back often!

If you live in the area, or stop into the area on the weekends, I highly recommend stopping into SSPB for a quick breakfast-- something along the lines of an egg and cheese on one of the many incredible bagels. It's quick, it's yummy, and it's local.
