They also have Israeli newspapers, if you want to practice your Hebrew while you indulge.

I come here alot for business meetings.  The food is fine and the service is as expected.  The building needs a little updating but it does not retract from the level of service you get or the size of the portions.  I recommend it as a mid level alternative to fine dining.
Best place to have raw oysters during happy hour! So fresh n clean!! Thomas is the best oyster shucker n friend!!
This is a newly remodeled restaurant but unfortunately it's still impossible to find a clean table.

This is a decent place for the quick meal. Overall this place is small, seems like a family run business. The owners are really nice and friendly, anyways I ordered the Buffalo Chicken Sub, which was really good, the sub was fresh, the chicken was cooked to refection, the only negative I would say is that a little more flavor would have made it great, the flavor was mild for my taste. Besides that the restaurant was clean, the price was reasonable and the staff was really friendly.

Friday afternoon, Mix and Match, fried fish and the turkey wing, with collard greens and mac & cheese.  Washed it down with a little Homemade Sweet Tea.  Everything was great. Turkey was fall off the bone tender and the collard greens were the best I've had yet! We will be back!

We used to come to mckenzies all the time and get the fondue. Ordered take out from here for the first time in awhile and ordered nachos and the fondue among other items. The online menu clearly stated the fondue comes with bread,apples, broccoli, etc. after picking up our order the fondue we got was what looked like queso dip & chips, I assumed those were the nachos because that clearly wasn't the fondue. Had to go back anyways because the nachos we ordered were forgotten. Was highly disappointed with the "fondue" and would highly recommend you update your online menu with the right correct menu items. I am in the restaurant business and can understand mishaps, but even from the short time being there, the management came off as careless.

This restaurant is BEAUTIFUL! The staff is so friendly and welcoming. The food looks DELICIOUS!!!!!! Oh, but it isn't even average. We ate the chocolate chip pancakes (very light and not fulfilling at all compared to every other pancake in the world) and the steak and eggs (very little steak, but the eggs were mediocre). If perception is key, this place has it in the bag, but the food just wasn't impressive. I'm sad I didn't enjoy it more.

Awesome find!!!  My husband and I were on our way to Soho for some live Reggae when we passed through this corridor and smelled a piece of heaven wafting out of the back door of the pizzeria.  Looking through the glass, it was so inviting and cave-like.  The pull of the scent and ambiance was irresistable.  There was a table for two waiting for us.  We ordered a pizza and shared it - The Capricciosa with prosciutto cotto, artichoke hearts, mozzarella.  We loved watching the chefs tossing pizza dough behind the bar and shoveling pizzas out of the wood burning brick oven.  The menu looked so authentic Italian.  I have to come back again.  I can't get that pizza out of my mind.  We ended with the chocolate hazelnut panna cotta, which we thoroughly enjoyed!  The waiter was very pleasant and had an Italian accent.  This is definitely our favorite place in Santa Barbara!!!  It was very trendy, upscale, romantic.  It looked like all locals.  We wore jeans and felt very comfortable. 
The waiter recomended the house favorite Umbra pizza that has the umbrian black truffles, which I will get next time.

WOW! Saw Yelp and decided to try it...amazing place. Whatever designer did what I understand was a recent renovation deserves huge accolades. The exterior makes you want to go in and be welcomed, and the interior is jaw-dropping, from the celeb photos to the mind-blowing trumpet chandler to the reminders-of-great times vinyl album covers arranged colorfully on the walls. The bar is a 10, with high energy fabulous bartenders. Try the Smoking Saz..great entertainment and even a better cocktail! I followed that up with their excellent brie and the steak and frites. All  absolutely wonderful. What a great place for a treat while on the road. I'll be back!

I stopped after work for a light dinner at the bar. The wine by glass menu was very small and my first choice which was the headliner special was not available wouldn't you know it. So I paid $11 for a 6 oz pour which I thought looked small but I'm sure everyone is used to the pour we make our selves at home. Anyway on to the calamity. I ordered the calamari which tasted delicious and was lightly fried with peppers and jalapeños. Two hours later I was cursing the my choice and I continued to pay for it ALL night long. Needless to say I won't be back to any Chart house restaurants after this intestinal event. When thinking back on it, I was the only person eating ....hmmmmm

Old church turned into a brewery, what else could you want? They kept as much of the church as they could and it's really cool to see. 4-5 star food at a 2 star price. The beer is also fantastic - usually have at least 12-15 beers of their own on tap. LOVE this place. Definitely a must stop when I'm downtown. Parking is limited but there is also street parking.

This is SO old school Tampa it ain't even funny.  I grew up walking distance from this joint back when it was a little store, deli and the sandwich shop was a side gig.  Yes the service is slow and sloppy but I'm used to it.  For my money the quality of the food makes up for the less than streamlined operation.  I always get the turkey, cuban and or crab.  Like all the time.  So after literally hundreds of times eating here since the 70s, I can safely say their sandwiches and crabs are right up there with the best traditional cubans in the Bay Area.  Well seasoned(BEFORE adding hot sauce), fresh, tender and juicy.

They take their time with preparing the food here.  It's still  tastes like home kitchen food after all these years.  The dedication of Mike (Joe's son who now runs the place) Joe(Mike's Dad who with his wife made it into what is it today) and all their staff to keep it genuine and away from the blandness that popular chains become is evident.  It's old school as it gets.

Yes they could use some more visionary inspiration to modernize and make the customer service more efficient.  Maybe one day.  But for now, I'll know to call ahead by at least an hour with my order and look forward to digging into home fresh food from an East Tampa institution.

We tried this place based on previous Yelp reviews.  We went on a Saturday night and had the dinner buffet for $6.99 per person.  It's vegetarian, but very substantial.  There were about 6 entrees (including a tikka masala, korma, spinach, potato and peas) plus a couple side items.  Everything was hearty, hot and delicious.  (Except the naan, which was just OK.)

They also have a full menu, including Indian chaat (like street food, often called Indian snacks).  The only other place in St. Louis that has chaat is Gokul (on Page Blvd, also vegetarian).  There are some chaat dishes on the menu... we tried dahi puri, which I enjoyed more than pani puri.  They also have some ingredients on the buffet that you can use to make your own chat (like Delhi chat)... I didn't remember the combination so I asked the server and he was happy to help me.

Overall, we thought Raj's was a little better than Gokul... more hearty, quality food and nicer atmosphere.  The other customers were all Indian couples and families (except us), so that's a good sign.  

We will definitely go back.  Great food, inexpensive.

I've ordered lunch from here twice last week and their to go system leaves a lot to be desired. What should be a quick option for lunch isn't, whether ordering online ahead of time of time or placing the order there. The first visit we actually ordered there and sat in the small waiting area. We watched as others came to pick up orders that were not complete or simply not ready. Seemed to be a bunch of confusion and possibly too many workers in the back/kitchen and not enough employees bagging orders up especially during lunch hours. We waited 30 minutes for our food. While their lunch specials are great, if you're in a rush or on a timetable, this isn't the spot. The next order was placed online, and we were given a time to pick up. Order was not ready upon arrival. There was still another 15 minute wait past the initial pick up time. No complaints about the food, just the timeliness of the service unfortunately.
Breakfast on Sunday was pretty good. Cinnamon muffin was less than fresh. It's close it's cheap so I'll be back

Always just awesome!!!!!
Lounge is my favorite in Edmonton.
Today I had Flatbread.   Everything is great!!
Servers are all beautiful and kind.
Very good service and food. Came in  with a large group and staff was great and food was outstanding.

Rude service and unpleasant. Only one person working seemingly. Phone rang and rang without staff to field calls (poor other customers...). Took longer than it should have for my pizza that I ordered ahead to be ready.

My husband and I came in on a Monday night and I was thoroughly impressed. First off, I thought the decor was adorable but not overkill. Love the checkered table cloths. Little tealights in the jars on the tables would have just set it off but I can't complain. 
We ordered a BBQ chicken pizza with no onions. It came out with onions and we told the server and she was super apologetic and said she put it in wrong. She was great and redid our order and it only took about 10 minutes for the new pizza to come out. Due to the mistake she brought us out some complimentary garlic bread to ride us over which I appreciated. 
Our corrected pizza was done within 10 minutes and it was delicious! Definitely the kind you need a knife and fork and you can tell the crust is homemade and not frozen. I'm looking forward to coming back!

The good is good albeit a bit pricey for the portions in a small cafe/coffee shop atmosphere. Would I go again? Maybe. Again, the food was good but for the price I might head west of Penn for Ethiopian.

We tried Grand Lux on two occasions. Both times we had a very minimal wait (less than 10 minutes) on a late Sunday morning (in contrast to most other brunch spots that have an average 45 minute wait). Both times we ate here were for a breakfast/brunch (child's) birthday.

Food is honestly not that bad. The prices aren't insane, but they are higher than your usual diner prices. The prices seem more than fair when you compare them with the low wait time and the atmosphere.

Keep in mind that this restaurant is related to the Cheesecake Factory, so there is definitely a chain feel to it. The servers seem a little robotic and speed through their opening speil like a drill.

The first visit I ordered Eggs Benedict (my go-to), which they claim is made entirely in-house, including the hollandaise. After instantly not liking the flavor, I decided that it must be my layman's palate, and I force half of the meal down, not enjoying it in the least. At the end of the meal, the server asks if everything was ok, and I tell him of my dislike in my food (what else do they expect when they ask that?!) and he only offered an "I'm sorry", but no attempt to remedy the situation beyond that. So, we ask for the manager, who promptly tells us that because I ate half the food, that they "normally" don't take things off the bill, after the customer eats it, but they'll do it as a courtesy this one time. I was a little miffed at that, but despite the fact that we were probably "annoying" customers at that point, they still came out with a complimentary whipped cream and puff pastry(?) birthday treat, candle and all, for my daughter.

I guess I'm a glutton for punishment, but we decide to give this place a go one more time today, now for my son's birthday. Again, the food is not altogether bad, we were more concerned with the service at this point. We were a party of 6 (including 2 kids) and we all ordered just one brunch entree, except the birthday boy. We ordered him (in Denny's terms) a grand slam; pancakes, eggs, hash browns, sausage, you get the idea. However, when all of the food was brought out, the only thing the birthday boy got was his pancakes, which he ended up not liking too much. So we are assured repeatedly by our server that the remainder of my son's food was on the way, but 20-25 minutes is too long to wait for the rest of ANYONE's food in your party, let alone the birthday boy himself!

We ask for the manager, and magically, as the manager introduces himself, the food appears. We explain our experience, and he complies with taking the tardy food off the bill.

I'm sorry, but a good experience shouldn't include any need to confront the manager. Unless you have low expectations on service, try a smaller restaurant and enjoy the banter of your own company while you wait that extra 20 minutes or so.

I stopped in for breakfast with a date a few months back and was super happy with my experience. The place can be kind of intimating but everyone I interacted with was super nice. They had Buffy the Vampire Slayer playing on the projector which was sweet. Loved the ambiance. Food came out quickly and I was happy with it. Vegetarian options. Loved the whole experience. Look forward to returning next time I am in town.

Mesa Verde had amazing vegan food! We shared the BLTA and Street Tacos, both were delicious. The tacos were beautifully prepared with tiny flowers and chives on top, a yummy mix of beans, jackfruit, tomatoes, and jalapeños as the filling, and a tasty tortilla as the base. The BLTA was also amazing... the layers of bacon tempe, avocado, tomato, horseradish, and bread created an extremely rich flavor; it was so good that I wish I had one right now! As we were preparing to pay the bill, the owner came over to us and insisted we try a small dessert... our waiter brought out a beautifully plated dish of vegan baklava and vegan vanilla ice cream drizzled in a fruit sauce. The incredible dessert and generosity of the owner made our meal at Mesa Verde thoroughly enjoyable and a very memorable dining experience.

We are in town for a convention.  This place is in walking distance from the convention center.  We had a fantastic wood fired pizza, we ate outside and the bill was cheap!

Also, this place had no wait unlike the places closer to the convention center.

This McDonald's didn't deserve the one star. Horrible service, cashier was rude, and employees were bickering.

When we actually received our bacon, egg and cheese biscuits, a large black fly fell out of the wrapper. We took the biscuits back to the counter and asked for a refund... Thinking that management would be embarrassed, they just said sorry and refunded the minimum cash.

Huge inconvenience stopping for breakfast and walking out with an empty stomach!

Really nice server Gary, he was very attentive to our party of six. We sat outside which was ok. The food was very good actually. I had the cod fish with coconut and rice it was delicious. My boyfriend ordered the seafood paella which was delicious as well.
Great place! Get the white tiger! However if you come during happy hour and can't sit at the bar or outside, they don't honor the happy hour price :/

An excellent classy chic upscale Chinese bistry.  Full bar, large menu, good service, real nice place.  Nothing like the "typical" Chinese restaurants you may be thinking of with lanterns and red decor, this place is very  'uptown'.   No buffet so forget that idea if that is what you are looking for.  You WILL get plenty to eat though.  Good for big appetites and/or left overs. 

I must warn you at dinner time it is very busy and you may end up waiting for a table.  It is worth it.  Go early or wait if you can't go early.  The food is excellent and very pentiful.  A good place to share.       

We have been quite a few times and  every time is great!  Highly recommend this Seminole Heights bistro.  Try it - you will like it if you  like Chinese food in a classy envornment.

Love their Tom Yum Goong! So good!!  Reason I gave them three stars is there recipes seems to be off a-lot lately! Doesn't  taste as good as before! Shrimp is often over cooked which is disappointing!

Ok, maybe this is a mistake to tell people how really good and fresh the food is at Uncle Chen's.  I like the fact that we can get in without waiting.  But to be fair, I have to tell you that none of the negative reviews I have seen below seem to be the same restaurant I go to.

Hubby is Chinese-Hawaiian, so we know our way around a puu-puu platter.  We dine often at Chinese restaurants in Los Angeles, so we are not un-initiated, if you catch my drift.

Our food is always, always, always fresh and hot!  (We never do the buffet; maybe that is the difference between us and the haters??)  We order shrimp balls for our appetizers....they are AWESOME!  Crunchy, hot, deep fried but NOT greasy pillows of shrimp heaven!  Served with cocktail sauce or a sweet sauce, you can't go wrong with these.  Only problem our family has, is leaving enough room for what is coming.

Our family's list of favorites:  Beef with broccoli, shrimp in black bean sauce, war won ton soup,almond duck/chicken, imperial soup, sweet and sour ribs, shrimp with snow peas, sesame chicken, moo-goo-gai pan, beef chow fun, shrimp egg foo young, peking duck, moo-shoo chicken and mongolian lamb.  We usually get the steamed rice (Mom-in-law makes the best fried rice, so we are kinda spoiled!) and they always bring us the latest fresh fruit at the perfect ripeness for dessert, and all of the vegetables are at the peak of freshness and cooked tender-crisp.

Tina is amazing; all the staff are amazing!  They are friendly, and really want you to have a great dinner experience.  (Most of them work 7 days a week.)  They answer questions; make substitutions without rolling their eyes, and will do special orders even if it isn't on the menu, providing they have the ingredients.

Buffet is for kids who haven't developed a palate for Chinese food or people eating on a budget.  Not bad, just what it is.  Order off the menu and ask for recommendations; they are more than willing to share their knowledge.  Even if this means I have to wait for a table from now on.  And we are rating the won-ton crispys?  Really?  Okay, I agree the carpet needs a good shampoo.  Don't eat off it, okay?!


BTW, I drive from Ventura for Uncle Chen's.  There isn't anything close to this good in Ventura or Oxnard!  If I don't go to Uncle Chen's, I go to L.A.

We were recently strolling through St. Charles Historic District and came across this gem of the restaurant. 

Mother In Law House definitely goes all-in with the "mother in law house" feel. I found the decorations charming, but I could see how it could be hit or miss with others. 

They have a simple and affordable lunch menu. All of us ordered the chicken salad sandwich with the the side salad. Our server mentioned that the poppyseed dressing on the salad would change our lives. I can't say it was actually life changing but it was very good! I also enjoyed their chicken salad. Lastly, we ended the meal with their world famous coconut cream pie. Now this pie definitely lived up to the hype! This might have been the best coconut cream pie I have ever had in my life! If you happen to stroll into Mother in Law House, I would absolutely recommend saving enough space for desert so you can get a taste of this pie! VERY yummy!

I was between 2 and 3 stars. Food is pretty good and seems authentic. Bad service and cash only are forgivable. But the prices seem ridiculous at roughly $11/arepa. Maybe that's just how arepas are? But for my money I go elsewhere. 


Didn't try the sweets.

Horrible customer service - I live 2.04 miles from the restaurant and they wont deliver even though the website clearly states $1.00 for up to 3 miles.  When I told the lady the website confirms they deliver up to 3 miles and I am under that she rudely said she would deliver but it would be even longer (1 hour) - NO THANKS!!!!

Hands down 4.5-5 stars! 

Anyone try the cheesesteak!? ‍ It might be just a tad overpriced at $120, but my girl friend & I decided to try it & we both agreed we would definitely do it AGAIN! Although I'd probably prefer a different type of bread because I'm not much of a sesame seed fan. BUT, it was still one of the best cheesesteak's I've had in forever. The 1/2 bottle of champagne with it is a cute touch. And because we're greedy we also ordered the mac & cheese..SO GOOD! We had top notch service even though we had late reservations at 11, which is what time they close (that we didn't know). We felt pretty bad and we opted to just sit at the bar, but the staff and our bartender/server was friendly & didn't rush us at all. Overall, we had a great time & next time we're in Philly there won't be any hesitation to stop by again.

Went to Liter House with a group of ladies who blog together. We reserved a private room and there was a our 15 of us total.

We were seating promptly and water glasses were full upon arrival which was appreciates since it was rather warm outside. 
Menu options were plentiful,full of flavor and unique! 
Presentation was awesome......service was great!
The beers and cocktail options weren't overwhelming like at mise breweries. They had a wide enough selection but not too much to where you couldn't make a choice.

Another of the "gem show" stop offs for refueling.  South of I10 on 6th Avenue, E side of street, big yellow independent building.  What the facility lacks in ambience the customers make up for, colorful weathered characters wearing their rancho attire, lovely lunching Latino women of all ages and the large happy Mexican families make me feel like I am back in old Mexico.  Well South Tucson is old Mexico.  
Seat yourself and a small bowl of refried (bacon grease) beans are delivered with fresh corn chips and salsa in a plastic squirt bottle.  So many memories of my childhood with that plastic salsa bottle.  Salsa is classic thin with nice oregano and heat from the tepin.  The food is Sonoran style mexican.  I like the two eggs with chile verde breakfast, served with beans and potatoes, hold the cheese.  Way too much food, but fun to try and eat it all without bursting.  If I order taco's I go for the old style which is deep fried, really crispy and you can order just one for $2.50.  The meatball soup is good and hearty.  Big menu and the servers are friendly and sometimes mix up the language, part English and part Spanish--funny!

This location has definitely gone downhill. Took my daughter here a couple of years ago and had a great time. Good service, clean location, food was ok. 
Tonight? Completely different experience. Waited at the counter for 28 minutes then finally left. When we arrived we were told 5 minutes then we were ignored for the remainder of the time. After asking for help several times we gave up and left. 
Go somewhere else... ANYWHERE else.

I really enjoy this place, kinda like a go to for brunch. There aren't many places where the service is consistently great, but everyone who works here just seems so calm and nice!  House cured meats are wonderful and the organic/fair-trade aspects are awesome.  I've only ate off their brunch menu (great eggs, bacon, coffee cake, cinnamon rolls mmm) but would love to try some of their to-go sandwiches!
Very slow customer service at the counter. The woman behind the counter has a very nasty attitude. I won't be patronizing this business moving forward

Fried Dumplings (aka Pot Stickers) were delicious!
Spring Rolls which were good!
Wild Mushroom and Goat Cheese Strudel was good!

Not so Great - Brandy Infused Szechuan Beef - Tasty sauce, but the meat seemed not high quality, very fatty cheap cuts covered up with fried coating.
My wife had the Mongolian Lamb with Eggplant - She didn't think it was great, just ok.

Service was very, very fast.  We were there on a Thursday so we had no trouble getting a table last minute.

Fun atmosphere. Great music. Steep steps to get inside restaurant! 
DaBeef sandwich is number one!  Wet or Dry (dipped in gravy!) ... combo includes sausage!  
Homemade chips with seasoning - excellent! 
Pretzels are awesome!  With cheese & mustard. 
Pass on the Italian beef egg rolls ... too spicy!  Not so good!

This was the BEST little restaurant!!!! It was a great vibe with all the bobble heads and personalized feel to the city. It also had custom t-shirts from specialty brews that they created that were creative and hilarious. The staff was above and beyond and had no problem bending the menu to accommodate. The burger I had was one of the best I have ever tasted!!! Great little gem in Philly!

While convenient to Philly airport and its hotel, this Ruby Tuesday doesn't measure up to other restaurants of the chain.  The chair seats are cracked vinyl, the restrooms need attention.  Our server was friendly, but he forgot items.  Food was average.

so disappointed in your sales manager Kim  I guess she doesn't work weekend, or check her voicemail even though your staff swears she does.  BTW, whoever answer the phone on the weekend is very rude, try retraining her to be more courteous and human.  I understand that I called late on a Friday and then AGAIN on Saturday afternoon for a Monday evening reservation.  But I would think you would want a party of 15 and the revenue it would generate.  Must be nice to be doing so well you can ignore the customer.  Thank goodness there are so many other restaurants King of Prussia who want my business.

Low grade sushi at best, the spider roll was not fresh from the crab to the cucumber slices that looked like they were cut up the day before. I also ordered a spicy tuna roll that was not spicy at all. The service was alright, without asking they never gave us back our change which wasn't much but makes me not want to come back.
I love Bern's! I've been going there for years. The best kept secret is sitting in the bar and ordering "off the menu"! Chicken sandwich, steak sandwich and an unbelievable burger.

I stumbled on this cute little place across Philly AIDS Thrift one Wed evening and decided to give it a try. I'm a senior on a fixed income so their $1 Wed special was a definite enticement for me. I was a bit confused, I was thinking of dumplings of old that my mother made as "chicken and..." but I decided to try the mixed root veggies and the apple dumplings dusted with cinnamon. Both were very tasty and I will definitely return. The staff was courteous and patient with me. The place is clean and has an eclectic vibe.

Not for kids, very old school 'dive' bar (with the locals whom have probably been there all day. However, the burgers were slightly above par. Would recommend, but only to one who is looking  for a speedy snack, or a bar to grab a quick drink after a rough day.

Great music venue bar.   Make sure to try the BBQ.  They have a great beer selection.  The staff is friendly and helpful.  The Amy we went the live music was some of the best we heard in the city.  The only draw back is they have a bathroom attendant.  Bathroom attendants weird me out.  It is odd having someone spray soap on you're hands, hand you paper towels, offer cheap cologne and then expect a tip.

We've gotten lunch take out over the last year but this was the first time we went in for breakfast. We tried some fresh mozzarella which was awesome. We shared the breakfast sampler and burrito platter. The pancakes were fresh and tasted wonderful with a hint of cinnamon and real maple syrup. The burrito was stuffed with everything. It was so good! The potatoes came with big fresh cuts of sausage, peppers and onions. We ended with 2 cannoli's. The entire experience was great and we will be back!

Good food, nice place inside, business casual attire. Restrooms were clean. Food was tasty and drinks were great. This place is a little pricey. Expect to spend at least $125 without appetizers. The only thing is the menu is really limited. But will definitely go again. The steak was juicy and tender, shrimp was great. Didn't try the lobster. Also, nice desserts.
AWESOME!!!! we had fried chicken, Mac and cheese, greens, cornbread and salad. Everything was great. Service was very good also.
Very good but small portions and very expensive so we rarely go there. If you don't care about prices then you will love it.
It was very good! The Italian beef was great! The service was friendly and speedy. It was like stepping into a little mom and pop place in Chicago.

OK here we are...arrived in New Orleans at 9:00 p.m. and looking for a restaurant for late dinner.
Royal House was one of the few....So being from Louisiana,  I thought id try the crawfish etoufee
With fried crawfish... not expecting much, I was EXTREMELY surprised and very pleased... Food was awesome...server , John Smith,  was outstanding,
drinks very satisfying,  and dessert SWEET...
try it...you'll LOVE ,it...thank you

This is exactly the type of bar I like going to.  It has damn good food, no children,  and art everywhere.  Their bourbon selection is fantastic.  It's one of the few places that serves Angels Envy. Try it!  
3 of us were always served quickly. 
Bacon wrapped dates stuffed with goat cheese. 
Truffle potatoes wedges
Lobster tacos. (doesn't taste anything like lobster and deep fried) gross! 
Next time I go I'm sneaking in chalk.

FIrst time visit last night and I will be back. This place has a great food menu and excellent service.  Zoe was fabulous.  This place is owned by the Hamiltons who also run PW Pizza, Vin de Set and the other places right there on Chouteau.  It is literally farm to table with greenhouses in the back along with 20 chickens and bee hives across the street.  

Most of the wine and all of the beer are produced by the Charleville Brewery down in St Genevieve and are quite tasty.  

It is a very open space with plenty of tables so you do not feel crowded.  I highly recommended for date night or a larger group.  You will not be disappointed.  There is street parking or a lot that is open after 5pm.

The beer at Bruges is absolutely the best in town try the black or the triple ripple. Only 2 person,bcuz of the high alcohol content.
The fish stew is to die for, and the muscles are fresh and plentiful.
It's way too loud on weekends with college students.
I like to go early around 7 PM, has a nice crowd

My favorite aspect of Noble Crust is the variety of unique options they have on their menu...this includes a salmon Benny (seen on their brunch menu), fried green tomatoes atop yogurt and balsamic dressing (side), mac n' cheese (side), chicken fried chicken parm, shrimps and grits, and from last night's specials menu, grouper with corn risotto. This place is always popping. I'd recommend making a reservation if you hate waiting. If you don't mind waiting, you can sit and stand by the entrance or make your way to their back bar for a refreshing cocktail or beer. Noble Crust isn't a large restaurant, but they've done a wonderful job of making the most of the space. There's 2 long tables for larger parties, tables for couples, tables for small groups of four, high tops, and bar style seating. The waiters and waitresses have been full of life each time I've come here and they're certainly on top of things. The manager brought our room to us and was super friendly and passionate about her job. There are TVs here for games and live music. Not sure of his name, but the performer last night had a beautiful voice and was very talented! Because this is a popular place, the parking lot is usually always full, however, there are 2 other lots nearby, so you shouldn't have an issue finding parking. Enjoy! Xo

Chows chinese is a great stop for both chinese or Japanese.  I usually come here for sushi: it's one of my favorite local spots. The sushi is fresh and its a nice intimate atmosphere without a huge cost. I've been coming for sushi for about 10 years. Tonight I ordered out and got chinese for dinner: General tso's chicken with pork fried rice. The rice was kind of dry, and the chicken had dark meat only.  Not the best general tso's I've ever had.  Also, the chicken seemed a bit dry on top and I really had to dig to the bottom to get to the sauce aka the good stuff. I'm not disappointed but just surprised in the difference of quality between this and their sushi.  Anyway, I'd still eat their again.

Another "Independently owned and operated" Subway that doesn't honor Subway coupons.  Must be the same owner as the one on Vista Blvd.  Sorry Subway, got to go to Port-a-Subs for now on.  #BoycottSubway. Avoid Sparks Subways!!!!
I'm there every weekend in the summer for the produce. The rest of the year its for the chicken salad.
We've been to Alfredo many times throughout the years. I feel the quality of the food has been going down and the price has gone up. the only reason I will go back is they are byob.

Put your skepticism aside. This place is great. Delicious omelets, good coffee and nice servers. Being used to Jersey diners I wasn't so sure but this place more than earns it's stars! Catalina omelet all the way.

Wow! Amazing. I've been wanting to go here for some time now and I am so happy that I was able to go. The building alone is huge and sooo beautifully decorated. The service is amazing everyone was so nice and attentive. Our food! Our food!!!!! Yummm delicious, incredible. You won't be disappointed. I will definitely be going back and recommending to everyone. (Operating dine in and take out during Covid-masks upon arrival but you can remove when you sit down. Hand sanitizer station available. Very clean restaurant)

I have been here a few times and I feel very strongly when I say this place is waaay to hoity-toity for my taste. I mean, it doesn't really matter what I say about the pricing because that has basically been said in every review on here. 

Quality of products is okay, but not great for what you get. I can't wrap my head around paying $10.95 for a salad. Granted, it can probably be 2 servings, but it is so inflated! Quality of food doesn't match quantity. I do not particularly care for their sandwiches nor the snooty service I have experienced.

Many times I would come here because my co-workers preferred it, but I long learned that ship has sailed. Not my style. Kudos for free wifi.

Bye Felicia.

I have been here twice. Neither time was it a busy night. Both times service had been slower than one would think. Food was ok.  Ordered the wings and they were really small and tasted like something I baked from the freezer at home. I did see someone ordered the pretzel with cheese and that looked good..

Terrible service and food wasn't very good. The server took 10 minutes just to get me water. When I asked for more information on the special he said it was on the board, I asked if I could get the special with the okra and tomatoes and he said they don't have okra, I thought that was odd since it said that was on the special for today. After I put in my order he comes back and says they do have okra... I kept my order and when the food arrived it was the wrong order. When my right order did come out it was super salty. Service is slow and food isn't the best, I don't recommend eating here.

How fun is this place?! Kenzie is a sweetheart!! Breakfast birthday day club! Like we weren't prepared for this experience but we were ready to take it all in! The booty shaking is so fun! All of them are so sweet! The wait (1.5hrs) was crazy long to get in, don't come hungry! Loved the atmosphere, vibrant and loved the hip hop music! Food was also great! Had the classy and pancakes!
First time here and it was by pure luck the people are great the place is clean and super cute. The food was very good had a bacon egg and cheese it was just great good coffee too.

Cheesesteak was very good. Interesting in that they don't chop the steak and it comes out with complete slices. Was worried it would be overcooked and chewy but it was actually perfect. Bread was also amazing. Got double cheese which I believe is a must. Also have a variety of toppings. Place is small but easily walkable from all of the nearby hotels and city hall. Line was too long, had food within 15 minutes
Great food.  Ginger beef is amazing. My hubby loves the tuna twists.  A favourite for us.

I don't go here during the day because the parking situation is a nightmare.  I'm surprised Starbucks hasn't tried to buy this lot.  Constant vigilance is required during busy hours.  People making 5 point turns, jockeying for position with the Wawa truck, the trash truck, or the Coke truck that doesn't even pull into the lot, they just park on Bryn Mawr ave and block the road.  Traffic is backed up on Haverford Ave and Bryn Mawr Ave because people have to wait for someone to pull out before they can pull in.   I much prefer going here late at night and dealing with intoxicated college kids vs everyone doing the rat race during the day.  Do yourself a favor and go somewhere else, maybe an actual convenience store, because this ain't it!

Fantastic food- the pork belly and fired oyster apps melt in your mouth. Bacon wrapped shrimp and grits and the crayfish special entree we're outstanding! Wait staff was fair, thus a four instead of five star rating. Recommend!

Went here tonight, the "20 minute wait" turned into an hour. A friend of one of the waiters and the manager walked in with a party of 5, he didn't wait. With 7 people waiting for a table on a busy Friday night he simply just got his table with no wait because he had friends working there. The appetizer sampler was great, the expensive steak I ordered and waited almost an hour for was disgusting. I took a bite, it had like this rotten taste to it so I tried to have it turned into a hamburger and it was still nasty. I ordered dessert not because I wanted dessert but because I wanted to get that taste out of my mouth. I was still satisfied with the delicious sampler and dessert. Two waiters walked by my table laughing about unhappy customers they had. So I decided to Yelp because of that. I'm still a little hungry and after spending $70.00 for a dinner between two people that I didn't get to enjoy, I'm not coming back. My waitress was great, we tipped her good. It's not her fault her coworkers don't seem to care about good service.

Went here for breakfast. Staff was very friendly, but it took a really long time to get my food. Normally I don't mind waiting a little but there were only a few other people in the place at the time. The biscuits and gravy were just ok. Biscuits were hard as rocks. The veggie breakfast sandwich was very good though!

Disappointed. Went on a Saturday evening. Had read largely positive reviews. We were seated pretty quickly despite a very busy evening. We ordered a margherita pizza and bruschetta. The pizza took close to 30 minutes to be served. The taste was quite average - you could smell/taste the cooking oil/base. The bruschetta was worse than average - missable. Very noisy - as would be expected. We noticed that the servers were literally running through the aisles- whisking plates away, serving food. It gave an element of being rushed that we didn't enjoy. We have had far better stone oven pizza, with cleaner flavors and better ambiance. Give it a miss.
Worst service I have ever experienced even in an airport.  Overpriced and poor level of food. Me Puck should be embarrassed.

I think the food was okay, however, I didn't spend a whole lot of time there so I didn't get to taste everything. It had a pretty wide selection of food than I'm used to seeing at Asian buffets. When greeted at the door, the woman wasn't the kindest, and the set up wasn't too fancy or pleasant. It was quite bland and casual. The sushi selection wasn't as extensive as I hope, but it was pretty alright to quench a craving. The salt shakers were also sticky and dirty, as well as the table itself--which was very off putting. However, there are free refills, which is neat, but mostly, it's the customer service and hygiene that resulted in a lower rating.

The location is nice, but skip the food, trust me. Just walk on by. The food is so bland, as in the cheese has zero taste - like plastic. The fried shrimp seem to taste like frozen Mrs. Paul's. The workers are great and friendly but this food needs an overhaul in a big way.

I've been eating Donna's sandwiches for about three months now, and I've eaten everything she has on her menu.  The sandwiches are overstuffed, and she crisps the bread in a sandwich press for truly delicious combinations.  She uses imaginative juxtapositions of foods to bring out flavors I hadn't thought possible.  Most of her sandwiches have some form of ham and cheese in them, but my wife asks Donna to leave the ham off hers, and Donna always comes through with something good.  I like the food here enough that I eat her stuff probably twice to three times per week.  Everything I've ordered had melted cheese and tasty sauces that made me happy, and usually elicited comments from the people around me in the office or in the cafeteria.  "Hey WHAT is that smell?"  "Where can I get a sandwich like that?"  "I've been watching you eating that thing, and I just have to know where you got it!"  Every time I bring one back to work i get comments like these.

The only issue I've heard people state about A Fork In The Road is that in order to produce these delicious sandwiches Donna has to take five to ten minutes per sandwich, and since her press can accommodate only two sandwiches, she can't - and won't - rush her creations.  Do not come to Donna with a ten-sandwich order at the height of the lunch rush, but if you're willing to wait a few minutes for a really delicious sandwich, come see Donna.  Her sandwiches are culinary delights, her prices (at $6 - $8 per sandwich) are reasonable, and she always delivers a smile.

Prasino is located in St Charles on the end of a concept development. This small restaurant features a well stocked wine and craft beer selection and is beautifully designed using post-industrial modern and loft elements with high-end furnishings and finishes. The lighting over the expansive fully stocked bar is spectacular, sporting over-sized globes that harken old-fashioned exposed, hanging bulbs.

Having just hit St Louis on business my team did a quick search for a great lunch spot on Yelp and boy did it deliver. Prasino well deserves the solid 4 stars awarded, based on our overall experience, the food and the great service. We arrived shortly before the dinner crowd and were seated immediately. We were then pointed to the Happy Hour specials and were happily tempted to order one of the great $4 draft selections, for food we mostly selected items off the regular menu.

Wanting to sample the local craft, I had a very nice 4 Hands Resurrection IPA. It had great body, hoppy snap and great hints of citrus.

Turkey Burger with Seasonal Veggies - we subbed ground turkey for the special Prasino Burger - smoked gouda, tomato jam, pickled onion, arugula and whole wheat. This came with a great side of roasted veggies made up of brussel sprouts and squash.

Turkey Burger with Truffled Potatoes - The other Prasino Burger came with truffled potatoes - the sauce was delicious.

Portabello Burger with Sea Salt Chips - little did my vegetarian partner know how close this portabello burger came to tasking like meat. I could eat this all day.

Between the bartender and the waiter, service was well above average and as a bonus, while clearing the table the waiter knocked over my water glass so my meal was comped. Prasino has class and knows how to treat its customers.

-- John

(also posted in much longer form on my food blog)

Despite the fact I'm a straight woman, I've become a regular at Knock. I can't say anything about the food because my friend and I usually hit the Westbury because it's cheaper. What I love about Knock is that it has beautiful decor and plenty of space for socializing. The clientele is diverse, with a mix of regulars and occasional patrons. It's almost entirely gay men, so it's not uncommon that I'm the only woman there. 

I got lucky there this past New Year's Eve by snogging with a man who defined himself as the "gayest straight man." But that seems typically of Knock- unusual and interesting encounters are possible there. Every night at Knock feels a little different, which makes me want to come back. The bartenders pour the drinks strong and know how to hustle when the place is packed.

I can't say enough about my first trip!

I will my restaurant food blog post do the talking!

www.willseatsandtreats.com

Amazing!
Ordered a ham and cheese hoagie to go. Great tasting ham. Good ratio of meat to bread and veggies to meat and bread. I will be back

Seriously how did this place get good reviews?  This place is gross and NOT authentic Mexican food.  I just moved here and decided to check it out based on the reviews and I regret it.  Do NOT order the Margarita, it tasted old with a musty after taste. The chips and salsa are not freshly made, which is inexcusable. I ordered a taco and an enchilada...again NOTHING here is fresh. They served my "crispy" taco lying in the beans, making it impossible to eat by picking it up, which is the whole point of a taco.  You could buy all of this pre-made crap at the grocery store and do a better job.  We ate half then gave up, paid, and won't be back.  Gross.

This is seriously the best meat in St. Louis!  I usually get the turkey, salmon, or brisket and they are all outstanding.  The rotating side dishes are usually excellent too.  My favorite side is their jambalaya although I've only seen it there once.

They make delicious food! I live right up the street from Franco's, and it's one of my go-to spots. They're incredibly kind too. I go all the time, and I haven't had anything less than an awesome experience! 

If you're looking for recommendations, definitely try the enchiladas!

Came in to celebrate Valentine's Day with my fiancé. I highly recommend reserving one of the private booths, as it made for a very intimate and seemingly private evening, while still getting to people watch. The food and drinks were all excellent. My favorite bites were the scotch egg and the Brussel sprouts. The large plates of hangar steak and tagliatelle pasta were good but not great. The drinks were also good, though the blackout bramble was 95% ice, so felt a little cheated about that one. 

Main reason for the star deduction was our server. He seemed super stressed out, instructed us to basically yell out orders to him because he couldn't hear very well and just seemed down right grumpy at times. Once my fiancé and I both had empty water glasses, he filled hers and then just walked off without filling mine, despite me trying to call after him. He also made an error with the check that I had to call to his attention. Anyway, we did our best to enjoy ourselves despite him and we did have a very nice time.

Now closed but open from December to late March.  When open, the crowds are crazy.  They make superior strawberry shortcakes and fast food sandwiches including Cubans and grilled cheese.
You can buy berries and "accessories" for at home delights. You can buy flats of fresh picked berries and other produce that they grow.
Also you MUST have a strawberry milkshake.

i LOVE condados. their tacos are so good and i love their chips and guacamole and queso. it's amazing. there are a lot of options and different variations to try especially for the build your own tacos or nachos or packed bowls. it's great for take out and great for dine in. love the vibe and atmosphere. i'm gluten free and have never had an issue or gotten sick and they've always been helpful and cautious of my allergy. always happy after leaving here & miss it when i'm away at college!! forever a #1condadofan

Not a pure jazz club, a pure restaurant, or purely anything else except fun, this New Orleans institution features a wide range of musical acts, depending on the night, or a chance to sit and have food and/or drinks in the beautiful courtyard.  It's worth a visit.
the best. hands down.  if the line is really long, just order for pick up then skip the line.  pro-move.
I've been 3 times now and honestly think the food is way overrated. Fun atmosphere and always crowded but the food is average, maybe a half-step above average, at best.

Went to dinner here last month and food was delicious but wasn't exceptional nor did it stand out EXCEPT their crab cake appetizer which was to die for. For $14, one crab cake but well worth it with the amount of crab you get and the delicious garnish. I ordered a scallop dinner and it wasn't seared enough but it was OK too. Husband had the pork chop which he liked a lot too but it was a bit on the sweet side for his pallet. The waitress we got was not as friendly or when she was, it seemed fake but who cares, we're all about the food!

You know, I've had some irritating experiences (i.e. not seeing my cup by the Clover and therefore making 20 minutes' worth of drink orders before I showed them my cup sitting there), but overall, this is a great Starbucks location. I've been to countless Starbucks all over the country, and I find it very fortunate that my favorite is right down the road. 

The baristas are friendly, the drinks are made with accuracy, and they work quickly (which is important for such a busy location).
Hands down the best Italian food around. Prices are high but for a good reason: the food is incredible. I always order the gnocchi's and they never disappoint. Great place for a date night!
Way over priced for the food. The stone crabs were horrible. They had to of been frozen for a while. My husband and I left feeling sick.

Cheesy bruschetta is my favorite Since it is always crowded inside, I usually do take-out these days. I love this place because I love eating something light and healthy. The only thing that tastes a little weird was the burger. I am not sure if they forgot the sauce but there was literally no sauce in the burger.
Excellent food. Great service. Very cozy. Would definitely go out of my way to dine here again.

The food is amazing! I am very picky and a bit critical of what I eat. I have enjoyed the paleo meals. My sister orders the vegan meals and really likes them as well. I love that the food is delivered daily. They offer a nice variety of food that actually taste REALLY good. Their paleo pancakes are AWESOME! 
Me and my husband get 4 meals a day that we share. I highly recommend this to anyone who wants to loss weight or just we really great tasting nutritious food. I HIGHLY recommend it!
YUMMY YUMMY PIZZA! The only reason I didnt give 5 stars is because it put me in a really bad situation when I got on the plane... Good thing for the other passengers that it was only an hour flight!

Boneless wings were flavor less and overcooked, sent them back and think we just got the same ones back with a little more seasoning. Burger was ehhh and my wife's buffalo chicken sandwich was more of the same. Service was less than to be desired as well. Will not be returning.

A great addition to the downtown area! The full menu gives plenty of options, both healthy and more indulgent. The Mac and Cheese with chicken is beyond incredible, as well as the Kale and Quinoa salad. Their signature cocktails are super tasty, as well. Make sure you check out the rooftop, which is the tallest on Broadway. The staff is great, and I would def recommend trying it out!

Very good. Would recommend. They're open late. I think their kitchen closes at 11:00pm. The food was hot, fresh, and delicious. I did attempt to get the fish and chips but they ran out :(  instead I got the mushroom and spinach flat bread which was really good. My boyfriend got the blue burger and fries. 
They don't have much of a stout selection but everything else was really good and the service was so veery lovely. 
Would definitely go back!

Love this place downtown Nashville. Let me start off with our waiter his name is Austin we love him he remembers your name ever time we see him and that is about five time or more a year. Our sweet tea never got below half full (they have the simple syrup)make it how you like it. Start off with soup or salad and of corse it the soup Chicken and Rice it like a little bet of heaven the best I've ever had the broth I could drink by the glass full. The Blackened Chicken Pasta. Alfredo noodles chunks of chicken a four cheese cream sauce with Peter Ds spices sprinkled on top. The spices they sell at the register. It's a place everybody in Nashville has to try from pasta to steaks you leave full and still have money in your pocket. And ask for Austin he's the best.

I went there on a friday night with my girlfriend for dinner date and also our first at joeys tbh and of course when it started to snow yes we all remembered that day. Anyways it was a good atmosphere when i came in they sat us in a booth the lounge near the window but facing he bar. We both order a bottle of wine to start then we proceeded to entrees and i ordered the steak with peppercorn sauce on the side then my server suggested for the to try out the baked potato that look like spring roll looky like at first i was like really so what the heck id try anyway and man did i ever not regret that cause it was good. My girlfriend ordered pasta and she loved her food as well. Our server did a phenomenal job that night. Thank you for the wonderful experience we will definitely be coming back here again.
Very good place to stop in and eat. The price is very right it like a flashback to 1980 $2.99 $3.99 for all most everything you could want. Five star place

I thought stir fry vegetables would be a safe bet   undercooked and over spiced is what I got, the veggies could have been served as raw with dip.  Friendly service.  I  guess I should lower my standards when trapped in an airport
Good burgers. Nice beer selection. Crazy phenomenal music.  Prices are not particularly good on food. Cool spot. No better spot to chill and take in the real music scene in Nashville.

I read some not so great reviews and since I was in town, I thought I would revisit. The salad was, as always, great. I ordered their pasta special which was also outstanding. The place was packed on a Wednesday night. I'm glad that I went back and ate here again.

Awesome food.... Awesome Service considering they were super-packed!!!! I gave them 4 Stars because I didn't have that WOW experience!!! I also dined here for late night dinner!! Excellent and yes I am going back

Awesome bagel with a very old pickle! This bagel was everything I wanted! It was crispy, delicious cream cheese and seasoned great but... Old and withering pickle?? C'mon!! That's just lazy!
Their coffee is from Peet's, so you know it's good. Service was great too, just that damn pickle....ew.

Steak and eggs are pretty awesome. Chocolate gravy is a must if you've never tried it. No coffee refills so keep that in mind. Be prepared to stand in line outside for awhile if you're hitting the peak hours. Worth a visit if you're a brunch/breakfast person!
I had the pho, pad ki meo, and red and green curry. It was actually really good. I enjoyed the service as well. The little lady server was quite professional.

So we tried the Preston tonight. Really nice ambiance, sat at the bar. Some of the bartenders are still learning how to make a great cocktail. Husband ordered an old fashioned, took about ten minutes, and we received a cloudy drink without bitters. I heard the other bartender tell ours that he missed a few ingredients, he still served it. Tried a Geneva white which was flat. Wine list needs some work and upgrading. 
Good was pretty good. We ordered the octopus- super yummy, five stars for it, the beet salad was delectable. Barramundi was good, interesting flavor, duck croquettes were lacking flavor and um duck;) all the food came out at the same time with the salad at the end. They may want to consider coursing thru it a little as we didn't have space at the bar to put everything. Overall a good experience will def return for the octopus and salad. Reasonably priced.
Not pet friendly. In a town loved by dogs everywhere, and the one place that has a great outdoor seating areas doesn't allow dogs. Boo!

Sometimes you just crave some pizza! 

Jockamos has one of the best gluten free pizzas I've tried. I have a guilty pleasure of siding with their delicious ranch. They have a ton of specialty options and I've never tried one I didn't like. They even have a hangover option for those who had a crazy night before.

When tomatoes are in season, I highly recommend their health nut salad. Its offered year round but there is a noticeable difference in the tomatoes over the summer. 

They are mostly staffed by younger individuals but service is always great!

I recently had dinner at Gio before a show at the Rialto.  So conveniently located right by the Rialto! YAY!  My favorite fella and I each had the two taco meal and we shared guacamole and chips.  His tacos were two of the Korean BBQ, mine were one Korean + M's veggie and we each had the rice. The Korean tacos are by far where it's at!  They are delicious and in future that will always be my taco of choice.  The guacamole is also super!  It is fresh and flavorful... just the way I like my guac!  I should've ordered a cocktail because as we were leaving I spied that they have a cantaloupe fresco (tequila drink) or they have Modela Michalada!  They have lots of other cocktail options ($8.50) that look amazing too (some you will recognize from The Abbey, which is a great thing!).  Oh and I should not fail to mention that there is Happy Hour from 3-6, where the cocktails are half price!  I will be back for Happy Hour and Korean tacos!

Jet's is a good choice when you have people that just cannot agree on what kind of pizza is best.  They offer both thin and thick crust and have a variety of choices AND they are probably one of the better choices if you are buying budget pizza.  I don't mean this as a bad thing but just basic pizza to grab and go.  It is not a ladies night out sipping cocktail type of pizza.  This is hearty, tasty, affordable and I have had nothing but positive experiences at this establishment.

We came in to use our rewards cards from the Christmas season and celebrate our 2 month married anniversary. We had Adonis as our server and it was the best service we've ever had. He was personable, friendly, fast, knowledgeable and provided great suggestions. He seemed genuinely happy to be at work and like he loved his job. We had an AMAZING date night! We'll definitely be requesting him in the future.

We went on a busy, Saturday evening.  Restaurants were just beginning to allow for more capacity, and there were several weddings and other special occasions taking place that evening.  Despite that, we only had to wait less than ten minutes to be seated at a lovely and comfortable table with a great view.  Chips and salsa were immediately brought out to us.  They were very tasty.  Our entrees were also very good.  The food was fresh and well seasoned.  Portions were generous.  The best thing however, was the friendly service.  Both the food server and her assistant were always smiling and very attentive.  In fact, I cannot think of an occasion when we have been there over the years when the service has not been friendly. Nowadays, restaurants that consistently offer both good service and good food are getting harder to find.  This is why we will continue to go there.  If you are looking for a Mexican restaurant to have a nice meal and a good time, check them out!
I love it.  My bartender tonight Irish-y and so I pretended it was an Irish pub and he was so happy!  And he put so much rum in my drink!  So I love it.

This place was recommended by co-workers.  It is a fusion Asian restaurant.  We all had different things.  I tried some tuna melt that was ok.  We had french onion soup dumplings, shoe string frys and sate skewers.  I had the french onion soup dumplings and they were meh but the fries were pretty good, not great.

My rad na Thai chicken salad dish was HUGE.  I think this place could go down in price and also serve smaller portions because I am still eating my leftovers a few days later.

The decor is stellar and the wait staff was stellar to say the least.

They supposedly have roof top service at night and I heard it is a happenenig place.  Need to make it there and report.

what is wrong with the service here. please re hire and re train your staff. when you act like trash, it shows. if you dont like your job. get a new one. also, the food is a hit and miss. try to be consistent. thanks!

If you are looking for a great place to get your car washed in Williamson County then go here. The staff is great, the guys are always attentive and walk you around your car to make sure that everything is done that you needed done. They do get a bit busy but its an affordable price for all of the services they offer. I have not tried the coffee bar but I have helped myself to looking around the shop and a coke. The sitting area is nice and cool, or warm depending on the weather outside and is a nice break from the standard car washes. I also trust the workers, some car washes I hide everything or take it with me. I left money under my seat and the guy actually brought it to my attention! Great place!

We had breakfast here a couple of weeks ago and it is my new favorite breakfast spot!  Very reasonably priced and delicious!!  I had the Quiche and an Almond Milk Latte and my boyfriend had the Chorizo & Goat cheese omlet with an espresso.  This place is excellent!  Definitely don't leave without trying one of their Croissant Donuts, fantastic!  I can't wait for our next breakfast outing to Piquant!

I normally don't write reviews. I work very close to here and I hear ppl talking about it . Referring to the food as 'ok ...  Let's start by the containers didn't have no dividers so I ask the gentlemen if he could put my greens in a separate container he going to reply and say that is a side and I would have to charge for you . I'm like whatever who want green juice in there macaroni . Also the curry chk was very bland no flavor at all also the jerk chicken was very bland it was baked jerk chicken also I had to put hot sauce on the jerk . I would never ever come back here . The guy was a lil rude as well so if you in the area I suggest you go somewhere else and spend your money .

Im a gyro lover from Nashville. Jus left there and I must say it is by far one of the best gyro places in Nashville. Also conveniently located in a strip mall next door to a tattoo parlor, hair salon and nail salon. Go get a tattoo or get your hair cut or nails done and stop for a bite to eat! :)

Not great. Ordered the catfish poboy sandwich with okra. The okra was great and the service was better, but the sandwich was not very good. The poboy bread was soft and low quality. The catfish tasted like it was frozen and under cooked. The restaurant is like BassPro shops with food. Very touristy and sorta like being in Disney land. The service is what sets the place apart. The waiters, waitresses, and staff are extremely funny and friendly, but they need some serious work on the quality of the food.
Very friendly service! It's a great south city beer drinking bar. Food is worth a try too

We found ourselves looking for a place to eat in Fenton. Not being a fan of chain restaraunts, there are plenty in the area, we found a gem. Unbelievably great food that you have to try to believe. I ordered the Sloppy Hans, huge serving and my wife had the F-town burger. Can't say which was better but we left extremely full and happy we happened into this humble establishment. Go see Heather at the bar and you won't regret it. The patrons were even friendly and welcoming to us newcomers--we will definitely be back when we're in the area!

This place is the real deal.  My hot & spicy loving husband and DD17 can take the heat a bit better than me and DD14, but the entire family adores this place and we drive 20 minutes from home pretty routinely (every week or 2) to dine here - matter of fact, we are going there tonight for Sunday dinner.  Our usual order consists of the poached fish and cabbage with chiles, the fried chicken morsels with chiles, tofu stuffed with shrimp, baby bok choy with Chinese mushrooms - we try to order a mix of both spicy and non-spicy, to soothe my fired up mouth.  We've ordered other dishes (kung pao, eggplant, dry braised lamb etc.) and they are all fantastic.  If you love Chinese food, and ESPECIALLY if you like spicy foods, this is the place. 

Note that Szechaun cooking is SPICY, and authentic means that an abundance of Szechaun peppercorns are used -- these are literally numbing to the mouth, in a very unusual way (google it).  Prices are extremely reasonable.  

The decor is very clean and new, but not fancy - the focus is on the fantastic food.  A bonus for me is that the Chef (one of the owners) comes out of his busy kitchen periodically to smile and nod to his admiring patrons.  Look around and you'll see that 50% or more of the restaurant is filled with Asian Americans.  Nuf said.  

ps, it's BYOB :)

I don't have a bad thing to say! My first visit was last night with 3 friends and we enjoyed this place; in it's entirety, immensely! From our sever, Tiffany to the food and drinks Irish 31 did not disappoint! Although we traveled as far as Tarpon Springs, we all agreed we will be back soon!

1.5 stars. This is just a typical overcrowded dive bar for the younger crowd.The person who designed the layout of the restaurant must have been very drunk... the upstairs is a bit like a narrow square with the bar smack in the middle of the room. In order to get anywhere in this establishment you have to walk through large crowds of drunk people and hoards of drunk people will be forced to walk through you. Prepare to wait a long time for a watered down mixed drink, since there are only a few bartenders serving tons of people. They have a large selection of beer at cheap prices which accounts for much of their popularity

Irish Mile has zero decor or ambiance, just a dark dirty room. There is no dance floor or any room to dance. There isnt any where to sit besides a couple tables pushed off to one side that wastes limited room. The downstairs is not finished but you are allowed to go down there. It feels as if you are in a dirty frat house or something.I know people who have had their belongings stolen here.They sell pizza near the bathrooms (ew) but I would never dare to try it since the place is filthy. 

I usually feel like I need a shower after leaving the Irish mile because it is that dirty. Overall i give the Irish Mile 1.5 stars, I would only return with a large group of friends if everyone insisted on going there. Soo many better bars in the area!!

A start of something very good. Berlin's Doener has the basic German restaurant menu and does it well. It also carries "Berlin style shwarma" - nice big sauce and onion covered gyro meat sandwiches. 

There's a good beer menu, and some nice desserts too. I've tried the classic doener sandwich, Schnitzel Wiener Art,and the strudel. All were excellent.

The wait staff is new may not always know what's going on but they are helpful and enthusiastic. I will be back soon.

So I like the backyard beans nitro brew and I decided to come into the shop to see what it was like.  I was very dissappeared in my customer service experience by this blonde barrista.  She looked like a chicken with it's head cut off, very sporatic and really slow.  My order came out 25 minutes after I placed, I wasn't in a rush luckily but waiting that long is obscene for coffee.  It wasn't even that busy in the shop it just seemed like she had no customer service experience.  Buy the nitro cold brew stay away from the shop.

Who doesn't love a record shop and beer bar?  Good craft beer selection on tap.  Unfortunately they only had about half a glass of the beer I ordered so they gave me that one on the house and I picked another option.  Staff were friendly.  Would go back when in East Nashville again.

I'm not one to write reviews, but this place is amaaazing and I'm so glad I decided to give them a try!! I've only gotten food from here 4 times as of today and every single time the food was hot, fresh, and way better than I expected! I work nights at the hospital and don't feel like eating breakfast-y stuff when I got off in the AM as I've been up all night.. I want "real food" and this place is it! You may have to wait a couple minutes once you order but that's because they're making it fresh as you order it. Great service, friendly and polite! You guys make me want to come back after each visit! Thank you for being one of the only joints open in the early morning that I can count on!
Very good food . Lots of variety Lili enjoyed the fish , Broccoli, dessert, and of course the chicken

Not going to say a ton. We ate here with our family 3-days in a row. Friday night, Saturday night and Sunday lunch. Speechless. Food is phenomenal and the love behind each plate is to die for. Best food and best price. Love this local gem.

They're very misleading when placing a phone order for pickup. Never intended on paying $40 on burgers, fries and milkshakes. Ordered two burgers then called back to add fries as a combo meal and wanted milkshakes instead of sodas and was never told until the order was picked up that they don't have combos and everything's Ala-carte which rings up separately. I feel as though this should've been explained while placing the order or when the second call was placed to add the additional items of how they charge for everything separately. Needless to say 2-burgers were $16, 2-milkshakes $6.12 a piece, 2- orders of fries $3.09 a piece when two people could've shared the big 16oz cup of fries that they give you. Just a total rip-off!! I've tried giving this place another chance but the fact that they don't explain there pricing policy to you is very misleading and I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone unless you're willing to spend $40 like we did. I questioned this but was told that they don't offer combo meals and they charge separately for everything.

My boyfriend and I have ate here twice and we love it!  I've been having my weekly cravings. Not only is the owner and staff so warm and welcoming but the food is fresh and everything is made from scratch. This is true Mexican NOT Tex Mex like most other so called Mexican restaurants around. Delicious!

This place is a disgrace. I was in a rush home one evening and was in the mood for a turkey platter so I pulled off at the Voorhees diner to place a to-go order. I ordered two turkey platters. One with corn and mash, one with broccoli and mash. I received no corn, but soggy boiled string beans instead. Then I ordered soup, a chicken noodle and a beef barley, I got two chicken noodle soups. One mashed potato had gravy, one had no gravy. I would've preferred gravy on both. The cranberry sauce was brown, not the color it should be. The taste of the stuffing was putrid, not edible. Both were served with an orange wedge and wilted warm lettuce on the side which wormed its way into the turkey. Why, just why would either of those things be near a hot turkey platter. The manager who took my order said to me, I'll put some extra bread in there for you. Guess what, no bread at all. The best was, the bottom of the bag literally fell out and our food ended up all over our driveway. I tried to call that night, no answer. I tried to call the next day, I was told the manager was off. I tried to call again, I was told manager was on her way to the phone then they came back and told me she wasn't there. How could she have been on her way to the phone but not there? Hmmm... Then yesterday and today, the phone is busy for two days strait. I could only imagine that they blocked my number. You couldn't pay me to go back to that diner. There are so many good establishments out there. I know they're all struggling and j do my part to give them all a play, but when you come across a place that fails in multiple ways and won't own it, apologize for it, nothing, that's a disgrace. I wasn't looking for a refund. I was looking to tell them about it so they could do better. Then it turned into frustration over being ignored. They don't deserve the business. Let's give our business to deserving establishments. To the management, if you were any good at your job, you would've gotten on the phone, heard me out, and avoided another bad review, but now you deserve it.

I was very pleasantly surprised by this place. It's got a great vibe... the food was incredible. I'm usually really good when it comes to spicy foods, but the Thai spicy level was off the Scoville scale.... it hurt so good. So be WARNED: Don't get the thai spicy level unless you can handle super spicy foods.

I'll go ahead and throw out my one complaint first. The food's temp wasn't the best, but not cold. Since it's a buffet, it wasn't "hot." However, Matthew and his service were phenomenal. The food was tasty and filling. Prices were definitely worth it. Atmosphere was chill and good. Was on our way to another brunch place then heard a radio ad for this place and reset the gps to here. Super glad we did.
Large portions and delivery all for a great price! Macaroni salad is 'must' side for any entree. Teriyaki chicken plate and coconut shrimp are both super yummy!

We stopped here for lunch after traffic prevented us from getting to our original destination. I guess it was predestined. This place is great. The food is slanted toward the healthy side but don't let that stop you. This place was well worth the stop and we will be coming back.
Another solid spot, very good food and some outstanding wine.
Really delicious food. The right size portions for a dinner.  Really cheap. Its hole in the wall style is made up with excelent food.

Lolita's was excellent! They use quality ingredients and you can taste the soul in each dish. The owner, Kelly, is very knowledgeable about wine and the service is second to none. Can't wait to come back!
Put the doors back on the bathroom please. I love Barnes and Nobles but really, I don't want to hear the man with diarrhea while I'm in the bathroom because you all took the doors off.

This place quickly became one of my favorite places on south grand.  I end up taking a number of people here.  Why?  Because it is great.

I happen to love lamb-- and their lamb dishes are some of the absolute best (if not they best) in Saint Louis.
i liked this place. it's very nice. i had my first moscow mule

I can fit it into my macros, it's cheap, they always get my order right, and who doesn't love Taco Bell?!?! For the record I have lost 160lbs with Taco Bell as my go to fast food. This location is quick, friendly, and a great location so I'm never late getting back to the office. Great job guys! I'm not saying this is health food, but when you forget lunch on the counter and live 30 minutes from work, the fresco menu is where it's at!

I was so excited a 24 hour store was only a block away from my vacation rental. During the last five days of my nine day stay, I'd come in and get groceries and supplies every other day. The pizza was awesome too. On a Saturday night @ 2am, I went in with my boyfriend to get a couple slices of pizza. I wanted a soda and noticed they had a fountain soda machine. I got a small drink since it had TWO signs that said: "Free Refills." I ate two slices of awesome pizza. Earlier that day, I came in to shop for groceries and spent about $40 bucks. After devouring the slices, I went in to get ANOTHER slice and even bought three cookies. I was munching away and decided to get a refill of soda. Then the dick of a staff member, some fat and bald loser, tells me that there is NO REFILLS on sodas. I tell him that the sign said on the fountain machine that there was free refills and I had no idea. He checks the machine and tells me that someone must have ripped the NO part of the sign. He then mumbled something. After finishing up, we leave and thank everyone. But the dick staff member yells at us as we're heading to the door. He demands we pay for the drink refill. I notice the sign is finally removed from the machine. My boyfriend tells the staff about another guy who got another refill (apparently a local who knows the owner) and the dick staff tells us "Don't worry about that guy." He literally fights us for a fucking refill on a small soda and tells us that if he doesn't charge us, then 30 others would get it for free. Um, free for your mistake on your signs?!

We pay...via credit card since that was all we had. And after he struggles to run our card for FIFTY FUCKING CENTS and we pay, we leave after spending over $60 bucks that entire day in the store.

Seriously?! What kind of lameness is that? Well, they definitely lost my business. I'm going to walk the extra three blocks to go to a store that treats their customers better than that.

So I never could stand the long lines.  But decided to suck it up and it was worth it.  Line looks daunting but moves fast.  I did a half dozen because you save some money.

Agree with most that the blueberry frittata was awesome.  The boston creme is an oldie but goodie.  The bacon is also yummie.  Overall tastes fresh and lots of variety.  Only knock is that the donuts are kinda small size.  It was was worth a try but I probably wouldn't wait in line again for it.

Texas Roadhouse was awesome. At this lcoation I always get great service. The atmosphere is great...peanuts and line dancing workers. Food has yet to disappoint.  The complimentary hot rolls with the cinnamon butter to start off.  I did try the fried pickles this time. They were tangy and crunchy... yet not sure how I felt about them. When they came out super hot...I found myself eating them quickly but as they started to cool down... i had some mixed emotions but still found myself eating them. In the past, I have had the cheese fries which are fries with cheese and delicious bacon...one of the best cheese fries I've ever had.  The last visit was rib tips with mushrooms and mashed potatoes and gravy. Full rack of ribs with corn and baked potato loaded. Large portions ...I have yet to finish my whole meal from this place.

We were trying to evacuate the state in front of Hurricane Irma. I-95 was backed up and most stations we visited were out of gas. 

Wawa was clean, well lit and had fresh fruit and salads. This was such a welcome sight to us because we'd been restricted to canned, bagged foodstuffs for too long. 

We topped off the tank and got a balanced meal on the way out of Florida. Until then I'd never visited a Wawa before, but I'll never forget them now.

Went in to try it out around 1pm on a weekday.
Very crowded but luckily  i found a window table and ordered sausages and eggs with a side order of pancakes and coffee.
Waitress was friendly and they had a couple newspapers around to read so that was good.
 The place was very loud as most people must have been regulars a guess.
The food was very no frills basic and  slightly below average sized portions.
Potatoes could have used some onions or spices .
Coffee wasn't great but was drinkable .
