Price was average for Edmonton these days.
Might go again to try something lunch-like sometime.

One of my favorite modern Mexican restaurants. They have excellent tuna ceviche- which I've found hard to find in Missouri. I've been here several times: moms night out, dinner with family or just me and my kids. They have something that everybody likes. Every order I've had you can tell is made from fresh ingredients. They do not disappoint!

I have been eating at Chinatown approximately once a week for at least the last 7 years. It is by far the best Chinese food in Nashville. The hot and sour soup is excellent- I get it as soon as I arrive home from a business trip as comfort food. The garlic sauce chicken, Kung pao and chicken in cilantro are also winners. Service is great and the owners are incredibly sweet.

I had high hopes the atmosphere is great! We went for Sunday brunch and unfortunately it was totally disorganized. We were told there was a hostess, but they weren't monitoring people just sitting down. We waited 20 minutes for coffee when they were serving people far behind us in line. We only got this coffee after asking twice. We finally asked about seating for the second time when we saw many people just taking tables. We were taken down to the cellar and finally seated. We waited another 15 minutes for our food, and the eggs and potatoes came out cold. I don't typically send food back, but after waiting such a long time for food I didn't expect it to be cold.

The BEST BBQ, the BEST specials every day and on top of it, they have the most amazing customer service. 
Always my go to for some good meat, amazing sauce and tasty sides.

This was a destination well worth the ride on the Tampa Water Taxi.
Excellent creations of local foods. We had excellent service. 
Want eclectic food good service & interesting drink concoctions that comes with excellent & friendly service?
This is your place.

This place is amazing!! Everyone who works there is very friendly, we loved that the chef came out and said hello. Our server was lovely and had great recommendations for beers and food. My husband and I shared the Chickpea Fries and we can't wait to go back for those!! We also shared the half chicken and again the flavors were amazing. Our 3 year old son is very picky but he ate almost his full plate of pasta and some of our chicken. The atmosphere, food and service were great! We all can't wait to go back!
Best chilaquiles I've had outside of Mexico. If you're looking for American-Mexican food, this might not be the place, but if you're looking for authentic -- yum!

I'm ready to take the 2 hour + drive from Long Beach to Santa Barbara right now for the best Mexican food I have ever had. 

We were up in SB for 2 days in early August and I found Los Agaves on Yelp :) 
We went both days of our trip for lunch/early dinner and both times were blown away at how amazing everything was. 
The horchata was also exceptionally delicious. 
Definitely can't wait to return!

If i could give them a 0 for customer service i would. I went to buy cheesesteaks with my uncle and my smaller cousins , and I asked the guy at the front if it was possible to cut it into 6 pieces. But the guy cutting the cheesesteak answered me with a big attitude, saying:" ARE YOU KIDDING ME!? HOW AM I CUT IT INTO 6 PIECES!? AM GONNA CUT MY FINGER!". So yeah instead of a yes or no answer, if you ask them something expect them to answer you back with a tone and attitude, so rude . Not worth the experience. Just got 1 cheesesteak from them and then went to GENO's to buy the rest.

Ate here in February 2017. The pizza was pretty good. The crust is hands down the best I've had here in the St Louis Metro area. The sauce was good, but not remarkable. It was a little more acidic than I would've liked but the flavor was good. The cheese was good but my pizza was a little greasier than I would've liked for a plain cheese pizza (about as much as you would expect to find on a Little Caeser's Hot & Ready).

I recommend the lunch combo of you are there midday: 10" pizza, salad, and drink. The salad was nice and fresh and the light dressing was still really flavorful. Our wait was typical for a handmade pizza to order (about 15-20 minutes). The staff was friendly and the customers were all friendly and talkative, something that I found ref roadie waiting for our food to go. Perhaps that has to do with the location.

Sadly, somehow they were out of fresh basil the day we went here. I really had my heart set on a Margherita and had to settle for plain cheese. My son said that the sausage was pretty good. All in all,  I wouldn't hesitate to go back again if I was in the area and wanted pizza again.
Excellent food...tom yum hot was great.....staff was awesome....full bee and good drinks....would highly recommend!!!

I really like everything I've eaten here, but I can't shake the idea that Siam Lotus seems to be having a major identity crisis. It's a nice space with great atmosphere, but it's located next to a gun shop in a terrifying neighborhood. 
Also, the small intimate dining area is complete with... a DJ!?!?

I recommend the kang dang.

Great beer selection. Full bar. Very good food. Lots of specials and happy hours, mini tours frequently, and participation rewards as you move through the world tour. Great staff. If you can't enjoy yourself here and find something you love then you shouldn't be writing reviews.

Thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the Radnor. Every single employee I encountered was polite, helpful and went above and beyond to make sure my friend's wedding which was held at the hotel went off without a hitch. Flew in from Texas and was nervous about being so far from home but I immediately felt the sense of hospitality and all nerves disappeared. The servers and bartenders in the restaurant are so helpful and nice. Breakfast buffet was amazing (definitely try the sausage...so delish), happy hour was AWESOME and affordable but drinks were very affordable not during happy hour as well. Everything I ate was super flavorful and tasty and not overpriced. I know exactly where I'm staying the next time I visit, the Radnor! Thank you everyone for an awesome experience.

If you are in the area this is a must eat. I cannot believe how delicious everything we were served was. I would start with the bone marrow bruschetta it was the most amazing thing I have tasted this year (and that's saying a ton because I've eaten some delicious food in the past year). I would order two just so I can eat it again, it was that good! Everything comes on small plates (but no worry prices are very reasonable) so try a lot of different things. We made sure to leave room for dessert, we were so happy with dinner we couldn't wait to see what choices they had. We had a light delectable chocolate mousse.  It was balanced with candied oranges and chocolate nibs. Not overly rich and felt like a great closure to a wonderful meal. Again don't pass this gem up!

And this is another place I love just like hip city veg. 
The staff were so nice and they also have kale which was so good! 

YES YES YES  GO HERE!!  and you wil notl be disappointed!!
El taco al pastor was not seasoned well and the margarita was ok. Three stars for being open late.
Oh yummy Chinese. This place is good. Easy, casual. Spicy stuff is spicy. Crisp stuff is crisp. All very flavorful. Reasonable prices. Will definitely go back.
Liu Shun Wok is our favorite Chinese restaurant.  We love the hot braised chicken and crab rangoon.  My teenage boys want to go here every week.

A great little hidden spot on Sansom, squeezed in between numerous Irish bars. My friends and I spent the night hanging out in their little outdoor space which was very comfy and well attended by the staff. A great Saki selection along with a great range of sushi and sashimi choices as well. I will definitely be going back here in the future!

Love this place, amazing happy hour from 4-7. The staff is friendly (Adan was my server and he's great), the food is good I love their pork tacos and queso fundido (both $5 happy hour) and their MARGARITAS are soooooo good. Check this place out.
Food and service is really really good.. amazing selection of vegan food.. Blueberry Lemon pancakes are absolutely delicious...

From out of town. Teen boys  devoured their pizza and I had the wings. Pizza gets 4 stars as well as the wings. Really liked the atmosphere. Order at the counter and a self serve kinda place. 
Would recommend

Positive: I can't say enough about how incredible the double dipped wings are! The house salad is amazing as well. 
Negative: The draft beer is always lukewarm at best and has a funny taste. Stick with bottle beer or mixed drinks!

They have a happy hour every day, enough said.

Bacchus is relatively new. When my boss chose it for our holiday party, I was perplexed. I had never heard of it before and I'm pretty good with knowing most notable Tampa Bay restaurants (it was my job for two and a half years). I felt validated when I was walking, trying to find it, and two lovely ladies who asked me where I was going (I looked super lost) had no idea this place existed either...and it turned out we were across the street. 

Now that I know this place exists, I can see why it's my boss' favorite place for a date night. It has happy hour every single day (even on the weekends) from 4-7 p.m. and it consists of a variety of cheap appetizers ($4) and drinks. I could make a meal out of the happy hour! If this place was closer, it would be dangerous for me. 

The charcuterie options are very good. I didn't take pictures, because I was trying to not stick out at my first holiday party for my new job, but I was very impressed with the spread. My favorite, by far, was the truffle cheese. It did not skimp on the truffle. The slices of cheese were pretty large and I selfishly took a whole slice of the truffle cheese and enjoyed every bite. 

The flatbreads were also very good. I had a mushroom one that I enjoyed. 

It is a smaller restaurant. We were off to the side which isn't the best place for a party, because it is so narrow, but I can see it being lovely just for sitting. 

I also found out that they packaged the remaining food to give to my boss the next morning. I really appreciate that they do this to prevent food waste! 

Since it is DTSP, you have to pay for parking. Luckily this place is super close to the Sundial parking. It was $5 and I was set for the evening.

If you have a girl's night or a date night and want a nice place to go, this is your place!

I was with a friend when I visited this Salem's. We were hungry and was looking for any place open at night to eat at. I've heard about this place a few times so I decided to stop by. The experience was fun and the workers there was really funny.

The food was just average. I wasn't really expecting much so it was not bad at all. I don't think I like the wings too much but I can't remember why. 

If you're looking for fast food gyro style this is a place to go.

Not a typical Mariott Hotel. Relatively spartan. We were there in mid December 2019. The lobby was under construction and not accessible. On the east side of the hotel, where we stayed, we were awakened by loud banging construction noise from next-door at 6:00 AM in the morning. The staff were nice. And, you're only a short walk from numerous pubs.

Pat O's in Orlando is awesome! This one... the music is good per usual but the bartenders and servers were all ass holes. The first part of your bartending job is customer service. If you don't like your job, find a new one ‍

You MUST go to this sushi restaurant for the experience of the "Sushi Nazi." He's honest and will send you out if he thinks you are unworthy of his sushi (so we were told). The sushi is served in large portions and is incredibly cheap and delicious.

March 7, 2017 Friday - 12:15 PM for Lunch
2 adults

Went here for lunch with a coworker. We enjoy trying new hole in the wall type places because they tend to have pretty good food. We looked over the menu, pretty simple and predicable, but that did not disappoint since most Mexican food places are. Ordered at the register, took our number and found a seat (not hard, there is plenty of seating in the store). Enjoyed looking at the art and pinatas while we waited. Also, we got the chips and salsa while we waited. The chips were fine but the salsa tasted like tomato sauce with a lil heat. Tried once, and did not try again. We both ordered burritos, standard option for the first time visitor... At first glance it looked very good, but then cut into and realized how everything was piping hot as if it just came out of a microwave. After tasting the meat, it confirmed my suspicion that it was microwaved to bring it up to temperature. Overall I was really disappointed. I would highly recommend people to only go here if they are looking to shop an "authentic" mexican store, and not looking to eat any food prepared. The tortilla was good and the beans were good. Guy working the register was very nice and easy going. The food was just not executed. Also, no active cooking was going on. It appeared that everything was pre-cooked and then re-heated. Bummer. Needless to say, we will not be returning to eat.

A surprise compared to other "tourist" bars.  Had appetizers.  And drinks.  Both done quite well and served a lot faster than some places we've been.  If we're this way again, will give them another try.
Every time we eat here the food is always fantastic and the service is just as wonderful!

I poked my head into this lovely little coffee shop during my apartment hunting trip to Indy and have been a fan ever since! Snag one of the tables in the front or in the back of the shop to get some serious work done, or grab a spot on one of the comfy couches to catch up with a friend.

I'm super excited to be in the neighborhood so I can pop in to check out the rotating artwork and for the myriad of events that Monon hosts.

Fantastic local coffee shop in the heart of Broad Ripple, serving up tasty beverages and yummy pastries. I know I've found my new favorite spot in BRipp!

Protip: There's a free parking lot behind the coffee shop, entrance is immediately to the west. The lot isn't large, so I'm sure it fills up quickly!

I went here and was very pleasantly surprised. The atmosphere is very nice with the little shop right outside in the entry way. Since the wait is usually a bit of time it's nice to relax and walk about seeing the flowers and odds and ends. It's nice place for a date and easy to get a small souvenir to remember it by. 

Food wise, it's very delicious. I had their cherry compote pancakes along with eggs and sausage. Their scrambled eggs were very silky and 'wet' which I love. They were all evenly textured as there were no clumps to large or to small. 

I ordered an espresso and it was quite delicious, though I would have rated it a 4/5 on espressos.

Disappointed.  They claim to be "the worlds greatest hot sandwich".....which it even says on the door and on the menu.  Saying that makes me more skeptical, and they shouldn't make those claims if they haven't really been rated that way.  Anyone can claim to be the best at anything......but who said they were the best?  

They are probably a step up from Subway and Firehouse subs.....but I have had much better sandwiches before.  Also, their sandwich menu isn't really that big, and it doesn't have what I would consider to be the typical "hot" sandwiches.  When I think of hot sandwiches I think of Reuben's, hot pastrami, corned beef.....but they don't have any of those.

If you were going to go to subway, this would be a better choice....but I wouldn't recommend going here otherwise.  Basically a typical fast food sandwich place, and nothing special about it at all.

I'm glad I went here for a work dinner, otherwise I would have been really disappointed.  I think it's a fitting place for work meals.  The place is huge and has that created "Western" motif in terms of décor.  It's nice that it's right on the greenway.  Had the trout, which was a rather large piece of fish. It came smothered in a creamy sauce with slivered almonds.  The fish was OK, the sauce unnecessary.  It was accompanied by rice pilaf and broccoli.  A perfect meal for your grandmother's birthday! The Idaho Cabernet (can't remember the name) was decent, although a little overpowering by the end of a glass.

Love this place! Had them today for lunch. They deliver!!!

Chicken spinach? Dee lish!

Crust is crispy and thicker, I love it. Sauce is mild and now I want to sleep.

Thank you!!

ok food. but terrible service for buffet. asked for extra naan. the waiter did not show up. ask for water he said yes and water was in front of him, but never returned to our table. before we could finish, the cheque was on our table. Felt unwelcomed.

From the time we walked in, nothing skipped a beat. The service was lovely and every bite we took was an experience. The atmosphere causes you to slow down and pulls you in. Yolan tops the best restaurants we've been to in Nashville and we hope they're able to maintain the excellence we witnessed and tasted!

Final Nashville night, final Nashville Dinner. I had yet to have hot chicken and had been wanting to check out Kitchen Notes based on their Yelp reviews and website. I was able to snag a reservation for one via Open Table on a Thursday evening so I definitely had chicken on my mind as I walked over. Located in the Omni Hotel close to the Music City Center Convention Hall, this place was worth the walk through low 30s temperatures.

Food: Of course I was going to order the bucket of fried chicken but first I started with the deviled egg appetizer with cracklins. You get 3 eggs sliced in half topped with a slice of pickled okra and a small piece of cracklin served on top of a nice spicy sauce. I chose the half bucket of fried chicken with the optional hot chicken sauce on the side along with charred okra and sautéed collards. While waiting for the dish, someone dropped off a 3 variety of biscuits at the table with a complement of butter and jams. Okay..i been watching the carbs but hey..it's the south, it's hot biscuits, it's my last evening in town. YOLO right (for those living under a rock, YOLO means. You Only Live Once and usually heard right before making a bad decision but in this case the biscuits were worth it). The chicken comes and it's literally half the chicken fried to a perfect crispy golden brown. My first piece I doused with the Hot Sauce..It does have a kick! Seeing how I have an early flight out the next morning I decide to go easy the rest off the way but the entire dinner was fantastic. While I loved the chicken, I was most surprised by the charred okra which i kept popping in my mouth. Maybe it was because this was my last night here but each dish was amazing.

Service: From the hostess, to the bartender, to my server, the service was at top notch through evening. Great, fast, friendly, and very accommodating. 

Atmosphere: Open and spacious with booths that can seat probably 8 but are used as two booths with no dividers which gives the space a very communal feel. It's off to one side in a hotel lobby which accounts for the very high ceilings. Clean, relaxing, and comfortable would be the words I'd use to describe it.

Value: I found great value here for such a highly rated/reviewed restaurant. My half a chicken with two sides ran only $17 and that included the nice three biscuit treat. 

Overall: Located in the Omni Hotel it goes far beyond what I usually expect or have experienced in a "Hotel" restaurant. If you are finishing a long day of meetings at the convention center, exiting the country music museum or finding yourself anywhere in the vicinity I would highly recommend you check out Kitchen Notes!

They have lots of options for sushi, sashimi, and hibachi grill items! Service is slow and the last time we visited, we kept getting other peoples food and we had to wait over 30 minutes each time we ordered more food!

Had a sushi craving and looked for something nearby.  Small restaurant  but it was packed.  I did takeout, but I may come back and visit in person too.  People seemed to be liking the food.

My takeout sushi is not the best that I have had.  The rice was too sticky and the size of the rice huge.  It just was lackluster, hence the 3 stars.  Will try again and update if required.
First time here.  We split the dinner sample platter for lunch. Everything was good. Service was fast and friendly.

We made a reservation for our family during Tulane graduation weekend a few months back, and about a month ago we started calling asking to add one extra chair which we didn't think would be a problem, however, after numerous calls over the past few weeks no one from the restaurant would call them back. Finally, we called again today a few times as our reservation is tonight and we wanted to ensure everything would be okay and when we spoke to Ashley, the sales manager, she rudely let us know that no one called us back because it isn't possible since they are so busy. We asked why they have ignored all of our calls and never let us know so we could make a reservation elsewhere and Ashley rudely hung up. Both my mom and my sister then called back to further understand the situation and Ashley continued to be incredibly rude. As a famous and well respected restaurant in New Orleans and someone who works in hospitality this is no way to treat a customer or another person for that matter and incredibly disappointing to hear that this is how the situation was handled, when it could have been resolved weeks ago. We will never be returning nor recommending this to our friends and we hope from an internal standpoint there are changes made to the way they treat their customers.

We started and ended our night here. I admit, I was a first-timer.  I loved the ambiance when you walk in. Very nice and cozy.  I wish we got to eat here too. The items on the menu seemed very good!.  The one that caught my eye was the lobster mac & cheese!  Next time for sure!  =)  I also like that they have their own customer parking in the back too! A+

When we first got in, we headed straight to the bar.  Happy hour!  =)  They had $4 well drinks.  The bartenders were very nice and friendly and made sure our glasses were full!  haha.  But since it was our first stop, we only had a couple.  Pretty good drinks for the price.  We did come back later though!  For none other than their ice cream!  I had half a scoop of macadamia passion fruit and half a scoop of honey cornbread. OMG!  It was so delicious!  The gal at the counter was so nice & patient.  I think I had a sample of all of the different flavors before settling on these two! LOL.  Anyway, if the food is as good as the ice cream, this will be my new fave restaurant...  =)  To be continued...

I'm not a beer drinker, but their Bloody Mary is GREAT!  I also had a Peach Sangria that was very light and refreshing.  The pizza here is outstanding.  They do a thin crust, so it doesn't compete too much with the toppings.  They have a huge selection, so there's definitely something for everybody.  And not just your everyday, ordinary pizzas!  When was the last time you tried SALMON on your pizza???  Anyway, the setup is nice.  You go up and order your drinks and take them back to your table.  You go up and order your food and they bring it out to you.  Cuts down on their wait staff and your tipping.  Love this place!

Super cute cafe with amazing coffee and food. I had the biscuits and gravy and it was one of the better ones I've ever had! The biscuit was nice and thick and homemade and the gravy was the perfect amount of peppery. Absolutely would go back here again.
The fried chicken was amazing! And the mashed potatoes and white gravy were soooo yummy.   Plus they serve biscuits that taste like homemade donuts along with Apple butter. It was so yummy
Pretty disappointing. Chicken was over cooked and dry. Rice was far too hard and dry to eat. I will not be going back.

I didn't want to write a review on Abe's Place until I actually sat and had a meal in their restaurant instead of take out but I couldn't resist. To be honest the only thing I've eaten from here has been the wings and they are pretty bomb!

 Compared to other wing places I've eaten at, their wings are way bigger in size. So far I've only had the buffalo flavor but I definitely plan on trying many more.

I was in Philly for the first time and my friend had recommended me sonny's famous steaks. I ordered a cheesesteak through their online ordering system for pickup. In the cheesesteak, I chose to include onions, sweet peppers, provolone, and jalapeño. The dressing I chose was mayo, salt and pepper. The cheesesteak was very tasty and I do recommend adding the jalapeno because it gave it more flavor. I liked how soft the bread was which made it easy to take bite after bite. The only negative thing I can say is that I wish the meat was a tad bit more tender. I'm not a huge meat person so it did not blow me away but I was still very satisfied with my sandwich. Service was prompt and it was ready within ten minutes.

I LOVE THIS PLACE SO MUCH. quality food. Consistent. And mostly, amazing, amazing staff. So nice and make us feel welcome every time we order food. We get out of the hospital late often and everytime we order food for takeout, the owner (?) Is always so kind and pleasant. A great way to end the night!

Not fast and not fresh!!  I just purchased the original banana wrap, which is supposed to be grilled and warm.  It was the last time I ordered it.  I waited 15 minutes in the drive thru line, which is actually 15 minutes faster than my last visit for the same purchase.  That alone made me wonder.  My curiosity was answered soon there after, the wrap was definitely DAY OLD.  It had grill marks, but COLD.  Get it together B&D.

I was beyond disappointed. I would give the food 3 stars and the service NONE! My husbands fish was undercooked, and when he pointed it out, they simply placed his WHOLE PLATE in the oven, (not even put the fish in a pan, which would still be unacceptable) then brought out an extremely hot plate to him exactly how they took it! Very disappointed. Luckily my husband didn't get sick from the uncooked fish going from so many different temperatures!

It's taco bell ! 

So saw all these bad reviews and went to check it out. I Did online mobile app ordering three different times of the day in a week before making my review.

The staff was friendly fast and each item ordered was made with care no smashed tacos, no cheap filled portions it was exactly like pictures show it was a great experience for me all three times !

1st was midday mid week a full order of chalupas and burritos with some Loco tacos the ones with the flavored shell fast and quick to order and pick up. 

2nd was late night weekend line of cars on Saturday night ordered on my way through the app. Got there and the line of cars whipped out fast within 4 min pretty fast for over 8 cars in line including mine.

3rd was a Tuesday evening on popular taco Tuesday and they were fast courteous and on point.

The reviews for delivery you might as well ignore most food isn't meant to be delivered and sit on wait for pickup and the on a drive to your house if want fresh fast and delicious go to the place !!

If your ordering from your couch expect couch expectations there are so many factors from your delivery driver to the traffic to how they handled your food it isn't right to review negative to the location itself try different times and then post in my opinion.

Again this is my experience and what I witnessed in my own time on my own dime. See for yourself but this locations kicks it right.

Worst place for service.  Their billing system is inconsistent and they claimed we did not pay our bill, but shows on our credit card as being settled, and verified with the credit company. The manager Michael is very unprofessional and demeaning, ruining and turning a good day bad.

I love walking over to mix in the summer and sitting outside.  The waitresses are usually super friendly.
Sort of an odd order tonight...spaghetti and meatballs.  But, if its on your menu... I feel you should be able to execute the dish well.  It was extremely garlicky, bearing huge chunks of garlic in the tough meat.  The spaghetti was cooked perfectly.  No bread? $23 before tip for two orders?  The food was warm not hot at all.  The pizza and Caesar are good on their premises.

We've eaten here three times so far and have never been disappointed. Had a reservation last night and called at the last minute to see if we could come 30 minutes later because our son wasn't feeling well. They couldn't have been nicer or more accommodating. 

The place itself is small and intimate. Perfect for a date night. The wine choices are excellent and drinks are inventive and well-balanced. My kalamata martini was one of the best I've ever had. They also give you a complimentary Chilean bruschetta that is out of this world - the bread is warm, crusty and flavorful and the salsa is delicious!  I've ordered the crab cake entree the last two times we went and they are just perfect!  My husband was very happy with his Chilean sea bass. 

While some reviewers have commented that the prices are high, my husband and I both agreed that they are reasonable for the quality and quantity of food. If you are ordering drinks, you will probably spend at least $100, but it is well worth it!

Finally got down to Ristorante Pesto and was not disappointed!! Be prepared to EAT because the food doesn't stop coming... starting with complimentary balsamic marinated carrots... salad with poached pears, candied walnuts and pumpkin seeds... and their famous gnocchi pesto... out of this world!! The gnocchi's literally melt in your mouth. Topped it all off with a classic cannoli and we were officially spent. The service was so attentive and well timed, and it was such a pleasure to feel like you were special to them, not just another table. In true Italian form, they just wanted you happy and well fed. And both were certainly accomplished tonight!! Lots of options for us vegetarians and, with some slight adjustments, vegans too! We are already looking forward to our next trip back to Ristorante Pesto!!!

Overall bad experience here, the food was alright at best but the service is what really got to me. I came in and could tell that they were short staffed on a Saturday but honestly do I have to wait 30 min just to order food. In addition I had to pick up the menu instead of them taking 10 seconds to offer it to me. Along with that a server was filling water for people instead of taking orders. When I walked up to ask they had the nerve to argue back and say wait 5 more min. If you are looking to come for food alone I guess it would be worth but as for service I would not recommend going

I was really looking forward to having a nice, big juicy burger and a simple Yelp search got me here. I ordered The Brickyard Burger and my fiancé ordered the Mac Daddy. We also got the mixed bag appetizer sampler. Everything in the mixed bag was good, pretzel bites, cheese fries, and mozzarella sticks. My burger was so good! Too big to pick up and bite, so I had to cut it up. I loved the spitfire ranch. Unfortunately, the fiancé's burger was dry and he isn't as thrilled about the visit as I was, and that means we probably won't be back. If he's not happy, we usually don't return. The atmosphere was good, there was a live band that was pretty decent and I recommend you visit at dusk and watch the amazing view of the sunset!

Geno's steaks are really good, love their roll and the "whole steak". Bright and clean outside and staff members do not intimidate. When we do make the trip we usually have one cheese steak there and one across the street. Love the hot pepper condiment station.

Tonight was the second time we ate here.  If you're looking for a quick meal this isn't the place for you.   But if you're looking for a relaxing evening enjoying some outstanding food then this is the place.   Every plate is homemade to order.  The mussel appetizer my husband has gotten both times and loved it each time.  Tonight I had the roasted red peppers- they were still warm and everyone at the table agreed they were delicious.  You can't go wrong with any pasta dish - it's all made fresh to order.  Tonight my husband had the veal and although he was full he couldn't stop eating.

I highly recommend trying this out - but remember it's a full evening out.
Ordered the roast beef sub. Not very good. Very weak ice tea. Just not a good experience.

We've been eager to try Pizzeria Vetri since it opened and tonight presented the perfect opportunity for an early dinner. We arrived at 5:40 and the place was packed - no space for a table of 3. Good for them being so busy during a time I'd still consider the early bird special!!! We put in our name and I got a text about 15 minutes later that our table (or pizza bar seats, I suppose) were ready. The service was fantastic from the moment we walked in. The hostess and all servers were extremely attentive and friendly. No one gave us a hard time that the 3rd member to our party wasn't there yet, which I felt bad about because there were people waiting for tables. I really enjoyed sitting at the pizza bar and watching the hardworking guys toss pies.

We started with the gin fizz bottled drink, which was pretty disappointing. I was shocked because all the ingredients are my favorites, but it was just...meh. For the three of us, we ordered two rotolos and a white pizza with rosemary. The food was good, but not mind-blowing. I was super excited for the rotolos and those were disappointing. The dough on the exterior was seemingly overcooked whereas the dough in the center was undercooked. I didn't taste any pistachio pesto - just some crushed up pistachios. The pizza was yummy and fresh though. Overall, it was a decent meal, but I don't know if I'd rush back with so many great wood-fired pizza spots in the city.

We visited this location on Father's Day and prior to arrival we called 30 minutes in advance (as we had been told they were not taking reservations and you could only call 30 minutes before arrival) and were told it would be a 30-45 minute wait. We arrived at 4:55 and were not seated until 6:05. It wouldn't have been an issue if they had followed the correct order but at 5:30, a family that had literally just walked in was seated because it was a waitress's family and she wanted them in her section. This unfair prioritization is specifically what caused the wait to be so long. On top of this, we were seated in that waitress's section anyway which made the other group being seated first even more pointless. We were also seated directly next to the waitress's family and therefore the service was extremely lacking as she was giving all her attention to the other table. She also leaned over our food several times and she also put cheese on dishes that we had not asked for cheese on. The waitress's name was Lily or Lilly, she had no name tag so I'm unsure of the spelling. Our soup came out very cold and was brought back out after being out in the microwave. Also, despite them cutting the menu down to bare bones, they were still out of items. This was not a pleasurable dining experience.

So disappointed in the recent menu changes. Maybe it is due to COVID-19, I don't know. They eliminated the Buffalo Chicken Sandwich from the Club Menu. They no longer have daily specials including the Cajun Meatloaf on Mondays. They no longer serve soup AND salad with dinner entrees, now it is soup OR salad. Too bad. It was a good thing.

First time for me when it comes to Jamaican cuisine.  I ordered the Jerked Chicken, and it was so good.  It has a nice smokey flavor with some nice heat.  I ate everything on my plate.  Definitely give this place go when your in the mood for Jamaican cuisine.

Literally the best burgers I have had in quite some time! Service was fast and easy going, wasn't to packed when we went around 2. I will def be coming back again. We used groupon for it and saved like 13 bucks eating there but again I highly recommend it!

original rating was 3 stars (shouts to Robbie on the second floor for giving us a 5 star experience) but bumped it up one star because of Robbie

love visiting the test kitchen to grab a beer or something yummy on my break/on the way home from work but 9/10 times I have to stare at someone (and even then it depends on whom I am staring at), I rarely get serviced until I've been seated for 5-7 minutes (yes, it's happened so often I've timed it and here's my average experience)

I love my co-workers too but customers come first. Not asking for someone to be breathing down the back of my neck but to at least be acknowledged (like others I see) without having to flag down a server would be nice. 

Lil Dumplings is worth making the trip, I would suggest grabbing your drinks before you order your food (just to be on the safe side)
Good coffee and awesome space. Lots of space and beautiful interior. The breakfast sandwich was pretty delicious and the cups and plates are so cute. The scone was good as well.

We hosted our rehearsal dinner at Rusty Bellies and we could not have been happier! 
Jacquelyn was so easy to work with from the very beginning and really listened to what we wanted for our event and made it happen.
Our guests were all very pleased with the food and the service! My in-laws were so pleased with their experience they went back to have dinner again before they left town!

We were in the area for the Midtown Sidewalk sale and decided we needed food to keep us going.

We should have just left.

I was so excited to eat here. Burgers, dogs and wings? Perfect!

I ordered a hot dog with BBQ sauce, onion and bacon. Sounds like a perfect combination - paired with fries - for $9.50.

The fries are ok. Nothing great. From frozen to fryer to plate in just a few minutes. 

The hotdog. It was sliced in half lengthwise and put on the bun which made it quite easier to eat which was nice. The BBQ sauce was an ok flavor - again, nothing great. The bacon was crisp and probably the best part of everything ordered. The onion were just raw and diced into larger chunks. You couldn't even cook the onions? That would have made this better but alas, I can go without raw onion.

The wife ordered wings, ate most because she was hungry and said she doesn't need to eat anything else on their menu.

So... overall, meh. Truly meh.

I won't come back. 

I wish I hadn't come in the first place. I should have left from the area and opted for something else.

especially at the price point of $9.50 for a not great hotdog and fries. If I really want a sausage or hot dog fix I'll go to Costco. That's more bang for the buck for sure!

Chocolate nut roll
crispy and flaky, oozing 
sweetness -- you're the best!

We regularly order take and delivery from this place. I don't know what's going on, but lately it's gone downhill. They changed their fries and they literally always taste stale and old now, and yesterday I ordered a salad and the chicken was rotten! That's right, it smelled and tasted like rotten chicken. I had to throw it in the outside trash cause my cat kept trying to dig it out of the garbage. I called them to let them know, but no one seemed to care. The manager didn't even call back after I let the phone person k ow that takes the orders. Ew.

Had a wonderful dinner including buffalo wings appetizer (cooked to perfection), shrimp cocktail, blackened grouper (perfect with a light citrus glaze), crab legs, and delicious key lime pie.  Great food, great service, great experience.

Horrible I wish I could give less than one store ordered two po boy sandwiches it took over 30 minutes for the food to come and it tasted mediocre at best. The  drinks were expensive, weak and didn't taste very good. Our waitress knew absolutely nothing about the menu and doubled as the bartender who made the terrible drinks.
This place is delicious! My dad took me here for my birthday and we were so impressed. You won't be disappointed here!
Awesome. Tuna tacos and tuna rolls were awesome as well as the wet burritos.  We stop in every time we are in Florida!

Andy...   Whoever Andy is has it figured out.  I saw a picture thru another food business and dreamt of this try for two weeks. It's in the middle of Fishtown where bars and pizza joints dominate corner businesses.  So I figured in order to be open for three years this place has to be good.  

The Chicken-  They have various flavors to use on top of golden Korean Fried Chicken. It looks beautiful just sitting there underneath the warmers. The meat is cooked to perfection. Rips right off the bone with spicey chili pasted on and is on every piece.  I must say it has such a different taste for chicken that it's a game changer.  Only a few Korean BBQ chicken places I've tried but Andy's reins Supreme.

The KimChi rice-  Such a wonderful taste for fried rice it kinda mixes a Chinese Fried rice with a Spanish kick in taste only.  The only down side a order of this beautiful portion is 12.95.   I'd like to see a chicken kimchi rice combo.

The Onion Rings- very tasty onion that is there and juices scream in your mouth with flavor. 

The Staff- they took there time with us knowing it was our first time trying them. We were able to try the sauces before we ordered. We are originally from the Philly area but never knew  of Andy's.  Now we know and will be back.

One of my absolute favorite eateries in Indy. 

Every meal ive had heard has been fantastic. Great beers to go with as well. 

If the tenderloin medalions are on the menu- get em!!!! Brussel sprouts are a must as well! 

They do it all right. You wont leave dissatisfied. Great outdoor seating area as well!

OK, just the points: We went at lunch time on a Sunday.
We had to wait for enough people to fill a table, about 10 minutes.
Got our drinks quickly, and refilled as soon as they were not even half empty. But took a while for soup and salad. Soup was slightly flavored with a couple thin slices of mushrooms and some chives. For the salad I got house dressing, watered down thousand island with ginger.
The cook was entertaining, the food was ok. They give you sauces that you can purchase at most stores. Not a lot of zing to the food. The veggies were mushroom, zucchini, and onion. The only veggie that was in the fried rice was corn, and it tasted too sweet. The Shrimp tasted fine, but was very small. The steak was overcooked. We most likely will not return to this place.

Ordered 4 pizzas for my employees at 5PM on Valentines. Not only did the pizza arrive earlier than estimated, it also arrived very fresh and delicious. All of my employees agree that it was one of the best Papa John's pizzas they have ever had. I was even able to convert a couple non PJ patrons to try it and they loved it! Hats off to the team on Brandon Blvd for a great meal. 10/10 would recommend again

A great Karaoke for my friends and I, we celebrated a wonderful birthday there. The sushi tastes greate and the size is really huge And the BBQ Eel Rice is the first to recommend! It's the favorite for all my friends! However if you do not order drinks, their minimum bill is hard to reachFor Chinese friends, I have to say their song book is really complete and new, they even have TFboys

Pizza was horrible as well as the staff. They had zero personality/enthusiasm about their job and made it uncomfortable to be there. Pizza was cold, once we FINALLY got it, and halfway through the second slice my friend notices a bug in her cold piece of pizza. So I walked up to the manager, or whatever he calls himself, he's the fat cashier and demanded a refund. He acted like he wasn't going to refund money for "already" eaten pizza. I mean really the meal was 6$ a person we weren't looking for a handout, idk if those were his thoughts but needless to say we received full refund. Oh and on top of that he was a COMPLETE and total DB about the whole situation. NEVER WILL I GO BACK OR RECOMMEND THIS PLACE TO ANYONE.......including my goat

I really love the new location. It's warm and inviting with great views of the mountains or city. The service is friendly and attentive. The food was good, too. I enjoyed my penne with sausage; tasted just as described by the server. My wife was not as enamores with the risotto but she's eager to try something else next time. I do recommend the restaurant without reservations.

I had the Small Baby Mamma Nachos ( I think that is the correct names :-) with beef and adding guacamole and it was good. 

The location can be hard to find within the plaza but on the opposite side is the New Orleans Burger Restaurant on the left side of the street however if you pass the Buffalo Wild Wings on the left side of the street you have passed this place.

Enjoy.

Me and my fiancé went last night for the All You Can Eat Seafood on Thursdays.  The restaurant itself was nice and the feel of it was really good.  The selection of food you can chose from was a nice picking.  It was $35 pp since we came and got seated before 9pm because it is $30 after 9pm.  The food was delicious and they give you a salad before you start which is included as well.  We really enjoyed ourselves until the check came.  I felt like we were over charged due to a 20% gratuity they already include on your check.  I one did not like that because it was only two of us on the bill.  I feel it is not fair to the clients because our server really didn't do the best. until we had our second round of food.  SO in all reality we spent like 55.00 pp than 35 per person.  I think the 20% should be hatched on when their are more than 4 or 5 people at the table.  I personally would not give someone a $20.00 tip unless they were extra awesome and went way above what was expected of them.  All the waiters and waitresses do is  just ask what you are having next and someone else brings out the food.  The manager should really look into that because now I do not know if I would go back for that specific promotion they have.

I have never had chicken and waffles, but a coworker picked this place for her birthday lunch. There was almost no wait for a big group, which was nice   Our waitress, Cece, was great and checked on our table frequently and did a fabulous job. 

The food was good. I wasn't the biggest fan of the famously popular chicken and waffles, but tthe portion was veery generous and many of the people in our group also got the chicken and waffles and really loved it! I was a big fan of the peach butter that came on the waffles! So yummy! 

With the location, I was a bit unsure what this place would be like, but I was very happy with it!!

We went there for lunch during our trip to Madeira Beach. We had a great meal, superb service and enjoyed the view. You have to pay $5 to park, but then when we visit John's Pass in Madeira Beach, you have to pay to park there as well as the public parking spots on the beach.

I like this place a lot. For an Indian restaurant it's extremely progressive (ipad based reward points/card system, non-Indian staff, female staff, etc.) The food is very good, especially if you go when the buffet is offered. I like that they put more "home cooking" type dishes on the buffet, not just the really heavy/creamy "special occasion" food that some places do. The buffet contains more than enough vegetarian and non vegetarian items and is frequently refreshed. I've had better overall Indian food at other places, which is why I did 4/5 stars and not 5/5-- but this is a VERY solid choice.
One of the best Peruvian restaurants I've ever been to. The food is authentic and the service is excellent!

Ok, let's just cut to the chase:
- Great ambiance
- A lot of attention to detail (as far as food and drink)
- Helpful staff
- Good location
- Offers great breakfast
- Unique selection of coffee
- Trendy (if you're into that)
Delco's Originals continues to lead the pack with quality Cheese Steaks and Hoagies !

i used to eat at this place all the time when i was like 4. haven't been there for atleast 10 years. it's always packed and i think i celebrated my birthday there. mom and dad stopped bring me there for a reason i guess.

Service first off was very friendly, no hurry or push in ordering-- menu was bacic Mexican/American cuisine- ordered the lunch "big burrito" -- excellent choice!!  Came with rice & beans, very large portion for lunch! (That's right!) Flavor not over the top but still really good, price was better than expected for portions-gotta go back and try other items on menu, let ya know- highly recommend! Seriously!!
Amazing cheesesteaks! Always fresh, hot, and tasty. Super convenient place to pick up beer with dinner also.

Needs a little improvement in the service department, though I can't be exactly sure whether this is just the situation for late lunch.

We've ordered an Omakase, which came magnificently serviced with an ice sculpture and fish that was delicious like I've not tasted in quite awhile.  Tuna, Salmon, Mackerel, Snapper, etc, etc, etc.  Presentation of the food other than an Omakase was also wonderful and the Spicy seafood soup was as they say "just what the doctor ordered"

Usually places like this you don't find the level of service and food presentation like this but this restaurant is a welcome exception.

I love Dreamers for their thick milkshakes that taste hand-scooped.  Near my office, they are a nice little getaway spot and offer some really cool drinks and snacks.  Definitely a change from your usual Starbucks.

I spent highschool here. Sometimes during, but mostly after. It didn't necessarily raise me, but it did lend a helping hand to creating my coffee addiction. 
I revisited fennarios a few days ago, and not much has changed... Except for the missing $0.25 cigarette jar ;) But regardless, I've always liked it here because its a place to just be, and they also make a good cup of coffee. I'm sure it'll be around for another 20 years from now if not more, and that's a good thing.

Visited today with reservations for our parents anniversary.  We had a party of 6.  2 of us ordered dark chicken and we were served a platter of chicken with 2 dark pieces.   
The veggies that were served were at best one serving per person.  The salad...Literally a bowl of iceberg lettuce. 
The waitress around at the end of the table and passed drinks and food to the first person to pass down the table.  Over priced!  Very disappointed with both the food , service and price.   To top it off my parents were never recognized for their anniversary!

Solid Vietnamese cuisine with more traditional Vietnamese breakfast dishes served such as banh uot "wet cakes," sunny side ups with sides of pate, homemade mayo, and a french baguette. There's of course pho, but do try the other soup based noodles -- Lettuce wraps, com tam (broken rice) dishes with marinated grilled pork, chicken, beef, seafood, etc. They've got a wide selection of dishes so there's plenty of choices for the picky eaters. Google the dishes for pictures when the description doesn't help!

Though lacking the interior glitz and glam of many other New Orleans sushi favorites, sushi brothers has quickly risen to the top of my list for sushi.  The service is prompt and attentive and the sushi is amazing and not overpriced.  Having been to pretty much every sushi restaurant in New Orleans, for now, if I do dare say, Sushi Brothers is the best sushi in town.

Yum, yum, yum! Everything was perfect. Hubby had the French Dip, and I had the Chicken Philly. 

Owner waited on us and talked us into dessert, a Guinness Stout Pub Cake, which he makes from scratch! Get it! It was delicious!

been going to pho places since 2012 and have tried alot of them. this has become my go to place. the staff is nice and friendly. the food has been great so far with everything we have tried. portions are nice and big. i will always tell ppl to go here. we have converted to here after being regulars at phostreet. and you know the staff knows their customers and you go there alot when the staff knows you when you walk in the door

Did their ten course tasting menu and it was AMAZING.

The spanish omellete, bacon wrapped dates...mmm... everything was incredible.

It was a great deal and I can't wait to go back.

Great service, great atmosphere, delicious food.

Went in for happy hour. Left sad. Ordered a "Basil Gin Smash" which had one leaf of basil, an indescribable amount of gin, and a whole lot of sugary syrup - they clearly don't know how to make a proper mixed drink behind the bar. Crab cakes were not fried, more like crab salad. No need to try them for dinner; the huge happy hour disappointment will save me some $$$$

I came here after driving by for two years..... I was pleasantly surprised. It was was great service by the bartender Nathan. Great drinks and our food was really good. It came out quick and was delish. I will definitely come back!

The food was very bland. The service was awful. I would strongly encourage anyone to look elsewhere. I have the biscuit and gravy with poached eggs. The biscuit was barely warm and not soft. The eggs overwhelmed of vinegar. I left a full plate and the waitress never asked if it was good or something was wrong.

Bud's gets credit for the uniqueness of a charcoal cooked burger in a fast food type setting. Good price as well. I wouldn't include this among my must-have destinations. 

Onion rings and French fries: paltry serving size and mediocre quality. 

Pleasant enough service.

Always a pleasant surprise!

Atmosphere      80    Clean. Modern.
Service             80     Always above average. Well trained.
Food                 95     Never, I mean never a bad deal
Value                90     Its all about the food

A must for a franchise type meal.
So happy to have a great breakfast restaurant in our neighborhood!  Friendly wait staff. The special cheese grits with Barbacoa was amazing!
One of the best fried fish places in STL! & it's black owned! Their hours do change sometimes so I always call ahead

First time eating here. Headed back home to New Orleans, land of good eats! Had the pulled pork sandwich. Not bad for what it was. Peppers made it really good. Just wish they would have had like a sauce to it. Overall, give it a 3 of 5.
The philly nachos were great. Needed more cheese but their cheese was what made the dish hands down!!

Came in with my girlfriend last night. Breadsticks were awesome as always, I ordered the carbonara, which was also good. Girlfriends pasta was a bit over cooked, however. Our server was knowledgeable and suggestive. I can't remember her name but she was great.

First impression: beautiful lobby, the grounds are beautiful. We were two couples and we went for each of our anniversaries. We went there looking for a nice quiet getaway. Much to our surprise, when we got to the pool it looked like raging waters. There were SO many little kids and strollers all over. For the size of the hotel, the pool size was TERRIBLE. There was no room to move anywhere, very claustrophobic. Although there is an adult pool, it's a piss pond. It's so small and did not look sanitary. On Saturday when we went to the pool, there was not one chair to sit on. We complained to the manager, who was very nice and understanding, and she offered us a free cabana the next day with free drinks and such. We took her offer and stayed in the cabana. You're in a luxurious cabana with a tv and everything but the kids were SO noisy and loud that you could not enjoy. What kid belongs in a $600+ per night hotel?! 

The rooms: We were on the first floor. The rooms are nice and cute and a good size. I guess since we were on the first floor there was an odd smell in the bathroom and the water pressure was horrible. Ladies, if you have long hair, prepare to be in the shower for hours to get the shampoo out. It felt like drizzle. The water doesn't get hot fast, you have to wait. And there is only one sink. The bathroom floors were very dirty as well, not acceptable at all! 

After years of wanting to go, we left highly disappointed. The only reason I'm giving two stars instead of one was because the staff was amazing and the manager, Alyssa, was so great, and went out of her way to help us. 

Do not even attempt to go down to the beach, you will get oil on your feet for sure. There was a massive oil spill. 

Bacara should take a drive down to the Four Seasons with a pen and paper and take notes on how a high end resort should be. 

PS: Don't even get me started about the Bistro Restaurant. I could go on for days about how bad it was. $45 for breakfast for one person?! HORRIBLE.

Advertised as closing at 10 pm. Attempted to get a Togo order at 9:30 and we were turned away and were told the kitchen was already closed... you're a restaurant that is advertised as closing at 10 why is your kitchen closed before closing time? Very disappointing.

It's my first time eating here and I was impressed. It's located in a beautiful area close to Forest Park and this adds eye appeal to a well prepared and delicious breakfast. Pancakes bacon eggs and grits filled me. I will definitely be back and try the regular entrees.

Dinner last night with two friends.  We had to wait about 25 minutes at the bar.  What a fabulous bar.  These were the BEST cocktails I have ever had in NOLA.  The cocktails have all fresh ingredients but unlike other bars "experimenting" with the chemistry of cocktails these are amazingly good not just merely interesting.  We sampled 4 different cocktails one more amazing than the other.  Kim the woman behind all of this is obsessed with her job.  Her fresh ingredients and concoctions are the reason everything is so great .  Plus she obviously has a special palate.

Finally  they were ready for us.  For a minute we had a table in the center of the room.  So noisy.  We asked to be moved to the corner and the staff was very accommodating. Especially the hostess.

Settled in we could look around the room.  The restaurant is an a house which is very charming on the outside.  The inside has been gutted and is basically a large contemporary space, vibeless.  With really bright lighting and crazy noisy.

Our server was friendly but the service was spotty.  For example before we ordered I said we were going to order wine.  She took our food order but ran off to another table before we could order the wine.   We were headed toward that beverage gap between cocktails and wine.  A gap feared by any New Orleanian.

The food was very good but not mind blowing in any way.  Lobster salad with 5 basils was interesting at first but sort of boring ultimately.  We were all sharing and eventually I could not give it away.   

Fried green tomatoes were excellent served with a tiny amount of crab lost in a forrest of fennel.  I love fennel but it was odd to see it as an ingredient in almost every dish.

Beef tartare was great.

Entrees :

Lamb was wonderful, large portion with potatoes and a kind of salsa that really did not belong on the plate.  The meat was perfect temperature and the mashed potatoes really delicious.

Mahi Mahi cooked to perfection.  Usually the most overcooked fish in most places.  More fennel.  Curried rice with so much lemongrass?  that it tasted soapy.

The pork chop was okay.  A bit dry with an herb rub on the surface that called too much attention to itself.  There was Kale which I love so much and it was good but undercooked in a way that makes you chew and chew and ...chew.

Finally the desserts, which I was keen on, because DOMINIQUE'S Is the only restaurant I know in NOLA that has my favorite Dessert in the world. FLOATING ISLAND.

Biggest food disappointment of the year.  Their Floating Island is an" interpretation" of the classic.  The Creme Anglaise was ...green!!!! ugh flavored with creme de menthe???  Floating next to the meringue was a bunch of weird fruit.  Citrus, blueberries strawberries and Kiwi????  WTF I tried the green creme anglaise it was frightening.  Out of loyalty to my passion I took one more taste of the custard to make sure I wasn't being close minded ugh!  My friends tried it ugh ugh ugh.  we left it untouched.  

Weird ending.  We got the bill and something was wrong so we checked it closely.  The server seemed to be avoiding us.  At one point my friend saw her look toward our table and roll her eyes.  We asked the bus person to send her she never arrived,  finally after another 10 minutes we asked another server to get our server.  

Finally she arrived and we told her that she forgot to add the $80.00 bottle of wine we drank to the bill.  Shocked she thanked us for our honesty.

We live downtown and while the food was very good the atmosphere was too bright and noisy and somehow the actions of our server were a weird last memory of the experience. 

 Do not see myself going back to Dominique's.  Will never say a bad word about it but don't think I would reccommend it.  IRIS in the FQ  hits all the notes DOMINIQUE strives for.  It is closer more inventive and better run.  I will always have an envie for those DOMINIQUE cocktails though.

Absolutely a disgusting diner. I was in Reno in the beginning of August and we came here to get an awful-awful burger, and there were flies EVERYWHERE in the diner. Didn't help that they had the back door wide open. Get a screen door!
And the service is horrible. My boyfriend and I were in front of the register waiting for someone to take our order, and the cashier girl was standing behind the register texting, telling her coworkers about the guy she was texting, munching on red vines (health code violation! You can't eat behind that counter in the food service industry), and totally ignoring us. Then some REALLY sweaty girl took our order, and she was rude! I got a little tongue tied saying my order, and Sweaty laughed at me and gave me a dirty look!
The extra star is only because it was a lot if food for a good price. Given, it was probably fly meat seeing as there were at LEAST 50 flies flying around.

This a wonderful restaurant!  Our family of four made a day-of reservation. The kids shared gnocchi and calamari with side salads, my husband had a kale salad, and I had the vegetable farro bowl (which was excellent).  For dessert we shared the best peanut butter pie ever!  Cocktails for the adults and frozen lemonade for the kids were great as well.  The vibe was more intimate and hip, exactly what we were looking for.  We're visiting Wesley Chapel from Massachusetts and feel lucky that we found this restaurant!

I grew up around Chick-fil-A and the memories are way better than what is here in Reno. We ordered through the drive thru and they forgot a sauce that we ordered, the chicken strips serving looked like a child's size order, and they also (sadly) served us very old sweet tea that tasted like it had been sitting out since yesterday. 

I understand they are still new and trying to get things right so I will definitely give them another chance, but as of today - Raising Cane's is far superior.

We are fans of Emeril so we bellied up at NOLA in New Orleans. NOLA was packed but we had a reservation and we seated right on time. NOLA runs like a well oiled machine and has food to die for. Cool atmosphere in an old French Quarter building, superb service and outstanding food.

Went here last night with family visiting from out of town. Ambience was nice. Food was okay but not amazing. 2 stars is for the portion size (pretty small amount of food) for the price ($23 for 4-5 small tortellini)...I don't think it's worth it.  We had to order another pasta dish (another $20ish) just to feel a little satisfied.

Location great - right on State Street Service fantastic. Food is varied and all good - we ate there a couple of times! They obviously specialise in Danish baking, so be sure to try out their pastries!
The best service in town! We were impressed by how nice and attentive the servers were. We went there two nights in a row! Our servers Stacy and Jordan were exceptional!

Really delicious.  Great food all-around.  I would highly recommend this place based on our experience.  Nice outdoor seating area and they had caribbean music playing.  Food was delicious, staff was nice, and ambiance was relaxed.

We ordered the Chicago-style deep dish with sausage to see how it stacks up.  Unfortunately, the poor weather conditions extended our drive time home, which made it hard to render a verdict on the pizza at its peak.  However, nobody in our family is particularly fond of chunky sauce and there are a lot of BIG chunks in this sauce.  All the other elements seemed fine, but sauce is critical.  I should mention the flavor of the sauce was good but after scraping off 50% of it, the ratio was off.   Not sure if we'll be back or not.  We've tried and like all the other prominent Chicago style pizzerias.  The service was excellent and prompt here and I hope they do well!

My favorite aspect of this place is their cool patio and bar. I also love the concept that everything they serve starts with the letter C. We went later on a Saturday afternoon and they had a limited menu available. They have a full bar and craft cocktails. Had a delicious fried chicken sandwich which was nice and juicy. And the fries were delicious. Friendly service.

I frequent the El Sitio location at Fairview next to McDonalds and have never been disappointed.  

Recently I was in the area so I decided to try this location on Calle Real behind the 7/11.  

When I ordered I was the only person in the place.  After placing my usual #4 taco order I went to get salsa and Pico De Gallo.  The door to the bathroom was open and I noticed a smell similar to a gas station bathroom - nasty.  Too late now - I moved to the other side of the "restaurant" and waited for my order.  It took 10 - 15 minutes to get my order and when I sat down I noticed portion of meat was half what I normally received.  The meat was cold as well as the two corn tortillas.  The meat wasn't "Adobado" it was something else altogether.  I had asked for onion and cilantro on my taco which didn't happen, but by that time I decided to eat and run.  

(Run far, far away and never come back!)

There was nothing pleasant about this experience.

I went here for lunch with a friend today and the food was really tasty. The lunch special is a great deal and aside from slightly slow service (for a relatively empty restaurant it took a while to get our food) and interesting decor, this place was a win. I will certainly return!

I was really excited to try Piccione, especially since I live right down the street. The thing is, whoever owns/operates this establishment is out of their mind...it's a coffee and pastry shop that doesn't open until 11:00?!?!  By the time they open, most have already had a coffee from Kayak's or, dare I say it, Starbucks.

When I finally did lounge late enough to get a coffee and pastry, I dragged myself over and ordered a latte with a Chocolate Chip Cannoli.  Coffee was decent, nothing spectacular.  The cannoli was disappointing at best.  I made sure it was ricotta-filled, but it still tasted too sweet and fluffy.  If you like extremely sweet cannolis with a flavorless shell, you're in luck.
I like experiencing different food and ambience. DuBu gave me both. Amazing food!...spicy, but delicious.

My husband and I received a gift certificate for Grimaldi's. The service was great. The wine Prospect was very good as well. A glitch in the Sunday afternoon was and I don't know why or what the schedule was, but when we got there today they told us we would have to wait until the rocks were changed in the ovens. Ok no problem. But why on earth would you do it during early dinner hour on a Sunday. Busy time?  About 30 minutes wait. However, I do not know about the process to say this was a negative. We were not pressed for time. We order a pizza vegetarian with pesto. It was a little dry. I love pizza and when I take a bite and have to drink water to get it down that is a problem. Maybe with new "rocks" or whatever they did to the brick oven made the crust a bit over cooked.
Authentic Caribbean food at its finest!! Everything is prepared with love and care and the guy that works there is super nice! The atmosphere is small and laid back.

We were planning a beach wedding and in keeping with the beach theme, planned to have the reception dinner at The Original Crabby Bills in IRB. From the beginning, we had an exemplary experience with their team. Our first experience was with Madison and Matt, Jr. in the marketing department who booked us the perfect space for our party of 17. We were given a wide variety of menu options as our party included vegetarians as well as landlubbers! We had a tasting of Matt Jr's menu creations which included a seafood cornucopia: lobster claws, crab legs, shrimp, mussels and clams. Plus, butternut squash ravioli, Caribbean chicken, grilled corn on the cobb, delectable garlic-roasted potatoes, and coconut-infused coleslaw which knocked our socks off! Dessert featured made from scratch key lime pie that left our taste buds tingling! After the tasting, we added some special requests which they accommodated without question and priced very fairly for us.

The wedding reception dinner was one of the most memorable events not only of our lives, but for all those who attended. Upon our arrival, a huge Crabby Bill's greeting was written on an entire wall! Andrew, our server, handled the entire room by himself and did the job of 3 servers! After the drink order, the food flowed in a steady stream. When Andrew brought out a 30lb boatload of mixed seafood, a communal gasp turned into laughter! We laughed even harder when we realized that nobody was talking - we were all consumed in consuming the abundant, decadent meal. How we even had room for dessert astounds us - but along with an awesome key lime pie, Matt Jr. made the bride a special order apple strudel and mixed berries with homemade cream. Throughout the meal, employees and servers came in to wish us well and offer kind words.

The entire wedding party was absolutely blown away by the food, the service and the love that went into preparing for the biggest day of our lives. If you are looking to have a beach wedding and/or are looking for an amazing catered experience, give the folks at The Original Crabby Bill's a call. They will make your event memorable beyond your wildest dreams.
Never disappoints!! Food was amazing, service was great! Will continue to frequent! By far the best Mexican in town!

Went to this place in March, was far from a good experience. First they put us at a high top. I told them I had problems doing a high top due to some leg problems. They told me there was nothing they could do. There was empty tables just in an unassigned section. To much for them to make an accommodation. After twenty minutes of standing they finally offered me a table. Ate my meal which was lackluster. You are better off going across the way to Firebirds they run their place better

I really wanted to like this place. I love all of Tucson's local breweries, but I just wasn't impressed. The space itself was really chill and enjoyable. We ordered a flight to taste all the varieties since it was our first time. We're IPA lovers, so we sort of enjoyed their IPAd, but really everything just tasted watered down (I think we had stout, blonde, and ipas) and didn't have discernible body or flavor. It was just bland. But I will say I'm not a beer expert. I've just had a wide variety of beers from most of the breweries and craft beer spots, and this just wasn't as good as any I've tried. 

The service was pretty terrible too. It took about 30minutes for them to drop off our beer. We also ordered chips and salsa and never got it, so we left. Meh.
One of my favorite Happy Hours in town.  Reasonably priced and a great variety of appetizers to choose from.  The staff is always attentive and friendly and I highly recommend giving it a try.

Ordered various nachos.  A couple of different plates.  Each one had nachos.  The problem is, what if I can't eat the entire plate?  nachos are ruined.  They do not separate their nachos and toppings.  So when you get the order via doordash or something, they are already soggy, and then it is impossible to save left overs!

SEPARATE THE NACHOS FROM THE TOPPINGS!!!  Man!  I am not even a trained chef and I know that much!  Most of the chefs in Greenwood are idiots and just don't think of this stuff.

Instead of being called "IHOP," we should probably call the place "I Hope," as in "I Hope I survive this meal." 

What was I thinking? Was I thinking?

I mean, within 3-4 blocks there's a Culver's. There's a Fort Ben Pub. There's Sherwood Cafe. There's Cafe Audrey. They all have better burgers and infinitely better atmospheres. The saving grace here, without question, was my fairly attentive server who made sure I got a couple refills of sweet tea (including one to go). 

But hey, I thought to myself "I've never tried this IHOP." Let's try it. 

Again, what was I thinking?

As one of the businesses that has popped up in this area around Fort Ben in the last few years, IHOP is one of the newer model IHOP restaurants - you could sort of think of that shiny new entry-level Hyundai you buy that glistens in the sun until a bird poops on it and the bird poop actually dents the car. 

I'm kidding. Not really.

There are a couple accessible parking spots up front, fairly close to ADA compliant but not quite. You enter the double-glass doors and arrive at a hosting area where you will get attention (though from what I've read that may depend on the mood at the time). To your left and to your right are dining areas comprised of both tables and booths. I was escorted to a 4-top, though one of those yellow "caution" markers had to be moved so I could get through. 

After the crew debated for a few minutes who would be my server, though I'd already been told who it would be, she arrived and, quite honestly, she was the highlight of the experience. 

I checked out the menu - of course, IHOP does emphasize breakfast but at about 2pm I opted for lunch of a cheeseburger with fries with a sweet tea (which is on their menu as if it's new). 

While I wasn't exactly expecting a brilliant meal, this processed beef patty, and I'm giving it credit for being real beef, wasn't just a lifeless beef patty but it was more like a suicidal beef patty. It's like it recognized it was going to be served at IHOP and just gave up. Served with one piece of limp lettuce and a tomato that looked like it may have had a late night tussle with the beef patty and lost, this cheeseburger began IHOP's journey toward a 2-star rating. While the fries were slightly better, browned and seasoned in a relatively slight serving, they couldn't compensate for an overpriced burger. 

At just over $11, I couldn't help but think I'd have eaten at Culver's for less and Sherwood for less or close to it. While Cafe Audrey would have been a couple bucks more, I'd have gotten better food, better service and a better atmosphere. 

I wanted to like this meal a whole lot more - mostly because I'd taken a mental health day from work and wanted to have a nice meal. Ultimately, I didn't. While it certainly wasn't the worst I've ever had, or even close to it, with so many better options within a few blocks there's no reason to think I'll ever go back.

The space: Nola is right in the French Quarter, and was just a couple blocks from our hotel, which I liked. It's a multi-leveled spot, and a glass elevator makes the trip from the 1st to the 2nd floor one that requires few steps. It's a pretty small area, but they have used the space well and it feels more open and large than it actually is.

The food: Excellent, refined cooking using traditional New Orleans ingredients and techniques. New twists on familiar dishes. The baked oysters and crab meat was so good, like Oysters Rockefeller, with a generous lump of crab meat in each bite. Next, I had the shrimp and grits, and it was over-the-top good. Big barbecued shrimp on top of cheddar grits with smoked bacon and porcini mushrooms.

The service: Perfect. Teams of three serve each table, with a lead server and two helping out. Each member of the team was engaged with our table, asking us how everything was, offering up favorite dishes from the menu, and making us comfortable with friendly small talk. Management and/ or the maitre d' were visible on the floor throughout our meal, checking in with everyone and spreading good cheer. Never did we want for a thing while we were there.

my expectations for this business were set high. my esthetician (simply sweet sugaring) is close with the owners and tells me the food is good. she knows i'm YES and my standards are high lol. 

the location in greenwood is currently closed for remodeling. i do know there's been some staffing issues as most businesses have faced due to covid. 

i knew this location was on the west side but i did not know it was in the exact spot the former go carting food place was. (their food wasn't good so this is truly a great exchange) 

i called and ordered ahead, the person who took my order was nice. i'm going to say now that they didn't direct well when i got inside and i went to the bar but they have an actual pickup area (awesome) 

i ordered a sausage pizza with light sauce and extra cheese. personally the serving size was too big and i hope they consider a personal or just one size smaller. the pizza was good but it didn't have the reheat value i like [the next day]. the garlic knuckles are the best bread i've EVER had and i've thought about them every day since. their cheese sauce is good af.

i will def return for sure. i'm hoping to try their chicken alfredo
Great coffee. Friendly service. Why not give it a try instead of going to Starbucks? Young crowd.

Being from the South, my expectations  were high. I was disappointed.  I got 3 lbs of pulled pork. I was not happy about spending $40. The pork wasn't smoked well,  and it was dry.  I won't be going back. Disappointed customer.

My girlfriend and I came here for a nice Valentine's Day dinner last night. I ordered Linguini with crab meat, shrimp, and scallops topped with marinara sauce. Everything was very delicious. Only thing that I could say is that they went a little short on the shrimp. She ordered Chicken Parm and it was good. We also both ordered their Pasta Fagioli Soup and it was fantastic! Hostess was very nice and we had great service. Even had a reservation and arrived 15 minutes late, but they still took us right in. We'd definitely come back!

Great pizza at the right place! I'm kind-of learning about pizza, the New York way! Hey I love pizza no matter how its done as long as its not over or undercooked. Pizza by the slice was reasonably priced, since I don't get hardly any toppings anyway. The food didn't take that long as it didn't appear to be microwaved (as I thought!). Again, cheers on bringing a new kind of place that takes snacking to a new level!

This place rocks!  And their martinis are always made spot on!  The only reason I'm not giving 5/5 stars is I decided to walk down the street one night when the Drunken Fish was packed and found an equally yummy (although less fantastic ambiance) sushi place that was much more reasonably priced.
