So as long as you go here realizing you are paying an upcharge for a two story "hip" place in the CWE, by all means go right ahead.  My favorite is the rainbow roll.  :)

Boise Fry is consistently my favorite burger spot in the Boise area. The burgers always taste fresh and are not over thought. The fries are some of the best I've ever had. I'd recommend the classic burger or the vegan burger and you can't go wrong with any selection of fries you choose. Make sure you sample the blueberry ketchup!

I don't know, 3.5 stars I guess.  Very nice looking restaurant.  We went for lunch and there was only one other table seated.  The filet in the filet and shrimp was VERY good, the shrimp was overpowered by the hibachi sauce, though.  The sushi was very small and we couldn't taste much of the fish, but it was very well made/cut, very tidy.  The restaurant is kind of tucked away and really is way too swanky to be where it is.  I might be back, might not.  Samurai is where it's at in Nashville.
Went at lunch on Monday, they were out of f#*^ing buns! How can you stay in business being this stupid?
The wife picked up breakfast for us this morning. Would have been a whole lot better if they didn't serve us half-cooked, hard qpotatoes.

Breakfast burritos. Oh, dear, sweet motherloving god those breakfast burritos are magical.

Load up the green salsa at the salsa bar and pour onto each bite.

Hands down: BEST HANGOVER MEAL.

Love the amount of beers on tap here! Their rewards program is pretty good too as they'll have specials for the 'hop cat pack' every so often. Also, can't go wrong with their crack fries, mac n cheese, or pulled pork sandwich

I find myself in Indianapolis for work again this week.  I was feeling something lighter, like in the fish category.  I really like Salt on Mass, but decided to try a new place.  CharBlue didn't disappoint!  The hostess was so friendly and welcoming, which started things out on a positive note.  Sometimes hosts judge when you ask for a table for one and I was appreciative that she did not. I opted for a seat at the bar.  The bartender was also friendly and offered up a few recommendations.  I ordered a glass of wine and was torn between the scallops and the swordfish.  Ultimately, I opted for the scallops because of the bartender's recommendation.  For starters, I was pleasantly surprised at how large the starter salad was!  I could have probably gotten away with that an extra roll.  Also, whatever butter they provide for the rolls was so good!  I had to stop myself from just licking that!  Because, you know, butter.  The scallop presentation was so pretty!  I LOVED the risotto.  The rice was cooked perfectly and the light lemon sauce over the top was a surprising touch.  My only disappointment was that the scallops could have been a little hotter.  The risotto was hot, but the scallops were more on the warm side.  One was also not quite cooked thoroughly, but I was disappointed enough to send it back.  I was pretty full after the salad and opted just not to finish it anyway.  If I lived in the area (or if I find myself back here again for work), I'd definitely come back!
Went there for a birthday party. 18 people. Ordered a fillet it was the worst i ever seen. Came out over cooked (burnt). Quailty of the the steaks complete garbage. Will never go back

Oh my God, Federal Donuts was definitely astonishing. The atmosphere and staff are phenomenal. Every single thing that I have purchased was really good and I would come again to have it again! Service was great and every one working here was very nice and generous. It's totally worth it.

I heard so many great things about Cleavers and had to try after moving to Philly. I'd say it's worth like 85% of the hype.

I've had a few different cheesesteaks here: the regular, one with fresh mozz, and one with mozz sticks. All were pretty good, but the last is especially delicious. It's not cheap but the portions are pretty hefty. If you're eating in, there's a decent-sized second floor with tables. It's not the cleanest and it's always kind of chilly, but it's whatever. It's not tryna be a date spot. 

A good go-to and only a few blocks from the SEPTA so you can ride home and fall into a cheesy coma.

Decided to try Ruby Tuesday's before going to movies.  Just looking for a burger with the salad bar.  Food was as I expected but I had a problem ordering beer.  I was there during happy hour.  My wife and I were sitting in a booth 10 feet from the bar...the empty bar I might add.  When our waitress came to take our drink order, I asked her what they had going for happy hour.  The waitress said that happy hour is only for drinks ordered at the bar.  So I looked at her, pointed to the bar and said that maybe I'll order my beer at the bar and bring it to my table.  The waitress said that can't be done.  I'd have to drink it at the bar.  I ordered an ice tea, had my burger & salad but I  resolved that no more Ruby Tuesday's for me.  What a ridiculous policy.  Happy Hour is happy hour and should apply to the drink regardless of where it is ordered!

Wow...so disappointed in our  time here tonight.  We came here to celebrate a special occasion, and I left without having eaten a meal. We have been here several times before, have recommended to others and have brought out of town guests...well, no more.  Things have gone down hill unfortunately. This place has a unique atmosphere and delicious cocktails...but it stops there now. For appetizers, we got the truffle popcorn and duck fat fries...delicious but portions are much smaller now than they used to be.  I ordered the wagyu steak ($36) and my husband ordered the duck($26).  The duck was mediocre and the steak was not even warm and very chewy (I had to spit it out.  I sent back the steak immediately and asked for their burger instead as I've had it previously and was quite tasty. Well...it took over 20+ minutes to get my burger and then as I cut it in half, found it very raw on the inside.  So, after being served two bad dishes, I didn't eat a meal. I politely asked to speak to the manager but he never came, so I seeked him out myself to make him aware of our experience before writing a review.  To my dismay, he didn't seem overly concerned. He only said that they had some new people in the kitchen. I was not looking to get anything comped(which he didn't offer anything) but was at least hoping for a  genuine apology and how could he make our experience better tonight or in the future...not a word was said.  I do not feel the manager handled this with care or professionalism.  There are many other upscale restaurants in the Tampa area that we can and will patron that care more about quality and customer service...unacceptable. And one last thing to mention, when I go to a restaurant to spend at least a couple hundred dollars, I would like my menu not to be coming apart and have splattered food all over it...smh. The owners really need to look into the details of cleanliness, food prep/quality and management.

I've eaten here countless times specifically on Friday nights. On January 24th,2020 myself and my two 6 year old daughters were turned a way very rudely at the door. We were told we couldn't get in if we didn't have a reservation because the entire restaurant was reserved ! 5:30pm and i was being told the entire restaurant was reserved as i looked around the place was empty.. i spoke with the manager and was told "we rather reserve our entire restaurant rather than wait for walk Ins." I have never been so disappointed... i sure hope that race wasn't a factor  because if it was SHAME ON YOU MIIKIMOTOS! I will never patronize this establishment!
Really delicious pizza ! I love how you can add so many toppings all included in one price.

This is just what our little town of Tarpon needed, the food is excellent and the staff is great and attentive. We have been twice now and are very impressed. Portion sizes are great and our 1.5 year old loves their Mac n Cheese. I have had the lasagna twice and it is is very cheesy and good and my husband loved the pesto pasta.
I love pats steaks. In a city famous for its cheese steaks this is a great option. The food is always consistent and the service is prompt

Super underwhelming. Let's "dive" right in. The hostess was frosty. I had called and asked to move our res up a half hour and they said no. We showed up early and they let us sit anyway... so yeah. I got an old menu which was super upsetting when I ordered something they didn't have. The food was below average. The bread was warm but all the seasoning was just laying on the top and got all over.  Tomato burrata salad was like anywhere else and the soup was good!  I made a mistake ordering the vegetarian meal- pasta with "seasonal veggies" in marinara- the sauce was worse than canned and the veggies were blah. I left most of it there but was thankful I had had soup and bread so I wasn't starving. The atmosphere was great for big groups- there were several. You can be loud and enjoy drinks. The noise level was ...exciting. Not good for intimate dates.

We are not from the area, but are passing through for a few months and craving great coffee that is a locally owned business. We were impressed with the Yelp Reviews and rating for this establishment and the fact that a few employees form the medical field highly recommend their coffee :)
The basics: The business location was decent (near a veterinarian's office, a local restaurant, and Trader Joe's) with plenty of available parking and from the looks of the inside, it looks really clean. The staff (in the numerous occasions we came to place our order, we've seen the same 3 staff) were always courteous and friendly. Surprisingly, they were even open on Easter Sunday!
The order: The usual order are Iced Soy Chai Latte with extra chai and Iced Dirty Chai with 2 or 3 shots (dependent on the day's mood). We tried the Azteca Mocha once or twice, but it didn't "hit the spot" so we stuck with what works. The Dirty Chai was delicious and refreshing; it reminded us of Philz back home and we are grateful for that. The Soy Chai Latte was creamy and has the right combination of spice. Thank you, Caffe Luce for providing us with the caffeine boost and yummy liquid gold during our months long stay here in Tucson...
FYI - We have been here in the Tucson area since March and should be leaving soon. Since our stay, we have mostly been sheltering in place, but on occasion do place orders for pick up or to go. Of all the places we've been to, we have not been able to write a Yelp review until now; therefore, the numerous Yelp reviews written in the past few days is simply due to us being able to actually take the time to write them. This is not a fake account or review and we simply provide our reviews based on OUR experience and taste buds/preference (same as other Yelpers). So for those who address our reviews as "fake" (Teaholic), that is your opinion and are entitled to it. Obviously the other reviews we wrote while we're here in Tucson aren't all bad (low in number of stars). Take for example this review of Ni Hao, Caffe Luce, Beyond Bread, Back Dough, etc.
The place was really nice, because it was in the Hilton. But the food was just average and not worth the price.
Best Sunday brunch in the city. The Breakfast pizza is phenomenal. Chicken and waffles and sausage beignet also great. It's hard not to go there every Sunday.

Not our first time, but my boyfriend and I stopped in here on a Football Sunday (in between games).  It's like the cook in the kitchen was taking the day off.  It wasn't a team effort, but our waiter was doing well.  It was all downhill from there.  The problem was the cuts of meat on the burnt ends (appetizer and entree portions) were nothing else but cuts of fat.  The meat was chewy and very much NOT worth the price.  It was like City BBQ on their bad day - only much worse.  Only 3 out of the group of pieces were good. For two people, we paid $43 and some change.  We always order water - we aren't ever charged for sugary beverages.  So, that price was just for bad food.

Everything else was somewhat edible.  The brisket was a little more dry than normal so I used the BBQ sauce to enhance the flavors, however, I feel like there wasn't much good in it to make this a memorable meal.  It lacked finesse, taste, and tenderness.  

We won't be back, so continue with your lazy cuttings of meat.  It was the worst meal we ever had.  We should have gone to Weber Grill.  It was an insult to culinary creations in the kitchen.  Gordon Ramsay would have thrown a fit.

From the the spicy fresh beans with chips to their cantarito cocktails, Si amigos knows how to Mexican.

For food, I usually go for the carne asada burrito, but the enchiladas are a close second. 

The service is great and most of the staff has been there since I first started going years ago, so its nice to see familiar faces.

Overall, Si amigos is hands down my favorite Mexican restaurant in Reno.

I always enjoy the food when I order. I like that they  are always adding specials that can be found on their Facebook page. The empanadas are really good or any of their burritos which are more than generous in size. Their Elixir is a homemade beverage that is refreshing too!

With family in from out of town and a special occasion to celebrate, we made reservations for the New Year's dinner at Flyte.  As one of the last seatings of the evening, we were seated late, and the service overall  ended up a little frazzled as it was obvious the restaurant had had an overwhelming night.  Although the food was excellent, the meal was poorly coordinated and we were informed we could not have the dessert we wanted because they had run out. Overall, it was disappointing for an expensive special occasion meal.

But what happened afterwards was remarkable.  After we expressed our disappointment, Scott (one of the co-owners) responded immediately and invited us back for a "make-up" dinner, which we scheduled for the Valentine's weekend.  We took a chance and went back. This time, every detail was attended to.  Scott personally greeted us when we arrived.  Our server, Paul, was warm, attentive, and efficient.  The food was fresh, well-prepared, and had interesting elements of local cuisine with old-world influences. We enjoyed the creative wine pairings, which introduced us to a few new wines we might not have noticed otherwise. In short, everything was wonderful.  

Many restaurants claim to value service, but few would be willing to go to such lengths to actually deliver on their promise--Flyte is one of them.  Highly  recommended.
Love this place I'm Vietnamese and pretty picky with viet food and this place is awesome with everything and super fresh. Best place in pa.

I've tried this restaurant a few times now and my opinion hasn't really been swayed. I think the prices are great and they do give you a good amount of food. I've really only ordered the tacos but it was bland. The chicken taco was a little dry too. On the bright side the salsa was good.

We stopped by for a quick walk around and I was impressed by the offerings inside. Very reminiscent of Napa Valley's and LA's market. We stopped by the charcuterie and got a cone and the portion size was a lot, so good bang for your buck. There's a nice variety of juices, seafood, pasta, etc. A great place to visit!

Yims is my go-to for ingredients I can't obtain other places in town. So many amazing finds here! They usually have everything I need to get on the shopping list and more. 

Parking is tricky as it is limited and cramped.

Finally tried his gem! I was randomly trying to eat gluten free for a week and decided to go for their gluten free menu. So glad I did! I had the curry pad thai which was way better than any standard pad Thai if you ask me. Kind of like a super chill party with a group of eclectic friends that just all happen to get along really well...except the party was in my mouth. Service was helpful and attentive as well. Unique foods, killer flavor, friendly ppl, what's not to love? I will be back!!
Wow. tasty!!!  They know how to make a burrito!!!  Not dry over cooked like some places.  The tortilla soup was smashing!!  Nothing boring here!  Great interior.  Well done. Bring me the Mezcal

I feels strange to write a review for a fast food restaurant, but this particular Chick-fil-A deserves 5 stars. 

Always been a fan of their food---always fresh and you can't go wrong with any of their chicken products. Chicken strips with the Chick-fil-A sauce is my go-to. 

I have to mention the excellent customer service here though. Everyone was friendly, and for the 15 minutes I was sitting down I was offered a refill on my Coke twice by two different staff members, and each thine they asked if the food was good, etc. Absolutely impressive, especially for a fast food place!
Sometimes the service is decent and quick, but for the most part it is unorganized and extremely slow.  I would search for the next closest Manhattan bagel before coming to this location.

1. Cash Only
2. Tacos Overpriced for Quality (also...aren't these burritos?)
3. Tijuana Poutine is good

They did orders of wings around the Super Bowl for $5 that were really, really, good. If that were a menu mainstay at the same price & portion I'd go up a star.

For now the only reason that it's not a 2-star place is bc the Tijuana Poutine is something that I will order again.

This place is my favorite place for Thai food. They do have a wide variety of Thai food to appease the whole family. I love their pad woo sen. It's glass noodles with a protein and vegetables. 

Furthermore, the sushi is fantastic as well. You definitely won't go hungry after eating here. My sister loves the yellow curry here. It is so nice to have a restaurant that can satisfy the whole family when it comes to eating out.

Sushi at its best for the region!

Looking for cold beer, fresh fish and the latest roll selections this place has it all. I was most impressed by the fish quality like the "Uni"sea urchin which was just as good as if I were in Los Angeles or Tokyo. The toro was good quality and texture. 

I would highly recommend this Sushi Bar in St. Louis Mo., you won't be disappointed.

Nice classic chill vibe but the food was underwhelming. Nachos had good flavor but super skimpy on the cheese and not served with salsa. Asparagus fries were pretty good but half had the tough chewy white part on the bottoms left on. The Bam Sammy was decentsirloin sandwich (steak over cooked), Burger meat was good but the "Fork  Sauce" is a bland Mayo mushed slaw or like a bad thousand island. Overall just meh...

My girlfriend and I went for brunch.  The atmosphere was great.  We were happy to see mojitos on the drink menu and started off with that.  I like mojitos because they're not too sweet.  They were the worst mojitos I've ever had.  It was a 6 or 8 ounce glass filled mainly with ice and limes, but almost no mint.  When we tasted them I think they must have forgotten the sugar syrup.  I don't like sweet but this was ridiculous.  
We were a little surprised at how limited the menu was but found an asparagus and goat cheese omelette and crab benedict.  The omelette was very good, with a nice fruit garnish.  The Hollandaise sauce on the crab Benedict was cold.  We returned it.  While we waited we shared the omelette.  It was a good thing because we had finished the omelette by the time they returned the crab Benedict.  I think they took the fruit garnish off and put it under the heal lamp because the eggs were now hard cooked.  
At this point we just wanted to leave.  We noticed the drinks were taken off but not until after they figured out the tax, so we ended up paying for tax on the drinks we didn't have.  
Not coming back.

I would like to give these guys a better rating but the morning crew (11:00ish)almost always gives me my Diet Coke without the limes being squeezed. When I order lime in my drink I want it squeezed or you cannot taste it and I pay extra for it. So I have to dig them out with my fingers and squeeze them myself. It ends up all over my car and me. Lazy morning crew. All the other crews are great.

Great fried chicken. The complimentary honey glazed donut was ok. It was a little disconcerting to find blood oozing out of my chicken when I bit into it, but hey, I like my chicken on the rare side occasionally. Next time I'll try one of the fancier donuts, and I'll check the meat more thoroughly before chowing down.

the only real thing this place has going for itself is the view and the cute waitresses. other than that, the food is not worth it. the burger had absolutely no taste to it and was very dry. the burger supposedly comes with their "secret sauce" which is still a secret since they dont put any on the burger so no one can find out. even with ketchup and mustard the burger was pretty much garbage. the fish tacos were deep fried fish nuggets, again with no flavor. the fish taco was just mush i my mouth. their bloody mary was good tho. got mine extra spicy and it was probably the best thing they served me this afternoon. go here for everything but the food.

The best oyster ever. PERIOD!!!! 
The oysters are so good that we had to try them twice.
Very pleasant atmosphere, friendly people....they have the best ribs and salmon over rice at the LIL THAI MARKET  the Amish chicken wings melt in your mouth

Great place for breakfast or lunch. Breakfast can be ordered for lunch! Had a yummy turkey sandwich with bacon and avocado. Fries were really yummy too! My nephew had a PB&J Cheeseburger. Didn't sound good to me but he really enjoyed it!

Great T-Bone steak. Very tasty. Onion rings were the best & only 4 bucks for a martini. 
Service was also good. We went there 2 weeks in a row while visiting Tucson.

GARBAGE! Had only double shots of Patron which the bill came to 98.00 bucks. The waitress not only overlooked my table but the one behind us. Never going there again. Never heard of a franchise with such over priced drinks nor an impersonable waitress..

Just in town visiting, my buddy took me here for breakfast, I had the chicken fried steak and eggs.
It was the most delicious chicken fried steak that I have ever had.
Prices are fair, food well cooked and service was great

Stopped by this little spot in our way home from a weekend getaway. Food looked and smelled great so we were excited to find a good spot on Mother's Day that wasn't packed with a long wait. We ordered lunch and breakfast and I asked for one small request which was super light toasted bread, and over easy eggs with my breakfast. Neither one of those requests was met, my bread was literally blackened and my eggs were so thoroughly cooked they had hardly any yolk. The restaurant wasn't nearly busy enough for this to have been okay, and had our server checked the ticket before running our food out she would've (I hope) had it fixed. I didn't bother to complain because I was hungry, and thought it was fine but then our server didn't even check up on us to see how we were doing or how the food tasted to us yet had plenty of time to do side work and connect with other tables. Not very happy with this.

Kind of hidden in Clearwater (but right around the corner from Pair O Dice and Rapp Brewing), this was a fun find on the Tampa-area brewery trail. Brand new tasting room has a ton of seating, TVs, and they even give you snack mix with your beer. Kind of a rustic, nautical theme that is comfortable with all of the windows on the building. Cool space.

Beer was very good too. A dozen or so choices of various styles with four Belgian beers as well. I did a flight and a pint and all were quite tasty. They will let you taste them too so you can decide what to get. I really liked how the bartenders knew the beer and had lots of suggestions. Check this place out if you are in Clearwater.

The restaurant is located in a building with other restaurants so the parking can be a bit of a challenge.   The door is on the southeast side of the building.  There is outdoor seating with heaters available, a bar and a pretty large restaurant.  The menu is the same as the other Tridents.  There are TVs all around the the restaurant and one very large one, all featuring sports events if that is your thing.  It is owned by a veteran and they give a discount to veterans which is a nice thing to do.  The happy hour is pretty good and includes discounts on drinks and small plates (1/2 to 2/3 the size of regular menu).

I was with a large group of people-we sat at 2 long tables.  There was one waitress and she was great.  Orders were correct and timing was quite good.  I had the clam chowder which came with sprinkled bacon and green onions on it and the appetizer crab cakes.  The clam chowder was very good-bacon gave it a nice flavor-wish there had been a little more bacon though.  The crab cakes had a lot of crab meat.   They were a bit burnt on the bottom but still tasted good.  They came with a spicy aioli.  For the size, the price ($15) seemed a bit high for an appetizer though.  They tasted good though.

I was really looking forward to coming here for awhile.  We did the tasting menu for $39, which definitely gives you a nice assortment of food.  You get 4 courses, including dessert.  While the food was decent and the service was good, it boggled my mind that this is supposed to be a "Jewish" food restaurant, but has many items with pork.  I know the place isn't kosher, but I don't think you can call it Jewish food from the diaspora if pork is involved.  For the money, Zahav is much better.

In town from Atlanta, and a serious fish taco lover. This taco stand rates about #1 taco stand for 2013, for me. I had no expectation, other than filling the void....but this was amazing. The size was just right, the taste was fabulous......get there quick

Newton's Fourth Law of Motion :  A sandwich spot which has has claim to making "America's Best Sandwich" by the Travel Channel, and is located a mere four blocks from my hotel, will have a tendency to put an object into motion which otherwise would have been at rest.  I was not going to rest until I devoured one of these gems. 

Upon entering the Reading Terminal Food market, I discovered an expanse of what I can only hope will be equivalent to what the Food Court looks like in heaven. 

DiNic's Pulled Pork with Provolone and roasted peppers. What was I waiting for? The laws of physics would not be denied.

Do yourself a big favor and top it off with a fresh soft pretzel from Miller's Twist.
Awesome Po-boy tonight with shrimp and fries - best fries EVER outside of duck grease fries... Alligator bites to go with fries for the kids - excellent

Great food - outrageously small portions. Stopped by for a special dinner with my girlfriend. The prices for everything are a bit out of control, but I knew what I was getting myself into ahead of time. Everything was tasty, but I left hungry $140 later. Wouldn't recommend it if you are looking for more than tapas sized plates.

Weird atmosphere, i found it was very much an older crowd which was understandable because it used to be packrat louies but also weird considering the stark contrast from the downtown location. The food was not consistent and poorly executed each time i dined in. Not the best. Service was good though.

This place is great. Huge selection of beers on tap. Definitely a bit of a overwhelming at first, but the staff helped us find what we liked.  

We got the chicken tenders and they were absolutely delicious. High breading to meat ratio which I like and super crispy. We got the fries which are some of the best I had. I was pretty disappointed when we finished them. They just left me wanting more. 

My wife and I will definitely be coming back many times.

So nice to have good poke and sushi places in St. Louis. I tried the Shaka pole bowl and tofu nugs with the hot sauce. Loved them both. I think I'd opt for tuna instead of salmon next time but that's just personal choice. The portion sizes are good and filling. The place itself is tiny so most people seem to get food to go. The great thing is their neighbors, Narwhal's Urban Crafted Ice, are happy to let you bring food in. So that's what we did. If I could suggest any improvements it would be to streamline the process a bit. Many were have some sauce ready to go. They also ran out of white rice , so maybe then can have some more food backup. Overall, liked the place and will go back.

I got the large jerk chicken platter with cabbage and rice&beans. I don't know about the other people who commented but I didn't get no large amount of chicken. It tasted good if that means anything. Lol the rice&beans SUCKED! Big time. I only ate a couple of spoons full. The cabbage was OKAY. I've had better. All for $11.59....... I won't be returning -not in this life time. Lol&SMH BTW when I threw platter in the trash I tucked the menu in it also, I have no. Need for it.

Omg. Do not get seafood except a few oysters. 3 from Louisiana and 3 from east coast. Pork belly and burgers are amazing. Go for happy hour. A Sazerac with Absinthe on the side: OMG!  The decor is REAL. Not hipster!  Keep the secret. Great!

We drove a bit to get here. The Yelp review made me do it. That's my story and I am sticking to it...lol
Walking in my mom and I scanned the near emnty place.  It was very clean.  Since I am Italian I am used to Italian bakeries.  Where there is essentially a smorgasbord of dessert and cakes as far as your eyes can see. This place barley had a case or two of pastries.  Not a smile or a grunt or a how do u do around.  Just number. .. (there were 4 of us in there) so I ordered 2 creme puffs and a creme horn and 3doughnuts.  They did have fresh baked bread but I didn't get any. The creme puffs were good not OHH MY GOD DEAR JESUS I'M COMING HOME good but still good.  The creme horn was very good.  Flaky pastry nice creamy texture inside.  My husband and mom. Liked the doughnuts.  I am still waiting to find a place that makes my eyes roll back in my head and is reminiscent of NYC bakeries.  So if any of you YELPERS out there know of any please please please let me know.

I've eaten at Chima before and enjoyed the experience!! I decided to treat myself and my son to Mother's Day dinner May 12, 2019.

I'm surprised I was able to make a reservation because it was so last minute. My 6pm reservation was made at 4pm.

We made it to Chima by 5:30pm with a short wait (Not even 5 maybe 10 minutes) before being shown to our table. Our table was the perfect spot (by a window no less), ample lighting for me to snap a few food pictures.

A waiter promptly arrived and offered us drinks. Two Coca Colas. He also explained how dinner worked to my 12-year-old son. It was his first time experiencing a rodizio style restaurant.

He was a little anxious about the food and was scared he wouldn't like anything that was served. I told him to try a few "No Thank You" bites and go from there. Well ... he loved the experience, which made my dining experience better.

We will definitely return as my son wants to continue to test his palate!! My only wish is that I could have requested more Fried Bananas (I love them!!)

After the movie on Feb 2nd, we went to late lunch early dinner to Joey's House of Pizza..it was the first time we went here and they were getting ready to close. Literally, we walked in about 5-8 min before they were locking the doors.

 If I had checked my yelp site I would have known this and chose another place, so I am actually glad I didn't though...This place was fab...We went in and it is rather small, but very open and inviting. The color scheme is very ITALIAN...black, white and red with large very open style windows making the room look less small and giving you a great view of Nashville..I bet this view is gorgeous at night..but alas, their hours are only 11am to 3pm.. The serving counter area was loaded with pizza, pizza rolls, pastas and lasagna,...

OMG..to many choices and all the food looked absolutely to die for... We were immediately greeted by this smiling young lady behind the counter..she asked what we would like to order and I told her it was our first time here and she immediately began to make suggestions, told us specials and even asked our likes..Very nice lady and after more conversation we found out that this was her family restaurant, her father was the "JOEY" and her mother was there behind the counter with her. Her father came out and we met him and she said her brother was in the back making dough for tomorrow..amazing!!! 

Noel opted for the double decker pizza called "the Gladiator" it was a stuffed pizza slice with tons of meat and cheeses with a rootbeer, I opted for a slice with pepperoni, onions and jalapeno peppers and coca cola, and Tony went with a pizza roll with water..We didn't have to wait long. When I realized that they were closing, I offered to have our food to go, but she said "SIT SIT"...please stay and enjoy...that was so nice and inviting. She also brought me a second slice with fresh mozzarella cheese and fresh cut basil for free and then she also brought us additional sauces for the side another great gift from her..

.It wasn't that expensive, it was like $24 for everything and she even gave us a sack of three pepperoni rolls to go home with us and wrote a personal note on the bag, Thanking us for coming and enjoying and inviting us back...OMG..those pepperoni rolls were awesome reheated in the oven..I am definitely going back to JOEY's Pizza and enjoying some more delicious food...especially those pepperoni rolls...Thanks so much !!! I can't wait to go back again...

Great spot with healthy breakfast. They substituted greens for potatioes.  Nice
Waitress was Pleasant too and understood the need for healthy food when traveling.
The waitress was Haley by the way.  She filled my coffee often and was otherwise very good

What can one add to The Pasta House that hasn't been said, since it's such a St. Louis institution. So...this review may be short, but hopefully worth your while. In no particular order of importance:

1. They don't take reservations for parties of 8 or less...bummer since they can have lines on weekends.

2. The tables are spaced out well,  good Italian ambience.

3.  The food really is superior, and my 3 stars is probably 3 1/2 stars. I always get the grilled salmon. It's like a little secret. Who goes to "The Pasta House" and orders Salmon /: - | ? But it is really good, thick, flaky, perfectly pink. Buttery, hint of caper?sauce.
Wife had seafood ravioli. Big pieces in a rich cream sauce that is that "stucco" color. Very good. Daughter had Rigatoni Carbonara pasta cooked perfect al dente, not mushy, good bacon taste and richness of egg-in Alfredo cream came through. Excellent. Salads are as always the famous Italian pasta house signature. I don't have to tell you about. Damn fresh, damn crisp. Damn good!

4.  Reading the above, you are probably wondering why not 4 stars ( as am I). Here's why. Pasta House is deceptively expensive, I think. Entrees are in the high teens, and some don't include the salad! Also, while the service is decent, there is something about having teenagers/near teenagers be your waiters at those prices that doesn't seem quite right. Our bill for a nice Sunday lunch with eight people and no alcohol, was $165 after tip. I guess not THAT bad. ( $20/person lunch).

Bottom line. It's The Pasta House. We know it. We like it. It's more expensive than people think. Get the Salmon if you like Salmon.
Hope this helped.
John

What an awesome place nestled on Maple St. I stumbled upon this place last week and vowed to return tonight. The smells outside this place would drawn in anyone walking down the street. The service is friendly, fast and genuine...

What great sandwiches! The freshest meats and cheeses. You can get almost two meals from one. If you can order ahead do so...place stays busy! Don't go in asking for cheesesteaks like the lady ahead of me. They don't have a grill!!

I travel to Nashville frequently on business and being a foodie, I'm always for "culinary experiences."  Fleming's was recommended by a colleague so I visited on a Tuesday evening at opening time.  I liked the atmosphere - dark wood, open wine holders - that steakhouse look and feel.  The waiter didn't come to the table to greet us for about 20 minutes and there was lengthy wait times between each course. A colleague and I shared the Beef Carpaccio which was outstanding. The beef was thinly sliced, buttery soft.  We thought if this is the starter, the rest of the evening would be fantastic.  Not so!  I ordered a steak and seafood special that evening. The servings were small and there was nothing outstanding about the steak - I think it sat for several minutes before it was brought to the table. The waiter almost burned himself and the tablecloth by trying to light the  butter warmer candle using a small Bic lighter. He later reached over the table and knocked over the butter, then tried to dab the spill which left even more of a mess in the center of the table. Several minutes later, he placed a cloth napkin over the spot and never asked if I wanted more butter.  Again, several minutes passed before the dishes were cleared.  Twenty minutes later, a lady came to take our dessert order (not our waiter) and had no clue what desserts/specials were offered, explaining, "...someone just told me to come over and get your dessert order..." 

If it was like this on a Tuesday night, I'd hate to be there on a Friday or Saturday night.

My customer experience was lackluster and left a negative impression with me and my guest.

With a bill well over $200 for two and poor customer service, it's unlikely I will revisit nor recommend.
My after work spot for chicken wings and shrimp rolls. Fast with great customer service
One of the best pizza places around town!!! Check it out for yourself. Fresh ingredients and great service.

We have been dining at the Chop House since they opened and have never been disappointed.  Favorites include any steak and the calamari.  They have a good selection of beer and an excellent wine list.  By far my favorite when I'm "baching it" is the bar at happy hour; Kona beef tips with mushrooms and onions, fresh rolls, butter and an interesting people watching population.

Delicious restaurant! Not my first time dinning here. Every time I have been to this restaurant I have enjoyed I new entree and dessert with kind blowing flavor! Truly one of my favorite places to eat in town. The customer service is spot on and the chef always checks on his customers. Please give it a try and you won't be disappointed.

I'm rarely down in this area.  So when my guest and I were passing through, we figured we pop in and check the place out, based on the reviews.  I couldn't agree more with most of the other reviewers here.  

PRICE:  2 nice-sized paninis, 2 side, and 2 beverages...with tip, the bill was around $30 with tip. Reasonable in my opinion.

SERVICE:  You have to order at the counter, and then they'll bring the food to your table.  The staff is VERY friendly and helpful.  They were even able to accommodate my guest's special dietary needs.

ATMOSPHERE:  The place is VERY CLEAN.  But I think they only opened their doors less than a year ago.  They have nice-sized tables and even a few   lounge chairs.  It wasn't crowded with patrons - but if it was, you won't feel cramped.

FOOD QUALITY:  The portions were nice...dare I say, slightly larger than average? I had the Battered Haddock Panini and Chimichurri Cheese Bread.  The panini came out nicely plated.  The bread was nicely toasted and stayed that way (vs. going soggy on one side) for the entire meal. 

The Chimichurri Cheese Bread was tasty.  My only [very minor] comment is that there could have been more cheese on the bread.  Also, the cheese could have been melted a bit more - I like a little char on melted cheese..and perhaps finely grated and sprinkled instead of sliced and placed.  But this is purely personal preference.  

OVERALL: Great service, great food, reasonable prices.  I'd definitely come back to this place.
I truly enjoyed my time here, it's quite cozy, love the food, perfectly seasoned, so much to choose from, this place should be franchised!

Really good curry dishes. We had Masaman Curry and Drunken Noodle. Both of these dishes were full of flavor. We got it Thai hot and isn't wasn't bad, had a nice kick! The place was clean and welcoming. We will be back.

I like this place, great service, no waiting much for your food, prices are decent, and I love their guava margaritas. My favorite place is the ceviche tostada. I find other Mexican places in town pricey and slow.

I got a snickers and brownie milkshake it was so good! Customer service  is awesome! Almost anyone who walks in there is just down having a good day and is super chill and friendly! No need to wear clothes and shoes up in here!!

It's that time again folks, when every Friday I am relegated to meat derived from the sea. Diva's is a great place to indulge in a lot of things but their fried fish is amazing. I called at 8:30 on Friday, and while other places would have balked at taking an order 30 minutes before they close, they didn't even blink. 
The Platter was huge and could have been split up between two meals but because I hadn't eaten anything all day I was starving. Two sides were on point and the prepackaged cornbread was still up to par(even though I would rather homemade). All in all great place to pick up food from and if you have a minute the inside diner is pretty good. Not too much in decorations but a good place to slow down and eat great food.

I worked with Keller and then Rachel from La Cocinita to cater my wedding on New Years Eve. From start to finish, I was extremely happy with the service provided. Keller arranged for my wife and I to have a tasting of anything we wanted and discussed all the details for feeding people at the wedding. Closer to the date, Rachel and I hashed out the final food order and delivery. Day of the wedding, the delivery man was exactly on time and the food was amazing. Every guest at the wedding raves about the food, and I personally ate on it for days. I also should mention that the price for the generous portions of delicious food, great service, and timely delivery, was very reasonable. I highly recommend La Cocinita for both catered events or evenings out for dinner. Thanks Keller, Rachel, and everyone at La Cocinita for helping make my wedding very memorable.

Saddened to write this review because the food here is really good but it is handled in a very unsanitary manner. I have been there several times since they opened and the past few times I've been there I've seen the employees mishandling the food. This last time the  guy with curly hair that wears a bun was wearing gloves at the  cash register. The customer in front of us was having trouble with his card so he grabbed his card with the same gloves. He then  checked us out, touched his face, then went back to preparing food with the same gloves on. I was really put off by this behavior. I wouldn't have been as  disgusted if he was simply spooning food into  plates but he was actually handling the food with his gloves. Unfortunately this is not an isolated incident, on another occasion one of the girls who was preparing food came to the register  to check us out. She took her gloves off and stuffed them
In her sweater pocket and when she was done took them out put them back on and went on to prepare food again. I really dislike the idea of my food being  prepared with contaminated gloves so sadly I will not be returning which is a shame because as I  mentioned the food is good but the employees need better training.

I was super, pleasantly surprised by this place. Came here with my parents and brother after a failed attempt to go to the new Thai place next door. I was happy, because I was in the mood for Mexican food - and this is not what I expected!

It's not a sit-down place, you order your food in a line like at Qdoba or Chipotle, but everything is fresh! I got a chicken quesadilla, but it was STACKED! Veggies, salsa, beans, and anything else I would have wanted inside. It was ridiculously tasty, like. so, so tasty. It came with this ranch-type sauce, so good! I also tried the nachos (awesome, I wanted to share them with friends over beers) and the tacos (the hard shells were bomb). 

I don't know that I'll be back any time soon, but I'd definitely suggest it. They still have kinks to work out, but they've got some tasty food.

Barra Rosa has a cozy atmosphere and two floors of dining.  I enjoy the gluten free pizza variety they have as well as some of the other dishes.  I mostly get take out from Barra since it seems the take out prices are much less than the sit-in pizza prices.  The staff is always friendly!

Nothing to write home about.  Ordered a Carolina Pork Sandwich which had very little flavor.  The sandwich was not even close to worth $7.99 (and yes, I know, pork prices are on the rise); the bread to meat ratio was disappointing to say the least.  The boy behind the counter actually weighed the pork before he put it on the sandwich, which is one of the least "southern style" things you can do. Again, if it would have had any flavor, I would've been less upset. I also got a sauerkraut perogie, which had potential to be delicious, but it was drenched in at least 1/3 c of butter. I love butter, but that was overwhelming.  Just felt like everything was off.

Climate was great. Dianne was our server and done a wonderful job. I ordered the Sunrise Sampler, which is always too much food. Everything was cooked perfectly and served hot. Coffee good. Seating and service were good, and the place was packed. Good experience.

We had the most amazing experience last night at this restaurant. My son and his wife wanted to take me to this spot in SoBro so he made reservations for 5pm as he was unable to get any later because they were already booked up. I now know why...it was excellent! We were greeted by friendly staff when we arrived, seated promptly, we all decided to start off with a cocktail, and the Panela Frita appetizer, all on point. Next we tried three different menu items. Duck, Halibut, and Calamari all were cooked to perfection. We finished off with chocolate cake with fruit and cream. We found the cake to be dry and a bit crumbly so we mentioned it to our waitress and when she returned with our check had removed the cake from our bill and told us the chef agreed and would not be using that vendor any longer. 
All in all a perfect night and excellent meal and I can't wait to go back and try other items from the menu!

The food was good but they didn't bring any condiments as far as eating utensils and the sauce that I ordered. I actually brought the rest of the uneaten food back the next day and they replaced my whole order. I'm very satisfied now.

The ambiance is warm an inviting very nice! All the food is cook to order with great ingredients. This location is clean with fast and friendly service! 

We enjoy the food  here and the awesome suggestions from our waiter.

I love both the Ballwin location and this location.

This family owned business knows how to treated larger parties and individual.

Gloria~

My wife and I were looking for a good place with a vegan option and this place did not disappoint us. We had a very good vegan pizza made just the way we like it.  The service was great and our server was very informed about the vegan menu.  It is a nice active atmosphere.  Parking was a bit of a challenge but once you are inside it will be worth the effort.  We will be back.

We've been to Vito's twice now. The first time was over two years ago for a Saturday evening dinner. The place was packed!! Our food was good and we said we'd be back. Finally got around to it this past weekend when I saw a Yelp coupon for $20 off $40. I snatched it up and off we went with another couple.

This time, being December, there was no sitting on the patio! But, to our surprise (we'd made reservations based on our last experience), there was really nobody in the place. Odd for a Friday evening at seven PM. I wondered, between the coupon and the empty place if we were going to regret the decision. Nope!

Around the table, we had pepperoni pizza, pepperoni and sausage pizza, chicken marsala and lettuce with aged Parmesan (I'm on a restricted diet 6 out of seven days!lol). Everyone was pleased! The pizzas got very good reviews, the chicken marsala looked hearty in portion and came with a side of pasta and steamed broccoli and the bread tasted and house-made and came with either oil or real butter.

The place has bar seating, dining room and a killer patio (in the right weather - no heaters for winter). The servers seemed nice and our waitress seemed unfazed by my request for just a bunch of lettuce with Parmesan. You'd be surprised who many servers this stumps! But maybe she saw I had my own chicken and salad dressing sitting there. Either way, I got exactly what I asked for and it was even plated nicely. Our drinks were kept filled and I also had a coupon (Yelp check-in incentive) for a free gelato. She was kind enough to serve it with four spoons!

I'm still stumped as to why the place wasn't packed. The only guess I have is that it's near a university and maybe many kids were gone for winter break and they make up a lot of their business? Additionally, the restaurant is near the Fox Theater, Grand Center and Powell Symphony Hall, so I'm guess they got a lot of before and after crowds from those venues.

We will go back yet again!

I can't give them less than one star or I would. This gay hating disrespectful restaurant blew my mind away yesterday. Then when speaking to a manager who didn't do anything about It i realized it was not worth the 45 min. Wait. We got off a long day at the boat and we're hungry after being told about 45 min approached the host stand after an hour and asked how much longer as the young girl roled her eyes and my group all of a sudden she was able to pull two tables together and said here and I don't want to hear another word from you! Then when my friend decided to go talk to manager she profiled him from across the room and wouldn't even listen to him since he was dressed pretty flamboyant this lady was so rude she will never have my service nor anyone eles i know. She needs to get a job she's better at and not have the potential to serve the gay community! Not sure her name but it was at 6:00 pm on a Sunday if this restaurant even cares about this

I just love blue moon. It's such a hidden gem. Here I go spilling the secret about how great it is. Anyway, tonight I went by myself for the first time and just ate at the bar. (*My intent with this was to not look a screen, which I had done all day. Yet here I am again.) I politely mentioned that she may just want to know that the chicken was slightly underdone. (Which it was and for some reason I always check now cause this girl in college was very particular about it.) She informed the manager and they were both really cool about taking it off and thanking me for letting them know. There was no charge so I just tipped in cash! (Tip your servers!) 

Anyway

This review is a longtime coming and I truly can't believe that! 

Tacos Jalisco has been on my radar as one of the best patios in the entire city. Seriously. Don't believe me, just look at the photos. I can't think of a better place to stop and sip a margarita or ice cold beer in the warmer months than right there! Boo. Now I'm thinking about summer in the midst of a crazy winter storm... but I digress.

The food is also highly rated, and I cannot disagree with anyone who says it's not great. I came in after a hard day of hunting and was blown away by the generous portions and solid Mexican flavors I found. I enjoyed a carnitas plate and the marinade on the pork was delectable. There was also a great ratio of crunchy bits to soft tender pork as well, making for a fun time filling tortillas! My friends got burritos and now, having had a baby, I can legitimately say they were as big as an infant. 

So why four stars? Well, when we walked in the place was empty, save for a few tables. I figured service would be a breeze and we'd be in and out. Not so much. It started off good, but after the order was taken it was tough to get any one back to the table. Water refills, chips, and even right down to paying the bill. 

If service were on point, this would be 5 stars all the way. Here's hoping that first trip there in the summer wins that extra star from me because I can't wait to eat their food again!

I had the huevos rancheros and it's such an amazing dish. Mirella and Edie and the two lovely ladies that served my table. I came with a coworker and it was her first time. Coworker was absolutely astonished by the ambience of the restaurant as am I regularly. We are leaving happy and highly recommend this place! Overall, awesome food, staff and atmosphere. Enjoy!

Went there for my mom's 70th birthday. The Server was awesome, but the variety was not. The three meats we were served were either undercooked(garlic chicken) or overcooked. The small buffet area was not appealing either. Again, the server made all the difference.

Again, another excellent meal. We had picante de mariscos and ceviche en cream de aji amarillo, followed by one of the best tiramisu either of us have ever had.  The mariscos were perfectly seasoned in a light tomato and coconut milk broth, reminiscent of a bouillabaisse.  The ceviche came in a delicate creamy garlic sauce with a moderate amount of spice- just the right accent.

This tiny, intimate restaurant has framed chalkboards throughout, featuring highlighted menu items paired with complementing wines. As you might infer, the wine menu is chosen to accentuate the food, with a diverse selection. 

The service is friendly, knowledgeable, and fast, although you will never be rushed. 

This is the perfect date night restaurant, but it won't break the bank.  Very reasonably priced, for top quality food and service.

This was our first visit to The Southern and I had heard nothing but wonderful things about it so I was very excited. I am local to Nashville and had chosen The Southern for my birthday dinner with a few friends that were coming in from out of town. We had a reservation for 7 people at 6:30pm. When we arrived at the restaurant I informed the host that 5 of us were there and 2 would be arriving late, probably after w had already ordered. Traffic on the way to the city had slowed them. He told me this would be no problem. The five of us sat down and ordered, our waiter was fine, not great, but not bad. We each got a drink and ordered our food. Let me point out that everything we had to eat was fantastic! Which is why this is a two star rating. However, when the other two were getting ready to arrive I informed our waiter that we would need menus and he said he was pretty sure the table we were at was booked at 8:30 and didn't believe we would have enough time for the other two to eat. Tables are booked every two hours. He would have to talk to the manager. This was ridiculous. The manager also eventually came over after the two friends arrived and said she had a table for the two on the patio and the other 5 of us could find a spot at the bar, if we could find one, and hang out there. While she was apologetic, I find this completely ridiculous. I do understand places trying to turnover tables. However we were going to continue to buy food and drinks as we sat- no just take up a table. Also, if people eating later was a problem it should have been presented to me that way when I told the host they would be showing up later. Unfortunately this ruined our experience. I have never heard of someplace essentially kicking you out. Maybe they shouldn't reserve EVERY table EVERY two hours. That's not always how dinner works. Once we got closer to the "8:30 deadline" our waiter become much shorter with us and somewhat rude. All in all it was disappointing because the food was so good but they lost our business on customer service.

are you a man? do you like sports? boobies? pool? darts? boobies? food? boobies? dont kid yourself, the reason people go there is scantily clad women, booze, sports, an watnot. There is nothing wrong with this, infact in encourage such activities. foods nothing to email anthong bourdain about but it works. also booze and boobies and sports. prosit.

Finally....a modern restaurant that is super clean serving CLEAN food.  The staff is friendly, and ready to provide great recommendations.  I  was so impressed from the time I walked in - to the time I walked out the door.  My new favorite Reno restaurant.

We were visiting a doctor nearby and were hungry so we stopped here.  Everyone was very nice and helpful upon entering.  My wife had a gyro which was very generous while I opted for tHe lunch special of rice, a tomato based soup and some leg of something.  The portion was huge and needless to sAy, I could not finish it.  My wife's lamb meat was not too spicy but lackeD tizaki sauce.  Good value for those who are hungry

We wandered in here with no expectations but was so pleasantly surprised. We had the pleasure of meeting the owners and I have to say, we are an Italian family from upstate New York and this was by far... the BEST pizza I have had since moving here. Their sauces were insanely good and authentic and the the crust in these pizzas had the perfect snap but amazing bubbles like an authentic pizza should! Their cannolis had amazing flavor and the mars alone was so fresh!

Coffee with an "attitude". 
I ordered a vanilla latte and specifically asked barista to add milk only 3/4 of the way and when she made it, milk was filled all the way to the top so she just pour the milk out a d said to me here you go. I told her you threw out all the crem and now it's all watery so she gave me an evil eye and dirty looks. She made another coffee which was disgusting. She must have added about 4 shots of vanilla just to make it disgusting.
To the owner of this place, know that I am the customer and I'm paying for a product and if you're going to give me an attitude I can always go someplace else. It's your call.

The first thing to know is this place is CRAZY expensive....however, the portions are big and the food super high quality!  We ordered the calamari for appetizer, got some French onion soup, and the seared tuna for the meal....all were very good!
Still amazing. Second time here, food is still great. Very fresh, and reasonably priced.

The service is incredible. The environment is magical. They can make anything out of the ordinary just extraordinary. My sweet tooth was very pleased with this amazing desserts. Our celebration was very welcoming because they gave us for free two desserts. Go and enjoy!

El Cap!!! This place is not where you go if you're on a 'clean living' kick or wanting the latest 'artisan' bullshit burger experience.  And thank God for that.  Coming here is like visiting the wood-paneled 'rec room' of a cranky great-uncle, who's still pissed that his doctor has forced him to give up his Lucky Strikes, and who's spending his retirement drinking Budweiser and watching baseball in the afternoons while frying up the greatest OLD SCHOOL burgers, that's AMURRICAN burgers son, the way they made 'em long before McDonald's and Burger Kings dotted the landscape.  The seared crust on the patties is on point, they are juicy as all get-out (the tiny saucers they're served on only emphasize the mess you're inevitably going to make) and the toppings are fresh and cold... just a perfect homemade burger every time.  The cook regularly pops his head out of the kitchen to ask if your experience has been a good one.  I've been coming here 15 years and have never had a bad one.

Try their onion rings, too, they are seriously the best in town.

We were in from out of town and our first interaction was great. The nice lady taking our order with the pixie haircut was nicer than most. We got our number and sat down. A very polite gentleman delivered our food. Everything was great. Until, Patrick decided to mock us. Not once. Not twice. But three times. My friends and I were laughing and enjoying our stay in St Louis. Only to have Patrick who was casually tossing pizzas behind the counter, living his dream, start mocking us. Sure some people want to be lawyers or doctors or veterinarians. But not Patrick. He's out to ruin your dinner while in St. Louis. The pizza was great. The manager was more than accommodating. When we made our complaint about Patrick she referred to him as the parrot. So if you're looking for a great slice of pizza and someone to mock your entire visit. This is worth a stop.

When I moved to SB a few years ago, I could not find a place with decent pizza. Then Bettina opened its doors and saved the day for SB pizza lovers. It is truly the best pizza spot in SB, by a LONG shot. I have only ordered take-out, as it's always super crowded, even on weeknights. They have some outside seating that isn't affiliated with the restaurant, but is generally open for those who want to grab a pizza to-go instead of waiting for an official table.

I've had the pepperoni, meat lovers, and the carbonara pizzas. The pepperoni is my favorite, mostly because they pile it on! The pizza itself is thin, but still has a pretty thick crust. I prefer the marinara base, which you can also order on the side. 

It's obvious that the service is what sets this place apart. A man in front of us in line accidentally took our order, and we were left with a few pizzas we didn't order (you can't go wrong--so it was totally fine with us!). We didn't make a big deal about it, and the generous staff brought us a free cookie for the trouble. Thanks, Bettina, for a great experience!

Pretty decent and cheap for a Mongolian BBQ place. If you want to eat here low carb which is what I prefer, ask to get vegetables instead of rice or noodles. They also have a variety of sauces and seasonings to choose from. I definitely recommend for any vegetarian or carnivore as they have plenty of options.
Speaking on the bar experience which is usually where I come to every time. The alcoholic drinks never let me down and Alex is a great bartender!! I like just about everything on the menu.

Very disappointed in my take out meal tonight.   Ordered two Mongolian Beef and between both there was enough for one dinner, no joke.  The California roll both orders were unraveling and the two orders of Shrimp Low Mein were missing out of the bag went i got home.  I had to drive from Chalmette back to the mall in Metarie to get this remainder of our dinner.  I was past irritated with the botched order and double trip.  Won't order take out from them again
Great table side guacamole-and solid Mexican food! The chicken quesadilla was crisp-not soggy-and loaded with delicious grilled chicken. I would return!
The food is fabulous, and the staff are terrific. I love coming back each time. Thank you for being here!
Delicious and great portion sizes! The asparagus fingers were amazing and everything we ordered was tasty. Ambiance was great as well!

I absolutely love this place! I can come in and grab lunch or dinner and not feel bad about skipping my "prepped" meals.  Lots of healthy options, but, the key to this spot is everything is soooo tasty! 

This is an update to my initial review... I am very disappointed in SoFresh today, I come here all the time and have NEVER had a problem.  I ordered the Super Food bowl with steak & shrimp, which is not a first for me, however, when I got into the car and took a look at my meal the steak (which they cook medium rare) looked extremely mushy, again, I have ordered this before and I should note I do eat medium rare cooked meat.  I went back in & addressed my concerns & was spoken to in a condescending tone as if I am not aware of how meats are cooked.  The guy "up cooked" it and when he returned I asked him if the steak initially came out of the holding tray (maybe that's why it was like that).  It seemed as if he took offense to my question and stated that NONE of their meats are placed in the holding tray & everything is cooked fresh to order, he later stated that only the chicken is placed in the trays.  Needless to say I probably won't enjoy this meal.  I was trying to give them the benefit of the doubt since they were busy with lunch hour, however, the employees response was awful and for $19 I really don't think there should have been so much of a debate.  This will definitely reduce my 5 star rating to a 3 unfortunately.

Ok I am not going to lie I had my doubts about these tacos. Yes , I came all the way across the country and still need tacos #tacosarelife I just want to say these tacos were amazingly delicious. I got pork belly, shrimp and carnitas. The guacamole was definitely fresh and to die for! Salsa  I definitely recommend it. Especially for anyone missing home on the west coast! Demetrius was super knowledgeable and helpful with the drink menu and the food menu! Not to mention Dominique the manager was super nice and made sure all our needs were met! I love this place. 


Visit 2! I had to go back one last time before my visit in PA was over. I have to say the service just gets better every time! I tried the Asada tacos and they were just as amazing as the others! All this food is made with love! I got to try a new cucumber jalapeño mint margarita! (ARIZONA MARGARITA) Man it was delicious especially if spicy is your forte! The half sugar half tajin rim really lets you choose your hotness level! I like them so much I had 3! Made with fresh jalapeños and cucumber it's definitely this Arizona girls go to place every time I visit!!! 
I love Bartaco! Ps. The plantains are to die for! Thank you Demetrius and Dominique! You made my visit to PA super special! Tell Larry he's amazing too! You have a great team!

'Big Food' was the comment from my family. And that it was. The burgers were huge! They were tasty and my California Cobb was great. The nachos were mediocre. For the 4 of us, our bill was over $70 plus tip, with no alcohol. So kinda pricey for best part to be 'big'.

Nice sports bar with nice staff. Free wifi barely worked but I got my skype call done inside the big room on the right. A couple of cold beers and sports on TV. Hard to beat on a warm day!

Will be back.

You would not assume that Husk would be the ideal restaurant for vegans to dine at but it is quite the opposite.
My wife and I have been to Husk twice and both times the chef and staff have been incredibly accommodating to modify menu items to meet our dietary needs.
Both times we ordered the southern veggie plate and it was absolutely phenomenal!
It changes seasonally so the second time was quite different from the first but both were equally amazing! 
A lot of times when you make modifications as a vegan, the chef will simply subtract the non vegan parts resulting in a bland, dry lifeless ( no pun intended ) meal. 
It is obvious that the chef went above and beyond to create a beautiful tasty platter that had a lot of care and love put into it.
The grits, grilled asparagus, zucchini, wheat berries, Swiss chard - it was all incredible.
A special mention must also go to the service which was impeccable.
We will be back!

Hostess was not friendly, was the owners wife, they require the hostess to also take payment which delayed our seating.  Server (Rachel) was also very unfriendly, my wife said her soda was a diet coke, the server said it wasn't.  When we told her we didn't want the soda and to bring us a water, she said "oh yeah, that is diet I checked".  The appetizer we had (broccoli bites) was tasteless and overcooked, Rachel said they are not made by their restaurant, but didn't offer us any compensation.  Never coming back.

Standard hibachi fare - but very tasty.  I liked how the grill/tables are in sort of semi-private alcoves, so it's quieter than some more open Japanese Steakhouses.  

Try the pot-sticker appetizer -- without question the lightest I've ever had - none of that heavy starchy texture.

The house ginger salad dressing is very nice, though the "chicken onion" soup had little shell pasta that one would normally see in italian food -- not sure what that was about.

The meal includes a small scoop of rainbow sherbet that was very tart and tangy, and just the right touch after the proteins and rice.

There were seveal kids in our room and nearby who were having a great time with the "floor show" cooking -- though some were a little freaked by the flames at the beginning.  Warn your kids, if they are a little leary of flame. 

All in all - a nice meal!
Always enjoy the food. Dining room is small but they move fairly fast. They never disappoint. Best bubble tea I've had in a long time!! Garlic shrimp dish is delish

Although located near a lot of tourist attractions, Sonny's is not a tourist trap like other Philly Cheesesteak restaurants in the area. It provides the traditional cheesesteak experience without the long lines and questions by tourists. I highly recommend the quintessential Philly Cheesesteak loaded with beef, peppers, onions, mushrooms, and Cheese-Wiz. Don't forget to ask for a cup of wood-er (water) to wash it down.

Granted - I've never eaten Chicago style pizza in Chicago, so I can't personally verify the authenticity of the pizza here, but my Detroit-born and Chicago-raised boyfriend gives Pi his stamp of approval so it must stack up pretty well against the competitors!

I personally love the pizza here. Of course, I'm talking about the deep dish. It's so insanely delicious. So much cheese, so much delicious sauce, and so much perfectly delectable - crunchy - incredible crust. If I could afford a meal here every day for the rest of my life, I might well consider it.

The boys that own Pi know what they're doing when it comes to pizza. This becomes overwhelmingly obvious once you branch out from the standard pepperoni or meat pizzas, and try one of their neighborhood specials, or even the special of the day, when they're offering one. My favorite of their regular selections so far is the Delmar. Normally I prefer the sauce on top variety, but there's something about her that has me coming back for more.

The atmosphere here is exceedingly cozy. Funky lighting and quirky decor really give this place a great vibe for a date or bringing any visiting guests to. Sure, parking is a hassle, but that's expected. It's the CWE. This place is dressed to impress, no matter if you're looking at the delicious combinations of toppings that might adorn their pies, or at the restaurant itself. Only the most stuffy and closed-minded of foodies will be disappointed here. For everyone else, this place is a guaranteed hit.
So much fun celebrating a family birthday here! The staff made the kiddos feel like royalty!

I was surprised by this restaurant since I live in a super small rural town in Alabama. The restaurant is a great vibe from the inside to the outside. I really don't know what to say about the meal I ordered which was the short rib Chiang Mai noodles. I honestly have nothing to compare the taste to. It had a pleasant taste and the aroma was nice. Now let's talk about these crab claws, they were by far the best I have ever tasted in my 44years of living. If you want to try something different please visit this place

Quite honestly I was wowed by my first and only visit here as part of a preview of the menu here for Rodeo Week (Nov 6-15). I had some absolutely delicious peppermint tea which was served to me in a neat contraption to accompany my food. The tea helped me digest and then we got some hors d'oeuvres: steak bites, tempura vegetables, tuna tataki, and mini yorkshires with meat in them, as well as a couple entrees of 22 oz steaks (18 oz each without the bone) with pesto tomatoes, mashed potatoes, white cheddar mac 'n' cheese and of course a delicious amount of spices including garlic cloves etc. Stefan, the sales and special events coordinator explained to us all the different uses of this space and was truly hospitable while delivering us our food and beverages. We were served quickly and efficiently and all of our food was quite delectable though I'm not sure if I'm a fan of the mashed potatoes as wasabi isn't always a flavour I appreciate in non-Asian dishes.

The meat was the highlight of our visit, but I also adored the white cheddar mac 'n' cheese. The tuna tataki was remarkably delicious (I often don't find this dish to be done very well, so I was pleasantly surprised). The steak bites appetizer is one that I would certainly recommend. The beverage selection that they can serve is outstanding (including alcoholic and non!), and I'd be tempted to come back for those alone.

The single stall washroom on the ground floor of the restaurant seemed a bit odd to some of our group, especially given the size of the restaurant, but there are additional washrooms on the second floor. I liked hearing about the private rooms available for groups. Additionally the decor was really interesting including a cow up in the air on the wall and other interesting eye catching items.

Great, friendly staff, delicious, generous scoops of Bassett's ice cream (the attached picture is a small) and they serve La Colombe coffee. Haven't tried their dessert crepes, but their savory ones are good.

I couldn't imagine why they don't have a higher rating. I brought my mother and sister here and we enjoyed everything!!! The service was fantastic, great complimentary offering of a small shareable appetizer (they gave us smoked tuna with crackers) and the meals were great! The charcoal shrimp, i wish me had ordered more. My sister loved her crab grilled cheese, I had blackened salmon, the cheesy hash brown potatoes were great and My mother loved her fish tacos. Will definitely beback to enjoy some drinks and their outdoor seating.

Excellent coffee, euro-vibe, great people watching. Back in the day (late '90's) this was the best, smokiest, chessplayingest place to be, nowadays there's no smoking and the chess is back out in the Square. You can order their coffee online but it's best sitting right there prepared by the well trained, slighty eurosnobby staff. There coffee is in some of the best hotels in NY and has finally arrived in SF...find it at Cafe de la Presse, SF.

This place is a nice neighborhood coffee shop. Really good coffee, but the breakfast food is just okay. It's basically decent stuff just warmed up. 

The staff if super friendly plus there's Wi-Fi. I'll be back since it's close.

I've been to this Studio Movie Grill at least five times over the past 2 years. I love it, the food is great especially the macaroni and cheese (and even more so if you add the chicken!) . All of the drink specials are good prices but I do think they make the drinks a little bit weak. This makes a great spot for a date night whether you are single and dating or married. It's even more a great spot if you are a USF student, because they have a really good student discount (I think it's like five dollars per ticket). They also often have specialty drinks and menus depending on what holidays are going on. Once I went around Valentine's Day and they had some really yummy specialty drinks.  I think I had a "Love Me" strawberry martini. It was made with premium liquor and it was delicious. 

Some people have complained that is dirty or the floors are sticky and I don't know where that complaint is coming from. I have never had that experience and I have been to the studio movie Grill at least five times over the past two years, including some times where we saw movies back to back (like we made a movie day). That meant we changed theaters for each movie and none of them were dirty or run down in anyway. I don't know what those reviews were talking about.

Came here the All You Care to Eat Lunch.  The service was great there was a large menu to choose from.  You choose what you want from salads, soups, sushi, appetizers, fried rice and dessert.  Everything we ordered was very good and for $15 we will be back for sure

Went there today for the first time ordered chicken tacos and shrimp tacos didn't realize how filling they were took half home with me they were delicious and not pricey at all split order of the loaded Texas fries omg they were awesome too I loved this place great atmosphere service was great definitely will go back again you have to try there sangria

I am a die-hard foodie that eats different foods for all around the country/world. The crawfish beignet is BY FAR one of the best things I've ever put in my mouth. Omg! It was everything!!

We had swamp fries which we absolutely delicious along with chargrilled oysters. Bottomless sangria didn't hurt either. The food was life. Do yourself a favor & head to Katie's for brunch!!

Ridiculous joke of a restaurant. Do not go here under any circumstances. Food took absolutely forever and was ice cold. When they delivered the food they only then chose to tell us they were out of mashed potatoes and would need to order something else. Ordered Mac N cheese because two others had that and it looked ok. What they finally brought out this time was now linguini and cheese topped with a pile of unmelted shredded cheddar on top in a soup cup. They just set it down and walked away as if this is what we had received previously. Um yeah, that's Mac N cheese. I swear your mama never made you Mac N cheese like that before. WTF. Another one of our party had ordered the Arugula Salad, but what came was spinach drowning in a pool of dressing. I felt sorry for our server as it was obvious that this kitchen has no clue what they are doing. The whole ordeal took 2 and a half hours to receive poorly cooked and cold food. This place is a freaking disaster. I felt like I was being punked on television. Seriously sad, sad, sad.

This place is definitely soo much better than it looks on the outside. I went to the sushi house inside of Yoshimatsu, and it is the most traditional sushi I've had in Tucson. They have all of the good rolls in addition to the ones with pickled veggies instead - yes! 

This is also the best display of knife skills in town - excellent cutting of the fish and everything else. I very much enjoyed my visit. We got lemon salmon roll, seafood udon and spicy yellowtail. Even the lemon was meticulously cut, and the yellowtail was the freshest I've had in town.

Haven't been in years and yes I know it says steakhouse...so what do I order-fish!!! Not because I pretend in God but because I love talapia and crabmeat(Friday during lent)! Well...should have ordered a nice big steak!!!!! Pieces of my dish were delicious and pieces tasted like bad fish-strange I know!!! So minutes after leaving the joint...instant mud butt(Dave Chappelle is my fav comic)!!!! Had to do the mud butt shuffle into the house while my daughter laughed at me!! Now with that said, our server Chris was great!!! My daughter loved the Mac n cheese and again I've been before, I know Outback is good stuff! Today was just not the day for fish!!!! Should have ordered the ribs but then I guess I would have the Itis!!!! I got warrants!!!!!

Love the decor here- rustic meets modern with edgy twists. Been here once before for brunch and it was delicious!
