I just can't get over the fact that it's not particularly good food. I've been here 3-4 times over the years, mostly for work dinners that require me to be in attendance. I've sampled plenty of different things on the menu, and have come away disappointed with everything that doesn't end in "oasted ravioli." The common theme seems to be too much sauce, too much cheese (and believe me, it takes a lot for me to say "too much cheese" in any context), too much garlic, too much SOMETHING. None of these dishes have any balance. And I expect more from a place that's considered at least somewhat iconic -- a place that, in all honesty, I really WANT to like.

Listen, this review seems a little harsher than I wanted it to be, because I HAVE had good experiences there. But I haven't had anything resembling a great meal, and for me that makes all the difference.

The craft beer is excellent!  The food is very good and big portions. The price is fair. If you leave hungry or thirsty it's your own fault. Make sure to talk to the manger Bob.  He's a great guy and really cares about patrons satisfaction.

Mama's is delicious!  Don't be turned off by the line out the door at lunch - it moves fast and the food is worth the wait.  This is the best falafel I have ever had.  I usually get the Mama's sandwich (the small on a normal day, the large if I'm particularly hungry).  It's falafel in a pita, so you can't go wrong.  Their platters are huge and if I get one, I usually save half for lunch the next day.

Don't forget cash; they don't take credit cards.

Fresh, delicious meal. So happy to have an option where cheeaesteaks and pizza aren't the mainstays of the menu.

Bright, tasty, light dishes. A welcome addition to a fine selection of local owner operated restaurants.

First of all, the margarita came virgin, there was no tequila, or if there was, it was a few drops!!! 
But the main issue we are ordered steamed shrimps and fish sandwich, the food came more than an hour later! It's just unexplainable ! It's on Thursday night, place was busy but not THAT busy!!!!never ever come back and recommend anyone
The food is good, service is good, prices are fair.  The only gripe has been the wait but they are expanding  :)  so that is good news.

Amazing breakfast food.  I came here during COVID and they had outdoor seating and very limited indoor seating.  The service was good.  Expect to wait to be seated because this is a very popular restaurant, and for a good reason.  I ate the breakfast hash with orange juice and a mimosa.  All were great, especially the orange juice!  The OJ tasted completely natural and pure, with just the right amount of pulp.  5/5

We came one night during happy hour. Honestly I'm more about the food than the drinks. We were seated right away. The chairs were not comfortable as it was more of a stool with no backs. The table was also too small for what we ordered. We ended up pushing two tables together. We each ordered a drink. They were ok. We sorta ordered too much food. We had the tuna tartar, oysters, calamari, brussel sprouts, "fiery" potatoes and lobster mac and cheese. The mac and cheese was from their regular menu and it was a nice portion. It was just the two of us but we finished everything. We could have did without the tuna tartar. That was my least favorite. My favorite was the potatoes. It came with a creamy spicy aioli dipping sauce. Service was great. I would definitely be back for happy hour.

I dicovered this place on Yelp, as I do for every new place I eat at!  This was so, so.worth the trip here!  Great selection of beers on tap and pizza...what more could you ask for?
Great service with a smile and very helpful.  Quick to get drink refills do to the small nature of the place.  
The pizza was hella' good but this place...it's about the pretzels!  It doesn't matter the flavor you get,  just get them and put it in your mouth!  THANK ME LATER!

No...this location is not following COVID-19 safety guidelines. Poor service. Three people making food, yet it took over 20 minutes in the drive through. Not one of them wearing masks. Will not be returning to this location.

Never had Chicken & Waffles before so I thought I would give it a try. Tried the southern style chicken with plain waffle and all I can say is Wow!! The chicken was fantastic. Going to take the family back tomorrow so that I try something else on the menu. 
Good stuff!!
I had the lamb biryani. Very good. The portions were plentiful had enough for two servings. Also had the samosas. Very as well.

My fiancé and I went here several times for drinks, however had not eaten here until recently. The cocktails are delicious. The menu has lots of options, and if you can't find something you like they can make something different on the spot. Dinner was delicious as well. My fiancé had the pasta Bolognese and I had the fish tacos. The tacos were good, but I was jealous of his pasta-amazing! We have always had great service, however do prefer sitting in the bar area versus the dining room as it's a bit quieter. Highly recommend stopping by this establishment.

Mt. Fuji puts a refreshing twist on Japanese cuisine which really separates it from your run of the mill sushi restaurant. Service was great and I'm still dreaming about the guac and sushi. I could honestly say I'd come here everyday. Love this place.

Great flavor! Burrito was a LITTLE soggy from the slaw, but I waited about 10 minutes to eat it after buying it, so that might have been better if eaten right away. Chips were thick with the perfect amount of salt and the guacamole was very good. Wish I could give 4.5 stars!

If I could give zero stars I would. If you have an out of state ID or or are visiting from outside of the country, they will not let you inside the premises. Pretty sad considering we would have spent a lot of money there, and the whole thing place was empty. Discriminatory towards people. Would not recommend.

Delicious and authentic Mexican food. Try the jalapeño chicken Enchiladas. Yummy! The beans and rice are fantastic. Friendly service. Delicious chips, salsa, and guacamole also. This is a favorite spot of ours to eat out.

This is my Neighbour's Family Restaurant. We dined there in the winter and are going back tonight. Do not let this location or the outside fool you. I grew up in Vancouver BC and have eaten all kinds of different hot pot. This restaurant ranks in my top 3 of Hot Pot experiences ever. They have an honour system that they will allow you to take what you want provided you don't waste it. Unlike other places where someone is giving you minimum ingredients to make your hot pot from behind the counter, this is truly all you can eat. Friendly staff, top notch ingredients. I'm Celiac so the fact that I can go and not worry about not having the essential noodles, they've got that covered with rice noodles. Everything is fresh. Recommend any of the broths. If you like spice get the Tom Yum and add the homemade sauces to your customized dish. What makes it is green onion or cilantro. Ice cream for dessert if you've even got room. This is a place not to skip!

Love this place! Food is amazing and the staff is the best! There 3-4 different shops you can go to if you are waiting to be seated, they offer so many things. You definitely need to try this place if you haven't already and if you have go back they are still great!!

Just recently had a lunch dining experience at TBBC.

Great stout, porter and blondes.

Love how they try to incorporate their beers into the dishes.

starters were the bar pretzels with a cheese fondue and honey mustard, delicious.
split the philly cheese steak pizza that was essentially a "mouthgasm" for lack of a better term.

Great menu selection with very descriptive details.

Ate outside on the patio area; bartender was very attentive and made sure we were satisfied.

We were missing the Italian Beef's from Portillos back in Chicago and when we looked around the Tampa/Largo area we found Bruce's--what a discovery.  We got there and it was a cute little cozy place jammed full of Chicago memorabilia.  I ordered the Italian Beef and was in paradise.  The beef was moist and delicious, the bread was fresh and soft, the aus jus was very tasty.  I never thought I'd say this, but even better than Portillos!!  Awesome!
Slacks is one of my fav places in Delco. I love their upside down style pizza, fries and cheesesteaks. My boyfriend is a big fan of the "Wild Thing." Friendly staff and quick service. Can't go wrong!

Summary: average to good western style Japanese food, bad amateur service, cold loud environment. Probably best to come for lunch. Don't bring a large group in, the gratuity is gratuitous given they can't serve their way out of a bento box.

After talking our meat-and-potatoes caucasian relatives from going to Sumo Sumo (ugh), they settled on the Mikado. Food is OK, a few good grilled items (try the BBQ squid and the Norwegian mackerel), some Japanesey items (sashimi, nigiri, gunkan) but otherwise quite western with lots of sauce and tempura. I'm astonished at the quantity of sauce served with the dishes, why so much? The roll selection has decreased from my last visit, seems smaller and less interesting than an equivalent restaurant like Kyoto. The specials can be fun, had the yomogi daifuku, nice treat for $5 though the mochi outside tasted like it had been frozen, had a mild yomogi flavour. As other have noted, the bento boxes have become below average, they used to be quite good. Also disappointing is the size of the sashimi and the nigiri, I couldn't believe how small the fish servings were, especially at $3.50 a pop for nigiri. Smallest unagi I've ever seen. Dragon eyes were good, better be for a "specialty" item and $13 for 6 pieces.

Service was woeful this last time, especially given the 15% gratuity for groups of 8 or more. Our group even had an early booking, 5 p.m., it wasn't busy yet and the server still screwed up the order so many times. Slow service, items forgotten, and at least half the dishes delivered to the wrong person. Our mackerel took over an hour to deliver to the table, wtf. My spouse wanted to give a 1 star review based on the service alone, he was hangry and ready to bail. Our server was like a deer in the headlights. We would have ordered more food if the service wasn't so slow.  Then we got two bills for three sets of people, and even these were screwed up (how we got billed for the kids' items when they sat at the opposite end of the table...). We just ended up exchanging cash later instead of trying to deal with the clueless server.

Used to love the Mikado but man, if you're going out with peeps who don't need western-style food to eat at a Japanese restaurant, go elsewhere. I'll only come here for lunch on the off chance that I want to torture myself shopping at South Edmonton Common. Cuz really, if you don't live in the deep southside, why would you come here?

So my coworker told me about this place and how great it is, so of course I had to check it out. He was completely right, this place was great and their Cubans are on point! The price is extremely reasonable.

Unfortunately they are closed due to COVID which wouldn't be a big deal but how difficult or expensive could it be to have an outgoing message for those who  call??  We wouldn't have had to waste a trip to see a small handwritten sign on the door.  Hope they're able to return and if so, hope the business is the same.

Live music that was nice and a cool breeze that wafted through the restaurant was nice.  Staff was friendly and helpful.

Immediately wasn't a huge fan of the paper plates and glasses.  Went over the menu and decided to go with what they said was the best item and that was the burger, which they claimed was the best on the island.

It was very very good, cooked exactly as requested and was a nice angus blend.  Did not like the coated fries at all, but the bun and meat was great.  Note to mgr., get rid of battered fries!

Party of six and every dish ranged between excellent and fantastic. The place was easy to find using GPS, but otherwise you'd never guess that such a great dining experience was hidden in that Gloucester City neighborhood. I was all set to be disappointed but was almost flabbergasted by its high quality food and the warmth of it's staff and service. Go there hungry.

Cups Coffee has really great coffee (better than I can make at home).  They treat me like a personal friend.  Their multiple downtown locations make it easy to stop in.  I always look forward to going there for the flavored coffee of the day (my personal favorite). By the way, their hot chocolate is awesome!

I enjoyed the eclectic design and set up of this coffee shop. There are vegan options which is a pro. Seating inside is very sparse so group meetings is not advised. There is seating outside if you don't mind the heat and humidity during the day. I came in on a Saturday around 1pm and many menu options were sold out. The employee was very kind and knowledgeable on teas. Very calm atmosphere,m. The common area is small and intimate in  size, so you will hear everyone's conversation. Overall good first time experience. Also, there is parking in the back of the establishment.

I guess I had a craving for more fresh bowls, so I found myself at Ciccio Cali the same evening that I'd eaten at Big Island Poke for lunch! Again, the perfect choice! So, I had no idea Ciccio Corp had opened another restaurant up in New Tampa! I love Water in South Tampa and the Green Lemon which made choosing this easy. 

I posted pics of the menu, mostly because I was so hungry I forgot to take a pic of my food.  I'm happy to say there are several choices here-but I was surprised that so many had a southwestern flavor profile. Not MY fave, but hey! That's just me. My husband ordered one and loved it - I ordered another spicy tuna dish! A creature of habit. If I could eat raw tuna at every meal, I'd be thrilled!! 

The service was impeccable and we sat outside in this adorable outdoor area with lights hanging from the trees and music. They were great about us bringing our new puppy to that area and even came out to pet him and take his pic! So sweet!

I would definitely return and encourage everyone to try it out! Next time I'm going sans puppy so I can stay and relax!

Only suggestion? Please replace the stout that your vendor doesn't carry anymore! Y'all need a dark beer!!

I had lunch in the main dining room a few months ago while attending an employment law update hosted by a firm located on another floor of the same building. I had no idea -until reading other reviews- that this place was only for the sophisticated and prominent upper echelon of Tampa; lunch was included in the (very reasonable) cost of the event, and I was just happy to be fed half way through the day.

I was lucky enough to be in the company of a handful of some very down to earth (and also mostly) non-members, and had an enjoyable (although not spectacular or memorable) chicken dish. The service was great, but what I found most impressive and enjoyable was the panoramic views, which was quite visible -and breathtaking-  from our interior table.

Three stars for the food, four for the atmosphere and service, and five for the views. Being that I'm not a member and probably won't ever be one, I doubt I'll be able to try this place out again to provide an update.

The food is good and prices for the beach are reasonable. The 4 stars are for the service. A lost ticket kept us waiting with anxious kids longer than I would have liked. Management and wait staff saw to it we left happy. Pretty rare for beach restaurants with a trapped audience.

Clean, good food, etc. - yes, wonderful and their food IS good but I think priced too high.  

My girl loves their chicken noodle soup and my son gets the (kids) turkey and cheese sandwich.  I loved the chicken Caesar salad I had on my last trip and that's where the $ value was in my opinion.

And the BREAD - yuuuum-o !!! 

Vince and I split a large (really?!!) sandwich.  A chicken salad one, that was very tasty but I was still hungry afterward.

Their macaroni and cheese is good - made w/ the shell pasta and cheese that's not too thick or cheddary.  

I feel like cattle when we're there w/ ALL of the customers and how you go from station to station to order, pick up then bus your food when done.

I'll go again but I'm not in a rush w/out the kids.

We came here because many people recommend this place online. After we experienced, we highly recommend this place too! 

I ordered hurricane and loved it. Not an alcoholic person but this cocktail tastes more like juice than alcohol. It came in in a jumbo size glass and made me stuffed for whole night.....

We went to the piano bar, which really exceeded my expectations. Line was nearly nothing if you compared to preservation hall next door. But the outcome was great! Ladies and guys played piano in various artistic ways - sometimes fluid and soft, while sometimes dynamic and exciting. Performers sing pretty well too. The ambience overall was great and we enjoyed ourselves here. 

Come here if you want to hear piano; don't want to wait for hours for preservation hall; get good drinks and want to finish them here.

Ordered lava cakes and specialty chicken.took forever to deliver and they forgot the 2 sides of icing we paid for.called back and they promised to bring us back what we paid for.the driver never came and my kids were really upset after waiting an hour and a half then after promising the icing,that never came.this place sucks and so does the delivery guy

The food is nothing special, not good, not bad just standard fare diner food. The service was excellent and its a cool spot if you like to watch the airplanes. The staff was very nice and attentive. I had the tri tip sandwhich...  meat was very tender and tasty. Seemed like pretty good happy hour deals too.

A little more than your typical corner pizza joint.  Along with the staple items, this place opens early enough for breakfast, offer delicious, home made desserts, and both Greek and Italian items.  Be warned!  Their pizza slices are large enough to use as a sail!  Seriously!  Biggest slices in the city!!

All good places have a line, so expect to wait. Come early to avoid running out of the sides you want. 

Customer service - 5/5 great job finding tables for everyone
Menu - 5/5 although it's all about the chicken, the catfish was also extremely delicious and they had great sandwiches (the biscuit one was AMAZING)
Price - pretty decent for the amount of food you get. 

My ONLY complaint is the lady riding the fried chicken on their sign - it's 2018...

Otherwise, I'll definitely be coming back.

To get to heaven you find Ralston and 4th, turn north and go past Hope and look for the little house on the sunny side of the street. The green lawn, the welcoming porch - you found it. It says "Homage" but don't be fooled, you have found heaven. 

I have been here a number of times - for a soul soothing coffee and lushious pastry, a yummy breakfast of quiche and muffin, a special event - all have been delightful and soul satisfying and completely yummy. 

Our latest visit was for Mother's Day brunch - a "Tournant Popup Restaurant" five course meal by reservation only. I was greeted warmly by Nicholle herself and offered a mimosa while we waited for them to get ready for the 12:00 seating. (We were a little early). All was beautifully set. The meal was amazing.We were plied with pastries, fromage, fruit, Fish "en papillote") and a perfect parfait. All was fresh and seasonal and beautifully executed by Ben Deinken. The service was leisurely with plenty of time to savor the wonderful food and enjoy the exquisite weather. 

OK, this was a special event and not the typical experience at Homage. However, the excellent food, friendly service and welcoming atmosphere is the norm here. This one of the best places to come and relax and reflect and refresh while partaking of the highest quality food and drink in Reno. 

Yep - sounds like heaven to me.

The employee was so knowledgeable and friendly and helpful. He was attentive and kind. It was a great experience dealing with the humans. And of course, THE CATS! It was so fun! Some cats were frisky and some were napping but it was just so nice to be in a calm and warm environment that was brimming with love and acceptance. The cats are clearly very well cared for and loved. 10/10

The service was quick. The quality of the meat was good. I guess my expectations for an authentic philly cheese steak was more. I cant really put my finger on it though.  I chose the provolone cheese, perhaps a messier cheese would have been better.

COVID 19 pickup order while doing a job in Treasure Island. the food was good and while waiting the bar tender was able to serve me a beer at the door. Though it was raining... still good! We will come back when the establishment is open fully..
Food is great and love this place. If you never tried Burmese food, you should probably go to this place. You will love it too

Stopped in to try their breakfast. Their omelette does not come with cheese. That is an extra charge for them to slap a slice of processed generic American cheese on it. No seasoning whatsoever on omelette or on home fries. Bland, and unimpressive. I would have enjoyed a gas station breakfast sandwich more than I did my breakfast here. Complete waste of money.

Stayed at the Holiday in on a Saturday night a few weeks ago. Even though it goes against every fiber in me to go to a restaurant twice during a trip we did just that. First was that night since traffic through Clearwater was so bad no one wanted to drive anywhere. For the first time ever being a group of 8 was advantageous since they had a big table available. We ended up having to kill time waiting for the rest of our party to come down. Food was average tourist trap beach fare. Tastiest things our group ordered were the Bonsai shrimp and the island rice. The Bloody Mary's were pretty over the top (literally) but a little weak. 

Flash forward to the next morning and we find out the hotel gave vouchers for breakfast there. We wanted to go to one of the nearby places but weren't going to look a gift horse in the mouth. They had a buffet going but we all ordered off the menu. My wife and I split the banana foster french toast and some sort of country gravy skillet, but the best thing any of us had was the jalapeño gravy that came with my father in laws chicken and waffles. Wish I'd gotten a mug of that. 

Speaking of mugs, we had one big issue that everyone I was with thought should make this a one star review. We all ordered coffees and they brought out a bowl of creamers. Half of them were expired (to the point they were curdled). We sent them back and told them. The brought more out and still half expired. Thought third time would be a charm and still nope. We ended up just picking out the usable ones but couldn't believe that the staff cared so so little even after being called out on it.

We visited Pat's and their nearby competitor based on a couple shows on a popular travel cable channel. Based on our experience, it is obvious the cable channel is not interested in eking out good food, but filming a location-based food story. The story? Pat's invented cheesesteaks.

Pat's is located in a single lane, tightly knit, blue-collar neighborhood. The steak is chopped (my preference), but dry and lacking much flavor. In fact, that sums up the sandwich nicely: dry and lacking flavor. To Pat's credit, in contrast to their competitor, they provide access to napkins and a sloppy assortment of condiments. The do have a large number of sandwich options to choose from and the staff was easy-going and friendly, creating a friendly environment, opposite of the "other guy". They also nudged out their competitor in our informal taste test.

In summary, they are a local mom-n-pop fast food cheesesteak eatery with a history and claim to fame, but not not much of a sober foodie destination.

The line was crazy long and I was starving! But we soldiered on and I'm glad we did. The line moved surprisingly fast. My husband & I decided to split a roast pork with greens & provolone. Although I was "starving", I get full really quick. And I needed to save lots of room for my Beiler's doughnuts! 

The sandwich was yum. Everything tasted fresh and worked very well together. Those greens were delicious! The pork was surprisingly moist. Although, on it's own, lacked flavor. Thank goodness for the garlicky, delicious spinach. Oh, and the provolone gave it that extra umph. It is a pretty messy sandwich though. So any thoughts of being lady-like go out the window. Plus be sure to check your teeth when you're done. Those greens are really sneaky and like to rest between your teeth!

Is it the best sandwich in America? IMHO, no. But it is a tasty and filling sandwich. The price is a bit on the high side but you do get a decent sized sandwich that could feed two of me.

Wow!! This place has the best nigiri ever!! You must try if you like raw fish. It is so fresh and you can see the fat line of the fish. They are slice thinker than any all you can eat that I have been. If you are nigiri lover this is the place to go. Raw salmon!!! Yummy!! I give 4 star because the appetizer just so so.the mussels were so tough to chew. Fried calamari ring so tiny don't feel any thing. All rolls are ok!! I want just eat their nigiri.
Good pizza but warning, not a place to bring your young kids. The pizza takes soooo long to arrive.

Visited Philly on a whim and what an amazing place to eat!  We picked it based on multiple good reviews on multiple sources and you definitely won't be disappointed.  Any time I'm near this spot, I'm going to go out of my way to eat there.  Friendly staff, quick service, and amazing food!  We ordered a Philly Cheese Steak and the famous Roast Pork.  Both had their own unique flavor and were delicious.  I'm recommending this spot to everyone!!

Not a local or a philly cheese steak expert but this was a delicious steak sandwich. And Not greasy. I was the annoying visitor that didnt know the lingo and took too long ordering but oh well! Loved the spicy fries, would go back just for that!
Fitos has gotten better over time.  The service is always good and never had an issue with that.  The meat is better and so is the taste.

awesome food. good wine.

was a little on the pricey side for the "mi casa es su casa" attitude they are promoting.

4 small plates and 2 glasses of wine was $70. ouch.

Used to be great
Not anymore
Falafel was cold and hard. Sode salad had no taste
We used to tolerate bad service and fact they don't accept credit card because food was outstanding 
Not anymore
Always incredible from start to finish! Cody and his staff are incredible! The seafood pasta is to die for! Client for life!!!

Manayunk Brewery is a great place to hang out with friends in the spring and summer time because they have a large outdoor patio! That is my favorite thing about the place. The beer is great but the food is so-so. They have a nice variety of beer for a local brewery and I love supporting local brewers so that is another reason that I keep coming back! 

Their downfall is the food! I have never been completely satisfied with a meal here and I have been here at least a dozen times over the past three years that I have lived in the Manayunk area. 

One time I really wanted the salmon dish but they were all out of salmon so instead I got sushi. Bad idea- sushi was warm and not tasty at all! I have never ordered sushi again since that experience. 

The one meal that I enjoyed but wasn't overly impressed with was the cobb salad . It's loaded with bacon, eggs and blue cheese! It is not a guilt-free salad but that's OK I ordered it because of the flavors not the nutritional value.

I really want to give this place more stars because of it's astronomically sized beer list and adorable plant orbs hanging in the window and weirdly erotic art painted on the walls but I can't overlook how small the portions are for the price.

Went on a Sunday afternoon at like 2:30-3 which apparently qualifies as a late, late brunch for the unusually good-looking yuppy crowd.  Place was packed but luckily the food didn't take too long and we were able to sip our hangovers away with some nice hair of the dog raspberry lambic and a delicious Belgian beer called Ephemere.

Regarding the food portions, boyfriend and I each ordered a burger and since I'm used to paying for burgers in the $8-10 price range (and $2 extra for a yolky egg on top!), I'm generally accustomed to getting bang for my buck.  Though the burger was cooked just fine and the bacon on top was crispy, the size was just mehhh....underwhelming.  A couple bites and I was done.  Not to mention there were way too little of those addicting, crunchy, and salty shoe string fries on the side.

Over $40 for two burgers, two drinks, and an egg on top of my burger is a little bit pricey to do every week for brunch.  It'll be one of those 'once in a blue moon' type of places.

Seriously, though, solid beer list.

I do not know where to begin with this place. Firstly, I know middle Eastern and Mediterranean food very well. Secondly my wife is 100% Oromo and I know the amazing diverseness of Ethiopian cuisine and it's delicious regional varieties.  This restaurant is an absolute fake and ridiculous excuse for anything authentic. "Aksum" and the "Mediterranean" have absolutely no cultural, geographical, or historical commonality. The menu options are bogus. There is no such thing as "Moroccan Chicken and Waffles", this is an insult to both maghrebi cuisine & culture and to southern comfort food. Neither the chicken nor waffles had any flavor. Fail. The service was incredibly poor. Fail. The staff were kind, however, poor service is a reflection of poor management. There were other very concerning things about this restaurant I will not mention other than to blatantly warn people to save your money and choose a better option in Philadelphia. This place is a pitiful excuse for a restaurant and an absolute insult to the pseudo items listed on the menu. Aksum = Wack,son!
Hands down, the best time, every time. Great food, veggie options included. Great beer selection followed by solid service, definitely a St. Pete Pinnacle. Well done by the owner! Cheers!

This place is great because it's open until very late at night. I often stop by to grab one, for the price comes the quantity. However, from time to time the cashiers tend to take advantage of their customers by over charging them (I guess they think people walking in late are all drunk) and they don't hand you a receipt unless you ask for it.

Just sat down with burger and waitress put her hand in my food to throw it away while getting napkins 3ft away.  She began screaming at me when I asked her what she was doing.  Went to counter to get another burger, where waitress followed screaming as if high on meth.  Clerk, who I was told is owner's family, refused to replace burger. 
 Waitress made a racial slur as I walked away.  I think her throwing my food out is their way of keeping 'white tables' clear.  The owner and his family should all burn in hell, all are uneducated trailer park trash as it is.  This place is a symbol of the factory midwest, that the rest of America has forgotten and moved on from.  No matter how many beers they sell, the owners and staff will always be pure trash.

This place was not good and I think holds the distinction for the worst chinese food I have ever tasted. 

I tried the chicken and broccoli and it was barely edible.  It was very bland and the sauce was too sweet.

There are a few things I like about Kang:

- food is not heavily seasoned with MSG and other types of sodium
- restaurant is clean and fairly modern

Food was okay.  But,  expensive for what you get. 
Staff leaves a lot to be desired.  Seems like they hire the best for the least amount of money.  Bathrooms were clean.  Had some dirty tables that needed to be cleaned.  I don't think I will be back.

Stopped in for lunch on the advice of a friend. Had a lunch special of beef lo mein. The hot and sour soup was very good, so I thought I was in a for treat. Agreeing with another reviewer, the lo mein sauce was a bit too sweet for my taste. The fried rice was over cooked and mushy. The egg roll had a metallic taste which was off. Overall, I won't be going back.

I had the duck taco, glazed pulled pork taco and the tuna taco wrapped in lettuce.y wife had the sesame ribeye rice bowl.
I am a value diner. I have no problem spending money for the value. My duck taco was tasty. The duck had a crispy sear and was very flavorful. My pulled pork was average. And my tuna was tasty, but nothing special.
I usually taste what my wife is eating, but if I did that she would have that much less to eat and the bowl was small.
She said the ribeye was good, but nothing extraordinary.
As much as I would like to recommend it, for the money, there are much better options for me when I get a taco.

I've brought family and out of town visitors here numerous times and every experience was a hit. Good service, great food at Datz and a visit to dough for dessert or just smells always made the night. Table favorites for us were the Buffalo cauliflower, monkey bread, and their meatloaf entree. The corn side that went with the meatloaf stands out to me even today after it's been months since I was last there. Be prepared for long wait times or just go with a friend and sit at the bar.

Normally a 5 star but they need some other tv shows. Like the game show networks. Lady beach volleyball. Also, Like to meet wife for their fantastic pressed philly cheesteak wrap sandwich. If it could be served beautifully for her you know young muscular boys. She wold let me come more often. Plus the music way to loud!
Got takeout from here during COVID.  The food is great, including the desserts!  The tastes are inventive and delicious.  5/5.

This is a great diner, wish I'd found it sooner. Listen, it's a diner, not everything is perfect but everything is decent, and some things are really great! Bottom line, they care about what they do, they deliver a solid meal, and their prices are very affordable. I would pick this place over nearly any breakfast joint in Pinellas. You can even get mimosas if you're into that sort of thing.
Good food & atmosphere. It's large inside & out so you don't feel cramped. Delicious long islands!

Disneyland for the vegetarian/vegan in you featuring a changing menu of vegetable goodness. I tried some of the meals here and all were very tasty and they promise you won't miss the meat and they are right. If your in the bywater/upper9 and your looking for a nice veggie meal, this is it.

This is the most authentic food place ive ever been to. The smoked meat is done on site, every thing is prepared to pleasure the taste buds. The highlight is the atmosphere. The people are genuine and the feeling is rustic. This is defently the place i go to for the best pulled pork and ribs in arizona.

It isn't fancy but it's a good diner. I had a breakfast special with 2 eggs, bacon, hash browns and toast. It was good but nothing special. The hash browns lacked any flavor which was easily remedied with a little ketchup. The toast was amazing. It looked like it came from a local bakery.

I found this place when I was on the bus going to the mall and me and my bf decided to give it a try. We didn't try the BBQ because we want to try their other dish out first. We didn't regret not getting the BBQ either! Their utensils were very old and looks dirty so we have to ask for the plastic forks and spoons:( And the foods(squid and teriyaki chicken) that we ordered were ok. What I try to say about this place is that it is over-priced and not worth your hard-earned money!
P.S. Be careful, the people here can't really speaks English so you have to be very patient with them!

Went here while on vacation in New Orleans,  and we were all beyond pleased with our meal.   Every single side dish was amazing,  and we couldn't have been more pleased with the entrées that we ordered.   Topped off with the best desserts that we had while in town.

I was not prepared to like Smashburger.  

Why?

Because it's not only a corporate-envisioned burger joint (owned by the same parent company as Quiznos) but also because it's fast casual and in my opinion, burgers are best either served up slow - or at a greasy take-out window.  But I was traveling through Boise and figured "what the heck" and needed a fast meal.

It's a good thing that my stereotyping is flexible... because it would have missed out on an amazing burger.  

The burgers definitely have a fresh, not frozen taste.  That's good since that's one of the selling points of Smashburger.  I liked that the ingredients I selected seemed to be in perfect proportion to the burger I selected, but also to each other (nothing is worse than a bad condiment-to-topping ratio!)

You can select not only burgers but also chicken (grilled or fried) and salads.  They have suggested burgers but anything can be customized which seems the way to go if you know how you like your burgers.

The real selling point for me, however, were the sweet potato fries.  Holy smokes... those are the best fries (of any kind) that I have ever put in my mouth.  Like so good that a day later, I'm still craving them.  

It's a good thing that Smashburger just opened in my hometown.  Or maybe a bad thing... check my cholesterol in a month as I have a feeling I will be sneaking back for those fries and to try a few other menu items that caught my eye.

The food is fantastic, but a lot of the staff do not seemed well trained and are disorganized. Came here this past Friday evening and almost all the workers could not seem to communicate with each other properly. We had to repeat our orders to the staff about 4-5 times (there's not that many items on the menu....). The girls who rang us up were not friendly at all. Additionally, they ran out of chicken so we had to wait for more chicken to be cooked which was a whole other process and more confusion for the staff. After a while of waiting, the cashier told the cook that we were still waiting for our chicken, to which the cook reacted very confusedly and asked us if we ordered it....They didn't ask me if I wanted white sauce on my platter and handed me a dry platter once the chicken was FINALLY done, and didn't even bother putting it in a bag for me as it was to go. At that point my food had been paid for, and I was so annoyed and wanted to be out of there that I left. I love the food, but the staff really needs to step up their game.
1st time  hitting this spot  the tacos were pretty good although I was shaded on my shrimp taco it only had 2 shrimps piss me off other than that good food try the ahi poke taco .& spicy shrimp..

OMG!  'Nuff said!  Salsa, seasoned chips, smoky queso..... the list goes on and on with fantastic, fabulous deliciousness!!!!!

Will come back again and again and again and again.....

The Father Kino is a fantastic cocktail and I'm a fan of the pork bruschetta. Came here and paid $7+ for one beer even though beer was supposedly on special that night.  Turns out they had added gratuity to our tickets for our party of six people, though I didn't see this mentioned on the menu anywhere. Still, they were very nice about our group arriving at separate times over the course of an hour.

Very sad.  I had a 1/2 rack of dry and a pulled pork sandwich.  As other reviewers said, the flavor of the dry rub is excellent, but the meat is tough and dry (almost like pork jerky).  It was ready about 4 minutes after ordering so probably sat out for a while.  The pulled pork was good but the bun was not.  Very dry and stale.  I almost cried.  HOWEVER, the fried apple pie was incredible and redeemed the evening.  If that's all I had, I would rate this place 5 stars!  I'm not in Nashville often but would come back for that alone, unfortunately not the ribs.  Sorry guys.  Oh, the slaw was also excellent.

Food is very bland. I was underwhelmed by the calamari, which is rubbery and fried in a batter that is absolutely tasteless. As for the gnocchi, of the 5 pieces served as my entree, I savored each and every bite. They lacked flavor and above all the entree was WAY too small for $16. I went home and fixed a wrap at 10pm. On top of everything, our service was horrible... We only saw her three times the entire night. We will not be back.

I really think their chief is one of the best! Brace yourself to eat a lot though, it is just too good to leave on the plate.
It is  crowdy, true, but  we got our breakfast, and then our dinner table, without making reservations. Luckily.
Terrible slow service my god how is it you have a happy hour and one waitress? We have been sitting at a table for 20 minutes. It was like this the last time we came here.

This type of old school diner is so hard to find anymore. No frills, basic, and filling American diner food at low low prices. Wholesome and not greasy, either. Cheese burger deluxe special for $7.55! Incl. generous LTOP, fries, slaw.

These owners must never sleep. They open for the early birds and make much of their food in house. Roasting turkeys, soups, meatloaf, etc. Sweet to boot people too. 

Nice place to hang around and live life slowly.

Gluten free fried chicken?...!!!! Mmmmm, thank you for not bloating my slender physique while feeding my voracious poultry appetite! 

Wonderful fried chicken- really out of this world (:

This casino had the worst service I've experienced at any hotel or hotel casino I've stayed at. I stayed three nights. 1st thee valet was closed and after a 7 hour drive, it would've been nice if they had valet service 24/7. 2nd they had just 1 person checking people in. It took forever. I called a week ahead of time to make some reservation changes of which were never entered. The employee had to go into a back room to get his supervisor to approve a room for me. It left a bad taste in my mouth when that supervisor sat in her back office and didn't help check people in. 3rd I was at the cashier and some "big boss" interrupted the cashier helping me and said he needed an emergency fax sent. The cashier left instructing the other (busy) cashier to help me next. She apologized knowing that Mr. Big Boss should've made sure the casino customer should've come 1st and not his emergency fax! I've been in customer service and yes, the customer should come 1st. 4th I was gambling three evenings in a row and was only approached by 1 cocktail waitress the entire stay!! 5th I'm a smoker and couldn't find ashtrays anywhere! 6th my machine ran out of paper-it took twenty minutes to get a floor person to come change the pater roll so I could move on to another machine. That was after flagging down a security guard to find the change person for me. I did come out a little ahead but lost significantly on my previous trip! We stopped at Boomtown on our way out of town and wished we would've stayed and gambled there! Great service at Boomtown!
Good Italian food, reasonably priced, family atmosphere. I am a fan. I always have a good meal and kind waitstaff when I go.
Love this place! Charming little bistro in Old City with great brunch and lunch fare. Great selection of cheeses, salads and sandwiches, and brunch on the weekends is delicious!

Looks can be deceiving.... 

I wanted to like this place. I really did. It started with the salsa and chips. Salsa flavor was not balanced. It was a little too tomato/citrus/tart, bordering on bitter. I ordered a combination chicken/carne asada burrito with rice and beans. When they brought it to the table, my eyes bulged because it was HUGE!!! Bring a big appetite because the servings all seem to be pretty large. However, the chicken was not very flavorful and the carne asada was like chewing shoe leather. Nope, won't be back to this one...

3 months living in Malvern and I finally made it to Malvern Buttery and the only disappointment I have is why didn't I go there before ? Food was delicious , flat white and green tea latte we ordered were perfect. Loved the urban hipster feel of the decor. Friendly for kids. Enough space for strollers to move around. You are going to see me and my daughter here often.

Two of us decided to split the $97 surf and turf which was a 1-1/4 lb lobster tail and tomahawk ribeye; the third person ordered a petite filet. This would have been four stars if not for the mistimed delivery of the entrees and our server requesting we "cut into the meat" each time it was delivered to the table. I don't know if they were training a bunch of new cooks or what, but it was such a strange way to deliver food to a guest and ask them to immediately cut into the steak and test for doneness. First off, we received the big a$$ Surf n Turf at the table but where was the petite filet? After 5 min of awkwardness, we were able to get our servers attention and learned, after a few minutes more, that the filet had been overlooked and they were preparing a new one. More than 10 min passed, a new one was delivered to the table but was undercooked. Back to the kitchen it went, only to return six minutes later still not done to the correct temp but at this point my friend gave up and ate it anyway. Our tomahawk was more rare than medium rare and a little tough; certainly no match for the steak knife provided. I've been to this restaurant many times but these last two visits to the Bay Star family of restaurants has left me disappointed. (Salt Rock Grill Aug 2016)
I stopped in last week and the aroma was awesome bought home made sausage a large lasagna and an Italian sandwich  made spaghetti out of sausage turned out one of the best ive ever made great flavor

Honestly one of the most overrated Mexican places in Indy. They are always way too crowded for the quality of tacos. The margs are also just okay. They don't take reservations so try to go during an off hour.

I had gone to this place at least twice before I finally admitted to myself that they could NOT cook!  It's just that they were 0.5 miles away and I could walk there, I didn't want to face the truth.  But jerk wings overpowered by soy sauce and bloody curry chicken- enough was enough.  Plus, they don't have any coco bread :p  Lame.  

I gave them an extra star for the plantains, because they were good...when they had them, which was hardly ever.

Love the pie!!! Love the sauce!!! Great steaks!!!! My son and i always stop after his school football, basketball and baseball games. Consistent and flavorful. The staff is friendly and the same guys cooking have been there along while so the have a great team.
Big plus, restroom is always clean....thankyou..

Our sandwiches were good. Very good. BUT the service was amazingly bad. We waited and waited......and waited ....AND waited. And we sent one of our own to the bar to get drinks.  When our drinks finally arrived via the waiter, he didn't seem any too surprised we'd helped ourselves. Something's not right here. 

- the servers seem strangely disconnected from what they're doing. They aren't quite rude, but it's a close call. They definitely have attitude. Also, we watched as two different servers ate their own sandwiches ( lunch?) while standing in front of the cooking area. One took an order to a customer while finishing a bite. This, being a place where food finds your face primarily by hand, gave me pause. 

- the general system of food delivery must be at the root of the problem here. I'm not in the business, but there has to be a better way. 

Bottom line: tasty food, but the service was way below par. Tough call on whether to return.

I eat a strict low carb diet and I was excited to see that Blue Sky Tower had "skinny" drinks on their online menu. I had planned everything I was going to get and whenever I went to make my order the waiter looked at me like I was nuts and said that the skinny drinks are only at their other location. BOO!! I hate when certain locations offer certain things, such a bummer. So, drink skipped. Diet coke please, thanks. I ordered the chicken lollipop skewers as an appetizer, those were pretty tasty. Ordered the All American Burger sans bun and cottage cheese which overall was really good. My friend ordered the pork nachos and really didn't like them, the taste of the pork was not appetizing. I probably wouldn't go back unless I was looking to get some really fried and greasy bar food.

I came on a girls trip with 6 girls for a bachelorette from Chico. Today, Sunday after the trip came to an end we wanted to have something good for a hang over aka menudo. We all got different items BUT everything was 5 stars. We had the menudo, they bring out hand made tortillas and home made salsa. 

If you order tacos those are also served with home made tortillas. We were all so impressed and any time I'm in Reno I will NOT leave town without stopping by. For those of you who don't like menudo they don't have posole but they have an albondigas soup. 

Items ordered today: menudo, tacos and chiles relllenos. The food was so incredible, so we took a torts for the road. Their prices are so cheap it's insane. It's a small restaurant with approx 12 tables and they also make home made Mexican bread and pastries. If you're in town and you love Mexican food this place is as authentic as it gets. We are all Mexican and approve of the authenticity.

The bbq wings are quite good but suspiciously different every time I order them 

The pizza tastes okay-- better than anything else I've tried in the area-- but they never cut it all the way through. Last time we ordered a pizza it came in three pieces: one tiny sliver, one regular-sized slice and then the rest of the pie. How is it even possible to get an odd number of even odder sized slices with a pizza cutter? Incredible.

It also takes at least an hour to get your pizza which means that it's always cold by the time i get it (I live 6 blocks away). 

The delivery people also generally refuse to get out of their cars. Recently I've been playing games of "Chicken" with the delivery guy to see who will make the first move. 

I once had the pleasure of an elderly couple delivering my food. They chastised me for not answering my phone (they had called the wrong number) and wouldn't let me walk away until they had scoured the order paper to make sure I had left a tip on my card.

Oh, and sometimes the delivery guy will call and tell you he's outside when he's actually 10 minutes away.

..but the wings. I really like the wings. Don't get the mild ones-- they're just soaked in orange grease.

Food is as good as cheap Chinese food can be. Very strange picking up and paying for food. Plexiglass everywhere with a small slot to insert your card. Food comes out like they are passing out something that needs to be disarmed. Think they hired the interior decorator from Amscot.

Another terrific pizza place I will recommend to you. It's a good tasting "thin crust" pizza style. The best thing here were the "small" salads that weren't very small at all. Great service, food choices, and overall quality. All at a good price that won't bust your wallet. The only downside here is, that it has a "Pepsi" only contract. Even with that said I am putting this place on our restaurant hot list. We will return. Perfect 5 out of 5.

Very cool spot, reminds me of any other open market I've been to similar in New York & Chicago. Everything you can buy you didn't think you'd need, haha. From sushi, to barbecue, vegan places and candy shoppes galore. Don't forget the cheesesteaks- this is Philly after all! Expect to pay between $15-17 for a fully loaded sandwich.

Overall the food was pretty good. We decided to eat in our car right in front of the restaurant. In my opinion the rice needed a little bit more flavor but it was still good and the chicken was perfect. Everything is made to order so it's nice and fresh.
Love this place! Great food and great service! Will always be a loyal customer.  Best drunken noodles I've ever had

Don't let the outside neighbourhood fool you, this place is great!  

Family owned, and it shows through their very personable interaction.  Tom was super friendly, and was totally accommodating for our 15 month old.  We had chicken salad rolls, Tom Yum Pho with chicken and the vermicelli bowl.  

Short and sweet, this place was excellent.  A must try!
This place is soon going to be The Wishing Well, so long Pat Bombinos!
Awesome food, awesome atmosphere. Mac and cheese, ribs, and chicken sandwich were all amazing!

I LOVE sushi and my brother introduced me to Sushi Ya. It's not someplace you would typically think of based on the area of town and the building it is. From the outside, just looks like a building that you roll into by chance, but once you are in, you are greeted by a counter of fresh fish ready to get in your belly! They have a stellar menu with delicious rolls for anyone from the novice sushi eater to the advanced I MUST HAVE it sushi eater. They have a deal for all you can eat sushi for 18.95 per person. HOLY COW what a steal! You can get your meal's worth in just two rolls, but of course I ate a BIG plate. The variety and flavor details of each roll stood out and kept me asking for more until I just couldn't eat any more and had to tap out! The ambiance is nothing special, but you're going for the food right? Right. Get in there and experience sushi before you go anywhere else. The one thing they could improve on is service from the servers in regard to keeping drinks filled and checking in on plates sitting empty and patrons waiting to order more.
Great food! pleasant staff always remembers my past orders
The manager was very accommodating when we needed a table quickly. The food was great as usual.
This is the best Mexico food I ever had. I and my husband both love it! Want to come back before we leave Santa Barbara.

This place has a very nice "broken in" feel. Classic/traditional accents. Warm wood tones. Mosaic bar backsplash in the back and another bar connecting to more seating space near the restrooms. Much larger than it appears from the outside. We were promptly seated and our waiter Eric set himself apart from other servers while rocking Jean overalls! We went with our friends. ThEy ordered an appetizer of fries which came with 3 dips.. one of which was truffle aioli which was the bomb. We began with fried green tomatoes whicH was plated very nicely topped with black bean salsa. Vibrant and fresh. The guys both ordered fish and chips which came as a largE portion.... neither could finish their plate. My friend got beer steamed mussels. She has ordered them before and couldn't finish but she tried!! It  has a  butter,  lemon and bacon sauce. The waiter brought her an extra plate to shuck. I ordered vindaloo  curry with chicken. The meal was also offered with tofu as a vegetarian option. The developed flavored were incredible. VERY evident that this brewery has experienced and passionate chefs in the kitchen delivery lots of curated and cultured dishes which are elevated from the expectation. Beer was solid. Atmosphere was invited. Service rocked!! Eric was funny, efficient, attentive and thoughtful. He even brought a  side of aioli for the to go boxes without being asked. Cheers!

I can't even begin to say how amazing this place is. Atmosphere and staff are top notch. The food is the BEST in Edwardsville, and one of the best in the St. Louis area. Unique, tasteful, and high quality. This is how a restaurant is done. A++++++... I'll be back again and again and again.

Had dinner here tonight with my family. Had high hopes based on reviews but was not too impressed. Ordered the feast or prix fixe menu. I have to admit I was a little hesitant to try the quail shooter-ok but would have rather had it cooked and it was drowning in Siracha and teriyaki. The grilled octopus was really rubbery because it was over-cooked. It also had way too much bbq sauce as if to disguise the chewy texture. Shrimp endive was good and salad was tasty. I did not care much for the flavor of the soup du jour-not a fan of dill and this had dill seedlings. Filet and lobster was next and steak was cooked perfectly but lobster was over-cooked, but tolerable so it was not so tender. Overall, presentation was beautiful and restaurant had good ambiance. The chocolate creme brûlée tasted like my home made pudding with a brûlée over it but it was yummy. Honestly the food was ok and would have given maybe 3 1/2 stars if I could. Nice place but across from the Wild Orchid.

Just ate here. I had the vegan banh mi. It was absolutely fabulous. The 3 star rating is because of everything else that happened during my short visit.

When I got the check, I was surprised to find out that there was an extra charge of $1.5 (!!) for the vegan mayo. I was not informed that this charge would be coming when the bartender so kindly informed me of the substitution possibility.

If you're going to charge that much for a substitution - which you absolutely shouldn't do - you need to inform the patrons while they order. The bartender's response of "I don't pick the prices" is hardly an excuse - nor is it an appropriate thing to say when a patron communicates their dismay after you asked them if they enjoyed the food (I said "yes, absolutely", but that the surprise charge did not sit well with me).

On top of that, I found out later - your bathroom doesn't lock and had no soap dispenser: the latter is hardly a good sign in an astablishment that serves food and at which, I assume, the people handling the food also relieve themselves sometimes.

After the bartender's poor and defensive behavior earlier, I didn't really feel like saying anything to her. Seemed like she wasn't keen on receiving negative feedback, constructive or otherwise. 

It's too bad that this is the taste I left with, because the food was really great and your chefs / cooks absolutely deserve applause for their work!

I've got to give noble hops three stars only. My husband and I are trying to visit all the Tucson restaurants and this one was only average. The sober hen was delicious but the bone-in makes it extremely difficult to eat. My husband got the same dish and he seemed to struggle with it more than me. Overall it seemed like an early 20s type of crowd environment and would probably be a lot of fun. We sat outside and the temperature was just right but there is less attention to the customer outside. Our waiter definitely took a long time to bring menus, take our order, and deliver the food. Prices aren't bad, around $18-$25 a piece but the service is NOT that great.

It's a hole in the wall shop with very confusing decor and vibes, but very friendly staff. The service is slightly slow and it's hard to discern the freshness of the ingredients at times, but all-in-all, it's great.

The prices are cheap, portions are fair, and flavoring is on point. Would definitely recommend for lunch or family takeout.

Great stop - super friendly and nice staff.  We ordered tacos, Campechanos, Camaron (Shrimp), Al Pastor and were very very happy.  - A definite do over by all means.  

Very cost effective tasty num nums.

It's okay. The pizza is delivered quickly and the delivery person is always nice. I'm giving a low rating tonight because i find Marco's post delivery survey atrocious. First the survey gives you a link on your ereceipt to select and that's convenient. But then it requires you to enter a 20 yes 20 digit code into 4 boxes on the website. There is no way of knowing how many numbers to enter into each differently sized box, and I tried 3 separate combinations before giving up. AYIEEE!

I don't care about getting a free cheesy bread order. I have completed more than one survey in the past for previous orders and I have never written down the coupon code which is another gripe. 

Why why why after selecting the automatic link tied to your ereceipt that's tied to your online Marco's account is the coupon not automatically uploaded to the account. But I digress. 

All I wanted to do was compliment the food and the delivery and yet again Marco's already ridiculously long survey has been made every worse by adding a 20 digit code! 

Marco's Pizza, if you actually have anyone any where actually monitoring and adapting your business processes to customer comments, do something about your damn ridiculous survey and I will not give a one star rating again. 

Thank you Yelp for offering a forum for my rant because the company that actually cooked and delivered my food does not. I feel better now.

Was disappointed after I saw all the great reviews.  The smell the instant you walk in the door is amazing.  Makes your water mouth instantly.  

For the price, the food was just ok.  I had the BBQ wood grilled chicken and my date had the 1/2 slab ribs.  They didn't even fall off the bones.  Ribs and a fork just don't go well together.  The while meat of my chicken was dry.  The dark was tasty and flavorful.  

Best part of the meal .. . . .the cocktails to start with.  They are known for their carmel apple martini.  A tad on the sweet side but what do you expect?  The orange mojito. . . .AWESOME!  Great flavor and not overpowered by the mint.

My husband and I went there a few months ago. He ordered something that was expensive and I ordered something like a chicken enchilada or chimichanga or something like that (you can tell it was an easily forgetful experience - lol). Anyway, I remember thinking that his portions weren't particularly large (considering the price) and my chicken was dry. Also, our appetizer was like an eggroll with a very different mixture of sweet and savory tasting sauce. My husband said he liked it, although I noticed that he never finished his leftovers later on at home. All in all, I felt like it was a little over priced for the quality of food and to be honest, I was a little disappointed that it wasn't more authentically Mexican. It's more like daring and creative cuisine with Mexican roots and if that's your thing, then go for it... but I wouldn't be missing out if I never went there again. Final notes: our waitress was sweet but dressed in tight black clothes (not classy but trying to be?) and kept trying to talk to us when I wanted to be left alone. But then when we were ready for our check, she was nowhere in sight. Kind of annoying... (I hate having to ask for the check - especially if it's already slow business that night. I feel that a sign of a good and attentive server is them knowing the appropriate moment to give us the bill.)

I'll give it a second try but...the pizza dough was more like a frozen (pre-prepared) thing rather than the homemade hand tossed wood fired crust I expected -- I admit however, I didnt actually see the dough being made.  I say this because the crust was a too uniform and didn't have the slight char on it I expected from a wood fired oven (not hot enough?).  The wings and pulled pork were excellent and I think the pizza needs some elevating to match the quality of the wings and BBQ.

This weekend I was visiting Nashville for my birthday and my friend surprised me with going to brunch here. I must say the place is just beautiful! From the outside to the inside. The decor was absolutely stunning. I love how it is actually a furniture store but also a cafe. On to the food the food was amazing, I ordered the thick cut maple bacon, lobster roll with a salad. Delicious! My friend ordered the Avocado Toast he said it was great. They give you a lot of food which is great. I wish I could remember who our waitress was but she took great care of us the whole time! I definitely say pay a visit to them the next time you are in Nashville.

This used to be my very favorite coffee shop but ever since they got some new staff the coffee rarely comes out the way you order it. Also, when you're ordering they act super annoyed when your trying to be very clear but I'm trying to be clear for a reason! It's just not worth gambling wether it's going to be good or not anymore. Such a bummer!!

The food was ok. The biscuit was huge but hard not light and fluffy. The sausage tasted great. The gravy was a bit floury tasting. I was supposed to get 3 eggs but got 2. The potatoes were good but some sort of aftertaste. I asked for a specific  cinnamon roll and was brought a different one. When I got it home and heated it up it was still hard. Yuck. If it is only good fresh out of the oven it is not well made.

I know there is a lot of discussion about cheesesteaks. Pat's, Geno's, Delassandro's, Tony Luke's. Much of this is personal preference, and in the case of Geno's, a lot of history and nostalgia. 
When we come to Philly, Geno's is always on our to stop list. It is my wife's favorite, and it takes me back to my childhood walking through the Italian market in South Philly. 
Their sandwiches are just like they have always been, served with the classic "whiz" and of course have to get "wit" onions. Their fries are always hot and fresh, and service is what it is. After all.. it is south Philly on a street corner. What do you expect. I love the tribute to law enforcement with patches from police departments all across the globe!

This lounge was exceptionally unexceptional. We were going to go to another lounge near by but the decor and appearance outside made us check this place out. My party was ID'd at the bar and then told to find any seat we would like. after grabbing a booth and awkardly sitting and chatting for about 15 mins the waitress came by and asked if we had decided yet w.o getting any menus. They had a nice and extensive drink menu but their Hash selection was iffy at best on a terribly laid out "menu"

Pros- nice environment, Person who plays music has a great phone playlist.
Cons - eh service, no interesting/outstanding flavors available.

PS. evidently the promo on yelp no longer works.

Came to Philly for the day and ended up walking into this bar, we were looking for a place to sit and grab a bite to eat. 

The second I walked in I loved the vibe and feel of the place, it's a true authentic Irish bar with a nice fun low key young college crowd. I sat at the bar and ordered a burger and a Stella on tap. Bartender was super friendly and she had a fun happy vibe about her. Food came rather quickly and the burger was pretty good. 

Reason I'm only giving this place 4 stars is because the burger was good but not phenomenal. I've def had better, but it was still a great lunch and perfect break in the day to stop in. Would def go back
First time here.  Very comfortable atmosphere.  The food presentation was awesome and tasted as good as it looked.  What makes this place so good is the exemplary staff.

I got the Royal Grill - adult grilled cheese with apples and OMG it was GREAT, but what I cannot forget was the ice cream!  The flavor of the month was SHIPwrecked and I cant stop thinking about it!  This ice cream was perfect...and it is the flavor of the month and I am going back tomorrow to get more since it is the last day of the month!

Most everything was amazing.  Some of us also eat meat, but we were all very pleased with our vegetarian options and the tofu Po Boy was the best tofu I have ever had.  We also shared the roasted carrot avocado salad which was also very tasty.  The other dish we all tried was the Pad Thai, which personally I wasn't as fond of being as it is a cold dish.  The flavor was very good, but prefer it hot.  Really great service and would definitely return.

中国人开的餐馆，菜还不错，尤其是对多日被西餐虐的人来说。服务人员也是中国人，其中一个有些小屌，基本上是"你们来这儿可选的余地也不大，我们就这样"的态度。

相对于国内，饭菜多少都有些变异，不可奢求过多，吃饱吃好就行。

Me, the wife and another couple stopped in here on a Friday night to kill some time before dinner. Been here a couple times now and really like the vibe and atmosphere. We ordered the Cheese Plank to nibble and liked sampling the different cheeses. Wife enjoyed a margarita drink and her friend had wine. My buddy and I tried some scotches via flights. Service was good and we maybe should have just ordered dinner here the way things were going. Would have liked to see the "flights" of scotch on the menu - we had to ask about that option (having been there previously I knew we'd be able to get flights).

Showed up mid morning on a Sunday to find out it was a 3 hour wait. Urgh nobody wants to wait 3 hours for breakfast. But we noticed you could order online and carry out. There were plenty of picnic tables scattered around the property so we decided to go that route.  Instead of 3 hours we had our food in 25 minutes. While we waited the shops & cornhole occupied us. 

The service from the younger girls at the hostess stand/counter was probably the least appealing about the whole place. Asked for forks & napkins for our carry out order was like asking for the world.

Food was decent, nothing special or worth a 3 hour wait. But I can now say I've been to the Loveless Cafe!

Pollo Loco serves some tasty chicken, but I feel that at the regular price, they should be serving free-range organic. Now, if you use the $5.00 coupons that come in the mail, it becomes a good value, especially the double pollo  bowl; that's a real fill-'er-upper. I recommend mixing the spicy avocado salsa with the pico de Gallo for a nice combo of taste and texture. As far as sides go, the corn is good; the cole slaw is meh, and the mac and cheese is like a bad version of Kraft. They should replace it with a roasted poblano chile smothered in some kind of Mexican cheese. Keep an eye out for those coupons!

This place just opened this week. Great location in the Scolari center next to the Eye Zone. They place is really nice inside and has a patio with a killer view of Reno. No patio seating now too cold. I got a flyer in the mail and they even have free delivery. I decided give it a try for lunch. They have sushi as well but I didn't try that. They have a good lunch special menu with your choice of chow mein or pork fried rice. I chose the Chicken curry partially because it is something I'm usually disappointed with but that I really like. 

It's less than $6 for the lunch special and the portion was huge. I like spicey food and the Chicken curry was the perfect spice level and didn't have an overpowering curry flavor. This may have been the best chicken curry I have ever had. Loaded with very fresh veggies and good quality Chicken.

It was only  a lunch but I'll be back for a full dinner and will adjust my review as needed but for now 5 stars for the nice atmosphere, great service and food.

Mahalo!
OMG!!
All my favorite things in one place at one time.
I'll have a bowl with salmon, avocado, pineapple, mango, edemame beans, seaweed salad, etc, etc, etc...

Riverside Grill Shack is my new go to for burgers in East Nashville. Since my formerly beloved East Nashville burger joint  has gotten a little too awesome to provide customer service, I was forced to venture out to see who can step up to the place.  I'm so glad I did.

Look no further! This is the place. Sure you really can't eat there unless it's warm out, but that's ok. It is named a "shack" so I think that's fair game to be mostly take out only. I live close enough to happily trudge home with my yummy cheeseburger and insanely amazing fries. I will say I won't be upset when spring arrives though so I can sit on their covered patio and eat my burger in the great outdoors :).

Staff is cool- easy to talk to helpful. We've been twice and will definitely go back next time we need burger deliciousness.
Great food and served at a nice pace where we could socialize but not feel like we were forgotten. Marisa provided us with great service!

After attending the Pride parade, my group and AI were starving, but knew that most restaurants in the vicinity of the parade (Mass Ave) or festival (City center) would likely be packed. However, I f figured most people don't think about eating in a hotel restaurant of they aren't staying there, which is an absolute crying shame. High Velocuty was a great place to relax for a bit, put our feet up and escape the incoming heat and rain. My partner and I shared the chicken and waffle tacos (always a must) and sweet potato fries. We were well taken care of, and the food was great. My only complaint was that they didn't have decaf coffee, only regular, but if we wanted it badly, we could have stopped at a Starbucks. Would love to go back to take advantage of their patio and adult slushies!

Had Banana foster.. Loved it.. They made it in front of us.. The bloody mary was very good, especially the pickled Okra. 
Staff was really very nice. The place has a great decor. Hard to find a gem like this close to Bourbon Street.

Great food! Great Taste. The dishes from this restaurant are from a different region of China than most of the Chinese restaurants in Philly Chinatown. So, if you are ready for something new, fresh and tasty I really recommend it. There are noodle soups, cold noodles, lo mein dishes, stir fried rice dishes, rice meals, but maybe the most tasty are the Chinese dumplings and buns. The vegetables in the dishes seemed very fresh and crisp, that was a major plus for me! Even with the great food, the prices are still very reasonable: average dish ~$6.50. Oh and the waitress was very nice!! One of my new favorite restaurants!
Consistently great seafood. Always fresh and creatively presented with delicious sauces and side dishes. The crab cakes are some of the best I have ever had.

This restaurant lives up to the hype! We ordered the boucherie plate which was amazing, the gumbo was just spicy enough, the pork cheeks were small but delicious!  The cucumber salad is great if you like dill.  For dinner, we enjoyed the ribs for 2.  It was 3 lbs and cooked to perfection!  We even brought some home.  We finished the night with the pineapple upside down cake which was an amazing mixture of fruit flavors and decadence.  

Service was on point the whole evening.  Only suggestion is to make a reservation.
New York style bagel shop with family feel. Ordered whole wheat everything bagel and a coffee, both delicious.
The best!! 3 beignets and a cafe au leit.  Yummy
When you walk in you'll smell the fries. Order them. Awesome beers and sandwiches. Looking forward to coming back
Must get that turkey neck. It's not an option. The crab and crawfish where great. The price perfect. Not get into decor or bathrooms...it is what it is.
Loaded fries are fantastic. The bar is really limited, not much variety. Love the milkshakes in the diner side.

First, this place is NOT closed! at least the restaurant isn't. I just ate there last night for the second time. the food is delicious. they have a chef who really cares about preparing tasty and innovative dishes. he's very friendly and you can tell by his enthusiasm that he loves what he does, takes pride in preparing great food and presenting it in very impressive ways. our waiter, daryl, is always friendly, personable, and funny. they have live laidback music some nights which everyone seems to enjoy. I've only been twice but it appears to be an older clientele, maybe 40s and older. prices are probably typical for quality food. not cheap. burgers run about $14 and up. entrees can be upwards of $25 to $30. but if you want delicious, memorable food, I'd recommend it.

Cute buzzy bistro with a luscious roast chicken that could feed a family (in this case fed two) and interesting sweet potato mole side. Wait staff galore want to engage you in chitchat. Delivered a tasty parsnip soup amuse bouche that leaves a good impression. Tables so close together enables easy eavesdropping.
The food was excellent. The atmosphere was fabulous. The beer selection was lovely. I kind of wish the servers had been in character though.

Was I disappointed when the prior diner establishment closed, yes.  Did I think that I would be bitter for whatever came in next, yes.  Am I?  NOPE!

We have stopped in twice so far and sampled the croissant, the cinnamon roll, and cruffin.

Place is very cute.  Clean, very friendly.  Easy parking.  Reasonable prices.

The baked goods are most excellent.  Our most recent trip the cinnamon rolls were still warm.  This is a very flakey roll.  Does not need frosting on top.  I wonder how much butter is used in them, but then stopped thinking about it.

One day soon we will try the sandwiches for lunch.  

Welcome to the neighborhood Crumb Factory!

Very nice server but house margaritas are pre-made, very weak. Very slow service so don't come starving and the food is super bland. 
Nice atmosphere outside but go only for drinks. 
The bartender was very rude and didn't want to give us glasses after ordering a $28 pitcher

In town for work. Good service. Decent food. I had the half chicken for dinner with the Greek salad, potatoes and green beans. The salad was the best part, the rest was ok. Then had a coffee, which was good, and a dessert that's kind of like a cheesecake, yummy.

I ordered for delivery 3/8/21, two pizzas, one small bbq chicken and one XL Big Cheesy with add on toppings (bacon, ham, mushrooms, red onions and spinach) and a family size garden salad with Greek salad dressing. This was my first time to order a pizza from Marco's Pizza. I wanted to try a different company instead of my usual PJ or PH. I have to say I am disappointed that the pizza staff didn't bother to contact me about any possible ingredients they may not have had. My XL pizza was missing the ham and spinach. I thought I ordered a two liter Pepsi, but I looked back at the order and it wasn't there. So I'm not sure what happened there. Maybe I forgot to add to cart. I gave them 3 stars only because of the lack of communication and the missing pizza add ons. 

The pizza has a very good taste and a minimum amount of add on ingredients. I wish there was more, especially if the ham and spinach was on the pizza, it wouldn't look so naked. The small bbq chicken was very tasty. One more wish would be that I could choose a thin crust over their regular crust. I don't like so much bread. The family size salad has a lot of ingredients and is very large. They provided 4 dressing packets. I'm not sure I'll ordered from them again. Not a good impression for a first time order. I wish communication was important to them!

i ate here and then i left and was immediately concerned after seven steps, the length of the patio, that i no longer had carolyn (sp? i'm so sorry if that's wrong) to talk shop with. they know more than you. food was perfect wine was perfect, get dessert and an amaro if you go. you deserve it (?) Yelp Person. spend the check correctly. thanks yall.

Fabulous restaurant - we were celebrating a special anniversary and they couldn't have been nicer, plus we sat outside with our dogs. The food is innovative but still delicious (loved the Seabass) and the wine list offers something for everyone. 5 stars. We can't wait to return.

I am going to rate them at a solid 3.5 stars. They lose a half star because it's cash only and everything on the menu seems to cost $12.95. First of all $12.95 is a bit steep for lunch and what kind of place in this day and age does not take plastic?

Chips and tasty salsa to start with.... no complaints there. 

I ordered the Camarones Culiche, which apparently translates to perfectly cooked, plump Mexican shrimp in a what-the-heck-is-in-this-very-delicious-but-very-green-and-cheesy sauce.
