The décor was what was expected of a family restaurant - cozy with lots of wood.  The fall decorations were tasteful and not overdone.  There were a few areas that could have used an overhaul - as one Yelper mentioned the carpet was dirty, but not extreme.  Our Formica table top was cracked in several places, and in the ladies room the toilet tank was held in place by a bungee cord.  Not sure what that was all about....

But at this point we would have ate off the concrete!  With bellies growling we made our selections from the menu.  It had a good variety of sandwiches, wraps, soups, and meals.  The selection was vast but not overkill.  It was what one would expect from a family type dining establishment.  We both choose different sandwich "melts" because we wanted something quick so we could make the long trek home.

Our food arrived in the normal amount of time and was made perfectly.  Each sandwich was grilled and gooey.  My turkey melt consisted of carved turkey and not processed lunchmeat which was filling and fresh.  We each had a side of battered fries (good, but obviously from frozen) and were supposed to get a side of coleslaw - which we had to ask for. While I felt my portion size was adequate hubby was slightly disappointed.

 In fact I think aside from maintenance issues service was probably my biggest gripe.  Our waitress was not warm and friendly - but rather cold and to the point.  I had to ask twice for mayo despite there only being one other patron in her section.  I had to ask for the coleslaw although it was included.  We had to ask for the check.  We didn't get water refills like we should of.  It wasn't horrible, just wasn't extraordinary either.  Food was good but not special.

Obviously a place that caters to older clients where everyone knows each other - good for them and good for us in a pinch.

WORTH MENTIONING: we paid with a credit card and handwrote the tip however we were not offered a copy.  Red flags go up immediately when that happens. Fortunately I asked for one, as it is easy for them to transpose what you wrote.  After reading the non-recommended reviews there was mention of one customer who added a cash tip to the table only to have the cashier add another to his card w/out his consent.  IF PAYING WITH A CREDIT CARD INSIST ON A RECEIPT!  Although him and I might be an isolated case it's better to be safe than sorry!

2 stars is appropriate for this  because well... 'Meh. I've experienced better.' I was very disappointed with this new restaurant and now I really missed Growlers! (previous restaurant in this spot)

I love Mexican food and was looking forward to it opening  but this place missed the mark on so many simple things. Ironically, the only thing I really enjoyed was not even a traditional Mexican dish, it was an appetizer.  Hopefully they improve since they just opened.... 

Tacos - Pork Carnita tacos came three to an order. Instead of using two corn tortillas for each taco, there was only one which made it difficult to eat and it fell apart. Many traditional Mexican tacos are served with two so that it doesn't get so sloppy and the tortilla absorbed a lot of the marinade. Well, the pork was dry so maybe that's why they used only one. The pork was very dry! 

Nachos - We got it topped with Chorizo and that was good but I feel that there should have been more and there were a lot of extra naked chips meaning that there was not enough toppings. 

Cocktails - I should have just ordered the Negro Modelo(great Mexican beer)!  Instead, I had two signature cocktails and they were both off-balanced.

Based on yelp reviews, we went to Barbuzzo for late night pizza.  Although we opted to sit outside (without heating lamps) on a cold night, the excellent food more than made up for the temperature.  I'd highly recommend it.

I don't usually review places on Yelp, but I just had to review Spice 28 - simply because I've never had a better dining experience. (And I'm no hermit; I dine out quite a lot!!!) 

We went in there for my friend's birthday on Friday around 7 pm when most places had a wait time of around 2 hours. They seated us within 5 minutes of us walking in despite having an incomplete party. 

Our waitress was amazingly friendly. We were quite surprised to learn it was her first week working at the restaurant, because she was educated on all the menu items & offered great suggestions as we were deciding on appetizers and drinks.

Two of us went with the Lychee Martinis while one of my other friends decided on the Philly Love for drinks, and for apps, we had Thai Crispy Calamari, Indian Pancakes, and Thai Spring Rolls. 

The drinks came out within 5 minutes and the apps followed immediately after. We ordered our entrees - Mango Chicken, Dan Dan Noodles, and Pepper Chicken. When the entrees showed up 20 minutes later, one of the people in the party realized her entree - pepper chicken - was too spicy for her palette, and our waitress (with no fuss!) immediately offered to get her something else and even helped her pick out something much less spicy - Thai Basil Fried Rice. She even left the Pepper Chicken for the rest of us to nibble on! How awesome!

As I mentioned before, it was my friend's bday so obviously we had to get dessert. I managed to sneak away from the table to ask our waitress if she could surprise my friend with a candle lit dessert. Of course, our waitress pulled me aside so my friend wouldn't notice us huddling over the dessert menu. (How sweet & thoughtful!?) We picked out the house dessert (Exotic Bomba) for dessert, which was bought out by four "Happy Birthday" singing wait staff. 

Did I mention she didn't charge us for the dessert nor did she charge us for the Pepper Chicken?

If you do decide go, please ask for Stephanie!!! We were so amazed by her, we even had her call her manager over so we could let the manager know what a wonderful job this girl was doing! :)

I enjoyed the variety of beer and the sour beer. The staff was well informed and guided me well with the selection of beer. The food was tasty and well cooked. I had a burger and it was ample. I will definately visit this place again and try more variety of beers.

Really cheesy, really cheap pizza. The building is a bit rundown, but the food is good and the people are friendly. Since Mullica Hill is the one town that has pizza (that I know of) in about 20 miles or so, I recommend this place. It's not New York, but if you're looking for pizza in the area, then this will do.

Came here on 1/10 Sunday around 12 - there was a 40 minute wait but it was well worth it . The interior was for modern and the service was great . My girlfriend and I both had the French toast cannoli it was good , was it omg no but it was good and def served a lot . The bacon was probably the best bacon I ever had . Coffee was good . I have two complaints - one is parking and secondly is that they don't accept credit cards - cash only  and although they have an atm on site it sucks bc ur paying for the fee . But besides that goo for it

Not your typical breakfast from @torshi_egyptian_food in @st.rochmarket. The perfect falafel with a hard boiled egg inside, served on creamy hummus. This breakfast was incredibly filling, but didn't leave me feeling that 'I need to take a nap' type feeling after brunch. The fresh Greek salad  on the side with fig vinaigrette was also refreshing and delicious.

So if you want to get extremely particular, some of the food here lacks a little flavor, but it isn't anything some salt, pepper and their own sauces don't help correct. 

We stopped in one night when we didn't feel like making dinner, and it turned out to be a great choice. As a vegetarian, it's a little hard to know for sure if you can really find something to eat and certain places, but they offered a bunch of vegetarian sides which turned out great. 

Their garlic sauce (provided at a side table full of sauces) was amazing. I wish I could take a bottle home with me. 

So all in all, for a "fast food" spot, this place is a gem.

I Went here with a very sweet guy for dinner. We started with stuffed mushrooms with crab and scallops with bacon. Very good!!  Next we both ordered the crab cakes. They were good and they came with a nice salad and potato and a vegetable. The ambiance was very pleasant. Nice mix of people. They had a good selection of craft beer and wine. We didn't have reservations but we were seated at the bar at a high top which was really nice. A special fun night.

Located in a new retail area on Franklin Rd in Brentwood, Blaze is bright, colorful and spacious. As one of the few tenants open right now, parking was easily found. Upon entering, you place your order at a counter and your pizza is assembled as you go, in a Moe's or subway shop fashion. The pizza is then baked in 3 minutes. I love the simplicity of ordering, and that they have thin crust dough. All pizzas are the same size (11") and for a flat price of $7.85, you can get as many toppings as you want. If you want just one topping and cheese, the price is $6.25. There's a choice of three different sauces, various cheeses and meats, and a colorful array of vegetables. They also offer 8 signature pies for $7.85. 

I opted for the simple pie ($5) with just sauce, mozzarella and parmesan, since I was more interested in the salads today. They offer 4 side and 2 entree salads, all made fresh in house. I had the tomato, basil and ovalini salad - a very substantial portion of arugula, basil, cherry tomatoes and fresh mozzarella with a thick balsamic dressing. It was almost enough to be an entree salad and a steal at $3.85. My total with drink came to $11...very reasonable for Brentwood. I also have to mention the drinks. They have the typical soda fountain and iced teas then lemonade and blood orange lemonade, which was so tangy, sweet and refreshing on a warm Spring day!

My only teeny tiny complaint was that it was pretty loud in there. It was okay for a table of 2, but I imagine it would be difficult for a large group to hear each other. Perhaps turn the music down a bit during weekday lunches. Otherwise, I loved Blaze and will definitely return.
This is my absolute favorite place for Thai food!  Delicious, fresh and always the right amount of spice.

Five Guys Burgers and Fries. 
I'd eat it more often
But it'd go right to my thighs!

They make a tasty burger 
And I like mine with all the toppings. 
When I've stopped by here for lunch,
Man, the place was hopping!

They finally offer the fries 
In a slightly smaller size. 
But I still find my stomach
Is not as big as my eyes. 

My orders never take long
Nor have they ever been wrong. 
Maybe they'll take my poem
And turn it into a song!

Getting off of the shitty New Century bus, starving and grossed out,  we headed over to this McDonald's to use the bathroom and grab a snack. 

This turned out to be the perfect Philly welcome. 

I was able to enter the bathroom right away, but my boyfriend had to wait for them to BREAK INTO THE BATHROOM with a putty knife....as a HUGE fight consisting of female McDonald's employees broke out in the street. It was insane. Screaming, clawing...we couldn't wait to get out of there (okay, who am i kidding, i ran out of the bathroom without drying my hands to see this spectacle..). 

FInally the employees were able to pry the men's bathroom door open and we were able to make a swift exit. 

Only in Philly?

We got some late night tapas after Krewe de Vieux. It was a good choice. Good value, good service, good food and great drink.

Our friend J needed to pick up some late night liquid courage, in the hopes he'd get lucky later that night. He got the chameleon, which was frankly delicious. In hindsight I wish the Biff and I didn't have to wake up at 4am to catch our flight. But alas! 

OUR MENU: 
Pimenton sausage sandwich- Nice and savory, but definitely a tapas item.

Market greens/Crowder peas- Veggie options to cleanse the palate.

Mussels- A deep bowl full of delicious bivalves. Well done with unlimited bread to sop up that sauce. 

Goat tacos- 3 of em, perfect for out group. The harissa is key and so so flavorful. I also greatly enjoyed the tomatoes on the side.

Sweet potato croquetas- Pretty delicious.

This is one of my favorite Thai restaurants in the Nashville area! Nothing else came close! Everything they have on the menu is delicious but my go-to is the Tom-Yum Noodle Soup. It's been my dish since I started coming here 5 years ago. Highly Recommend!

Exceeded expectations. Great service, smiling faces of servers and great tasting food. Ordered samosas, kadhai paneer, paneer Sarah and Maharaja bread basket and of course mango lassy. Each and every item was awesome.
The food was awesome. Try the spicy sausage linguini or the vegetable linguini. The turtle chocolate cake was great for dessert.

Asked my daughter where she wished to go eat for her B-day, gave her a choice of the common places in the area, the ruby's, friday's, chilis, and so on. Why did she choose NY Buffet I have no idea, no matter how many times I drove by this place, it just never appealed to me, not for a second. But she insisted we go, even after I tried to talk her out of it. 

Didn't take long till we all realized this place was nothing short of a hot mess. it just felt gloomy and sad inside, the food was not far off. Didn't want to judge the food by it's cover so a tried a little bit of everything. Food tasted gloomy and sad. It was the usual Asian style food that'd you expect but poorly done. How does this place manages to stay in business is a mystery to me. Spend your hard earned money somewhere else.

For what is worth, we made the most of it. Baby girl did not enjoy the food either, sometimes you gotta learn the hard way. smh.

Food way too salty although decor is excellent.

One star as a restaurant. As a party bar, I might love it for the atmosphere and decor

I went here with my friend on Valentines Day and I was not disappointed.  We both did the Valentines day tasting menu and it was amazing! The dishes were well thought out and well executed.  I believe for the the price it was great quality and well worth it. 

The atmosphere was low key and intimated.  It would be a great "grown up" date place without it being pretentious.  I definitely would come back again to check out their regular menu.

We loved this establishment the first four or five times we enjoyed meals there.  However, the menu now seems to be centered around chicken dishes.  We could always count on seeing a meat or seafood entree being offered occasionally, but we haven't seen seafood on the menu in months.  So sad!  We're looking forward to update the rating when the menu returns to a semblance of the varied offerings of the past.
Excellent sushi. The rolls have gotten bigger. The fish fresh. The service great!

Adding the spinach & artichoke dip to my list of favorites. Also pretty bummed that they no longer have the Sangiovese, but our server suggested a few other reds and even let us try two before deciding. Perfect spot for wine night with the girls.
Tried to order an ice mocha, said they were out of espresso. The person behind asked for a mocha and the cashier whispered, "I got you". Never coming to a place where they lie to customers.

Went to this place for the first time this past Saturday night for my brother's birthday and I will never go back. As everyone else has already said; its way over-packed, drinks take a year and a day to get (but only 2 minutes to be spilled by one of the many obnoxious, stumbling, frat boys who make up most of the crowd), and the music is just bad. 

However, my real problem was with the coat check operation and the disgusting way in which the staff handled it's mishaps. Our group of 9 was trying to leave. We hand them our coat check tickets and proceed to wait for 25 minutes as they get 7 coats. My friend and I were the last two left of the group waiting, and waiting, and waiting some more....for a total of 45 minutes. At this point, we are starting to get pretty annoyed by the whole thing.

A girl, named Ashley, who claimed to be the manager was sitting next to the coat check and watching the progression of the situation in between breaks of playing on her cell phone. As my brother started to express our understandable frustration to the coat checkers, Ashley decided now was the time to step-up and get involved by getting aggressive with him and yelling in his face. I tried to calm the both of them down and politely explained that we just wanted to get our coats and leave. Her response was (in a tone not even appropriate for a stuck-up teenager and certainly not OK for a "manager"), "Uhhh do you see the other 800 people in here, your just gonna have to wait". This floored me. I run a company myself, and was appalled by the complete lack of customer service. All she needed to say was. "I'm sorry for the delay, we appreciate your patience. Let me see what I can do to help speed up the process as there is no reason you should have to wait almost an hour to get your coat." But nope, once again manager-of-the-year Ashley went with a different approach and now put her hand in my face and told me to chill out or she would kick me out. The irony in this whole thing is that she looked like the one who needed to be kicked out as she aggressively yelled in my face.

Ugh, grow up and learn some management skills Ashley, Your behavior was a disgrace and caused your bar to loose nine good, paying customers who will never return.

Food was OK, service was BAD.
I asked our waitress if the breakfast sausage was spicy. the response was "I don't know I'm vegetarian!!!!!!!!" she was clearly not prepared to FIND OUT.  Other items we ordered NEVER arrived. Sorry but i thought the waitress was supposed to serve. I don't want some miserable rude girl serving me. I'm sure she wanted her tip!!!!!!

Being originally from
Cuba, I appreciate having a Latin grub place to go.  The Ceviche was fresh (considering locked in province status) and the Cheese Empanadas decadent.  The flank steak was yummy and tender, although a bit too small for a healthy appetite.  The fries that came along with it were delicious as well.  The side house salad was not initially brought out, but when we pointed it out was promptly served. They also offer a hot tea variety, plus beer & wine.  We were told by the Chilean owner (very friendly) the menu changes often to feature dishes from different Latin countries.  The Chef is Peruvian.  We wanted to sample dessert, but what we had our hearts set on listed on the menu was no longer available that night.  We will return for sure.  It can only get better!

Their blended Green Tea Luce is reason enough for five stars!! I come here to park and run on the river and stop by before I go home about once a week. It's a perfect way to reward and motivate myself to wake up at 4:30. The last couple times I've been here John has helped me and I've never had a finer blended ice drink, I am impressed! I would recommend this place to anyone and of course, I will be back. I hope to see you there! Oh, they also have a stamp/ reward card to get free drinks!

Stopped by today on a whim. Got the roast beef sandwich, a variety of macarons, the honey focaccia, a maple pull-apart, and a chocolate almond croissant.

The meat was the best roast beef I've ever had on a sandwich and the bread was delicious. With just a tad bit more horseradish aioli, it would have been the best roast beef sandwich I'd ever had.

The honey focaccia was unexpected. Soft, salty, savory, with the perfect amount of sweet. Absolutely delicious.

The macarons we ordered were espresso, salted caramel, pistachio, raspberry, sambava, and rose white chocolate. The raspberry was our favorite and was TO DIE FOR. The pistachio, sambava, and salted caramel were up there. Our least favorite was the rose white chocolate, it was just too sweet for us, but white chocolate is usually VERY sweet!

The maple pull-apart was incredible. Buttery, crispy on the outside, chewy on the inside, and not overly sweet.

But the best was unquestionably the chocolate almond croissant. That was probably the best baked good I've ever eaten in my life. Flaky, rich, soft and chewy in the middle, the perfect amount of sweetness. I would eat these every day if I could.

Can't wait to return in the future!

So good we ate here twice!! This place was right across the street from our hotel and we stopped in on recommendation from the bartender at Jimmy's Beach Bar. Such a great recommendation! We ordered the shrimp tacos and fish tacos not once, but twice! We came back the next day for lunch. Great outdoor seating, good food and entertaining Tuesday night trivia (and À la carte tacos).

Not the best for breakfast. I ordered eggs my way, with potaters and bread and it was good, just not mouth watering. The bread was tough to chew. It's a beautiful restaurant and I wish I came back to try the oysters! Michael was out waiter and he was great. Very courteous and welcoming. Thanks for the great service, Michael!

Tonight was my first night eating at Cancun.  The food was pretty good.  I would recommend the cheese sauce with your chips.  The fried ice cream was delicious.  

There was some confusion with the staff about what food goes to which table, but soon as you got your food it was worth the wait.  

I did get a margarita on the rocks.  It was just "ok".  I thought that it being a Mexican restaurant it would of been better, but the food made up for the drinks.

Wonderfully delicious!! I was so excited to try Bearcat CBD, i practically ran here from my hotel! 

We ordered the Cat Daddy and Steak and Egg breakfast burrito. Both were great! The Cat Daddy was a great portion size and the gravy was so tasty! The steak and egg burrito was possibly the best breakfast burrito we have ever had. It was smaller in size but the quality was outstanding. It is definitely enough to fill you, maybe get a side with it if you are feeling extra hungry. 

Also huge note to our waitress, she was so helpful, full of energy and joy - she made the experience even better! 

Stop by and eat here if you haven't already!
Love,love love the chicken gyros and sweet potato fries. Chicken tenders are good too!
Great service, wonderful iced tea with honey and raspberry grilled cheese! I love local spots like this. And, the price was awesome, too. Only set me back $9 for a drink and sandwich.
What a neat place! Their boba is very fresh and the staff provides exceptional customer service. Be sure to try the waffles with your drink you will not be disappointed.

Not going to lie but it was a really good sandwich; it was also a pretty basic sandwich, by no fault of theirs. 

My only draw back was for meat, cheese and lettuce the combo came out to a little over $10 -- something about the price seemed way too high for everything to had been so simple. 

I was also given spicy brown mustard which I don't care for not did I ask. I asked for yellow mustard (this is me just being detailed, not complaining lol)... 

I was short on time and the service was really quick and efficient. Sandwich was hot and neat. So no real complaints.
Service was obnoxious, bagels were good but not actually what we asked for, and crazy expensive for bagels that weren't in any way special. Why bother? Should have gone to Schmear It two blocks away.

I stopped here and grabbed dinner with one of my kids and ordered the chicken croquettes. I noticed that a lot of people were ordering this. It was a double portion, which came with soup, garlic green beans (that were amazing), a huge piece of super moist cornbread- I actually thought it was cake- mashed potatoes and also a nice bread roll. After coffee and a hot chocolate for the kid, the bill was about$15. We had so much leftover, I ate the rest for lunch the next day! Delicious stop!

Service was top notch, I never had to ask for a refill which is one of my pet peeves. Food was hot and fresh, I had the fish and chips (just to try something different), the breading was a bit heavy for my taste but otherwise it was great; though the burgers are better in my opinion. Well priced, good food, great service everytime I've been there. If you're looking for a good place to eat you won't be disapointed coming here.

Extremely slow service I don't recommend anyone to come here especially for the endless apps because you'll be waiting forever to get them. I had to wait for my ice to melt to get my refill on a drink

We arrived at Sandbar parched and starving.  The hostess seated immediately upon arrival and promptly served us with ice water and an ample amounts of chips. Our god given gift of a server, Cassie, took our order the moment we were ready and made amazing recommendations. The service was beyond spectacular and before we knew it, the best dining experience of our young lives ensued. I ordered the fajitas del mar and might I say, they surely lived up to Cassie's stellar recommendation. My friend ordered the burger (in a Mexican restaurant) and said it was the best burger she's ever had in America. This glorious restaurant even made a bean and cheese burrito a delectable dish. Bottom line, food was beyond incredible and Cassie's serving was so great it's indescribable.
The staff is super friendly and nice but the food is not great. It seems like a Fridays imitation, not so many options to choose from.
The bartender put her bare hands in my glass and touched the ice during a pandemic. I also saw her pull her mask under her nose multiple times

RUDE...RUDE....there was no line outside at all..so we walked inside and was told very loudly that we had to wait in the line outside...we tried to explain that there was not a line outside....we were told there is a sign outside..you need to read it...needless to say we went across the street to Felix's where they were friendly, 3.00 less on a dozen oysters, and great food!

Three times and I am yet to be disappointed! 

This place is out of this world.  The chef and owner has created some seriously unique and wonderful recipes.  Every time I have been there there has been a special pizza and it's always out of this world.  Here's what I've had:

B.L.G. - I have dreams about this it's so good.  I want to start dating this pizza.
Autumn - A pizza with brussel sprouts.  Surprisingly good.
Bianco - Who thinks to put pistachio's on a pizza?  This guy does and it works!
Picante - More of what you'd call traditional toppings, but executed oh so well.
Corn Pizza - Yeah.  Just get it.

Checking this place out since I'm in the area. I've been driving past this place for a while 

I order take out and everything was tasty. Really loved the fries 

We also order chicken tenders and pulled pork sandwich

The food was fantastic, but the eating area was an absolute mess.  It was not busy, but many tables sat uncleared and uncleaned.  We sat eating for more than half an hour and didn't see any of the employees bothering to wipe down tables even though many them needed it.  My husband and I both very much enjoyed our food, which was fresh and flavorful, but the dirty tables all around us definitely made the overall experience less enjoyable.  The employees seemed unenthusiastic and borderline unfriendly as well.  Smiling employees and a clean dining area would easily bump this restaurant up to 5 stars in my opinion, because the food is excellent.

I tried Foodie Fleet at the last Tucson Food Truck Round-Up and while I enjoyed what I ordered I still feel there is something missing.  Maybe my food truck standards have been set high after going to places like Animal Farm and Planet of the Crepes.   

I tried the goat cheese sandwich with granny smith apples, arugula, and whiskey pear jam.  It was pretty tasty, I wish there was more of the jam on the sandwich due to the fact that arugula is pretty overpowering and I could only catch a hint of the jam and what I did taste I loved.  I will definitely give Foodie Fleet a few more tries.  I think there is potential for them to be great.

Great sushi! I've dined in multiple times pre-pandemic and ordered takeout during. My order has always been ready in a timely manner and beautifully prepared. Generous portions, good quality fish, and reasonable prices. Would highly recommend!
Pretty good little Italian on the beach. Excellent wood fired pizza. Eggplant parm was pretty good. Very good value. Recommended, and will try again.

This place is amazing! We weren't that hungry, but really wanted to try it out, so we just got the conch fritters and the jerked chicken salad. Both were insanely excellent, and we can't wait to go back and try more food.

This place was a COVID hot zone. I appreciate restaurants, and what they have had to endure, but at least try. We walked in and were surprised by the number of guests without mask waiting for tables inside. The hostesses were not phased at all. Then you pass the bar which looked like a zoo, people all over, not sitting, and a complete virus battleground. We proceeded to the table, back past all of the semi adequately spaced tables to some sort of addition of the building reminding me of a cramped dorm room. I look to my left and could have high fived the table next to me , there was a foot of separation, not the 6 feet required! I politely asked if there was a table with 6 feet of separation we could sit at... surprise....the hostess said no. So we turned around and will not be returning.

Haven't even got our food and already the place is terrible, it's December, light snow on the ground and its 60 degrees in here.  At least that what shows on what must be the broken thermostat in our dinning area.

This chipotle just opened and isn't super busy yet! They have outdoor seating and ample parking. The inside is a little smaller than most, but since they aren't a popular location yet, there were plenty of seats available. The location tag is a little off, it's attached the same building as regions bank. It looks like a new build or like it was completely transformed.

Not sure why this place is so highly rated. Came here for a second time this past weekend for breakfast, and was disappointed again. Specifically told the waiter, twice, not to put cheese in my omelet. Got my omelet, got halfway through it, and noticed it had cheese in it. Not good for my lactose intolerance. Will not be returning.

I enjoy trying new Sushi joints and i have to say this place is on top. 
Great service and good quality sushi rolls. 
I recommend the house rolls: 007 Roll and Mexicali Roll if you like a little spice in your life :) 
The only reason I gave it four stars because one sink out of four worked. 
Besides that, the environment is cozy and clean, the service was great and the rolls were delicious.

Admittedly I'm not sure how NY style pizza should taste, but this here is good eats, imo. I've ordered the stromboli and the pizza and haven't been disappointed. Stromboli was very good. The cucumber salad is my favorite.  The chocolate cake is multiple layers of amazing!

The pizza by the slice is enormous! Ordered a slice of the veggie lovers minus onion and a small custom pizza so I had options. If I'd known the veggie slice would be so large I wouldn't have ordered anything else! 

I haven't been into the restaurant but ordered delivery. The time in delivery was much faster than the estimate and went without a hitch. Definitely my new go-to for pizza delivery.

UPDATE:

Not sure what happened to Joe's pancake house post Covid, but this place has gone downhill considerably. A few of their waitresses are rude old ladies and also pick and choose who gets seated first, even though you might have been waiting longer. Hoping these servers snap out of their awful mood and start to realize that with this pandemic they may want to get things right or they might start losing customers, in turn, close the restaurant because they cannot sustain. 

Need to do a better job Joe's...


We loooove Joe's Pancake House! The food here is exactly what comfort food should taste like! We have had quite a few items on the menu and everything has always been served piping hot and delicious. The servers here are all wonderful, especially Stacy. 

Note: there isn't a hostess station and you must grab a table once one is available. Try to sit in one of the middle booths in Stacy's section. Trust me, you won't be disappointed!

5 stars and two very big thumbs up for this place! Happy eating my foodies
Breakfast passed. The French fries are too hard because it was the rest of last night. I bite my toothache. It's a waste of my money fries. It won't be bought so early
always amazing, super fast delivery, high quality food and customer service. one of my favorite spots in philly!!
Ask for *Brett to serve your drinks at the bar. His attention to detail is spot on. Late night is best in this neck of the woods.

Updating my previous review to give 4 stars per the excellent customer service received by Marc Simonetii, a manager at Finch & Fork. He took my previous review (3 stars- good food, but a few little things I didn't like) very seriously. He reached out to me, explained what he was doing to change things, and offered a complimentary item which I had previously tried to order. I was glad to hear about the changes that he implemented, and that he reached out to me. A+ for Marc!

Now about the food- today I had the fried chicken sandwich with fries. Be aware that the fries which come with the sandwich are normal fries- they are not the super special garlic & herb $7 fries. I am curious if guests can upgrade to the yummy garlic & herb fries? Anyways, I was surprised that this sandwich came with a side since during my first visit, the F&F burger that I ordered form the brunch menu did not come with a side. Maybe it depends upon if you order from the brunch or lunch menu? Anyways, the fried chicken sandwich was decent. I think that the F&F burger was outstanding though, so I may go back to order that again.

Also, something to note is that the nearest bathroom is technically outside the restaurant. You need to leave Finch & Fork/enter the Canary Hotel, go down a set of stairs, then look immediately to your right and there is a small-ish sign for the bathrooms. The decor is BEAUTIFUL by the way, and the bathrooms reminded me a lot of the nice ones inside Nordstrom's (private stalls and real hand towels to dry your hands). I did see two sets of elevators just outside the restaurant, so anyone with babies, and/or the elderly or handicapped can use the elevator to access the downstairs bathroom.

Pleasantly surprised. As a service industry professional, I will admit - I wasn't expecting much from a little chain restaurant on my way home from work. I was starving, sat down at the bar and was engaged by the bartender, Mindy. I was not in the mood for conversation...she didn't lay on the usual corporate banter or sales pitch in specials. She was very personable and I was further surprised as I watched her take care of the other patrons ( can't help it. Once a bartender always a bartender). She was quick, attentive, and never missed a beat. I'll be back ONLY because of my experience tonight . Thank you !

It was good.  Was it everything that I could have hoped for?  It left a little to be desired.  We went during the lunch hour on a weekday in January so it was mostly empty.  We sat outside and quite enjoyed the scenery and the little birds hopping about.  The beer was, of course, quite good but the food wasn't as appealing as what I'd heard about on the Food Network show.  I was not so impressed with "The Bomb" burger.  It was greasy and a real mix of flavors that I wasn't convinced really went together.  My hubby and I split it, I got an order of their "famous" cider wings and he got a side of rice and beans.  The wings were dry on the outside and didn't taste like anything special but they were good quality wings which is a plus.  My husband was convinced the rice was the best Spanish rice he had ever had.  So, if we're in the area again, we'll definitely give it another shot because it was good... just not all it was hyped up to be.

Stayed here one night, booked through orbitz. Check in was quick. Room was extremely outdated, seemed clean enough though at first glance. We used the valet car service and got our car fairly quick when we left at around 8 pm.  Came back about midnight and no problems. I woke up early and wanted coffee,  the coffee maker had about a quarter inch of dust on it, which was weird because everything else around it was clean. Went down stairs to Starbucks to a horrendous line of about twenty people. Finally got coffee and went back up to the room. Started to get ready for the day, turned the water on in the bathroom sink and this is where it got nasty.  The water wouldn't drain at all, and there were bugs in it. I don't know what kind, too small to be a roach but bigger than an ant. Decided to skip showering.  The mirror was so old it had black spots where the reflective back was gone. Nasty!!!  Trying to check out and get your car at ten am took a while as well. I paid 130.00 for the room and feel it was about 60.00 value.

Heard over dinner "I just fu**ed this food"

Those types of expressions are not so uncommon to hear when one dines at Zahav, if this type of talk scares you skip down a few sentences.

Our party of 6 arrived closely to our 8:15 reservation and were seated at a roomy table big enough to fit at least 3 more people. Our server went over the RW menu ( which is pretty much the regular tasting menu just 4.00 cheaper).

We all decided silently on food options and when it was our turn to order we proudly stated our options ranging from duck hearts to foie gras. We would probably share but no one knew for sure.

The first to arrive were our drinks and hummus alongside a trio of salads. My favorite was the beets. It's very strange how ones palate changes I never thought I would  want to SMD in those beets but it did. The hummus at Zahav is better than any other restaurant hummus I've had so far world wide. I would love to know the secret to this magical spread.

A second round of bread was brought out for our dipping pleasures. Courses came out in a a staggered way which have everyone a chance to dive in and share. My favorites were the grilled haloumi, the bête salad and the mackerel.

As food came out conversations slowed down and we enjoyed all the extras sent out by the kitchen . I was too full to enjoy my entire dessert but I took at least one bite from all the options offered and the French press coffee made this such an enjoyable dining experience . I don't think Zahav should be limited to special occasions or RW, the menu and level of service remains the same no matter when you go. Some biddie I'm friends with keeps hinting at wanting a 30th birthday dinner here I'm sure it can be arranged .

I am torn, should i give it a two or a three. I will say this about the sunday menu, i will never go back on a sunday. What made it worse, is this is supposed to be a traditional sunday Itailian meal on Sunday!! Guess who house i am not going to. Lastly, it was Father day, the chef surely could of been more creative on Father day. 

Starters we had pork meatballs, chicken wings and  a pizza. The pork meatballs were fried, dried and died!!! The pizza was good, but the dough does not come close to De Sano. Chicken wings were cook well but the sause was uneventfull. 

Entrees we ordered the Pork Burger, The trout, and the Chicken thigh, the only other entree was a veggie dish which one of our party could not order because of the use of pork stock.  Just like the pork meatballs this Pork Burger should not of made it to the menu, It absolutely had no flavor. The Burger came with potato salad, which was not edible because the potato were not cooked!! The trout was good piece of fish, cook well, but was not great. The chicken thigh were cook very well, but i am not going to this caliber of restrauant to eat chicken. 

The Panna Cotta for desert was runny!! and the cookie tray was not very creative. 

Service, well this was Father day, you think you are at dinner at a fine place with 3 kids you would maybe have a happy father day!!! LOL The waitress once again was uneventfull!!! Guess maybe she wanted to be home with her dad!!! 

So, execution not good, menu creativity not good, service was not all that good, creativity not good! Maybe my expecations were too high going in. But maybe i am be generouse by giving this place a 2 star after i read what i wrote. 

Maybe I will give them another shot. But it sure wont be a Sunday. 

Sorry guys you missed the boat on this one.

One of the popular brunch places in town. Hence, always a line, even on a Monday at 2pm. It's modern and shiny inside, with a glorious golden Nashville sign in the middle of the room. You wait online, order, pay, and seat yourselves. They're obviously known for biscuits, so try to get at least one, because they're light and fluffy and delicious. I got the French omelette. It comes with mushrooms and onions. It was great, but too small for the price. My friend got an egg plate and loved it. Service was good, and the atmosphere is fun and casual. Give this place a try when you're in town, either alone or with others.

I had dinner here recently.  Since there weren't too many other customers I was seated right away. It was pretty quiet there. 

Their complementary chips and salsa were bland and didn't really seem too fresh.

I decided to order the chicken enchiladas verdes. I've had this dish in a bunch of other Mexican restaurants but this one was really bland. Plus it was a little dry. The rice wasn't bad and the beans were fine. Their horchata just tasted like milk and didn't even have any cinnamon. Nothing was awful but I've had much better Mexican food in Delaware (check out my reviews.)

With that said, I would probably go back if I was in the area. There aren't many Mexican places in Hockessin; mostly pizza joints. But since Kennett Square isn't too far I just might check out the Mexican places there.

Wow! I can't stop thinking about this place. After ordering takeout from here a few times and being OBSESSED, a friend and I decided to dine in one night. 

The ambience is awesome. Dim lighting, but light enough so you can see your company and the menu. Soft music hums in the background. Wait staff was extremely friendly and welcoming. Booths are a beautiful blue and comfortable as well. 

I have found my favorite dish in the world. I literally non-stop think about this whenever I am eating something else and wish in my head it was this. The Fig & Pig Flatbread is literally God sent. It's not normally something I would ever order, but after my friend got it for takeout and I tried it, I was in love. I won't ever order anything else here, but I know that some of the other dishes I've tried are just as amazing. The Truffle Ravioli is rich and creamy and perfect for leftovers. The Yakuza Tuna was perfectly fresh and equally as delicious. And don't even get me started on the sides. Parmesan... truffle... bacon... all the flavors you could ever want. 

All in all, this place is absolutely amazing and in just a few short weeks and visits it has become one of my favorite spots. Not too pricey, and you get what you pay for! Definitely recommend if you are in the SoHo area.
Great food and service. Fantastic crafted margaritas. Guacamole was fresh And flavorful.

This is a great location for lunch with a beautiful view, but my experience was disappointing due to the food and service (we came on a Friday afternoon). We started out sitting at the bar area and ordered a Mai Tai. When it was delivered it was overflowing but the bartender/server didn't bring it with a cocktail napkin so I had to request one. IMHO every drink should be served with a cocktail napkin or at minimum a coaster. The drink, however, was very good. We then were taken to our table with a wonderful view and ordered the grilled artichoke (it was okay) and the fish and chips (again just okay), I ordered another Mai Tai and our server (a young gal) delivered it, again, without a cocktail napkin. Both times the servers brought the napkins and just threw/set them on the table. I believe proper etiquette is to bring the napkin and set the customer's drink on it. Why are they not trained on this? Lastly, when we went to pay, we put down a Discover card. The server walked away and then when she saw the card, she said from about 15 feet away (in front of all the other customers) "We don't take Discover". It was very embarrassing. There was no need to say that in front of the whole patio of guests. We paid with another cc, but still.... Where is the training for these young people?

The family was looking forward to trying the new neighborhood sushi place but left disappointed and unlikely to return. "All you can eat sushi" is a predictable red flag that you won't want much of it and this remains true at Sushi house. The servers and host were extremely attentive and friendly and my udon soup with veggies and seafood was passable. But some of the sushi, especially the mackerel tasted not-so-fresh and the spicy tuna roll had very little tuna. Such a bummer.

This is by far one of my favorite places in Nashville. It is a "gay bar" but that doesn't mean that you have to be gay to go in and enjoy yourself. It is very casual, yet quite upscale at the same time. Even the smokers are not relegated to freezing in some outside corner. The staff is very good (Brandon is a great waiter) and the drinks are great (check out TJ, he makes some of the best!). I highly recommend Tribe for meeting some people and having a good evening out.
We ordered delivery from here while staying in New Orleans and it was great! Nothing amazing, but it just the spot and was an enjoyable pizza. Would order again if I find myself in NOLA.
Best Chicago hot dog in Carmel. Love the feel of this local place. Needs to be on Diners, Drive-ins, and Dives

I love breakfast, and the Penrose makes a mean breakfast. Portions are huge and service is on point with a side of Philly personality. I'd eat here while sober, and I don't say that about many diners.

Recommended: the disco fries (think Philly/jersey style poutine), the cheesesteak fries (mouth is watering as I type this) and the open face hot turkey sandwich. Oh, and the omelettes. Did I mention I love breakfast?

I was super unimpressed with this location. I frequent their Yardley location and this place didn't fit the bill. When we sat down the waitress told us we were getting bruschetta. The waitress actually brought us french bread. Then, there was no place settings at our table. The iced tea was horrible. I literally couldn't drink it and had to send it back. The prices were at least $10-$15 higher than at their other locations and they did not offer half the items. The fig salad however was great!!!! The seafood bisque had no flavor and tasted like a bowl of cream. Adding pepper into it didn't help. Lastly, the chicken Parmesan was just fair. The tomato sauce over powered the dish, but it was good. I was also disappointed to find out that their mixed vegetables were just broccoli and not the same as their other locations. 

The positives of this locations are the banquet space, the fact that they have a bar, the valet parking, and the waterfront!
Visiting from Texas and tried Vernons. Everything was delicious ! Pear cobbler is sooo good

Tried Big Ray's for lunch today.  Almost turned away due to the overall appearance of the 'shack' but glad we gave it a try. Blackened grouper was fantastic and good size portion however be sure to let them know if you dont want the sauce (mayo).  Also, fries loaded with garlic ...first timers be sure to ask for 'regular' fries. As for the onion rings...well mine were more like onion strings so not real my favorite.   People were soooo friendly! Would love to see this place improve on the space and drink selection.

Please is really good. It hits all the high notes. Cheap, tasty and good service. Only downfall is no liquor license. If they had margaritas I would give this please a 6/5 but I guess a 5/5 will do. :D La Parada is amazing...
Great food , great service . Highly recommend the Maryland crab soup . Ask for Jeff the Bartender . Always has great stories and is even entertaining . The wings are good as well

Now that tigerlilly is gone this and Mark Pi's are probably the best Chinese restaurants in greater Indy to do lunch. House beef is a winner. I know American Chinese and this is good. Decor/dining room is super relaxing and food comes fast.

I have to stick up for Semolina's. I have some good memories here! Went here for a bday celebration and they accomodated our group nicely. If I recall, their paella is awesome. They also have a delicious alfredo mushroom and chicken pasta that tasted quite fresh. It was not oily. I don't remember that many places you can get such varieties of pasta in New Orleans. And lastly, we had a house party and Semolina's, even though it doesn't have deliverers itself, worked with an external company to deliver it :)

The food here is good, average run of the mill 'southern' food served in a meat and 3 fashion or you can order nachos, sandwiches, salads or other typical american dishes with a side of chips/fries, etc - your choice. Food average, iced tea - kinda excellent.

The feel is kinda old wordly country club, actually - country club from 1981, but its clean and the clientele is very mixed. A lot of golfers as mentioned below. But public course golfers - no snooty patooties.

The one thing I think that gives McCabes a special little place in my heart is the super great service. I wish all servers and bartenders were like the McCabes staff (and no, I don't know anyone who works there, this is fo' realz), they are timely, friendly and seem like they always want you to be genuinely happy. The last time I was there the Pred's game went into OT and the bartender not only let us stick around, but he made sure our beers, waters and sodas were full. When I told him I couldn't drink anymore caffiene (I mean, it was a school night) he all but insisted in getting me water. 

So, while my foodie heart cant give them too many stars - I really think the service is among the best in town and its an excellent place to hang out.

Tip - you can't even smoke outside on the patio. I think its amazing, but smokers be forewarned.

Great little place, very small and intimate, artsy feel, maybe 15 tables. Service was prompt and courteous, waters never got below half full before refills. And the best part, food was delicious! I ordered the drunken noodles, extra spicy, and it was awesome. Fresh veggies, perfectly cooked noodles, just the right amount of spice, and large portion size, big enough to spilt if you are not extremely hungry. Also ordered Thai tea to drink which was also great served in a large mason jar (also free with the offer on yelp) Could not ask for a better meal to satisfy my Thai craving!
Ordered delivery and I was impressed. It's tastey American Chinese but done really well. The Moo Shu is on point. It's my go to for delivery.

OMG!  What a perfect combination of fresh sea food and excellent service!  I go there for the lobster and cioppino, but see people ordering surf and turf, and other items on the menu which look amazing. I'm going to try steak and lobster next time!  I cannot say enough good things about the service. I've been served there by many on the staff and each has been friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable about every single item on the menu. If you live in the tri-state, make the trip. You won't regret it.

Chicken was really tough. Teriyaki sauce was thin and a little bit lifeless. 

Fried rice was good, but very light flavor and not anything in it other than a bit of egg here and there. 

Pork egg rolls are peppery which is good, but not cooked well. Really chewy, seems like the entire shell doesn't get cooked through. 

Miso soup good.

Edamame standard.

Not impressed! I had heard good things..but was really disappointed. There was not very much cheese under the sauce. Chicago deep dish has cheese an inch thick! I couldn't even tell if there was cheese. The sauce was bland to me. The crust was the best of it all. I'm gonna leave the deep dish to the pros up north!!

Summary: Bar that serves tasty food

Review: in my mind, this place is primarily a bar: noisy, lots of beers on tap, no reservations, wooden booth tables. But, once we got our table, we discovered they serve write-home-good food. My burger was the best burger I've had in the city. At our table, the mussels and the seafood stew also received much praise. Of course, we were onto our third and forth rounds of their fun local beers. Wonder how much that affected our opinion.

Quaint place, great for groups and nice outside seating. Quiche, salads and crepes were "bon"! Our group really liked everything they ordered. Wait staff is just ok, took awhile to get our food so don't go if you are in a hurry.  Life is short so you could order something scrumptious from the bakery first. (-;

A friend highly recommended this as a must visit restaurant during my time in New Orleans.  We went for dinner on a Friday night, everyone really enjoyed through food. The fried okra and jambalaya, omg... good!  I am giving it a 4 star rather than 5 because although the food was delicious it was very cramped and once we were done eating we felt rushed. The busboy kept hoovering around our table, we only lingered for 10 minutes after we finished eating but you would have thought it was an hour.  
I would definitely visit again, the was delicious and hopefully next time we won't be seated in such a cramped area.

I used to go to the Rusty Pelican quite often & for no specific reason, it fell off my radar. Rusty Pelican is located at the far end of the Courtney Causeway, right on beautiful Tampa bay. They defiantly  have a lot of windows & let you have fabulous waterfront views from almost any vantage point. I love the upscale ambiance and posh vibes I get from the establishment.
I recently returned for an after work evening of pure decadence. 
We imbibed in the beat wines and started our evening with an overflowing amount of seafood appetizers for our table. Everything was fresh & properly prepared. After an abundance of appetizers, they still wanted full dinners...LOL, hey who am I to argue, I wasn't getting the check.
Between all at the table we had some great steaks, seafood & various other dishes.
Did I mention the service was excellent...outstanding. I will admit I don't think we were the easiest table to wait on, but I will bet, it had the best tip. We chatted over our food and the overall concensus was very good.
Going into gourmet  desserts & tawny ports, all remained high caliber & no major complaints.
It is a great date or special occasion restaurant, but it can also be a regular restaurant, that is defiantly going back on my rotation.
Everyone had a wonderful & enchanted evening. Don't know about the check & don't care, just glad I was participating! 
What's a girl to do? Luxury comes in many forms & I found quite a bit tonight!

Just in town for the weekend, so I checked Yelp to see where to eat.  The first choice was Chandlers, but they were booked all weekend.  Next was this place, so we gave it a try.  Super nice hostess at the door as you walk in. very friendly.  We had booked, and they were kind of busy.  Our waiter, Robert, came over right away, and told us all about the place, and he had a great personality.  Just the right mix of knowledge and humor - not trying to be a wise guy.  So, I had the filet, and he had the 28 oz rib eye that had been aged for 50 days.  Of course, I had a baked potato, and he had the au gratin.  When in Riome, right?  I was not disappointed.  And the mushrooms on his rib eye were to die for.  The meat was amazing - the flavor was melt in your mouth.  My filet was a little underdone, but Robert took care of it right away.  They were busy, but my filet came back very quickly.  You could taste the quality of the meat - it was amazing.  And Robert could not have been nicer.  The food was great, and the service was superb.  We were busting at the seams after - could not have squeezed in dessert if our lives depended on it, but saw them passing by, and they looked yummy.    It's been an hour, and I'm still full!  This is a great restaurant - definitely give it a try.
Love this place. Awesome pizza. 3 toppings for $10 on Mondays.

What a lovely Italian restaurant! I've been very impressed with the Italian scene in Philly recently, particularly around South Philly. I came here for a graduation party of four and they were able to accommodate an extra +1.

Food: Perfect portions and came SUPER fast. I wasn't very hungry so I ordered a prosciutto antipasti, which was plated very nicely and tasted delicious (good cuts and I really liked the vinaigrette, though a little heavy). My family ALL ordered the lobster spaghetti and they liked it. Everything was presented beautifully and I like how it wasn't a mountain of pasta per plate, as I find a lot of Italian places can overdo it on the portion sizes. 

Free bread: Five stars. Ugh it was so good. Fluffy and doughy, and I appreciated how they poured out olive oil with a flourish into a small condiment dish right after sliding the bread onto our table--because that is the only way bread should be consumed at an Italian place (plus salt and pepper).

Don't waste your time or money. Took over 40 minutes to get our food. Chicken picatta was awful, fish chips were over cooked, hardly any sauce with the spaghetti. Only thing decent was bread and butter. Never again
Honestly some of the best fried chicken I've ever had, their plantanos were also flame. I definitely recommend this establishment and will be returning.

The manager here is absolutely awful. My boyfriend and I ordered food here through yelp and grubhub after a long day at the pool. Our order was supposed to be delivered to us in 30-45 mins and after we waited 55 mins we called the restaurant because grubhub would not answer. They said our pizza was done 30 mins ago but cannot contact grubhub. So after waiting for grubhub to answer they said it would be another HOUR wait. So we picked up the pizza ourselves. The manager was rude to us immediately and walked away as I was telling her the situation. She said it wasn't her duty to keep the pizza delivered on time. It was cold when we got it so we asked if we could have a new one and she wanted us to pay for the old and the NEW pizza. So we left with our cold pizza because we were starving. The manager did not say anything to us, no "I'm sorry, or have a nice night". Pizza was good but manager is awful.

I've had a horrible experience ordered my food a bit after midnight , didn't receive it until after 2am . all for me to find two bugs at the bottom of my salad , called the company back with respect to explain the situation . And ask of a refund also so they could pick the order back up .. they insisted on me getting another salad after i had just had the horrible trifling experience with one , NO sympathy or concerns to customer regards , very unprofessional , rude and nasty . it's so sad that a company could be so low to not want to compensate with their customers . SO now I am without any type of compensation , NO refund NO Understanding NO Compensation .. I am so disappointed. JIM GARBENRDING YOUR BUSINESS SHOULD BE SHUT DOWN !!!!!!!!!!!!!!

i give this place 3 stars only because the second time around it was no where near the first time.  We went in on a early evening thursday  waited maybe 5min for a seat (Tip:  no outside drinks allowed inside and you have to wait outside the door)  we ordered the charboiled oysters, shrimp po boy and roast beef po' boy.  drinks were beer, sodas and long island ice tea.
charboiled oysters were excellent, melted buttery delight all over the plate slab of french bread to drag thru that butter yumminess..  shrimp po boy was good  the roast beef was OK.  the only draw back i had was the long island ice tea, way to much sour mix and didnt taste any liquor but that seems to be a constant anywhere you go but it does get irritating with what you pay for it. great dinner otherwise
we went back on saturday and ordered a dozen of the charboiled oysters because we were so craving them...no where near the first visit.  presentation was  NOTHING compared to the first evening,no buttery yummy for dipping in fact they were on a piece of paper on the plate,  i had a half a one and was done.  maybe a different cook?

Sushi was so good! It was our first time here and the service was good, fast and delicious! We love this place! It's even better than the original place sushi kingdom. It's the same owner but servers are a lot nicer from our experience!

Tried this place after reading rave reviews, and were sadly disappointed.  We bought 3 take out meals.....one chicken with rice, and two other chicken dishes.  Ate parts of two, were NOT happy, and threw out the chicken/rice dish.   There are WAY too many choices for good food...we will not go back to Felice.   And if you want a great Italian deli, go to Mazzaro's, and for delicious Italian food, it's Positanos.

I gave this place 3 stars for the waiter Ray, he was very nice and accommodating. He got the order right
It was the stupid ass cook that didn't.
The reason I know this is because we were sitting by the grill.
Over well mean well done not running yolk.
And he asked her " over well means we'll done right" 
Her response " well kinda well done" 
No, dumbass it means we'll done yolk.

Then she had to ask him three times does she want raw onion on her has browns, or grilled in the hashbrowns.
He told her 3 times what I wanted I finally leaned over and said grilled onions in the hashbrowns.

My bagel I had to send back, because I order a crispy grilled bagel both sides.
I saw it in the window knew it wasn't done enough and asked to get it thrown back on the grill, it came out one side grill the other side cold. I had to saw the damn thing long ways and kept the crispy side. Worst cook!


Ray you were awesome, keep it up.

Mi Ranchito is about as authentic a taqueria you are going to find this far north of the boarder in Reno, NV. It is off the beaten path, not far from UNR and in a tiny strip mall. The place is small with minimal decor, the service is friendly and the food is fresh and very nicely prepared.You are likely to find items on the menu that do not show up at your standard Gringo-fide Mexican establishment. I mean how many place have you seen Armadillo in these parts as one of the menu offerings. The chips are not the greatest we ever had but the salsa is tasty. Our chile rellenos were outstanding and I like the fact you can get whole beans as well as refried beans. The carnitas our friend ordered looked delicious so we have to go back to give them a try. We ordered flan for dessert and it was a good as flan gets. Along with a couple of Modelo Especials (we asked for glasses and were brought 3 ice cold frosted mugs) and we were three very happy amigos.

They were scored by me 7 points pretty good
10 is the highest.
The price is a bit high for pizza's wings were poor 
Pizza very Good
Wings poor
Other products goo

Excellent Thai food for Philadelphia. I lived in Thailand for over a year, and having lived in Philadelphia for a decade, I've noticed that the Thai places aren't that great. This one is very good for the city.

The som tom salad had grilled shrimp in it. At other Thai places here, the shrimp is cold.

The tom-yum noodle bowl had a very generous helping of seafood as well as bok choy.

The frog legs were fried but not heavily breaded, which was a plus.

The coconut custard for dessert was quite tasty.

Word on the street about Thunderbird: 

- Amazing, craft cocktails. 
- Located in an up-and-coming, trendy area.

Things that even exceeded my expectations when I went: 

- Caipirinha cocktails (I hadn't had these since Portugal and hadn't found them in Indy yet - so delicious and excited to find them)
- Best fries ever (they're super crispy and a must-order)
- Big outdoor patio (I had no idea that existed) 
- Standard prices (my cocktail was $7)
- 'Beer & Shot' combos

I'll be back to try the Whole Bird and frozen daiquiris & coladas as well! This spot was such a fun find and our whole group enjoyed it.

Thanks for steering me in the right direction, my friends. I'm staying down the street from Delachaise and just had the steak frites based on a few good reviews. I was not disappointed!

Someone said it reminds them of a NYC type of bar. I agree. In fact I'd say this place is very similar to d.b.a. in the East Village...but with New Orleans style, I can only guess (I've been here 3 hours). 

- 6 well chosen taps (Spaten, Schneider Weisse, Flying Dog...) - I opted for local and had the NOLA Hopitoulas. 
- Lots of bottles.
- Excellent menus for aged Scotch (Macallen, Lagavulin...), Irish Whiskey, Bourbon, and Gin (Hendricks, Plymouth, Old Raj...). 
- New punk and alternative (The Killers, Radiohead...) played relatively low, but it was dinner time. 
- Steak frites were great - relatively thin steak, but juicy and cooked to order. Frites are fried in duck fat cut with oil. They were crispy and had a rich oil flavor. 

I did not have any problem with the service. I was there on Labor Day, and there was only one bartender for several customers, but he managed it well and the food came quickly.

I give one star today for lack of fairness. I just left there and took the dregs of a soup which reached a teensy bit above half of their smallest cup. The cashier asked the manager if she should charge me less and she said NO...THE SAME. I was shocked. That means that either the employees are allowed zero wiggle room for decisions or that she was an idiot or she was scared of her boss. All at the expense of a good regular customer.

SO SO GOOD. My boyfriend and I went there the other day and the food was GLORIOUS! He has been several times and has been talking about it; I have never been before but I LOVE pizza. Seriously, pizza should be in it's own food group.  So we ate the roasted cauliflower (A MUST TRY), a brussel sprout salad, a lamb and goat cheese pizza (the current special SO GOOD LIKE WOAH)  and the chocolate ganache dessert. Not to mention craft after craft beer. Staff was friendly. Atmosphere was nice. Food is on point. I will be back.
Awesome food! Staff is amazing and very attentive. I come here at least twice a month. Best margaritas in town.

I would give this place 0 stars if I could. The website is completely false advertisement. The website stated that the minimum spending rate includes food and drinks but when we arrived, we were told the minimum spending rate is ONLY for drinks. (They want you to crawl out of the building with alcohol poisoning) It is absurd to say the least. The management is appalling and the prices for the drinks & food were awfully overpriced. Will not recommend.
Very good beef and tendon noodle soup.  Ordered basil eggplant and tofu with bold Choy to go.  Been wanting to try this place, glad I did today!

3 stars for atmosphere and good food, 0 for service. I understand restaurants are having a hard time with help, but we sat at the bar for brunch and I guess I should have known it would be bad when the BARTENDER didn't even give us a drink menu. Ordered a cocktail which took so long I thought he forgot about it. Then he did forget to put in part of our order. The runners gave us our food, and we were more than half way finished when he even bothered to ask if we were ok and only then were we able to tell him part of the order was missing. Keep in mind that he was eating his own meal at the bar during this time!! He finally brought the forgotten side with no apologies when we literally had one bite of our entrees left and still charged us for it. We have both worked in the Industry and often give a pass but this was just kind of unacceptable. 

In hindsight, should have talked to the manager but I think we were in shock at how terrible he was and just wanted out. Won't sit at the bar if we come back.

Whenever anyone asks me what my favorite restaurant in Philadelphia is I always say Talulas garden. Every time I come here I have an amazing meal. The decor, service, and especially the food is always exemplary. The way the layers of flavors are created by the chef blow my mind each time I visit. On one of my visits we were also given a free desert which is always a plus.

Didn't try the food but the service was terrible. The staff was not friendly, acted like our presence was putting them out, and I will never come back here if I have the choice based simply on how my group was treated.

We've been eating at Chubbys for over 20 years. The food is good however the service over the telephone to try to place an order makes us feel like they're doing us a favor to take our order. I always support independent businesses over chains but if I'm treated like I was tonight again i it'll be the last time I eat there.

Apparently asking for them to toast the bread is too much of an inconvenience at 9AM. I'll have to find somewhere else that can take 10 seconds out of their day to make an enormous request possible. Very rude, find somewhere else to get a better steak.

Food was ok but we all ordered our food at the same time and my pizza came out when everyone in our party was finished eating. All the restaurant manager had to say was it will be our shorty. Not a good experience and not the right answer.

First visit here &&& I must say!!!!! KitzMo where have you been my whole life! Very delicious & fresh!! 
Oishi Roll has the perfect spice kick super yummy! Mickey nigiri also very scrumptious!

First time here and will definitely be back! The view is awesome, and the food was good (we ordered a Caesar salad w/chicken, a veggie wrap, and fish tacos). The only issue I had was that the creme brûlée dessert wasn't made properly and was very runny. Other than that, a great dining experience.
A couple of standouts, but overall a pretty average place to get tacos. Cool environment, though.

I dont even want to give this place 1 star. Went in for a late breakfast on sunday around 11 am. Ordered a breakfast omlette wrap. A western omlette, side of scrapple and 2 coffees. To my surprise the bill was $24. Like wth. Ok. So we go get our coffee and sit down at a very dirty table. Mind you there was almost no one in the store. We wait for our food. Sip the coffee and it was burnt and stale. I wanted to throw up. After about 15 mins our food was ready. My wrap was literally a wrap. Nothing in it. It also said it came with home fries so I asked but the very unpleasant girl stated no that's just for omelettes. I pointed out the fact that it stated it and she goes oh well it doesnt. Ok. Fine. The food was awful. The same girl had already told another customer, I screwed up ur omlette take this it's free. The lady said what if I was allergic to what u fed me, she stated who cares. Lastly, the girl cooking had a long ass pony tail, no hair net. In fact NOT ONE PERSON had their hair covered. I WILL NOT GO BACK.

Im a bit biased being that I worked there more than a year ago. Howevever, there is no doubt the bartenders are great. They are fast and professional, and will know almost any stupid drink some douche might order. You know those people.... the guy that thinks he knows every drink type cause he read it in a drink bible. or that girl that orders a shot because it has a cute name, but is really just sugar that is 20 percent alcohol. order a Guinness there, please! They pour it properly, by the way.

Rant aside. The bartenders rock, the music is decent.
Dont expect a really great dance scene. But, dancing can surely happen.

 It is for the 27-35 year old for sure. But, you can be a bit younger and enjoy the mix of people trying to get their dance on if your crawling around old city.  stay to the seats and dining area and chat with friends or other strangers. After all, its an Irish Pub, so socializing is certainly encouraged. 

Food is great. If you have the bills for the food and tip. Then do it. If you love UK minded people. Do it. The place is owned by Irish immigrants, first generation. So, it will remain an Irish pub feel for quite sometime. 

Good beer selection, as well. 

Most interesting thing about this place is it changes all day. Early morning is for great breakfast, then great lunch, then awesome dinner, then a good late night. And the scene gets younger. Early morning averages 60 year olds. Then once lunch hits, minus 10 years. Then dinner, another 10 years. Once your at late night, its the 28+.

I haven't had this pizza for years and decided to try it again. I ordered a large cheese and a works (deluxe) pizza through the Yelp app. The experience was great! Ordering and paying was easy through the app. I chose to pick up and that too was very smooth. The pizzas were ready when promised. The quality of both pizzas were great; the toppings were fresh and pizzas perfectly baked. I will use them again and would recommend you do too.

The food here was very good! The general tso has just the right spice. The roast duck had great flavor. And, best of all, the price was right! The service was extremely slow after receiving my food. I sat for almost 25 minutes waiting for my check after having my plates cleared. The waitress had to be asked 3 times for it and each time acted like it was the first time. Annoying. That aside, this place was really good.

Great atmosphere, but not one waitress at the bar would make eye contact or would ask if I would like to order a beverage or food. I order a flatbread pizza which should be crispy and requested with extra sauce. They did not put extra sauce and the pizza was very soggy. I was very disappointed in the service and food. This was my first time to visit this establishment and I arrived around 2:30pm on a Sunday afternoon.

Our favorite casual spot nearby! Good food, great drinks. We love their mini Juicy Lucy's, buffalo quesadilla, and even the sushi is decent. They have good appetizers too, but their portions are definitely big enough that it's not always necessary! Their beer towers are a great price and they always have plenty of seasonal mixed drinks to choose from if you want to switch it up and try something new.

This was the worst service I ever received. We didn't get biscuits until after we payed and we're ready to leave. My order was wrong. The baked potatoes I ordered looked like someone spat in it. No meal suggestions and a crappy waiter. Never going back and I advise anyone thinking about this place to rethink.
Fast friendly service. Ask for extra pickles and got extra extra pickles. Perfection!!!

I loved this hotel.
Staff was amazing and friendly.
Room was exactly as described and wonderful.
I had a great time even though I didn't spend much time in the hotel room
it was the perfect retreat.

Love the Lark!  The ambience is very swanky and the people watching is amazing.  If you are looking for chat with interesting, worldly, fun people, this is your place!  Reservations are highly recommended, but if you just waltz in and would like an app and wine, the bar is a great option.  I have been a handful of times and I prefer the bar over the tables.  You MUST try the brussel sprouts and the deviled eggs!  Both are divine.  The staff here is friendly and super attentive.  The only bummer is the wait for a table, but that's common for a new, trendy SB hangout.

I have no idea why this place did not get a 5 star rating immediately!  The sauce is perfect, the crust is ridiculously good and I just want more, and more, and more!!!! Come on people!!  Get
On Board!!  I am a faithful Alex's pizza fan in Rox and a Mac n Manco (that's right) fan at the shore.  This pizza...off the charts.  Try it.  You be the judge.
Great food! Very nice service staff as well. The lights are a little too bright though.

This review is based on the dinning experience. I was invited to this location for a birthday brunch. The party consisted of 13 people. It was a Sunday around noon, the restaurant was pretty much empty aside from one other table that looked like they had ate and had already moved on to the games- seemed like a kids birthday party. Now I know better than to expect a good brunch at an arcade but truthfully there was no reason (at all) for their food to be so bad! Our server was overwhelmed and no one stepped in to help her despite just standing around. The kitchen also looked overwhelmed with 2 chefs initially, a 3rd jumping in and a guy who was in a dress shirt (probably a manager) jumping into help. 

Lets start with my honeys drink, we saw a picture for a fancy bloody mary with bacon and shrimp (the works, etc.) we ordered one and confirmed with our waitress it would bring everything pictured. It did not. In fact 3 others ordered bloody marys afterwards and it got worst- they came with no ice- we had to ask for a cup of ice which didn't help it was like room temperature tomato soup. Third time has to be the charm right? No! Honey asked about the picture bloody mary (again) and this time were informed its an upgrade- he ordered it. This drink took forever to come- turns out they had to cook the bacon- despite the fact there was tons of bacon in almost every other dish ordered which had been served at this point (he ordered his second bloody mary at the same time he ordered his food). The shrimp was disgusting we both spit it out and the bacon was a sad little piece. On to the food, I got chicken and waffles- chicken was okay but the waffles were pancakes cooked in a waffle maker, this was confirmed when i sampled my honeys dish which was the pancakes, they were horrible! How do you mess up pancakes? There were a lot of let overs. I did not get pre meal photos since it took forever to get our food and we were starving. 

Finally our checks took about 30-40 mins to get from the time we asked for them. The manager was close by and seemed unbothered. The benefit to eating here was that we did the eat and play so we got $15 game cards with our food, unfortunately everything took so long that most of our party was unable to use their free game cards.

Finally I will mention that one of the individuals in our party found it very unfair that all these issues affected someones birthday so she addressed it with the manager, anyhow this resulted in our remaining party (about 6 people) getting a round of shots (or sugar water?).

*The arcade was cool and only ran into 1or 2 out of service signs
*Much cheaper than Dave & Busters

It's a great experience from beginning to end. You are welcomed in and taken care of throughout the whole meal. The atmosphere is relaxed but upscale and the food is good. It hits all kind of flavor notes. 

The Thai coconut ceviche has all kinds of seafood and was pretty tasty but I thought it needed more freshness and tang. The oxtail croquettes were little balls of meaty goodness. They sit on a bone marrow and were topped with some greens and chili peppers. The flavors just were a party in my mouth. The scallops were cooked to perfection, crispy outside and super tender inside. The carnita empanadas had avocado and pickled onions on top. All which added more creaminess and tartness to the crunchy porky treat. Don't overlook the carrot purée. The chef found the sweet spot of savory and sweet. It was so smooth.
