Umami Sushi wowed me from start to finish. I was quite impressed what they had done with the place knowing I had been there when it was a Chinese restaurant. It was literally like night and day! Great job on the ambiance.

Our serving was a sweetie and very patient. My hubby and I had questions galore. She was great and very helpful and always had a smile on her face.

We started with Fried Calamari. They weren't the standard teeny tiny fried ones you usually see. They were almost the size of onion rings and the breading was somewhat like panko. it was very crunchy, Not greasy whatsoever and the sweet chili sauce complimented it very well!

I ordered a pink lady roll. It was so so good with steamed lobster, mango, and spicy tuna. It wasn't spicy to me. Just had a perfect flavor. It was 8 good sizes pieces with not too much rice. It also had a fun little flashing light and palm leaf for decoration.

My hubby has the chicken yaki udon noodles which had a decent amount of chicken and some veggies. He liked it a lot.

The cherry on top was the tempura cheesecake. Oh that was so good and different than any other cheesecake that we had because of the tempura shell and the creamy soft cheesecake in the middle.

This Japanese/sushi place will be a new favorite. Everything inside and out are truly amazing! I wish them tons of success and happy people loving their food.

This is a wonderful restaurant! I am always in search for vegan options and this is one of my new favorites for sure. Great spot for everyone to eat! I tried the samosas, garlic naan, chana masala and aloo matar. Aloo matar and garlic naan blew me away! Everything was so tasty and there were very large portions. In the masalas, each part is served in its own bowl so it's very great for sharing. Staff is very friendly and welcoming as well! Also I believe Wednesday night is buffet style. First time stopping by and I will certainly be back!

Been eating here for a few years and am finally writing Cafe Mochi their well deserved 5 star review.  Ate here on Wednesday night around 7pm and the place was packed.  Let me say it is deservedly so.  This place is consistent as can be.  Everything from their fresh product, to presentation to quality service.  Their recent expansion is surely derived from their recent success and I'm truly happy for them.  My girlfriend and I ordered the green mussels appetizer (this appetizer is baked and will most likely come out with or after your sushi but is certainly worth the wait), miso soup, spicy octopus roll, Godzilla roll and lemon drop roll.  Everything was incredible as usual.  I feel the lemon drop roll stood out just a bit more due to the amazing combination of flavors of the fish, lemon zest and honey wasabi.  Again, kudos to this place and it's success.  So well deserved.  Also, don't sleep on their lunch specials and Happy Hour, they're ridiculously cheap and quality is not affected one bit.

i kept going there for a week while i was attending a confrence.

It is a very  small restutant , but  is a great choise to have lunch.

This was the first experience for our girls and even my mom to have the food cooked in front of you. Our waitress Maria was very attentive and our chef Masato was hysterical! What a great personality and the two of them played off one another. They sang for my mom and our oldest for their birthdays and made the night very special for both of them. Our youngest daughter (9) was engaged in the meal the entire time!  My husband and I are already talking about date night and insisting on having Masato as our chef again. 5 stars for keeping my entire family off their phones for the entire meal!

This is convenient if you are staying at any of the hotels near the convention center. But, you would never find this restaurant if you just walked the streets looking for a place to eat. It is on a corner currently somewhat hidden due to construction taking place across the street. It is NOT like anything you will find just a few blocks away where bars and burgers are the main offering.
The service is perfect, no hovering but instant service at any time.
We started our lunch with the fig bread. It was served warm ... the best way to eat it. I had the fish taco, a special that day. It was incredible and a generous portion. My lunch partner had the catfish that she enjoyed so much I thought she might lick the plate.
For dinner our group shared Roasted Cauliflower (I now have the recipe thanks to a friend who found it on line), Octopus and shrimp bruchetta, and the Etch salad. I could have survived on just appetizers, they were that good and plentiful. The entree I  selected was Scallops with mushrooms. This complex dish as incredible! For dessert we all had the Chocolate, Malt, & Toffee Slice ... I don't eat dessert but loved every bite of this yummy dish.
My vegetarian friends selected this restaurant, but it didn't disappoint any of the meat eaters in our group.
I highly recommend reservations for dinner but we didn't have a problem getting a table for lunch.

We were here with several kids the adults were ordering coffee. The kids needed to use the restroom. The manager, a short, rude, blonde lady kicked us out because we were using their bathroom and not ordering enough. I offered to pay extra for our girls to do so as it was nearly an emergency for them. They still kicked us out. While we regrouped out front the kids noticed this old shady bartender inside taking pictures of them!  I went back into ask why. He first insisted he didn't do it. When I told him I would call the police for taking pictures of minors he changed his story and said he thought our kids were drunk and going to cause trouble? Really? 13-14 year olds, really?  He acted very suspicious and then told me he wasn't a "pervert or a child molester" so I didn't need to worry??? He then told me I was a rude person for asking him to remove them and accused me of being a "damn yankee". What? That's not true. I was protecting my kids. I don't think its right that he or anyone possesses pictures of minors that are not his. Please use caution if you have kids. If you go here, make sure you order more than coffee and drinks to use their potty. Skip the joint if you can. There are much nicer places all around.

We loved breakfast the first day and went back for more on day two! Fast, friendly service and great breakfast menu, my compliments to the chef and crew for the taste and presentation they put out in a very small kitchen!
Love this mom and pop shop. Food is great pulled pork, brisket, and let's not forget that corn bread. Mmmhhmmm! I highly recommend if in the Mont.

Was really excited to check this place out especially after hearing all the hype about it. Ordered the chicken & waffles with a Side of corn bred. The food Looked fantastic.  However, the waffle was cold and so was two out of the three pieces of chicken.  Not the best I've ever had and def not worth the price.  I'd come back to try something else just because the atmosphere was cool.

Enjoyed a scrumptious dinner at this establishment.  The Italian Wedding Soup was to-die-for!  Spouse ordered Veal Bellissimo for entrée which was beautifully seasoned, tender, and delicious, accompanied by a side of pasta and bread.  I selected Veal Cacciatori, a very generous portion of veal, green peppers, onions, mushrooms served on spaghetti and smothered with their wonderful tomato sauce.  (I brought half of mine home and we both shared the leftovers for dinner the following day.)  The dessert cannolis were exquisite, as was the bottle of Pinot Grigio which lubricated our fine dinner.  Highly recommended.

My husband and I have been to this restaurant several times in the past. Each time we've come, the service has been incredibly slow (luckily, we never came in a hurry). Unfortunately, our most recent visit tops the others. We walked in on a Tuesday at 5pm and there wasn't anyone at the hostess stand. We wanted to sit in the bar area anyway, so we made our way downstairs and sat down. After about ten minuets of not being acknowledged by any of the three or four staff who were either at the bar or behind it, we decided to leave. As we were leaving a young woman said "bye, thank you!" And we looked at her and said "we didn't get served and never got acknowledged." She started to grab menus and we said "no, thanks. We're going somewhere else."  and left. Between the overpriced food and terrible service, we won't ever be coming back.

I've been to Union Public House a couple of times, and I always have mixed reactions after eating there. I really like the outdoor patio space -- the atmosphere is a lot of fun, and they have always been accommodating when we have come with fairly large groups of people (anywhere from 6-10). They also have a neat interactive cocktail menu on iPads that I always find way more amusing than I probably should.

The food here is what I'm torn about. Some things I love--for instance, their soft pretzel appetizer is one of my favorites, and I always have to get it. But, the entrees are just OK. I've had the union burger with a side salad before, and the salad has come out with barely any dressing and the burger is good, but nothing to write home about. Recently on a visit, one member of our party got the seafood stew, and actually had a piece of wire in his meal--it almost looked like a wire you would get from a cleaning brush. Yikes!

All in all, come for the ambiance and a cocktail, but probably eat somewhere else.

I really enjoyed eating here it is just the cutest place, we loved the decor. I came for breakfast and they have a great variety of coffee drinks, I really appreciated that. Their food was delicious. The staff was friendly but a little under trained on the menu and offerings but that can only get better the longer they work there. We were very pleased and will return. We parked in the parking lot underneath expecting to get a discounted rate with validation, like the sign stated, but they don't validate. Other than paying, parking is a mess- maybe try walking/Uber if you don't live too far.

One word to describe the food here: hot. One of the main reasons why I did not give this place 5 stars. I do enjoy hot foods, but my companions did not. That being said, the salsa was even too hot for me. Our waitress told us that the heat levels do vary depending on who's cooking, but there were not milder options. The food very tasty,  housemade tortillas are always a plus. The margaritas during happy hour were great too. I still found this to be an enjoyable experience.

We stopped in here to pick up a cake that had been ordered for a bridal shower nearby.  We almost drove right past the little shopping plaza it's located in, but thankfully spotted it at the last second.  

The cake that was ordered was a 14 inch cake, but the cake we received seemed WAY bigger than that.  The woman helping us opened it so we could see the decorations which they did a great job on.  She then taped down the sides of the box, but not the front so the box was propped open, which I thought was very weird.  She lifted the cake into my arms and I was shocked at how heavy it was!  It was like 50 pounds of cake!  (Not that I'm complaining, because you can never have too much cake!!)

The cake was a bottom layer of chocolate cake, a raspberry filling, then a vanilla cake layer, and it was all topped off with vanilla buttercream.  It was so delicious!  Each layer was moist, not too dense, and very fresh cake.  The raspberry filling gave the perfect amount of "fresh" flavor to the cake without being overpowering and the icing wasn't sickeningly sweet.  I'd definitely come back here for some desserts if I'm in the area.
Awful. Bread was burnt and hardly any meat ! I had to basically tear the sandwich apart and throw half the bread away to even know that there was actually meat on it !
This restaurant is very quaint. The food is good.  I had the beef rib which is very tasty. I was surprised by the size and the taste.
This probably the worst place in Lakeview. You cannot have a nice dinner across from your guest and hear them. Tried it twice, third is not the charm!

NBO is the CHEERS of Wanamaker. It's a place you earn. And it has a nice bi-polarity to it. On the left is the bar, and it is COZY. On the right you'll find the dining room, where families crowd around the pot-belly stove. Chris and Matt will make sure you get the drink you want, and the food just the way you like it! Great pizza, tremendous beer selection, and tons of surprises on the quaint, but diverse menu!

Welcome to Skippack! If you are visiting Skippack you don't want to miss this little gem, perfect for date nights or family , you will be sure to feel the warm welcoming vibes as soon as you step on the property! A favorite of the town because of the lively music and outdoor tiki bar at night. The food is second to none ( my daughter is crazy for the Caesar salad, and their Alfredo and vodka sauce is the best around ) I had the vegetable panini yesterday that came with a generous portion of pasta salad that I definitely will be ordering again. The grandkids enjoy the pizza which is good also. For the weight conscience their arugula salad with shrimp and lemon is practically sin free!!

We just ordered from here thru grub hub. Their guacamole is incredible and the tortillas were homemade. The plattano yuccateco was also delicious. Will def be ordering from here again. The delivery was fast and the food was hot.  Every thing was authentic and delicious!!

Would be a 5 star if only the service was equal to the food and atmosphere. Circles is our Go To restaurant when family and friends are visiting. The atmosphere is great. There is a tiki bar that serves food and there live music most evenings that is quite good. With a blend of vacationers, snow birds and locals, it is very busy on weekends. The menu is varied and nearly every entrée we have ordered has been very good. They do seafood and steaks well and my wife likes their stir fry. Dining on the patio is a must in pleasant evenings. Service can be slow and at times very inattentive (especially when your server has a larger group at the same time. Pretend you are in the Caribbean and don't stress over the delays, etc.

My sister and I popped in to Flying Pig Saloon on a Friday night when we happened to be in Malvern. The place was totally packed but we were able to score the last available two top table. There didn't seem to be more than a couple servers but there were also a couple bussers running around. 

That said, service was still on the slow side, and our orders were inaccurate so we had to keep asking for things which was annoying for us and our server. 

We had a round of Moscow Mules which were served in copper mugs, but without lime. My sister ordered a taco salad which was on special, but it didn't come with dressing, which we had to request. I had a buffalo chicken wrap with fries. It was delicious, but served with the dressing in the wrap, which I would have preferred on the side, as requested. We also had to ask for silverware and napkins after receiving our food. 

Would I go back? Probably, if I'm ever in the area again. Maybe I'd choose to sit at the bar or at a pub table near the bar, if the option was available.

Excellent food. We had the daily specials #1 and #2 both were delicious.  Absolutely loved the salsa both the red and green couldn't decide which one was our favorite.  Will definitely come here again when we're in the Tucson area.
Good was good. I wanted to take home some chicken salad and they gave me a small cup.  I asked for a large container which I was able to get before.  Cashier and counter people need training.

We absolutely love coming to Sushi Cortaro! The staff is all so friendly and the sushi is delicious. We bring my son who is 18 months right now and they are all so good to him. Happy hour prices are awesome. This is our #1 go-to restaurant.

Oh man this place is amazing! Their hand-crafted beers are great! And their shots too. The food is to die for. The Moose-killer meatloaf is so good! The cider wings are huge and meaty and delicious. The Bomb burger is amazing. It's a half-pound of meat with bacon, cheese, and onions, wrapped in pizza dough, and baked. 
The atmosphere is good, the service is always awesome. We always get our food in a decent amount of time and they are always on hand to bring you a new beer. 
The outdoor bar is pretty good. I don't like cigarettes so the smoke bothers me, but thus just me. It was still nice. 
We like to bring friends from out of town here and recommend it to everyone. 
Will always come back!

Although Mesa Burger has only been open for a few months now, it is one of my favorite spots to go. They don't take reservations and it can get crowded on the weekends but tables open up quickly. The food at Mesa Burger offers all of the classics and has an innovative environment where the staff are really friendly to all. The avocado kale caesar is my favorite but the portions are large, so I would recommend going on an empty stomach. Another favorite is the burger and that's saying a lot because I don't even like burgers. The food always comes out hot, tasty, and melts in your mouth.

Mesa Burger is a great environment for people of all ages. For kids they have wiki sticks to entertain them and tv's for all the sport lovers out there. Here they have many seats indoors and out and I love the open beach vibe that can make anyone smile. As I said before the staff are all so kind to every customer and take very good care of all. I've been here now several times and it has always soothed my cravings for a delicious but casual meal. Overall, I couldn't have been happier and recommend that everyone goes down and tries it.

some of the best mexican and bbq in philly...apps/entrees that are great:

Veggie Wings (tastes really close to the real thing)
Bean Dip (ask for some extra sriracha)
Nachos
Cheese Enchiladas 
The Chronic and seasoned fries

drink specials were great as well

need to build this restaurant in a larger spot as the inside was a little cramped

Very small portion of rice for 2.00, great portion size for tacos,  salsa was horrible usually there is a different one even for chips and salsa, not here,  salsa completes your tacos. Horrible in taste, when I asked the waitress for something else she rolled her eyes!

Pancake Pantry was AMAZING. This place was recommended to us by a friend who is a local. The wait was not too bad. We did get there about 7:30am. I would recommend getting there super early because when we left the line was all the way down the street. They did great at getting people in and out in a timely manner though! This restaurant is also located in a really cool part of Nashville. Now the food, it was so delicious! My boyfriend got the sweet potato pancakes and I got chocolate chip. They were incredible. I would 110% eat here again.
Satsuma Cocktail, fried yam chips, aligator bites, pork sliders...all delicious!  Great bartenders and really cool courtyard dining.

Oh my god this place is so great! Food was great. Drinks were great. Their ceviche was probably the best I have had. Great service. The vibe is cool toom deff reccomend it :) I would come back if I am ever in philly again

The atmosphere is amazing. The menu is very unique -- wooden & contemporary. The staff is quite friendly.

The variety on the menu leaves a lot to be desired. Tacos. Quesadillas. Burritos. That's about it. I was hoping for fajitas, but they don't offer them.

The plated food is very pretty.

Our waiter (Bo) was very friendly & brought some free guacamole for us to try. He also brought me a free flight of sangrias. 

The food was tasty. The drinks were good, but the red sangria was much better than the white. The pink was kind of gross.

I grew up on Texas BBQ so I usually don't bother eating BBQ in other places because it's a disappointment.  Well, Sugarfire has changed my mind.  Great BBQ - I had the smoked salmon and doused in the tangy BBQ sauce.  DEE-licious!  They give huge servings so one meal is really two meals.  Reasonably priced for the amount of food they serve.  The customer service staff are friendly, personable, work pretty fast, all around A-1!  I recommend this place and when I return to St. Louis, I'll be going back to Sugarfire for a good meal.
First time for lunch, ordered Togo. Guy on phone was very helpful and friendly. Food was delish and good quality.

You're not going to find anything at Hella's you can't find at other Greek restaurants.  What they do offer, however, is above average in quality and reasonably priced.  The atmosphere is conducive to conversation, the service is fast, and there's rarely a wait to be seated.

The gyros are good size and the hummus is tasty.  If you do get hummus, make sure to ask for extra pita bread as they never bring enough with the initial order.   After the meal, stock up on mints because you will reek of garlic.

Hella's could improve itself if it wasn't located in the middle of a small parking lot.  An outdoor patio with a hookah bar would be nice but won't happen unless it changes locations.

Had the luncheon portion of the Bedda Chedda Bacon Burger (BBQ sauce on the side--used it in place of ketchup for the french fries that I had as the side.  (Really tasty).  Also had several of their beers since I wasn't driving--all were very good.  Had the chocolate cake for dessert which I took home.  Very rich, will finish tomorrow.  Also very good.  Will be back for sure.

For Sunday morning we were looking for the breakfast place and decided to have breakfast at First Watch. One of the best thing about first watch is that from website online you can add yourself to the queue. So this gives you an opportunity to go at the restaurant when it is your turn for the seating. So when we reached at the restaurant our table for 2 was ready. We were greeted by our server with water and menu. By browsing through the menu we decided to order coffee and hot tea for the drinks and Chickichanga along with Avocado Toast with the side of bread and jam. The coffee served was freshly brewed and tea was also good. Then came our breakfast which was delicious and tasty. We really loved Chickichanga and it was delicious as well as fulfilling. The avocado toast was also freshly made and it was well spread. Loved the delicious breakfast to start our Sunday.

What a fantastic little breakfast place!  Bright, clean and fun atmosphere.  Feels almost like a larger version of a breakfast nook at my dream house.  With a chef that makes delicious food.  The service is fantastic too!  Very personable, casual, quick and seamless.  Like I came to my friends house for breakfast.  :)

The food is delicious!  We had the traditional eggs and bacon and a pancake.  The pancake was like dessert!  So delicious, almost like a crepe.  And it has whipped cream!  The eggs were HOT and so yummy.  And the bacon is awesome!  I suggest ordering it extra crispy.  Love the homemade jam or marmalade that came out for my toast too.  The hash is perfectly made!  Great flavor without being too salty and goes so great with the eggs.   

Can't wait to come back and try lunch!  Thanks for the great food, awesome service and comfy atmosphere.  Exciting addition to the breakfast scene!  :)

It's been too long!  I still love this place and chose it to be my first dining experience since March 2020 (when of course I stopped dining out). It just doesn't disappoint. Great food and service as usual!!

My friends and I came here for a somewhat early dinner (around 5PM). I was expecting this place to be packed since there were so many good reviews on Yelp, but I was wrong. When we stepped in, there was only 3 other parties. We were seated immediately upon our arrival. Their menu is pretty extensive from appetizers, dumplings, noodle, soup, and rice dishes. We shared the scallion pancake as an appetizer and I had the Shaved Noodles with Pork Soy Sauce per my friend's recommendation. The scallion pancake was delicious! They were flakey and crispy. Loved how it wasn't too greasy and the sauce that came with it. The shaved noodles with pork soy sauce was a HUGE portion. Maybe I have a small appetite, but I thought this dish can be shared between two people. For $6.50, it's worth the price! The shaved noodles are known as the wider/flatter noodles. They gave a lot of noodles. A lot more than what I'm used to in California. This noodle dish isn't dry nor is it soupy. Instead, the noodles are mixed very well with the pork soy sauce. The sauce is very well seasoned and flavorful. I wasn't too thirsty after eating it. If I was in the area again, I would definitely be back to have more of that scallion pancake as well as their other noodle dishes. Prices are very reasonable for their portion size. If you do plan to stop by, make sure to bring cash!

One of my go-to restaurants in Santa Barbara!

The food is amazing and so is the service. We also met the owner which is also nice, personal touch to the place. The restaurant is small, but that's what I love about the place. Not to mention a delicious selection of cocktails! And intimate place right across from the ocean!

Super excited to Come here on a Saturday evening to celebrate my birthday with family. Place was pretty packed and busy. Should of made reservations but was easily accommodated outside seating for our party in their cute alley seating that resembles the outdoor seating in Europe. Very cute! We were there for two hours waiting on drinks then finally menus, slowly but surely appetizer, salad, and entrees. Waitress was very apologetic about the long wait for everything, stating they were very busy tonight. Food was pretty darn good. I had the spaghetti and meatballs. the rest of my group had the meatless rigatoni dish and the pistachios chicken, everyone was pleased. All entrees came with a complimentary sample plate along with a salad . From the reviews also an expresso as well . We weren't offered that but I'm sure it was due to the busy night. Overall nice experience at oggi will def plan to return and try other menu items

Chef Rons just made our Friday night this weekend. We had the famous gumbo jambalaya and the greens. All the choices were hands down the best.

The Gumbo here is soooo good I've brought several pints to the other LA for coworkers on the westcoast. 

Every time I'm in town I crave this place. It's a must visit.

This bar is very old and unique located in an alleyway in center city. It is my new favorite bar. I went there for the first time a few weeks ago and have been back several times. The food and atmosphere are really good.

On a trip for work, I stopped here because they have an awesome happy hour menu. That, and because my hotel was next door.

My server was attentive, and they found me a table in the bar despite being busy during happy hour and my being alone.

Their Prime Burger made medium rare is hard to beat, especially with the bacon and cheddar cheese. I'm not sure, but they may mix in a little cocaine (ok, probably, not but it could be that addictive).

The happy hour here is really hard to beat.

We went on a Saturday evening just hours before a heavy snow storm was moving in, so the restaurant was most likely abnormally calm. This allowed us to really take in the beauty of the restaurant's interior design and appreciate a relaxing, delicious dinner.  The lighting was warm and inviting, the flow and energy, lovely, and the sound levels were conducive to conversation.  Our waitress offered the right balance of attentiveness and privacy.   These key factors culminated a wonderful dining experience leaving us looking forward to our next visit.

Highlights:
Confit Pork Belly 
Crispy Pig Ear Lyonnaise Salad

Great food, convenient to Hotel Palomar.  Service is friendly and fast.  Chefs at lunch tend to 'mess up' but the server will correct it.  Ultimately food is great.  Had pork tenderloin that was best I ever had.  Great bacon wrapped dates as well.
Nova Grill is the best. So tasty, lots of flavor and lots of options. The most underrated "fast food" place in Villanova:

Delish.  I came here twice while staying at the Hilton (which is attached to the mall that this location is in).  Also went to the other location in the French Quarter which is just crazy.  This location I actually liked better because it was calm and I could relax with my chicory coffee and beignets and look outside at the Mississippi river.  Not as much charm, no, but still delicious.

The staff were not super friendly (in fact I would say they were the opposite of friendly) but I can understand that they have to deal with tourists all day.  However, I was expecting some southern hospitality which I definitely did not get!  The staff at the original location were much friendlier.

One pet peeve is the TINY water cups.  I know most people get coffee, but I wanted water and the cup was like 4oz.  With all the sugar and sweetness you will need a lot more water than that!  Guess I should have asked for two.

It didn't seem that expensive to me.  A small cafe au lait was $2.42 and an order of beignets was like $3.65 I think?  I guess if you are comparing the cafe au lait to getting a cup of regular coffee somewhere it would be expensive, but it was sort of on the lines of a "fluffy" drink like a special latte or something, so to me it didn't seem that bad.

Definitely a must-eat spot in NOLA!

I drive past this place every single day on my way to work and wrote it off for over five months.  That was a mistake.  The food at Leonardo's is great, especially for the prices!  I think my meal (two tamales with rice and beans) was less than $7.  I went with my group at work and everyone was easily able to find something they wanted.  There were several things I was debating between so I'm just going to have to go back and try them all.

It's open 24 hours too, so if I ever have some late night cravings, or desperately need a taco for breakfast, I know where I'm headed.  The cashier was friendly and efficient.  It took ten minutes or less for all of us to get our food.

When we first moved to Nashville over 4 yrs ago... we were driving around and I spotted the San Antonio taco Co.  I really wanted to try it but our timing just never made that happen.  This past Saturday we finally went.  We were out celebrating my birthday and I am so happy we finally stopped.  It was a beautiful day and we sat outside and enjoyed.  I ordered chicken fajita tacos, rice and guacamole.  My husband ordered the enchiladas which came with rice and beans.  Then we also ordered the queso and chips! Everything was delicious.  Is it fine dining? No... it's a taco stand and they know what they are doing!! Super efficient, very friendly and delicious.  Parking stinks but that was the only negative! Can't wait to go back!!!

Amazing sushi! Their spring rolls are excellent as well. Overall, the food was great. They could work on a couple things: 

1. They need to work on their initial presentation at the door. Right inside the front door it looks very bare, almost neglected. The entire front area, from the entrance to the short hall leading to the main eating area smells like dead fish - not very reassuring at all when you're planning to have sushi. Once you're inside the restaurant the atmosphere is great - the place looks amazing! 

2. Service time - Even though the restaurant appeared to be fully staffed, it took forever to get any service. The restaurant was well under capacity - maybe slightly under half-full.

Overall it wasn't a bad experience though. I'd come here again.

We recently lost our favorite Pizza place, who closed due to retirement.  We have tried numerous places and not even close.  UNTIL Rizzoli.  Outstanding ...crisp crust great ratio of cheese and veggies and sauce.  Thank You!!!!

I've been a member of world health for a few years now and I've loved every minute of it.  The staff is friendly and enthusiastic.  The gym is always clean.  There is plenty of equipment to use so you never feel like you are waiting around. If weights aren't your thing they have lots of classes to choose from.  My favorite class is insanity!  Recently I had an accident while at the gym and the staff was all so helpful and caring.  I had multiple offers not only from staff but other gym members to take me to the medi centre.  This is a great place to workout at!

It's very tasty! They have a large menu and their combos are fairly priced. They have really yummy enchiladas, burritos, and tamales. Since the lockdown, I've ordered out from here a few times. They're pretty fast at making the meals I order. Please order out from here you won't regret it.

If your looking for a five star service, ur probably not gonna get it here, but what you will get is authentic Chinese food that I would say is much better than the ones in the surrounding area, it's as good as it gets than being in China. Food is made fresh, but be aware that many of these foods are traditional ones, so tread carefully before choosing ur dish as it may not be what u think it is. Growing up in a predominantly eating Asian meals, fried pig intestine is amazing...Other than that, it's solid, I know it's cliche but I always get walnut and mayo shrimp, my fav of all time and I vouch that they do it the best here

Was at Modo Mio last Saturday night with another couple.  This was my first time there.  The tables were so close together (I was warned about that before so I expected this) and when I went to get into my seat, my neighbor at the next table had his cooler almost under my seat and was rude and didn't move it until he was asked to.  Not the restaurant's fault but if you are claustraphobic this is not the place for you.  The staff was nice.  It was a bit of a wait but we were enjoying our company so it didn't matter.  The food was incredible and it was plentiful however, in my main entree there was something in the dish (not food) and I know things happen but it wasn't pleasant and if we weren't with friends and me and my husband were on our own, we would probably would have packed it up and left.  Instead, I chose another entree and moved on.  The remaining experience was fine.  I was still shocked that I had to pay for the entree but not sure how they would accommodate me since it is a set price type of place.  Overall, the experience was nice, the food was incredible but am a little turned off by what happened to me.

I couldn't even order from here like I wanted to because when I called they were unable to give me ANY information about my meal. I'm sorry but if your chef is in the building, why can he not tell me the chefs choice sashimi? I've worked in restaurants and I understand sometimes things are weird but at least explain to your customer why it is the way it is. Don't be rude about it. Couldn't try your food so I have no comments about that. Just the service.
Oh my goodness. The care this gentleman took to explain the menu, the dough, and the sauce. The meat in the sauce held together the thick slices of ravioli like a honey comb. Uuuugh yes.

Well the name says it all and I was pretty impressed. I don't remember when gas station chicken became a thing but a friend turned me on to Royal Farms years ago. I did some googling and found out this is a very southern thing and that Krispy Krunchy Chicken is kind of a big deal down there. I was shocked to find one so close. I never noticed it because I don't use the Exxon station it operates out of.

They have stand inside and a menu full of combos and options. The chicken looked damn good. The sides I was a little iffy about so I got the $5.00 tenders special. I didn't know how many tenders I was getting but it came with fries and a biscuit. The nice man put my meal together and off I went with pretty stuffed little platter. Don't hesitate if you're craving fried chicken and see this stand at your gas station.
Came to get some soul while here in Tampa. Love this would recommend you come here if you want real Jamaican soul

Let me start by saying that this rating would easily be five stars had I seen any effort to request or enforce mask-wearing or social distancing. For those of you who don't care about those things, see this as a five star rating as the beer was great and the live music was high quality, at least what I heard of it during the minimal amount of time I was inside while ordering my beer before retreating to the large patio. 

I saw one food server wearing a mask. Not a single bartender was wearing one nor were any customers other than me and my friend. I understand not wearing them at your tables or stools while drinking, but not even when ordering? There was a distinctly too cool for public health measures attitude to the place. We are so fortunate to have our businesses and bars back open. It would be nice to not blow it as Texas did, but it's exactly this type of place that will drive us all back indoors.

There are several bars on the Morgan Ford strip in TGS that are taking varied but conscientious approaches to reopening in order to keep their staff and customers safe. I will be spending my money there in the future.

Ordered the Patty melt for lunch the other day. Burger flavor was good, caramelized onions were LARGE and not very caramelized. They give you an insane amount of fries that you will not eat. Would suggest looking at portion size for fries and 0/5 people at the table ate more than half of their servings.

Oh my is this a great place to eat. Food choices are almost infinite. And its healthy too. The staff was helpful as a first time visitor. I had ahi bowl and loved it. Service was fast and prices were really good. You want to support local then this is a must stop in Carmel. I'll be eating there again very soon.
Terrible, unflavoured, styrofoam eggs. Service took forever, coffee is weak, hair on the plate. Denny's would be a better alternative... it's that's bad.

Drive through was relatively quick.  Employee had rubber gloves and took my card.  At this point I had to ask myself how many other credit cards had she touched with those rubber gloves?  Don't have an answer on how to sanitize after each card, but with the same gloves she packed my napkins and silverware in the bag.  Both the burger and the fries were OK.  The burger was not over salty like some fast food burgers.  Food presentation was certainly better than the big 2 fast food restaurants.

I had a CBS deal burning a hole in my pocket and finally made it to Kris for a Saturday night dinner.  We were a group of 4 with a few food allergy issues, which were accommodated without too much trouble.  We started with the lamb and a few antipasto plates.  I think the plates are a little pricey at $4.50 each because that really adds up if you want to try a few things.  The cheese we had was delicious, as were the beets.  The lamb was okay, a little on the chewy side.  For my main course I had the pappardelle with sea scallops.  It was awesome.  Keep in mind that I try to avoid pasta so that in itself was a treat, but the sea scallops were perfectly cooked, and there was some nice heat in the sauce.  I had a little taste of the venison osso bucco which was also well seasoned and cooked perfectly.  We did have a little issue with the yelp check-in for the glass of wine.  It should say that you have to present it before you order if that's the case.  This issue made me nervous about my other coupon, but we didn't have any problems.  The restaurant was surprisingly pretty empty for a Saturday night, mostly guys sitting at the bar watching the Phillies game.

Went in on a slow Monday night and was able to get a table. I'm gluten free vegetarian and they went out of their way to accommodate me. Cocktails were delicious. Soundtrack included Portishead and the Cure, which I appreciated (YMMV). Would go again.

This is a much needed addition to downtown food! I've been twice this week and already can tell it will a regular rotation in my lunch choices. I've had the Udon noodles and bun bowl. Both were awesome! Their eggrolls taste fresh - nothing like the frozen crap you get at other restaurants. 

Beyond the food, one of my favorite aspects of this restaurant is their drink selection. The Vietnamese coffee (you'll know what I'm talking about when you're there) is AWESOME! I get mine iced and it's the best wake up for the after lunch doldrums.  

Also worth mentioning - everyone in there is nice and super friendly!

I love Mafiaoza's!!!! The pizza is great and the beer is cold. What more can you ask for?! I take a lot of out of town guests here and they all ask to go back each time they visit. I highly recommend this restaurant.

Such a great concept! My girlfriend and I were visiting from Chicago and a friend that lived in New Orleans recommended WINO. Its a little off the beaten path from where we were staying but well worth the trip. My girlfriend and I tried a crazy amount of different wines and had some appetizers. We were pleasantly surprised to see our final bill wasn't ridiculously high either.

Very nice decor . Service was excellent , the restaurant host is very courteous and served very helpful and friendly . The dishes were decent size and good variety of options . Nice southern food flavors . Very comfort food , no surprises on the flavors . Nice simple cocktail drinks . Our dessert took long time so we couldn't taste it . Overall good experience , will return. May be little pricey for what you get but still nice place to meet friends

This is a great place to eat   Fantastic fish - especially the batter    Good Mushy peas and excellent coleslaw 
I would recommend this place - the prices are very reasonable 
Thanks for a great meal

This place is really good! We found it on a whim when our usual spot was closed. The food was good and the portions are gigantic. The prices were fair and the service was good. 

We will for sure be back!

Cheap Price, Large Size, Great Taste.  Pick two.

If you're eating lobster rolls and looking for a value proposition, you are doing it wrong. Other posters complaining about the small portions for $15 must be too used to the $1.50 hot dogs at Costco (and if you don't know what I'm talking about, you're missing out!)

Yes, the regular roll is a standard hot dog bun. But It is stuffed to the brim, and then some, with large, meaty chunks of lobster, sauce, butter, and spices. It is truly fantastic. I've tried my fair share of lobster rolls, and Luke's offers up one of the best. Honestly, I almost wish they had a larger size, even if it were priced accordingly. Say a $20 roll on a jumbo bun or something. 

Anyway, if you love high quality seafood, and aren't a cheapskate, give Luke's a shot.

Just spent 10 minutes sitting at the bar waiting to be acknowledged. 4 bar tenders, bar half full and felt like we were invisible. Finally just walked out.  This is totally unacceptable for a 5 star hotel.
Amazing!!!  Make sure you say HI to Gene! Get chicken st. Charles! Owners should be proud of team

This location has changed 
They dont carry all the items the other locations 
Have no fruit bowls and they only have one 
Race of people working here no diversity 
Very disappointed and no plastic forks in the 
To go bags had to eat my nuggets with my hands

X marks the spot for good seafood at Captain Bill's found on Treasure Island.  We had an assortment of great dishes.  Char-grilled oysters, Oyster Rockefeller, Crab legs, crab claws, and crab cake.  The $3 Sangria was a nice touch to wash it all down.  If I ever end up on Treasure Island again I'll be back.

The sushi here is good, it's just everytime I come the service is so poor. I'm a pretty patience person and I usually never complain it's just not good. Maybe rethink in hiring new people...? Not everyone was horrible though:)

Wow.

The onion bread + tomato salad + chicken polenta dinner with bacon au jus = Most memorable birthday dinner in recent history.

Don't let the geographical location fool you.  Make a reservation and go immediately.

Decent takeout chow. But nobody there seems to know the first rule of retail: if you've got four people behind the counter, at least one of them should be able to at least fake a smile. I felt like I was interrupting a funeral.

the worst pizza I have had in the city. nay, ever. 
i split a pizza with my friend - i have a thing for goat cheese, so i went for the farmers market pizza, which on the menu is described as a veggie pie (no mention of cheese) so i ordered this with added goat cheese. It came out with mozz AND goat cheese. this was not what i orderd, so i sent it back. Then they rushed the fix-it-quick pizza, and the crust that should have been crisp and blistered because we WERE there for brick oven pizza, was doughy and underdone. there was NO sauce ANYWHERE on the pie, there were no onions as described on the menu, and when we ATE the pie, i realized there was no salt, garlic, or spices of any kind. it was literally a few vegetables with a few smidgeons of goat cheese on half-raw bread, and there was a good 2 inches of nothing between the edge of the crust and the toppings. 
UGH. 
I am never eating there again - sLice is my spot - no one has beat them in my book. 
but we'll see if gianfranco or mix can bump sLice from my topspot. I'll keep on posting.

Went for a Sunday brunch. Still getting used to how much of a difference fishtown is compared to the old days. This place was great and can't wait to come back. Awesome to be able to go to breakfast and enjoy it in vegan fashion. The whole atmosphere and food was great.

great authentic food, tasty salsa, friendlly and fast service. I had a combinateion with a carne asada soft taco (meat was seasoned perfectly) chille relleno (one of the best i have had and a chicken sopa. My husband had the fillet relleno which was fish stuffed into a fish and he was blown away, fresh, and delicious! it is only a bear and wine establishment, something you dont mind since the food is so delicious!

I highly recommended this place, 
We got the chicken biscuit and the beef tacos, both were awesome,
We also got some of there donuts and they were the best we have ever had. 5 stars in my book

California Tacos is a solid taco choice!

This awesome taco Shack has been around for a few years and I've been coming since 2014. I've always been a huge fan of the amped tacos. They use fresh veggies and have some of the best meats for tacos. I'm a big fan of the carnitas as well as the shrimp/chorizo. If you get lucky you can get chicharrones which they run out of very very quickly. They also have decent horchata. 

Food takes about 10/15 minutes to come out and prices are pretty fair.
Outside seating and online ahead ordering are offered but no inside dining at this location. I'd say if you are in the mood for really good tacos this place is worth the trip.

This restaurant was so good that I went twice during my one week visit to Nashville. Everything my family and I ordered was excellent, including the Philly sandwich, all three tacos, the spinach dip, garlicky kale, chickpea salad, and a kale/peanut butter smoothie. Everyone on staff is friendly and attentive.

Tony's is arguably the best pizza in Edmonton.
Visiting this place is like being in New Jersey. The only thing missing is a mobster sucking down linguini in clam sauce...

The food is old style Italian American, made with fresh ingredients, served by friendly and efficient staff who genuinely care about good service.
Tony's has been a mainstay in town for many years, and I confess I just discovered them a couple of years ago. I knew they were there, but I always figured it would be a dive, due to the location.
Then, a friend and I decided to seek out "the best pizza in Edmonton." I Googled that phrase and what I got were Rose Bowl, Famoso, and Tony's. As Tony's was the only one we had not tried, we set off on an adventure...
I will admit, I was duly impressed. In spite of the neighborhood, this is a beautiful little restaurant, well decorated, with a real family vibe. Once we tasted the pizza, we were converted, wholly and completely to the church of Tony.

I am still working my way through the menu, but I recommend trying the Special pizzas. Sal's Deluxe and the Pescatore are my favourites so far, but I have not had one I did not like.
The house salad is amazing, with black olives, feta and Tony's Special Vinigrette dressing. I rarely pay much attention to a house salad, as one plate of lettuce is much like another, but this is a must to go with your meal. My friend and I usually split one, as it is a generous portion.
They do not like substitutions on the Special pizzas, but on our most recent visit, my friend batted her eyelashes at the waiter, and they deigned to add fresh Prosciutto to our vegetarian. It was amazing...

There are not a lot of Italian restaurants that impress me with their pasta. I find most of it the same, and generally over priced, but I have had a few here, and they are wonderful.
My first suggestion is the Penne Sambuca, which has Italian Sausage with Roma tomatoes in a Sambuca infused tomato sauce. The flavours are subtle and delicate and the whole dish is a savoury experience.
There is the fore mentioned linguini in clam sauce, which has always been a favourite of mine, and Tony's Linguini Vongole In Bianco is the best I have ever had. 
You do not have to be mobbed up to order it...

Tony's has a decent wine list and a nice selection of beers, and the prices overall are on par or lower than other pizza places, the food, vastly superior.

Tony's is popular with families, but makes a great place to take a date.
It's like a trip to Jersey, on 111 avenue.

What an amazing restaurant and breakfast!
This was such a nice and fancy restaurant, but they don't have any crazy restrictions. 

The detail to everything the staff does is fantastic. 

The food is good and the coffee is hot!
Possibly the best burger i have ever eaten! I habe been here 12 times and when i leave i feel like i just won a war versus the yummiest prime burger ever!
So delicious! Food was amazing and our server Kurrie was so nice. Manager made sure we were enjoying ourselves as well. Definitely coming back soon !

I came to Philly for my fiancé's bday!!! Found this place thru Yelp!!! Everyone talking about the wait.... Fast seating on a Sunday around 12 :) Tina gave us such great customer service!!! Whenever I'm in the area, I'm bound to come again lol You will NOT be disappointed!!! Food is delicious and so is the customer service!! 

Signed,
A Satisfied Customer

We visited K-Paul's on Oct 17th, our third night in NOLA. We arrived around 5:30 without reservations but we were able to be seated right away. It was nice and cozy inside. We thought the dress code was casual but it seemed to be more formal. The staff was so friendly that we did not feel out of place. 

The server brought out a bread basket with a variety of breads that were worth coming back for. I did not order an appetizer because I wanted to save room for my meal. My husband ordered the gumbo for appetizer and I tasted it. It was absolutely amazing! It was very thick and rich with a little spicy kick to it.  For the main course I ordered the Blackened Twin Beef Tenders with Debris. The beef was very tender and juicy; melts in your mouth kind of good. The debris sauce was very very very rich and good. The potatoes were good but not piping hot. That was not a problem for me. The vegetables was string beans and they were cooked to perfection. 

I loved my meal and would definitely go here again.

This Restraunt gives so much more than great food,
Aromas in the air creates you mouth  to water, passion for honest food good vibes is the music in the air!
BYOB...... Be prepared to have a little wait ...go on Booker.com....

Second time here. Packed, as should be expected on a Friday night. First available had us seated indoors and not on the lovely patio.
We ordered a bottle of Malbec and eggplant rollatini which tasted good, but should have been served warmer.

The Margherita pizza was hot with a well done crust, but there was little basil ( my sole purpose in ordering this type) and not evenly distributed.

Saved room for gelato!! My husband was pleased with his Nutella and strawberry gelato. My coconut was creamy but coconut flavor could have been stronger. Cappuccino was "very tasty" ( I don't drink them!)

Our server hustled and was excellent.
A bit disappointed over the quality of the food, but will return at a later date.

My first stop off my flight was The Three Coins Diner. Basically a glorified Waffle House.

Servers were friendly enough. Once again, reminded me of a Waffle House. I ordered the Mushroom Bacon Burger with Swiss cheese. Standard - but super tasty. I can imagine it's even better late night after a night of drinking. 

Classic diner food perfect for soaking up alcohol! Daytime though? - not so sure about how much better it tastes in the light...

3rd time is a charm.  Passed this place the first two times just after 6 two weekends in a row.  Was determined to try it out.  Went there Sunday around 2 in the afternoon (they close I think by 5 or 6 on Friday and Saturday).  You order inside and then they deliver to the table outside.  It was so nice not to have music playing, you could actually enjoy conversation and company.  I had the blackened grouper sandwich with the side of cucumber tomato salad.  Everything about it was perfect.  The roll was not obnoxiously bulky, the grouper was perfectly cooked and seasoned.  My wife had the grilled grouper sandwich and the potato salad.  On top of the food being delicious, I had a cigar city oatmeal cereal stout beer.  They sell beer and wine can or bottles.  The lady serving was super nice.  Only outdoor seating.  Excellent and will absolutely go back!

The variety of tacos is Excell! I had the chorizo with pineapple salsa and it was amazing! The guacamole was very flavorful with good size chunks or tomatoes! The kids were fighting over the queso.great place to eat!

We liked this place! Generally we've been fairly disappointed with the Chinese food on the west side of town so we decided to try something new. We were pleasantly surprised!  It was all very fresh... The Mushu vegetable was clearly hand cut and not overly-sauced. (The rice paper rolls were terrible as they are everywhere. We just order hours with white rice.) The Kung Pau chicken had lovely, generous tender slices of chicken, crunchy peanuts, fresh celery and green pepper in a thick, spicy sauce. Pork fried rice: serviceable but not a standout. One more thing: the prices were very reasonable, too!

This is probably one of the worst catering places I've dealt with. We ordered twice.  The first time, they didn't have the order ready for pick and when asked for plates, they don't have them. They were rude and slow and the food wasn't hot. The second time, they left bulk bags of lettuce because I guess it was too hard to put it into a contain and make it look nice

Great food choices on a really quaint street in safety harbor. Prices are reasonable, service was good, and I loved the low carb breakfast options. My sister had the poached eggs and said they were great. They make fresh bread that is offered as toast option but you may need to be a local to know this. Kids menu was great offering drink with meal. 

2 thumbs up.

Ok so I couldn't resist - I went back for dinner on Sunday as well.

The chicken mole burrito is very good, with just the right amount of cocoa-y-spic-y sauce and some tender grilled. 

Gorditas are fairly good.  They're compact, tasty, and dry - but not in an unpleasant way.  I would like to take a few of these hiking with me. 

I'm sticking by 5 stars.
We were unaware there was not seating inside. There is a small patio where you can sit. The pizza was decent. Very greasy. I wouldn't go out of my way to come here.

My mother and I visited Zaika for the first time today even though I heard of it when it first opened. Great authentic Indian food, swanky decor and an overall great atmosphere. Lunch buffet was decently priced ($14 pp) and you have so much variety. The rice pudding and the mango custard are to die for! Definitely will go back one day soon!

I don't need to go here every week, but my kids love it and I like it. There are lots of different games of luck and skill so they can collect the ever precious D+B tickets and then exchange them at the "store" for stuff that's junk in my eyes but previous in theirs.

The food is not amazing, but this is not really a restaurant. I think that's what upsets some of the reviewers - when you are a giant establishment that has food and games, there's more that people can find wrong. D+B is kind of Jack+ of all trades and master of none.

No, it may not be as big as the D+B in Chicago or Cincinnati, but you're not in Chicago or Cincinnati, are you? So that's kind of a moot comparison.

I had high hopes for this from reading other reviews. I'm positive that the biscuits were Pillsbury and the steak in the chicken fried steak was obviously some frozen processed item. I'm not a great cook, but I could make a better breakfast at home. I expect more when I go out.

Pretty unhappy with my experience here. The service was pretty terrible. Clearly they were under staffed. There were only 2 servers who also were the bartenders. The food came out extremely late, the orders were wrong, we were charged for items that we didn't receive, drink orders were never delivered, no utensils were given and the list goes on and on. I suppose if they had extra help/employees maybe the experience would have been better. Many of the patrons were complaining about the poor service. The food that we did receive was subpar. The servers were complaining to patrons about other patrons. Extremely unprofessional. My group came here for a celebration happy hour experience but left very unhappy and underwhelmed. Probably won't be returning.

Sure, if you want Mediterranean influenced by Louisiana, you're already way uptown and need a break from Cajun/creole fire. If you're in a group of 3 or 4, order 3 of the "Salatims" for $21: Tabouleh: crushed pecans, freekeh, avocado; Labneh: pink peppercorns, shallots, mint; and Cauliflower Baba Ganoush with roasted garlic and olive oil. Should also try a hummus. The Tahini with extra virgin olive oil was a good choice but if I got to choose for my group, I would have ordered the blue crab with sweet potatoes, lemon butter and mint. For the entree, I ordered the lamb sandwich which included shreeded lamb with a scrambled egg and lettuce in a pocket pita.

This place is pretty darn good.  It's a casual pizza/brew pub that has a ton of pizza options - all of which are available in personal or larger sizes.  They brew their own beer (and root beer for that matter) and are always packed!  The downsides are that it is always busy so you have to park pretty far away and the service has been slow to awful every time I've been there.  That being said, I really like the food and it's worth a visit, especially if you can go during an off peak time.

Great Food! Great service!  Great prices.  What is not to like,  Tuesday night steak specials...outstanding.  The rib eye I had was excellent, perfectly seasoned and perfectly cooked.  The bottle-neck fries were hot, crispy, tender inside.  The veggies were odd, beans undercooked, carrots mushy...but who cares, the steak was perfect!
  The fish and chips is my typical go-to meal for Rail City.  My good friend Anne who is Scottish swears it is the best fish and chips in Reno; I agree.  Outstanding!!!!

I love this place. The food is solid and it has The best dining rewards program in the nation! Must come for the bar bites menu alone. Paul and his co manager are great. Had a problem once with a rewards promotion that they couldn't fix so lunch was on them. 
Pic is from bar bites menu. Pepperoni dip and shrimp Napoli! Boom!

This is your typical Dennys. The only reason that I are here was because it is difficult to find a breakfast place in Edmonton that accepts AMEX cards.  I had an omelette with a side of sausage.  The omelette was their supreme omelette which is basically a sausage and bacon omelette with cheddar cheese.  

The bottom line is it was ok but not great.   I will eat here again because they accept AMEX.

Love Bertucci's Pizza.
If you ever go to this location to eat ask to be served by Jeff French.  The guy knows what he's doing and deserved a generous tip from me.  I recommend everyone else doing the same!

Although pricier than standard Mexican restaurants, Reforma's quality stands out above most others. The four of us agreed that Reforma's ingredients were fresher and more authentically Mexican. One way to tell is by the beans and rice served: these were fresh black beans and homemade Spanish rice, not the crap that most Mexican places serve that comes from 5-gallon freezer containers. 

We had the enchilada Suisas, the fish tacos and everything was delicious, ample servings, and colorfully presented. The only negatives were the large screen TVs everywhere and the higher prices. The TVs are apparently to attract the sports bar crowd.

Crabby Bill's is a tourist trap. It's hard to find parking. Very busy but not waited long for a table. The decor is like most beach restaurant.  The service was not the best; they a little messed up our order.  
The food was very average. This is not the place where I will come back.

We made our first visit today. I will have to say-- I am impressed. They make the pita bread on site and it tasted so fresh. My lunch partner and I both got the Number 1- Gyros. Both with the sauce on the side (which they honored). I got fries (which were not greasy) and my partner got their homemade chips (which were also good). Unlimited drinks. I knocked one star off for the decor-- not all that great. However, if you are into minimalism, you might be into it. The place was clean. I will go back-- maybe try a sub next time.

Pass. The food wasn't worth waiting for. Just plain old bacon and eggs but at home it would taste better. It's just a place to go if you want to eat food made by a neighbor. Nothing special. Neither good or bad...just made for you so you don't have to cook

So my review is for a carryout from the new West Nashville location of Five Points Pizza. 

Having said that, from my short trip there, I noticed they have the place divided into carry-out and dine in. And the dine-in area was busy at 10 pm too. There is plenty of seating available. So will have to try a dine-in experience some day! 

But the carry-out service was super smooth. I just called the West Nashville number and the customer service was friendly. Sometimes I can be annoying, because I ask for opinions and details and the receiver was patient and friendly throughout. An order takes about 20-25 min on "a not so busy time" and they have a little waiting area too. There is decent parking in the area as well. They do close their lines at 10 pm, and I am glad I checked in earlier to place a pick for 10 pm. 

Now there is good reason why Five Points is the hype. One of the first places I was recommended when we newly moved to Nashville was Five Points Pizza. And, I see why! It is delicious. NY style pizza but the flavors are amazing. There are many tempting flavors on the menu so I decided to do a half and half. I went with the habanero cream sauce and pesto. 

So I am one of those people who douches their pizza in chilly flakes. Let's be honest tomato sauce has a sweet undertone and I like my pizza spicy. This makes a habanero cream sauce pie so insatiably good. It is not tomato sauce. It has a lovely kick to it (some may think it is spicy, it wasn't for me). And the beautiful basil accompanied with red onions and oven roasted grape tomato, with hints of garlic and with a delicious balance of mozzarella was very satiating. I just loved the flavor. 

The pesto pie was delicious. Their pesto sauce is made of walnut and it was not too over-powering. It was well balanced and the artichokes are a great addition. I liked this in the non-spicy way. 

I did note that beef/chicken toppings were missing from their selection but that wasn't a big deal as I had plenty to choose off of. 

Needless to say, super excited to have a delicious pizza place walking distance from my residence. So for those who haven't had a chance to visit the east nashville location, come to the west side and try itu.

Boyfriend heavily enjoys their food. Empanadas are good (some are drier inside depending on filling) as are the burritos which are huge! The rice dish is okay, as the meat could be of better quality but I LOVE the potatoes they have in it, and the flavor of the rice is delicious.

I have dined here 4 times. Each time the pizza is perfect. Being an Italian myself, It's hard to find genuine home made tasting pizza. chain pizza is off limits to me. This place really tastes good, wait service is quick, helpful and friendly. The bill is never too much and they have a bar for the rare times I do drink. Cant get any better for a pizza place! This place is an A+ in my book. Try them out

A visit to Boise should include a stop at Wild Root for brunch through dinner. The huge outdoor seating area is COVID safe and provides a perfect view of the pedestrian friendly district of downtown Boise.

Perhaps Boise's most creative bartender is Morgan at Wild Rose.  Did you know Figs can Fly?  Need a Sweater for this Weather?  Morgan creates delicious concoctions.

Ruby our fabulously friendly and helpful server, and Tony and Jarrell in the back, put together a couple of impressive meals using mushrooms, zucchini pasta, a medley of vegetables, and perfectly seared tuna.   

Thank you Morgan, Ruby, Tony, and Jarrell for a tasty and entertaining evening.

Disappointed. They hosted an event and didn't have seating in the dining room. So they put us on the patio. Tempura was overcooked and the sashimi was not fresh. Service was thin as we were an afterthought to the event. Bad timing, too bad, won't be back.

Im a huuuuuge fan!! I always do delivery, the delivery drivers are always fast and the nicest gentlemen delivery drivers Ive come in contact with. 
They have their own special online ordering system and it is by far the best thing any restaurant could have. It lets you customize your orders in every way that you can think of. It even lets you know when your food is on its way and when its done being made. 
I had one slip up the first time ordering, I ordered a personal pepperoni pizza and i got a cheese one instead. Called them and got another pizza with heavy pepperonis in less than 10 mins. I would love to actually go inside and eat when Im dont being lazy ordering from online.
Im pretty sure they get tired of seeing my address on the food ticket, because I order there waaaaayyyy too much.

Great atmosphere and wonderful food. They unfortunately overcooked my Filet but promptly replaced it. Shit happens. Prices are above average but fair. Seating outside is nice. Lunch for 3 was $100. Not too shabby. Go check it out. Burgers look outrageous! Salad was awesome. Steak sandwich is a real filet!

I've eaten at most of the pizza places around Temple and this is my favorite. Their buffalo chicken pizza especially is great, and they sell large slices for $3.25, which is fair. Plain is about a dollar cheaper, I believe. The employees here are awesome, even on late weekend nights they are friendly and welcoming.
despite having food in the case, worker just kept repeating "kitchen not open" refused to provide service for food that was right there

Great staff, yummy food, and an overall perfect experience. We had dinner on a Friday night, and while it was mildly busy, we were seated immediately and comfortably. The menu was straight forward with simple descriptions and our server was patient and very helpful. The ambiance was very bistro like and tidy. My goodness was the food delicious: samosas, chicken tikka masala, curry chicken, lamb saag, and two different types of naan--all were delicious. Medium was perfect for me (I'm not much for spicy food) and my husband appreciated the hot option. We took a box home since three entrees was waaay to much for two people, and I bet it will be just as satisfying tomorrow. Great place for your craving and now a frequent stop for us.
Great little gem of a breakfast/lunch place. Very friendly staff, fast, and affordable!

I love this place for a sweet treat. Not only do they have the best cup cakes in the city but they also have awesome cookies, brownies, etc....  They have all kinds of exotic cup cakes so depending on my mood I might have something like their Espresso Hazelnut Praline cupcake or their chocolate covered banana cupcake.  Once you bite into these delicious cupcakes you will never enjoy any other cupcake.

We are frequent visitors of boardwalk pizza in Clearwater... I still like their pizza but their service can be down right bad. So we have been on the look out for a new New York style pizza , after driving by Big Romans many times, my boy friend finally decided to give it a try! Boy am I glad he did! This place is spotless and the cheese pizza hits the spot for me!  And the staff is down to  earth n friendly, score ! We ordered  a large cheese pizza for 12 bucks! Delicious ny style! I really liked the sauce n cheese n crust, oh that's everything isn't it! The have a special for two slices and a drink ... at the lunch hour on certain day! I think that is more then far! We will be back for sure

The staff are super friendly!  The food was ok. I'm from Phoenix and I have a lot of choices. So for me the food was just ok. 
I got the taco,enchalda and Chilereano for $11.99. Maybe the burrito would have been a better choice?

You really would walk past this place and not give it a second thought ever again unless you love hummous as much as me or had a bad craving of poutine as a local.
So that happened and the hummous was a bit better than average the bread only got once peice and was bit stale for $4 total.
Tables were dirty and the guy/not owner behind the counter made me wait to pay and not friendly at all. Owner is friendly and wwe was on the tv the second time I came in ontop of a cheesy murale.
Patrons are friendly despite neighborhood.
I liked my poutine for the fries was good and the gravy good, a big portion to share for $13 with 2 pops.
It looks in the picture on menu that it is cheese curds but is only mozza, I did not dislike it as much as some other places who make it that way.
Good value will be back and try the falafal some time.

It's just OK I would say.   I like their steak and pork chops and lamb chops, but they are all $30+, where I would say they probably should be no more than $24.  I haven't tried the crawfish, which seems to be popular amongst yelpers, but the only appetizer I that even looks interesting is the coconut shrimp (a tip ... any appetizers 1 appetizer is free with the purchase of 2 entrees).  The muffins are usually good, but sometimes they are a tad dry.  The desert soufflés are good, but probably a tad overrated.  Also, while the beer is fine, my wife has yet to find a cocktail on their menu that she enjoys.

We decided to try curry night- are we glad we did. It was a cold evening and there was  great singer out back.  They had heaters which kept us warm. Even though it was cold out - never too cold in Florida for blueberry beer on tap.  The curry was fantastic and staff were funny and helpful - we will definetly be back!

Delicious. There was a wait at 10:30am on Saturday, but they move through fast. Maybe 5 min with a long line. Order the Crepes Parree with strawberries! My 7 yo picky eater loved them! The hasbrowns and bacon are extra/separate when ordering things like waffles and crepes. Great kids meal prices-huge pancake portions! Only one warning with kids-the crayons for table art are in a coffee mug-awesome because there's more than two crayons!-careful, my daughter reached into my actual coffee mug without looking, luckily we were nearing the end of the meal and the coffee was tepid or that would have ended terribly! Busy but friendly staff-no issues there. Will definitely be back to explore the extensive menu!

Being from New York, it is hard to find good fish in Nashville. Fin & Pearl has done it. Everything was superb including the octopus, tuna poke, branzino, and beef tenderloin. Friendly service and a fun environment.

Was a solo diner. Came in on their 1-Year Anniversary. Staff was chipper, attentive and happy. Live music was in the parking lot offered decent ambience and something to watch instead of awkward "busy-ness" we all do on our phones when we're alone. 

Anywhoooo, ordered 2 meats and 2 sides. 
The sweet ice tea was delicious & very sugary just like mom used to make when no one gave a shit about dental in the 80's. 

Meat comes out dry (exterior/no sauce, not taste). Ribs were delicious, chicken leg quarter was good as well- the BBQ sauce on the table made it. 
Mac & Cheese tasted too "processed cheesy". 
The BBQ baked beans are a game changer though. 
I WANT TO BATH IN THEM. Yummmmm!!!
Love their breakdast. Get there early because thry get busy. You need to get the danish basket.

Absolutely love this place! I've been about 4 times now. A few things I recommend here..the maple bacon burger, the quesadilla, the nachos, and the funnel cake fries. Definitely give this place a try!

Being from Los Angeles and Palm Springs and after eating in Paris at the Ritz, NYC & a great cook myself...you get the drift, I was intrigued by Lourdas each time I passed by while visiting in Bryn Mawr. Finally one evening . rather early,  we were able to get a seat.  Fortunately it was near the wall and my daughter and I got the banquette. It is rather small and a little crowded but very quaint, clean and you get a feel that you may actually be somewhere in Greece. 

Our particular waiter was spectacular, however, in observing some others, I think we got the good one! The place is a little pricey but very, very delicious, fresh, and serves authetic Greek food. 

My other favorite  Greek foodery is Taverna Tony's in Malibu, CA, so I am a Greek food junkie and know what I am talking about!!! 

I had the mousakka (moose=UH=ku), according to my waiter who corrected my rather touristy pronounciation, and it was delicious and enough for a doggy bag. They had a children's menu, great for the grandchild or they made whatever  else she wanted if it wasn't on there. My daughter had a fish that was superb and fresh, and overall we thought the food was great. We did, however, hear that as the evening progresses and the place gets more full of people the din gets more objectionable. Since I prefer eating early, it suited me just fine. Loved it...would go back....didn't try dessert, I was too sated. I hope to try them next visit. Recommendation of this restaurant  to you! Opa! 

Watch the movie "My Life in Ruins" for a fun Greek movie.

This place radically re-branded for Whole Foods competition.  Thank God they Got It that acoustic tiles and fluorescent light bars and bad music belong in a 1970s mall and not a quality grocery... They re-did the ceiling into industrial chic and lights and really stepped up the products.  They fail at good wine deals, they don't have the products expected much at a Trader Joes or Whole Foods  (pie crusts on down), but i must compliment them for the BEST Fried Chicken I've had in years.  I assumed their light golden fried chicken next to the baked salmon at their expensive new food bar would be something far beyond the old grocery chain horrors and I was right.   This place is nice to shop at... A great Vibe... Save Mart and Smiths should pay attention.
I come here all the time. It's actually the only pho place that changed my mind about pho.

Desi took such care of me and my friends when we came in to eat for her birthday! She was very attentive and was on top of it when taking care of us! Thank you so much for the great service and i will be back!

I always want to love this place, but it's always just slightly less than I want. The selections are plentiful, the food is good. They love to cook the heck out of eggs, so if you like your eggs a little less crispy, order them over medium. The gravy is thick, the chicken is just slightly overdone but it's better to be safe than sorry with chicken. Overall, it's a filling breakfast, you definitely won't leave hungry!
Fish could be more fresh.  Uni and yellowtail were a bit fishy.  Portions are not large. I would also rate it $$$.  Spent close to $120 for two people. Won't be going back.  Service was good.
Great food. Never had a bad meal here. I usually get the grilled salmon. My wife always gets the chicken parmesan.

There was literally no one in the restaurant and took 45 mins to get out food. The waiter spilled water all over the table (not too terrible as things happen) and after waiting 20 mins to order, after we all were about to order chimichangas, we were told the deep fryer wasn't working!  This would have been great to know right away!  The heater was broken on the coldest night of the year and they did nothing to rectify it. We were with my sister's friend who was pregnant and asked for a space heater or anything by her and was told there was nothing they could do.  As we left, there was a couple who asked and were given a heater right next to him even though they arrived an hour after us (we were the only patron's for over an hour until they showed up.  My fiancée's taco salad came out 20 mins after our food and had no meat (which it should have). Literally took over an hour to put lettuce in a bowl. All of our food was luke warm.  

The worst part:  As well as the heat being out, the restaurant had no hot water.  How were the servers and cooks washing their hands?!  Disgusting!  This restaurant should have been closed due to the circumstances!

Would not suggest at all!!

Cepas is really good. The tapas were all good and the sangria is one of the best I've had.  We tried the Spanish Sampler, Gambas al Ajillo, Ensalada Mediterranea, and the mini paella de mariachis.  The great thing about going with a group of people is that you get to try different dishes.  All were delicious. I highly recommend this place.

This little breakfast spot is the PERFECT place for a nice brunch, breakfast, or even grabbing coffee with an old friend. My best friend told me that this had become her new favorite breakfast place in Fishtown and I couldn't wait to try it! 

The place is smaller in size, but do not let that scare you if you need to wait 20 minutes to be seated because they are FAST! We got seated right away luckily arriving before 9 am, by the time we left a little after 10 it was completely crowded with every table filled. 

I ordered a coffee, tofu scramble with latke and biscuit, and my friend ordered a mac and cheese pancake, yes you read that right, and eggs. The tofu scramble was ok, not the best one I've ever had, but it did the job and the latkes/biscuits were perfect! I tried a little piece of the mac and cheese pancake and wow! Who would of known? With everything and tip we only ended up paying around $30, which is amazing. I'd recommend and looking forward to going back myself to try other options

Not sure if this was an off night but the pizza was horrible. I haven't been here in years and talked it up to the people I was visiting with as great Chicago style pizza.
