Wow, talk about disappointing! The "pie" came halfway up the crust, was dry, and looked like it sat under a heat lamp for an hour. I called it in and picked it up at 45min as instructed so it wasn't my timing that was off.

I'm guessing things have changed since I left STL and in this case, not for the better. With all the great food in STL i'm going to have to pass on coming back when I vist. :(

The Brewte Salad (romaine lettuce, tomatoes, sunflower seeds, parmesan cheese) was wonderful - large portion of perfectly dressed greens with delicious house made pita chips. The black bean burrito was good when I got a bite with guacamole and black olives but bland for the other 90% of bites. Adding some of their salsa helped but the beans need some seasoning.

The staff is always super nice and emulate warm positive vibes however the restaurant always seems short staffed so the service can be very slow and erratic.

Wow! So mad that I didn't find this place sooner.   Wings crazy good!  Hamburger? Phenomenal!
A must!
Love this place. The food is consistently good & the service is wonderful. Pad See You is one of my favorites!

I love a good burger and O'Connells has a good burger. It's a pretty standard burger, but it's done really well.  

But even better than their burgers are their chicken wings! They were crispy and saucy and spicy, yum!  They only offer them on Sundays becase, as the waitress explained, their kitchen is too small to serve all of their daily specials everyday.  If you like wings, make time to go to O'Connells on Sunday.  They are $6.50 and you get a heaping bowl of wings. 

Oh yeah and everything is served on paper plates, because it's just that sort of place.  :)

What a disappointment. Decided to try this restaurant on a Friday evening for dinner. The place was not busy but there were some customers. There was one server and it took the server at least 10 minutes to even recognize us. Food was below average and the prices are expensive for the quality of the food. It was an unpleasant dining experience and we will never come back. There are other places you can try along South Street.
Went for date night the other night. Love this place and their authentic Ethiopian food. Don't forget you can bring your own booze.
Came for Sunday brunch, ate outside- cute ambiance. Server was friendly and food was good. Not mind blowing, but I'd gladly go back.

I, like many others have driven by this place for many years, never giving it much thought. After moving into walking distance of it, I made a point to try it out. WOW ! I regret not having tried this place much sooner.Now I can't stay out of the place. The Legend Club is the King of sandwiches in my opinion. I've yet to hear anything but raves about it from everyone I've recommended it too.

Was in town on business so why not.

The burger itself was cooked to med-rare perfection the whole patty through, which makes me wonder if they sous-vide it and then give it a quick sear.   The meat itself, while quality, lacked proper seasoning. 

Foie gras has absolutely no business adorning a burger that also contains such overwhelming flavors as bleu cheese and bacon.  Or even a burger at all for that matter.  Its ALMOST as dumb as the concept of a kobe burger.  In any event, it's a gimmick thats worked well for this restaurant, to be sure.  I took mine off and ate it separately. It was delicious and i recommend you do the same if you want to taste the extra $12 or so you are spending. 

The deviled eggs were a pass. Nothing you couldn't replicate with google search and an ability to properly boil eggs.

Well, I'm not thoroughly disappointed... the pizza is good. I've only eaten here for the first time last night, and I wasn't used to the theme of the restaurant. It's really for hipsters. Small and quaint. The restaurant is self seating, self-serve, and self clean. I just wish the person at the front counter would have been so kind as to be more informative about that cause I definitely didn't know about the self cleaning part. Its no problem, but I just would have liked to be told up front. So I'm here to tell you that... otherwise, its ok.

My husband and I come here all the time for the lunch buffet. It's a little bit quieter during the week than on the weekend, but they seem to have the dishes we prefer on the weekends. Love this place. When it's busy, it's the antithesis of "intimate' but otherwise, extremely pleasant dining experience with very good food. I wish it was just a little bit spicier but I understand that they have to cater to bland local taste buds. Overall, fantastic, plan to keep coming here for forever.

My husband does not like to eat out but this spot has been the only place we have eaten since we moved from Downtown St Louis to Fairview Heights two months ago. We've been here five times now, taking friend and family when they come to visit. 

This is a friendly family running the restaurant. The owners always stop at the table and make sure everything is OK. It's evident that help is hard to find and they are a unorganized or short when it comes to front of house. Even with reservations recently we stood at the door for exactly 30 minutes before we were seated. Refills for water/drinks are generally slow and you usually have to ask first. If something like a take out container, extra napkin or extra plate is requested, it usually takes a bit. 

Having said this, the family is nice and they mean well. And the food...amazing. Looking at the photos, I'm guessing the menu used to be larger. However, everything on it now is delicious and it's been consistent. The steaks and tuna steak come perfectly seared rare and you sit and cut slices of your steak on hot lava stones so each bite is cooked to perfection. It's genius and our friends who visit just love it.  The meat is seasoned perfectly and simple rice and salad keep the meat the star of the show. I'm a fan of marbled cuts so I usually get the smoked prime rib or ribeye; my husband is a fan of the pichana cut. We also always start with the sweet plantains. Delicious. We don't bat an eye at dropping $100 on a meal here. We are always satisfied food wise and I love searing the leftovers at home for steak salads. 

I have absolutely no clue why people are not lined up out the door here, so much better than places like Longhorn or Outback. Hopefully service gets better with some extra help. It has not been a huge deal because we have been going with friends or family that we haven't seen for a while and so we don't get grumpy about it, plus by the time our food comes it's such an impressive experience we kind of forget about how long we waited to sit or for drinks. On the flip side, the family doesn't rush their tables. They chat with the customers and allow them to have experiences and I think they would rather have that than have tables in and out quickly.  We will continue to go back.
My friend randomly got his Hydro Flask searched for alcohol and since he had lemonade in it he got kicked out... worst place ever, never come here.

Ordered bruschetta and a pizza through bite squad. It should be common sense not to put the topping on the bruschetta bread because when it arrived it was chewy. It was also so salty I could barely eat it. Pizza was just ok. We won't be return customers.
Best lunch spot on the north end of Santa Barbara. Day hello to the owner, Larry, who is usually there. Great patio and fast accurate service.

We had a cheese platter- it included 3 types of cheese: A hard goat cheese, sheep Brie and a cow pepper jack. The platter also came with toasted bread, jam, dried apricots and salted nuts. My husband's favourite was the nuts and I liked the pepper jack. It was unfortunate that they are not flexible with the cheese they give you (we are not a fan of goat cheese). But the service was fast and staff was friendly. They offer a good variety of cheese in their deli. There is this aged smoked cheese from Holland that has a really full and pungent flavour I'd highly recommend.

Pascale's Manale is the perfect embodimentm of the Creole-Italian mixture. I hate to beat a dead horse, but the BBQ shrimp are great and oughn't be missed (unless you have the opportunity to eat some home cooked ones instead). I had the fine pleasure of showing up on an evening when the special was fried drum toped witht he BBQ shrimp. it was amazing. The tender fish was swimming in the butter sauce. The waitress made sure we ALWAYS had pleanty of french bread at the table to soak up the wonderful sauce.

If you are staying in the quarter (even though you really should be staying up river of canal), its a 20 minute street car ride ($1.25) away; its a block away from the stop at Napoleon (the halfway stop).
Looked up the best Cheese steaks while in the area visiting. This little Gem did not disappoint!!! Simply amazing! Definitely give them a try.

First night visiting Nashville, Edley's was near my friend and mine's Airbnb. We came here to get some barbecue before heading out for drinks. The system was simple enough, order at the counter and they'll bring the food to you. We ordered the catfish tacos and a chicken platter.  The catfish tacos were really great. I devoured my portion within a minute. The chicken on the chicken platter was a whole leg (drumstick and thigh) and a breast with an attached wing. On the menu it said it came with 2 sides and a piece of cornbread. We ordered the cole slaw and Mac and cheese. When we got our food the catfish tacos for also came with a side which we had no idea so the cashier had just given us both the same sides which was very disappointing. She also didn't tell us the chicken platter already came with coleslaw so we had even more . We also were not given a piece of cornbread. Eventually I flagged down a staff member and they got us a piece of cornbread. The chicken itself was cooked well but wasn't anything amazing. We also ordered an appetizer of fried okra and there was sooo much that we could not finish it. Definitely better to order of you have a big group. We also ordered beers at the bar and the bartender was informative and helped us pick out beer. All and all we couldn't complain because an appetizer, two meals, two beers, and a piece of cake for dessert only came to about 40 dollars.

I've been here now 6 times and can't say enough good things about this place. The appetizers are unique and tasty. The build-your-own Mac n cheese is homey and filling and delicious. The signature cocktails are amazing (if pricey). The bartenders are great. I've only had one complaint (seared scallops were undercooked) and they took the item off the bill after noticing I hadn't finished them. I didn't even need to complain!  Social is a strong addition to the Edwardsville dining scene

Nice addition to Main Street in Speedway. It's a small space but the food was quite good. I had the taco special which came with many options including two types of fish. I went with the fish tacos and was quite happy. Having recently moved here from San Diego I have become spoiled on fantastic fish tacos. These were quite good with a variety of hot sauces on the table. Service was excellent. Definitely check it out

Had a very good dinner here.  All the entrees were good but the appetizers were exceptional.  Seriously the ceviche was some of the best I've had.. in the middle of the mid west!  Who knew?!  Maybe I was just desperate for it...

Actually, the only really odd thing was that we enjoyed out bottle of wine, and ordered another, but they wouldn't sell the second bottle to us because it was their last one, they would only sell us glasses.  Strange..  oh yeah, they didn't have Dos Equis either..
Another great meal at my favorite sushi restaurant, It is always family friendly with great vibe and awesome service. I always try a the special fish of the day. Great people...
Fantastic food: moist and flavorful chicken with appetizing sides.

I'm forewarning you,  food coma incoming.  We got the all meats and all sides. The food came so fast. The staff is really nice and the drinks are great and comes at a great price.  I'm excited to come back.

So, when I read the menu online, it comes across as  limited and a little fussy, but I kept an open mind. That was a mistake.

Honestly, I was not that impressed.  Yes, the staff was kind and pleasant, which one would always expect but the pricing is waaay out of touch with reality. To charge $12 dollars for a wedge salad which is part radicchio (served limp and partially brown), part iceberg lettuce with a standard blue cheese dressing, sprinkle of bacon and small tomato halves is unconscionable. I'm glad I asked to not have the caramelized onions that is part of it because that would have ruined it. Who ever eats a wedge salad with caramelized onions on it? People who order a wedge salad, want just a wedge salad. It means they are not impressed with any other salad being offered. Agree?

Ok, so, I ordered the $35 dollar rib eye with mash potatoes. The mashed potatoes were boring.  No flavor. Sorry, but this dish is not worth $35.  They would be better off serving an 8 oz filet for that price with a reduction demi-glaze. I asked them to withhold the caramelized onions to this dish also, but they decided otherwise and I got the onions whether I liked it or not!  LOL!! The bus boy decided to refill my half finished San Pelligrino glass with regular tap water. Very kind of him. In his defense, he's a teenager.

Think twice. Hopefully, it improves over time. Anyone who gives this five stars, I question their integrity. Maybe they are friends and family members of the owners. Kimberton Inn is five stars, not this place.

I want to love Stella's because it's local and was the only breakfast place in walking distance (until Isabelle's across the street started serving brunch!). Love that they offer eggs Benedict but would love a seafood version often seen in seaside towns (Bread (or crabcake) /poached egg/wilted spinach/ high pile of crab or lobster/hollandaise). Nope. 
Have had the French toast but found it so dry and lacking batter, I sent it back. 
Pancakes are good
Fried green tomatoes are excellent 
There's no vegan meat or egg dishes at all which is the trend and I'd suggest they get on board
No non dairy milk option for your coffee

Vegan review - Outstanding restaurant.  The food is so good that I wish I lived closer.  It was worth the 2-hour drive it took me to get here.  It really is THAT good!
I ordered off the brunch menu at lunchtime on a Saturday. 
The menu was vegan and had many choices. 
I had the Indonesian breakfast - seitan potato patties, palm sugar carmalized tofu, spiced chili fries and vegetable soup. 
The recorded piano music being played is very peaceful and is at the right volume. 
I'm so relaxing here. 
If you see someone asleep in the corner, please wake me up. It's a 2-hour drive to get home.

We came to New Orleans for a weekend getaway with a group of friends. We were interested in a place to have dinner that was open after 10pm but not on Bourbon St. This place popped up and we all had low expectations. Don't doubt this place. Everything was absolutely amazing. My boyfriend and I had macaroni and cheese casserole, meat pie, ribs and a twice baked stuffed potato. Our friends had fried alligator, grilled oysters and shrimp and eggplant dressing. Standout items were definitely the dressing and the macaroni and cheese. My baked potato was stuffed with cheese, scallions and hot sauce. We all could not stop talking about this place. It is definitely at the top of my list for future visits.

Walking down Main St looking for a place to eat on a Saturday. Saw the Paradise wasn't  very busy and went in. Nice old diner feel. We ordered Clam strip dinner and all you can eat fried tilapia.  All was beyond expectations and inexpensive. Even included nice fresh homemade bread. Friendly fast service. Table behind me was raving about the prime rib. We will return.
Boring and expensive. I was disappointed in the beer selection and lack of food- just sausage/brats and dessert. Rides were lame, dance floor too small.

Taking a break from Philly cheese steaks during our extended weekend in  Pennsylvania, friends of ours invited us out for dinner at Limoncello in West Chester.  How'd I like things?

They started us out with  a tomato and cheese bruschetta, which were pretty good!  Orders came next, and I decided on their Margherita personal pizza ($14)

Less is more with this pizza, being topped with tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and basil, the pizza was almost too pretty to eat, but eat it I did!

Thin crust, the pizza crust was really crispy, which is what I like, but sadly, the flavor really wasn't there, at least not like other Margherita pizzas i've had in the past.

Serving size of everything that hit the table were great for the price, and customer service was ridiculously helpful. 

There is street parking here, but there's a few lots around that you can pay for a few dollars as well.  If you're just coming to dine, i'd recommend trying to find some street parking before you pay for a parking lot.

Great ambiance, really nice food presentation, but flavors, at least for me, missed the mark.  But tell me what you think!

Mimi's has been my "cheers" for as long as I've been old enough to drink. I love all my bartenders there and they always treat me right. The tapas menu is unpretentious and delicious at a reasonable price point for small plates. The drinks are not cheap but you won't find any high dollar cocktail menus here. There's a decent selection of beer with plenty of stuff on tap (downstairs). 
   One of the best parts of mimis is its two distinctive bar vibes. Downstairs tends to feel more like a normal bar with a pool table and a Galaga/Pac-Man machine. Upstairs is more quiet and intimate and has small bands playing acoustically on some nights. Upstairs is a good date spot while downstairs is a great place to shoot the shit.  They won't put up with any BS in either tho so make sure you check your jerk hat at the door.

Delicious, delicious, delicious. Came here with a creep but the food was amazing. Perfect tapas menu for trying new things. But chances are you'll love it. Can get pricey quickly so be prepared if you want to try a lot of different things.

Right across the street from the Ocean, 1 block away from the coolest park ever, and kitty corner cross the street from the Pier, we decided to stop here for a late lunch after playing at the park. 

We stopped in apparently at the change of shift around 2:30pm, we were seated at the front window with an ocean view, before the late afternoon lunch rush began...... I noticed that people that arrived after us were having their orders taken and served their meals before our server ever arrived to take our order. 

Finally Cindy our server arrived and when I mentioned we have been waiting 20 minutes and people were being served and eating who arrived after us she said it was the change of shift and asked if we needed a few more minutes to decide..... Decide? on what? going to another restaurant? 

We ordered the fried calamari (excellent) and fresh red snapper cevechi (excellent) as starters, my road trip warrior had a spinach salad that she said was excellent and the toddler and I had bowls of clam chowder with big chunks of clams in a flavorful but watery base, and the best tuna fish sandwich I have ever had. It was to be a tuna melt but I forgo the cheese and they grilled the tuna salad and served it on sourdough toast. I think I want all my tuna fish sandwich's grilled now. 

Service lacked big time but the food was surprisingly awesome, very kid friendly restaurant and accommodating with color crayons and coloring menu. I thought it was reasonably priced for location and food quality. 

I could tell it is a big hit for locals, while we were there the hostess was taking phone calls for reservations non stop.  If I was a local..... It would be a place I would frequent in hopes of better service.

Throughly disappointed. Ordered the boneless wings and some chili. Menu stated that it was made with steak. There were two little pieces of steak at the bottom of my chili bowl. My chili bowl the size of something that I would use to serve a customer extra dressing in. For the bargain price of four bucks. Nope. The Boneless Wings, we're literally breast chicken cut and quickly deep fried. No breading - you were eating a naked chicken breast with sauce. That's all it was. 

Beer was okay, a little on the bitter side for everything I tried. Service was okay, friendly but slow and constantly forgetting things. So for a small cup of chili and half a breast of chicken I walked out of there for 12 bucks. Wouldn't go back.
Typical shake shack by the KOP mall. Good service, no complaints. I tried the new black sesame milkshake and it was delicious!!! Would highly recommend.

If you are unsure how you feel about Vic Sushi, order the Naruto roll, and then make your verdict. Salmon, yellowtail, and tuna (no rice!) wrapped in cucumber. Super refreshing on a hot summer day. If you don't like it you might accidentally be eating something else.

Quick: When was the last time you sank your teeth into a crispy brown, yet moist buttermilk-fried chicken? And when you did, was it served with a warm, soft and fluffy Belgian waffle? Honey-thyme butter, red pepper jam, and- of course maple syrup, on the side, for more dipping pleasure?

Well, the chicken & waffles is a classic for a reason- a delicious treat that's sweet and savory, soft and crunchy, and boy, maple and... chicken. Give it a little nod, and top it off with a Beermosa.

I've been here at least three time. I was satisfied each time.

I will keep coming back for more...

Four solid yelps

A pancake house well done would be how I would describe Roadie's.  Having been here before and never disappointed, I'll add this to my personal list of good, consistent dining spots for folks who love breakfast.   My wife was always a fan of eggs benedict and very few restaurants serve that, even fewer do a good job at it.   Roadie's did a good job for my wife in that regard although that is not one of my own breakfast favorites.

My ham and cheese omelet was very good and my son really liked his meat lovers omelet.  Another member of our party had eggs over easy and was well pleased.  The food was served hot and delicious, what more can you ask for.  The pancakes are light and fluffy and are like an extra bonus to me when included with a meal. 

The place is exceptionally clean and orderly.  Our waitress was friendly and efficient.  A really nice place to eat.

It's crazy that this was my first visit to Shoefly. I had the romaine salad and Cuban flatbread. Tons of capers on the salad add a distinct biting flavor. Perfectly dressed and big enough to share. The flatbread was super crunchy on the edges of the pretzel crust. I like that but beware if your don't like a chewing challenge. No booze but their lemonade with sake is delicious and gets the job done. Cool environment in which to dine.

We stopped. We eat. We will not return. Not good for the price.

Atmosphere       75       Stayed but acceptable.
Service                75       Okay
Food                    75       Nothing special. Bland.
Value                   70       Much too expensive for what you get.

Skip it if you can. Just not worth the $100 BUCKS.

Such a bad experience! The place was packed and loud, loud, LOUD over lunch, so we decided to come back a little later. We still had to wait and when we finally got served, the girl at the sandwich counter could have cared less that we were there.

My Chicken Curry Panini was curried chicken salad on a giant roll. The chicken salad itself was tasty, but with entirely too much bread. It was like chewing grilled cardboard. I had to pull mine apart and eat the salad out of the inside.

The coffee was also pretty good (la colombe) but the guy that poured my coffee rolled his eyes when I asked for a little ice in my cup to cool it down. I'm sorry if I don't want to burn my mouth cause its an inconvenience to you, guy.

I'd say skip it, but unfortunately there's not a lot else around. Just brace yourself for a loud, chaotic environment and rude staff with mediocre food and attitude.

I'll be honest, I'm a huge fan of First Watch.  They are reliable and consistent, service is always stellar and fast, food is great and the menu is plenty varied for whatever your in the mood for and they plentiful healthy low fat low carb options if you're into that.

One of THE best taquerias on Milpas, or in town. I was drawn in here the first time because the intoxicating scents got me salivating on the street. The peanut salsa, from Guerrero, is unique, and very addicting. I cannot seem to eat enough tacos aldobado with that salsa! Alvaro is a sweetheart. I wish they had a cold cerveza on offer, but this is my new favorite spot for aldobado. My boyfriend had Allambres and quite liked them too.

Excellent.  If you like Bosphorus Cafe near Fletcher Place, you'll equally enjoy Usta in Broad Ripple.  We had a two combo appetizer (which are all cold appetizers and 2 dolmas vs combo 4 which is the same but w/4 dolmas).  Also ordered the Sigara Borek (feta & parsley in puff pastry),  Since we had  Iskender at Bosphorus before (memorable) - - we opted for the Beyti; a beef/lamb sausage wrapped in lavash.  It had a mild back-bite kick which we liked, and was delicious.
Nice atmosphere  - - family operated.  
Worth a visit.

What the heck happened to what used to be a great spot?!? I'm only giving a 2 because the service was excellent. Four of us dined tonight... one had to send back her salad because the lettuce was so off (and didn't want a replacement). And two of us had food that was super over cooked and tasteless. We have come here for years, but after this we likely will go to one of the options across the street. What a bummer.

Small unassuming cajun place in a strip mall off Drew st. Don't let that fool you, the food is worth the trip. The food is great, portion sizes are huge, and all while being very reasonably priced. I have never been able to finish the 6.99 fried chicken lunch. Their cajun stables are excellent and generous. The owner is usually right there and goes out of her way to make sure you're happy. I have been here several times now, and will continue to go back.

Worst pizza I've had. We ordered the Red Dragon pizza when got there they said they had made a mistake with the ticket and the pizza was gonna take longer than usual. Ok sure no problem we're willing to wait. When we got home imagine how disappointed we are to see this piece of crap of a pizza. Stuck to the paper, falling apart, and with pieces of burnt crap in the crust. You would think that with the whole COVID thing that's happening they would be focused on making quality pizzas. I am so upset and disappointed.

The thing I like about this place the most is the decor and atmosphere. It was very quiet when I visited and I believe I was served by one of the owners. She made our espressos and brought them to our table for us too, which was nice of her.

I would like to give them a better rating, but I was not that impressed with the quality of the espresso surprisingly. I hope to go back and try some of their coffee and other beverages to improve my rating.

Discriminatory hiring practices make their 'sweet' treats rather bitter... See photo for details. The sign roughly translates to: 

Looking for someone (male) for night shift.

Last time I checked, you can't specify a gender for this type of job in the United States. Way to support equal opportunity employment, Kung Fu Tea!
Really good new middle eastern place in Hermitage. The lamb chops were great.  Hummus was pretty good. They have delivery through the doordash app. Will definitely be back.

I knew this place Would be my kind a place. Walked in off Virginia Street pretty hungry and a lil groggy. I was immediately greeted as I took my seat at the bar. There's a lot more than JUST two chicks here and they're all very sweet and nice. I was helped by Maddy and she suggested I try the Hawaiian bloody Mary. Since I was in the market for a bloody Mary, I looked at the menu. It said that pineapple juice was added in. My face scrunched up. Maddy smiles and remarked "That's the same face everyone makes at first" 
I said "I'm brave" so Mimi whipped one up. Sooooo happy I tried it out,  Mimi's handiwork paid off BIG! Jackpot in Reno. Then came my beautiful Veggie Omelet on an egg shaped plate. I was a good eater and cleaned my plate. Scrumptious 
If YOU ever get hungry in Reno, CHICK this place out.

My husband and I absolutely love sushi, and every so often, we venture out and try a new place. Needless to say, we always end up back at Bonsai. Their specialty rolls are wonderful, (we usually get 4, which is a LOT) and the sashimi is high quality. We've been here 10+ times, always bring out of town guests here, and have never had anything but a fabulous experience.

I love the tacos here! They make their own shells, crispy and fried.  The food is always fresh, not microwaved Mexican, and they never skimp on meat. Also, it's not greasy, and the meat has great seasoning. Definitely stop in Washington Square mall for this treat. I would love to see this mall make it, with local businesses and family owned restaurants.

Champion for international gelato. It lives up to its title.

Upon being seated, you're greeted with a plate of olive oil and complimentary bread. Service is friendly and they explain the menu to you in great detail if you're a first-timer!

This is a small-plates restaurant. Everything on the menu (aside from a couple pasta and meat entrees) is very small in portion. This means that it is not ideal to share and you will probably need to order at least 2 items off the selection if you want to be full.

I HIGHLY suggest the Maestro Biasini's Gelato Pairings. These are signature dishes paired with a dollop savory gelato that you mix together! DELICOUS. I tried the "Carbonara" which is essentially pasta...with BACON GELATO! Very good. 

I tried 3 flavors of gelato for dessert. There is a wide array of flavors to try, but you can't go wrong with your choices! The gelato is tasty; very light after a hearty meal but still very flavorful and indulgent. A perfect way to end the meal!

Overall, the food is very outstanding. I tried samples of items that my friends got and none of them were bad. The gelato is to die for! You must try it when you come. The atmosphere is a good mixture of casual but classy and you can come in casual attire. This space is HUGE for a restaurant in center city; I walked to the restroom and this place expanded so far down, I was shocked! The service is very friendly and attentive. I highly recommend this place and I am coming back very soon! The only downside is that this place is a small-plates joint which means you'll spend a bit more than your usual dining experience.. worth it, though!

The mocha was complete syrup and very little coffee. I ordered the super grande which is the equivalent of a Starbucks Vente.  My wife has the iced coffee and it tasted a bit off, almost having a mild ammonia scent. Perhaps the beans were old? 

They need to work on the mixing. 

Music was nice. Air conditioned. Conveniently located in the middle of the French Quarter.

This is a medium-sized Wawa with a well-lit gas station. Good place to stop for clean bathrooms and delicious sandwiches. I'm partial to the chicken parm and the meatball sandwich on their fresh rolls. 

The employees were all wearing masks to protect in this time of Covid-19, and patrons were also told that masks are necessary. There is a plastic shield between patrons and the cashier. Coffee is all self serve. 

A standard Wawa, which is a good thing! And a convenient central location on Baltimore Pike near other major roads.

Delicious burritos!! I've had the carnitas and the carne asada burritos (super and combo)... And both were made with quality meats, and packed with the right amount of fixings. You can't go wrong with getting your Mexican grub on at the Super Cuca.

Amazing service. The waitress was so sweet and always checking on us! However, the breakfast food tasted like I went to visit my grandmother in the nursing home. The sausage tasted like it came from the frozen section from Jimmy Dean. The ranch tasted like it came from a Kraft bottle. I broke my tooth eating the bread. We also had a solicitor roaming around trying to get some cigs.. Yikes. Good service tho!
Tacos are good nothing to exciting but the guacamole is the best I ever had. Simple but delicious and flavorful .... a must try.

I wish I went to this place sooner and I wish I went more than once!! This place is DANK. I don't think there's any better word to describe these slices of heaven!! The slice is HUGE and DELICIOUS. This shop has a vast selection of options for pizza and if you're as indecisive as me, you'll just want to try them all. 10 hours after adoring each pizza, I decided on the slice with tomato, basil, mozzarella and the balsamic glaze and honestly no regrets. The owners are also SO sweet and fun to be around!! Definitely on my top 10 list of pizza shops.

I had high hopes for this restaurant after reading the reviews, but my entire group had okay-nothing special food.  For appetizer we had the fried calamari which was nothing to write home about.  I ordered a trio of pastas for entree, the special of the night , including gnocchi, penne marinara &  ravioli w/ spinach sauce.  The entree was pricey & bland especially the penne & ravioli.  I do give the gnocchi a thumbs up, it was actually really good gnocchi.  If you go to this restuarant - Order the Gnocchi-  I wish I had ordered that by itself.   My husband had the chilean sea bass.  It didn't have much flavor and pretty much tasted like nothing.    The wine selection was good as well as the service, but for me to pay the prices, the food has to be there, and it wasn't.
They did a great job fulfilling my order and delivering the first business day after it was placed. I would order again from this Edible Arrangments.

I had to drop down a star which breaks my heart.  I've been to Wiz Kid several times since opening and they are ver inconsistent. The most recent time I brought my omnivore neighbor and she loved it!  She did comment on how the seasoning was inconsistent and I had to agree. 
There was so much black pepper on my wiz kid philly this time that it was spicy?!?  Each time it is different.  Make them more consistent please!

Also the fries are horrible to take out.  They are soggy and greasy after a 5 minute trip home.

I've had a series of mixed experiences with this Cajun Steamer.  Some days you can get a table only to be promptly ignored.  Other days things work out pretty well.

As with most of my reviews, I've tried to eat here more than once to get a feel for the place.  That feeling could only be defined as touristy.  While the food seems to be of good quality, it's not necessarily what I'd describe as cajun.  

As I spent the first 30 years of my life in Louisiana, I can definitely identify cajun and pseudo cajun.  There are some decent southern dishes in here and hints of cajun-ness that fly if you are looking for non-native Louisiana foods.  

That said, I will eat here on occasion when I'm in the area if I want shrimp and fries.  It's ok shrimp but not great and they don't blink more than twice when I ask for worcestershire sauce to mix with ketchup and louisiana hot sauce to make my own dip.

Took the Living Social coupon --- and boy was this worth it.  Our first time going into the shop - so the coupon worked for them.  

So many yummy things to buy.  We got some Valentine's Day cupcakes, some bagels (yes, bagels), some sort of iced bun, and an amazing flat pastry.  It seemed to be butter and cream.  Really good.  

They had a good assortment cakes, cookies, and all sorts of pastries all made in the shop.

We will visit again once we work off these calories.

Cool Hang out spot definitely worth checking out when u in French quarter! Hurricanes are delicious and even when u don't drink sweet drinks u gotta try as its cheap huge and all u need is 2 of them for the night.any more than 2 u will not be happy with your decisions the next day! Great atmosphere and great service. Did not try the food as we were here just for cocktails. 1st time we sat down and had them in a big glass. The glass is nice size and you can get 3 bucks back at the bar for it. At night we were hanging out at the bar and they serve in cups 8.50 each!! Definitely worth coming out for a drink. I like these a lot more than grenades that are also very known in French quarter.
Grear hang out spot with an excellent staff, Jafra is the place to relax with a few friends
I love the mules here. It's a great place to enjoy a drink and some pretzels with friends

Great bar atmosphere - mostly locals - and friendly service. Food, however, is just OK. Nevertheless, if you're stuck for a restaurant, this place is recommended. Stick with the cheap regular menu, vs the overpriced "specials", and you won't feel shortchanged.

Great option for Colombian fast food!! 

Chuzos, hot dogs, burgers and arepas are typical of street food carts in Colombia. They are also your first choice for late night/after-party cravings.

You won't find tables but you can sit down at the counters against the wall...definitely not a romantic environment for couples, but you may fall in love with their tostones and their monstrous hot dogs and burgers.

Some of the items looked that they were chargrilled and brought me back to those humble joints back in Colombia were you can find the best food. 

The place is sketchy, non-diet friendly, food tastes great, portions are big and prices are low... definitely a fit for some of my nights.

I came to this place for my birthday dinner and it was one of the best spots i have been to! 
The decor was beyond gorgeous and i ordered a thyme flavored gin cocktail and it was delicious!

I got their steak and it came with a side of creamy gratin potatoes. It was veryyy delicious!

This place is definitely fancy and expensive but the quality is
Waited at the speaker for 10+ minutes just to be told they weren't taking any orders because their machines were "updating"

My favorite place in St. Louis by far. I heard about this place from a friend and finally was able to check it out today. I understood why there was a line out the door...the food is sooooo good!!! I got the chicken doner and let me just say it was different than anything I've tasted in the absolute best way. I thought the best part of the dish was the bread which they hand bake in their fire oven.  The meat was also seasoned very well. My friends all enjoyed their dishes and finished every last bit on their plate. I definitely recommend coming to this place and trying any of their options but I recommend number 3!  Can't wait to come back very soon

Really nice spot and within walking distance to several hotels. Food was good. Tried the tater nachos. The shrimp tacos and fish tacos were really flavorful. Great selection of beer. Like that they rotate and have local selection le. Good drink selection as well. Friendly place to meet for cocktails or dinner. Nice outdoor seating and they have some activities. Clean and modern looking.

Impeccable service from beginning to end- starting with hostess offering to take our coats, to table staff, to chefs. iPad of beverage choices with ability to flag drinks your are considering. Dining area is cozy, seats are comfortable lounge chairs. Quiet atmosphere allowing conversations with chefs but also intimate conversation. Sat at a table facing chefs and watched the teams prepare each course meticulously- almost each one used tweezers to perfect presentation. Table staff was attentive but not overly so, perfect timing of courses arriving and removal of objects from table (never too long and never too soon). We had a main waiter but it was a team effort to make sure we were well cared for. While each course wasn't large, we left perfectly satisfied- not over full. Each course offered a variety of flavors and tantalized the taste buds. My favorites were the tuna (which I've had often before but not with this combination of accompanying flavors), the beef (melt in your mouth- which I didn't believe until I found it to be true- perfectly cooked with slightly crispy/sweet on the outside, tender, and dashes of sauces to compliment nicely, the potatoes (white truffles brought to table and shredded on top - amazing!), and the creme dessert in eggshell (sweet with the perfect zing of salt). The chefs were fascinating to watch and very friendly/open to general inquiry.  I'd highly recommend and look forward to an occasion to return with friends to share the experience with.

I had heard this place was good but it really blew me away.

Some Coworkers and I ordered several plates to share, two of which really stick out to me.

1. Roasted Cauliflower - I'm not a cauliflower fan but this was veggies elevated to a new level. I'd return solely for this dish alone

2. Dragon Shrimp - I love spicy food and this was close to my limit. So spicy but so much flavor. 

We sat outside on the patio just outside the bakery and had a great experience.

Had brunch here.  The food was ok.  I was unhappy that the only way you could get your eggs was scrambled.  Maybe it was just the day we came that eggs were not available to be cooked any other way but eggs Benedict with a scrambled egg just isn't eggs Benedict it my opinion.  My daughter had the gumbo it was alright I get it had a sight tinny taste to it but my day enjoyed it.
Great food. Really crowded when we came in, but I totally get it. The food was worth it! Love how they have gluten-free, seasonal, & vegetarian options. Will def be back!

Great place to have dinner. It's fun. A little bit cold today even dine inside. But it would not stop you enjoy the dinner. Great drinks, appetizers, and entrees. I would give four stars for food because red snapper a bit over cooked and dry. 
The thing is service level is low. It doesn't mean people are not nice, people are very nice here. But service is just not good enough. We ordered kids meal and water for kid, it never came. We had to pack it to go. Service is 3 star. I would give average 3.5 stars for this restaurant. 
There are lots of varieties of food here. I might come back without kids and it could be better.

Being from Medford my entire life I have always loved otts! It has indeed changed over the years however the new outside addition is terrific, especially the fire pit! I must say the crowd that comes in now a days is definitely different but that hasn't stopped me from coming in. No the main reason I return to this bar is the staff! The bouncers, wait staff, and of course the bartenders! Everyone is so friendly and makes you feel at home. They actually strike up a conversation rather than just pour a drink and walk away. Personally I am not one to walk into a bar by myself however when I've had a long night at work I have no problem stopping by there. I love when my Asian persuasion (along with all the other wonderful bartenders) is behind the bar, I can always expect a relaxed, fun, and overall enjoyable night! I love this bar and all of its staff! And due to its reputation rising if you come here and it is busy be patient, because unless you've worked in this industry you have no idea what they go through!

We really enjoy trying new restaurants each year when we visit. This year the star of the week was the food at Jakes. We both enjoy Mexican food and decided to give them a try. I got the burrito with house made roasted pork and my wife got the burrito bowl with chicken. We both really enjoyed our food. The item that blew me away was the Mexican street corn. I would come back just for that. Our entire meal was under $25 which is fantastic on a tourist island. We will recommend this place to all of our family that comes down.

Great happy hour with 6 dollar margaritas and 2 dollar tacos on Tuesday. Definitely worth a try. Try the tamarindo or mango margarita on happy hour 2p-7p. Food is on point and is flavorful and has the right amount of spice
Always excellent. Great food and atmosphere. Nice staff and local flavor. Thoughtful menu and great Happy Hour specials. Try it for Brunch too.
Yum, yum, yum, yum, yum.  The fresh oysters and lobster rolls are the bomb.  That and a dirty martini and I'm good to go.

Shopping center doesn't look the greatest very outdated. Then when we walked in, it was a almost walk out moment. Very small and cluttered with pizza boxes and didn't look inviting. But we were short on time and just went for it. Waitress was nice and took our order quickly and surprisingly from our first impression the food was very good. We got Asia wings and everything pizza both very hot, fresh and very tasty. Definitely would go back if in the area.

A nice escape from the crazy Broadway atmosphere this chill bar/restaurant has a nice vibe and friendly staff. Food has always been amazing every time I visit whether it's a quick sandwich for lunch at the bar downstairs or full steak and seafood dinner upstairs. 

Always stop by every time I visit Nashville, and always leave happy.

Ordered takeout from here this past Saturday because they actually do takeout on Saturday evenings. (Sidenote: Seems so bizarre to find out some places do not!)  The person taking the order could've been friendlier but it was a Saturday and I figured they were busy.  Slightly rude service on one occasion isn't enough to deter me if the food is good enough.

After picking it up, we munch on the great french bread on the drive home.  When we opened the food up at home, it was a completely different order!  (We really have to learn to remember to check these things!)  Made a quick call and packaged it back up and set off for the restaurant.  When my husband went in to pick it up, the waitress was very apologetic and sent him home with both meals plus a $20 gift certificate.  For the record, we weren't abusive or rude, or honestly even terribly annoyed by the mixup, so the little extra was surprising and nice!  

The food was pretty good.  I enjoyed the mixup tutto mare more than the spaghetti I originally ordered.  I'd definitely order it again.

The pancakes with maple syrup were delicious, as was the apple bacon & eggs. But the gouda grits were the BOMB.com!! They were scrumptious! I would come back just based on the gouda grits alone! 
I am a full happy camper!

Was kind of expensive so was hoping for more ramen, but it was delicious anyway so I felt satisfied. 

Great customer service, they obviously care a lot about that and that means a lot to me too. No one seemed to have a bad attitude or seemed to be in a bad mood. Everyone was cheery. 

Parking kinda haed to find here, especially with construction near by taking up A LOT of spots, so we had to drive around for a while.

One of the best breakfast places around.  Even if your not that hungry, just the smells alone from this place can drive you crazy with anticipation for your meal.

Small quaint place with home-style cooking served by a friendly staff.  

Make sure you have CASH, as they DO NOT take plastic of any kind.

Always a favorite. Yes it is a chain, but there is a consistent standard in the food. We like to eat in the bar and avoid the wait of getting a table. Happy hour deals are great. They also have a to-go service where you can call your order in and it will be delivered to your car. They have special to-go parking places.

I was there for a friend's birthday party. They have yet gotten their alcohol license. It was my first time, and I have never been to there old location before. 

The food was amazing. If it sounds weird on the menu, maybe you should try it. If it sounds ordinary, they can make them extraordinary. The fries, as many reviews have mentioned, are a must-have. 

I do hope the construction nearby will be done soon.
Yum Yum Donuts is hands down the best donut shop around. My favorite is the white lightening and my mother likes the peanut butter cup.

What a cool place this was!  Walking in past the pools and icy trays of seafood into the back dining room bar area we knew we were at the best place around for good, fresh seafood.  The bar area was dark and we were immediately greeted by staff who told us to grab a seat wherever we pleased.  We happened to arrive during happy hour 3-6pm and domestic draft and bottles were $2.50.  Our waitress pointed that out to us so we wouldn't miss out on the special since it was 5:30pm.  We tried Dungeness crab legs for the first time here, and they were great! 1 pound for $18, which came out quickly and they were delicious! All in all great server- friendly and funny. Also worth noting that there is a fair amount of Coca Cola collectable vending machines in the bar area for those who enjoy.

Beautifully presented sushi in a great location at the outlet mall. We were able to get a table for 2 immediately on Father's Day at 2pm. Interesting combination rolls were fun to try. We enjoyed most of it, but not sure what is up with the obscene amount of red sauce they put on most rolls. It has a ketchup consistency and tastes a bit like cocktail sauce, but we weren't quite sure what it was and scraped most of it off. Crab Rangoon was good but could use more crab. Tempura veggies were delicious.
Nice place in the terminal for food. Small menu but good food. Prices are not terrible either. The waitress was friendly and quick. Place was clean.

Loved this restaurant. Service and food were top notch. Our server Caylie was the best! The food was amazing. Do not skip the crawfish bread. Still thinking about it!  Oysters were also so so good. Do not skip this place.

This gorgeous, very romantic restaurant was an amazing meal and dining experience.  The ambiance is absolutely perfect, candle lit, with perfect music that makes you relax the moment you walk in.  The food was absolutely amazing.  Simple combinations that perfectly compliment each main course, lovely lightly dressed salads, beautiful broths that cover amazing mussels, salmon and steak frites, perfectly prepared, to enjoy the perfectly selected steak or seafood, enjoying the true flavor of the meal without heavy sauces.  If you want a romantic evening out or just a peaceful European experience, and want to feel good and healthy about your meal, I strongly recommend The Little Door, you will definately be back.  I know I will!

LEGIT! This place is not Taco Bell. This is a legitimate Cantina style Mexican Spa with awesome sopas. Seriously,  twice in a week after first visit. Authentic homemade Salsa's which are chilled and go perfectly on the food. From mild to fairly hot, all sauces were amazing. 
I ordered sopas Al Pastore, pork tamales and tacos. 10 out of 10

You know what? It's just kinda pretty really great in here. It's hard to explain. It's got this really cool but way too weird vibe, but it works. The food is killer. I don't even like eggplant, but I'm obsessed with the eggplant dish here. Fried rice with pineapple and bacon? Check! I think last time I was in here I saw a guy giving his friend a lap dance for her birthday. The time before, our waiter ate a piece of pineapple off my plate when he dropped it at the table because "the pineapple to bacon ratio was off". I personally like eating out back when it's nice, or at the bar with the weirdo bartenders. I think you get the point. It's either your kinda place or it's not. But if it is, get over here!

My friend, who studies French, came into town and I thought it would be great to take him here. Oh my gosh my expectations were definitely exceeded! The staff was amazing and the atmosphere was enjoyable. 

I really liked the Brie en Croute and French Onion Soup. The Brie was baked into pastry and topped with apple and pear glazing. It was a great start to our meal. The French onion soup was smaller than I expected but it was delicious. 

As for dessert, we ordered the crème brûlée and "Rum baba". Both were absolutely fantastic! And their cappuccinos are on point as well.

We arrived a couple minutes late for 8:30 reservation, the place was packed, so it took a couple of minutes to seat us -  which was fine, we were seated at a wonderful seat over looking the entire restaurant and it's decor (plus all Gulf of Mexico views) Costas, the waiter approached, and immediately got the evening progressing.  The pace of the meal was perfect -  the food was prepared the proper way and served quickly and we were allow to enjoy the meal, at our own pace.  I had the Veal Chop stuffed with Prosciutto and Fontina and was prepared perfect, my wife had the linguine vongole and it was made a little different than classic linguine and clam sauce(including cherry tomatoes) which made it special.  The clam broth was light on the traditional wine and garlic and more of a cream sauce... for the appetizer, she had the Tuna Tartatre and I had the Polpette and again, the pomodoro sauce, and the meatballs themselves, were light and full of taste but not over powered with the classic Italian type of sauce.. the meatballs were light, usually, meaning they used the veal mixture.  I can't even describe the desert - Zeppolle, filled with a vanilla cream sauce, again a little bit of a departure from classic Italian fare... A quick note - the menu of this restaurant is Italian, but all the dishes have a different approach, as I have indicated above. The decor has a very un-Italian appeal to it, complete with glass and water art dividers, very contemporary. Overall, the waiter Costas, the view, the dinner, an the overall experience was perfect.. This night, the restaurant deserved a 5 Star review..

Very good meal, definitely for the older sect. The wine glasses were wet when given, but other then that very nice. Wait staff was very attentive and friendly. I had the oyster KSI...very nice with a good lobster sauce. Also had the mushroom soup, which is amazing. My main course was one of the specials, the mussels marinara over angel hair pasta. Nothing to write home about. It was good, not great. The mussels were not meaty at all. For dessert had the vanilla nutmeg ice cream from Woodside Creamery. Amazing. Overall a good night out. Not flashy or trendy, but solid.

Nice place for a quick lunch at Brandon Mall. Service was quick and attentive. The food came out quickly but the server still apologized for the time it took. My crab cakes tasted fresh and my wife's dish was well prepared. We visit because the service and food quality is consistent.
Great service.  Awesome fresh margaritas and amazing tacos.

Best kept secret, for sure. It doesn't look like much from the street... and is pretty standard on the inside, but it's all about authentic food when you get down to it. 

Hubs and I were the only non-asians in the place - always a good sign. I should have told the waitress to bring me her favorite dish. I had no idea what I was ordering by looking at the names; rolling the dice seemed to be the best way to decide. And I got a WINNER!

Super affordable. Great food. Large portions.

Amazing! Loved every bite. 

We started with the Bloody Mary bar, the Bloody Mary mix is great and they have lots of fun things to add. 

Do yourself a favor and order the jalapeño corn bread muffins - amazing!!! I ordered the shrimp and grits, which normally isn't my thing but it looked so good I had to try it. It tasted great - all the right flavors and big shrimp. 

My friend had the breakfast sandwich. It was really yummy. The pepper jam made it. 

Great service, cute atmosphere, live music on Sunday. Overall great!

Only two stars because we love Panera, but this location has extremely poor service. We've dined in and attempted carry out. Our dine in experience was just horrible. The cashier had a poor attitude. When asked about one of the menu options, she lacked on providing the proper information. Our food took a little longer than usual. 

Our carry out experience was even worse. We placed an order to this location since we live within the downtown area. When we went to pick it up, they said they were closed and that I would be refunded my money. I had placed my order before you closing time, which is at 7pm and not 8pm which what is listed on Yelp. I believe that if I had ordered my food prior to your close time, you should still provide the service.

This little gem pulled off the proverbial "hat trick" with us.  Great unique food and drink.  Great service.  Great Design.

Nice job folks.  Really.

Went there today for brunch.  Alexandra was our server.  She answered questions and made recommendations with poise and genuine enthusiasm.  The food was exceptional, well plated, fresh, and flavorful.  The interior is a relaxed rustic vibe blending conventional sit down dining, dine-at-the-bar, and a unique "Old Fashioned" bar area.

It was a little dark lighting-wise for a brunch, but considering the number of novelty menu items named in recognition of those nursing Sunday morning hangovers, I could argue that the dimmer lighting was entirely intentional and benevolent!

This is one we're going to return to as a destination.  I'll be sure to update with my 'tales from the Old Fashioned bar" if I can remember any of them next-day.  (hic)

The food was absolutely amazing!!! It was hot and fresh,
seasoned to perfection. The customer service was great, all the ladies were very helpful and informative. I'll definitely be back again.

This is a good place to go for reasonable prices and consistently good food. I like the menu options and I like how quick and easy Applebee's is. However, I have found that the servers at this Applebee's are not the best. They are slow, not too friendly, and don't enhance the dining experience much. For the most part this place is family friendly, but I would much rather spend my money some place where I can get exceptional food and service.

Apparently the staff can't use a clock. Every time I place an order ahead of time I'm still waiting 45-60 minutes for my food.

This has happened multiple times and today is the last straw. I won't be returning.

We had some food and dessert while visiting. 

The banana bread was really just okay. If you are trying to stay away from the real bread and butter, then maybe you will like it. But it is very sweet, so it might not be that healthy. 

The bowl was good. Can't remember much of the rest. Must not as impressive.
Not impressed. I ordered the chicken nacho burrito and it was mostly stuffed with beans and rice, hardly any meat or cheese.  Will not be going back.

I can't judge the food here because we walked out. The restaurant was sooo dirty. We went to the bathrooms before making salads and it was disgusting! 1 of 4 stalls had toilet paper. 2 toilets didn't flush at all. Just nasty. 

Walking back to the salad bar, we noticed that the floors were beyond dirty. From the bathroom to the front door there was dirt and filth all around. We decided to leave. 

Please close this place or get management who cares about cleanliness. Never visiting this dump again. The location on Dale Mabry far surpasses the quality here.

The food is amazing and the beer selection is great.  I had  the raspberry beer which was crisp and not too fruity,  pretzels and cheese sauce (yummy) and crab cakes.  They have plenty of space as well as a heated patio.  I think I found a great place for our company happy hours.  Looking forward to going back.

I had a reservation booked at the Hermitage for tea... this reservation was made 1 month in advance (on October 21, in fact). I received an email notification of the cancellation and then a voicemail stating that my reservation would be cancelled, as there was some sort of glitch in OpenTable and they had overbooked. Unfortunately, they didn't realize this until 48 hours before our reservation.

When I called to ask if there was any ability to get in for the weekend (as we had folks flying in for birthday celebrations), I was told there would be no accommodation or attempt to help, as they were booked through the end of the year. I will not, in future, ever book a reservation here... I didn't even get the chance to sit down before experiencing terrible customer service. Cancelling 36-48 hours before the reservation and then notifying the customer is not the way to win folks over.

Beautiful place, beautiful people, beautiful art....and delicious food. If I went back to NOLA, this would be on my must do....number one place. The chicken is to die for. Delicious and the perfect amount of spice. I really wish I had saved room for dessert.

Eugh. I just bit into a red velvet cake pop from here and it is terrible.

Gritty texture, wet inside, and it has a bad flavor....nowhere near red velvet.

Did I really just pay $3 for this? Hell, cake pops at Starbucks are way tastier, and slightly cheaper.
Sure, it's gluten-free, but what's the point if it's not good?

I want to give this place another chance, but it's too expensive to be gambling on, especially with Sweet Ts across the street...

Amazingly enough I had the oysters and grouper, both were as good as I get on the gulf.  
Anthony makes some killer drinks and definitely knows his wines!!

Another new place for us.  We will be back.  Normally we do the Chinese to go route and enjoy it at home but in trying to find some new places to go out to we dined in this visit.  Staff were very friendly, was not crowded on a Saturday at noon but I noticed that they did many take out orders while we were there.  Hubby had the lunch special hot braised shrimp which came with soup, 1 crab Rangoon and I egg roll.  The shrimp were large and plentiful and very tasty, soup was tasty.  Crab Rangoon was not as flavorful as other places I have tried and the egg roll was small but he said delicious.  I had empress beef which I will say was delicious, very tender, delicious sauce.  I could have taken on more spicy heat and even my hubby commented that he would not call it a spicy dish so I might up the heat factor next visit.  The beef was very plentiful so ended up with left overs which is always good.  We will be back, not sure if it will be for sit down or take out but will return!!

This place is fantastic! Everything is made to order and delivered to your table. The California Club us my personal favorite, but they have a lot of tasty options. Oftentimes they'll offer a free cookie if you fill out a survey (which you can go up and get while you're still there). There's free ice cream (soft serve) for all and a nice, big salad bar. One if my favorite lunch spots on the north side!

The avocado toast is really different from those I've had at other places, really tasty with a mixture of refreshing flavors. Latte is also a good pair! Service is very nice and I like the environment a lot!
Unique artwall and good vibe. The ramen is awesome with lunch special combo so you can try two item for one price. The portion is oerfect for me. Good place and will try some more

Best catfish I've ever had! Dinner is a little pricy but you'll be stuffed by the end of your meal. If you are antisocial you may not want to go here since you have to sit and make small talk with complete strangers.

It was my family's first time we came from Pennsylvania to see who takes the crown pat's or geno it was a tie half and half. Now I love pat's for the bread roll and the flavor of the meat great even fell in love with the fries will stop again and just knowing that they are 24hr their no reason you can't make it.

I have been going here since I was a kid and always enjoy their small friendly store and crunchy dogs.  The new owners are keeping the same traditions as the old and It's great to see a local company hanging around while a corporate hot dog resturant was built next doot.

I had the house salad with the raspberry vinaigrette dressing with a cheese pizza. The food was really good. We thought all of the memorabilia on the walls was cool. It was cozy. Our server didn't wrote our order down and remembered everything! I was super impressed. We will return.

We had the shumai, salmon avocado something and the drums/wings combo. The shumai was good but its too small for an appetizer. The salmon avocado something was good and I could finish the whole thing. The drums and wings are pretty tasty and delicious I could keep eating, eating and won't stop. Would definitely comeback and recommend to friends.

Thank you Erica! Your exceptional service and knowledge of the meals really makes a difference.  You were able to articulate every detail of each and every meal my wife and I had questions about. Thank you for reassuring us that our needs and concerns were important to you and your managers. You were very impressive!

Had not been here for a couple of years.  Bought a Restaurant.com certificate so decided to return to get an update. I wish I had not. The place has not changed.  The food was acceptable but not enough for me to rave about.  My Cod father meal had a small piece of fish. I'm so glad I had the $15 certificate. It lessened the sting of mediocre food. I will drive on next time. Sorry NEAHG. You lost my future business.

I wish I looked here before I ordered... this store clearly is the worst of the worst. Can't update stock online, can't inform phone reps of what they have avalible. Plus they don't give you the right prices... delivery showed up an hour later with half the order and everytging priced wrong... drive has no clue about anything and is clueless to what pricing should be

We love Cappys pizza! The atmosphere is old school pizzeria meets urban retro.  The salad and dressing is an absolute must. (Memories of our hometown Italian places dressing) we stopped in after a Long Beach day, Allison is an outstanding server! We ordered a 16in NY with extra cheese and olives.  It came to the table steaming and dripping cheese! We were told it didn't have the extra cheese we ordered and another one was already fired for us to take home made properly!  YOU DO NOT FIND SMALL TOWN SERVICE LIKE THIS IN MOST CITIES!

Let me Start off my saying that I am extremely picky when it comes to food. Texture is important and flavor is key or else I won't eat!
I was skeptical because being from the Caribbean and moving to Trenton, I was highly disappointed in the food options.
So I decided to take a chance and order.
And when I received my food I was pleasantly surprised. 
I ordered the jerk salmon and the jerk chicken. The chicken could have been grilled/charred more and the salmon could have had more of a jerk flavor in my opinion, but that does not take away from the fact that simply put: THE FOOD WAS AMAZING!
Rice was perfect. And so was the cabbage.
I'll be ordering again!

After 20 minute wait to even speak to someone when it's dead....not what was expected. But let's see how the food taste..

Now got the food and have to say....Calzone was amazing and soup was good as well. Had to revise the review but the wait was our tables wait doing.... Hailey took over our disappearing waiter and she was great!

Pro: Outside seating, good food, friendly service, right on the beach.

Con: Parking - it's Santa Barbara. 

Stop by SB to visit a friend on a trip up to San Luis Obispo and was led to Sambo's by her when we wanted breakfast food. Sure it is not around the downtown area, but the beach front view is a good break from any indoor eatery. 

Try their omelets, one of the best I ever had.

The muffins were yummy. I got a garden omelet and it was just ok. I asked for home potatoes but was brought hash browns instead. When I called this mistake to the attention if our server she promptly brought me ample home potatoes and much to my hubbys delight left the hash browns for his consumption. I should have stuck with the hash browns. The home potatoes were over cooked and awful! The pancakes were pretty good. A lot of food for the price. 

The staff was friendly and fast. The place was clean and neat and the bathrooms were clean.

ordered the chicken venezia lunch special a million times before in the past.  some guy tells me on the phone today that it is eat in only and I cannot order it for pickup.  Not only that but he could barely speak English and the phone connection sounded like he was on mars.  You just lost my business permanently.  Only terrible business owners don't have a working website and don't understand how to treat their customers.

Best BEST best Mexican food joint, my #1 favorite place to come too... A little on the pricey side, but it's worth it. 

Besides that Just stay away from the manitou, it's not that good.  

5 stars for sure.

So the concept is really cool....but I feel it's just that...still a concept. It feels like it's still in the testing stage and definitely has room for improvement. The bag thing is odd to me unless you are taking your order to go in it,  and it's not a salad.  Otherwise, it's kinda wasteful n useless I feel. PLUS, the salad should have its OWN bag and you should have every option on it there to circle. Not every "wich" bag had all the ingredients I wanted for my salad. So I had to finally just pick a bag and forego some of the things I wanted on my salad cuz they were on a different bag so I wouldn't waste 2 bags on a salad that was never going to fit into either bag.....am I loosing you yet????!!! Good!!! Cuz this is how crazy n nuts n A.d.d. I felt in this place trying to figure out wtf I wanted and how to tell them with circles n bags re: what I wanted. Ughhhh ....in the end the salad nor its ingredients were any better or worse than the Grab n go salads at publix or airport terminals. Not bad not great just a salad. :/

After weekly breakfasts for 7years we are cutting this umbilical cord.  Drawn by their strong coffee and tasty dishes we loved it.  Now the portions have gotten so small and the bread rolls so tiny that we always leave feeling ripped off after waiting 1 hr for a table.

The service is hit and miss but what I really love is the authentic "je mon feu" attitude of the owner.  I don't think she has thanked us for our patronage in all this time.

I usually dont write reviews but I had to write a review about this restaurant, first the gumbo is probably the blandest thing God ever placed on this earth I added at least 12 shakes of salt and it still had zero flavor. The bbq shrimp was okay at best terrible but edible. The only reason the place is getting 1 star is because our waiter was good other than that I would avoid this place like the black plaque. Do yourself a favor and go to Charters House!!
I went here with a friend for drinks and I had a blast. The liquor selection was great and the service was fantastic. I would definitely go there again.

Straight up bar. Everything in this airport strip area closes at around 10pm. We went in at 2:00am and had a couple of cold drafts. Ashtrays on the tables haha. Kind of like a biker bar without the bikers.

I've only been there once.... 

The food was good and so was the service. 

The dining room setup is a little weird though.

The fabric on the walls was a little off putting.

That's really my only issue with the place.

3 stars.

The worst Chinese Food I have ever tasted. I cant say ate because it went from the bag to the trash. Trump's Great Wall sounds more appealing.

I dont order Chinese often because I dont want to overeat. THIS IS THE PLACE FOR DIETING, 

Sesame noodles... frightening. 

Most Chinese restaurants purchase some items from the same nationwide distributors. Like Egg Rolls Fortune Cookies Crispy Noodles and Sauces. Even these were inedible.

Plain steamed veggies  tasted and smelled funky.

I am not a picky eater or a foodie or a snob....but I do have taste buds and have eaten amazing Chinese food from the worst dives.

THIS WAS CATEGORICALLY DISGUSTING.

I have no idea where these GOOD reviews come from.

MAYBE WE NEED TO CHARTER A BUS TO ANY DIVE IN NYC SO Y'ALL CAN TRY CHINESE FOOD.

Staff were super nice. But, food quality seems to have gone down a lot. Hummus is just ok. Falafel's seem to have both shrunk in size and lost flavor. Isn't the same as it was. 

(Also, the shop adds an additional 10% supplemental charge before tips.  If prices are too low, raise prices... supplemental charge just feels sneaky.)

Having lived in New York and San Francisco, I have had my fair share of amazing Chinese food. Unsuspectingly located in Paoli, Cheng Du offers the most authentic Chinese food in the entire Main Line. I have eaten here several times with family and friends and will keep coming back. Everything here is delicious. My favorites are Fish Filet in Spicy Sauce, Cumin Lamb, Pea Sprouts, Green Beans, Vegetable Delight, and the Dry Pots. I hope Cheng Du is here to stay for a long time, as this restaurant really offers a whole new genre of food to the Main Line.

Swiss Chalet is Swiss Chalet, probably why there are no reviews. I will say on this last visit the service was well above all my previous experiences. The food is always of Swiss Chalet grade (whatever that is) but the service always varies. On this last visit they truly came out on top. Sometimes we expect very little from places like this but I always enjoy when I can be surprised by a few people that care.

Being from south Louisiana, I feel like I know "good food". The staff was very friendly and cane around by the table to  greet us and make sure that we were enjoying our entrees. 
I was going to get the famous chicken and waffles,but since my husband ordered that, I opted for the fish and grits.  I was AMAZING!!!! It was seasoned perfectly - not too salty. I had enough to share with 3 other people at our table. 
I did taste my husband's chicken and (blueberry) waffle. Scrumptious! I did taste the Sunshine drink, but it was too sweet for my liking. 
Before we left, the staff came over to thank us for coming in.
I am a very satisfied customer!
Terrible. Slow slow slow. Ignored walking in. 20 mins for soup. Worst village inn. In country.

Willa Jean was my first stop in New Orleans and it didn't disappoint. We came in on a Sunday around 12:30 and only had to wait around 15 minutes. We split a blueberry ginger muffin while we waited and it was delicious. I also loved the unique cylinder shape. 

We got a nice table by the window and started with a mimosa, a bloody mary, and the pimento cheese plate. Points to the mimosa since it was mostly bubbly and just a splash of OJ (how it should be). The pimento cheese platter was a great serving size. The crackers that came with it were almost deep fried in the best way possible, and we loved the pickled veggies. I had the short rib hangover bowl and my husband had the fried chicken biscuit. This hangover bowl was one of the most perfect bowls I've ever had. The short rib was tender and flavorful, and it was a huge portion. The grits were cooked perfectly and the sauce/onions/garnishes were spot on. I felt like I was going to keel over but I ate as much as I could since it was so delicious. The chicken biscuit was also fantastic. The chicken was super crispy. The biscuit was almost more of a pie crust flavor, but I liked it. Not only was our meal great, but the service was fast and friendly.

Nice to have a hot pot near the neighbourhood. Tom yum broth is my favourite. My next favourite is the mushroom broth. Good food. Good service. Clean tables. Could have been 5 stars if they accept credit and a more generous portion.

I love me some Lorenzo's but they're not the best slices in Philly - just the most popular. Worth it if you're looking for spot to eat after drinking or if you're showing around friends from out-of-town.

First stop when we got to Santa Barbara, awesome atmosphere, great food, and great views. We sat outside and had a great time here. We ordered the chili cheese fries which was really fresh tasting and delicious. The jumbo shrimp cocktail was delicious! Those shrimps were HUGE. My friends ordered popcorn shrimp and a lobster roll, all of which was soooo good. My friend didn't really like her bloody mary, it was really really strong, and after she had some more tomato juice added in, it was really really watery. Not a biggy though, because the experience was great.

This salumeria is without a DOUBT as authentic and as real as anything you will see anywhere.

I frequented this place for the 5 years I lived in St. Louis, before moving back to NYC.

The meats and cheeses are imported or made locally and are excellent.

The salsiccia is some of the best I ever had and the staff is friendly, and have no problem letting you sample whatever you want.

Tell Armando I said hi.

Enjoy!!!!!!!!!

I've come here a number of times and it's always been a consistently great experience. The green falafel wrap is excellent, the drinks are really tasty (try the walnut old fashioned!) and Falah is one of the most welcoming hosts/bartenders in town. A+!

Great artisan asian cuisine, great atmosphere & service. Pei Wei certainly has the best sauces and chicken (grilled) along with great Lo mein, and could be the best Kung Pao, if only the dish weren't missing zucchini I like in my kung pao.

I had 15 minuts to spear  this morning on my way to play golf near by so instead of stopping at the wawa I decided to stop here as soon as I walk in I was welcomed by a friendly host that led me to my seat. 4 short minuts after I order my breakfast it was served to me very good breakfast I'm glad I stop by instead of wawa definitely will come back again.

My friend took us here and it was recommended by another friend. I heard the wait get long here but for us it was only 20 mins because it was noon. The place was a little smaller then average and the decor fit the look of the restaurant. We had a party of 8 which wasn't bad of a wait for 20mins. On there menu they have a good cat sauce which was vegan food and a bad cat side which was non vegan. I told the waiter if was my first time here and I told him I want the dish u have on the good and the bad side lol. So he recommended the farro on the good side and the hot chicken on the bad side. Let's start what the farro first I was told this was a very delicious and popular dish. All I have to say is . The most delicious vegan dish I ever had. It was so good that I would eat this over a lot of hamburgers and pizza it's that delicious. The dish was so well balanced and seasoned so well. The hot sandwich was also very delicious the chicken was very moist the breading on the chicken was seasoned well. I have to say the waiter was right those two entree he recommended was on point. Only if I lived in New Orleans I would go back and try everything. Also two of my friends order the shrimp and grits and they wasn't to pleased but now salty it was I did try some and it was salty. But I really recommend the farro and the hot chicken. This place deserves a 5 Star to me because of how good the waiter was and how good my dishes was. I didn't have no complaints at all
what else to say? It's got the best pizza in Nashville. The owner is super dope. You should go here... just don't bring your annoying sorority sisters.

Cool Little Dive Bar

Been wanting to stop in Roadside for some time now, and glad I finally did. Met a few locals, met a few bar maids (Sweet Hearts!!) Had a few beers and shots as well. The only down was a loud mouth local that the girls took care of in short order, and had him out in 5 minutes.
