The food is excellent. They have a well trained chef.  I ate the trout which was perfectly cooked, and there were plenty of mashed potatoes-even too much for me to eat!   The service was very good and very prompt.  The atmosphere is very nice.  So far, it is the best food I have had at a restaurant on Central Avenue in St. Pete.  My husband and I just bought a house in Kenwood.  He and I are really enjoying all the restaurants within easy walking distance and this is one of them. It is the best so far,  and we've tried a few others. Cappy's pizza is a great pizza place down the street too.

After an event at the convention center, we popped over to Pi across the street to warm up and fill our tummies.

The pizza was excellent, brought out nice and hot.  However once the pizza came, the waiter disappeared.  Our drinks were not filled as much as one would hoped and the only time he came back around was when he thought we were done so he could box it up.  So hopefully they can improve this aspect because their food is delicious!
When they say hot...they mean HOT!  Be prepared. Even though my eyes watered and my nose ran, the chicken was flavorful and the sides that I tried were good. Really friendly staff.

I've been a customer of this restaurant for many years. In the past, the customer service has been A+. Recently, the customer service has been marginal at best for call ahead take out service. The few times I been my order is never ready and I have to wait even though I have given plenty of time for it to be prepared. I also go ahead of the evening dining hour to avoid the crowd, I.e., before 6 pm. The staff is disinterested in the fact that I am a customer and never even says thank you for your business. When I ask about my orders not being ready, I'm told that they are very busy, which is not true. I will note that Jesus the owner never seems to be around which I think has contributed to poor service. I am very disappointed and I know Jesus would be too. That is why I am posting this review. Please do better.

Ordered to go, the mixed grill and a side of hummus. Serving is big and fed 2 adults. Holy cow, it was GOOD! Meat marinades in perfect spice, not over cooked or dry. Great skill in the kitchen . Pity we don't have such a place in my home town. 

One sort of downside is it also serves as a hookah bar. The hookah aroma is pretty strong, but as I said we ordered to go. For this, I subtract one star.

The proprietor and the waitress were friendly and hospitable. Check it out. 
I'll be back!

Not. Very. Good. 

Came here again before a Blues game. I have no idea why other than there is nothing else close to Scottrade Center. We sat and ate with dirty dishes from the previous diners right next to us. Zero service. In fact every table in the place had dirty dishes on them. The buffet would be bearable if there was fresh food on it. The pizza is the only redeeming factor but just barely. It's slightly better than Chuck E. Cheese but that's about it. 

Attention Maurizio's: Hire more help! It would fix a lot of your problems.

Had a fantastic Thursday evening dinner at Tinker Street. I wish I discovered Tinker Street when I lived in Indiana, but I'm still glad I discovered it sooner rather than later - thanks to Yelp! 

We had the: 
*Fried Brussel Sprouts (House Made Almond Dukkah Spice, Dijon Vinaigrette, Caramelized Onion): I love the dukkah and the warm and complex flavor it adds. I've never had it on Brussels but I enjoyed it! The dijon vinaigrette was a nice touch of acidity to help break up the flavors.  

*Baked Raclette (Smoking Goose City Ham, Roasted Potatoes, Honeycrisp Apples, Cornichons, Baguette): I wish this were the wedge of raclette served tableside BUT it was still tasty in the mini skillet. Nice share plate for all to pick at! 

*Pumpkin Gnocchi (Pumpkin Pesto, Pumpkin Puree, Pumpkin Seed Oil, Brown Butter, sage, Parmesan): Love the fall flavors of this!! The gnocchi was also a perfectly pillowy texture. 

*Sakura Pork Belly (Red Cabbage Kimchi, Forbidden Rice, Sorghum-Tamari Glaze, Duck Egg, Scallion): Very bold flavors, but still well-balanced! I just had to make sure I ate the gnocchi before I ate this. The pork belly had a beautiful glaze and crust. The richness helped balance out the duck egg. I'm usually not a duck egg fan, but all the flavors on the plate made it work! 

*S'more Pot De Creme (smoked chocolate ganache, house made marshmallow fluff, hickory, vegetable ash): This is apparently one of the few items that has continued to stay on the menu. I can see why - it was fantastic. A lovely modern twist on a classic, family favorite.  

I also loved that I tried a Macedonian wine for the first time. It was surprisingly well-rounded and balanced! 

All the food and wine for two people came out to be $50/pp but we were STUFFED and it was incredibly food, so all in all - worth it! 

It has a parking lot, but it's tiny! However, there's ample street parking. 

290/365

I stopped in this cute bar after an early evening jaunt through the Vieux-Carré. I am glad to have come in that night. I had two glasses of red wine and chatted it up with the bartender and some of the locals. This was a great way to start out my vacation, and I liked that fact that there was not one tourist in the joint! I highly recommend if you want something off of the beaten path.

Awesome place with good service and drinks. For fall they are doing a pumpkin full of shock top beer and we get to keep our pumpkin! Who doesn't want that?? Over all fun place to go and great drink specials.

I have never experienced worse customer service in my life. We were seated and our server came quickly to our table. Before ordering I showed her a coupon on my phone and she implied that we could use the coupon. We had our meal and went to check out. The manager came and stepped in and insisted that since we had not printed out the coupon we would have to pay full price. We were not informed of that at the beginning and the manager was firm and insisted they could do nothing for us. She rudely suggested that I could take my toddler and infant next door to Walmart to print out the coupon while my husband waited at the restaurant. This manager needs to be fired or sent for customer service training. We will certainly never be back at this ihop and we will most likely not go to another ihop again

Having just returned from Puerto Rico, we were looking for someplace local we could go to enjoy the food we left behind. After looking through a couple places, we stumbled on this little restaurant in Pottstown.

Small, unassuming, and serving just the food we were looking to eat. 

We ordered the following:

Mofongo with Pork
Yellow Rice w/Beans
Tostones
Fried Sweet Plantain and  Beef

Everything that was brought to the table was hot, fresh, and cooked how we wanted. Portion sizes were great (we may have ordered a bit much) and the price was very reasonable. And to top it off, the Owner brought out little containers of rice and beans to our kids while we waited for the rest of our food.

Overall, this place is a great place to check out if you are in the mood for some good food. I may not have grown up on Puerto Rican food, but it looks like I will be eating a lot more of it in the days to come after finding this place.

Avoid entirely. Staff has no clue how to make a correct order. Called restaurant to let them know the issue and they refused refund and insisted on sending new pizza. 

Called GrubHub immediately and asked them to mediate a refund. They called store and the manager stated that a replacement was already en route.

Absolute lie, unless someone can tell me how someone can assemble a three topping pie, cook it and get it in a vehicle in four minutes.

Seems obvious they would rather lie and lose a customer than do the right thing. 

Will never order again and you shouldn't test the waters either.

Pizza is everywhere and maybe not as good, at least the other locations earn the business.

Management and staff of this establishment should be absolutely embarrassed

Outside of the mildly helpful service, this Noodle house rocks with variety and quality! The oxtail shaved noodle soup is a go to for me, however the roast pork noodle soup is equally fantastic. Be daring and try the spicy pig ears and enjoy!

BurgerFi is a cool new addition to the Seminole mall area. People complain that it's overpriced, I don't agree. Prices are typical of this style burger joint. Decent fries - add a side of aioli! Portions are generous, burgers are great, but the atmosphere is rather boisterous, but it's worth a try.

It was late and Daisy Mae's was one of the only places that was open and close by.  A group of us were starving...so this is where we ended up and we left satisified.  I had a belgian waffle and eggs..and it was perfect and hit the spot. 

The waitress, can't remember her name, but it almost sounded like Daisy Mae, but it was different...began with a "D"...Marie?  Anyway she was impressive...this is the second waitress we met during our stay that didn't write anything down...and got the order correct and there were four of us...with complicated stuff going on....she got it right...so just for that alone....warrants ALL the stars!

The food was great, everyone was happy!

Update: we went back last night and had a great time. The place is bright and ALL the tables were full--something we never saw when it was cornerstone. They even had a wait! They had karaoke and some people sang. Akash brought us menus and was helping out--he was super friendly and warm and had great eye contact. The female waitress (sorry I didn't get her name) with suspenders was also super friendly. The owner, Mike, came over and introduced himself. Food was great like last time. We're excited to see the full menu, have drafts, and pay with credit cards. We'll definitely be regulars.

Why was there a wait at 2:00 on a Saturday? And why did we stand there waiting when there were FOUR booths behind us that were completely unoccupied? And then why did we actually end up being sat at those damn empty tables!?!?! What's the POINT OF THE WAITTTTTTT?!?!

Guh.

The food was OK. The bathrooms were a friggin' disaster! It looked like some man went into the ladies room and pissed all over the place. After that, he ripped up little bits of toilet paper and threw them all over the stalls.

It also smelled like a fart.

I just can't imagine a female making such a mess. Yuck!!

Had a meeting here and I was overall impressed, they have a large meeting room you can use, and also a smaller one, great for work lunches or bringing clients!  The menu has a lot of variety, I settled in a bacon, egg and cheese croissant and was pleased with my decision, my friend had steak and eggs and said it is in top 5 for Tampa on taste.  I am very excited they are opening one in Lutz and can't wait to check it out also.

This is always be my fav dessert place to come in Philly so far. The cheesecake is good, the taste just perfect for me, not too sweet!! All the combinations is just perfect!!
Weekend is always crowded. If you come and eat in, you get lucky to see the table empty and sit around.
A small place with friendly and helpful service, and top quality sushi. Definitely coming back.
Great tea, friendly atmosphere. I enjoyed my pot of mate as well as the Larson sandwich. Looking forward to returning soon.

Love this place before a lightning game. Wings may be best in town. Only complaint is the chairs, they always get my back jammed up! Great service, staff, and food is consistently delivered out. Highly recommend !

This is a new neighborhood gem. Reasonably priced food and drinks. Authentic flavor. A place your would find in New Orleans for sure. The staff is dynamic and the food has a kick but is delicious. Simple, but tasty menu. I would recommend the Chardonnay on draft, but they are also carrying Abita beers. #nolavibes
Two servers were working, with one other table in the whole restaurant. It took 15 minutes to get menus, while the servers chatted in the kitchen. I walked out as the delay was silly.

Best Pho in South Philly - plus they have booze! I wouldn't come here expecting the finest dining experience, but you will have some amazing, steaming hot pho in about 5 minutes flat. The staff is sweet and the food is delicious, I would highly recommend!

I've only eaten here once but it was great. I had the grouper dinner which comes with steamed vegetables and a side salad. 

I was honestly impressed by just how fresh everything was period,,,,, but especially for an Irish Pub. 

Fish tasted great as did everything else. 

Service was fine at the bar where I sat mid-day on a Friday.

Una mala dedicion no hay mucho para escojer el menu se basa en lo mismo mala presentacion en los platos hay buena atencion pero se acaba con la comida sin gusto savor comonsifuera de lata y un presio notan axesible

Granted I'm not a huge chicken fan. However, I do know good chicken. This establishment did not provide me with good chicken. I thought the flavor was missing, and the chicken was a bit greasy. I'm used to Church's Chicken having affordable greasy chicken, but not this place.. Considering the price you pay.

Now... The ice! O M G! the best I've had since 1993 White Castle ice. The ice "sweats" and melts just the right way going down. I didn't like the tea I had, so I had my son drink it up. Phew! Let me tell you!! That was the pièce de résistance. The ice saturated in ice tea remnants was the highlight of my day.. All my cares went right out the door.. Walking hand and hand with the greasy chicken I did not like. 

If you are a nice ice craver like me - go ask for a cup of water. Grab some ice - "sprinkle" some tea.. Swirl around your cup and ice.. BOOM a free meal from this place.

2 stars for the delicious ice
Nice place, good atmosphere, but I felt the menu was limited. My food was good and the waitress was exceptional. Can't say I would go here again.

A welcome addition to downtown! Sugarfire is already a known source of good BBQ in the StL area, so not expecting anything less from their newest location. I  got a 6oz brisket sandwich and creamy slaw to eat here. The brisket was tender and flavorful w/o any sauce. They have a multitude of sauces on the table to choose from if so inclined.  I did try a few, but none needed to enjoy the brisket as served.  The slaw was very good also. The service is cafeteria line type, and all the help behind the serving counter was friendly and quick. All the meats and sides are visible as they create your tray. I also got some pulled pork and ribs to go, so I'll update later after consumption. Great to be able to support another local business in the downtown area!

Love the ambiance and vibes of this spot! I wanted a relaxing place to get work done and get a nice bite to eat and I got just that. I ordered the Pecan Encrusted Brie and it hit the spot. Servers were nice and helpful. I would definitely recommend, just don't all rush at once cause I still need a place to go when I have work to do!

The best thing about this place is the location. One of the few spots for brunch in area and it's in the cutest house with things to do upstairs. As it is on a college campus, there's always at least an hour wait. 
Food is off and on. Sometimes its great- the specials are usually my go to (change with the season). I enjoy their coffee. And the servers are hip. 
But it's not a five star favorite because one time there was a chunk of hair in my French toast. Too bad I had taken a bite before I noticed. Haven't been back since.

I just can't with this place!!

A good friend suggested I try the famous (shameless) happy hour.  So one afternoon I stopped by.  The hostess seemed confused upon walking in.  However, she was very sweet.

I sat for five (5) minutes, and a woman (who didn't tell me her name) comes to take my order with both arms full of dirty dishes (She asked for my drink first.)
I ordered French fries with cheese.
She told me they have their "Mac sauce". Assuming I meant nacho cheese. 
I tell her it's ok, as long as there is NO BLUE cheese.  

I believe she was more interested in other table of politicians rather than measly french fries.  She arrived with the fries covered in blue cheese, and she insisted several times they were not.
I asked her to check with the cook, and 10 minutes later she returned to tell me "the cook put a little blue cheese." 

I have been a cook myself for 12 years and in travel tourism now for 5.  I am also allergic to blue cheese.  After telling my friend she's crazy, she insisted I call the restaurant.  A few days later I spoke with the manager who offered a free dessert... (Yeeaaa no)  

I should have eaten the fries went into shock and had a much better story to tell my future children.  Regardless, I've been here three times (twice for dinner) and its not worth it.
I love this place! The sushi is affordable and the service is quick. I definitely recommend this for lunch

I don't always go to Bud's Broiler, but when I do, I'm disappointed. Seriously, I've yet to go to a location that had good food and service.

Product: Hamburgers, fries, and soft drinks. Maybe a few marginal items like shakes I cannot recall/have never ordered. The best thing about the burgers is the sauce. If all the components were as good as the sauce, you'd have one of the best burgers in town. The fries are those cheap, hard shoe string types. (2 stars)

Service: This was the true black eye at this location. I had to wait an interminable time for someone to take my order, as the cook wouldn't/couldn't. I suspect the owner doesn't trust her with money. The food took a while to get to me as well. I was in there alone when I showed up, mind you. A guy who came in after my order got to me took just as long to order and get his food. Overall, abysmal service (1 star)

Facilities: A rather homey, worn down location, like most of the restaurants in this chain are. It was spotless, though. (3 stars)

Overall: Go to Frostop across the street---the burgers are larger, more tasty, and come out quickly. (2 stars)
Great Cajun food!!! Try the chili cheese crawfish etouffee!!!! Want to come back and try more!! That chocolate chip toffee cookie was calling my name!!
OMG, the oysters and fish spread were amazing. Cool, relaxed marina atmosphere. They also had a great beer selection. Will definitely be back.

Horrible service. Doesn't anyone teach these employees ever to say I'm sorry? They lost our ticket and we had to bring it up to them twice! When the cashier told the cooks, they just threw their hands in the air like it's such an inconvenience to fill an order. We asked to speak to the manager, no surprise, there wasn't a manager there. Their order system has you pay your tip when you order. Wow, wish I could take that back! Never an apology.
Is this the same SUSHI AI, INC. entity #C2397431 that the California Department of Corporations says is suspended by both the Secretary of State and the Franchise Tax Board? Wow.

The Boxyard is seriously cool! The shipping container setup is such a smart concept for the area, perfect place to hangout with friends and get a drink! Love the variety of food options, Indian, Mexican, Vietnamese and BBQ, I can't wait to go back and eat! Great staff, especially Shawn behind the bar! Check this place out now!

Almost irrespective of which city you find yourself in within the United States there's likely to be an ice cream spot that houses masters of the craft; and in St. Louis that spot is Clementine's without question.  

Star 1: How were the service and atmosphere?

Classy meets comfort at Clementine's, and the quaint and historic location houses a clean and chic ice cream parlor that blends the traditional and contemporary. The servers are fantastically friendly and knowledgeable, and they're loose with the samples - which is an added bonus given the fantastically unique flavors. Star Granted. 

Star 2: How were the portions relative to the cost?

The rise of high end craft ice cream is a good guy for everyone, but it does come at a bit of a cost. My medium size ice cream at Clementine's ran me just shy of $6.00 for three scoops; and while that's not cheap it's also not absurd these days. The waffle bowl was extra, although honestly the ice cream is so good that you've every incentive just to get it in a normal bowl. Star Granted. 

Stars 3 and 4: How was the food?

Incredible. First and foremost, Clementine's dishes up ice cream, not gelato, but their consistency is such that it has a comparable texture while maintaining exceptionally potent flavors:

Gooey Butter Cake -

If you're not from St. Louis you might not appreciate a flavor derived from one of the cities more unique and traditional desserts, but this will sure as hell be a good intro. I can't really describe the flavor here, but it was sensational.

Salted Crack Caramel -

Salted Caramel is a staple flavor these days arguably having replaced some of the classics like cookies and cream or mint chip, and Clementine's rendition of Salted Caramel (now with crack!) has every right to displace every other version you've ever had.

Tommie's Toffee Butter Brittle -

This was the real surprise of the afternoon. While I like Toffee, I typically don't love toffee, but this flavorful blend damn near converted me. Excellent.

What more do I even need to say here? This ice cream was out of this world. Dual Stars Granted. 

Star 5: Would you eat here every day if you could?

Consider Clementine's in my top five ice cream spots in the country. Yes. Star Granted.

I wanted to experience a great beignet & I got to.
Im telling you, the couple of beignets I've had in other parts if the US were, trust me #GUTBOMBS. As in, I don't need to eat a deep fried DOUGH BLOB for the extra carbs. I imagined a little chew to the crust & LIGHT & fluffy inside & bamm- DONE.
(Oh, and I'm glad we didn't end up getting them at Café du Monde bcs, as others have confirmed, their's are meh.]
These were JUST THE TICKET the night before we leave.
Thanks Beignet Café, I'm 5 lbs heavier & it's all your fault!

Ask staff for the wifi password to get on their guest wifi. Small parking lot on the side, but plenty street parking nearby.

Good spot to grab a cup of coffee and pastry to meet your pal. Popular but not overly crowded.

It looked and smelled like a bar when we walked in. Did not smell a hint of Indian food. My girlfriend and I are of Indian decent and we frequent Indian restaurants every week. This was no Indian restaurant. The buffet was small to say the least. There was no butter chicken on the buffet.....every Indian buffet that I've been to serves butter chicken. The rice was NOT basmati rice and the food was seriously lacking in flavor. It was very watered down. The seats at the booth were broken and the atmosphere did not scream Indian restaurants. The naan was not real naan. It looked and tasted more like the frozen ones you would get at the ethnic grocers. They also had spaghetti on the buffet???!!??

Fusion Bowl is a win for me. My muddled strawberry and raspberry ice tea was so tasty and refreshing. It was served so nicely in a mason jar with mint on top. I loved it so much, I wish it was bigger.

I also ordered the shrimp with pork bun with egg rolls. It tasted so light and delicious. I didn't feel guilty considering all the flavor it had. It was served in a good sized bowl with a good ratio of shrimp, pork, egg roll, veggies, and noodles. 

Both of what I picked out are definitely a must try. I look forward to trying the pho, bahn mi, and other tea or coffee drinks.

What a great little place with a cozy casual fresh setting with wifi, tables, couches, and dominoes. I talked to the owners, and others working there, and they are as personable and helpful as ever.  Yes, I will be back.  

They also have one table to bring so you can bring your pet and eat outside. Bonus points!!!!

I was here for all you can eat sushi and I thought it was good. Although we sat at the bar, our rolls came out pretty slow because there was a large party there. One of our friends that was with us said there's usually 3 or 4 sushi chefs and was surprised there was 2 especially for a Friday night. 

All the rolls were tasty but my favorite was the broncos roll...SOOO good! I'd definitely come back but on a slower night just so we get our rolls at a good pace.

As for the service, it wasn't too bad. From previous reviews I thought it would have been really bad but it wasn't. The sushi chefs were nice and one of them threw out some jokes. The waitresses did their job but they weren't really friendly.
I hope this place sticks around for a while...really great burger, honestly one of the best I've had. Fries, regular and sweet potato, as well as a salad were delicious.

Visiting from Houston and needed a spot to eat close to our hotel. Waited nearly 2 hours. But once we were seated the service was great. 
But.... Maybe because I live on the coast, I do t know, but I have never had fried shrimp with the shell left on it. That was horrible! Is this a thing ? Its def not on the coast. I wish I got our servers name. He was super friendly and quick. 
Not a bad place for a Texas RoadHouse knock off.
Horrible service for average food. Incredibly slow because they do not have enough staff. Embarrassing for Nashville airport.

Nah. The clerk/cook took forever to acknowledge us. Whatever, I guess that can be considered "character" by some. I got a soft shell crab po-boy and there was nothing special about it. I wish I would have went to cochon butcher next door...
A good selection of interesting flavors, and I appreciate the mini-donut size. The donuts are a little too sweet, however.
wonderful vegetarian sushi options!  everything was delicious.. very cool ambiance and decor.
The only thing good about this place was the salsa. The shredded beef I got was basically just huge chunks of flavorless meat. Save yourself the time and the money and don't stop here.

Stopped by Jack's for an early dinner. It was a deli style way of ordering bbq. I went with the rib plate and got just the ribs and bread as I wasn't hungry enough for sides. The ribs were very tender and had a nice flavor. It was a Nice portion as well. It took me a minute to find where the bbq sauce was. I would stop by here again if I was in Broadway looking for a quick bite.
The workers here are very friendly and the food is amazing. I'd come here all the time if I could. The only thing is I wish they took reservations!

We were a bit weirded out that this Ricky's was at the bottom of a hotel but the kids were hungry and we had a Groupon. I have to say, the food was very good - better than the south common Ricky's. The fries were hot and fresh and their version of nachos was loaded and fresh.  The service was great. I'd come here again for sure!

Just a great restaurant. Nice ambiance. Owner greeted us at the door along with the greeter. He acted like he really appreciated us. There was a lot going on in the area and he thanked us for choosing his establishment.
Got there at 4 pm. By 5 the place was packed on a Friday.
Food was great. Menu is HUGE.  Maybe a little too big. Owner came by table 3 times to make sure our visit was up to standard. Super nice guy.
Staff was great. Lots of TVs. Full bar. And the most unusual thing I thought, but unique, was the fresh flowers at every table. Lilies I believe. Not sure.
Definitely going back
Poor service, and very overpriced considering both the quality and the quantity of food. Everything comes with a hidden up charge, we left hungry and dissatisfied.

I landed there as part of a company celebration (we are a low keyed company who likes beer).  The combination of warm and cozy interior combined with a terrific beer menu and what was a fantastic roast pork  sandwich with extra sharp provolone and long hots (best I've had outside South Philly) made this an instant favorite (I just wish I lived closer)

I am not the beer aficionado that many of the people in my company are but I had a recommended porter that was terrific and I heard many OOOOO's and AHHHH's from the thrilled and satisfied palates of my fellow guests.  

We need more places like the Pig in America (seriously) with all of the corporate restaurants with too many microwave ovens and falsely cheerful servers we need places that reconnect us with what our identity was back in the day when politics and sports were openly discussed, argued and share in public spots all over the country.  Places like this should be celebrated and enjoyed.  The only reason I don't give the Pig a 5 is because I think I want to revisit before claiming its as good as it gets but I think its well on its way to 5+.
Zakes has the best breakfast! Their French toast is my favorite and the caramel sauce is super delicious. The potatoes are also really yummy. I highly recommend this place for breakfast.

First visit and it won't be our last! My boyfriend and I came to wind down and watch the end of a football game. Turns out the late night visit calls for $5 appetizers 7 days a week, which we couldn't resist. We also liked how every day of the week is a different special. We were unfortunate enough to sit next to an obnoxious drunk at the bar, but the Manager, Ted, was quick to check on us about the situation and, although we were not bothered by the situation, offered to buy us a round of drinks to make up for the nuisance. 

I'm especially looking forward to visiting on Thursday for $5 nachos . We're happy to have such a nice sports bar close to where we live!
This is my go to pizza joint! Great pizza & customer service. Everything on their menu is excellent. The kids pick Gianni's over any commercial pizza. I am a regular at Gianni's. The Kings of Pizza.

It's a shame a big company like Bob Evans can't afford to have competent management at this restaurant.. 

Came in on a Sunday morning restaurant was 70% filled. Sat at the counter and had to ask (after 10 minutes) to get the counter cleaned of the previous patron's dishes. Counter was finally wiped off.  Another 5 minutes passed before I had to flag down a waitress to ask for some coffee.. it was brought to me, but I had to ask for a spoon and cream.  Another eight minutes passed while I passively waited for a server to stop by and take my order (the wait was in vein!), I ecentually asked for a server to take my order. 20 minutes  now passed, since I sat down. Food arrived after an additional. 10 minute wait. I then had to ask the lady that put my food in front of me, if it would be possibe to get a coffee pot refill, silverware, some more cream and a napkin. Finally got to eat. Food quality was average at best.

Overall, it was a terrible experience.
This place is a joke. Small group of people ordered (overpriced) food and they lost two orders in the middle of the group? Seriously.?? Dont waste time, go to McDonald's ... food is better!

They have a great selection of craft and local beers plus a cool food menu.  Rock shrimp coconut curry, fried cheese curds, escargot, truffle tots, roast beef kicker, Korean snapper tacos, and PB&J Burger to name a few.  There isn't a dessert menu, but when I came for dinner, they said they had cheesecake for dessert.

Calamari $8 - These flash fried calamari are great!  Crispy on the outside and chewy on the insdie, served with delicious marinara sauce.

Shrimp & Grits $13 - Great dish filled with shrimp, bell peppers, andouille sausage, onions and garlic, green onion and topped with a fried egg.  Just the right amount of spiciness.

Three Palms Coconut Cream Pie $6/10 oz - This blonde ale was interesting.  The light taste of coconut was pretty good for the most part, but started tasting a little weird towards the last few sips.

LOCATION: Stein & Vine is located between Family Dollar and Big Lots in a strip mall with the word PUB lighted up on the building.

I'm not going to write a long review as many people have extensively written their thoughts on this place.

-Staff was knowledgeable and enjoyed helping me select a beer.  
-Food was good.  I had a burger and fries.
-Place gets cramped really fast.

I would definitely go again.

Several weeks before Thanksgiving, I took to Twitter to find out which local businesses were taking orders for pecan pies. I received several recommendations, but Wedge & Fig stuck out since I had been wanting to get back in the wake of an awesome YEE in October. 

When I called to order my pie, I quickly discovered that W&F was not taking orders for pecan, but they were doing two other varieties. After explaining the mix-up of info I had received on Twitter, they generously agreed to bake a pecan pie especially for me. Floored and touched, I promised I would not reveal this information to the masses. Now that Thanksgiving is over, I think it's safe to let the cat out of the bag. 

For the record, the pie was absolutely delicious. Everyone in my family had a slice and all agreed that the rich, buttery flavor and crunchy, sticky texture was spot on. Out of the three pies we had, the pecan yielded the least amount of leftovers. I enjoyed a coveted second slice this morning, and it was every bit as good as last night. 

My mom told me I am now officially on pie duty for Thanksgiving. I know where I'll be ordering my pie from next year, and I can only hope that the pecan will be offered as one of the selections.

I went here for happy hour and was really happy with my experience! 
I got a $5 mojito that was super fresh and you could tell the bartender was putting effort into your drink despite being busy. 

I also got an app for $5 which was guac and plantain chips! Really liked that it was plantain chips instead of tortilla chips. I really felt like I was in Cuba!! 

Only meh thing is that it was a Friday happy hour so finding a seat was difficult and getting a waitress was even harder. But what can I expect on a Friday at 5:30?

BOTTOM LINE: good sushi for sure, but not my favorite in Nashville.

Wild Wasabi is a sushi joint in Cummins Station. Clean, spacious space with a big menu- lots of specialty rolls. 

PROS-

Friendly staff and quick service
Extensive menu
Interesting flavor combinations
Salad dressing was DELISH

CONS-

Fish could taste fresher
Flavors and sauces overwhelmed a bit

Favorite Rolls: "Happy Together" and "Couple"

I only will eat KOSHER hot dogs. No OINKERS or mystery meat dogs. 

On my last visit to this fine establishment, I had to eat the veggie dogs, which are not anywhere near as good as a Hebrew National or Abeles and Heyman.

I consider myself a hot dog pro. I admire the creativity that the owner has brought to this stand.

BUT, PLEASE, PLEASE get Kosher hot dogs as an option. They keep a long time, and ask anyone who likes hot dogs---they love KOSHER hot dogs.

The FIVE STARS that I am giving is based on you upgrading to carry a KOSHER HOT DOG!

Vegetarian chili is also a thought!
Terrible, load, don't waste your time or dime. Go to Mia for a great meal. Bad service and the food was Luke warm. Waited 15 minutes to pay the bill.

How can you not love SF Sourdough?! These guys hands down make the best sandwiches. We usually call in our order before we head out boating. Everyone is friendly, and they always call us by our name. (Yes, we've been there a lot)! The meats, cheeses and the veggies are always fresh. The only thing I would love to see added to veggie choices is Jalapeños & Peperoncini.

3 1/2 stars.

Tried this for the first time.  Got an extra cheese and supreme.  The extra cheese was pretty good but I would hate to see what regular cheese looks like because there wasn't much extra cheese.

They supreme was better and I would probably stick to their specialty pies if I return.

The crust is thin and pretty good.

$32 for a large extra cheese and medium supreme so I would say about average for pizza prices.

I saw a Yelp review that said they are cash only which is not true.

I've been to Kung Fu Noodle a handful of times over the past few years. It's a small place, tucked inside an anonymous strip mall just south of Ft Lowell on Campbell. Easy to miss. But if you find this place, you'll find a welcoming atmosphere and helpful, friendly staff, large servings for the price, tasty food that's more interesting than standard asian fare, and fresh noodles that will make you want to sigh with happiness, they're so good. Also, the cucumber salad is addictive.  I hope this spot gets enough business, because they deserve to be around.

Food - decent quality; we got the "bun bo hue" and "bo sot vang". 

Pricey - dishes are on average 2-3$ more expensive than elsewhere, prob bc of the location and the nice interiors.

TYPOs all over the menu for the names of the dishes in Vietnamese - this one is my biggest pet peeve! The minimum quality check you can do is to spell check it or ask a Vietnamese person to do so, huh?
Great service.  Great food.  The turkey and potato salad are the best.

Safari and food! If you want to eat while seeing mice run across the floor, this is your bar! Stopped eating after seeing the first, and saw the second (with the first again at the same time) while waiting on the check... If you want food, keep looking!

We went on a thursday night around 7pm, HUNGRY I tell you, it took forever for us to get seated in this 1/2 full restaurant, when we did get seated we waited 20 minutes no one ever came to the table...When I went to the Host, he said OH. nothing more.....so I said ok we will leave and he said Oh....I wrote corporate and the manager called the next day, she said she will make some changes and our next meal is on her, but honestly...It was that bad...i dont even want it.

First impressions - Valet parking with someone opening the door.  Bar has 25+ seat and another 15+ tables, concurring with other reviews of a busy happy hour.  The place is clean and the staff is professionally dressed including a maître d' in a full suit.

The Bar/Happy Hour

The happy hour deals for cocktails are great but a little limited.  The cocktails are great, but only 4 or 5 are on happy hour.  The happy hour appetizers and burger are the real deal for the place.  The bartenders are extremely attentive with any staff member willing to grab a plate, deliver an appetizers, ask if we would like anything, etc...

Definitely on the short list for happy hour and a future dining experience.

Nice looking place. Small and cozy. Service was good. My wife and I visited for lunch today. Gyoza was tasty as was the seafood and cucumber salad. The sushi rolls were not what I would term as bad. They were uninspired. We had two Mexican rolls, one spicy tuna roll, and one volcano roll. All the rolls were small and I thought just thrown together. 

It may work for some people but I don't see us returning.

I went here on Sunday evening for dinner and was surprised how authentic the food was, given how trendy the place appeared.  (My initial expectation was that it would be more "fusion/modern").  That being said, the decor is very nice and comfortable.  The service was excellent, and the owner also stopped by to chat with us, like many other reviewers have mentioned.  As a testament to how authentic and tasty the food was, almost every group that was dining there at the time was Asian.  

We ordered the dan dan noodles, pork intestine noodle soup, and the fish and tofu clay pot.  
- The dan dan noodles were okay, not that great, especially when you compare to Han Dynasty's dan dan noodles. 
- However.  Everything else we had was _very_ good.  If you like Szechuan, the pork intestine noodle soup was delicious-- full of flavor, not crazy spicy, just delicious and a GREAT deal at $11 (it's a huge bowl).  Despite the dan dan noodles, I would readily order any other Szechuan/spicy dish based on this one.
- The fish and tofu clay pot was not spicy, but exactly what I was in the mood for, which was simple but flavorful.  And it was LOADED with fish and tofu-- they did not skip.  At first I thought it was a bit pricy at $17, but now that I've been literally eating it for 3 days and counting, it's a darn good deal for the size.

I fully intend to be here often.  My recommendations are: Szechuan dishes and more Asian dishes.  It sounds like some of the more "americanized" dishes (trying not to sound pretentious or anything!) were not that good from what the other reviews say.  I am hoping to try the spicy beef noodle soup and mustard greens and flounder soup next.  Several tables nearby ordered the crispy whole fish with sweet and sour sauce, which looked really good too.
Hands down the best pizza in New Jersey. I get to Grandma, Buffalo chicken, and a plain slice every single time. Never flight had a bad slice!

I spent many a fun evening out here, when I lived in Nola. They have a free pint glass each Wednesday, and I just wish my design I submitted was picked. I remember them having a fantastic, out of this world pear flavored beer, circa 2003, but when I returned last year, alas, they had gotten rid of it. And the lady behind the bar looked at me like I was crazy when I asked for it. This place gets an "A" for nostalgia, but now is just alright. But you should stop by it on your Magazine Street bar crawl.
Great atmosphere with live music. Waitress was fantastic! My 7 year old son said it was "the best cheeseburger I've ever had in my life"!

I stopped in here to pick up lattes for a friend and I who were on our way to a Yelp brunch event.  We aren't exactly morning people...or late morning people.  Clearly, caffeine was necessary. 

We had trouble finding parking on a Sunday morning, so my friend had to sit outside with the car running. We're not that familiar with downtown Tampa, so we didn't know of any better options.  Feel free to chime in if you know any parking alternatives! Thankfully, the service inside was quick and friendly, even with a few people in front of me. The Caffe Lattes were just right, and the plain croissant I picked up was a buttery, flaky, pillow of nom-nom. 

The shop itself was cozy and had all the feel of an upscale but artsy café without the pretentiousness. The baristas were welcoming, friendly, and service was fast. I love Kahwa, and I'm so glad that they exist on my side of the Bay.

If it was possible to give NO STARS, I would!  Having recently moved over to Prater and McCarran, we have yet to find a GOOD Chinese restaurant in the area and this surely ISN'T one of them!  We ordered Mongolian Beef and Broccoli Beef and where's the beef?!  If I wanted my Mongolian Beef to be ALL green onions or the Broccoli Beef to be ALL broccoli, I would of ordered it that way!  WON'T be ordering from them again!

Azie has great ambience with an outdoor rooftop area, indoor seating and, when available, outdoor dining in the street.  We recently had dinner there (been many times before) and all was very good - the avocado salad was tasty and very large, the sushi rolls were very nice, and the gazpacho soup and tuna specials were top notch. Service was great, adult drinks were very tasty.

I'm starting to fall in love with St. Louis.  I saw this bar a few days ago and I finally got to stop by for a pint.  Wow, as I walked in I was taken back by its quintessentially Irish pubness.  It feels like its been a pub for a hundred years.  (Maybe it has?)  No music just murmur the way I like it, people jabbing away the problems of the day.  The barman quick to take my order.  I was pleased to see that they had an in house butchered Lamb burger.  Before I could ask if they could add a fried egg, the barkeep asked me if I wanted to add one, wow, if you haven't tried a lamb burger with fried egg you are missing out on some seriously gastronomically pleasing flavors.

Guinness, a lamb burger and good company, UGH!!  When am I coming back to St. Louis??  The best way to enjoy this and any restaurant is with an open mind and a good attitude.  I did see some people getting frustrated at the service but for me I can't be bothered.  Life's too short and when you're drinking Guinness how can you be in a bad mood?  Four stars for service but it didn't stop me from having a great time!
This place is always phenomenal. The almond croissants and macarons are my favorite. I even took a macaron class here which I highly recommend. It was so much fun and all the chefs are great guys.
Delicious food, gorgeous place, knowledgeable staff.  Great place to to go with friends or a date.  Pricey, but worth it.

I was being too harsh. Went back here one night with a bottle of wine (they're byob!) and got a few macaroons and the baklava. Don't know what I was thinking saying the baklava wasn't great, it's absolutely delicious. The macaroons were good too. I like the decor of the place too, and being in Queen Village (my old home) is a plus.

I don't think many people bring wine here, cuz the waitress seemed a bit surprised (but very pleased) that we came to drink there.
I have tried several things on the menu now and this place continues to rock my world!
Second time having lunch there, would say so so at best. The meat is fair and the burritos are stuffed with a lot if rice. Would prefer meat and veggies only. At least they have beer.

Service was good, grilled octopus appetizer was the best grilled octopus I've ever had. Unfortunately, I had the special of the evening which was sea bass-  tasted overlooked and covered in tasteless sauce. The mashed potatoes also tasted

I'll start with the food. It was good, but not sure it's something I would or will crave in the days to come. It's a little on the pricey side as well. My friend ordered the seasonal "boozy" milkshake for a slightly spine-chilling $12 and was hardly able to tell if it had booze in it at all. With that said, we both were very pleased with our burgers. Ordered and delivered to our table while the bun was still warm! I ordered a double patty and he ordered a triple. You get your choice of toppings and sauce, with additional costs if you get things like mushrooms (+ $.50) or bacon (+ $1.00). The sides are a la carte ($4.00). We both ordered fries for a side and they were pretty standard. The ketchup provided at the table was amazing. Fairly certain it is made fresh in house. Or, at least it tasted that way! 

Oh, Baby's interior... maybe I had the wrong vision going into it, but I had much higher expectations for the cutesy, neon pink, vintage diner-esque aesthetic that was so eye catching on Instagram! Driving up, I was expecting to see a bright pink paint of sorts on the outside, but instead it's a gray/black exterior (with an outdoor seating area as well). I will say it did make the Baby's pink, neon sign stand out above the bar area as we drove up in front. It's a much more modern twist to the 50's type diner, but just not as bright and vibrant as I had envisioned prior to my visit. The bar area was fun to look at while the rest of the restaurant was a little bit more standard. 

Overall, nice experience. Good food. Friendly staff. Knowledgeable waitress. Quick service. If you're into burgers and are just looking for something a little different from the Bru Burger or Bub's Burger experience, then I recommend you give this place a try!

Great place. Love coming here in the morning and catching up in reading before starting my day. Why support the mega corporation across the street when you can get equal or better product and service here? Seriously, think about that next time you spend your money there. The profits they make are not reinvested in our local economy. There are plenty of chairs, couches and table space and free wifi if you need to park it for awhile. I hadn't been in a long while, but the owner still remembered my name. I love everything about this place!

We have been here twice now and the service at the bar has been terrible. We were here on a Friday and Wednesday night and neither time was busy. It took us at least 10 minutes each time for a bartender to come to us to ask us if we wanted anything. The second time we were here we asked to close out the tab and the bartender then went and helped 3 other customers and the tickets coming from the waitresses.

The best place in Philly to go for karaoke They have a great sound system You feel like a night club entertainer Huge room well heated and air conditioned Food is good Drinks are great Waitresses nice Relaxed  crowd

This is a relatively new spot that opened in the shopping center in Newtown Square.  My fiancé and I went when it first opened and we were really disappointed.   We went again tonight to see if they worked out the kinks but sadly the food was not great and the service was average.  The best part about this place is definitely the ambiance.  If you are all about the food / service, I would sadly skip this place.
This place was amazing. We had a wonderful experience.  Thank you Elijah will be definitely going back.

This place is very disappointing.  Went there for lunch recently and it was very unpleasant.   The waiter/waitress acted like we were imposing on them and we could not even get a glass of water from them.  My friend had to get up and get  it himself.   The food was cold, however, there was no one to complain to....After they slammed the food on our table they disappeared in the back room.   They were very discourteous and rude.  We have no intentions on returning to this place.   We actually went there last year and it was ok,   Things have really deteriorated at this restaurant.   Their attitudes towards their guests are horrific.  I only wish we had left a lot earlier than we did.  Never again 
!!!

I've been here twice, both times for a work dinner. This is a great place for a group of people.

After yummy appetizers of calamari and the caprese salad, I had Penne Filanti al Quattro. My was that rich, which should be expected if there are 4 cheeses!! Oh, and the mousse (talk about rich!!!)

The bocce ball was the best part. We had a blast!

Taco Bus ruined my marriage. I came here with my husband for a quick bite to eat before hitting the beach, but now three days later I'm still sitting here alone shoveling mushroom tacos into my mouth one after the other. I barely fit into this booth anymore and I don't even care. I used to have a good job, a mortgage, and a dog that I loved dearly but I don't care about any of that anymore. All I want is more tacos. My husband begged me to come home but I told him this is my home now. There is no going back. Thank you Taco Bus for setting me free.

Around this time last year I had my first taste of fast casual Korean food in the middle of Missouri (random? yes). It was a fusion, so they had tacos and burritos as the mainstays of their menu. Since then, I've been looking all over the country for a place that could replicate, or even outdo, the deliciousness of that restaurant. Well, one year later here we are and Kogi Grill is THAT place. My first few visit to this place resulted in me ordering the kogi beef bowl, which was always worth a five star review. However, it dawned on me that this place had burritos and that maybe, just maybe, they could be what I've been searching for over the last year. One night while ordering Kogi for dinner, I went for it. I don't think I'll ever get anything different...tender marinated beef, greens, rice, and cheese served in a large pressed authentic tortilla with a side of their sauce. Brilliant! I've had the Kogi burrito shamelessly three times in the last month. It is that good. Don't believe me? Try for yourself.

Have you ever just been somewhere and because of the environment you want something you never usually go for? Well when I sat down, for some reason, the ambience of the place made me want a nice cold BEER! Kinda the same way I felt at John D McGurk's... However, I didn't get one, but hey, it made me want one.

This place has multiple rooms and sections. The main room is the bar area and the hostess stand near the back of the room. To the right is the outdoor patio which is fenced in and they also have a covered area to seat customers. Then there's an entire back room, and I am sure an upstairs. Our wait was said to be 45 minutes so we sat at the bar - and then the hostess showed us a table opened up in the bar area by the front entrance, so we opted for that!

Our waiter was quirky and nice, never felt annoyed with my indecisiveness. We started off with the Pub Chips and the Beer Pretzels, because any place that has pretzels I HAVE TO GET THEM. However, he recommended the spinach artichoke dip, but we didn't want to get too much heavy stuff before our meals.

The pretzels were perfecccctly salted, not stingy with the salt (YES) and came with the mustard and a queso like cheese dipping sauce. The mustard I believe has Horseradish in it because it tasted like nail polish remover (I imagine that's what nail polish remover would taste like) - but it went well if you dipped it in the cheese sauce after. The pub chips were both Idaho and Sweet Potato house made kettle chips with a house made french onion dip that was reallllyy good.

My mom ordered the BBQ Pulled Pork sandwich and instead of fries, slaw, or chips she got the vegetable medley. Pulled pork sandwich came on a soft bun and was quite messy, but was really good. I stole a bite or two.

I was indecisive going back and forth between the stuffed pork chop or the Bavarian Weizen Chicken. I went for the chicken. It's a bone in chicken breast roasted in herbs placed on top of garlic mashed potatoes with the vegetable of the day (medley) - I added brussels sprouts also. Now, I'm a healthy eater, so when it came out I didn't realize it would still have the skin on the breast.. No big deal, it adds flavor, and I just ran 21 miles earlier that day so WHO CARES. But I did give in and peal off most of the skin. The chicken has a Weizen beer sauce in it and the plate is also covered in the sauce making the chicken SO tender! It was really good and I cleaned my plate, nothing left except the brussels sprouts.

The brussels sprouts weren't soft.. They were cooked in some sauce that really added flavor though, but they were hard for my liking. The carrots in the medley were also not very soft.

Great location, everything is literally in walking distance - I guess that's why I love Lafayette Square. Bailey's Chocolate Bar, Sqwires, Tripel, Eleven Eleven.... etc, it's such a cute little area!

The only thing I would not necessarily complain on, but critique, is the welcoming by the hostesses. There was a family of 4 in front of us at the stand and the girl was on the phone of a good 3 minutes. There should be another person there at all times if another hostess is busy, you really should never have to WAIT at a hostess stand if you're going to have to already WAIT for a table. But no big deal...

Definitely a goto place, really large menu - and the menu online isn't really the menu they have in the restaurant as they change things up occasionally. Not expensive, our bill came to $49 or so with two glasses of wine included. Meals were a good size and they were filling - and it's not too loud! They offer a Mother's Day Brunch, Easter Brunch, NYD Hangover Brunch, and every Sunday they have a brunch. Sundays are also Fried Chicken Sundays! I will be back for sure.

If I could give 1 star I would. The service was good because obviously the servers have no control of their environment, that is on the "owner". The "rooftop" had absolutely no shade, it's very narrow and the sliding doors def need some WD-40. The menu is no better than Waffle House (Waffle House is prob better honestly) but the cherry on top WAS THE HUGE ROACH THAT CRAWLED ACROSS THE SAME COUNTER THAT OUR FOOD WAS COOKED AND SERVED ON. Never again will I walk in to this establishment. Whoever is running their Instagram account needs to stop acting like this is a nice place because it is not.

This was our first visit to Fogo. I have heard so many good things about this restaurant that I have been waiting to try it for years. Well for my birthday this week my husband took me, and we were both so disappointing!

We had 5:30 reservation and when we walked in we were seated right away. Our waitress explained everything to us and took our drink orders. I ordered the Guarana which was explained to me as ginger ale with cherry. It was very good. And i found out when we got our bill they are $3.75 a can. My husband just ordered water and he did not receive it until after we had went to the salad bar.

The salad bar has over 50 items on it. Everything is cold.I know salad bars are cold but there were a few things like grilled zucchini that should not be cold. There were other items like potato salad and sliced cured meat and cheeses. 

Now the meats! The real reason we all want to go. Once you turn your card to green the gaucho chefs come around with all of the different kinds of meat. The first one to our table was the gaucho with the bottom round. He asked how I like my meat cooked. I am a medium rare kinda girl. He sliced a long thin piece of the bottom round off the large piece he was carrying around. It was almost burnt on one side and pink on the other side. It tasted like it had no seasoning on it at all and was very tough! Every kind of red meat tasted the exact same. Tough and no flavor except the garlic beef and it was all garlic. The Parmesan pork was my husbands favorite thing and I think I agree. It was moist and had a great flavor. The bacon wrapped chicken was also good but the lemon pepper chicken was super dried out. There was also a small sausage that was brought around. It was super dry in the center cause there was an 800 degree meat skewer through it.

We had read reviews and watched vlogs about not keeping your card on green so you can eat and enjoy the meats that you have on your plate so we were changing it back and fourth from red to green. But the whole time I was watching for the bone in rib-eye. And it never came, I had to finally ask our server for it. And here it came. The gaucho chef came straight to our table and sliced me off a piece and went to back to the kitchen with it. You could tell it had not been sliced on yet, a full rib-eye. I was so excited! I love rib-eyes! Well not this one, just like the rest of the red meat = dry, no flavor and tough. I gave up at this point. 

Since it was my birthday I did get a free dessert! Yay! I picked the turtle cheesecake and asked for it to go. They brought me out a white plate with Happy Birthday written on it and a candle stuck in a half strawberry. It was so cute. It was the best part of the dinner. So thank you for that. I ate the cheesecake the next two night. It was super rich and very tasty.

I am thinking since we went in on a Tuesday the quality just was not up to par. It was still busy in there with all of the business people from the current convention that is in town. But when you are spending $53 a person for dinner it should be amazing every night!

I go to the Italian market location, but never on the weekends, because although there's great people watching, there's also a line that crowds the sidewalk outside. Of course, you're crowded inside, too, almost sitting in your neighbor's lap. The challah french toast, stuffed with cream cheese could feed a family of four, if you're willing to share. I love the huevos rancheros.

I remembered this restaurant from a visit 20 years ago.  Still great food!  Loved the pasta.  We had a group dinner.  The waiter went above & beyond to meet all our special requests.  Will def go back next time.

My husband and I like to come in for the buffet and it being so close to our house is just perfect.
I love the hot, pillow like naan that gets served to the table once you're seated. I tried the goat curry with rice and daal and was not disappointed! Also had a delicious mango lassi on the side. 
Service is nice and polite. 
The restaurant is big, open and very clean.
Really cute and quaint shop in the Business District. Had a yummy croissant and coffee. This was my first stop on my New Orleans trip. If you are in the area, this place is really adorable.

Big Ray's Fish Camp is KILLING IT!! Blackened grouper samdwich is easily one of the best I have ever had. Blackening on point, not too over zealous or skimp, soft bun, great light tartar, fresh lettuce tomato and onion. All coming together perfectly. I put my sandwich down once or twice maybe. Couldnt stop myself. By the time I thought to add hot sauce or something (out of habit with other mediocre foods) I was taking my last bite and immediately going to Yelp about it. Now im leaving Big Ray's to get hungry for my next trip!

-Rich

Took few seconds to get menu after sitting at bar on Sunday 3/12/17 but after I put in order I got my Bloody Mary and my pork bahn mi slider pretty quickly. 

The short rib slider I ordered after came quickly too and while this was better than the pork bahn mi none of that mattered cos of how annoying it was when the girl cashed me out before I was ready to go since her shift was ending. 

I get it, but stil annoying for me to possibly be rung up two separate tabs needlessly 

She was nice and so no issues with anything else but still I was annoyed.  And so instead of staying I just Fucking left.  Another sub par experience ruined by service when the food was decent

We decided to give the Pyramid Grill a try. It was an experience. I realize they are new, but you've been open for about 2 months now. When are you going to get it together?

Outside appearance is everything and this has nothing to draw you in. The name or hours of the previous restaurant were still on the door, someone had tried to scratch them off, but didn't complete the job. No real signage to draw you in or menu to view.

The interior was very bright, too bright for dinner. Same with the bar. There is no atmosphere to speak of, nothing that makes an kind of an impression. We asked to see the menu and if there was a full bar or just beer and wine, there is a full bar. We decided to give it a try.

Once seated, we were given menus, no silverware on the table, no basic condiments, or napkins. Our server came by and asked what we would like to drink so we ordered from the bar, 2 vodka/7ups. About 5 mins went by and someone else came by and ask us what we would like to drink, we told them we had ordered drinks from the bar already. After another 5 mins or so, someone else came by and asked us again what we would like to drink. We again told them that we had already ordered from the bar. At no time were we ever offered water. Finally our drinks arrived and they were very weak. 

The manager Rob came by to see how we were doing. I asked him if he put any vodka in the drinks, he apologized for the confusion, as they had 2 large parties that just came in before we did. He grabbed our drink glasses and went to the bar for refills. He was fun to joke around with, and he personally took our dinner order. I had the Combo Louie, which was reasonably priced $13, and very good. My friend had the Avocado Cheese Burger w/Fries, again reasonably priced $11. She said the burger was good, but the fries, although made fresh were kind of greasy and limp.

All in all it wasn't a great experience, but it wasn't bad either. We will give them another shot. Maybe for breakfast next time.

Things that need improvement:
Preset the tables with silverware, water glasses, and coffee cups.
Bring the menus with water and perhaps bread and butter, offer coffee or soft drinks, and liquor.
Supply basic commandments at the table like ketchup, mustard, salt pepper, sugars, and napkins.
Dim the lights in the dinning and bar areas for dinner.
Put some atmosphere into play.
And slot machines at the bar, plants, artwork. 
Reorganize your staff, they appeared to run about shelter-skelter, no one seemed to have a set work area and/or job title. Everyone did everything, designate who is waiters, and who are the busers and etc.
Have dinner specials that are not on the menu, that the server explains when they bring the menu. 
I have more, but that should keep you busy until I return.

Good luck!

When craving a burger and in the thick of Reading Terminal Market, you can't help but to seek out Hunger Burger. Plus, with the backing of a good cause, adding a side of mac and cheese or lobster mac is even easier. 
Hunger Burger reminds of your typical Shake Shack, In and Out, Steak and Shake and shake style burger. Prepared fresh, tasty, and filling! 

The burger was a little bit smaller than I thought it would be, but most are doubles so they are just as filling. Crispy bacon, fresh tomatoes, and cheesy cheese! It was the perfect combination to my side of mac and cheese. 

I chose the regular Mac, but you have the option for lobster mac and cheese, fresh side salads, or fries. 
The mac and cheese was bit soupy/saucy so not "cheese-y" and they use shells instead of macaroni, but overall still good. 

I'll be back to give a few other options a try!
This is my second time at this location and it was really good.  I had Megan and she rocked.  So happy to see service to such a high level.  She was awesome and I will be back because of her.
I first tried BP in Toronto, and man am I delighted that they chose to open in Edmonton. We love the shop and the food. Tasty every time!

When we sat down, we were the only table in the restaurant. However, our COLD food took 45 minutes to come out. Also, our waitress and the employees looked like they hated their jobs and lives. Terrible service. Don't come here.

I went on Sunday, February 9, 2015 and I was thoroughly impressed with the hostess, the management and the Omelette Chef.   I have recently moved to this area and I have to say patrons should KNOW to TIP the Omelette Chef.  My man, you made the best omelette I have had since I moved here - kudos!

However, the service was poor.  I had to explain what ice coffee was, ask several times for water, had to get my own tabasco sauce and my friend waited for over 40 minutes for a burger.  The waitress explained that she had to wait on tables on the other side of the restaurant (yeah a list of excuses).  I overheard her say to the customers in which she was working the tip she had over 10 years experience.  My only wish for this poor waitress is to stop flirting with the customers and provide follow-up with other customers.  

The management team was sensational and remedied the situation in a flash.  Thanks a million!

By the way, this is a good review BECAUSE the management team remedied the situation, offered an apology and all is forgiven.  I realize the restaurant just opened so it speaks volumes that there were those to pick up the pieces and make this dining experience a great one. 

I'll be back.

Very nice little pool hall directly across the street from the AMC Veteran's 24 on Anderson (next to Subway).  They only have 5 or 6 tables, but they are regulation size and balanced like a mofo!  Very nice, brand new tables, good vibe, great music selection, beer on tap, and a whole host of specials on the menu ($2 Taco Tuesdays for one).  It's worth mentioning that they have FREE pool on Sundays until 7 PM.  No smoking inside!

Tired of playing pool?  No worries because along the back wall sits a long counch with various board games (Connect Four, Checkers, Jenga, etc.) that one could play.

The staff was a little stand-offish in my opion, but I'm okay with that. We weren't there to socialize with the staff anywho.  However, if they're working for tips, they may want to brush up n the people skills a tad.  Other than that, no real gripes!  We're going back this Friday =)

P.S. They do service cues.

UPDATE-------------

The food is good!  Had a BBQ Steak & Cheese sammich, fries and 10 Sweet & Spicy wings; all mouth-watering!  The steaks was super tender and heavily-coated in cheese, served on a sourdough bagguette.  The fries are season with something spicy... chili powder maybe?  Good stuff either way.  And the wings were massive and de-freaking-licious!  Order them "extra crispy."  Also, service has been outstanding since the first visit.

Fast and cheap, can't ask for more. Stick with the large rice platters and noodle soups and you can't go wrong. I prefer Wong Wong over Sangkee because there is usually no wait and you pay less for the same product.
Umm a little disappointed in this place. The fried rice was just rice with condiments and the sandwiches were just that a patty on bread

My favorite small bakery in Reno.  This is a great place to get a unique lunch with the fam.  A fun environment and very good service! I have always loved the staff at Homage.  Great food!  I suggest a croissant and one of their soups.....it never fails me!

In hindsight, when we saw folks waiting outside the restaurant Sunday morning, we should have tried a different restaurant.  

I'm not expecting egg mcmuffin service time, but two hours for two breakfast orders is too long a wait for my taste, especially when the food comes out LUKEWARM.  

The service seemed harried and we ended up neglected.  I appreciate water with my order, for example. 

First and last time for me at this restaurant.  I  can forgive a lot but can't get past cold bacon.

We ordered Punch Burger through Door Dash during the pandemic. I tried the Thai burger and had a chocolate milkshake. I through everything was tasty. The milkshake was not too frozen or too runny. The flavors of the burger were good, but it was a little heavy on the peanut and spicy notes. I would have liked more slaw on it to help balance it out. I thought the price was right on for the amount and value of the food. I'd be happy to try another burger from here!

Our favorite dishes are working wonton, spicy squid, and peach shrimp.   This is our "greasy spoon".  Excellent for take out. Good size portions.  Great comfort food.  Our families favorite take out.   Dine in is fast, lots of space for big groups, free parking in the back.  The area is kinda in the hood but the food is worth it.

We came with a group of 15 and the staff was very responsive throughout the night. The room was really cold when we first got there but they brought in several space heaters as soon as we brought it to their attention, which was much appreciated since it was real COoLD outside

The song selection was standard and had most of the current pop songs (and throwback songs) that we wanted. 

We had to buy $220 worth of food to have the karaoke room for 3 hours. It was just enough food to satisfy all of us. There were no complaints about the food and the dishes came promptly.

Really happy that the staff was always attentive to our questions and orders! Although we had the room until 11:30pm, the staff was flexible when we stayed for a little longer.

Tip: bring cash for a discount!
Arrived for a to-go order and every employee was in a bad mood claiming that they wanted to go home; and they had just clocked in! The service killed my excitement but the food was great

Fuck this restaurant/club. A bunch of us came from Vegas and two of the five of us had our phones picked right out of our pockets. When we went to the Verizon store the next day, we were told this happens quite often here and that bartenders might even be in on it. Which made sense because when I asked the bartender if anyone had turned in a phone, before I could even finish my sentence, she told me no. 

The environment was fun but damn, the crowd was sketchy AF and security is a joke.

THE OOOOOLLLLLLLEEEEEEEE WATERING HOLE! Cheapest beer around, which is a necessity for yours truly. Beyond beers they have above average pizza and solid bar food beyond all for reasonable prices. Trivia night on Wednesdays is also a good time as long as your okay with getting your clock cleaned the first couple times you participate.

Muriel's is known for its haunted past. They even set a table daily, food & all to prevent the ghost of the first owners from reeking havoc on the restaurant. The decor is beautiful & elegant and you can watch the entertainment of Jackson Square from your table. 
From our Andouille Duck Gumbo to our entrees of Blackened Mississippi Catfish & Pecan Crusted Puppy Drum, we couldn't have asked for a better brunch. 

Overall score 4.9

This spot used to be one of the best Pho places in town, their flavor was good, their service was good and the food had the same consistency in the taste and texture. You can tell there are new owners in this place, way longer wait times, the food has a different flavor and not using the same ingredients at all, must say disappointed for sure.

I had heard about the Guadalajara Original and thought we should try it.  We were closest to Kolb so we went there.  Margaritas were very good, beer cold and white wine nice.  Chips were thick and crunchy.  Salsa fresh and tasty.  Now for the disappointments.  Seated in the back in a booth that had seats so far away from the table we might as well have eaten off our laps.  Pork dish was tasteless.  Fajitas tasteless with no sauce so veggies were dry.  Seems the only thing with any taste was the salsa.  Do not eat here.  It was dreadful.

I want to stay here every weekend! My husband and I booked a room with a full bed and I'm so glad I did. We were close to everything downtown.  The room was so neat, old phone and radio. But updated with a nice ac unit, bathroom fixtures and tile in the bathroom. I've heard that it would be loud but I slept through the night without being woken up by anything. Easy late check out and they validated parking. This is the place to stay!

Only been there once but I really liked Wildflower. First of all, they are open on Sundays after church. It was a great place to go with girlfriends to chat over mimosas. Our meals were very good, and they had healthy options. The service and drinks were good. It is pricey but I found it to be deserving of its reputation for being pretty good, unlike many other places I have tried. Excellent for date nights, or getting together with girlfriends or bringing guests from out of town.

Very meh, especially for the price. Service speed was OK, they ran out of certain bourbons on the menu, and gave us free pork rinds that didn't belong on the menu. Outside of that, most of the food was good, if over seasoned. I think the most disappointing thing was the highlighted meal for two. It was just a breaded pork tenderloin with white bread...seriously that's it.

OMG, this restaurant was AMAZING to say the least. There was definitely a little wait due to it being Burger Night, but it was well worth it! It was my fiancé and i first time going and it was a great experience. Our service was very nice & the manager Anthony was great as well. I love when managers check on their guest. He made ya feel welcomed and made sure he followed up with us! 

Make sure you get the wings !!! They're to die for

Go local! Not down the road!

Curds n Whey is run with family-like friendliness. Amazing local foods! The bread there is outrageous. Whatever you need for a catered event, light lunch or dinner, or a few select groceries, you can get in Curds n Whey. Oh and they have bags of Philly Fair Trade Roasters!

All around excellent! Very creative and unique menu for New Orleans - breakfast options that are beyond just having 8 different omelette choices. Options for all diets - vegan, vegetarian, and even paleo! I was very impressed that the yogurt, granola, and coconut milk are all house-made. Excellent coffee, beautiful and clean interior with lots of light and plants. Cute little area with sofas to hang out if you're just staying for coffee. And they even have to go house-bottled beverages like kombucha, cold brew with coconut milk, thai basil tea, etc. Such a welcome addition to the New Orleans restaurant scene. I will definitely be back!

My husband is the connoisseur of chocolate pie. I have picked up French silk or chocolate pie from Jennys, Pie oh My, Olivette Diner, Four Seasons and the pie place in Rolla among others. Hands down, this is his favorite. Their chocolate is so thick, rich, soft and moist. It isn't runny like others. 

I'm a carrot cake fan. While Hanks still is preferred over theirs, this is a close second and would be good for someone that doesn't like a lot of frosting. 

Limited hours, cash only but worth it.
Caravan has the best hummus in Tucson! Always a delicious meal, with excellent service.
Lousy customer service. People act like they don't know what they are doing. Tortilla on my burrito was tough and dry.

I bought a cake from Pastry Perfection for the first time today and am more than pleased!! I called in last minute and they had it ready right on time without hesitation. The price was surprisingly affordable especially for a custom cake. I have nothing but great things to say! Heading back this weekend to try some other yummy treats :)

Beautiful Location 
Easy to find 
Wonderful decor 
Ordered a small coffee a small peppermint tea and a spinach Quiche 
Received 2 small coffees not sure why 
And a large peppermint tea 
We gave one small coffee back 
Waited for Quiche to be heated 
Unfortunately it was still cold on the inside.

This is the 3rd time within the last 6 months that I have experienced rude staff at this cafe.  I had met the store owner, Robert Szasz back when it first opened and was just Tropical Smoothie, not Nathan's, not the sandwich place, not the salad place, just Tropical Smoothie.  He is a very nice man.  However, I apparently am not the only one who is complaining about the rude staff.  When I got back to the office and mentioned to co-worker how rude the staff was, she reminded me that she too has had that same experience.  There are too many other choices of healthy restaurants in downtown Tampa to put up with this rudeness.  Therefore, that was my last trip to Tropical Smoothie.  I will get my salad and healthy food options from Nature's Table and The Secret Garden.

This was my first time here and let me just say, the food was absolutely delicious as well as the wine. i wouldn't have gotten such an amazing experience without Sean out waiter. He connected and did a great job finding us a delicious wine. Somewhere i would love to return to and hope to be waited on by Saun. Over all i am so happy and feel grateful to have have such an amazing experience.

Service was fast and but the shrimp po boy and shrimp and grits were awful.
There are much better places to eat in NO.

I have lived in LA, and Vegas. Moving to Nashville was definitely a culture shock with the lack of great Asian food. But, when you try and try you just might find that needle in a hay stack. 

Dai Viet definitely has the cleanest and well seasoned broth for Pho. I tried the Banh Mi, it was my first time. 

And now I can say because of this place I am addicted to the food here. This is my 2nd time eating here in two days, and coming from a curvy girl that's saying a lot. 

So, please try this place it will not let you down. Also, I would hate to see it close from lack of business. Keep them going!!
Just got here for the first time. Great bartender; Justin.  Very friendly.  Sangria is deeelish.  More later...

Love the Brew Pub! Great selection of beers and even a few selections of Mead. The food is very good. Classic Irish bar fare with vegetarian and vegan options. Service is friendly but usually on the slow side. Just the pace of the place so, sit back and enjoy!

Great food. Service fabulous. Atmosphere is upscale city life. Gaucomole is a must. Chopped salad with steak is very flavorful. Desserts looked wonderful but too full to eat. Try the cucumber jalapeno margarita very destinct taste.
