I went here on a date with a guy who had just travelled to China for business the year before. He said the food at TW was authentic and tasted terrific! I always knew :)

My last stop in NOLA. You pass by City Diner on the way to the airport so I'd recommend it for a last-minute bite. I ordered the Shrimp & Andouille Hashbrown creation and loved it. The creamy cajun sauce they use is on point and they are generous with the shrimp. My friend and I also split a blueberry pancake and were blown away by how large it is. It is literally the size of a large pizza and is only $5. Service was fast and personable. In short, City Diner ain't nuthin' to f*ck with! 

This place is open 24 hours so it's convenient as hell but it is a tad difficult to find (at least for us first-timers).
Picked up pastries during covid times, loved everything we tried. The chocolate cake is lovely and not too sweet, macarons are just perfect, and Creme brûlée was awesome.

My very favorite place for breakfast.  They have the most interesting combinations and great fresh organic options.  They consistently have new specials and everything is delicious.  You'll be glad you went!

Jules is a chain of thin crust pizza. I've come here many times and they always serve good food. The thin crust pizza is very unique thing, I had never seen it before. Their pizzas are rectangular, and very, very thin. Another unique thing Jules does is they do have gluten-free pizzas available when you request it, which is cool for people who have a gluten problem. Jules definitely gives a "trendy" feel about their food and restaurant. Their salads are all microgreens and they serve organic products and all the like. They are at least trying to be healthier than just another pizza place, and that and the taste earns Jules a four.

Yes this is a must visit the service is very good went  there for lunch and dinner did not disappoint, tv's to watch the game good crowds 
The Media PA location

The one hour line (Sunday ~12pm) was definitely worth it to try this place. All in all, it was a great choice, and while I was slightly disappointed in the spice level of the "damn hot" (I wanted something tear-worthy!), I loved everything else about the chicken - it was very crunchy and well-fried on the outside but still moist on the inside and the portion size is extremely generous! 

The sides didn't shine as much as the main dish. I did like the crinkle fries and the black bean salad (balances the chicken out well with its cold acidity). However, I'd skip the mac and cheese next time. It looked promising but it was too wet/overcooked and reminded me of lunchtime cafeteria mac and cheese.

OO. The banana pudding! Get it! It's different from all other banana puddings I've ever had. I liked the nilla wafer crunch and how thick the pudding was! It's very well-known for that. So definitely try it! 

Very reasonably priced. I paid ~$13 for a small white chicken (wing + breast), 3 sides, and banana pudding.

Great craft beers on tap!   Good food - better service!!
Wings are very good!!

My friend, wife and I happened upon this place and I must say it was a great find. Our waiter, Sean was fantastic. He came across sincere, not one of those "ok, excellent choice" b.s. Slingers you find in these type of places.  We started with a bottle Malbec ( which was terribly dry but paired well with our entrees) and the mussels. The broth of the mussels was so amazing we had to order more bread as to not miss a good soaking opp. It was under the small plate menu but three of us were satisfied as a starter. 

The entrees were on the small side, but they were soooo delicious. I had the steak, and my wife and friend had the chicken. My beef was cooked perfectly and the side of potato salad was a perfect comfort side that was one of the best I've had. The greens too were cooked perfectly (not over cooked which happens all too often). Both my wife and friend raved about the chicken. A rich dish with a perfectly cooked soft boiled egg. They sounded like they were orgasming in unison, which made me a bit jealous...for the food! 

Anyway, there are a lot of places you can go in this price point, but P&A ranks real high on my opinion. Three dishes ordered, all spectacular and a fantastic server (Sean) makes this a must return destination.

Invented in the 1950s at either Schnuck's or Tom Boy grocery store, the pork steak is a St. Louis favorite. Do you ever wonder where you can get one? Smoking Barrels smokes them to perfection and puts delicious sides on a plate for you. Please consider  SB BBQ the next time you want to dine-in, carry-out, or have your meal delivered. We visited there two weeks ago. I wanted to make sure to share my joy with you.

Oh my goodness I can't say enough good about this place! Some locals in Tennessee told me to check this place out because I was visiting from California and was that a great suggestion! The staff was super friendly, the biscuits were to die for with their home made sauce and the omlett I had was delicious. This place is definitely something you should check out if you are in Nashville.

Let me first start off by saying, this kills me to write such a bad review, because it is really really difficult to displease me at a restaurant. But this place, the way it's ran, just says we don't give a f*** anymore.... "Indirectly". The only positive experience I had here was with our waitress, it's out of her control what's going on, and she's working and dealing with it the best she can, which is more than what a lot of people are doing now a days. We walked in, air conditioning is broken. No sunbelt rental ac units, like a normal large, commercially owned chain would naturally do if they decide to stay open with broken air units. Anyways, we roughed it out, cause like I said, I'm difficult to displease. I walked into the restroom and was immediately and unpleasantly greeted with the strongest musty smell of mold and moisture, that I think I have ever encountered. My lungs immediately closed up, and I have no medical issues, if that tells you anything. There is so much black mold embedded in this building, it should be demolished and rebuilt. But under a new general manager, because obviously they do not care or, they are unfit for their position. What I really hate to report even more, was after my bathroom visit. Coming back to the table, I watched one of the cooks, literally wipe the sweat off his arms, hands, and entire face, and throw that rag literally right on a food prep counter next to the boiling pasta. And continue onto preparing food with no gloves and without washing his hands. I don't believe in getting people fired so I will not name names or describe them. Anyways, the food arrived, I did eat, and it was good flavored, but wasn't hot. Also, keep in mind, we were the only table in the restaurant at 3pm, so I mean there's no excuse, sorry, none at all. Only complaint I have about service is the slowness, but on the same token, short staffing makes everyone do more than their job initially required, so I'm sure they're strapped. But my advice to anyone wanting to come here. Don't.

First thing: the tofu and mushrooms vermicelli bowl is amaze balls. It came with cucumbers, lettuce, mushrooms, bean sprouts, mint leaves, tofu, carrots, vermicelli noodles...oh my... If y'all didn't know, vermicelli bowls are like salads with vermicelli noodles. Super great meal for Ash Wednesday and for only $11?! Yes please. Might get this every Friday for lent season... With my first bite, I tasted a slight mint flavor from the mint leaves, a great herb that Vietnamese people use in their dishes. Good thing is, doesn't even taste like you're eating herbs but it sure the hell is good for you. The mint herb enhances the whole dish along with the sauce that comes with it. With every additional bite, I tasted freshness upon freshness upon freshness. You could tell that all of the veggies used were FRESH, just how it should be. Generous portion, I took the rest of my meal home for dinner...and hours later, still tasted delicious.

Only minor complaint is...y'all should try using a fresher crunchy onion topping. The crunchy onion bits were sooo hard, I felt like I was chewing rocks and was worried my teeth would crack or something. When made right, the crunchy onions should not be rock hard, but the perfect crispy for that additional texture.

The name of this place was a bit misleading... I was expecting meat-lovers paradise, maybe a BBQ joint. Instead, the menu contains a surprising number of vegetarian and vegan friendly options. Don't worry though, there's still plenty of meat to be had, including maple bacon ice cream for dessert. 

I had the porchetta sandwich because porchetta is the best. The server recommended it as well, but I had pretty much already made up my mind. It came out quickly, no side, just the sandwich. It was filling enough though, I probably could have shared it along with a side and been satisfied. 

The service was great and the decor is cute. My sandwich was $11... Not cheap, but not unreasonable. I'm looking forward to coming back for the ice cream!
Great dinner. Aromas took great care of us.  The food was awesome. Highly recommended!
The sushi was fantastic and the steak sauce was tremendous!! Thanks to our great server Scott who made this a great experience!!

Well let me start off by saying that the wait staff at this place is wonderful well at least our waitress was. Thats about where it stopped though my wife ordered the country fried steak and to our shock it came out almost completely pink on the inside so naturally it was sent back. The waitress was very apologetic and brought her a beef Manhattan which unfortunately came out tasting a little funny as well so the damage had been done and she was finished. Now as for me i ordered the steak with the brandy butter which on the menu says they do not recommend you to get it over medium which as all of us steak lovers know is a good call for flavor sake. Well ironically it came out well done which made me chuckle i politely informed our already embarrassed waitress who kindly took it back to the kitchen for a redo. Now here is where it gets a little sad. The second try it came out rare :( so at this point what can you do but laugh. I had her send it back to the kitchen for a third and final try but to my dismay the same exact steak i was just served arrived at our table having just been thrown back on the grill which by the way was still not medium as recommended and had lost the brandy butter it should have been basted in. Overall a very poor showing and we will not be returning.

I ordered from Coconut Breeze via Uber Eats. I had the small jerk chicken with yams and Mac and cheese. The jerk chicken was amazing and the yams were okay but the mac was ver bland and left a lot to be desired. I would definitely go back but this time I'm staying away from the macaroni and cheese.

Real southern bar-b-que.  The pulled pork was perfect and sauce was pretty good too.  The chicken fell off the bone.  Service was as quick as the food disappeared.  Best iced tea I've ever had too.  I will seek out Al's again.   I need to try Aunt Russ's Pecan Pie.

On point!! Great food, atmosphere, cocktails! They all hit the mark at this place.  Tired of IPAs? This place has a great variety of lagers on tap in addition to their range of sexy cocktails to try.  The food is really good with everything from brunch classics to unique tacos at dinner.  Brunch is my favorite with an amazing Bloody Mary and the campfire toast is the perfect starter...not too sweet just right.  This place is casual enough to be comfortable while also being able to dress it up without standing out.  

Only con? Seat yourself.  That works during the day but this popular if a place on weekend nights should not be seat yourself with so many trying to 'stalk' tables

On this night I made an odessey to duffy's cuz as most innocent beautiful boy with a face as smooth as a clean cut piece of steak, I was famished after being an awesome cheerleader for my school #malecheerleaderlife.  It was weird at first like when Luke and Leia kissed at the end of the Empire Strikes Back because most people who have seen the film knew that they were brother and sister, but they did not know.  It was weird cuz I was the only child with a whistle.  I mean yeah I lift on the low low, but only when I am in Zumba class getting my groove on.  Oh back to my order. I ordered the French dip because I am a classy cat (alliteration;)).  And a crispy side of French fries, again I am artsy like when someone moves around trash and calls it modern art.  You know what it is not art it is organized trash.  So when I can take my jello cup and stack it on my pudding cup I am basically Picasso.  In conclusion trash is trash and art is art and my overall experience was fair so I give this place 6.9 hams out of 10.

Unfortunately I moved far away. 

Lucky's was my "go to" pub to grab an amazing gourmet burger and beer. The atmosphere is great, the bartenders rock, and the burgers...WOW! PBJ&Bacon is unbelievable. Even better was the Pumpkin Pattymelt. Holy crap - AMAZING!

I don't get down there much anymore as I moved to the Poconos, but I can say its one of my favorite Burger/Pubs of all time!

I had a very good experience here. I received a flyer in the mail so I decided to try it out. I've lived here for almost 8 months and haven't been able to really find a place with good pizza and wings.  I ordered a gluten free pizza with pepperoni and mushroom.  It was made with a cauliflower crust. It was sooooo good!  It had a crispy texture. Cooked perfectly AND it was the first pizza place I've encountered that isn't afraid to use pizza sauce here!  I have to say I was leery about trying gluten free. The pizza here made me a fan.  I also tried an order of mango habanero wings and an order of garlic parmesan wings. Both were absolutely delicious and cooked perfectly. The price, $10.99 was reasonable for 8 wings too. Most of the places in this area overcharge for wings these days.  I'm so glad I found this place so close to my home. I will definitely be back!

This restaurant deserves 6 stars! Had a truly wonderful time at Dunedin's new prohibition kitchen last night. The service was stellar, our food came out quickly and our server was on his A+ Game the entire evening. When the food came out, it tasted delicious. Was also super impressed by the decor. One of the most well decorated speakeasies that I've been to yet. Can't wait to go back soon!

This is the worst experience I've ever had in a restaurant! Had friends from out of town, we were on bourbon street and this guys outside the restaurant waved us in to check them out. This was the worst restaurant I've ever eaten in New Orleaans. The gumbo was cold. Had to return it for them to warm it up and tried calling one of the waitress (Jess) over she told us she is not our waitress and walk off. The utensils were dirty with food stain wrap in napkin. We were just about to eat the jambalaya and a big roach came from behind me on the wall and one of the waiter who wave us in had to come in and kill it almost fell in our food.  He got the manager for us, Jessica Becker, she told us it's New Orleans what do we expect! Wow!!!!!!!!!!!I wonder if the health department was there, would they have felt the same way! She was rude and unapologetic. The manager and the waitress Jess needs to get retrained on customer service and how to treat people who come to spend money in their restaurant.  The only person that was apologetic was the black guy by the door, he was very kind, he should be the manager instead, he knows how to treat customers. The manager Jessica and the other waitress Jess  acted like they didn't want to be at work nor cared  about the customers. We will never go there again!!!!!  I don't even want to give them one star!!! Save your money go elsewhere!!!!!
We had drinks and shared a blt that was one of my favorites.  Something about sitting on the white sand beach.  This would be the place to go and future stops will be compared to
Just left there.  This is as close to Roselyn's as you'll find anywhere.  The danish was oh so good.  They even were selling King Cakes for Mardi Gras!

Excellent Food, Great ambience and Awesome Service!  
Enjoyed the Sushi rolls and the best Passion Fruit creme brûlée !!

A nice little Italian sandwich shop run by a NY transplant and former banker who is now much happier in life!  I got a turkey sandwich with hummus and some other things on it and it was very tasty.  It came with a little side of pasta salad.  Now the pasta salad looked pretty basic, just some fusilli with chopped red onion and olives but the more I ate it the more I liked it.  I think the owner/chef is just really good at coming up with tasty flavors, even if they look deceptively simple.  The pasta salad had a light vinaigrette-like sauce that's hard to describe and even harder to put down!

We had cannolis too and they were great!  I asked him if there was a liqueur in the cannoli cream and he said there wasn't, but there were some secret ingredients in there.  Again, you get more tastiness than you'd expect and that's just lovely.

We arrived late and they were out of some of their more popular chicken parm and meatball dishes.  The owner said he wants to add dinner service soon, so I am looking forward to that!

One of the worst Indian food experiences I've had in a while. We used to love coming to Aman's but their quality has gone down. We were seated at 6:05 and did not get any water or anything until 6:19. The restaurant was also half empty so it wasn't like they were super busy or anything. We then got to order our food at 6:24 and by 7:15, still hadn't gotten the food. I ordered the salted laasi which ended up smelling putrid as if it had been made with spoiled milk or yogurt.

This establishment had some tasty eats, but was really nothing to write home about. My friends and I spent 4 days in New Orleans and this wasn't our favorite meal. The service was quite slow even though there was no one really there when we went. It took about 45 minutes to get our food, and we were not that pleased.

This place is pretty damn rocking and not to mention it pretty much stays that way all day, especially when its nice out.  Both times we came here it was hopping.  The staff is definitely a little slow at times, but you are on the beach, so chill and enjoy the view.  The food is alright, nothing too out of the ordinary, but the party and fun atmosphere is what gets this place the little something extra.  We even came here at night for a jazz band, and everyone was going wild!  This is a must go!

We dined at the Sushiwa last night and had an excellent meal!.  Service was outstanding and the new atmosphere is very attractive.  Its a nice byob when you are looking for good food served fresh and authentic.

I was very disappointed in my stay at Embassy Suites on Julia St. My husband and I arrived for a wedding shower and then had reservations to stay there again with the wedding party in one month. We valeted my vehicle and then noticed that the right side of the vehicle was hit and both doors had to be replaced. This happened while the car was in their possession. We were told that a claim would be filed and that it would be taken care of. However, after we checked out and traveled home we learned that the hotel and/or valet service would not cover the cost to have the vehicle fixed. have made contact with the general manager and two separate occasions with no positive outcomes. We have since canceled our reservations for next month and the wedding party has as well. We will be staying at another hotel and because of this experience I will never return to Embassy Suites.

If zero stars was an option, I'd rate Johnny's with that. Horrible service, rude, long wait. Server didn't check on us the whole time even though we kept trying to get his attention. Had to literally get up and walk over to him to ask for check. This isn't the first time this has happened, but I thought I'd give them a third chance. I bet if I walked out on my tab, they wouldn't have even known. I will never visit this place again! 


Update: 11/09/17 Still horrible. Went after Tarpon's First Friday, but thought, hey just going to the bar for some drinks, what could be so bad? Well the bartenders were half tanked and paid no attention. Had about 10 people in our group and after one round took our business elsewhere.

So here's what's up: I had a concern about my receipt showing incorrect tip %s (basically the suggested tip % at the bottom was off--it said "20% is $X" but it was actually 40% of the total--this also happened to my friend's receipt), I didn't think THAT much of it (like maybe it was some software issue with their receipt app or whatever) but I emailed Datz weeks ago to let them know of the error because I thought they'd want to know--esp since at the bottom of the receipt, they say to please email them for any concerns/suggestions... but I never got a response. I also messaged them on social media and never got a response, which I think is p darn unprofessional, esp if you specifically ASK for feedback ON your receipt? It's like, claiming that a manager will reach out to you on Yelp but they never do (happens a lot LOL). Like, how hard is it just to reply with "Oh wow, we had no idea that was happening! We will look into the issue and get it resolved ASAP! Thank you for contacting us about this so we can fix it." Datz, if you're reading, you can copy & paste that as a response to my email, but I'm still waiting for a response.

OK besides that whole skadoo, I enjoyed my meal. They did mess up my order (I don't eat dairy and specifically said "no cheese" twice but both parts of my meal came with cheese on it) and fixed it. The food was good, but I think they need to work on their managerial skills...

For as long as it's been around, I had never actually been to Stove and Tap, so we stopped in for lunch on a Sunday. My first impression while walking in was, well, impressed. It is much more spacious on the inside than I had thought. Also, the decor was unique and well done. I was very surprised at how busy it seemed to be during a Sunday, but we were sat pretty quickly. Once my table was sat, we were greeted by our waitress, but this is where things started going downhill. It wasn't the usual, friendly welcome, it was very quick and not at all personable. I can't remember her even telling us her name. Also, on our first greeting we were already expected to know our orders..at a place we've never been to, within just a couple minutes of having been seated. Now, I am VERY understanding of how hard it is to be attentive to tables during busy hours, but the welcome is probably the most important part because you need your customers to feel  wanted. So, continuing on to ordering, I realized there were rarely any menu items available for vegetarians, and especially not for vegans. Most things either have bacon or egg slipped in them somewhere. I wasn't able to order any of the entrees, so I ended up ordering an appetizer of Mac and cheese without the brisket as my entree. Yikes. We also had the shrimp skewers which were actually delicious, but way overpriced. By the time we got our entrees, my partner and I were disappointed. Although my Mac and cheese did taste great, there's no reason it should have been listed under "shareables" because this was definitely a one person portion. My boyfriend really hated his flatbread, mentioning several times that it tasted like dominoes quality. However, our waitress never came to check on us while dining, so we never had the chance to mention how unsatisfied we were, or order anything else. The next time our waitress decided to visit was to hand us our check. By that time we were ready to leave. We paid and left, with no plans to return. I had high hopes for  this restaurant and honestly believe they could have done so much better, but the menu needs some strong updating, and this particular waitress needed much better customer service.
Best wings I've ever had. Get them well done if you want your mind blown. So good!! Friendly staff, family friendly, cute outdoor space.

2 hamburger, a salad, a glass of wine and a few beer shouldn't cost $100 for dinner. Over priced averaged food. The bar scene was crowded on Friday. Good service. But, $100 for basic average food is not worth it. Just my opinion.
Bring your appetite. Excellent Nachos, very flavorful and enormous portions, plenty enough for 2 people. Yum!

Service and ambiance are on point, but the food lacks flavor. The portions are very small so doing the family style would be smart! I'd come back for drinks, snack, and atmosphere, never for a full meal.
It was ok, had the chicken philly, that was good.  Wing sauce is not too good on the wings. Felt like it was a local only bar.

Korean and Japanese fare is easily accessible for a decent price in heaping portions.  The kim chee is just great now and then.  Best time to go is Fridays after 3pm - the plate prices drop below five dollars.

You might need to wait a little bit for this truck to get your food into the Styrofoam plate, but it's worth it ... a good food truck meal with normal amounts of greasiness and I can't complain about the ingredients.

They sometimes have got a TV running in the window so while you wait you can watch.  It's a better place to get your Korean/Japanese food fix than either Han Wool (Between 36th St & Steve Murray Way on Chestnut) or Nara (40th & Spruce) - pricing is better, food is just a little less good, service is faster.

My favorite pizza place in the city! One of my favorite pizza places on earth. The pizza is great, and the spicy calamari is amazing too. The best part of the pizza is the high quality pepperoni. Hit up pietro when your near Rittenhouse Park.
This is our standard takeout place, and we've also ate out here several times. Excellent food, consistently fast and reliable service, very low prices. Highly recommended.
The food is just ok but the reward of Giving to the great cause that this restaurant chain support is worth going for. Supports veterans

Customer service sucks!
Strike 1: I'm the only customer in the entire store, somehow my bagel is never ready in less than 5 minutes because the guy is not getting bagel out of the toaster.

Strike 2: two weeks ago I asked for bacon, egg, and cheese on a bagel and I got cream cheese instead! I called an hour later and the manager lady said she would "get me" the next day. The following day I got a free bacon, egg, and cheese on a bagel and it was very nice of them... Until...

Strike 3: the only customer in the entire store, I said good morning to the bagel guy, he replied without making eye contact, didn't care to service me, kept on checking a tinny list in a small piece of paper and totally ignored me, meanwhile manager lady kept her back at me but I know she saw me coming in, because of the noise of the door, 2 minutes went by and nobody asked me what in hell I need, I'm going to be late for work, good bye così. I left without my breakfast.
Also, like another review said, you have to repeat your order to them.
I feel sorry for the business Corp, they need to train these guy ASAP, or they will have to close this store.

I wish I found this place sooner. It's a great place for a "quick fix". They have quality sandwiches and salads, and seems like it is built more for take-out rather than eating in. That being said, they do have seating outside and limited seating inside, but it is more of a restaurant front than anything else. They have a pretty random menu, but I haven't ever thought that their food was bad. It's a great place to go for a quick meal and I'm sure I'll be back when I don't have the energy to cook.

Ehhh I wish I could leave a better review but we walked in and there were two staff members with their backs to us cleaning. Didn't turn around and say hello we had to try and get there attention. Overall they were very unfriendly and acted as if we were walking in 10 minutes to closing while they weren't closing for another hour. PB and J smoothie was delicious and so was the cheesesteak wrap. We got the pho special and it was the blandest thing I've ever eaten. No seasoning what so ever. Would be willing to give it another shot.
This place was great. The fish was fresh which was sea bass tonight. The drinks were pretty good so I couldn't complain. We will be back!
I love Cracker Barrel the food is always good here you can get anything off the menu and not be disappointed they showing the menu down due to the whole COVID-19 But that lemonade is always on point

Nice little hole-in-the wall around town- definitely a tavern.  Lots of appetizers on the menu looked good to try - we loved the fried pickles and potato skins.  The philly cheesesteaks are good, not as full as I am used to seeing but a great value.

LUNA Restaurant and Lounge is located inside of the Hilton Carillon Park Hotel in the Feather Sound area of Clearwater. Now before you gag at the thought of a hotel restaurant. let me say that the food and service are excellent and worthy of a visit even if you work nearby, or you're just looking for a nice sit-down restaurant in the area. There is plenty of free parking out front, and the crowd tends to be more professional and less touristy than some of the restaurants across the way.

LUNA opens at 6am for breakfast, and features an affordable $15 breakfast buffet as well as a traditional menu. The menu includes organic egg dishes, malted pancakes, French toast, waffles, frittatas, and more. The lunch menu has soups, salads, pizzas and flatbreads, sandwiches, and lunch-sized entrées. Dinner is a more formal presentation of the lunch options, but the menu also includes steaks, fish, seafood, South African lobster tails, and a variety of chops, ribs, and Italian specialties. Food is served until late in the evening.

I was on-site at the Hilton for a three-day conference, and since we had arranged a continental breakfast inside of our conference room each morning, I skipped the breakfast buffet. But I did have lunch there on the first day of the conference when the weather was a bit nasty. For lunch I ordered a cup of their Blue Crab bisque, and followed that with the Lobster & Crab B.L.T. sandwich, which was chunks of Maine lobster meat, lump crab meat, bacon, lettuce, and tomato on toasted whole-grain bread with homemade Remoulade Sauce. WOW, that was good!!!

Our group did tend to hangout in the lounge later each night (*insert shocked look here*) for some tasty Adult cocktails, local craft beers, and glasses of wine. After the appropriate amount of liquid libations we moseyed on back to the alcove with the billiards table and tried our best to keep the balls from going airborne.

LUNA is a very classy restaurant which is just off of Ulmerton Road, and well worth a visit if you'd enjoy an upscale dining experience for a very reasonable price.

Justin at Taze made it right for us.  The minute he found out about the issue he told us that he would replace the food we didn't receive.  He offered a buffet or the exact order we had plus any delivery fees we had from our courier.  

We all loved the food!
Food is pretty good, but honestly not a lot of options that are meatless or gluten friendly. Service is usually not great, so dockimg a syar there. To go is best.

Oh, how I miss you, 'ole CB.  Every Friday morning in high school, we met for breakfast before heading to HSE, filling up on fried eggs, biscuits and gravy, grits, hash brown cassarole, and coffee.  I still stop by after all these years whenever I visit Fishers, and I'm never disappointed.  Granted, I stick to the breakfasts... the other meals don't look as appetizing.

There are no CBs in all of California... the closest one is in Yuma, Arizona.  I might as well fly to Indy, it'll take me less time than to drive to Yuma.
This place is great.  Delicious, fresh, inexpensive mexican food.  I always leave stuffed! Nothing fancy here, just good food, good service, good price.  Great place when craving Mexican!

The place is a little small so it will be really crowd on weekend. But it is clean and nice. I came here on the lunch time and the table was almost full.

I went here several times, but today is my visit after more than a year. Nothing quite change. And i ordered the same menu, tan tan Noodle which was ok. My mom ordered spicy ramen that tasted good. And takoyaki for appetizer.

The price of the ramen is average about 10 dolars or so. U'll get a medium size of bowl. And u have to pay for hot tea, 1 dolar and no refill. Better ask for water if u want to save some money. Lol.

The pizza and salads at Pietro's are the best! This is a low key, fun place to go for lunch or dinner. Highly recommend the insalata mista and really any pizzas - every single one I've tried has been great.

Have stayed here several times at a great price after bidding on priceline. Nice "business" motel. This time the housekeeping services seemed especially good. Room was very clean. Breakfast at Shulas is wonderful and the service there is excellent. Ask for a room away from the elevators, which are noisy 
There is a panera bread right across the street, and a mall w maggiannos and pf changs.

I ordered a veggie deluxe sandwich with no cheese (I'm vegan) and it wasn't awful.  Just an overwhelming sense of bread because the bread-to-veggie ratio was off.  But at least the bread was good.  The one star is because 1) the place smelled BAD.  I mean, how do you make a pizza place smell bad?  That's got to be some awful funk.  But I stuck with it.  2) After they put in the order the guy in back yelled "Another f...in' veggie sandwich!"  Nice hospitality there.  Made me feel real welcome.
Food amizing. Everything is very good . You not gonna go wrong. The server , the Bar Tender and the place the best.

Okay, so I am torn here.  This place has GREAT food!  My table tried the street tacos, the corn, the queso, the guacamole, veggie chimichanga, shroom quesadilla, and the grilled jalepenos.  Again, great food, outside of the beans which were undercooked and hard when you bit into them.

What wasn't so great, was that for a party of 6, where two of the people were under the age of 3, the meal cost over 120 dollars and gratuity was already included in the receipt.  They also charge for each soda you drink, not just who orders the soda, each soda has it's own cost.  I was not made aware of this until we noticed the charges on the receipt.  

The decor is really cute, I love the Dia de los Muertos theme they have going on.  The tables and chairs are okay, could be nicer quality.

Lastly, the portions are... TINY!  My shrimp street tacos had, I'm not kidding here, a tablespoon of cut up tiny little shrimp.  Again, it tasted fantastic, but I was just still hungry after I had my two bites!  

If you are fine paying high prices for small portions of great food, you will love Memos!

One of my favs!!

Great steaks and great service. Not to mention the prices are great!!!

I also love the pizza!!!!!

Get there early.

Excellent pizza and salads . My favorites are the Greek salad and white pizza . They have many beers on tap and a very chill vibe . I always receive friendly service and it keeps me coming back time and time again .
Great food, authentic to Spain they have a great beer selection for Estrella and still have some of the few coveted 1906 black label and red vintage you have to go check it out!

I was visiting my sis & brother-in-law in Boise. They had already been to several in Meridian & Eagle, mostly disappointing. We have high expectations when it comes to any kind of Asian Food. We lived in the Bay Area for a long time and we find none better.
When it comes to Vietnamese food this nice, clean friendly staffed restaurant meets the bill!!. 3 are for $40. Spicy Chicken for Bro..andca big change up in the rice. Spicy tender white rice. Very good. Sissy had dumpling Pho. Everything they make from the ground up. I ALWAYS follow the Banh Xeo. That means authentic in my opinion.
Theirs was Great. A must have rice & tumeric crispy crepe with sliced roast pork & shrimp, sprouts, cilantro & basil.
Now Boise has their own authentic Vietnamese food.

A search of local breakfast places turned up EAT. The menu sounded really good, and the promise of something close to a fried green tomatoes eggs Benedict had my girlfriend sold. We got there right at ten and could not believe the place was almost empty considering it's proximity to bourbon st. The food was everything we hoped for and more.  Great food, great service, great little place. This is truly a hidden gem in NOLA.

Went in today to try them out live 5 minutes away I love wings had 12 wings 6 blackened and 6 lemon pepper and onion rings called in the order young lady stated 20 minutes was on point onion rings was the best they had but I have had better now let's get to these unflavored wing tasted just like it was chicken no flavor at all they were hot and fresh but that's it will I go back NO will buy wings from Pizza Hut the worst I have had and I have had a lot of wings
..was a favorite for me for quite a while..had many lunches n dinners there...food n service always good..great seating options n view too..fastish service..Great for LOL area!!

Not very impressed. Probably considered a nice place when I was in college. Being next to a bottle shop, I was expecting a better beer selection. Such disappointing beers on tap. The food was very mediocre at best. The banh mi sandwich tasted pretty bland. Not worth the money for the sandwich. Save that money and go get it on Washington ave!
You guys need more servers which would make your service alot better and quicker. Took 30 mins to get water after we asked. Shame

Been here numerous times over the years for family dinners mostly because my retiree parents have better success finding something they're willing to eat on the menu that many other places.  Certainly not fine dining but generally reliable in their execution of the dishes they offer.  Some favorites are the mussel appetizer dish and the sausage and lentil soup.  I personally think they succeed better at many of their grilled dishes than their pasta dishes but that could be my own bias.  I've seen some complaints about service from some other reviewers but overall my experience has been very attentive service.   Not bad, generally a pleasant experience and solid meal.

Nice place with a cool concept. Unfortunately, I went during lunch and it was pretty packed, but that's not a bad thing and in no way reflects negatively on the establishment. I got the Seattle Ceasar salad (I know, not very adventurous, but it sounded good), it was tasty and I liked it, though I would have liked a little more Salmon in the salad. The group I was with had good things to say about their food, so I'm guessing all the food is pretty good and next time I'll try something different. Personally, I'm not crazy about standing in line to order, then walking to another area to pay, then sitting down to eat, the format seems too 'fast food' for such a nice place, but that's just my opinion. All in all, I enjoyed it and will more than likely return again.

After a long day of shopping on Royal we were super parched.

We popped in and grabbed a seat at the busy bar. 

Pricey drinks but fun to sit at the bar and chat with the oyster shucker. Super nice guy, he has been shuckin en for 20 years!

We split the spinach and artichoke appetizer which was good.

Would love to come back next time we are in town and check out their dinner menu. They also had happy hour but it didn't start until 4pm

Summary: Homestyle comfort foods. 

This isn't a place I normally think of for a meal.  However, someone else chose it for a meeting so I got the opportunity to try it again. I have nothing against Bob Evans, however the menu is mostly things I can cook at home just as well as Bob. People tell me I do okay in the kitchen: Why pay for what I can do cheaper and maybe better?

Like Denny's or IHOP--both of which seem interchangeable to me with Bob Evans--the meal was acceptable and the service satisfactory. Consistency and familiarity are the reasons chain restaurants exist.
Brendan whined me into giving him 5 stars.  :)  And he's such a nice guy, I'll do it for him.

China Park is so delicious. All the food we ordered was tasty and well prepared: Roast Pork with Vegetables, Hunan Shrimp (spicy), Singapore Mei Fun, Egg Rolls, House Fried Fries and Chicken Wings were all good. We really enjoyed. This is a take-out aoot so no dine in option available. If you are around Fish Hawk looking for some good Chinese food, go to China Park!
Amazing service.  Food is excellent.  The waitstaff are very professional and know their stuff. Awesome decor.  Loved the experience.
I really like this location.  The staff is nice and helpful.  I have never had a bad experience and it is a typical Starbucks.  It is just a normal experience...

I upped the stars by one, as on our last visit the food was good, and so was the service. I ventured out and tried the veal piccata again just for comparison - this time, lots of sauce, including plenty for the pasta (which I requested). Food was served hot too. Others had the steak salad, lamb, and lasagna - all were pleased.
Pretty standard Vietnamese joint, but your money is better spent around the corner at Dong Phuong.

We were excited to try this place but were quickly disappointed!!! We were initially upset to find out that they only split tables into 2 checks. We were a party of 7 with 3 couples & one individual so we ended up sitting separately. We found out later this is common in New Orleans. Still don't understand the reasoning but that was not the big issue. My husband & I ordered the gumbo & a cheeseburger to share. The food came out oddly fast. The gumbo lacked flavor, & the cheeseburger was raw! Thankfully we we were sharing it so I cut it in half. If not, we may have eaten some before noticing it. The waitress was extremely rude & tried to tell us it was because we were sitting under a red light & had me walk to the front to look at it in different lighting. She then tried to say it was medium & they typically serve then med-well. We were not asked how we wanted it cooked when ordering & that burger was not medium! They did remove the burger from our check so we only paid for the bland gumbo but we will not return. Everyone in our group said the service was terrible & food well below average. I have attached a picture of the burger.

Heard really good things about this place but was unhappy with the service. Hostess got upset when I didn't want to sit in a chair but in a booth(I could see 3 open from where I stood alone). Good food that came out very quick. Took longer to pay the check than get our food. Will not be going back $50 is too much for burgers without alcohol on the bill.

The beer selection is very good. I especially liked the No. 7IPA and the Stranger than Fiction Porter. Our waitress was nice and helpful. I ordered a half rack of ribs and the garlic mashed potatoes and pickles. The potatoes were a little cold by the time I got them, but really good flavor and texture, and the pickles were sweet and spicy/hot. I liked both. The ribs were pretty chewy and not fall off the bone type. The flavor on the ribs was good. It was a dry rub with homemade sauce on the side. I think if the ribs were softer and the sauce was on the ribs they would have been fantastic. The sauce was really really good. My wife got chicken tacos that she said were good. The atmosphere was kind of like sitting in someone's run down kitchen. Not very good, but it was clean and they are moving to a larger nicer location in December. This place is very close to being a 5 star if they changed a few things.

Moved to the beach 5 months ago...still haven't eaten better french toast than this place!! Been quite a few time with the boyfriend...busy busy. Sometimes that is good, sometimes not so much, don't like being pushed around, elbow to elbow while you try to move, then don't go to the back bar on a weekend night.

I'm writing this review from the perspective of a LA native who just relocated to Nashville. This Chinese food was...weird. It wasn't inedible or anything, but it was not like any Chinese food I have ever had before. The fried green bean appetizer came with RANCH. Say whaaaa? Bizarre. And the garlic chicken literally tasted like BBQ chicken in a watery garlic sauce. The meat quality was good but the flavor was very odd.  Honestly, the strange flavors interfered with my ability to appreciate the fact that the Singapore street noodles were, at least, reminiscent of Chinese food. I won't be going here again because it made me sad.  Hopefully, my quest for decent and authentic Chinese cuisine in Nashville will eventually be met with some success.

I always enjoy going to the Bistro because of their atmosphere, there multitude of beers on draft, and their food. You can sit outside or in depending on your preference. If you're up to it, you can even visit the upstairs outdoor area. All in all, a great place to unwind and relax.
MMMMMMM. this is my favorite sandwich shop. I recommend the meatball sandwich. The staff is extremely friendly too.
This place is amazing! Their yiro meat is so good, highly recommend coming here. Can't wait to eat here again!

We enjoyed our lunch here.  The buffet has a lot of choices.  That being said...Chinese food never tastes fresh at a buffet restaurant.  The ambience is average at best and cleanliness could be better.  If you keep your expectations low, you will enjoy your meal here.
Love this place, the food is great, the staff is friendly, and the athmosphere is pretty good - typical italian.

This cart is easy to spot: Just look for the one with smoke billowing out of it. As you get closer, you'll notice the smell of delicious grilled chicken, the appearance of his cart covered by ingredients, and the sound of the chef's booming voice.

Instructions are simple. Stand in line. When it's your turn, receive a container full of food. Hand over $10 (cash only). Leave and enjoy.

What's in the container is subject to change. There are only two constants: The delicious charcoal grilled chicken and the crispy-on-the-outside, green-and-delicious-on-the-inside falafel. Otherwise, I've gotten combinations of chickpeas, greens/salads, rice, pasta, humus, spicy peppers, bread, pita, apples, grapes, berries, sauces, etc. It's a surprise each time and I've never been disappointed.

One piece of advice to first-timers: Know the rules.
-Don't ask what's on the menu. You're getting what he's giving, just know that it's delicious and fresh. Asking will launch him into a rant about the quality of the ingredient, how much work/time it takes to pick and prep, and how you should only put the best stuff into your body. Be warned: He might launch into this rant at any moment anyway. Just nod and smile.
-You can only order 1. Asking for 2 or more can get you sent to the back of the line or out of the line.
-Don't crowd the sidewalk. Forms a neat, single-file line against the building. He'll tell you to get back if you are blocking people.
-No substitutions. And don't ask for extra. The one exception is asking for vegetarian. He'll happily abide and throws on extra everything else to compensate the lack of chicken, so don't worry, you're still getting your money's worth.

I visit the Plymouth Meeting location at least once a week with my kids, it's always great! The food is great, service is usually pretty fast and my kids will eat veggies here in just about anything. The atmosphere is really bright and clean and we love sitting outside on a nice day.

My wife and I had Friday night reservations in early December. We sat at the bar before dinner to have some cocktails. Kyle was awesome and got us started off right. Dinner was EXCELLENT. The bone marrow appetizer was mind blowing. I could've just kept ordering it. The potatoes aligot appetizer was all I hoped it would be as well. Our server was great, the meal was top notch, and we visited the bar one more time for hand crafted excellence and some recommendations before we headed into the Gulch for more libations. If I find myself in Nashville again, I will be paying another visit.

Ordered the ahi club sandwich. Looked over the menu closely to make sure I knew what was on it, because I have allergies, specifically to avocado. Menu says there's no avocado on this sandwich, but my sandwich had sizable slices of avocado on it. I'm allergic so I couldn't eat it at all. I wouldn't have ordered this if it was described accurately on the menu.
This place is very good pizza joint hidden in town n country off of waters ave the magherita pizza and garlic knots and garlic parm wings yummy
They finally take cards !!!  Good drinks the can get slammed in am. Good breakfast burritos.

I have enjoyed the food at this restaurant since they opened. But there is new management and the bar is not managed the way it was. I ordered a Skinny Margarita for $8.00. They no longer carry that brand of tequila so I was told I had to choose the bar brand or a list of others and the cost would start at $8. I chose Jose Cuervo medium and they go on their way to make my drink. Nothing was said to me about the cost. I got my bill and was charged $16! For this freaking drink!  When questioned, I was told the choice of tequila would have been $18 -that's $10 for choosing Jose over bar brand-but they gave me a break for happy hour!  I'm so disappointed with this place because I love their vegetarian fajitas. But I'm not sure I will return after being bar -raped for a simple drink.  I could have gone to the VIP Lounge and gotten an Italian margarita for $10 and would have been ecstatic!
Loco offers inexpensive, but tasty Mexican fare. Highly recommend the chorizo queso. Good size patio and cool little bar area inside. Lots of available parking in lot and on street.

I was at the Continental Midtown Diner on June 12, 2015 at approximately 11:00 pm. My girlfriend and I sat at a table indoors near the car and ordered a cocktail. When she got up to se the restroom, she slipped on a depression that was in the floorboard and fell. We asked to see a manager abs relocated to the bar. When the manager, Brendan, came over, he thanked me for bringing the safety concern to his attention and moved a table over the depression. I asked for his business card and ge went to go get it. In the meantime, our server from the table, had us close out the check for the cocktails we ordered with her. While we were sitting at the bar, we waited for approximately fifteen minutes for someone to greet us, even though there were three bartenders and the bar was not full. Once greeted, they took our order and brought out our food. Unfortunately they did not provide us with any plates, napkins, or cutlery. We finishe our food and asked for the check. The server asked how our experience was and I explained that my girlfriend had fallen on the faulty floorboard and that I was STILL waiting for the manager to give me his card. We waited another twenty minutes for our second  check which the manager, Brandon, brought out. He told us he "took care" of this check except that he charged a beer to my card that I opened the tab with so that I could "take care of my server/bartender". I told him that I works be happy to "take care of my server/bartender" in cash. He offered to again void the check but at that point I had already waited long enough I and was so disgusted by the service that I wanted to leave immediately. So basically, my friend was injured at your restaurant, I paid two checks, and my card was authorized for $6.60 without my permission so that I could "take care of my servers". The ironic thing is that I worked for Starr Restaurants in 2003 and ur was a great experience for me. I know what the Starr standard is and I am truly disappointed that I even need to spend more time writing this feedback. Needless to say, I will NEVER be patronizing the Continental Midtown again and am very apprehensive to paronuze any Starr establishment.

This place was absolute garbage. The food was very cold and the gumbo had uncooked rice. The guy walking around was moody and it took forever just to get cold food. We spend over $100 for cold rice and alright sandwiches. It was over priced as well.
THE BEST DEEP DISH. I am from Chicago and let me just say their deep dish was amazing, if not better than the 5 places ive tried in Chicago. GREAT prices for their deep dish too!
First time trying their açaí bowl and it tasted great! It kept me satisfied after my workout.

What a fun experience at this hidden gem away from the hustle and bustle of the French Quarter!  Hidden in a residential area, it is easily accessible using the Canal Street Streetcar.  Our server, Wes, was attentive and the food was both delicious and plentiful.  It is worth the trip for the taste of Mexico.

Haven't eaten here yet but plan to soon! HOWEVER, we had to drive through the parking lot to turn around this evening. The valet yelled "F*** You!" and flipped off my car when I told them I just needed to turn around and started driving away.

Very mediocre, even more so after having to wait 20 minutes after our reservation time to be seated on a weeknight. No where to stand either, so we had to wait outside. 

Bruchetta was probably the highlight of the meal. The proscuitto was average quality at best. The "salad" with it was a ball of mixed greens with dressing? Really? 

The pasta with a porcini sauce, was really an incredibly rich white sauce with porcini mushrooms (which in total, probably was a single cap, very skimpy). 

The crab was very fishy (needed salt & lemon for sure, some pepper wouldn't have hurt) and overcooked. The portions of this dish were 1/5 pasta, 1/5 crab and 3/5 tomato sauce.... 

Honestly, I had heard this place was a nice cozy authentic Italian BYOB. 

Also, the host mid-way through our meal turned on the radio behind my GF and it was literally the radio and not on a station. It kept going back & forth between music and static. 

Pay a bit more and go to Melograno. Raddichio's food is 10x better for the same price. La Viola is better than Porcini and cheaper as well...

Great coffee and breakfast too. Best coffee in Reno IMO. The only place in Reno with hemp milk. For the hardcore coffee drinkers out there, try the "dirty hippie Chai" its a chai" with hemp milk(hippie) and a shot of espresso (dirty), its fantastic. NOTE: its not on the menu so lets keep this dirty little secret between us. :)

Great meal - very fresh, delicious veal. Portions not large (but probably good thing). Bread was outstanding. Service was great from time we walked in. Definetly will come back just not on first Friday we had kids banging on glass by our table.
Good food, good service. We went at night and it was just a little too dark in there. I get they were trying to set a "mood", but it needs to be a little brighter inside lol

This place is iconic, and one of only a few surviving restaurants in a lone East Side strip mall just off 465 and East Washington Street. 

The chili is fine, they offer a mountain of faux cheddar, and it has stayed in business since I was a twinkle in my father's eye. I was there with my brother tonight, and we remarked how when we were young this was a staple. 

That said, it hasn't aged perfectly, but for a few bucks and those interested in what fast food chili amounts to in Cincy, give it a go... maybe just once.
This was my first experience and the host was really great. The host was trying to put new things in the menu which is kind of really cool.
Best food! The calzones are amazing. If you like jalapeño try it on the calzone. They are extra hot and tasty. Service is typically not bad. Great lunch menu and of course beer is top notch

Good food, good ambience and excellent service.  A winner for sure in our books.  Had the fried alligator which was a tad salty but surely hits the spot.  We got the braised pork cheeks which we've not have anything like it and was delicious.  Even the basic max and cheese they got it right.  The gulf fish was done just right and was fresh. Definitely a place I be back again that it hey have it in Singapore :)

Amazing food and staff. Always a treat to eat here. 

They have a great selection of food with indoor and outdoor seating. Plenty of parking.

Live nearby and this is our go-to place for breakfast dining. The food is excellent, the service is friendly and very good. The prices are extremely reasonable, especially considering the large portions; when my wife and I eat there we usually take home enough for another whole meal.

I have been here a few times before, last time being maybe 5 months ago. My boyfriend and I came here over the weekend when we went out for drinks and I rushed to come here so I could have their gumbo I remember to be delicious. What they gave me was complete shit. Not the same. Very bland. Not even warm and it looked like it had been microwaved and sat on expo for 30 minutes before bringing it to me. Not worth $10 when you can go anywhere else nearby for great food and your money's worth. My boyfriend got heated up frozen pancakes. What happened to this place? On top of it all, the servers were very unprofessional and completely inattentive. They gave us the absolute worst service I've received in a long time. They need some serious training and maybe new management that takes the business and their service seriously. Unfortunately, I wont be coming back. Sad.

I went here just for ice cream after seeing the reviews about the great flavors but there wasn't nearly as much variety as I expected.  They had 10, maybe 15 varieties and nothing really super out of the ordinary.  I got the Key Lime Pie, which is not a flavor I'd normally choose, but I wanted something different.  It was good, maybe a little too limey for my taste though.  It's pretty close to my house so I'll probably go back when I'm down that way, but I was a little disappointed.

You've done it, Han. Having been in a 2 year relationship despite the ups and downs, we've always worked it out... but this time, a broken hearted soul walks out carrying painful memories. 

My usual dishes I ordered for take-out tasted nothing like the experiences I enjoyed in the past. Mistakes have been made in the past I forgave but this is noteworthy of sharing: 

- Dry Pepper Tofu: Overcooked and fried to the point it became dried crunch balls. No tofu to be found. Who knew it was possible to fry food until all moisture content was lost? Noted. 

- Dry Pepper Style Chicken: first time I could not tell what meat I ordered. It was dry and harsh to chew, not to mention swallow. The entire dish was loaded with peppers that my friends could only pick out ten pieces of meat. 

- Dry Pot Rabbit: first time ever trying this, a friend felt daring. Wouldn't recommend because all we remembered were bones with little meat for a $20+ dish. 

- Green Beans: To complete the meal, I believe greens are needed but not wrinkly overcooked ones. Sigh. 

- Dan dan noodles: only acceptable part.

Overall: Everything was overcooked and dry. Granted it was a Sunday night, Han, I have faith you can love on us loyal customers better than this. Please and thank you. We sincerely want to support you.
Yours truly.
Love love love!! So thrilled to have a gluten free spot for lunch and dinner! The chicken and sauces are amazing, my husband and I crave this place!

If I have my druthers, I prefer a straight hotel versus a resort since resorts, in their effort to have everything you need on the property and be convenient for you, end up being inconvenient.  And expensive.  That said, I do love this property.  Fountains and gardens and canals, oh my!  There are a line of concierges waiting to assist with a smile.  Pools (a loud one, a quiet one and an indoor one), spas, a salon, and a pretty good 24-hour gym complete with 14 treadmills, 4 spinning bikes, weights both mechanical and free and more.  My room is spacious and clean with comfy linens, a refrigerator, 2 free bottles of water per day, free internet and the bath area has two sinks, one inside and one outside the actual bath.  The bathroom also has one of those "power" toilets that flush with great force.  Love that!  Love that there's also a lighted magnifying mirror for perfect makeup application (or shaving for the guys).  

My nit-picky complaints would be (1) that the signage in this monstrosity of a property can be a bit confusing to navigate.  Not sure that there's anything that can be done about it though, because of the multiple levels and halls and such.  I'm getting to know my way around quickly, though.  Also, (2) there is nowhere on this property that showed the Pay-per-View Silva vs. Sonnen fight.  Had to go off-property to the Buffalo Wild Wings to catch it.  (3) The gym is way too hot.  Feels like a sauna.  I'm surprised I haven't seen anyone pass out.  

Because this is a resort, again, be prepared to spend lots of money wherever you decide to eat.

We went in 45 min till close, only to see the bartender saying she cant serve a few customers that showed up just before us, so we didn't even bother with the bar. The server was very sweet. Our drinks were mostly sugar. And I was baffled that one of our drinks came out in a plastic neon commemorative cup. Pretty sure it was just pineapple juice. The food was terrible. Way too acidic, and with no flavor profile to back it up. I love spicy, this was just gross. Neither one of us got half thru our meals nor our drinks. They comped half of our food, which I honestly feel, we still got ripped off. At around a 50 dollar price point per person, they should at least have good food. This place was absolute trash. The server and the busser were very nice. But you cant polish a turd. Ruined my girlfriends birthday. Now I'm sitting in my hotel and shes pissed. Thanks. I've been in the food service industry for 14 years. This is the only time I've ever posted a yelp review. Trash trash trash.
Get the crazy house fries. They won't let you down. Calamari is solid too. Dope atmosphere. Not over the top with the whole nautical theme.

I just moved back into town & Denny's must be under new management. We used to go there all the time & although it wasn't horrible, this visit was great! We were greeted by an amazing enthusiastic smile & our server was super friendly & attentive. The food was much tastier than ever before. Whatever you guys are doing right now... Keep on doing!!!

Pretty good little breakfast joint.  Dropped in after Black Friday morning shopping for some breakfast.  Good slinger with good meaty chili.  Eggs cooked properly (I went over medium and they were correct).  Excellent prices and nice wait staff.  Will be back to see if we get a repeat performance...

I've not had a bad meal at the Aristocrat. I love the fish tacos, black bean dip, and chicken gator wrap. Our server Bryan was really fantastic, friendly and personable. After we ate dinner we moved to the bar area for a little more quiet (open mic was going on in the main dining room, which was nice but too loud for us to talk). Unfortunately our server in the bar area was not friendly. He was deeply bothered by the fact that we had already spent money in the main area and were only drinking in his area. I suspect because he knew he wouldn't have a high ticket, thus a high tip. But what he didn't know is that we are generous tippers, no matter what the cost of the tab. However his sour mood washed that generosity away.

Amazing!!!  The food was delicious (I got the #2) along with the tropical fresh squeezed juice and coffee made with cinnamon, honey, and coconut oil.  Service was kind and quick!  Definitely my new local fave spot!

My visiting friends asked if there were any Ethiopian places that we could have lunch, of course, I said "Let's check Yelp!" We ended up here by default (the other place is closed on Mondays) and had a great lunch. There were several tables waiting for food when we arrived, so I feared we would have to wait too long, but once we ordered the food came out pretty quickly and it was all very flavorful.

We tried the veggie combo, the one chicken dish and lamb tibs. It was plenty of food for three to share with a great variety of flavors that were all new to me, but I really liked it all. The stand out favorite for me were the lamb tibs and my friend raved about the quality of the injera and  the collard greens. I would happily try this place again!

Man this place makes me nostalgic for my hometown! and Mexico!

When shopping at the Tucson Mall, I literally did a double-take when I saw someone pass by with a chamoyada. I hadn't seen these before in Tucson so I was fairly surprised. I finally tracked down the Paradise stand and bought one. I payed an extra dollar for tamarind-on-a-straw and tamarind ribbons but totally worth it.

The second time I went back to get a verduro. I've always called this treat a "chicharron" but when I asked for it by that name, the lady at the counter gave me an epic blank stare haha. A verduro is a deep fried pork skin about the length of an adult forearm. It is topped with a crazy combination of cabbage, mexican cold crema, and bottled salsa. This is quintessential Mexican junk food. Back at my aunt's house in Mexico, a man sells them out of a rickety cart and also adds beans and cueritos (pickled pork rinds) to his chicharrones. The ones at Paradise don't have beans but i.m.h.o. they should. So good.

Here's a link to a website with great verduro/chicharron pics for those who don't know what they are:

http://newyork.seriouseats.com/2010/08/chicharron-preparado-queens-carts-corona-jackson-heights.html

Took a star away because prices are a bit steep and because the chicharron could have been fresher.

Recommended! And people seem to like this place as it has been super packed both times I've gone.
I love this place the food is good i love the pool tables and bar area. The drinks are ok and the servers are always good to me so thumbs up

Service is excellent, always taking the empty plates and refilling drinks/hot pots.  Make sure you have a reservation, it is very busy.  The best thing is their homemade items, especially the DUMPLINGS and the meatballs.  I find that the mash (in the chutes) are a bit mushier than the homemade meat balls.  Love all the cooked food as well, deep fried items are piping hot when they bring it out to you.  The dessert is SO GOOD!  Mango and green tea pudding (one of each!), I would probably pay to eat that separately in another setting.

I can't wait to visit this place again, it is my favourite hot pot restaurant in Edmonton.
We had our pizza delivered this time & as always the pizza was very good. We ordered a pie & subs always good. Definitely worth checking out

Tucson local favorite since the 70's but was sold & now sold again to big food corporation gone national. Sunday afternoon remodeled store became busy after our arrival. Ordered large spicy grinder , spicy means jalepeno s on long fresh roll with not much meat in it plenty of jalapeño s . Order sat as name never called to pick it up? Tried to use restroom couldn't get in for 15 minutes an employee was in there changing clothes & probably taking a break? Give four stars based on the egee  drinks and past reputation .
Amazing. Maria is the bomb! Molly, the whole team! Best home cooking. The fries with cheese and beef debris! Fried artichoke hearts! Po Boys!!! Burger. SO AMAZING! Service is top notch.
This was my first time here, and I was glad I chose this place as a new restaurant for a date night. The waitress was very nice and the food was excellent. I'll certainly go back!

Four of us went to Dominick's on 8/29/2018 based upon my recommendation.  What a disappointment....  It took a long time to be seated--the girl seating customers seemed very slow and unsure of what to do..  It took a long time for the server to come to our table.  Once we ordered wine and water, it took along time to get the wine.  The server then took the order of several tables who arrived after us.  Finally we ordered.  We waited awhile and the server came back and explained he lost the paper with our order, could we order again and he will get the order in???  We ordered bruschetta for an appetizer and specified we want that out first.  We were served the salads and then he brought out the bruschetta.  The salads were awful--all dark greens and lousy dressing.  Nobody finished their salad.  The bruschetta was awful--loaded up with balsamic and terrible taste.  The main course was good--chicken marsala, chicken piccata, lasagna, and spaghetti and meatballs.  Then came the check.... We told the server, Diego, to split the bill (two couples) when we ordered.  One bill came and was wrong and included a bottle of wine which we did not have. He then separated the bill and still had it wrong--all the glasses of wine except one were on one bill.  

We paid the bill and left.  I will never go back to Dominick's again!  Terrible service and mostly lousy food.
.

This is our favorite Sushi place in town. They have high quality ingredients and friendly customer service. Our favorite is the Salomon Box Sushi. It's so good we rarely try other dishes. We haven't found an appetizer we don't like as well.
Went on June 10th. Greeter not wearing mask. We were seated at both that had obviously not been cleaned. Trash on floor beneath table, wadded up napkin wedged in seat and crayons..
This place is not only super yummy but the owners are so kind! Cannot wait to go back there! The food was to die for!

Great food and fantastic service. If you love island cuisine you are in for a treat . My favorite date night spot because of the intimate setting and ambiance . I highly recommend the Red Snapper or Curry Goat and don't forget the Mac and Cheese.

I've been to this place 5-10 times over the years and always come away with a great tasting meal!  I've gone here with picky people who weren't sure about the menu and even they came away thinking they had a great meal.  It is quite unassuming from the outside but once you get inside it's classy and the food is always delicious.  I highly, HIGHLY recommend trying Siri's if you're into trying new flavors and foods.
Not a bad cheaper casino buffet -- about $8.99 with a player's club card.  There's usually enough decent food to choose from.  There's always a carving station, and the staff is pretty friendly.

Don't waste your time with this place. 
New manager has no clue. He has all employees stressed out and hating their job. Not enough help. Orders all around me missing things. People complaining and some walking out.
The waitresses are super nice though.

We ordered the pepperoni pizza and the Great White shark and it was amazing. We also ordered the Caesar salad with checking in here on Yelp and it was also really good. Our server Emma was awesome. She is very sweet and kid friendly! Thank you!

Some of the very best sushi in the city! I've only ever gone for the lunch specials and have tried a few. #13 is my favorite. Make sure to check the hours before you go because they close between lunch and dinner.

Came here on a Sunday morning. It seemed they had more staff than customers and it still took quite awhile for our food.  It was simple avocado toast, I didn't think it would take long but maybe it's a Nashville thing to slow things up and enjoy the moment.  The toast was excellent and the server was nice enough but for what we paid I don't think this place was amazing.

A fave icecream place for me in St. Albert right now, especially with it being summer. Actually may be one of the best icecream places in north Edmonton. Why?!!! Because they have plentiful options of sorbet for dairy free people like me. Yummy and unique flavours for both sorbet and gelato icecream. AND the scoops are of a grand size. I ordered 3 scoops my first time because of my excitement and I was blown away. I went a 2nd time and got 2 scoops and it was perfect  amount for me even though I wanted to get all the new flavours of sorbet they had. Sooo it just means I am going to continue to return to try more. 

1st visit- I devoured peach passionfruit, black currant and strawberry lemonade sorbettos in a cup

2nd visit- I devoured watermelon and grape sorbettos in a cup

Great customer service and reasonably priced. Location is in a industrial area but you can see the patio furniture outside the icecream shop and their sign. Plenty of parking along the road and some in the parking lot.

We walked in and it was surprisingly slow a couple of days before News Years Eve but the service and food was wonderful.

Great Wedge salad and the White Maple Farm Pork Chops in sweet potatoes parsnip and mole poblano was wonderful. Next time we are in Nashville we'll be back.

We had such high hopes for breakfast out and not hotel breakfast but that was a bust. We asked for a well done toasted bagel and eggs and eggs,toast, and bacon. The bagel and toast was barely toasted and the bacon was barely cooked. We asked if both bagel and bacon can be cooked more. The staff member was very kind and said yes and 10 minutes later brought over a burnt bagel and dry over cooked bacon. . So disappointed. I know they are busy but unacceptable to me. The person putting the food on the plate should know better and the waitress who brought it over should have looked before putting on the table.

Went in for the Broncos vs Chargers game #gobroncos on the big screen on my first visit ever and happy to report, it was a great one. Being a gluten free eater can be challenging, especially when eating out; but BWW has an allergens list showing what you can/can't have. (Be sure to request it from your server.) Katie was very helpful, patient, and attentive! Thanks Katie!

So I quickly dove into my 10 piece traditional wing basket with Blazin sauce, Blue Cheese & Hot BBQ on the side for dipping and a basket of fries. I didn't get through half my food, not because it wasn't good (total opposite) but it was A LOT of food, which would equal to a great meal for a dude or leftovers in my case. Not to mention I had two 20 oz Sam Adams Rebel IPAs to wash it all down. Delicious! Glad to see they have some craft beers on the menu! 


Although it's a drive out to either this location or the one in Nashville West, I'll def be going back again.

Antoine's is the pinnacle of New Orleans class. The waiters know the whole menu, and everything in it. Your water glass will never be empty. If you go on the right night, you will have A-listers surrounding you (so long as you don't sit in the entrance room). The food is delicious, with half the menu completely original to Antoine's. Do yourself a favor and pick an Oyster appetizer (you can't go wrong with any of them). 

If you're looking for 19th century charm, there is no better choice in the world.

Originally our reservations were for Delmonico but they lost our reservation despite us showing them the e-mail so they sent us to Emeril's flagship restaurant in the CBD.  Atomosphere is great, very upscale but relaxed.  I'm from Chicago so the prices were of no great surprise but honestly, the four of us in our party said the food was good but we've had better.  We ordered the bruchetta as an appetizer and asked the server if it was enough to serve four people and he said yes so we were a little taken back when another server brought us the appetizer and said "I had to bring this over because I have to see how four people eat this" - it was two pieces of bruchetta, whic was fantastic but had we known it was only two, we would have ordered another appetizer.  I think the best part was the dessert.  Now we can all say we've been to an Emeril's restaurant but none of us have any desire to go back.  Disappointing to say the least.

Hard to believe that St. Pete only has 2 waterfront restaurants and Fresca's is the only downtown. The inside is nothing to look at but the majority of patrons choose to sit outside overlooking the bay. The food choices are well prepared.  Enjoy their blackened grilled chicken. You can find higher end restaurants nearby, but if you crave being near the water or want to impress out-of-town guests with a laid feel of St. Pete, you can't go wrong.

Went for dinner and drinks this past Friday! The steak and scallops we ordered were cooked to perfection, we didn't have to hunt our waitress down for drinks (or anything for that matter). We got a table immediately and didn't have to wait long for soups and appetizers to come out. Love the incredible beer selection and the eclectic menu. Definitely will be going back there.

The service was above and beyond here. The waiters were so helpful.  The manager went above and beyond in suggestions on where to go and what to see in Nashville. Everything from the wine i had, the beer my husband ha, from the tapas and the AMAZING olive oil cake was delicious !!! We will definitely visit the Barcelona Wine Bar next time we are in town!!

Came here with my bf for a rare dinner/date night out. Never been before, but the idea of being at a popular place where the Flyers hung out seemed like a fun thing. That is, until we sat at the bar and actually got service. The bartender Rita was down right rude and mean. We had questions about the menu, and she seemed like it was a bother that we were asking her such things. It was also a problem for her that my bf was drinking soda. He's not a drinker, plus he was driving that night. The people sitting next to us started chatting us up. I guess they must go often, bc they seemed to know a lot about the place. They mentioned that she was also the manager. They also said that the place goes through employees left and right because no one can work with this woman. Well if she treats her co workers  the way she treated us, I can see why. It's a shame bc my scallops were delicious

We've been there several times since this location opened. We went last night at about 5 p.m. It wasn't busy at all and we ordered quickly, but ordered items that weren't our normal choices. My husband order fish tacos and I ordered the Shrimp Louie. It was strange when the meal came and my husband was given the fish and chips and I got a salad with 6 medium size shrimp down the center. Obviously my husband's order was just plain wrong, but mine was extremely disappointing. I've never had a Shrimp Louie with a few shrimp on top - generally it is a large portion of small, sweet bay shrimp, something for every bite of your salad. To say I was disappointed would be a major disappointment. When we finally caught the waitress to say that not only had my husband order fish tacos, but the fish and chips arrived with only catsup, no tartar sauce, she looked at us like we didn't know what he ordered. I know that is what he requested because it's not an item he usually chooses and I was a little surprised to hear it. But rather than apologize for a mistake, she acted like we had hurt her feelings even though he told her that he would eat the fish and chips. He could have requested that she correct the situation, but he chose to let it slide. We actually felt like had this been our first visit, we would have felt that we wasted $40+ for a really lousy meal.
