They have around five ramen, including one that uses the friend chicken and you can also custom build your ramen. We ordered the miso and the sho yu. They are essentially the same but miso has the pork broth and shoyu has soy broth. It was great. Very generous serving of noodles and pork belly and a perfectly done hard boiled egg. 

They have a great packaging for to go, with the broth in a huge container and all the goodies in a separate container that fits into the larger container and closes it. And the seaweed sheet was separate from even that. 

We ordered a side of chicken nuggets as well, cause had to try. My daughter and husband loved it. Personally, as a huge chicken fan, I found the pieces too small so not enough chicken in each bite. I want my chicken  but the breading was fantastic and the yum yum sauce was great. Next time I'll do the tenders so have more chicken and I'm sure I'll be thrilled.

Worth the half hour drive from KOP. We always get the summer rolls (very fresh and the peanut sauce is delectable), and deluxe pho (served with lots of herbs, bean sprouts, jalapenos, and 2 juicy limes). The portions are large and satisfying, and the deluxe pho comes with an ample amount and variety of meat. The broth is tasty too.

We had the flan once and it was very nicely done.

Service is friendly and prompt.
The restaurant and bathrooms are clean and the decor is aesthetically pleasing.

We will be frequenting location whenever we crave Vietnamese food, unless a comparable place crops up that is less than half an hour away.

Visited this spot and nothing I ordered was worth paying for. This chains food is terrible. I ordered one of their large rice bowls, soup, fried yuuca, a limited time app (i forgot what it was but it tasted like cardboard), and dessert. The bowl was practically flavorless, nothing that makes this chain stand out from anyone. The soup was suppose to be a chicken and potato type stew, there was 1 piece of chicken.. all of the potatoes were pretty mashed up, so it was like just like eating mashed potato soup. They gave me the wrong dessert, and forgot the fried yucca. 

I wanted a refund for at least the missing item..  the direct phone to the place of business transfers me to a Hold, and noone EVER picks up. (Smart way of dealing with customer service, just dont answer your customers).. So I opted to go ahead and call the corporate line to get assistance with this just because now I am just not happy. The person I spoke with assured me this would get taken care of and should expect a refund. 

Nevertheless, I was never refunded... noone ever followed up... and I will never eat at a pollo tropical chain ever again nor recommend this place to anyone ever, customer service is horrible, food is disgusting. Why would anyone ever want to spend their money and support this place when there are so many better options out their? 

The experience was awful. Never again.
Soup was room temperature at best. Salad no longer comes with dinner. Garlic bread not on menu anymore. Pasta Bolognese lacking the Bolognese

Great place, great service, thanks Lei who was our server! The ambiance was fabulous! Live performer very relaxing. You had a choice to sit outside, inside, upstairs, downstairs the evening breeze felt wonderful with our glass of wine, calamari and our main dish. We ordered shrimp alfredo which was ok, key west combo was the bomb! We also ordered cajun pasta which was excellent, boom boom chicken very good (fried) these were to go! Great place to stop in and enjoy the food and surroundings!

Went here on an afternoon after work, with my working homies. Had a few pitchers of margaritas (only 30.95 a throw....), and free chips and salsa! The chips and salsa were great for sure, i think the 30.95 margaritas were a bit overpriced, and they start at 30.95...

Ordered the Chile Colorado (and if you see from my previous posts, im sort of picky about them) and it was decent. It was a 5.5/10 on my own personal Chile Colorado scale. A little watery, and not enough creamy red chile gravy. Thats just how i was raised on this dish! I could be wrong, and PLEASE dont take my word on it! I just prefer my Chile Colorado with a thick, red chile gravy! Thats the way my Nana made it, and goddamit, thats the way i make it! We serve Satan in my house! The beans and rice were great, as they should be in a mexican restaurant. 

So in closing, if you like over-priced margaritas near Virginia street try here! The staff was awesome, they always are cool to us when we go here. Im sure we will be back, but im pre-gaming in the parking lot. 7-11, big gulp/ half diet coke/ half Sailor Jerry or Wild Turkey.
Good frozen yogurt! Not the best I've ever had but it was really good and I'm always satisfied after I've been there! Great selection of frozen yogurt toppings and sauces

For the price point of the sushi, the food lacks flavor and is low quality. I felt most rolls were just overwhelmed with sauce or cheese rather than the fish being the star. It was more visually appealing, where some rolls were set on fire, rather than tasty. I would only recommend the piranha and samurai rolls since I thought they were the cleanest and freshest rolls.

Will never be back to this place.  Family of 5 ate dinner.  Nothing spectacular.  Paid and left tip..  exited the building only to be followed by our waitress to our car demanding more money on her tip.  Where in America is 15% not enough?

Pissed us off to the point where we went back in to complain...  where the manager suddenly could not speak English.  Lucky for us....  my wife is Japanese.

Finally got a "gomenasai" from the guy claiming to be in charge.  Never got a return call from the real management though.

Many other places to visit and eat in Indianapolis without the complete disrespect we received from this dispicable establishment.

sushi was pretty decent. But the fried rice was bland and just tasted like regular rice with some protein and veggies thrown in. The "chow mein" is just spaghetti cooked in sweet sauce and the calamari were thick blocks of squid. Overall I would not come back to this place of I stay here at the grand Sierra resort.

My husband and I recently went to your restaurant. It was beyond amazing. I recommend it to the universe! Michael , the manager on duty was so very kind and helpful. Our waitstaff Isaiah and Christian made the evening magical. We will recommend this restaurant forever and ever!And we will be back many many times. The food and the ambience is meant for royalty and they allowed us to be a part of that, thank you again!!!!!

Terrific bagels (I tried the salt and the rosemary, both were great) and spreads (dill pickle was terrific, my kids loved the strawberry on the French toast). The lox was like butter. Solid coffee. My service was pretty quick, but if things don't move as fast as you like, remember that they're brand new. I think they'll work out the kinks pretty quickly.

If ever there was a place that could boast Best Pizza in Edmonton, this is it. I love the Royale which is a classic, pepperoni, ham, onions, green peppers, black olives and sometimes I add pineapple. Their crust is classic American style thick crust. You will pay for one pizza what some places may offer two for but the quality is worth it.

Cafe Soho and Federal Donuts are great in their own ways, but Resurrection makes the best Southern-style fried chicken I've tried in Philly. It's crunchy and nicely browned on the outside, juicy on the inside, and even better dipped in honey, just as it should be. If you'll pardon the New York reference, it reminds me of the excellent fried chicken at Blue Ribbon. 

Fried chicken aside, my boyfriend and I had a lovely dinner at Resurrection on a Monday night. The place wasn't very crowded, so we got plenty of attention (but not in an awkward way) from our friendly server. After listening to my likes and dislikes, he suggested a great ale from the well-curated draft beer list. In addition to generous samples of the fried chicken, I had the mushroom tartine, which was a bit salty but otherwise tasty. 

Looking forward to trying other menu items in the future, if I can resist the fried chicken!

Headed into Tampa to see the hockey game and had to get some tacos on the way cause it's Tuesday! Well Taqueria Emanuel did not disappoint. The food was fresh, fast, and most importantly delicious. We started with the chips and salsa. They are definitely homemade. The salsa comes out warm and it's not chunky more of a sauce.
The tacos came out soon after. The chorizo con papa was fantastic and so was the shrimp. The carnitas were a little dry but still tasty! Overall, I would definitely come back. Friendly staff and fresh food, what more could you want.

Last night there was a 45 min to 1 hour wait for a table, but my boyfriend & I were able to snag 2 seats at the bar after about 30 min. We received exceptional service from Corey & Kaylee, (2 of the bartenders). Even though the place was packed & the bar was swamped, they went out of their way to accommodate us! I ordered the short rib & mushroom risotto & my boyfriend had the Italian market pizza (it was the featured pizza). Both were delicious! 
We always have good service & great food, but last night I feel that Corey & Kaylee went above & beyond. Thanks again, guys!
You can never go wrong eating here! Current, upscale entrees, great service, and good drinks. Great atmosphere and one of Greenwood's top downtown restaurants!
Amazing!  If you want healthy food that is out of this world, this is the place to go!

I was so excited to finally try the breakfast sandwich at Panera. The ad they sent me online showed a perfectly cooked over easy egg oozing its yolk down the soft bread  when it's cut in half. What I actually received at Panera felt like a bait and switch because the over hard egg had no ooze and no flavor. The sandwich was such a disappointment that all I could think is how much better I could have made this myself at home. Save your money, and make breakfast at home. However, I will say that their salads and soups are still top notch here for lunch. And they have lots of yummy tea choices for drinks too.

I never thought I'd find a good fish taco in Nashville, but what a surprise! Baja Burrito had an amazing fish taco with delicious slaw and I can't wait to go back for more. I also love the atmosphere- casual, fun, great hang-out place. The location was unexpected- tucked away between a gas station and the Applebee's. But it's a treasure- great tacos and service. This place isn't related to the Baja Burrito at the Nashville Airport, which is not that great, so don't let the confusion keep you from coming here.

Ate there a couple of weeks ago on a Tuesday night for dinner with my wife and mom.  The clam chowder was as good as it gets, the house salad was very nice and the Red Snapper was outstanding.  I don't think you can go wrong with the seafood here.  My two dinner partners both had the scallops and they loved them!!

A big shout out to their waiter (not server, he's much more than that) Mark.  (I hope there is only one Mark).  Absolutely what a professional waiter should aspire to be.  Attentive, efficient, unobtrusive, old-school.  He could work any 5 star restaurant. 
Kudos Mark!

I really wish they would change their sign out front and perhaps their decor, that would be more in line with what a great establishment that they are.  It just doesn't seem to do it justice, and in fact may even give the wrong impression of the place.

I loved being here! It was very interesting on the inside. It looks like something from Alice in Wonderland. The staff is extremely friendly and when we told them that it was our first time being here they got very excited and welcomed us being here. I got a root beer float fudge square along with my Chocolate Orange Mocha. Both were very good. The fudge tasted exactly like root beer and the Chocolate Orange Mocha was made with the melted chocolate from the chocolate oranges. It was very tasty. The guy serving us was named John. His recommendations were definitely on point. We are definitely coming back here.

Wow! Fun to try something different!  Great service (from Georgene) & accent to boot!  She was well versed to explain differences to novice German food eaters...and with a smile.  Decided on the Jaegar Schnitzel and from other review,  knew to order bit extra mushroom sauce (which added great depth & flavor to the spaetzel). Also,  the pork schnitzel was best and you really should try a bit of lemon squezed on..provides a nice  brght punch!  Another in our party had the Brat Wusrt (DELISH) and the Curry catsup...really tasty and different!  ONLY reason didn't get 5 stars is for the older members in our group (86 & 89!) struggled with the picnic bench style seats (we were quick to grab table when one came up!) It was very chilly today& with such small place, every time door opened was bit brisk, we put our coats back on!  Also. ..make sure to try the Cheese Spaetzel...bacon, cheese etc. ..could have eaten just this! Overall, great experience, little pricey for 5 of us ($90) but greatly enjoyed!

I've been to alot of burger kings in my day, but this one has nowhere near the standard of quality of others. I was there at about 9:15 this morning and ordered the 2 croissant for 4 dollars deal. I was surprised as they were ready instantly,  but as I got on the road and reached into the bag, I quickly realized why. The crossaints were hard as a rock. Like they had been sitting under heat lamps for hours. I definitely don't want crunchy crossaint sandwiches. I was in a rush, or I wouldn't have been using the drive thru in the first place. I had somewhere to be, but still considered turning around and returning the sandwiches for my money back. Not exchanging them, because this place obviously can't even keep up with the already low standards of fast food. They have everything needed to meet the industry standards. Well everything except apparently competent management. I dont know who is running this particular spot, but I know for a fact that they aren't doing a good job of it. I will no doubt stop at Burger King in the future, but never at this location again.

What a find!  I was in Philadelphia for business for one night....it was pouring rain....I had work to do....so I wanted something yummy for takeout.  The carnitas tacos were amazing....wonderful flavors that really worked together.  The price/quality relationship is spot on; a great value.  I only wish I had been able to eat at the restaurant (cool vibe).  Will go back on my next trip to Philly.

Ruined.  the place is ruined.  It's a lot cleaner in there, I'll give you that.  but that's about it. 

What made this place good was the charcoal and steel grate that sears and chars the meat.  As the heat from the coals sears the meat and carbonizes the steel grate, it gives a cooking surface that just keeps adding to the flavor of the meat. This is at the heart of "soot bul" or coal fired meat.  

They have switched over to a butane over ceramic grill to make it easier for the staff. There is less smoke and less work for the staff to clean.  What happens is though, flavor goes bye bye.  instead of a seared meat, you get ribs that are boiled in it's juices.  That is not barbecue the way we are used to at restaurants.  It is how kalbi is made at home, which is why we go to restaurants to eat it. 

The service is fine but the overall quality of the food has suffered.  I knew there was something wrong when we went in post renovation and the place was slow.  We were there an hour and as we were leaving, the place was still only half filled, and mostly with non-Koreans.  Word gets out fast I guess.   There are still a few good "Soot Bul kalbi" places in north Philly.  Wish there were some in upper darby which is closer to us, but haven't found one yet.
This was one of the best meals that I have had in a long time. Everything that we ordered was done to perfection. The ambiance and the service was very good and we had a wonderful meal.

Ok, I have not been to this place in over 15 years. But man "Paradise is Lost".
When I used to go to this place, there was a line to get in. Today......empty seats.......hmmm maybe I should have known better.
Dinner salad was beyond pathetic.....pile of lettuce.
Grilled chicken breast sandwich had been pounded to within a millimeter of it's life and it was tasteless, including the bland bread and "Old looking tomato slices used on the sandwiches"
On the upside the margaritas were pretty good, but all in all I would not go back and from the looks of empty seats, it appears many have done the same.

ThunderbirdII salads are great, especially the Speedy Gonzales, but their Chicken cheesesteaks are severely skimpy.   Upon receipt I thought the sandwich felt light... only to confirm after scraping all of the sandwich contents into a bowl that chicken+mushrooms+onions= 5.4 ounces.   That's lame by any standard.

The food is really good. I tried the calamari app, bruschetta, and meatballs. All were great. The dinner special was a steak topped with scallops and shrimp with melted cheese. It was perfect. I'd definitely recommend this restaurant.

I genuinely dread writing a bad review, but as much as I hate  being negative, I feel a responsibility to tell the truth. And the truth is, this was the worst bbq I've tried to eat in at least twenty years. I say "tried" because stringy tough slices of brisket with globs of fat is impossible to coax down my gullet, and my hunger has great powers of persuasion. The ribs were okay, but bland, & needed a good, tangy sauce. The only sauce available was a bottle of watery, vinegary mixture that a baby could suck & not burp. Even the smoke taste on the meat seemed tainted. I'm not sure what kind of wood they use. I'm glad to say the beans were delicious, but sixteen bucks for a bowl of beans, a few ribs, and some scraps of road kill does not make one a happy diner. I'm from the south, I got the funk, and I know bbq. This ain't it. Sorry.

Chifa. Is. My. Favorite. Restaurant. In. Philadelphia.

Rarely do I allow a latency period of more than week between a meal and a review. Chifa is somewhere beyond the third standard deviation and three meals later. Even after a reminder dinner tonight, it's disconcerting to me that I still am at a loss for the proper adjectives to describe Garces' triumph over Peruvian cuisine. 

The pork belly bao buns are sticky, succulent and literally melt upon meeting your tongue. The buns themselves are fluffy with a slight white rice flavor.

The Yucca fries are fat, hot, and have a pull-and-peel root-i-ness. The outside is crisp and flakey, while the inside is thick, soft and ever-so-slightly sweet in that cactus sort of way. 

And the cheese yucca bread bun rolls with guava butter - which is somehow red? - are phenomenal. It's like somebody took cheddar buttermilk biscuits, replaced wheat flour with glutinous yucca flour, added like 10 ounces of delicious (yeah, new ingredient called delicious) and baked. They're chewy, sticky and simply amazing. 

Mom said it best: "Chifa is the best restaurant in Philly. It's like a traditional Chinese dish but you know, they give it a twist or something and that just makes IT." 
(She's Asian, and it was cute.)

This is hands down the best market we have seen in Indiana for Korean foods. Store has almost everything we need to feel at home, just wish they sold bulgogi and spicy pork already prepared. It's far from where we live but I love this market.

RTM is the kind of place that makes you wish you had an infinite stomach so you could eat all the things. 

All the things to eat:
DiNic's roast pork sandwich with broccoli rabe. This is the true Philly sandwich.
Hershel's brisket sandwich. 
The Fair Food Farmstand has amazing local products, like heirloom apples and ethically raised meat.
Termini Brothers for your Italian sweet tooth. 
Bassets for ice cream.

Tried this place out today because of the awesome reviews and it really is amazing! It's probably one of the best Thai restaurants I've been to. We ordered the dumplings as an appetizer (which were the best Ive ever had), yellow curry, and pad Thai. The pad Thai was average but the curry and dumplings were delicious. We plan on going back to try a lot more off the menu. Almost forgot the Thai tea! It was perfect.

They say everything is made from scratch but I honestly couldn't tell the difference between Cheddars and other similarly priced restaurants. I went there right after they opened and had really high expectations but nothing really stood out.

I will probably give it another try at some point but there are better options on that side of town.

Edit: I may have been to harsh with my original 2 star rating. The atmosphere is really cool and the drinks were well made and affordable.
They cancelled our uber eats order after an hour.  Food might be good, I have no idea since they won't send me any.

This is a great place to go for coffee.  So much nicer than the big chains.  They have a nice variety of coffee.  My wife and I are having cold brews.  They taste very good and really do not even need cream.  The atmosphere is very cozy.  This is a great coffee shop.
best bagel sandwhiches i ever had. have to try the cinnamon raisen bacon egg cheese toasted with butter. yooooo

The live music starts at 8PM... 7.30PM the line is long.
So I decide it to sit on the bar, thanks God there's still couple seat are empty.
The bartender was really nice.
They put big TV on the bar so we can watch and hear the live music too :)
Order some gumbo and calamari, both of them need lots of spices.
Over all service was great... 
 Food need to put more spices

I visited this place at least 40 times in the past few years. Its inside looks old and the whole place is kind of small. All the tables are arranged closely to each other so more tables can be squashed in. The chairs you're gonna sit are poor quality ones so you don't want to sit too long and therefore your table can be used by the next group of people. You probably always need to wait for a table on weekends and Fridays around dinner hours. Waiting won't take long though. The servers can be friendly or mean all depending on how busy they are. 

They have a few dishes I really appreciate but not all of them are good. The must-order dishes for me include pork with pickled meicai, curry beef that served in a hot metal pot (really don't know how to differentiate this one from regular curry beef). Interestingly they have two menus one English one Chinese and you'll find totally different stuff on them. The dishes I like can only be found on the Chinese one. You can order individual dishes or select dinner combo for two/four/ten I remember (again use Chinese menu). The Chinese dinner combo comes with free soup and rice. Price is just fine. The dinner combo is pretty good though. 

Here is why I keep coming back to this place. The free soup that comes with dinner combo is simply amazing! Well for very a few times it doesn't taste as good as usual. But it never lets you down! It's not a broth or a thick soup. The liquid is completely clear. You can find a big piece of pork/beef spine bone there with carrots and other veggies. It tastes like hours of work concentrated in a single bowl. I'm not exaggerating that in cold days this free soup is why my bf and I would go and dine there. It warms you up and soothes your nerves. 

Make sure you drag a Chinese friend with you if you decide to try this place out. If you just want to have stir fried rice/noodles or Kung Pao chicken or lemon chicken, trust me this place won't be any different from any other restaurants. 

I'll go back again for that soup.

Chips were warm but stale.  Pass. 
Chimichanga had chicken in it but the chicken was in cubes, and tasted like it was taken out of the refrigerator, nuked, and then added to the dish.
Beans and rice were blah.
Salsa was tasteless.
Waitress was decent.
No music inside (4pm on a Saturday).  Place was nearly empty.  Weird eating in total silence.

Haydel's is my neighborhood bakery and I feel pretty lucky to live so close to it. I absolutely love their king cake (the BEST in New Orleans --- I have tried at least 15 New Orleans king cakes and Haydel's is hands out the best), their eclairs, salt water taffys, and everything else, really. It is worth every bite, money, calories and soul.

Lunch Jan 4
FINALLY got to eat here!
Worth the trip, deserving of  the hype - this place is the BOMB!
The owner Mario is a genuine, real, incredible guy!
Media Noche & Cuban were fantastic!
Always packed, but you will feel welcomed!
Come early, they close I think at 4:00.

Stopped here on the way back to Jacksonville from Clearwater. I AM SO IN LOVE! I really, really wish we had one here in Jax. I am loving this slow move towards conscious eating. Air baked fries tasted so much better than those greasy shoe string things at other places. My husband's burger was awesome. I got the avocado something wrap. So good! I ordered a kid's meal for my 1 year old, even though she really only had a few nibbles. The breaded chicken strips were a bit too salty for a kid, in my opinion but not that big of a deal since I didn't let her eat any of the breading anyway. LOVE the place.

PLEASE OPEN ONE IN THE JACKSONVILLE AREA!!!

found this place several months ago and my wife loved their pizza with cherry tomatoes on top.  I thought their cocktails and italian dishes were way overpriced for a strip type mall with little atmosphere but wife loved their pizza until the other day when no tomatoes were on the pizza.  I also received my sandwich ten minutes before the pizza arrived.  Not good timing.  The pizza when lifted rolled off the sauce and cheese but the server did not charge us.
When leaving, the pizza maker stated about two months ago customers were complaining that the tomatoes were making the pizza runny.  The fact that they were using the tomatoes for two years went over his head.
Could it have been an end of year cut to save money?

This place is amazing. I've now been coming for lunch to sit outside and it's so nice for lunch. Dinner is also amazing. I love the chicken sharma no rice so it's like a salad. The server we had was amazing probably the best service I've had in a long time and were used to high end places to eat so I was impressed again. Had their tzatizi yogurt which was really good as well. Will order this instead of hummus as I like this better.

Went back to my parents' house for a weekend recently and I was legit craving Sal and Joe's.  I worked here for a few summers back in high school and I kid you not I have not had better Italian food since, and that includes a 4 month study abroad stint in Rome.  

Every meal comes with a soup AND a salad, garlic bread, and one of the biggest portions you'll ever see.  I always look forward to having leftovers for lunch the next day!  Everything on the menu is delicious (trust me, I've eaten most of it) and everyone that works there is so friendly.  Definitely a homey mom and pop place, totally casual but with really good quality food.  Oh, and it's BYOB!

Seriously, just go (and eat lots of pasta).

I ate at Drake's this past weekend early on Saturday evening.  Both the Phillies and the Eagles preseason games were on so we sat inside where we had a good view of TVs showing both games.  Our waitress was great and we had no complaints about service.  My husband stuck with an order of Buffalo wings and they were pretty good--a nice garlicky flavor.   I ordered a burger since I've heard people rave about how good they are but I was kind of disappointed.

I didn't think to ask but I just assumed my burger would come with fries on the side.  Nope.  I had to order a separate side of fries and, while they were good, the order was way too much for one person. So I ended up eating only a small amount and I wasted most of them.  The burger was ok--I asked for medium well, it was actually cooked to well and the bun was too dry for my liking.  I did like their red sangria. 

We'll be back because it's close to home and the food was pretty good---just add a few fries to the plate on burger orders.

Nice room, not a place I would usually stay. Probably stay closer to downtown, but the sleep# bed will make up for it later. See if it's better than our temperpedic ergo cloud. The remote for the bed was hard to use, didn't wanna work. Got to push the buttons way down. Okay, finishing this review, our bed was better. Free wi-fi and breakfast for 2 was nice. Hotel is right by I-40 and the airport  and only 7-8 mi. From downtown. Considering it's location, outside noise was minimal. Didn't use the pool or weight room, but peeked in and both seemed nice. All the staff we encountered were nice. Booked on priceline for the sleep# bed, but had us for a double on arrival, desk clerk changed with no problems. Overall I'd say this is a great place to stay, no matter where you are going in the Nashville area.

Excellent service and great food at a great price!  Start with the Dr. Lee cocktail! Have the Pork Bao Bun, the Vietnamese Chicken Satay, the Crispy Rock Shrimp, the Brussels Sprouts and the Filet Mignon and you will be very, very happy!  I sat at the chef's counter and watched it all being prepared.  Highly recommend!

Hate to see a 4 Star place slide so low. The wife and friends went for a gals breakfast today and noticed that things have gone to the literal hell in a hand basket. Here are their observations:

1) All different help.
2) Poor service, tardy refills.
3) Coffee has gone back to weak swill.
4) Burnet toast served.
5) Smaller portions by a considerable margin from before.
6) Higher prices.
7) Not as crowded as before.

So one must assume that something drastic has happened, like maybe a change of ownership or management?

In summary, we have written them off from further meals.
Our place to go on Valentine's Day. The salted caramel volcano is amazing! My kids love the white chocolate volcano

As you can expect from the name, it's all about the seafood.  Most places in NO aren't very suitable for those who don't like seafood (even if it's not the main part of the dish, it'll be a garnish); if I remember correctly, there was only one thing on the menu that wasn't seafood.  

After looking at the menu in dismay (too many things looked good), I settled on the tactic of "What are the side dishes?"  That helped a little, but still left too many choices, so I further reduced them by "What's at least reasonably local?"  (thus excluding things like the Maine scallops and the Pacific something or other).  

I recommend this method.  The side dishes were excellent.  (The main course was good too, but all I can remember about it was that it was a pumpkin seed encrusted whitefish of some sort)  It was served with snow peas on a bed of squash risotto, which was the truly memorable part of the meal.  

Dessert was the best bread pudding I've ever had.

Great location and a lively atmosphere in the middle of State Street - great food, generous portions (had the fajitas) and reasonably priced. The service was very good - Victoria was super helpful in recommending what to order and telling us that they could put on any game we wanted if it wasn't already showing. Recommended!

Had the burnt ends platter. Burnt ends were very good. I love Mac and cheese but unfortunately it was not good at all. It's not the typical Mac and cheese you would normally get at a bbq spot or southern style restaurant. It was more like boxed Mac topped with cheese. Save yourself the disappointment and try a different side dish.

Mungo's is STL fine dining tucked away on the other side of the river in Illinois. Food is fantastic. If you are looking for authentic Italian dishes from a place that prides themselves on great customer service then you have found it. We will be going back again soon!

The most upscale hotel I've ever stayed in! The service was not even comparable to other places. My husband and I made reservations for our one year wedding anniversary last weekend and had an excellent time. There was a huge bathroom and the water ran very hot for the bathtub. They had an Ipod charger for my Iphone on the alarm clock and the bedding was very comfortable with plenty of extra pillows. Big HD Flat screen TV in the room and everything smelled like the candles they were burning in the lobby, even the travel size shampoo and lotions. It's just a short walk to Burboun street and a short drive to the Audubon Zoo and Aquarium. Just don't touch anything in the fridge unless you want to pay for it! They have weight senors and will charge for everything you move! (We called and they refunded the charges because we didn't actually use any of the products.)
Fresh extracted juice from the juice bar is amazing. I love the açaí bowls too. It's pretty difficult to get fresh fast food in this part of town so Earth Origins is my go to.

We came for the burgers lol to be honest- and of course I got some gambling in. My partner had the double bacon cheeseburger well done with a Bloody Mary  and I had the cheese burger well done with a coffee. Social distancing is enforced, and they also wear gloves with masks worn properly. The tables are encased in plastic barriers just like the slot machines. Our waiter was really clever and a gentleman.

Glad that I found this place close to my hotel thank you once again Yelp!  Everything that I ate was delicious. Jen the bartender was fabulous and really working hard as they were incredibly short staffed this evening. If it was not for her friendliness and hustle I probably would have walked out. But the place was packed and the food was excellent so hopefully this was just an off night for their staffing.
The BEST Burritos. My go to is the Sausage Burrito, no beans, add sour cream. Their salsa is hot but goes so well with it. ALL of their drinks are great.

Loved the experience- great drinks, great service, cool atmosphere, and not as crowded as a typical bar in the area. 

Downside: full of cigar smoke and once it got crowded, the dress code thing kinda lacked. The guy next to me was wearing a flannel, cowboy boots and a dirty ball cap ...

Whatever it was fun I'm totally going again

Bad boy burger on fairview is really good. I have had their burgers in the past and they are great. This morning I saw they were open on my way to work and stopped in and grabbed their $3.75 bacon breakfast. I am amazed how good it is and how little it cost. I couldn't of made this at home for how cheap it is. It comes with two eggs, 4 pieces of bacon, hash-browns and toast. You should really give it a try. The best part is I took it two work and my coworkers sent someone back out to order more for everyone else.

Stopped in with a freind while we were waiting for a tow truck.  And she said she had eaten here a few times back in the day and the food was pretty good.  Well that's not the case anymore it seems.  Bar food that was just ok.   When you bit into a still partially frozen chicken wings......... It's pretty much game over for me.  This place has seen better days I think.  In need of a good cleaning and updating.   As we walked out we noticed a guy singing in the bar that was doing a pretty good job.  So maybe a good place to go for live music.   I will say the staff was trying hard but when the bill comes and the frozen wings are still on the bill..... Well not the place for me. Sorry!
Amazing and totally worth the wait. Went here for lunch and got the mild level heat on chicken tenders. Some friends got the catfish and said it was great too. Will definitely go back!

my favorite favorite favorite place in the city. perfect for catching up with a friend or going on a date. great selection of wines, beers and cheeses. music played there is also a bonus. i go here every time i'm in the city without fail.
Since it's the same owners as Lolita's we knew the food would be absolutely amazing and it was! It's always busy so make reservations, you will be happy you did!
We don't know when it happened, but rebar is suddenly cool now. It's because cool people come here. And there is a heated porch. And they split bushwhackers three ways.
Service was excellent. Food was delicious. Had gumbo and shrimp poboy. Will definitely be back.

Get the portabella mushroom sandwich!  It's a cheesy with alfalfa sprouts & it's amazing!  The fries here are da bomb!  

Excellent beers on tab and friendly servers.  

The only negative thing I have to report is that the upstairs bar/seat-yourself/order yourself thing going on is kinda confusing.  I wish they just had servers up there to take your orders... it's tough to pick out your beers from a chalk board on one side of the room and then go to the other side of the room to see the menu (on another chalk board).
Service was EXCELLENT and the food was even better! Our waitress, Sally, checked in and was very personable.  Can't wait to come back again! The Kale salad with shrimp is my FAVE!

This place is the best for bagels, there's nothing better anywhere around. Best bagels, delicious. Fresh ingredients always on all sandwiches. Love going here on a weekend for a scrumptious everything bagel with nova lox, cheddar horseradish cream cheese, tomato and onion. If I don't make it before they close on the weekend, I don't go elsewhere for bagels, I just do something else entirely. My one and only criticism would be: about half the staff I've dealt with since I moved here about a year ago is really nice and about half really isn't. I will continue to patronize them because no other area bagels compare.
The queso tasted like it came from a budget brand jar queso or a massive can from a food distributor. Not my thing, but it could be yours.

Food was pretty good with a small menu. No kids menu but we worked around that. Went after some rain had passed and sat outside with some other families because that's where they have some games you can play in the front lawn area. The rain had already passed hours before and there was no more rain coming. The owner ran out and grabbed all the corn toss games from the yard and said that the bags will get wet and destroyed. He wasn't nice about it either. He put them back in the storage cube. Another family comes up and the kids grab them to come play, owner comes running out yelling. Was pretty ridiculous. Don't have games out for kids if you don't want them to play with them. How much do bean bags cost? $5? We would have had more drinks and sat there had we been able to have the kids play and they would have made back the money pretty quick. Just disappointing customer service. Our waiter was great, however.

extraordinarly bad value.  basically they have a 10000% markup.

everything about my angel hair pasta with alfredo and grilled chicken was 3rd Rate crap.

Our service here was great! It is very popular so allow yourself enough time and be prepared to wait if you come at a popular time. The servers were awesome and had great recommendations. This place was typical beach fare but still very high quality seafood. We had the crab cakes which had great flavor and the salmon which was a very large portion for the price and had good flavor as well. Their sides are great, especially the very cheesy Mac and cheese! We had a birthday we were celebrating and they gave complimentary key lime pie. Great experience!

I could write a long review saying how truly amazing and special this place is... and how I'll think about the meal long after I fly home... but I'm not going to.

Just come here and I'm sure you won't regret it

We ordered to go at this restaurant bc it was just across the street from the hotel our family was staying. The host that took our order over the phone was very cordial and nice. We walk over about ten minutes after our order. We then waited about 20 min for our order to come. The brought our order and we checked to see if they got our fathers order correct because he has certain allergies.  It was.  All of our food was cold or Luke warm and we only walked a cross the street not even 5 minute walk. My burger was not cooked medium it was cooked rare. My husbands burger was fine. But the spaetzle was cold and over cooked mushy.  Very underwhelming. My husband brought my burger back and for the garlic fries they forgot to include with our order that was a free Yelp deal.  

When he went back the restaurant the manager was apologetic. She took the burger off then a 25% off the total order and gave him a free Coke while he waited.

After checking out some articles about the food scene in Reno, my partner and I decided to make The Depot our first stop for a bite--and we're so glad we did!  What a lovely establishment! 

We were able to grab a seat right away (we arrived shortly before Happy Hour) and were brought waters promptly.  My partner and I opted for tasting flights to try a sampling of beers; while their styles consistent with what a seasoned craft beer enthusiast would expect, there were some misses for me, personally BUT the hit beers were EXCELLENT, so it really just comes down to preference.  Unfortunately they were all out of The Viking which was the beer that sold me on visiting in the first place, but I fell so in love with the 'James & The Giant' Imperial Peach Wit that all was forgiven.  Seriously--I'll fall head over heals for a fruit-forward beer that lacks any heavy-residual-sugar stomachache, and 'James & The Giant' was perfect. Being that I was kicking off my vacation with this experience, I also opted to try a cocktail, Albee's Knees, which was the honey-lavender concoction of my dreams.

Food-wise, you can't go wrong.  BP and I split the Caesar (a yardstick item for me, dining-wise) and it was so fresh, so crisp, and delightfully fishy.  Those who are not anchovy enthusiasts might want to reconsider ordering this salad but I'm definitely having it again at my return visit.  We then took advantage of the Happy Hour offerings and ordered a veritable picnic:  the cornbread fritters, the shishito peppers, the beet/burrata plate, the lengua poutine and the beef carpaccio.  Sublime!  So delicious!  My only warning is that the shishito peppers we enjoyed were all much spicier than anticipated, so I ended up taking a fair amount with me to munch on later.

Service was mostly okay, though a little slow at times considering the number of patrons present (it was still earlier in the day).  For that, and a few of the less-than-amazing beers, I had to dock just one star.

The next time I'm in Reno, I'll definitely be back; I'm dying to try The Viking and that Caesar was one of the best I've ever had.  Definitely give this place a try if you've been on the fence, or you're considering dining options while in Reno.  You won't be sorry!

Great place on busy Broadway. The waitress was super friendly, nice and attentive. The music - two older men that were in their 80s probably - did a great job entertaining the crowd. It was so much fun seeing how much they enjoyed singing and entertaining the crowd. There was a special New Years menu so not as much to choose from as normal. We had fried bologna and french fries. It just sounded so funky we had to try it and it was not bad at all. Good place to hang out for a while.

Haven't even been able to try their food yet! I have called three different times to see if their vegan menu was available and it consistently was not. Big disappointment. Shouldn't have to phone days ahead just to have access to a menu I can order from.

Food was ok

I loved the banana cream pie. Both my dessert and the mango margarita were delicious. 

But word to all they do not have gender neutral bathrooms

I stood in a line 50 ladies deep for the ladies room and watched a woman try to help a friend in a cast and leg scooter use the men's room since the line was so long and the management kicked them out of the bathroom and told them it was illegal to use the men's room and he then posted an employee at the men's bathroom door to make sure no other ladies tried to use the men's room. He said it was for their own safety.

All these good reviews are real. Wonderful and flavorful food. Don't know about consistency yet. Wonderful costumer service and my daughter loved the music there. Bosnian of course. For my Mediterranean ears it sounds like Greek / Turkish. 
Mouth watering spices. Will go again now that I tried them at last.
Open 24/7, really??! No one responds to take orders at the drive through at 11:00 pm! I waited a few minutes and left.. so the driver on the other line. Terrible service! Shame!

I've been dining at Zona for over a year and have found it to be the best sushi in East Tucson (maybe all of Tucson). The atmosphere is cool and attractive. The owners are very welcoming and friendly; they remember what I order and how I like it and seem to appreciate my business.
Wow!!! Tampa needed a new spot! This place is awesome! I ordered the Pork Belly and Barbacoa tacos.. Absolutely amazing!! Drinks 5stars Food 5stars

Omg delicious bbq!!! That's really all I can say!!! Absolutely delicious! It's authentic not smothered in sauce bbq! The flavor is unreal and needs nothing added to it! Definitely recommend!!! They also seem to have a buffet, not sure if it's every evening or just select evenings but when we went they had an Italian dinner buffet. Didn't try it, I wanted the bbq!  definitely check it out! Also make sure u check their websites bc they are closed some days due to catering. Staff was very friendly! Go...just GO!!!

Probably the best place to get tacos in Trenton. The portions are great and the prices reasonable. I highly recommend the Carnitas tacos, they're my all time favorite. The location is usually never packed so service is very attentive. Be warned that the establishment seems to be family owned, so there may be a language barrier for non-Spanish speaking customers.  If you dine-in you get chips and salsa as an appetizer.  Another tip: if you get tacos ask for the "hecho a mano" tortillas which means hand made, they will charge you an extra dollar but the flavor is incomparable to regular flour tortillas.

I'm almost hesitant to write this review...because this is my secret spot. With 142 reviews, I know it's not so secret but let me dream. lol.

When you come here BE HUNGRY. You get a TON of food and it's all amazing. I took my husband for the first time last week and he loved it. We both ordered platters. You get a protein- which we picked chicken kabob- two veggie sides, a salad, and a GIANT piece of naan...all for about $14. It's a steal. 

So we place the order and my husband is pumped about the value but then takes his first bite of the chicken- WOW. They marinate the chicken in yogurt so it's so tender you can cut it with the side of your plastic fork. I got chana masala as one of my sides and it was incredible. Had a kick to it but also very flavorful. 

This place isn't fancy so if you don't want to eat there (they have parking if you do) they do have delivery and take out. Either way, GO. EAT. BE HAPPY.

#NotAHockeyBar   We went in to watch @IndyFuel   since they were out of town. Well, forget that. They say they support the Fuel but told us they were "blacked out" on TV and couldn't get it. Uh, just spring for the ECHL out of town package. We do. 
Instead we got to "enjoy" the WWE Westlemania complete with trivia before. 
Beer - usual Indy beer bar selection. 
Food - mediocre at best. 
Never. Again.

Love love love this place! Best views of Tampa. Trendy and tasty! I have not been disappointed any of the three times I have been here. I went 3 times in a month when it first opened. My favorite drink is the Mai Tai and the best eats is the Jerk Chicken Egg Rolls which are spicy and delicious. There is a wait to get in every time I've been but no cover thankfully. The price point is reasonably considering the ambiance it offers. Definitely a Tampa gem!

Amazing pho. Probably some of the best I've had. My girlfriend and I order from here at least twice a month. Staff is always courteous and professional. Only downside is they are closed on Monday, but everyone needs a break. I will continue to frequent this business.

No calamari.  I LOVE the calamari that you can get from the Chinatown location and the fact that this location doesn't have it on the menu is a huge let down for me as that's one of my main go tos to order.   When I asked about it, the server (who was clearly more about watching the Sixers game) said "is that octopus?" No.   Then he went on to say that they can put calamari on anything I want and he's sure it's in a lot of the dishes..... I explained how it is its on item on the Chinatown menu but he said they never had it here.    (I'll be honest here, this was in the same week that I lost a family member and I just wanted something that I loved to help cheer me up, so I took the void of calamari harder than a normal person would). 
My partner was also disappointed by the chicken.  He said it tasted the same as Chinatown in terms of breading but it wasn't the true Korean fried chicken that he gets in the city.   
We both agreed that even though this is the same chain, the quality of this location is subpar to the city.   It doesn't have the same feel at all.  Chinatown has K-Pop blasting to make you deaf, this one quietly had basketball playing and didn't have the same vibe at all.  While I'm excited that Bonchon is in the suburbs, I will wait until I'm in Philly to partake. 

Only saving grace is the pickled radishes.

Overall the food was very good. I decided to eat here after traveling all day and checking in. I was offered what appeared to be focaccia bread that looked good but was very hard and had no flavor. My entrée made up for it. Grouper Asian style. Nice portion and the flavor was fantastic. Very healthy meal. I was not offered to sit outside on the patio and wished I had asked as it looked like a beautiful night out.
Great friendly and fast service. Nice inside and the food was SO good. Will definitely recommend them and come again when back in NOLA!

Company Burger where have you been all my life? We found his place using google maps and decided to try them out. When you walk in the first sign you see is the blue one telling you where to go for the type of service you want. We were here on a Friday during lunch so it was packed so we had a little wait to wait for bar seating to open. Once we did the bartender was very attentive and helpful. The draft beers come from different breweries so you might not see anything you know but the bartender will help and let you sample. I ordered the lamb burger and shared fries and let me tell you! The best burger I have had in a very long time! It was cooked medium and a little messy but so juicy and well seasoned. I'm glad we found this place and I miss it already.

Excellent!  The food was great.  We got a burger and the pulled pork sandwich.  The burger was in the shape of a hotdog bun - very fun.  The pulled pork was the winner, though.  Delicious!  Great venue and fun view of State St. from upstairs.  We'll be back and next time with the kids!

Had a bacon, egg and cheese sandwich and thought it was below average. Everything was flavorless. The eggs were grey and seemed microwaved. Bagel was slightly chewy and bland. The interior was ugly, with truck stop lighting and low ceilings. The checkout experience was terrible.

Overall, it was not disappointing.
The Salmon BLT was perfect. Best sandwich on the menu. I'll definitely be back for that.

Great bartenders. Hidden gem. Nice spot off the beaten track. 
Food was quick and very good. 
Clean bar with a staff that welcomes all.
Why eat at the Hotel buffet when you can get the beat at Pegs for half the cost. Every time we visit we only eat Breakfast at Pegs!!!

Great place for lunch. Whether you want it hot or cold, you can order from the menu. Lots of beer choices. This location is nestled in the center of Whole Foods. The staff is very friendly and prompt. This place can be jam packed near the happy hour, so arrive early to get a seat. If you like what you are drinking, you can order one to go. I be returning soon. It's a fun place to hang out and relax with friends.

Service is friendly, but they are overwhelmed.
Pho is pretty good, not the best I've had, but good enough to come back.
Wish their prices were $1 lower per dish, then they would be a really good deal and a weekly visit.
Their Vermicelli Bowl was hands down the best one I've ever had. The flavor, the portions, everything about it was phenomenal, well except the price, a bit pricey, but it was so YUM!
My husband really enjoyed it, and he can't wait to come back again. 
I'm just happy I found a above average Pho place in the area.
To the reviewers who said the bathroom was horrible, the bathroom I walked into was actually pretty clean and neat. You have obviously never been to bathrooms in Chinatown. That's an adventure..

My husband and I had dinner at Arnoldi's a couple of times and knew we wanted to have our wedding reception there and then Covid happened. We had already put a deposit down and were working with Arnoldi's event planner Sara, who was very helpful and accommodating during this time. We ended up having a small dinner with socially distanced tables the night we got married and it was perfect. Everything from the food and drinks to the beautiful setting of their outside patio area. The few guests that were there raved about how amazing it was. 
The only suggestion I would have for the restaurant is to remove the "recommended florist" you have listed on your website. Ruben from Elevate Floral is a crook, who stole our money and left town without ever providing flowers for our wedding day. 
Arnoldi's cafe is a restaurant I would recommend for a date night, a family dinner or when wedding receptions are happening again, a beautiful reception! Great food and great service and we will definitely be coming back for years to come!

If you come here with the expectation that the food is going to blow you away: you're delusional. You come here for the atmosphere and the "dick's" of course. I just laughed nonstop here. I thought the waiters and bartenders were super dicky and it was hysterical. My favorite part: one of the girls I was with had no idea that that was the theme of the restaurant... one of the waiters yelled at her for being in his way and she started yelling back at him and called him rude. Again, I just laughed. 

And even though I didn't have high expectations for the food...The chicky fried chicky was very juicy, crispy and tasty. Although the server was a "dick," he was very prompt when bringing our drinks and attending to us.

Stop in here if you're looking for some laughs!
Great vibe. I wasn't big on the cooking your own meal. But I really liked the server, bartender and other patrons.

Went here for the first time tonight. As others had posted, the service was excellent! My glass of water was never empty. I ordered the OMG roll and it was nothing short of that! It came out 5 min after I ordered it beautifully presented. I also ordered the spicy ramen soup with the seasoned egg. I have been looking for a good bowl of ramen ever since my visit to Guam. This came pretty darn close to what I fell in love with there. The broth was very good with the perfect spice level. The pork was better than what i had in Guam. The noodles however were a little less than amazing. I'm pretty sure they came out of a package, which is ok, but not amazing. I would def go back!

I noticed that Dat Dog had vegan dogs,  so we scanned the menu, decided on a dog, the field roast Italian dog, and went in.  When I got there, my choice dog was not available so I ordered the chipotle dog.  It was a little spicy but very good.  I'll be back and hopefully have the Italian dog.

Great brunch place! The wait was like 20 minutes or so which apparently is great compared to what it usually is here. They have a water cooler outside which is great since it's been so hot outside. 

I ordered biscuits and gravy with a side of home fries and some orange juice. The orange juice is fresh squeezed and tastes amazing. The biscuits and gravy weren't the best I've ever had and were actually a little spicy? But pretty good still. The home fries were probably my favorite part of the meal so I'm glad I got them as a side. Perfectly cooked and a great compliment to my breakfast. 

The service was great. Very friendly, helpful, and attentive employees.

About a 15 min walk from the end of State Street. No reservations so get there either early or late if you don't want to wait long. Get there around 7:30pm and got lucky to get upstairs bar seat (full menu); downstairs bar seating only serves about half the menu. The restaurant was full! Sat inside but all of the windows were open so wear a jacket/coat! Ordered SEABASS which came with slaw, rice (or fries) and a cup (mug) of Chowder. Fish was well prepared, chowder was filling and hot and service was pretty quick. Wine list is okay (could be better since Santa Barbara has a lot of wineries - Best red wine, by the glass, on the list was Meiomi).

Wait staff- Mediocre at best 

Drinks - Prefect Bloody Mary to much smoke/ bacon 

Appetizers - Chicken (Awesome!!!) and Tuna ( tasty a little less Rosemary next time)

Entrees - Octopus(fair) Pork shoulder (not bad but salty), Ribs (fair but salty)

Sides - Split Roasted Cabbage ( delicious), Skillet Mac and Cheese ( an absolute must have!!!) 

Dessert - Grilled Apple Pie - ( delicious)

I had a craving for a chicken sandwich and wanted to try something a bit different. After some research, I opted for the spicy chicken sandwich from Huda (via delivery). It did not disappoint! The chicken was crisp and juicy, and the sauce gave the sandwich just enough of a kick (though I would not actually call the sandwich spicy). As good as the chicken was, the best part of the sandwich were definitely the buns - they were extremely fluffy, and all around just super delicious.

I completed my order with a side of fries. I loved the chive topping on the fries, though I think the fries were a bit oversalted.

This isn't the cheapest sandwich in the world, but I would say the portion is fair and the quality of the food is high. I will definitely be back to try more of the menu.
I have loved the pizza at taffy's for the last few years... best crust ... until lately... maybe new owners... things are not the same.. todays order was just bad...  I hope u get it together.

Trying new restaurants while girls on a two week vacation. Two of the ladies had been here before but I had not. Great surprise....food was above our expectations. Peel & eat shrimp were amazing, blackened grouper some of the best we've found. Salads were fresh and nice size. Atmosphere casual and family friendly. Prices were some of the best we've seen especially for a tourist area! Going back for sure!!!

Great place with large portions!  Fast and friendly wait staff.  The food was fantastic.  The choriqueso dip is great with the Tortilla chips as an appetizer.  Very affordable.  Will be going to this place more often.

pizza is okay. kinda sucks that you have to go home and then heat it up to eat it. pretty inconvenient. should start baking them and then selling them so they can be ready. should get a drive thru too.

The day? Friday night. After struggling through classes for the entire week, my friend and I decided to drown our sorrows away with some ramen. We waited outside for a solid 10 minutes after having given one of the workers our number. He did not end up hitting up our line. After sitting down, we waited another 10 minutes until our order was taken. This was no big deal. We enjoyed each other's company. 

I took it upon myself to order the Tori ramen with chicken, corn, and crispy garlic. My friend ordered Nikki ramen with chicken, egg, bamboo shoots, and bean sprouts.  

After waiting for a bit over an hour, we finally received our meals. To be honest, it was very underwhelming. While it was definitely flavorful...it wasn't the flavor we wanted. It was good, but nothing special and definitely not worth the wait. Oh well. At least they had nice music and it was fun trying to find all the hidden ducks in the restaurant. I will add, our waitress was absolutely lovely and she apologized many times for the wait! We would come back for her.

We love Indian food and we've ordered from this restaurant before. But tonight, it was not good. 
The picture taken is of the mulligatawny soup. It has veggies if it - not like that before. Very spicy. 
We also ordered the vegetable vindaloo, was pretty much the same thing - which it should never be. Almost as if they mixed it together?! Idk! Leftovers?! 
The prices are so high, I expected a better quality! I understand smaller portions, so not even complaining about that. But the quality was weak. Maybe it's great there if you actually go to the restaurant. But I was very disappointed with the $80- delivery order that just landed at our house for Sunday dinner. Not worth it!

We had garlic knots requested with no cheese, no oil and 2 small pizzas. The marinara dipping sauce was thick and zesty, the ranch dipping sauce was one of the best I've had, and the bread texture and flavor was top notch in the garlic knots. Crust on the pizza varied from thin towards the center to thicker on the outside with that same great taste and texture. I highly recommend this place. P. S. The honey on the table is to dip the crust in.

I was desperate for a good, quick breakfast. It wasn't good or quick. I concur with the other reviews here: very slow but friendly service, food not so great, place not clean. Off-shift employees came in to pick up paychecks and food while I waited and the 2 1/2 people on duty spent time chatting with them instead of tending the counter/kitchen. Drive-thru orders were delivered to the parking lot 10 minutes after ordering.

So, the food and ambience and service is sublime. Let's start there, but we are approaching this from a food-sensitivity perspective that makes every meal out a potential minefield.
I want to say that Hearthside really did put in a solid effort to accommodate my allergies and my partner's Celiac, but at the end of the night, my partner was sick as hell and showed clear signs of gluten exposure. 
We believe that it was the "Special", the fried potato small plate, since he started feeling sick after eating that but before dessert. They were kind enough to comp out dessert, but our server was slightly dismissive at the end of the night - I get it, it was late, she tried, they may have thought we were free-food seeking - but I want the chef/management to be aware that this exposure occurred for the future. This was our special night out; we usually cannot afford such fine food. But, are all safety precautions truly being taken? It could have been as simple as grabbing the potatoes from the wrong fryer.

Mamma Mia this is an incredible staff.

Kind of a cramped location, it was a bit hard finding room to even take off my jacket.

This is also a cash only BYOB restaurant. However if you do bring any wine, they will serve it to you as you eat.

The menu is authentic Italian with a full Italian speaking crew. They are all excellent servers with the greatest manners. We really felt top class dining here. 

The olive oil /vinigrette and table bread was excellent. The bread was always toasty and oven warm.

Prices were certainly modest, pasta dishes being around 15-20 dollars and the most expensive dishes about 22.

The salad special that day was truly exquisite we ordered one right after finishing the first. Light olive oil based dressing, hearty helpings of fresh, not watery mozzarella and diced, crisp tomatoes. Also the thickest cut prosciutto I've ever seen!

The dessert selection is really impressive. Definitely listen to the list no matter how full you are. 

I enjoy coffee with my sweets and so we got a piece of their fresh homemade tiramisu! It was really nice. However, the coffee had almost no taste to it. It seemed very watered down and was hardly distinguishable from hot water.

Cramped location, very weak coffee, only accepting cash, and BYOB are my only criticisms. Otherwise this place is perfection.

I highly highly recommend this restaurant if you're ever feeling Italian in philidelphia.

Today was a little busier than usual. This is my 2nd time coming and the sauce in the pop corn chicken was sooo little today. So stingy in the sauce for the popcorn chicken. Also - it appears you cannot purchase popcorn chicken thru the app. You can only purchase some of the appetizers and the drinks. I'm not exactly sure why so I had to wait a lot longer as opposed to being able to buy ahead of time. The bubble tea is as expected delicious tho and the service is decent.

After protesting my group to go here and I was out voted, but I bet I won't be again.  True to the Outback Hazelwood form we were not disappointed and got the service and food I told them we would. BAAAADDDD!!!!
We ordered appetizers that came out burnt and out waitress forgot our two of our salads.  All four of us ordered their large Outback special thinking that was the way to go.  NEVER again, we waited 30 min and our steaks were obviously not the right size.  One was huge, one was the small and the other 2, after we asked, were the child's portion.  Why couldn't the cook or waitress see this was wrong????  So one of us got to eat and the rest of us had to wait.  Then they came 
out one by one.  Three of us were done before the 4th person ever got their replacement!  NEVER did the manager come by apologize or anything!!!  NEVER will I go here again.  This restaurant is a huge mark on their reputation as far as I'm concerned.

YUM! So good!! First, the workers were some of the friendliest I have ever seen. I created my own wrap to the cashier's suggestion, and it was great. I didn't notice the extra price for turkey which was my fault, but the food was flavorful. I loved the twist of a burrito with rice paper.

Absolutely delicious! Very legit Mexican cuisine, with choices of salsas. I'm a visitor to Santa Barbara, but I'm pretty sure I'd come here often if I lived here! Only downside: a slightly disorganized set up, and quite crowded. The service was OK, but very friendly once you got their attention. I highly recommended!

This was a nice little (and I do mean little) breakfast spot we found when googling "breakfast in New Orleans." It was like having a home cooked meal away from home. The doorman accommodated us from the time we checked in until the time we left. The doorman and the waiter tag teamed as they were the only two people working besides the cooks. The food was delicious and it was well worth it. The prices were excellent, not expensive at all. If I am ever in NOLA again, I will definitely be back.
First time at Chubby Cattle & Brandon was able to gave us the best customer service & he was very helpful. If you're planning to splurge this is the best place to go to eat..they have excellent food!
This Hotpot's taste and service like 3 star Michelin Hotpot! It's like the best Hotpot you can only find in Hotpot's hometown, you have to come check this out! And the price is very affordable!

Haven't tried the Asian items but the Puerto Rican items were so good! My wife is Puerto Rican so we ordered Amarillo, Mofongo, and Carne Frita. Safe to say she approved of the taste and use of the spices, and that it reminded her of her family's cooking. Will be back for more!

Definitely will have try them again. Everything was delicious the staff was friendly and efficient. They also serve Sushi I think I will try it the next go around. The restaurant is well established has been there at least 10 years.

I love this place. I used to not but they revamped the place and have new management. The servers are very friendly, the manager on duty greets every customer and the bartender is experienced and knowledgeable of mixology. The food is consistently great everytime. And the prices are well balanced and affordable. 
Coming again tonight for dinner and maybe even on my birthday this November 10th

Delicious!!!! We've had Lupton's cater and cook out on their truck for company BBQs & luncheons at the office, and they are amazing. From the rolls to their amazing chicken. All I can say is YES PLEASE & MORE PLEASE!!! the mashed potatoes are to die for, and everything I've had (ribs, burgers, every side) has been better than the item I tried before.

Now that I know from viewing here on yelp that they have a brick and mortar shop, looks like more BBQ will enter my world :)

Food was good as well as selection. This is a buffet style restaurant decorated in a clean French bistro style. Very nice ambiance with beautiful courtyard. The jazz band plays as you indulge in samples of local cuisine. The service however will depend on your server and will make or break your visit. OUR server was not great at all. She treated us poorly and when we asked for refills on water or coffee she never responded with any form of acknowledgement...so we never really knew if she heard us or not. We also asked for butter (as there is a sign on the table that says "please ask server for coffee, water or butter) and we asked for butter THREE times before it was brought to our table. Anything we asked for was met with zero response. When our checks came, same thing. No "thanks for joining us today ladies...." No "here are your tickets..." no acknowledgment whatsoever. Meanwhile we did observe other tables were treated better with friendly staff that actually spoke to them and acknowledged them as guests. 

So....ambiance is beautiful. Food is good. Selection is great. But your visit is predicated on how good or bad your server is just like any place you dine at. Ours unfortunately was not as great because of service from our server. So sad.
Beside the moldy bread which they took and brought back fresh, the food was ok expect for the portion sizes.
One of my favorite bars in the city for either happy hour or a quick bite. The food is tasty, the Brussels sprouts are some of my favorite in the city. And great for a post game drink.

Went back one more time to try take out. The young guy behind the counter was SCREAMING at a waitress before I even opened the door. Cou dnt figure out why they do NO BUSINESS but now I know. Mozz sticks were hard as rock, got the sausage pie which smelled funky and asked for l, T, O on the burger and got up charged. If you use a coupon the owner seems to get Mad. Two Strikes, wont be a third, just going to Francos from now on.

Hard to believe I havent written about this place yet. I have been here a few times both pre and post Eli Collins, and I have to say its still just as good as its always been. They make one of the best bloody marys in the city as well as an always delicious burger. It may have changed a bit, but its still awesome. We took a few friends here to celebrate their engagement recently, and everything really worked out nicely.

We started with a few cocktails, classic mule made with rye for me, and we settled in to a steady conversation of wedding planning and stories of engagement nights. The cocktail was delicious, even with the change from standard vodka in a moscow mule to the rye. The ginger beer and lime combo is bomb.

So many things on the menu caught my eye, but the one we all seemed enticed by was the whiskey and sage bread with ramp butter. We ordered one for the table and I ordered the pulled pork shoulder sandwich. The bread came out warm and covered in a flour "pabbit" the mascot of Pub and Kitchen. It was served on a slate dish with a smear of ramp butter that was deeply satisfying. I could have eaten the entire loaf all by myself. The butter was superb and you could definitely taste the whiskey in the bread.

I was a little bit disappointed when my pulled pork sandwich came out though. When I think of pulled pork, I think BBQ style. Had the sandwich description read porchetta or something of that nature, I would have expected what I got. That being saidm the sandwich was really tasty, an ode to the Philly staple of roast italian pork. It was super messy, I am talking juice running down your arms while you are chomping down messy, but in such a good way. I devoured the entire thing. So tasty. The fries are just as I remembered them, fantastic. They were super crispy.

We even ordered a dessert to share for the table. It was one for the ages, one of the most delicious panna cottas I have ever had. It was a vanilla cardamom panna cotta covered in a mango sauce. It was the most perfectly textured panna cotta I have ever seen. It had just the right amount of jiggle, so that it quivered in its dish when it was set down on the table. The cardamom was just powerful enough to really bring another level of flavor to it, but not overpower the vanilla in any way. Outstanding. Pub and Kitchen is just as good as its ever been. One of my favorite places in the city. Always worth a visit.
Wonderful food and service. Our go-to place in Santa Barbara

Horrible service. I went in on a very slow Sunday after a twelve hour shift to order a STEAK burrito. There was no line and the girl making my burrito was distracted by her coworker,  who was talking to her while i went through what i wanted on my burrito causing me to repeat myself and also prevent her from putting items on that i didn't want. When I got to the register the rude eye rolling girl who interrupted the whole process asked "what he get?" and the girl making it said ummm, chicken. (I honestly,  and perhaps foolishly, corrected her and said steak.) The cashier just looked at me with a blank stare... no "thank you" or "you're welcome" (because i did for some reason say thank you). Straight up rude employees...bye Felicia! I'll take my money elsewhere.

We have been to Erini many times and each time it does not disappoint. The food, service, and atmosphere are all great. Even through the dining room was full you are able to carry on a conversation at your table.  Most recently we dined with another couple, two of us had the prime rib special and it was absolutely delicious, hubby had chicken parm he continued to raved about it two days later, and the 4th ordered the a pasta with seafood and said it was equally good. Would highly recommend Erini. We drive about 45 minutes from our house and it is worth every minute.

My partner and I get food delivered all the time. I decided to take the kids I work with for lunch today. The place is nicely decorated with comfy outside seating. Too bad I was with minors, I would have had a pint! The food was excellent. Since my husband and I moved to Drexel Hill, coming from the city, we've been pretty disappointed with our local food selection. This place saved the day! The pizza is outstanding. The kids had spaghetti and meatballs. I tasted, of course, and the sauce was delicious. Needless to say, I won't be solely getting delivery from this.place anymore!

When it comes to "real" food there is nothing better to me than a good steak.  When it comes to steak there is nothing better than a blue steak!  J. Gilbert's is one of the first places in St. Louis I've found to cook a perfect blue steak.  

Yes, J. Gilbert's is pricey so consider it the perfect place to celebrate a special occasion.  

Yes, J. Gilbert's is in a mall.  Technically it's on the outside of the West County "Dove" mall.  It's in the same outdoor plaza that houses Bravo and McCormick & Schmick's.  The interior design has a nice warm feeling.  

Pete and I arrived early and had a pre dinner cocktail.  Bar Staff was attentive and made a good drink.  I was surprised how crowded the bar was but to me that's a good thing.  Drinks were pricey but you pay for where you are.  Pete had a martini and I had of course a Blue Moon ;)  Cost was 17.54 w/ tip was $21. (Yes,  I don't believe in tipping a dollar for a drinks, RUDE!) 

I love a simple set table.  Elegant yet simple.  No strange centerpieces to look around or candles to distract.  

Our server Joseph was beyond competent.  He was helpful and extremely knowledgeable of the both the food and wine menu.   I find this helpful when trying to pair a wine with my meal. 

I had the 4oz filet with sea scallops.   As I've previously stated my filet was cooked to "my" perfection. I asked for as rare as it can be cooked, Joseph asked do you like blue?  I almost fell out of my seat!  Finally someone in St. Louis who knows what blue is and will actually ask you if you want it cooked blue!  HEAVEN!  I've stopped asking for blue steak long ago as most servers look at me like I have snakes coming out of my head.  The scallops were divine!  My sides were poblano au gratin potatoes and grilled asparagus.  The asparagus while cooked well were just a tad larger than I like.  However I ate them all so what does that said :)

I like wine but I always have such a hard time finding one that I like that pairs well with what I'm eating.  I love Les Bourgeois Riverboat Red  (ok laugh now) but that really doesn't pair with anything.  Last night I had a red blend from Ghost Pines out of California.  It was a perfect dark wine with a smooth taste without an alcohol bite.  

Everyone in our party reported their meals were good.

I do want to mention Pete who rarely even has one drink had a second martini last night His second choice was a sparkling blackberry martini.  It smells phenomenal so I had to take a sip!  It was yummy.  Like my food, I'm not crazy about sweet things however  I would actually order this martini if the mood was right.  (Recipe for Pete: SPARKLING BLACKBERRY MARTINI Stoli Vodka, Chambord, fresh squeezed lemon juice, pure cane syrup, Ruffino Prosecco float garnished with blackberries and lemon)

Since it was a birthday celebration there was dessert.  My favorite dessert when out is cheesecake.  I always just want a bite or two so Pete and I split. Very good, a tad overly sweet but good.  The best part was their coffee.  Oh my it smelled phenomenal and tasted equally good.   

I have nothing negative to report.  If you ever need a place to celebrate a special occasion or just want an exceptional meal for the heck of it, I highly recommend J. Gilbert's.  Ask for Joseph, I promise you will have the best service of your life.

I don't give a lot of 5-star reviews, but this place deserved it. 

The food is great! Honestly, it's some of the best Indian food I've ever had. The Peshawari Naan is fantastic, with real nuts and raisins in the bread. And the paneer and chicken tikka masala was creamy and... well, you just have to try it.

The only negative is that it is in a gas station. But I kind of think that adds to the local color. However, regardless of the location, the food stands on it's own.

We will be back!

Hard to customize the flavor of the drinks you want.  Or at least, I've not like their tea lattes very much, and I keep trying. Definitely cozy with all the options for seating, but I've tried several drinks here and I'm not sure the price justifies the product. They actually have wifi, which works pretty well, so that's a good way to get out of the house and get some work done. The baked goods and sandwiches are about average for a coffee shop, except Green Line has done vegan and vegetarian options which is a necessity for these parts. 

Overall, nothing crazy about this place, but they keep a clean bathroom and every time I walk by, I see a few of the same regulars chilling around.
