Also, there's an asshole on the patio who brought his own Bluetooth speaker and is playing his own awful music that kills the little bit of happiness I had after this experience. I'm walking away from half of a beer to get out of this place.

Love to go here for a buffet. It's a small but happening place, so you might have to wait for a while outside ( yes,they do not have a wait area) during peak hours and weekends. Sometimes, I find that the Korma ( especially channa masala) lacked flavors (being Indian, I have very high expectations for indian restaurants). 

Garlic naan and Samosa chaat are my favorite. Love the chicken kabobs - but sometimes on a busy day, I find that they tend to be little flavor less in the middle or even burnt pretty bad. Again, dessert options are not that great - they are mediocre. Been there a handful number of times. Overall I would say its good place to go once a while for the buffet and stuff up with dishes flavorful that day! Better than the other Indian places in Boise.

I've heard about their Sunday 4-course $24 dinners for years and finally went last night. Our expectations were exceeded. Raddicho parm salad, grilled shrimp, hangar steak with mashed potatoes (hubbie had a wonderful sea bass) and almond chocolate cake. Every course was sublime and the service and ambiance was perfect. This will become a Sunday tradition for us since it's an unbelievable deal.

Went with my brother who just moved near bye.  We wanted a place a little off main so we would be able to enjoy.

It was pouring rain but the valet was happy to get our cars.
The waitress was very nice and had a great personality the food was great and came out fast and hot.  I got the fish and chips and ate every bite which if you know me does not always happen but it was that good.

If you are in town looking for a good spot then head 
In over
This place is amazing!  Fresh pastries, breads, and coffee in a relaxed family atmosphere.  Very good and fast service!

I wanted to make sure to leave a review for this new sushi place in NE Philly. Nowadays few restaurants (or any other services) impress anymore. 
The place is brand new, newly renovated with nicer than your average decor, and spotless clean. The sushi so fresh, beautifully presented, and most importantly - not skimping on fish. Most sushi places put a long list of sushi rolls on their menu, which end up looking and tasting  almost the same and are mostly rice. Not at this place! My boyfriend and I ordered our usual number of rolls and an entree each and had to take our entrees home because we were so full from the sushi. They do not cut corners when it comes to the food they serve, the service they provide, and presentation of the restaurant. My Pad Thai was excellent also. Instead of your usual brown sauce noodle mixture, their Pad Thai looks and tastes fresh and delicious. 
Service was great as well! I cannot really find even one thing to criticize. Maybe that the hot green tea could be stronger. Definitely the nicest and best quality Japanese/Chinese place in NE Philly. I hope they keep it that way.
Should have just went to wawa and saved a lot of money. Italian hoagie lacked flavor, tasted more like an American hoagie. Not impressed.

We have been eagerly anticipating the opening of this place at work, since there is not a ton of fast options (McDonalds, BK, etc.) and we weren't disappointed. First - the fries - I could have eaten a whole pound. They were coated in pepper and sooo good. The pasta bowl we got with Alfredo and Breaded chicken - which was also very good - a little small (I was full - but I could see other people not - it was also only $6) and it also came with garlic bread. The other people in my party got roast pork, canolli dip, gelato (definition - water ice) and everyone was happy. 

Downsides - Stuff was a little salty (mostly the sandwich meats), The garlic aoili was more like mayo than anything else, drive thru was a little long (it was the first day)

We will be back.

Fantastic ceviche, the steak was delicious.  Loved the sangria, and a really good, reasonable wine selection.  Dee was our server, attentive without being intrusive, great job!  Do yourself a favor and order the chocolate brownie with a glass of the 20 year port for dessert.  You will smile all the way home!

WOW! Last night was the first time I've been here and I was impressed. I've been looking for a traditional Chinese restaurant and I've found it. Family meal style and plenty of helpings. We started with Pan Fried Dumplings which were nothing short of perfection.  For the main course we had PORK SZECHUAN STYLE and HUNAN CRISPY FISH FILET WITH SPICY SAUCE. Top that off with a side of Chinese broccoli and a pot of Jasmine and oolong tea and you have a fantastic night. The food was flavorful and rich. The service professional and attentive. If You are looking for the real traditional Chinese food this is definitely a spot for you. I will definitely be back.

We went here after waiting to be served at the Texas Road House for 15-20 min and no one even got our drinks so we left. This is not my first time at J. B Dawson and their customers service has always been great. The food is also been very good. We got served right away by 2 waiters, guess they work as a team thing here and they were pretty busy. Left a generous tip and overall I'm satisfied!

My family and I eat here regularly. It's our go-to spot for Thai food in the STL area. We moved here from SoCal and needed to find "home" style Thai food that isn't too westernized. They make delicious food with the perfect blend of spices. In addition, if you like spicy, they have good options for plates with an extra kick. Service is good and comes out quick! I highly recommend it.

I'm a big fan of wingstop so I tend to grab some no matter what state I'm in when traveling. This wingstop serves the best wings out of all the other wing stops I've ever tried across different states. Dem boyz know what they doing in there!

Came here for lunch today for their devour menu. This was my first time coming to this chain and it will probably be my last. The food was very bland with no flavor at all. We had their spinach and artichoke dip, Mac and cheese, fish and chips, and banana toffee pudding. The app and main courses were a disappointment. The pudding was a little better but tasted as if it were still frozen from the fridge.
Great ambience on the intercostal. Cheap drink options. Happy hour is great. Food is delicious. Everyone is nice. What more could you say?

really bad service they're rude to customers seriously overpriced all they care about is their sales and nobody elseReally bad service the server's are standing around not doing anything you asking for something and you have to wait 10 to 15 minutes in order to get it. Constantly running out of beverages that people and regulars normally drink and they don't keep  any extra in stock and there is underage servers serving alcohol...

Friday night is the night to be at the Dutch Goose!  Fresh halibut waiting for the deep fat fryer and then your taste buds!  Those golden fried morsels of the sea are so delicious you'll be back for more next Friday!   Try the Prime Rib - only available on Friday nights also!  Fair price for excellent food!
This is by far the slowest place I've ever been. Tried to get 1 breakfast sandwich, waited 20 minutes and left. The people making them have zero sense of urgency.

Was in Nashville for a Bachelorette Party, this restaurant wasn't too bad - but you need to go with a very open mind, as the food is different, and not everyone's taste buds were pleased (so to say).  Also, pay attention to the breakfast/lunch hours - pending on what you are in the mood for and want to eat.  Nice ambiance and service.

The pizza, as the name suggests, is delicious!

Simple menu, with great options. This joint really knows their pizza. Don't be dissuaded by the price; it's worth it!

We ordered the margarita ($19, before tax) which apparently can only be ordered any other size besides large. No worries for us - that's dinner for later! I do know you can other by the slice, if you're not in the mood for a whole pizza.

What can I say... The pizza was FANTASTIC! Crunchy, crispy, perfect crust that wasn't soggy. Great cheese/tomato sauce ratio with good flavor and seasoning. Despite ordering an entire pizza, it was out in less than 10 minutes! 

The place isn't huge, but there is inside and outdoor seating if you're feeling adventurous.

Additionally, they offer a wide variety of drinks (alcoholic and non!) 

I drove out of my way to eat here, and was happy I did. Even if you're not in the neighborhood, give it a try!
Delicious pizza and great delivery. They even brought their driver in a few minutes early on very short notice for me so pizzas could be delivered for my daughter's birthday party in time.

Our waitress was very friendly, as well as the whole staff. Everything is priced fairly well, IMO. I like the overall layout of this place, you have numerous tv's as well some video games to play. Now onto the food part. We had the honey bbq flavored wings, and they were good. Not over cooked, just plain good!!! The sauce was right on point. The pulled pork sandwich was good as well as the beef o' brady burger.  Definitely will come back when were in the area again.

Great little local place! 
It's all small local produce tapas style dishes, I shared the pork pancakes & duck potpie - delicious both were juicy, flavoursome & satisfying. I could eat the pork belly pancakes all day! 
They have great local Jazz bands playing most nights that give the place a great atmosphere
I love coming here! The food is amazing and the service is outstanding! Always pleasant and kind hearted! This is my go-to for a GREAT burger and shake!

As a local I try to get here once a week. Biscuits and gravy, pancakes and eggs Benedict are awesome. Friendly
Family
Staff.

Very nice, upscale restaurant in Philly. The environment is lovely, especially if you get to seat outside on their terrace. The service was also excellent and the waitress recommendations where top notch. Everything they use is fresh and the food is pretty good. It was just a little expensive.

This restaurant probably makes the best pizzas I've ever had and the service staff is always friendly and great, our bartender Danielle she's always on point, creates amazing drinks and she's always fun and easygoing. I ordered their Pretzel Bites with the cheese dip and it was delicious, they're not classic pretzel bites instead they use their pizza dough to make the bites and parmesan cheese with the dip, simply perfect. We also had some of their double baked wings and they were amazing. They also customize orders to your liking, my wife's parents had their Portobello Salad with their meatballs on top and they loved it. My wife and I shared their Great White Pizza and added banana peppers and black olives. Amazing combination of flavor and toppings, we enjoyed how well crafted it was, how well baked it was. Also another thing we liked and you would like is their draft options, they have different options from different breweries, from those known to those not so much that produce those rare good finds and I think they bring new ones every month and every season. Overall it's always a pleasure to eat at this place.
Love this place!! They have so many vegan options! The coconut curry is to die for! So much flavor in everything. I would recommend this place to anyone :)

Ordered the elotero hot dog and steak nachos. The hot dog was absolutely huge, but the topping could've had more flavor and complexity, and there wasn't much of it, so most of it fell off as I was trying to eat it and it didn't stand out as much as I was hoping. Decent meal for the price, it definitely fills you up. Only tasted a couple of bites of the nachos but they were good, too.

I'm SAD and DISAPPOINTED!  My best friend found a cigarette butt in her mussels!  My husband and I moved to Brooklyn after Hurricane Katrina but we return home for a visit at least twice a year.  We always make the effort to eat at Crepe Nanou with our friends.  It was for us, a New Orleans restaurant institution we loved until our dinner last Friday, April 14th.  Everyone at our table has worked many years in the service industry and in fact, we all met at a restaurant/music venue almost 2 decades ago and still remain best friends.  I managed a restaurant in New York City and my best friend, who found the cigarette butt in her mussels, is the general manager of another New Orleans restaurant institution.  We all know stuff like this can happen and know how it should be handled.  No one came to our table to apologize and when my friend asked to see the manager we waited 20 minutes before she had to get up to find someone.  When she finally talked to the owner, he had the audacity to blame her for putting it there for a free meal. As you can imagine, she was insulted. We were all shocked and disappointed that the owner Rich handled the situation so rudely.  I am sad to say we will NEVER return to one of my favorite restaurants in New Orleans.

First and last time at this place.
Server seemed nice but she lacked the serving skills or any interest in serving.
We ordered overpriced Pizza. It took more than 25 mins to come.
The pizza was very salty.
Our server never came back to check how was the food or refill our glasses.
I will not recommend this place to anyone.

I had my wedding there and  the food was excellent, the service was  great and most of all  Felix and the staff makes you feel like family. They did an excellent  job on that special day. No matter whether you  come for Lunch , Dinner  the quality is the same and  Felix is wonderful to all  people   Thank You

Saw the rave reviews on Yelp and as a sushi foodie had to make the trip to this restaurant. The inside is spacious and very clean and modern. It's located in a strip mall in Maple Shade but don't let that sway or deter you from coming in. The place was CROWDED on a weekday at lunch which indicated to me the food (and most importantly the fish) was fresh with great turnover of inventory. The sushi and sushi rolls were delicious. I ordered the Kani salad as well which was light and delicate in comparison to many I've had before which are heavy with mayo. The sushi three roll combination lunch was delicious and quite a good value. I had in addition to the rolls a try of tomago (egg) and also unagi (eel). Both were very tasty. Overall this was a very positive first visit and I will be sure to return often.
Went for Sunday brunch. Some other reviews mention slow service, but ours was very efficient, and our waitress was friendly and helpful.

Very disappointed in this location I took my party from out of town thinking Brentwood was a good place to eat. The server dumped all of our lunch on the side of my head ruining my shirt and a bunch of honey mustard in my hair and on my shoulder. The server was shocked and apologized which was fair they comped the meal we didn't really get that much ruined my shirt and had to stop by the washing house then Go Take A Shower Totally Ruined My day

A friend discovered this place last summer.

He convinced a group of us to go here after class, for their 12.99 lunch special all-you-can-eat. Depending on how much you can eat, the price is definitely worth it. An order of 4 rolls and 2 appetizers definitely sets you back over 13 dollars. However the sushi is not exactly the best, nor fresh, and to me, every roll seems to taste the same. I'm most likely biased from the sushi joints back home in California.

This same friend is ecstatic about the place; he always raves about coming back here for their all-you-can-eat. After a while however, I begin to diverge from their buffet menu and order from their normal one.

Glancing past their sushi and rolls off their regular menu, Sushi Ai has a satisfactory selection of bento boxes and side dishes. While this place advertises serving Japanese food, the workers and selection of music playing overheard begs to differ. The whole environment is a mix of Chinese and a little Japanese. Their Orange Chicken (??), Teriyaki Beef and Chicken all do not have any resemblance to true Japanese food. In a way, the food tastes rather dull and not worth the $10+ price.

I've since been here at least 10 times. Sometimes my friends drag me along for the sushi but I've found the quality and service to be inconsistent. Sometimes the rolls taste fresh, whereas sometimes it's obvious that the ingredients have been sitting out for a while. Moreover, the first couple of times I came here, there was this one particular waiter that lingered awkwardly over us, and objectively cut in to ask if we needed more water. At the end, he even stopped us before we went out the door asking for a tip. The hell? However it seems that Sushi Ai has let that particular waiter go and their service has seen been improved. 

The atmosphere is average, nothing too special. My friends and I are always seated at the same exact table. Nothing to really complain about though.

After passing over their all-you-can-eat menu, I have found the Shrimp Tempura Dinner specialty to be the best thing for me. The order comes with 6 generous pieces of shrimp tempura, along with 4 pieces of potato, broccoli, and cucumber. The batter is nice and crunchy, the sauce is sweet. It is also served with a side of miso soup and sub-par tasting ginger sauced salad. 

Overall, Sushi Ai is ok. They do have a 10% discount for students of neighboring schools such as Wash U, STLCOP, and SLU. It basically waives out the price of tax. After coming here a number of times, each visit seems to be more and more drawn out. I know that I am spoiled by the taste and delicacy of California sushi/Japanese food. Coming to Sushi Ai makes me reminiscence of better and cheaper food elsewhere.
Decent pho, but definitely not the best I've ever had. I wouldn't recommend the steamed vegetable add-on, because it sort of ruins the pho broth flavor. Also, the portions are a little bit small.

Highly recommend.   Checked in, advised 20-30  minute wait.  Directed to waiting table, dirty table.  Asked manager to have the table cleaned.  Watched him seat 2 parties of 4, table still dirty.  Asked bar tender for a towel - referred to receptionist,  told him that did not work - he gave me paper towels to bus my own table.  Gave dirty towels and cups to manager and left!  Deanies is existing on reputation alone.  Customers are secondary.  GO 1/2 BLOCK DOWN THE STREET TO MR. ED'S SEAFOOD!!  CLEAN!  GREAT SERVICE! GREAT FOOD!

I love kolaches, and the ones here are pretty good! They do tend to run out of flavors and when I went one Saturday afternoon they had a very limited selection left. The employees were not extremely helpful but they were pleasant.

Excellent food and service. We stopped in for lunch today and always happy to find a good neighborhood family owned restaurant. The atmosphere was very pleasant and the service on point. We enjoyed a tasty lentil soup and wonderful watermelon feta mint salad as starters. My husband had a Falafel roll and I had a kafta roll and both were excellent. They came with homemade potato salad and some fruit as sides. Plenty to take home and prices were very reasonable. We will be back to try some Italian dishes at dinner.

This place is perfect.  The juices, salads and snacks are fresh, delicious and refreshing.

I began following a paleo diet and lifestyle about 6 years ago and have spent ALOT of my free time studying nutrition.  I can tell you without any doubt whatsoever these guys are not faking it.  They really know what they're doing and they are using the best possible ingredients to deliver the maximum possible nutrition to their customers. 

I wish these guys all the success in the world.  I need them to open a 2nd spot near my house and a 3rd near my job lol!

Great place. Love the decor. I might wear all red next time. A bit disappointed to later find out my open table reservation wasn't logged in after I told the host we were checking in early. Chelsea was our server and took good care of us. I had the S&S burger, gator tail (taste like chicken) and a few purple haze on draft. Yes, draft! This place get's crowded as the night goes on. Come early if you don't want to fight the crowds. Four stars for the dining experience and food, with a fifth star for taking care of us Yelpers!

For all of the hype, I was not impressed. The restaurant is very loud, with a cafeteria/dormatory-like level of volume. The food was fair, though the menu had limited options. The garlic bread and whipped butter were delicious! My main concern was our wait staff. When we ordered our main courses, we pre-ordered our desserts, as asked. We even had a little discussion about the bread pudding souffle with our waitress. After dinner we ordered coffee to have with our souffles, but our coffee had grown cold, and still no souffles. She finally showed up and said our desserts would be out soon, but were taking so long because we didn't pre-order. What?? No one ever offered us a coffee refill, and on top of everything else, the restaurant was freezing. I will not be back.

We live two blocks always. Thought the burgers would be great.  Not at all. They are thin well done pieces of meat.  So much so they give you two patties.  We like Port of Call burgers, or The Boulevard.  If you like sonic burgers, then you will love these.

This is hands down my favorite Italian restaurant. The atmosphere is old school which I love and the staff is knowledgeable about their menu and courteous. The food is mouth watering. Anytime I'm in the city I seek out a time to eat here. You won't regret anything you order.

So when you have a picky eater in the family you tend to frequent places they will eat. This isn't the case here, we all love this Red Robin. I've been to some where the service is sub par but here, we are definitely welcomed. Our food always comes out hot and fresh. I try to get something different every time and I have yet to get something I haven't absolutely loved. You can tell this is a well ran establishment....we have coming here at least monthly since moving here a year ago and that's saying something for us. Well done to this Red Robin.

We had a friendly greeting upon arrival by the manager, and she checked on our meal. The walleye was delicious, but the mushy crabcakes did not hold together on the plate. Also the blueberry cobbler was mostly blueberries without any pastry dough.

These guys are so quick. They're like the Jimmy Johns of pizzas. You can make any pizza your imagination can conjure up in the time it takes you to think of it. 

The toppings are tasty and fresh! The staff and ambiance are upbeat. The prices are good. 

If you like building your own pizza, give those folks a try.
Great food, great prices and the delivery got to me when they said it would. Would definitely order again when I'm back in town.
Great service, nice patio outside, excellent food. Not much more I can say! Try it out.

I visited Redstone for a late lunch around 2ish. I ordered buffalo shrimp they were really good and big w/ chunks of blue cheese crumbles. Also, the grilled BBQ wings pretty good. A salad w/ a crab cake, my salad had to many pieces of white lettuce the trky was a little slimy with a weird taste so I took the pieces of turkey out. The food was pretty good. Will try something else next time~

Very interesting menu at very reasonable prices...had to try it.  First of all, the waitress seemed annoyed at something the whole time, I can only think it was us though I can't imagine why.  Secondly, the food was bad.  I think they're trying to do a fancy comfort food thing, but the dishes we had lacked both the refinement of a fine restaurant and the flavor of a down-home comfort food place.  Major disappointment.

Verducci's has been a family favorite for over a decade. It is a staple for my parents who live in town and I (and all the other members of our big extended Italian family) MUST have it when we come to visit. The food never disappoints. Just really good authentic Italian. The wood fired pizza is a particular treat - so good that we've had it for Easter dinner before. We love Reno who works the pizza oven. He and the other staff are always friendly when we visit. Fabulous customer service. If you are a local or a visitor, I would highly recommend.
Great beer selection and the briscuit was pretty good. Service was excellent and very attentive. I was  hoping for more menu options.
Hands down my favorite hole in the wall places in Tucson. I've been coming here since I started school here and their fried rice and Sesame shrimp never disappoints.

Lunch buffet is reasonably priced at $8.50+tax+tip but food is mediocre.  There was quite a variety but food was  insipid and not warm.  Mexican restaurant with colorful decorations but food quality leaves much to be desired.

If I had wanted to distract my attention from our 81-year old guest, I would have sent back to the kitchen the soup and appetizer I ordered at lunch yesterday.  The overwhelming flavor of the special soup of the day (root vegetable) was salt with a tinge of gone-by. The crab beignets looked great but were uncooked in the center causing raw batter to ooze out. Service was seemed chaotic (drop and disappear) but it was not busy.  Server did not engage, was sweating profusely, rolled his eyes when we declined to order dessert, and appeared to suffer from tourist fatigue. Not pleasant.  We did enjoy the shrimp and grits, short rib appetizer and bread.

We have wanted to stop in here several times and decided to do just that after picking Strawberries up the road. Everything was hot and fresh plus out waitress did a great job. They have plenty of TV's and neat things to look at on the walls. When up this way again we want to go in the outdoor area and have some drinks!

My fiancé and I were in town for a concert and wanted to eat someplace neither of us had been. The stillery was chosen because of the reviews on Yelp! They did not disappoint. The pizzas although they say are individuals could feed 2-4 people, we were able to take ours back in a pizza box. The best part is the music! The musician literally plays on the bar, plus he was fantastic. This is a great restaurant with an awesome atmosphere and I will be back.

Beautiful French pastries and lattes. We didn't have time to stay, so just grabbed some stuff and walked down to the beach.

This is the real deal. Their chocolate croissant and currant scone were excellent. Lattes were very good. Our hotel sort of rolled their eyes when I mentioned I had passed this place the night before and saw the speed racks of bread cooling. That alone made me want to come back. Where there are speed racks, there is baking on premise. Your chances of scoring good pastry are clear! They agreed it was "simple and nice." Simple? More like lovely!

I can't believe it took me this long to leave a review! Crawfish Asian Cuisine is hands down my favorite Chinese restaurant in town! 

Literally love everything I've tried, but y'all must try their fried flounder fish (splurge and get the whole fish$27), the best calamari(appetizer), garlic noodles, or a bag of shrimp with garlic butter sauce! You will never evaa go wrong! 

They also have macaron ice cream sandwiches for dessert. It's usually packed when I go so try going early. Definitely on the pricey side, but they have good quality Chinese food!

Cooper's Hawk is one of my favorite restaurants. I have been to this location a few times now (I used to live in Orlando so I frequented the Waterford Lakes location). I am also a member of their wine club. I went with a friend for dinner last night and we had the most OUTSTANDING server named Michael. He was very personable and gave great recommendations on food and wine. This has been the best experience I have had at Cooper's Hawk since I have been going to this location. Michael and Danielle are the best and took great care of us!
Very tasty. The food is fresh and full of a variety of spices. Will be coming back again.
Boogie burger is a good place to eat but its too expensive it cost about 14 bucks for a double cheeseburger and fries and a pop

A must visit if you are in Nashville. We went for brunch and our experience was unforgettable. I ordered the Denver scramble and my only regret was not ordering two. Absolutely delicious, made to perfection and the presentation had my wife taking a photo shoot.
Excellent food! Best fish tacos we have ever had! Very helpful staff. Took his recommendations and was not sorry!
Had the Pot Roast.  Super tender.  Mashed potatoes came with it. Delicious!  The mini jalapeño muffins were very moist. Lots to look at as far as decor. Multiple floors.  Strong Drinks

Was at North Saturday evening. The martini was great. The food fair. The waitress sucked. Had an attitude. Was annoyed when we didn't place entree order right away. At one point she came over and said sorry for the delay. Had no common sense to have brought bread over at that point. We had to ask. She should look for another type of employment where she has no people interaction. There are many restaurants much better all around than North.

Good Indian food in a GREAT location! Super-friendly service is a big plus. They even brought fresh naan right to our table. I went for the Lunch Buffet, but look forward to trying their dinner menu. If you are downtown and in the mood for Indian, try Taj-Mahal!!!

The pizza was pretty good, but we're still talking about that massive, cold, crisp antipasto salad chock full of cheese, olives, salami, peperoncino, and the dressing... We're back home in KC and trying like mad to emulate it. So delicious and perfect after a long hot beach day. The staff was sweet and fun too. Thanks for a nice eve/dinner!

Well, first of all- the hours are wrong. They close at 9PM and here's how I know lol. Placed a pickup order on 9/4- just before they closed. When I got there, at 8:55, the door was locked and an employee was standing outside. she & her friends laughed at me as they watched me try to open the locked door. she then proceeded to tell me that "she" is in the back and my drinks are being refrigerated... no info on when I'll actually get them. then she proceeded to finish her convo with her friends. I had waited 5 minutes before I just ended up leaving and reporting the experience to Uber and now here. I actually work at one in Marina Del Rey, CA and was just here visiting for the weekend. I was excited to try Jamba in another state, but I guess not. terrible experience, 0/10 would not recommend. It's literally in one of our Mottos ("BOOST"), to be fast and FRIENDLY and while idk how fast they are, they are certainly not friendly lol. oh well.

Ate there a twice last week. Had the rib eye cheese steak first nights. One of the best cheese steaks I have ever had. Choose the potato salad for my side was disappointed, potatoes where chewy. Luckaly we had also ordered the fries which were excellent.
Second nights had the burger which was also very good. 
Other in our party had the calzones which they enjoyed a lot. 
The metal chairs and stools make it hard to stay around a try a second one of the 40 beers on tap.

Weekday luncheon to catch up with girlfriends was lovely. Our waiter was attentive,made sure our water glasses stay filled,presented menu options clearly, and checked on us several times without being overbearing. The crab cakes were perfect,and  we enjoyed a delicious, leisurely meal with a glorious view of Forest Park. Shopping afterward at the History Museum Store capped off a delightful afternoon with best friends.

I've eaten here and taken out before. Both experiences were good. They have the usual pizzeria offerings. Everything is good and is cheaper than most places on Spring Garden which is great! Definitely good for a work lunch.

Food was delicious, service was on point. And the atmosphere was nice. The table felt a little cramped but nothing serious. I'd definitely go again. Plus they offer a free shot of limoncello after your meal.

Quiche is fresh and delicious. The French fries are the best
Service is very good. I never feel rushed

I use to eat this however my stomach won't allow it now. Lol It is so freaking good and I love the bread drenched in hot sauce. I know it sounds gross but it's actually good. The parking can sometimes be a headache and u better call in your order or you will be waiting hours. The first time I had it I was thrown off by the pickle on a toothpick in my chicken breast. I never ate chicken with pickles before. You get a nice size chicken breast, a piece of bread, and I normally get fries. This may sound gross but the only way I can eat this chicken is with a tall glass of milk. Lol it calms down the burning sensation... YES! It's that HOT!!!! Many has tried but there is only ONE Prince's HOT chicken.. Lol

Decided to do a restaurantour for Father's Day weekend and we're very happy we decided to try Hellas. Our Restaurantour involves trying 3-5 restaurants, in one day, that we've never visited before. 

Parking was a little challenging because it was crowded on Father's Day weekend. We arrived around 4:30 pm, so there wasn't too many people in Hellas yet. 

Our group of five tried various beers and specialty drinks and totally enjoyed them all. The waiters were wonderful in explaining all the dishes and since it was our last stop, it was time for dinner. Each of us tried  a different specialty item and loved each one. Very huge portions and great for sharing. 

Of course we had to stop at the cookie/dessert counter on our way out to have something sweet later. Extremely happy with everything! Will definitely visit again.

This cafe was a delightful experience. If you can, be seated on the outside balcony. The people watching is excellent and is a very strong second to the amazing pastries and coffee drinks. My friend and I had a wonderful experience. However, although it didn't seem particularly busy, our server was a little I attentive as we didn't even receive napkins and she wasn't present to ask for them by the time we finished our desserts. In spite of that, everything was good enough that I'd definitely go back for another try.

Had Jack's BBQ brought to me across the city as take-out. 

It was so completely worth it! 

Had: 
Pulled pork - delicious! 
Their BBQ sauce - PERFECT dipping sauce. 
Brisket - smoked justtttt right. Amazing. 
Cornbread - moist, and dense. 
The sides of green beans, BBQ style beans, and corn is NEEDED. Can't go wrong with ANY of those options...especially the BBQ Beans!

I don't claim to be a pizza snob, but it's easy to tell when something just isn't good. I decided to order pizza and onion rings and have it delivered since there's nothing like pizza on a rainy sunday night. First off, the guy on the phone just didn't understand because I had to repeat everything like 3 times. Whatever, fine. It happens in a city. Then, even though the food got here exactly 40 minutes later (which was the estimate), it was more warm than hot. The delivery guy was also talking to his friend on the phone the entire time, which I found rude.

There was nothing terribly good about the pizza. It just was. The onion rings were HORRIBLE. I tend to judge places like this by their onion rings, and these just failed completely. They were soggy, luke-warm, and very bland. Actually they reminded me of the shitty ones from Burger King. I was severely let down because I had read these reviews and expected a good meal and, unfortunately, that was far from what I got.

The only thing I can think to recommend is the turkey club. My roommate ordered it and then went out of town for a few days so I ate it and thought it was delicious.

This was our first time to Craft Street!  From the moment we walked in to give our name to the minute we left, it was amazing! Zach was our waiter and knew what beers went with what meals, everything he suggested we got and he didn't not steer us wrong! We will be back again and again!  Great experience!  Make sure you ask for Zach!!
Sea Bass with shrimp risotto was delicious! Highly recommend. Had the calamari appetizer which was very good as well.

Stopped in with the family for nice meal, boy was I disappointed. We all ordered the prime rib because it came with all you can eat shrimp. The picture of the shrimp on the advertisement, showed about 10 shrimp sticking up out of the scampi bowl/plate. In reality it was 5 salad shrimp and since our waiter wouldn't check on our table unless we were able to get his attention I was only able to get one extra order and we had to remind him 3 times for the shrimp and refills of our drinks. Then he had the nerve to tell us when we were done. "Looks like you're all done here, do want desert or the check". Don't get me wrong the prime rib was great and there all you can eat salad bar was good. But the service sucked and the shrimp sucked.
Love this place!!! Sushi is great!!!! We tried several rolls a couple that lit on fire ... absolutely incredible!! Tim the owner is on hand and very welcoming.. I definitely will be back !!

Service was great very attentive. I had the chicken pakala, Chana masala and veggies samosas. Everything tasted fresh and was delicious. Also had a mango lassi and that was delish! Place was very clean, food came out quickly. Can't wait to try other things

What to say about Fogo de Chao...I have been here three times and have absolutely loved it every time. The ambiance is great. Huge place, tables aren't on top of each other, and even though it is busy, you can still have a nice conversation with your dinner companion. The service has been nothing less than exceptional every time I've been there. Waiters, bussers VERY attentive. Extensive wine list, as well as traditional Brazilian cocktails. Last but not least, the food. They have a fresh salad bar has a great selection of meats, salads, veggies; enough to make you almost fill up on just this alone. But don't! The gauchos come around with different cuts of meat that are to die for, each more tasty than the last! Perfectly seasoned and cooked, sliced right there and placed on your plate. Oh and you get an endless supply of mashed potatoes, polenta, fried bananas(YUM) and little cheesy rolls. If you can survive the food coma you slip into, the desserts are well worth over stuffing yourself even more.
The staff is super nice. They remade our puck up order because there was a misunderstanding of pick up time and didn't want the food to be cold.
General Tso's chicken was really good, egg roll was also good with a slight taste of nutmeg, and crab rangoon was very tasty!  Delivery took an hour, as they stated, but came hot!  Recommended!!
Absolute horrible service when there were only people at the bar gettings drinks.  Never again!
I love BFC. Superb fry selection, sauces are great, and the burgers a very good.

Just had my usual drive up takeout order - beef brisket platter with 2 sides of slaw. I request "the fattiest" brisket and they never disappoint. This time was OFF the CHARTS amaZing. Love my Martins!
my absolute favorite sub shop!! my dad used to bring me here when I was little and now is a must when I come home from college. 10/10 would recommend
Great food, service and atmosphere !!! Hats off to chef and his delicious menu!!! Flourless chocolate cake was decadent !!!
Very good breakfast and the staff is wonderful! Come earlier in the day to avoid the crowds.

I'd probably give 3.5 for food quality if it were possible but the hostess staff all three times we've been in just really sours me. Also the bartenders two of the three times seemed disinterest and slightly annoyed as well. The first time we went for just drinks was ok but the beer seemed heavy on IPAs so if you don't like that there wasn't much else. 

Also I tried to make reservations three weeks ahead for a party of 8 and I got just nuthin' but attitude. It was a Monday night reservation so not like I was taking tables on a weekend. Whatever I guess but it really annoyed me how it was treated like such a hassle. We ended up canceling the week before because of the attitude we got when they called to confirm. A small group of us went recently. 

Some of the menu items are fabulous. Eggplant meatballs, Brussel sprouts, pretzel bread, ribs, for sure. Wings. Warm skillet cookie. 

Super disappointed in mashed potatoes (watery and unsalted), Italian meatballs nothing special, my friend liked the sausage but I didn't. I wasn't crazy about mac and cheese either. 

Drinks are expensive and the waiter pushed us into ordering far too many dishes. We had excessive leftovers and a huge bill.

Seriously, amazing. We first came to downtown to go to BruBurger...but as the wait was over an hour long, my husband picked Weber. It blew my expectations out of the water. We sat in the bar in a super cozy booth.  Our waiter was extremely knowledgeable and answered all of our guests questions. The service was AMAZING. All of the workers were on-top of refills (big plus in my book) I ordered the bbq combo and chose pulled pork, quarter chicken with macaroni and mashed potatoes....all was so good! My husband did the devour downtown meal and received a house salad (meh, take it or leave), steak with brisket butter, asparagus and loaded mashed potatoes and a mini carrot bundt cake. He demolished the steak in no time. Our meal was finished off with hot hand towels (very nice touch)! I would recommend to anyone!

I always hear about Federal Donuts and how you have to get there early. 10am on a Saturday morning, this location was completely empty. 

The doughnuts are nothing special in my opinion. The texture was good but it's just your typical cake doughnut that can be made at home if you had a fryer. They were all the same doughnuts with just a different sugar or glaze over it. I tried four flavors but none of them particularly stood out to me.

The fried chicken wasn't bad. It was moist, but again, nothing to rave about. It comes with a honey doughnut but I didn't get any pickles as stated on the online menu. I had a dry topping and a wet topping. For the dry topping, I chose the coconut curry. It tasted more like regular curry powder dusted over the chicken with no hints of coconut.  And the chicken 

Coming from New York, I think everything was pretty reasonably priced.

OK we've lived in New Hope for just over a year now and just decided to try THE preeminent gay establishment of our rivertown metropolis this Thursday evening.  Sat down at the bar and ordered a couple drinks. Let me say that Tony at the bar has THE BEST pour of any bartender in New Hope and it's environs that we have ever experienced (and we've been to them all). A couple drinks at The Raven is 4 drinks at any other bar in New Hope.  Got some bar food. It was good.  The wings are a little more deep fried than the traditional fare, and the rest is basic bar food...not great but quite serviceable.  Next time we'll try the dining room.  The real draw is the people-watchinig.  As far as the clientele...there is absolutely no doubt you're in a gay bar. It's kinda flaming...which is cool. It's all about the company you keep at the bar.  We were sore thumbs....even if my wife and I were not together at the bar...individually our personas would scream out "STRAIGHT NEW HOPEANS...Gotta be home by 10 so the kids can get a good night's sleep for their soccer game".  Never felt anything but 100% welcome and we met some great people.  I want to go back.
It was my first time there and I was happy to hear that they have vegetarian and seafood options. You can replace the meat with tofu! Yum!
This is a great place.  Lots of different food stalls. All have good service and tasty food. Nice bar with good happy hour drinks. Clean with excellent atmosphere.

I was a frequent patron at this location when I lived in St. Louis. North County isn't exactly the mecca of fine dining, but this place was ok for what it was- a wannabe sports bar that sells bbq. As I don't eat pork, I generally get the same thing every time- which is either beef brisket or smoked turkey. I've had them both here and they were mediocre at best. The staff was always gracious and attentive, but Bandana's is basically another chain bbq joint that doesn't offer anything new.
Very enjoyable ! Good Food and nice staff. And I like the variety of beer. They also have dart boards. Lightning good be better. That is the only downside for me.

For what it is-or at least when I went there-it was solid. I had been fasting, and travelling, so by the time I got to Bucks County, I had not eaten in almost 24 hours.

Food was solid. Open-faced shrimp melt and open-faced tuna melt were really good. It is a diner, and it gets 4 stars for a diner.

I rate things depending on what they are and what they are trying to be. I am not going there looking to be fed Michelin worthy food. But it was simple, the older lady was nice, the people were helpful. Btw I took my food to go to the hotel. The Crowne Plaza. Now the hotel, that SUCKED.

This is a stunningly beautiful venue that is also extremely versatile.  We saw Wynton Marsalis on night and Lyle Lovett and friends another.  Each concert we were in a different location, but for each we heard and saw everything perfectly.

The floor configuration will change with each concert, setting it up for the optimal viewing and listening.  For Wynton, there were people sitting behind the band, giving them a very unique perspective, as well as giving the performers someone to laugh and joke with!

The design and decor of the building is stunning.  I'm glad it was built and can't wait to see more.

Honestly, 4 stars is the perfect rating for this restaurant. As someone who loves Boiling Crab from LA/OC, this place wasn't too bad! I was skeptical at first trying this place out, but I'm glad I did! It's definitely a nice place for some seafood and their food is good! 

I ordered a pound of shrimp with their special drunken sauce at their second to spiciest level. It wasn't that spicy to me personally (I can handle spice pretty well), but the actual flavor was really good! The shrimp were pretty big and fat, which is really good! I had to ask for salt, pepper, and lemon to make my own dipping sauce but I didn't mind. It was totally worth it. The Cajun fries weren't spicy at all, and I'm not sure if I would personally call them Cajun fries. Don't get me wrong, their seasoning was really good and the fries were really crispy and yummy, but it didn't taste like the Cajun seasoning I'm used to. Next time, I'm going to try the spiciest level since spicy didn't have enough kick in it. 

For the customer service, I think it's pretty average. The workers there didn't exceed any phenomenal service, but they were nice and attentive. What I noticed while waiting for my food, is that they clean up really quick after customers leave. 

All in all, I was pleasantly surprised at this restaurant and I will definitely be coming back!
Atmosphere was good bbq average at best sides were ok. Lots of better bbq choices out there for the money

We stopped in from visiting another business in the same lot and thought we'd like to give it try after reading a few good & bad reviews.....
So we were going to order food to go but decided to lunch in. First off, the staff was all very welcoming and nice! I ordered the bacon cheese burger, I was a little disappointed it didn't have anything on it but the buns, meat, 1 slice of bacon and a big blob of cheese. No lettuce, tomato, mustard or ketchup. It can with fries a 1/4 of a pickle. The food was really good but one thing I do have to mention that I didn't bring up to the waitresses because I didn't want them to assume I was trying to get comped or being shady. I did find a hair in my burger! I was about 3 bites from finishing it but I would've never noticed it if I wasn't dipping it in ranch. As I said the food was good 2 bacon strips would've been perfect if it wasn't going to have anything else on it. I do like that they have 6 TVs and music. 
I would recommend Hair Nets when mixing the beef!! Other than the hair good food

I would say closer to 4 1/2 stars.  I love supporting local restaurants.  Yes, the name is very misleading as they serve Korean food along with salad.  I have been coming here for over two years and have yet to be disappointed.  I LOVE the kimbop with bulgogi.  It's like a sushi roll with cooked meat (to all you pregnant ladies craving sushi there's no raw fish).  I also enjoy the bibimbap bowl (rice topped with veggies and bulgogi).  YUMMY food!

Service:  I have always had awesome service!  The daughter is sometimes at the front and is beyond the sweetest thing... Sometimes the wait can be a little longer, but there's generally one person in the kitchen and it's worth the wait.

I would definitely put I LOVE SALAD (need to find out how they decided on this name) on your list to try.

Went last night AND......

Pros:
The ambiance was really nice 
The cocktails were very good , but pricey
The lobster taco was worth the money

Cons:
1)Some of the waitress's need a Spanish lesson to learn how to pronounce the menu items correctly.

2) the price of the menu items are just way OVERPRICED . I could understand if we were not in a town with a Mexican restaurant or taco stand on EVERY corner . However we are. So if your charging over $11  for shrimp enchiladas they better be off the chain. These were good but dang I could have gone to cheuy's for this. don't get me wrong I understand rent In the gulch is expensive ( even thought I'm thinking  they own the property ) but hell give me a reason to come back and drop $180 on a Mexican meal. Rick Bayless does it well ,  Saint anejo  does not.

3) stay away from the fundido, over price and you will receive a 3rd degree burn from the pot . Which is going to burn most of the cheese to the bottom of the pan anyway. Wow epic fail

4) the desserts suck major , what was suppose to be tres leches was .......a parfait? A trifel ? A banana pudding minus the banana , sub mango and 3 blueberries? What ever it was suppose to be it was not tres leches. Good tres leches should be so sweet you feel your front teeth rot out with each spoonful and you drink a gallon of water after each bite . This was not it  . The churros were made from the same dough as profiteroles and had wow factor but no taste factor . I was waiting for that crispy fried dough taste but was let down like a blind date.
Side note : the caramel sauce which was authentic dulce de leche was awesome . I ate the entire thing with my finger. 

Conclusion
Dress up and have some great drinks and 2 tacos and if they ever have a happy hour jump on it . Other than that , I will see you at the taqueria on nolensville rd

I got the pork tacos and the chicken tacos because i was really hungry. It was really overpriced for the portion. The pork was really dry and bland. The chicken was okay but that's the first and last time I'm going there.

This restaurant was a lovely stop for our holiday in Santa Barbara. The staff and owner are warm and inviting. Each of the three dishes served to our guests were attractive, tasty and prepared exquisitely. I have dined here before, for a late breakfast, and was not disappointed in my return visit. I highly recommend this restaurant for any occasion, and predict it will become a "special" occasion because of the quality experience. J Miller Henderson, NV
It's amazing tthaya it by far the crab was so meaty  and the Cajun butter was insanely good. Get the #2 you won't be  sorry!

Stopped by here last night for dinner and I have to say I'm very impressed with the pizzas.  They had bunch of different slices which was awesome so we were able to try the General Tso's, Margarita, and plain.  My husband and I also split the cheese steak and fries combo which was very flavorful.  We will definitely stop back here again.
Freshest and best sushi in Tucson. I have eaten here multiple times and every time has been fabulous.

Wow I can not say enough about this place. It never let's you down! The food is top notch and they have a great menu but if u don't like that they have make  your own menu! The tea here is awesome and the atmosphere is relaxed. They always have the games on the tv. 

That being said even though I love this place there are a few cons. The food does take a wile most of the time. The seating is a bit camped. Also if you do have a small child it would most likely be a messy venture for the whole family. 

Even with these cons this is, in my opinion, the best burger joint that I have been to. It has something for everyone and is a treat every time I go.

Went here for Mother's Day Brunch. For $65 pp and an ocean right there you would expect crab legs. They didn't have much to choose from. A small room and an even smaller dessert table. No variety or special foods you would expect for $65 pp. The Universal Hilton for the same price has 3 huge rooms of variety including king crab legs. 

The mimosas and champagne were included however for people that don't drink that, it was extra for every drink. I was pregnant so I just wanted an OJ and my son got cranberry juice. We asked for refills and the server said it was extra charge. I thought that was odd seeing how the orange juice for champagne was included, but not just the orange juice? We ended up just getting water. 

I wouldn't recommend this place. There's a great seafood place a few minutes away, Enterprise Fish Co. way cheaper and much more worth it.
Ybor get ready to welcome some wonderful Indian cuisine.  A must try! samosa excellent, Saag chicken , a delight

Excellent service, excellent food the three times I've been here.  The mushy peas are the best.  Follow that down with a nice, cold brew and it's proper. Love the portions you get, too! Definitely IS the only spot I have hit every time I've been to Santa Barbara!

I thought the food here was good but not great. The service and presentation of the food were both on point. The noodles in the spaghetti and meatballs were over salted, and the meatballs were overcooked. The meatballs tasted quite dry and gamey - not what I had expected. I also tried the Lancaster chicken. It was a light dish with the chicken cooked in wine - not exactly what I was expecting but it was very flavorful. Definitely willing to come back, but will likely opt for Giorgio's down the block.

I went here with a co-worker for dinner. The place was almost empty; we sat at the sushi bar. The sushi chef was trying to make chit-chat with us until dressier chicks showed up. 

The place looked a little old; plates, computer system. 

The sushi was mediocre. 

Won't be back.

Diamond in a strip shopping mall that I am so sorry I didn't come to in 2013 when I moved to Clementon. Finally went yesterday and what a treat. We will definitely have this on our favorite list. Started with appetizer of sausage, peppers, onions, and roasted peppers. Delicious. Side of bread fresh, tasty. My husband said Ceaser salad dsg was better than most, and my Balsamic dsg was great. Entrees OMG...veal malanaise very good, string beans done well, side of spaghetti done perfectly, and same with my eggplant rolltini stuffed etc. Was amazing also with side of spaghetti, of course brought home lunch for today. Expresso and the best cannoli in the world for dessert. A++++ Everyone wanted to make sure everything was ok. You can eat in or take out. We ate in. Relaxed. Tv there to watch. BYOB . All that food, and homemade, quality prepared and tasting, for an extremely reasonable price. Owner great . Close 7 or 8 on weekdays, but definitely worth the trip. Etc........

I hate when they put the burger patty on the bun and let the lower bun get soaked with the grease. I don't want to grab a wet burger. I suggest next time they set the lettuce under the patty, or put the patty on the side with the rest of the fixings. And my patty was over cooked.

One of my favorite spots to eat! Everything I always try is enormous and Delicious! One portion size is good for about 2 people. Love that they serve breakfast all day long. There biscuits are so big and yummy. Took my mom for the first time and she loved it. She was shocked when she saw her food plate come out.She kept telling people about this place that is was a muat have when visiting Reno! Our waiter was amazing super friendly and great customer service.May toddler feel in love with her .Over all want great place and nevet gets old!
Always great food and service here! The chicken tinga tacos are my go-to. The cheesy bruschetta is also sooo good. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu

Time for our teams quarterly lunch.  Team decided to go to Claim Jumper.
Kim the manager handled the reservation and our pre-order for the lunch
for 11 people.
Kim was very professional and friendly and ensured our pre-order was
taking cared of.
We were greeted promptly and brought to our table and beverages of choice
were awaiting. 
Jessie attended to our group, greeted us and let us know that our meals
will be soon coming out.
A few of us had the Chicken Pot Pie.  Always so delicious and a go to meal
for me anyways.
So full of chicken and vegetables and O sooo good crust.
One of our guys order was not included in the list, soo my fault, so we
ordered another lunch item and was expedited and came out quickly.
Other mentioned that their meal were also very good.
It was also our lucky day, Claim Jumper was celebrating their 40th
anniversary and give us a free dessert.
I was strawberry butter cake.  I usually do not do dessert, but it was soo
good and I finished it.
Our team was in and out in less than an hour.

So great to have a restaurant were my expectations were exceeded.
Congrats to the team at the Claim Jumper in Reno and thank you so much for
the experience.
Definitely a must do again.

This place is beautiful inside. Their pastries are incredible, they always run out of their popular pastry dishes but what they have left you should purchase & devour with a good coffee in hand. 

But I cannot stress this enough,, the inside of this place is gorgeous. I'm a huge fan. Take ya girl, a big group, or come here to read the morning paper. I'm a huge fan.

Can't wait to stop by again when I'm in town!

Visited for the first time under new ownership. Wow! Big screens EVERYWHERE! Beautiful large bar, very nice intetior and exceptionally clean. Bartender was prompt and friendly.  TV's were on a great variety of games ( Sat.) & World Series so no matter which game you wanted it was on. I had the "Bee Sting" wings. Excellent sauce; just the right amount of sweet & heat. The wings were cooked perfectly ; crisp & fully cooked but still juicy and tender. My wife ordered a Quesadilla " plain (no meat). The cook came out to the bar to very nicely ask if she wanted sauteed onions & peppers along with the cheese as he didn't want her to have a bad experience. She said yes and She absolutely loved it. The clientele consisted of  a group.of 30-somethings at the bar and numerous retiree couples and older single males (This is Largo after all). Very comfortable non threatening atmosphere and smoke free! Only negative is that they still allow vaping. If not for that & lack of personal experience with more of the menu I would have given them a 5 Star! This business very much deserves a try! Look for the Havana Harry's at the entrance to the strip mall. The bar is at the end of that section and can't be easily seen from Walsingham.

Outside, three middle-aged women sat around a metal table chain smoking and speaking in... Bosnian?  They all looked like formidable arm wrestlers, so we didn't have the guts to ask.  Inside, Chef Alisah's spare interior was filled with the delicious smells of grilling meat and warm bread.  Perfect.

The food easily lived up to the smells.  Like many other eastern European cuisines, it relies on well-tested combinations of simple flavors--fresh vegetables, strong cheeses, good meats. We had the Bosnian salad, which was similar to a Greek salad, and was mostly a vehicle for excellent cheese and peppers.  The goulash was subtle and complex, boasting a rich sauce and perfectly cooked beef.  The Bosnian sausage plate was a glory to behold: ten homemade sausages piled between two discus-sized pieces of crispy, buttery bread and accompanied by onions and tzatziki.  The sausages were oddly like breakfast sausages you would find at a diner... except these sausages were good.  Mild, but good.  The meal ended with a small, complementary dessert of dried fruits that were formed into balls and rolled in shredded coconut.  They were unfairly tasty and made a great palette cleanser.

Bosnian food is a welcome change of pace in Tucson and Chef Alisah's solidly earns four stars, but the family that owns the restaurant is so ridiculously friendly that the overall experience deserves five.  They were super-attentive and were happy to talk at length about Bosnian food.  Their location is obscure, but the pilgrimage is more than worth your time.

We came here for a late afternoon brunch and with the help of their online waitlist, we were able to be seated as soon as we arrived. Although it was packed, a waitress approached us immediately and brought us water and gave us suggestions since it was our first time there. 

I decided to order the catfish and grits and my boyfriend ordered the chicken St. Charles. They were absolutely slammed, so there was about a thirty minute wait for our food. By the time we got our food, the catfish and grits was a bit lukewarm, but we were so hungry at that point that we did not mind. The catfish and grits came with a pork tasso cream sauce and a warm biscuit. Even though it wasn't piping hot, it was still absolutely delicious! The chicken St. Charles was also fantastic. 

All in all, Ruby Slipper has absolutely delicious food and good service at a reasonable price. I would definitely go back in the future!

I have eaten here twice in a week. The food is great, very good prices and my server is so sweet! Highly recommend.  I went around lunch but it would be a nice spot for a romantic dinner too. Ill definitely be back!

We ordered takeout for our Friday night comfort food from Huma. Sooooo delicious: Queso Fundido with Chorizo, Heuvos Rancheros, Fish Tacos, Chorizo Tacos, and Pastel Azteca were all delicious. Even the kids were delighted (not always easy with teenagers)! Thank you Huma for making our Friday dinner so delectable!!

A sort of ratatouille of Indian fare 
Chef Remy was on one night 
The second visit ...our to lunch
Half the items not available
The Chai must have been sitting there all day... as it was spoiled 
As Spany once eloquently said 
Don't drink the milk it's spoiled 
Dont drink the Chai ita spoiled

The atmosphere is  bit cafeteria like 
Bright florescent  lighting 
Bedazzled with far too many oversized LCD belching out bollywood ballyhoo
I'd say this place is best set for for the local new transplant of IT workers 
Rather than a mixed crowd 
The staff aren't overly friendly to non  Indians as is the wait staff who pretend not to understand English too well..
My prediction is
Won't last more than a year 
Here today 
Gone tomorrow
Too bad too bc the food is well prepared but..I'd speculate a poorly run and managed resto destined for failure

TL; DR: Donut heaven. The wait in line is worth it. Get the fritters.

One second you're standing in a crowd at Reading Terminal Market, the next second there are people lining up behind you. Congratulations, you just found yourself in the line for Beilers Bakery. The line is literally over 100 people long, and you slowly inch your way towards the counter while blocking traffic to all the adjacent shops. Finally, you reach Beilers, and you are still maybe 20-30 people away from the front - but now you gaze upon the birth of new donuts. Watch that dough get kneaded, pounded, and cut. Watch other donuts being dipped and transformed into their sugary glaze. Still, watch others being jammed full of jellies. The sights and smells before you are glorious. The only thing left to do is order a dozen donuts, eat them all, and admit to your gluttonous nature. The only nightmare scenario is when you finally get to the front and they are all out of fritters. Woe is me.

At $5.49/lb. for boiled crawfish, I thought it was on the expensive side (for New Orleans). But it was totally worth it. Flavorful seasoning and juicy! The best part was the juice from the boil. Great service. The restaurant closes at 9, I came at 8, and my waiter still offered me more crawfish even after the kitchen and restaurant closed. They are real hard workers there. Only downside is the surcharge for using credit cards and not allowing multiple checks.

Excellent steak and eggs before the race!  Very reasonable prices.  Worth the wait.  We had a great time with the crowd and had a tasty meal.  They have a touch screen ordering system now, so the food came out relatively quickly.  Would recommend ao anyone looking for an authentic Indy 500 experience.

Silvergreens was closed. Decided to check out Sam's to go since I always see it with its doors open! Definitely a great sandwich place. The menu has the usual types of sandwiches. I got the Turkey Sandwich on wheat with no mayo or cheese. Everything with it (lettuce, tomatoe, onion, etc) and it was DELICIOUS. The owner knew his stuff and he made it within 5 minutes of ordering! One thing that I was a bit weird about was that he didn't use gloves to make the sandwich. Hmmmmm... but the sandwich was still good! i'd come back again! it's decently priced and for a small, its pretty fulfilling!

YUM!
The best eggplant parm I've ever had. I tried my husband's meal as well and it was equally good.
Burger was ok.. Service was crap. I will never give theses guys any more of my money!!

A bit pricey for food court fare.  Gives Chick Fil A a run for its money in this department.  Not really what I was expecting especially compared to the new noodle bar down the road inside the Seminole Hard Rock Casino (Tampa).
Had the Judges BBQ plate/a good value@$12.50 pulled pork was good, fries soggy thou Merideth was very attentive to our needs.

1 Star...hubby and I got so sick after eating here.
The waitstaff were nice and attentive. The food was warm not hot.

We had a Harmon pellet stove installed. They were great and very helpful and clean. The stove was installed in just a few hours. It didn't come with a timer start up and shut off. My husband took our thermostat from our living room and hooked it up to the stove. Now we don't have to get up at 5am to turn on the stove. It starts up on its own. We can also turn it on while we our out. So when we get home its nice and toasty..

Frank and the team just celebrated their 28th year open after Frank left Paul Prudhomme in the 1980's. This is a warm and cozy elegant spot with excellent New Orleans dishes. Frank cooks most nights and you have to try the Shell Beach diet at least once. One of my favorite regular spots in nola!
i loved the foods but i think when someone order salads they should ask them what kinda dressing they want instead choosing a dressing for them. After that that place is amazing

As soon as I stepped inside Bistrot La Minette It felt like I was transported to this cozy bistro in a small town in France!
After looking at this bistro on Yelp, I was super excited to try It and it did not disappoint. We went here for a Sunday brunch and I fell in love with the ambience and the coffee. You will especially love the coffee if you like the European variety more.  They started us off with some warm bread with butter and we got the escargot for appetizer which is the best I have had outside of France till date. The oil with garlic and parsley in it was very flavorful and we loved dipping the bread in it.

For plats we got the Euf de pachur and Omlette with Peggy eggs and everything was very well made and delicious. Our server was very attentive and sweet and even made me Cafe au Lait which was not on there menu. 

Even though we were very full from the appetizer and the plate we wanted to taste one of the desserts and got the chocolate cake to go. The cake was so soft and delicious and came with some whipped pistachio cream.

We were surprised when we got the cheque as they have a Sunday special pre fix menu and one of our meals cost only $25 for a appetizer, entree and dessert.  I will surely be visiting again soon.

Omg! My first time here. I passed it twice on our way to sassafras and today i decided to turn around and come here after looking a the pictures posted on yelp. I always judge by the pics rather than the reviews even if it has 4-5 stars pics tell it all and omg i do not regret it! U have to come here. chef Ruiz u are amazing. Pure comfort food. For appetizer i ordered the fried shrimp but instead of the buffalo sauce i asked for the thai ginger sauce that comes on the salmon bits and it was Amazing! .

My mom ordered the plain chicken wings and the gourmet potato skins n LOVED it. The wings were perfect tasted like my homemade fried chicken yum. This is definitely authentic NOLA Cuisine. I ordered the Pork chop w/ mac n cheese entree and omgggg  delicious. I rarely eat pork chops but the picture i saw of it on here made me want to get it and i was not disappointed. The baked macaroni was dream tasted homemade like something we'd eat at thanksgiving with a stuffed bell pepper or dressing lawwwddd! N my green beans were sautéed to perfection. .... And the food was sooo good i had to try the dessert which is also made from scratch too btw. Jesus take the wheel i dont even like or eat bread pudding my mom ordered it n i ate some of hers n its THE BEST IVE EVER HADDD lawwwd like seriously yall im not even exaggerating. I ordered the key lime pie n it was really good and flavorful but that breadpudding won my heart. seriously id give 10 stars if i could im so impressed and thats says a lot coming from me. N ill pay anything for great food and the prices r reasonable and worth it!!! Wheeeew... I already know what i want to try on my next visit. And FYI i was born and raised in New Orleans so i know good food when i come across it. Ohhh and i cant forget the sweet and verf attentive server Alexis. Thanks girl u were great. Very good attentive, knowledgeable and was even playful with the other guests kids. Great Job Chef Ruiz! Great restaurant.

The owners are very nice and accommodating. The food and service is very good. They recently rearranged the inside and it looks great. We bring our infant and they go above and beyond for us. I'm a Hatboro resident and we frequent this place often. Have not been disappointed once.

Almost everything about Relish screams "hip upscale nouvelle American cuisine": the quirky name, the fabulous interior, the interesting flavor pairings, even most of the food presentation. The thing that did not live up to the image, in my opinion, was the food itself.

I'd wanted to try this place since it opened, but I was pretty disappointed. The menu looked good. Our party tried the fig and brie flatbread and the tomato and mozzarella bruschetta. I tasted the latter and thought it was decent but not outstanding. I also ordered a Caesar salad, which was wholly unremarkable. The lettuce looked and tasted like it had been cut the day before: not bad, but just a little limp and dull. The croutons had that hard-chewy mouthfeel of croutons exposed to too much moisture. The cheese and dressing were pretty standard. 

For an entree, I chose the kasu salmon. I found the fish overcooked and unseasoned, basically dry and flavorless. There was some flavor in the sauce, but it did not infuse the meat. The rice seemed underdone, a bit harder than I would usually expect rice to be, and the spinach had a very bitter aftertaste. My husband chose the prime rib special, which was cold, tough, and tasteless, swimming in a pool of juice. I also tried the crab cakes, which were exceedingly sweet. The friend who ordered them enjoyed them, but after tasting them, I was glad I hadn't chosen that. 

Service was fine, although the waitress seemed kind of unhappy and didn't mention the special until we asked about it. We never did find out what the soup of the day was.

Awesome breakfast at a reasonable price, cash only but ATM on site.  I had the Kitchen Sink omelet with biscuit and gravy and it was more than I could finish, and I am a big eater.  My wife had bagel with lox and it could have fed two as well.  Pepper Bloody Mary was great too.
Great salads and the best barbecue chicken pizza. Service is usually very good.
This is our go to Mediterranian restaurant! Food is always fresh and flavorful. Love their Sultan Pulau, Shashank, and Nans are the best in town.

This was such a fun culinary experience! Your seated and order and then you get to cook your own food on a griddle that's located in the center of your table! We had so much fun making different combinations- defiantly not your average breakfast place! I had a pumpkin chia latte (we went in October) and it was delicious! If we are back in the Nashville area we will defiantly be back!

People seem to really hate this Jack in the Box.  I think people forget it's just fast food.  What do you expect from fast food?  Every time I've gone, my order has been correct, the service has been fast, and the people at the Drive-Thru have been nothing but nice.  Often times, my curly fries are hot and fresh.  I don't think I've ever been through this particular Jack in the Box where I haven't been happy.
Finally found good Chinese food in Tampa!!! Best Chinese food around hands down. I got the General Tso and it was great. Definitely recommend

it sucks.  They are very expensive but you don't see it coming.  Also I remember anoter customer had to chase down the waitress to get her drink, and then the next waitress took her drink with some booze still in it.  Great customer service.  That lady was happy... NOT!

Also it seems crowded and feels dirty.  I just felt gross sitting there.

This place is certainly one of the better tex-mex restaurants in the area, in part, due to the unique decor both inside and out.  From the outside, it certainly doesn't have the appearance of a functional restaurant, but if you're willing to take the long road in, you'll be happy you did.  Service is usually pretty good and the food comes out quick.  They do carry a number of cajun meals in addition to your standard tex-mex fare and there is something on the menu for everybody.  As for price, it is one of the cheapest sit-downs you can go to these days.

One word of warning though, much like the Melting Pot and Subway, you will walk out smelling like the restaurant you just ate in...

Great atmosphere and pulled pork was amazing. Side dishes are ok. Server was great and super friendly. Long waits so be prepared but they take your phone number and text you when your table is ready so you can walk around. Great location.

12.05 is an exceptional artisan distillery right in the heart of Fountain Square. We have been here a few times and have never been disappointed. Whether you like your spirits mixed into a cocktail with all homemade ingredients to make a delicious cocktail or a bourbon straight is more your speed, 12.05 has something for everyone. They have there standing drink menu as well as a rotating seasonal cocktail. Everything is one simple price, $8 per cocktail. At such a tasty price and such quality drinks and ingredients you have to stop in and say hi to Brad and the rest of the crew for a drink. Also, if you are looking for a great spirit to add to your home liquor cabinet they also have the hookup with their variety of spirits. Be well, stay well, but don't drink "well", drink craft.

My husband decided to go on an elimination diet to identify any food intolerances he might have and it was limiting what I could cook for dinner. Between making special meals for my husband and our toddler I was starting to feel like a short order cook. My husband decided to have meals delivered to our home from Eat Right. Since I wanted to lose some weight too I selected the conventional meal plan for myself and my husband selected the keto meals.

Every week we receive meals delivered to our front door step. Meals for Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday are delivered Monday morning and Thursday and Friday's meals are delivered Thursday morning to ensure the freshest meals. We could have meals delivered for the weekend on Thursday, but we enjoy cooking and occasionally dining out so we opted to not do meals during the weekend.

I was a little skeptical how the meals would taste since I have tried other prepared meals in the past, but the meals at Eat Right have been pretty good if not sometimes excellent! The chimichurri steak, steak hibachi, chicken sandwich, beef enchiladas and Asian meatballs have been some of my favorite dishes. The most surprising thing about the meals have been the high quality cuts of meat. The steaks are usually very tender and contain little to no gristle. 

There have been a few misses. I haven't been a fan of most of the ground turkey meals and now avoid them when selecting my weekly menu. A few of the vegetables have been underwhelming such as plain green beans or steamed broccoli. I usually reheat these on the stove with a little lemon, garlic, and a splash of olive oil.

So far the meals have made life easier for me and my husband and I have lost some weight so we are both fans of Eat Right!

OMG!!! I love this place. Every time I go I am with a bunch of my friends so we get a lot of different tapas so there is a lot of variety. I love the Guacabello and I love the Mazorca, but the last time we went there was a special we got which was a potato topped with this delicious crabmeat concoction. Wow, wish I would have had more of that! For my entree' I had the Jerked Chicken which was awesome. I ate every last bite of that chicken over risotto topped with these greens that were cooked with bacon. So yummy! Can't wait to go back! Oh and I forgot, you can bring your own wine so don't forget that!

I'm all about customer service and hands down this place has the worst. 
We came in (family of 4) on a rainy day. 
We signed our name on a roster and patiently waited for an inside table. The server informed us there was seating outside. However due to one of our parties having bronchitis we asked to please sit inside. The server kept insisting outside and we kindly told him we would wait for an inside table. 
We stood there and two of our members of our party sat down. (Both 70 years of age - they both don't do well standing for long periods) and two people stood up while reading the menu. 
Then another female server came and told us to stand elsewhere because we were "hovering over customers"
That was exceptionally rude. We barely stood there and she was giving us attitude. Worst service ever

The first time I went there was 7/12/18. We ordered a cheese steak, turkey sub and a tuna sub. The cheese steak was good. The turkey sub was okay and the tuna sub was not good. The tuna came out of the can and was place on the roll with lettuce,tomatoes and onions. We were given a mayonnaise packet to put on the sandwich. On a scale from 1 the lowest to 10 the highest score. The steak was a 8, the turkey sub was a 5 and the tuna was a 0 score.
