Moved to Indianapolis/Indiana 6 months ago and we finally found a great desi/pakistani restaurant that tastes similar to NJ. Chicken biryani, halwa, behari, and falooda all were super delicious. I'll practically start living here from now on.

Also the atmosphere is super welcoming and warm. The carrom table is a great idea.

This place was a disgrace! We went in for dinner and called ahead for a reservation. They ignored us for almost 20 minutes then we finally got seated and ordered drinks then the server brushed us off as well. We heard great things but I have never felt so unwanted at a restaurant. We decided to leave and waited another 20 minutes to get a check for the drinks,left money on the table. And walked out. We decided to go to zozo's.

I'm from the northeast where we are all pizza snobs - this pizza was very good - crust was nice and crisp, sauce was very good and dessert at the end was nice and refreshing.  Glad this is so close to home and can't wait to go back!!!

Simply amazing, I  can't complain about anything...

5 reasons for 5 stars

Crepes

Pastries

Bacon in a flaky croissant with scrambled eggs and cheese.  Oh my

The staff is super friendly and will  accommodating 

The ambiance is homey.  

I  always recommend people here.  The food takes you away to a more relaxed place in time.

This little bakery is a sweet bun heaven!

I wish I could have ordered one of each but we had to control ourselves. I can't wait to go back!

You pick up a tray and tongs and select the goodies you want yourself, go to the register, pay, and enjoy! 

We bought the taro stuffed and red bean stuffed sweet buns and they were so fresh and delicious. It wasn't overly sweet at all and the buns are HUGE and the prices are fantastic.

I discovered this place when I drove to a Chick Fil A on a Sunday for 100th time,  only to discover it was closed of course. As I sat in my car wiping away the tears I opened the Yelp app and searched for tasty chicken alternatives. Though I wouldn't compare the two at all, Drunken Chicken was a beacon of hope that sad day and I can always count on them to be there on Sundays. Try this place out people! The Mega Strips are phenomenal. I'm generally not a fan of deviled eggs, but their fried deviled eggs are next level! Also, don't neglect their hot sauce selection it's fantastic. They have a pretty moderately sized beer selection as well too! Enjoy!

We finally decided the check out this restaurant after passing by it every day and hearing about it from several friends. We arrived early around 530 or 545 and there were only a few other tables seated inside - which we thought would be a good thing. 

We ordered the spinach and artichoke dip and crab cakes for appetizers. Both were ok but not great. We then had sirloins on the hot stone and shrimp.

The food was decent but the issue came with how fast the food came out. We received our appetizers quickly and started eating when my Caesar salad arrived. I put the salad to the side and continued eating our appetizers. At this point our steaks and hot stones arrived hot and cooking. We moved everything to the side again to make room for the entrees. No complaints on the steak but the rest of our food was getting cold as we cooked our steaks. 

Overall the food was decent but it came out so fast we were unable to really enjoy the experience without feeling rushed.
The Haven is awesome.   Great food, good atmosphere, and friendly people.

Have been here a couple of times to listen to my friends band. Love that it is a outside venue, beautiful for evening drinks. Costs of drinks are very reasonable and bartender was attentive to every one. Bathrooms are clean!!!  Nice comfortable vibe!!! Keep up the good work!!

Great Italian BYO. If you want a delicious Italian meal that that isn't that expensive, you must try Cucina Forte. Got a reservation easily, but the place was still packed. The waiters are very friendly and helpful. They really make you feel like you are at home. 

The food is really good. The mixed green salad, though just a regular salad, was fresh and had a nice balsamic dressing. The mussels were tasty. They were cooked in a white wine and butter sauce with some sage. Make sure to get some extra bread to sop up the sauce. But the gnocchi was really the star. They are big, light, and fluffy, and plenty filling. You have the choice of ricotta or spinach gnocchi with either a marinara or gorgonzola sauce. 

The only con is that it can get quite noisy. But overall, a friendly waitstaff, good food, and a smile on your face when you leave.

Went here for my Bday dinner and everything was amazing! Pretty sure i ate my body weight in oysters and lobster. After looking over the menu we noticed they also do brunch which looked appetizing. So a couple months later here we are at 11am starving. Seafood and charcuterie bar... can I live here? Just go, it's great. You're welcome.

Food is good and always ready in a timely manner. Great family business, always have positive interactions with the staff and they are helpful. We have ordered the beef and broccoli, wings, crab Rangoon (very good), egg drop soup, and egg rolls.
To call what they serve there pizza is a disgrace. Dry, burnt, tasteless. Being from Chicago we know great pizza.
Loved Plaza Maya!! We sat in the courtyard and had the most amazing meal. The drink I had was not weak either which is always a plus.

Every Sunday they have family fun night. Cheap deals especially for bowling take my family here usually every other Sunday. It's kind of started to be a family tradition. If ur looking for a family place and r in downtown Sundays r the best for family outings at the rack! Thank you rack for having a place in downtown that I can actually take my family out to too have a good time! Too bowl it's 3$ a person. Have fun!

Alison was the best! I picked her based on a recommendation from a friend, and her winning my favorite baking show, Cupcake Wars. She impressed me so much in person with her wonderful flavors, flexible attitude and willingness to get exactly the flavors I wanted. We worked side by side to create the perfect and personalized flavors for my husband and I. I also have to add that I brought my gluten-intolerant friend to test gluten-free flourless chocolate cakes and it was delicious!! My final flavors featured in my Dessert Barn with a buffet of desserts included: 

1. "Mexican Hot Cocoa" - Cinnamon Chocolate cake with marshmellow frosting dusted with chocolate powder 

2. "Jossi's Oreo Cookie" -Chocolate Cake (not vanilla we decided) with vanilla frosting 

3. "Really Red Velvet" - Red velvet with Cream Cheese Frosting and Mini Chocolate Chips 

4. "Champagne Toast" - Summer Fruit with Champagne Frosting - Blueberry surprise in cake 

5. "Meg's Sweet & Salty" - Salted Caramel with Pearls around top 

Thank you so much again Alison! Your cupcakes exceeded my expectations, were affordable compared to other bakeries we called and our guests raved about them all night! I also loved the beautiful cupcake platters provided in the photo below!

Came here to get take out for some 2AM eating. First let me say...the bouncer at the door is the FUNNIEST part. Hello? Why is there a bouncer here? I guess for dine and dashers.... Second, my waiter was rude. I don't know if it was due to him being tired from having being at work all day or if this is his natural nasty attitude: either way it was very unbecoming, i didn't feel very welcome, hmp. On a better note, the food was amazing. I ordered a cheesesteak w/ American & wiz and it was prettty amazing! They give you lots of fries with it :)

I ordered hibachi filet mignon and shrimp, with a side of jumbo scallops. The meat tasted fresh and the fried rice was so good. The filet mignon was really tender. I really like this spot but sadly I moved, I always come back when I visit delaware though!

Have been looking forward to trying this for a while.  Nice restaurant, decent beer selection.  I first tried the IPA, which isn't very good.  Sadly has a very odd taste and the aftertaste isn't much better.  The Lager is really good, as is the red and the barrel aged beer.

Nice selection of options on sandwiches, had the drunken chicken, which sounded like the best option on the menu, the chicken was rather small, and kind of flavorless.  The highlight was the beer cheese and the pickles.

Friends had the wings, which looked like they had no sauce on them, they were tossed in one, but none were on the actually wings.

IF  this place is going to stay around, and places downtown don't seem to do so, they need to make sure the food is done a lot better in my opinion.

After hearing Brett and Chris rave about Poke Bowls and U Poke Spot, I figured I should finally try them out! U Poke Spot Hawaiian Restaurant is one of the top rated Poke spots in Tampa and it is no mystery why! U Poke Spot offers tons of great options! U Poke Spot is located off Fowler and North 50th Street, near USF in North Tampa next to Tazza Mediterranean Grill, QDoba Mexican Eats, Einstein Brothers Bagels, Perkins, Felicitous, CDB Pizza, & Pollo Tropical. 

Poke means "to slice or cut" in Hawaiian and refers to cutting up chunks of raw, sushi grade, marinated fish, which is then tossed over rice and topped with vegetables and umami-packed sauces. Poke Bowls are essentially sushi rolls in a bowl with more vegetables and toppings and are a tasty alternative to traditional sushi. 

U Poke Spot allows you to pick among tons of different options to create the perfect meal catered to your exact desire! 

1. Pick your Base: Rice bowl with white rice, brown rice, or nachos, poke burrito with sushi rice, seaweed wrap, or soy bean wrap or a poke salad with romaine lettuce. 

2. Pick your Proteins: Ahi Tuna, Chicken, Seared Escolar, Spicy Salmon, Squid Salad, Salmon, Steamed Shrimp, Spicy Tuna, or Marinated Tuna. 

3. Pick your mix-ins: Cucumber, Jalapeño, Sweet Onions, Sweet Corn, Cilantro, Tofu, Edamame, Carrots, Pineapples, Hijiki Seaweed, & Tamago. 

4. Pick your Flavor: U Poke sauce, ponzu, sriracha aoili, sweet chili, yummy sauce, yuzu Miso, Wasabi aoili, Spicy lime ponzu, Spicy poke sauce, & gochujang. 

5. Pick your Toppings: Avocado, Pickled Ginger, Green Caviar, Green onions, Krab Delight, Fish Eggs, Wasabi, Mango Salsa, Furikake, & Seaweed Salad. 

6. Add Crunch: Sesame seeds, crispy onions, sunflower seeds, crispy noodles, tempura flakes, toasted coconut, & katsu flakes. 

We came on a Friday with coworkers during lunch time and it was not too busy. There was only 2 people ahead of us and we were able to place our orders in under 5 minutes. I ended up getting a poke rice bowl with spicy ahi tuna and spicy salmon, with all the mix-ins, all the toppings, Spicy poke sauce, Spicy lime ponzu, Wasabi aoili, sweet chili, and all the crunch options. All the options looked so good and there was no up charge to getting every item so I thought why not! Needless to say, I ended up getting a very large portion size with my 2 protein poke bowl and everything was delicious, very flavorful, fresh, and well marinated. The serving size is enough for 2 meals if you are disciplined. In my case, I was not too disciplined lol. I liked all my selections in my poke bowl so much, I ate the whole thing in one sitting, although maybe I should not have because I was very full afterwards. For less than the price of most deluxe sushi rolls at $10.95, you can get close to 3 times the amount of food, so its really a great value that I highly recommend you try! I'm looking forward to trying more from here soon!

Unfortunately I am in the same boat as those wondering how Golden Dragon receives such high Yelp reviews.  In fact, I am so perplexed about the reviews vs. the food we received, it has prompted me to write my very 1st review!  We love Asia Wok in Brownsburg, but wanted to try something new. Decided on Golden Dragon solely based on other reviews online!  The bulk of our order is now in the trash can, and we followed up by getting food from another restaurant.

I ordered the Kung Pao Chicken.  My main complaint with the dish was the chicken pieces were so small and fried, you could not tell what type meat it was.  

The other dish we ordered was Orange Chicken.  The breading was so thick, it made up the bulk of each piece of 'meat'.  And again, the chicken was unrecognizable and actually tasted like processed meat.

The Crab Ragoons most likely receive 'best' reviews because the filling has A LOT of sugar.  The spring rolls were typical. No complaints. The 'fried rice' was really just yellow rice.  

To say we were disappointed is an understatement,  If you do visit, I recommend something that does not contain fried chicken (note: ask if the chicken is friend before you order. Their menu picture of the Kung Pao Chicken is unfried, which is what I thought I'd get :/ ).  

The good news is Asia Wok does not have to share our business! :)

Quintessential "I want fairly greasy pizza but to hell if I'll get dominoes" place. I have to say... the Stromboli is the actual winner of the menu (sorry 'za). The cheese situation, guys.. at times, I thought I was eating a mozzarella stick. So, you CAN have it all (pizza, mozzarella stick, daily veggie intake (?)) 

Important to know: for TAKE OUT be prepared to wait. This is not the typical 15-20 minutes. This will take approx 40 mins so plan your appetite accordingly

Tranquil and enjoyable either after a round of golf or just because.  This is the clubhouse to the beautiful Jack Nicklaus golf course at the Ritz Carlton Dove Mountain.  Cayton's serves up "American Comfort Cuisine with a Southwestern Flare".  They have a nice Happy Hour from 3-6PM that locals should really head out there to enjoy.  The fish and chips on the menu is A-MA-ZING!!  it is slightly spicy with a light crispy breading and the dipping sauce is tangy/spicy... definitely has the "Southwestern Flare".  Any of the food we tried was great!  Great patio to enjoy the cooler weather months in Arizona.  Very romantic in atmosphere, makes for a nice weekend date.

When my husband and I went for the first time to Grain of Rice we weren't sure what to expect, but I will tell you: we were nicely surprised! The food is absolutely delicious and the staff is super friendly! Their salad rolls are amazing! The beef Gailan, yummy! There's not even one item from the menu I asked and did not like. Everything is delicious! Totally recommend!

I can't wait until it the lobby opens to try their hot pot. For now takeout will do, the bento box portions are very generous. Our order consisted of the Squid bento, BBQ pork and Taiwanese diced pork, food was fresh and delicious. We were so excited to try we forgot to take pics, which I regret because the squid was huge. I hope they do well during these trying times, I can definitely say you won't be disappointed trying it out and helping local businesses.

Reading through all the good reviews, I have to wonder if I am crazy for thinking this place is just eh...... 

I have heard great things about it, so me and the hubby stopped by on a Friday evening. It was pretty slow so we didn't have to wait in line. The ordering process was very confusing and for being so slow I would have thought they would be a little more patient with me. I didn't really know what everything was or how it worked. I got the baked chicken, mac n cheese and green beans. My husband got the fried chicken, mac 'n cheese and something I don't know? 

The baked chicken was extremely dry, but I know, what was I thinking ordering baked chicken anyways......I had a piece of the fried chicken and just found it ok, there was barely any meat, I felt like I was gnawing on a bone. The mac n cheese, ok, nothing spectacular. The cornbread was way to greasy. 

I am sure this place is great if you like soul food, but I guess I just don't. It is very bad for you and I felt gross after eating it.
Not the best diner... server was not attentive and chicken gyro was horrible not even worth a second bite. They charge for lettuce and tomato on our burger. Whatttttt.

Wow! Just wow! I am usually not a fan of doughnuts but Dotties definitely made me a doughnut believer. a friend gifted a half a dozen and within a day they were all gone. I side eyed it for a couple of hours, a vegan doughnut? I doubted that these doughnuts were going to change me, but my gosh! It did.

Can't ever go wrong!!! Quite busy due to the Memorial Day holiday so wait was a little longer than normal. Sat at the counter and had my regular order of crispy hash browns, one crispy waffle and side order of sausage. Food was delicious and cheap!! Location could be a little cleaner and parking is a bit of a nightmare but all in all always a good experience.

I come here for lunch quite a bit.  It's a local business, not some chain sandwich place.  The women who work here are really great.  They're friendly and helpful and just make you feel at home.  There are a lot of different sandwiches, daily soups, deli salads fried chicken and for-real jojos.  There are cold and hot sandwiches, or you can choose your own from a long list of toppings, meats, cheeses, and breads. The prices are low.  The jojos are so good!  They have combo specials.  There are desserts.  It's a good place for a nice, simple, tasty, quick, and inexpensive lunch.

Had a great dinner last night. Steak fajitas were awesome! Meat cooked perfectly and veggies were crisp! Haven't been in years . Our waiter was helpful, but the kitchen was slow. We ordered and could see the kitchen staff, waiter put our order in computers and about 15 later they began cooking. Salsa was good. Building is pretty run down

So this place was what it was, and I say was, because it is now The Frozen Cactus, after it was rebranded by that Idiotic Bar Rescue Show!
When it WAS RJ's it wasn't bad, but it wasn't really good either.
What I liked about the place was the beer selection, yep that's pretty much it!
A great place to have a few Craft Beers before going next door to Serial Grillers for some BOMB ASS FOOD! It served it's purpose well, and I always had a decent time in there sitting at the bar!!
I'll have to see what horrors Bar Rescue brought to the place next time I'm in that area!!
This place is rad.  Great beer selection and tasty food.  A bar that makes a good beet salad is worth visiting regularly.

We had eaten here a couple  of times before  relocating from Nola. The food and service was really impressive.  I have to say that tonight's experience was less than good.  The hostess was not a great first impression.She seemed less than enthusiastic about greeting customers.  The food and service was just okay. Nothing to really talk about.  I am sorry that I suggested this restaurant and will not be returning.  There are so many other really great restaurants in Nola. Very disappointed.

Loved everything we ordered!!! Highly recommend!  Ordered for lunch today for work and got a little bit of everything from turkey sandwich, brisket, macaroni and cheese, fried pickles, cookies and shakes.  There were no complaints from the work place! Will order again!

Think of the classiest, upscale, most French diner with decor you can think of, and that would be Parc. We loved coming to this restaurant for a weekend brunch in Philly.

I ordered the Quiche Lorraine. I was a little worried that the portion wouldn't fill me up, but it did. It comes as a nice slice along with a dressed salad. The crust was super nice and buttery and flakely - I think it was the butter they made the quiche with that made it so filling. Inside are pieces of ham and green onion. Nonetheless it was yummy and made for a delicious brunch! Would definitely come here again.

See my hungrier half's review from @AsianCoupleEats from David N (davidngo.yelp.com)!
I got a iced matcha, great taste! Pretty good quality matcha. It would be great if the sugar level is adjustable.

Carnivores rejoice! For the meaty bbq goodness is upon us at 4 Rivers smokehouse.  The variety of pulled chicken, angus beef, pork, or the salty burnt crispy ends; being nothing short of flavor fireworks to your tastebuds.  Served on top of warmed buns or healthier alt like Creamy Polenta, 4 Rivers creations serve to please every time. Sure there are tasty sides like Fried Pickles, Fries, Hot Cakes, Corn Bread as well there are old fashioned bottled drinks ( plus fountain drinks ), the bbq meat are the super stars here.

Service is simple yet top notch - walk up counter to order, to have your order put together in front of you, then after payment seating is cafeteria style. Cleanup is efficient by the wait staff who are attentive but not uncomfortable hovering.  A little bit of socializing with fellow patrons brings a great touch to the experience.  


BONUS - The in house bakery offers many flavored cup cakes that's sure to please your sweet tooth.  Don't let your mouth water too much over your screen as you check out the pictures for visuals.

Quality of Food, Ambiance, Service and Desert 4 Rivers hits it out of the park for this reviewer, scoring a perfect star rating. 

A MUST MUST MUST Go and then Repeat.

Best Thai/Malaysian food I've had in Philly. The restaurant is comfortable and huge! There's a whole upstairs I didn't even know about until being seated up there for lunch one time. I've been there when it's packed and when it's empty and its just as good regardless of the crowds. 

The Pad Thai is light and flavorful. Why is this so hard for so many restaurants to do? They give you so much of it in this really neat vessel thing, which I can usually only get through half of.  Since it's not too heavy I usually don't feel overstuffed and I still am able to take some home for later. I recently tried the scallion pancake which was delectable as well. Job well done.

Love Love Love! I've been a few times and went back again last night for oysters and clams casino. The place was packed since we got there just as happy hour was ending, we waited about 25 minutes for a table, but the hostess was extremely helpful and organized. We ended up getting a seat in front of the shuckers. Definitely going back for happy hour next time

Fantastic beers! They're "reverence series" beers are brewed according to classical, European recipes - and they did an incredible job! Really liked their Bavarian wheat, Zwickel and Pils. Very happy to have found these in the US - now if they were just  shipping to other states...

This is my first review(yea cliche or unbelievable) but truly this is an amazing quaint spot with some great bites. It's awesome to try some true Japanese food that isn't just sushi and spicy tuna rolls. Would highly recommend this place. Keeping it short for ya'll. Enjoy

I couldnt go lower than one star. The veggie pizza was horrible!!! It was  cold, loaded with old vegetables and the cheese had weird taste as well. 
My bf ordered it after not eating all day and even his hunger couldnt mask the taste of icky tasting cheese.

I used to go to this place back when I was living in Metairie I used to hit this place up once in a while. I am not much of a fan of writing reviews about chain restaurants but here we go.

The service here has always been fairly decent. The waitresses have always been polite and attentive. Best of all quiet a few of the servers here are really pretty. Kinda pointless to mention but I figured I would throw that out their.

The food here is okay but nothing special. Their beer battered chicken tenders were alright but nothing to brag about. Most of the food I have had here was Mediocre at very best.

This place has a full bar and decent drinking selection. It is a little on the pricey side for most drinks and beers.

Probably the best thing about this place is that they have lots of pool tables. The layout consists of a dining room in the middle, pool tables in another section, and a side area reserved for parties or other events in another section.

The biggest con about this place is the fact that there is usually a JPSO squad car waiting outside to bust someone for drunk driving. So if you go here make sure you have a designated driver with you.

In short decent service, mediocre food,full bar, and pool tables. But make sure you stay sober unless you want a DUI.

This place has some of the best and freshest Vietnamese food I have had in Edmonton/SP area.  I often go here for the vermicelli bowls and grilled platters (wrap your own with meat of your choosing) which are delicious and extremely well priced.  They also have amazing Kim Chi and onion cakes as well as lemonade soda.  The service isn't always the best, can be slow and a bit abrupt, and they always forget our Kim Chi.  However, the food itself stands out enough that it keeps me going back, and leaving full usually for about 12$.  Check it out if you are in the park!

This is the most dive spot in center city.  That being said, it's not really much of a dive.  I like this place though.  It doesn't do anything amazing.  But everything is still solid.

Decent prices.  They serve pitchers.  The beer selection is not bad.  There are some really good lunch specials.  Wings are pretty good. 

Nothing amazing here, but sometimes you're looking for that middle of the road, but still good spot.  Locust Rendezvous is it.  I bet this is a good place to watch some Phils or Flyers.

It is so delicious and for a great price! Very authentic, large portions (even for small order) and quick service. Clean and safe with covid protocols. Friendly employees. Ordered Carry out and the containers are sturdy and they even put cardboard in the bag to keep it upright.

Almost a 5er.  Food was delicious.  The owner (I think, could've been the manager) greeted us and helped pick out a couple glasses of wine, both great.  Pretty decent cheese plate for an appetizer. Both entrees we ordered were very good. A couple things that keep this place from being 5-star is the ambiance lacks and our waitress was a little forgetful, probably just having an off night.  Definitely worth a return trip.

I've had bad experiences here before but tonight was the worst. At 7pm I ordered online. I ordered a hot roast beef sandwich with extra cheese and au jus. It took almost 2 hours for the order and when it arrived there was no au jus. When I called I was first told they would sent a new sandwich but then he said no they were closed. 

This is not the first time this happened. Last month I placed the same order and the same thing happened. 

All I want is what I paid for. There are too many other places that deliver that want my business.

The ambiance and spanish design really enhances the experience. I went during lunch which it was very light in patrons. Immediately we were seated and our waiter approached kindly. She brought warm chips and salsa, and drinks quickly. I attribute the exceptional promptness to it not being many other parties to serve. We ordered our food which also came quick in 15 minutes or less. I ordered the Enchiladas Bandera which consisted of 2 enchiladas (1 w/shredded chicken & 1 w/ shredded beef) topped with sauce, cheese, and sour cream. It also came with rice. While I have eaten Mexican food, admittedly, this was my first time eating enchiladas. They were pretty good. I'm always open to to trying different foods, especially ethnic foods. 

My dining companion ordered spinach over chicken and mashed potatoes with bacon sauce. I thought, I dunno about the bacon sauce, but surprisingly it was given a raved rating. The prices were moderate, and the lunch menu prices were really decent. Overall, the service was very good, and the food too!

Food and service so good, I forgot to watch the college football games that I stopped in to watch.

I'd been here before, many years ago and was in the area. I remembered a great restaurant for steak, but could not find it right away. Surrendering my desires, I pulled into a fern bar. Then, my eyes spied, down the street a bit, the sign for Darfons. Whoot! I'm there.

This review will cover service, food and decor. I was smiling the entire time.

"Bri" (Bree?) was my server in the bar area and she was wonderful. Granted, I stopped in mid-afternoon and the place was less than bustling. However, instead of just chilling, she kept alert to the customers who were there.

To give you an idea how sensitive to customer needs she is, I'm going to tell you about my club soda.  I ordered it with lime. She brought it as to my order. As the drink narrowed down to 1/2", she promptly brought a refill. Not only did she bring the refill, it had more limes. Most restaurants will just bring lime slices with the first serving. Nice work.

Darfon's is famous for great food and great steak. Steak is what I wanted and was a bit intimidated by the reputation. Questioning if I really wanted and expensive steak, I went in, planning an alternative, salad and soup, or maybe an appetizer. I settled for the appetizer, and boy, was I happy! I got "The Pantry."

Here is what comes on the plate when your order the appetizer named, "The Pantry":
Duck Prosciutto
Fresh Mozzarella with cherry tomatoes
Truffle Salami
Truffle Mayo
Brie
Fig Jam with Candied walnuts
Pickled Capers
Ciabatta bread.

It was a meal in itself. Wondering how to eat this plate, I just started sampling each offering, then played with combinations. If they did not make the unique foods on site, they did great job finding them.

Prosciutto is one of my favorites, and I have had many imported Italian varieties. I've had a Tennessee version, as well as a lamb one. The flavor was wonderful. The duck meat came out with a nice rustic color. The small slices were great.

Fresh mozzarella is wonderful, and theirs was great. Tiny balls of this cheese with split cherry tomatoes reminded me of a Capresse Salad.

Quarter sized slices of the truffle salami occupied one corner of the square plate. Afraid that they would be tough, I tried one. I was wrong, It was a nice texture for a hard salami, and the truffle flavor was just right.

At first, I did not know what to do with the Truffle Mayo. It was a nice spread for the bread and that is how I enjoyed it. It was a nice bold, but unobtrusive flavor.

I think it was Brie. The menu said it was Artisan Cheese. It had a rind like Brie, but instead of a soft cheese, it was semi-soft. It tasted like Brie, but I liked it anyway.

Fig jam had the walnuts sprinkled over them. Candy coating on the nuts was nice, not too strong. I opted for combining the figs with cheese and duck.

Pickled Capers were the size of green olives and had a sharp, acidic and salty bite to them.

What a great complicated dish to play with.

A lot of steak houses decorated in wood, are a bit dark and have a smokey feeling. Large windows let enough natural light in to make it pleasant.

I can only comment on the pho here but I ordered the vegetarian pho and it was pretty good, broth was really good. I must say for the price of 9.50 the portion was small. Had to order another side bowl of noodles. This place is trendier with a bit more ambience than your average Vietnamese pho place. Good to go for a date. I thought for a small 16 oz of Thai iced tea, $5.00 was overpriced. (even though the menu stated 2.50, I was told her menu has been updated)

Overall good, I would come back.

Just decided to order from them because delivery was free and it is a black owned business. 

Got the hamburger on french and fries. Im so pleased with the food I had to write a review. Why am I so impressed? Well...the meat was REAL! Yes you heard me...REAL HAMBURGER MEAT! I'll be ordering  from them again for sure!

The food is good but not great! The matza ball soup is nothing speical, and ive had the corned beef sand and pastrami sand and there pretty good but nothing great. I wouldent go out of my way to eat here again. Mehh
Ask for Rosie! Best bartender in Tampa.  Drinks are fresh and innovative. She knows her shit!

I am not sure what "Mexican Soul Food" is and after my first and most assuredly only visit; I can definitely say that neither does the Owner or the cooks. I was expecting maybe flavors tied to the Chefs/Owners personal experiences of being African-American and Hispanic. The restaurant business is definitely competitive but using a name that implies fusion to appeal to exoticism and not even delivering on the basics is no way to win repeat customers or solidify a good reputation.

I walked in around 7 pm in the middle of the week. There was only an Owner/Manager and his friend at the bar so service was pretty quick. I was greeted expeditiously and very warmly; and with both the doors open and a nice breeze coming in, I was expecting a nice enjoyable meal. First things first, long day at work equals a drinky drink! I went with the white sangria. It was less than weak it was almost flavorless and I wish I would've gone with the margarita - they iced that bad boy down too - boooo.

Reviewing the menu I knew that I wanted to go with taco combo plate, it comes with any two tacos and two sides from the menu. My number one choice was fish tacos but they were out - ikarumba! Starving and under pressure, I went with the poblano taco (peppers, onions & mushrooms); the tinga (turkey, infused with tomato chipotle & onions); and my sides were black beans and the epanzote white rice. Most places use corn shells and normally they collapse in the center due to the thin texture and the moisture of the toppings that are added. Here they make their own tortillas but they're really thick and the consistency is kind of weird and viscid. The toppings were plentiful and the plate photographed well but the wow & flavors just weren't there. The consistency of the gummy taco just took away from whatever the toppings were supposed to deliver. Each component should be flavored separately so that they meld together - that was not the case, both tacos were single note profiles.

I think this place will get business because of the allure of the concept, and it is across the street from The Fox. Mexican Soul Food? The inspiration behind this restaurant definitely needs some recalibration and with that said, beyond its location I don't believe this is a dining destination. I know Restauranteurs have some tough competition but this place is truly having an identity crisis. Wednesday at 5:30pm with no shows or Saturday at 8pm with two shows - you need to show up and show out and Lücha didn't; not sure dude was even in the building.

The food (and the prices) are perfect. Went with a large party. The food came quickly and everything was better than the next plate. There is outside seating which is much better than most restaurants as it's in between two buildings rather than on a sidewalk. The parking situation around NoLibs is tough so come a bit early.

Considering it's a BYO, I can't think of a better place in Philly to get your Mediterranean fix.

This was our favorite restaurant in New Orleans! The place was huge, the staff were attentive, the food was amazing - winner! We tried four different items on the menu (the seafood salad, spicy shrimp linguine, stuffed crab and ribeye), and EVERYTHING was yummy! It was so good, I forgot to stop eating to take pictures!! 

For our entree, we ordered the ribeye. I know I know - how can you order steak at a seafood restaurant??! We were all seafood out by our fourth night in New Orleans, we wanted some meat. We didn't really expect it to be a Ruth Chris steak since it is a seafood restaurant - but oh my gosh it was one of the best steaks we've ever had!! It was cooked perfectly, so tender and flavorful and the 22 oz. is humongous! We couldn't finish it (even shared) so we took the rest to go. Some lucky homeless dude got to eat well that night!!

Hands down, a must visit when in New Orleans!

I rode the Grants Trail today and I wanted a bite and a beer. I headed to the bar to watch some basketball. The bartender was very friendly, she set me up with a flight of their beers. I ordered the chicken club and sweet potato fries. The serving size was perfect and the platter looked appetizing.
Really tasty food.  Nice cocktail list.  Just blocks off the beach on State.  Not too noisy.  Go for any ceviche and the octopus!

Calzones bigger than your head! Premium toppings and  creative flavor combos. It's an order at the counter and they bring it to you style restaurant. You can order drinks separately at the bar. Although there is ample room to sit and eat at this location with comfy booths and date tables, I think sauce on the side is best enjoyed take out! I didn't have a chance to try a dessert calzone this visit but next time!

Hotel Congress has changed a lot over the years, from the Dillinger Days to being an apartment complex. Today, it has been re-vamped and is a nice place to grab a drink in the downtown area. 

As an extra: the manager is a very nice guy, and the beef wellington bites are pretty good. The shrimp cocktail was delicious. Check the place out!

Food was great but the service was slow and apathetic. I had the phat Albert burger and it was great. My girlfriend had the shrimp and grits which was also good. However, service took forever and the place didn't seem like it had a big lunch crowd.   Waitress forgot my ice tea! Three stars for the food but if you have schedule to keep forget it. Three for the food.
Price is very reasonable and affordable for college student like me. I got the burrito and original waffle, which both were amazing!!

Went on a Tuesday night.  The restaurant wasn't busy.  We were seated immediately.  We were seated for a bit before our server showed up to take our drink order.  We gave her our entire order, drinks and all.  I got a diet coke with lemon, my daughter had water.  To start, my daughter and I ordered chips, salsa and guacamole.  We both ordered plain chicken and cheese quesadillas.  I couldn't find our server nor the bartender so I went to the hostess.  I asked her to find out where our food is.  People seated 10 min. after us got there food before us.  It took40 minutes

Ordered 3 burgers, 2 onion rings and one fry to go. Cost with tip $55 plus. Everything was greasy and falling apart. Everything was soggy, flavorless and disgusting.

So very disappointed.
This is a wonderful restaurant where you feel like family. The food is great and the chef, owners and Paolo are great people!  Be ready for an excellent evening!

I met my husband here!!! Love the pizza!!!! Had the risotto appetizer with yolk and it was sooooo good and rich and flavorful. Great atmosphere for big groups and offers a little bit of everything for everyone with fine dining, craft beer, and high end cocktails! Beer garden and tough luck club are a must!
Best Italian food around and very friendly owners! Very fair prices as well. Highly recommend them as a local

This is a nice new location for Walden's.  The menu is the same as the original location, the inside has a little more space and doesn't usually get to crowded but it is usually a bit colder inside I'm assuming from the giant windows in the front.  It doesn't really have the cozy feeling the original location does but they could fix that with a little work.  The food and coffee is still amazing.  This is a nice place for family breakfast.
Celebrated my son bday tonight . Great food ,lovely staff , sushi was delicious .. one of my fav sushi place .. they brought him fried ice cream cake was delicious .. this place never disappoints
Always have a good experience at Dom's. The food is always good, nice service, and pretty quick. We stop in regularly now.

Wow the food quality has really dropped off
While my prior reviews noted some inconsistencies last night there was not a redeeming item on three meals. 

Stopped in last night for a ~7pm dinner with the family 

Son's cheesesteak was loaded with those completely charred black carbon bits of burned meat, fat and cheese that are usually scraped from the griddle into the waste bin

Mrs' fries were not the jacket on home cut Belgium frites on the menu but rather some basic frozen fry

My burger had the perfect smash burger crip griddled meat skirt expect it continued over the entire patty on both side making it an overcooked dry and crunchy burger

My onion rings were is over cooked the onion inside the coating resembled a fried corn flake 

Service was happy and helpful 

Great decor 

Fun outside dining area 

Maybe it was an off night but we felt it was a complete waste of money

I really enjoy Roys whenever Im close-by I just have to have one of there lobster tails. There lobster tail at Roy's is definitely in my top 2 most favorite, also there ribs! OMG they are so good I definitely recommend them to anyone. Also great ambiance love the vibe, also the aloha HR is great

the worst brunch in philly in 21 years of living here - small portions, food came out late and at different times and was bland and mostly over cooked - one dish seemed reheated and really horrible. there are so many other places to have brunch in Rittenhouse for this price - place needs a wake up call - big time

Flavors were enjoyable but the service, and my portion, made this an absolute disappointment. Don't order the half salad and cup of soup combo unless you've already eaten, this was a waste of $12. Should have known given we had to wait 25 minutes to get our seven top prepped despite the table being open when we arrived. Just not service oriented, do the tour and enjoy food ay one of Nashville's other eateries.
We had great food. I had the Thai Crispy Chicken. Yum!
Not real grouper,Basa.I don't recommend this place to anyone that's looking for fresh food.If you want Sysco frozen food,have at it..Not me...

They need to invest some money into keeping the lanes clean/smooth and the replacing the balls.  We have been to Pinewood several times in the last couple of years, and last Sunday we went and noticed the up-keep on this place has totally gone down the crapper.  The lanes needed smoothed out and polished, and the bowling balls had chunks missing out of them.  Food still is great, but they definitely need to spend some money updating the lanes.

This festival takes place once a year in November.
St John's Greek Orthodox Church puts up tents,
sets up tables, rides, food and entertainment for a three day weekend. This festival has been run for
over 30 years and is a big fund raiser for the Church. It is spread over the Church property 
and grand hall.
They serve all the Greek favorites such as 
Pastitio, gyro, spinach pie,  Keftedes, stuffed
grape leaves, greek salad, feta cheese, lamb
shank and chicken. Make sure you save room
for desert.  You can buy baklava, custard filled
pastry, cookies, sweet bread, and kataifi.
Most of the food is inside the grand hall.
There are many large tables set up in front of the stage. 
There is a bar outside under the tent. They
serve beer, wine, ouzo, and a few mixed drinks.
There are also many tables set up outside under the tent.
Handicap and take out parking is behind 
the church. They have a separate area inside the
grand hall for takeout food.
The food is prepared and served by the church
members. The food and service is great.
Such nice friendly people.
There is a high end car raffle at $100 per ticket
with only a set amount of tickets for sal
Street parking may be hard to find. 
There is a small parking lot at Swann and Armenia.
Street parking is limited.

This is probably the best taco shop my wife and I have visited in Southern California. I had both of the fish tacos and they were superb. My wife, who grew up on the Mexico border, said that the carne asada was some of the best she's ever had.

Love everything about this bar except the service. Sat at the bar on a slow Monday night for football and was constantly overlooked. Wasn't checked on or asked if I needed another drink when mine was empty. Instead, I had to flag down the bartender and  they made me feel like that was somehow an inconvenience to them. Will be back but hoping for a more attentive staff.

For a place in the suburbs, this place is good! It was packed on a Saturday night. Make a reservation. We did not, and had to sit at the bar which was quite uncomfortable as we had to really lean in to eat. The way the bar was built, it was not meant for dinner at the bar.

We had the mango shrimp, pad thai and beef massaman curry. Apps: tom kha soup and scallop salad. All was delish! The spice level could have been more but the Thai flavors were all there. I wasn't a fan of the tom kha soup. The scallop salad had mango and the dressing was so flavorful.

I woke up this morning wanting to eat the leftovers. It was really good.

Upland is probably my favorite neighborhood brewery. I've been coming here for years, as have many of Upland's loyal customers. The staff is incredibly friendly and know their regulars by their first name, have a beer ready for you almost immediately after arriving if they know what you like and always make sure their customers are taken care of. I come here to hang out, meet new people, write or read. There's truly so much this place can offer you if you're open! My favorite beers they have on tap at the moment are Dragonfly IPA, Coastbusters (seasonal). They just got rid of Juiced my Style so come back for that when they get it back! 10/10 recommend.

That is a tasty burrito. Maybe the best I've ever had. They're stuffed with rice and sauce and protein of your choice, veggies, and magic. The Golgi bowls, with rice, an egg, protein, and veggies was also fantastic.

If you're claustrophobic at all, I recommend carry out, the dining room is tiny, maybe room for 16 people.

Have had lunch here twice now.  The chicken sandwich is bland and needs something added to it.  The pasta salad is boring and needs a little more pizazz.  Prices are high for lunch and the meal is unmemorable.  The atmosphere however is really nice but not many tables.
Reliable. Not stellar but far from horrible. My waiter had an attitude a bit but I thought the food was decent enough.

You should check this place out.  My girlfriend and I went to try it; Friends recommended the walnut old fashioned and it was excellent.  I love foxes so I was really digging the theme and I'd say the ambiance was similar but an improvement over American Ale.  Very good arabic/fusion food!  We need more middle eastern food in town and the prices were very fair.  The grape leaves were super tasty but the falafel wrap was even better.  The baklava, though, was incredible.  They even kept some classic American Ale burgers on the menu for A-A loyalists ;) The two cousins who own it were really good guys too!  Say hi to them from Zack :)
favorite sushi in town. The dynamite is dynamite.. My favorite is the marlin tacos though. Great happy hour specials too!

blackened grouper.

blackened grouper.

.....what was I going to say?

blackened grouper.

So, if you haven't picked up by now, I obviously ordered the fish and chips. (What?!) jk I ordered the blackened grouper. OOH.. *whistle* it was so. Good. Perfectly seasoned, guys. I mean, perfectly. Not overly salty. Had some garlic and onion goin' on in there, maybe some paprika. And a tad bit of subtle sweetness that had my mouth wanting MORE. And such a decent amount! It was so good. Even the beans and rice were good! Tender rice with seasoned beans. Fresh pico de gallo. And this FISH oh Lord this fish.

So good. Let's just say....If I could only subsist on fish alone...and I also lived right next to Badfins Food + Brew...and I also had lots of money.

I would eat this. Every. Day. And get ALL the Omega 3's and 6's that this world has to offer! 

Definitely a fantastic place to stop in and eat at if you are ever in the area!  After you stuff yourself with fish you can swim like a fish amongst fishes....

yep.

blackened grouper. lol.
I've been eating at this one for almost a year. The past two orders haven't been correct and the bread didn't taste or feel fresh. Very disappointed
Great place. Have been here a few times. The grilled wings are great!! Good daily specials. Inside and outside bars and seating. Definitely worth checking out. They have a few locations as well

This place was surprise - mostly for the food

I expected try to a couple new local beers (which we did).   They were fine, but nothing memorable.

However, the food was really memorable and good - full Hawaiian menu with a lot of unique offerings.

If you want a quick salad, steak or burger from outback and save a little money on tipping this is the place to go!  The food is fresh and made to order. I enjoy the salad and the Aussie pedals which taste just like the real thing!  Definitely visit at least 2 times a month!  I love it!

Ahh, the place where I began hone my craft as a drinker!  Great decor, menu, and overall atmosphere.  If you're lookjng for a bar with some character - this is the place.   Probably my go-to place for a late night menu.

This place has amazing food with a super fun atmosphere. Great food, great music, great art!! I have ordered most things on the menu and have always been thoroughly pleased. You really can't go wrong here!

Tucked away inside the historic Chase Park Plaza, The Preston is probably one of St.Louis's best kept secrets. We made a trip out from West County just to try this little gem of a restaurant.
Unless you're a foodie or staying at the Chase/ nearby area you probably wouldn't randomly stumble in here. In the slight chance that you do however, you're going to be thoroughly surprised.

The restaurant itself has mixed vibes of rustic meets chic. It's beautifully designed with wood tables and picture frames hanging along the long wall. 

Our waiters name was Jay, and I can't say enough good things about him. You know that feeling you get when you're going out with an old friend? That's exactly what it was like. He was warm, enthusiastic, and caring. From the moment we sat down he made sure to welcome us and ask us about any special requests, allergies, etc. He took his time explaining their seasonal menu which he explained had been recently updated and made suggestions. His presentation and service were impeccable, and honestly that can either make or break a dining experience. 

Now on to the real deal: the food. The menu is designed as small plates. Not quite like tapas serving sizes, but the same concept. Jay recommended we get 2-3 plates per person, but it all depends on how hungry you are. 

We ordered the bread plate to start, which came with 3 different breads: jalapeño, whole grain, and croissants. The bread was absolutely mouth watering and came with the delicious spreads. We also ordered a couple of the salads and for the main course we ordered the NY strip steak which was Creekstone Steak. All of which I would definitely recommend! 

Ah, and to top off the evening the desserts were my favorite of the night. We ordered the Chocolate Melt (which came out with a candle compliments of Jay for my brothers birthday). It was a delicious concoction of peanut brittle, salted peanut gelato, chocolate, and hot caramel drizzled all over. The presentation was key and definitely snapchat worthy! Literally having licked the plate clean and not quite having our dessert fix we decided to order the Milk Chocolate Panna Cotta which had an equally amazing presentation and was just as delicious. It came in an air tight jar which once opened a foggy smoke trickles out and smells like smores over a camp fire. We loved every bite of it! Jay mentioned that the dessert menu would be changing next week, so I'm sad we won't be able to get these desserts again! 

Having left completely satisfied with every part of our experience, The Preston set the bar pretty high for our favorite dining spot in Saint Louis. Can't wait to come back again!
We frequent this restaurant, and they always have the best steaks. The value is good, and the customer service is usually outstanding.

I'm having a hard time with all the 5-star reviews for this place (which is solely why we chose it).  The salad was great, the wedding cake dessert was amazing, but the in between was mediocre at best.  My steak was tough (even though cooked medium rare) and both my potatoes and my companion's were undercooked and still slightly crunchy.  I'm fine paying $$$$ for food that is worth it.  After all, you're not only paying for quality food but also trained personnel to cook and serve it.  Our old favorite steakhouse was Prime 1000 but unfortunately it went bye bye.  We'll give this place another go and hopefully I can update my review to something better.

Horrible horrible experience. We went last night for happy hour because it was rated best happy hour in South Jersey Magazine. The bartender was extremely rude. If the food was bad and the service was okay I would return, but all around bad service and food is just unacceptable. I heard such great things... Maybe they were having an off night but I thought it was a complete waste of money. I eaving there I was disgusted. I will never return. The view was pretty but the bartenders attitude and bad food made the experience horrible.

I order from Boston Style all the time, being that they're one of the very few places that actually knows how to deliver to my residence (I share an address with hundreds of people). Delivery is usually fast, and even when it's not the food still comes hot. Drivers are all nice, and in these strange COVID times they all wear masks. Stick with the pizzas and pastas, you'll be happy.

Running errands and I was starving + craving a poke bowl. Luckily Yelp helped me figure out that I wasn't that far from the Metry location of Poke Loa. 

Even though this is a big shopping center, everyone was there so parking was a bit tight. This location is small and doesn't have much interior seating and only about 4 outside tables, luckily one freed up for me to eat. The staff was great. And the restaurant was clean just no as charming as the uptown location... but it's a strip mall.

So they were out of all the flavors of aqua fresca. Color me sad. I got a 3 scoop protein bowl with lettuce (to offset all the Christmas cookies). And here's where I got sad. The lettuce wasn't great, wilty and some pieces tasted off. And then some of the fish had an ammonia smell. Very offputting. 

Because I was starving and paid $$ for my bowl, I took the risk and ate it anyway. And it was fine. I finished about 1/2 of it (so I wasn't a starving beast) and then got it home and added some balsamic vinegar to hide the smell. And ate the rest. I was fine so it definitely wasn't bad, just smelly.

Maybe it was time of year or just a bad day. Would stop in again, but would try to not be ravenous and more aware of the ingredients.

Absolutely delish!!  I love that they get all their meat from Tyner Pond farms.  I had the kipply dog and the fresh garlic fries.  Service was friendly and not too in your face.  The guy preparing the food delivered it your table and made sure you had everything you needed.  Will definitely return.

How have I never been here before!? This dang beef eater is out of this world. Little pricey, and took a few mins for my food to come to the table.. But well worth the price and wait. Absolutely delicious. If you're looking for a good sub shop, stop in at Jason's deli.

The food was not that great. I had the clam chowder and it tasted like a creamy chicken soup with two pieces of clam. My toddler got the kids hot dog which came on a steak roll, I don't know how he was supposed to eat it! My husband got the chicken salad club, he said it was okay but he's had better! Service was okay, but I don't think I'll be back.

Great food in a wonderful old bank!
Had the brisket and a few drafts. Will def swing by again on my next visit

I ate at shells about 2weeks ago and everything was really good today a different outcome the shrimp tasted so fishy I couldn't eat it they must be frying all seafood in the same oil it even stunk up my car the toss salad was large chunks of iceberg and a pile of tomatoes 

I ordered Togo from shells today i ordered clam chowder crab cakes fried shrimp when my order was ready I asked for a side of island sauce the server said that would be good on the crab cakes well that would be nice but I didn't get my crab cakes when I got home I had peel and eat shrimp instead of crab cakes I guess nobody checks the orders before they go out pay attention people
This is my favorite Chinese restaurant to eat at! I love their orange chicken, but it sometimes is a little over cooked. This place is now my go-to Chinese restaurant.

Great chill service, my garlic hot wings were great would've gotten them naked but didn't know that was an option. My friends bbq wings were very crispy and delicious they had a great flavor. The bar itself had great atmosphere.

My mother and I sampled the oxtail, jerk chicken and curry chicken. The oxtail was perfectly seasoned and tender, and the sauce was wonderful over the rice and peas. The rice and peas were wonderfully savory without being salty, and I enjoyed the smokiness of the jerk chicken. The macaroni and cheese was so-so and the plaintains were tender and sweet. I would love to go back to sample their fish and beef patties if they have them that day!

My name is Anne O'Brien. My husband and I visited the Holiday Inn in Lansdale/Kulpsville, Pa.on Sunday Jan 27.
We went to go to a new restaurant but it was a long wait so we came to 1750.
We were greeted by a host and seated by him also. We then had the same waiter come and wait on us. 
We were served a great fresh salad and served drinks from the bar.
Our meal was excellent. I owned and operated a large restaurant in Springhouse Pa for 30 years so it is sometimes a risk to go to a new place.
We will tell others of our experience and will return again.
Sincerely,
Anne and Frank O'Brien 
1342 Mark Drive
Lansdale, Pa. 19446

We were making our way down PCH when we decided to stop by Santa Barbara for some seafood! A lot of restaurants in L.A. source their sea urchin from here, so why not get it straight from the source, right? 

Everything was so fresh and good! The oysters were slurpilicious. The sea urchin was sweet, but I wish it was bigger and had more of the edible part. Seaweed salad was bomb. Salmon poke was good. The only downside is... they didn't have Tabasco for the oysters. We were offered soy sauce, but that's kinda weird unless it's ponzu sauce. Overall, I'd recommend this place! Will def pay it a visit next time I'm in town!

We, Husband and I, went to this restaurant looking for good Mexican food. Our past experiences have been fair to say the least. This place has some of the best flavored food I have ever had. Even my husband who is extremely hard to impress told our server, "please give my compliments to the Chef." 

The salsa is slightly thin and a bit spicy....but extremely addictive. Like you can't get enough of it. We ordered Cheese Nachos which had a mega amount of "real" cheddar/jack cheese on it. Sour cream and guacamole came on the side. The guacamole was obviously made from scratch and fresh. The only thing was it was a bit light on toppings like tomato's, olives etc., for my liking, but it didn't make it any less enjoyable. 

My husband ordered the Devils Shrimp and I ordered a shredded beef Chimichanga #27. Both meals were fantastic. I even asked to have mine wet with green sauce which they did at no additional charge. Portions for the price where fantastic..more than enough plus. My husband ordered the Flan for dessert which he enjoyed as well.  

There appeared to be a private party going on in a separate dining room which only became apparent to us if someone came through the door attaching both dining rooms and you could hear the music from the party. Which didn't make our dining situation uncomfortable in any way. 

The service was outstanding. Friendly, efficient, and extremely attentive. Never did our drinks go without refills, all dirty dishes were removed promptly, all questions were answered and all our needs and desires were met with a smile. 

Cost was around $42 without tip.  Will be going back very soon.:):)

This place is in the practice of lying to their customers and hoarding food for preferred clientele.   Disgraceful way to run a business.   Menu items should be available for all paying customers,  not just certain one's.  If you list something on your menu board,  then serve it,  otherwise don't list it.

I was surprised how nice this restaurant looked when I walked in. I usually don't pay attention to that kind of thing but it looked clean, inviting and comfortable. From what little contact I had with the staff, they were also friendly and helpful.
They also offer free wifi.
The food is still KFC food. I wasn't unhappy with my chicken or mashed potatoes, but the food isn't reason enough for me to drive all the way over here.

My new go to spot. This is the most creamy, flavorful hummus I've ever tasted. I had no idea that there was such a thing as "high quality" hummus, but this is it. The hummus bowls with pita offer a very filling meal or would be perfect as an appetizer to grab last minute. I will definitely be telling my friends about Hummusology!

I have never read such polarized, mixed reviews as I have for this place. So of course, my interest was piqued and I decided to make a reservation and try it for myself.
The hostess and servers were polite, but the restaurant was half empty and I felt we were seated at the worst table in the house. No big deal. I enjoy looking at my fiancé anyway. 
The decor was great, very Elisha if I can say so myself. 
We were offered a lovely crusty bread with pimento cheese bread to start, and ate or so fast they brought us another batch.
We shared the guava fries (could be crispier) the pork dumpling (yum) and the star of the night, the pulled pork pot pie. I thought there was crab in it but didn't notice any. No matter, we are the entire thing plus the delicious and sweet shell. 
Our cocktails (street car and gimlet) came late with apologies but were expertly crafted. I would surely return on a future trip.
Good basic mexican food. i especially like their salsa bar
It's sad. This place has such unique history and all it is now is a rundown sports bar. I'm pretty sure the Haunted Tours keeps this place in business.
Beautiful and chill, recommend the lucid dreams (with cbd flower) and love potion( full of aphrodisiac)

Freshest crunchiest wings in New Orleans! Every time I come to visit I always have to get some golden wings. Their prices are reasonable and affordable! We placed a party tray of wings and fried rice combo when we got there and they were able to make our order within 15-20 minutes. Fresh fast and friendly service.

The outdoor seating was never available, even though I went on two separate occasions. Regardless the inside seating was also nice. The food is good but not amazing, honestly I would go more for the decor than anything else. I would even go more for coffee really. Wasn't a fan of the hostess, she was a bit rude and seemed "selective" as to what party sat outside. Just found that odd.

Tldr: Kinda meh pho - delicious dumplings.

It was a cold and rainy night while visiting Nashville, so my friend and I thought pho would be perfect.

The place is super cute! We got there around 5 and had the whole place to ourselves.

Ordered the chicken dumplings and beef pho. The dumplings were so good and tasted freshly made - I wanted more!

The pho however, the broth was so off. I've had a lot of pho and some tastes different, but this one was so off that it wasn't very good. 

Didn't try the sandwiches so maybe that's the route to go?

This place is just Ok. We get bagels once a week and really look forward to it since we try to eat clean most of the week. The service is really not good at all. Everyone working there looks like they are completely miserable so it's a bit depressing of a vibe. Which I don't really understand bc BAGELS are LIFE! Oh well, our options are limited so we will be back, but cheer up guys!!

I've been eating here all my life but I'd never choose it on my own. I know a lot of people like this restaurant. I do not. I visited on a weekday for lunch with my family. I ordered a small Greek salad and an order of Saganaki.  The Greek salad was very good. The Saganaki was a hot mess. For whatever reason when the cheese was fried it did not form the thick crust and it came on a plate swimming in oil.  Also there was no squeeze of lemon after plating.  Perhaps there was way too much oil and they didn't get it hot enough? It was very disappointing.  Everyone else enjoyed their lunches.  I'm 43 and no question I was by far the youngest customer in the building.  This is the restaurant that time forgot.  It looks exactly the same and serves exactly the same food it served in the 1970s and 1980s.  If they did it right I could perhaps consider it comforting.  Since they don't I just consider it passé.  Service was brusque and slow.

Solid place for fried chicken - I think it's worth checking out. If you actually get a meat and three sides, it's a little overpriced for what you get. I got hot chicken, and it was certainly hot. Not my favorite hot chicken I've ever had but it was good. Cocktails were a bit too sweet for me. Favorite part was the dessert - banana pudding was delicious.

Hands down my fav Thai place in town. Great quality, good portions, fantastic owners. The weekday lunch specials are amazing. They come with soup, curry puff, small salad, rice and your choice of entree. Even the lunch portion is generous! For dinner my family loves the Thai street noodles-pork, tofu, veg, wide noodles, all meld together into a flavorful dish. Highly recommend giving it a try! If you like spice go for 4 or higher. They do tend to hold back just a bit.

I have to say, Chuck E. Cheese has definitely improved since my last review!!  They've upgraded a few of their little kids games, amped up staff to ensure everything runs smoothly, including cleaning up Chuck E. Cheese's dance...in other words no more throwing tickets at kids and calling it good... The management is new I believe and the difference is noticeable. 
The salad bar is always full and looks clean...their pizza is crispy, garlicky and always good. One criticism is that their family size sampler platter doesn't have enough in my opinion...
On this last trip to play the day away with Taven, the manager offered us more tokens with a coupon he had, and even offered extra tickets if we filled out an online survey...
Once completing the survey, the manager kept his word and gave us a receipt for tickets! I like the amount of effort he is putting into turning this place around!

I'm not going to lie, I know hotdogs cause butt cancer, but they're SO DAMN GOOD! You can NY it up, sauce it up, throw on some kraut - it doesn't matter how you like your wieners, you can make them to order here. Mine are usually a pretzel dog with chili, cheese and onion - just keeping it simple. 

Aside from the delicious food, the staff here are very friendly and welcoming. I haven't met a stranger in here. Plus, they're cheap! Just go. And make sure to use your rewards card!
Sadly, an assortment of chicken entrees and various appetizers proved inedible tonight. The culprits were poor meat quality - or no meat, just breading - and over sugared, sticky sauce/seasoning
So good! So friendly! Margaritas are delicious and food is fresh and tasty. I may be there every day this week...

They have unbeatable lunch specials ($5 a plate) and the food is pretty good. The restaurant is clean and the staff was friendly and attentive. I wish Yelp would put in half stars because it didn't quite measure up to 4 but deserves higher than 3.

It's not often you walk in a door and feel like you just came home, but that's what happened here.  This place is the very definition of funky. No contrived "upcycling" here. No contrived music or food. All real and gutsy. If you need for your plates to match, your music to be quiet, and your kids to be perfect, don't come here. It can be loud, and the meatloaf is better than mine. And mine is GOOD. We also had the gorgonzola chips.  I'm not a great fan of blue cheese, but these are addictive. The service was great and the music outstanding.

Went with a friend to try the new vegan ice cream and it was SO good. I also love all of the topping options (chocolate almond butter drizzle?? yes please!). The cookie dough chunks were also really good. It's a bit pricey so I can't go too often but it really is super tasty :)

First off, I'm not reviewing this place based on food, which is good but over-priced. I'm reviewing the nightlife. This place is nuts after 10pm on Thurs, Fri, and Sat. Over-priced drinks, horrible parking, but decent DJ and hottest girls in STL.

Incredible restaurant!! Amazing food, beautiful venue and wonderful service. Will be coming back here very often!! Would recommend it for a casual lunch or nice date night. Great venue overall! If I could give this restaurant more than 5 stars, I would.
Great meal! Fresh, real food. Simple but deliciously honest without being overpriced. Nice relaxing atmosphere with friendly wait staff.
This place is so great! The sushi is delicious and the service is awesome. Definitely check it out.
Best Chinese food in NOLA period.  I moved to the lower garden district to be within their delivery area.

The hype is real!
Was walking around center city yesterday and friends have told me to check this place out, but I never have before, so thought I'd give it a try.  It has a cool open ambiance, with a glass garage door as their opening, and an airy vibe that stays warm in the winter.  The seating inside is limited, so if you're with someone else in line and you see seats open up, one of you should grab them.  There is a large mirror to the left with a few seats, and then a picnic table to the right.  I presume most people order to go.

Their counter is in the back, but takes only a few steps to get there as the restaurant front is fairly small.  The gentleman who took my order (and brought me my food and hot sauce later) was extremely pleasant...in fact everyone working there seemed to have a smile on their face and greeted each and every customer.  That speaks volumes, as most tiny joints that are trying to get as many customers in and out won't necessarily do that.

The menu changes daily and you can find updates on their Instagram and other social media posts, but I believe they always have their regular hummus on the menus - Tehina.  They also have a couple of beers on tap, a drink special, and a couple non-alcoholic ones as well, in addition to free tap water in pitchers everywhere.  I ordered the Onion Hummus, per a friend's reco, and it was DELICIOUS.  By far the best hummus I've ever had, and I've had a fair amount of hummus in my day.  It wasn't overly flavorful or too thick.  The texture was just right, and it was creamy, filling, and tasty.  There were white sauteed onions in the middle, along with chopped walnuts around it.  The pita was warm and flaky, and was definitely awesome.  I hate to say it, but the pita was not the best I've ever had, but certainly up in the top three.  In addition to the hummus and pita, a nice side salad of cucumbers, onions, pickles, and a pepper was a great complement.

I was shocked as to how filling the dish actually is.  They also don't skimp you on the hummus and there's plenty to finish with the one pita bread they give you, if not more.  Overall a solid place and will definitely be coming back here.

Oh. My. God. I may have just died and gone to heaven. I got take out tonight from Mirko and it is seriously... EASILY... the best Italian food I've had in Nashville. (I'm Italian... and hard to impress - I mean... have you TASTED my Nana's coking??) 

I'll go through things one by one... 

Salad... didn't even taste it. Too excited to get to the stuff I could SMELL! 

The Bruschetta... the bruschetta itself is PERFECT - the right about of tomatoes to garlic... the bread... meh. 

The Crispy Brussel Sprouts... this is where it starts getting good! These lightly fried brussel sprouts are so delicious - I could eat them as a snack any time!! 

The Fettuccini Alfredo with Crab... LORD have mercy!!! This will set your taste buds on fire! Cooked perfectly, just the right amount of sauce... and REAL crabmeat!! Not that fake orange stuff... realllll crabmeat! This made me forget every other pasta dish I've ever eaten at a restaurant - almost as good as Nana's! 

Mangia!!

This was actually my first steakhouse experience back in 2011. Sadly, I haven't had the opportunity to come back just yet. From what I recall, the decor was something out of an old Hollywood film - deep, dark, and mysterious. You walk through the days and feel transported to a different world. A world with tender and juicy filet mignon and oh so amazing shrimp cocktail.

Awesome people, friendly staff even when you are not local alien. if you are visiting this place as tourist you will be very welcome. 
Food it's tasty, fresh and delicious! 
Mexican tourists are welcome. Great place to visit, eat lunch!

We came here for my mother-in-laws birthday. We were looking for a place with good local seafood while sticking to somewhat of a budget and New Orleans Food and Spirits in Bucktown seemed to fit the bill. The Bucktown eatery was booming on a weeknight with the restaurant almost at full capacity inside. They even had a few diners enjoying their dinner on a particularity hot September evening on the outside patio. I made a mental note about the patio to remember. It has been redone and looks great. The wooden fence creates a privacy barrier from the street. They have a nice big fountain for ambiance and I noticed heaters ready to go for the cooler nights. 

Inside was open and airy with the doors to the patio open and plenty of windows in the front. The bar area was nice with minimal decor. There is a large window to the kitchen so you can see the open flames of the charbroiled oyster action. 

Since we had a big group we wanted to get some appetizers to share. We settled on the large order of onion rings and voodoo crawfish rolls. The onion rings were plentiful as the huge fried onion rings were stacked up and piled high. The voodoo crawfish rolls were sort of like a seafood cheesy egg roll. They came with a great sauce that made them go from good to wow. 

I ordered the stuffed grilled catfish which was a crabmeat stuffed catfish served with a side of pasta Lafayette (Alfredo shrimp sauce). This entree was rich and definitely big enough for two people. The fish tasted great and the stuffing was perfect with it. 

I also got to taste a sampling of the shrimp and oyster poboy which was excellent. The seafood platter, which again was huge and could be shared with 3 people easily. All of the fried seafood was perfect. Great taste, great seasoning, perfect crunchy batter. 

The service was on point. Our drinks were constantly refreshed and everything that was requested came zooming out. The wait time for the food was pretty short. Since we were celebrating a birthday our waitress brought us a bread pudding with a candle at the end of our meal. It was a nice surprise and a sweet way to end our meal.

There atmosphere is great, the service is also great. The chicken tenders are amazing. However they use whole chicken tenders in the buffalo chicken wrap, they could be cut up so it's better for the wrap. They put the lettuce on the outside, it was more of a garnish then a part of the wrap. The fries were okay, like something that you could get at Applebee's, not crispy, a little bit soggy, like they are microwaved. The Mac an cheese was dry, over cooked, and lacked cheese. The draft root bear was flat but that could have just been the tap upstairs. Floats are amazing. The ranch is pretty good too. May return to order something new.

I've been here so many times, both for brunch and dinner. I love it every time. Love how the menu changes with the seasons, makes you want to come back and see what else they come up with. Brunch has bottomless mimosas, bloody Mary's, etc which is nice. Dinner is amazing, I always get whatever hummus appetizer they have because it's always good. Happy hour is pretty good compared to what drinks are normally priced as. It's pricey but worth it, always leave feeling full. The different themed rooms are also cool. Bartenders are nice and helpful, conversation is fun if you're by yourself. Overall a great place

I've seen some negative Yelp reviews but I have to say, for us, it's been nothing but great at El Charro Cafe (and yes, the one on Oracle Rd in Oro Valley).  Now, we do typically sit at the bar, so I don't know if that makes a difference, but we've been treated so kindly by the staff, the bartenders, by everyone.  First of all, Ciara has been great, to mention one bartender.  She remembers what we like after very few interactions, she's pleasant to talk to, she's efficient and personable and makes great drinks and checks on us at the appropriate times.  Rachel, if I got her name correct, is also a great bartender.  Very pleasant to talk to, knows the menu, knows her stuff as far as mixing drinks is concerned, she's great too.  Margaritas are excellent here, not that overly sweet mix out of a machine but good tasty drinks.

We've never had an issue with food not coming out fast enough or anything at all in the service department.  And the food is great here.  I particularly enjoy the tamale stuffed chicken but there are lots of winners on the menu here.  Original enchiladas are great, the hola hemp tamales are also delicious, and the standard fare (tacos, etc) are also quite enjoyable.

You absolutely cannot beat happy hour here either.  Incredible value for the quality of food and service you receive.

On top of all that, lots of gluten-free options - and truly careful gluten-free, not lazy "it's corn therefore it must be gluten-free" but real care in understanding cross-contamination (i.e., yes you can eat the chips without worrying about other fried items because it's a dedicated fryer).

We will continue patronizing El Charro (we really like Charro Vida too and still have to try Charro Steak) because of excellent food, service, and value.

The first thing you notice when entering Bertucci's is the fantastic aroma. The smell of the restaurant itself attracts customers. Next is the fire of the brick ovens. After that is the wide variety of delicious entrees. My personal favorite is the margarita pizza with a side of macaroni and cheese. I constantly find myself coming back for more. Simply marvelous.

I love love love Local Taco.  The ingredients are fresh and local and they usually have a great one or two special tacos daily.  I f you are looking for authentic mexican food you will not find it here.....that is not the point of the place so don't fault it for not being that.  It isn't supposed to be that.  The brisket with pickled onions is awesome, the spicy shrimp is probably one of the best shrimp tacos you can find in Nashville and the fried chicken is just fun.  

I have tried a lot of different stuff on their menu and it is all good.  The sides are not done in a traditional way and are all very good.  Their gaucamole and chips dip is super yummy and their Sangria kicks ass.  

Staff is super friendly and when there is a long line, they move you through pretty quickly.
