I've gotten the Caesar wrap I don't know how you mess that up but it just wasn't good. The pancakes are fine but they serve you syrup in packets. Get some real syrup. I've been there for breakfast and dinner and it just doesn't work whatever time of day you go.

I live in Tampa and discovered this treasure today! Best seafood I have had since our trip to Portland, Maine and onion rings the size of your head! The service was spectacular and the atmosphere perfectly suited for a sun soaked day.

Went in for an afternoon beverage and was greeted by the bartender Zo. (Sp?) He was fin, a people person and attentive.  Can i just say he makes THE BEST dirty martinis?  They were only 2.00! Best martini i ever had.  Spoke to the manager about how wonderful zo was.

The Passero's in Suburban Station is my everyday go-to. They are always unfailingly nice, very quick and efficient, and their coffee is fantastic! Also the quality of their coffee and other drinks comes at a better price than any other boutique coffee shop in the area. I know Philly lives on DD but if you're looking for quality coffee and service at only a fraction more of the price, Passero's is absolutely worth it. Small varietal every morning for me!

Best Steak in Nashville!!! We were celebrating a coworker that has been with us for many years leaving our company so we wanted to go out to a nice dinner, The GM Zack set aside a small private dining room for us to enjoy and celebrate our memories of our friend and coworker together, Zack and staff went above and beyond to make our night special. I highly recommend requesting Sheldon, his menu knowledge is top notch personality is beyond perfect and over all professionalism A+.
Great feel good sandwich joint. You won't be disappointed. I personally got the monte cristo and it was phenomenal.

This place is FANTASTIC. Highly recommend the burgers, almost everything from the patty to the mayonnaise itself is made in house! Delicious, great portions, reasonably priced, awesome workers-  a must visit!

This was the worst Mexican food I've ever had, and that's saying a lot. I don't know how this is in the top rated in Tucson. The tacos were extremely bland, worst I've ever had. They had no seasoning, the meat was very dry and the meat tasted old. I got both chicken and carne asada, both equally bad. The burrito was also bland, but tasted fresh at least. As for the ceviche, definitely the best out of the food we got, but still disappointed from it. The chips were good, but still not very flavorful. We got churros too, and they tasted old and not chewy, but overcooked. Overall, I would not recommend this place. Very disappointing for $50 worth of food. Most of it was left untouched after taking one or two bites. Do not recommend.

I traveled to Nashville last week for a business trip and thought I would make the trek to the Loveless Café which I read so much about.  Hey, if Gwyneth Paltrow states that it was her favorite restaurant to eat and hang out at while filming Country Strong, it's got to be good!  I talked 2 others into driving the 40 minutes from our hotel to this roadside cafe and motel so we all had expectations.  The meal started off on a high note with delicious homemade biscuits and 3 kinds of preserves.  It was all downhill from there.  We all ordered the Southern Sampler Platter per our waiters' suggestion and all 3 of us were disappointed.  The pulled pork bbq was tougher than my leather hiking boots, the 2 strips of fried catfish were about as thin as a number 2 pencil and the fried chicken was drier than an extra crispy order at KFC!  I was looking for a "green" vegetable side dish to save myself from using a defibrillator and the only option were "green beans cooked all day in a pot with ham".  I ordered it anyway seeing as the "vegetable of the day" was a sugary apple.  Hmm...did someone change the category of an apple from a fruit to a vegetable and not tell me?  The green beans were nothing short of mush.  The chef must have gotten wind that I recently had dental work and was abiding my dentist's orders of not biting into something hard for awhile. We skipped dessert and burned rubber out of the restaurant only to complain about it for the next 40 minutes back to the hotel.

I've visited this IHOP on a few different occasions for breakfast. FYI: breakfast is probably my second favorite meal of the day, right behind dessert (also, is it bad that I consider dessert a meal?!). As you all know, I don't have high expectations when it comes to visiting chain restaurants- but I do appreciate the relative consistency that comes with them and IHOP meets that standard. 

The hostess has always been friendly whenever we visit this location, and usually seats us quickly. If we don't like the section she puts us in (i.e. near the kitchen, by a rowdy table, etc.) there has never been an issue if we ask to move to another table/section. One of my favorite things about IHOP in general is the Never Empty Coffee Pot. A major pet peeve of mine is waiting for refills, and it seems that the coffee cups at most breakfast places are on the small side thus requiring frequent refills. IHOP has answered this issue with a relatively simple answer- a thermal carafe! I wish more places would adopt the idea of using carafes, even if only by request. Otherwise, I'm going to need a bigger cup (cue Jaws soundtrack).

IHOP meets all of my standard breakfast must haves, i.e. eggs, bacon, sausage, hashbrowns etc. Even though I am a waffle kind of gal, I've got to admit the pancakes at IHOP are pretty darn good and in my opinion only require minimal syrup and butter so you can really appreciate the yummy buttermilk batter. Overall the service has been pretty good but obviously like any restaurant some servers are better than others; that's just the way it is folks! 

I do prefer this location over the one in Kenner, predominantly because it is newer and the staff seem to be more attentive. I'll definitely be back, and recommend stopping by if you're in the area and looking for a reliable spot to grab breakfast.

I live in the Philly area and it is comparable if not better than most. The staff is nice and attentive. The mixed drinks are phenomenal, the Thai tea is my favorite of all. I would recommend the p1 (pho deluxe) and c4 (rice with everything) it is my favorite place for pho and broken rice dishes.

I really wanted to like this place because I love Lebanese cuisine.  However, I was charged $27 for a veggie platter & $10 for a slice of cake.  And a 20 minute wait to top it off when there is one table of 2 before me.  The quality nor the service was worth almost $40.

As a Flight attendant on a layover, I depend on Yelp to help me find a great place to eat and drink. Jen, my bartender, is constantly on the move , but still manages to be very personable in delivering her excellent service. The food was very good and the prices very reasonable.   Even though the address is on Franklin, go around to the entrance on Twiggs Street. That's where the front door is hiding!! Thank you fellow Helpers for leading me here!!

I love Sushi. My girl and I live coming here. Sushi has always been high quality. Lollipop cucumber is awesome. Cali rolls are great. K Town delicious. But my favorite is Uptown Funk. High recommend this place for
I didn't think I liked wings until I had the garlic wings here. Get them. They are life changing. So incredible. Great customer service. Will be back! Thank you.

We visited Morning Call Coffee Stand for a snack while we were in City Park in New Orleans in Jan 2017.  Service wasn't the nicest and the chair / table areas were in a bit of a disarray and not the cleanest, but I did enjoy the food!  I tried Muffuletta, a New Orleans staple, for the first time at this cafe.  The dish is comprised of a large, round, and somewhat flattened loaf of bread with a sturdy texture, around 10 inches (25 cm) across.  I had a muffuletta sandwich, which was comprised of a muffuletta loaf split horizontally and covered with layers of marinated olive salad, salami, ham, Swiss cheese, provolone, and mortadella.  It was quite delicious - I loved the combination and being able to try this famous staple!  Not the best cafe I've been to, but I did enjoy the sandwich I ordered.

Great place to grab a drink. Went here on a Saturday night. Beers are around $8 bucks with lots of variety on tap. Cocktails are delicious at $10-15. So a bit pricey, but this place has a lot if character. It's sort of prohibition/speakeasy place. They also had some old school love music that blended into the atmosphere of the place. Wood and barrel tables. Not crazy crowded. Not sure about the food cause I just had drinks.
Great bar. Food is awesome too. MUSIC IS TOO F'IN LOUD...I just wanna drink & talk to my friends.
We come here at least twice a month. Their Mango Tango roll is one of my favorites!  The staff here is pretty pleasant too.

Called to check if they delivered to my address was told yes. Called back 5 min later to place order and was told they didnt have a driver right now and they were too busy. They shouldn't advertise delivery of it is only on a case by case basis.

I love this place!!! I've been twice so far, and the food is heaven. So far I've tried the naam salad (a perfect mix of sweet and spicy with a nice coconut flavor), the duck spring rolls (perfectly cooked and not greasy), the Cornish hen (flavorful but I wish they hadn't cut it into pieces), and my all time favorite THE KING'S SOUP!! I cannot even describe the deliciousness of this soup. I ordered mine with shrimp and tofu. The broth is a flavorful red curry with lots of veggies, and a mint garnish that is really good. I plan on going back and trying the fried fish, and the papaya salad.
Love this place.  Only been a few times, but so far its the usual Mexican fare.  However, their salsa is phenomenal and they have HORCHATA!!!!

Green eggs & ham w/ extra tomatoes  please! 
And it was only $5! They always have fresh infused water available too.
#starbagelcafe #nashville #nashvillefood #nashvilleeats #eatnashville #sundayfunday #bagels

Totally worth the hype. If you like fried chicken and you are in Nashville this is a must. Truly some of the best fried chicken I have ever had and still dreaming about it two weeks later. All the sides we had were delicious as well, especially the spicy greens. Excited to return again soon.

Traveling from Ohio for work and first time visit.
Cannot say enough good things about the Stacked Pickle!
Started with Natalia at the bar as her friendly, knowledgeable and professional attitude kept everyone happy while zipping from bar patrons to servers drink orders, to multiple carryout orders. Owners need to bonus this girl!
Ended with a great food carryout. 
All of the employees were engaging, fun and the type of place to hang out anytime!
Will vist again as in Indi monthly!

Absolutely loved the vibe of this place and how laidback and beautiful the space is itself. The barista could tell I was indecisive about what to get and took the time to recommend some drinks to me based on my preferences. She went on to make me an insanely delicious lavender mocha with oat milk that was perfectly creamy with just the right hint of sweetness. My fiancé had a dirty chai latte which was just as good. Probably the best dirty chai I've ever tried. Would absolutely come back and looking forward to my next trip to downtown Burlington.
ordered my first Po Boy ever here.  We got fried oyster Po Boys and man were they tasty.

To me this is the best food in all of Tampa Bay (and there are a number of great choices).  Chris is one of the most talented chefs I've ever met.  I've taken business partners who specialize in gourmet foods to Cafe Ponte and now every time they visit, they insist on Cafe Ponte.  I love to travel to New York and San Francisco for their famous restaurants but I feel we have that type of destination restaurant right here with Cafe Ponte.
Overpriced and tasteless food! Chicken was over cooked and dry. The tacos were tasteless, no seasoning whatsoever. Very disappointing! I'm surprised you're still open!

Places like this make Philly a world class city. Very hip. Cold brew on draft. Food is very good. Baked goods off the hook. Pretty moms with there kids and neighbors working on the computer. They have a distillery and make excellent rum. From the outside you would never know. If I lived around there I would stop every day.

My husband and I were visiting our 2 daughter's who decided to bring us here for appetizers and drinks.
Our waiters came and introduced themselves as anthony and cianni. Both had so much energy and enthusiasm which was so nice to see. They were both well informed on the menu selections. We ordered a variety of Appetizers which were outstanding. 
Both waiters managed to bring us a dessert that said happy anniversary on it. 
The extra attention that was given is what makes customers want to return.
We will definitely be  telling our friend who visit the area to go here.
Good Food,drinks and atmosphere along with great waiters.
We come here before almost every Pacer game. Excellent pizza. Long beer list.  What's not to like?

Good food yet Horrible service . We went this Friday night and waited to be seated  along with others waiting to be seated , at the please wait to be seated sign . While it looked moderately busy , the few servers who were on looked slammed trying to catch up with their tables. So slammed they refused to even look our direction at the growing line at the door . Nobody was look led at let alone greeted - a very bizarre way to conduct business . After a long while people gave up and started trickling out the door one by one , we followed their lead and left too . I mean Don't servers work for tips ? Why would they  blatantly turn away half a dozen people ? I don't know weather to call it rude or dumb but you can always go to IHOP or the McDonald's in Walmart and get far better service .

Hands down the absolute BEST cheesecake in Philadelphia.  The bananas foster cheesecake is fantastic.  The recently added key lime cheesecake is even better.  I do not like banana flavored desserts, but the bananas foster cheesecake does not have a strong banana taste.  However, the rest of the food and cheesecakes are not that great.  Also, the service is not great.  Very very slow and inefficient.  
*EDIT: Now they charge an extra $1 for take-out, even for cheesecake.  I do not return for the take-out cheesecake anymore.

This has to be one of the worst tan places in the country. Doors closed again. Their system is accepting orders only to have people show up and no one there. This has happened multiple times. Spreading the word to not go here

Thank you Waffle House for being open on Xmas morning and full of cheer. Everyone at work was happy, cheerful and welcoming.  Service was fast fast and fast. 

My server , Bri, took care of my family. She was warm, full of Xmas cheer and happy to be at work. 

Merry Christmas you and yours!
I've always been a fan of Lee's. I'm here picking up dinner at least once a month as their "Hoagie Day" is a permanent fixture on my calendar. Always friendly staff.

I'm a big fan of Rook. Great service, usually one super friendly barista behind the counter. And the perfect amount of nerdy that I need in a coffee shop. And the space is unique and fun. It's a little less busy than Mojo up the street and a more manageable menu (for people like me who aren't super positive the difference between fancy coffee drinks and super fancy coffee drinks). I'd definitely recommend Rook if ever you find yourself wandering Freret Street

Wow.  That's all you need to read.  Go on to the next review....

Okay, if you want justification for the "wow," here goes.

First of all, this place is adorable.  It's a cute little house and each room is decorated so nicely, but with a little flair.  They even excused our very casual outfits (in comparison to other patrons), since we had just come from JazzFest.

It is clear that there is a big focus on local fruits, veggies, meats, and fish.  I mean, they cure their own bacon, and it's incredible!

But, let's start from the beginning...drinks.  Good wine options, and a yummy strawberry mojito.  Plus, Abita Strawberry, what more could you want?

I ordered the shrimp and grits, escargot, and rootbeer sweet potatoes.  My mom had the scallops and dad had the short ribs with pork belly confit.  They both raved about it and one bite of the pork belly made me want to cry with happiness.  But, my shrimp and grits were incredible and the best thing I ate on my trip to NOLA.  The shrimp were incredibly flavorful and still had their heads, leaving me the deliciousness inside their heads.  They were also HUGE.  The red eye gravy was absolutely unbelievable--spicy and rich.  I seriously licked the bowl.
The escargot was very good and the goat cheese in the broth added a softness and richness that was excellent. Again, the house-made bacon was perfect.  The escargot was already shelled and that took away the fun of digging them out!  Oh well...
Unfortunately, the sweet potatoes never arrived, but I was so full, I didn't even complain (although now I wish I tasted them....)
Dessert, however, was a bit mixed.  The pot de creme were fabulous.  I was super excited for Red Velvet Cake, but was so disappointed.  It was dry and thick tasting and the lack of cream cheese frosting made me sad.
This is top of my list when I'm back in NOLA.

I've now patronized the Amish Market's sit-down eatery twice and it seems like 3 stars is a fair rating.

No matter the time, there seems to be a queue on weekends, both for eating in and taking out. That's probably because the market as a whole is always rather busy. It can be awkward waiting for a table because no matter where you stand, you're certain to be in the way of someone pushing a cart or carting five kids. Fortunately, the wait seems to be on the shorter side, so that's a plus.

The restaurant is small, bare bones, and classic. Nothing to look at, so it's all about the food. For my first visit, I ordered one of their omelettes and a side of bacon with a bottomless coffee. Refills were offered; the food was good. Service was friendly. If I was rating just off that, I'd probably give 4 stars. Although I will say the food is pricy and adds up quickly for the quality.

My second visit was for lunch. I ordered the Philly cheesesteak, no onions, and requested the bacon-cheese fries as well. When my plate arrived, the fries were attached as my side. I was confused since they were billed as more of an appetizer on the menu so I assumed they'd get their own plate and I'd receive the chips I paid for. 

The sandwich was passable but the fries were pretty unsavory. I left most of them behind. My mom felt the same way about her turkey bacon and only had a bite. She also disliked her pancakes -- said she felt like they had been cooked on the griddle right after meat and had a funky flavor.

Our server seemed bored and confused (she gave my mom the wrong tea type even after clarifying twice), so I figured I'd just consult the check for the price breakdown of everything. When the bill came, it didn't have any prices listed, so I asked the hostess instead. She told me they were separate orders, yes, and confirmed that I was supposed to get the chips with my sandwich. But then she didn't give me the chips, so I have no idea what happened there. Maybe they were all having a really bad day...?

I've ascertained that this eatery is more of a diner establishment and thus would be best patronized for breakfast. I'd return eventually for eggs. And likely only eggs.

First night in Clearwater Beach and had to go to the Columbia. We have been to the historic Ybor City Columbia years ago. Call ahead for reservations. So we chose the 5pm one. We of course started with drinks and waters. They have both still and sparkling water. We asked our waitress Taylor about side salads. She suggested sharing one of the 1905 salads which were prepared table side with garlic dressing with julienned ham, julienned Swiss cheese, iceberg lettuce, cherry tomatoes, olives and grated Romano. It was perfect. My husband ordered his favorite grouper which was the Grouper Jimmy. It was stuffed with crabmeat; served with asparagus and dirty rice. It was a generous portion. He loved it! I ordered the cannelloni de langosta which was stuffed with Maine lobster, ricotta, crabmeat, shrimp, scallops and shallots with a sherry cream reduction. Oh my gosh. Is your mouth watering! It was sooo good!! So when in Florida you have to get the Key Lime pie which we shared. It was very good. My only suggestion is I just like it a little colder.

I popped into Bakery Melange when my husband was getting a haircut across the street hoping they'd have some French macarons, our favorite. While they do not sell macarons, they had plenty of other goodies to try. I asked the gentleman working behind the counter for his recommendation for a small treat and he suggested a chocolate peanut butter thingy. I ordered one of those and a chocolate meringue bite as well. I had half of each (split with the hubby). Both were quite delicious, though I must say I preferred the meringue. The gentleman at the counter was extremely nice, though a bit unprofessional. I would definitely go back to try other treats!

Honey,

H- Had my anniversary dinner there. It was my first "tapas" style eating experience. The flavors were bold and the selections unique. 

O- On point. The food was on point. We ordered the shrimp martini, risotto cakes, mixed olive plate, B.E.L.T and a couple others. I enjoyed them all. 

N- New food for me to try!! I never had pork belly until my experience here, It tasted like succulent bacon cubes. I am a fan, although I had pork belly once since eating here and it was not as good. 

E- Expensive, but you get what you pay for! Great flavor paired with lovely presentation. 

Y- You should give honey try! Its a great place to spend a special occasion.
Authentic pizza. For Chicagoans, it's a mix between Giordanos and Lou Malnatis. Good crust. Chicago bar atmosphere. Recommend.

I had the fish and chips and they were amazing. Fries were delicious! Some of my coworkers got the philly and the pork stack sandwich. Everyone was raving about how amazing their food is. The guys were really nice and had fun music going on. I love this truck!
I dream of the Wild Boar Bolognese and the Rabbit entree. Well done with fantastic cocktails!

This place has pretty good chilaquiles and even better mole. Great drinks. I wish they carried spicier sauce tho.
It has a really chill atmosphere. Would recommend!

I went with my son and future daughter in law for an appointment for wedding cake tasting. We were brought 2 stryofoam plates with cupcake pieces, a spoons of different fillings and icing and hunk of peanut butter "that was a filling". The woman put the plates down, offered no water, didnt describe any of the ingredients, i asked her if she can tell me if there were any hydrogenated oils etc, her reply was I don't know I don't bake them. The cakes taste like box cake, the filling was from a can and jar of peanut butter. The displays are outdated, dusty and yellow from time. It wouldn't have mattered if those cakes were awesome the service was so bad! I don't know who the owner is but when you have a couple set up an appointment from north Orlando to possibly dish out $500 to you for a wedding cake and you provide this service, I can tell you good luck because $500 walked out your door today. Yes myself and the bride to be work in customer service and were astonished!
Bartender knows how to make a drink!   Shrimp was fabulous. Definitely put this on your list of stops.

Drinks were great. Service was great. Need more places like this in our city. All of us in our group could actually hear each other talk while we
enjoyed our drinks and food.

Had a great time at Cook! We went with friends for Frutti Di Mare-A Celebration of Italian Seafood with Chef Michael Vincent Ferreri of Res Ipsa. The food was amazing! First time trying squid ink pasta and grilled swordfish-loved them! Definitely expanded my seafood repertoire as promised. Chef was informative in a casual way with a great personality explaining techniques and the various local ingredients used. Service was off the chart! Water and wine glasses were never empty. Very cool setting. Great books and products for sale too. Excellent way to spend an evening learning and eating. Will definitely go back-and will also
Be trying Res Ipsa!
Pizza and crazy bread were ice cold even though they were just placed in the new electronic pick up boxes. This place is cheap but is just way too inconsistent to waste the time with it.

Been trying to get my husband to go to Maggiano's for awhile now. I have been there before and just love it. We decided to have a nice dinner before catching a Christmas concert at Scott Trade. So nice to see the restaurant all decorated for the holidays. Love the intimate atmosphere. Waitress was amazing and we were even greated with a gift from the manager. Food was so delicious. My husband loved his entree which says a lot because Italian isn't his first choice. He had the baked Ziti. I enjoyed my beef braised entree. And the desert!!! We are still talking about the cherry chocolate cake. My husband is even talking about his return visit. Highly recommend Maggiano's.

Creative menu, lots going on with many flavors on the plate, food was good, service average and a bit disappointing based on the price of the meal. Server shouldn't be so confident that she has mastered the art of service and attentiveness "over 11 years working with the chef". Loud restaurant. Probably will skip this one for the next special occasion.

Great seafood place. Very casual, nothing fancy. One of the most impressive things is that you can see into their kitchen and it is spotless and you can tell very well kept. Food comes out very quick also. Only complaint is food portions could be a little bigger. They have the best key lime pie I have ever had. Many of the staff have worked there for decades so they are attentive and know how to do their job properly.
Love their food very much!! Love the spicy rock shrimp appetizer & kimchi sashimi salad & sushi pizza :)  nice music!
The trap pizza was flame! Can't wait to go back. Great selection of food and drinks and game changing pizza!!!

This was my 1st time at Feby's. It came highly recommended so we thought we'd give it a try. The verdict? Mediocre food + expensive menu  = meh, we could've done better.  Don't get me wrong, the seafood was very fresh, we had 2 dozens of raw oysters which were absolutely delicious. So here is the question, if the seafood is so fresh, why all the extra preparation? I had one of the seafood platters. It would've been wonderful without the "imperial", the "casino", the "deviled" stuffing they put all over nearly every single piece of seafood on my plate.  The downstairs dining room was charming, like a little inn you may find in New England. The service was slow, but since it was Mother's Day dinner, the kitchen is understandably backed up. If there is a next time for me at Feby's, it'll be on someone else's tab and I'll be sure to order everything plain so  I can really enjoy the seafood.

Fabulous dinner and atmosphere inside Ox & Field last night. The Pho-men soup was delicious and the Kalbi Lamb was to die for.Oh, the Green Tea Creme Broulee  was fabulous perfection. I highly recommend going... and make a reservation. We will definitely be back!
Best sandwiches around!! Every sandwich I've tried is really good compared to other places

We stopped here about 6:30 p.m. on a Saturday with some relatives from out of town. We have been here before and they have been to steak and shake before but they don't have it in their local area.  We had a long day and just wanted something simple and easy. 

It was not very busy inside and we were taken to a table right away and provided menus. 

We each ordered one of the burgers and fries and three of us ordered a milkshake as well.

Our meals arrived rather quickly, looked good and everyone enjoyed what they ordered.  The prices are very reasonable as well!  Our only complaint was that the interior temperature was very cold and even though the day was unseasonable cool we felt the heat should have been adjusted.
Really enjoyed this great spot in Narberth! Good drinks, wings are perfectly sauced and the bread pudding is very good! We really enjoyed the small town feel and can't wait for our next visit!
My BFF and I had lunch here while on a girls trip.  We had the gondola salad.  The dressing was very good and the salad was filling.  Great service.

I'm so glad great Basin opened a new location. The Sparks location limited my visits, it was just out of the way. The food is good. I've enjoyed every micro beer I've tried. Try their fried zucchini yum, yum, and their amazing home brewed root beer.

At strong urging of one of my friends who LOVES this place, I tried it for the $5 Burger Night which is Mondays. This is the much more affordable option now that my fave Five Guys has increased its prices yet again. I will say I was not disappointed. Its not the big nasty greasy burger I am used to but I enjoyed it. 

Burger Monger specializes in a more gourmet burger experience. The burgers are Kobe beef. There is a selection of 30+ toppings including cheese, vegetables and sauces which you can add. Some of the toppings are consider premier and cost additional but most are included. They also have chicken and hot dogs if you have varied preferences in your family. 

The burger was a bit small to me and would not be filling if not accompanied by any sides but I enjoyed it. I would go back again, probably more often if I lived closer. Its worth a try in my opinion for sure.

So, we have been here several times because its in the neighborhood.  Its never anything great but its good enough.  Well today they really LOST two good customers.  I will NEVER go back there.  I went with my daughter and six month old Granddaughter for lunch.  We sat down and were looking at the menu.  There was a huge Egret on the table next to us when one of the waitresses started feeding it shrimp ON THE TABLE.  Seriously?   How disgusting and dirty.  Well, the bird knew where his next meal was coming from and when we got our food this bird was pecking at us, walking around the table, it flew onto the table next to us then jumped down and lunged toward my plate.  We started to throw stuff towards the water to get him to stop.  It worked for a minute and he was back.  Not one of the waitresses thought this was unacceptable for people paying to have lunch there.  It was not cute or funny.  We asked to speak with a manager, he came out, we explained the situation and he said he would make sure it didnt happen again.  Then he just disappeared into the back again.  Well he must have told our waitress because she came over, rolled her eyes in disgust and shooed the bird out of the dining area.  We asked for boxes and she said of course. Walked away and then the original waitress who fed the bird shrimp, an older woman with frosted hair in a bun with long ringlets on the side and an overbaked tan, walked by giving us the stink eye and laughing as though we were ridiculous to not want a bird hovering around our table.  The thing was molting all over, it was really disgusting.  We boxed our food and our waitress, the "feeder" and one other watched us as we walked out.  No one apologized, or took our complaint seriously.  Well take the fact that yours is the only waterfeont restaurant that is dead at lunchtime on Friday as a clue to start doing things right.  Dont be surprised if this place gets closed down.

Bodhi, in addition to having iced green tea and the best dill chicken salad (on a Wild Flour brioche bun, natch) now also takes PLASTIC! 

Huzzah! I'm moving in.

This is a super low-key chinese restaurant.
They have a lot of variety of food that you can use from.
Say you want something tasting a bit more americanize or even authentic chinese flavors, they have it covered.
I especially like their Szechuan menu.
Overall great value since they have massive dishes. 
The owner also has a great attitude and servers are quick to respond. 
Will return again soon!

My favorite bar in Philly! The food and drinks are always AMAZING, and the service never fails to exceed my expectations! Definitely get the Blue Hawaiian Sky and the Nachos Grande when you come! I  BARLY!

Was in the area and yelped Chinese restaurants and found this gem of a place. I called in my order of general chicken, Mongolian beef, chicken chow mein and house fried rice. The person that took my order said it would be ready in 20 minutes, but by the time I drove from Costco to the restaurant it was ready for me. Super fast service. I was greeted by the cheerful owners upon arrival and thanked when I left. Love when the people working in the restaurant are happy, the mood is infectious. 
The food was well packaged and still hot when I made it home. My family and I really enjoyed the food. The Mongolian beef and general chicken wasn't overly spicy as I requested and the fried rice and chow mein were delicious. I liked that the food wasn't oily. This is a Chinese food restaurant that my family will add to our take-out rotation.

Their broccoli lunch sandwich is to DIE for. I get it all the time. They also serve 8th and Roast coffee, which is one of my faves. The staff is full of friendly people who try to get to know their customers, and I feel so warm when I come in! Thanks for the food and service, guys!
Quick lunch with a friend, delicious sushi. We were both very happy.  We had the avocado roll and a mixed vegetable roll.  We shared, they were both very nice.
Food was good. Bought Restaurant.com coupons and they don't work for tak out orders. Cashier was not flexible. VERY disappointed.

This is a great "local" pub to call into for a drink and some bites if wanted. It has a small but nice selection of beers and ciders. The staff are friendly and attentive when it's busy the atmosphere is great when it's quiet it feels nice and cosy. In the summer they take off the huge front windows so it's completely open and co

We've been waiting for almost 30 ish mins till we get to cook our food.. How long did it take to serve us uncooked meat? Seriously, I still can't find a good Korean BBQ here in Arizona that has an all you can eat.

I'm sorry but nothing beats L.A.'s All You Can Eat Korean BBQ..

I'm full but not satisfied..

Good atmosphere,
Great beer selections.
Food is nothing to write home about. 

Very long wait time on Saturday.

"House made ricotta" and "fish and chips" are awesome!!!!!
But steak and chicken are so so.

A little bit too dark lol

i was thoroughly disgusted with my sandwich from campo's - soggy and (besides the extreme overdose of parm cheese) very bland.  not to mention the service was poor.  they messed up our takeout order and ended up charging us for an extra sandwich.  very expensive too (even for olde city).  keep your distance

Servers are overwhelmed and take so looooong for everything . Margarita was pretty good but the food was quite sad literally. Didn't enjoy it at all 

Not recommended as a goto Mexican place in this area.

DIRTY. sticky tables and forgot to give us our blooming onion. Small steak and expensive and half of it was fat..bad quality... Could get a bigger steak for less money at the grocery store. Save your time and money and make your own steak...seriously

You gotta love imo's, this pizza is THE st. louis pizza, another tid bit of info st. louis is where the toasted ravioli arose. Most people who try imo's love it for the cheese, thats the provell ; ) and yes it is godly cheese. The pizza can cost a pretty penny but its worth it usualy because of the quality of the pizza. For people out of town this is ST LOUIS style, meaning provell cheese, square slices, and thin crust, don't expect anything else.  In recent years due to the economy i think the quality went down while price's went up but its still good pizza. I suggest onion and sausage mmmmmmmmmm, another place which is similar and are all over south st. louis is cecil whittakers pizza, almost as good but alot cheaper.

Food is fantastic, and I am a fairly frequent customer.  All staff are friendly.  PROBLEM is that this place is terribly unreliable.  Tonight, during a snowstorm I walked three blocks in 3/4 foot of snow to buy dinner at Zuppas.  I arrived at around 6:50 and there were two different tables currently eating however no staff was anywhere to be found!!  I waited until 7:12 (22 min without any staff anywhere to be found) and decided that was enough and left.  In addition they advertise being open until 8 PM but are rarely there past 7:45.  Great great product, but my god can it be a frustrating place to visit.

Great food and great service!
The food was fresh, it was prepared in front of us, and the area was very clean. They seem to put an emphasis on quality.
We will be back!

Stopped here for a quick bite before a game. It's a small location but has outside sitting, good for the area for all the residents with dogs. It took me a long time to stop here since most reviews I've heard weren't great. Personally I think the food is good and a decent options on house wines. As far as appetizers I'm a seafood girl but I don't like fried food so was excited about the octopus but disappointed when I realize it was fried.
Every time lm in Philly, this is a must have. Just right around the corner from my condo. Great service. Great food. So glad your right around the corner from me.

We go to Roccos because our kids like the BBQ chicken pizza. We usually order other meals for my husband and I. We have been disappointed several times with portion size of the hoagies and sandwhiches. I ordered a spinach calzone that ended up all spinach and little cheese. The spinach was just dumped in,no seasoning. My husband ordered the Napoletano hoagie. There was hardly any meat and it was missing the long hots all together. We would have taken both back but did not want to venture back out in the cold. Very disappointed. From now on my kids can get their own pizza,we will be going elsewhere. It is a shame as we have been coming in for 20yrs and the quality and quantity has really went dow.

My love for oxtails is something that words can do no justice for. Just know it is DEEP. Craving Oxtails while out of town. I turned to Yelp. I saw that Yah Mon had rave reviews so I had to check it out for myself. Best oxtails I've had in a while. Best dumpling I've had while In the US ( 3 years) with a hint of sweetest like back home. Delicious! My diner partner went to pick up and said the interior was very nice. Actually he said " that s!#* is pretty " lol. I will be back when in the Tampa area again! Oh, I even ate the plantains and I usually don't like plantains!

They have a $35 3 course dinner meal option here (and you can upgrade it to bigger cuts or substitutions). If you stay here at the Hyatt, they also give you $20 off Ruth Chris dinner entries (you can't combine the 2 offers).

We talked to the Maitre Dis off hours and he was very friendly and chatty. We talked about Ruth Chris, the competition (Mortons) and other local original restaurants.

We are looking forward to coming back and enjoying some steak! Of note, it seems quite dead, so I doubt there will be much of a wait or need for reservations.

I don't know what you guys did to the Big Mac sauce but it tasted horrible. Never buying a Big Mac again. Why can't you guys fix the ice cream machine. It never works ever. The line is also very long and I only have 30 minutes for my lunch so I'll be taking my business over to Carl's Jr. next time

Sushi on Mass Ave in a swanky environment where mod disco meets Asian fusion food.

I am going with 3 stars because it represents an average of my 4 stars and my dining partner's 2 stars. He barely ate anything and was not impressed. I, on the other hand, ate my half and most of his. 

One of the highlights of this place is that you can add a side salad or soup to any sushi order for only $2. woohoo! Salads for all! And they have really, really great salads! The sushi was what I'd expect in terms of freshness and taste, so they get a B+ for being above average. They had some roll combinations that I had not seen at any other sushi place, so they get an A+ for creativity. My dining partner was not impressed with the quality and felt the flavor combinations were too chaotic, like they were going for too many strong flavors competing in the same bite. He felt the flavor of the fish was lost inside a peanut-plum-soy sauce or jalapeno-pineapple-mayonnaise bomb.

We sat at the bar and aside from the party crowd knocking me in the arm whenever they came to order their drinks, it was a positive experience because the servers were attentive and the food came out in the right order at the right time. Also, I could tell the 'tenders were not impressed by the party-goers bumping me in the arm and tried to subtly convince them to come around to another side of the bar to order. Much appreesh. 

I would go back if I could convince my dining partner to go with me again. Not sure he will bite.
This place is the best deli in Santa Barbara county.  Hands down! There breakfast is great too.  Super nice people. Prices aren't ridiculous like some places in SB. - nickspears.tv
Good beer and food. Comfortable atmosphere but doesn't really have any distinguishing features from any other restaurant. Waiter was helpful and friendly though.

Such a great place for food and drinks! 
Love their location on the river walk and the outdoor patio is perfect!
They have a fantastic bar with unique and delicious cocktails!

Chinese food with contempo decor.  The lighting is very cool and a first in New Orleans area that I know of.  Professional service, delicious appetizers and decent parking.  If you can't find it, you can't eat there!  Unless you are Asian, you probably don't want to bring children here.  We eat here for business lunches and special lunch occasions.

So glad Yelp led me to this place! I was able to easily find parking behind it on a Monday afternoon. Took the back entrance and waited for a table. Once a hostess noticed me, she said I could sit anywhere. I opted for the covered balcony since it was a sunny, breezy day.

I started with chips and salsa, which are $3 (many up and coming Mexican restaurants don't do free unlimited chips & salsa but it helps keep their menu really affordable). The depth of the salsa flavor was insanely delicious, as were the fresh chips. Then came the corn, covered in cheese and crunched flamin' hot Cheetos, which was tasty and really fun to try. I ended my meal with the shrimp taco, which was honestly the best taco I've ever had. It was loaded with fresh, perfectly cooked shrimp! 

This place puts layers of flavor into everything they serve, I am so impressed I plan to make this a new regular go-to spot. You can even bring your dog when you sit on the balcony. Between the convenient location, kind staff, and amazing food, as well as daily specials (I can't wait to try the Sunday brunch!), there's something here for everyone to love.

A simple idea, taken flight. Everything is vegan, so no worries there. The soup was great and the 'toes were great. The pesto mayo and the Big Bang are my favorite sauces. The cashier said thy were franchising,and that makes me happy!

It's a great pizza king, and if you're wondering, yes. they have the good breadsticks. if you've been to a pizza king, you know what I'm talking about. The thin, slightly crispy, kinda airy breadsticks. For me, ensuring they've got the good breadsticks is a pre-req before I'll hit up an unfamiliar pizza king location.

Every time that I have eaten here or ordered, I was disappointed. the waitresses and service all in all suck. i've had two older ladies as waitresses the two times that i've been there. waited nearly 30 mins for water. so i had to walk up to the bar for water. then the waitress came over to refill my glass when she watched me get out of my seat. the food takes ridiculously long. i went there before 1 and expected to leave 2-2:30. nope. left close to 3:30. also had my stromboli come out BEFORE a caesar salad. ordered a chicken cutlet sandwich but said i didn't want it because the sandwich came out 20 mins after my salad and stromboli. waiting for my check was even worst. watched the server print the check and instead of turning around and handing us the check so we could get out of there, she completely avoided us and walked outside and came in the bar door. i watched her walk around and stop and talk to people. literally waited 10 mins for her to drop the check. the waitresses are older in age. all look close to 50 with botox, maybe that's why they take their time. ordered off of grub hub and it nearly took an hour and a half for a SALAD to be delivered. this place is ridiculous.

The Parish has been bookmarked on my "To Try' list since I moved to Tucson. I finally tried it out on Friday night, and although the food was great, service was a bit disappointing.

We came just before 7 and only had to wait about 15 minutes, but people who arrived shortly after us were being quoted 30 minutes or more. If you don't want to wait, you may want to come a little earlier.

Once we were sat, it took 5-10 minutes for our waiter to come by. Unfortunately, this trend continued throughout the night. I think we spent more time waiting for our waiter to bring things or take our order than we did actually enjoying our food. He was very nice, but not nice enough to make up for the waiting.

I didn't order a cocktail on this visit, but I definitely will next time. The cocktails all sounded really good, and the beer menu was huge! Instead of drinks, we started with an order of the bacon popcorn which was delicious! It had a bit too much black pepper, but overall, I would definitely order it again.

For my entree, I ordered the fish and chips. The fish was really good. It was crispy, but not greasy, which is quiet the feat to achieve with fried foods. However, be aware that fish is not the typical presentation you get when you order fish and chips. Instead of it being several pieces of fish, it was just one big filet on top of a pile of fries (which by the way were also super tasty!)

My boyfriend had the Parish Burger, which has blue cheese and red onion marmalade. Although he hates onions, he loved this burger, and from the bite he shared with me, I have to agree. I'm not a blue cheese fan, but I would consider ordering that in the future. It was a good-sized burger, flavorful, and cooked to a perfect medium rare.

All in all, while the food was really good, the service really dragged things down for me. I will definitely be back for a visit though. I would like to try lunch next time, since they only have their po' boy available during the day.

OMG its the worst meal I have had in a while. I feel really gross having just had dinner there.  Where to begin...My chicken entre was smothered in a gross white thick sauce with mashed potatoes all over and the brocoli underneath so that I could not eat the brocoli because it was smashed. The chicken was disgusting.  I'm giving it t the racoon.  The brussels without the caramel were ok and the beet salad was beets and cheese..very few greens. The fried chicken sandwich was also bad and my dad's pork chop was too tough to chew. 
The servers were incredible but to spend 30 dollars on a lousy pork chop is just wrong.  I will never eat there again. Really bad food.  Super friendly staff !

Another loyal Osteria NATALINA (not the infamous Osteria...don't mix the two) customer here. This restaurant is the pinnacle of Italian in Tampa...from the princess pink sauce to the sacatina ("they're these little pasta pockets" in the words of my favorite waiter) to the excellent service and affordable pricing. My favorite place in town.
Went here on Easter, food was absolutely great! Would go again. Prices very fair. Bathrooms were clean. Overall great experience.

Great food! Always come here for breakfast. Until management decided to inject a little chaos. Now, there are so many people that you must get in line, then after 20 minutes they refuse you to place an order since you don't yet have a table. You  must find a table which means you lose your place in line, go out and stand around other people eating and as soon as they get up you must grab their chair among other people grabbing the same chair. Then somehow go back in line while holding the table. Want to complain? The girl that supervises this chaos  is on hand to tell you "next time find somewhere else to go"  Really?

Went for lunch on a Sunday. Was seated by the host who just put the menus down and walked away without saying anything. A couple minutes later the waitress stopped by, we ordered drinks and the clams as an appetizer. Drinks were delicious, the clam broth was very good as well...until flies landed in it. Ordered main course which took about average time to come out and tasted about average as well. I had the roast pork & broccoli rabe, my party had the crab cake sliders which tasted good, and the bass special which didn't look very good. Server was overly nice, and gave an far above average amount of time between check ins. Overall wasn't impressed, probably wouldn't come back for a meal, maybe a drink
Nice place, the environment is good and the food is decent. The ham is a little bit too salty though, but the pancake and potato are good.

Could not have chosen a better restaurant for my birthday! The lobster bisque was the best I've ever had and the sourdough bread as great! Fresh and hot. We were too full after eating that each much of our meal. We ordered the rock lobster roll and the chefs special 3 fish. So good. The Chardonnay sauce that came with the fish was delightful. 
Our server brought out a HUGE slice of chocolate cake with ice cream and sang! Our server, Jennifer, was one of the best we've had, so thoughtful and nice!

This place has a deli side and a restaurant side.  For this review I'm critiquing the restaurant.  Over the last three years I've visited several times both for breakfast and lunch.

There hasn't been a remodel here in decades.  The atmosphere is 60's or 70's and it's a little beat up.  Some people might call it homey but that's a stretch.  One other note; it's generally clean.

The wait staff is just fine.  Usually friendly and competent.  Often I feel like I'm being served by my mother and that's not a bad thing.

Now for the food.  This is a three star place.  Everything is hot and fresh.  Portions are at least average and often large.  Its three stars because when I walk out I never say "Wow that was great!"  However I do say "Ahhhh that was good!"

Had a lovely meal there. Definitely value for money. The naan quantity was good, the curries we had, tikka chicken and palak paneer were great. Food arrived in time.  All in all it was great, only downside were the waiters didn't seem to happy to be there, which kind of a bummer to our overall experience of the outing.

This was quite a find for us. We loved our waiter, Brett!  There is plenty of parking all around. Outside or inside seating. The menu is fabulous for any taste buds you might have. We will certainly be coming back when we are in Reno!!  Love the quality of good food.

Why five stars for a random pizza joint in New Orleans? Honestly, it has so much less to do with the pizza than it does the guys who work there. Allow me to explain.

Okay, so after a few hours wondering around Bourbon Street, my friend and I were craving a pizza before heading back to our hotel. Literally stumbling onto Dante Pizza while looking for a slice, we walked in, waited our turn, and then ordered. They sell pizzas by the slice or whole pies if you're that drunk.  My friend ordered a slice of cheese which wasn't ready but they promised it would be done in 2 minutes. I got a slice of pepperoni and a Coke. Total for a slice and a coke was $7, which is high, but understandable given the area.

As we waited for my friend's pizza we noticed how kind the two guys behind the counter were to each and every person they waited on. How patient they were. Could you imagine serving pizza to drunk people day in and day out? How do you not snap? How do you deliver service with a smile? Honestly, I wish I had asked them both because they did.

Once the cheese was out they asked my friend if that is what he was waiting on. Upon confirmation they apologized for the wait and gave us our pizza.

The pizza itself is pretty decent. It's a little on the thicker side, definitely not NYC style if that's what you are looking for, but I enjoyed it. Again, I enjoyed watching these two guys skillfully master the art of drunk patrons more, but from now on this is my pizza place any time I'm back in New Orleans.

This place is my go to for people when they come into town. It's great for brunch, great for drinks, great around any holiday (specialty drinks, decor, etc), just all around good. Food is yummy. Decor is cute. Staff is personable. It's place where both my parents, all my out of town friends and local friends love to hang and ask to go back to when they're back in town. I love that there's never a wait and regular fun events like sassy bingo!

Okay I'm sorry for this but I used to eat there all time and it was delicious.  This place has changed and is just not recommendable.  The salad bar was not fresh and I was there at 11:00 o'clock.  The buffet was no better then a can of .69 cent Ragu, well Ragu would taste better.  Please do not eat there.

NO MILITARY DISCOUNT.  The food, we'll it's Wendy's ,so it was as expected. My major complaint if they don't offer a military discount. A military discount is no different then any discount that they would ordinarily give a coupon holder. The main exception is ease soldiers his military members fight to defend corporations right to own a private business. I do not like doing business with anybody that does not offer a military discount.

Mostly went for their sandwiches for lunch last summer when I worked near the de la vina location. They were fresh and really tasty. They also come with chips which I thought was really cool. The atmosphere is really welcoming and a nice vibe to hang out to.

"....with a name like Smucker's...

Couldn't resist, but the slogan does hold true.  If their food isn't good, they will hear about it in a bad way.  

Fortunately, most of the salads and side dishes found in the display are very good.  The service is friendly and prompt, and you can even taste a sample of anything that interests you.  My favorites are the Baked Lima Beans, Chicken Salad, and Rice Pudding; all of which I can eat in one meal either in the tiny sitdown areas, or as take home.  Also, the jarred goods on the right hand side of the shop are worth a look for some esoteric Pennsylvania Dutch/Amish treats.  Their Corn Relish is great! 

Still only open Thursday through Saturday, it is best to get there early for the freshest selection.  Eat it quickly to enjoy its peak flavors.

Went this past Friday night with a friend.  I ordered hush puppies and my friend ordered seafood gumbo.  Hush puppies were alright at best.  Friends gumbo was slimy.  After that ordered a catfish and shrimp platter to share.  Catfish was good, the rest . . . not.  The fries were hard.  I got the attention of a server (not mine because she wasn't to be found).  Asked him if the fries were frozen and then fried.  He asked why and took a fry and broke it in half.  He said it was hard because it was from a hard potato (please explain that one).  The little scoop of jambalaya, you can keep that crap.  Bland indeed.  Even the salad that came out had a surprise, a fruit fly (hope that wasn't included in the bill).  Left everytbing at the table and paid a $50 bill.  My friend said she was sorry ahe recommended this place.  This place certainly isn't the same as the one out at the lake.  I had my rehearsal dinner there back in '04 and everyone loved it.  Now . . . I wouldn't recommend to my worst enemy.  Good luck on anyone going.
Delicious food and kind staff. Went with three friends and we were all pleased with everything we got. The mac n cheese and Brussel sprouts were soo good!
The chicken was okay but the customer service is horrible and the man at the counter is very rude.
Ordered spicy crunchy tuna roll,  green salad,  and miso soup. CURBED my hunger however,  the sushi was mediocre,  miso soup was bland and the green salad was soggy. Wont be back.....

I love Clear Sky been coming here for a little over a year! Brunch Linch and Dinner alllll amazing!!! I've tried almost everything on the menu at this point and have absolutely no complaints whatsoever! Service is outstanding! Really love this restaurant

Had a birthday dinner planned here for a party of 9. We have been before and as a novelty, it's interesting. But, we won't be going back. We ordered the lobster bisque because we've had it before and liked it then. Unfortunately it was only lukewarm. The server took it back and obviously put it in the microwave and brought it back. Very tasty but obviously microwaved. My wife's cocktail was undrinkable, and was sent back. One of the couples with us got up and left after their entree was presented with some used cutlery on the plate. We will never go back and could not recommend it to anyone.

The BBQ oysters were ok (fried and covered with BBQ sauce)

The Mississippi catfish was light and tender, good choice for lunch. 

The service was average, but the complimentary load of bread was awesome.

Stopped by to have some lunch, I've lived in the area for years and I have never been in. I was impressed. Nice little restaurant to grab a bite to eat along with some great ice cream!! I had a burger and fries and it tasted great!!

I'm very disappointed in the service that they provided. Actually there was no service provided. My boyfriend and I walked up to the hostess today and we told her we needed a two top outside because we have our dog with us. She said the wait would be 45 minutes to an hour. We said okay. 

As I surveyed the outside tables, there was a group that just got their check dropped. And another table that was completely empty. It looked as though it needed to be cleaned off. 

We waited until the group got up and the table was cleared. Many people were being called to be seated, yet we were still not being called. We figured there were other people who wanted to sit outside. So we waited.

15 minutes goes by, the tables are empty still. My boyfriend goes to remind her we wanted to sit outside and she said she will get us seated right away. 

Another 10 minutes goes by and now people who are waiting outside, grab the seats to sit on as they wait.
Another 4 seats become available.

Meanwhile another group of two who just walked up get seated right away. We decided to leave at this point because the hostess obviously had no idea what she was doing. This whole time while we waited for an outside table she only was worried about inside tables.

This is our second attempt in two weeks to dine here for brunch. Honestly this deserves 0 stars.

We were pretty unimpressed by Butchertown. The food was okay, but somewhat over priced. We had the pound of brisket which came with only 3 tortillas. I suppose we could have asked for more if we ever saw our server again. The brisket itself wasn't bad, but it was nothing that we would go back for again. We had the street corn and papas bravas as our sides. The corn had good flavor, but with it priced at $6 for 1 ear of corn, I would expect the quality of the corn itself to be great. It was the tiniest ear of corn with small, dried out kernels. I could buy better corn at the grocery store any month of the year. Oh, and they were out of ribs by 8 o'clock on a Saturday night. With such a small menu, I'm sure that would be a deal breaker for some.

The only saving graces for Butchertown were the beer selection and the ambiance. The draft beer selection was unique with a ton of things that I've never seen anywhere else in town, and the restaurant itself has a good vibe with a nice patio/beer garden.

Came here in the summer. Lots of fruit flies all around. I was handed a glass of wine that was dripping wet like it was just pulled out of the sink. Our waitress was EXTREMELY unfriendly and looked like she hated her life. We got a cheese and fruit platter with pita bread .. they literally give you 25 pieces of pita bread (I'm not complaining). I've been here 3 times and overall it's OK.

Order at your own risk!!! Bbq chicken is burnt, baked chicken tastes like hospital cafeteria food, cake was stale, and even when you call in for pickup you are still waiting for ever for their service. I will not be supporting this place. I will start going to Rose Petals or other black owned establishments in Northwest Philly.

As our olde post favorite Thai restaurant in Madeira Beach had closed last year (Café De Bangkok), our quest for a replacement establishment has officially ended. We have frequented Aroy Thai at least a dozen times and it is now officially our personal favorite Thai restaurant close to Madeira Beach. We've regularly have tried their Green and Panang Curries, Phad Thai, Garlic Pepper, Pad Kee-Mao, Pineapple Fried Rice, Thai Basil and Cashew Nut entree's along with the "Fresh Roll" appetizer.  Either we dine in or carry out occasionally and most recently tried Door Dash Delivery. The food tastes very fresh and is hot and delicious. We try to stay Plant Based eaters, almost vegan and Aroy Thai has been a great choice in our local eating establishments. The restaurant has always been clean and the service very good. Another place that I coin the phrase "Small Joint-huge on flavor!". If you're a Thai foodie, it's worth a try on Seminole Blvd just south of the 54th Ave N traffic light, west side. We Love it! I Highly recommend!

Such a mixed bag!
The beer on tap was good, the burger was great as were the Brussels sprout appetizer.

However, the service was below average w the waiter taking a full ten minutes to bring us our beers even though we ordered them immediately  (and no it was not busy). We ordered a side salad w our meal and it was blech...old browning lettuce so we didn't eat it. We told our waiter and he agreed that yeah it didn't look very good but charged us anyway. 

We asked for the check and immediately set down the credit card and watched our waiter sweep, clean another table and walk by our table multiple times without picking up our card. Finally we got up to handle it ourselves and he came to run the card.

Really...it is the small things like being attentive to your customers that matter.

The beer and burger was great so we will go back but the waitstaff needs some training on how to compliment the experience.

The Fresh Harvest Buffet  Restaurant is located on the 2nd floor of the Seminole Hard Rock Casino & Hotel of Tampa and offers a lunch buffet for $24.95 and a dinner buffet for $29.95. If you have a players card you can get $5 off! On Fridays, fresh harvest buffet even has unlimited crab legs for $40. On Sunday's they do a brunch buffet with unlimited mimosas as an option. 

Fresh harvest buffet is in a huge space so you never feel congested even when it is busy and there Are so many offerings! Theres 6 different kinds of sushi, oysters, peel and eat cocktail shrimp, coconut shrimp, bbq ribs, grilled salmon, steak, chicken, lobster, and much more! If you'd like Crab legs, it is a $12 up-charge and is not unlimited. Just make sure to ask your server for it! Fresh Harvest gives you roughly a pound or 3 clusters of crab legs. Service really isn't much of a factor at a buffet but there was a made to order hibachi, made to order pasta station, a roast beef carver, and a server bringing drinks who was very attentive. 

While other Asian buffets I have visited in the past offer tons of seafood and made to order hibachi at a lower price point of $10 or so, this buffet has more traditional American cuisine and a large variety of offerings. While i cant really do a buffet very frequently because i will over-eat too often and it isn't exactly inexpensive, i did enjoy this one and look forward to coming back and having it again sometime!

Considering this is an airport restaurant, I have to admit I'm a proponent.

First off, you're tucked away in a cozy, fun environment.  You will really feel separated from the hustle & bustle of the airport.

Servers are extremely friendly, and there's a happening bar scene as well as comfortable booths.  

Food is good, although trends toward the greasy side so ask for light on the oil.  They have a good cocktail sauce with real horseradish for their shrimp, clams, and oysters.

They usually have some special fishes of the day, although from appearances the tuna steak is the best bet.  Most people swap out the carb-y items for broccoli and more greens.

Clam chowder is very good.  The calamari looks a bit too crispy fried.
Absolutely delicious seafood! Highly recommended. The food was fresh and great quality.

I'm so glad to have Engimono Sushi in my neighborhood! The sushi is fresh, the prices are fair, and the service is friendly. It's a BYO, which is always a plus, and the atmosphere inside is nice enough for dining in (though it can sometimes get crowded since the space is small). For less than $80 plus our own bottle of wine, my fiance and I had a lovely Friday night date featuring the impressive sushi boat pictured here. I'm sure we will repeat this date again more than once!

Like the old saying goes "you get what you pay for". Sure, Rodizio is cheaper than Na Brasa and Fogo de Chao; but so is the food. At Rodizio, you won't be blown away by the salad/appetizers bar and the meat selection is very generic. You won't find Filet Mignon or other quality selections that Na Brasa and Fogo offers and the meat selection that they do have is just mediocre. My favorite was the sirloin and my fiancé liked pineapple. Yep, she disliked the meats altogether and thought the pineapple tasted the best. We probably won't be back unless they added more quality items to their menu.

Great new taqueria in a revamped fast food building (used to be KFC/Long John Silver's) - and a vast improvement! You order at the counter and then they bring the food to your table. Lots of street taco options (I tried the asada, carnitas and adobada) with an impressive salsa bar. I suggest you try them all - they run from a mild pico to some pretty hot options. My fav was the avocado/jalapeño - creamy with a nice kick. It's definitely worth checking out.

It has been great to see many business adapt to the Covid climate and continue to provide excellent service to customers. Sadly for Big Al's this has been the complete opposite. My wife son and I went today for some bowling and arcade games for a fun Friday outing. This was the second chance my wife and I had decided to give this place after a separate negative experience in the dining establishment where we as customers were required as wait and service staff due to the DRASTIC lack of appropriate staffing. We went today a couple months later and to my dismay this establishment has only gotten worse. You have staff running around trying to keep their heads above water as they are tasked with a ridiculous amount of responsibility. Of course this naturally leads to an abysmal experience for all customers. It took about 20 minutes to get our bowling lane functional and working after multiple return trips to the counter and eventually having to be bumped to a adjacent lane. I do not fault the employees working as it is blatantly apparent they are being forced to run the establishment by management with a disgustingly inadequate amount of staff. We then couldn't finish our bowling games as the lane shut down with two frames left in our second game and at this point we were over it and wanted to take the kiddo up to enjoy some arcade games. This was only to find out once we got upstairs that their one machine that reload gameplay cards is inoperable. This place has gone to absolute shit and it is sad because it used to be a place for family fun and enjoyment. However it is now apparent that the current owners and operators of this establishment have chosen to drastically under staff this place so that they can provide a worse experience for their clientele in order to maintain their profits by shorting the staff members they employ. Fantastic example of a business doing it completely wrong and they have most definitely assured that I will not be a return customer.
World's best tiramisu cheesecake whether you are vegan or not!  Completely allergen free as they say and delicious.  The "cheesecake" part is lush and creamy and tastes exactly like tiramisu!

A group of us from work met here for holiday drinks and dinner. I used to eat at this location frequently when it was the Bamboo Club. Let me start off by saying, they did a remarkable job with the remodel! There's no way anyone could tell that it used to be a pacific-rim style restaurant. We started off at the beer wall upstairs. What a great concept... although it did have a couple of technical issues where it wouldn't dispense. But overall, an interesting way to serve beer. 

For an appetizer, I highly recommend the Cheese Balls.  They had a light dough which didn't make them taste greasy at all.  I had the Bangers and Mash...a standard British dish which was great.  A couple of the guys had the prime rib sandwich and both raved about how good it was. (They did substitue for the pretzel roll which they also enjoyed.)

Since it is new, it is also very popular and we did have to wait almost an hour for a table for a party of 6.  But it was worth it.

My fiancé and I had our Thai favorites: Crab Rangoon, Tom Yum, Thai Fried Rice, and Pad Thai Noodles. 
DELICIOUS! We pride ourselves on visiting the best Thai restaurants around the city and this hidden gem shines bright! If you're in Castleton, do not hesitate to stop by.

Food was alright but the service was exceptional we had a small minor issue with the bill and our server Chayson.. no questions asked handled it with no problems.. i would recommend going here and sitting in his section if you want great customer service!!
This place is amazing. Me and my friend decided to go for lunch. Food is really fresh and just very tasty!

I can't believe it took me so long to come here. It's very cute inside. Spacious, adorably decorated, and with lots of sunshine streaming in. I loved the silver-metallic wall paper!

Although they do have a small menu, my friend and I just ordered coffee and shared a few cookies. The coffee was nice and strong and the cookies were yummy. The other pastry looked good and my friend and I are going to make it a point to come back. for something more substantial. 

The staff was warm and friendly. This place is the complete opposite of Rocket Kat (bleck).
Love this place but the Collegeville location moved to Limerick and now, sadly, they are out of business.

These used to be my favorite steaks in the city, but my most recent visit 9/30/20 I found them to be dry, under-seasoned, and disappointing. It's our tradition to get these on our anniversary, as we came here on our first date but I'm not likely to return and would rather start a new anniversary tradition. Sad.
The epitome of a Philly Soft Pretzel!! When I lived in Vegas for about a year, I would fly with these on my lap to share at the hotel I worked at... Enjoy with spicy mustard, mmmmmm....

This was my first visit to Los Portales, and I had a good experience.  The restaurant is in a run down strip mall and at this time it is the only business open in the strip mall.  There were several people in the restaurant when I visited, but the only English I heard was from me and a five year old girl.  The girl helped the waiter take my order.   The menu was almost all in Spanish but I was able to manage.  I had a burrito which was very good for a small restaurant like this.  I also had pork tacos which I would say were average.  The food tasted very authentic and was very fresh.  The only downside was that I had to wait a long time to pay after I ate.  The staff was very friendly.

I will be back and get the burrito again, or maybe a torta.  I visited the restaurant at night and I did not feel any danger.

This store is really close to my house, so I come here pretty often. It's usually fine but tonight I found a hair in my food and when I mentioned something about it to the cashier, they offered to remake it. However, the sight of the man who was making our food play with his hair the whole time was enough for me to decline and waste $10.
This place is the best! I always get the pulled pork sandwich. They are fast courteous and consistent with the quality! If you want barbecue, go to Harry's!

Good food. Great Service. The server filled never let our water glasses get empty but wasn't intrusive. The appetizer arrived less than 5 minutes after our order was taken and the main meal within 10 of the appetizer. The appetizers are somewhat expensive at about $6-8 each but the crab ragoon was worth it.The main dishes are about $10 each but didn't have as much food as the other reviews led me to expect. Still, two dishes for my husband and I was more than enough and we had left overs. We had chicken pad thai which had smaller noodles than we're used to but great flavor and mongolian beef. I was pleasantly surprised that the beef was good quality and not stringy like most asian restaurants I've been to. The atmosphere was nice too. We will definitely be back.

Customer Service- Great customer service. I love how they bring your food out to you. 

Presentation- The place is set up well. Usually clean etc

Food- The Food is awesome.  The side selection has me back again and again. My favorites are the mac & cheese and the sweet potatoes. The chicken is ok too. Not the worst not the best. 

Price- The price is reasonable. Also there is no tipping so that keeps the cost down. 

Me- I order the "meal for 5" every Thanksgiving. It has become our Thanksgiving tradition.
The food is good, fresh and authentic. Price was reasonable.  Good job.

When I went they ran out of beef brisket and pulled chicken. So I left after standing in line
 So service kinda sucks. I have ordered from here before and the food is usually good.  But I give it a low rating for in person dinning
Best po boy I've had in NOLA so far!!! Tavern was very busy and a little understaffed but we received great service regardless. Wouldn't hesitate to return!

I did two follow up visits to JMS. 

One day I mistakenly ordered the Big Kahuna Chicken Cheese Steak. 

I ordered the Large, but it felt like the Giant cut in half. It was a VERY SMALL SANDWICH, I kept looking at in shock. I would give that sandwich size 2 stars, taste 2.5 stars, because it's FRICKING CHICKEN, it's just not tasty like Steak! 

NEVER order any size here except Giant is my recommendation! If you are dining with another person just split it! 

So after being disappointed by ordering the wrong number, I definitely needed to revisit the Big Kahuna, and see if it could deliver again. I went on-line as I love ordering on-line, it's so easy and convenient, and I really don't like speaking to people on the phone. I started ordering through Yelp, but then I remember I am a Rewards Member, so I signed out of that order and went to the website. GOOD THING I DID! 

Unfortunately on the website, you cannot really customize your order, like last time I got mayo, lettuce, tomato, and onion, but in a way that might have been a blessings, because the sandwich I got this time was, "Worthy" of "Big Kahuna" titling. It was full of meat like you would expect paying $15+ (w/ tax) for a Cheese Steak, super Cheesy, and Very Tasty. The only thing, and I have not eaten here enough to know if they have different breads, but this one didn't remind me of East Coast Bread, it reminded me of Soft White. It was good, but the East Coast Bread definitely would have been WAY BETTER! 

So I know you are wondering 5 Stars, Brandon rarely gives 5 Stars, He Loves giving 2 Stars, why 5? You are going to love this ANSWER! They had (maybe still have?) some kind of promotion ON-LINE, 50% off if you are NEW, 25% if you are EXISTING! Yes, you heard me RIGHT! I got 25% off my meal by ordering ON-LINE thought JMS! I arrived it was on the Grill Cooking, and at that point I could have customized, I didn't, BUT it was DELICIOUS when I took it home w/out the add ons!

P.S. the % off sale is over as of 2/17/17! =(
Service is so slow.  Apps came with meals. Wrong meal was received. Think seriously about eating here.

I always love trying local places!! I have driven by so many times, and I have wanted to try this place out. I took my husband and 2 kids today. Sunday's are typically busier most places so I was trying to stay optimistic!!

First impression walking in: super cute!

However wasn't greeted, and waited for at least 10 minutes before anyone acknowledged us. The two people working were working! So that's understandable but a simple hello we will be right with you is easy to do while busy!

Okay so a few pieces of advice:
On busier days like Sat/Sun maybe hire 1 more person! The two that were working were doing their best but we were there for over 35 minutes. We ordered the Baja Burrito and the Monster Burrito. Too slow sadly!
 Greet people when they walk in.

Most likely won't return soon, I just didn't get that wow factor.
The food was good though Minus the egg shell leftover we got in the burritos- oh well! I hope they get a few more friendly employees to help out.

Good food. Especially the pho. I always get the meatball but tiny girlfriend get the rare beef and that is good as well. Pot stickers are pretty good as well. The only thing I don't like about this place is that they roll around a clearing cart. There's a cart that they poor old soup and other plates into and stack the dishes. They wheel it between the tables and sometimes it is right next to where we are eating. It's promoted us to get our food for takeout much more than eating in.
Our party of 6 that has lunch about every 3 months finds a consistent level of good selections and attentive service.  The dining room is well attended by other customers.

After hearing all of the hype around Sun Valley Steakhouse, we thought we'd give it a try last night.  Located in Hobey's Casino in Sun Valley (North Valley area), it is an easy hop on the 580 and turn right on Clear Acre and keep going, located on the left.  Ample parking.

This was their first week of opening after the COVID pandemic and reservations were already booked through the following week.  Capacity is at 50% there and they follow mask requirements.

Kevin was our waiter and he is very friendly and attentive.  Marco is the manager.  Everyone made sure that our needs were met and that is one characteristic that sets this restaurant out from others.

The food was very good.  I had the ribeye steak with a baked potato.  We had sauteed mushrooms as an appetizer and chocolate mousse for dessert.  The steak was cooked to my liking.  Potatoes were tender.  Even the vegetables (squash) was yummy!
