I don't live in St. Pete any more but will make every effort to stop by when we are in town. Talked to the owner and he said how much he enjoyed coming in yesterday and feeding people after the hurricane even though he was the only one there. Class act and a great pizza place!

Great food and service plus a live band... fried green tomatoes and green beans were fabulous.. then we had the ribs... smacking good apple wood smoked juicy and not fatty. Meatloaf was so yummy and the piggymac was yummy but I saved that to enjoy the sooooo fabulous pecan cobbler... wow.... a must stop when in Nashville.

Went to Terakawa Ramen for lunch and got immediately seated at the bar.  It's a bit warmer there as you can feel the steam from the kitchen.  

I got the Terakawa Ramen that comes with pork (delicious - tender and slightly fatty), bamboo shoots, mushrooms, pickled ginger, egg and green onions). 

I definitely did not like the bamboo shoots - something just tasted a bit funky for me.  Had to pick them all out of my meal.  The star of the dish is the pork - loved every bite.  The egg yolk was seasoned and a tad too sweet for me.  

Overall, great meal and would come back!

This is a tough one for me.  The beer and wine selection was expansive and delicious, with a great atmosphere and wonderful staff...but the food was just underwhelming.  

We came for happy hour, and had great service from a bartender with great knowledge of all the tasty libations available.  We sat in the tasting room, which has a cool vibe, board games, and great iron work and windows.

Unfortunately, we were disappointed with the food.  The burger was average, but that isn't a bad thing.  The crab cakes were over salted, without much other seasoning.  The ceviche was interesting, but too tart and tangy.

Overall - great place for drinks, but you might want to eat elsewhere until they nail the dishes.
Excellent food. The hot Italian beef and Philly Cheese Steak are our favorite. The Greek salad and pita bread makes your mouth water.

If you love pho, and you need a place with consistently good pho for a low price, this is the place to come. The quality is on par with the pricing, and I have never had a bad meal here.

My husband and I have been coming here for a few years now. I usually get the asparagus or wonton soup or pho ga. He usually gets the brisket and round pho. The flavor is always mild and consistent. 

We usually get the spring rolls, but I have to admit that they are very bland and filled with nothing but iceberg lettuce and three half pieces of shrimp. Again, they are never bad. They are just on par with the price. Spring rolls here are only $3.50. Many of the other dishes are also very bland as well, but if you don't like surprises, this is the place to go.

The service is very good as well. No one here is particularly warm, but they are efficient and proficient. I'm ok with that.

Everytime I visit St. Petersburg on business, I find an excuse to stop here for lunch. This is the only gyro place I've been to where there was so much meat on my pita, that I had to take some of it off just to eat it! The Greek salad and grape leaves are also worth a try. 4 stars for cleanliness, but, then again, the place a kind of a dive. I'm definitely coming back here.

Love this location and every other one lol -- the BEST customer service ever. They have a wrapped line all the time but manages to get their customer in and out quickly and EFFICIENTLY. I've never missed any items, they ALWAYS give BBQ when asked -- and they give multiples even when you ask for only one. 

Every fast food chain needs Chick Fil A training course!

My wife and I went in for brunch on Sunday morning. I had the brunch burger, and my wife had the avocado toast. Both dishes were delicious. My wife also had a side of the waffle special, and she enjoyed it very much. Overall great place friendly owners and staff. Can't wait to go back and try lunch.

Do ya like to eat food? A lot of food, really great, home style Italian food with super fresh ingredients? And, do ya like to watch that food being made? You do!!! Well, then I have a place for you! 

Vivo strives to use authentic Italian ingredients mixed with fresh locally sourced ones to create a family style eating experience that will knock your calzini (google it) off! This deep southwest restaurant is located in an old Blockbuster Video (insert small tear rolling down face for my dusty DVD player) and is quite large. But the best seats in the house are definitely along the long, expansive chefs table that is the entire length of the kitchen. And it is up high so you can see everything! I love it. 

Now, Vivo is family style, so it is better to go in a group, one pasta is good for 4 people. So, if you go for date night be prepared, it will be pricey if you want to try a few things. On the upside, you will have leftovers for day if you do go date night route! Everything I have tried on my 3 visits has been quite good to excellent with one big, huge, must have, rock star... The grilled Caesar salad. I know, I know, I thought the same; how can a Caesar salad be Ah-super-crazy-mazzzing? Normally I would never order a salad, let alone a Caesar, but a close friend told, no forced, me to get it. It blew my proverbial mind. I believe the secret is in the grilling: They grill a whole head of romaine on a the grill where all the pork and beef is grilled, without cleaning it. So, all the super yummy charred little bits of happiness left on the grill, sear into the lettuce. Then it is drizzled with the most delicious dressing and topped with fresh bacon and heavenly grated parmigiano reggiano. It is the Michelangelo's David of salad!
Whenever we can actually make time for a good breakfast/brunch we love visiting this gem. The staff is always present and accommodating. The food and coffee are delicious. You can't go wrong.

Best meal in New Orleans that we have had so far! We started off with the cheesecake, then had the shrimp and grits, blackened drum with crawfish etoufee, and finished with the strawberry panna cotta. Each dish was better than the next. A bit out of your way if you are staying in the French Quarter as we are, but I would highly recommend making a trip here for dinner - it's well worth it and a quick Uber ride!

Me and my boyfriend went here for dinner. (I'm writing this review while we sit here) when we first arrived we were told It was a 25 minute wait and we were seating in less then 20 minutes. our waitress is AMAZING. The food is so extraordinary. We ordered the Lasagna Fritta as our appetizer and It was amazing we ate It within minutes. Everyone should go here love the staff the atmosphere and the food
Good soul food. Their cheese steaks are great and so are the fries. Plus the employees are nice. Great greasy steak sandwiches. Enjoy.

This place should be burned to the ground. What is there to praise and glorify? How about memorialize the hundreds of slaves that worked endless days and nights so that "mastah" could keep his prized horses.

So far so good. Nice addition to the neighborhood. Initial taste, coffee has a bit of a bite that mellows as you drink. Just opened recently and looks like they are going to capture a mellow hipster vibe. Should be a good spot for a casual meeting or just a quick stop for a cup. 3 shots for a 20oz mocha seems a little light, kick it up a notch. Keep up the good work.

We drove 34miles to get here. We came because they have a deal on Groupon. We got in and they seem short staff there were 2 girls and one guy saying will be there in a minute. We got sitter on the patio on a dirty table. We waited 15min for someone to come and clean the table and get our drink order. When our waitress came out we knew what we wanted. She ask for our drinks and she kind of got upset we started our order. They ran out of chile rellenos. So if you get the big combination no chile relleno. It was ok nothing to make me drive back here

I have only been here once for lunch so the 4 stars is based on limited experience. I had the chicken enchiladas which were delicious and filling enough for a small to moderate appetite. I also had a side of fries which were also very good and well seasoned. The staff and other patrons were also friendly. The decor is simple but elegant and fitting for the neighborhood. Prices were reasonable for lunch. I would visit again to try more of the menu selections.

This is one of my favorite veggie spots in the city. I stop short calling it my favorite vegan spot since they do serve some dairy. The best thing to order here is vegan chicken cheesesteak. Instead of getting it on a roll, I usually go with a wrap (most commonly their habanero wrap.)

My advise if you're getting take-out is be sure to call ahead. I never seen them turn-around an order in under 15 minutes. It usually takes 20 minutes or so. They also stock Vegan Treats desserts.

The food here is delicious and the menu has a great selection of breakfast and brunch foods. Also, this First Watch has a great atmosphere along with fantastic accommodating servers. My food always comes out quickly and it's always delicious! I also recommend the iced coffee!!

This place is so cool. I had been meaning to go since they opened at this location. The owner happened to be there this day. She's very nice. I got the signature latte. It's very good. It's not overtly rose flavored. It's barely noticeable. The little design on top was so cute. Look at that panda! 

The coffee shop sits in the front of a neon sign studio. Very cool stuff to ogle while sipping your beverage.

The $12 "top shelf" margarita tasted like it had absolutely no alcohol in it. I could only take one bite of the tilapia taco because it was completely disgusting (very fishy). However, the veggie taco was really good as was the overall service. Definitely overpriced for a restaurant that's one step above fast food.

I took my dad to bruch for Father's Day, and it was was amazing! Their gumbo (and I have eaten a lot of gumbo) was amazing! It was made with a very dark roux that made it taste rich. The staff was great, atmosphere was great...it was perfect!

I enjoyed a dinner here with friends on a Monday evening a few weeks back. Likely thanks to the pandemic we were 1 of maybe 4 total parties in the entire restaurant. I really appreciated the touchless menu option (you have to scan a QR code on your phone to view the menu). Not only does it help reduce the spread of germs, but they also have free wifi. I've experienced other restaurants with a similar setup since the pandemic began and rarely do they offer free wifi so this was huge to me. 

As far as other safety measures go there were plenty of clear and wooden dividers throughout, seating was arranged so folks could socially distance (if, in fact, there were to be more people dining at the same time), cashless payment was required, and staff wore masks at all times from what I could see. 

As for the food I was completely disappointed. I'd heard SO many good things about this place and had always been curious about the cuisine as it always looked packed out there (*pre-pandemic that is). 
I ordered chow faan and the pork shoulder dish. Frankly it just lacked flavor and didn't taste like much of anything. Despite the portions being a  considerable size, even for small plates, I really didn't find it to be worth the price. I was pretty disappointed in the variety of options on the menu. They call themselves "Asian Street Food" and that is not what I gathered from the selection on the menu at all. 

If anything I'll be back for happy hour as the mule I had with my meal was pretty standard and the overall vibes were good.

Yelp made it easy to make a reservation at Spiro's, got confirmation email.

When we arrived we were greeted and seated. Angela took our drink orders and we mentioned that we wanted the prime rib.  She checked and we got the last two. This was 6:00pm on Saturday evening. 
She brought our drinks which were good. We started with saganaki. Where else can you yell oomph. We shared salads and then got dinner. Our daughter and I had prime rib which was excellent, my wife had the fish special, she said it was very good. Our son in law had the pork tenderloin special, he said was good 
To top off dinner we shared creme brûlée and the bread pudding deserts with coffee. I was ready to be "rolled out ".
A most pleasant evening and dinner. Will definitely be back.

A Local Told me about this Location. EAT What the Locals Eat... Get Here ASAP...the Wait isn't Long, and The Hospitality is Top Class...
You Will Not Be Disappointed.  OMG...Ready to Walk.

Active construction on the property and you can hear the construction all day even out on the beach  (no notice on website or during booking,) noisy rattling AC in room, and internet doesn't work. Made many trips to the don over the years and this was my last.

My family and I went to Casa Molina for the Sunday Buffet. The food was really good. My husband liked the menudo and my kids and I really liked the mini chimichangas. There was plenty of variety on the buffet. Our server, however, was a bit of a jerk. We had to flag him down to get refills on our drinks. And he never came by to see how we were doing or see if we needed anything. The service really makes or breaks the experience in my opinion. I just hope if we ever come again, that we get to sit in someone else's section so that we don't get the same server.

We had high expectations for this restaurant and met our foodie friends at this restaurant.  Well, it is definitely has the ambience but the menu is over ambitious and nothing was worth ordering again,
Appetizer: Oysters on the half shell didn't have a good flavor especially when they have an extensive variety and is extensive.  That was a disappointment.  
Sweet corn jalapeno fritters which were recommended and ok.
Bam Bam shrimp were excellent! Flavorful and cooked to perfection.
Salad: Saffire Ribbon salad was overloaded with the dressing and lacked taste! It was ok but I would not recommend it.  The salad was blah!
Entrees: My daughter got the gumbo which was so thick in tomato sauce with few "bits" of seafood.  It was underwhelming so I don't recommend this at all.  
I got the pan roasted salmon and it was dry and tasteless.  It was on a bed of three bean mix and what appeared to be overcooked spinach. It was not a dish worth ordering again.
Saffire short ribs weren't well cooked and unimpressive but the mahi mahi tacos were good.  Our friend got the special but I don't remember what it was except that he didn't care for it.
I might be willing to give this restaurant another chance but there are so many amazing restaurants around here to try first.

EGGCELENT!! Loved the ambiance and service. From the mimosa to the french toast and breakfast potatoes an easy 10/10!

I will be back for sure!

Who goes to Bluebeard with a full stomach? Unfortunately, this girl. Seriously, the day we're invited to meet up with friends at Bluebeard for dinner is the same day that I had eaten a ridiculously late lunch. 
I ordered their salad of the day, of which each ingredient tasted crisp and freshly picked. While I didn't get too adventurous with my meal (which was actually an appetizer), I made sure I tasted bites of the other food ordered at our table, and it was delicious. The big surprise was how wonderful their bread pudding was. The first serving was so delicious, our table ordered a second one to share.

I really enjoyed the beautiful outdoor seating. Very urban, hipster, industrial vibe going on. And more than anything, our service was top notch. He was knowledgeable and incredibly helpful, especially when ordering drinks. They have an intriguing twist on their mixed drinks from the bar. And man, do they serve up some strong drinks! Beware if you're stopping in for drinks. Make sure you have your ride sharing app at the ready!

Right on the beach! Beautiful patio with plenty of seating.. scallops were prepared just right and the risotto with creamy.. highly recommend pistachio crusted mahi-mahi was very tender and very flavorful
Service was great, prices are average and quality of food was high.

Just had the best sandwitch. All the workers we so amazing. It took a long time. I can tell the company is a little understaffed. But the food was amazing and it was all worth it in the end. Would definetly come here again. I cant wait for next time.

Great place to have lunch near the Tampa airport. Multiple beers available on tap including Bud Light and Mich Ultra. Food was good, we had the wings with hot honey bbq. Very good! We tried the buffalo sauce, but, it was too vinegary for us. We also had Chipotle BBQ Chicken Flatbread...delicious! Our server was Falesha and she was very attentive and accommodating. We will go there again when we come back to this area!

When I go to Heaven (fingers crossed) it will be sitting on the porch at the Columns with a dirty martini... watching the streetcars pass by.
The garden district is beautiful in itself, but with a cocktail and great clientele and this porch, you just cannot get a better time.
Love the bar in the back, very speakeasy-style. Decor is old NOLA.
Highly recommended, not so much to bring your A-Game, just to relax and have some laughs while spending time in one of the most beautiful places on earth.

Surprising good Chinese cuisine at this basement kitchen associated with the Asia Market on North 11th Street, Chinatown, Philadelphia. There may have been change of ownership and this is a first visit, but if the past owners were even better on the wok than these folks, then I missed something pretty special, because I was quite happy with what we ate this night. 

Amazingly convenient if grocery shopping of Chinese ingredients is your reason for being there in the first place. Just go hungry, eat, and then shop.  Worked well for us. It is not too far fetched to think that if the Tasty kitchen runs out of something, they just walk a few feet into the supermarket and pick up what they needed. Symbiotic. 

We ordered the wonton soup, salt baked squid and roast pork on rice. All were very good to excellent, despite the somewhat dank surroundings. The large bowl of soup was loaded with more than a dozen freshly handmade wontons with ground pork filling.  The beef consume was hot with a pleasant flavor.  Made for fun slurping. The squid was cut into fairly large pieces and coated with a light flour, salt and pepper breading.  It was tender and juicy. Especially enjoyed the scallion and sliced jalapenos the dish was mixed with.  The flavor/texture profile became quite animated on the palate. This was the star of the show.  The roast pork had a nice ruddy bark and was lean cut.  Not quite Ting Wong Restaurant level, but close enough. We ended up taking about half of the dry dishes home.  

With all the wonderful alternatives on the street above, there is not that much reason to go subterranean for a solid meal, unless price motivates you highly. The numbers on the menu were very reasonable, and it is easy to imagine that Tasty Place does a large business with students and others on a budget.  

You certainly get more than you paid for here.

Ariano is a cool casual place to go on a date or to hang out with a small group (6) of friends. You can't go wrong with pizza & sandwiches or dinner entrees because both are delicious. I recommend the lamb chops & the salmon complimented with a nice bottle of wine....even better when the weather is nice & the entire restaurant opens up.
Benedict galore! always stop in when I come to Reno area

oh my god sooo good! this is legit italian pizza. 
went here randomly for lunch with my husband while visiting the town and wow we were not expecting that. great wine, great pizza, and great appetizers.
super friendly and really helpful staff. cute ambiance

New favorite thai place on the westbank! The food is so good and what I love is that the service is pretty quick! Thank youuuuuu! 

Everyone is served a started side salad. The crab rangoon was good. I think the shell is a little too thick and doesn't have that crisp that melts in your mouth. The filling and sauce totally make up for it though. The pork and shrimp shumai were super! Especially the shrimp!!! We had two orders of the shrimp and one of the pork! We ordered a large order of the tom yum soup with shrimp as well and flavor was on point! Perfectly sour and crisp on your taste buds! The large can easily feed 4 people as a soup starter. I had also ordered the green curry with a medium heat (perfect) and added beef. Although the meat was less that I'd hoped, it was still enough and the sauce was very good! 

Husband wants to come back to try the pad thai. We will be back, very soon. I hope they do well!

Easily located a few blocks beyond Lee Circle on St. Charles Avenue is That's Amore. Being a native New Yorker that prefers deep dish pizza, I had to try this place after being made aware of it's existence. I've only had deep dish from the big three locations in Chicago Lou Malnati's being my favorite, than Giordano's and Uno's.
I wandered in the front door a little past 6 pm on a late March evening to find an empty dining area which was explained to me happens with the time change every year. So there's a tip for you to go early if you want to avoid crowds, especially since the pie takes 45 minutes to cook properly.
With it being empty and time to kill, I got to talk with the staff about multiple things and they were all very friendly and engaging.
I oredered a 14" Meat Lovers to go and eventually headed home with my food. It took about 30 minutes to get home but when I dove into the first slice, it was still hot. With the initial bite I immediately noticed that they put a lot of care in their sauce. It's been a long time since I had deep dish from any of the previously mentioned places so exact tastes are long gone memories, but I don't think any of them had this much flavor going from herbs and seasonings without being spicy. If there was a downside to that it was the sauce kind of overpowering the flavor of the meats. This won't stop me from returning though, just possibly altering the ingredients. The pie also heated up nicely in a cast iron skillet over the next few days.
So if you're looking for a really good deep dish, look no further. They also have a wood burning oven which I will get around to trying a pizza from that after making up for all the years of not having a place close by that serves deep dish.

My favorite green smoothie! 

I love that they have a frequent buyer program and they're available on UberEats!

Great selection of fresh, healthy eats and if you're craving a certain combination, just ask and they'll create it!

I love the consistency across all stores - you always know what you're going to get!

I'm not a huge cheeseburger fan but this place has the best burger I've ever had by far. Literally everything on the menu is great. The restaurant is small though and it's hard to get a table. The Booths are also very tight and you are often brushing shoulders with the people next to you. It's also pretty expensive but it's definitely worth it if you are a burger fan.

Our most recent meal here was really good. We had the caramelized octopus with arancini, the spring lamb cassoulet, the cocoa and coffee short rib and (of course) the lemon tart. Everything was delicious but the chef was a little heavy handed with the salt and that drowned out the flavors a bit. The lamb was my favorite and it was a great combination of ingredients that meshed really well. Because of COVID we ordered ahead of time and did curbside pick up. Hearth has the process down to a science and the call you to pull up the car when your meal is ready and they bring it out to your car. Even though our meals were in to go containers the presentation was beautiful and the entrees were very filling and the portion sizes were generous. And you can never go wrong with the lemon tart of course! The next time we go back I think I will order everything without any added salt and we will be in for a perfect meal.

WARNING: DO NOT SUPPORT THIS BUSINESS. 

I ordered a pizza from Michaelangelo's through my school's delivery app. I'm a poor student on financial aid where I can't afford to waste money on food. I ordered a 12" pizza, 1/2 gallon iced tea, and a Gatorade. When my order was delivered, the pizza had the wrong sauce on it. Figuring that if I called they would help me out, I called and was treated with absolute disrespect by the man on the other end of the phone. He said that it wasn't his fault and that he had no obligation to replace the pizza because the order was taken down wrong inside. He told me what they had written down was wrong and despite my claim that I ordered a different pizza he refused to help out. He told me that in order to get a new pizza I'd have to travel to his restaurant and complain to manager. I don't have a car and that's absurd regardless.

Please don't support these crooks. Took my order down wrong then refused to fix it. I lost nearly $20.

The food and service were both really good. 

The location is great too and it was busy both days we went. It is on the main floor of an apartment complex. 

This is a family run place. The food was incredible. The Beef Steak Sandwich in particular was really good. 

They have a separate small hall for private events too.

To my annoyance, Pat's and Geno's gets all this cheesesteak love and I just don't get it. It SHOULD be Jim's Steaks & Tony Luke's up at the top, with Jim's inching out to the number one spot by just a hair. 

This place is great. I even bought a tshirt to proclaim my love for it. Everything you want in a cheesesteak and some weird options for you that you think won't be delicious but are... 

The seating situation is kind of horrid on a weekend night. Enough of a bother to deduct a star. But I don't know what they can do about it, since their cheesesteaks are so damn good, people will still come. :)

If you're around when some brave soul wants to attempt to beat the record for most cheesesteaks eaten in one sitting, you should stick around for that. It's crazy to watch but you won't be able to take your eyes off of it.
This place is great! Burgers are a bit greasy but they are awesome (and don't forget the fresh cut fries)!

When they say hot chicken they mean hot!! 20 mins later and my mouth was still on fire from the chicken sandwich I got there. The chicken was good but I wouldn't say it was any better then chick fil a or another chicken place.

I've been here twice, it's a neighborhood restaurant within walking distance from my place and I'm lucky for that.  

The food is wonderful and staff is casual and friendly.  Bring your own wine bottle and share with friends.  Perfect atmosphere and outside dining along beautiful South Carrollton.

I keep discovering more reasons to love The Tree House. Last night I had the Risotto with fresh asparagus, carrots and green beans. Not only was the presentation spectacular, this dish is over the top delicious. And happily, the serving was generous so I also get to enjoy it for lunch.  

I just love The Tree House, best food, service and outdoor patio.

2 stars for the hostess being very kind and pleasant and the manager being visible and checking on customers. However our waiter, which seemed to be the bartender as well, pretty much made the experience unpleasant and awkward. It basically seemed as if she didn't want us there or maybe having a bad day. Regardless, we stayed and ordered brunch. I ordered the Killer Breakfast Tacos, which literally had no flavor at all, it came with breakfast potatoes that were over cooked with no seasoning. I had to give a generous amount of salt, pepper, ketchup, and Valentina (I think) to even eat it. Seems to be a chilled spot for happy hour which is all day Sunday but this is a place I will not return to.

Okay so I didn't try anything with the mushrooms because I'm not a mushroom guy. So if you're not a mushroom guy do what I did- get the baked potato and hamburger with everything they offer besides mushrooms. It was life changing. I know, I know, I was skeptical too. "Oh, another burger joint people love, don't believe the hype." But it has been two weeks and I can't stop talking about it or remembering how good it tasted during that first bite. I think the flavor profile that they master here is cold sour with hot savory. The baked potato is so soft and with their sour cream it really nails it. The hamburger is hot and salty and with a pile of shredded cold cheese on top it, once again, NAILS it.

If you're like us you may be full when you show up because you've been eating rich food all day or all week because everything that's cooked in that town is super rich and super salty but I don't care. You have to try the baked potato and/or burger here.

If you're reading this now you're probably considering going. You may already be on your way. And if so... I'm so jealous.

I love this place, authentic Mexican food, it is so hard to find authentic Mexican places in my opinion. I am a proud Latina and sometimes it is hard to cook going to college and working full time and sometimes you need those meals that remind you of home. My favorite thing on the menu is the shrimp tacos, best shrimp tacos in Nevada! The restaurant itself is gorgeous, has Aztec figures, the plates, the plaza, the place is cute.

Definitely need to get there early, this place is always busy. I'm a big fan of the blueberry pancakes (blueberries in the pancake and on top? Yes, please). My husband also loves the French toast and their huge breakfast burrito.

For lunch try the wicked good turkey (it's has Doritos in the sandwich). So good!

You can't not love Beefys!
Not only do they have some amazing burgers, especially the monthly specials, but they actually make it a point to get to know their customers. They don't just learn your name and your order but you can actually enjoy their conversation too, they're a great bunch people that are happy to sever you.

Great food, Great atmosphere, Great Service and Great employees!

If you live in Nashville or if you are visiting the city and you are wanting a good Mexican meal, then this is your place! The restaurant has a great vibe and their food is amazing. 

They have an inside bar, outside bar and an upstairs bar. If they tell you it's a long wait, see if there are any spots upstairs at the bar and treat yourself to a margarita as they are GREAT!

I have to give a shoutout to the staff! You can tell they are the best of the best because they made sure to check in often and wanted to make sure you were taken care of. 

Will return the next time I'm in Nashville! Yum!

A truly bad Chinese restaurant. We dined in. Sushi is decent and that's the reason it gets 2 stars. Plus my toddler was able to get an order of chicken nuggets, not often seen on a Chinese menu, so for once she had something she would eat (it's not listed on the eat-in menu, only the take out). 

Service was mediocre, the older waiter couldn't tell us what red text in the menu meant. (It meant spicy of course.) The Chinese food was nearly inedible. I ordered veg chow fun, which was coated heavily in a very generic and salty soy sauce mixture, hardly any veggies. Husband ordered mu shu beef, only 4 pieces of meat and so salty he could barely eat any of it. 

The only good part was that the waiters promptly deducted my meal off the check (they seemed to expect the complaints!) and our barely edible meal was just $23. 

If you want good Americanized Chinese/Japanese, go to:
Tomo sushi (Glassboro)
Tokyo Peking (Sewell)
Ocean Asian (Sewell)

If you truly want good Chinese, ya gotta go to Chinatown in Philly.

My family is Yugoslavian, so we were excited to see a European restaurant close to home. Unfortunately, it was not great. The spaetzle and mashed potatoes both seemed to be from mixes, though the cucumber salad was addictive. The chicken paprikash was mediocre. The sauce was good, but the cuts of chicken were low quality. I prefer white meat, but if paprikash is going to be made with dark meat, it shouldn't be grisly or especially bony (i.e. meager thighs).  I can see that people really like this place, and I love to support local businesses, but I don't think I'll be back here; I'll go to my mom's.
This place is great! Food always comes out hot. The service tonight was great. Though it can be noisy at times. Try the beef tips with mashed potatoes. Don't forget the peanuts.
Just had dinner and Eric was our waiter.  He was very friendly and was on top of everything.  One of the best waiters we have had in a long time.  Great experience.

First things first. 
Are you strictly Vegan/ Vegetarian? 
Yes ? Then Go. No? Also Go! Give Blackbird Pizzeria a chance, and you won't regret it. 

My very good friend, Melissa, who I haven't seen for almost 5 years, was visiting from Washington,DC and she happens to be vegan. For lunch, Melissa suggested we go to Blackbird Pizzeria, since it was one of her absolute favorites, when she used to live in Philly. 

Melissa had the Cheesesteak sandwich, and I split a huge meatless Calzone with her. Mmmm.. A Calzone loaded with melted "dairy-free" cheese, and my choice of fresh pizza-topping (mushrooms, olives, and onion,) served with a side of tomato sauce. I think, I'd much rather have it filled with the sauce instead, then it would be called a Stromboli, perhaps?

Well, I think the time has come, and I finally made my way to an all-vegan restaurant. And it was a definitely two thumbs-up.

After I picked my jaw up off the floor, I had a confession to make. I've been steering away from vegan places, for no reason but my ignorance. I'm not saying I'm going Vegan, but this place made me realize that vegan food is not tasteless nor dry as advertised.

I'm so eager to try their famous pizza, and maybe the cheese fries.
Blackbird Pizzeria, I'll be back.

Three and Half Yelps.

Very cool atmosphere, and a good place to go meet with people. Definitely enjoyable experience and friendly staff, and good cold beer! Not much of a menu for food, but the stiffed pretzel sandwiches are really good! I have tried the blackened chicken and the gyro stuffed pretzels the times I have been there, and they were really unique and interesting!
Food was amazing and staff was very friendly and nice! We had sweet plantain lasagna and Puerto Rican stew. Definitely coming back again!

Place is great! Chorizo burrito is typically my go to when getting mexican and this one definitely did not disappoint. Flavorful and hearty portions for a reasonable price.  The epitomy of what I think good Mexican food should be. My wife has had many of the tacos and has enjoyed all. Her only complaint, if you can call it that, is she thought there was a little too much meat for her to eat.
Such an amazing deal for all you can eat sushi, with very fast service and staff was super nice! The indoor dining was also very clean!

I would give 2.5 stars, but in honor of my mom being so disappointed by her sandwich, I rounded down to 2 instead of up to 3...

We were here for lunch, and loved the fact that we could get outdoor seating right in the prime realty area of state street in SB, so that was a great start. Then they forgot my mom's iced tea about 4 times, and we just felt awkward having to reorder it each time. Their lunch menu isn't the cheapest in the world, but for a bistro on state street what do you expect? I got their crab melt sandwich which was overly greasy to me. I could feel the oil and cheese on my fingers way more than I wanted to, and this is coming from someone who absolutely loves cheese. It was just an okay sandwich. 

Then my mom got here french dip sandwich and when she opened it up, noticed that all of the meat had so much fat on it, she had to burn a ton of extra calories cutting away at all of the fat in her sandwich! Who wants to eat pure fat? No one pretty much. And for a sandwich of that price, that work should already be done for the consumer. Better yet, buy better quality meat without that extra fat in it! My uncle thought his salad was so so and their homemade soup was also nothing to scream home about either. Really we all just felt blah, and left wishing we had eaten somewhere else.

It was a great experience to try this burger joint. They have variety of fries and sauces and it goes really well with each other. Their burgers are the bomb and unique. The bison burger is what I go for. Even though, the burger is a little expensive. It is still worth it at the end.

Very good food. The new ribs were amazing the most tender I have ever had. The waitress was very friendly. Our last experience a few months ago was horrible so I hope this experience means that new management is turning this location around.

I will never forget that day. Came by with my
Girls after having a horrible experience at a seafood place in Clarksville TN. This place was amazing. We were all at the table eating our food not saying anything it was so amazing lol. Oh we will be back :)
Love the food- wait staff is attentive to allergies and very accommodating. The drink pours are paltry at best. The bourbon tasted watered down...disappointing aspect to the dining experience.

I will definitely be a regular at Chao now. Stopped in for lunch by a friend's recommendation and loved it. We started with the spring roll appetizer with shrimp which was ok. What was great was their chicken Bahn Mi and their pho. The chicken had excellent flavor. This is by far the best Bahn Mi I've had in Indy. The bread was also perfect. A bit toasted/crunchy which made it perfect. Tip: have them add avocado to your Bahn Mi. The pho' broth had great flavor and the beef was good quality. The portions weren't huge but definitely enough and the price is pretty reasonable. Service was friendly as well. Solid restaurant!
Just walked in for first time with GF for breakfast. She had Italian and I had sandwich. Excellent food. Friendly people. We will be back

being that all of the reviews were 4 star and above I was expecting more. Service was terrific. We had a great waitress. All of the things on the menu sounded terrific. My brother in law and I shared Chimmichurri wings and brussels sprouts with Chorizo. The wings were very large and were really fall off the bone tender......however the Chimmichurri sauce was not flavorful at all. It just tasted like some onions/parsley mixed with olive oil and no salt. The lack of flavor and seasoning is something that will carry on thru out the meal. So the wings while juicy had zero flavor. The brussel sprouts w chorizo were bland as well......maybe some salt???? The chorizo rounds really weren't assertive which is odd.
Anyway.......I had the Portuguese burger and my brother in law had a burger with fried onion rings and bbq sauce. 
The server switched them up on us, we both took bites and realized the error.
Anyway....my burger was supposed to have had beef mixed with Chorizo meat and topped with cheese and Serrano? ham......
All assertive flavors.......yet the burger tasted like a regular burger and the serrano ham flavor couldn't be tasted. The burger was cooked perfectly medium and was juicy, but just didn't taste anything like you'd think it would given it's ingredients. Bland. My brother in laws was a bit better because how do you not taste BBQ sauce on something?
Again.....great waitress......a server who needs training on how to deliver the correct food to the correct person........and a great beer list.....but food that sounds awesome, is cooked perfectly, but completely lacks flavor...........and tastes nothing like it should. 3 stars.

Ten years ago, dessert options in Tampa were sparse. It was either guava pastelios from a Cuban bakery on Boliche Blvd., cold stone ice cream, or the mediocre working cow ice cream. Now there's Sprinkles cupcakes, Thai rolled ice cream parlors, nitrogen ice cream, Moreno's amazing coffee cakes, and now a cookie dough shop! Just what Tampa needed. The best part is that all of the proceeds go to Metropolitan Ministries so you are helping out people in need and satisfying cravings for delicious cookie dough. I ordered a scoop of the chocolate chip cookie dough with asian carmel on top, which is like regular Carmel but even better! The chocolate chip cookie dough and Asian Carmel were amazingly delicious but it could have used more chocolate chips and it was a bit too doughy. The vibe of Dough Nation was a sort of charitable hipster vibe mixed with cutesy white girl vibes. Overall, the best place to get dessert in downtown Tampa and Tampa's only cookie dough shop.

I love their fresh baked bread! And little chocolate cakes are so moist and wonderful! The icing actually tasty, not just plain fat. We had salmon sandwich which was dressed with fresh greens and herbs, taste great! Next will try soup in a bread bowl. Staff is very helpful and friendly.

My hubby and I ate here today, never again, I ate chicken and waffles, only flavor there was the maple syrup. It was Awful.  My hubby had Cuban rice bowl, cold and bland as well.  Other than the location on the river, I don't get it unless people don't like food with flavor.

I've seen this place so many times but only came by when I started working in this area. I ordered a shrimp on bun combo.  It was a pretty big bun and plenty of shrimp.  It's a drive thru with a walk up as well and it's fast fast food. Will definitely be back very soon to try the wings and burgers.
most friendliest people and delicious food. my parents are super picky about what and where they eat and they absolutely loved it. enough said.
Great service and food! Reminds me of a Bass Pro shop. Loved the Meltones band playing. Reminded me of appreciation of banjo music. Bison burger amazing!! Best slaw I've ever had!!

My husband and I ate here for the first time a year ago April, and we purchased the LivingSocial deal because we wanted a reason to go back. We both really like Aaron May's restaurants - May's Counter is one of my favorite places to eat. Last night, I ordered the BEC (bacon, egg, cheese) burger and my husband got the fish fry. My burger was fine, but unmemorable. There was nothing on the bun, or any "burger stuff" like tomato, lettuce & onions. It was moist and flavorful, but kind of boring. The tater tots were delicious - super crispy and piping hot. The fish fry, on the other hand, was a major disappointment. As you do when you order fish at a restaurant, you want a big, beer battered plank of fish. I'm pretty sure everyone feels that way. And at $15.99, I figured that was what he would get. Instead, it was a few sad looking frozen fish sticks on a plate with a dish of coleslaw and some waffle fries. You could have made the whole thing for $10.00. He was disappointed, and flagged down our waitress. Samantha was great. She kept our drinks full and recommended other choices on the menu after my husband returned the fish. He ended up with a turkey Reuben instead, which he was really impressed with. It wasn't a terrible experience - we got a terrific waitress, tots were good and my husband liked his sandwich. But I don't see us going out of our way to eat here again any time soon. Pretty sure we'll stick with May's Counter from here on out.
I lovedddd the beignets . They are super big though so I would either go really hungry or be willing to share with friends. Also their croissants and flaky and stuffed with filling.

Stopped by for lunch and we are thrilled with the food!  Husband had ramen, I had vegetable chow mein. Both were delicious! Could use a little heat but that was our fault for not asking. I also had an eggroll which was absolutely fantastic. We will absolutely be back. So lots of things on the menu we would love to try!

Passable, but if I want overcooked salmon I can make it at home. Generally if you go to a restaurant and the waitstaff spends the whole time talking about dipping sauces and not about any actual food you know the priorities might be a bit off. Even the scallops are cooked straight through, which in my book is a sin beyond forgiveness.

The sauces are actually entertaining and the food is better when the spices and breading are the main attraction, like with the faux-asian (and slightly racist) Bang Bang Shrimp. But don't expect "grilled to perfection" here.  Grilled to char is about all you're going to get.

This is one of my favorite spots to hit in Chinatown for good hand drawn noodles that are inexpensive and authentic.  The hot pepper paste/sauce that is offered on the side is perfect and the right amount of spicy.  The seating is limited so sometimes there can be a wait. The food comes out very quickly and is always a good portion size.

Went for the aesthetics surrounding Jack Rose, stayed for the food and drinks. And well, the photo opportunities in the Living Room. A month out, I attempted a reservation for lunch but they were already booked so we had an early dinner reservation. We were some of the first people in for the dinner crowd, but within 15 minutes, it was packed with everyone else. So definitely plan accordingly! Don't attempt it on the fly if you really want to eat here. 

Food was delicious. We had the Murder Point Oysters for appetizers and I had the Red Snapper for dinner. The others had the Fried Chicken Parmesan and Short Rib Daube. I don't think anyone had a chance to fully discuss it because we were too busy cleaning our plates. 

The drinks were fun and delicious and if you go, you cannot skip the Chambong. It's just not possible to visit Jack Rose and NOT get a round of Chambong. 

Of course, stop by the couch under the Lil' Weezy photo because no trip here is complete without it. Expect a line of people thinking the same thing. 

It's a great place to treat yo self!

Wow was I disappointed. We went on a Wednesday evening for "Dinner Under the Stars". We had a reservation and it took 20 minutes to seat us. I was surprised how long it took to be waited on and to receive our food. They were so short staffed - and for this night to be a busy one which they knew about (dinner under the stars is a weekly event) - they should have planned better.

This place is awesome food to qualify it worth the price. We spend over $1150 for 7 adults b 3 kids, well worth it. The Kobe steak was delicious, the sea bass my was a little over cook but not bad, appetizer was very very good , like tuna n king crab. View was fantastic service was outstanding. Cocktail drink was so so not as good as Las Vegas. But this is the best in the hotel. The resort by it self  was ok not that good over price for the hotel. Not as up to date pm furnishing n decoded. Cleanning need more on the facility , poor and resort only worth off 3  not crazy price like this. If I paid this price $450 a night I would expected more like Aria n vdara n cosmopolitans hotel in Las Vegas .

I have to give them some stars because the food was fantastic and the bartender was great. However, we brought a group of 8 for trivia, which was advertised online, and it never happened. We ended up playing games on our iPhones.

Greek fast food. Fresh, tasty, fast, relatively cheap - discount for cash too. Let's be clear that this is not really Greek food but the American idea of Greek food. I can't help longing for fat slabs of Spanokopita with a giant Greek salad on the side, but you won't find that here. That said, it's good food. Food for quick takeout. Dining room is comfortable and the outside patio is nice. But truly...Styrofoam plates and cups? It's 2018, how about trying some Earth friendly paper products?

If you are looking to have a glass of wine or better yet explore by tasting a few pours, this is your place!! They have everything from very high end wine (Jordan, Conn Creek, Stags Leap) to mid and lower range wines. Get a card and have 2oz pours to your heart's content or go all in with a glass or a bottle. Customer service here is excellent. Audrey our server was awesome--fun, knowledgable, and attentive (sit in her section if you can!). John the sommelier(?) was also very helpful and attentive. While we were tasting we encountered a corked bottle (it happens to the best of them!) and it was immediately changed out and we were comped a glass. There is also a full bar and a few big TVs if you want to watch a game. All around a good find in Indy!

Not the fanciest place to take a date, and the food lacks presentation but then again, it isn't a masterchef kitchen. In all the food was delicious and well worth its price. Don't expect 5 star service though.

The service was definitely a vice as it was slow and the hostess accidentally switched checks with us and other customers. So once again, come for the food (or take out the food) not for the service.

Small, intimate winery located down a long lane on a littke knoll.  We enjoyed the live music on a Sunday afternoon outside on a nice lawn with picnic tables with umbrellas, seating around a gas fire pit.  We brought folding chairs and a small table with picnic supplies to accompany our wine.  We purchased the Reisling and their chambourcin which went great with our cheese, crackers and meats.

Ted's was our first stop of a weekend filled of good food and college tours for my younger sister in the Nashville area. After 5 hours in the car, everyone was getting hangry and we needed to be fed...LIKE NOW! We needed to stay close to Vanderbilt for the first tour, and thankfully I found Ted's on Yelp! :) 

Immediately upon entering, Ted's Montana Grill has that rustic cowboy feel to it. Bison heads mounted on the wall, authentic wooden bar, and southern charm to boot. 

Being mid-afternoon we tried a variety of appetizers rather than full meals. The Bar None Sliders were just that. Bite sized bison burgers with American cheese and an onion ring on each. That is some high quality meat and very satisfying. Bison Nachos were also a crowd favorite for us, topped with bison chili, cheese, and other nacho goodness. The menu featured made from scratch meals along the lines of burgers, meatloaf, steaks, ribs, and a few seafood options as well. My absolute favorite thing at Ted's was not even on the menu (I don't think?), but when you are seated, they serve you a small bowl of salted cucumber slices. They didn't have the dill flavor to be full on pickle chips, but they were A-MA-ZING!! I think the waitress through I was crazy when I keep asking her to refill the bowl of those. No shame in my food game for something that fantastic! 

Service and food were top notch - make sure to stop by if you are in the area.

I stopped by here to get a cheese steak in Philadelphia.  It was only ok.  The sandwich was huge, plenty to eat, and it was good.  It just wasn't amazing.  Super crowded place,  had to battle to get seats for our group but that went ok.  Maybe that's just the way there supposed to taste but I've had better cheese steaks at other places
One of the most amazing, authentic local businesses in indy! Must try the pie. If you're eating dinner, make sure you try the pulled pork. Ron is an incredible chef!

will never eat here again. I've ordered several times from this place and never experienced this before. The food was not the same quality, didn't get any fries with the combos that we ordered, and the fries we did get were clearly sitting around for awhile as they were cold and soggy. The man working the counter was rude and continued to argue with me about the fries not being included. Not only that but I literally watched him make the food with his bare hands touch the cash register and go back to the food to complete my order. After getting home and taking a bite into my food it did not taste the same as it has the few times I had ordered and it had tomato's which I explicitly said to leave off my food. In my opinion if you're looking for some decent Greek food take an extra 5 minutes and drive down Bruce B and hit the Hungry Greek. They can at the very least be competent enough to get your order right. This place has lost a customer for life.

would have to say this is most disgusting place ever 2 and a 1/2 weeks ago I came here with my brother I ordered a guacamole Burger my brother ordered another hamburger by the time we got it our food was cold as can be I ate my hamburger because I was so hungry and/or because this place was the only space open at that time a night which was 930 while 3 days later I got an alert on my Yelp review of a manager kind lady contacted me I talked to her she sent me some vouchers in the mail which was very appreciated it and I went in there tonight with my dad my brother Lorne by daz never been there but I use one my free vouchers for the Burger and I had it to the guy the guy was not very happy at me but OAA and so I we are seeing at our table my brother and I got our food 1st and we just waiting on my dad's hamburger and it was done but the guy a that kit red starred was helping some other people and doing the red shirt and talking and shed chatting with them why my dad's food was ready behind them just getting cold and what really ticks me off this they gave us fries up my dad ordered the fries were called they try to pass it off to us when we went back and asked them for fresh fries the young kid was countered not happy but he came back and gave his fresh price war 6 parents ever I will not be coming back here again even though I have 3 more free vouchers I won't use those I would just got a in-and-out Burger and I hope the manager calls me back she has my phone number on my Yelp page  Below is a picture of the crew that was working tonight and slow war screw ever these guys were talking a LA goofing around not really caring customer service they sucked

First time at Rumba and it was such a nice evening I sat outside, where you can smoke (yay for those of us who still choose to). 

Started off with a mug of beer, it was nice and chilled and cheap.  I got the fire roasted jalapeños. These came out hot and very delicious, I thought I wanted some ranch, but the menu is correct you don't need any sauce. The flavor was just slightly spicy, but not overwhelming and the cheese and meats complimented it. 

My entree was the rum chicken fiesta, with veggies and cabbage as the sides, it comes with a small salad, not a lot to it, but was good. The cornbread muffins are awesome, could have eaten a ton of them.  The chicken was very good, tender and juicy with the pineapple chutney adding good flavor. The veggies were firm, not mushy like you sometimes get from sautéed dishes. The braised cabbage was excellent!!

The atmosphere is great, they allow dogs outside, wish I had my puppy with me.

Overall a great meal and experience.
Love the fact they will make gluten free Chinese! It's just well, tasteless.

We arrived early for our tour of Penn State Penitentiary and we were starving. My husband absolutely loved his grass fed burger. I really liked my fish tacos as well. I was ecspecially happy to find a restaurant like this on our first day in Philly. We started our road trip looking to eat at locally owned restaurants and were happy to find a place with local fresh fare.
Had a lovely breakfast, prompt service,clean very friendly !   Will go back!   Had the meat omelette and it was very good!
Zudars is insane. Chocolate stuffed french toast, strawberry pancakes six inches high, crispy bacon, and great friendly service make this "the" breakfast place in downtown Tampa.

My boyfriend and I visited this restaurant on a Sunday around 11:30am and they were packed! We called in advance and put our name down so a table was ready for us when we arrived. 
They have a full menu with great breakfast options. I ordered the veggie Benedict and my boyfriend ordered the 1/2 ham steak and eggs. Both were very tasty. The veggie benedict had spinach, onions, and tomatoes, but the spinach had a very weird taste and was too much so I put the spinach to the side. 
Overall it was a good experience, but the restaurant was very busy and it was difficult to flag a waiter down to get some service. It didn't have the homey feeling we were expecting, the experience was very rushed. We weren't able to get our waters refilled. The meal my boyfriend ordered comes with unlimited toast, but no one stopped by our table to check in on us or for him to request more toast. Hiring more servers would help the customer experience greatly. 
Also a good tip: there's no parking lot, but they do validate tickets for the parking garage across the street.
Fajitas and burritos were fantastic. Our waiter was in training so I understand that our drinks were late, but still very good service. Good outside seating with a fire built into the table.

I can't believe such a great candy store is in an airport. It feels like vacation :) 

This store has such good variety! Especially of jelly beans and gummies. 

Also they have sour belts, real ones! And they have a huge sugar free selection. I was honestly amazed. As a girl who frequents candy stores on vacation, I have a lot of experience not being able to find the candy I want. So this place was awesome! 

If you're looking for vintage candy, their selection is smaller but their are some options.
wow the best sushi place in Santa Barbara hands down. freshest sushi and great servers. Dracula role, toro, and spicy thruster are a must have.

PaperMill Food was the perfect way to create a healthy, safe wedding! We wanted to have a way for our guests to have individually wrapped and served food so that we could have an outdoor wedding in October 2020. PaperMill accommodated everything from providing health checks for the employees, following COVID safe procedures, and checking in with us every step of wedding planning. The staff was friendly, professional and a delight to work with! We went with four different types of tacos so that all types of diets from vegans to weigh watchers could enjoy the food. They even removed all bell peppers from their set up that day to ensure our best man (with a severe bell pepper allergy) had no problems. My husband now talks about eating their food at least once a week and we hope post-pandemic we can get out to enjoy more spurritos!

Man this was a good find. Thank you Yelp for Hot and New. We stopped in for the oyster happy hour and ended up ordering half the left side of the menu. We really enjoyed all of it. Atmosphere is perfect. Crawfish Spring Rolls and Oysters Florentine are legit. I definitely recommend asking for chargrilled oysters during happy hour.

Came here for parents weekend while visiting my daughter and her roommates at UCSB.  I liked the setting, it's a quaint Italian restaurant with a nice simple/elegant décor.  I suggest making reservations as this place is popular and gets crowded.

Your experience will start with olive oil and bread which was very good. In addition, their wine selection was very satisfying, although I did not partake.    

I got the duck ravioli, which had a super rich sauce, I found the flavor to be really fantastic, totally happy with my selection.  Our table of 9 all were very satisfied with their food decisions based on their smiles and empty plates. 

I found the service to be just OKAY.  The food pacing was off, I suspect they forgot someone in our group as one of the plates came out noticeably late.  Aside from that snafu, I sat with an empty water glass for long spells and had to ask for more on a few occasions.  The overall experience was good, if you are looking for a nice Italian meal out, Olio E Limone Ristorante will surly satisfy.

Impeccable service today by Lee B! Friendly, prompt, anticipated my needs, dropped the check before asked. Four, not five stars, as the veggies in my shrimp bowl tasted like cooking fuel. Great music.

Wet burrito was awesome and a great deal at $8. My baby daughter had an off the menu mini-quesadilla for $2.50. Fair prices and good food if you like tex-mex, burritos, tacos, nachos. It was good enough that I came back the next day for more. Small dining room, but good for kids and families.

For starters I lived in New York City and I rarely give any restaurant four stars. However,  whenever I am in St Pete's this place is my go too. The Sea Bass was the best I have ever eaten and the food is exceptional. The place is always pack but it is well worth the wait.

NOISE!
Good food, OK coffee, moderate price but much too noisy from a terrible heating/AC system to enjoy a peaceful meal.

I enjoyed having lunch at this place. Their Seafood is superb. However they leave the mud line in their salmon which led to a bad taste in my mouth when I was eating it. Had I taken the mud line or bloodline I'm not sure what it's called off of the salmon my experience would have been totally different. The tuna was awesome perfectly trimmed and seasoned. The salmon seasoning was good too. They need to make sure that they have all their premium products available because most of the premium all the premium products were gone. However the owner was out shopping for the missing things. So maybe they should have discounted our lunch who knows. It was a plus plus plus in taste and friendliness and I go back a million times more but I live in Maryland. So please go it's awesome and the guys are awesome!!

Sat at the bar after a titans game....wasn't that much fun. I was hoping for the experience but it was uneventful. I ordered the fruity bastard drink and felt ill after, not from the alcohol but from whatever nasty mixes they use and my friends drink was just as bad. Fried pickles were the worst I've had yet in still ate them and the cheese sticks were fine.

Meh. Fair. The GF was craving pizza. I wanted to watch playoff football. We had never been to PW. We compromised by sitting at the bar and watching the game. The old joke goes something like........ Pizza is like sex. Even if it's bad, it's still pizza. I am in no way, shape or form equating pizza to my sex life (Love ya , honey) but let me just say I was not wowed.

Chicago deep dish is my favorite style so I tend to favor Pi/Lemmon's/Black Thorn for my pizza choices. But being a big fat guy, I have come across few pizzas I wouldn't make friends with. If you are looking for brick oven "neopolitan" style pizza (which is what they serve), I think The Good Pie in Midtown does it better.

The space is cool. The open kitchen concept is always appreciated to include a large strategically placed mirror that lets you see your pizza being prepared. The bar is small and kinda seems weirdly placed. It's just stuck in the front of the room and doesn't seem to fit right, to me. All things given though, it's a nice space

this place is wonderful!  clean, well managed, friendly staff, low price on a wide selection of meat and cheese.  stop here first for you holiday treats,
and everyday comfort foods.  you can trust these people.

I come here often because it's the closest DQ to my house but the service is always terrible. I order a Oreo cheesecake add cookie dough bites blizzard every time and 75% I don't get the right thing. It's either just a plain Oreo blizzard or they don't add the cookie dough bites even though I pay extra for that. Tonight I went and of course they give me the wrong thing. Not only that, it's pouring rain and they didn't care to put a lid on the blizzards so it became watery. I'd rather drive the extra minutes to go to another one from now on. It's unfortunate that the teenage kids who work there don't know anything about quality customer service or don't care to listen to people's orders.

Ordered delivery so I can't vouch for the restaurant experience but the delivery wasn't bad.  I ordered the house fried rice and tried to add green onions to it but they told me they don't carry green onions, only white onions (which means I am not trying the Mongolian Beef). Anyway, the rice wasn't bad but definitely could use more veggies and more egg (Golden Dragon on 22nd and Miss Saigon definitely have the best fried rice in town).  Also ordred the spring rolls and the Green Apple Boba.  Those two combined cost more than $8 but the spring rolls were nice sized and the boba was decent. I will probably give it another try when I get a jones for asian food but it won't make the best in Tucson list.
This venue has been closed since May 2011.  Temaki Sushi Bar now resides at this address. Different owners with a new Chef.

In general, good Vietnamese food and friendly staff. I have been here twice. I had beef pho once, chicken pho the second time. The broth is excellent and the noodles perfectly cooked. I thought the meat (especially the brisket) was sliced too thin, though. 

I wish the egg rolls came with lettuce leaves for easier eating and dipping. 

The limeade is excellent.

Wi-fi connects but always times out. When asked, management states it works, so no interest to correct it. Great pancakes though! Update, it's been 4 months and the wi-fi still is not working. I wouldn't care but my phone connects and the I have to turn off wi-fi and remember to turn it on when I leave. Just turn off the wi-fi please. Great pancakes tho ;-)

EDIT: December 2017, Pancakes have gone downhill. Worse yet, I ordered the 5 pancake stack for $5.25 and was told coffee comes with it, I questioned the price and was told it's a special. Check out the bill pictured.$6.99...it's not the $2 for coffee that bothers me, it's the principle that I specifically asked because I just wanted water, but it "comes with" so I took it.....

I was here on Mother's Day and it was about a 30 minute wait.  I was thrilled that they had my beloved German Apple Pancake on the menu.  I can make my own, but having it made for you is a real treat.  They kind of half assed it though and did not use fresh apples, but rather they used a precooked syrupy apple.  They also folded the pancake and stuffed the apples in the middle.  I prefer to have melted butter with apples covered in brown sugar and cinnamon on the bottom of the pie pan, then you pour your batter on top, so the apples caramelize and bake into the pancake.  These pancakes are a sight to behold anyway you make it.  They are the size of a plate and they are big and puffy.  It is essentially a popover/yorkshire pudding batter.  It is incredibly tasty.  I also had a side of bacon, which was just your average cut of bacon, nothing fancy.  I loved their menu!  Crepes, Swedish pancakes and potato pancakes were all very phat (pretty hot and tempting).  The server was overwhelmed and a little scattered, poor guy.  They also sell fresh baked sweet breads and some jams like lingonberry.

Me and my friend decided to eat here after a perfect day at the beach. Our server Howard was very nice and efficient in answering our questions about the menu. He brought bread and oil w/ herbs to the table. It was tasteless. My friend was pleased with the Caesar salad I got the tossed salad and the lettuce was wilted and the ranch dressing was too sweet i had to drown it in salt & pepper to make it decent. We both ordered pasta and it was the most bland pasta we ever had. Will NOT be visiting again nor recommending to anyone.

My favorite wing is med garlic and Press box simply makes the best I found in Tampa though the best I found anywhere is still the charley hoarse bar in Ormond beach but they do not put them on special so for the money when on special 50 cent price  Press boxes wins 
one thing to mention garlic medium dos not sound hard but there a trick to keeping the garlic on the wing that most places simply fail at

Terrible experience. Food was average at best and extremely pricey.  The worst part was that we were seated in the dingy basement inches away from the restroom.  

What really set me off was the pork tenderloin dish that was served in the 3rd course as part of the "Chef's Selection." I know it's trendy now to cook pork slighty rare these days but I wasn't expecting Pork Tartar! 

Not worth your time or money.

How is it that a chain can be relatively good at one location and totally suck at their other locations? My husband raved about the Milwaukee street location...we went, and I have to agree! Everything we had there was wonderful! We will return! Went to the location on Eagle Road - eh. Nothing to brag about. Will not go back. And just had lunch at the new location on Broadway. I'm sick. It was disgusting. The best part of the meal: the soda machine. The worst? Pasty parmesan crusted chicken. Dirty knives wrapped in napkins. Dirty tables waiting to be bussed. Pasty and icky noodles. Garbage tastes better. For 9 bucks, I deserved a far better lunch. Will not be going back to this location. And this location kind of put me off the Milwaukee location for awhile...got to let my tummy recuperate.

Always satisfied with the amount of food I get. Servers are normally very friendly. The only complaint I have is about the wait time for a table or your first cup of coffee. However, it's normally busy so I understand. Never had a bad experience. It's my favorite breakfast place in town.

A little pricey but really good, so it's worth it! Their sauce is real yummy and we love the thin, wood fired crust. I've been in for a quiet lunch and also been in for dinner on a packed Friday night. Service was always kind and timely. Great place!
I go there about 1nc/mo on business. The food is decent, service good, and the ambience is okay. I never mind eating here; Salt Rock Tavern offers "fancy diner" type fare. The bar is also good.

My husband found this pizzeria and we loved it!  The sauce and ingredients were good and the crust was perfect.  Our favorite was the Grandma pizza.  I would give it a 10 out of 10.  Travis and Roxy were friendly and helpful when we were trying to figure out what to order.
I came in once, the waiter take me into a seat but didn't care about me then, they don't even give me a cup of water, and then I just leave

Finally made it! Headed in on a weekday with mom in town. Great food, great presentation and attention to detail. Food was hot and flavorful and nicely garnished. Everything in the restaurant is meticulous even in the bathrooms. Nice service. Pricey, but what isn't in the CBD?

I love the food!  But Wed service needs to step it up, especially on All you can eat wing night!  The service is very slow (not sure if on purpose?)  We like coming here just not when its busy because service can be so slow
Overall average or slightly above average dim sum place in Edmonton. Reasonable price items and service for an older style Chinese restaurant.

I love this place! It's cheap, filling and very decent for what you pay. I love the red sauce enchiladas, 3 to an order for around $6 and I can never finish it all! The hot salsa on the salsa bar is excellent. Good place for an inexpensive but tasty meal.

It doesn't matter when you go or how busy they are, the service is always slow and they always mess up order. Ordered 2 mcdoubles without pickles, and or course after waiting 15 minutes @ midnight both burgers had pickles. Will be calling to complain tmr!!

Had brunch here last weekend with a friend. We ordered the side of brussel sprouts, the grilled cheese and the pork sandwich. Everything was good, just not sure it was the best I have ever had. The service and atmosphere made up for the ok food. I would likely return for dinner. The bread was excellent though.

Bad enough that the food was as bland and cold as the decor.  The Alfredo was runny and had none of the rich creamy texture or flavor you expect with a good sauce.  If the food was better, another visit might be merited were it not for witnessing the staff member who cut the bread, delivered salads and water to tables chew his nails in between activities.  It was nothing short of disgusting.  Called it to the attention of the manager who spoke to him about it and made him wash his hands.  That would have been the end of it, but five minutes later, the fingers went into his mouth again.  We won't be back under any circumstances.

This place receives a three stars mainly because the customer service and the drink were good.  I had my first espresso shot and it was pretty good, nice and strong.  Next I ordered a vanilla chai latte and I was amazed that they used Tazo tea which is one of my favorite brands!!! The servers were great and checked on their customers.  I ordered the Caesar salad and the salad was okay...the croutons were hard as a rock!

The place loses two stars because the cleanliness of the facility.  The place was beyond filthy!!! I seen the dirt on the floor and the tables were dirty.  I just couldn't with this place!!

The decor was really interesting...I came in thinking this is the cafe bar off of Friends.  with Feebie singing 'smelly cat.'

Overall a good experience, just needs to be cleaned up...

Summary- Excellent atmosphere with very meh food.  

Food- 2 Stars
Chili Omelette was just all around meh. Waaaaay too much cheese inside of it. The chili on top was out of a can. Hash browns on side were OK.

At least the coffee was very good.

Atmosphere- 5 Stars
Just can't get better than the big bar style counter top eating area.

Service- 5 Stars
Just awesome service, playful, funny, welcoming.

Hmmmm.... This place definitely has some pros and some cons. I would probably give it 2.5 stars if that were and option, so I decided to round up. 

Walked into the waiting are and the sign reads "please wait to be seated". Waited 7 minutes before tracking down staff to help with seating. Once seated it took another 10 minutes for our waitress to come to the table for our drink order. To give her the benefit of the doubt, she was super nice. 

I ordered the Grouper Bites and the grouper taco. OMG! Both took me by surprise. Perfectly seasoned and perfectly cooked. They were bursting with flavor! 

We should have stopped there, but decided to partake in molten chocolate cake. Big mistake. It kind of tastes like a "just add water" cake batter that was "cooked" in a microwave. Just, no.

Uhhhhh. None of the food that I got was flavorful at all aside from the strong smell inside the men's bathroom. The Fiesta burger was a big disappointment. How is there no flavor at all with a burger that has "housemade southwestern spice rub, pepper jack cheese, fresh jalapenos, housemade smoked pepper salsa, chipotle mayo, and pickles? Maybe I had COVID and do not have my tastebuds, but this burger just tasted like grease. I didn't taste any flavor at all and then I decided to try the tater tots, against my best judgment, and there were grease pockets. No potato filling at all, I recommend sticking with the french fries for sure. 

Now the BBQ bacon burger was much better. The sweet and salty combination of the BBQ sauce and the bacon brought much of the flavor out. The meat patties here are voluptuous and enough to feel in every bite. 

Now on to those "ONION RINGS." What the hell was this Donnie/ Mark.?? These are not onion rings by any measure. They were not crusted and even the onion itself had no taste, I kid you not. This whole "onion ring" thing needs to be taken to the back of the barn and taken out. What a disgrace to onion fanatics like myself. 

Save your money. I guess Culver's will do for now.

This was my 1st time at Kulture and the food was delicious, hot and fulfilling. Our server, Kiki was nice and gave us a lot of suggestions. Can't forget my drink, Bar Punch, was sweet but strong. Sorry I forgot to take a picture. I will definitely be back.

Very nice ambiance, great service and a great deal. Monday night special was worth it. a 6 ounce filet mignon with a nice salad and light dessert, overall great meat with nice side dishes and very cozy. thank you
Great service and super fast with yummy food!! Reasonable prices and scallops were amazing!

We had the crab claws and stuffed mushroom appetizers. In my opinion the crab claws were probably the only decent thing we had. Neither of the 6 of us cared for the mushrooms. We also got chargrilled oysters that were small and not worth $20 at all. For entrees we ordered the seafood boiling pot, shrimp boiling pot, rib eye, fried seafood platter, oyster pasta, and the soup trio. ALL of our entrees lacked so much flavor. My friend probably took 2 bites of her pasta and pushed it aside. The seafood platter was room temperature and just overall mediocre. My friend hated the soup trio and said it tasted nothing like jambalaya, etoufee, or red beans. The boiling pots lacked so much flavor that we expected since we are in New Orleans.. AND they were supposed to come with corn, which we never got. And when I asked my server if it was supposed to come with it she said yes but we probably ran out since it's the end of the night. It would have been nice to have been offered a substitution or be told they were out to begin with. They probably hoped we wouldn't notice. And the rib eye was just ok. We didn't even want to order dessert for our friends birthday. Would probably never come here again since we paid almost $400 for a meal we all werent the least bit satisfied with. And for $400 we never even got a single drink refill. Save your money and go elsewhere. WOULDNT RECOMMEND TO ANYONE

Been here several times and food is always good.  Prices are decent.  Outside patio area is nice...just sit at your own risk.  My husband and I went here to have dinner before a movie and opted to sit out in the patio.  We got chips and salsa right away, they were good but...we waited 15 minutes and NO ONE came to take our drink order.  A table came after us, sat behind us, got drinks right away and were helped immediately.  Were they busy, no.  It was a Tuesday around 5:30.  You failed this time, El Maguey.... will we be back, possibly. If we do come back we won't sit outside.   This is the only bad thing that has happened and their food is good.
Boyfriend loves this place but I wasn't thrilled. I would rather go somewhere and have them make the food for me.. handing them frozen chicken and a mix of veggies was not my idea of fun.

This is my go-to place in both SB and Goleta for an amazing sandwich. Not only is their food delicious, the staff is amazing! Owen is the man, so helpful and everyone is super kind. Also... Their pickles are mind blowing!!!

We ordered multiple dishes to try one of everything & while all were delicious, the sauces here are the BEST! I really loved how well seasoned & flavorful everything was. The veggies were super fresh too! My favorite was the chickpea wrap & spinach & artichoke dip.

What can I possibly say about Fogo that hasn't already been said?  
Location:  great!
Atmosphere:  fabulous!
Service:  impeccable!
Salad bar:  delicious!
Meats:  heavenly!
I'm going to be completely honest, though.  The only reason we dined at Fogo was because we had a gift card that we had received as a present from a friend and the restaurant was still running their Devour Downtown $30 per person deal   We made reservations (thank goodness) and when we arrived there were probably 30 people waiting.  But, they must have been reservationless because we were seated immediately upon giving the hostess our name.  We really loved this place but since we do not have any self control when it comes to good food we made pigs of ourselves.  Even though they serve small portions of the meats, when you sample every meat available it's WAY too much.  But, again, this was our fault. And, the salad bar in itself is amazing.  If we return to Fogo I think we might just order the salad bar and let everyone else feast on the meat.
