We have tried all the chicken entrees - they're equally delicious, though could use some diversity. The vindaloo is the most different from the others, which all resemble butter chicken. The biryani are all very-well prepared and makes a great side dish. Naan is so fresh, crispy-yet-soft... I want some now!

The flavor absolutely comes alive in your mouth - if you've not tried Indian food, or it's already one of your favorites, you will love the experience at Persis.

EVERYTHING here was amazing! 

Appetizers: Turtle Soup, Seafood Gumbo, Frog Legs with Onion Rings and Fried Green Tomatoes. (Excellent! Everyone of them! I've never seen such GIANT frog legs!)

My dish was the Blackened Louisiana Drum with Crab Meat sprinkled over the top, served with a side of vegetables and mashed potatoes. This is supposedly their signature dish. The vegetables were soft enough and still able to give you a little bit of that crunch, while the mashed potatoes were perfecly moist and tasteful. The fish was unrivaled, I've never had so many of my taste buds activated at the same time. Just flawless! I also was able to try the rib eye steak and that just melted away in my mouth, another dish done amazingly well. 

This place is definitely on pricey side as no dinner dish is less than $32 but if you're looking for a great taste of the Bayou, this is it!!! Highly reccomend!

Fun bar restaurant, food was not very good, the pot roast consisted of beef that had been braised very little seasoning frozen vegetables that had not been cooked with the braised beef and tater tots. but the Ambiance was great. Service was super. The place was pretty crowded and busy, I will probably give this place another visit.

Wandered in for some drinks and MJ the bartender was more than amazing. Not only did he make the best dirty martini I've had he went the extra step to make me bleu cheese stuffed olives. Great atmosphere and very friendly staff. Will def come back for MJ and his awesome drinks!  Thanks!!

To be perfectly honest, this place really isn't that good. I'm just assuming it's hype and allure comes from the surrounding area of college kids living off mommy and daddy funds not knowing the first step to boiling water for pasta and or even simply preheating an oven. Service is always half assed and or poor, food isn't awful but nothing over the top, if you enjoy pancakes I do recommend you to stop by, constant wait time for seating over 30 mins because I swear they have about 4 booths total with about 15 tables for two only. Overall one of the most basic restaurants I've had the pleasure of sitting in a cramped booth that's damp from the last server wiping it down with a wet dirty rag.

Great food, good value, but must try again on another night besides Friday. Insanely crowded. Congrats on success & popularity. But way too busy for us. Multiple waits were unacceptable. Not server's fault, but kitchen & bar must have been overwhelmed. Just too slow for us. And absurdly noisy. Plus, we were given the wrong appetizer. And the dining room was cold with their long front glass wall allowing all the heat out. Not very fun. Great food & drinks though.

OMG!!!! Zero stars! I read all of the horrible reviews but we went ahead anyway. ..because we're gluttons for punishment I guess.  We sat on the inside for 15 minutes without being acknowledged and it was very empty inside.  We watched servers walk back and forth, totally carefree.  The hostess who sat us (who was actually friendly) looked at our server and pointed to us as if to remind her that we were there. Our server looked directly at us then walked in the other direction. Epic fail!  We were hungry and not in the mood to play games.  We got up and left before experiencing the bad food we already read about.

I keep trying to give this place a fair shake and have been here multiple times both pre and during pandemic both dine in and take out. Because I keep seeing all the great reviews and people who say this is their favorite Indian food in all of Philly and I unfortunately, just don't get it? Am I ordering the wrong stuff? 

Dining in and the staff are always pleasant. My go to when trying any Indian place I haven't before is to order chicken tikka masala. I always think that's a good standard common denominator dish. And it was pretty good. Not the best I had but it's decent and a good portion but still not 18 dollars good. However I've also ordered the butter chicken and another dish I can't remember and they all seemed really similar with no discernible difference (at least to my eyes or taste buds). 

Another staple I like to use to base how much I like an Indian restaurant is vegetable korma. It was a total bummer. Usually you order veggie korma and you expect to get a healthy portion of veggies and a rich and creamy flavorful sauce and what I got (pictured) was some weird unappetizing looking paste with some peas in it. It had the weirdest texture. Gritty, but also really wet and when mixed with the rice felt like I was eating some kind of sponge. It also just tasted like straight cardamom pods with no really great depth of flavor I'm used to getting from veggie korma elsewhere.  I hate to be negative but it was so bad and so disappointing especially considering I paid 15 dollars for paste. 

It's hard to really justify paying the prices for the quality of the food and takeout is also inconsistent with how efficiently you wait and get your food. Sometimes it's quick other times it's a small eternity and it's hard to predict what you're gonna get. And every time my takeaway after eating the food is "this is fine I guess" (or in the case of the veggie korma "I have regrets"). 

At the end of the day, I think this place is worth at least trying once, rolling the dice and maybe trying some of the stuff some of the five star ratings have mentioned. Maybe you will fare better than me. Maybe it just requires trying something off the beaten path and not the typical Indian food staples. I will probably give them one more shot to try the dosa because it seems everyone is pretty hype about them. But it will take a good while for me to shake off that korma. Good luck!

Over cooked and over priced steak (32oz tomahawk ribeye). Ordered rare and got closer to medium. I don't mind eating medium but the meat was still bland tasting. 

Small tables that are crammed close to other tables (even worse with the winter coats hanging off the back of the chairs).

Drinks and apps were good but for a $300 dinner definitely didn't get experience.

I'm from Los Angeles and we found this spot on Yelp. As we was in line a guy who worked here walked up with open food container pile up high and had it leaning against his dirty shirt. Then as we approached the counter to order are food a baby roach was on the counter top by the cashier. When we told him he tried to kill it with the EBT machine, but it turned me off so we left without getting food.

This is my favorite coffee house in New Orleans. I am not really into 'fancy' coffee; I usually get a small cup of whatever is somebody's darkest roast, or at most a cafe au lait. The reason I love Luna is the location itself, the space in which you consume whatever you got, whether inside or outside. Something about the porch's design keeps air moving even in the summer, I comfortably read quite a few books out there despite the heat. Good place to work, meet people, sit and ponder the world. Reasonably quiet inside, a busy but not terrible intersection, great to walk or bike to and easy to park within a block on a side street. Just far enough from Tulane and Loyola not to be overrun with students, but close enough to be convenient to those most dedicated to the ambiance.
We sat at the bar and had a great experience chatting with the bar manager and exec chef. Learned about local culture and had some awesome drinks made from house distilled liquor. Highly recommend.

I was hesitant to dine at a chain across the street from the mall, etc.  However, the food was good except the chewy calamari.  The fried zuchinni was excellent!!  Service was excellent!  We had the steak and spaghetti with meatballs--I probably wouldn't get either again but the quality was decent.  Pricepoint was average.  I wouldn't make this place a destination but in a pinch I wouldn't avoid it.

Maybe it was cause I was starving stuck in the office late, or something, but this place was amazing when I got some takeout! 

I ordered the vegetarian platter with spinach & mushroom pie for $10 which came with hummus & pita and salad. 

I'd give this place 4 stars because the spinach & mushroom pie wasn't great (too shroomy and spinach tasted frozen) but the salad and hummus rocked my world so whatevs.. I'll just opt for another one of the vegetarian options next time. 

Everything tasted well seasoned and authentic. The salad was fresh (hard tomatoes and crunchy lettuce lol). Next time I want to ask for something spicy! I was stuffed halfway through. 

Def adding this place to my lunch rotation.

We ordered food to go and we had to wait longer than usual because they did not have enough people working. The quality of food has gone down and the prices have gone up from the last time we visited.

Food: 2.5 stars
Service: 4.5 stars
Ambiance: 4 stars

Overview: A great place to go if you want to impress your date, when your date requires no complexity in his/her food.

Food:
The food was incredibly underwhelming.  Admittedly, we were using a Groupon menu.  But the point of the Groupon, as I understand it, is to point a diner to the best (affordable) dishes in hopes that they return at full price.  Well, even those dishes are entirely not memorable.  Nothing was bad, but these prices can get you better food elsewhere in St. Louis.

Service:
Service was on point.  No complaints.

Ambiance:
We sat indoors, which might have prevented fully experiencing the highlight of the restaurant - the outdoor patio.  (Even then, the view still is not as interesting as the former Top of the Riverfront restaurant.)  The indoor seating is comfortable, well-designed, and tables are spaced apart appropriately.  The venue is a bit loud to be a very intimate atmosphere.

Stopped by for lunch today.  Pablo had the crab bisque and was delighted, thick chunky and orange.  I had the tomato pesto cream linguine, almost did not as the word pesto scares me but I am glad I threw caution to the wind, it was delicious, not really pesto like at all, just  sundried tomato and not too creamy.  We  did not partake of anything else but lashings of pomegranate lemonade.  Check came to $26.  
Glad to see Happy hour from 3.00pm - 7.00pm and $5 well/wine and appetizers and half price beer.  Service was A-OK 
Still not crazy about this location. lots of outdoor seating but too much traffic.

My favorite African restaurant in Philly. I never have a bad experience here. The staff is helpful and food is consistent and inexpensive. The chicken joloff is amazing and is enough to feed four people. It has a strong kick so I would recommend if you want something that will leave your tongue numb while leaving you wanting more! I would recommend this spot to anyone looking to try something when they get bored with the usual fare of burgers, pizza, Chinese, Japanese or pho.

I love the red curry.  My friends love the Evil Jungle Princess.  My husband loves the Pad Thai, extra peanuts and spice...  The food is so fresh.  I would love to eat there at least once a week.  Don't let the strip mall exterior distract you.  It is intimate and pretty inside.

We had the roasted chicken, pimento deviled ham and cheese plate! 
Oh my goodness so yummy!
We had the greens beans w bacon!AMAZING!

EVERYTHING WAS FRESH, And delish! 

He drinks were good, service was great, prices were good,overall a great experience! I would highly recommend!

I live in Boca Raton and everytime I come to St. Pete's with my girlfriend, our must-stop for breakfast/brunch is always Social Roost. Hands down the best breakfast experience you can ask for; the ambience, service and the food...oh, the food. We love the pork belly hash with scrambled cheesy eggs - so but so delicious! My gf from Kentucky says that their collard greens are the best she has ever had. Other menu selections offer a variety of yummy dishes that we have to return to explore. If you come to St. Pete's, you have to stop by for the ultimate gastronomic experience.

Service was less than stellar, I understand due to covid some adjustments have been made, but waiting over an hour for service is unacceptable. The hostess Bella was amazing though, she made sure we were taken care of and constantly checked on us to make sure we were doing well.

My friends and I came here after stopping at a place near the Skyway to watch the sunset. We were hungry and didn't want to venture into the other crowded areas on St. Pete Beach. This place was crowded for a Saturday night, but we were still able to find seats at the bar. 

We were able get very cheap drafts of PBR (most of their drafts are domestic or Canadian lagers) as well as various appetizers and entrees. I ended up ordering the grouper sandwich (blackened) with fries. The food was just OK. I liked the fries more than the grouper, as it didn't taste as fresh as other local restaurants. I did enjoy the fried green beans as an appetizer, though, and my friends enjoyed the hot wings. The bartenders are on top of it here, so I'll give them that. 

The interior of the place is very hole in the wall with views of the water. You feel like you're on an old ship when you're inside. It's a cool spot to feel like you're stepping back in time to old Florida. However, food and drinks are just OK.
Great food and great service.  They were super accommodating in helping with our 6, 4 and 2 year old.  We split the brisket and the pastrami and both were very good!  Will come again!

This was my first time visiting Max Brenner with my fiance, my friend, and her boyfriend. 

We were not sure if we wanted to come here or to Buddakan. Since we were not sure and chose Max Brenner about an hour before arriving, we did not make a reservation. 

We arrive and ask the hostess how long the wait will be, and she says THREE. HOURS. We decide to look at the chocolate shop for a bit. 

The bar area that they have in the back does not require reservations, and that is kind of like a "first come/first serve" scenario. Luckily, my friend and I decided to check out the bar, saw some open space, and waved over our men to sit down. There were four of us, but only three stools. We originally asked a waitress if we could grab one of stools at a nearby table since no one was sitting there, but she said no. 

We were really sad and were about to leave, but we decided to ask the bartender if we were able to snag the seat and she said yes, so we took it. 

Our bartender/waitress at the bar was AMAZING. I don't remember her name, but she had glasses and gave us AWESOME recommendations, as well as remembering our ENTIRE order PERFECTLY, was really friendly and sweet, was kind enough to split the bill for us when we asked, and gave us to-go bags with forks!! 

I had the Hazelnut Chocolate milkshake, my fiance had the Oreo hot chocolate made with dark chocolate, my friend had the Mexican hot chocolate and her boyfriend also had the hazelnut chocolate milk shake. ALL THE DRINKS WERE DELICIOUS. Sooo rich. Divine. 

My fiance ordered the waffle fries with cheese and bacon as an appetizer and they were so incredibly delicious. 11/10!!

My fiance ordered the mac and cheese burger, my friend and I both ordered the mac and cheese and added crispy chicken, and her boyfriend ordered chicken Alfredo. So delicious!! We were all considering getting dessert, but were wayyy too full. The portions are VERY generous for the price. I only ate 1/4 of my food and boxed the rest up and split it again with my fiance the next day!! 

This place is awesome, but DEFINITELY reserve a table!! I'll be coming back again with my fiance and his brother next month! :)

Sorry, but this establishment should not be compared to a Mastro's. The ambiance was nice and the live jazz on Saturday night was a plus. However, how does a server at this type of fine dining restaurant not know what charred rare is? Also, can we please have some bread for the 3rd time was just annoying. The steaks served were not that great.

So gross. Dont waste your time with the food here, its the equivalent to Panera for Mexican food. Somewhere between taco bell and Chevys. Poorly seasoned meat, way too greasy, and just not very authentic tasting. But, they get a one star bump for being open late. You can get quesodillas and nachos until 3am
Oysters are absolutely fabulous . The sevice on the other hand has a lot to be desired, this is at the downtown location in the Hilton Hotel.

I wish I could leave zero stars.  This place essentially just stole from me.  I went in there for takeout.  It took them 24 minutes to prep a grilled cheese sandwich at 10pm.  That seems like a pretty long time.  They offered me no water or anything else while I waited.  On their takeout menu, they have an entire section called "32 Ounce To-Go Beverages," and I ordered one of those.  They brought out my drink in a 24oz cup (if that).  I asked the bartender, who took the takeout order and my money if it was a 32oz cup.  She informed me that they only have one cup size.  I noted that they had an entire section on their menu for 32oz drinks and that she'd charged me for the 32oz drink.  She said they'd only ever had the one size of takeout cup and looked at me as if I was being unreasonable.  So, am I being unreasonable?  The menu charges 3.99 for a 32oz drink.  I get charged 3.99 but don't receive a 32oz drink.  Am I wrong to be annoyed?  Certainly the bartender looked at me like I was being an annoying hassle and not a mischarged customer.
Had experience dealing with Tony - very rude customer service. Food was mediocre too! Wasted my money here and will never go back again.

Unbelievable! Order food at 11pm. At 11:45, I asked about my food. They forgot to make my order. Requested my money back; was told to wait while they made 5 ice cream cones. I waited, and was then told they do not know how to refund money. They had to call someone. I left at midnight hungry and $45 poorer. You're welcome for the donation. First and LAST time ~ didn't even get to taste the food.

not very impressed. Italian restaurant without a good selection of soup!!!  Only one type and it has ham. When I got to select a drink, they did not offer any flavored iced tea. Just regular iced tea.
The Lombardo salad is not that impressive either. Too much cheese. They put the whole salad in a small plate and every time I touched it, the cheese fell all over the table.
Waiting for my Fettucini Primavera. I will write another review for that after I finish.
Great Colombian food, great music, and ambiance. Truly enjoyed the restaurant and people, felt very welcomed and I will be back !

After a disappointing dinner in this area, my partner and I came across this bubble tea shop. It was one of the most delicious and refreshing teas we've had in TN. I was surprised they weren't more customers there. When you drink it, it didn't feel like it had an overwhelming amount of sugar or intense flavors like other places. It was a great end of the day treat.

Amazing Acai Bowls! 

I tried the strawberry-banana-nutella-peanut butter one and it was delicious!
Absolutely love the atmosphere here and all staff is very helpful. Cocktails and small bites on menu are unique and delicious!
Jessica Mader is the best!!!!! She is kind, patient, warm, friendly, outstanding, and a kick ass bartender!!!! This is my first visit here and won't be my last. I highly recommend this place.
Pete's is a great local pizza place. Bummed that they changed their fries! They used to have such delicious fries, and now they are the more standard fries to see around. A shame! But love Pete's.

Then only reason they got 2 stars is because the customer service was crappy! Rude. Rude. Rude. Horrible phone customer service. Horrible Im restaurant service. Oh but if I were a nice young man I would've been greeted with a hug kiss and a high five! 

Now the food- my pambaso was like 2 bites (3.99) however it was tasty. And that ceviche bowl (raw shrimp) was sooooo delicious. I would go back just for that!!!
Simple Mexican restaurant hits all the right notes with ample portions fit for hard working folk all served with a smile.
The menu is pretty boring. Fish and chips in a brewery should be fresh and beer battered, not fried frozen. Seriously disgusting food.

I have been waiting to come here!

I've heard the absolute best things about this place, but we can never get a reservation. 

And wow does it stand up to its reputation!

The food is phenomenal, the ambiance is perfect and the service is impeccable!
I was so wowed by the small plates and their pita bread? Hands down the best pita I've had. 

I could've ordered 3 of the blue crab hummus just as my meal and them enough to take some home. 
We actually ordered one to go because it was just that good!

I can't wait to come here again. 

Fantastic food!
Cheese steak was great! Service was fast. Bring cash, they charge a $1 service fee for credit cards (eye roll)

I really like Serafina for a hip and still casual restaurant and bar in Rittenhouse.  The bar scene is fun and vibrant. The wine isn't great but the service is very good.  All of the food I have eaten there; the seafood, salads, bread, pizza.... All has been really good. I would recommend for small groups and dates.  I will keep going back!

My biggest problem is the frozen New Zealand green mussels. Please just get fresh mussels. Makes me worry about the clams. Otherwise portions are big. Pasta is pretty good. Burgers are decent. Reasonable prices.

Mmmhhmm. DELICIOUS food! The establishment itself was pretty sketchy but the chicken was amazing! I had the chicken tenders meal which was juicy and very flavorful. The breading is unique with a little extra jazz to it. Will definitely be going back but will get it to go. 5 stars for food but only 1 for the actual place itself.
Great omelets. Visiting Tampa for business and found this little gem.
Food is very good - and always something going on. Just outside the Quarter and well worth stopping in for a pint or an enjoyable dinner.
Being a native Southern Californian I love Mexican food and I come out to NOLA for work once a quarter. That being said, this place is actually really good. I'll definitely come back again.
I went to the Gyro House simply to order a gyro. I assumed that since this is the name on the door, it must be what they do best. I was right. Delicious.
Solid selection in the Hyde Park area. Owners are really friendly. Gave me a pint glass for buying a bunch of brew. Also, there is a small deli in the back.

THE BEST BARBER SHOP IN TAMPA!
From California to Atlanta to Tampa, no one has cut me the way these people do. As a black boy in a predominantly white area (Clearwater) I was suspicious about the shop. But once I got in and got my hair cut. I've LONGED the day for when I can come back. Shoot that's today honestly!

Tried their dum sum under new management today. Food was OK. They increased price for dum sum. Small item 4.99/each, medium item $5.5/each. We used to pay for 3 sesame balls for $2.95, now $4.99. We caught they stamped more numbers on the ticket than what we ordered. We asked them to check again and they did. They asked us to pick something else for that extra charge so they didn't have to fix the ticket. This is sad. Bad customer service.

Cafe Lift is a welcome addition to Philadelphia's growing brunch scene.  Located just north of Center City, this BYO offers unique takes on classic brunch staples as well as inventive dishes of their own.  I've been a couple times and honestly don't know why I don't go back more often.

Walk in the front door and up the steps and look around.  You'll notice young professionals, students, and couples sitting all around the cute little tables, and colorful chalkboards displaying the daily specials.  You may have a hard time ordering something; not because the wait staff is rude or hard to come by (they're extremely attentive), but because everything on the menu looks incredible.  This morning, my boyfriend and I tried a mix of both sweet and savory: he got the Lemon-Ricotta pancakes while I opted for the Eggs Florentine.  His pancakes were light, fluffy, and not overly sweet; served with fresh strawberries, cream, and honey.  My dish was a new take on Eggs Benedict; subbing in crabmeat for the canadian bacon, adding sauteed spinach, and serving the dish atop toasted foccacia covered in a light truffle-infused hollandaise sauce.  Perfectly portioned, everything tasted delicious and didn't leave me feeling sleepy or sick.

While parking may be a bit of an issue if you get there when it's busy (street parking is limited), the food and ambiance is worth the trip. Also, make sure you visit an ATM before you go; this place does NOT take credit cards.  Overall, Cafe Lift could possibly be your next favorite brunch spot.
The RH burger is by far my favorite! My boyfriend and I had a great meal here. The atmosphere was fantastic, the staff  professional, and extremely friendly. I would highly recommend

I went in with high hopes after seeing all the reviews praising the food and service and left with a lot to be desired. The service wasn't bad, but maybe a little under average. Seems like there's a few times they forgot about us and it took longer than expected to get our orders in or get then than other places despite it not being too busy. The baked mussels were probably some of the best I've had at a sushi place. The Nigerian was good, but rather small. The rolls? Meh! They were fine. I didn't experience anything wether it be the food or service that would make this my go to spot in the future. There's so many options in Reno that I would most likely go elsewhere or continue to try newer places before coming back, but wouldn't be against going if someone I know wanted to go there.

Dominos has made improvements from where they used to be, but are still light years away from the pizza New Jerseyans' know and expect. In some ways, their pizza is like doritos- it's an explosion of confusing flavors in your mouth. But when you need a good slice, this isn't the place to turn. Their toppings are unimaginative and each slice lacks that handmade quality you could get a few blocks away. I generally also have a stomacheache within an hour of finishing. I do appreciate their proximity, easy online ordering, and rapid production. They frequently have deals that are hard to match elsewhere. And finally, they're one of the few places that stay open late in Camden (everything in the city seems to close at sundown). But there's a lot to be said about why I've only eaten here 3 times in 3 years, despite living next door...

Not a bad place for dinner. The Meal Deal is a pretty good deal. However, I was disappointed with the service- the waitress didn't crack a smile once! I was also disappointed with the quality of fries since our fries were lukewarm when we got them. The burger was nice, tasty, and properly cooked. Also, I thought it was a little weird our burger took longer to cook than other customers' and we got less fries on our plate than the people next to us. Does getting the Meal Deal mean you get warm fries and have to wait longer? The ice cream was yummy but the whole experience was kind of ruined by then.

I've been following Mac Mart on Instagram for over a year and a half and I can now finally say that I was able to make my dreams into a reality. 

Yes it's absurd that they can charge 9 dollars for a small *reusable* tupperware filled with noodles and cheese. But are they able to get away with it? Yes. 

I ordered the jalapeno popper Mac and my sister got the Rittenhouse. I'll start off by saying that the classic Mac base is amazing on its own. A cheesy pile of beautiful noodles. Tbh I didn't order the jalapeno popper dish because I particularly like heat, but because it had the word cream cheese in it and I eat that shit with a spoon on the regular. Cream cheese on top of Mac and cheese? Sold. It wasn't too spicy anyway (I asked for no jalapeno oil, which apparently is where most of the heat comes from). Not once did my nose drip and I did not begin to perspire, which generally happens to me when I eat anything more spicy than a mild buffalo wing. 

My sister liked hers, which was topped with a garlicy spinach and artichoke dip. I had a few bites of hers and liked mine better.  

Although the tupperware is small, they do pack a lot of food into it. Regardless, I could have finished the entire thing in one serving. About halfway through I began to feel a little full, which is usually when people decide to stop eating. That's not typically the case for me, I often take it as a challenge to clear my plate. Also i have no self control. However, my sister did and decided to save some of hers for later. I didn't want to, but the idea of watching her eating more later with none for myself, inspired me to follow suit. 

You may be thinking to yourself "it's just Mac and cheese", but ok really there's no such thing bc all Mac and cheese should be idolized and imo no Mac and cheese is bad Mac and cheese unless you accidently step on it. 

This place is worth the hype and everyone should check it out at least once!

Dropped in for lunch during the work day.  2 of us received quick service and cold beer from a large selection.  Ate oysters 2 ways, casino style were very good.  Quick lunch, in and out.  Good service.

Absolutely wonderful service and food. Hubby and I visited Tampa for a short vacation, and stumbled upon Mirage on Yelp. Went at 10:30 at night hoping it would be open, and lo and behold, it was open and the staff so warm and welcoming. The wine was great, food so incredibly fresh and delicious. Highly recommend the chicken shish kabab. The owners were so nice, it truly made the meal special. You can tell this restaurant is a family business, and they have regulars stopping by all the time. In our 4 day trip, we visited once again, surprised that the owners remembered us and treated us like family! How wonderful. Highly recommend!

My waitress was Vanessa and I received the best service from her! I felt loved me she bent over backwards for us. The atmosphere was chill and welcoming and everything came out the way I wanted ! I would definitely go back and visit this place again! Try the quiche if you go !!!! It's the best!! Ooooohhhh the Manmosas aren't so bad either!!!!!!

I really wish I could give zero stars because when  I was babysitting I went here and as soon as we sat down the workers started talking about sex tapes and it made me and the girl I was babysitting really uncomfortable. I get the workers must be close to each other but they shouldn't be talking about that during work hours especially since they were basically yelling and there were little kids there too. I definitely wouldn't recommend this place to my friends and I'm never going here again.
Good food. Solid service. Really good margaritas. NO WIFI!?! Come on now, your right out side Maryland farms, gotta have wifi. Sorry, the no wifi cost you a star.

Still five stars and doing a brilliant job with safety--best place in New Orleans on that score

And the fried chicken remains in the top five of the nation in my book. My extended family completely enjoyed themselves, especially the 95 year young one who was out in a public restaurant for the first time since the pandemic. Thanks High Hat!!

Today's visit was rough. They were clearly not prepared or staffed for "day after Christmas" traffic. Ham and cheese croissant had a slight freezer burn taste to it. They put one latte in a cup and the other in a "to-go" cup. Ummmm no, I ordered food and 2 lattes for consumption in house. If the lattes hadn't taken 15 min to get I might have had them remake the one, but whatever. They were out of Lox, I ordered a quiche 10 min after ordering told they didn't have the quiche I asked for so fine, substitute again. After seriously another 20 min. Still no food I ask, was just told they are "backed up" and server refused to provide a time estimate when pressed. Many others were beyond frustrated as well. Finally get food that is clearly premade elsewhere and heated up and the edges are over cooked as microwaves can do. Do yourself a favor and don't order food. The last two visits have also had some "to cool for school" attitudes from workers. The one on Main Street never has the air or pretension the this one seems to. Time to break up for a while.

What can I say...I love it here!  

The food is amazing!  The service is amazing!  The salsa is amazing!  

The environment is comfortable a pleasantly relaxing.  We are treated like family every time we come in.  

Thank you!
Out of all the three Indian eateries in University City, I would rank Tandoor as #3. The food was OK (could use more variety), but it was just the atmosphere that did not quite sell to me.

Trash. Told them I have two separate orders and they couldn't do that. So I was going to go inside the lobby to make it easier and it's locked. So you guys don't like money?? It's not hard!! Foods just crap and I hope they shut this place down.
This place has the best oxtails I have ever eaten! Desserts are out of this world. Especially the guava cheesecake! And smoked Gouda Mac and cheese to die for!
A great sports bar on the edge of the Quarter.  This is a go-to place to watch a game, have some good food, and enjoy a cold beverage.
Excellent food and always cozy atmosphere with history where the locals like to go and hang out. We had the BBQ pork sliders and the Santa Fe salad and both were excellent.
Love the giant slices. They have done a lot of renovations to both locations putting in a bar and pool tables. I just go for a good slice. Much better than  Mammas.

This location does not provide video surveillance for customers eating at this location.  My wallet was stolen from my bag yesterday. According to the Willow Grove Police, it is not unusual for people to have things stolen due to the lack of security surveillance in the dining area.  The counter and the main entrance are covered by video surveillance. But not the dining area. 

Be aware of people sitting in close proximity of you, it only takes these thieves a second to steal from you.

The flavors of this place are great. I can't deny that one bit.

My only gripe is the portion sizes are painfully small. My pad thai was in a very small container and my immediate thought was, this is not worth the price.

Wife's green curry came int he same container, but when you consider that it comes with rice in a separate container, you realize that since rice is whats actually filling you up, that's fine.
Excellent service, amazing food and atmosphere.... Staff very helpful and friendly, especially our server Amanda...
Came here spur the moment for breakfast. The place was empty which surprised me cause the food was very good! The theme was super fun too. Lots of '50 memorbilia.

So glad we tried this new restaurant out. The food was excellent! I couldn't believe how busy they were having only been open one month. If they keep serving food like I had last night they will remain that busy. Even with a full house, our food came out quickly and our server Jamie was very attentive and a pleasure. Our table shared the crab cake and BBQ shrimp apps, both were so good. I highly recommend the entree I had called eggplant Barbara. Fried eggplant round served over Cajun creamy pasta LOADED with crawfish and shrimp. Delicious! We'll be back for sure!

Found this place about 4 years ago when visiting the Rum Distillery around the corner.....BEST FIND EVER!!!!!!!!!! When you find a place packed with locals you know it's gonna be great!!!! Love the Red Beans and and Rice!!!!!! Love the shrimp Po  Boy!!!!! Love the potato salad!! LOVE LIVE TJIS PLACE! Eat there every time I go to or through NOLA!!!!!  Parking is crazy but well worth eating here! Saw some of the one star reviews and imok with them not going back since I love the place... Will make parking easier lol

I just finished my second sandwich from Pedalers Deli this week. 

For my first visit I ordered the #4, the Tricycleclub. I chose the Jalapeno Cheddar bread. I ordered the #4 just as it's described on the menu. It was fantastic. I knew that day I'll be coming back. I was jonesing to try the #13, the Pedalerstrami...

Today I went back to get that #13. I ordered it with French Bread and asked to hold the lettuce but that's because I almost always hold the lettuce on my sandwiches. And this is another home run. It's warmed on a Panini press and the flavor of this sandwich is awesome.

The bread here is fresh and soft and the choices are great.

So far after two visits, I'm delighted with the sandwiches here! These are fantastic sandwiches, folks!

I'll be coming back often!

The food at OM is invariably high quality - vastly better than what I imagine you would get at a typical Asian buffet (much better than at Sushi Garden, although the selection is much smaller at OM). However, they consistently are slow to replenish the lunch buffet, which leads to a lot of sitting around waiting for food to come out. That isn't much fun when one is hurrying to finish lunch.

This is my go to wing spot. Their wings are always so crispy and the sauces are great too.

The wings are battered, which is why I love them so much. The wings aren't fatty either which is also why I love them so much. My favorite sauce is the Thai chili glaze-it's one of the best sauces I've ever had. Sweet heat is also really good. It's not too spicy, which I like, but if you are looking for a hotter wing I'd recommend getting a hotter sauce. The only sauce I really didn't like was the honey bbq-it was too thick for my taste and had a weird consistency.

They also have the best garlic parmesan fries, although I try not to order them every time I go (so I won't feel as bad about myself after eating them). They are greasy, but that's the best part!

The staff is also very nice. Every time I've been here, I've always been greeted with a smile and they were eager to answer any questions i've had.

The first time we experienced Irene's was several years ago when we were walking down the street and smelled simething incredible.  They are a must do on our list for New Orleans now!  Make a reservation because they do get busy.  The food is incredible!  I personally prefer their lamb and duck.  The service is always phenominal!

I have been here twice for brunch and once for dinner. The service is always spot-on, and the food (especially dinner) is masterfully balanced. There is a mixture of typical American fare and more unique items on the menu, so I think anyone can find something they want to eat here. Check it out!

Definitely a similar theme to the Rainforest Cafe, but without the cool animals. They have bird noises, flickering lights, water trickling down to sound like rain, & a lot of greenery.

For $21.99 per person, there are a lot of options to choose from, and for the price, it's decent. The quality of the food is average - there wasn't anything I ate which prompted me to go back for a 2nd taste. However, it seemed like most guests enjoy the seafood line. They have crab legs that are sliced in half & readily available to eat. Minimal work to stuff your face, hooray! 

They took awhile to clear out all of our dishes (we had a party of 6 at the table) but were helpful bringing out beverages and asking if everything was okay. 

Overall, it was decent, but I'm sure there are better buffets in Reno to eat at.

Fairly busy when we went.  The restaurant does a good job of socially distancing customers which makes for a quiet and more personal dining experience.  The staff was extremely friendly and were quick to check in to see if you needed anything, extremely pleased with the table service we received.  

We ordered the Green Curry and the Pad Zee Eew.  Both came promptly.  The Green Curry was my favorite, with lots of bamboo shoots and green peppers.  The Pas Zee Eew noodles were tasty as well.  The only criticism for both of the dishes was that the flavor wasn't near as strong for both so I ended up combing the dishes together to try to add some of the curry spice to the Pas Zee Eew.   

Friendly neighborhood Thai restaurant!
Great menu, something for everyone. Bowls, sushi, salads, entrees. On of my go-to spots here in tampa. Cool vibe on the weekends as well
Love this place in the funk zone. All the food is outstanding and the service is top notch. Love the romantic setting too. Cool patio as well. Will definitely be back!

I'd heard so many awesome reviews. Decided to try today. Had cheese steak without onions and peppers,way too much bread. Could have used more meat and mushrooms. One tasted one mushroom. For fast food,it's a little pricey. Eventually I'll probably give it a second try. Hopefully it'll be better.So far nothing special.

Ate here the other night.  Still being on ny time we get that about 5:45 and we had no line.  There were 4 in our party, 2 adults and 2 kids.  My youngest eats nothing so be ordered macaroni and cheese with a side of mac and cheese from the kids menu which was delicious.  The rest of us ordered different dishes and sides to taste everything.  Nothing disappointed us.  Keith, the manager, stopped at our table and when he learned that we were from ny and tasting all southern food, he brought us samples of some of the things we did not order.  Keith also brought us a molasses/agave type of spread that is available to all but you need to request it.  Keith taught us to mix this with butter and spread on a biscuit.  This was amazing!  So was the hasbrown casserole, creamed corn, fried chicken, hot chicken, stringbeans, pork and catfish.  We liked the city ham better than country ham.  Skip the fried green tomatoes.
No refills on fountain drinks? $2.49 each or $5.19 for a pitcher? That's enough to keep me and my Diet Coke Crew from coming back.

This review is solely based on their lunch buffet. We wanted a quick lunch in the area, and it was either buffet or meat and 3. Service was good, the hostess/waitress was nice and informative. The food choices had an average variety for a sushi buffet. There was about 8 different sushi rolls - 4 simple rolls, 4 'exotic' rolls. However, they did not do a very good at replenishing them. I understand the need to have fresh sushi; however, the entire 30 min duration we were there. The titan roll never got refilled. And the others were very minimal. The rolls itself were very disappointing, very little shrimp/fish, and I'm pretty sure I had a bad tuna. The crunchy shrimp was stale. They also had chicken teriyaki, fried rice, pork and vegetable stir-fry, glass noodles, fried dumplings, and salad. The stir-fry was extra salty, and everything else was mediocre. The glass noodles was the best thing we ate there. At $11 per person, we most certainly, did NOT eat our money's worth. To summarize our experience, we should have went to Vittles.

Serving sizes are huge and moderately priced. Service was quick considering how busy it was. Food quality was good but all drinks were watered down. Staff was VERY friendly. They definitely need a kids menu considering how big the serving sizes are. Definitely a good local spot for out of towners.

Worst experience EVER! We were too tired to go drive anywhere so we decided to just check this place out. 

We got seated immediately and that made me happy. However It took our server about 15-20 mintues to just greet us and take our orders. We got water and bread from the busser/bus boy. Once we order we noticed there were 3 empty tables. So we're eating our bread and the tables slowly starts to fill up. The tables are quite close together, so I coudn't help but notice how we got our soup the same time the table next to us did. 

Worst of all is when the server dropped off the soup. So the tables are really close, she decides to place herself in the middle of the two tables, stretch her arm out, and she facing the wall while she's doing this and she lowers her arms to put the soup bowl down without trying to see if it would spill or not. Why did she do that? Why can't she face one table, put the soup down and turn around face the other table and put the soup down? I just don't freaking get it..Anyhow luckily the bf grabbed the bowl from her before she completely let go because she placed it on his silverware. The soup was about to topple over. 

So beside the fact that she didn't think correctly why is our soup 25 mintues later? So as we sat the two other tables have already received their entrees..Um wth? We were here first. This is a total about maybe 35-40 mintues later, the waitress comes by and stated that the Chef didn't like how my salmon was cooked so he had to recook it. WTH? 

I was thinking off the bat "Alright if he's actually doing that I better get a salmon that is not overcooked, because I'm going to throw some elbows". Okay not literally, but you know what I mean..

Anyhow of course when I received the fish it was super over cooked. I thought it was me just upset since we waited an hour for our food. The bf tasted it and we cut the fish apart to see how it was cooked, it was SUPER OVERCOOKED! How can you do that after making me wait for 1 hour? 

I super upset, the waitress didn't offer to help me out too much, I just told her that this wait is unacceptable and she just said ok. She didn't apologize. Another person came along, I'm not sure who she is but I saw her servering other table but she apologized and asked if I wanted another dish, she even offered me dessert. They took the fish out of the bill. I did not eat it after my one bite, I was super upset about the service. 

So Never AGAIN! How do they even get four stars?
Full slab baby backs - $13,99, I'm all in. Probably the best ribs I've ever had. Truly exceptional. Good job Sonny's. Getting very close to that 5th star.
Amazing experience!  Great service.  Very nice lounge area.  Takes you out of Oldsmar while dining!  Delicious and fair prices!  Extensive dessert menu as well.

When I spent a long spell down south in my youth, I became mildly obsessed with Bojangles chicken and biscuits.  When I returned north later in life, I longed for that Bo, y'all.  Well, they've finally opened something even better, right on 130 across from Howard Hill of all places!  I can't eat fast food like I used to, but this is better than most fast food and is potentially addictive just like Bo was back in the day.

The chicken tenders are huge and fresh and perfectly breaded and seasoned (just enough kick).  The fries are crinkle cut and seasoned too.  The biscuits are topped with a honey-spread.  The inside is clean and well lit and has wood top tables and metal chairs.  What more could you ask for?  Puts Popeyes to shame.

Had late Sunday morning breakfast.
1. Almond milk latte was strong
2. Salmon avocado toast with delicious
3. Two eggs and a croissant were also great
4. Lastly, we try to piece of a cake called African something and it was outstanding.

The place itself is very very cute with a nice little outdoor area sitting. Hi Lou recommended to anybody who wants to have a cup of coffee or breakfast in French quarter.

We had to make a stop on our way up north. It was a wonderful experience. The manager and staff are all super friendly. Also, very welcoming. The restrooms and tables are kept clean. The manager made sure that the lines were spaced out and receiving their orders. Thank you to the staff for providing us with excellent service. We appreciate you.

Went on a Friday afternoon and had a pretty lousy experience overall. Poor service: it took 15 minutes for the waiter to come back with a refill for a glass of water, he forgot to bring us the check and then forgot to split it. Then it took another 15 minutes to get the correct check. The bathrooms smelled REALLY strongly of sewage. Meatball hoagie was dry, cold and the bread was stale. I won't be back and was very disappointed.

Came with a group of 32 women in my industry for a party during our convention.  Everyone loved their food and the venue was fantastic too!  They were willing to divide our checks and everything cane our hot and accurate.
best pizza i have ever had in philadelphia. good pasta dishes and a decent cheesesteak. i am a regular.

Why God why did I try this place?!?   I was perfectly happy not knowing how freaking delicious the food is here.  I was looking for something besides pizza or Chinese food for delivery when McAlisters Deli popped up as a place that delivers.  Turns out that they only deliver for catering but they do have curbside service and an app for ordering.  So I downloaded the app and ordered enough food for dinner and next day lunch.  The app worked great and the curbside service was fantastic.  The food was so well prepared.  The nachos for two came deconstructed so they weren't a soggy mess by the time I got home with them.  In fact I was actually able to save them for lunch today.  Such yummy, crispy, gooey, cheesy, goodness. I love French Dip Sandwiches and have had a lot of them over the years.  This French Dip sandwich was the best I've ever had.  The Best!  I initially thought they were a little over priced but for this kind of quality, it is worth every penny.  I shouldn't talk about how wonderfully delicious the chocolate cake is because I should never have eaten it. I am not a big fan of ganesh (not sure about the spelling) but I think it was a main ingredient in this cake, and it was sinfully awesome.  One tip for the super friendly and energetic staff member that delivered the food to my car.  Bring back change in smaller bills when possible.  I would have tipped you a few dollars but I didn't have any ones.  The last thing I needed was to try a restaurant like this and fall in love at first bite.  I'm absolutely coming back but I will have to fast before and after eating your food.  Your place is a permanent replacement for Subway, Arby's, Schnucks Deli, and sometimes Panera.
Greasy, slippery floors. Sticky tables. Food so salty it is inedible. Ripping off 20-somethings who don't get the difference between trendy and good.

Love this place. First, super speedy delivery. Second, their pizza is bomb. Get it with pepperoni and additional garlic. Your place will smell like heaven. Third, all of their salads are ginormous, full of toppings, and awesome. I like the salad with goat cheese but all are great. Overall a solid delivery spot in Old City!

Probably the best customer service around! The owner makes you feel very welcome and is so sweet to everyone. The food here is always delicious and tastes super fresh. The homemade sauces that are brought to the table are amazing! I love them on the potato chips that come with the sandwiches. I highly recommend the pesto sandwich, but everything I have tried so far has been great!

Yes to everything here!
Food is delicious. Service was great. Must have the Risotto balls. Pizza is wood-fire oven made, fresh, crispy and delicious combinations. Lunch special is great- large portions of pasta and nice sized salad.

The food is decent. However, my friend ordered chicken wings and the and the bag was drenched in buffalo sauce. It was an absolute mess and nightmare to clean. I ordered a side of honey mustard and they should've just said no. They have the tiny packs of kens honey mustard. Anyone who loves honey mustard knows this is unacceptable. The food it's self isn't bad buuuut I won't order here again

We visited on Easter weekend to see Kermit Ruffins & the BBQ Swingers and have dinner. The show was very good and definitely worth the cover charge.

If you want to have dinner and watch the show make reservations early. They had us booked at a high table but we needed a low table and they graciously moved us.

The Little Gem Sparkler cocktail was great but the Old Cubano was just ok.

We had the Seafood Platter and the Fried Chicken - both were very good. The side mac and cheese was excellent.

Zoe was a wonderful server. We will be back again.
I AM IN LOVE WITH THIS PLACE!! Nothing negative to say except I wish it were open longer hours

Great local spot. It's as the name states. Pizza and wings. Both great options and the all American meal. 5 Stars because the people working are friendly and never had a true negative interaction.  Love supporting local small shops like this!! Delivery option is. Ice for those on a lazy Saturday or Sunday.

I am so sorry to write this review, I come here quite often. Lately I have been disappointed in the quality. I can get fresher, tastier fries at Burger King, mine on the catfish dinner were perhaps twice cooked with a third of them being outside skinny and over cooked pieces. The catfish were skimpy in size as well and cut long and very, very  thin. The hush puppies were overcooks and perhaps cooked ahead of time and just dipped in the oil once more before slamming them on the plate.  Someone needs to have a word with the cook these cost cutting methods are shameful. I know you can do better. The mac and cheese is fabulous and I do love the pickles they make. The BBQ shrimp is pretty amazing and generally they are  large delicious shrimp. One thing for sure the fried chicken is excellent. And oh yes, the bar service is silly slow. I love the people, and will try again soon.

Honestly this place was such a let down. The outdoor area is super cute and the place was very busy on a Friday, not sure why though. We got mocktails that our server recommended and they were pretty but lacked flavor. I got a bruschetta peach flatbread, there was nothing special about it, the peach and ricotta combination was summery but the assembly was messed and the flatbread was frankly burnt, and not just the edges. I also got fries which were perfectly fine but the sauce and so was the aioli the offering of the aioli though was no where enough for the amount of fries. My friend got the chicken skewer plater, it came with one skewer and no sides, kind of disappointing. Pretty for pics, food lacked substance and flavor. Will not be going back

My boyfriend and I got the Sweet and Sour Chicken bowl here and it was wonderful - the flavors were vibrant and fresh and I would return without a doubt. Love the casual interior, though it was a little warm while we dined. Either way, yummy food and a great lunch!
We highly recommend this restaurant, the service was great thank you Mr. Patrick. The food was great! We would go back in a heartbeat.
Great beer selection, excellent service, and fantastic Irish style pub food! I truly loved this place and the servers really made me feel welcome. The Crowley's Pie is a must!

Went here for a holiday family meal with the in laws- what a great dining experience.  I say "experience " because our waiter Rich had amazing suggestions and was spot on with guiding us through the menu to figure out what each person would like.  He was very attentive and everything we ordered was top notch delicious!!!  My daughter had the lobster bisque and this was on par with what we've had in "New England". My husband had the jambalaya- not an obvious choice but he raved about it.  Mother in law had Scallops and seafood Risotto.  They were tender and risotto full of seafood chunks.  This place was so great we can't wait to go back.
I will definitely book a reservation and ask for Rich as our waiter!!!!
Excellent burgers, but my favorite is the seafood platter or shrimp po-boy. Overall an excellent place to eat.
Excellent food, great prices. The rellano was so good. Mom had the fajitas, Anaia the beef enchiladas, Laura the chicken enchilada. A good tune was had by all. Great chips and salsa.

This place is always wonderful. Healthy and whole food options without sacrificing flavor. The FLTA is the signature sandwich in my opinion that gatwleways their great talent. Cheesy brushetta is beautifully balanced and is still lower in the carbs. The soups are masterful and always changing up so the experience stays fresh. The new teriyaki bowl keeps the sodium down and introduces whole grain but makes eating teriyaki a gourmet experience.

The service and seating rotation goes nicely and staff is warm and welcoming and non judfemental. Very nice.

The loss of 1 star is for the pricey and pretentious art and clientele. My other half and I are larger and we know and love our food! So when we are staring down the barrel of a debutante who feels the need to judge fellow customers sharing the road of experience; It makes me want to nuke society. Please drive your your eco sport box car off the back roads of Nevada and let the hillbillies have their way with you. 

I thought of whether or not the place should be dinged for these factors and I did come to peace with it. There is a way of welcoming healthy without supporting trendy. The art for example is for sale at only $400 per print. The photography prints tell me that the art community and the restaurant are keeping Burning Man people stoned and lazy...

Anyway go for the food!!! It is worth it!!!

I LOVE T&T!!! I love ethnic food markets but this one is so much more. 

They have several different ready-to-eat counters - the one along the wall near the bakery has a fantastic selection of food - you have to try the beef brisket stew with vegetable (can't remember what vegetable it is, could be Chinese carrot - and be warned - the meat is a little fatty and chewy but that it's my favourite), or spicy shrimp (I don't even bother taking the shell off), or try one of their barbeque combos, which is what I did today - got a mound of rice, veggies, a soy chicken leg, a good chunk of Chinese bbq pork, and a bowl of hot&sour soup, for only $6.99!! Can't beat that price for the amount of food you get!

Their sushi is ok - the spicy salmon roll is the best, and they have pretty good salmon sashimi and a pretty good chirashi bowl. They also have really good congee (I don't know what the seasoning is but it's soooo tasty), and chicken teriyaki bowls.

They also make a ready-to-go series that are different kinds of foods packaged in a little aluminum container and wrapped in plastic wrap, that you can bring home, steam for 20 minutes, and it's ready. My personal favourite is the black bean garlic spare ribs - better than what you get at dim sum - it's awesome with a bowl of steamed jasmine rice. The chicken feet and beef tripe are also very good, just like you would get at dim sum.

T&T is great for getting Chinese fruits, veggies, spices, weird cuts of meat (lots of organ meats), everything! They also carry Korean, Japanese, etc food stuff. 

Oh you can also buy bags of chicken and pork bones, which are great for making stock. Lots of live fish as well - they have great deals on the weekend on crab and lobster. 

So my point is... go!! It's awesome!

Food and beer was great. Our server Justin was great. Management however was terrible. We noticed quite a few times that while the servers were running around and working hard, the manager was on his phone. I work at a restaurant and have management that is always helpful on the floor. When the restaurant is busy, it should be management's responsibility to support the staff, especially during such tough times in the service industry. And that was not the case here.

I am never disappointed in this place. I've dined in before and really appreciate the customer service. I especially love their green curry sauce dishes and the level of heat they add. I like my food spicy but not to the point that it is inedible and they find the right balance. It is definitely one of the better Thai restaurants in the area.

Outstanding! Pricey as hell but f' it, don't care! EVERYTHING is made by this family run operation.
Their breads
Their pastries 
Their prepared foods
Their pizza (duh) ....
I mean they are so authentic they've an olive farm in Italy they import their own olive oil from!!!
Again, pricey as it gets but when I've got change to toss I bring it here. 
Carlino's is decades old and growing and everything I want in a delicatessen market.
I can't speak highly enough of their quality and authenticity.
Tops.

Small "dive" type atmosphere grill that is quite unique.  Al is very friendly and usually around to greet his guests.  The burger was very unique (a little spicy) and really tasty.  Hopefully an establishment that stays for a while. Definitely worth a visit! Look forward to trying the rest of the Southern fare.

This place has one of the best cheeseburgers I have ever had in my life. I was pleasantly surprised to find it in the French Quarter at a reasonable price! I'll definitely stop back by there next time I'm in town.

So, I was unimpressed by Bank & Bourbon. I went here the Wednesday before Thanksgiving and they were out of the top two things that I wanted from the menu (the scallops looked incredible, so I may have to go back when they are back in stock and update the review). 

We had a nice dinner, with relatively inattentive service. After ordering drinks (The Afterthought cocktail should not be its namesake, don't hesitate to order that beauty), it took a while to get them and then an even longer time to get out waitress' attention to order. 

Ambience wise, this place is very trendy despite being inside a hotel. The restaurant is pretty dimly lit and there are a few types of tables with different seating options like couch loungers. It seems good for groups as well.

For dinner, I had the Bronzino with roasted vegetables. It's a whole fish, but you  have the option of removing the head when served, which I requested. It was really buttery and rich. I couldn't finish it because I am not used to that amount of butter. The roasted veggies were pretty oily as well. My friend had the ahi tuna appetizer and a Brussel sprout salad as her dinner and she liked it. 

All in all, there are very few options for vegetarians, and some of the fish items even have bacon grease, so it's even tough for pescatarians. I am not anxious to recommend.

This place is really good. Nice atmosphere, great hosts, and really good food. We got several small dishes and shared them. I think our favorite was the cod in black bean sauce. We will definitely be back!

We went to dinner here on a weeknight and it was our very first time. What a wonderful experience! I don't remember what our waiter's name was, but he had sort of longish hair and glasses (I think). Well, I'd just like to say that he displayed EXCELLENT customer service. He was very informative and made sure we were well taken care of. 
The bread and olive oil that they serve every table with is outstanding. The pan fried edamame dumplings was probably the best appetizer I've ever had. My fiancé ordered the spicy shrimp pasta and I ordered the spinach pappardelle and we both thoroughly enjoyed our dishes. Mine had what felt like the most random ingredients that you don't think anyone could ever think of going together and it all tasted fantastic together. I was so impressed!
The only downside to this was the price... It wasn't a ton of food and we had about a $60 bill. Obviously not somewhere we'll just casually stop by to get a bite to eat, but definitely a great place for a date night!

Went after church on Sunday so they were pretty busy. Waited a while to be seated. Then waited along time for drink order. They took food order at same time. 

The ice tea did not taste fresh brewed. Fountain machine maybe. Would order the homemade bubble tea instead next time. 

The crab Rangoon's were tasty. Very generously crab cream cheese filled. Served hot but not greasy. 

My friend had the chicken clay pot. Said good but lacked spice and was just chicken no veggies..

I had the hot and sour catfish hot pot. Next time I would get shrimp since easier to eat in a soup and no deboning needed. Lots of very fresh vegetables which so really liked. Take with rice or I picked homemade noodles. The broth was good but not spicy. There is a few sauce bottles in table. Next time I would ask if they had any homemade hot sauces etc. 

Waited a while for bill. 


The busboy was attentive and stopped by a few times. 

The place has an easy to get in and out of location on 38th. I would pick a less busy time next time.

Yelpers have totally nailed it!
AMAZING food. Slow service. Totally worth it. It's a family run operation all the way through 3 generations (I think?), and they are friendly as can be, and cook everything fresh. The place gets totally packed because they are just that good. Expect to spend some time there. Enjoy the food. Don't worry so much, about anything. The food will be hot when it comes out an hour later - I guarantee it.

Oh and vegetarians, look no further. I think my first time at El Rancho a few years ago was the very first time I didn't feel out of place as a vegetarian at a table of meat eaters, the options are so accessible and varied.

Conveniently located off of 206, ample parking, friendly and very helpful staff. Reasonably priced entrees. The Philly Cheesesteak Omelette was very large and filling. Chose to have broccoli and tomatoes instead of the home fries and toast, waitress was willing to accommodate my wishes.  I definitely recommend their breakfast menu.  More than enough omelette choices to meet anyone's taste. Oh and if you like Butter Pecan ice cream you can't go wrong here as it is mouth watering and very buttery, they even top it with whipped cream.

This is one of th best Brazilian Steakhouses, compared to two others (one in SJ and the other north of Philly.

Food:
Well cooked and prepared. Meat preparation is executed well and delicious. LOVE their salad bar. I could eat my way through the entire salad bar, even if no meat was provided.

Service:
The 'waiters' (I forgot what they are called here) were attentive and came to check out our table many times.

Definitely make reservations ahead of time as it can get back in the off-shore season.

This place has been a favorite for a couple years. The quality just gets better. Brew Link rivals the best of Indy area (and beyond) brews and kills it on the pretzel sticks & beer cheese & stone ground mustard (YUM). They have a solid tenderloin, excellent Brisket Mac n Cheese, and a pretty darn good dessert of the week (currently brownie w/ vanilla ice cream & whipped cream). Go.

Kinda reminded me of home in NJ except the prices were much lower. I had the big old chili dog I saw pictured on Yelp. I also had the soup called hamburger soup. It and the HUGE chili dog were BOSS!!!!!! If you are ever seeing a Buc's game save your appetite for after the game and come here!!!!

After Jamie Oliver won the lawsuit against the king of fast food burgers, I really thought I would boycot them and have. I think it is unconscionable to take meat not fit for human consumption,  wash it in toxic chemicals and serve all of us a Big Mac. SHAME on you and I am so very glad someone finally called you out on this practice.
I will miss my BigMac attacks and your fries.
Tonight a friend came over with 2 of your seasonal egg nog milkshakes. They are so delicious,  I had to pour it down the sink right away or I would have drank every last drop and maybe forgiven your greedy ways at the expense of our health. 
Nope as totally awesome as those shakes are, I could not give into your temptation.  Yes, we all realize your business requires temptation.  But us humans have a thing called choice. 
I choose not to purchase your products due to your deception and disregard for the general populous. 
I love ice cream and a friend did something nice by bringing me a treat and I threw it away.
What can I say, I guess some things are more important than ice cream.....Wait did I really say that?
Oh well, what's a girl to do?  Stick to her beliefs.

I so want to write a better review of this place. I've been a few times now with mixed experiences.
-Good drink selection. Whiskey and tequila are my favorites, and their cocktails are solid.
-The food is good, if and when you can get it. Plenty of veggie options for those of us who don't eat meat, and fresh tasty chips and queso.
-The vibe is trendy - lots of wood and exposed lighting, a bit if a saloon feel with casino and Western movies playing around the bar. It's often crowded and noisy - great place for drinks with friends or a casual taco night, but expect to wait a long time.
- The customer service is... lacking. We went on a Monday night and it was packed. We put in our name for a table and we're told 30 min wait for a table for 3. Over an hour later of waiting on the patio where we sat right in front of the host booth, we still had not been seated or given any acknowledgement. We eventually gave up in frustration and left (note: they do not provide service or food on patio, but you can order appetizers at the bar yourself).

I probably won't be back for awhile.
My wife and I went in hearing that they had 50 cent oysters. It was true!!! It is only for happy hour.  We had lunch on a separate occasion, it was also above average in this food town.

I enjoyed Nuvo Burrito on my first visit earlier this week. I ordered the Berkeley and my boyfriend got the special (I can't remember the name). Both were vegetarian and both were good. We both agreed that mine (the Berkeley) was better. It was flavorful and delicious. The special had a few too many spinach leaves stuffed into it, which detracted from the rest of the flavors. I want to go back and try some other burritos. There are very interesting combinations that I can't wait to savor!

These folks do it right. My favorite place in Reno. A seasonal, chef-driven and vegetarian-friendly  menu. Great service. Great cocktails (real Gosling's Dark & Stormy's! really good cider on tap! changing tap brews!). I've been here for Girl's Night, for date night, for a pleasant place to grab a bite. I love them.

They are a little small, so if you're planning a weekend dinner, make a reservation as soon as you think about it. They also have outside seating, and it's charming.

Also, the chilled sunchoke soup is astonishing. If it's on the menu when you go, get a bowl. It's possibly the most perfect blend of flavors I've ever experienced.

Nice coffee shop with excellent coffee. I wish they had more offerings. Almost no cookies or anything else. I was a bit disappointed I wanted something besides my ice coffee. The cold brew was as good as it gets but it was almost $4 for a pretty small cup. The service was very good and the space is very pretty.
Why would anyone who is interested in juicing to stay healthy want a product that isn't made with organic produce?

I came here for lunch on a recommendation from a coworker.

Ordered the 3 roll lunch special which comes with miso soup for $10.95, what a deal.  There are several rolls to choose from.  I ordered the sweet potato roll, the avocado roll, and the smoked salmon skin roll.  All three rolls were amazing.

I came in and ordered but you can also order online.  Did not wait long for my order.

The restaurant has some seating and a small sushi bar.  While I was there they seem to do quite a bit of take out orders.

Enjoyed it so much that I think I'm going back for lunch tomorrow while I'n still in town.

Drove for something to stop the hanger and not the same old "ordinary". Though the choices were there, the results were lack luster. My latte yielded the best results unfortunately. Grits and Greens. Kale, Pork, Grits and eggs with a tasty drizzled oil. I have to say, had this arrived hot this would have been simply delish but it didn't it made it parts of it mediocre to partially palatable. It wasn't busy, so, No go. Good concept, poor delivery.

Have gone for lunch a few times this summer based on a recommendation of a doctor colleague. Decor is stunning, food is excellent, service is above outstanding but down side is that many other people are aware of it. So I recommend you go early or a little past the normal hour to, hopefully, miss the crowd. But do visit and often as you will never be disappointed. I recommend the chicken dishes but all the food I have had is excellent. As a disciple of David Rosengarten, the former food critic and contributing editor of Gourmet Magazine, I normally wait til I have visited the fifth time, as he recommends, to praise a restaurant but with Amici's I could not wait to let you know.

I loved this place. I went on $2 wednesday's ( $2 bowl and shoes) there was a 20 minute for the lane.while we waited we drunk and ate at the bar. i love their tater tots (which is also $2 on wednesday's!). when you get your lane you also get a server. overall great service and a fun atmosphere.

First time here. Great meal. Fast service. Personal attention that impressed us. Sous Chef Daniel deserves a raise. Our special requests were all handled with aplomb. Appetizer, entrees and desserts were impeccable.  New favorite place. Short wait to get a table but once seated we were pleased with the pace of the meal.

I have been on the fence about trying this place since I haven't really heard good things about it.  My friends complaints have ranged from terrible service (which seems to be the norm there) to the food is just okay.  So I haven't really gone out of my way to get there, a friend happened to have a bday dinner there so it got me into the restaurant and from my experience it exceeded my expectations. 

First, I can't comment on the service.  We had an extremely large party and so I never expect service to be amazing for large parties.  Especially since most of us kept getting up and moving around.  So I can't comment on that part.

But for the food and drinks, I can.  I ordered an 18oz skinny margarita.  Good, but nothing special.  At first I thought it was going to be super expensive but only ended up being $9.00, so I was pleasantly surprised.  I also ordered a Margarona (margarita with a mini corona in it).  This was much better since it helped tone down the sweetness of the margarita.  So drinks were good and fairly priced.  For food, I ordered the avocado deluxe and I loved it.  It's an avocado halved and chargrilled then filled with ahi tuna and drizzled with a spicy crema and a chili sauce with a side of cilantro lime rice.  This is now my new favorite dish, it's simple, relatively healthy and pretty flavorful (I would have liked extra chili sauce and next time I go I'll ask for more).  I will def be back for this dish, the tacos looked okay from what other people ordered and for me I wouldn't make a special trip for that but will for the avocado dish.  So all in all not bad and I'll return (but prob just sit at the bar)

After eating here twice, once for brunch and the second time for dinner, I left wishing there was more. 

Brunch: We ordered a $16 dollar mushroom omelet, the mushrooms were the only vegetable component for this price, the only side included was standard toast. 3/5 stars.

Dinner: We celebrated a special occasion and told the restaurant in advance, but the waiter failed to acknowledge our event. We ordered the $70 dollar restaurant week special. Turns out that all four dishes including the main course were put on one plate and were supposed to be shared. Basically, there was nothing special about this deal  there was one appetizer, one salad, one main course, and one piece of cake. The service was good, not personable, but efficient. At around 855 the house lights turned on as a signal for everyone to leave, yet they were supposed to stay open until 930, felt like a nightclub during last call. 

Can't say we will be back.

Thought i'd check out a new place in Carp. Saw the Yelp reviews and wanted to try it out. I got a bacon cheeseburger and some onion rings. The cheeseburger was edible but barely, the bacon was chewy and not crispy (nasty). The cheese was not melted at all they just threw a slice on it. Onions were okay but not great. Will not return.

We are so unbelievably happy to have found this place! We have lived in the area for 3yrs and couldn't find a place remotely close to this. We ordered for the 1st time tonight. Great prices, everything was soooo delicious, so fresh and tasteful! Veggies crisp and not soggy. Brown sauce is absolutely divine! Crab rangoons are exceptionally scrumptious! Its so hard to find a place that doesnt over fry. Cant wait to try other dishes. The menu size is absolutely impeccable!

Friendly,, friendly, friendly! And authentic Chinese cuisine. Great restaurant tucked away here in Sparks. Staff was awesome and making recommendations and checked on us over and over. They took the time to stop by and discuss a lot of other menu items we should try on our return. They have the typical American/ Chinese menu options, but hit the last page for the real experience. I had the Dang Dang Noddle. I spaghetti style yellow noodle with pork and chives done in a authentic Szechuan oil. I have never experienced this seasoning/spice before. The heat was a shuttle medium but not like Thai or Mexican. It was actually slightly numbing and tingling that lingered Nut was not invasive. Very exciting to cross some new culinary boarders. The rest of the table ordered from the safer slider of the menu and all were happy. The table next to us ordered the Sesame Chicken and I have to admit it looked plentiful and delicious. Give this place a try and the friendly factor alone will make your day.

A great place for authentic tacos. Being from Texas I need my Mexican food and this helps get me through until I can fly back home. The staff is great and I've never been disappointed with anything there

In town for the holiday and decided to order out as a change of pace.  Sorry to say that we were very disappointed.  We placed 5 different orders of varying spice ranges.   Not only were the orders not marked,there was absolutely no difference in the level of spice.  The noodles in the drunken noodle order were soggy and  not flavorful.  All in all a disappointment.   We won't order from here again

The atmosphere is what you would expect of a pub called the beer hunter. But that's about where it ended. The staff was incredibly friendly and we noticed that customers were treated like long time friends. The food also surprised us! We had a meat and cheese platter to go without wine and it was well thought out and super tasty! The spiciest cheese I've had in a long time!

This would be an awesome place to hang out with friends for an evening and eat and drink!

This place was off my foodie path, but Im glad I found it. They have the best crawfish I have tasted so far to date. The crawfish had so much flavor.I wish I could eat here everyday.Even the onion and garlic which  was cooked with the crawfish was delicious .I give this place 5 stars.Until next time.

This place can't get it together. Closed on Sundays. Website says they offer brunch though?!? Even on Saturday there's no brunch to be found. Menu is small, and not very good. Tried a few of their "signature items" and they were barely edible. And way too expensive for what they offer. They won't last.

So far so good! Appetizers excellent, shrimp cheesecake fabulous! Shrimp cake wonderful ! Étouffée & jambalaya were fantastic. Service was good food came out for the day sometime I would highly recommend you to eat here. Space and if you like that NOLA  Cajun Creole food
