the service is good. we order some appetizer Tempura Jumbo Shrimp Roll & Dynamite Roll. it was Joke. too much rice (almost 1/2 inch of rice) and you are unable to see the shrimp at all. every bite I try only rice and very little Shrimp and crab. For the main entree nothing to WOW about; its just regular. I ordered Gulf Snapper which very small and too much red quinoa.
The creme brulee was weak and a little liquidy (Fresh Market better). Given the prices, there are just a lot of better options in South Tampa.

Delicious breakfast!  They've taken simple meals and elevated them to wildly deliciously and imaginative twists. My wife and kids took me for father's day as a surprise. I recently moved to the area and I'll be making this a place I frequent.

Stopped by ChopHouse Grille on Friday night for appetizers and drinks. 
Pros: Beautiful atmosphere. They've really done a nice job with the interior. Outdoor bar with fire pit. Modern and elegant, but not stuffy.
Service: We sat at the indoor bar. Our bartender, Tim, was great. Attentive and made nice recommendations. The GM stopped by during our meal and asked us if everything was okay. The staff work together as a team and food came out of the kitchen very quickly on a busy Friday night. 
Cocktails/drinks: Creative and delicious. Thyme lemonade ($11) was tart and earthy/herbal. Irish mocha cold brew ($9) was like having a chocolate martini but only better. I like how they use their cold brew coffee in cocktails. They have good local beers on tap. 
Cons: This place is expensive! Drink prices are reasonable, but value for food is not. 
Food: Found the food to just only be okay. The kona filet tips ($17) were decent, but only a few pieces of meat and mostly the dish was made up of mushrooms. The crispy Brussels sprouts ($13) again were okay, chili sauce was pretty good, but not worth the price. Buffalo shrimp ($16) was your standard fare, nice with chunky blue cheese - but the shrimp seemed like they were sitting around for awhile because they were somewhat cold and soggy. 5 shrimp, standard size, for $16. Whipped ricotta ($12) was a nice option for dessert - because the ChopHouse does not offer a "real" dessert menu. Just dessert "shooters" for $3. This is always a good idea if you want to just have a small sweet treat after dinner - but ChopHouse would not be a good place to stop by if you were looking for dessert and and a cocktail. 
The place is new so certainly they are still working on their operations. ChopHouse is owned by the fine folks at The Pour House and PJ Whelihan's, so they are good restauranteurs and will figure it out. The food coming out of the kitchen looked really good and maybe we just ordered wrong. Go check out the place for yourself and if the weather is good sit at the outdoor bar area.

Quaint little French Restaurant tucked in the lower floor of the Autograph Collection Hotel. Nice outdoor eating area that looks out over the courtyard of the Art Building next door. French Press Pots available for your table. Entrees are beautifully presented and the flavors are outstanding. Make sure to ask about the rotating daily quiche. Currently I would make a reservation so you can enjoy a table as capacity is being regulated. Staffing is an issue until the governments end the stimulus and unemployment loop holes so individuals return to the job market.
Wife and I came in here on a Thursday afternoon and enjoyed a few glasses wine.  Nice atmosphere and good wine to taste.

Smokey Bones.  Brandon FL
First visit for a late lunch.  Only a few patrons at this time during the week so our expectations for good service was high.  It was met in excellent form and then some.  Our server Danielle exhibited every good quality one could possibly expect... She explained the menu, the specials and how we could order to get the most for our money.  She took our order and then returned several times to see if everything was OK and then again to refresh our drinks and bring more napkins...  As for the food... I give it four(4) stars because I've only been to a few restaurants in my life that qualified for that fifth star... One was le' circue in Manhattan, another was le tour de'argent who was visiting the Mandarin Hotel on Hong Kong island...  But this local BBQ  site served unique and very well prepared food no matter what you chose.  I had the 1/4 BBQ chicken with broccoli and a baked potato.  The BBQ sauce was excellent with a quite unique tasting sauce.  The chicken was roasted perfectly; not over done... My partner had the pulled pork. She said it was ve sd t she'd  had in recent memory.  We were so impressed that we even ordered some wings to bring home.  Again the food items were very well prepared indeed,  although I found that they dipped the baked potato in salt, undoubtedly to crisp up the skin; but for my taste it was a bit much...  the baked beans were excellent as were the french fries... Overall an delightful meal and at prices that were very reasonable...  Needless to day we've paid much more for much less.  Would highly recommend this to everyone. Can't wait to return.

We first went to BB Kings when it was still in Vegas so we were looking forward to this visit to Nashville so we could go again. 

However, we were let down!! The ribs were cold, refrigerated cold, not room temperature cold! The Mac n cheese tasted like they just microwaved it. Horrible stuff! It seems like they are relying on their reputation to get them business and the quality of food is going down hill. 

We hand two drinks that were decent, but if you want really good drinks head over to 417 Union or Skull's! 

The music, I gotta say, was awesome! The band was Hayes and the Hustle. I think that's the name, they were really really good!!

Love, love, love this place!! Have been here a hand full of times and never disappointed. There can be a long wait but it is always well worth it. The ceviche roll is our favorite followed by the ring roll. A-M-A-Z-I-N-G!!!!! Strongly recommend this place to anyone who loves fresh sushi. Yum!!

This is one of the best restaurants I have ever been to. The food was amazing and our server Daniella gave us excellent customer service. She gave us a wonderful recommendation about the crawfish boil and it was delicious. She made our experience memorable and above all enjoyable. We defiantly will be back. I give the 5 stars hands down.
My first time to Wok Fire and really liked it a lot. I liked the fact you can choose what to build your bowl on and not just have everything on white rice. Good value as well.
Good store I come here once in a while to post classified ads on the newspaper kilbarkilat

I am one who orders from this location at least once or twice a week now for quite a few years.

The drivers are so nice and it's great when they know you by name. A special shout out to James, who is such a nice person and always makes sure my order is perfect.

The few times that my order has been messed up, the manager there ( it's a lady, dang me for not remembering her name) has been so courteous in making sure things are made right.

One of my all time favourite places to get my lunch from due because of the great staff there..


UPDATE:
They keep raising their prices..another increase in less than a year. I have been ordering a lot less because of it.

Such a let down! V E R R R R RY pricey for little of no food as well as it's bland! Guy asked me how my food was told him it wasn't what I expected & wasn't fresh and he told me it's not for everyone and to have a good day as We were walking out. No type of remorse or cared if I or my husband was satisfied walking out, nor tried to fix the problem. Definitely going to be reaching out to someone higher up.

Cheap food, but really good. The balance of sauce to cheese is perfect and the service is great. If you visit often, they will greet you in a very friendly manner and will often talk about soccer with you while you wait for your delicious pizza. Joe's is everything you want from a local pizza parlor.

My husband and I visited Rococo Steak for our twelve year anniversary.  Hey, we married young!

The staff 's hospitability was the most enjoyable, memorable, and relaxing experience possible.  I was even being super annoying on the phone when making the reservation to ensure that they were open on New Year 's Day and that we would have a booth hidden away in the corner.  As other reviews have noted, make sure to not sit in the center of the room as you will definitely feel like you are on display.

Rococo Steak is located in an amazing stand-alone, stately two story building in downtown St Petersburg with plenty of parking.  The building is breathtaking and even more impactful inside.  Like a true steakhouse, the lighting is perfectly dark and comfortable.  So far, all of the other steakhouses I have been too in Tampa Bay are way too bright.

The side dishes are to-die-for; authentically washboarded cream corn, perfectly toothsome mac and cheese, and crispy truffle fries.   I could go on about the crème corn for hours, but I have not had that exact flavor since I was a child eating our farm grown corn prepared by my grandmother.
Drinks were plentiful and creative.  Now, I can see why there was such a crowd at the bar for daily happy hour.  It is nice to find a place that has more "manly" drinks--- bacon filled, smoked, and savory flavors.
Oh that seafood!  Seafood should be noted as their specialty, along with desserts.  As all of the seafood we tried was plump and freshly prepared.
Unfortunately, I was not a fan of the steaks here, which are of the highest quality.  The steaks were thick cut, barely seasoned, and tough to chew.  The steaks were even prepared medium, so I don't know what happened.  I did not want to complain to the waiter, and was getting full anyway, so I just took the steak home and fixed it up to eat as leftovers later.  For the price, I recommend going with the seafood instead.

They were so kind to give us a complimentary dessert that had a chocolate note "Happy Anniversary" on it.  Such an unexpected treat!  The Honey Lavendar Crème Brulee is amazing.

It was over $200 for our dinner for two.

This restaurant is fantastically unique. It was an incredible escape from the ordinary Mexican or seafood restaurants. The atmosphere was awesome and friendly staff were ready to make the dining experience perfect. Victor was great. I would highly recommend this place for a tasty flavorful meal in a entertaining place. I can't wait to go back and try everything on the menu !

Good gas prices, clean store, no complaints. My choice! My wawa! 

*Reviewers should not hold it against a convenience store for running out of stock during a hurricane. This is a time when their business may double or triple in demand, while supply side gets completely shut off by circumstances beyond their control.

Solid place to get a good breakfast but definitely not my favorite. They have a large menu so there is something for everyone but nothing about the meal was spectacular.

I had the crab Benedict and the crab was very dry and it seemed like that burned it on the grill before bringing it out. All together, not s lot of flavor. Now I know this is not a seafood restaurant so I didn't expect much but overall it lacked flavor.

Service was fantastic and we didn't have to wait to be seated.
i dont care what you think of sushi or people from the orient but this food was good enough that racists should be ashamed

As a SunDevil wandering onto wildcat territory, I sometimes cringe just the tiniest bit to enter such a blatantly marked wildcat establishment; especially when i am in full Devil costume. But not here. I have drank and ate and partied here countless times in the past couple years. 

   Despite all the stares and BOOs directed my way (it makes the place even more thrilling ) i really enjoy myself here.  The pizza is pretty good, All I've had is the fuzzcock with added garlic. I never tried anything else. It tastes even better with a bucket of beer. 

   It can get crazy busy here during game day; Service can get slow but the great patio and good people watching make up for the long wait for pizza.  The servers are great. I have never had a bad experience with any of them so far.  The ambiance and food just makes everything perfect.

   Such a great place to relax. The only bad thing about this place is that its in Tucson next to uofa and is like that crazy old lady that has one too many cats in her house.  Specially wild feral ones...

Anyone who has called this place a hidden gem is 110% right.
I don't drink but I certainly eat! Their grilled cheese may have been the very very best one I've ever eaten!! I also had the olive assortment and it was delicious!
I highly recommend it to everyone!!

What can I say, I love Robeks. So glad it came to Philly. And with the heat and humidity lately..who can resist these refreshing beverages? typically I like to go for 'the hummingbird,' but last time I switched it up and got the 'Big Wednesday'...and definitely was not disappointed.

Oh. My. Goodness.

My wife found Tartine on Yelp and was very excited about coming here. There was some seriously good karma in this recommendation, because Tartine may be one of our favorite restaurants in New Orleans, and heaven knows that there's some great competition.

I had the Salmon Rillette, and there was nary a crumb left on my plate by the end of the meal. I know I was supposed to craft these elegant little sandwiches with all of the ingredients, but by the end of the meal I was just spooning every last bit in as fast as proper decorum would permit.

I don't remember what my wife had, but it was vaporized as quickly as my meal was.

Without hesitation, a five star restaurant that will *absolutely* be on our to-do list the next time we're in the area.

This place is right around the corner from me and it is awesome! Their azada and al pastor tacos are SO GOOD. I guess of I had to complain about something it's that it always seems to take FOREVER to get your order, but maybe I just perceive it that way because I can't wait. Everyone there is always super sweet and friendly, too.

Being told there was no table available when the restaurant is 90% empty at 5:00pm, so we sat at kitchen bar.  I had steak, tender but over salted.  Server was nice and knowledgeable.  Menu is limited and over priced.  Would not go back.

I've eaten here five or six times. Only two of them were by my own choosing (or my wifes)... this last time and the first time. The three in between were birthday parties in their private room in back (which is very nice by the way).

First and foremost, the service is always really good, so no complaints there. The atmosphere and location are also better than average.

However. The food has fallen off a cliff. 

I am a steak fanatic. I love steak. Unfortunately for me, I ordered the large filet. Long story short, this steak was plain at best. I can get a pound of filet from Greenwise for $18 bucks, throw some olive oil and sea salt and some gorgonzola butter and have a tasty treat with 8 ounces left over. I paid $28 dollars for an 8 ounce filet from 717, with what I thought was going to be a gorgonzola crust, or butter... but ended up getting just a plain filet, topped with red pepper for garnish. Who puts red peppers on steak? If you want colorful garnish, put some parsley on it and a drizzle of olive oil. Anyways. My waitress, who was fantastic by the way, realized they didn't put the gorgonzola on it and had them remake my plate. I got new mashed potatoes which was nice of them, but low-and-behold, the gorgonzola was just that, crumbled cheese, barely melted on top of my steak. For $28, I expect something with flavor. I also don't expect it to taste like a tender sirloin cut of meat, which is what this tasted like - it was very VERY bland.

I will say that they have a lot of appetizers that I have eaten before and they are all pretty good, but that's about it for me. I don't go to eateries for appetizers, I go for steak or chicken or something a little more full. My wife has asked me if I wanted to go there a handful of times, each time I say, 'no way'. To be honest, the only reason we even came is because I got lucky and snagged a groupon a few minutes before midnight a couple of weeks ago... otherwise, I would not have proactively come back.

It was Saturday at 845 and they were at 70% capacity, if that... which should say something. I don't want to sound like I am being overly critical, but I was less than impressed. For what our bill was, even after the Groupon, we could have eaten elsewhere two times over and gotten better prepared food. 

As I said. The atmosphere is nice. The staff is always friendly and it is conveniently located. But as far as the food - it wasn't even remotely up to par with the pricing.

Can you give lower than 1 star? You're lucky you if not. You guys BLOW. I ordered 2 1/2 hours before close and made doordash wait over 2 hours at the location for an order that was never fulfilled. After countless cellular minutes wasted, I was told by an employee (via doordash call) that the location was closed and was not taking more orders... you would think I dropped my colostomy bag when I say I absolutely lost my shit! 10/10 would definitely NOT recommend this garbage excuse for a well-established franchise.

Awful. What a joke. I didn't leave a tip, and I always tip 20% minimum even for mediocre service. This was a new low. 

- "30-45 minute wait" for a table for 2, despite 10 tables standing empty.

- The place wasn't busy, at all. But we sat at the bar for 10 minutes without even being acknowledged. Multiple staff loafing around, playing on their phones, aloof and unfriendly.

- Food 100% overpriced. High school cafeteria  burger and microwaved Ore-Ida fries for $12.
- No refills offered.
- Had to wait and ask a bar back for ketchup.
- No napkins with our food. 
- After asking how we wanted our burgers cooked, and telling them "medium rare", they came out well done.
- Staff totally disinterested in our enjoyment. "Here ya go..." then nothing.
- Staff arguing with/complaining to manager in front of customers.
- No service after food dropped off. We could have walked out without paying and I wonder if they'd have noticed. We put cash on the bar and left. 

Totally ridiculous. Don't go.

Stopped by to pick up a pizza for take home. ABSOLUTELY what we have been looking for. Great crispy crust. Sauce good. Plenty of topping and did I say CRISPY. Yum. Fantastic. Only negative will only deliver as far West as the Suncoast Parkway. We are in Grey Hawk. Come on guys. Send it just one more block to Grey Hawk. You are missing 225 more families fir just a block delivery.

Solid 5 stars!  Amazing bahn mi cafe, with multiple varieties of banh mi, desserts & drinks.  I enjoyed a vegan bahn mi with tofu and an iced green tea and it was wonderful.  The bread is fresh baked and crisp, and the portion sizes are excellent.  Staff is friendly and helpful.  I highly recommend

I had a most scrumptious meal at the brick and mortar.  Try the potunie, layered in home goodness of fries, gravy, shredded pork, jalapeno, and fresh veggies. This is my favorite place to eat when in town. My only complaint is the hours. I wish they were open earlier and every day of the week. Great service and drinks options as well.

I went into this Thai shop yesterday and had myself a nice little lunch special. For about $9.00 you get to have soup, appetizer, and a main dish which is pretty sweet considering that a burrito and a drink cost about 9 dollars down the street.

I ordered the Chicken Pad Thai special, with Wonton Soup and Chicken dumplings with soy garlic sauce. The flavors weren't complex and may be too sweet for some, and the noodles were kinda hard but I found it to be quite edible. Overall it was a pleasant experience and a nice change of pace from the usual
Was pleasantly surprised to really ENJOY this place. It's great to enjoy pizza with a glass of wine or beer and they have an outdoor seating area too. Great crispy pizza, and it came out quickly!

First visit here. It is a fun experience. Great food! Don't fill up on the sides. Go hungry. If you are a meat person this is your place. Some say it's pricey. Where in Nashville are you going to go for all you can eat meat (including steak's) for under $50? I've never had lamb until I tried it here. Probably one of the best things I tried today. Very friendly. Staff was helpful, especially being our first trip. Will be back!

I used to love this place when it first opened! After a few months the line was always too long. So it's been a year and I'm back on a slow day. The workers look like they hate not only themselves but everyone else. They're slow, work slow, don't care, don't smile. So I got the gluten free crust, no cheese. My pizza was in for 10 seconds when the edges looked cooked. But now the toppings are still cold (mushrooms, peppers, other veggies.  Some guy is responsible for cutting the pizza into slices and he can't even do that right.  So long Blaze. It was good while it lasted  I really want my $30 back (my son is with me trying to get through his soggy pizza.
Update:  we just couldn't get through our pizza. Raw crust and cold ingredients. We were hungry so I asked for the manager. And out comes the pizza-slicer guy  well now I know what's happening. A business is a direct reflection of its management. I explain the issue and he says "no problem it happens!" And gives me a refund. We left and are now en route to Louisiana Pizza Kitchen.

Just had lunch there and it only took two hours! Half of which was spent on waiting for my check. Asked the bartender for assistance and he told me he couldn't help and I would just have to get my waitress' attention. The food itself was mediocre. There are way better places to eat in New Orleans with superior service.

I tried the beignets at Cafe Beignet and Cafe Du Monde on the same day. The beignets at Cafe Beignet are crispier and lighter. The beignets at Cafe Du Monde are chewier. Hands down, I liked the beignets at Cafe Beignet better.

Great location and great idea. It's never too crowded. However, it's really unfortunate that the wait staff seems surly. One bartender argued with me for a good 2 minutes over the fact that I had ordered some bizarre drink that I had not even heard of. I mean, come on. She was rudely arguing. That's not okay. 3 stars for the food and drink prices and quality. Minus 3 stars for the crappy attitudes.

Impressive! Looks (and smells) a heck of a lot better than it used to. Not that we didn't enjoy it as JR's, or Connell's, but this is a complete change - for the better.

Check it out. Do yourself a favor and try their burgers.
Amazing spiked coffee and staff! The vibe is spot on and welcoming and we came here three days in a row!
Great food and service.  Excellent vegetarian options lentil soup and platters etc.  Great gyro and I mean great for the meat eaters.

Delicious food. Whenever my family is in London, we go to Nandos. Now we don't have to go to London. Instead we come to Delaware to Piree's Piri Piri. 
The food was awesome. Everything

Chase the manager and Spencer our server were amazing! They were so personable, always made sure we had what we needed and were a pleasure to talk to. They made our family feel comfortable and welcomed. Thank you! Amazing food as well. I got the lobster ravioli and it was a great portion with lots of flavor. Excellent food and service, even when we did take out during covid-19.

The birthday blondie was a little too sweet and it felt like both the frosting and the cake bar component were missing a little something extra in terms of flavoring--can't quite figure out what it is. I think I was expecting a punchier, more full-flavored dessert (maybe more butter or salt could've helped?) The brownie was excellent though, and the brookie was pretty good too, although I wish it had been a bit thicker and chewier. I think I should've ordered more along the lines of the muffins/scones, but the child in me wanted to try these treats.

What a disappointment from a food standpoint. The service was quick and friendly however the food was terrible. Not to mention they were out of ice and the tables had not been wiped down. It was 2PM. I got the nibblers with fries. The bun was very burnt so it did not help the taste at all. I was asked if I wanted Zaxby sauce. Sure well the pea size drop I got gave me no indication of what it actually tasted like. The rest of the food, chicken and fries were loaded with salt. I think I met my monthly sodium intake in my first bite. I will never go back.

One of the things I miss most about working in Newtown Square is getting my breakfast delivered to me every Friday from Jean's. The fact that they deliver breakfast is a automatic default 3-stars in my book because I can't think of anywhere that delivers breakfast. The fact that the food arrives warm, tasty, and accurate -- makes it an easy 5-stars.
We were told we couldn't leave New Orleans without having a muffuletta, which is fancy name for a deli sandwich. A fucking (pardon my French Quarter) bomb sandwich.

Our third time here, and the service was just as impressive! I don't know if they got a new chef, but the meats were better than ever!  The new hot options on the salad bar were good, and the cheese puff appetizer was amazing. Yum!

This place is excellent.  It's location is tough to find if you don't know where it is (west of the Capitol Theatre), but once you know where it is you'll just want to keep on coming back.  The gelato is fresh and delicious.  I love After Eight (mint chocolate chip flavor) as well as all the nut-based ones.  My wife loves the fruit and, of course, the great Italian chocolate.  I've also enjoy crepes (sweet and savory) and a few different coffee options.  

The best thing about this place is that it feels like you're in Europe.  The staff is made up of real Italians, not some high schoolers or Midwestern transplants, so the atmosphere and food is completely authentic.  This is a great place to stop in for a quick cup of gelato or sit around sipping coffee and chatting with the great people who work there.

Heritage is a gorgeous restaurant, with a large bar, outdoor patio and a stage area for nightly jazz. The food is a mixed bag. I sampled a few small plates. The house sausage and the beef tartare were good. The mussels and the mackerel were disappointing. They also serve a lot of bread, which is only so-so.

Although I went for dinner I think heritage is better suited for drinks and a snack at the bar while listening to live music. I enjoyed my drink and the music, but there is better food in the area.

They really need to open a location in San Diego. I loved my experience here at topgolf!

A group of three of us went on a Tuesday to take advantage of the half price deal. It turned out to be just under $100 for a mimosa carafe, an appetizer, 3 hours of play, and 3 new lifetime membership fees ($5).

It was suggested by a friend that we choose the bays on the top level for a fun view and easier experience. I definitely would pass along this advice and also suggest the top floor for n00bs.

There's a topgolf game guide at each bay/table which are categorized by beginner, intermediate, advanced, and expert. We spent about the first half of our game play on topgolf for beginners - basically hitting the ball into any target that you desire. With the microchip technology, your allotted points per ball will show up on your player screen with the yardage details as well.

The second half we played the quick 9 novice game - which was perfect for short round games and players whose hitting range tends to be the closer target. In this game it's all about accuracy. You get three shots at each target (red, yellow, and green) - hence the quick 9 name of the game.

Definitely a lot of fun, I'd come back! 

Ps with the $5 fee for new players, comes a lifetime membership meaning you don't have to pay another $5 even if you go to a different topgolf location.

I have visited for both lunch and teatime. The highlight is their scones! Make sure you get some with their Devonshire cream, jam, and lemon curd! 

We had a slight issue with an order but our waitress and the manager were quick to address it. I have always been pleased with their courteous service.
service was poor--lady at register was unwilling to explain the menu and seemed annoyed at us asking a couple questions.  Hummus was good and smooth.
I got the Chicken Piccata and a cannoli from here, my husband got the lasagna and a tiramisu. It was delightful!! Would def recommend!

Went in to get my French Vanilla Medium Coffee, while standing in line, I heard a the Cashier yelling at a Customer to speak up. Then a Customer came very polite and told the owner that she mistakenly picked up the wrong bag and wanted her sandwich that she had ordered. He was very belligerent toward her and then he told her that he was not going to make a sandwich nor did he give her a refund.  They were both Black Women!!!
Myself and another Customer got out of line and left Dunkin Donuts on 230 S. Easton Road Glenside, PA. I will not be returning to that location. 
VERY DISRESPECTFUL to the PAYING CUSTOMERS EARLY IN THE MORNING!!! 
                            THE DAY BEFORE 9/11!!!

After hearing MANY good things about brushfire,I stopped in for lunch today. I ordered the 2 meat meal (Hungry size:2 extra ounces of meat i believe).I picked the smokey brisket and the hot italian sausage. My friend ordered a one meat meal (shredded chicken).Would have been nice had our meals came out at the same time but not even close! I was very disappointed when i saw how SMALL the meat portions are. The sausage was 1 1/2 links and not huge links either. The Brisket was a VERY small amount and cannot even imagine how much smaller it would have been had I not "upsized" !! Both meats were tasty and cooked well. My friends chicken was a VERY NICE SIZED portion... Of course chicken is much cheaper than brisket. For $17 (drink included) I can think of several other restaurants in the area that will give me my MONEYS WORTH !!

We had a delicious meal of the duck breast and 1/2 rack of lamb both cooked a perfect mid rare. Ryan Clark has made some fantastic changes to the menu. Try the duck pate to have your mind blown. Service was a bit spotty but easily forgiven.

Decent place for pad thai, unfortunately after reading the reviews I was expecting to be wowed and wasn't. This is a friendly run place and they are quick with everything -food, service, refills, check and I appreciate that tons. But I was underwhelmed by the pad thai. Pad thai is my jam, 99% of the time it's the only thing I will order and I've been to A LOT of Thai places all over the country so I've seen the good the bad the ugly. 

At Sawasdee:

The good-big lunch portion for $6.95 along with two if the following-salas, soup or spring roll

The bad-no sight of glass noodles in the dish, it was more like a thin spaghetti. 

The ugly-I ordered it hot and it barely burned my tongue. I thought I was being adventurous since I usually order medium hot but access denied, it just wasn't hot.

That being said, I scarfed it down since I was jones in for some pad thai and it was cold and raining out, perfect pad thai weather. I just wouldn't stop here again for it if you're a pad thai freak like me.

Bourbon and fresh seafood. 
Two of my favorite things on earth. 
A dream come true for me, and it mostly delivered... 

Okay, the bourbon flights were awesome. Got to try new bourbons I'd never had before. Mmmm. 

The huge and pricey Le Grand Plaeaux de Fruits de Mer (a selection of fresh shucked Louisiana Oysters, Gulf Shrimp, Seasonal Seafood Salad, Crab Fingers & Maine Lobster Tails) should have been amazing but unfortunately the Crab Fingers were totally overcooked. 

We said something to the server about it and she retrieved the manager right away. He came over and said that he could tell just by looking at the crab that it was overcooked. He apologized. We asked for another run of it. This time they came back, better, but still not perfect, as it should have been for the price. 

We also ordered a trio of baked oysters (OYSTERS ROCKEFELLER, BIENVILLE, FONSECA) and they were DELICIOUS! 

The service is weird in that you get 2 different servers, and there is some hierarchy there, which was weird, and they wear different clothes based upon this hierarchy, but it worked out fine. 

Good southern hospitality too.

Apparently, this Panda Express does not read its reviews. Came to Panda on July 8, 2018. I ordered at the window and they said they were out of FRIED RICE of all things and did I want to order something else but the wait would be 5-10 minutes. I said I would wait because I was picking up food for 4 people. They told me to pull up basically out of drive thru with the other several cars waiting for fried rice. What an unorganized mess this place is!
The food is decent but if they're busy, their service is awful. Several times my order has been wrong and it's taken over an hour to be served. Go to Pegs instead.

I can't even fathom giving OUTBACK STEAKHOUSE a bad rating. I enjoy it with every little bit of me.  I will say, it's been years since we've ventured here; Spanks to Texas Roadhouse. Haha Anyways, my little pregger tummy was craving some Aussie fries the other day. I told my husband we have to go because the price for my piece of happiness.... Well, ya just can't beat it. I guess I should have thought that they would skyrocket the price since its been years since we've came here. They have two sizes of Aussie fries. One, being the small for 7 and some change.... Last time we were there is was a wopping 5 and some change. Okay, so small seemed like maybe it wouldn't be enough; So we ordered the $10 one; which is a large! Okay, cool... I'm craving it, so we will deal with the price....... UNTIL WE GOT IT. It looked like a small! I couldn't believe that it was the same exact size we were paying a little over $5 back in the day. Not to mention, back then, they filled the ranch up to the brim. Ugh, it just irked me. Let me say, the lady who took our order was superb! Very kind and precise. Another thing I didn't enjoy was the worker who appeared to work in the back (because of her attire) coming back in from break or coming into work on her phone having an obnoxiously loud and deeply personal conversation. Then, she flipped her nasty cigarette butt on the ground and went right on in..... Betting $1000 she didn't wash her hands. Come on, we all know how this city works; As well as the folks in it. Just nasty. Overall, I'm not saying I don't recommend coming here. My husband should have went ahead and spent $13 so he could have got the chicken and shrimp with the Aussie fries. ( They have a meal including all of this ) They do include the bread and butter regardless of the purchase though. I like that part as well.

We had the red chili con carne burrito . It was just tortilla and the meat but it was AMAZING ! The flavor was so delicious that we had to come back 2 days in a row before we headed back to California . A small little family owned restaurant but worth the find. The tortillas and chips were also bomb.com

Problem with seating,the host was not attentive but the manager was nice and gave us a round of drinks. We might give them a second chance since our waiter was so friendlyl and of course very refreshing cocktails!!! The pizza was excellent.

Down to Earth locals sort of spot. Friendly faces, lots of laughs. The pizza is quite good as are the happy hour specials. The bar area is separate which is amazing for keeping the noise down and watching a game. The staff was awesome (especially the bar tender) and the location was convenient. Will munch again
So amazing! So glad I finally got a chance to go for Brunch. I have never tasted anything so wonderful. Will be back to try dinner.

Yummy food. There was a wait upon arrival but the manager made up for that since there was confusion on reservations. We ordered stuffed dates, meatball lollipops, ceviche, mezze platter, crab cakes, chickpea fries, gnocchi, and 4 cheese Mac. My favs were ceviche, mezze platter and the 4 cheese Mac. The others were good just not as good as those 3. Cute ambiance and layout. Ordering via iPad was fun. Food comes very fast. Go try it out.

Absolutely delicious, great customer service and experience.The steak tartare with truffle was tender,fresh and a very generous portion. The escargot in a green maybe pesto sauce it's a must try. The Delmonico was outstanding, grill to perfection.Last but not least the amazing dessert room, what a great atmosphere and so super cozy.We had the Alaskan, I can't recommend it enough, delicious flambé merengue in a mix of different liquors. moist cake and the best ice cream in Tampa bay their macadamia ice cream. 3 layers of decadent flavor but not too sweet.

Waited long time for food. Waited over 30 minutes for dinner past salad. While watching 4 people standing doing nothing. Waited again for check to be picked up paid cash because I was not going to give my real name.

Not returning to the restaurant

I would give them more stars for the food but the atmosphere is not that good. Unfortunately we had to sit next to a big group stuffed in one of the booths and we couldn't even hear each other. With the music and the birthday party celebrations going on it's too much. More rowdy bar atmosphere than restaurant. I had the country fried steak and it was good. Plenty of food for each order from our group of 6. Too bad it's so loud! Also, we had to wait a long time to get our check. Busy for a Thursday night.

Stay away there are better places for Wings n sports bar food. We ordered a few specials and 2 beers. First off the wings at Mcdees are better and those I wouldn't eat either. . We never received our beers until after we were finished with our meal we asked why they were were not served during the lunch and the brainiac bimbo said we should've reminded her to bring the beers out when we first ordered, its not her job to remember,....... My friend ordered medium she received mild instead of course she had no response other than well next time we will get your order correct., They charge you extra for celery and or blue cheese, something that should come standard when you order wings.       Buffalo Wild Wings or the Pressbox in Tampa are much better choices for wings, The eye candy was decent but it reminded me of strippers bending over backwards literaly for tips.

Ohhh my Gosh!!!! These tacos are nothing to play with! So much authentic techniques and flavor embodied in such a small Tortilla. We had the steak tacos  and Gordita that bursts with punch and subtle spices that you're not gonna wanna miss. This is one for the record books as the best taco place in Tampa!

Went there for breakfast just before flight out.  Sat at bar.  The bar tender spent the entire time sitting in a corner booth gossiping with friends.  Never got a coffee refill, and took a while to get her attention just to pay the check.
Great service, welcoming setting, outstanding service! I had the Oceana Redfish and I dreamed about it the night I went to bed. Sooooo tasteful.

I got the seitan cheese steak with mushrooms. It took awhile to find the very small amount of cheese on the sandwich. My friend thought I didn't get any cheese. The flavor was bland & this supposedly hot sandwich was not even warm, room temperature at its best. My friend got a salad with salmon & was it ever a small salad. I hadn't been there for a long time & it seemed to me to be not as good as before.

A+ for service that is friendly and enjoyable. Interior decor is what you'd expect from your classic Bertucci's and it reminds me of the 90's. I've always been a fan of Bertucci's, it is one of my favorite chain restaurants, and I am happy to see them re-emerge from bankruptcy earlier this year. This location has a very enjoyable outside seating with fire, and I also like the view of the kitchen and pizza oven from the inside dining area. The downside of this location is that parking is a bit difficult because all the restuarants are on this side of the mall, and it can get pretty busy during lunch/dinner times. 

As far as food goes, this is a chain restaurant so the food is pretty standard across all of them. The bread rolls are always fantastic, and their classic dishes are great as always - such as their pizza and lasagna. I also tried their "fall menu special" of portabello risotto. The mushrooms on top are good, but the risotto itself seemed a little dry to be called a risotto. Stick to the classic dishes and you won't be disappointed!

Came around 6:30 pm - plenty of ice cream flavors to choose from, including dairy free and alcoholic flavors. I ordered an iced coffee. They had sugar free syrups but the only creamers available were 2% milk and almond milk. My friend tried the Cookie Monster and vanilla; she said both were a great treat after a day at the beach!
Definitely the best wings around Wilmington. The restaurants dine in is very nice and clean as well. Workers are fast and super nice.

We usually  go to BBC every week.
However, 
Now that there are events which are loud and take over the entire place on Tues, Wed, and Thurs we will reconsider.
Since BBC does not gave a banquet room to hold events it is unpleasant to dine at this restaurant on these three days.
And the event solicits your table for money and donations while you are dining.
After they gave been celebrating making it more unpleasant.
I support good causes however I do not like to become part of an someone else's event.
Very disappointing BBC cannot host these events privately 
They should close down the restaurant to regular patrons to avoid us becoming part of the loud events.
It's great business for them but the regular patrons are filing out on the way to Elizabeth's for peace and quiet three days out of your days a week.
And we waited an hour for a table.
They were holding one for a Mr DuPont patron who never showed up while we waited with the table empty for a hour.:/
Crazy night.
I do not recommend anyone to go on any event night.
Too bad they cannot build on a room to host their events.
Disappointing since it was one of our fav places:/

Once again the food here doesn't disappoint! Everything I've had here is full of flavor and extremely fresh. The manager, Cooper, is always very polite and helpful. It's definitely my go to for a quality brunch when I'm in the city!

Decent food, great view, and the best pie I've ever eaten in my life.

It was the "Ozark Mountain Berry", and I've only been able to try it once.  The next two times I returned it was either sold out or hadn't been made that day.  Shucks.

It was great place. Now they are cheating to customer. Try order 1 salmon sushi and order 2 salmon sushi, exactly same quantity salmon even if you order 3 salmon sushi. They make slight as much as you order. Plz owner has to be change mind if he wants to be best. I missed when they are open.
Absolutely amazing fast service! Delicious food and even better frozen custard! Good prices, good music!

Great market when you are looking fresh vegetable and fantastic meats. Only one problem, the crowds of tourist just milling around lost. 
Love Iovines for fresh fruits and Veggies. And Martine for the best chicken and turkey products.

The St. Louis style ribs with the Memphis Rub... OMGOSSHHH! I have eaten at a few bbq places here in FL, and these ribs are really good, jus like home! I licked my fingers and thoroughly enjoyed myself while doin it! LOL I will be back, for sure.

I've eaten lunch here nearly every weekday for 8+ years. Best hospital cafeteria I have ever be to. Salad bar is fantastic and a very good price - just under $6 for greens + five toppings. Lots of different stations (Mexican, Pizza, Hamburgers, etc), all with good food. My only complaint is that the Chinese food station is surprisingly expensive for not much food. For Chinese, better to go to food trucks outside hospital. (Cafeteria run by Aramark with contacts to other private restaurants. For example, Garces used to control the Mexican food station).

I can only speak to the food (ordered Postmates from here last week) and it was phenomenal. I've literally raved about them every day since. My boyfriend and I split the bulgogi fries and I had the wings. The flavor balance on both was lively- sweet, spicy and salty, but I didn't feel gross after eating. The portions were generous and leftovers good too. The kimchi fried rice is even better cold +1 day. I like that the containers are all compostable. Will definitely dine in soon and often. Thanks!

I mean, it's a cheesesteak. As far as Philly cheesteaks go, this place has a pretty great variety with a friendly staff. It was a pretty good cheesesteak. VERY large serving size which is always wonderful. I would say a bit above average. Plenty of seating , easy to find. I would go back.

I saw this place on a few blogs and compared to Jim's on South Street, I am a bit underwhelmed but still - pretty good. That's all I got.

How I do love a good hot dog, and with the recent advent of gourmet hot dog "restaurants" I am literally in hog (I mean dog) heaven.

I actually found Diva Dawg by "accident" as I was stuck in traffic on Magazine St.  The culprit of the traffic was a car exiting a parking spot in front of Diva Dawg so I "ganked" his parking spot and opted to give Diva Dawg a try.  What a great move this turned out to be.

I decided to keep it simple and ordered the "Diva Dawg", which is their signautre dog.  My idea of the perfect condiments are sauerkraut, chili, onions and a squirt of spicy mustard.  This premium beef dog had a subtle cajun spice and is made with what I think is a natural casing, as it had that "snap" when I bit into it.  The dog itself is as fresh as it gets, as Diva Dawg gets all of their hot dogs locally from Vaucresson's; which has been making their sausages in New Orleans' 7th ward neighborhood since 1899. 

Nothing can ruin a hot dog quicker than sad a$$ bun.  But Diva Dawg has the best tasting bun I've ever had.  In fact, I never knew how important the bun was to the overall experience until I tried this one.  Once again, Diva Dawg sought out a local bakery (Laurel Street Bakery) for their buns.  This bun was amazing.  I know you are all thinking, hey it's just a bun.  But you would be wrong to assume that.  Their buns are baked similarly to a brioche in that they are very light in texture  and are made with a high butter and egg content that imparts a wonderfully puffy texture and rich taste.  There is a subtle sweeteness to it that reminds me of a Kings Hawaiian sweet bread.  However, this bun is lightly grilled and the outer layer is reminiscent of Texas Toast or a lightly toasted grilled cheese sandwich, yet it remains light and fluffy on the inside.  Just trust me in that this is a great bun.

I won't spend a lot of time on anything else as this was a quick lunch, and we were in an out in a hurry.  My co-worker had the Zapp's dog which contained crumbled Zapp's potato chips and was topped with chili & nacho cheese.  However, I did not sample it and cannot comment on the taste.  However, it looked solid and he confirmed my observation.

The staff is super friendly and informative about the menu.  In fact, it was nice to experience their pride in their workplace, as they were almost bragging; and rightfully so.

Can't wait to go back and 'get me some more'!

Went for lunch at opening time and was pleased with great service and even better food. Had the fried chicken sandwich and the beet side dish. Both were very fresh and well-prepared. Also had the Brussels sprout appetizer and that was also great. My friend's BLT was well above what one would expect for such a simple sandwich. Highly recommend and look forward to returning.

Update: Their customer friendliness has improved substantially, thank you. You're now acknowledged, greeted, smiled at, etc.

The Juice bar area, while improving from more options/Acai bowls, etc, is still painfully slow, painfully. Additionally when (2) employees are in the area (5'x5') there is not sufficient counter space for 2 people to prep the product, so the customers again experience further delay.  

I like the ocassional sales/discounts I've seen at the deli counter. Keep up the improvements, we appreciate it.

I've upped 2 stars to 3.

Is has great atmosphere. The staff was very pleasant and professional. The Chicken Cutlet Melt is great the balance of the flavor and crispy of the breading. Their chipotle blue cheese dressing is great with parmesan fries. Will come back again for us next time their French Toast.
The blueberry wheat germ pancakes are awesome! Good coffee, quick service, and a table in the sun at the beach in Santa Barbara. What more can you ask for?

Pub n sub is great. It's locally owned and they use some of the best ingredients. It may seem expensive at first, but it you go on a special day it's an amazing deal. You get so much food for so cheap. It's also really good for vegetarians, because there are quite a few options on the menu. Some of the ingredients seem like they shouldn't go on a pizza, but don't diss it till you try it. Try one of the pizzas that are house specials, you won't regret it.
Although seemingly popular with some locals, my fish sandwich was so salty as to be inedible. Friendly service. No pretenses.

I have been here just once... and that experience was so good to get me to come back! 
I was here for their Sat-Sun brunch and nothing to complain about. I  have tried thousand of brunches in NYC, and although, this is not an unlimited boozy brunch, it is all you are going to need. Besides, it is good to take a break from those watery-too-sweet drinks included in NYC brunches and just opt for what you should drink (well, sometimes it can go from 1 to 10 mimosas LOL).
You have a buffet to choose from, and with the best quality meals: omelettes (diy), artisan sandwiches, cheeses, salads, cutting sections (meats), olives, quiches, etc.. and the sweet station has no comparison, there is even a donut station where you can create your own donut (customize it)... Although, I am not a big fun of donuts, I did try one.
The atmosphere is also nice, with high ceilings and pictures hanging on the walls. Maybe the seating might not be to your liking, but this is another way to interact with others.
As I said, alcoholic drinks are not included, but you have unlimited coffee/tea and freshly squeezed juices, on top of a menu with very good prices for cocktails and the like.
Service was great, our waitress was attentive and friendly at all times.
I actually wish I can find something similar in NYC to enjoy (quality meal and sweets).
If you are visiting Philly on a weekend, I strongly suggest you to stop by H&C and you can thank me later. Reservations are strongly recommended.
Until my next visit... which I have already scheduled! 
P.S. Pics to come later.

Really struggled with this one...

They were humming along at a solid four stars all the way through dinner.  I like a place where I'm young compared to most of their patrons.  

When it came time to pay, we were tired so I just handed the waiter my credit card and he brought me back the slip to sign.  Only there were two of us and he had run my card for the $180 bill that the party of 6 behind us amassed!  He was very apologetic but that's a pretty egregious mistake for a waiter so I took another star.  

I started with a Russian Mule;  it was yummy and of course served in the ultra chic copper cup.  Bread service was tasty and included real butter pats.  Split a calamari appetizer - it was tasty, but was all rings and the tentacles are my favorite.  For dinner I had the grouper oscar - grouper topped with crab meat, beurre blanc, and asparagus.  I chose market veggies as my side, mostly because I wanted to try rutabaga and it was a component.  I dug the rutabaga,and would order it again.

Not a perfect experience, but A-OK and I would definitely try them again if I find myself in Tampa.

My family and I came back 2 days in a row! Friendly and efficient service. We ordered walnut shrimp, pan fried chow mein, salt and pepper pork spare ribs, crab and fish maw soup, and fried rice. We also got pho #3 to go. I think the next time we are in town we will remember to stop by, thank you!!

Well just moved Cherry Hill and was out shopping and wanted to try a new restaurant so we did. Well probably the last and only time we will come back to Distrito. We ordered the steak and shrimp fajitas and we were very very disappointed in the dishes for the price. First of all it was all onion and very very few other vegetables. There were some peppers but very hard to pick them out. The steak was probably just a skirt steak thin and extremely disappointing. I think you got my drift no need to go into the shrimp fajitas more of the same like the steak. We were really disappointed.
This place has some of the best brunch in New Orleans, hand down. Amazing service paired with even better food. Worth the wait that it sometimes takes. Freddie H was the man!

I have been going to Makiman for about 8 years. It is always great! Some of my favs are the TO no mo! roll which has another name now that T. Owens is not with the eagles.But the service is good, the place is clean and the food is delish!!! The cap n crunch is wonderful, and my kids go crazy for the eel. I never have been disappointed.

It's really great when you can eat 3 flour tacos, one grilled chicken, one steak and the other barbacoa and be left feeling satisfied. No heaviness. Tacos were vibrant and earthy. Have to ask for a squeeze of lime on next visit. Otherwise, everything was fresh and clean tasting. I hope that makes sense.

Yeah, I managed a slice of Tres Leches...nom, nom!
Love this place!! I will return when we come back to Nashville. We maybe waited 10 minutes outside and that was it. We got  in and out in about an hour. Food was AMAZING! They service was great!

We have always been their customers since they were open. The hot pot was always good but the bbq was so so. Their wait staff was very nice before that's why we kept going back. But two weeks ago we had the worse experience we ever had when we were there. The service sucked. The dirty dishes kept piled up on the side seat and the empty bottles never got taken away. The sever kept disappear on us. The bbq food was all very tasteless. We had 9 people that day and it made all of us fell disappointed. Don't think we will go back anytime soon.

This just absolutely wonderful. I had a brisket, cat fish plate that was great. There pre packages sauces were just perfect, enough in a package to use, which was refreshing not having to open bunch of pouches. Anyway really enjoyed the over experience. I'll eT here again

I have no beef with the IKEA concept. I shop at the store and have done so for years. I go there with my mom. But...

I had a very distressing incident occur during my most recent visit on November 5. While I was in the store, I was taking photographs as well as video clips of the store displays using my cell phone, for Google Maps. I am a "local guide" and do this for many stores in Philadelphia. I have noted that Ikea has many similar pictures online, and no posted policy that photography is not allowed.

Consider how many shots of this IKEA are here on Yelp...

Nevertheless, I was approached by security and told to put my camera way and stop taking pictures. I was told that this is because a customer complained.

I would like to note that I was careful not to include any customers in any of the imagery I captured.

now, I understand that a store has the right to ask somebody to simply stop taking pictures. That is not my complaint. 

I am upset that the security guard was not able to cite the policy that would form the foundation for the request that I stop doing something that it is readily apparent is permitted.

when I further requested clarification from the store manager, I was simply told that a customer didn't like that I was taking pictures.

That is simply not a good enough answer. I want to clear response as to what the policy is regarding photography inside the store. And explicitly I'd like to know what the policy is when there are no customers or Ikea associates in the images, since I understand and respect the right to privacy.

At this point I'm left feeling nervous that if I were to take a photograph inside an Ikea, a total stranger can request that management use security to stop me from doing so.

The whole thing is very unfortunate to, rather uncomfortable, and it's entirely unclear if it was in any way justified by any sort of policy.

I've never left a bad review but I feel like I should be allowed to since this is where I chose to go for my birthday and it was horrible. 

The bus outside or you can order drinks is a really cool idea and a lot of fun but the actual restaurant is not. It is so crowded and close quarters. The tables and chairs are so uncomfortable. I came with a table of six and they shoved us into a corner and we were literally touching elbows because we were so close together. 

The service was fine. Every table in there was filled so they were super busy and had their hands full. However, getting charged a dollar for everything even just sour cream is a lot. There is a big pressure to upsell everyone at the table and there is a lot of add-ons that they try and slip past you that you later find out on your bill. For instance, I got the grits and I was asked if I wanted to add avocado or an extra egg and I said yeah sure and it was almost a four dollar up charge?? 

The grits had whole pork in it and it literally tasted so wet that it was like slop... when I sent it back I was very nice about it and felt really uncomfortable because they were so busy sending it back but it was my birthday so I wanted something I liked. When I let the waiter know I was met with 1000 questions about why I didn't like it... I ended up just ordering two sides because I didn't know what I wanted. The waiter was nice and gave me a free drink for my birthday since I couldn't find anything else I wanted. 

Maybe it's because I went on a Saturday but it was so uncomfortably packed and the food was so subpar it legit was the worst bday brunch I've ever had.
Great place.   The Mrs. and me have been coming here for years.   Consistently good experience.

I like to consider myself a donut aficionado, so when Hook and Press Donuts opened up in the Mosaic Locale a month ago I knew I had to try.

My friend and I shared the POG, Pumpkin Cheesecake and the Mexican chocolate. All were incredibly delicious and the dough is one of the best in the city. Of the three the best BY FAR was the POG (passion fruit, orange, and guava). The icing was tangy and sweet - a super unique combination that worked in all the right ways. The pumpkin cheesecake is a filled donut an the Mexican chocolate tastes like a dark chocolate iced donut. For the three donuts and two regular coffees it ended up being around $17.50. $3.50/donut seems pretty pricey to me, especially if the flavors can be found elsewhere. 

However, if you're looking for pretty donuts and a pretty atmosphere (aka for the 'gram), then you are in the right place!

If I could give 6 stars I would, they just do a fantastic job here. Dining without Michael as my server would not be the same experience. The waits outside are frustrating even with a reservation but it's worth it. 
Pad Thai and Garlic shrimp or chicken all great. The Shrimp Penang Mole is magical. Is a staple for a yummy night out. Sangria is delicious too.

As a Korean New Orleanian, born and raised in Seoul until a couple of years ago, I like this place a lot. This place does Korean food right. The food is clean, MSG free, and VERY authentic.

I hope they keep up because I plan on going back regularly.
Highly disappointed because they had NO RIBS or MAC&CHEESE. A rib joint with no ribs on a Saturday. SAD SAD SAD.

What a pleasant surprise to find a Dutch restaurant in Tucson of all places. The best surprise was finding some of my favorite dishes on the menu. The patat oorlag with pindasaus and echte frietsaus and this Dutch girl was in heaven! Topping off my meal, I had to have the Poffertjes...and they just melted in my mouth! Thank you to Candace for the excellent service! I thoroughly enjoyed a taste of home!

Manager tried to give away my branzino to his friends that came in after us.  We strongly objected and he never came to the table to explain the problem. Never going back there. Food is mediocre at best. Owner shows preference to his friends. Does not treat all customers the same.

Service was great.  Went in to order my dinner.  I asked for a suggestion on a burger and the Brisket Burger was recommended.    I got that, some tator tots, and a Carmel shake. 

Sandwich was so so.  Didn't care for the bun, so I ate the brisket and bacon, which were good.  Tots with a little catsup was good.   Shake was good, but on the thin side....too much milk. 

Should've had a regular burger on a regular bun
Come here to try 4 courses summer special, end up we order whole table of food like we always do for 3 plus 2 kiddo, always good food & the service

Well to start off with this bar, they put cheap liquor in expensive liquor bottles to try to rip you off. I had ordered regular shot of grey goose and it was some cheap flavored vodka. I told the bartender to pour it again in front of my face. Same thing. They had poured shitty alcohol in brand named bottles. Of course they act like they had no idea how it could happen. It's clientele isn't a surprise. Full of douchebags.

Connot go back.  We loved eating here when the two sisters worked here.  One left and service kind of showed it.  Then on prime rib might we went and the cook was off so the owner was cooking.  Our meal arrived and I had a bunch of hair in my meal.  I called the waitress and she pointed out my wife's plat had hair in it too.  My wife started gagging from it and walked out.  The waitress asked if we wanted anything else? Not only mom but hell no.  Then she brought me my ticket for 2 prime rib dinners that never were touched.  Never again

We were happy to find a hibachi restaurant in the area! We didn't even know it was there because it was hidden in the corner. It was actually really good and we got seated right away. We got a lot of food and you get both rice and noodles with your hibachi selection. We will definitely be stopping back in.
If this place were any slower they'd be moving backwards! And poorly stocked.  10 am and out of plain bagels and bread! Not to mention the line and the air head help.
Bangkok kapow wows, Tom yum is yummy, Duck and rice iz very nice,. Massaman curry is dearly. That's all I ordered tonight.

Very good BBQ. First ribs I've had in a while. I preferred the wet style. The Cole slaw was a bit different and we didn't like it much. Considered "the" BBQ of Nashville. Very busy at lunch and dinner times. Hi at an "odd" time like we did.
It's a subway.  If you've eaten at one, you're familiar.  This one is always clean and the people are nice.
Nice authentic pizza - fresh food, vegetarian options many. We sat by the gulf waters, nice views. They were able to make vegetarian pasta for us - not on the menu. Easy parking and good music.

So good, but definitely on the salty side. 3.5 for food, 4 for ambience and service. 

This was my second time here, my first probably at least 4 years ago in the baby college years when everything tasted good. 

Came for restaurant week like everyone else. Picked this one cause I had been here before and they actually put stuff from their regular menu on restaurant week. 

The stracciatella was amazing. Super creamy with a hint of salt and perfect with the grilled bread. Olives on the side to snack on. Too bad you get like three small half slices of grilled bread. I was half considering just buying more bread. 

For the apps, we got the BVP meatballs. Rich and super flavorful with the cheese in the middle, marinara and more cheese. The wild mushroom arancini was also a great one. Who doesn't love fried risotto?

For the mains, we got the lemon chicken al marine, the rigatoni, and the pan fried gnocchi. I think this is where it went a little sideways. The chick was super tender, but definitely more on the salty side. I liked the crispy fingerlings though. The rigatoni was average as pasta goes. The pan fried gnocchi was salty too. The gnocchi was a tad too mushy and not enough pan fried. 

Desserts were luxurious, but we were all too full to enjoy them to their rich potential. We got two tiramisus and the pistachio cannoli. Tiramisu definitely wins out and it's a decently large portion. The pistachio cannoli comes with two small ones. They were pretty good too. 

I might come back, but honestly for a regular meal it was too salty for me. Maybe next year.

I'm happy to say that the service, food, and environment met my expectations which is not easy to achieve. Typically when you go somewhere you don't get all of that. Does not disappoint, must go if your driving by or if you live in the Reno/Sparks area.

Finally drove to this place to see why so many gave this place five stars.  After my visit, I walk back to the car wondering why five stars... I have to say the place did not impress me at all.  The staff was pleasant and look good enough to eat but for the food, well I can only say "at least I gave the place a try".  
Allow me to explain!  We tried the place out between lunch and dinner time to avoid the rush. Being the only customers, we tried couple of dishes and appetizers.  As we waited on the food, we looked over the place as it is an old building probably was a house at one time renovated as a restaurant.  Our first concern was the location of the bathroom as it sits right at the dining room.  There are 3 tables facing the door way and we were thinking how embarrassing it would be to come out after doing #2 and the smell enters the dining room.  LOL!!  If I sat at the table directly in front of the door, I would just about gag.  The other concern was a back door that goes out the back alley where we were certain the trash bins were located.  Couple of times, the door would open by an employee and flies would enter and end up on our food.  We had to wave over our food to get the flies away.  Very gross!!!!  But most of you readers would probably care little over these issues and would rather want to know about the food, correct?  
Well, as for the food, I ordered a soda and receive a can instead of a glass from a soda fountain.  Now mind you as we were seated, I saw the nice cloth (CLOTH) mind you, wrapped around our silverware.  I said "now there is a nice touch to an old building".  I was expecting a lot from here on but when the can of soda was presented to me, I looked over my shoulder to see if it came out of a soda machine.  And to top it off, it did not come with a glass of ice and the cost was $2.  Yikes!!!!!   The appetizer was good, and it had my palate craving for the main dish.  Mine was the mix grill and for the most part, was ok in flavor with an exception to the third meat.  I recognize the beef and the chicken but not sure about the third meat.  I had to drown it with lots of sauce to get it down my stomach.  The other platter was the lamb dish and was actually worth the price.  We drove a from Illinois to try this place and glad we did so now we know we can wait for the second try.  Parking is not that great cause of the area so be aware of walking a good ways to the front door.  
Over all the visit was ok but definitely not a 5 star restaurant.

So delicious!! Great staff and good service . The food is fresh and very tasty . Definitely my new favorite Mexican spot . Thumbs up !! I would recommend this to anybody that wants Mexican food for sure

Seamus McDaniel's in Dogtown is a St. Louis staple.  There is a small parking lot in the back and street parking all around.  

Walk into Seamus McDaniel's and immediately feel at ease.  From single diners to large groups, Seamus has a seat for you.  There is bar seating, table seating, booth seating, and even patio/enclosed patio seating depending the time of year.

I recommend the Buffalo Chicken Sandwich or Burgers.  Ranch is King at Seamus; you must try their homemade Ranch Dressing.  Fries dipped in Ranch Dressing are a total win.  Caramelized Onions make the burgers that much better.  I will be back soon.

I really wanted to like this place.  Its close to home and we so need a good Sports bar.  But every time I go not so much to like..... The outdoor area was always dog friendly and now that is no longer an option.  They close at 10 and while watching the Rays game in the 8th inning at 945pm they told us they were closing and we would have to leave.
Food at Hooters has always just been average.  My last visit the service was slow to say the least, and then the dirty dishes sat on the table till I actually approached the manager who had them removed.  She did give me a card for 10 free wings, but I don't think I will be back.

This place is a hidden gem. Was debating on what to order and Olivia was kind enough to go over the menu and give us recommendations on what to order and the favorites. Decided on The cinnamon maple biscuits with icing, green tomatoes and the squawking goat biscuit sandwich. The biscuits were baked perfectly nice golden and lightly toasted. Great buttery flavor in the biscuits. The green tomatoes was some of the best I ever had, fresh and super delicious. The squawking goat succulent, juicy fried chicken with fresh goat cheese and some tasty pepper jelly. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Special thanks to Jindi and Olivia the owner couldn't ask for better employees.

Chipotle in a food court?  I thought part of their business model was the uniqueness of the design of their dining space.  I have been to this location a few times and the quality of the food is almost as good as that of the stand-alone stores.  The atmosphere is, well, a food court so that right there is a minus but they are good for take-away.  I am basing my rating on all my years of food court dining and the reasons to do that--need to eat lunch while shopping at the mall, driving on a road trip and a mall food court gives you lots of quick options if you are a vegetarian, etc.  They are one of the best options at this particular food court but I'd prefer to eat at one of the stand-alone locations.
Best cheesesteak we found in Philly. We liked ours with lettuce tomato and onion. And onion rings good too. Get the ordering right though!

Really!!! You made your breakfast bowl half the size but you still charge the same price as before...??? Well you just lost me as a customer because I'm not paying for half the amount..I'll go to Wendy's from now on.

Awesome!  My wife & I were looking for new restaurants to eat at around Hendersonville.  We found this little gem online & saw all the good reviews.  We thought we'd give it a shot.  We just came back from eating here on a Saturday night at 6:30.  There wasn't ONE person there, but we decided to still go in since we read all of the great reviews.  The people working there said the crowd had just left.  Anyway, my wife & I both received a free sample of their Italian beef.  Wow.  We were sold.  We both got the Italian beef along with an order of cheese fries.  I have to say it was one of the best sandwiches I've ever had.  The meat was tender & juicy, and the spices they use tasted amazing.  The cheese fries had a nice crunch since they just came out of the oven.  The staff were also very friendly.  Although we were stuffed, we HAD to try a cannoli.  I'm a sucker for a good cannoli, and I read some reviews that said they were authentic.  Boy, were they right!  The cannoli was fresh and tasted awesome with the cinnamon in the dough.  We'll definitely be back!  Can't believe we have missed this place all these years!

Extremely disappointed. Was told an hour wait. Waited for one hour 45 minutes. Hostess is not very friendly and actually is not honest about wait times. If rather be over told than under told. Brew master was very nice and knowledgeable as well as bar tender. The wait staff looks stressed and over worked. The food was just ok. I am not certain if come back. But if I do I will have to have a reservation but from what I've read those don't work out well either.

After walking by Audrey Claire and jealously staring at the dishes it's diners were eatting, I finally decided to come here for dinner. The wait  can really be hit or miss as they do not take reservations. 

Being a byob, I naturally gravitate towards loving the atmosphere and fresh ingredients that they use. I wish they offered the use f traditional wine glasses as the smaller ones they used were not particularly good to swirl the wine and open it up I did not pack an Aerator with me

We started with the smoked salmon flatbread which was a disappointment. We had about 1 salmon piece on the whole flat bread and it was basically a salad. The dressing they used was nice and light but I cannot recommend this dish.

Moving on to the entree round is where the restaurant received it's stars. My husband got the Australian Sea bass special. This was amazing the Sea bass was crisp yet still light and flaky. The risotto was perfectly creamy and cooked to perfection.

I ordered the black truffle potato encrusted tuna which was served with the freshest and crispest free beans I have ever had!

Though I did not prefer the glass choice and the flatbread the entrees were superb an fresh!
Food was good, we ordered butter chicken and paneer masala, both were spicy and good. But owner is very rude, someone has to teach them how to talk to customers. I Wouldn't recommend anyone to go.
I have been here for lunch several times. The food is delicious and so ridiculously cheap, I want to tell the owner to raise the prices so he can stay in business!!!
Great atmosphere and food. The lobster rolls are the best around. My only complaints are the pricing and the lack of a proper waiting area.

If I could give this place no stars, I would.

My husband and I came to Bella Italia while on our honeymoon in Reno because we received two 25 dollar gift certificates as a gift. When we arrived we were immediately disappointed by the horrible atmosphere, or shall I say lack of atmosphere.

The next blow came when we asked for a drink menu and were informed that water was the only available beverage. Next, the waitress informed us that we could only use one of our gift certificates.

The table next to us (the only other table in the restaurant, in fact) were just about to pay and we offered to give them one of our gift certificates for 20 dollars (they'd make 5 dollars and we would get to use both of our gift certificates since we probably wouldn't be in Reno again anytime soon to use the second one... seemed like a win-win situation). That is until the owner/chef decided to come to our table and yell at us for losing him money and "doing bad business".

This of course made me burst into tears as our first romantic dinner as a married couple went up into smoke. The man walked away and we continued to sit there as my husband attempted to console me and convince me to leave. But being the stubborn girl I am I wasn't ready to leave yet. However, apparently the man was ready for us to leave since he just decided to never come back to take our order. Talk about excellent customer service.

My husband, not wanting to make a huge scene, waited for the other table to leave. He then approached the man and asked if he could explain  why we were losing him money and basically demanded that he apologize to me. Further arguing ensued before we finally made it out the door.

Apparently the gift certificates had been bought as a two for one deal (two 25 dollar gift certificates for only 25 dollars). We did not know that coming into the restaurant but either way I am still not sure how we were losing him money, since he was the one that must have done that promotion in order to bring people into his obviously failing restaurant.

Newsflash Mr. Angry Italian Man, if you are trying to get people into your restaurant and especially if you want them to ever return then maybe you should actually treat them with respect while they are there. Take a course on customer service and perhaps your restaurant wouldn't be failing miserably. As someone who has worked in the food service industry for 6 years (three in an Italian restaurant, actually), I was in total shock at the lack of customer service in this establishment.

On top of all that, let me say that I was still pissed that we hadn't been able to use our other gift certificate. I didn't want to let him win, so I convinced my husband that I should go back the next afternoon for a to-go order. Luckily the man that had yelled at us the night before never came out of the kitchen and the girl in the front was not the some one from the night before.

So we did end up getting a salad and pasta. The salad was lunch meat and some balls of mozzarella with some dressing that tasted like nothing and the pasta was drowned in so much pesto sauce that it was nearly a pesto pasta soup.

Now, I don't want to accuse anyone of anything, but my husband and I also felt sick for about two days after eating the food here. So whether it was intentional or not, it certainly cemented in my mind that Bella Italia is a horrible horrible place to dine.

Overall, probably the worst restaurant experience I have ever had.

Stopped in during a quick trip down Frenchmen Street. Didn't get what we ordered exactly but had to be going so we ate our grilled cheese with cheddar without comment. They were decent. Nothing spectacular but they were one of the cheapest items on the menu so didn't expect much. Just disappointed they couldn't get such a simple order correct. I recommend if you come here be very explicit in making your order. Other than that, nice cheap eats.
Just got another well-done pepperoni pie. They are great!!! Their crust has just a little crackery crunch to it. Their sauce has just a touch of sweetness.

Once again the worst service ever. Had an 88th birthday dinner for my dad and if we were lucky the waitress came to our table maybe 3 times. Had to go up and ask her to get me a beer. So to the management get more help both in the kitchen and on the floor. You change the place but your service sucks. Somebody has to figure this out 2nd time but will be the last time.

My in-laws live in Hillsboro Village & told us we ought to check this place out. 
We were very happy we did. 
Even though it was a rather cold rainy evening the heaters on the deserted patio were very inviting. 
They offered us happy hour drink specials of which I tried a couple. 
We are so spoilt for great cocktail bars in Nashville (as well as the very well stocked 1 at our house) that unless I'm going to a restaurant for drinks, or they just really wow me, I don't count underwhelming tastings against them. 
The burgers were legit as were the fries. Our very friendly waitress bought us a fancy ketchup for our fries but we ate them all without even trying it!
Even on a dreary weeknight we noticed the patronage swelling with an enthusiastic hum as the dinner hour advanced.
