Great food!!! The oysters were amazing! Order the east coast oysters over the west coast oysters. Overall the seafood @ parc is great; the scallops and the bouillabaisse were very good. Don't forget to get the cheesecake for desert, the creme brulee was just ok, u can tell it came outta the fridge.

We have enjoyed countless meals at Elvira's in Tubac with visiting family and friends.  And they were all terrific.

Our daughter was visiting with a friend and asked to try the Tucson version or Elvira's. She is senior management for an Iron Chef/ James Beard awarding winning chef with dozens of highly acclaimed restaurants.

7PM Saturday night it was partially filled and we were shown directly to our seats back by the kitchen. Not my first choice for seating but...

The house Margarita and Paloma cocktails were delicious. We naturally ordered the $0.50 Hola tequila shots---one for each entree. We started with a table shared Fundido Natural and a Mussels special.  Both were well prepared and wonderful.

Kitchen timing was off---the entrees arrived before we finished the appetizer course and the waiter was in a hurry to clear the table. We were in no rush but...

Entrees were Chiles Poblano Frida Kalho, a chicken Mole negro, a special Snapper and a sizzling hot Flank Steak Molcajete in Salsa Verde. Flavors were very savory. Two of the entrees were barely warm.  We asked about warming and they said they would start over but that would take time and the other table members would be finished when they appeared appeared. The side plates of rice and beans were all cold and one was sent back and quickly replaced with a warmer plate. 

From our vantage point near the kitchen window we noticed many kitchen staff members just milling around.

We were offered a shared complimentary Caribbean Treat (Bananas Fosters).It was then 8pm with few tables taken but it took a while to arrive at our table. The flavors were delicious but the bananas were barely warm as if they failed to flambe the dessert or it sat in the kitchen being neglected.

We asked to take home a portion of the chicken mole negro but it never appeared at our table and the waiter had disappeared. By that point we had given up.

Sooo, overall not a great dining experience. Cold entrees for $200.
Love love this place great vibe great atmosphere great food great drinks obsessed with this place.

I assume this restaurant gets more positive buzz for its location than it's actual quality of food. I traveled down to Hyde Park twice to try this restaurant. Unfortunately,  both times have been the same. 

The actual establishment is nice. Large TVs with sports and a long bar for eating/drinking. There is an outdoor eating patio,  but I didn't sit there. Too many flies to enjoy a meal. 

The menu is small,  but has a good enough selection that most groups will find something they want. I personally like the burgers. They are large and flavorful. From this review alone I would rate a high 4 even 5 star. 

Unfortunately this establishment has some of the worst waitresses I've been around. It takes a long time to get orders taken,  drinks refilled,  and checks delivered. I've sat in my booth waiting for my check as the waitress discussed her current relationship with what I assume as one of the regulars. Mind you the waitress only had 3 tables so it wasn't busy. Each time I've gone has been the same story. We eventually have to get up and ask for our check. I don't like feeling like a hostage. 

Because of the poor service I can't rate this higher than a 2. If management makes some changes I will gladly come back to redo my review.

I've been wanting to try a Poke Bowl for a while now and I'm SO happy I gave this place a shot.  Since I didn't know much about what to choose, one of the workers gave me some of his recommendations.  I got shrimp with a spicy Korean BBQ sauce on it.  Definitely a good recommendation-but next time I'll try something different just because I'm curious about the other sauces they have.

When I was selecting my toppings, there were so many yummy things to choose from. I got avocado, mango, cucumbers and wonton strips.  When I got home to eat my bowl I was INSANELY HAPPY.  I loved every bite.  I'm super into things like sushi and fish and this was really delicious and completely satisfied my craving.  I am definitely taking my fiance' here and I am even happier to know they are making a location in Conshy so I can walk to get Poke' bowls :) yum!

This is my favorite spot in UCity, the people here and the service I've received has always been consistent and beyond expectations. I enjoy the happy hour, the food and drinks are really fulfilling. Today the manager stopped by my table and introduced himself stating, "I see you here all the times and I just would like to introduce myself and asked for my name." Much appreciated effort going above and beyond to recognize your frequent customers
If you like comfort food, this is the place. Breakfast plates are really big and with so many options, is very difficult to decide on what to eat. Recommended place.

I highly recommend their Bramble cocktail, I crave it all the time. So dangerously delicious. Their cheeses are awesome and there's this one pickled beet spread (I think?) paired with it that is so amazing. The vegetarian Shepard's pie is killer! They host burlesque every Monday night which is a lot of fun.

I ordered delivery when I was staying in Clearwater on business. The basil stir fry was very tasty, as were the fried spring rolls. The only unfortunate thing is that they forgot to bring rice with my meal. The delivery person was very apologetic and came back 15-20 minutes later with some rice. I ended up eating the stir fry without it and I still enjoyed it very much.

I've been here for both happy hour and for dinner. Happy hour is amazing, truffle fries were so good, and pretty good drink specials. Lots of people, making for a good scene after work. Also had a delicious dinner. Lobster bisque and wedge starters- both great. Had the scallops and short rib for entree and it was awesome! Other people at my table got the filet and thought it was cooked perfectly. Got the carrots, Mac and cheese and garlic mashed potatoes for sides and I recommend all of them- the carrots were surprisingly good! Sweetly glazed. Service was great, beautiful restaurant. Though there are a lot of high end steak house places, ocean prime is still worth a visit.

There is nothing new i can say about this place that has not already been said. yats is an indy institution in my opinion. Having tried almost all their dishes and offerings i can say that they know what they doing to entice your taste buds. From the maque choux to jambalaya and everything in between in tasty. At these prices it is also a very reasonable place to eat for great taste and super fast service.
My co-workers and i have almost unanimously voted to eat here multiple times for office lunches.
When i have had friends from other places try it, most have fallen in love with it and asked to be taken back. 
I have been to new orleans and i realized that yats has truly perfected the art of making cajun food and is better than most places i had been to over there.
overall, this neighborhood hole in the wall has now become a roaring chain in indy but its good to see that the quality has remained the same, though the portion size seems to keep going down on a consistent 3 month basis. The day i will ever dock stars for them is when at 8 bucks they stop filling me up with a sense of satisfaction.
Best bbq in town better then brush fire they don't skimp on the meat like brushfire does.

The restaurant has a nice location and style, but the overall experience wasn't a pleasant experience.  The dinning room was freezing cold, not only did my girlfriend complained but also the party of 6 behind us. 

We ordered the quesadilla and the fish tacos.  The quesadilla was good.  However, the fish tacos were also good but SUPER tiny, I have never seen a tortilla that small from my experience dinning out.  It was almost the size of a lemon, not kidding (I will uploaded a photo).  I told the waiter very politely about the matter and she actually admited having the same complaints on previous ocasions!

We decided we didnt wanted to continue eating there because of the small dishes so we ended having entrees somewhere else.

They tried to bring me tacos when I ordered a tostada and I said " these are tacos, looks like it's carnitas and chicken "(being a so-cal native I know what a damn taco is) but the waiter insisted "that's what the order said, I'll come back when you know"... rude and its strange  HOW DO YOU NOT KNOW THE DIFFERENCE AND HOW FISH LOOKS LIKE COMPARED TO DARK STRINGY BROWN CARNITAS , WOW. He kind of rushed off and got the tostada with fish that was OK but kind of greasy..upset stomach for both of us. The only positive was the tri tip sandwich was decent. Seems like a cool place to get drinks and but that's basically all..this place would not last a month down south.

The food was good! The Monday night music was a blast! Real good blues, and then an awesome open jam session consisting of a band of six people who never met, but sounded awesome together! It doesn't look like much from the outside, but you you must check this Place out!

Better each time....have now tried several items and specials and have a more difficult choice each time with prior knowledge of " deliciosity " and still  the desire to explore the menu and then blindsided by a special that I cannot pass up, ugh so much good, so little tummy space....

I had only had greek food once before visiting Hellas. My niece and sister took my mom and I. They are huge greek food fans. To say I was pleasantly surprised would be an understatement. The food is heavenly! They ordered 6-8 different foods to try. Every single thing was beyond delicious. You can't go wrong at this amazing restaurant. Please stop by and take some friends with you. Afterwards, go next door to Hella's Bakery. You'll be glad you did.
Really really bad drinks. We had to send our first round back and the waitress seemed a little hesitant to take them. The second round (both margaritas) wasn't much better

As far as Philly Pretzel Factory locations go, this one's as good as it gets.

The employees always welcome me with a smile. The pretzels are usually hot and fresh.  The private rooms are always clean and tidy. (Oh, no, wait that last one's some other place I'm thinking of.)

Conveniently located around the corner from Ultimo Coffee@Brew, I often pick up a pretzel or two on my way to get my blissful buzz on. Phoodie Alert™: pretzels and coffee are an excellent pairing. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise.

So I actually discovered The Tomato Bistro from a Groupon a few months ago.  Holy cow what an awesome deal!  4 course meal for 2 people for $25!

Pros: The Bistro is located upstairs, cute atmosphere, good service.  Perfect portion sizes, we were actually full before the pizza came out (salad and 3 small plates prior to the pizza).  And the waitress was pretty attentive.  Oh, and I did sample duck bruschetta at a Yelp event 2 weeks ago - tasty!

Cons: I guess my only complaint is that when they did have live music the one night, it was a little loud, but fortunately it started towards the end of our meal.

Overall, I would definitely check it out again :)
Agreed, BEST cheesesteak in philadelphia. I need not say more.

This Waffle House is like Cheers or something. Tons of regulars that all of the staff are familiar with. Your standard fare of greasy breakfast and lunch items, with all the fixings. We've been here quite often (though we're not a "regular" yet) and eaten at various times of the day, though usually it's 2am, or maybe a brunch at 11am. My favorite is the pecan waffle. Yum. Friendly staff, quick service, delicious and artery-clogging food. Woot!

It may have been the weather and the fact that it was a Sunday on Valentine's Day, but the place was rather empty. This location is the original Schlafly location and they offer on site brewery tours with free beer at the end (unfortunately we missed the last tour of the day) there were two sides and I believe we were on the tamer of the 2 sides but we grabbed spots at the bar and chatted with the bartender our entire visit. We ordered a flight of 6 Schlafy beers to share and hthe bartender heard me mention that I'm typically not a fan of oatmeal stouts so he threw in an extra sample just so we could both try it. He was very knowledgeable not only about Schlafy, but also about the craft beer industry overall and we had a entertaining and through provoking conversation. 

Once again, the beers aren't my preferred style, but I can see why people love the brand. It's definitely worth a quick stop and their merchandise was the best designed and cheapest of all the breweries we visited over the weekend. I'd definitely go back for a free tour and to pick up an awesome growler! 

Also, they have a TON of on site free parking (which I feel is a huge bonus when it comes to breweries now a days)

Really was craving bubble tea and realized there's no bubble tea place at KOP HOWEVER they just had a grand new opening at KOP and I'm super excited that there's a bubble tea place here. We got the special of the day which tasted super fresh as if they squeezed the fruit out (doesn't taste powdery at all). Also got the pearl milk tea. The bubbles are super soft and chewy and taste like they were freshly  made. All in all I love mr wish. It's prob one of the top best bubble tea place on the east coast ^___^

Literally my favorite place to be in Channelside. All my favorite beers, delicioussss food, and so friendly. The perfect mix of modern & comfortable, great place to chill after a long workday or to soak in Friday vibes with the DJ. Like Cheers of Channelside, but better. 

I intend to eat everything on the menu, but my current favs include:
Tavern Shooters
Grouper Sliders
Tavern Burger
Onion rings 
The huge pretzel

VERY friendly service, split the bill without us asking, and fantastic beer. The jabanero tastes just like jabanero (beware!) but the margarita was a little blah. Would have been better off sticking with the beers. 

Food was nothing to write home about. A little overpriced actually

Fleming's had the worst service I have ever had at any restaurant in my life! Horrible Service ! I will never go there again! It took 2 1/2hrs before my party food came to our table with a party of eight people.  The party of ten who came after us had there drinks appetizers and food before we did! It was so bad I cancelled my order because I refuse to get food from a place that treats you as if you don't exist! I don't want to play the race card but that's what it seemed like to me! The waiter would not even acknowledge one of my guess once she began to complain about there service! It was really ridiculous! All the staff on shift today including the manager should be fired! I'm really appald at there service!

Go to this place during the week not during Mardi Gras and guess what? It's an awesome dive to drink in. 

I didn't eat the food, I didn't sit in the garden, I didn't drink one of those horrendous hurricanes. What I did do was drink top shelf scotch, smoke indoors, and watch espn for awfully cheap and have a really pleasant time with the patrons and bar tender. I wish I had this place at home. It's what every bar ought to be, except for that awful month of tourist overload and occasional force of nature destruction.

Don't bother with the hurricane. I had a taste and it almost ruined the night for me. Tastes like fruity mouthwash.

We love this place. Always fast, consistent and delicious. The Basil Fried Rice with steak is a staple for me. Yellow curry is outstanding. Volcano and Pad Thai will not disappoint. The staff are always very friendly and helpful. Been here several times and highly recommend it.

Found Andre's Wine & Cheese Shop a few months ago while trying to find cover from a down pour while attending a outdoor fair and found this amazing five star place hidden in the mall walk through

Looking for a relax time no pressure and great fresh to order food and  sangria is a the best i have had anywhere come to Andre's Wine & Cheese Shop 22 South Main Street Doylestown PA

NOTHING SHORT OF AMAZING

It's our second time being back to Kumas since they reopened. We're so happy they're back! However, tonight was ROUGH. First off, they did not have any AC going. Not only that, but they had the front windows/door open the entire time we were there. The heat index today was 102. Our toddler overheated and we ended up having to take our food to go. We were all physically sweating by the time we were able to get our check and leave. No one wants to eat when they're they hot and uncomfortable. When we got home, we dug into our food and were really disappointed. The chili was so spicy that my husband couldn't even eat his slayer. I opted for the grilled chicken tonight instead of a burger and that was a bad idea. It was so charred that I couldn't take more than a bite. That's probably my fault, I should've stuck with the burger.

Overall, a let down from Kumas tonight. We'll keep going because we know they can do better, but for the love of god PLEASE use the AC in the summer.

BEST PIZZA AND COLDEST BEER IN FRANKLIN! I love how it's all high school kids trying to make some money working the front of house. I could eat here everyday seriously! Make sure to get a side of CI with your pizza!!!

I love NOLA because of the people, food, culture, and history that surround it. The W French Quarter helped my mom and I get the best out of our stay. Because there is so much to do in the city, not much time needs to be spent in the hotel. Mainly we woke up in the morning and got free breakfast in the SoBou restaurant (highly recommend this option for SPG members) and then came back late at night. I would definitely recommend this hotel for SPG members.

The service, the flavorful food, the nice atmosphere...this place is just GREAT. My coworkers and I recently visited St. Louis on business. We heard about the Hill neighborhood which is full of authentic Italian restaurants and markets and decided to head that way. We went to Lorenzo's just by chance and were very pleased.

I had a house salad covered in grated parmesan, romano, and pistaschios, carpaccio, and gnocchi with spinach and sausage in a cream sauce made from gorgonzola and fontina. The sauce was just incredible, with a strong flavor. The ricotta based spread they serve with bread is delicious as well. I didn't order desert, but tasted my coworkers gelato which was also delicious.

The staff is courteous, knowledgeable and attentive. It's a huge plus that smoking isn't permitted here as smoking in restaurants is still legal in Missouri. This place is just wonderful.

Food was great! Nice atmosphere! Excellent fries and milk shakes! Chicken bites were super fresh and chicken sandwich was Slammin!  I was surprised when one of the employees came up to me and took my tray! Nice touch! Be ready to spend some doe though!
The food is great. Crab legs, lobster tail were so fresh, and the seasoning was perfect. I will be returning for sure!

The food was good, but expensive. Our service was wonderful. The Oscar Filet and the fish were great. We also loved the cheesecake and key lime pie. Good spot if you're looking for somewhere fancy. Dinner for two with a bottle of wine was about $140.00.
Fantastic food and service. The majority of the bad reviews on here are for the Brentwood Corner Pub, which is completely different than the Green Hills Corner Pub.

I was looking for a local place for lunch as I was walking around downtown Nashville and found this place via Yelp.  I was not disappointed in my slice of pepperoni pizza. The staff is very friendly and efficient and there are tables in the back for dining so don't let the hole in the wall look deceive you.

I have been waiting for ages to try the fried chicken at Willie Mae's, and I must say it did not disappoint! I went with a party of 3 for lunch on a Monday, and we waited in line about 20 minutes. Everyone we met was visiting the city and really friendly. I think the weather definitely played into how fast the line moved for us because it was pouring earlier that morning so the line was not long compared to others I had spoken to before.

We all ordered the fried chicken (bone-in and tenders) with mac & cheese, green beans, cornbread, and rice and gravy. The chicken was surprising light with the breading, and it was delicious. The white meat was definitely juicy, but not greasy. The dark meat had a tendency to be a little too greasy, but the flavor was great throughout. The sides were good and the green beans had a nice kick to them. I ordered a lemonade which was really good, not too sweet at all. 

The service was wonderful. Our waitress was quick and attentive. There were a couple of times she forgot some things, but she was managing a number of tables and multitasking so it's to be expected. She remembered without us having to say anything, and returned quickly.

I plan to return with family later this year!

This is my favorite place for brunch - the french toast/fruit is to die for & the white Sangria is amazing (my partner had more of the standard egg/bacon/toast & it looked yummy).  This is an outside cafe - beautiful & has a peaceful vibe!   Try it - you will not be disappointed!
Best Thai food in Tucson! Food was amazing and very good customer service! The chef came out and asked us how our food was. Price was reasonable too. Would definitely recommend eating here!

Dinner for two on a Wednesday night was really really tasty. Great service and staff. The food was delicious and very tasty. Not the cheapest place around but it was very much worth it. The pork pot pie was brilliant.

I'm not going to lie. I was a bit let down. I had very high expectations as a friend of mine had been saying this place had the best sushi he had ever had and would always crave the sushi from here. So I went in with that on my mind, so that could account for the less than stellar review. 

They have all you can eat at a decent price, but you have to sit at the bar. You don't have a choice. Your chef is right in front of you, so you can talk to them all you want. Our chef was a real nice guy, but I had a hard time hearing what he was saying for the most part. 

The quality of the fish is overall, pretty good. The fried roll was probably the worst fried roll I might have ever had. It was huge and almost all of it was fried. Most fried rolls have more fish. Also felt like it was just warmed up versus being freshly fried. 

My gf liked this place a lot more than I, but I dunno. It didn't wow me. It was very similar and there are no pictures of any of the rolls. The special rolls should have pictures as you don't know what you're getting with rolls that are designed for a particular location. 

Not a bad place, by any means, but nothing special either.

This past Sunday was our 1st time going here. The place is so small! They only have 8 tables! They really need to expand. We had to wait for a table. I think if they were to expand they'd make more money because most people won't wait that long! We got lucky and didn't have to wait that long. However, the food was pretty good and so was the service. I'm not sure if it's worth waiting a long time though! They do a good take out business! We'll be back but I doubt if we'll wait long!

Tried the Twisted Tandoor for the first time today.  Amazing!  Owners are exremely friendly and the food is fantastic.  I had the vegetarian Kathi Wrap and tried the Chicken Tikka Masala.  The wrap had a ton of paneer and veggies.  The Tikka Masala sauce was the best I have tasted.  I will definitely be coming here again and trying more delicious items.  

I texted in my order at 10:30 and it was ready when I arrived at 11.

I love brophys so much I have been going there since I was three the service is really great and all of the employees seem like they are in an amazing mood and I also love the out door dinning part because you are on a balcony and you get to look out to the harbor and see all the beautiful sail boats. Also the seafood is amazing my favorite is the Calimari because it is so light and fluffy! 
Great Place!!!!

We decided to try Bears after seeing them featured on the local news as one of the best poboy shops in the city. Unfortunately, I whole heartedly disagree. As a pickup order, we waited a half hour- not a big deal, but expected much better food. We ordered the roast beef cheese fries, a small roast beef poboy, and a regular alligator poboy. Fries were okay, wayyyy too much cheese for my taste. You really couldn't taste anything but the cheese, which was disappointing. 
My roast beef poboy was burnt, and the meat itself was dry. The gator poboy that the husband ordered was swimming in mayo, was also burnt, and the meat had little flavor. 
We were both excited to try this place based off of reviews and proximity to our house. Maybe they had an off night? Definitely disappointed and I don't feel that I will be brave enough to give them another chance anytime soon.

I ordered takeout tonight and was not disappointed by any aspect of the experience. Upon arrival, my food was not ready yet but I didn't mind waiting for a little bit. Everyone greeted me with a smile and pleasantries. It's definitely a smaller space, but very intimate and has a nice flow. Some people might be mildly put off by the location and riff raff associated with that el stop, but I've lived nearby for a few years so it didn't phase me. Chef Joe Kim checked my order himself so nothing was missing and he seems like an all around great person(he was smiling the whole time and engaging with everyone in the restaurant).

My husband and I both said the miso soup was the best we have ever had. I ordered my go-to spicy tuna and green salad- both perfect. The spicy tuna roll was the best I've ever had, fresh tuna cubed (not like the average finely chopped) with fresh scallions and perfect spicy sauce. My husband got the Bulgogi and Spider Roll- said both were delicious. Apart from the amazing food, the overall vibe and kindness that you receive in Da-Wa is what earns it every 5 star review. We'll definitely be back!

We went here a pretty long time ago but I really needed to give a 5-star review to balance out my Yelp feng-shui.

Not to say that I am artificially giving Sauce on the Side 5-stars. Oh no. They kick ass. All kinds of ass.

BrunchPrincess had something with figs that rocked.  I had something with mushrooms that rocked.  Hard.  They were both fantastic and the folks we brought with us loved it as well.

Just go. You will dig it.

Arrived right after opening on a Saturday. Too small of a location. Waited. No service, no pizza, not worth it... I'm going to Cheesecake Factory. (Which is saying something considering the wait) 
Try again Giordanos, you're not ready for Indy. #Disappointed

This little spot was a nice surprise! Food was excellent! Menu had a great variety of choices. Everything was served prompt, hot & fresh. Lobby and eating area was clean and condiment stations well stocked. Crew was friendly and each person was busy with a task. Overall their teamwork provides for a well kept and well rounded food service establishment. We ate everything on our plate! We will def return to this location. Great work Salsa Verde Team!!!

We're local, walking from home customers and want The Shop to succeed. Today was a disappointment. Hopefully, it was an off day or adjustment to being so popular.
 
I ordered quickly as the group of 6 ahead of me was lagging and offered me to go before them. My husband likes eggs and bacon so I got him the Rollex on the order taker's recommendation.  Half the egg was very cooked(dark brown) basically burnt. He tossed it halfway through. My Ahhnold was bland.

And, the funny part...the table of 6 who ordered after me were served before us, as was another table who ordered after me.

So, not a bad experience, just underwhelming. My take-away, still quality ingredients and maybe needing a bit more attention to detail.

I hope none of you come here because I don't want to share!!
Best Whiskey Sour ANYWHERE!! Love this place. I can order anything on the menu, it is all delicious . 
Randy is the bartender other bartenders wish they could be. Love this place!

Holy smokes -- I was so surprised to find that Schlafly Tap Room (key - not the Schlafly Bottleworks location) has the best fish sandwich I've had in the area. It's the Catfish Po' Boy and WOW, was this thing good.

Typically with a fried fish sandwich you often expect something somewhat heavy and sometimes a bit greasy. This is not. It's a large portion and it almost seems dare-I-say "light"... But that can't be with fried, right? 

But I encourage you to try for yourself and see.

It's served on a large hoagie bun with a great sauce which complimented perfectly and did not overpower the flavor.

Also points for a LOT of space at this location and always a fine selection of beers.

I'm a fan.

First time here tonight, celebrating a belated birthday. First I want to say that we reserved a table for 8 (which you have to have to reserve a table) unfortunately 2 people had to back out at the last minute. The waiter couldn't have been nicer about it. He quickly adjusted table arrangements to make us comfortable without looking annoyed. The food choices were very adequate, veal, fish, chicken...the usual suspects. I switched out veal for chicken that was served with mushrooms and roasted veggies in a creamy cognac tasting sauce and it was amazing. The veggies hurt the dish a bit because they went from being under cooked to overcooked and I couldn't eat them but I didn't mind too much. The Shrimp scampi pizza was a hit and so we're the scallops ,chicken parmesan, and veal saltimbocca. I also do not want to forget the ceasar salad, served nicely chilled with huge cheese shavings and a delicious dressing. Our waiter was fabulous btw and so was the hostesses. Very attentive and friendly. Ok so one bad thing? The coffee...ugh...I don't know what kind it was but that was served luke warm and tasted just bad...so skip the coffee! Lol
We will absolutely be coming back.
Very clean nice service and good food great prices and I would say a great home style Cuban food

When vegetarian/vegan-ish and hungry...come here!!  And if you eat meat...come here too!!  

Quaint place with all of the Thai ambiance and decor you can imagine. The staff was very helpful and attentive. We ordered a couple of veggie dishes and were very pleased with our choices. 

I ordered a veggie curry and he ordered Pad Thai, no eggs. Delish! Very flavorful and came to our table piping hot and quick! 

I love that this place is locally owned and has a veggie buffet on Thursdays.  Come with an appetite and your stretchy pants!

Had the best evening there!  We had a late reservation (8:45) so I was a bit concerned we would be rushed.  We arrived a little early and were given the option of inside or outside.  We picked outside and am so glad we did!  Such a festive atmosphere, with tango dancers, then a drum show.  The wine recommendations we great and the food was outstanding!  I had the skirt steak and my husband had the sirloin - both amazing!  A relaxed atmosphere and after the entertainment there was a dance floor outside!  Such fun!  We were never rushed and stayed for hours!  Can't wait to return.

This place will be a very nice dinning, shopping and entertainment venue when completed.
Right now there are rows of refrigerated containers serving as small food outlets. They sell  tacos, 
burgers, oysters, chicken sandwiches, alcoholic drinks, coffee, ice cream, and several
other kinds of food. I believe these will be permanent.
There is a large  Biergarten with seating overlooking
a very large grass field. At the far end of the field
is a stage where live bands play. They have numerous tables with umbrellas to sit at and
enjoy a beer while listening to music.
All of this is right on the river.
Construction is underway on what looks like a two
story building along Channelside drive which will be the outer perimeter of the wharf area. I believe
that will consist of shops and restaurants, and work space on upper floors.
Weekends are busy here with many families enjoying the open area and live music.
Parking is available at an outdoor lot and parking
garage next to the wharf.

Nice new spot in Nashville. Lively crowd on this post Thanksgiving covid evening. We were a group of eight seated on the second floor. Good menu options. Reasonable prices. Good and reasonable wine list too. Had the Bonanza Red (from Camus) for the first time. Ordered the skirt steak and frites. Ordered medium. Cooked medium. Tender. Seasoned perfectly. Good sear. Fries were thin and crisp. Served with a little salad.

Great place. Ambience classy and subdued in a refined space. Buffet is not the largest, but selection and choice is excellent and filling. Good meat cuts and service is nearly top shelf. Great wine selection including plenty of columbia and willamette valley selections.

The beers were good. My husband got the stouts and loved the imperial stout. We got the mussels to start, and I got the steak tacos. The mussels were abundant and well cooked but nothing amazing. My three pieces of baguette were burned on one side and they put the lightly toasted side to be shown. My steak tacos were cooked with sauteed onions, although it was well cooked and not overdone, it lacked seasoning. It seemed like it needed more salt and pepper, which I did add, but I needed maybe some sour cream or maybe an aioli to cut all the meat. It came with fresh tortilla chips and salsa. The salsa was actually flavorful but you got very little of it.

  My husband got the Bridgeport burger - it was ok, not amazing. Cooked well but under-seasoned as well. The fries with the burger we're soggy and not crispy. 

I really wanted to love this place and will come back but maybe not for food and just for beers, chips and salsa.

I stopped at the end of a Saturday night to get some late dinner at Lil Sum Sum in the Piazza Pod Park.  Then waited about twenty minutes for my food.  I did hear people in the park saying how they love the mushroom chicken dumplings, however my shrimp shumi were raw like sushi and my fried rice tastes like steamed rice with no flavor.  I will avoid the Lil Sum Sum and recommend no one eat there.

I love Pressed Juicery. What I'm about to say isn't going to stop me from coming back (although if this place was in LA I would find another location. SB just isn't convenient like that). I think that there's an opportunity for them to nicer from a customer service standpoint. I felt like the woman who helped me today was either having a bad day, she didn't like her job, or didn't like me, all good either way. Just don't project your attitude towards me when I'm literally in there for 5 minutes. The energy you put out, you will receive.

The thing about New Orleans, is if you are staying in-near The Quarter, do your homework on dining so that you can find an unpretentious delicious gem like Daisy Dukes.  The nook-and-cranny locals' places like this always have more character, besides.

Thanks to Groupon and another site, I was alerted to this restaurant, found very enlightening reviews on Yelp and dined there on September 1.  Long week, long travel day, compounded by miserable rain, and a quick tasty meal  was in order. 

My server, Jaz, was very friendly and patient with me (so much good stuff on the menu, and I was starving and couldnt decide).  The greeter and other staff were equally inviting and friendly, in person that day and also for my take-out order another day.

I ended up with a side salad (gigantic) and a fried oyster poboy (gigantic and delicious -- impossible to get good fried oysters anywhere but Nola and I dont like them raw).  A perfect comfort meal that hit the spot and I certainly was back on my weekend trip.  My lunch on September 5 made this 5 stars, hands-down.  

For a bite on-the-go, I thought I'd grab a shrimp po-boy and soem of the famous (per the menu) hand-cut wings.  I was absolutely overwhelmed -- the bag felt like someone had mistakenly put someone else's larger order in it.  

The po-boy was gigantic -- the the point that I decided to enjoy each large shrimp (you're talking 26-30-count or larger) individually -- yummy by the way with light and perfectly seasoned batter -- and make an impromtu salad of the lettuce, tomatoes, and pickles.  The wings were equally spectacular -- very large and meaty and the barbeque sauce/seasoning was out of this world (like what you'd expect in a BBQ specialty restaurant).  

Trust me, the folks near me on my flight were wondering where did you get "that?"   I certaily wonder why folks can't make the 2-block trek from Bourbon St for this great comfort food -- vs. straggle into a fastfood joint with nasty, cold burgers (just because it's on Bourbon) for a combo price that is the same as a po-boy or wings etc.

Thanks, Jaz, and thanks to Daisy Dukes for being you -- and getting my vacation off to a great start and ending it with a bang!  Five stars all the way -- if I return to Nola, I'll be here a lot!

I've eaten at this restaurant twice, both times in groups of 4 or larger. The first time was a late Sunday lunch and the restaurant was nearly empty, service was awesome as a result. We started off with the wonderful garlic crisps with mango butter and assorted mojitos. The mojitos are fresh and tasty, and they're made with real sugar cane, (that really makes a difference). I had the mango mojito and the balance was nice, the mango wasn't too overwhelming.  For a meal, my husband and I split an assorted appetizer platter that had chorizo, beef and chicken. It was fine but nothing extraordinary. The main course we ordered was a beef entree that was soft and flavorful, a better hit than the ordinary appetizers. Our meal companions had the Ropa viejo and a turkey burger, both which they reported were awesome. The one highlight from the meal was the fried plaintains. They were ripe, sweet, soft and had a little carmelized coated crunch from frying. 

The second time I ate here was with a group of girlfriends before a night of going out. We were a group of six and it was a Saturday night. The service was a little slow, but they were very crowded. We opted for mojitos and I tried the energy mojito, which is a regular mojito with Red Bull. I was disappointed when they gave me the Red Bull on the side, and didnt' add it themselves. 

We ordered a variety of appetizers and split entrees. Our one vegetarian diner had a variety of options including polenta cakes with mushrooms, fried plaintains, a potato dish, and she ordered a side of rice and beans. She said everythign was tasty and filling and she didnt' feel left out of the dining experience like she usually does while dining with omnivores. I had the Ropa Viejo, which I found boring and uninspired honestly. This classic Cuban shredded beef dish was more like pressure cooked shreds and the sauce was watery. The food is pricey, but you get filled up fast since it's heavy. I split dishes both times and had sides, so I was very full.

I think this place is a good tourist spot because all the diners I came with were satisfied with the ambiance, the mojitos and appetizers. The restaurant looks like an old time Havana bar with giant white sheet fans, cane rattan seating, and salsa dancing on weekends. For someone who really likes Cuban food and has had the authentic stuff, it's more like a chain.

I wanted to give less than one star to Joe's Crab Shack if I had ever received food. We ordered beers, an appetizer which only arrived after we asked for the manager, and the food never came. The half filled Shack was 3/4 empty and the excuse of the waitress said that the kitchen was backed up. Ironically, people that were seated after us, with their dog, got all of their food and drinks before we got our drinks. The manager apologized, offered to comp out meal, and offered gift cards. He then said he was watching over our table for some reason.  We decided that it was a waste of time, poor service, and HORRIBLE dining. Or should I say lack there of. Have good luck if you wish to eat there.

Now in dining there are two sepulchral doors a man takes when it comes to stickin up a set of ribs, yea, and of these I grapple with.  Upon thy cistern emanating a faint plea for mollusks, crustaceans and cocktails, I found myself two abreast in another's iron horse at a doubleknot making our way to what seemed the most briny, seafaring place in this city of St. Louis, in the year of our lord, 2017.  

Upon turning off Gravois and onto Sidney, alas!  Here I was, reader.  The Yukon Valley, the shining emerald of the north.  The place where hope and love intersect without our creator's consent in an innumerable pit of blackness in a vacuum of greys that hauntin like sittin arise from a dream so wholly bitter as the world lies waiting and you wake up with the whales.  

I said, take me there.  

Take you where, my companion asked.  

To the place with the whales, the sea.  Wherever intarnation my bloodstained tongue may lead my heart to thee, following my cistern aglow.  

The restaurant was full of the hearts of whalers, crabfishermen, tanners, trappers and all sort of kin from the new world.  New sort of lantern aglow over the bar.  No gas.  Must be the work of some bespectacled fella, one patron chuckled as he touched the lantern with his mudcalloused finger and o, not only did it not burn him it seemed to put a fire back into his heart that warmed him ever so the same as the jet fuel he glugged as I ever did slowly added color back into his cheeks.  

When the time came for the shuckin I did, reader, have a biblical remnant of some fuel in me, o, I said pigeontailed coat sir bring me some east coast oystahs so I can quit my yammerin.  

Yes, he said.  

The oystahs were fresh, briny, sweet.  They tasted the way an angel would kiss, I reckon.  I said, I'll take another.  Again.  Again.  Another, I cried, banging on my table drunk off the company of our creator's imagination.  

It is time, I said.  

Yes, of course, the waiter said.  I know.  

Some time passed as I put some of that jakelegged rye down my cistern as quickly as a horse'll jet when you give him a floggin on the ass and a pat on the crown.  

Red, hot, delicious friend in front of me.  Claws and all.  

Bib me, crack me, don't forget me.  As the stones of time and the tide of the gunpowder of all Easter turn, I am in you and you are within me as the stones turn in the river we both drink from flows as our children vote.  I will be new again.  My hands will brine as the tide will turn while we wind our pocketwatches freshfaced every dawn.  Gullets full.  Quail egg.  Hard bread.  Dreams.  

This redclawed friend in a clarified butter was nearly venomous; I could see myself eating crustaceans ever so until I so shall perish.  Such a dangerous thing shall be limited to those men who can only exercise self control for he so shall perish shall he lack the self control possessed by I.   

Sausage.  Brussels sprouts.  Potatoes.  O lord, o.  Contain me.  Call me again.  

The secrets of the world are not hidden in dusty leatherbound books in libraries found in cities amongst those wirespectacled fellows that declare the law.  The secrets of the world are waxed beneath the manna at Peacemaker and o, can you understand me?  There exists no indignity, no hangover nightmare of the commute of daily life, reader.  There exists a refuge, yea, a salvation in the chowin of the ration here and yessir, there is a valet out of the facade of this palace should your iron horse need a trough streetside while you placate that cistern.  

I'll see you there, at the oystah bar, without any fear of death in my eyes.

Ordered the general tso chicken and and the lo mien noodle with chicken. 
The lo mien noodle is pretty good. The general tso chicken I threw out after trying a few pieces. Very fatty and one was very tough. Would not recommend to others

I too had the greens and tofu.  Not sure what exactly it was, but it was full of garlic and I loved it.  The tofu was cooked perfectly, firm and flavorful. The fresh rolls were also good and I was happy with the generous portion of white rice with the tofu. Our server was friendly and efficient.  I'm also lookinnf forward to the addition of vegetarian pho.

Wowzers! Hubby and I wanted to take a break from New Orleans cuisine to get my favorite food...SUSHI!! Royal Sushi & Bar was a few blocks from our hotel so we walked over. We started off with 2 rolls: White Ninja & Sex and the City. Both were delicious. Fish just melted in my mouth. (I'm salivating as I'm typing). Those rolls had me wanting more. We ordered the Fantasy Roll and that left us full and satisfied. All rolls had a great balance of ingredients. Reasonably priced too. Love, Love, Love!!

Wow.  The crust on this pizza is so good.  I was craving the pizza again the next day!  Unfortunately, it is closed on Sundays and Mondays.  Thank goodness, or else I would have gotten another pizza!  I ordered the mushroom pizza.  The mushrooms are so fresh and strong.  I love good fungus.  The tomato sauce is just acidic enough to offset the greasier crust.  The crust is crunchy, yet chewy,  And the cheese is under the sauce.  It's almost like a focaccia, but more complex tasting!  I ordered to go, so I cannot comment on the service.  The service to go was excellent.  He even came outside to get me when my pizza was ready.

Transplanted Texan reporting here:
Cool locally owned diner with a slightly art deco vibe, and a great little patio area if you're bringing Fido.  I had my favorite dinner, the country fried steak, and I got the white sausage gravy with it, along with mashed potatoes and cornbread.  The country fried steak was exactly what I wanted: tender and flavorful, with light, seasoned breading that clung to the meat just right. It wasn't a huge portion but it was just right for me.   And ehere I come from, you can't have country fried steak without cream gravy.  Their white sausage gravy complimented it nicely, and I was happy to have some comfort food like from home.  The mashed potatoes were barely mashed, but the flavor was very good.  The cornbread was so GOOD, and I normally wouldn't have even bothered to review a piece of Cornbread, but this deserves a most honorable mention.  It was a little on the sweet side, with real pieces of corn, and a consistency similar to bread pudding.  It was scrumptious!

I had mine to go, and while they forgot to include my collard greens that I ordered, I was still happy enough to give them  5 star review.  It's about the 7th time I've been there and the food is consistently amazing.  Give this place a try, you'll be glad you did. PS try the cheese grits, too!

On my search for some Italian.. I noticed the laughing cat had No reviews. Wth!?! Ok I know allot of people have come here.  I want to first say that I liked the place when the owner had a smaller place.  Expect a long wait for your food and expect the portions to be big! I have to say the food is good there but it's not the best Italian I have ever had. Although you know someone is making the dish from scratch and made to order. Waiting  30-45 mins for my food to come out is a bit crazy. Came here several times and not impressed. I rather have smaller portions for better quality
It's applbees. It sucks. Overpriced and crappy food.

I moved to ciccios two years ago and this is still one of my favorite places for happy hour! Their slamgrias are the best, and did I mention huge?! It's definitely worth the money. You also can't go wrong with the California bowls. The hot and crunchy tuna is probably my favorite and the fish is always so fresh! 

Did I mention that you get a free shot bucket for your table on your birthday? It's awesome! The only downside is the wait can be pretty lengthy.

I was walking down the strip looking for a good place to eat and found the Spotted Donkey Cantina. I was seated quickly and the service was friendly and fast. I had the barbacoa chimichanga, which was delicious - highly recommend. The atmosphere was very nice, not sure how long this place has been around but it looked brand new. Will definitely visit again next time I am in town.
Delivered to me burnt. Waste of time and money. If you make a mistake please redo the order verses pawning it off on the customer.
This is an amazing place to grab coffee with someone, eat good food or just hang out and read a book. I love going here, grabbing coffee and working.

Went back again last month with my girlfriends... fantastic... going back again with more girls... and I will continue to come at least once a month if their food and their attention continues in the high level it has been... 
Please don't come talking about the simple decor of the restaurant... It's about the food and the service and you get plenty of both here...

Haven't been there in years. Stopped in around 5P and won't be back. Ten minutes and no service whatsoever. Place was not full at all. Told them about their service and why we were leaving and all I got was "Have a Nice Day".  Walked across the parking lot to Seasons 52 and had a great meal and great service.  I guess everything happens for a reason.

Had another good bagel today the only down side of coming here is dealing with your neighbors audubon used appliances. I Finally got the stove delivered but it turned out the left rear burner was not igniting a flame when you turn it on. I just wish you move to another location away from audubon used appliance I dont want their bad business practices to rub off on your business

Best "locals" bar in Old City, probably one of the best in the Center City area. No Philly attitudes here, no hipsters or pretentious individuals either. Just always seems to be a solid, friendly clientele always looking to make conversation. One of the few places in Philly I feel like I can sit at for hours on end and truly enjoy every minute. 

Beers are as cheap as you'll find them - 5 bottles for $10 - and as other mentioned a great place to pregame before going to the more expensive restaurants in the area.

As for food, I've only tried two things on the menu: Roast beef and curly fries. Both are great and the roast beef is only $5 during football games. Absolutely no complaints here.

Brennen's

Home of the Original World Famous Banana's Foster. A show in itself, have to order this classic as it is prepared at your table.

Started off with the Seafood File Gumbo filled with Gulf shrimp and oysters, Porsche's andouille sausage and basmati rice. 

Shared the Gulf Fish Amandine, a New Orleans classic with marcona almonds, haricots verts and preserved lemon butter. 

Satsuma Lacquered Duck slow roasted Rohan duck, duck confit jus, Daikon cake, mustard grill, local satsuma and green peppercorn vinaigrette

Garlic Shrimp Bayou Cora grits, roasted King Trumpet mushrooms and bacon emulsion

Dessert was capped off with Buttermilk Bread Pudding in stewed Louisiana Blueberries topped with Lemon Verbena Sherbet 

World Famous Banana's Foster. A must to order this classic as it is prepared at your table.

Had a wonderful meal and if you are celebrating a birthday, let them know.
They charge $15 for rice vegetables and a little meat because organic, gluten free, etc.  But when you order To-go they shove your hot food in a plastic container. What a joke!

The service was crappy, the food was ok, mine was luke warm again but everyone else's was hot. The server (Cory) rarely came back to our table, he seemed annoyed that we hadn't made up our minds after being told we weren't ready and needed a few minutes he just said we will start here and pointed to one person in our party. He said he would be right back after putting our food order in to get a drink choice from one of the kids but didn't return until after the food had come out. I told the register people I wasn't happy about the service and they said "we hope it's better the next time you come". They never asked what my complaint was not offered to get a manager. Guess what, you won't get a second chance and this may be the last time I eat at cracker barrel period.

Nice, updated Burger King. Restaurant was clean but the restrooms were marginal (not actually dirty but very messy and in need of attention). Restaurant had easy access (on and off) to I-70.

Food was served piping hot and fresh. Classic BK fare.

Staff had zero personality and customer service skills. On a scale of 1-10, the gal taking our order probably rated a minus 1 or 2 on the scale. The only words she uttered was the total that we owed. No other greeting or thanks.

Man, I love this spot!! My girlfriend and I can never go wrong with the traditional Cuban. The mojo sandwich is also very tasty. The chicken Parmesan and meatball subs are a cheese lover's dream .

This is, by far THE BEST sandwich spot in Ruskin and the surrounding area!

Oh, and get the tater tots. Trust me.

Great menu choices, but the coffee was terrible.  The sugar on the table was so old that it was one big clump and wouldn't shake out. I had a lite omelet which was good though. Servers were nice and friendly,  hostesses were distracted.

I ordered ceviche for $10 through UberEats. It was sea bass, scallops, sweet onions, jalapeno, red pepper, and cilantro marinated in lime juices. I was feeling lazy and didn't want to drive to Happy Fish. I got 1/3 of the portion that I would have received had I ordered it from Happy Fish. Since it was an appetizer, I felt like they could have served a little more in order to be able to share it with someone else. It was a small size and my hunger had not subsided nor was it supposed to afterwards, but I was hoping a little bit more for the price I paid. I am not sure I am willing to pay for some of the expensive entrees if they don't deliver on something as simple as an appetizer. I think I'll save my $ for other restaurants. Also, the dish was too sour. Perhaps they could have added other ingredients to tame it down, such as lemon. From my experience, they did not get the correct ratio of acid to fish. It was too tart tasting!

AVOID, AVOID, AVOID!! Should have Yelped before going here. Overpriced, unimpressive food. Worst service EVER!! We stopped by to see the Market St. Concert at Purina Pavillion and thought we should enjoy the tunes over food. Turned out to be a terrible idea. Apparently there's some inner turmoil between the hostess and the waitress because there was some hostility and bickering going on because we asked to sit on the patio. There were only 5 other tables with customers but it took us well over an hour to get 2 kids meal, an appetizer, soup, and salad. The spinach artichoke tasted like a Subway tuna salad soup (completely unidentifiable). The kids meal were bland and blah. The clam chowder was ok but I had to ask for crackers. Took us almost 2 hours from start to finish. No apologies. No explanation.  Should have gone to the Soda Fountain or spent my money feeding the koi.

I live just a few blocks from Big Dan's.  I have to tell you, there aren't many restaurants within walking distance where I am not afraid to eat.  But, what a SURPRISE I was in for when I walked into Big Dan's.

My favorites are the 11th St. Italian Hoagie and Dan's cheese steak.

There are no cheap ingredients used in the 11th St.  Top of the line Italian meats are used along with sharp provolone.  This is one of the best hoagies I have ever had.  The roll is perfect, the meats are beyond good and the price isn't too bad.

Everyone likes their cheese steak done their way.  I like mine with fried onions, marinara sauce and sharp provolone.  When I bit into this steak, I thought I was in heaven.  You can't compare Dan's fresh sliced rib-eye with some frozen minute steak.  The fresh roll is packed so full I have to use a fork to eat what falls out.  Absolute heaven!

What a gem of a place I found on the corner of 11th and Jackson.  I am now a regular and everyone knows my name.  Can't wait until they get their "Best of Philly" award.
Note-changing my review due to human trafficking charges by restaurant owner. We will not support the cruelty. Can get my Asian fix at Ko or Oishi and will find other places.

As soon as I drove up to Brown's I knew I was going to like it.  It looks like a trailer (and I guess it WAS a trailer) with a building built on to the back of it.  My kind of place.

Then I walked in and was greeted with the glorious smell of fried beef from the hamburgers being cooked in the kitchen.  I love that smell!  Missing is the smell from cigarettes that I do tend to cherish in a dive bar, but no biggie.  If they allowed smoking in the tiny bar area no one would be able to see anything.

I loved the sign that told me it has been there since something like 1927.  And was that a picture of Neil Diamond on the wall?  Or a really close lookalike?  Love.  The crowd was generally above the age of 45-ish and they were all feisty and enjoying the band.  This band was the reason we were here.  Although they didn't turn out to be an Irish band, it was a band manned by some older people that played only 60s English rock.  And the bass player was a chick!  Plus, that chick was having a birthday and she was offering everyone homemade cupcakes.  Who doesn't love that. 

I didn't eat but the burgers smelled pretty much amazing and I really want to come back and try it.  I didn't like the fact that they only have beer and not liquor but I fully realize there's no damn room for a full bar.  However, if you are looking to eat, the room they built on in the back has plenty of tables.  Bathrooms....well....let's just say I hate those hand dryers with the rolly towel that just goes around in a circle.  Ewww, just use your jeans to dry your hands.

The main thing I loved was drinking quite a few beers and then getting the tab for my brother and I - $23?  Um, um, REALLY?  Cheapest 2 hours drinking at a bar for 2 people EVER.  That is what took me over the edge and made me realize I am going to really love this place!

Mediterranean Mistake. 
We came to Petra because of the high rating it received on UrbanSpoon. Unfortunately, our experience was anything but what we expected. Upon our arrival, we were greeted warmly and seated promptly and that was the extent of our pleasant visit. I came with my husband and two young boys. We ordered our drinks first (just water) and an appetizer. It took almost 15 minutes just to get our water. The appetizer then arrived about 15 minutes after that, just before our meal was served. It was not crowded or busy and the boys were becoming restless and impatient while waiting for their food. The waitress did apologize for the wait and offered us free bread and hummus. When our food finally came, it was sub par to say the least. I ordered a salad with chopped beef on top. The beef was tough and over cooked. The salad with mixed veggies on top and the dressing it was tossed in, did not pair well together. The flavor over all was a flat lined vinegar taste. The boys had chicken kabobs and fries which were very good. My husband had a lamb kabob, in which the meat was also overcooked and slightly dried out. I barely touched my salad and snacked off of everyone else's plate. When asked to have the salad taken off due to the fact that it wasn't eaten and I didn't like it, the waitress gave a funny look like we were crazy for asking. My husband paid for the food since it was obvious we were wrong for asking. No tip was left since they got about a 40% tip by us paying for something we did not eat.

I would not recommend this place due to their lack of customer service and inability to cook food properly and pair flavors together.

The food here is GREAT!!! Something for everyone. Gluten-free, vegan, vegetarian, carnivores, etc... Also good for kids! Lots of entertainment. Indoor & outdoor seating. The wings are fantastic & love that they offer vegan cheese (daiya)! Will definitely return!

Pizza and meatballs were very good.   Artichokes were too deeply fried.  Grilled calamari was good, but a ridiculously small portion even for tapas. Cocktails were expensive .   Fun, casual place to hang out if in the area.  Great view with outdoor seating.

Man this place just stinks. The food is so bad and full of bland oil. Everything tastes the same and will require lots of pepto to get it all down. Do yourself a favor and take your money somewhere else. Even thinking about the food makes me sick

Fresh tortilla chips and tomatillo sauce. Huge Beef Burritos prepared on site with very fresh and tasty ingredients.  The burritos are wrapped in homemade tortillas!   Nothing to complain about here and you will not be disappointed.  
Also it is a "Girl Power" Mom and daughters business.  Give them a try!

The best new Mexican Tucson hands down!! Always prepared fresh , spicy green Chile is just enough heat with a ton of flavor and for the not so spicy folks the sour cream green Chile enchilada sauce is to die for!! Also never had a better Chile relleno ever!!
Food is very good! I love their hummus! Portion sizes are pretty big. Staff is very nice!

I've been here plenty of times in the past year. always a great burger, delicious fries and fantastic service. be warned the "small" fry is huge! they put it in the bag with the burgers and fill it up. plenty for 2 to share. you'll leave here full

Disappointed in food quality and service. Husband asked for two burritos fried received two small burritos fried that look like two very small soft taco used. Manager says "oh thats how they normally look" and walked away. Not let me try again for you or im sorry your disappointed. 

Also, I normally get the chimi in chicken. This also looked very small and always served  with a taco shell of lettuce and cheese salad on a separate plate. Next to my chimi on the same plate was a hard shell with the lettuce on top probably used to fill in the plate space.

 Very unsatisfied customer service and we wont be coming back for a very long time.

Cool little specialty grocery store.  If you're looking for something organic, or something homemade from a mom and pop shop you'll probably find it here.  The bakery is excellent, the stir fry bar is cool, and beer and wine selection is very ecletic.  Here's the kicker, it's not crazy expensive either.  It only get 3 stars for it's lack of variety and selection, but like I said "specialty grocer,"
We were there just before breakfast ended so we hurried and ordered breakfast instead of lunch.  Great choice!  Atmosphere was awesome.  Directly on the beach.  Be prepared to pay for parking.

We were seated right away; loved the ambiance--low lighting, fun place to chat.

Ordered drinks, mine was an Old Fashioned which was fine; ordered the Mac n cheese w mushrooms, my friend got the mushroom "cheesesteak," and we got the pretzel bites w beer cheese to share. First off, the pretzel bites were weird  because the pretzels were soft/sautéed in butter, and had way too much salt on them. The cheese sauce was fine. 

The mushroom Mac n cheese was disgusting; the cheese sauce was super soupy, the mushroom flavor overpowering (and I LOVE mushrooms!!) I can eat like a truck driver, so you know it's bad when I leave half my meal untouched. 

My friend's meal: the fries were squishy, undercooked, and covered in this weird green powder neither of us could place. The mushroom cheesesteak lacked flavor and was, as she put it, "not bad, but not great either."

Before we left I used the restroom nearest the kitchen. First off, you can see a sliver of the bar through the "closed" and bolted door, so I imagine that goes both ways. The soap was out--hope the kitchen staff weren't using that bathroom!--and it's pretty gross when you have to shove your hand between the towel dispenser and the wall to get the towel crank to work. Gross. 

Would not go back, would not recommend.

The food was JUST ok but I think it would have been much better if the service was better. I stood at the door waiting to be seated while what appeared to be three employees ignoring us as we patiently waited to be greeted or even acknowledged. Finally a manger noticed us waiting from the back and came and asked if we had been helped. I really wanted to leave by this point because the three gentlemen could at a minimum said "hi, hello, the Bruh man nod or something to welcome us." But my hunger superseded my patients this night. Don't think I'll be dining at this establishment again, if anyone is going to ignore me I'll let it be the under paid cashier at Burger King on her cell phone while at work. Matter of fact the service was better at BK then Lüke, The muffled distorted voice of a dive thru sign saying "Welcome May I take your order!" was more welcoming then being treated like you are invisible.

Don't go here if you want to get attacked by the bouncer! Worst experience at a bar!!! The bouncer wearing a cowboy hat physically grabbed my friend and flicked her drink out of her hand spilling it all over her! He was yelling at us saying no outside drinks. Hey, I get it no outside drinks but couldn't he just say it?! Did he have to grab her?! He was totally crazy. The fact that he thinks it's ok to act that way to anyone is crazy. I used to love going there since I lived down the street but after last night I don't think I'll be going back.

Gave this place a shot since we are big fans of Cajun/New Orleans style cuisine.  It's a bit unusual inside but nothing to scoff at.  The friendly gal that seated us was very courteous and nice.  I assume she is one of the owners.  I believe they had a recent incident that jeopardized the building and caused a temporary closure, but they are back in business as of late January.

We popped in for dinner and sampled the menu - ordered the avocado bites for starters.  Those were fairly tasty, and hit the spot.

For the main course - I went with the old favorite - Fried Shrimp Po' Boy.  It did not disappoint and took me right back to good, ol' NOLA.  It truly hit the spot.  Choosing what to order was a challenge, though.  There were several options that seemed like winners.  Thankfully - you can order from Sisters via GrubHub delivery on those not-so-social evenings.  

They also have this amazing thing called the Gumbo Slinger served only on Sunday.  I absolutely must try this.  I can't wait to order online and/or go back so I can try out more of the venue.  If you love Cajun food - give them a whirl.  I highly recommend.

Beyond the hype, it's still fast food.  My grilled chicken club was just average fast food. The bun was dry and it didn't have any type of sauce. The bacon was the paper thin fast food kind with no flavor. The lettuce was one small piece about 1/2 the size of the bun, one tomato slice, not like the picture. My waffle fries had been 'held' and had that old fryer oil taste. I asked for sauce for my sandwich and she said it's over there, pointing to the condiment area. Just ketchup,  mustard, mayo, jelly, hotsauce.  I miss understood that they had dipping sauces. Service was really slow. People in line were complaining, seemed like they were having trouble getting the food out. It was around 3pm and not rush hour. About $20 for 2. For the best chicken sandwich in Tucson go to the Canyons Crown and get a chicken wildcat burger.....it will blow you away.

Good quick menu for the price. Had the 3 piece meal. Chicken fingers were good but small is size. But you get what you pay for.

Did have a bit of a line, but the food came out hot and quickly.

Terrible...poor service, long wait.  Music/was so loud you could not have a conversation.  Server was nice but no explanation just kept saying sorry. I undstand busy and they were busy but the entire experience was poor.  And the food was nothing special.

Always delicious and filling. Me and my family have eaten here multiple times and have never been disappointed or left hungry. I strongly recommend the pastrami and corned beef. The pickle chips that are served before the meal are delicious as well.
Stopped in for lunch on the way back home from the beach.  Open faced reuben was awesome!

My first meal in NOLA and I was not disappointed. I agree these are excellent po-boys. I had the shrimp, which is sauteed instead of deep fried or breaded. I looooove the sauce. Only downside is the bar in front is pretty seedy. I wonder if this place has ever thought of opening up their own separate location, with better visibility and less smoky atmosphere.

But hey hey, don't let the dive bar out front deter you. These are really good po-boys and worth trying...mmm, if only I could go back to NOLA and have more!

Food was good! A little pricey for what it was, but understandable given the hype and location. Our waitress was awesome. Super nice and very friendly. Food came out fast. Shakes were delicious! Overall, I would definitely definitely recommend for a special St. Louis treat.
I love this place, great staff and fresh, healthy & delicious options. Many combinations of ingredients are available.
Drove an hour to this place to be told they were "closed for private party's only until October" VERY NICE. Thanks for posting that online. JK. It wasn't posted anywhere.

My family of four was in for brunch on Sunday (father's day).

We waited 45 minutes to be served though the restaurant was NOT busy and the food ordered was not complex (scrambled eggs, pancakes, eggs Benedict and chicken and fries). 

We waited an additional 5 minutes for utensils after being served. 

My food, scrambled eggs with vegetables, was simultaneously raw, over cooked and frozen. The veg was a store bought frozen medley which was obviously added to the pan with the eggs at the same time. The result was gross. The frozen veg was still cold in the middle and the eggs that were cooked near them never had time to fully cook while the rest of the eggs we so cooked they were hard. 

My wife's crab cakes Benedict was also gross, smelling of spoiled crab and the eggs were, again, raw. Not poached. Not over easy. Raw. Period. 

My daughters pancakes were fried in oil giving them the smell, flavor and texture of funnel cake. They charge an extra $3.00 for a small handful of chocolate chips. 

My sons chicken fingers and French fries were served as we were leaving. The fries were tiny for some reason. Like every individual fry was no larger than an inch and the chicken was terrible. 

We did order Beignets, their signature dish. They were doughy and raw in the middle. 

Beware!!!  You must pay for your food first.  A huge gamble considering the inconsistent reviews on Yelp. This experience set me back $55.00. 

The coffee was good, though no one ever asked if we'd like more. One cup, 3 bucks. 

Good luck.

Amazing food! I always order the same entrées brisket, waffle batter chicken tenders, bisque, lobster mac&cheese, and French fries you can go wrong. I always order dessert too I love the Chocolate cake, the pecan pie, and cheesecake are also very good.

I always have a great time at Winslow's! Between the tasty food and cool atmosphere (its like a general store had a baby with a country restaurant) this is a great place to go for some food. My only complaints are that it seems the place has gotten a bit more pricey over time and because it is both a store and food establishment sometimes it can feel like the place is short-staffed, with employees running to a register to ring-out a store item and then having to dash to the kitchen to get food for someone. Still, a wonderful place!
Oyster's both ways! The Chargrilled Oysters come with fresh French bread so you can soak up all of that buttery goodness and Oysters on the half shell are equally as yummy.

Great bacon burger  and a place committed to customer service. My friends got the wrong order and were immediately made brand new food... they were stuffed and happy. Also love the peanuts while you wait, it helps tide you over while waiting.

Quick yelp find on a very snowed-in day; quaint little spot for a hearty, yet light, breakfast. 

Ordered the breakfast plate and my friend ordered the biscuit breakfast, and you likely can't go wrong with anything else on the menu. You know when the food critique in Ratatouille is taken back to his mother's cooking? You'll leave with that kind of smile on your face.

And definitely order a latte, hot or iced -- they have paper straws!
Arguably my favorite deli ever...  Get a North Beach, add bacon on Dutch Crunch.  So amazing. The meatball is a close second place, and the tri tip sandwich is awesome too.

I had an outstanding experience here today. We came in and were taken care of in an extremely friendly and timely manner. Our food was phenomenal and that is an understatement. I rarely get to eat out and today my pregnant girlfriend and I stopped by for a bite. We were showered with kind smiles and positive attitudes as well as outstanding service. We are now going to try to make it here once a week and I encourage others to do so as well as it is a rarity to come across such well mannered staff. The manager on duty, I hadn't caught his name, was extremely helpful and went above and beyond during the processes entirety. 

Thank you again! We will be returning immediately!

I got the half salad and half sandwich combo for lunch today. I ordered the roast beef sandwich and Simply salad. Everything tasted good; however, I was disappointed with the amount of roast beef on my sandwich. Two measly one layer slices does not count as sufficient for me. It was probably right around an ounce of meat. Prices seem a little high based on this amount of food. Sevice was good and everyone was nice. I doubt I will be going back.

Best place I've been around here. I got a lil John Vito with just the meat and cheese. Im not a fan of all the toppings. Was enough to fill me up for the time being. Best customer service you could think of. Made sure to see if that's all I wanted and proceeded to ask me if I'm a rewards member and told me how to sign up. Better then all the other Jimmy Johns I've been too

Why would you come here for sushi? Intention fail.

Try the hot braised chicken, it's delicious.

Best bagels and donuts I've been able to find outside of the NJ/NYC area. Great service as well and really clean. 

Don't let the outside appearance fool you. 

This place is a real gem!

This coffee shop has been around awhile and the Owners Do Not know how to run a business!  They Do Not have any kind of customer service that is acceptable in Today's business economy!  I've worked at the World's largest coffee company for over 21 years and We (Starbucks Coffee) bend over backward to ensure out customers are 100% satisfied with Every Experience or We (Starbucks Coffee) go above and beyond to ensure they are taken care of!
Today, October 3, 2018 I visited Lighthouse donuts for a Big Train Chai Latte.  Yesterday, Tuesday October 2 I stopped by as well and my drink was Weak and just ok.  Today I ordered the same exact drink, Large Chai and the owner, who is undoubtably Rude made my Chai with 1 extra scoop of Chai powder and charged me for 1 large chai and 1 small chai to make the equivalent of that extra chai 1 scoop.  No more milk was given to me to account for that extra scoop of powder and he charged me $3 more dollars.  I then had to stand there stating I will not pay $3 extra dollars for 1 more scoop of Chai, which is the price of a small.  I order the powder online from Big Train and know 1extra scoop should have not been a $3 dollar chai.  He proceeded to argue, throw out the drink 1st made and make me a Chai with 2 scoops.  What a waste.  All I read is horrible reviews on this place and now that the parents that use to run things have 1 died and the other incapacity with elderly disease are gone this place with be going out of business!  Reputable, they Are Not.. This deserves a Pass!  I will never go again.  The son running it has No Idea of what he is doing or How to run a legit, honest business!  BEWARE.. WASTE OF TIME & MONEY!!  Parents are dead and there son who runs it has no common sense or enough knowledge to run a successful, quality business without cheating the public!  
Michelle S. from Chicago, IL

Cute little place by the wharf. The sushi is good and there is outdoor seating right by the marina. It's fun to watch the chefs at work in the tiny little food area. The girl was such a sweetheart, she was a student from Burbank and just adorable. I met lots of nice fun people who were eating sushi at the tables and it was very communal, the weather is always perfect and the boats are always peaceful to look at.
9 am on Sunday, plenty of open tables and still a 30 minute wait. I understand when it's crowded but we came here as early as possible to be beat the crowed and still waiting.

Beautifully located in trendy downtown St Petes! Its always hard to choose one flavor because they ALL sound so good! Last time I was in they told me I could do 3 flavors!! Why the hell not!!! Ha ha!they are EXTREMELY generous with the proportions, even the small size is gargantuan. It's very clean and has a wonderful outdoor seating area. It's a must in St Petes!!

Had a fabulous, socially distanced, outdoor brunch at this new Nudy's location!!

We were seated right away when were arrived around 8:30am on a Thursday. We sat outside on the deck where there was only one other table. The rest of the outdoor tables (about 20) were safely spaced as per government guidelines regarding the virus.

They are currently not giving out menus. They ask you to review the menus on their website. Great way to decrease the spread of germs!

Service was wonderful. Our waitress wore a mask the whole time.

There is a beautiful waterfall outside by the tables. If the sound of this small waterfall doesn't drown out the conversations of patrons next to you, the sounds of nearby 202 sure will! Personally, I didn't mind this noise as it assured your conversations weren't overheard by people next to you.

I ordered the Western Omelette and a side of Scrapple. I know I can always count on Nudy's for a delicious omelette and this one did not disappoint. Excited this location of Nudy's has iced coffee. I've tried ordering at the location in Paoli and they could only offer hot coffee with ice cubes.

We decided to try the deep dish pizza all the reviews said was good. We ordered the steak out royal pizza and it was delicious. The only negative I have is that the large was not as big as I was expecting. We are a family of five and it wasn't enough pizza. For the price I thought it would be a 14 inch or 16 inch pizza. I should mention we did take out so I didn't see the pizza until my husband came home. I'm not sure I would order there again just because of the size of the large and the price for what you get. If you are two people sharing a large it's enough pizza.

Food is average - not spectacular as the prices would suggest - service is not very good at all.   A female manager came to our table and asked how things were but seemed relatively uninterested in our answer.... she talked to a server poorly in our presence.  Host staff seems very frazzled in busy times.  T&C location was NEVER like this....
