Love Bodega! They have two vegan options - tofu and tempeh - both are pretty good and flavorful. The sides are awesome. Make sure to try the jimica slaw and the homemade sodas! The wait times are sometimes a bit long, but there is lots of outdoor seating and the food is worth the wait.

I have never been treated with such disrespect, this place has the worst customer service I have ever experienced. The manager is rude and so is the staff. Their tacos are absolutely disgusting, the tacos at jack in the box look and taste better. I would rather eat ice that eat here.
Good locally-owned Irish pub hat sticks with basics, doesn't try to be trendy.  Never been disappointed with food, drink, nor service.
The Asiago Cheese Loaf, the Coffee Cake, and the Bagels (which I always either get here or The Bagel Stop in Cherry Hill), are some or the best breads/baked goods I've ever had in my life!

Never before have I been so compelled to take the time to write a review of any dining experience. 

I have ordered from PYT before, through GrubHub or Caviar and on each occasion, my order was screwed up, but not to the point where it was unacceptable, and in this case, inedible. 
First, two chicken sandwiches didn't come with the cheese wiz for the fries which is a $2 up charge. 
I asked for a chocolate shake, got a cup of room temperature vanilla milk. 

This is where it gets creepy. We also ordered the Burger Mini-Me's, which are basically sliders. I simply asked for there to be no PYT sauce or bleu cheese,  however, what I received was quite strange. A styrofoam box of waffle fries and 3 chunks of burgers tossed on top. There were no buns, just chunks of burger patties mixed with fries. Very strange. 

The only thing that came as described was the Cookie Monster shake, which sadly was also at room temperature by the time it was delivered. 

You broke my heart, PYT. You broke my heart.

Well spent afternoon!
Laura, our sommelier and tour guide had so much information! 
Our visit coincided with their receipt of this year's grapes shipment, and so we saw a pivotal moment the very beginning of the fermentation process. 
Also, we tasted last year's Sauvignon Blanc, a Pinot Noir, and a Cabernet Sauvignon. 
We'd visited for music performances before, and it's always been a pleasure, but this time seeing behind the scenes confirmed it for us.  Classy operation.
The best Jamaican food in Philadelphia! I got their stew chicken, rice and beans and steamed cabbage. Mmhmm good!

I'd noticed a number of local friends had FB checked in that they were there so I decided to try it.  The dining area was warm & inviting.  An assortment of beverages were available to include wines & beer.  I had a one-time salad bar & my friend ordered a salad from the menu.  Both were made from fresh ingredients using romaine lettuce. I was given a dinner sized plate for the salad bar & was pleased with the selection. We ordered a medium pizza & thought it was delicious on the thin crust!  There were 5 different TV screens on, one with the NCAA final game, but the volume was down & they were not distracting.  Glad we tried it & will return again & again to select from a large sandwich, Calzones & various pasta dishes menu.  I understand the banana pie is awesome!

Went here for a brief dinner I got the brisket.....LOVED IT!!!  The sides were awesome. My husband got the ziggy burger and loved it. Great now I have to figure out how to make it.  Seriously if u get up that way try it.

No restroom? Than you should close your dine in area. 
Coffee also tasted like a water. Cheap quality.

The Drunken Fish was one of the best sushi restaurants I've been to in a long time! The food was delicious and well presented. Service was quick as well as incredibly helpful and outgoing! Our server Zach was incredibly knowledgable about the food and gave us wonderful suggestions. the spicy Eskimo rolls, were something I've never had before and were absolutely amazing, a very unique dish. The atmosphere is also very friendly and pleasant. The prices are also very reasonable considering the supreme quality of food and amazing service. I highly recommended the Drunken Fish, for whenever you crave sushi.

This place is really close to my little apt, I love hanging out and chatting with Christina one of the owners. She is very kind and makes awesome Americanos and her husband is great at them as well. Today I had the hot chicken and waffles. It was a reasonable price for a filling lunch before work, and the chicken was absolutely perfect. Great flavor and wonderful wonderful service. I'm so thankful for this place and its vibe!

Since I have more than 2 children, my family was not allowed to sit together to eat dinner for my birthday. Ok, not their fault, this nonsense came from the governor. 

I called twice to confirm my reservation and both time told the hostess we would be dining with three young children and would need the tables as close together as possible so we could best supervise the children. I was told sure, no problem.

We arrive for dinner and our two tables are very far apart and separated by another table that was occupied. I asked the host if we could sit at another pair of tables that didn't have a table between them and I was told no. 

I called twice, explained my situation of dining with three young children and STILL wasn't given the tables that would best promote a family dining experience despite restrictions! 

Thanks for nothing BJ's! Do better! We won't be back!

Our food was good but the service was terrible. We arrived around 2:00pm and were told that it would "be a few minutes." However, there were tons of available tables and were escorted to a table that had been empty when we arrived. We waited a very long time before we were even given water to drink. When it came time to order our appetizers, we ordered our food as well for fear that it might be the last time we saw our waitress. The food would be worth a return visit but our experience wasn't.

This is our new Go-To place, we LOVE it! We have four teenagers & they LOVE it! Lunch has a great menu! My favorites are the Pulled Pork sandwich, the Sloppy Joe, BBQ Nachos (great to share), & stuffed potato skins!!
Very Tasty And Fresh Food. Friendly Staff, and always an amazing experience. I Would definitely recommend this.

If I could give this a 0 I would. Both our orders came out wrong. The workers there were really loud and very obnoxious. One of the workers decided it was ok to start "sweeping the ceiling" and we had to sit there and watch dust and dirt fall from the ceiling while we were trying to eat. On top of that he did not clean up or wipe the counters where he was sweeping so if someone came in to sit down they would be sitting in ceiling dust. Disgusting. This makes me never want to go to another Waffle House ever.

Located in a run down plaza .. looking for some good pho around Clearwater on vacation can be difficult and have to rely on the friends residing there locally to recommend us. The pho here is decent and could be better . It could have been better if the meatballs are better quality also. Don't expect great service at a Vietnamese restaurants. Overall it's a decent place.

We come in every few months for lunch, dinner or carry.  Slow service had been an issue the last two visits but decided to give them another try. Server was good.  Management/Owner was not. 

This evening we ordered potato skins, 8 pieces, we ate 3 but found rest to be over cooked & burnt. Returned & asked to be taken off our bill. 

The owner came over mad, red faced and talking loudly accused us of eating most of it and stating people come in and try not to pay for their meals after eating all of it. Stated would give us 10% off. My husband stated then we won't be back and he said that's fine with me. They went back and forth on it but at the end the manager stated he will take it off the bill.  Well the bill came and guess what was still on our bill.  

We will not be back despite the rest of the food being good for being treated so rudely and it ruined the meal for us.
Kogi is super unique and the food served is addicting!! It's soooooooo freakin delicious!! Once you try it once, you're guaranteed to return!!

Perfect location. In the heart of downtown and I must say the downtown nightlife is great, the place is so lively! wasn't expecting that. It was so good, that we extended our stay by one day - initially it was just supposed to have been an over night stop.

The hotel was nice too, very friendly staff, great restaurant.

As some one mentioned about the bathroom - they could be better. The tub area definitely needs a light bulb. For the size, well what can you expect in a downtown hotel....things tend to be smaller

Great food and we enjoyed a beautiful night on patio supporting Pottstown. Enjoyed appetizers and dinners. Wait staff enjoyable. Didn't seem busy but took very long time for food to come. We were easy as relaxing to all enjoy the evening together.

I can't believe I had never heard of Shaw's before today. It was such a beautiful space I will definitely be back. The coffee was pricy (as excepted with a small local shop) but so delicious. Tables inside were nicely spread out and people were wearing masks.

Warning these donuts might cause orgasms, belief in a higher being or make you forget about our current political situation.  Climate change could be fixed and the cure to all disease found within these inspirational bites.  The Pope, the Dali Lama and Neil deGrasse Tyson spent an afternoon in a sweat lodge to create these other worldly desserts.

We have eaten here several times in the past - and had nice meals - This Saturday was a vast disappointment. Bar drinks were no where near consistent, the meals took a LONG time to arrive, despite the lack of crowd - and when they did arrive, they were cold. NEVER will we return, even after the mgr. offered us a GC to try the poutine another evening ( apparently they forgot the gravy and substituted mozzarella for cheese curds on our 14$ plate!) I hope they can get their kitchen in order - it used to be a good spot!

Wow i went to the Melting Pot for Girls Night out the day before halloween and it was hilarious! I wish i was able to dress up for that night. But mainly all the waitress and waiters were dress up which was 2 cute! But i didnt mind eaiting there. The parking was great! I know if i would have went downtown i would have been pissed as far as parking! I love the Fisata Cheese with the Nachos and the Bread oooomg!! That was one of my favorite parts. My next and best part was the desserts! I tell ya my face was soooooooooo bright! i enjoyed the pure chocolate with the cherries and the cake and the rice krispys with the chocolate was FAnTASTIC!!!!! I am going again next tuesday for my b-day and people let me tell ya that i am truly excited!!
Grate place with excellent service. The food is outstanding. Real European (Italian) style.
Best food downtown.  So good I went back for more!  Fast service.  Fresh food.  People were cool...

Brandon and I stopped in here on Friday while we were up in npr and it was pretty tasty.  I ordered a baja chicken burrito Zim zari style which has their salsa and cheese baked on top and it was very tasty. Brandon had a burrito as well I think it was called sunfire something but it was supposed to be spicy and have steak in it. Anyways he thought the steak was a little chewy and he wished he got his Zim zari style after he saw mine. He tried their red ale beer and thought it was pretty good while I had a blue margarita of some type which was also pretty tasty. I feel like any drink that is blue is always delicious. Anyways we also had the white queso dip and it had a little kick to it but overall was pretty good. I think they should serve more chips with it though to start with because we went through ours very quickly. 
The menu is really unique and looks like a lot of options. We did notice that the tacos seemed to be quite small compared to thr size of the burritos. 
I think we'd go back again in the future.

Definately bring a friend. This is a place to share and be merry. My wife and I struggled to find cuisine that was worth the visit in the Nashville area. If you are searching for anything other than comfort food you will have to look very hard. 

This place is worth every penny. We have taken all our family members there when they visit and come when we are looking for something special. 

Featured on Diners, Drive-in, and Dives this place has upheld the quality and sets the bar for unique.

Only for the tasty and health conscious souls! Me and my boy had the "Grass-fed" cheese steak salads and the fabulous broccoli & cheddar soup!

P.S. This place you don't want to miss!

Long line was worth it. Food was great! And service was quick. Within 10 minutes of ordering, we were eating. And nothing disappointed. Only con, was that I felt rushed. The place has nine tables so they are moving pretty quickly to serve everyone.
Why over priced.  Never going back again. $78 for a burger chicken strips macaroni and cheese.  Never again
One of our favorites! The chicken bites and chicken quesadilla are our go to's. It's usually always busy but the service is great.

The sushi is great and the cost is reasonable. My only critique is that the location is small and cramped, and the open kitchen appears dingy and run down. Working in restaurants I understand that it's not a dirty kitchen by any means but I think if it's going to be in full view it needs to be pristine.

Lets be real this isn't a place you'd want to take date but if your just in the mood to sit for a long time with a friend and talk this place is perfect. 

I've gone here over the years and for me this place has many good memories. Lots of heart felt conversations at this place. 

Is the food great--meh? It's defiantly not organic or out of this world, but it's do able.

I think what I like about this place is the fact they don't make you feel like you hurry because they want someone else to have your table. Again, a lot of deep conversations have been had here..

It's no beverly hills restaurant but for a small town it's laid back style fits in with the calmness of the beach. If your in a rush or super I need to eat this second--I'd keep it moving. Want to sit down and converse over a beer and chips--grab a booth.

Not for everyone but for those who are looking for a quiet place to talk this works out nicely.
The food was very good. The Service we had was only OK. He was forgetful and it took about 30 minutes to get a beer 15 minutes to get Lemons. The other servers we asked for help they was great.

We loved this place!  The service was great. Loved the decor, lots of food for the kids to try. I have never had homemade yogurt.  It was such a treat.  I loved the cucumber, mint and lemon combo.  The baba ghanouj was very rich in sesame.  We couldn't stop eating it.  I ordered the kafta kabob. The mix of lamb and beef was very good. The salad was very fresh and the pita seemed homemade. My kids 2 and 4 love the gyro. My only complaint was that they did don't love the rice, which usually they love rice.  It seemed a little rubbery. Maybe a little dry. I'm thinking just an off day for the rice because everything else was spectacular. My husband ordered the half roasted chicken, Mousakhan. It had an awesome presentation and tasted great.  We all left very happy and satisfied with our meal and the prices are awesome.  Will be back!

The best part of summer is walking through Soulard and Benton Park with friends and family. You just feel love oozing out of each brick of the  vibrant neighborhood. And it's the diverse businesses sprinkled into buildings here and there that create that unique fabric that is impossible to replicate. Cones+ Cups definitely helps play up the nostalgia of the summer nights of yore. 

Recently, my boyfriend's parents came to visit St. Louis and we were trying to give them an authentic Soulard experience by taking them to businesses in the area. So we hitched up our pup and put on our walking shoes to roam the neighborhood. While we knew we wanted ice cream from Cones+ Cups, it never ceases to amaze me that you can basically "happen upon" this small business. The building that houses this creamery is unassuming and feels like a residence. That plays into the neighborhood vibe in my opinion, giving Cones+ Cups an insider feel. This ice cream joint is OUR ice cream joint. In fact, that vibe is furthered by the fact that Cones+ Cups has next to NO online presence. Seriously. No dedicated webpage. No Facebook. No Instagram. You truly have to either be in the know or be a big time Yelper to stumble across their page. This factors into why I'm giving Cones+ Cups a four star rating. So many people prefer to "know before you go." And without a digital footprint, you don't know what you're getting into. Since Cones+ Cups has an ever changing menu of homemade ice creams, it would be really nice to have an updated, online menu. That way you know if they have your favorite flavor! 

The ice cream was rich and smooth. The cone it was served in was fresh. I got a scoop of banana walnut. It was refreshing and the banana flavor didn't overpower the experience. My only complaint was value. I felt the serving size was not commensurate to the price. While I understand this is more of a boutique ice cream provocateur, I would have appreciated a slightly larger scoop.  

We ate our ice cream on their patio. It felt like a secret garden or like you were trespassing on someone's property. I was into it. Was glad to see so many water bowls for pups scattered about.
Delicious and just overall a great place. Bakery items are fresh and the staff is very friendly. Would definitely recommend.

The best ribs I have ever had.  We shared a full rack of ribs.  These are dry rub (no sauce).  They had plenty of smoke, but we're amazingly moist and tender.  Often, they are dry, but not these.  They offer about 7-8 types of sauce, including a fantastic coffee stout sauce.  You can also go for St. Louis style, Alabama White, Carolina mustard, and others.  The sides were great, especially the green beans.  I had a "real sugar" local cola at the fountain and it was BBQ perfection.  The people doing the food line were great to talk with, giving helpful suggestions.  We loved it.
I love these guys. The breakfast sandwiches are great, the wide variety of snacks are great, the hours are great. All in all, I love having this place right around the corner.

We went for dine in outside on the patio and had steak and Mac and cheese. Both entrees were delicious and the waiter was really nice. The tables were spaced apart about 6 feet and we felt comfortable eating there
All the food at Happy Fish is amazing!!! Serving sizes are huge, good to share. The service is phenomenal. Best Peruvian restaurant I've been to...Highly recommend!

You're cheap, you're a block away, you satisfy my chinese fix. You have coupons, and sweet tea. You have to staple your wonton container shut because it's so packed. I watch you prepare meals upon order. I love your dumprings.

BUT WHERE ARE YOUR FORTUNE COOKIES.

My experience with this place does not deserve even one star.  My order was delivered with food missing.  When I contacted the store and spoke to a staff member about the missing food I was told they would have a delivery driver drop it off.  An hour later I called back and another staff member answered when I explained I was still waiting on my missing food he said he knew about this issue and when he asked if they were bringing it i was told no they were too busy.  When I asked to speak to the manager Jen she said she was too busy to speak to me.  They were not too busy to charge me full price for my order!  They were too busy to give me a credit or offer me a refund for the gross customer service I received.  I will never order from this place again and I most definitely will not recommend it to anyone.

I was waiting to pickup my stepson in the lot and had a few minutes to grab a bite. Went in and took a seat. Ordered the Cali Club with onion rings and iced tea. The iced tea was the highlight of the meal. The sandwich was skimpy for $8. The onion rings had a super crunchy crust that was a bit hard to chew. The waitress was nice and the service was good. The tab was $12 and some change. I could have had a lot better sandwich at any other diner for the same or less. Not a good value for a national chain.

Yes I would eat here again and again and again! We came in with a large group attending a convention at a nearby hotel. Several members of the group had to leave for programs at various time putting extra pressure on our server. She handled the situation very professional and accommodated everyone's schedule. The food was amazing not one person at the table had a complaint. Everything tasted fresh and was presented as one would expect at a fine dinning establishment. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed!

Deck Pizza serves New York style pizza.  This is by no means the best NY Style pizza in Tampa, but this is pretty good pizza.   

The first time I went they used fresh basil on our pizza...at least that is what I think I remember.  (I was a little tipsy on my first visit.)  All of the pizzas since my first has contained dried basil instead of fresh... a bit disappointing. The garlic cheesy bread is AWESOME, but it would be even better with fresh basil.  

The atmosphere is fun and casual at Deck Pizza; making this a great place to go to after a night of drinking for food and people watching.
Love everything I have tried here. The rice is moist and tasty! The atmosphere welcoming and makes you want to return. Try the taro mochi desserts, they are delicious!

Quick Summary: An uppity scale locale for a nice dinner out. Bring a date, have some wine, enjoy a couple of entrees. It'll be a nice intimate evening.

After my escape from Army traing (for sailors)... we wanted to hit up a location a where a little more class was more than 'no weapons without a BFA allowed'. Copperfish met that desire nicely. The feel of restaurant is like chill upscale restaurant... it looks nice and feels nice but doesn't ooze of it or slap you in the face with it's class.

The menu selection is a nice mix of grilled seafoods mostly. We were mostly interested in the oysters. Their selection had a good mix of east, west, and gulf coast. The entrees were of a good portion and flavor, though nothing really stuck out in my mind.

It's a good place to take some out of town guests you want to impress, or for an intimate dinner with your guy/lady friend.

The bf and I ate here and really enjoyed the food. All I know is We will be returning. The place is pretty big, and although we ate around lunch time, we were able to find a seat. The set up is pretty cool as far as the place goes.

I have always come here to get a buffalo chicken cheese steak and before they moved their location I've never had a problem. My girlfriend had wings at her house one day and I fell in love. So I'm craving them today we go in and yes it's Sat but so what, my hubby wants a burger and the girl says it'll be like 25min wait so he comes to tell me and I said well that's not too bad we can wait. He goes back in line and then they say "oh sorry we ran out" WTF you just said it'll take 25min you didn't say you were out! Bad customer service and pure laziness because this is the 3rd time this has happened, although I love their wings and their buffalo chicken cheese steak I highly doubt I will ever come back!!!

Beer sucks and it's way over priced!! It's a shame because the place itself is pretty cool with live music and the food is good but the beer sucks. If your looking for great beer go to La Cabra Brewing, Tired Hands, Hidden River or even Hollow Earth. They should just turn this place into a taproom. Really was hoping for a great brewery in Kennett. Such a shame!

We recently moved to Tucson from NYC and I have to admit, have been loving the food here much better than NYC.  Every single place that we've been to has been absolutely the bomb!  Culinary dropout is such a cool place to hang out with friends, play some games, eat great food, I am guessing their drinks are great too as my partnered liked her drink.

The food was good and it was nice to have an opportunity to try some things you wouldn't normally try (lamb chops for instance).  The service was outstanding and probably the highlight of the evening.  Not being someone who likes to gorge on meats, I knew what I was getting into however I felt like I was speed eating.  It's probably a good idea to slow down and enjoy.  The noise level was probably the worst thing about he evening, way too loud.  There were a lot of big parties in the room, including small crying children.  Unless you are an absolute meat lover, I would recommend NaBrassa as a place to try at least once.  Personally I would not likely go back only because it's not my type of menu.  I will say that we had a coconut sorbet for dessert and it was outstanding.
Service as always was very good and food came out super fast. Salsa and chips are complimentary and tasty. Prices are reasonable and portions are good. Will definitely come back.

Great experience at Conner's from start to finish!
We arrived early (20mins) to our reservation and were able to get seated right away. 
Micah was our server and he was very friendly and attentive. 
We started with the corn bread appetizer and as a cornbread lover- BRAVO, it was delicious. I always love when cornbread has actual full corn kernels in it.

I had the turkey Cobb salad and it was delicious. I loved that there was deviled eggs on the top. I had not see that on a salad before.
Husband and kiddo had a burger, which they said was delicious as well.  

Ended with the 'make your own sundae' and donuts. Wonderful ending! 
I could foresee us coming back again!
Love this place especially on Sundays for half price sushi and drinks! You won't be dissapointed!

Stopped in with my son before heading out on the water. The proprietor/owner runs a tight ship and you need to have your mask on. I ordered an Asiago bagel breakfast sandwich and it was quite satisfying. They serve Kawha coffee here, it was pretty good. I would stop here again.
Adrian was our server and I mean wow this guy is a step above and needs recognized. Phenomenal service and knows his beers. Definitely will come back to see him

Love this town and this bistro is a nice affordable option to dine at while you are there! Attentive service and well thought out menu make this restaurant a staple that is not going anywhere anytime soon.
A lot of the stuff is expensive but god do I love this place! Great staff and is a great place to grab stuff on the go, especially when Krewe du Vieux comes through!
A nice family type Italian restaurant,  good salads, good chicken parm, good veal parm, a nice selection of pastas, all done in an old style family atmosphere.

645pm, starving and excited to try a new place.
650, seated after the host shouts "aw shit" as he drops our menus 
7pm, we finally meet our waiter and order some drinks and chips and queso (see above, we were starving and a quick queso would hit the spot)
715, our waiter stands 10 feet away and asks another to get us waters. "I'll be right back"...
725, our beer and standard cocktail arrive, still starving
735, main course arrives... we are hungry and not willing to argue that 35 minutes for chips and dip are crazy and we never saw them. Waitress delivering refuses go acknowledge us as we ask about it and she walks by, clearly annoyed
745, waiter asks if we still want appetizer... no. Asked if we wanted it removed from our tab, which remains an unnecessary question. My meal was undercooked and remained less than half eaten. Description on menu also did not lead me to believe that the sandwich would be covered in powdered sugar and resemble a jelly donut. 

For over 30 minutes the table next to us has been waiting for their check. They were then given the wrong check.

The other table had received their drinks and appetizers in under 10 minutes. Same waiter.

Well, we tried.

Hands down best customer service I have ever received. They treat us like family every time we stop in. They are especially great with young children! My niece loves VIP so much she requested to have her birthday party here. They did a great job! Food is delicious, I usually order the chicken cheese steak salad. My niece orders pizza and they make sure to slice it in smaller portions and only heat it enough so that it's warm but not too hot. We love it here and will continue to visit often!

Great food, atmosphere and prices. This place rocks after 6 pm. Great live entertainment and service. Only down side is parking. Limited spots available. 
Best to get there before 5:30 to get a spot. Great breakfast, lunch and supper options. It is our go to place on the Gulf Shore.

I had the Gyros burger and was blown away. It combined two of my favorite things: Gyros and Burgers. Beer selection is great, but way overpriced. The location is also super small it's basically a bar with two tables outside that serves great food.

First off I hate writing bad reviews, I always try to find something good to say about restaurants but the service was just TERRIBLE! First we waited for a seat outside since it was a beautiful night out. The waitress was nice and made sure to keep an eye out for us while we had a drink at the bar. Once we sat down about 15min later she cleaned the table and walked away. We sat for about 10min waiting for her to come back with menus at least but no one ever came. The people around us seemed to get menus and even got to order their food way before us. Finally I got up walked inside and grabbed us menus. After looking them over 20min went by and we finally had to grab the waitress to put our order in... The food took forever to come out. We barely ordered anything too. It was nothing that would even take long to make. The people around us who arrived after us were already done eating by now. By this time I just wanted to leave but no I waited for my food. 

The food was good though which made the experience a little better. If the food was bad I wouldn't even give it two stars. I don't know if it was just an off night for our waitress or the service is always bad here. It wasn't even that crowded and she said the kitchen was backed up which made no sense. Also, the check took forever to get to we had to find someone to get it to us. All I know is I won't be coming back here to eat. I wish it was a better experience because the food was decent but that was really all I can say nice about it.

Went there on a recommendation for breakfast, but was unimpressed with the pancakes. Fat, lifeless. Great views of the river. Mixed lot when it comes to staffing - some staff was unfriendly while server was quite pleasant. I only ate 1/2 of a short stack of pancakes, but the server didn't inquire if I didn't like. My partner had a hamburger and was very pleased with it, although it somewhat deconstructed itself due to too many condiments in it.

Would recommend for the view. Not to the food so much.

I am lovin' The Nook Cafe!

I attended a Babes Who Brunch event which was a private event in The Nook Cafe. It's an adorable space with kitsy decor and a great cafe vibe --- plus, excellent for hosting private events! Brunch was provided which included french toast with blueberries and a cheese platter. Both were delectable and I look forward to returning for the decadent french toast. 
The coffee and orange juice were also flowing! 

I am looking forward to returning to the cafe during regular hours, as well as hosting a private event in the future!

Came here for pick-up and ordered a pizza and wings. They ran out of wings so I got boneless wings which I still don't understand why they're a thing.

The pizza was pretty standard Pizza Hut pizza. Boneless wings quality was fine but tasted like something Tyson would do so...hard pass. The staff was very friendly and helpful, though.

Holy shit! This place won me over handily. 

There was an hour wait, but the hostess took my phone number and said she'd call when a table was available. That was nice because it gave me time to grab a beer somewhere else while waiting, instead of sitting there at the place, twiddling my thumbs. 

Grabbed a bottle of wine to compliment dinner. Started with some bread and olive oil. The olive oil was a special oil from a really small olive. I liked the flavor of it. Different. WE ordered three cheeses. The sauces that complimented the cheeses were amazing. Could not have picked better sauces for the cheeses. 

I ordered linguine and clams. Fiance ordered flatbread pizza. She said her pizza was delicious. Nothing was over powering, she said that the flavors were everywhere. Even the crust was crunchy and chewy and good. The clams were amazing. Cooked in garlic, lots of garlic. The linguine was buttery and hints of spiciness helped make the dish fantastic. 

Dessert for us was fresh coffee. The waitress was very helpful. She allowed us as much time as we wanted drinking the coffee. She also said that the coffee was available inside, if we were interested. 

Overall, a very pleasurable experience. Will be back there, no doubt. I don't mind waiting an hour to eat food that good.

This place was absolutely amazing, and I'm glad I happened to see it while we were driving around. I remembered seeing it on Yelp, so we checked it out.

I didn't drink, so hard to say, but looked like they had a full selection of booze, and some casino games built into the bar to keep you occupied.

It seemed like a real locals hangout, we saw older people, younger people, wine drinkers, beer drinkers. Even though it was a Friday night, there wasn't any issues with overly drunk people (like you run into at some bars). 

The burger was amazing. I ordered mine with jalapenos, and they stacked a pile on there, not just a few like some places. You could tell the burger was handmade, and I had mine with some of the best potato salad I've had in ages. Also homemade.

The cook, and the bartender, were very nice, and even though there was just one bartender, and about 20 or so patrons, our sodas never got low, and we were checked on regularly.

I anticipate coming back with some friends next time and hanging out for the evening.

Also, extra clean restrooms, which for a bar is ALWAYS a plus, and a rarity.

There was even a "take a book leave a book" shelf in the back, which I thought was a cool touch. Check this place out if you are in the area for sure!

We went to The Island Grille in Tierra Verde this evening - a first time visit for me although the others had been there often.  I was looking forward to great seafood.  The menu did not offer lots of choices or options, so I asked the server if I could have an appetizer and two sides from the dinner menu.  I was told "no."  So I picked an entree. The menu stated that it came with  two sides. A house salad would be $3 extra.  Since I only wanted one of the listed sides I went ahead and ordered a house salad and one side, but don't understand why there was an additional charge for a salad that most restaurants include with a meal, especially since I only ordered one of the listed sides. Then, when the manager came and asked how are meal was, I asked if might have a breadstick.  I was told "No, they only come as three for $3."  I told him "never mind" and he quickly retreated without a word or any effort to make us "satisfied customers."  One of the people I was with mentioned this to our friendly server who agreed with us that manager was certainly not customer friendly. On the way out, one person in our party also mentioned something about the manager to the hostesses who mentioned other comments they had that evening and "wondered if he would still be there tomorrow."  Too bad. Food was tasty and nicely presented. And our server was friendly and responsive.  Just hope this rude manager doesn't drive customers away.

Fantastic!  Amazing service and the owner came over twice to make sure all was great. Poke ahii tuna, cheese plate and spaghetti were amazing. Such a great experience and wonderful atmosphere!  I highly recommend!

Rione is fancy pizza that is sold by the slice.  Each slice costs between $3.25-$4.25.  This place is great if you are a small family with little kids or are a single person going out with friends or someone who wants a slice for lunch.  

However, if you have teenage boys who like to eat, it will cost you an absolute fortune to feed them.  This is not the place to bring a boy who can eat an entire pizza unless you can spend the big bucks.

I didn't see an option to buy a full sized pizza. 

The pizza is delicious.  The mushroom pizza is fabulous.   There were many vegetarian choices.

Amazing. Cool decor and seating. Nice bar, unbelievably great food, pricy but worth it. Queso fundido (made with duck) is a personal favorite. Their salsa is chunky like pico de gallo - also a personal favorite. Call ahead to reserve 'the car' table. Tacos are very filling- three per order. Tortilla soup is gorgeous. Only wish they still had "district chicken" on the menu. Highly recommend for any fancy/fancy-ish occasion. 

P.S. Great drinks!!!

Ordered the pasta with scallops and shrimp in s blush sauce. For $19 I'd expect more than two shrimp and scallops. The side salad could not be more than two pieces of lettuce. Bread basket was good but seemed everything had been in the fridge. Grated Parmesan was stuck in the shaker. Won't be back :-(

I (like others) am hoping that this place is just in their "getting our feet wet" stage.

I REALLY hope this place gets better.
I enjoyed the potato Dosa. Prior to cooking it, they asked my spice level liking which I said was a 3-5. Well, their definition of 3-5 is much higher than mine (in other words my Dosa was SUPER spicy. Great but almost TOO spicy). I will adjust accordinlgy next time.

I hope they learn to keep more options available later in the night in the future. Alot of the food seemed to be gone at about 8:00pm and they stated that what they had was what they had (in other words they were not cooking any thing additional to choose from). I ordered a few curries and apps (basically I took one of everything they had left). mothing stood out except the Dosa.

Great food, great service.  We were a little concerned about the fact that this was a hotel restaurant, but it had the feel of an upscale place.  It was advertised as gulf to table, and our food was certainly fresh and well presented. I would go back in s flash.

What gem of a find. Outstanding food. Was packed but they still fit us in at the bar. The French fried eggplant is a must. Also tried charbroiled clams. Outstanding. Fish was fantastic, not over done. Highly recommend.

Okra, crinkle fries, and baked beans were delicious and the chicken was good, but beware, hot levels are deceptive! Hot is SO HOT. Levels should be measured on the Scoville Scale!!! If you want a little spice, but not wanting your face melted off, stick with mild or lower. Seriously. 

Tried the Applejack and it was DELICIOUS. The fried apples give a much needed relief from the devilish spice.

Man, the waitress really knew about the beer, not just telling me to read the descriptions.  I sat outside on the sidewalk seating and enjoyed watching people pass by on a nice night.  Met a B list local celeb and had a great conversation with some nice people at the table next to me.  In short, my atmosphere rating was great.

I had the beet salad, they need to put more goat cheese and nuts and a little less bitter greens and fennel on it.  For being a beet salad, it felt unbalanced away from the beets.  I know the cheese is probably the most expensive part, but I had 3 dime size pieces, not enough.

I had the duck flat bread and I liked it, however it was very rich and needed something to cut the rich fattiness of the flat bread.  Best to split this with someone else and have them get a lighter flat bread as well.

A GREAT place to get great beer.  One of my favorite beers of all time is the Saison Dupont and they had the dry hopped cuvee on TAP, which I have never seen.  Awesome, I recommend this place highly.  A touch of refinement on the food side and they are a 5 star.
Italian beef was delicious. Very friendly staff. Took time to stop and talk to the babies and ask how everything was. Great spot and definitely will be back next time I'm in the area

OMG we stoped in here to eat and the whole thing was a MESS.... The food was all WRONG, Cold and NASTY.... The service wasn't even better. The cook was the manger and he was VERY RUDE when he came over to see what the problem was. When we point out there was HAIR IN OUR FOOD he did not say anything. Not once did he ask how he could make it better. So, if you want to eat at a IHOP DO NOT GO TO THIS ONE. 
ITS BAD!!! This place needs HELP!!!

Most authentic Mexican food in town! 
Hospitality is great and prices are more than reasonable.

My wife and myself moved to Green Valley Arizona from the Phoenix area 2 years ago. We eat out several times a month and we usually go out for Sushi. We had several favorite spots in Phoenix but were not familiar with what was available in the Tucson area. We tried most of the more popular Tucson restaurants with limited success. Then we went to Sushi Cortaro on River. Much to our surprise Sushi Cortaro met and exceeded all of our requirements as to quality, service and value. Their lunch special includes a number of half price items and their dinner happy hour has an excellent selection. We have now eaten there numerous times and have always enjoyed the experience. It is now our go-to restaurant. If you are going for Sushi this is where you should go.

Thanks and I'll return here

I picked my friend Jason from Franklin road and were discussing on having an afternoon snacks. Let me tell you that I'm fond of chili and spicy food. We got this restaurant and ordered Red curry with rice, Khaeng Phed and Spring Roll. Though I preferred it to be more spicy; the red curry was full of coconut milk and vegetables along with an Asian sauce. I got the taste first in Bangkok and now I got it here. Jason added drunken noodles in my list. I saw the sunken and floating vegetables, mushrooms, pores and pieces of chickens. Seeing it, I was wondered as they were so green. Afterwards, the taste took my all concerns away. The hunger was taken up and I ordered more with drinks. Nita was so keen to help me a lot and I got to know that I was talking with the owner. Thanks and that was enough to draw my hunger and attention here again.

THE most incredible meal. Fresh ingredients perfectly prepared and new twists on traditional creole fare as well as other influences.  An incredible treat was the grilled oysters -- nothing like them, thank you Michelle, the best oysters of my life, still dreaming of them!!!! :)

This review is a bit delayed but I was at raijin for their soft opening and have come back multiple times since then. When it first opened it was crazy crowded so the wait was not ideal. It's evened out a bit since then but you can still expect to wait at peak times (weekend, evenings thurs/fri) but I think it's worth it. 

I haven't had all the ramen in tucson but I've had my fair share and raijin is pretty good. Definitely top 3 for me. The staff is friendly, the prices are decent and most importantly the ramen is tasty. I've had the spicy tonkatsu, black garlic tonkatsu and umami, my wife had the chicken and my kids like splitting the white tonkatsu. You can ask for additional black garlic sauce if you want to add a little kick. This isn't as good as ramen in California, but you can't be too picky in the desert. We'll definitely be back again.

The Cafe advertises one price in the room for Prime Rib That the cafe does not Honor  . The Buffet Poor service Like your not even there paying good money. Call to complain to the Hotel was told I would get a call back . Never called Me . Will not spend a  Dime at The Nugget but will spend my time here for a room provided by work . Do Not go to the Nugget . Rooms are equipped with discussing Carpet. Avoid the NUGGET!!!
Seriously just told that it would take too much time for appetizers - on Saturday night at 7:00 with like 6 people in the place - good luck lasting another month........

Best hot chicken in Nashville and I will be back every time I'm in Nashville. Don't go to any of the touristy spots like Hattie B's. Trust the locals and come to Prince's. The owners are super friendly as well.

I wrote about my experience here under the previous ownership name.  Didn't know there was an updated listing.

Nice place, good food and good people.  Check it out!!'

I was a little disappointed in our meal at the Black Olive. It might have been I was expecting too much from all of the excellent reviews. I will give it another try, but based on my recent trip the Black Olive was good but not great.

The place is really nice inside now. This is the second or third restaurant that has been in this location. We were there on a Saturday night and they were pretty much full. The service was attentive and efficient. The food came pretty quickly also.

We started with the Hummus appetizer. This was not bad but not anything awesome either. It did taste fresh. I had the Moussaka , a dish I order at almost every Greek or Turkish restaurant I try. The Black Olive's was good but not great, it just tasted a bit bland for me. My daughter had a special with lamb over pasta in a gravy sauce. The lamb was super tender but again the whole dish seemed to lack flavor and seasoning.

I enjoy Greek food and I will give the Black Olive another try soon.

WOW! The food here is amazing. Everything I tried from these guys I have loved including their beer. They brew under the name of Big Lug.

We started out with some loaded fries. Holy $&@#! Topped with chicken, bacon, jalapeño, cheese, and did I say bacon? Incredible. 

Next we got bacon cheese burgers. Nice thick and juicy patty done medium. This is the type of burger that will show up in your dreams. AMAZING! 

The Big Lug beers are all very well done. I had the Helles lager and the Kolsch. 

I will hit this place and any of their other locations anytime I am in Indy. Check out Half Liter and Liter House.

Excellent food and so-so service, I went here with TUCP board members for our annual dinner and the food was great! Went back a second time with a date and the food was great!

There is a bar up front with a piano if you want to jump in and play a tune...hahhaha

That apple brie salad was great, oyster rockefeller and the shrimp cocktail. This place is located in the Quarters and is located in an alleyway so make sure you watch where you are going if you are going at night, parking---there is no parking so you have to find one of those pre-pay parking lots or one that has an attendant.

Is Boise and the surrounding areas the new hot spot for Q? Sure, you could make the case for it as there are a lot of place cropping up, but as the pig once noted (paraphrased), some animals (places) are more equal than others. 

Case in point, this little spot. It is fitting for Eagle, which is sort of a small town setting stuffed into the sprawl of Boise and Meridian. It reminds me a lot of Park City, where all buildings must conform to the motif and which makes finding anything an enormous pain in the keister. This one is deep in the middle of this throwback section of State Street and features a pretty dinky parking spot. Inside is more modern, trendy design chic, rather than BBQ joint, but we'll let that slide...if that food is good...

The food here is...ok. I've had much better and much worse. Pulled pork is pretty solid, if a bit dried out. Ribs are done acceptably, but both of them are slightly lacking in flavor. Beans are sweet, of all things. Garlic French toast was pretty good and the sweet potato fries and iced tea acceptable. Their regular sauce tastes like they went crazy with baking molasses and the spicy has a good amount of a pepper I can't quite distinguish, probably Habanero, along with another spiking element, probably either Ghost Pepper dust or maybe Habanero dust. Neither one is good by itself, but work reasonably well together. You'd not go out of your way for that combination, but while there, it's the best alternative. 

All in all, this is a spot to hit if you're hungry, in the area and wanting Q. Otherwise, keep looking.

Dry rub ribs were excellent. Prices are very reasonable for the quality. Half rack of ribs was $10 and worth every penny. I got here are 11:30 and was one of 3-4 people, which had me worried that it wouldn't be good. By noon, there was a line out the door. Apparently everyone else has discovered this place already. Glad I got here early. Really really good.
Not fancy. If you're expecting Sonnys or Shane's Rib Shack, take your weak bbq-eating self somewhere else. This place is legit.

Food was good. Service fast. Environment was clean and friendly. We had scallion pancakes that were really good for an appetizer as well as multiple dumplings (both steamed and fried). For the entree I had a spicy beef noodle bowl that was very good. The portions were decent size.   I gave it four stars because I don't have a lot to compare it to in the city so I don't want to be misleading. We enjoyed the food and would definitely return. It was also kid friendly

So this replaced Pompei if I remember correctly. And to be honest they get points for a clever name. FYI the actor is Pesci. The floor level areas are nice, well decorated (cool curtains hanging down, main dining light fixtures). Looks like a decent place to grab a drink at the bar. There's also a more "exclusive" or at least gives off the notion of exclusive upper area in the back. It gives you some options since it's slightly more intimate depending on what you're going for on a given evening.

I've been to this place before but guess I've never reviewed it. I like the atmosphere here, the outside sitting and the friendliness of the staff. This is a counter service style place. Everyone in the kitchen was wearing a mask, which I really appreciated. I got the shrimp tacos, a veggie taco and a tofu bowl to go. The order took about 5-10 minutes. The bowl came with grilled tofu, plantains, mango salsa, avocado and some rice and beans. The bowl was very small which kind of disappointed me. I was not full from it. However, it did taste good. The shrimp tacos were soft tacos with grilled seasoned shrimp aioli and done other add ons I don't recall but they were seasoned really well. The main winner here was the veggie taco: zucchini and cheese with a beautiful delicious seasoning.

Great service, very kind staff and amazing hot bar selections. If you know, you KNOW. 
    Very impressed with the meat department for good cuts to smoke. Awesome prices too.

Shake Shack is tasty, regardless of which location you choose. This location, although new, is no different. However I have to deduct 1 Star for the prices, a little steep for burgers, a double with bacon is $10. I've also had some of my burgers over-cooked. The other star deducted comes from the terrible service at this location. I order online every time I eat here to save time and skip the massive line. Twice I have come into this location and walked up to the counter only to be ignored by employees who will stand in the kitchen and stare at me but not say hello or offer to assist me. At one point I had to lean over the counter to flag down an employee just to grab my order that I can clearly see next to them.

We are super fans of Pollo Tropical.  We have been to both locations in Atlanta, locations in Tampa, Miami, and Nashville.  So far all of them have been satisfactory both in service and in quality of the meal.     Kudos, Pollo Tropical!

My favorite donuts ever! Hook & Press has fresh gourmet donuts daily. Their flavor rotations feature local flavors and ingredients and are always so creative. The online ordering/pick-up system makes it so easy (although it may be unavailable on the weekends due to high demand). I indulge almost every week because they're that good. Favorite donut flavors include - fig&honey, pumpkin pie, pumpkin spice latte, chai crumb, and an insanely delicious seasonal Halloween one that was raspberry filled. Their coffee is great, too.

Best burrito I've had in a long time. 
Salad was very good as well. I ordered chorizo tacos too which were also delicious and it would have been a 5 star review had the tacos been less greasy.

So this place has been open for 35 years and this was my first time here. Boy oh boy was I excited!!!! 
After looking over the menu we started to place our order and the disappointment began. We ordered a beer and the guy behind the counter said "Nope try again we're out" same thing with our next selection. So Pepsi it was. 
Ordered the small combo which is wings and a small two topping pizza. We also ordered the garlic knots. Brian loved his wings. The pizza was thin and crispy. I got salami and sausage. The sausage was very flavorful and the salami was sparse. The garlic knots were greasy. You'll love them if you like bread dripping with butter I just don't. 
The booths were cool quite private but be careful with your drinks the wood tables are uneven and bumpy! 
I also have to add the part of the kitchen that I could see was very clean and organized!

Take out is available during Covid. I wanted to try multiple items and decided to give this place 3 stars. Some items on the menu are really good and some items I wouldn't order again. 
The hot and sour soup had too much vinegar in it. 
The pickled chicken feet left me super thirsty, and it was a bit slimy. I have had this at other restaurants and it's not supposed to be slimy. The beef chow fun was okay. I have had better and I have had worse.  The scallion pancake had good flavor, but it was a little soggy. Since it was take out, then it wasn't freshly eaten when cooked so that is just the covid environment of take out.  The beef tendon chili sauce dish was super good. 
I would like to go back and try the other items as certain things were really well done. 
Service was friendly and quick. The order was ready in 15 minutes.
Personally, I enjoy kfc or Popeyes over what this establishment serves.  I had to wait a very long time for service as well.  I thought about giving it one star but the food wasn't that horrible.

Delicious food! I was about 7 months pregnant when we stopped in to eat. The place was packed but we were seated pretty fast for a table of 4. We ordered table side guac and of course had the free salsa and chips. Both were very good. Being that I was with child I had a virgin mango margarita. It was sooo good. I cannot imagine what it taste like with tequila. The server was very nice. She was patient with us, since the menu is huge we had a hard time figuring out what dish to order, and answered all of our questions with a smile. I had the taquitos and my husband ordered a combo meal where he picked 3 different things. ie burrito, taco, quesadilla, enchilada, etc. He enjoyed his food but was even more excited about the amount of food he was given. It was a lot! My taquitos were good however, we did take out a couple of weeks ago and i ordered the burrito de casa. It came with one chicken and one steak burrito. It was so tasty! It was seasoned just right and the rice and beans were delicious! If you want a good Mexican place to eat at Las Margaritas is it

A really cute and cozy spot! I had dinner with my mother here and we both enjoyed the food. Everything was so yummy and fresh! I will be coming back to try more. 

We enjoyed the tres tacos, santa fe salad, black bean soup, and key lime dessert. I highly recommend the key lime dessert, it was the best one I had in awhile.

Tip: CASH only + ATM inside

This is the one BBQ restaurant I will frequent in Tucson. It's at least 50 miles from home but when I'm in the area (S Park near airport) I find time. Chains such as Dickeys on Ina Rd. are overpriced and lacking quality and taste. Tucson does not have many choices. Limited menu but honest BBQ at reasonable prices. Owner active on site each visit to this and previous location. Nothing fancy and I like it that way. Awesome sauce.

The special seafood gumbo was absolutely delicious! I would definitely eat here again!  The charcuterie & cheese board had a nice assortment and was excellent as well. My fresh blueberry mojito really put me over the moon, yum!

The best brisket I've had. Lots of good sauce choices but the ribs and brisket were so good, you didn't need or want sauce. The people and atmosphere were terrific. Wish there was one in Orlando. We'll be back when we are in town again.

You would never go into La Pizza based on seeing it on the street. The shack-like building in what seems like the middle of nowhere isn't terribly welcoming and the name isn't particularly unique. BUT, the pizza is awesome. Made myself sick eating la pizza because it was so good I couldn't stop! The specialty pies look good, but they have tons of toppings to create your own. Nothing special about the crust but it makes a great vessel for the delicious toppings.

This is a great location for Prince's and much easier to get service from than the other location. Compared to other Nashville Hot Chicken places, it's not as good. But, it's worth a shot if you are in the area. It's a larger location, and the staff is very friendly.

Here for the first time and I must say I'm not (again) NOT disappointed! Even tried oysters for the first time and maybe I'll venture to other flavored menu items. Only bad thing is you gotta come hungry- I'm stuffed and didn't get 1/2 way thru my sample platter. Bar staff is great (we managed to sit there faster and ate most of our food before the buzzer went off).
Went there with friends for dinner, the atmosphere is amazing and relaxing, and the food was absolutely incredible! Vegetarian soup is to-die-for!

First time ordering out from Dim Sum and the food was great.  Ordered the Shrimp Pad Thai, the Dim Sum Combo (the pork buns and dumplings were really good), and the BBQ Korean Short Ribs.  Everything was great.  It was delivered by bike so it wasn't super hot but that's to be expected.

Art's Skillet is officially our new favorite breakfast place! We've been a handful of times over the last couple months and it's always excellent. The place itself is clean, cheerful, and inviting. Art and his wife are there every time we've been, and are always kind and welcoming. The food is always delicious! The fried biscuits with marmalade are a must. My family and I have tried several different items from the menu and have enjoyed everything. My personal favorites are the Navy Seal Skillet and the French toast. I cannot recommend Art's enough. It has a great neighborhood feel and is a welcome addition to the east side. Kudos to Art and his family for an all around great dining experience!

Ate here during the evenings while visiting friends in the area a few years back. Service was horrible, the food was worse and the bartenders expected you to tip more than what your drink costed. If you're from out of town or have a "funny accent" the staff will ask you a million questions. I'm there to eat, not give you my life history. If I had been more familiar with the area I'd have eaten elsewhere. The Cheddar's back home in Virginia never had these problems.

City Tap House is slightly upscale restaurant where most adults/college students in the Philly area go. The bar area isn't noisy and perfect for a quick bite and drink. I highly recommend any of the pizzas on the menu or the Blue crab mac and cheese! The prices aren't the cheapest, especially on a college student budget...but if it's a treat yourself night...it's definitely worth it!
Great coffee, perfectly cooked (and fast!) avocado omelette, and an amazing biscuit... what more could you ask for?

I thought The Stillery was totally fine and acceptable, but I don't see how it's currently the highest-rated restaurant in Nashville. The food was good but nothing to write home about. In fact, my visit was not memorable at all aside from being a quiet in comparison to the normal craziness of downtown. Definitely come here if you want a good bite to eat in a sea of sub-par downtown restaurants, but don't set your expectations sky high.
Clean, fast service, excellent food.  Got the uncooked poke bowl.  Was excellent.  Sauces are tasty.  Price is extremely fair.  I will be coming back here.  So much better then the dirty Zen Bentos
Pizza was well cooked and service was great ! Not my favorite pizza place in West Chester but it was still yummy

Katie was our server tonight. Very sweet and attentive, never let our drinks get low and quick to tend to our needs. As a server myself I thought she did 150%. Good work!! 
Drinks were delicious and our meal was fabulous!! The lamb is by far the best i have ever had anywhere in Nashville. The sauce that the lamb is placed on is superb and my daughter( who is very picky) devoured the potatoes the lamb was served with. 
We had a lovely time. 
Love {Pub}licity so much!!

The restaurant itself is very nice and the food was good. The hush puppies were great, very dense. I also had the steak with fries and béarnaise sauce which was delicious. Wouldn't recommend the ginger sazerac to drink unless you really like the taste of alcohol, it tasted like I was drinking a glass of fireball.
Good place to eat, came with wife and 2 toddlers. Sat on the covered patio. It was nice, food isn't really kid friendly but it's good non the less

First time at this Denny's in Santa Barbara and I haven't been in one in years. Thought the one in Santa Barbara would be different as in the past, I haven't had the best experiences in Denny's. 
We were first sat down without any utensils so when our coffees arrived, we had no way to stir them so they got cold while waiting for waiter. We had to track down the busboy to bring us some utensils. The cold brew iced coffee tasted like water with coffee flavoring (I don't expect high quality coffee from Denny's but I would at least except it to taste like coffee). It was very hard to track down the waiter for most of our meal. He never checked on us even though he was paying extra attention to the table next to us. We would still have to grab his attention because he would never look our way. I had to wait a pretty long time (over 10 mins) to get a new iced coffee because the first one didn't taste right but I saw him constantly bringing drinks and food over to that table next to ours. By the way, we were charged for the new coffee without being told even though there was something wrong with the original. I ordered Moons over my Hammy sandwich with no meat but substituted it with avocado. My sandwich arrived with no avocado and again, it was very difficult to track down the waiter and when we told him there was no avocado inside the sandwich, he said "It's in there" (as if I was a liar). I had to physically dismantle my sandwich to show there was no ounce of avocado. Although the service guy was nice and friendly, the service was not good. I'm not asking for special attention but when you're paying $11.99 for some eggs, toast, hashbrowns, avocado, and coffee, I would at least to expect to not be called a liar and have my food arrive hot and correct. During the entire course of our meal and the time it took to write this review, the waiter not once asked if our meal was OK or if we needed anything UNTIL our plates were almost done and we had been sitting there. Getting a bit sick of waiters suddenly giving attention and compliments when the bill is about to come... bucking for a big tip for their subpar service.
At the end when we were paying at the cashier, she asked how the meal was and we told the truth and she was kind enough to give us $3 off the meal.

Ordered the calamari, which where ok, and a feast plate. It was more than enough for 4 people. The beef briskets was the best on the plate, cooked to perfection and very tasty. The sausage was also very good. If it's your first time order a platter so you can taste all of the meats and then decide what you like best for your next visit.
Very nice set up, service was good. The Rails dbl pale is their best beer!  Coming from San Diego, I cannot go 5 Stars as we know San Diego is the craft Capitol of the world!
This place is amazing! Great food, drink, and service. I highly recommend the duck breast, potatoes, and stuffed squid.

Four stars for history. See, in a sense it doesn't matter what the food tastes like, as long as you believe it's earth-shatteringly good. And a great crowd can make you believe such things.

My father is not Italian; actually his grandparents were Jewish immigrants from Russia and Romania. But apparently the Jews and the Italians used to hang out a lot in Northeast Philly in the 1950s. My dad's best childhood friend lived in a very, very Italian home, and, after many nights of dining there, my father seems to think of himself as an expert on the Italian-American culinary scene in Philly.

"There's nothing like Ralph's," he'll tell you. I mean, shit, I could buy him the finest plate of spaghetti money can buy at some fancy shmancy joint, but my father, inevitably, would tell me that it paled in comparison to his old standby. 

Ralph's is cool, no question. On weekends, it is absolutely packed to capacity, and my father likes to tell me that a lot of the clientele are actual South Philly mobsters. (Are there really South Philly mobsters? According to a special with Geraldo Rivera, the answer is yes; and apparently one of them tried to knock him off.) And so, with all of this history and mythology surrounding the place, it's hard not to romanticize you meatballs or your seafood pasta. 

The other reviews are right: Ralph's serves up pretty standard stuff. But then, that's what we like here in Philly; we're traditionalists. People always scoff when someone tries to fancify the great Philly cheese-steak (if I'm not mistaken, Steven Starr offers a variation on the theme made with Kobe beef, which apparently runs in the vicinity of $100). And likewise, people are always happy to have a great plate of pasta at a simple place they've been coming to all their lives.

I have driven by this place numerous times, looked at it many many times on Yelp. Each time saying I want to hit this place up. 

Finally!!! Wow! Food and staff were excellent. Staff were courteous and kind. Explained the story of the restaurant and the different sauces. 

Food stand point steak sandwich and the columbian bowl. Incredible. I love it. Taste and flavor galore. Add in those aforementioned sauces. Delicious! 

10/10 would recommend

The beer selection is good, but the food is only okay. The last time I went, I tried the pork pelmeni, which wasn't particularly memorable and rather bland. Their flat breads are pretty good and there is a good variety to try. HandleBar is a decent place to have beers and appetizers with friends, but I wouldn't go out to dinner there.

A group of us went to the Lemp Experience. What a fun time! The drink and appetizers were nice while we were told a history of the museum.  The tour was very informative and fun.  Nothing happened, but possibly some orbs seen in one of our infinity mirror pictures.  The staff was then very accommodating when we asked for a table to have a meal after the event.
The only thing we thought that could use improvement was more items available for purchase in the gift shop. I had a lot of ideas on things they could sell.

We chose this place as our New Year's Day, boy I am craving a huge burger location.
If I were to pass by this place in a car I would never think about walking in.

Based on some Yelp reviews and closeness of its location, we decided to try it!

When you first go in, you enter in the bar, its small but has a decent amount of bar tables. There was a large group taking up most of them. So I noticed they had a secondary semi-separate dining room. We sat there.

I had read reviews of slow service, but we sat down, had our drink order taken right away.

I KNEW we were getting fried pickles after seeing a photo on yelp. No brainer on the appetizer. I chose the South-side burger and my buddy chose the Cheeseburger.  I made a special request for my side to have both waffle fries and regular seasoned fries. They accommodated my request and notified that I would still have to pay the additional $1. Worth it to me so I can try both!

The fried pickles came out and they were delish! They are chip style, and came with a different southwest style of sauce vs just ranch. I enjoyed it and saved it for some fry dipping!

Our burgers came out and they were HUGE! I piled my optional LTO on top of the already high burger with onion straws, and bbq sauce. Cut it in half and dove in.

It was cooked to my perfect medium, pink all the way thru. It was delicious and exactly what I needed after a night of a few cocktails.  The iceberg lettuce had an enjoyable crisp when biting into the sandwich. I even heard my buddies crisp as he took a bite.

The fries were great too. On my next visit I plan to stick with just the regular seasoned fries. I liked them a lot better than the waffle fries which were very large.

I ended up taking half of the burger/fries home as I could not finish it!

Only reason I didn't get it a full 5 star is it needs a bit of remodeling. It looks like they might be in the middle of some, with spackle on the ceiling and half torn up floors in the back of the room.

If you're in the Loop and need to piss, no one will stop you from going at Blueberry Hill.  Walk in the door and go toward the back and to the left.

Incidentally, their scrambled eggs and chili mac are both pleasant.

Craving soup, a coworker recommended Woody's and I'm so glad I went. The owner was very personable and let me sample the lemon chicken feta and Armenian lentil. I had never had lentil soup, but really enjoyed all the spices and flavors. The lemon chicken feta was simply heavenly. I'll definitely be returning for a bowl of that!
Hole in the wall burger spot that puts out one of the best hamburgers you'll ever eat lots of different varieties if you haven't been make sure to put it on your list of things to do

What a surprise, excellent choice for lunch. Food and service were both very good. Huge portions! The combo Italian/Mexican menu seemed a bit strange, we stuck with the quesadillas and were very happy. Don't let the sad exterior discourage you, grab the beer from next door and try the food.
This is my favorite happy teryaki to go to, the food is always good and the lady who works there is so nice!!
Well, I loved this place and they had the BEST fried rice. However, I just went there last Friday night (March 2016) AND THEY HAVE CLOSED!!! It is now Miss Saigon. HUGELY disappointed.

Delicious dinner! I was only in Nashville visiting, and was told this place was not to be missed. I went with a fellow vegetarian, and we split 2 small plates and 2 pastas, plus the bread to start :) Everything was amazing, although the sweet potato was my favorite. Honestly, the best sweet potato I've ever had! 

Ambience and decor were both lovely, and very Nashville. We went early (around 6) and by the time we left it was full and a bit noisy. Highly recommend for a delicious meal in Nashville!

I used to go here a lot and went back for lunch on a recent Saturday and was quite disappointed. I git wings which were fair and hubby got chicken quaesidillas whih wer just plain bad- just chicken and cheese. A couple of hours later he got sick and we attributed it to the food. The service was civil though not as attentive as I remember.
What happened?

I've heard great things about this place but I ordered the "jumbo" smoked wings through grubhub and was not impressed. They were small. And I asked for buffalo sauce and blue cheese but I got neither. They were fried crispy but overcooked and kinda dry. I'll go back to try the real bbq but so far not a win.

I've been here twice. Once for happy hour and another for dinner

The happy hour was really nice, and it lasts for like three hours so you don't have to rush. The snacks and drink options were plentiful and you should probably get the beer cheese pretzels. 

The dinner wasn't as good as I'd hoped. The entree portions were kind of tiny, and they didn't even offer you bread to start. Bread is like the hack if you end up offering small servings... because you'll trick us into thinking we ate a lot of entree but really we just ate a lot of bread. But this just left me feeling a bit empty inside. I also made the reservation with a note about a birthday, but they wrote happy birthday on the dessert we ordered after the meal.. lol.. so if we had not ordered the dessert this gesture would not have been expressed? Just seems a little fake. 

Skip dinner. Come here for happy hour.
Hreat food!!! Loved it!! Great service and great food kids lived it so did I. Definitely coming back
Best fried chicken I've had in a while and that mac and cheese doe

This was originally an unintended pit stop on my way to Santa Barbara, but it's now going to a necessary visit whenever I'm in the area! Very friendly service, and the lentil soup was outstanding. Highly recommend it over neighboring options.

We ate here the first night in NOLA because it was close to our hotel. I had the crawfish etoufee and it was excellent. Be sure to ask about the specials. Service was equally excellent both nights we are here, we had the seafood platter the second night, it was good, but I really enjoyed the etoufee better.

The atmosphere is very clean, modern, and slightly upscale. They offer a brunch and a large selection of drinks. They are very packed for brunch though. Their brunch runs pretty late. I got there around 2pm and they said brunch was ending soon. Their brunch menu items cost around $10 each. Their normal dinner menu gets a little pricier, but you don't have to spend a lot of money here.

My family and I went on the Steamboat Natchez tour on our first full day in New Orleans. We are from Connecticut so we hadn't really seen anything like it and we enjoyed ourselves a lot. We went on a Sunday early afternoon in May 2014.

I would say there are three groups of people on this boat.  People who came for the brunch buffet, people who came to learn about the area/pay attention to the tour, and those who came to lounge on a boat with drinks.  Whichever reason you're interested in it for-there's potential for a good time. 

I was on board for the tour part, we opted out of the brunch due to some mediocre reviews about it. I wanted to be able to see everything the tour guide was talking about. We were advised to board early to get a seat on the front left side--but there were plenty of seats even after everyone was aboard.  Even if you don't opt for the brunch there is still plenty of food you can buy at the bar/snack bar. I got a frozen margarita, that was pretty nice. 

We enjoyed the guided tour portion of the ride, learned a lot about the area (being Yankees, we knew absolutely nothing when we started) My mother especially liked the voice of the gentleman giving the tour over the loud speaker--she said it reminded her of Disney World. 

They play the calliope when its time to set sail. Try not to stand too close to it, its SUPER loud. I liked it a lot more when I was several blocks away in the French Quarter and the distance created a decibal buffer.  

Don't forget your sunscreen!

What a great way to introduce us to southern comfort.  We visited on a Wednesday night after walking downtown and was seated with my girlfriend into a table of about 10 other people.  We traded stories about where each of us were from when the dishes of food started rolling out.  The menu changes daily but we started with cornbread with biscuits.  I also made my own Arnold Palmer with the lemonade and sweet tea already on the table.  From there on, dishes of baked/fried chicken, string beans, mashed potatoes, cranberry sauce, breaded pork chop, Mac n cheese, and plentiful other southern dishes.  They had a wonderful cherry jubilee for desert.  Not just the food, but a couple we met at the table gave us a taste of southern comfort when they paid for our whole meals!  Great way to begin our trip in Nashville.
Fried bologna and brisket are absolutely phenomenal.. The bologna is homemade and super tender. The mac & cheese is good too...but the creamed corn is delicious! Definitely worth the wait!

Went there on a Sunday at around noon. Not a lot of people there. Had a house margarita which was very good, excellent. Queso was very good, chips and burritos too. Only complaint is that the meat nachos were all meat. The service was very good, they put on the football game that I wanted to watch.
I love this restaurant.  Clean, great food, and cheap.  Great Cuban sandwich!!

Amazing all the way around!! Best food in the area. Best managers of a restaurant in the area. Not very pricey, and amazingly delicious. We try to go as much and as often as we can. The owners are really down to earth and as sweet as sugar to their clientele/patrons. Beats any diner for sure!!! If you want a great meal with a wonderful atmosphere, go to the Red Lion Inn!! Don't waste your time with a crappy diner.

We arrived mid afternoon on a Sunday and there was plenty of parking. No wait. They ask you right away what game do you want to watch while you eat....what a country!

We had a party of 4 and had great service throughout the day. Drinks arrived in minutes and again the service was great. I ordered the steak philly and my fiance got the swiss and mushroom burger. We were both very happy with our choices. My fries were crisped to perfection and the sandwich was very flavorful and filling. She ate about half her burger and saved the rest for later. It had a perfect rare cook to it which she loved. Her parents both got salads and they were very big and left them satisfied. I believe they were Island Chicken.?.?.?

Overall, the food was surprisingly great and the beers were cold and tasty. I enjoy Cigar City Jai Alai on draft especially. The NFL games everywhere were impressive and there was a fun vibe to the place so I recommend going on a Sunday.
Closed down. We made reservations for today, Friday, May 11 at 7 pm. They are not open for business on a Friday night.

I took my family to celebrate my sons birthday. We had a party of five including a grand parent. Our server, Candy was fantastic, and the table service was fantastic.
The issue we had was the noise. This is a very difficult place to have a conversation across the table because it is very loud. We were on the second floor, and the mens bathroom has one urinal, and one stall which equals a long wait on a Saturday night.
Our food was good, especially the special of the evening. We spent six hundred dollars with one bottle of wine, and the grandparent only had two appetizers. If you don't drink, but enjoy diet coke, be prepared for $4, 8oz soda bottles and with two kids we spent $48 on diet coke and Shirley temples.
Our service was great, but we will not be going back mainly because of the noise.
