It was so thickly breaded I'm only half convinced there was actually eggplant inside. Over all I'm fairly disappointed with the quality of food. I can't see myself returning. :(
This restaurant is definitely overpriced and the customer service needs a lot of improvement. I was super excited to check this place out but it did not meet my expectations.

Officially obsessed with their Acai bowls! This place has become a staple of mine! Got the Peanut Butter Acai bowl and my friend got the tropical coconut one. They were both filling especially the pb and so fresh and fruity! We both cleaned our bowls! Would highly recommend!

有名店Cafe Du Monde が長蛇の列だったけどこちらは適度な混み具合。フレンドリーで誠実な店員、ジャズのライブ演奏とローカルビールで散策の休憩に最適！
Gazebo cafe, 3minutes walk from Cafe Du Monde famous cafe and long line to take the seat, serves nice live jazz music, local beer and friendly staff.
There was not the line to wait.
It's a nice place to take a rest and relax.

Should be 4 stars if not for a few things!
I went for dinner with my 18 yr old son and 2 of his friends.  The menu looked great and we were hungry.  It was 7pm on a Friday night (12/10/21) and they were pretty busy, just not busy enough that I had to have a reservation. We were out fishing all day and had a 45 minute drive back to the Sarasota area so I unfortunately couldn't have an alcoholic beverage.  
We walked in and were greeted immediately and were sat.  In no time, our server; Andrew V came over, greeted us and asked for our order.  Had to have him 'slow his roll' and we gave him our drink order; 3 cokes and an unsweetened iced tea.  He came back in a couple of minutes to tell me that they were out of unsweetened tea!  WTF, out on the water all day and I was completely jonesing for one, so I also got a coke.
7 pm on a Friday night and you 86'ed iced tea-STRIKE ONE.
When he came back, we placed our orders;
App-Pollo Chichironnes
OH Wait, it's 7pm on a Friday night and you ran out of a fried chicken app-STRIKE TWO
FOr entrees, we ordered 3 Short Rib Burritos and a Steak Fajita.  The Burritos were good but only warm!  They were big, filled and had a lot of flavor.  The steak fajitas had so little steak, it really wasn't worth the price.
Ok, back to drinks.  We finished our first round pretty quickly AND OUR SERVER WAS NOWHERE TO BE FOUND!
He eventually came around and we asked him for another round.  It took about 10 minutes before he came back and left the drinks without taking the empty ones.  We were 3/4 of the way through our meals and we're in need of drink refills, and again he got to our table and checked on the food for the first time even though we were almost done eating and we requested another round of drinks. This time when he brought the drinks he did clear the cups but leaving all that garbage on the table when he was by the last time was sloppy.  So I have to say that our servers extreme lack of table visits and table maintenance was STRIKE THREE.
The taste of the food was very flavorful but service lacked, no iced tea and out of an app this early in the evening was very disappointing, hence only 3 stars.
I would come back but definitely not before trying out all the other restaurants.

The Food was super dope. The prices were also dope. Recommend HIGHLY. 

Our server, Shelley, was the most fantastic and wonderful human being. It was myself and 5 other annoying tourist girls, asking for non stop food and beers and gelato. Shelley was so pleasant, so lovely, so attentive, so fun! I tell everyone to visit NOLA just to find Shelley and bask in the glory of her. 

Team Shelley all the way, with love from California!

We have a monthly dinner with friends and we only go to locally owned restaurants. Our friends chose a different restaurant that was nearby but lucky for us they were late so we redirected them to Pho Le! Excellent choice on our part. Our waitress Pamela was very attentive and gave us great recommendations. The Pho Sure for me was amazing. The hubby had the steak and shrimp vermicelli which was also great. Our friend chose the hot soup of which there was enough for her to take home another two meals. Their spring rolls were very tasty. So happy we found this local place that's close to home. I can see me calling in an order when the snow flies and I don't want to get out of my jammies

Has a clean and bright feel inside. Server was fast and friendly. For a breakfast spot I would've liked iced coffee options other than their brewed coffee over ice without any syrup or creamer options besides those individual creamer pods on the table. Lots of menu options I could hardly make up my mind. I decided on the steak and egg wrap which was served with my choice of side. Food arrived in a decent amount of time but taste wise was pretty bland. I added hot sauce to my wrap and ketchup to my hash browns to give then some flavor. I tried a biscuit and gravy and the biscuit was nice and soft.
Good service, nice place to watch March Madness, fresh dough and quality ingredients.

The food at this place was mediocre at best, and the owner was quite rude concerning a restaurant certificate that I used to purchase my meal.  There is far better Chinese food and quality of service elsewhere in New Orleans.
Authentic, fresh Italian food that makes your mouth water.  This is a hidden gem that is worth a visit!  Service is great and food is delicious!!  Highly recommend.

If what you are looking for is a straight up honky tonk on Broadway, this is your place. Entertainment is twangy goodness. Fried bologna sandwich special was an exceptional deal and good when trying to absorb a bunch of liquor.

This place used to be called Ivery bistro. We moved to done Eden one and a half years ago and tried it as ivory bistro and it was the best Chinese restaurant I've ever been to. We tried it on Christmas Day and the Grinched us. My wife got her food in the table bit arrive 10 minutes after us got their food then 20 minutes later I got my food and it was wrong. Five minutes later they bring me the fried rice I ordered vegetable fried rice they brought me pork fried rice with no vegetables. I went and got my own to go boxes loaded my food up set on not paying the up charge for the vegetable fried rice she gave me 20% off the order when my food should've been free.I can't even eat with my wife on Christmas Day. 
This went from being my favorite Chinese restaurant to what I will never set foot in again.
I understand it was Christmas and they were busy but they handled it totally wrong.
Do yourself a favor if you want Asian food go to Blue Sake down the street.

Food was okay. Prices were really high for crawfish compared to everyone else in the area. Service left a lot to be desired. I heard rave reviews about their Gretna location so I was looking forward to it but... Hope things improve. Really cute place though.
Great cheesesteak, any way you want it , but be prepared to stand in line  almost at any time , but well worth the  wait !

I like the fact this place is busy and a little noisy, because it is FULL of energy. I have eaten at the bar, inside and outside. Service good and I love the food.

I've eaten at the bar twice. Second time, the gal behind the bar needed more appropriate attire. The bosom show was not pretty.

An absolute great place to have a beer and enjoy the moment! My wife and I got the seasonal pale ale which was very refreshing and hit just the right spot! We tried the garlic butter fries with mozzarella and their oysters. You just have to try them!! Service was very fast and friendly. Highly recommend it!

Long wait for appetizer and had to ask about it. Long wait for main course then it came out cold. Took it back to the kitchen and claimed we got new orders; however, it was very dry so suspect it was microwaved. Didn't include the plantains and had to ask for them. Drinks were 95% ice. Sat us over the wall from the open kitchen so we sat through loud, constant yelling out of each order. Won't be back here anytime soon.

2 stars because food was great, especially the tomato basil soup. We also had the meatball and parm panini and the 12" american pie pizza. This restaurant gets 4/5 stars if this review was based on solely food....but its not and service is just as important as food quality. Our servers name was Karma. Non existent is about the best description of her service. She had 3 other tables besides ours, 2 two tops and a four top. Nothing too crazy that I would say she was weeded. No check back once our food was delivered. Her fellow servers bussed our table and brought us refills. She didnt thank us for coming nor did she invite us back. When bringing back my change, she tossed the server book on the table, didnt say a word and walked away.  Normally I would say maybe shes having a bad day but, this experience was different. She was actually pleasant with her other tables. She gave one table a menu tour and explained a few menu items. She was attentive with her other tables, checked back timely and even conversed with her guests. We were an easy table and didnt do anything to inspire a poor service experience. Needless to say the food wasnt great enough to overcome the awful service experience.

I generally try not to eat raw fish in states that don't touch the ocean, but I made an exception based on the good reviews. I ordered the shrimp tempura bento, which came with rice, two large pieces of shrimp tempura, some vegetable tempura, a few pieces of cali roll, pork dumplings, and salad. The tempura was great, although I could have done without the broccoli. Something about cooked broccoli's texture doesn't play right with tempura for me. The rest of the package was standard fare, and the rice was undercooked and dry. I also ordered two pieces of white tuna sashimi, which tasted good but obviously weren't "ocean fresh". Kind of an expensive lunch, but it hit the spot.

We went on a Friday night during happy hour.  This place has great prices buy the place was jam packed. It is an old building that has been added on to multiple times. 

It is not the classiest place but definitely could be a good time. If you like dive bars and want to save some money while still having a good time then this is your place.

Drinking at the Patterson House was a great experience.  The cocktail menu was excellent and the atmosphere was a lot of fun.  I always love being surrounded by books, even if I don't plan to read any of them.  Anyway, we got a weird little triangular table the first time we went in, and sat at the bar the second time.  The staff were helpful when we asked for advice on which drinks to get.  We were also surprised that we were able to get in so quickly, as I'd had the impression that it would be super crowded.  We were out late-ish on a weeknight, though.

LUUUV this place , found it by accident - our flight was cancelled, truly a silver lining.
Authentic Indian food served in a modern setting with a fresh, hip vibe.. generous portions, friendly service , complimentary cutting chai served at the end of our meal- what's not to love ?!
Very solid food the Ramen is amazing really good price and great quality. Service is good as well but definitely come for the food
All sushi is NOT created equal.  Very impressed with the unique rolls and happy hour pricing.  I can't wait to return...I wish they were open on Sunday :-( .

Decent food, over priced but if your staying at the  Hyatt worth checking out. 

Pulled pork sandwich for $14 was pretty good, fried pickles for $9 weren't that good as the batter fell of the pickles. 


This is a solid 3 star spot. Good food if your nearby
I just can say this is the best place to eat Tacos in the area! Fresh food and great costumer service!  Tacos al Pastor my favorite... delicious! !!!

A great 'go-to' neighborhood Mexican restaurant. It's clean, the servers and staff are friendly, the margaritas are solid and the salsa is some of the best in town. The menu and selection is wide, but let's be honest -- you don't go to a place like this healthy or gourmet food. Lots of other reviewers talk about the food being inconsistent, but I've never experienced that. I love Nacho's for exactly that reason ... I expect solid -- not necessarily excellent -- food and drink and they deliver that every time all in a clean, fun atmosphere that's great with kids or without.

I'm a student at a nearby college and today was my first time coming here. The food was awesome the drinks were so tasty and the fat bastard sandwich was amazing!!!!!! The service was also very good I would highly recommend
I stopped for a quick take-out lunch order today.  $5 got me a whole bunch of food, and included a can of soda.  Chicken is crispy and very tasty.  Great service.  Best chicken in Broad Ripple

Needed to find a place for good B+G's close by and they DID NOT disappoint! This place is so good and has such a cute atmosphere! I have found a new favorite place. Whether you live in Indy or are visiting, this place is a must try!

Fresh, quick, healthy, delicious, and in a bowl. Need I write anymore? If Fresh Bowl Grill was closer to me, I would have already returned a few times.

There are a plethora of options that are sure to please most palates. You can have a base of rice noodles, white rice, romaine lettuce, cauliflower rice, or tri-color quinoa. Or, get this...a combination of any of the above. You then add your protein. Grilled steak, grilled chicken, teriyaki chicken, pulled pork, taco meat, veggies, or a combination of the above. 

You can then pick as many toppings as you want. Black beans, steamed broccoli, sauteed mushrooms, sauteed onions, romaine lettuce, corn salsa, chickpeas, cucumbers, green peppers, red onions, roma tomatoes, pickled jalapenos, shredded carrots, sour cream, feta, and / or mozzarella. 

You can then top your creation with one of their homemade sauces: avocado ranch, creamy siracha, sweet thai chili, ginger lime cilantro, spicy salsa verde, mild salsa, or (you guessed it) a combination of the above. 

I believe my bowl had  (who knows by the time I was done) quinoa, romaine, grilled chicken, teriyaki chicken, black beans, steamed broccoli, sauteed mushrooms, sauteed onions, cucumbers, red onions, pickled jalapenos, feta, creamy sriracha, and ginger lime cilantro sauce. 

If you cannot tell by now...bowls make me very happy. I like a variety of flavors. The young lady working there was extremely helpful and efficient. She answered questions and made our bowls quickly while having patience with us as we decided. 

All of the food items were fresh and flavorful. It was a delicious dinner and I had leftovers for later. I will definitely be back sometime soon.

Katie's for Sunday brunch is awesome.  The unlimited drink special is great.  Good bloody mary's and sangria.  The food was real good as well.  Had the Eggs Cochon which were very good.  Service was great, fast with the drink refills.  Must go before saints games.
Absolutely delicious food and really great customer service. The cashier/server was so nice to my family, I was genuinely impressed. This place is fantastic!

Shocker: this place is not a dive! It is nice inside but the real star is the bartender who was working yesterday mid-afternoon (I apologize for not getting your name) and the food was really good, too. 
We needed a drink while we discussed making a LARGE purchase for our home down the street and decided to go someplace close (like, just on the corner) and I'm glad we took the plunge and went inside. The bartender directed us to any of the many tables which are separated from the actual bar and pool table with short walls, so it makes it nicer. After we sat down, she left the bar which looked like it was nearly filled with many regulars and brought us the food menu and took our beer orders. 
Wings...wow, do they have the sauces! We decided on a mix of Cajun spice rub (yum!) and a Ghost pepper sauced set. She warned us of the heat but said they were both her #1 and #2 favorites. They were both delicious and not too hot but you have to watch the heat build up with Ghost pepper. Good thing I ordered another beer! We also ordered Potato skins which were stuffed with melted cheese and the works and really hit that mid afternoon munchie spot.
I was really impressed she would leave the nearly full bar and come over to see how everything was and take her time and talk with us. Did I mention we were the only people in the dining part? Yes, that is service that make you feel special. 
Being a sports bar, there are TV's all around but a mix of music is heard overhead. Could be the neighborhood place for Golden State Warriors games? I'm looking forward to returning and giving the menu a hearty try.
Pizza with a unique twist.....delicious!  Loved the crust. Very tasty garlic bread knots too.  Give it a try!

Think diablo burger meets five guys.  I got it at 3.5* but giving the benefit of the doubt.  I will go back. They do have a couple kinks to work out service wise, but nothing fatal and nothing unusual for a new opening.  

Burger patty was good, I had the regular (not the grass fed) but it did need salt which I added myself, not sure but maybe they intentionally don't salt the patties. The bun was delicious (probably the butter), fluffy but held together well.  Fries were just decent fresh cuts, could maybe use a little improvement, like a fun sauce to go with (if there was one I missed it).  But I think I got a bad batch as they were late and then hurried to get them out so I need to revisit. 

What's cool about this place, especially for those who are all in on organics, was everything is organic from burger patty to condiments and fountain drinks are Maine Root (not sure about bun or anything else used in the cooking process like the butter but expect it would be at this place).

Owner/manager was nice, came out in the line to answer questions, etc. so points for that.  And I like how the menu is smaller with not an overwhelming amount of choices and menu items.  I may have missed this but it didn't look like the fountain drinks could be purchased separately from the "combo" that comes with a hefty up-charge of $4 although other bottled choices were available.  I wanted to try the fries because it was my first time but if I went back I would just want burger and a fountain drink but not sure if that's an option.

I really felt at home in Gramm's Kitchen. The servers were friendly, tentative yet not overbearing. The restaurant is well lite, clean and roomy. Although I only had Breakfast I throughly enjoyed every bite. 
I will definitely stop in again when in the area. Gramm's just seem to be a friendly down home kinda place.

The good: it was open on Labor Day (3 prior places we tried were closed). The ingredients were fresh and not choked in grease or fried. My Rose Benedict was good--especially with a touch or three of Tabasco.

The alcoholic drinks were truly delish and not expensive at all. My ginger limeade was made by them, not a canned drink that they added vodka to but fresh made. Loved it. Wish I'd ordered three. 

The bad: my only issue was service but for me that can make or break s place. They seemed irritated to be open and busy on Labor Day. Our food was handed to us from the door since the only table we found was outside. The guy couldn't be bothered to deliver to the table. Then I went back in to grab some silverware. There wasn't any. I told the cashier who took our order.  She shrugged her shoulders complete with the palms up gesture and said, check the other table. I walked over there. Nothing. Meanwhile my breakfast was cooling off outside. Argh! Then I heard the clinking of silverware as the other girl had shoved some still dripping wet forks into the canister at the other table without even signaling to me that they were available. 

The food was fine, the drinks was great but I really hate when service is disinterested, overly nonchalant  and/or rude. It seems ungrateful especially when a generous tip was left in the jar that informed customers that "every time a tip isn't left a unicorn dies." I like unicorns but I didn't like the service at all. 

Hopefully it was an "off" day for the cafe.

Went here one Sunday for lunch with a whole slew of friends. We used a Groupon for half the table and a Restaurant.com gift cert for the other half; they were nice and accommodating of our cheap college student antics. The dishes here are solid, and I think most everyone enjoyed what they ordered. I myself got a boring old chicken tonkatsu lunch combo. A one-entree lunch combo was $6 and a two-entree, $10. Incredibly filling as it also come with edamame, miso soup, their house salad, and orange slices. They threw in a cute cup of exotic coffee, something that you definitely don't expect from a Japanese restaurant. All in all, a great place to have lunch. Recommends.
a breath of fresh air in this upscale downtown area. The staff was inviting and helpful at choosing some yummy tea. Wish I lived in the area, this would be a hang out for me.

This mall is big and clean! The restroom maintenance was wonderful, especially during these times! We travel to Tampa from Texas, it was a good experience. Best thing going is a little store in the middle of the mall called Awful Waffle. The picture I showed does not do any justice for it because I had to screenshot it from a video I made. I had a candy pop waffle- it was a warm brownie waffle that was fluffy but had crispy edges, topped with caramel/chocolate syrup and topped  peanuts. I thought about this tasty treat the whole trip!

This place is great. We stopped in here after a concert at the Pageant. Got a couple of Old Fashions and bowled a couple of games. Great drinks, no problems with the bowling aspect. Great crowd with a good mix of ages.
Since they converted to all organic, you get half the food for twice the price. The selection was also halved.

I've been coming here for around 18 years. Sorry it took so long for review )). The food is very very good and consistent. It's nothing spectacular, but different than a lot of the other Mexican restaurants in Nashville.  The only reason I give it three stars is the service is pretty blah. Most of the time they forget something. A lot of the times they forget to come back and refill my drink.  I'm lucky to get one refill almost every time I come here. Very very subpar service.   And the crazy thing is they seem to have so many servers working at any given time. Kind of a lazy vibe. But I would definitely recommend it, as most Mexican restaurants in Nashville seem to have lazy service.
Is ok... nothing special.  Should of went next door as same breakfast items were less expensive.  Food was greasy.  Will know better next time.. this is where yelp failed me when looking at reviews.
Same ole thing in deli. Can't get to items wrapped r taped. This place is a joke u ask they look at u like da don't shop here they suck
Great food at reasonable prices.  Drink and dessert are included for around 10 bucks.

The Q is an improvement over the Whole Hog.  The BBQ hasn't changed (and that's a good thing - both the brisket and the pulled pork are very good, although I like the pulled pork better), but the daily specials have expanded and are pretty good.  I'm a fan of the stuffed potato with pulled pork (go light on the cheese) with the yellow mustard sauce.  It's a weekly ritual.

This is a cute place! Parking is easy to get in and out of the lot. The food was good and cooked thoroughly. The price you pay for the food you get was great.  Staff very nice, even offered to go teas.
the food here is delicious! the rigatoni alla vodka is by far the best pasta i've ever had
another one of those pretentious bars that i forced myself to like because all my friends were bouncers.  but i like their flirtinis and their music and let's face it, i'm just as pretentious.

We had a great time here!!! David Douglas & James were these best!!!!! Our vacation was so fun because of them!! Thanks guys!!! See you next time we are in town!!! First stop on our list of things to do!!!!

I wish I would've had enough of a charge on my phone to take photos because it was that lovely. My friend and I went here for a bite to eat and wow!!!! I live right up the street from this establishment and have never been here unfortunately. It came highly recommended by my pharmacist who orders from here frequently. I plan on doing the same. The atmosphere was quiet and very high class and modern. The staff was very friendly and polite. They were on top of everything. The food was fantastic! It was absolutely the best Asian cuisine in the area. They offer a little bit of everything fora very reasonable price! The food was crispy and fresh. We will definitely be back!

Living nearby, It's always exciting to see a new restaurant join The Summit. I decided to give it a try and placed a mobile order. 
Immediately upon walking in it was clear customer service skills were non-existent from the two girls working behind the counter.
When I walked in they briefly looked up and then continued their conversation with each other. Once at the counter still not greeted by a hello or any type of acknowledgement other than blank stares by both the girls. I let them know my name and that I placed a mobile order and one of the girls turned, grabbed my bag and handed it to me then both continued with the blank stares. I went on my way with my food, having experienced what was probably the first time that going to a restaurant was a one-way interaction. 

Onto the food. I ordered the Chicken Katsu bowl with fried rice. The fried rice didn't have a ton of flavor and was pretty soggy, but the Chicken Katsu was good and not overcooked. 
Overall nothing impressive, but definitely has potential. I hope they figure things out as so so restaurants don't last at The Summit.

This is pretty much our work happy hour spot since it's right across the street, and easily accessible to 30th street station. Missed the train? Stop by Slainte. Have a craving for fries? Stop by Slainte. The place reminds me of a classier Kildare's. At lunch time, you'll find construction workers to business professionals. Beware: can be a lengthy wait during the hours of 11:30 - 1:30 pm.

This place has a pretty decent draft list that changes with the season. And a major plus for me - Mad Elf in the winter time! :)
New find! The breads are all amazing!! We got a free sample right when we walked in. Will be coming back soon. Taking some to go!!

We went here with some friends and had very high hopes.  Many of the restaurants in the South Tampa area are very good, innovative in their menu and unique in their offerings.  Soho Sushi was ok but their menu was quite unique with some great variety of cooked and raw sushi as well as other more traditional Asian dishes.  I had the Teriyaki chicken and while the chicken on top was tasty, the piece underneath was bland and with little seasoning.  This is ok for a date night, but we won't be back.
My favorite breakfast spot in SoBro. Beautiful whether you are hung over or not. Fair prices and an incredibly friendly staff, consistently keeps a line on the weekend.

This is my favorite place for breakfast in the valley. And I am very picky. 

We have been coming here for breakfast for about 4 years, and the staff here is consistently the friendliest, happiest, most upbeat, chatty, and sincere I think I have ever encountered at a restaurant. Seriously. I mean, they are just always smiling and energetic and nice. This stuff makes a difference as a customer.

The food is delicious and fresh. Lots of interesting options. Love the scratch jam.

The only thing I would wish for is more vegetarian options, like a full veggie scramble or something. 

But really this place is great!

Food is good. Made a big mistake and sat at the bar.. A older gentleman is waiting on us .. I have never ever in my life experienced someone so angry and rude at a restaurant. Sadly this was my mom and I's first time here and for sure will be our last. Judging by his interactions with guests and employees this is very common behavior from him . I am in shock this is tolerated at a place like this . You can get friendlier service at Wendy's so save your money !!! Happy dining everyone.  Should have sat on the other side of the bar the female working looks very sweet and engaging with guests .

We visited on a Saturday morning and it was very busy, had to wait about 30 minutes for a table. Our drink order was taken as we were being seated and our food order was taken when the drinks came. For as busy as the place was the service is outstanding, our food came out quickly and was delicious. The only thing that was less than desirable for me was the "bottomless mimosas crowd" the place was packed with 20 somethings who think doing brunch is cool and need to take 20 selfies while holding a drink. Of course, this is likely their target audience during this time of day, but it was annoying nonetheless. I would totally recommend and will be back if ever in the area again, maybe just not during brunch.

Definitely one of our favorites and never a bad meal here!  The scallops are huge and delicious and the shrimp & grits are amazing. If we had to find anything that needs improving or mentioning it would be that we wish they had more sound absorption on the inside. We always want to eat on the outside patio because it's very loud inside. Difficult to have a conversation without almost having to yell. Sound just bounces off the ceiling and floors. Very annoying. Now that we get cold weather this time of year, we wish they would invest in some heat lamps for the patio. Lastly, parking is a real issue. Dangerously tight squeeze on the side of the building and so very few spaces out front. We will go back again and again because we love the food, but we will walk over instead of the struggle to find parking.

This place is expensive -- be aware when you come here that this is likely to be a special occasion; but oh, what a special occasion you're in for!  

Be sure to start with the shrimp cocktail.  Yes, it's spicy.  It's SUPPOSED to be spicy:  that's what shrimp cocktail sauce is.  

The service is impeccable; the food, mind-blowing.  I'm from Texas, so I know steak:  this is the creme de la creme of steaks!

Absolutely worth the expense.

Just wonderful. The things here that we ate that were great include: the grouper sandwhich, the cod bucket with hush puppies, the crab cakes, the carribean taccos, the sangria, the rum runner. Basically nothing has been bad. We came here twice during our week visit and both times were awesome. Live music too!!

I LOVE sushi-I could eat it for every meal every day.  This was the worst sushi I have ever tasted. Worse than Publix even.  I am sorry I don't get it why this place has great reviews. I just moved right down the road from Naples and was SO excited to try this place because of it's high yelp rating.  I ordered 4 rolls plus wontons and edamame, and EVERYTHING tasted like old fish.

I mean that in the worst possible way...it tasted like rotten fish smells. EW EW EW! Between the dirty restaurant, the creepy customers (lonely truck drivers sitting alone eating sushi with a fork), and the fish taste that will haunt me forever, I am steering clear of this entire plaza!

Sushi lovers be warned...far better places in the area!

The food at Olivia's is wonderful and had I been rating it 2-3 months ago, I would've given 5 stars. However, over the recent month and a half, I've found myself more and more disappointed with every visit and/or pickup order.  The wait staff has changed and I don't see employees that are knowledgeable or excited about their product.  When you have a business that focuses on healthy options and local/organic products, your employees should be knowledgeable about those products as well. Employees should be oriented to learn what Kombucha is, if you're selling it. They should know what the popular menu items are and if they don't have an answer, they should gladly find out.  
Among another frustration is the fact that they are often out of certain menu items, including the Kombucha.  And when they have Kombucha, the flavor rarely changes from Chai.  I had a wonderful Blueberry flavored Kombucha there over the summer but right after that it changed to Chai and even when it's tropical, it has a chai base.  I just wish they would change it up a bit.  
I really like the food and would like to continue to give Olivia's my business, but I feel like they need to get back on track and get their stuff together.  The prices are a little higher and I don't mind paying for good, healthy, local food, but if I do, I expect consistency and unfortunately Olivia's just hasn't been as consistent in the recent months.  
I hope that they can get it together because this could really be a great place.  I want the employees to be excited and knowledgeable about their product.  I think what they are trying to do is wonderful but I wonder if they even know what they are doing sometimes!   
Lastly, beware of ordering online.  I recently ordered online and the system indicated our order would be available in about 30 minutes.  When we arrived and our order wasn't available, we were told that the online orders go through the owner's email and he was out of town so they hadn't fulfilled it.  If this is going to be the case, indicate on the website that online ordering is temporarily down...plan ahead!

Great place, especially in summer outside, but beware of pretentious girls at the host desk who have no clue about good customer service. I have come here three times but after tonight's majorwhen my outside table was given away without notice, I won't be coming back

This place has the best frozen old fashions. Fun drink menu. Food is good and different from anywhere else. They have daily specials besides their regular menu items. A bit pricey but worth it. I love the chicken wings, great flavor. Vietnamese with a spicy twist.

My family and I had a disappointing stay at the Omni (wrong rooms and two cars damaged and robbed on two different nights)  and Bob steakhouse really didn't make it any more memorable in a positive way. I have a family of 6 and my daughter and I went with the 12 oz fillet and the bone in fillet. Neither of us could eat more than one bite as it was so salty it really hurt your stomach. It is super difficult to not do a fillet properly and for the almost $100 bone in I would have been better off eating from  a salt shaker and having a ham sandwich with it.  The staff was great, we did in Room dining as the restaurant was full however this will go down as the worst steak experience I have had ever in all the places that I have travelled.

We have only ever ordered out from this place, in fact I'm not even sure what it looks like as we usually have friends pick it up on the way to our house, but it's a mainstay for our game nights at home. 

As I understand it, they only take cash, or at least they used to. However, the prices are so low, you'll be more than happy to hit up an ATM. My wife and our friends love getting their burgers and subs, and I prefer two BLTs ($2 each) and a bag of fries. We have always been happy with the food. 

I've heard some people say the owners/staff can be a bit curt, but again I can't speak to that having never personally been in. Either way, I'd take it as a trade off for the food we get from this place. It's always great.
Disappointed in happy hour food.  Drinks were good as was the Calamari.  Ceviche was poor: little pieces of tasteless fish in a watery base, and chicken wings could have been from a frozen package.

Oh, Rocky's, how I once loved you.  Your delicious pizzas, your yummy salads, your interesting music choices.  But then you got sloppy; I would get a pizza with someone else's ingredients slopped over on one edge.  The service got...odd.

Then that whole Katrina thing happened, and you abbreviated your menu.  OK we all had to adjust but you never returned to your pre-K menu and you eliminated all my faves.  

Yes it is decent pizza but I go to Theo's or Reginelli's instead now.

I just happen to be driving and seen the sign for tacos in brew, I took the chance and went in but I must say their tacos Asada we're wonderful along with the handcrafted salsa. I am definitely going back again

First visit this evening.  The staff is very welcoming and attentive.  Very large menu, lots of options.  Had the Carne Asada Tacos.  Very good.  Larger than street size, which was filling.  Food was delivered quickly to the table, was hot and very good.  Looking forward to my next visit and the chance to try other items on the menu.
The food was amazing. My boyfriend and I had the lamb tika masala & it was divine! The service was very friendly as well. Delicious food and great customer service!
the lunch buffet is a sure shot. good times.

I ordered a pizza over 2 hours ago, pre-paid online. Pizza still hasn't arrived. I was told that delivery time was an hour, and then after an hour when I called, was told that the pizza was out for delivery and would arrive in a matter of minutes. I didn't realize they meant over 60 minutes. This is ridiculous. I only ordered online because I am pregnant and have a small child and it's raining. Upon my third call to Pizza Hut (which is a call center located in a different state), I was told half of what I paid would be refunded to my card as a 'courtesy.' This is the worst food delivery experience I have ever had. And no matter how many times I request it, I am never transferred to speak to someone at my local store. So not only do I not know if I will ever get my food, I am unable to reach anyone locally to find out what's taking so long. I certainly wouldn't be as upset if I was able to speak to customer service rep from the store to find out what's going on-- or if I had received a call from management to inform me that my order would arrive extremely late. I will be stopping my the store tomorrow to a speak to someone about this. Really disappointed in the lack of customer service. Would also like to note that I cannot imagine my food will be fresh over 2 hours after I ordered it. There isn't an option to give 0 stars, but this is the first time I wish I could.

This place popped up right next to our house and it's now our favorite pizza spot. I had a calzone and it was the best calzone I've ever had in my entire life. My partner got a pepperoni pizza and the crust is much better than the pizza from NY NY.

Food was ok at best. But customer service was poor. Over 30 minute wait for a tea??? Unbelievable. Also they were sweeping the floor under our table. How rude is that? There's a time and place for everything but this is that back home
Mentality where they didn't learn common courtesy.

We love Pizzava! Anytime we are in midtown we make a point to stop in and order a pizza. We wish Under the Rose was still sharing the space next door, but alas, we drink our own beer now. Had some friends visiting from out of town and they loved it too. Keep up the good work!

Place my order on the phone I get there is paid a 45 minutes later supposedly they forgot I was there in the restaurant waiting , they give the food and it was all cold and and the bread sticks where like rubber, they need more attention to detail and communication between the all in the counter employees, I  suggest give your customers a number as well as your take out customer , and please be a little more organized, other than this long complaint at times the food is great. Since there is nothing better in this side of town.
This was a first time, and it was so good. Service was on top of refilling our drinks.. Biscuits and gravy were great. French toast was thick and tasty..

Completely disappointed!  The food is subpar and the mimosa is like drinking gasoline because they serve cheap champagne and OJ.   The management decided today to charge a guest in our party that clearly did not eat breakfast./brunch...  that is a new all time LOW.    They should have charged them for their beverages and that is it.   For someone who has been in the industry for over 30 years... this is not the way of keeping your clientele!   And, is clearly why your business had declined by over 30% this past year.  Completely disappointed and expected alot more from your management.  We are locals and frequent your establishment on Saturdays and Sundays... but, don't worry, no longer.  Competition has a lot more to offer and with alot better food quality and customer service.  Too bad management doesn't know that you don't need to charge for seats..poor, poor decision.

My favorite place!!!

Delicious coffee and beignets. By far better than any other place in the city.

The live music and outdoor park topped off the visit!

we were there saturday evening and had a fantastic meal..started with baked portobellos and carpaccio, both outstanding, my wife thought the carpaccio was one of the best she's had..split a terrific penne putenesca and then had the special branzino and a wonderful chicken..we were greeted warmly by Anne and Franco, served amazingly by Marcos and visited often by the the superb chef Giovanni..also enjoyed a couple bottles of Vernaccio from their very nice wine list..and outstanding dining experience..we live in Redondo beach, so a bit far to become regulars but definetly will return as often as possible, thank you for a great evening

Hands down one of the best meals I've ever experienced! In town for my daughters birthday and CP was phenomenal in helping us celebrate. Balloons on the table, staff recognition, candles, the whole 9 yards. I had the pork chop and it was as tender as an aged Filet Mignon. I've never tasted pork so wonderfully seasoned and cooked. 
The staff was abundant and gracious and kind. Our server Katelyn was incredible! Sweet, knowledgeable and very efficient! Stunning dining room! The wall paWe couldn't ask for anything more!

Been to Stateside 4 times, first 3 times drinks only,  dinner with last visit.  The space is small but decor and vibe are spot on.  During summer months, the huge windows open up and you're seating from outside at the bar.  We stopped in for a drink after dinner at Le Virtu.  Had a whiskey sour and a boulevardier.  Loved them both.  Their cocktail game is solid.  The bartenders were friendly but really didnt engage us but it was busy and it was a cocktail hit and we all know how that goes, ok, maybe not all of us.   All in all service and cocktails are solid.  Last visit we decided on dinner.  I thought dinner was ok.  Nothing bad but nothing great.   I'll still stop in at Stateside for my night caps.

This review is more based on the interaction I had with one of the owners then it is actually about the Mac and cheese I had today. I'm hoping one of the owners will read this review and will reconsider their position as they open the new brick-and-mortar store. This week I found myself checking out their food truck near the state capital and I just got the regular mac & cheese which was perfect for the cold crisp fall day. Their regular mac & cheese that they have is quite good and it always hits the spot. They recently added a taco Mac to their menu which is very delicious. They recently announced that they're going to open a brick-and-mortar store near the Edwards on Overland. I run a meet up group that sees movies quite regularly and we go out to eat after the movie. I have several people in the group that cannot eat eat gluten. I had asked them  before about gluten-free options and I understand it's a struggle to find gluten-free pasta that works with their Mac and cheese concept. I know there is another successful food truck that utilizes all gluten-free menu so maybe they could discuss with them some ideas. On this day I asked I believe the female owner about gluten-free options at their new brick and mortar location. She replied that they haven't been able to find a gluten-free pasta and when I suggested maybe some salads since they already using chicken she said salads don't sell. My perception of the conversation was that she was arguing with me rather than trying to find different ways to grow her business. I was offering to bring sometimes groups of 10 or 15 to her business but she refuses to have any gluten-free options available on their menu so that means our group can't go there. I hope that they expand their menu as they get into their new location and consider other people such as gluten-free diets and be more accommodating to their diet. I'm excited to try the new brick-and-mortar store since I live close and I really enjoy their mac & cheese. Normally I would give this restaurant five stars based on the food but just my interaction with them today was a major disappointment and that they're not willing to accommodate those that cannot eat gluten. I think through networking and adding different food options they would be able to come up with something rather than just dismissing it and limiting what types of customers will frequent their business. Hopefully that will change and they will have some options available for those needing a gluten-free option. If you're looking for some delicious mac & cheese and that you and and you're not on a gluten-free diet this is definitely a place to check out especially on these crisp fall days. Their mac & cheese is some of the best in Boise will definitely warm you!

Some of the best brick oven pizza I've ever had in the downtown Philadelphia area. 

They have a decent election of different style pizza but I highly recommend their BBQ chicken pizza. Oh man, that is my absolute favorite to get when I swing by this place.

The only complaint I have is the size of the joint. Its quite cramped and on a busy day its not even worth trying. The outside seating isn't much to think about either, which is a shame. If they relocated to a larger and slightly closer place I would frequent here way more often, but as it stands I would prefer to just call in an order and pick it up.

The service is excellent!!  Ask for Joe!  He gave me the advice to try the seafood Benedict for breakfast. So yummy!  The pancakes were good and the cheese grits were good.  The coffee is HOT!    The bathrooms are very clean. Highly recommend for breakfast!

Hotel restaurants are not what one might call memorable.  Frankly they are designed for one thing and one thing only, refreshing weary and indifferent travelers.  Eat bucks that trend.  Tucked away in the lobby of the Loews Vanderbilt Hotel, Eat makes a subtle albeit important statement.  With it's head Chef Garrett bringing creativity and ingenuity to his craft, Eat sets out to make remarkable the otherwise unremarkable.  On a recent visit I was pleasantly surprised by a few menu items that I have not seen other places.  

Before I launch into my review of these items, let me say that service was impeccable.  Hotel restaurants have a reputation for lackluster service, but that is not the case here.  My glass was never empty, and I wanted for nothing throughout the meal.  Attention to and anticipation of needs was the name of this game.

For appetizers we had Deviled Eggs and Lobster Fritters.  Deviled eggs are a brave menu item, having a tendency to get rubbery and stale.  These were delightful.  Garnished with small pieces of house cured bacon and a small vial of house made hot sauce, these were simply terrific.  The lobster fritters had amazing flavor though they were slightly overcooked.
For Dinner I had the pickle cured fried chicken.  Before you dismiss me as crazy hear me out.  This chicken was sublime.  The pickle flavor was mild but cut nicely through the fry.  This chicken I can honestly say is some of the best fried chicken I have had.
Dessert was great too.  The house made corn ice cream with toffee was incredible as was the salted caramel ice cream sandwich.

Concluding here is easy.  Give it a try, they might even pay for your parking!  (no seriously, they will pay for your parking if you eat at the restaurant)

Our family of 5 went there on Tuesday night family night.  It wasnt what I was expecting, but I wasnt disappointed.  The restaurant is set up so its family style seating - long tables and you choose your spot.  They set up a few sterno burner buffet servers with a few choices to form a complete meal.  We had chicken parmesan, angel hair vegetable pasta, grilled veggies, bread and salad on the night we went. Also there was tirimasu for dessert.  The ingredients were definitely top of the line.  The chicken was high quality, the salad was delicious and included different varieties of tomatoes and other veggies. The bread was to die for.  The veggies and pasta were tasty as well.   A non alcoholic drink is included but they also have a wide selection of wine.  The server was nice and you can tell it is a family owned place. It pretty much encompasses the concept of italian family gatherings that are portrayed in Olive Garden commercials.  The price isnt bad either - $15 for adults, $8 for kids.

I have came here three times and also to the new location at American Eats - I like the food , food is good. But the service isn't great - almost every time we have came they get our orders wrong even after it repeating it many times. You can find better Mexican food many places around TUCSON. Wouldn't highly recommend, could be better if the service and workers were more genuine.

Same awesome pizza as the original on the East Side, but with a little more elbow room. The other night I popped in and sat at the bar. They had a special that included a slice and a beer that seemed like a great deal (I'm not a beer drinker). The bartender was friendly and attentive and the space is really nice while still feeling true to the spirit of the original.

Pretty disappointing overall.

Food was average.  Service was rushed, not personal and lackluster overall.

Setting is decent and has potential.

Not sure if it was a staffing issue (short staffed?), but probably won't try again.

I come here pretty frequently and the food is always good! The service is always super friendly and accommodating. The drinks are made well and like everything else super creative. I recommend this place more than any other whenever someone asks. 

The pork chop and ribeye are amazing! The pork belly is to die for as well as the watermelon daiquiri. Even the Caesar salad is one of the best in the city! 


Overall, just stop reading and go.

I really do love love the food hear... but I waited 45mins for tacos... and when I went to check on them absolutely no one wanted to deal with me... I wasn't trying to take anymore of their time as they were very busy. But I continued to get ignored by everyone working there. I finally cancelled my order as it took another 10mins of waiting and asked for a refund. The guy who tried to help me, told me he refunded me but never gave me a receipt. I went up again to ask for the receipt(got ignored again) and the girl who tried to help me told me they refunded it but gave me a purchase receipt and not a refunded receipt... when I called I spoke to a manger who told me they never processed the refund. Again I love their food but the service(even when patient) was absolutely awful!!! I mean there was no type of customer service..

I've tried to give Passyunk Bagels (and their counterparts Fitzwater Street/ South Philly Bagels) multiple chances. They don't fresh cook their eggs (even Manhattan Bagel does this) which I really don't understand. They are a bagel sandwich shop...how hard could it be to add a small griddle and fresh cook eggs for each breakfast sandwich. The re-heated eggs should be saved for Dunkin Donuts and Starbucks. Since I've given up on the hot breakfast sandwiches.. today (a Sunday morning) I tried a toasted bagel with cream cheese. I ate it on the sidewalk right in front of the store (within 1 minute of being handed the bagel at the counter). It wasn't hot ...or even warm, and the bagel was stale. It felt like I had been given a day old ACME bagel, toasted yesterday. The only thing this place serves is bagels and I am just soooo confused about how they fail to make a hot bagel *sigh*.
This is by far my favorite coffee restaurant in Nashville. While it can get slammed on the weekends, their cappuccinos are amazing. The baristas are extremely friendly and professional.
Incredible place for breakfast. Read other reviews for the process as it's communal. My daughter and I love the atmosphere, the food and the workers were great. It's trendy in a subtle way.

We have been coming here for over 20 years. Best Mexican Restaurant anywhere, anytime we try something different, no matter where, they all fall short in comparison. I try something different all the time, while my husband has 2 favorite, Chalupa or Enchilada.  I have never been disappointed, everything is delicious, even the American food. Great place, great service and most of all, delicious food and ice cold beer and the best chips and Salsa anywhere.

I love this place!! Great food and great service. Was over zealous with the spice level of a dish and they took it back and made me a brand new one!! The Thai tea is also sooo good! Highly recommend!!

Food - okay.  The prime rib sandwich was delicious but a sloppy mess with juices.  Not sure what the au jus sauce was for.

Service - disappointing and terrible.  First, the pictured receipts, which I'll add, show that I wasn't even charged for what I ordered!  This'll be fun trying to expense alcohol, which my company prohibits.  And, no, I didn't have time to carefully review the electronic receipt; I was going to be late for boarding after waiting 15 minutes to pay!  I had to wait that long because, as my server noted, she and the other servers were swooning over the latest Bachelor that had just dropped in!  Glad to know who's important at this restaurant!  I won't be returning.

Great ambiance with plenty of seating. They have beers on tap, wine and a really interesting cocktail menu. We waited for a dinner reservation here and definitely will be back. Was here around 8 on a Saturday and they had an eclectic mix of customers, everyone fits in.

Tasty food , not many choices . You get plenty of food but 80 percent of it is rice . Good fast place
To get a bite . Healthier then fast food joints

Going to update my review because this last visit was downright awful, I should've known when I called to place my order and it took me close to 10 mins to order. The girl taking my order was pretty incompetent at taking my order. I had to repeat what I wanted at least 10times to the point I actually said oh my god r u seriously asking me this again to the girl. Got the food and it was just horrible. Carnitas was dry and inedible and nachos were not good like prior times.
The sandwich meat was good but pricey. The alcoholic drink they make is very good.

The food was good. The menu was very specific. Open your palate to different tastes and ingredients. Menu options were non-traditional. Plate sizes were not large. I didn't have desert. Drinks were ok. I kept it safe with red sangria. It also helped that the drinks were during happy hour. This is one of the few restaurants that remained open late on Monday. Meal prices were ok; I think they've could've been better given the meal sizes. Service was fairly quick. Parking in Philly is not ideal. Good thing this restaurant was a 10 minute walk from my hotel.

One of the better Pho spots in the area, extensive menu that includes pho, rice platters, appetizers, vermicelli etc. The food was pretty good, the service friendly and the atmosphere was clean and modern. We'll definitely be back.

So impressed!  Saw it on the corner and decided to stop in on a whim.  The atmosphere was welcoming. Greeted and seated promptly.  Great drink selections and menu filled with a variety of dishes.  We got the DLT and Slam Elliot Burger....soooo yummy!  Our server said everything's pretty much made in house including the smoked meats, sauces, desserts, and breads. 

I will definitely come back and had the greatest experience.

Their pistachio rose cookie bars are delicious! The pistachio is baked into the base and the rosewater icing is light and floral. All of their items are  vegan which is amazing. I love the decor and atmosphere with the plants and pretty colors. They have a plethora of desserts and baked goods. Definitely worth a stop if you're on Central!

Incredibly fresh sushi with premium cuts of fish. Attentive service, kids menu, wonderful restaurant layout. The 23.95 all you can eat deal is a steal. The location at River & Stone may not seem ideal now but this corner is about to blow up! Eat here now.

Had a great meal here. First meal after arriving in city. Ordered a burger which was super yummy. Partner got blackened fish Alfredo and loved it. Staff were very friendly and helpful in giving us ideas about places to go. Came back the next day to get the smores bread pudding which was Amazing!!!! Would definitely go back again. Only gave 4 stars as there was a lot of adult activity going on right across street and it was midday. Just a lot to take in while eating lunch... Even for NOLA!!

This is one of my favorite places to eat! The staff is always so friendly, the food is phenomenal! My favorite main course is the chicken shawarma but, their burgers are also amazing! They have great milkshakes for desert too! All over just a great experience and a great environment.

This was our first experience with this restaurant and we were very impressed.  The dining area was very clean and attractive, and seating due to COVID was following guidelines.   Service was very friendly and quick...and the food was outstanding!  We've been to just about every Mexican restaurant in the Boise area and this one just made it to the top of our list.  In addition to excellent food, they served some favorites as well as some different items.  Unfortunately I forgot to take pictures prior to digging in, but all the dishes at our table were beautifully presented.  We WILL be back!

Tonight was my first night at Helium. Before heading out I read the reviews here and was admittedly a little hesitant because there are quite a few dauntingly negative reviews. My experience was to the contrary. I got to the show a half hour early with reserved setting. We had a party of 8 and were only 3 rows back, dead center. Our waitress was prompt, friendly, and didn't leave me waiting when I was finished with my beer. The host, Conrad Roth, was extremely funny as well as the opener Stephen (who I am racking my brain to remember his last name). Adam Ferrara killed it and there was a great vibe in the entire audience. I am definitely going again.

Stopped here for lunch on a Friday while in the area. They have an enormous wine list but not much off the beaten path regarding beer. 

The food was delicious. I got the Shoreline Salad. It was a spring mix topped with filet mignon, roasted red peppers, and blue cheese. Holy crap - amazing! If that wasn't awesome enough, the waiter asked if I wanted to add crab for additional charge. Hell yeah, sir! The crab pieces were HUGE. The charge was kind of huge as well but it was justified. 

My fiancé ordered the Parmesan Crusted Chicken. He liked it but it was served with a blush (vodka) sauce. He wasn't crazy about the sauce but ate it all regardless.

I can't speak about desserts because we didn't order any --- I was stuffed after my salad. The server was very personable and attentive. The view of the Delaware River and Philadelphia were an added bonus. It was a very relaxing time!

Impressive food menu sure to please anyone's tastebuds.
Although it was strawberry season and both the French toast and the pancakes loaded with fresh strawberries were tempting... I went with eggs and never looked back.
A spicy Bloody Mary topped with a crispy bacon strip made the 40 minute wait worth while.
Shop around the country store or head next door and nosh on fresh baked donuts or a scoop of fruity pebbles ice cream while you wait.
This was our second visit here, a favorite after Hunapu day for a filling, great tasting meal with great friends and always top notch service!
Do Yourself a favor and try everything!! It's phenomenal!! Keep up the good work and we will surely visit again!!!

Capriotti's is the BEST.  I called last night to place in order and could not have been treated more courteously.  The food is amazing- I am vegan and get the Impossible Cheesesteak (no cheese) and it is excellent.

Thanks for providing great food and superior customer service.

Pretty little restaurant in a neighborhood that has a lot of takeout places. I took out myself but I would definitely eat there another time. My order was ready ten minutes after I ordered online. No trouble at all! (Often online orders at other restaurants end in confusion and longer wait times.) 
The chicken and shrimp red curry is delicious. Both meats are tender and the dish is perfectly spiced. 
My only complaint is that they were out of brown rice so I had to get white.

Sushi Teri is a great spot! I come here way to often well at least in the last week lol. I just get California rolls which isn't super fancy, each time they have been fresh and perfectly rolled with a good portion of each of the ingredients! When I've dined in at the place the service has been always excellent!

This place has AMAZING food! I was looking for something with a true European cafe vibe, and the food here blew my expectations out of the water. The flavors really reminded me of France, from the cherry almond cookies to the mortadella sandwich! I can't wait to go back, and all of the guys working here are awesome too.

Interesting place...kind of fun and funky with a retro feel, dollar bills on the walls and wood cut out artwork and art laminated into the tables.

Was seated pretty quickly; but that's where quickly ended. It took quite a while for the server to get to me.... after he came over I realized he had been walking around the dining room attending to other tables in clear view of my table.

He was a 'One and Done' he seemed to only be able to focus on the table he was at, back to get their drinks / food, and back to the table.

By the time he came to me I was ready to order - a cup of PJ's Seafood Gumbo ($3.25), a dozen oysters on the half shell ($13.99) and Fish Spread ($8.99). {I was hungry!}

I told him I was happy to take the food however it came up...

The gumbo came first, the cup was PACKED with fresh fish, with some diced tomato, rice and veggies... but it wasn't packed with flavor and really had no spice.

Fish Spread was brought out next (by someone else) it came with canned black olives a few rings of white onion and a lemon wedge.... it also had some packs of crackers.... it was OK, creamy, but really not very smokey and not much flavor. It would have been nice to have some other vegetables with it... the olives did nothing for the dish.

Last up we're the oysters - when they arrived the server asked if everything was OK but never bothered to clear any of the dishes or offer to refill the soda...

The oyster were average, they looked like they were opened by someone with limited experience; several were torn up and most were flat and not really plump and moist.

Again no server, I could see him walking around so I flagged him down for my check.

They website promises great service and great tasting food.. they kind of fell short on both... 

With lots of other local seafood places in the area I won't rush back

Terrible foods!  I got the grilled chicken and it was burnt.  Fried rice not even cooked.  The chowmein tasted bitter and sour at the same time's.  I would recommend others should not come to this location, doesn't worth it. Very disappointed and upset!

I really can't rave about this place enough. The gentleman who greeted us at the door was our server. I work in the restaurant industry and this man seriously impressed me with his ability to explain every menu item I asked about. He was helpful, knowledgeable, and attentive. He was also friendly and personable - which is more than I can say for most places we've eaten since being here. The food was to die for. We had the whole fish special they were running, but started off with gumbo and the Brussels sprouts. Every piece of food was amazing and really showed off what the kitchen could do. Cocktails were amazing as well. This place has really impressed me and is most definitely my favorite place that I've been too since coming to New Orleans.
The burger was delicious. The fries are definitely of potato origin. Also tried the sweet potato fries with garlic aioli. Overall, it was a nice burger place for a quick & delicious meal.

Great place close to Philly with tons of seating! We went there on a Monday night around 7pm and were immediately seated. Our server (I wish I got his name!) was amazing and had a great smile every time we interacted. He explained the menu to us and talked about hotpot in case we wanted to try that next time we were there but we knew what we were there for: KBBQ. I've only been to kbbq places where usually the servers cook the food for you but they'll generally let you cook it yourself. Here, they exclusively want you to cook your food which took a little more work than what I was used to. They had a sauce bar and while I love the concept I think it's hard for some of us not as familiar with Asian condiments to try and mix a sauce together. They did have some posters explaining some sauces but I think I would have preferred the sauces to be delivered to the table. Overall we had a good time.
The food is super fresh and reasonably priced. They are not offering dine in but do offer take out. The hot and sour soup is so good!!

We really enjoyed the lunch here.  It missed the 4 stars by a hair. It wasn't really clear what to do when you enter, but once you figure that part out (walk up to the prep area, ala subway style) you're good. They have a full bar here which is nice. I didn't try the margarita so i can't speak on that. Staff was friendly and the location was great. A few blocks away from our hotel and from the water.

The high rating of in n out is nothing but a cult. Is it better than Burger King? Yes of course because Burger King is the worst. Is it better than McDonald's? Not sure. It is it better than five guys? No it doesn't qualified to compare with five guys.
The Burger is not bad, I highly doubt whether it is really better than Big Mac. The service is as slow as five guys yet every burgers are almost the same unlike five guys. Also the fries is probably the worst, very similar to leftover Wendy's fries.

Easily one of the best cheesesteaks in Philadelphia... pairs perfectly with their milkshakes.  I grew up going to their other location in Northeast Philly (formerly known as Chink's), and that was always my choice over the other NE Philly favorite Steve's Steaks .. 

This to me is as good as it gets.. I can't comment on their burgers, chick cheesesteaks, etc.. but if you're for a great steak done right, this is the place.

I love to eat out for breakfast.  I highly recommend something from the staff favorites menu - unique blends of foods that end up being great.  They have done a good job of fusing your basic diner food with a twist.  It is for sure a local fav.

I've only had the pleasure of visiting Margot once.  My girlfriends and I were all in town on the same weekend so we stopped in for a nice brunch and some catching up.  The food was all delicious.  I think the most notable thing was that the portions were much more generous than what you usually get at nicer restaurants.  Our waitress was very friendly and patient with our inability to make decisions.  We sat upstairs where you're conveniently away from a lot of the foot traffic through the front room.  The place was full of sunlight and cute, fresh flowers on every table.  The whole experience was quite pleasant, and I hope to have the opportunity to recreate it.

Great sports bar. Enough said. You want to watch sports come here. Here's the deal...

TVs everywhere including a special section with recliners where you can have food and drink and relax Ina comfortable recliner. 2 rows of about 10 chairs so if it's a popular sporting event you are watching get here early. 

Food was really good. The catfish bites and gumbo were both fresh and delicious. Some reviews give the food less than stellar reviews and the nachos were just okay. But the wings are a must. Guess it depends what you order. 

Great beer selection. Very friendly staff and TVs are everywhere. Oh wait I mentioned that. Even TVs when you sit at a booth. 

Area is awesome. Lots of shops, seats outside where you can hear the game and close to the waterfront.

Outstanding execution and inventive flavor profiles.

Ordered the Sea Urchin and Scrambled Eggs, Rabbit Pappardelle, and Cocoa-Encrusted Lamb.

The Sea urchin and eggs had an incredible flavor profile. The server instructed me to get a scoop with all three layers: uni, shrimp butter, and eggs. The flavors are insanely deep, marine, and intricate. The uni is sweet and briny, some of the freshest I've ever had. The shrimp butter is cool and lightly savoury. The eggs are so smooth and creamy. They are almost a sauce vs an egg. More like the style of eggs made by Gordon Ramsay.

The star of the pappardelle dish was the fresh pasta and butter sauce. The pasta is very fresh with a doughy and floury taste built to absorb buttery sauces. The rabbit was well executed, but didn't bring interesting flavor to the dish. 

The cocoa encrusted lamb was perfectly executed to medium rare. The exterior was crispy. I enjoyed the dish, but found the cocoa crust to be too powerful for the lamb, which was lean and light on flavor. The lamb neck was the best of this dish. It was fatty, tender, and full of lamb-like savour. 

The service was friendly and helpful. However, the course timing and replenishment of drinks/plate clearing was slower than I'd expect at Philly Mag's top restaurant. 

The experience at Vernick was excellent from start to finish. Dishes were interesting, well executed, and balanced flavors well. Definitely check it out.

After waiting an hour in line on a hot day, I ordered the Nasty Princess which was the hot chicken topped with gravy on a biscuit. The chicken was tender, juicy and crispy, but the restaurant's featured item fell way flat. The biscuits were way too dense, not flaky and light like I was hoping. My friends ordered different items but they all agreed the biscuit could be better. I don't think this place is worth the wait, but if there was no line, I'd come again just for the chicken!

Love, Love, Love this place. 

We have been to Phili several times a year for the past few years & this place is always on our list. I'm not  a beer drinker, but they have Lindemans Framboise on draft- that's all I need- plus they do have other ETOH drinks available. You MUST try the dijon mussels- they were highly recommended by the bartender & they are the best mussels I have ever had.

By far my husband's and my favorite brunch location in the area. I've gotten the corn beef hash and the Mexican skillet and my husband's favorite dish is the crab cake eggs Benedict. 

The service and employees are always super friendly and great at getting you what you want/need. They treat you like family! 

I absolutely love this restaurant and am glad it exists.

Had a very good experience. The menu had some great offerings, from turkey bacon/sausage to quinoa. The fruit bowl was fresh, and the coffee was hot. They offered flavored creamers at the table too. I ordered the Chickichanga... egg, avocado, chicken, cheese, and a cheesy enchilada sauce on top. Prices were very good too. It's so nice to find breakfast joints that offer bacon/sausage substitutes for those of us who gave up the ol' porky pork. We will be back for sure.

Never again. We were just there for a late lunch and the place was empty and no wonder. It's a shame. I used to love it. I work at the front desk of a local hotel and have been sending people there for years. Like I said, never again. I bragged to my family all the way there how Great the food and the service always is.  I'm embarrassed to know that I've recommended R.T. Weilers. Did not know it's gone downhill like that. It started with the slow service from the waitress. I had to go find her myself to take our order after waiting 15 mins. Now keep in mind that the place had maybe two other tables. There was 6 of us and we were starving. We ordered a large pizza with cheese and bacon for the kids and Homemade chicken salad sandwiches and wings for us. We got the wings pretty fast but the kids sat there waiting for their pizza. An hour later! Seriously? An hour later they got their disgusting burnt pizza! Our sandwiches were ok. Not like they used to be. I guess they sat there for an hour also, waiting to come out with the pizza, so the toasted bread was stale and crumbly. I asked the manager  to check on the pizza to see what the delay was and just as she approached the kitchen doors, the food was coming out. She never acknowledged me after that. It did not surprise me when the so called "manager" did not come to our table to apologize or to just check on us. Very poor customer service. After the waitress brought our check, I asked her if she can tell me why it took an hour to get a burnt pizza, she tried to make something up instead of just apologizing like "there was 2 or 3 other pizza orders ahead of yours and our oven only fits one pizza at a tIme". Wow, good try! A simple apology would have been better. We didn't say anything about the pizza being burnt because the kids were crabby and starving. They just ate it. Worse pizza ever! My husband said the men's bathroom was gross and it stunk. The women's bathroom was nasty as well. Only good thing was the wings and the beer was cold. That's all she wrote.

Always have loved this restaurant- but takeout experience mediocre at best.  I asked if they included silverware and was assured they did.  But, nope! Condiments were also not included - even though I specifically asked.  This is after they told me 25 minutes fir curbside and it was an hour.
Awesome food. Great Shrimp Tempura. Family owned and very nice people. Totally recommend!

One of my most favorite places to stay in St. Louis is Union Station because of the Grand Hall. The drinks are out of this world! My favorite is the California Zephyr made with St. Germain. I love to get a drink and watch the beautiful light show. It's such a classy place.

Very happy that my husband and I stopped by during our stay in Philly. The cheesesteak I had was delicious, although it could have been better had it had a bit more seasoning. The amount of meat and cheese was satisfactory and I also loved the fries, although they wouldn't give us a side a cheese vs the cheese being drizzled on the fries, which was a no-no for me, as I prefer crunchy fries dipped in sauce instead of eating them soggy.

I also didn't like that they only take cash, which is a bit inconvenient for some people, but thankfully there was a place across the street with an ATM. 

Overall, I think the place is okay. If I'm ever in the area again, I will probably go back.

Still my fav Indian restaurant, and I am so happy to see that the food & service remain to notch. Dined out on their porch recently, on a balmy summer evening. This is also one of the best places to dine if you are gluten intolerant, since their menu is mostly gluten free. They even have gluten free Naan!
The shrimp appetizer was enough to share (6 jumbo shrimp) and was perfectly cooked with just the right hit of spice. The spiced mayo was an excellent accompaniment.
For the main course, we had Chicken Biryani and Honey Lime Chicken Chipotle ( a version of tandoori chicken). Both were excellent, and even the chicken in the tandoori dish was tender & juicy -- not dry. You could taste the individual flavors in both dishes. It was not just one spicy mess with different textures. Chicken Biryani is my current fav Indian dish, and Inde Blue does it better than anywhere else I have tried.

For a delicious & filling meal, the prices here really are a bargain. You'd spend this much going out to eat at most chain restaurants, and not get food anywhere near as good. Highly recommended on all counts.
All I've had here are cocktails and they are my ultimate favorite. Ramos gin fizz, English punch.... All deliciously made by the best bartender in NOLA

My single experience at Bourbon blue was disappointing enough convince me I never need to give it another chance. The lunch menu was completely generic - nachos, hamburger, salad. I ordered the $9 bruschetta. This turned out to be 4 tiny slices of foodservice french bread, topped with a little of the "bruschetta stuff", and enough balsamic vinegar that it was the only thing that I could taste. It service was slow and inattentive; even getting our first drink was a long wait. The place was fairly busy during our visit, but that never really elicts much sympathy from me. So it's  Saturday during a well publicized Main Street event? Maybe scheduling some extra staff would help... This still might be a nice place to go for drinks, but for eats, you've got many better options withing two blocks.

This place has inspired me to write my first ever yelp review. I went with a group of six and had an opportunity to try several different things which i thought were all disappointing, outside of the mac n cheese, which probably would have been really good if it was hot. 
So in chronological order, the fountain soda had a weird taste and was undrinkable. The pretzels in pretzel n cheese appetizer were more like saltless, tasteless bread puffs with burnt bottoms. When our  entrees finally arrived ,after an apology from our waiter for the long wait, they managed to get 5 out of six correct with only one needing to be remade. The others were lukewarm at best. 
Even the ice cream was blah. This place was a complete bust. Overpriced to boot. Seriously, can i at least get some chips with my $11 burger???

Pleasantly satisfying. I, along with 2 others visited on a rainy Wednesday night, and even without reservations--we were seated rather quickly. We enjoyed witty cocktails paired with delectable dishes.  Would visit over & over again.

***WORST SERVICE EVER!!*** came in with my daughter and wife. We had to wait 10-15 minutes for a booth to open. Thinking to myself, this ain't Texas road house or the DMV so why is it taking so long. Well I found out why. After we were seated the waiter was pretty fast with our water and plates but some of the plates were chipped which can cut you and my daughter plate was dirty with dried wasabi stuck on her plate"GROSS" and then we never heard from him again and got a different waiter. Filled in our order on the sheet of paper they gave us and 5 minutes later the waiter came and picked it up. The gap between us waiting for our food was RIDICULOUS! 20mins-35mins and we only order some rolls and a few nigiri and was missing a few rolls and nigiri. We ended up sitting there for 2hr 30mins the longest I had ever sat at a sushi restaurant. only got to order twice and then we left due to very slow service and how long the sushi came out. This was why we had to wait 10-15mins when arrived. We always had to flag our waiter which makes it a horrible experience and we will never return.
