If they serve you dirty plates and chipped plates thenThis place is filthy,gross,nasty and really don't care about the customer and the quality of their food. imagine how the kitchen looks like.

Sushi:  -1/5(mostly too sweet)
Cucumber:   -5/5 (serve on a dirty plate)
Service:   -5/5
Mussels:   -5/5 (serve me old and cold mussels)

I WILL NEVER STEP IN THIS ESTABLISHMENT EVER AGAIN!

A great lunch!  We enjoyed fresh ingredients in carefully prepared sandwiches.  Healthy alternatives abound.  Fast service!  Cucumber water self-service. Limited table space.  I believe many customers carry out.  It is hard to think of other sandwiches I enjoyed more than at this place.  While $13 sandwiches are a bit pricy, they are worth it.  We look forward to a return visit.

We went during brunch and it was surprisingly empty. We ordered the pimento cheese dip, salmon croquettes, and a power bowl. The cheese dip was fine, although nothing special. The croquettes were good although we felt that they and the power bowl were over salted. The bottomless mimosas/bloody Mary's are "build your own" - a fun feature. The staff was great and very friendly and helpful!Overall, we felt it was expensive for the menu options and taste and would not return for brunch here.

The staff is extremely nice. Came here for my Veterans Day meal . It's like an Asian Chipotle. I would take a picture of my bowl but it's almost gone. Glad I came to this place...oh and they have a variety of sauces. I got the yum yum of course. I will be going here again.

Such a cute place with great decor and atmosphere. Finding a quiet place to get lunch in this area can be such a pain with most places being rather loud and busy but when I stopped in here on a Friday afternoon, I was pleasantly surprised by how laid back the environment was. The staff was very friendly and helpful and the food was great. I hope to come back again soon to try more things off their menu.

Breakfast was really good  had the Eggs Benedict and the andouille breakfast hash eggs were cooked perfect and food was outstanding service could be a little warmer but all in all very good and is some of the best breakfast I've had in philly

First time here. We had never been to NOLA before but this place was recommended and did not disappoint. Vanessa & Don are the bomb. From the moment we walked in, they were extremely welcoming. Vanessa treated us like she has known us and helped me (super indecisive) make the decision to get the pulled pork and brisket. Did not disappoint. Try this place out.

Few restaurants in this genre are so affordable. Delicious authentic Thai entrees including curries are under $10 dollars for dinner. Even the Thai Iced is less than $2 dollars per a drink.

I ordered the Basil Chicken and enjoyed this dish. However, my wife's curry was excellent. 

If you are in Saint Petersburg and want Thai food this is the best value and probably one of the best options.

The first 2 mornings the food and service was excellent.  The 3rd morning we arrived,   was seated in a non busy restaurant,  and ignored for 15 minutes while at least 5 wait staff walked around.

We left and told the hostess we were not waited on.  No reaction.

People make mistakes.  It's how you react is the thing.

Went on a football night and the bar was packed. Bartenders were friendly and attentive but the service we received from our poor excuse of a waiter was horrible and disrespectful! She gave us attitude from the start when we showed her nothing but respect. Not to mention she was not attentive...at all. 
Our waiter never delivered our drinks(which melted at the bar) nor our quesadilla which came out 40 min later. Needless to say after we put our order in we never saw our waitress again.
The service was so horrible we cut our night short, asked to have our food and drinks removed from the bill and went elsewhere. If you must go here, just sit at the bar.
Went for the first time tonight for a family birthday. All 5 of us loved the place, food, service and very fair prices. Entrees we're BUG and we all needed boxes for leftovers. I'll be back   100%
Very disappointed this is not a Cuban bakery at all they don't even serve croquettes. I had the muffin and stuffed potato, it's over priced and lack flavor.

Incredible restaurant with excellent service and greeted by the manager and thanked by Chef Lynch. We had their red fish special of the day and it was amazing 10/10, double pork chop was juicy throughout, sauce was a savory chunky bean that was even better than the pork chop. Also had the NY strip with a slightly smoky crust that was perfect. The aeoli sauce was too fishy The heirloom tomato salad had a perfect compliment of a rich cream crab sauce, it was so fresh and tangy, this was the best dish!
This place got better from my last visit 4yrs ago during RCA.

Came in on a Sunday morning. They took my name said the wait is about 40 minutes. Long story short, they never called even though I gave the place my phone number.  You could tell just by way of a quick observation the place and the wait staff moves quite slowly.  You could say they are on their own time. Get the sense they would not move any more quickly if someone yelled fire. No, won't ever be back.  2 hours later they still haven't called.

The food was amazing along with the awesome belly dancers. The ambience of the restaurant was very appealing as well. The food was reasonably priced, however I didn't enjoy the baklava due to the fact that I have been to Istanbul and hands down the best baklava. Overall, would recommend this restaurant.

Restaurant August is the reigning culinary monarch in a city of gastronomical stars. John Besh has managed to craft an establishment that somehow seamlessly integrates an atmosphere of a warm cozy family dining room, with one of the very top kitchens in the world. The service is exquisite, the wait staff somehow managing to be inconspicuous yet always there when wanted. As stated earlier, the ambiance makes you feel very warm and comfortable, like a small family owned inn in the Pacific Northwest, coupled with a distinctly unobtrusive theme of elegance. The wine list, though not ridiculously large, is world class with every option imaginable at a very reasonable markup. Chef Evan, who was personally taking care of our table, crafted one delectable masterpiece after the other. Bravo, for August was one of the very best dining experiences of my life.
Another vegan place with flavorless food. People begging for salt shakers. Just Hang up a vegan sign and start cashing in.

So this place is hit or miss. We've only been here three times. The first time was a miss. The second time was a hit and the third time was a miss. I really don't like much of the food. The first time I got the tacos and I didn't like them. The second time I got a turkey club which was so awful that even the leftovers got tossed and the third time I got the chopped salad which I didn't like. I wouldn't order any of those things again. Ever. I did really love the nachos the second time we came so we came here specifically for those on this particular night. They weren't as good which was super disappointing. They weren't very hot. The toppings were minimal. My fiancé said they looked like flat hair. LOL! The worst part? They are chicken nachos so chicken is definitely the most expensive part of the dish but if you're a vegetarian and you don't want chicken you are still forced to pay for chicken. LUDICROUS! 

Our server (Noel) was awesome. We had him the last time we dined here and I saw him when I walked in so I requested him. He's great. All three of these stars are for him. He asked the manager about not charging me for the chicken that I wasn't receiving and apparently the manager couldn't problem solve how to take a couple of bucks off of a bill in an effort to not penalize someone for not eating chicken. Great customer service! 

The chopped salad wasn't good. It had a Bloody Mary vinaigrette...ok, you're doing too much. I asked for it on the side. I tasted it before pouring. It was alright. I poured it on. It tasted like tomato soup. It got grosser the more I ate it. The combination of ingredients was bizarre. Celery does not belong on there at all with roasted corn, avocado and cilantro....especially with tomato soup dressing. Decide what you want to do. I would never recommend it to anyone. Ever. 

My fiancé got the chicken schnitzel. It was the most unhealthy plate I've ever seen. An entire plate of friedness. Chicken? Fried. Potatoes? Fried. But wait...there's more...Brussels sprouts? FRIED! Aside from that, he said the chicken was bland and had absolutely no seasoning. He had another chicken dish here before that he didn't like because of lack of flavor. 

The cheese curds were good. It was our first cheese curd experience at a restaurant. They basically taste like mozzarella balls instead of mozzarella sticks. The sauces were a strange combo for me. 

My Dad and stepmom came here before and said they didn't enjoy their food, either so I think it will be a while before we return...if we return. The only thing I've liked so far is something where I have to pay for a main ingredient that I'm not even eating so that's certainly a deterrent.  

I am truly disappointed and underwhelmed with the KOP dining experience in general. We were so excited when all of these new restaurants were built and we have rarely, if ever, had anything more than a three star experience...at any of them.  I feel like the Cheesecake Factory is the only KOP restaurant where we have consistently enjoyed our food. I hope they all, including Yard House, step their game up and offer something more than mediocrity. It seems like they all have the expectation to survive on volume alone. 

Plenty of parking. Good for groups. Plenty of space available to sit on a slow Monday night at dinner time. Not a huge happy hour crowd on this particular night. Seemed clean. High top seating available. Indoor and outdoor tables. Lots of tvs. They used to be on open table but for some reason decided against it which is a bummer. 

Meh.

Went to Sampan over the weekend, we were a party of three. Made a reservation and they had a ton of outdoor seating and were abiding by all COVID restrictions, which was great. Dana was our server and she was attentive and happy to make suggestions, all of which were awesome. 

We were there for happy hour and I'd highly recommend going for happy hour in order to try some of everything. We had spicy tuna roll (4/5- tasted very fresh), the pork bao (4.5/5- definitely recommend!), kimchi fried rice (4/5, the rice was good but it also had shrimp, and I thought the shrimp was fairly flavorless), short rib stay (5/5, our server recommended it and it did not disappoint!!), the chicken wings (4.5/5- definitely recommend!), and the pork potstickers (4/5, very good but I personally didn't think they exceeded expectations for a pork potsticker). 

Overall, would highly recommend a stop here!!
Food great, customer service a nightmare. They lost our reservation then sat everyone else before us. Asked for a manager and they would not tell us who she was.

Love Glory Days and wanted to check the new one out. 
Nice layout. Wide open and great TV viewing. The big screens are pretty cool. 

Great food! Dry Rub wings are my favorite. Best wings anywhere. 
Service was great. There is still newness but very nice abs efficient.

Came here for lunch and it was delicious! Had the cheese plate (a bit pricey but really yummy especially the kunik). Followed by possibly the best apple oat muffin I've ever had (hubs even liked the raisins in them - a first!) The omelet was perfectly cooked with a nice herby salad on the side. My branzino had a lovely flaky skin and scrumptious vegetables covered in the juices of the fish. Friend had the duck egg with rave reviews.
A cute place with friendly service, will definitely come again

This place isn't bad and considering the location and the fact that Delaware isn't really the eating scene, sorry DE. I came or stubble here because I wanted to get tax free on the goods I was going to buy. I must say DE area is one of the location that it is best and safe to stick to franchise restaurants. The local stuff is brutal and unless you're a local you probably do not have time to Google and Yelp a good place to eat.

Anyway, J & C offer good price and choices. Food isn't so bad. I recommend it if you're around and looking to fill up but nothing fancy.

Excellent food and decent service.  I grew up on 24-hour diners in New Jersey, with the jukebox at the table, and this place is very similar (although the jukebox is near the restrooms and I am not sure it is a working jukebox).  The atmosphere was upbeat, and the food came quickly, even on a crowded holiday weekend, but the best part was the ability to get breakfast at night - always my favorite kind of dinner!  Get the challah bread French toast.  You will not be disappointed!!!!

Really a gem. Some people complain that the pork sandwich is too juicy and I think they are crazy. Juicier the better!! And the paesano sandwich had eggs in it. There should be more sandwiches with eggs in this world.
Went twice during my visit to Tampa. Fun atmosphere and enjoyed Karin nights. (Thursday) never too packed, there was a cover at the door though...

Great service. Fast and friendly! My boyfriend and I both had burgers which were great. Our sever suggested the Cajun burger with jalapeño bacon. It wasn't as spicy as I would have liked but it was still excellent. Will definitely be visiting this place again!

Wonderful food.

You can't get more exciting and ambitious cooking in Philadelphia for anything close to this price point.  This is really one of the best restaurants in Philly.

Oysters, scallop "pasta," Salmon carpaccio, duck, bean-stuffed rice balls were all delicious.  The cocktails were also inventive and delicious.

People have complained about the portion sizes - I think for the quality of the cooking the place is a value.  My date and I shared two firsts, two seconds, a main, and 4 drinks.  It was about $160 with tax and tip.

That said, if you want heaping portions of comfort food, (which for some reason some reviewers expected here) go somewhere else.
If you're in the search for a thoughtful meal and perfect ambience look no further! We were taken care of by the lovely Emily-she came correct with excellent recommendations for drinks and food!

Topgolf is a super fun activity for a variety of age groups! I have been here twice now and had great service and fun both times. The first time we came on a Saturday afternoon and had reservations- there is a charge to reserve based on the time/ date but we were definitely lucky to have those since the walk-in wait time was 3 hours. You purchase a one time card membership and can use that card at any Topgolf location. 

My second visit we came back on a Sunday afternoon and waited maybe 5-10 minutes only because we wanted a higher level bay. We came here to celebrate our engagement and the staff were very nice and excited for us and even announced it to the entire floor which was a surprise but made it fun. 

There are a variety of "games" to choose from once you're in the bays. There is also staff that come around to help you set up for the games before your time starts and they come around to take your food and drinks order. 

The parking lot is huge but don't worry if you get a far spot because they have someone on a golf-cart to pick you up / drop you back at your car. (This was a hit for the 6 year old with us- he loved this perk!)

I think Topgolf is a great addition to the Fisher's area.

The set up is a little strange as there is a large open area in the middle with no furniture or seats. The drink machines are off to the side. 

There is a wide variety of drinks that are sweet. I ordered the Peach Bellini. They have a decent amount of alcohol in there but by the time that you're half way through the container, it starts to smell like vomit.
SO great that I don't know where to begin.  Drinks are strong, food is delicious, service excellent.  The space is gorgeous, and during the summer they have a great patio and deck.  All over it!

Went through drive through and it was a little slow but staff were friendly enough. Got my Earl Grey double cream no sugar always fantastic only complaint wheres my second tea bag? This is a good location if you're heading into or out of Sherwood Park.

The master gelato artist in residence is not to be underemphasized.

You should make sure to include gelato as part of your meal, as I did -- twice!

For dinner I had one of their seasonal specials, a wide noodle that included a savory gelato on top.  

For dessert I had a scoop of pistachio and a scoop of their stracciatella gelato.  So worth it.

Also I think every staff member in the restaurant stopped by to ask if we were enjoying our dinner.

+Convenient location
+Rates are reasonable
+HUGE hotel
+Starbucks in the lobby
+Staff is friendly
+Gym facilities is pretty spacious, cardio equipment is updated & well maintained

-Old rooms and could use a make-over
-Ridiculous fee to use wireless

Thank you, thank you, Thank you!!! 
I just hosted my grand daughters college graduation dinner here. A table of 4 and all the guests were just blown away. No sense going into greater detail the food, service and ambiance converged to make one of those unforgetable meals.

The bad news is my family expects to dine like this all the time.

The deep dish pizza was overall just okay.  I was expecting something to really stand out to me when I tried it but was disappointed. However, I've eaten some Chicago deep dish before so that might be why.
Great food with great service.  Right inside the Harrah hotel.  Food is a huge amount so bring your appetite.

This is a great spot in a sketchy part of town. One of the best take-out salads I have ever had. Blackened chicken is outstanding. Great size potion and what a great price. Highly recommend this place, inside has all the sports game and great vibe.
If you're around give it a try. I had the shrimp&grits. It was fantastic. Good service, music, and most importantly food

Great establishment, came here while staying at the Sheraton visiting Sesame Place. They were very accommodating and the pizza was delicious, we bought pepperoni pizza by the slice and I told the employee that my son loves just pepperoni so she made him a plate full for free, that just shows that they go above and beyond for their customers. Will definitely stop by again when I'm back in the area.

Condado is a tough one to review for me. First I think the Mass Ave location is much better overall for experience than the Broad Ripple location. The tacos, queso and guacamole are great. Good drinks too, but service is up and down. Sometimes really fast like you would expect for tacos and sometimes you wait an incredible period just to pay. It seems like maybe there are some staffing issues. With so many places to get tacos, I hope they figure this out.

We recently decided to try The Green Lemon for Sunday brunch, as it had been awhile since we dined here. We made an Open Table reservation for 8 people at 10:30. We arrived on time for our reservation, and were meeting up with some friends, including a couple we hadn't met yet. The hostess said she didn't have a  reservation for that time and name, even after showing her my confirmation. The restaurant wasn't that full, so she sat us at an empty table to wait for the rest of our party. Well, it turns out that the couple we hadn't met yet had shown up a few minutes before us and checked in under my reservation. I have no clue how the hostess wasn't able to figure out that the party she had just seated was mine. Same name, same number if people, same time, and opentable. Smh.

Don't expect your typical breakfast items at brunch. They all have a Mexican flare of some sort, which we found delicious. The grits have shredded cheese and a little but if jalapenos on top. Yum. I got the French toast which was pretty tasty, as well. Everyone was happy with their food, but our waitress really failed with bringing out one of our friends' beer. They were out of the first 3 beers he wanted so he picked another. It never came, even after he reminded her. She actually remembered after we had finished eating and someone made a comment about him never getting his beer. I would think in this situation you'd just comp the beer, but no, he had to pay and didn't have much time to enjoy it since the rest of us were done. And it was Fathers Day so they were already giving free beers to dads so it wouldn't have been a big deal. 

All in all...good food, mediocre service, great atmosphere.

Casual breakfast/lunch eatery with cheap, delicious biscuits as the focus of the menu. You order at the counter and then can be seated anywhere as they bring the food out to your table based on ththe  number. I went at breakfast and had the $4 biscuits and gravy which I thought may not be enough food based on the price, but it was plenty of food and then some. I also snacked on the side of tots which are crispy, delicious and come with a spicy dipping sauce. The rest of our crew ordered Biscuit egg sandwiches which everyone raves about as well- if I'd had another day I would have gone back for one!
Service was fast pizza was really good a little pricey but you get the amount you pay for around 25$ for a pizza that's around 20" really filling.

Love this place! We always sit at the bar and the service is always great. The menu has good variety and is delicious, they don't cheat you on the drinks, and the people watching is always the best entertainment!
Pre-order your food might have to wait awhile. Come in for lunch instead of dinner to avoid sold out items.
Need to reserve a table 2 hours beforehand. Overall good. Like the 五花肉 and chicken wings. Marinated beef is a little hard to cook.

Yummy no frills seafood! Casual atmosphere- I recommend sitting upstairs with the ocean view- even at night the area hotels look nice all lit up.  Staff is nice and attentive.  Food prices are reasonable- esp for the generous portions!  We had the onion rings (so good!) broiled seafood platter (surprising large scallops, grilled shrimp were excellent, fish & crabcake average).  Florida Peach drink was delicious! Very happy we went there.  Mixed drinks are small and overpriced (but that's the norm in st. pete beach).
The pizza is awesome, but their pasta is nothing impressive and their chicken is definitely frozen and poor quality.

We stopped by for a lovely lunch yesterday.  The cream of asparagus soup was both delicate and tasty.  The complimentary rolls and baguettes were perfect.  I had their plate of cheeses and cold cuts, all of which were first class.  Their creme brulee was thicker than usual, within a crust, and the tastiest I have ever had.

First visit was great. Chili and patty melt were good and we did not get the combo. The bathroom was clean. Only thing was the floor felt sticky around the restaurant. Fairly friendly staff too but a little shy.

Place is very good, good food, very affordable for families 
Very friendly customer service

We stopped in St. Louis overnight coming down from Chicago, and stopped in this place based on the yelp reviews. Excellent food, excellent drinks, and excellent service.... definitely recommend. The decor was super cool and both adults and the kids liked their meals.  My wife's chocolate martini was outstanding.

Yesterday while walking down the monon trail we started getting hungry and well we decided sushi.

Ordered a little bit of sushi haha Spicy Maki Combo basically Tuna, Salmon and Yellowtail spicy.

In addition you can pick a salad or miso soup and I paid like 21 dlls for everything.

Liked the sushi but still can't compete with sushi bar or 45 degrees.

I'll give it another try soon!

This was my go to takeout place while living in riverview.   They have a variety of Asian options from Thai, Japanese, or Chinese.  My go to favorites were the pad Thai noodles or the seafood fried rice.  The portions are pretty big and will fill you up.    The price is probably a little higher than most takeout places but it is definetly worth it.
Pretty simple, it's a decent Wawa with a good staff. I enjoy coming here and have never had a problem.

Very mixed feelings on this place. Please also keep in mind my review is based strictly on sushi and not on the hibachi. 

After being dead tired of Delta delaying my flights (in Atlanta), I decided to opt on getting Goten as opposed to going out to Franklin to visit one of my favorite sushi places anywhere, Sake. 

The prices seemed to be moderately reasonable for the sushi. $5 was the typical price for the average rolls and the Nigiri pieces were around $5 for two pieces. I ordered the White Tuna & Yellowfin Nigiri along with an Alaskan Roll and a Shrimp Crunchy Roll. 

I will say the Nigiri pieces were astonishingly flavorful. This is also extremely applicable to the yellowtail. Impressively fresh and tasty. I was very satisfied with those two choices. 

However the quality took a bit of a sharp nosedive when it came to the rolls. The Alaskan roll was about a 6 out of 10 on the flavor-o-meter. The sushi was standard in flavor but not anything eye opening. 

I was however extremely disappointed with the Crunchy Shrimp Roll. The roll was very very flavorless. And the tempura within the roll was not crunchy at all. My guess is probably the shrimp was fried way ahead of time. Otherwise I don't know how to explain soggy tempura. (But as I said, just a guess). I felt that I totally wasted my money on that roll. 

On a final note, I was not very impressed at all with the staff. Even though it was a pickup order, they did not show the slightest of courtesy when I picked up my food. Their stares were cold and in a sad way, mean. I was thanked though as I left, so at least at the end they attempted to act like humans if even for a split second. 

I don't know that I will try this place again, but if I do catch a crave for fresh nigiri, I may pop on over again.

More like a 3.5.

Food was good, but not life-changing. I had the voodoo gumbo, which had yummy chicken sausage and gator sausage in it, but where were the veggies? It was more like a spicy (and not even that spicy) sausage soup. I'm more of a chunky soup kind of girl, so I would have liked more than just sausage and bread. More rice maybe?

Didn't stop me from eating almost all of it though.

My friends all got breakfasty foods, and they seemed to enjoy their meals.

More points because our server was great. And large mimosas came in ginormous glasses. And they texted us when our table was ready, so we were free to wander around while we waited, instead of standing in a line outside the restaurant. I appreciate that they have their ish together to get people in and out quickly... but not too quickly.

Food was A-OK, service was great. Stanley averages to a 3.5.

We always order the BBQ platters and love every mintute of it

A great place and now with great parking and no wait

Music was great, lady at the door didn't seem interested in seating anyone, in spite of lots of empty tables.

Left after 15 minutes, without being able to order a drink.

Based on previous reviews I called in a takeout order expecting a long wait time. I arrived in about 30 minutes and the food was waiting up front. It was fairly empty & this was around 2:30pm on a Friday so maybe the busy hours are during dinner. The portion size is fairly large, all platters come with the choice of 2 sides and a side of cornbread. I ordered the fried whiting with a side of mac and cheese and candied yams. the fish was fresh, mac and cheese was cheesy and the candied yams weren't overly sweet,the cornbread however was a tad burnt and tasted stale. They also have a pastry case by the register and offer homemade lemonade  you can get original or strawberry. Cashier was friendly & I was able to see in the kitchen while at the register and all the cooks did have on gloves and hairnets so that's a plus; It's definitely worth a go.

One of the best brunch places I have been here in the city. My other half and I go here from time-to-time after our long runs on the levee. Their runners sandwich is amazing and he loves their Belgian waffle. Do not forget to get their pecan coffee! To die for :).

IF you want a good japanese steak house experience in Tampa go to Kobes' . This restaurant does not give good service at all and the food was sub par. The rice tasted as if they had not cleaned the grill. I regularly eat at these kinds of restaurants and I would not return. Not to mention the manager JD was rude and they do not accomodate their guests in the least. Also, overpriced drinks and food; better prices and quality anywhere else...

So much flavor in their dishes! Highly recommend this for authentic Indian cuisine. I love their butter chicken and chicken masala. With every bite you get a cascade of different flavors. When I have an Indian craving, Amma's is were I go!

NO GO! Tonight while getting drinks with some friends, we had multiple waitresses and the bartender whispering about us and making rude comments. They continued to stare, the bartender even suggested we "just leave". Very unprofessional, trashy and rude. When we left, she made a comment to my friend saying "we have no food for you here." We felt extremely uncomfortable and the fact that the waitresses are that unprofessional to make comments to paying customers is disgusting. I will not be returning, so the waitresses to not have to worry about that. The drinks were watery, the food is not that great and the service is terrible. I've never in my life seen a waitresses cuss and insult customers, especially while on the clock and there are other customers around. If I could give a zero I would. Being a local I will never suggest this place to someone else. Also the manager, Chris I believe, encouraged this behavior and seemed to not understand the meaning of customer service.

Had a business dinner with 8 of us the week after Thanksgiving.  First hour at the bar with a friendly tender and good solid martinis.  We booked the small semi-private table in the back right section and had a great roundtable review of the year with a ton of laughs without feeling like we were bothering other diners.

Filet was very good and right at med rare temp.  Solid taste and mouth feel.

I plan to take the wife here sometime in the future.  Leave the kids at home and take a cab to/from so she can imbibe the martinis, too.

Such a cute little bar! If I lived nearby I think this is the place my friends and I would designate as the official "meet up a couple times a week after work to catch up" spot. 

The atmosphere is relaxed and chill. It's lithe comfort and friendliness of a dive bar without the gross bathrooms and better decor. 

They have great deals on drinks too and a fairly decent menus of foods to choose from. If your local I would highly suggest this place (thought you probably already know all about it).
Not the best choice of flavors or toppings and when I went there to check in and use my 10% off they said they didn't know how to process it.

Meh. 

Overpriced, trying to be something it's not. 

I have never been in such a pretentious brewery - and this is St. Charles, Missouri, not the Bay Area or New York City. 

It was a hot day on a weekend and my boyfriend was wearing a sleeveless shirt. After we ordered and paid for our beer, the bartender brought him a bright orange t-shirt and told him he had to wear it because they have a clothing rule. He had to wear their bright orange t-shirt or leave - AFTER we had already ordered and paid, and tipped. Convenient. 

I counted three women at the bar wearing tank tops that revealed FAR more than what his muscle arms revealed. Double standard much?

By the way, none of your beer was very good. Not worth it.

You won't be getting my money, again.
This certainly is my favorite Sichuan place in Chinatown.
One of my fave places to eat in Tucson. I've been here a countless number of times, and each time I'm left satisfied. The ambiance, service, drinks and food are all on point.

I'm not one to visit hotel restaurants for dinner. However, upon my visit to the rooftop Rox I found myself rather hungry. Instead of venturing down Courtney Campbell I decided to give Julian Restaurant a try. Upon reviewing the menu, the Crispy Blossoms caught my eye. When I told the waitress this was my first time at the restaurant, she informed me that the Crispy Blossoms was actually one of her recommendations. Boy, was she spot on with her suggestion! I was I not disappointed! The crispy zucchini blossoms were stuffed with goat cheese, drizzled with honey and aged balsamic. Yum! I ordered the Cavatelli Pasta as my entree. It came out quickly from the kitchen and piping hot (food temps are very important to me)! The pasta was good and not overly sauced. And the portion was moderate (even for sharing). Honestly I was a bit worried about going to dinner at a hotel because I haven't always had the best experiences there, but Julian Restaurant is definitely a force to be reckoned with. Kudos to the chef! I look forward to visiting again soon to try their other dishes!
Waiters are ass food is ass everything is ass stay away till the day you die you won't regret it

Holy cripes- I have waited a while to review this place for fear that it will become more crowded than it already is....

But to put it simply- I'm addicted to this place. I love it. I need it. I gotta have it 2x a week. My favorite is the coconut curry ramen dish and you gotta order the dumplings.

I'm jumping out of my skin waiting for their new place "Bing Bing Dim Sum" to open as it's going to be down the street from me.

This place deserves no less Than 5 stars for the food.  So. Dang. Good.

We eat pretty regularly here!  I have always gotten everything i have ordered correctly.  I love the wings especially big and crispy.  Salads are great big and fresh.  Personal pizzas made to order.  Yummy!

I love the sushi and the shrimp fried rice oh man that shrimp is cooked to perfection.  I've never heard of this place it is a lot like kumo unless it is kumo in a different location. I wouldn't know the difference they were really good I'm glad I tried them out

I loved Taco Bus in Tampa and assumed it would be the same in St Pete. Went with my dad around 1-2pm weekday, place was dead, maybe because it was 900 degrees outside. 

Order 2 tacos each. one Chicken Verde, and one Carne Asada. Same order for both of us. I ended up with Chicken Verde and a Chipolte Chicken. My father ended up with Chipolte Chicken, and Carne Asada hahaha cant make this stuff up. 

They seemed more concerned with a staff meeting, then paying attention to order accuracy. If they were slammed I'd give them the benefit of the doubt however we were 2, of 5 total customers. 

Tacos themselves were okay, idk I remember the one in tampa being better.

Went on a Thursday night, 2 other parties there. One was leaving so that left two of us. You would think being so slow that service would be great, but it was not.  The waiter seemed apathetic, definitely didn't work for a tip. Saw two other employees floating around, none of them were making food preparation a priority.  All three of them at some point sat down to fold napkins, just a few at a time, before drifting back in to the kitchen.  Many times the waiter walked by us but wouldn't make eye contact, so if we needed something we had to call out to him.

We ordered 2 appetizers, a side salad (big enough for two people), and a falafel sandwich each.  Food was good and we left full, but I wish they had other vegetarian option for entrees than just a falafel sandwich.  Will I return?  Maybe for takeout but not to dine-in.  If the service was this poor on a slow Thursday, I can only imagine what it's like when it's busy.

I hope the management reads these comments because the majority of patrons seemed turned off by the lack of service, and this is going to have an effect on their success.

Oh, and they don't have a liquor license, which is a negative.  I asked if they had a drink menu and was told, "We have soda, tea and Arabic coffee."  Not what I meant, buddy.

I went to The Cheesecake Factory with my hubby and got the usual!! Fettuccine Alfredo. Delicious! My hubby got chicken costoletta!! And we had the sweetest most helpful waitress Keira! She we never had an empty glass! AMAZING service. The food is always great but Keira really made our date night enjoyable with her great service.
This is such an amazing place. Some of the best Burrito/Mexican food I've ever had. Our waitress was a short blond woman. Amy maybe? I don't remember the name. She was amazing! We will be back.
Horrible!!!!!  Their shredded chicken burritoes tasted like canned tuna.  My friend and i , both,  thought it smelled like cat food as we unwrapped it from the foil.  NO BUENO!!!!!!!

Mike the owner is an impressive entrepreneur!   Welcomed us when we entered, helped picky eaters choose a dish and offered great table side service. The ribs, brisket and fries are delicious!  See you soon Mike

This is a nice hole in the wall bar that has nighly live music and drink specials.  It has three sections that bar area with bar and dining room seating, another dining area and an enclosed patio area with dining that they host their nightly live music. The bar has their regulars and they know a lot of their patron by name. Most of the staff id friendly, while a few are somewhat stand offish unless they knew you. 

The bar has a a light menu with wings, tenderloins, fries, burgers and other pub type food. They stop serving at 10 PM sharp, so get your order in early. They have a small parking lot with some overflow parking available across the street.

You will find a juke box, and some type of gambling machine in the bar area. The bar area also has a few televisions around with sports playing.

It looks like the area that have live music is an expansion. It is enclosed and very well heated. It is a nice cozy place to eat, drink and listen to some good music.

The drinks are small, but pretty stiff and very cost efficient. 

This is a very nice place, and one of the few Southern Indianapolis bars. You can get some reasonably priced food and drink while listening to some local live bands. I will definitely be back soon.
First time for Greek food.   Won't be my last. Great place. Had gyro and it was delicious.

Upon arriving to St. Louis, I knew had to check out their BBQ and I had only one meal to devote to it. I also knew I had to try Pork Steak while I was here too. After careful research we decided Five Aces was the place to go!
First the neighborhood was quaint and beautiful. The staff, who you could clearly tell were family also treated us like family. 
The ribs were meaty and fell off the bone but also had the perfect amount of bite and chew. 
So let me just say, I love Pork Steak, because of this place. Its just such a great bite of meat! 
The Slaw was cold and refreshing. The fries were golden fresh and crispy. 
If I had to split a hair, the sauce and slaw were all a bit on the sweet side. But still oh so damn addictive and delicious. Definitely recommend.

I was here for lunch a couple days ago and really enjoyed it. I had the Philly cheesesteak with a slice of the chocolate French silk pie and they were both delicious. The only thing for me was that the lighting seemed a little dim, but maybe it was just me. Will definitely come again.

This is a good spot to come in and watch the game and actually have a good food menu. 
I think we just ordered some odd things on the menu and I wasn't overly pleased with them. 

The service is good and the outdoor area is amazing!

Their champagne vinaigrette is to die for.

This place was so awesome! I could tell it would be good because of how busy it was. I went fishing with Double Eagle and they suggested I take the fish I caught to The Bait House. Great suggestion. They gave me the options of sautéed or grilled; there was another option but I can't remember. I got mine sautéed with a Caesar salad and chips as my side. I also got the peel and eat shrimp cold which were DELICIOUS. This was a very chill spot that I would definitely recommend!

Arrived an hour before close. Nothing available except chicken. They were out of everything. So got a quesadilla to go, since it seemed my presence bothered them. Name called , grabbed the food. Didn't feel like my food was in the container, it was so light. Checked. It was there. I guess. Where the cheese? All that this thing had was some lettuce looking stuff. Flavor wasn't bad. But for 7 bucks, I coulda eaten 5 of these things. I'm not a chub a tub either, but not at all filling. I had to go to Taco Bell afterwards and get a meal. Very disappointed. I'll stick with the Korean competitor across the street.

Had a love/hate experience here. Food was great. I had the salmon. That's the love part. The flip side is that when my second drink came (just ordered same as the first) it clearly wasn't the same vodka and tasted totally different (vodka and soda water...pretty easy to distinguish what's in that drink). I told the waiter that I thought a different vodka was used that didn't taste good to me and he told me no it wasn't (even though he didn't make the drink). Five minutes later the bartender walks over, SLAMS a glass down on the table (there were six of us at the table), pours my requested vodka from the bottle (so I can witness it) in the glass without speaking a word and walks away. We were all shocked. So incredibly rude. Is that truly their definition of service? He didn't even bring the soda water so we had to request that to blend our own drink. It was ridiculous. Even if I was wrong there were so many ways to handle this. But ironically, the drink that he poured in front of me tasted just like my first and nothing like the one I sent back. I don't care how good a restaurant's food is...if you don't have service, you lose customers. And that's how the story ends for me.
Meh.  Cold food. Long drive thru time in a mid week, hot, daytime hour. No bueno. Yawn.

This isn't a knock your socks off type five star place, but it's really solid. I'm a fan of their bean and cheese burrito, it comes with a lot of good fixins. I think their mexican rice might have some sort of queso in it, because it tastes better than normal mexican rice.

Also if you come here, you HAVE to get the halloween sauce. I don't know why it's called that, but it is amazing. if they didn't have it, I probably would give this place four stars. So don't leave without it (but for you non-spice eaters, it's a little spicy)
Delicious King Cakes (both the chocolate and the traditional)!

I was there yesterday morning while trying to get some eggs the lady on the station asked what I wanted so I told her and she said move to the side wile I make it and she was about to break the eggs  to do my order when a gentle men said he wanted and omelet an the lady stop what she was doing and said go behind the line so I can make there's first when I was there  first waiting for my order I find that super disrespectful and I considered that discrimination she ruined my breakfast I think the managers really need to keep an eye on the people they hire if I could talk to a manager that would be great!

So I've been coming here with the fervor of a religious zealot for 2.5 years now and am sorry to say I suspect there has been a change in ownership. The food is similar but in particular the general tso's recipe is a bit tweaked. Prices are still the same as well. What was more alarming was the change in staff. The last time we came after ordering, eating, and getting the bill we were told by the new waitstaff that they do not accept credit cards. I asked if this was a recent change because in the past credit cards have been accepted. They then stated they did have a machine but it was broken. We were short about $5 plus the tip in cash and I said I could run to an ATM and come back at which point they offered to 'try to get the machine to work'. Well shockingly the machine worked. The whole demeanor of the new staff is kind of sketchy. I personally felt like they were lying about not accepting credit cards and then it not working because they wanted us to pay in cash. The whole lying thing is no chill. Just be aware ownership may have changed -- it's now young man and woman working there.

A great brunch place, especially when friends or family are in town. Previously I've tried the Lily, a great sweet treat with blueberry compote thats to die for an a cream that adds some moisture to the biscuit style pancakes. 
This past trip however I decided to change it up an got the Gertie, two buscuits topped with chocolate sauce, carmalized bananas, and peanut butter. The food was fantastic but the sauce combination was so thick it took forever to eat each bite. If youre considering the Gertie I strongly recommend splitting with a friend and getting one of the other egg or meat dishes to offset the sweetness.
I just found out you can't use the Yelp coupons now if you want your membership points. Not sure I'm a fan of that policy when most other coffee shops allow both.

from Colo Springs and came here w/ my daughter. I got the 'meat pizza' and she got mac & cheese. Food was delicious--warm and fresh. Cool, relaxed atmosphere and not overly boisterous like the other honkey tonks  on music row.

Michael at the bar took great care of us and treated us like locals. Sit at the bar and ask for him.
Walked in they took care of three people that came in after me.  Walked out.  Lousy customer service

Let me start by saying, not to be confused with the quality of food. Service was amazing. For as expensive as this place is, the food lacked in every way. Decided to take some clients to dinner here and was very disappointed. Had to send food back 2 times.  Potatoes came out almost burnt. Just not an all around good experience like we expected. May try again in the future but it will be a long time from now.

The food is here definitely worth 5 stars, but the service was worth 2-3 stars. 

A group of us came here and split 3 pizzas - spinach artichoke, pepperoni sausage, and tomato basil. The tomato basil and spinach artichoke were incredible. Great combinations of toppings with a good crust. We also had their mixed greens salad, which I loved! This is one of the best salads I've had in New Orleans. The candied almonds really add a nice touch. 

As for the service, everyone was very friendly but we didn't get menus for 15 minutes after we sat down (though we were served beverages). After waiting for the server to come back, one of my friends just got up and got the menus herself from the stand. Approximately a minute after she did this, the server came back and asked if we were ready to order. Wtf???? We would be if you had gotten us menus a little faster... After this, things went more smoothly although service seemed a little slow for there not being that many people there (maybe 6 table total when we arrived). However, they had no problem splitting the checks and perhaps they became more aware of the problem later in the night because they sent multiple servers to check in on us towards the end. 

Despite the slow start, I would surely come back for the food. The location is really cute too - end of Maple Street. There's Christmas lights strung through the trees which makes outdoor dining a very pleasant experience.

Thank you to my Yelp friends for keying me onto this new (ish) entry into Boise's special-night-out dinner venue options. 
We were there on a Tuesday night - were able to get a reservation without a hassle. 
The decor is a hit or miss based on one's preference but who is thinking of decor when the food in front of you is king? Not me. 
At the newer restaurants these days, I am  often intrigued more by the apps than the mains and the situation was the same at Camel's crossing. I wanted to try all of them but rationality prevailed and we ordered three for the two of us (well, bounded rationality): the sumac cauliflower with nettles (yes, nettles - what?!), duck liver pate with a balsamic jam (heaven!) and the seeded bread with the goat butter. Who knew I could eat goat butter with a spoon? 
When I was younger, my mother would refer to me as the carnivore but I can tell you I would happily make a meal out of a giant bowl of that cauliflower. 
Next it was time for the mains -- we were both drawn to the same one so it was porcini wagyu (celeriac, fingerlings, black garlic) all around. Black garlic - again, at the risk of repeating myself - what?!  Lip-smackingly delicious.
When our server  Christian (very attentive, very professional - much appreciated) came back, there was not even a drop left on my plate! We laughed out loud. I had to tell him that was a rare thing. And that it was a compliment to the chef. 
We have not tried their prix-fixe menu yet, but are looking forward to going back and trying it soon. 
They are planning big changes with this establishment - there's a move to a larger space in the Adelmann bldg planned in the near future -- a spin-off of this restaurant so that this location, which originally began its life as a wine bar, can revert back to its former role. Exciting. 
One last thing - there is a diner rewards program that is a great deal. Do look into it.

I had a quite filling and yummy tofu wrap (which was more like a burrito in it's density) for 5 bucks here yesterday.  The filling was tofu, edamame, chickpeas, rice, and some sauce and veggies.  I would go here again.

Have been here many times and recommended it to many friends.  Has reservations for lunch today with my family to celebrate a graduation.  Got there early but the doors were open so we went in.  Rudely greeted at the front door but that was not the problem.  THEY WERE PAINTING THE WINDOW FRAMES.  THE SMELL WAS HORRIBLE - ACTUALLY CHOCKING.  Made a comment and the hostess said Oh we are painting all the windows -  My reservations were made thru Open Table days ago.  This was not a great situation and an impossible situation.  WE went across the street to the bar on the corner.  It even smelled a little in there.  Did i mention that our party contained two young boys who were looking forward to "pancakes"  

Called the Health department - hoped they shut them down

This review will be short, as many others have already written my feelings.

Service: Mediocre.

Food: Excellent, yet somewhat pricey. I think many reviewers focus on the size of the plates, rather than on their taste. Moreover, I've left full each time i come here. It's not like Applebees where you get a giant serving of rubbish. But if you take your time and relish the food, you'll find yourself quickly full, and for not much more money than many other restaurants. 

Overall Verdict: Four stars. I especially like this place when another person is paying.

First off the food is great service is not they make you wait forever also the other day they had no chips for table side guacamole asked for beef got steak never got a refill on waters wasnt busy and service was slow wish they could fix the staff as we just love the location and food

This place has changed hands so many times over the years but I think they finally got it right ...oh wait..no they didn't...the service was less than par.

I can't understand what the deal is with crabby waiters and waitresses.  Don't you know that it takes honey to draw flies?  Seriously.  Of the past 4 restaurants this week, I have had only 1 good service experience and that was at a coffee shop.  It really isn't hard, guys and gals.  If I owned my own restaurant, the first thing I would do is to send everyone through client service training and teach them the simple meaning of patience...but I digress.

It was a beautiful day and a friend and I decided to dine for lunch al fresco. So we tried the New Tavern Restaurant in Bala Cynwyd.  As we passed the restaurant, we noticed a quaint patio out front where patrons were dining so we decided to join in on the fun.

We waited outside for a few minutes to see if someone would notice us from the inside but I ended up going in to see if someone could seat us.  We were met with a chap who turned out to also be our waiter.  He seemed disturbed that we were there to eat lunch.  At first I thought that maybe they were trying to finish up on the lunch crowd but when I looked at my watch it was only 1:00pm.  Hmmm....not really sure what his problem was.

He took our drink order (without smiling mind you) and was back within a minute to deliver them.  Okay...not a lot of time to decide on the lunch choice but he asked us anyway.  I immediately felt rushed and my mood turned sour.  After our lunch was served to us, I did not see him again for 15 minutes at which time he delivered our check.  Hey!  Wait a minute!!!  No dessert?  You don't even ask us if we want anything else?!!!  Another one of my pet peeves.

The food was okay for a BLT and a turkey club.  Chances are I won't be going back to try the dinner menu.
The fish tacos blessed my whole life! They have an awesome menu with a ton of great selections. I've gone a few times and they never disappoint. Can be a little noisy since it is located in the mall.

This is probably my favorite American food buffet, although there isn't really to many in town. Last night the food was very hot and everything looked fresh. All of the employees were working hard and not standing around. I can't remember our waiters name but I added a picture of him; He was so polite and we didn't have more than one dirty plate on our table before he got rid of it. I was very pleased because I don't remember the food being as good as it was last night. I do feel like the price is slightly high and the ice cream was watery but over all a pretty good experience.
Foods are really good, the waitresses can be busy and would not care much about the customers. This is the only downside of this place! But you will definitely enjoy the food

Ate here with some friends before a Keswick show. Parking was a bit of a struggle because of the show, since we were going to the 2nd show of the evening, but we lucked out and found a spot behind a flower shop up the street after driving around town for 10-15 minutes looking.

We had reservations so we were seated right away. Our server gave us menus and returned a few minutes later with wine glasses and a corkscrew to open our BYO bottles of wine. When we arrived the place was fairly quiet and empty, but as our meal progressed the restaurant filled up and got increasingly LOUD to the point where we shouting at each other to be heard. 

Our server was friendly and seemed very knowledgeable of the menu and Greek food in general. We placed our order and a little while later our starters showed up. We ordered 3 of them to be split between the 4 of us. The grilled octopus was not what I expected, as I have never had it before. It was dense and meaty, almost like chicken but with a unique flavor that hinted it was from the sea. I would not order it again. The meat patties, keftethes, were dry and lacking in flavor. Would not order again. The Greek sausages (Loukanika?) however were something to savor. Another first for me, I liked the spices and orange flavor that was enjoyable but not overpowering. 

Our salads were good and large, I don't think anyone finished theirs they were so big. On with the entrees. I had the moussaka which was amazing and I would order again and again. Layers of flavors melting in my mouth. Yes it was that good. Now on to the bad. My friends wife ordered a braised lamb shank which she could not eat. Maybe someone who knows Greek food can explain it but to us it was simply a hunk of lamb meat on a bone covered in tomato sauce. We all took a bite and agreed it was not worthy of being listed on the menu. My friend had the striped bass and said it was good, but not nearly as good as he had elsewhere. My fiancee had the Salmon and thought it was good as well but she usually isn't very criitcal of a meal I am paying for.

For dessert we split orders of galaktoboreko and baklava. Again maybe I just don't understand Greek cuisine, but neither were any good. It seemed like they were from a day old bake sale. We each had a bite or so and gave up, it was that bad. 

Hit or miss appetizers, entrees and a bad dessert. I would give this place 2 stars if I could, but the moussaka was just so good, and the service was good up to the point when they were rushing us out the door.

I would come here again before a Keswick show, but I know what I would and would not order next time.

Alumni is conveniently located in the Park Pacific apartment building. I've been to Alumni about 10 times now and usually have a great experience. All but one bar tender makes my experience to Alumni inviting and joyful. Jennifer is by fat the BEST waitress. She can tell you everything about the menu items and makes great suggestions. 
My favorite dish is the BLT triple grilled cheese....AMAZING. It melts in your mouth. They have a variety of sides to choose from including sweet potatoes and zucchini fries which seem hard to come by in the STL area.  For apps I enjoy the toasted raviloi and chicken lollipops. Prices are reasonable for the quality and quantity of food you receive.
The decor is inviting and relaxing. It never gets too loud for intimate conversations. Usually the evenings are not as busy as bars up on Washington Ave. It'd make a great date night were you actually can carry a conversation with your table. The bar is fairly large and wraps around in a functional shape to provide a party of 4-6 to sit semi facing one another.
Has a great happy hour with discounts on house wine, tap beers, and apps (maybe even more?) The wine is average many tap beers are locally brewed

Recommendations to make it even better: open for lunch on Sundays and serve Victory Golden Monkey ale :)

MAKE YOUR WAY OVER THE TO ALUMNI AND TRY THEM OUT!

Great place for drinks and tapas! A hidden gem on the mesa, I've passed this restaurant plenty of times and never even glanced at it, so happy I did tonight. We hit the tail end of happy hour, the mojito and sangria were really good. The food was amazing! Definitely recommend the manchego and guava, eggs on toast, and the beef sliders. The pigs on a date were delish too, but I didn't like the honey getting all over my fingers. Will definitely visit again, the atmosphere is very intimate and the service was outstanding.

I really like this restaurant! I had the Grape leaves as the appetizer and Kufta Kebabs over rice as the main course.  The food was very flavorful and the food came out quickly.  The server was very helpful in deciding what to order.  I finished the meal off with a hot cup of Yemeni tea.  If you don't try this restaurant at least once you are doing yourself a disservice!

The food is really awesome. They have such delicious menu. Simply love it. One of my favourite place in Asia food. 

*Recently they seem to have changed the management and the customer service has become very very poor and even the quality of the food has changed compared to the pictures I had posted 9 months ago. So I am really disappointed over all with Han Dynasty*

Incredible staff and pizza. I've never been to a place (especially a pizza place) where everyone is so happy serve you! 

They have really fresh ingredients and a unique cauliflower crust that I thought was awesome and light. 

Make your own pizza - done right!!
Very refined place. The food was incredible and the service is even better. Great bartender! The french onion soup is amazing!

My go to Pho place when I'm in town for work. Tried 2 other places including 777 in downtown and another hole-in- the wall place that seemed to have been run by 20-somethings and Asian Noodles had a better beef broth Pho #1 and spring rolls. Prices a tad higher than 777 and egg rolls are a bit smaller but I think you get what you pay for. Quality over quantity. Atmosphere is small and clean but can be extended into the darker Hot Pot side that is adjoined to the Pho establishment.  Coffee has a hazelnut flavor, I would prefer the traditional Vietnamese coffee grounds. Otherwise, I crave Pho from this place when im in tiwn. Finally, a huge deciding factor was no MSG buzz like the other places.

Will definitely come back next time I'm in Reno!

Stopped by for lunch when we were walking in the neighborhood. What a great spot! Really friendly and accommodating owners and team, with a great offering of groceries and ingredients for a fairly small space. 

Most importantly, our sandwiches (Fig and Pig, Caprese with Prosciutto added) were delicious. Wish we lived in Fishtown so we could go more regularly--a lovely, tasty neighborhood spot.
Better than Acme :). Oysters are great! Try the oyster du jour if you are feeling adventurous- it is always delicious!
Clean, contemporary, and inviting.  Food is fresh and reasonably priced.  Service was good.

I was attending a conference at the Hyatt Hotel and was looking for a lunch option that wouldn't break the bank. I was happy to see signs directing me to this place! It is quite difficult to find, however, if you are coming from the Hyatt, because it is actually in the Entergy building, and the handy directional signs disappear at some point (at a fork in the road of all places). 

If you are fortunate enough to find it on the ground floor of the Entergy building near the main entrance, then you are going to find some surprisingly good Q. They offer sandwiches with a side, plates with two sides, and some specials as well, like smoked wings and loaded nachos and potatoes. 

I opted for a two meat plate with Brisket and Sausage and potato salad and bean for the sides. They had a bunch of other sides like Mac and cheese, coleslaw, collard greens, sweet potato casserole with marshmallows, and corn on the cob. The plates also come with a big jalapeño cornbread muffin, that was pretty good actually. 

I thought Brisket was quite good and was a good vehicle to try the four different sauces that were on the table. I'm still not sure which was my favorite, I wound up using them all at some point. The sausage was a little bit of a let down, as it was a tad bit on the dry side. Both sides were also pretty good. Add a drink, and it comes in around $15.

I've been coming to Pollo Rey for years, and it's always been delicious.  Mexican on my mom's side, PR reminds me of the food my grandma always made, very simple, fresh, and delish.  You won't find anything made out of Doritos here, no faux-mexican foods, just fresh, simple, satisfying fare.  

The carne asada burrito is my favorite.  Carne asada, pinto beans, and rice (I hold the salsa).  The chico (small) size is plenty, and the burritos come with a side of chips (there is a salsa bar with plenty of choices).  

One of my favorite things about Pollo Rey is the location.  Right on the corner of 8th and Idaho, the outdoor seating is a prime people watching location!  

Come with friends, hang out for a while, and enjoy the atmosphere of downtown Boise!

Just go elsewhere.  Booked a reservation for party of 5 weeks ago. The seated us at a booth for 4 with an add on seat in the isle. I tried to get them to move us and was told " We full up".  I was bumped and prodded all night. I do mean all night.  Waiter arrived quickly, drinks did not.  Screwed up appetizer order. Meal took 45 minutes and was marginal, at best.  Way overpriced for what's delivered. Will never return.
3 stars only because the iced Cuban is good. Way too expensive and my order has been lost on the last two trips in. It's not hard people.

I can't say enough good things! We walked in got seated right away and were graced with the presence of ZAC our waiter who was nothing sort of amazing. We told him we had a show and had to be out in 45 mins, he smiled and told us not to worry. He helped me with drink orders which I ended up loving. Recommend all the right food and to top it all off, everything was beyond delicious. We ordered 2 of the dumplings and beef satays! So good!! He also surprised me with an ice cream sparkler since he knew it was my birthday!  WE WILL BE BACK!!

Another year of Food Truck Fridays ends. There were some smoking hot Fridays this summer that made for some uncomfortable meals. But the final day was perfect and the big crowd had a lot of fun. 
The food trucks keep evolving, tweaking their menus and offering more interesting choices. I still haven't found a barbecue truck that hits the mark for me. 
I am thankful for all the work the Sauce people put in. I really appreciate the work the truck staffers do in those horribly hot trucks and the way they stay friendly and helpful is above and beyond in my book. 
See you all next year.

We are from the Bay Area and decided to eat here before going back home and it was the write choice! 
This place has awesome Chinese food! 
The service was pretty fast and the host was nice.
I recommend others to come. 
I loved their chowfun!

Little Saigon is a favorite restaurant of mine that I don't patronize often enough because I forget about it. The service is wonderful and the food is fantastic. I believe the menu is on the healthier side of the spectrum, so that's a bonus. I've had a few different items and have yet to be disappointed. 

My husband's usual order is a vermicelli dish with shrimp skewers and spring rolls; I like that dish and also enjoy the Ca Ri Ga, a yellow curry with chicken, potatoes and carrots. It has a deeper spiciness to it rather than chili spice. The chicken sate is tasty too.

The best thing about the food here is that it's cooked well -- neither overcooked or undercooked. 

P.S. Even my 4-year-old likes eating here, and that's saying a lot!

Wandering around the city looking  for Christmas gifts today, we bumped into the Foodery.....long ago and faraway (the 1980's)  this Foodery used to be the saddest little food store in Wash West. Filled with oily, dusty cans of who knows what and snack foods, it was only entered when desperate.  

BUT.............NOW............. it's a beer mecca!  Refrigerated case after refrigerated case of single beer bottles.  Some we knew: Rogue...DogfishHead...Sapporo..JOEs coffee ale..Pabst (who doesn't know Pabst?)  Some not:  Abita Christmas Ale...Old Ruffian Barleywine..even a couple of hard ciders.  

And there's more than just the single bottle...we saw beer magnums!  (Talk about a Christmas gift...hohoho.)

OK food, inflexible service.  Linguini was nicely cooked, red sauce was sweet rather than seasoned.  Manager refused a small, free appetizer coupon from my phone - he only wanted a paper copy.  Bad service decision to save him about $5.  Waitress was good.
Delicious fresh fruit salads for super cheap! The ladies who work there are very nice and accomodating. They also have smoothies at this location as well.

Just finished anothet great meal at Italian Affair. Had the best lamb chomps and mussels. My server was the kindest ladie that helped us with whatever i needed. The service was great like always and we met the owner for the 5th time and like always he was so nice to me. The night was very filling and wonderful.

B & C Market BBQ is one of my new favorite barbeque joints.  My husband loves this place and brought me here for lunch at the Farmer's Market.  I was a little reserved at first site considering it's ran like a cafeteria line.  I was thinking, "How good could it possibly be?"  

I ordered the pulled pork plate with the Mexican grits and macaroni and cheese.  I cleaned my plate.  That is very rare, especially when it comes to eating barbeque - something I rarely eat.  I couldn't believe how good it was.  The pork was so tender, I could easily pull it apart with my plastic fork.  The Mexican grits had a nice kick to them and the mac and cheese was baked like Grandma used to make.  Very good. I will be a returning customer to B & C. 

Tip:  B & C BBQ is one of the only eateries in the Farmer's Market that offer free refills on beverages.
Great takeout for Friday! and Saturday nights

thinking and analyzing, the food is good, but choosing MORENO food to take away or serving myself for such a high price, I prefer a restaurant with waiter service 1000 times, it's crazy the price, it's my opinion of my friends  and relatives, and the ethics problem of some employees is not acceptable and the client does not have to pay for mistakes, there are still many details and improvements

Crazy good! They started us off with complementary Turkish coffee. We had the kebbeh for appetizer and it was very good. For main course we ordered the fahsa and the mixed grill. Fahsa was sooo good, it was shredded tender lamb meat in a hot bowl. It reminded me of the Mexican dish barbacoa. All the meats were so flavorful and tender! I loved the condiments. They gave us bread, hummus, what I think was baba ghanoush, yogurt sauce, chili sauce,  picked onions, tomato, and pickles. I tried the adani tea with milk. Similar to chai tea but the spice blend is different. We were served by a very nice young lady and didn't lack anything. I will definitely be back!

This is one of my favorite places to dine at in New Orleans. We've been here multiple times over the years as visitors, and now as locals. We always enjoy great food and atmosphere. We especially love the "Chef's Selection" cheeseboard and their courtyard area. The only issue I've ever taken with Grapevine is their service. It's not consistent. Sometimes we have  fantastic wait service, sometimes it's just so-so. However, I highly recommend this place!

Great place!  The food was fresh and cooked perfectly.  Good coffee, and there is a bar!  I had a perfect build-your-own omelette.  Guest had 2 eggs, toast, crepe, french toast, and 3 meats for only $10!   Say what?  Fantastic.  Service was good, ambience was diner like and cute and spotless!  Definitely will return.

It wasn't my favorite - sorry!  I felt that the hummus lacked flavor, I prefer mine to have a little tang and not taste just like chickpeas.  The Isreali salad was exactly as it is - tomatoes, cucumber and onion....no other seasoning....again, bland.  I so wanted to like it - but it fell short for me.  I got the combo plate and the salad plate (hummus and isreali salad) and it all came with 1 piece of bread...it worked - but that is just because I didn't even come close to eating much - if it was better food, you would definitely need at least 3 pieces of bread.

Ground makes the most delicious burgers I've ever had! This is my go to burger spot. They also have great appetizers and salads. My husband goes crazy over the French fries and they are absolute perfection!

Decent cheeseburger, Amarillo Firecracker Burger and fries with great tv coverage for your sports viewing pleasure. Friendly and happy staff. Sat at a high top in the bar area. Nice pour on the rum and diet. Heinz ketchup and French's mustard if that matters.
Pretty dirty location compared to others. Very very chincy on the servings of meat and rice, I had to order double meat which should have been the regular amount. Won't be back here any time soon.

Vegetarian Review: Mike's is NOT to be missed by us non-carnivores! While Mike's is obviously known for the heaping mounds of bbq meats, served appropriately on those silver platters, their sides are soooo bangin'!!

The Gouda Mac & cheese is to die for. It has a slight smokey taste and is ultra creamy!! You will not regret getting a large tub of this to-go, because I guarantee you'll be craving this again later on! I actually plan on stopping in and grabbing some cartons for a side dish for Thanksgiving! I think my guests are going to flip!!

The cornbread is definitely one of the most delicious ever! It's a huge square for $3 and it can surely be split. It's super buttery and crisp around the edges with a hot soft middle. YUM!!! Although we took out, it still held it's own and didn't get soggy at all! 

Their homemade sauce selection is unreal! It's honestly really hard to choose a favorite, although their traditional comes close. Perfectly tangy, thick and smoked! Wow! They encourage lots of sampling and I say go for it, because it's so much fun! They even have little sauce containers for takeout! 

Hanks root beer In a bottle completed our veg-tastic takeout meal, although they are BYO and we plan on bringing back the whole fam for what we can imagine will be a fun, casual great night out! 

The place is small but homey and when I called ahead to see the wait, the guys couldn't have been nicer on the phone and then so sweet remembering me again when I arrived! It's such a South Philly style spot! And what else would you expect from Mike, who also owns Taproom on 19th on Ritner. 

I would give a 5 star for these few items but I'm not sure that's fair since I didn't taste the meat. I dunno. But definitely don't skip the sauce bar and sides! For me, worthy of a stop alone. 

*easy unmetered street parking and no wait 2pm on a Sat!

A great breakfast place in Brentwood Tennessee. Found this spot on Yelp and decided to try during a recent trip to Nashville. The menu for breakfast made for tough choices but I settled on the pancakes which were excellent. As you can see from the photo the coffee mugs are very cool looking and our server kept the coffee filled. Wish we were in the area for a few more days because I would've really enjoyed trying the different breakfast items and lunch sandwiches. Definitely a place that will stay on our go to list anytime we are near Brentwood.

After trying the scrumptious and satisfying Shack Stack over at the Madison Square location for the first time last summer, I knew I wanted to experience that bad boy again.  After a long arduous wait, the Philadelphia location has finally opened! It was a lovely late Sunday afternoon, and I was craving for some burger goodness. As I walked from Rittenhouse park over to 20th and Sansom, I noticed there was a line. A pretty long one. What was this? A line for Rumor? While we waited for about 30 minutes to place our order, there were several servers who were giving out free samples of the concrete, waters, and assisting with the menu. Nicely done, but I'm pretty sure I heard "Any questions about the menu?" more times than I needed to. I was asked yet again while I was waiting in the line inside.

Now, for the food. I wanted to try something different so I ordered the Smoke Shack burger (cheese, bacon, chopped up cherry red pepper, famous sauce), and I made it a double. (I was hungry!). And then, we waited some more. While my friends and I waited, I was jealous of those around me already sinking their teeth into their burgers, eating their fries, and indulging in their cold treats. Sigh. It was about another 10-15 minutes until I was able to satisfy my hunger. Was it worth the wait? You're darn right it was! Oh my, my, my. I was overjoyed with the perfect trifecta of beef, melty cheese, and crispy bacon. The pepper could be seen on my burger, but it was not hot at all.  My only regret was that I practically inhaled it, rather than savor it. The burger itself is small, compared to the other mighty burger next door, but it was still flavorful and kept my stomach pains at bay.

The place was clean and air-conditioned. Very welcoming coming from the hazy summer heat!

Thank you, Shake Shack! Will definitely return.
Fried oyster was pretty good. It is definitely one of the best seafood place in Nashville. You can expect coast standard seafood here. But it's a nice place to go if you have seafood cravings.
They have excellent wonton soup, and the freshest sushi in the area! I have gotten take out a few times and also dined in. Very nice people and great service.

Very solid and very interesting burger joint in Fishtown. They've got kobe beef and smashed onion, but I'd reccomend the regular sirloin cut. Got a beautiful burger from there a week or two ago, advacado, pepperjack cheese, chipotle sauce, onions. Shit was scrumptious! 

Sides sound delicious too, but I can't stray from the burger and fries when I go. Nice music, nice decor, crayons and shit for the kiddies. 

Only negative... a bit pricey. That burger above I spoke of, cheese fries, and a coke came to 16 bucks for one person. C'mon now.

Come here if you want your food with a huge dash of COVID-19. It is so sad because their food is good, but literally no one wears masks properly. They just sport the masks chin-diaper style with the mask pulled waaaaay below their faces exposing their nose and mouth. Go to Craft Fry instead much more precautions are taken and everything is better. Why go to a restaurant that doesn't value your health/safety? You are literally giving people money to make you sick....think about it.

Reluctantly, I agreed to meet Gig & Mommy here for lunch. I was so worried I wouldn't find anything to eat that was under 1000+ calories. Truly, their menu is way over healthy options BUT I was able to get a great Chicken Tortilla Soup @ 180cal and a Caesar Salad for 230cal. Happy Boy! My BOC was an unsweetened tea Arnold Palmer! We sat near the bar and the Bartender/server was polite, friendly, and impressed Gigi. She usually tells me to tip good or bad! Everything was good. Gigi loved her Three-Cheese Chicken Cavatappi! Thank goodness she only ate half of that 1280cal dish! 

Bottom line is I would go back for a soup and salad or their Lighter Fare which ranges from Thai Shrimp Salad @390cal to a 700cal Caprese Mozzarella Chicken. I've already decided to try their Cedar Grilled Lemon Chicken @580cal . So, Applebee's, you're trying and I appreciate that! See ya soon. ;-)

Super polite in the drive thru! Food was hit and fresh, I always order the same thing and it's a modified menu item. One of the best times I've received it.

Thanks for the hard work!

Goodness gracious the worst service! I went to this location and we were greeted and seated, then waited 15-20 minutes before we even saw our server. When she finally came it seemed like she was a bit annoyed, took our order. Once our food was brought out we were missing an order of wings, a pitcher of beer and another drink. It took another 10-15 minutes to notify someone of the missing items. It was just a horrible dinning experience, overall. Service was awful, I wanted to speak to someone to remove the auto 18% gratuity on our bill, but it took too long for the waitress to even come back to the table I gave up.
Riquísimo ! Buen servicio, buena higiene , súper rápido , un lugar tranquilo para compartir en familia . La comida súper rica y buenos precios . Adore !!!!

Being afflicted with a gluten intolerance I was less than excited to go to a place with pita in the title! I was definitely surprised by how easily my food needs were accommodated here. All the dips can be served with blue corn chips or cucumbers and there are plenty of fun salads. My server was attentive, patient and knowledgeable in regards to the menu. Best of all, happy hour is awesome. Definitely worth a visit even for us wacky gluten free people!

I just have to say that the food is incredibly delicious, my wife and I go there for the unique taste of the burgers (as well as the rest of the menu) also the people there are friendly. Highly recommend it! Oh and parking isn't an issue, there's a lot of parking space !
