Then I asked the waitress who took our order 5 minutes later and she just basically said "ughhhh I told the kitchen to put that on there." Then brought the topping in a bowl like 5 minutes later. And one more gripe- which honestly could be just all in my head but I just have to say it- The particular wine we were drinking Is one that we drink all the time at Nonna, at home, anywhere. I am 95% that the waitress was pouring another wine for us and saying it was the one we ordered.  Did not taste the same at all.

This is all to say that eating there now is just a really weird experience. At first I thought we were just sad that everyone that used to work there mysteriously all disappeared, but after tonight it is confirmed- Caffe Nonna is definitely going down hill. 

Caffe Nonna ownership, management, whatever, please fix our neighborhood gem before it's too late!!

This is our favorite burger and fries place that we found while living in STL over 4 months. It seems to be a hidden gem that we are so glad we found. The burger patties are locally sourced and thin in size. You may want to get more than one patty on your burger because of that. The melted cheese on top is what makes the whole burger so delicious in my opinion. Be sure to get the RIP fries for a STL specialty, and honey mustard lovers who like a little "kick", please do yourself a favor and get the creole honey mustard for dipping. Worth the $1 in my opinion.

Superb selection of hotdogs. Must try the Alligator hotdog, it was very soft. 


 We had the polish one and the alligator one and both were amazing.
Ordered through Grubhub - food was still hot when it arrived. Ordered the egg drop soup and crab rangoon - tasty!

Ugh, I really hate writing negative reviews, but unfortunately sometimes the experience just has to be told...

We spent a wonderful Sunday afternoon going to the library, followed by the Art Gallery of Alberta, and decided to top it off with dinner downtown. We settled on Lazia, a place we had been to a few times previously, because they have a nice, varied menu, and we've always had great food there.

I ordered the Spicy Chicken Sandwich, and my wife had a 6oz Filet Mignon, and we started it with the sweet potato fries. That was our second choice of a starter, as they were out of the bread we wanted. The food was delicious; my sandwich was a huge chicken breast, and though I didn't find it spicy at all, it was exactly what I was looking for. My wife's steak was cooked perfectly, and she devoured it.

So, if the food was so good, why such a low score? The service. Simply put, it was atrocious, and there's no excuse we could find for it. The place wasn't busy - there were maybe 8-10 tables, and 4-5 servers, so no one was overworked (some looked a little bored). The poor service started when my drink arrived, a Sprite. I took a sip of it and noticed not one, but two hairs in the drink. They weren't mine, and they were too short to be the server's; it was a bit gross, but I didn't make a big deal out of it. She apologized and brought me another one which was hair-less. My wife needed another minute before deciding on what to order; 10 minutes later, our server came back (keep in mind they weren't busy). Later in the meal my drink sat empty for 9 minutes (after we realized we were getting shafted in the service department I started timing things for the review) and I was given the knife for my wife's steak. When the bill came I was a bit surprised to see that I was charged for the pop that included the hair, but we were even more surprised to find my wife's 6oz steak was listed as an 8oz (I think it's $6-7 more).

When I get good service I enjoy leaving big tips; often 20%, sometimes 25% if it's outstanding, but I rarely leave less than 15%. She got $1 on a $60 bill. Yes, I felt bad leaving such a small tip, especially because my wife is in the service industry as well, but we had really, really poor service, and her tip reflected that. I hope she checks this review and reads why we gave such a small tip (I left a "You've Been Yelped card along with the bill) because I don't want her thinking that we were just cheap jerks. We had a great afternoon, and we hoped to have a great meal, and while the food was great, the service was horrible.

I order a simple ham and cheese breakfast sandwich. As simple as it gets. They tell me to wait 20 min. I think this is long for a task like this but ok. I get there and they haven't even touched it. Plus they get my order wrong and charge me for a more expensive sandwich. This isn't rocket science, people.

The Original Crabby Bills is now in Westchase.  It's the second day open and we just had dinner. The service was great and the vibe was light and fun.  We ordered the blackened grouper and it was fresh and amazing.  We had the calamari boat and it was one  of the best I've had in recent memory.  We can't wait to come back.

Worst pho place in sherwood park/edmonton. I ordered chicken vermicelli and seafood pho for the gf.
The chicken vermicelli had probably half a breast of chicken, if that, the pho had cold noodles which kept a bowl shape as if just taken out from the fridge. We had to ask for sprouts and sauces which you usually get as standard at every other pho restaurant.

Will not go again.

Decor is nice though, service was okay.

I attended Gentle Ben's on gameday (ASU vs. UA nonetheless) and like fellow diner Kristen S., had the worst possible restaurant experience of my life.  I used to serve tables so I was used to making sure that customers got the best experience possible and if the service or food was not up to par, they were compensated for it.

However, this certainly was not the case for my experience here. 

My drink did not come out until the meal (40 min after I ordered) and I was forced to chug it down in order to make gametime. Unfortunately, I should not have chugged it down because it turns out that due to the extremely slow service, I would not make it out of the restaurant until 6:15. Fifteen minutes after kickoff and about an 1:45 minutes after we were sat. (We ordered as soon as we were sat at 4:50).

The food that my table ordered did not come out the way it was supposed to and even the food that did come out ok was horrible tasting.  I spent 9 dollars for a dry hamburger on a week old bun. Absolutely not worth the money.

My table also spoke to management about the issues we were having and they did not seem to be in the least concerned that their customers were disatisfied. Never had I ever been to a restaurant that didn't put their customer's concerns first. 

If you are looking for a good experience on University, DO NOT GO TO GENTLE BENS. You will only receive mediocre food AT BEST.  I would highly recommend Frog n' Firken for a much more enjoyable meal as well as better customer service.

I didn't even realise this place exisited despite working ONE! BLOCK! AWAY! 

It's pretty overwhelming at lunch, there are loads of different counters to get your grub churned out cafeteria style.  I never know what I want and I feel like the Soup Nazi (or Sammish Nazi) will cut me off.  The place could use some clear "order here for ____" signs.  That would solve the confusion for me.

I've had a really good ceaser salad and also a fantastic NOMZ NOMZ NOMZ GET IN MY BELLY turkey club wrap.

If I have to eat a burger that isn't grilled by my dad, then Five Guys does the job.  Their fries are killer, their burgers are a tasty treat, and it's a cheap date overall.

Oddly, the thing I like best about Five Guys is that their staff is always genuinely friendly and cool.  I don't know what it is, but they seem to be pretty happy to work there.  I dig that.

We we're lucky enough to reserved a day prior to dining in. Awesome place to dine. Must visit when you're in New Orleans.  Oh .25cents martinis  say no more. Didn't fulfill my 3 drinks maximum, but 2 was tasty enough. Their quail dish was delicious. Pan roasted pork shoulder was juicy. The service was excellent and waiters was very knowledgeable. Awesome time, awesome experience.

Worst meal I have had in a long time. Initially, ignored by the two staff members having a big chat. I interrupted their conversation to get them to seat me. After 10-15 minutes of no attention, I got up and interrupted them again and they sent a young man to wait on us. He was very nice and responsive. Next, my drink was awful and I sent it back and drank water. My husband got potato salad with his meal and it had gone bad. His pulled pork was very mediocre. I had a salad and it was ok but they didn't have the dressing I ordered from the menu. We would never have eaten here but we were staying at the Holiday Inn where it's located. Yuck, stay away.

Foodies love to tell and write about the places they eat and the wonderful atmosphere and presentation some restaurants create. This place is foodie paradise! 
Start by sitting at the bar and talking to some of the best cocktail crafters south of the Mason-Dixon Line. They have a creative menu to order from but I always prefer to chat with Richard and let him know what I'm thinking and let him create. Never been let down yet taking that approach. Last night started with a small batch bourbon I've never heard of but comes from the Michter's family. Wonderful! There was three of us and we all got drinks to suit our tastes. 
Now to the food, the chicharrones are porky crispy with a rich decadent dip, great starter. Along with that, we were hungry, we got the bell- ringers, bacon wrapped stuffed dates. We were encouraged to keep sharing even the courses so we did! Next came the Pork cap, I'm not a huge pork eater but this has so much flavor with the Chinese 5 spice seasoning and the peanuts this was a home run. Then came the chicken breast, another item I normally avoid because I like the dark meat, yet this was another winner. The stew it was sitting on melded well with the nice roasted white meat. We finished with my favorite item, the grits and grunts. Get this if its your first time there. They are just perfect and shows off the best from chef. So come hungry and thirsty foodies, you won't be disappointed!

I should have tried the French Toast!!

Hubby and I couldn't decide between a nice breakfast out or a trip to the beach, so we decided to have breakfast ON the beach. A search on Yelp turned up Clear Sky and we headed over.

The restaurant is a pleasant, clean establishment with plenty of wait staff to keep you happy. Despite it being a weekend morning and quite busy, we were seated in less than 5 minutes and once we ordered, our food was brought out quickly. There is also a bar which served Bloody Marys and Mimosas, but we didn't sample those. 

I had seen the Yelp reviews that mentioned how good the French Toast is. It's made on Challah bread and comes in a variety of flavors. French Toast is my favorite breakfast food, but looking for something less sweet I went with the Beach Boy omelette. It was fine, but it wasn't the best I've ever had. It contained Home Fries, but they also put a side of Home Fries on my plate so it was potato overload. The ham was sliced deli meat, not chunks of ham like I expected. But what really sealed the omelette's fate was when the server delivered the French Toast to the table next to us. It looked so delicious and I knew that's what I'd order on our next visit. 

Hubby had Lox on an Everything bagel and raved about it. He said it tasted really healthy. I didn't try it, so you'll have to take his word for it. 

Great location, friendly staff and delicious-looking French Toast...I'll definitely be back!

Tldr: long wait to be expected with 4 people and no reservation on a busy Friday night. Fancy menu.  Starters: pork sausage, longfin squid, sweet potato, and beef chuck steak and sausage. Pasta dishes: Mafalde, Ditalini, Cavatappi, and Garganelli verde. Desserts: cheesecake, two orders of ice cream. Two of us had 1 drink apeice. $250. Worth every penny. 

My wife and I met some friends in Nashville for the weekend and we had heard some time ago about how good Rolf and Daughters was. We suggested it to them and because of its close proximity to downtown we decided to give it a go. Damn, were we not disappointed. We did have somewhat of a long wait, but we came in without reservations on a Friday night, so we were lucky to be seated at all.  The food erased all the thoughts of the wait. We decided to go family style and ordered 4 plates of food, along with 4 pastas. We started with the sourdough with seaweed butter as we deciphered the menu. We finally decided on the pork sausage, longfin squid, sweet potato, and the beef chuck steak and sausage. Every single dish was phenomenal. I was amazed at how good something as simple as a sweet potato could taste. The potato was a favorite of more than 1 in our group. The squid had just enough kick from the jalapeño to really set off the flavors. The pork sausage in essentially a corn tortilla was the dark horse of the starter plates. But, the steak and sausage was outstanding. The pasta dishes came out quickly and we went to town divvying up portions. They all were great in their own ways, but the overwhelming favorite was the garganelli verde pork ragout. On to desserts. My wife got a honey ice cream with graham cracker and I got the cheesecake with ice cream. Our friends split an order of the honey ice cream. The cheesecake was the low point of the night, but the ice cream it came with was yet again, astounding. The meal was a little pricier than I'm typically used to, but then again, it also tasted much better than I'm typically used to. I wouldn't hesitate to go here again.
Best Nee York style pizza in The Bay Area. Hands down. After moving back from nyc, I thought I'd never find good pizza again, until I met Big Roman's pizza pie...  I posted pics on google. So yummy.

We have been here a few times over the years. The food it pretty average. The prices are fairly average. Service tends to be above average. The hostess was very friendly. It may be just the times we are there ( usually Sunday brunch ) the clientele average age is around 70.  That may be why the food is not seasoned much and pretty basic. Nice location to go to the Mall either before or after. Or going to play lazer tag like we did. Did I use the word average enough?
Excellent food.  Absolutely encourage anyone to make it their regular spot. The food is incredibly tasty. Beans and rice are on point.

Ordered a few bagels from this place and I was told its going to be about 15 mins. Hour later I call to find out where my order is and the guy told me the boss thinks its too far for them and I was supposed to receive a call from them. 

Customer Service does not get WORSE than this.
Edit: Got a call back from this place explaining why this whole situation happened. Willing to give them another try

This is just a run-of-the-mill hipster brunch place with one exception: BONUTS.  The food here is good, so it's worth ordering and enjoying but the BONUTS are what set this place apart from other, similar brunch joints.

The line outside on a weekend can be incredibly daunting, but have no fear: it moves quicker than you think so you only end up waiting 20-30 minutes instead of over an hour (which is what I expected).  I have NO idea how the staff logistically run a place like this since there's always a line and always people eating, but there's some magic that they've discovered that allows for tables to miraculously come available when you're leaving the pay station to sit down.  

Order the bonuts.  In fact, get two orders just because you can.  Since they are donuts that use biscuit dough instead of sweet pastry dough, they are more amazing than any donut hole that has ever existed.  The marscapone cheese in the middle is a bit warm, a little melty, and super delicious as a compliment to that biscuit dough.  GET THEM.  

Other than the bonuts, the food was good and priced accurately for a place with this kind of cache.  Since you order and pay ahead of sitting and being served, if you've ordered an alcoholic beverage there's a 95% chance you can't get another one since there aren't really servers around to take orders - they are basically all busers, moving stuff around from the kitchen and back.  Keep that in mind if you plan on having more than one Bloody or Mimosa.

There's parking on the street and in a lot across the way but it's all pay so prepare yourself.  There's a couple of other bars/restaurants nearby in case the wait becomes to much for you to bear.  I'll come back here with my family, for sure, just for those bonuts.

Love this place. Expect a bit of a wait but worth it. We split a senior meal and it is more than we can eat. Best corned beef hash I have ever had and biscuits and hravy amazing. Go e here

Went back again yesterday and I swear it was even better than the last time.  Fiesta Hash is the best breakfast ever. Can't wait to go again.

Sorry to say I ate here this morning and it was tasteless. I had half a bacon and tomato and avo benedict.  The hollandaise had no flavor, english muffin not toasted, bacon way overcooked. Hash browns were crispy on one side and not cooked on the other.  Absolutely no flavor in this whole meal. I will come again because it is usually so good but....our server JJ did a great job.

This was by far the best experience I've had at an outback, we got our food so fast that we hardly had time to loosen our belts between all the devouring we were doing.  The food itself was pretty good, especially the desert, Chocolate thunder from down under.  I'm not a huge fan of brownies, but I have to say this was pretty great.  Plus, our waitress Jacqueline had an absolutely great personality and greatly helped out with our experience.  Pretty great experience, definitely coming back.

Absolutely love those gyro at Pita Jungle.

We been to Pita Jungle about 5 times and never had a problem like Holly H said. Food came fast and service was excellent.. every time.

Go happy and leave even happier...every time!  The kids are happy too.

Good job Pita Jungle, and now looking forward to try on the one at Oro Valley :)

Such a cute place. Been here 3x already and loved everything. Manchurian chicken.. delicious. Bbq steak sandwich.. heavenly. Butter and curry chicken dishes... amazing. Naan bread... fresh and yummy. Great service and nice staff. Definitely eat here! Takes a while for the food to come out but it's fresh and worth the wait.

Got the volcano chicken. The menu clearly states its stir fried with veggies. The chicken was DEEP FRIED
in a thick batter and a little greasy. It came with a large tub of very sweet brown sauce on the side with a small serving  of unseasoned steamed veggies on the side. I got  a carry out. Not what I was expecting. Sauce had good flavor but was extremely sweet. Tiny serving  of vegetables. No seasoning on chicken. Just bread which I pulled off. Thin chicken pieces. Quite the disappointment. I might give them another chance. My tip is question your waiter about exactly how your food is prepared. The menu is misleading.

More casual than Acme across the street but food was just as good. Stopped in for dinner when there was no line, but noticed a line outside every other time we passed by. Great casual place for fresh local seafood before a night on Bourbon. Nothing fancy but great.

I usually go to Chinatown for my dimsum fixes, but came here because of a recommendation. I was a little hesitant to go to a place called China Gourmet, thinking it would be something like a run down dirty corner store, but it actually is huge and bright! And because the foot traffic is so high, the food is freshly made. Now this is my favorite place to get shrimp chang fen.

 Expect a wait during peak times. We came early on a Saturday and we didn't have to wait but as we were leaving around 1230 the line was crazy long.

Fajita shrimp was really good and the margaritas wasn't that good but are ok they forgot to put salt and I forgot to ask them to put lol I was going to take a picture of the fajita but I was so hungry that i forgot sorry, is a ok bar

I had rancid tuna! It was not edible. I ate one bite and was sick all night & the next day. I told the waitress while I was still there that the tuna was rotten. She spoke to the manager. The manager told her to tell us that they couldn't do anything and I would need to call corporate.  The waitress said she would take it off the bill, but I told her not to. I just wanted the chef to be aware so they wouldn't serve it to anyone else. I can't believe the manager didn't come to the table to apologize. We were very nice to the waitress the entire time. She told us her manager cut her, which wasn't fair because the situation was not her fault. The night manager needs to learn how to treat customers when there is a problem & how to treat her employees fairly!!!
My friend and I will never go back again!

Love the sandwiches here!

It's not a fancy place, or a large place, but it's called Your Mother's for a reason, it's good basic fresh sandwiches like mom used to make when you can in for lunch.

I love the turkey breast, they use the real stuff not that weird pressed lunchmeat stuff. They also use fresh baked bread for the utliamate fresh tasting sammy.

Very reasonably priced and the salads are great too!

Definitely worth a try
Delicious and interesting food paired with knowledgeable and friendly service. That's always a win in my book.

Ordered through DoorDash, order came quickly but part of the order was wrong.  No big deal, chicken fingers instead of chicken sandwich, but the chicken fingers were dry and tough, the spinach pie was dry and seems like it was day old, the fries were ok, the only good part was the avacado spring rolls.  Probably should stick to pizza.

Words cannot express how much I crave all of the flavors and spices at Taj. Each meal I fall more in love with their food/staff/restaurant. The fluffy naan, chicken tikka masala, mhhmmm! My hubs is new to Indian cuisine and the staff always lead him down a different road of delish every time. The heat of their "hot" pretty mild but you can always ask they're honest about the level.

Amazing food, great service!  Just passing through town on Memorial Day and stopped here because my husband wanted baked beans. We ordered way too much food and everything was absolutely delicious. Never had such good bar food before. If we're ever back in Trenton, we will be stopping in to eat again!

I came here on a cold rainy day around 3pm. There were a decent amount of people enjoying a variety of Thai. A creature of habit, I chose the Tom Yum Goong which is the typical Tom Yum soup with shrimp. It was somewhat spicy, not as spicy as I would like but still decent and warmed me up. The shrimp were small and on the skimpy side as were the vegetables. The edamame were somewhat overcooked and they did not use sea salt so they were slightly too salty. 
The server was sort of snotty and seemed distracted. When asked for recommendations she replied, "it's pretty much all good." Okay. Plus she was sort of MIA once I got my soup. I needed to flag her down for my check. 
If I am in the area again I may try some of the other options as they have a broad menu and the price is decent.

Went with a few friends today for happy hour. We had a great waiter named Paul. We started with chips & salsa & guacamole everything tasted homemade.  We also got the nachos. They had bite size pieces of chicken.
The views for the property are amazing! 
I will be back for sure!

Just have to stop here whenever we pass through Tucson.  We usually order a variety of tacos....all have been so good.  Tried their Sonoran hot dog today.  It was our first so not sure how it compares to others, but it was delicious.  The fellow taking orders - could be the owner - is so friendly and jolly.  Always fun!

A purrfect concept for coffee and cat lovers!  Adorable locally owned cafe with a separate section that allows you to interact and play with friendly kitties from the Humane Society.  And all the cats are adoptable, which is a bonus.  My sister, her family, and I made reservations this past weekend to attend.  I have always owned cats but this was a great way for my niece and nephew to interact with them to see what type of cat their family will be best suited.  By the time we arrived in the afternoon the kitties were most likely worn out from playing with humans all day since a few were sleeping or just enjoying us from a distance.  It was nice to just sit and pet a lazy kitty while the kids played with the active ones.  Very friendly staff, good coffee, and yummy pastries.  Definitely a spot to visit if you're an animal lover!

This place was just ok. It was overpriced but I was ok with it if quality matched. Ordered a sweet crepe with strawberries and nutella - for an extra $4.50 for those toppings I expected at least fresh strawberries but they were these thin soggy slices that got mushy really quickly. On top of that, we just wanted some water to wash the sweetness down with ... 2 cups of iced water that I assumed was tap water .... Got charged $2 for "infused water" ... I didn't taste any infusion of anything and I certainly didn't buy a fancy bottle of water so that was total BS. The only positive was the nice staff. Will not be returning or recommending anybody here. Too bad the other crepe places aren't closer.
The fried shrimp was phenomenal! We also got the sampler and it was just ok. I had much better etouffee during my visit at other places.

Stopped in for dinner last night because we knew there wouldn't be a wait. The food was delicious but the service was excruciatingly slooooooow. The waitress was incapable of performing more than 1 task at a time. We sat so long before being able to order we thought that they had forgotten we had been seated. We had to ask for silverware and a napkin. We had to ask for drink refills. No one came back to check on us. We had to ask for a box for our leftovers. We eventually had to even ask for our check all while the waitress stood and chatted with her tables right next to us!  It was very uncomfortable. We then had to hand our bill and cash payment to a busser because the waitress was nowhere to be found...again. We left a 20% tip because that's what we do but I don't think I'll go back. Dinner took us close to an hour longer than it should have.
Terrible. Terrible staff. Low expectations for an ice cream place. 1 car in the drive thru, no one in the store. And over a 15 minute wait.
I has been there many times. I like the place and interior, food is very nice, I love terramisu there, they bake it there. OMG it so  delicious. But servers need to be more professional.

I went here just now, around 1pm on a Saturday. It was busy inside, so I placed a curbside order online and waited for my food in my car in the curbside spot. The time it was supposed to be ready came and went. I go inside, they're not busy at all. My order is sitting there waiting. The girl tells me, not even politely, that I need to call when I arrive. Not sure if this is customary or what. Why do I need to put in my car info if I need to also call when I arrive? The sign didn't say call. I think they were just being lazy. No receipt either. Food was meh. Pretty disappointing compared to my other stuff experiences at other McAlisters. Also, my salad had a huge chunk of chicken in it, not cut up. Which was difficult to try to cut up in a to go box in the car.

We joined friends there for dinner last week. The food was amazing and our service was top shelf including a visit from Mollie to explain the specials and take our dinner order. It's our new favorite restaurant in Santa Barbara!

Said they closed at 2:30, got there at 1:15, and she said they were too busy to sit us and we had already been standing for 15 minutes. I'm kind of upset I didn't get to eat here, but it is what it is. They had live music and seemed like they were running around a lot, you should get there early if you want to eat
They are a true family-run Mexican restuarant.  We have gone there for years, but we now usually do a to-go order, since our son doesn't eat Mexican food. I highly recommend them.

Goan shrimp curry
Faithful to you, never stray
Rice so flavorful

Order "spicy" if
You don't mind runny noses
Makes you feel alive

Two of our faves are a great restaurant meal and great live music ... but not in the same evening, for timing and comfort purposes!  So, since St. Elmo has been on our radar for a long time, we booked dinner here on an overnight stop en route to Rose Music Center (Dayton OH area).   A perfect plan!  
St. Elmo is the classic steak house of yore: warm atmosphere, great cuts of prime meat, traditional accompaniments, and excellent service.  
A large, rich meal calls for a light seafood tastebud alert, and our shared Shrimp Cocktail was just right.  Huge shrimp + zippy, well-horseradished sauce = great start.  The soup and baked potato were very good, but the meat is, justifiably, the main draw.  
I had my first bone-in filet, and hubster had the Cowboy ribeye.  Each was cooked to perfection and were juicy, flavorful, wonderful indulgences.  (I would have been just as happy without the bone, but some insist it gives the best flavor.)  
Did we save room for dessert?  Just barely, but YES because the menu listed a White Chocolate Blueberry Bread Pudding that had to be tried!  And though we groaned a bit afterward from so much of a good thing, it was probably the best bread pudding creation we've ever had.  (In truth, all the desserts sounded fab, and they could probably open a late-night dessert bar and do quite well.  After all, not everyone saves room to have it with dinner!)
So why not 5 stars?  Only because the menu has very little red wine by the glass and no half-bottles.  I don't drink, but hubster enjoys good wine with a good meal, and more selection for him would have put that 5th star in place.  
Bottom line:  a well-earned reputation, and life's too short not to splurge every once in a while!

I went to eat at Surreys uptown today and over all a decent experience. It was a small but cozy little spot with good food. I had the bananas foster French toast and it was really good! I loved the banana cream cheese filling in the middle which really brought out the banana and made it the star of the dish. I wish you can really taste more of a rum sauce because it tasted more like caramel than anything else, but it was still delicious. I had a side of grits and I loved them but couldn't figure out if they used garlic in them bc that was the only thing I wasn't too big of a fan of. The service was ok, they were friendly but it took a little bit to be greeted by our server once we sat and then we had to ask for our drink order. Other than that it was an overall decent experience for our table!
Food here is so bomb!! Ate here two days in a row, ordered something different each time and was not disappointed!!! So awesome!!

Yum! Tofu Banh Mi was delish. Vermichelli bowl was pretty good, but what really topped off everything was the coconut pudding. Oh man. Still thinking about it a week later. Reasonable price and the staff is super sweet. Only downside is the small space. 

Side note: their delivery (through Grubhub) is pretty solid too.

As far as BBQ goes this is pretty good. Large selection of meats and sides with big selection of draft beer. No frills just food. Large seating area so bring the family or the gang from work. Service is great and fast even when the lines are long. Give it try you won't be disappointed

Absolutely love this place. I'm from Austin, Texas where local juices are a big deal. Raw did not disappoint. I did their three day cleanse which was much needed after eating so much amazing New Orleans food. I can't express how friendly the staff was, they're great! Love love love.

I haven't written a review in a minute but I had to come back to write these guys a good review. I've never ordered the pizza but the pasta is delicious. I feel like this area is lacking in Pizza/hoagie places that also sells delicious pasta & this place fits the bill. The owners are really nice and they make the pasta fresh. Oh and the garlic bread is AMAZING. There are tables inside and some street parking surrounding the place. Oh and they also deliver. Try them out so they stay in business forever so I can always get my pasta fix.
Best pretzels in stl. Love all three locations. Got to try the cheese sauce; jalapeño is my favorite.

Had the shrimp and fish tacos, let me just say WOW!!!! So fresh and scrumptious. 

I definitely recommend this taco spot.

This was a great experience for newlyweds and couples who like the finer things. The ship menu was pretty good. The staff was very friendly, the cruise was fun and the third floor was mesmerizing. I enjoyed it to the fullest. I encourage you all to give it a shot if you're in Tampa

My son and I come here every week for sushi. He says "it is awesome and yummy!"  They have great prices for all you can eat for kids under 11 and if you don't like sushi they can accommodate as well. The service is usually pretty fast too! And surprisingly they have a pretty good wine list too!
This place is clean the servers are very polite and foods good what more could you ask for other than being here game night not in the stinky bar

So happy to have a different chain available in the area. The ham and cheese sliders are great-very filling and super cheap. The potato cakes are always a must! And If you like mozzarella sticks, I would recommend grabbing some of them here. They're always hot, gooey, and delicious. Not the average "frozen" mozzarella sticks in my opinion. And if you want a sweet treat, try the cherry turnovers. Always fresh and delicious!
Came in for dinner.  Nothing was very memorable... other than the GF being miserable for still unknown reasons!

Ok...so by the looks of my reviews,  it appears that I only eat breakfast, but what can I say...I find breakfast/brunch cathartic.

I have been driving, riding, and walking past the cafe for over two years now and for some reason have always forgotten to go there. Finally one morning I drove past it with a friend and yelled WAIIIIITTTTT! After a quick loop around the block we parked in the lot( yes a parking lot in the city...hooray!) and happily waited only about 5 minutes for a table. 

I was pleasantly surprised at the lack of a wait on a Saturday morning at 10am.

We were seated and promptly greeted by a super cute and friendly waitress with coffee in hand. What more can I ask for with my coffee than a cute girl in awesome boots? 

Their menu is small, but I appreciate that in a restaurant. To me, this means that they know what they are making and they do it damn good!

I had an omelet with avocado and swiss, yummy homefries( the big chunky kind), and probably the second best multi-grain bread in the city(aside from metro). The omelet was a great size and I only ate half. It was priced at 10 dollars which seems about right against comps. 

The bread is made fresh on premises, as are the pastries. I grabbed a banana muffin to go because they had been staring at me the whole time. It was one of the best muffins I have ever had. It was chock full of bananas that caramelized from baking and they were insanely cake like and indulgent.   

That thing about only having a 5 minute wait...yeah that quickly changed. As we were nearing the end of our meal the line was starting to go outside and was becoming a 30 minute wait. I have to say though, we were never rushed out. Even after we had received our check and the line was growing, we were offered more coffee. Although we declined in order to free up our table, the offer was really appriciated in this city. 

The one negative I will mention is that they don't have room for strollers inside and you are asked to leave them outside. There were a few angry parents who were forced to leave their 1000 orbit stroller outside. So word to the wise...grab your sling and strap the kids in.

So yeah, don't go to morning glory walk a few blocks east and head to this quaint and lovely cafe.

Eh..not too sure if I'll be back. I had never tried FatBurger until I moved up in the area recently, I've been here twice now and both times were mediocre at best. Service is just fine, and things are a bit slow because it seems like they cook to order which is just fine by me. But the burgers are just not up to par, ingredients just don't seem fresh. My bread was on the verge of being stale, veggies were not fresh, and it was just unimpressive all around.

Have never had a bad meal here! Their wings are great and they make a really good bushwacker. What puts them over the top was the fact that I had my engagement celebration here and they went above and beyond to make it an amazing experience. They brought out champagne and even made a sign congratulating us. It was a very thoughtful gesture by their management staff and it really meant a lot. Can't wait to have many meals here in the future!

Lovely old bar open to the sidewalk, waiters in long aprons and white shirts, a touch of old with classical music in the background which was a welcome break from the screaming jazz in many other places. Service was good and the lunch food hit the spot.

This place is 100% worth every penny. I get the chicken and cheddar with everything except onion and oil. The hot peppers are not too hot so that shouldn't scare you. They simply add a delicious twist to the sandwich. Also, the VooDoo chips are spicy and very good! I've never had Zaps chips before I went to Potbelly and I must say they're my favorite now!

Now we have seen/walked past this brunch spot but never thought to pop in until today - glad we did! When you walk in, you definitely pick up a 'mom and pops' ambiance and the staff is very friendly! Our server KeeKee, was very attentive and took great care of us! When we first arrived the host advised us due to staff shortage, the food wait was a bit longer - it honestly didn't feel like we waited more than 20 mins. Our food was pretty good - pancakes were perfect and the chicken sausage definitely has a unique taste! Can't wait to come back!

I came into Cafe Beignet Friday while on a business trip. Let me start by saying the customer service was great. I was helped by a girl named Jessica. She was very kind and the perfect example of Southern Hospitality. The girls working the counter handle the crowd very well by having the drinks prepared before we arrived to the register to order our food. I will recommend this restaurant to everyone I know who visits New Orleans. Thanks Cafe Beignet for making my first Beignet experience one to remember. BEST BEIGNETS AND SERVICE IN TOWN!

I'm down for a very nice authentic tasting gyros.  Say yee-row.  Kay?

I ordered without the onions and with cucumbers.  Oh yeah baby.  Good stuff.

$6 and the drink was free.  Beat that McDonalds.

Ok for a quick bite. Nothing special about the food.  A bit pricey for what you get. The anbiance is nice, with a large patio and seating area.  When it gets too hot they have ample indoor seating.  Seems to be a very popular place since the parking lot is always packed.  I personally didn't find the menu or the food to be that impressive.

Finally got here last Saturday night.

Atmosphere was nice.  Just making assumptions from the clientele, it must be a hit.  The age range was from 21 to 70.  parties of 2 - 6.  

I went on a date here and we ordered the Kale Salad and another app that was a special....but I cant recall exactly what it was.  Some sort of Calamari with rice patties.  Both were very very good.

For dinner we had the steak and a Sea Bass special....both excellent.  

Dessert the Chocolate Brownie Semifreddo .  Awesome.

Service was phenomenal server could not have been better.

Bill was just over $120 with tip.  Not too bad IMO.  Would definitely go back for the right occasion, however I am not a fan of that part of the city.....total douchers running around those blocks.
This place is totally unorganized and the food is less than amateur
A bit of a wait but totally worth it. I got the buttermilk Pancakes with bacon and pork sausage links.

Never coming back. Im not sure why I even stepped food in this place. You immediately feel like the place is mucky and when we were seated in a booth the sit caved in. That should of been a sign we should of left. But my husband and I stayed. The waiter was rude he gave us the water and threw the straws on the table. Food was gross. Left after 10 mins.

Great Sandwich spot in Reno. This place a gem, as a local deli and they have the most interesting fixings to go on your sub! 
I had the wagyu roasted meat sub and it was great! locally sourced bread, meats, and cheese! 
If you're in Reno, make sure you stop by this place and check them out!

Biscuit love is such a cute place. I just wish my boyfriend and I didn't go when it was so busy.... The wait was long but that chronic bacon made it worth the wait. The bonets were okay, I was anticipating them to be hot and when they got to the table they were about room temperature, so eh. Maybe if we came earlier we would have had a better experience, but all in all it was a cool little breakfast.

Like everyone says, the alligator cheesecake was amazing. I also fell madly in love with the quail and the shrimp etouffee. I did not enjoy the red fish, which was recommended by the waiter, at all. The flavor was on point but the texture was similar to mashed potatoes and I just couldn't get past that. Fun time. Visitors to New Orleans should not miss this place.
Great little spot for lunch. I've eaten here twice and both experiences have been excellent. Service is fast and friendly and the food is delicious. Go on Tuesdays for $5.99 lunch fajitas!

It's taken me a while to decide what to rate Another Broken Egg

I've gone several times and love it but I wish that my choices weren't limited to a "quinoa power bowl"

Don't get me wrong the bowl is amazing and always fresh and appealing to the eye , I just wish for a couple more dishes to discover here; as they have so many choices for someone who isn't vegan. 

That's why I have finally decided upon the 4 stars instead of 5

That being said, the restaurant is always bustling and the staff is very friendly. Everyone in the party always enjoys the food the get. All in all a relatively inexpensive brunch place

Sorrows for those with early flights departing from gates 78-84 in terminal F: $3.50 for a plain croissant...$4.25 if you want the chocolate kind - and that's pre-tax. I understand these are airport prices, but I felt like I was being charged even more than Starbucks, which was shocking. Granted, pastries are "locally sourced" from the Tampa patisserie "Piquant", but still. Shouldn't they be cheaper since they don't have to import them from another place? My cranky early-morning-flight-self talking...

Line was long, too. Seemed to be going a bit slow. At least customer service was friendly in my experience, I can say that.

Most importantly, what happened to their world-famous coffee? Like other customers, I felt like it was watered-down and not as smooth and strong like this usually-sultry Italian tastes elsewhere. Disappointing latte for around $3.90 after tax. Ouch.

All in all, I rather spend much less for my coffee and have it from Dunkin Donuts where I expect quality to be just a bit above average instead of being overcharged for a brand name that seems to be going downhill. So, so sad coming from Illy..

These tacos are the best. This is a great restaurant where you can pick multiple different tacos to really try everything. The flavors are delicious and come through well together. The guacamole is also quite nice. Actual establishment is very rustic and pleasing to the eye. Service was great.

We are so glad to have this place in Kenner! Perfect spot for a quick, delicious bite to eat. The chicken shawarma is fantastic, the shawarma bowl is great, and the Philly cheesesteak is phenomenal. We took our family who was in town for the holidays and the owner was so welcoming and kind. He took great care of us and even gave us free sweet treats as we walked out the door! We love this place and will keep coming back.
My niece had a shower at The Gables at Chadds Ford and the food and the service were excellent.  The ambiance was also wonderful.  I cant wait to go back.

I give 4 stars for the food..But the experience I had with the service gets one star..if that..

We arrived during a weeknight, we got there at exactly, 8:35 p.m...I sent a text to one of my sons that we had just arrived..We sat on the far right, behind the wall..The waitress "M"..I wont mention her full name, but I wrote it down..offered to take our drink order after no one came for more than 15 minutes..my son got up and asked the bartender to please send someone to us..

We got our drinks and before we had a chance to say " we know what we want" she scooted out of there..by the way, the place was EMPTY..waited and waited again..we just wanted to order anything from the table menu..the heck with waiting for the larger menu..

Finally my son gets up again, and asks the bartender( who couldn't be arsed) if we could get "M" back..

She came over with a look in her face like she was to bothered by us..we ordered the chicken wings for my son and the Cuban sandwich for me..IT TOOK TILL 9:55 to get our food! They were sweeping around us, cleaning around us..and we just couldn't believe that this so called quick meal and service had taken over one and a half hour..

Threw the tab at us, and I still left her a 20 percent tip...not my usual 100 percent like I am known in my neck of the woods to do..

"M", you're in the wrong business if you think waiting on a woman with her son, won't tip..I paid my way through college and grad school with tips...and I was dang good at my job...and my son is an owner of a local restaurant..

Love the ice cream but the service (or lack thereof) is horrible. My husband and I walked up to the window to order. There was no one in line and only one car in the drive thru. There were three employees inside. One was helping the drive thru customer and the other two were watching something on their phone. They saw us and completely ignored us. We waited for over 10 minutes being completely ignored so we left. Very disappointing.
Turn down the lighting....create  a atmosphere. ..Hello.....who wants to go to a super store to unwind.....

This is my favorite by far I took my wife out for the evening she had the filet mignon steak with side veggies and I had the broiled seafood platter and wow we had a great time are waiter was awesome we will be going back soon best in south jersey
Love this place! Cute, relaxed, hip atmosphere. Food is well prepared. I got the veggie quesadilla and absolutely loved it. Everything seemed so fresh. The staff is very kind.

I am giving 5 stars simply because of the impeccable service I was given by one of the busboys (who I at first assumed was the waiter). He was charming and funny and made sure we had everything we needed. He told us that his name was Nick and I hope he gets the recognition he deserves because he certainly made out dining experience and amazing one. Absolutely coming back. Thanks Nick!

I really wanted to like this place after reading all the great reviews, BUT, first of all, we seriously waited for our food for 40 minutes, then our order wasn't even right (got a smores toast instead of a fruit & cheese), and they forgot our drinks (had to ask twice for my coconut milk, which I didn't even get until we were about to leave).  We also never received one of our two sides, and the one we did get didn't even come until we were almost done with out food. During all of this there was a lady behind the counter (maybe the owner?) yelling at the other two employees...can't imagine why.  I will say that two of the toasts we did get were good, the others were just ok.  Basically this place was total chaos, so cramped, no seating, terrible service, long waits, incorrect and missing orders. In a nutshell, I won't be back. If you do plan on going maybe try a weekday when it's not so hectic?  I dunno.
Food and service are great. My only complaint is the lack of cleanliness of the hallway where food is stored. If you walk back through the hallway to the restroom, you'll see some issues.

The drive thru light was on and it was before closing hours and they had the lights on the menu turned off by were talking to someone in the drive thru for at least 5 minutes without even acknowledging anyone else had pulled into their drive thru. Ended up pulling out and taking business elsewhere . Go Burger King!

Noord was a ton of fun for an impromptu date night. The ambiance was cozy and romantic. The service was good. The food was good as well.

For the appetizer we got a liver moose that came with savory donuts, pickled onions and pickled eggs. It was beyond delicious. They also served house made bread with sweet potato butter. It was unique and delicious. The appetizer was definitely my favorite part of the meal.  

For the entree I had haddock with creme fraiche, corn and crab meat. It was tasty but lacked color. I also felt that there was too much creme fraiche and not enough variety of textures. My boyfriend had one of their seafood stews which was very good seafood with a nice smokey flavor. 

For dessert, we ordered a bread pudding and some chocolate to go with out dessert wine. The dessert was tasty but just wasn't very unique. 

Overall, Noord was a great experience, a great place to check out for date night!

I really enjoy Topgolf and would go a lot more if it weren't so dang expensive haha! Our server was exceptional, our drinks and food were absolutely spot on! We played for about 3 hours and everyone was very kind. The only thing I will say is that they do try pushing you out if you're not actively golfing because they have a LONG wait time. We almost always have a 3 hour wait to get in a bay. With covid they are limiting 6 people per bag so keep that in mind when going with a party! We are so excited for when they have music on the top floor, it's the best level if you go!

We ordered food via grub hub. Fish was spoiled. That's a problem when poke is what you serve. It's dangerous and unacceptable. Driver arrived and gave us 1 of our 2 items. We had to stop him from leaving and he simply said "this is all that they gave me sorry". In other words, he didn't double check nor did they. Grub Hub would not immediately refund us without contacting the restaurant first and then put us on hold for 30 minutes. Poke Zone is terrible, don't go there in person or order from them unless you want food poisoning. Grub Hub has also taken a huge turn for the worse - seems like they are always fighting to not refund your money. So sad this was our favorite restaurant too. Oh well, not doing that again. I'm going to go be sick now. Thumbs down for both of you. I'm copying and pasting this review to yelp as well. Shameful.

We got takeout from Akar for take away on our anniversary, and it was amazing. My husband actually said "if this is how it tastes at home I can't imagine when you sit down in the restaurant." We will definitely come visit in person once the shelter in place is over.

I was thrilled to find this place is not too far from my companies new office. The Italian Beef was great, and so were the potatoes that I got for a side. I can wait to be back to try some of the other things they have on the menu, looking forward to making this a regular stop!

I'm not sure why they have call ahead when they don't start making your order until you check in.  I thought the mac and cheese was very peppery for my taste.  I loved the brisket sandwich with the sweet bbq sauce.  I also tried the tangy sauce which was too harsh for me.  The ribs were just okay.  I'll only go back if its someones else's turn to pick the restaurant.
Bazbeaux is one of my favorite pizza places in Indy. They have some great pizzas--you really can't go wrong with any of them. I also really like the Rocket Salad as an appetizer.
Great burgers. Really flavorful. The fries are really crispy which were amazing !! I got the Pina colada and i liked it, it was sweet, and we'll put together!

I come to Archies all the time and every time I come Emily is my server. She is the best! So personable and kind, and I always enjoy having her. Thank you for being so great!! Food is great also:) my go to place!

This is a solid reliable taco and steak place which also has Sonoran style hot dogs. They have a nice fixings bar with all the guacamole you like salsas excetera. I find the quality is good the meats are well done and chopped properly. The tortillas are a fairly good quality not the best but good and they have states which are good but for the money. It's a bustling place about medium in price but I have always found them to be very reliable and very consistent.

I would rather refer to the food prepared at Sushi Koi as art on a plate. The location is great in the CWE, the atmosphere is simple and friendly, the service and knowledge of the staff is great, but the range of food offerings and the presentation are unsurpassed. Must eat there!! Often!!

I don't mind waiting in a longer line so Jerry is my Sales Clerk (cashier). I only shop at this Publix because of Jerry. If he's working, I only go through his line. I shop there about 3 times a week. Jerry honestly warms my heart every time I go through his line. He has the best attitude and is so friendly. That is so hard to find now a days in customer service. Thanks!

This was a great restaurant. We went on a Sunday and were able to do the jazz brunch. We had reservations and were seated after a brief wait (just enough time to order mimosas). The mimosas were amazing! The brunch was delicious! Our waiter was nice and attentive. No long lines at the buffet. Everything was great. Would definitely recommend. Great 21st birthday brunch.

Last night I was looking for a place to grab dinner after work when I came across Pho House, a Vietnamese restaurant, on Google Maps. Unfortunately many restaurants in the neighborhood close early (around 5 PM or earlier), so it can be hard to find a place to eat supper. Thankfully this restaurant is open until 7 PM from Monday to Saturday, which is perfect for my schedule. Conveniently located in the Cooper-Grant neighborhood of Camden, it's a quick walk from Rutgers University-Camden and all the businesses near the waterfront. 

Living with dietary restrictions, I was a bit worried about finding something that I could eat. I was pleasantly surprised to find that the restaurant is vegan friendly and has all vegetarian options clearly marked on their menu, including pho with vegetables and tofu and summer rolls. The staff was very helpful and explained to me all the ingredients and potential allergens in the various dishes. After careful contemplation, I ended up ordering the Vegetable Vermicelli, Vegetable Summer Rolls, and Vietnamese Iced Black Coffee. Everything was delicious!

The summer rolls were packed with tofu and an assortment of veggies like cabbage and shredded carrot in a glass noodle wrap. Included was peanut sauce to dip them in, which gave it a ton of flavor. But my favorite part of the meal was the vermicelli, which featured noodles, stir fry vegetables, and spring rolls filled with tofu. I loved the variety of texture as well as the savory flavor.  After my meal, the Vietnamese Iced Coffee was the perfect dessert. It was strong but also had a smooth taste.  I'm not sure how I lived my whole life without ever trying Vietnamese food! 

Not only was my meal delicious, but the atmosphere was lovely. They do both dine-in and take-out, but I decided to dine-in. Pho House was clean, cozy, and quiet. The staff was extremely polite and I didn't have to wait long for my meal either. The prices were very reasonable (around $15 for my entire meal) considering the portions were large. Seating is quite limited in the restaurant, so I would suggest not bringing a large group there at peak hours (i.e. during lunch time) without calling ahead. I will definitely be back again to try out the rest of the vegetarian menu, especially the pho. It felt great supporting a local business, and reaffirmed the fact that Camden has a wonderful, diverse dining scene! 

-Sarah F.

Food (sushi) was excellent and the prices were great. The staff was very friendly and the food came out quickly. My husband got the spicy tune roll and it was spicier than any other spicy tuna roll I've had.
Friendly, prompt service! This is real Thai, nice and spicy! The Pad Thai is my favourite! Great location downtown with street parking.

Horrible service, horrible management, and horrible dishes. 2nd time I have been to this particular restaurant. Decided to give it a second chance. Big mistake! The wait was just bad. I understand it's not management fault the wait is long but try to understand and accommodate us cause we actually decided to stay and buy your tasteless bland food. Took 2 hours for us to be seated and 1 hour for our food to arrive. On top of that, 4/6 of our orders were wrong so they decided to add some sauce on the side to replace the error. Which was salt/barbecue sauce in a cup. At this point, we just wanted to leave but the Manager Rick gave us a free side order of crab legs for the inconvenience. Again, we decided to just stay. We just wanted to hurry up and leave. As the waitress was taking our half eaten dishes, she spilled that nasty salty barbecue sauce on my friends $800 jacket. When we confronted her, she acted surprised. She disappeared into the kitchen with the jacket. When she brought it back, it reek of dish detergent and barbecue sauce. Manager Dick (Rick) gave us a business card for dry cleaning service and sent us on our way. Expecting us to pay full price for half ass service. We refused to pay the bill resulting in a swarm of police vehicles in the parking lot preventing us from leaving. The police was really cool about the situation and even called the place "Joe's Crab Trap". Long story short, the bill was reduced to half. I believe justice was served with the half ass service that was provided. Never will I ever give another restaurant a second chance. It's one and done.

1. Wanted chopped steak, they stated they sold out a few hours ago.

2. Mac and cheese was decent nothing to brag about.

3.  Ordered linguine and couldn't eat it all so I asked for some of the sauce to go and I was told no. For a $40.00 plate I cannot get sauce to go? Oh ok.

4.  Our meal was over $200.00 for 3 people.  I'm not going to take anything away from them the food was good but for the price I think they could of been a little more accommodating.

5.  Get dessert!

I have been to this place three times. I knew I loved their beer--though I like their pale ale more than their very popular IPA; but I have grown to really love the restaurant too. The menu is Salmon heavy (which my daughter loves!) but for a brewery, it has a nice diverse menu. The last time I went, I brought my wife and my mother. We all left happy!
They catered my dads 70th birthday and it was amazing, from the food to the ambiance it is highly recommended!
Super savory, filling, and cheap breakfast fare. The CBB hit the spot for the cheese lover in me. Great place if you want just simple, fast, hearty grub for a good price.

I've been here several times and I guess I've always assumed that I've reviewed it already.  This is a really cool little coffee shop/cafe and the food is above excellent.  The staff are all very friendly and helpful and quick to offer up suggestions.
 There is a patio out back that nice and quite.
The decor is very artsy and hipster and there is a lot of seating for everyone.  I try not to come on Sundays since it can get rather crowded but after lunch it dies down and I can just chill out on the couch and get some work done.
Great food and service, and there a nice crowd as well. a little pricey for the bar atmosphere but it's always a pleasant experience. Great chicken parm and wings too

We ordered to go, the skinnylicious tacos lacked flavor and the sides, we also ordered our cheesecake slices without whip cream, instead they were slathered with melted whip cream. We were also disappointed in the Oreo explosion cheesecake, it was rich in chocolate but had 3/4 broken bits of Oreo toward the crust. Usually the food is filling and delicious sadly this time I ended up throwing away my food
Great spot for breakfast or lunch. Greek skillet is amazing. They do have vegetarian options. Staff is always friendly come here at least once a week.
The newly re opened Seahorse in Pass-a-grille remains superb / the staff are super friendly and the food comes out fast, hot and delicious. Bravissimo! Cute south Florida decor is wonderful,

Went here on a busy Saturday for lunch. Line was long, about at 20 minute wait but it was SO WORTH IT. You must must must try the fresh tortillas and can't go wrong with any of the specials. The chile rellano was the best I've ever had. Also despite the line, there was ample seating and service was quick considering it was all made to order. Just make sure to bring cash!

I wish I could give 6 stars instead of 5. The cocktails are phenomenal (especially the Wall-Dorf) and the tuna tartare is out of this world. My friend and I split 2 of the "small" portions and 1 "large" (salmon) and it was plenty of food. Everything was delicious, the service was friendly and welcoming, and the atmosphere is hip and unique. Highly recommend to anyone in Indy!

Stopped in for a quick bite and drinks before the symphony.

Honestly, our server was great, and the pretzel we had was awesome as well. That being said, though the drinks weren't bad, they were a little pricey for the amount of alcohol content.

The main reason I'm not giving this 4 stars at least is because of the salad.  I payed 12 bucks for probably one of the worst salads I have ever had.  It was a Caesar with all sorts of leaf on it, and though it felt super fresh, the leaves were whole, not cut up at all and it felt like a Brontosaurus trying to eat it.  Cutting it up was about as easy and eating it.  Dressing was light, but they put real anchovies on it, where most places have this blended into the dressing.  Raw anchovies are not exactly the best taste to experience when you don't have other strong flavors to balance it out.  Once bite of one and I literally had to put the rest aside.  Just a word to the chef or whoever curates the menu, it just takes one bad item to ruin an eating experience and that one about did it.  Luckily the pretzel came out second.

Probably wouldn't go back, nothing to write home about.

Excellent service and great food! Our waiter Jeff was really attentive and helpful! We had one 100 days dry aged cowboy steak and half a lobster tail for 2 people to share and it was more than enough. Steak was cooked to perfection and their truffle fries were amazing, I don't think I could go back to normal fries anymore. Wine selection a was extensive and their drinks were all creative. Really enjoyed the food, the atmosphere and the service. All in all, money well spent. Definitely coming here again.

I don't know anything about Salvadoran food but this is a good place to eat. The Mexican asada tacos were about the best I've ever had outside of Mexico. Fair price, good and plentiful servings. Brought home a menu to look up some things that I've never had.  I'll be back.

A pleasant dining experience after a wet day at Jazz Fest. Our server, William, was friendly and prompt. There were two of us. Ordered drinks that came out promptly. Brought nice hot bread and olive oil. We ordered two appetizers - caprese salad and their crispy shrimp. Both were nice sized portions. The shrimp (about a dozen) was delicious. Shared the scallops and angel hair pasta dish. They divided it into two plates very nicely. We shared a creme brûlée dessert. All was tasty, reasonably priced and the service was good. I will return.

The wings are awesome! Make sure to ask for them extra wet because there is never a good amount of sauce on them. I've tried various other items on the menu-- burgers, wraps, sandwiches....nothing special, just stick to the wings! The street tacos are delicious as well. Service is always good. Never disappointed with BWW!

This bar was right down the street from my hotel. Thought I'd give it a try since it was a more popular bar. Got right in sat down. Not a lot of good beers on tap. I feel like I get spoiled traveling the country, so I get to try A LOT of different beers from around the country, but being as this was a bigger sports bar I thought there would be more options. Also the food was typical bar food, which is good, I tried more of the local dishes, gator tail and some kind of duck dish. Those were pretty good. The best part about this particular bar was the amount of TVs. Lots and lots of tvs, projector screens. Every game, every channel. Bartenders were cute too ;)

If you want some delicious tacos, this is your spot! I am always on the hunt for the best taco joint and I finally found it in Clearwater. The Oink Oink baby tacos (pulled pork) and loaded waffle fries were a huge hit within my party. We likes how the restaurant was low key in a sense you place your order inside and then they bring the food to you. No dealing with a server all night or waiting on the check. Can't wait to come back and try more!
Unbelievable service!  Jon went above and beyond.  As a bartender myself I tend to be a little difficult when it comes to my expectations!  He delivered!!!

Very impressed with the Italian beef here!!! In my opinion, it is way better than Portillo's. Luke was very kind & helpful being that it was our first time there. I highly recommended going here if you are looking for an amazing Italian beef sandwich. I will definitely be back, and bringing family and friends too!!!
Usually five stars for dickies but their smoker was broken so they were out of pork and brisket not their fault the price is great get your free ice cream awesome

I was pleasantly surprised by The Eagle's Nest Tavern.  I had feared it would be a smokey dive bar, but it is nothing of the sort.  They have a country vibe without being cheesy and have some fun local news stories.  There are plenty of tv's for games.  We were given complimentary cornbread and jam when we sat down.  We were told the jam is all local.  On draft they have a few local crafts.  They have domestics in bottles.  I ordered the hot chicken and Brussels sprouts.  The chicken was very tender.  The heat level descriptions are very cautions.  I ordered a 7/10 and it was probably a 5/10, so don't fear going that hot if you aren't good with spice.  I'll definitely return.

Not knowing what kind of restaurant this was from the outside,  no menu on the outside to preview, my 10 yr old daughter and I decided to be adventurous one Sunday after church...switching it up from our usual chain lunch of the typical chain like Panera's or Chili's. It turns out the menu was solely brunch and no kid's menu. We decided on the Quiche Lorraine and pancakes.  Both were good enough.  My daughter was most impressed with the fruit compote butter.  It was delicious. On the higher end of price points but, portions were a good size. Won't likely return for brunch but,  may try for another time. The menu looked interesting.

Yum yum yum! Excellent food and the service was great too! Ordered orange chicken with white meat and I throw in veggies. The egg rolls were really good too. Just moved to the area and I will be back! Good to know they also deliver!

GNO on the coldest night of the year.  Beware: there is absolutely NO protection from the elements when sitting st the bar.   We were literally shivering the whole time we were there. Mental note: either don't go in the winter or get seated in the far back of the dining room.  (Management needs to look into adding some sort of curtain or vestibule at the entry)
 

First off,  I was disappointed that a "whiskey house" was out of my favorite whiskey, Basil Hayden. I tried Rebel Yell - it's ok, but not one I have to have again. 

Secondly, the food was great (we had some shareables: Brussels sprouts, potato wedges and bread plate) but the service was a bit slow. That was surprising since you could count the number of people at the bar on one hand.   Side note: A guy next to us had THE most delicious looking steak which I must try on my next visit. He could almost cut it with his fork. 

We'll definitely go back, but probably not til spring.

I've been here twice already and the food is excellent. Honestly, one of the best Mexican food places in town. I ordered a torta, a burrito, and an horchata and they were all very enjoyable. The fact that they use premium white meat chicken is great. The only reason I will take one star away is because of the location itself. There is hardly any parking - only about six spots in total and the interior is very small. A lot of people come inside and it is difficult to wait for your food without bumping into someone else, however those are minor setbacks. I will come again for sure in the future but make sure to call ahead.

I'm a bit of a Cantonese bbq snob, and one of my favorite dishes is soy sauce chicken with pork bbq and roast duck. This place absolutely hits the spot. 

The chicken is moist and the roast duck is juicy. It's very very authentic Cantonese bbq. The prices are also super reasonable.

This is a gem of a place to go in downtown Indianapolis if you are looking. For a romantic evening with your significant other! I spent the lovely night with my man who set up a reservation for just at sunset! As the sun was lowering we enjoyed a chocolate cocktail (that was to die for) and a garden salad! For dinner we had the chicken and duck! The half chicken was so good and the duck was also really good but I wish it had been more well done. The best part was the restaurant rotated in a circle so you could enjoy dinner with a full view of the city of Indianapolis. Had a lovely time and would definitely go back!

The servers work in sync and are very nice, the food is always delicious. The Honey drink and honey chips are superb, this is my second time getting the chicken tibs and we got the sample for two people, we killed it . thank you ladies for the nice ambiance.

We've been here a few times now and two for birthday parties with large parties.
They are very accommodating and attentive.
The food is always fantastic... today one of the specials was pumpkin arancini and though the center was not melted the flavor and outside crunch couldn't be beat. We've ordered specials and favorites and sandwiches... Everything is great.  The beer is on point and The mixed drink selection is always good.  Keep up the good work!  Looking for a nice casual funspot... You should not miss Iron Hill!
